16498.name: Annie Leonhart
16498.desc: __Height__: 153 cm (5") A member of the 104th Southern Division in the Cadet Corps. After graduating from the 104th, ranked 4th place in the top 10, she ends up joining the Military Police. She is roommates with [Hitch Dreyse](https://anilist.co/character/86017). A stoic girl, Annie is considered to be an isolated, solitary type, being rarely seen smiling or socializing and often having an emotionless expression. She is apathetic and somnolent, with little desire to put in any effort into meaningless disciplines or activities. Nonetheless, what drives Annie more than anything is her desire for a normal life.

16498.name: Hannes
16498.desc: A soldier who saves Eren and Mikasa during the prologue. He owes a debt to the Yeager family.

16498.name: Armin Arlert
16498.original: アルミン・アルレルト
16498.desc: __Height:__ 163 cm (5'4") __Position:__ 104th Trainees Squad, Survey Corps __Relatives:__ [Grandfather](https://anilist.co/character/84313/Armin-no-Ojiisan) Armin is a young boy who was born and raised in the Shiganshina District within the walls, being childhood friends with both [Eren Yeager](https://anilist.co/character/40882/Eren-Yeager) and [Mikasa Ackerman](https://anilist.co/character/40881). After Wall Maria was breached, he chose to join Mikasa and Eren in joining the military, both to try to make a good and meaningful impact on the world, and to fulfill his dream of seeing the outside world. Even when he was young, the naturally curious Armin has always had a deep fascination with the world beyond the Walls. As a child, he found and studied an illegal book about the outside world that was owned by his grandfather. He often shared the book and information contained in it with Eren Yeager, his best friend, and his dreams of seeing the world outside the walls. Armin was branded a heretic by other children for his unusual interest in the outside world and was thus frequently picked on. Too timid to defend himself, Armin would often rely on his friends Eren and Mikasa Ackerman to protect him from local bullies. This, coupled with his frail physique, was a deep shame for Armin, leading him to have poor self-esteem and to believe that he is a burden to others. Because of this, Armin has always been very eager to prove his worth, especially towards his close friends. Armin

16498.name: Erwin Smith
16498.desc: **Height:** 188 cm **Position:** 13th Commander, Survey Corps Discerning, intelligent, and widely respected, Erwin is the unshakable and calculated 13th commander of the Survey Corps. While he cares deeply for his men, he does not hesitate to sacrifice them for the good and prosperity of mankind, and his men have proven more than willing to stake their lives at his order. Erwin developed the Long-Distance Enemy Scouting Formation.

16498.name: Jean Kirstein
16498.original: ジャン・キルシュタイン
16498.desc: __Height__: 175 cm (5'8") __Relatives__: [Mother](https://anilist.co/character/131444/Jean-no-Haha) Jean Kirschtein is a graduate of the 104th Cadet Corps, among whom he ranked 6th for his skills with ODM gear and ability to look at things through a more tactical lense. Jean hails from Wall Rose's Trost District, and joined the military with hopes of living a peaceful life within the walls as part of the Military Police. However, he would later find himself joining the Survey Corps after being convinced both by his close friend [Marco Bott's](https://anilist.co/character/62479/Marco-Bott) words, and after witnessing the death of several of his comrades. Jean has a blunt personality. He holds no restraint when it comes to speaking his mind, even when he knows it would not be wise to do so or when it could spark conflict. Jean is also pragmatic: he has a strong aversion to exposing himself to dangerous situations. During his time as a cadet, Jean was extremely hot-headed, easily becoming frustrated and quick to resort to violence when pushed. Jean was also very cynical about defeating the Titans, believing that humanity has no chance against them and openly mocking more idealistic individuals like [Eren Yeager](https://anilist.co/character/40882/Eren-Yeager), and saw resisting the Titans as a hopeless cause. However, despite these things, and although he presents himself as self-centered, Jean places high value on the lives of his comrades, and is willing to risk his life to pr

16498.name: Carla Yeager
16498.desc: Eren's mother. ~!She's eaten alive in the second chapter.!~ Note: Carla Yeager is the official English translation by Kodansha.

16498.name: Grisha Yeager
16498.original: グリシャ・イェーガー
16498.desc: Father of [Eren Yaeger](https://anilist.co/character/40882/Eren-Yeager) and caretaker of [Mikasa Ackerman](https://anilist.co/character/40881/Mikasa-Ackerman). He is a renowned doctor who was well respected in the District of Shiganshina after he saved the village from a mysterious viral epidemic by developing vaccines. He also provides a medical house call service to the people of Shiganshina and to various towns in addition to having a network of contacts within the Corps of the Shiganshina District. He is married to [Carla Yaeger](https://anilist.co/character/62475). ~!In the basement of the Yeager family house, he hides a secret which he refers to as the "truth". Upon finding Eren after the fall of Wall Maria, he injects him with a series of chemicals and amnesiacs and entrusts him with the key to the "truth", before mysteriously disappearing. This strange serum resulted in Eren gaining the ability to transform into a titan.!~

16498.name: Marco Bott
16498.desc: __Height__: 178 cm (5'9") __Affiliations__: 104th Training Corps Originally from Jinae District. Marco ranked 7th in the 104th Training Corps and is widely respected by other cadets of the 104th. Marco is a very kind, calm, and idealistic person, valuing the good of the group above his own interests, as well as understanding and coping with his own shortcomings and limitations. He is seen as a natural leader, and desires to join the Military Police to serve near the King. *Note: Marco Bott is the official English translation by Kodansha.*

16498.name: Krista Lenz
16498.desc: __Height__: 145 cm (4'8") __Affiliations__: 104th Trainees Squad, Survey Corps Ranked tenth in the trainee class, Krista is a very shy and kind, caring person, often being described as a "goddess" or "angel" by her peers. She is good friends with [Ymir](https://anilist.co/character/71479/Ymir).

16498.name: Thomas Wagner
16498.desc: Thomas Wagner was from Trost District. A member of the 104th Trainees Squad, he first met Eren Yeager while questioning him about the Colossal Titan. Later, he operated the training gear for the Three Dimensional Maneuver Gear during Eren's second attempt at his aptitude test. At Keith Shadis' orders, Thomas exchanged gear with Eren and it was discovered that Eren's gear was defective. After graduating, Thomas planned to join the Scouting Legion. ~!After the second attack of the Colossal Titan, he was assigned to the middle guard along with Eren Yeager and Armin Arlert. Initially tasked with working under the training corps, they eventually were incorporated into the front guard due to the number of titans. Catching the group unaware, a titan lunged at the rooftop they were standing on. The group scattered but unfortunately, Thomas wasn't fast enough. He was caught and swallowed whole, while his teammate, Eren, looked on in terror.!~

16498.name: Dot Pixis
16498.desc: The highest-ranked Administrator of the Southern Region. Head of the Garrison's Southern Territories, Pixis is a cunning leader with astute insights. However, he is also an alcoholic who is constantly watched over by his aid, [Anka](https://anilist.co/character/84331/Anka-Rheinberger), who constantly scolds him for sleeping and drinking during critical moments.

16498.name: Petra Ral
16498.desc: __Height:__ 158 cm (5'2") __Affiliation:__ Survey Corps; Soldier, Special Operations Squad. __Relatives:__ [Father](https://anilist.co/character/131987/Petra-no-Chichi) Petra Ral is a soldier of the Survey Corps hand-picked by [Captain Levi](https://anilist.co/character/45627/Levi) to join the Special Operations Squad. Petra is a very kind and caring woman, going out of her way to look after and guiding [Eren Yaeger](https://anilist.co/character/40882/Eren-Yeager) when he was first admitted to the squad. She seemed to have the most attachment to Eren among Levi Squad, as she was often the only one shown to actually worry about him and his wellbeing, at least at first. Although all of Levi's squad wished for Eren's unconditional trust, it was ultimately Petra who convinced him to do so. Despite her kind nature, Petra was a conditioned soldier with a quick reaction time against perceived danger. She displays extreme loyalty to her leaders, superiors and their orders, and cares deeply for her team, although she tends to be at odds with [Oluo Bozad](https://anilist.co/character/71687/Oluo-Bozard) due to his irritating tendency to try and imitate Levi. She greatly looks up to Levi as her superior and is deeply devoted to him, willing to completely dedicate her life to his cause. It is implied that she may harbor romantic feelings for her captain.

16498.name: Mike Zacharias
16498.desc: Squad Captain of his own squad, Squad Mike, a major division within the Survey Corps. He has been described by others as "humanity's second strongest soldier", being only behind [Levi](https://anilist.co/character/45627/Levi). Mike is an extremely strong and durable soldier and an acknowledged leader with a brave heart and a tactical mind. He also has a remarkably good sense of smell, which allows him to detect Titans from great distances. During times of ease, Mike is shown to be a quiet and reserved man, rarely speaking unless it concerned a more serious matter. He also has a bizarre habit of "sniffing" people when he meets them.

16498.name: Hange Zoe
16498.desc: __Height:__ 170 cm (5'7") __Affiliation:__ Survey Corps; Section Commander, Squad Leader. Leader of the Survey Corps' Fourth Squad, Hange is also in charge of conducting research on Titans, and pursues this knowledge so passionately that they have become obsessed with Titans as a result. After originally holding a deep hatred for the creatures, Hange decided to take on a new outside-the-box approach to their research by letting go of their resentment towards Titans and approaching the test subjects with compassion. Hange is an energetic, freethinking and quirky scientist, with a unique way of conducting both themselves and their work. Hange is a genius outside of just Titan research too, using their brain to create weapons, tactical plans, and inventions for the benefit of humanity. As a leader, Hange is thoughtful of their comrades, and can easily figure out complex problems in order to create plans for their teammates to carry out.

16498.name: Nile Dok
16498.desc: Chief of the Military Police.

16498.name: Darius Zackly
16498.desc: The head of all three divisions of the army. __ _Note:___ Darius Zackly is the official English translation by Kodansha.

16498.name: Nick
16498.desc: Pastor Nick is a member of a religion that worships the Walls as holy. He claims that he lost his family as a result of addiction to Vine. As a religious leader, Pastor Nick used his influence to oppose any modification of the walls, be it permanently sealing the gates or even mounting cannons on the top. Though he claimed it was blasphemy for humans to "maim" the wall, ~!the real reason was to reduce the risk of workers discovering the Titans within during renovations.!~ (Source: Shingeki no Kyojin Wikia) Note: Minister Nick is the official English translation by Kodansha.

16498.name: Keiji
16498.desc: Member of the Scouting Legion.

16498.name: Marlo Freudenberg
16498.original: マルロ・フロイデンベルク
16498.desc: __Affiliations:__ Military Police, 104th Cadet Corps. Recruit of the Military Police stationed in Stohess District. While most who join the Military Police Regiment do so because they want a safe position far from the danger of the Titans, Marlo did so because he claims to want "to uphold justice and do what's right.", much to the amusement of his fellow officer, [Hitch Dreyse](https://anilist.co/character/86017/Hitch-Dreyse), whom he often clashes with due to them being near complete opposites. His goal is to rise to the top of the organization so he can stop the pilfering of taxes and misappropriation of land. Though steadfast in his idealism, he could make moral compromises to achieve his goal, confessing a willingness to act like "scum" in order to move up in rank. Due to his passion towards his ideals, he had often been compared to [Eren Yeager](https://anilist.co/character/40882/Eren-Yeager) by people who know both of them.

16498.name: Dieter Ness
16498.desc: A member of the Scout Regiment and a team leader in the 57th Exterior Scouting Mission. ~!He encounters the Female Titan, who catches Ness's line and whips it to the ground, killing him instantly.!~

16498.name: Luke Siss
16498.desc: Luke Siss was a skilled member of the Survey Corps and a participant during the 57th Expedition Outside the Walls.

16498.name: Ymir
16498.desc: __Height:__ 172 cm (5'7") __Affiliations:__ 104th Trainees Squad, Scouting Legion Member of the Scouting Legion. She seems selfish, cynical, bossy, sly, uncooperative, exploitative, and confrontational, but she can apparently be kind, especially to [Krista](https://anilist.co/character/62481/Krista-Lenz).

16498.name: Nanaba
16498.desc: __Height:__ 172 cm __Affiliation:__ Scouting Legion Survey Corps

16498.name: Oluo Bozard
16498.desc: __Height:__ 173 cm (5'8") __Affiliations:__ Survey Corps; Soldier, Special Operations Squad __Relatives:__ [Mother](https://anilist.co/character/131991/Oluo-no-Haha), [Father](https://anilist.co/character/131994/Oluo-no-Chichi), Several Siblings. Oruo Bozad is a soldier of the Survey Corps hand-picked by [Captain Levi](https://anilist.co/character/45627/Levi) for the Special Operations Squad for his especially high Titan kill record. Oruo is a very self-confident, outspoken individual, and enjoys boasting about his own prowess. Despite his obnoxious demeanor, he is admittedly one of the best out of Levi Squad; having the highest kill count out of his peers, bested only by Levi. This only helps fuel his haughty nature. Though Oruo tries to come across as self-important, his cockiness is rarely taken seriously, and he is also shown to be somewhat clumsy, frequently biting his own tongue on accident while riding horses. Oruo also frequently attempts to imitate Levi, such as his rough speech and confident attitude, much to the frustration of one of his fellow teammates, [Petra Ral](https://anilist.co/character/62501).

16498.name: Eld Gin
16498.desc: __Height:__ 182 cm (6'0") Eld Gin is an elite soldier in the Survey Corps. He was hand-picked by [Captain Levi](https://anilist.co/character/45627/Levi) and placed in the Special Operations Squad, of which he is second-in-command. Eld is a responsible and firm leader with a strong sense of duty. He does not talk much, but when he does, he did so bluntly and in a straightforward manner. He also seems to have been a veteran of sorts as he teased [Petra Ral](https://anilist.co/character/62501) and [Oluo Bozad](https://anilist.co/character/71687/Oluo-Bozard) about how they acted during their first expedition. He also seems to hold some sort of belief of what makes a true soldier, saying that a kill record alone does not make a great soldier.

16498.name: Gunther Schultz
16498.desc: __Height:__ 183 cm (6'0") __Relatives:__ [Mother](https://anilist.co/character/131990/Gunther-no-Haha), [Grandfather](https://anilist.co/character/131986/Gunther-no-Ojsan). Gunther Schultz is one of the Survey Corps soldiers hand-picked by [Captain Levi](https://anilist.co/character/45627/Levi) to join the Special Operations Squad, both for his strength and his distrust for [Eren Yaeger](https://anilist.co/character/40882/Eren-Yeager). Being a soldier of the Survey Corps who survived multiple encounters with Titans significantly affected Gunther's personality, making him deeply obedient and loyal to his superiors. Within the Special Operations Squad, Gunther seems to be the most reasonable one. However, he is shown to get irritated when his comrades joke around with one another, showing he also possesses a stern side and does not take kindly if a soldier doesn't focus on the task at hand.

16498.name: Mina Carolina
16498.desc: Mina appears in Ch. 3. When the Colossal Titan appears outside Trost District, the burst of steam from its body knocks a number of trainees off the Wall. She follows when Eren instructs the other trainees to attack the Colossal Titan. After the second attack of the Colossal Titan, she was assigned to the middle guard along with Eren Yeager and Armin Arlert. Initially tasked with working under the training corps, they eventually were incorporated into the front guard due to the number of titans. Catching the group unaware, a titan lunged at the roof top they were standing on. When Eren was talking about how killing titans that got in Trost District will get their rank up high, she joined him indicating that she is also signing up for Scouting Legion. ~! After Eren's leg got bitten off by one of the titans, She and the other two tries to kill the titan that is responible for biting off Eren's leg. However, her Three Dimensional Maneuver Gear's wire was caught by titan's hand and was knocked over to the wall. When she found out where she was, it was too late for her to escape. She was caught by another titan and her face got bitten off. !~

16498.name: Keith Shadis
16498.original: キース・シャーディス
16498.desc: Keith Shadis was the head instructor of the 104th Trainees Squad. He seemed to be a friend or have some sort of relationship with Dr. Grisha, as he knew Eren is the son of the doctor and praised Eren for his effort.

16498.name: Moses
16498.desc: He was a member of the Scouting Legion and was the first person killed by a Titan at the start of the series. When the Recon Corps squad returns to the District of Shiganshina, his mother starts asking for him, and the Squad leader, gives her all that remained of him- his right arm. In the manga his name is Brown (ブラウン), although it is changed to Moses in the anime. (Source: Wikipedia)

16498.name: Armin no Ojii-san
16498.original: アルミンのお祖父さん
16498.desc: The paternal grandfather of Armin Arlert. Before the fall of Wall Maria, He possessed a book containing illegal information about the world beyond the Walls. He gave this book to his grandson, Armin Arlert, who showed it to his best friend Eren, kindling his desire to see the outside world

16498.name: Samuel Linke-Jackson
16498.original: サムエル・リンケ-ジャクソン
16498.desc: Samuel is a member of the 104th Trainees Squad. He appears in Ch. 3. When the Colossal Titan appears outside Trost District, the burst of steam from its body knocks a number of trainees off the Wall. While most are able to switch to their Three Dimensional Maneuver Gear and anchor themselves to the Wall, Samuel is struck in the head by a piece of falling rock and stunned. Sasha saves him from falling to his death by firing one of her grappling hooks into his leg. Eren tells Sasha to take Samuel somewhere safe, then instructs the other trainees to attack the Colossal Titan. ~!He is killed by Connie after being shot three times in the head.!~

16498.name: Franz Kefka
16498.desc: Franz is a member of the 104th Trainees Squad. Franz first appears Ch.3 in walking through Trost District with Eren and Hannah. Eren refers to Hannah and Franz as a couple, which they both embarrassedly deny. ~!At some point following the breach of the Wall by the Colossal Titan, Franz is attacked by a Titan. He is bitten in half and dies. Armin finds Hannah futilely attempting CPR on what remains of Franz's corpse. He tells her it's useless, and advises her to retreat to the Wall before it's too late.!~ (Source: Shingeki no Kyojin Wikia)

16498.name: Hannah Diament
16498.original: ハンナ・ディアマント
16498.desc: Hannah is a member of the 104th Trainees Squad. Hannah first appears in Ch. 3 walking through Trost District with Eren and Franz. Eren refers to Hannah and Franz as a couple, which they both embarrassedly deny.

16498.name: Daz
16498.desc: Daz is a member of the 104th Trainees Squad. ~!In Ch. 40, Ymir and Historia Reiss recount a story about Dazz from training. Wanting praise and recognition, Dazz undertook harsh physical training in the snowy mountains. However, he wasn't strong enough to endure it, and nearly died. Ymir told Krista to leave him behind or her own life would be endangered; when Krista refused, Ymir used her Titan shifter powers to bring Dazz back to the camp safely. In Ch. 12, when Dot Pixis announces the plan to reconquer Trost District, Dazz has a breakdown and starts screaming that he doesn't want to die. Though Marco Bott tries to quiet him, a commanding officer overhears and threatens to execute him. Dazz replies that execution would be better then being eaten by a Titan. However, Dot Pixis then announces that all deserters will be pardoned -- but have to live with the guilt that they abandoned their families to the Titans. Dazz is unable to leave his family to that fate, and returns to participate in the operation to plug the breach. After the mission, he briefly appears in Chapter 21 standing next to Sasha Blouse when Irvin Smith gives a speech urging the 104th Training Squad members to join the Scouting Legion. As he is not present in the group of trainees who join, he presumably opted for the Stationary Guard instead.!~ (Source: Shingeki no Kyojin Wikia)

16498.name: Megane no Kyoukan
16498.desc: Instructor with glasses that first appears in episode 3 and is later seen in episode 5 teaching the 104th Corps what is known about the Titans and their origins.

16498.name: Kitz Weilman
16498.original: キッツ・ヴェールマン
16498.desc: The Captain of the Garrison's 1st Division Elite Forces

16498.name: Bart
16498.desc: Original anime character. He is a Noble in the District of Marquis and friend of Pixis, who challenges him to leisurely games of chess. In the anime, as Pixis makes to leave upon learning of the invasion of Trost in the year 850, he tries to prevent him from going to the battlefield and instead have Pixis and his men stay and protect him and his property, viewing the lowly commoners being attacked as trash. (Source: Wikipedia)

16498.name: Anka Rheinberger
16498.original: アンカ・ラインベルガー

16498.name: Ian Dietrich
16498.original: イアン・ディートリッヒ
16498.desc: Ian is a member of the Stationary Guard in Trost District. Ian first appears in Ch. 5 after Trost District is breached by the Colossal Titan. He compliments Mikasa for killing a Titan that was attacking a group of evacuating civilians. ~!In Ch. 12, a plan is formed for Eren to use his Titan powers to seal the breach with a boulder. Ian is placed in charge of the elite squad assigned to protect Eren on his mission. When Eren loses control of his Titan form in Ch. 13, Mitabi and Rico advise Ian to abort the mission and retreat. However, Ian orders his soldiers to continue to defend Eren down to the last man, as Eren is their only hope against the Titans. In Ch. 14, Eren regains his senses due to Armin's intervention, and Ian orders his soldiers to protect him until he reaches the breach even at the cost of their own lives. Ian uses himself as bait to lure Titans away from Eren, sacrificing his life in order to ensure the success of the mission.!~ (Source: Shingeki no Kyojin Wikia)

16498.name: Nack Tierce
16498.desc: One of the graduates from the 104th Training Corps. He was a part of the 34th squad sent to support the rear vanguard during the invasion of Trost. He was killed after the squad was ambushed by a group of Titans. (Source: Wikipedia)

16498.name: Mylius Zeramuski
16498.original: ミリウス・ゼルムスキー
16498.desc: One of the graduates from the 104th Training Corps. He was a part of the 34th squad sent to support the rear vanguard during the invasion of Trost. ~!He was killed after the squad was ambushed by a group of Titans.!~ (Source: Wikipedia)

16498.name: Mikasa no Chichi
16498.desc: He and his family lived in a forest within the Shiganshina District. He seemed to be a lighthearted but hard working man. When asked by Mikasa how babies were made, he jokingly claimed he did not know and suggested she ask Dr. Jaeger when he arrives. ~!It is hinted that Mikasa's father, or a close relative of his, was driven into poverty due to their business failing. As such, Mikasa's father and his family lived in the woods within the Shiganshina District to avoid persecution from the government!~

16498.name: Mikasa no Haha
16498.desc: Mikasa's mother. First Appearance Anime: Ep. 6 A woman of Oriental heritage appearing to be in her mid thirties. She appeared to be a kind and loving mother, holding value in keeping with tradition. When her and Mikasa's lives were threatened, she quickly turned into a fierce mother, trying to do whatever was necessary to protect Mikasa.

16498.name: Rico Brzenska
16498.original: リコ・ブレツェンスカ
16498.desc: The Squad Leader of the 1st Division Elite Force of the Stationary Guard. ~!She is the sole survivor of the elite squads assigned to protect Eren during the liberation of Trost District. She does not trust Eren and still views him as a traitor.!~

16498.name: Tom
16498.desc: One of the graduates from the 104th Training Corps. During the invasion of Trost in the year 850, he was part of the squad including Jean and Mikasa whose Maneuvering Gears start to run out of propulsion fuel. As his fuel finally depletes he becomes surrounded by a group of Titans and is killed. Jean, who was in charge of the squad, capitalized on the opportunity and used him as bait to distract the Titans while the rest of the squad made their way back to the Headquarters to resupply. (Source: Wikipedia)

16498.name: Hitch Dreyse
16498.desc: **Height:** 168 cm __Affiliations:__ 104th Cadet Corps. Recruit of the Military Police stationed in Stohess District. She was roommates with [Annie Leonhart](https://anilist.co/character/46490/Annie-Leonhart). Hitch acts immature in certain ways, she has a sarcastic, easygoing personality and seems to mischievously enjoy teasing and needling her fellow officers, especially [Marlo Freudenberg](https://anilist.co/character/71457/Marlo-Freudenberg). She claims she chose to join the Military Police out of laziness, as it is well known that the senior staff are incredibly corrupt and she wanted to benefit from the system herself; however, she did not take into account that, as a new recruit, her superiors would dump all their work on her. Though she may act a bit air-headed at times, Hitch is not selfish and cares about those around her, especially her fellow comrades.

16498.name: Mitabi Jarnach
16498.desc: Mitabi Jarnach is a member of the Stationary Guard in Trost District. ~!Mitabi first appears in Ch. 13 as the leader of one of the units assigned to protect Eren on his mission to plug the breach in Trost's Wall created by the Colossal Titan. When Eren loses control of his Titan form, Mitabi advises Ian to abort the mission and retreat to the safety of Wall Rose; however, Ian orders him to continue defending Eren. In Ch. 14, Eren regains his senses and begins carrying a boulder to plug the breach in the Wall. As there are too many Titans to fight them all, Mitabi and his men instead use themselves as bait to lure the Titans away from Eren, sacrificing their lives to ensure the success of the mission.!~ First Appearance Manga: Ch. 13 Anime: Ep. 11 (Source: Shingeki no Kyojin Wikia)

16498.name: Boris Feulner
16498.original: ボリス・フォイルナー
16498.desc: is a member of the Military Police stationed in Stohess District. Boris came to Annie's defense when she got late to her duty, telling others to give her a rest. He stated that being the only one to experience the actual combat (Defense of Trost district) among her squad, Annie must be still suffering trauma from it. When Marlo tells his colleagues of his ambition to reform the Military Police, Boris tells Marlo good luck, albeit with nonchalance

16498.name: Dimo Reeves
16498.desc: Dimo Reeves is a merchant that leads the company that's named after him. He's stationed in Trost District. ~!After the Battle of Trost, his company was assigned a mission to kidnap Eren and Historia by the Military Police Brigade.!~

16498.name: Moblit Berner
16498.original: モブリット・バーナー
16498.desc: __Height:__ 176 cm (5'9") __Affiliation:__ Survey Corps; Executive Officer, Fourth Squad. A veteran member of the Survey Corps and [Hange Zoe](https://anilist.co/character/71121/Hange-Zoe)'s second-in-command within the Survey Corps' Fourth Squad. He also serves as Hanji's assistant and messenger. He comes across as an intelligent and responsible person, which may be the reason he was tasked to keep his overzealous and eccentric superior out of trouble. Much of the time, this leaves him in a state of near-panic, having to constantly remind Hange to be more careful or yanking them to safety. That he remains at Hange's side constantly suggests he is a loyal person, and that he cares deeply for his superior's safety, regardless of the stress involved with being under their command. He is also able to show signs of a serious nature when it comes to missions, going out of his way to investigate problems and put himself in danger before others.

16498.name: Abel
16498.desc: Goggles is a soldier in the Scout Regiment fourth squad under the command of Hange Zoë, who is noted for his trademark glasses, or "goggles". He participated in the 57th Exterior Scouting Mission and often accompanies higher ups, such as Hange and Levi, on serious missions. (Source: Shingeki no Kyojin Wikia)

16498.name: Phil
16498.desc: A member of the Garrison.

16498.name: Dennis Aiblinger
16498.original: デニス・アイブリンガー
16498.desc: Military Police Officer stationed in the Stohess District.

16498.name: Waltz
16498.desc: He is a member of the Military Police Regiment who serves as Nile Dawk's aide

16498.name: Annie no Chichi
16498.desc: Father and trainer of Annie Leonhart. He relentlessly trained Annie to fight, using mostly kicks and the attacker's weight against them. ~!Memories of his pleas for forgiveness later create an opening for Annie to crystallize herself before Eren Jaeger has the chance to capture her!~

16498.name: Jurgen
16498.desc: A member of the Scout Regiment and a participant of the 57th Exterior Scouting Mission. ~!Jurgen was a reckless man, who disobeyed his superiors and put his entire brigade in danger just to retrieve a body. This recklessness would prove to be the end of him. When his friend Ivan was killed, he showed more composure than his friend Dieter; but he still chose to disobey his superiors to retrieve his body. In his final moments, he expressed great fear and regret on his face as he was killed without even completing the task he had set out to do!~

16498.name: Darius  Baer Walbrunn
16498.original: ダリウス・ベーア＝ヴァルブルン
16498.desc: A team leader of the Scout Regiment who participated in the 57th expedition beyond the Walls.

16498.name: Dieter
16498.desc: A member of the Scout Regiment and participated in the 57th Exterior Scouting Mission. ~!Dieter appears very unconditioned and mentally cracking. He shows great distress over the death of his friend Ivan, and disobeys his superiors when they refuse his request to retrieve his body; resulting in the death of his friend Jurgen. When confronted by Captain Levi, Dieter bursts into tears, cracking under the mental stress he had endured. Though he shows passion for his friends, this passion manifests itself in the form of recklessness resulting in comrades deaths!~

16498.name: Ivan
16498.desc: A member of the Scout Regiment and a participant of the 57th Exterior Scouting Mission. ~!Ivan was killed during the Scout Regiment's 57th Expedition. As the Corps was returning to Calaneth District, two of Ivan's friends, Dieter and Jurgen, tried, unsuccessfully, to retrieve his body to return to his family!~

16498.name: Gunther Sofu
16498.desc: [Gunther](https://anilist.co/character/71691)'s grandfather.

16498.name: Petra no Chichi
16498.desc: The father of [Petra Rall](https://anilist.co/character/62501), a skilled female member of Levi's former Special Operations Squad.

16498.name: Eld no Haha
16498.desc: Eld's mother. Appears in episode 22.

16498.name: Peer
16498.desc: A member of the Scout Regiment

16498.name: Gunther no Haha
16498.desc: Gunter's mother. Appears in episode 22.

16498.name: Oluo no Haha
16498.desc: Oluo's mother. Appears in episode 22.

16498.name: Eld's Lover
16498.desc: Appears in episode 22.

16498.name: Oluo no Chichi
16498.desc: Oluo's father.

16498.name: Bean
16498.desc: Beane was the name given by Hange Zoë to a 7m Titan which was captured after the reconquest of Trost District.

16498.name: Sonny
16498.desc: Sonny was the name given by Hange Zoë to a 4m Titan which was captured after the reconquest of Trost District.

16498.name: Ellie
16498.desc: She is a young girl from the Calaneth District. She and her brother witness the departure and comeback of the Scout Regiment on the 57th Exterior Scouting Mission.

16498.name: Zoku 3
16498.desc: He is one of a trio of men who killed [Mikasa's father](https://anilist.co/character/84339) and [mother](https://anilist.co/character/84341) before kidnapping their daughter [Mikasa Ackerman](https://anilist.co/character/40881) in the year 844.

16498.name: Zoku 2
16498.desc: He is one of a trio of men who killed [Mikasa's father](https://anilist.co/character/84339) and [mother](https://anilist.co/character/84341) before kidnapping their daughter [Mikasa Ackerman](https://anilist.co/character/40881) in the year 844.

16498.name: Zoku 1
16498.desc: He is one of a trio of men who killed [Mikasa's father](https://anilist.co/character/84339) and [mother](https://anilist.co/character/84341) before kidnapping their daughter [Mikasa Ackerman](https://anilist.co/character/40881) in the year 844.

16498.name: Louise
16498.desc: A young girl who was in Trost with her mother attempting to flee when the Titans invaded. After being saved by [Mikasa Ackerman](https://anilist.co/character/40881/Mikasa-Ackerman) and the other 104th Cadets, she was inspired by their heroic actions and later joins the military herself as a Survey Corps recruit, hoping to get closer to Mikasa, her idol. Louise believes that strength is the most important attribute one can have in the world, to the point that she almost seems to have a "might equals right" mentality. Much of this mindset stems from her experiences during the Battle of Trost District, where she claims to have learned from watching Mikasa Ackerman fight in the face of adversity to achieve victory. She believes that the ends justify the means, and has no qualms about breaking rules if she believes that disobeying others will get her what she wants.

16498.name: Lobov
16498.desc: A Scout Regiment recruit and former commander of the garrison who participated in the Raid on Liberio.

101922.name: Tanjirou Kamado
101922.desc: __Height:__ 165 cm (5'5") __Combat Style:__ Water Breathing & ~!Sun Breathing!~ Tanjirou is kind by nature and has been described by others as having very gentle eyes. He has a great deal of determination and will not give up once he has a goal to achieve, an example being finding a cure for [Nezuko](https://anilist.co/character/127518). Even though he is relatively strong on his own, he isn't opposed to asking others for help when he needs it. He is very protective of his friends and even more so of his younger sister. His biggest attribute is his ability to empathize with anyone, even demons. ~!Eventually, he discovers that he is a legendary Sun Breathing user.!~

101922.name: Nezuko Kamado
101922.desc: __Height:__ 153 cm (5'0") Transformed into a demon and left mute, Nezuko travels with her older brother [Tanjirou](https://anilist.co/character/126071/Kamado-Tanjirou) in a box on his back. She can change her size at will, and is a capable fighter when she needs to be, but has never killed or eaten any humans. Instead of gaining nourishment from humans, it seems that she recovers her energy by sleeping for long periods of time.

101922.name: Inosuke Hashibira
101922.desc: **Height:** 164 cm (5'4") __Combat Style:__ Beast Breathing Inosuke is usually seen wearing a grey boar mask, with a shirtless version of the Demon hunter uniform. Without the mask he has messy shoulder length black hair and large green eyes with long eyelashes. He is described as having a girly looking face which greatly contrasts with his muscular body. Inosuke is extremely short-tempered and proud, and makes a big deal out of fighting opponents stronger than him claiming that's his only hobby. He is a sore loser and is always trying to compete with Tanjiro and provoke him into fighting him, and usually failing. Due to growing up in the mountains by himself Inosuke has trouble interacting with others and only cares about himself most of the time. Though he's often seen with 2 swords in hand, Inosuke is left-handed.

101922.name: Zenitsu Agatsuma
101922.desc: __Height:__ 164 cm (5'4") __Combat Style:__ Thunder Breathing __Affiliation:__ Demon Slayer Corps __Occupation:__ Demon Slayer Zenitsu Agatsuma is one of the main protagonists of Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba and along with [Inosuke Hashibira](https://anilist.co/character/129130/Inosuke-Hashibira), a traveling companion of [Tanjiro Kamado](https://anilist.co/character/126071/Tanjirou-Kamado) and [Nezuko Kamado](https://anilist.co/character/127518/Nezuko-Kamado).

101922.name: Muzan Kibutsuji
101922.desc: __Height:__ 179 cm (5'10") He is the Demon King, the first of his kind, and the progenitor of all other demons in existence. Muzan is also the leader of the Twelve Kizuki, an organization of the twelve strongest demons in existence that serve directly under him. ~!A millennium ago, during the Heian Era, Muzan was turned into a demon during an experimental treatment trying to cure his terminal illness, and his goal since then was to live without the fear of death and become truly eternal. He believes that Sun Breathing users are his only threat. He has a grand total of seven hearts and five brains.!~

101922.name: Kyoujurou Rengoku
101922.desc: __Height:__ 177 cm (5'10") __Combat Style:__ Flame Breathing He is greatly enthusiastic in regard to his duties as Flame Pillar and often cheerfully eccentric. He is amiable, kind and boasts extraordinary flame techniques and swordsmanship stemming from strict practice and discipline. He is an honourable warrior who adheres to his code of morals and principles that was instilled into him by his mother at a young age - the most significant being that those who were born strong have a duty to protect the weak.

101922.name: Giyuu Tomioka
101922.desc: __Height:__ 176 cm (5'9½") __Combat Style:__ Water Breathing Water pillar in the Demon Killing Corps. Giyuu is reserved and displays little emotion, instead giving off a calm feeling most of the time. As a water breath user, Giyuu has created his own style. The eleventh style, Lull, gives him the ability to nullify any oncoming attacks, though rapid attacks can pierce through it. Though Giyuu is reserved, he does have a few friends, such as Tanjirou and, in the past, [Sabito](https://anilist.co/character/137809/Sabito). Shinobu often pokes fun at Giyuu and is merciless when doing so, such as saying he has no friends and that others don't like him. ~!He is one of the only Pillar, aside from [Sanemi](https://anilist.co/character/137774/Sanemi-Shinazugawa), who survived during the final fight against [Muzan](https://anilist.co/character/129132/Muzan-Kibutsuji).!~

101922.name: Muichirou Tokitou
101922.desc: __Height:__ 160 cm (5'3") __Combat Style:__ Mist Breathing Muichiro is an air-headed individual who seems to constantly wander off in thought and never focus on one thing. Impassive and, at times, obtuse, he tends to think only for himself and operates on logic alone, never letting emotion guide him. Despite this, he has been shown to get serious when it is required and is devoted to his position as the Demon Slayer Corps' Mist Hashira. Alternatively, he seems to display a cold and arrogant side as well. ~!He later died at Kokushibo's hand.!~

101922.name: Shinobu Kochou
101922.desc: __Height:__ 151 cm (4'11") __Combat Style:__ Insect Breathing Shinobu is a demon slayer and the Insect Pillar of the Demon Killing Corps. She is 18 years old and one of two female pillars. Shinobu appears rather laid back, and always has a smile on her face regardless of the situation. Despite her relaxed exterior and her initial claim of wanting to get along with demons, she can be rather cruel and harbors a great deal of anger towards them. She is generally kind to other humans, but is rather sadistic in her treatment of demons. As a pillar, she is a top-class fighter despite her small stature. She is also well-versed in medical knowledge, and can concoct poisons and medicines alike. ~!During the Infinity Castle Arc, she encounters the Upper 2 demon [Douma](https://anilist.co/character/144591) and is slain by him in a fight. However, since she poisoned herself before the fight, Douma is severely incapacitated after eating her.!~

101922.name: Tengen Uzui
101922.desc: __Height:__ 198 cm (6'6") __Combat Style:__ Sound Breathing A Demon Slayer, and the Sound Pillar of the Demon Slayer Corps. Tengen is a very eccentric person, always wanting to complete actions as flashy as possible. Although he has displayed an uncaring and forceful attitude towards some people, he also has a caring side that is mainly only shown towards his most treasured ones, most notably his three wives, [Makio](https://anilist.co/character/250554), [Suma](https://anilist.co/character/250555), and [Hinatsuru](https://anilist.co/character/250556). He also shows a somewhat nicer side towards [Tanjiro](https://anilist.co/character/126071) after their mission and starts to accept him more as the series goes on.

101922.name: Mitsuri Kanroji
101922.desc: __Height:__ 167 cm (5'5") __Combat Style:__ Love Breathing Demon Hunter and the Love Pillar of the Demon Killing Corps. Mitsuri is a soft and kind person. She is very emotional and passionate, constantly complimenting people in her head, which probably contributes to her nickname of "the Hashira of Love". Although she is rather shy and is easily flustered, she is always kind to others, most notably towards [Obanai](https://anilist.co/character/137777), whom she appears to share a strong bond with. Besides her rather emotional personality, she can also come off as somewhat childish at times. ~!She was taught by Rengoku to use the flame breathing. However, although Mitsuri has learnt it, she was not as skillful with it and cannot fight to her fullest using it, leading her to solely develop the Love Breathing.!~

101922.name: Sakonji Urokodaki
101922.desc: Retired member of the Demon Slayer Corps, previously holding the title of Water Hashira. He is the main cultivator of the Water Breathing style, having trained Makomo, Sabito, Giyu Tomioka, and Tanjiro Kamado.

101922.name: Sanemi Shinazugawa
101922.desc: __Height:__ 179cm (5'10½") Demon Hunter and the Wind Pillar of the Demon Killing Corps. He is the older brother of [Genya Shinazugawa](https://anilist.co/character/137776). Sanemi specializes in Wind Breathing, which has 9 forms. The technique consists of drawing the air from around the user to create whirlwind attacks that follow the user's movements. Form names include Dust Whirlwind Cutter, Claws-Purifying Wind, Clean Storm Wind Tree, Rising Dust Storm, Cold Mountain Wind, Black Wind Mountain Mist, Gale - Sudden Gusts, Primary Gale Slash, and Idaten Typhoon.

101922.name: Jigorou Kuwajima
101922.desc: Retired member of the Demon Slayer Corps, having previously held the title of Thunder Hashira. He trained Zenitsu Agatsuma and Kaigaku.

101922.name: Genya Shinazugawa
101922.desc: __Height:__ 180 cm (5'11") Genya Is a Demon Hunter of the Demon Killing Corps. He is also the younger brother of the Wind Pillar [Sanemi Shinazugawa](https://anilist.co/character/137774). ~! Due to his lack of breath forms he is dependent on using his shotgun and demon form. His shotgun pelts are made from sun steel to be effective against demons. His demon form is active when he digests anything from a demon to gain demon like strength and abilities. He is the only demon hunter to have this ability given that it is drastically rare !~

101922.name: Obanai Iguro
101922.desc: __Height:__ 162 cm (5'3") Obanai is a Demon Slayer and the Snake Pillar of the Demon Slayer Corps. A young man of short stature and a pale complexion. He has straight-edged black hair of varying lengths, the longest reaching down to his shoulders and the shortest stopping at his cheekbones, which he wears down with two shorter strands hanging between his eyes. He wears a navy blue version of the standard Demon Slayer uniform, along with a black and white pinstriped haori, the hem and cuffs of which are striped lengthways rather than vertically, which covers his hands. Obanai also sports bandages in place of the leg-wraps around his calves, as well as another set of bandages that cover his mouth, and blue-strapped zori on his feet. He is also always seen with his white snake, Kaburamaru, wrapped around his shoulders.

101922.name: Gyoumei Himejima
101922.desc: __Height:__ 220cm (7'2½") He is a Demon Slayer and the Stone Hashira of the Demon Slayer Corps. Gyomei also serves as the mentor of Genya Shinazugawa.

101922.name: Makomo
101922.desc: A cute and mysterious girl who wears a floral pattern kimono. Her fox mask has two flowers on its right cheek. ~!She is a former apprentice of Urokodaki Sakonji.!~

101922.name: Kagaya Ubuyashiki
101922.desc: He is the head of the Ubuyashiki Family and 97th leader of the Demon Slayer Corps known mainly as "Oyakata-sama" ("Master") by his subordinates and peers.

101922.name: Sabito
101922.desc: He is a former apprentice of [Urokodaki Sakonji](https://anilist.co/character/137773/Urokodaki-Sakonji). ~!He dies saving the participators in the final selection, including [Giyuu](https://anilist.co/character/130050/Tomioka-Giyuu).!~

101922.name: Matsuemon Tennouji
101922.desc: Kasugai Crow assigned to Tanjirou Kamado. Very intelligent and seems to have a large ego.

101922.name: Susamaru
101922.desc: ~!Susamaru was a Demon that aspired to join Kibutsuji Muzan's Twelve Demon Moons group.!~

101922.name: Yahaba
101922.desc: ~!was a Demon that aspired to join Kibutsuji Muzan's Twelve Demon Moons group.!~

101922.name: Numa Oni
101922.desc: ~!was a Demon that went on a rash of kidnappings during Kamado Tanjirou's first mission for the Demon Killing Corps.!~

101922.name: Yushirou
101922.desc: __Height:__ 157 cm (5'2") Yushiro is a traveling companion of Tamayo and close ally of Kamado Tanjirou. He was turned into a Demon by Tamayo. Yushiro was a human who was under the care of Tamayo as she was practicing as a medical practitioner. He was in the frail state fighting disease when Tamayo gave him the choice of succumbing to his illness or to live longer as a Demon. He agreed to become a Demon and has since stayed by Tamayo's side serving as an assistant as well as her guard. ~!Yushiro would become the last known survivor of the Demon race. In time he would dedicate himself to a life of art and become a world famous painter in the present day under the name of Yushiro Yamamoto, known for his paintings of Tamayo to wide critical acclaim!~

101922.name: Tamayo
101922.desc: __Height:__ 150 cm (4'11") Tamayo is a doctor and close ally of [Kamado Tanjirou](https://anilist.co/character/126071/Kamado-Tanjirou). She was turned into a Demon by [Kibutsuji Muzan](https://anilist.co/character/129132/Kibutsuji-Muzan).

101922.name: Teoni
101922.desc: The Hand Demon was a notorious Demon that killed thirteen of Urokodaki Sakonji's apprentices, including Sabito and Makomo.

101922.name: Odou no Oni
101922.desc: The Head Demon is the first Demon encountered by Kamado Tanjirou.

101922.name: Hotaru Haganezuka
101922.desc: Hotaru Haganezuka is a swordsmith affiliated with the Demon Killing Corps.

101922.name: Kanao Tsuyuri
101922.desc: __Height:__ 156 cm (5'1½") Kanao Tsuyuri is a Demon Hunter and the Tsuguko, who is personally looked after by the Demon Killing Corps' Pillars. She uses Flower Breathing. ~!When Kanao is first introduced, she is an indecisive and quiet girl due to the abuse she endured in her past before meeting the Kocho sisters. She became unable to make decisions by herself and repressed her emotions as a defense mechanism. In order to help rectify this, Kanae gave her a coin to flip to decide which path to follow when she didn't know what to do. Later on, Tanjiro helps Kanao overcome her indecisiveness and Kanao soon becomes more confident in making decisions with or without her coin. Kanao and Tanjiro would eventually marry and start a family, having two great-great-grandchildren by the names of [Kanata Kamado](https://anilist.co/character/171144/Kanata-Kamado) and [Sumihiko Kamado](https://anilist.co/character/171145/Sumihiko-Kamado) between them.!~

101922.name: Kanae Kochou
101922.desc: Kanae Kocho was a Demon Slayer and the late Flower Hashira. She was slain several years prior to the present story. She is also the biological older sister of [Shinobu Kochou](https://anilist.co/character/136070/Shinobu-Kochou) and the adoptive older sister of [Kanao Tsuyuri](https://anilist.co/character/139038/Tsuyuri-Kanao).

101922.name: Kiriya Ubuyashiki
101922.desc: ~!Kiriya Ubuyashiki is the son and middle child of Kagaya Ubuyashiki. He is the current head of the Ubuyashiki Household and leader of the Demon Slaying Corps!~

101922.name: Nakime
101922.desc: Nakime is a mysterious Biwa Demon that dwells in the Dimensional Infinity Fortress. ~!Actually she is a member of the Twelve Demon Moons, replacing Hantengu and holding the position of Upper Moon Four.!~ (Source: Fandom)

101922.name: Enmu
101922.desc: __Race:__ Demon __Height:__ 168 cm (5'6") Enmu is a sadistic and cruel demon Who is only driven by his liking to making humans suffer. He is shown to be completely loyal to [Muzan](https://anilist.co/character/129132/Kibutsuji-Muzan). Caring about him probably more than what he cares about himself. He also hates the other lower moons, labeling them as "Fools". ~!Enmu was a member of the Twelve Demon Moons, having held the position of Lower Moon One.!~ ~!Enmu was aboard the infinity train, and starts eating humans in order to make himself more powerful. He knocks them unconscious, promising them that he will gift them with nice and peaceful dreams but in reality, after giving them a nice dream, he always likes to follow it up with a horrifying nightmare because he thinks it is so much fun.!~ ~!In the end, Tanjiro's Hinokami Kagura cuts through Enmu's train spine and kills him.!~

101922.name: Kyougai
101922.desc: ~!Kyougai was a member of the Twelve Demon Moons, having held the position of Lower Moon Six. He is also known as Drum Demon.!~ (Source: Kimetsu no Yaiba Fandom, edited)

101922.name: Rui
101922.desc: ~!Rui was a member of the Twelve Demon Moons, having held the position of Lower Moon Five.!~ (Source: Kimetsu no Yaiba Fandom)

101922.name: Kumo Oni Ani
101922.desc: ~!The Older Brother Spider Demon was a member of the Spider Family.!~

101922.name: Kumo Oni Ane
101922.desc: She is a member of the spider family.

101922.name: Kumo Oni Haha
101922.desc: Like most demons, she is cruel, unfeeling, and murderous towards humans. Though after much time with him, she developed fear for Rui and the Father Spider Demon who abused her for being weaker than expected. ~!She was a member of the Spider Family.!~

101922.name: Kumo Oni Chichi
101922.desc: ~!He was a member of the Spider Family.!~

101922.name: Ukogi
101922.desc: Ukogi is Zenitsu's Kasugai Crow. He is the only sparrow to appear in the series and pass the Kasugai Crow Test and also the only Kasugai Crow without the ability to talk. His family was killed by Demons.

101922.name: Naho Takada
101922.desc: She is a servant of the Butterfly Estate.

101922.name: Kiyo Terauchi
101922.desc: She is a servant of the Butterfly Estate.

101922.name: Aoi Kanzaki
101922.desc: She is a Demon Slayer, though she works as a servant in the Butterfly Estate rather than taking to the front lines.

101922.name: Sumi Nakahara
101922.desc: She is a servant of the Butterfly Estate.

101922.name: Kotoha Hashibira
101922.desc: ~!Kotoha was Inosuke's mother!~

101922.name: Kaigaku
101922.desc: __Height:__ 167 cm (5'6") A member of the Demon Slaying Corps, who was taught the Breath of Thunder by former Thunder Pillar, Jigoro, with fellow disciple Zenitsu.

101922.name: Nichika Ubuyashiki
101922.desc: Nichika Ubuyashiki is one of the older daughters of Kagaya Ubuyashiki.

101922.name: Hinaki Ubuyashiki
101922.desc: Hinaki Ubuyashiki is one of the older daughters of Kagaya Ubuyashiki.

101922.name: Murata
101922.desc: Murata is a member of the Demon Slayer Corps.

101922.name: Kie Kamado
101922.desc: Kie is Tanjiro Kamado's mother.

101922.name: Hisa
101922.desc: Hisa is an old lady who welcomes Demon Slayers to rest in her house. Tanjiro Kamado and his group visit her after they fight Kyogai at the Drum House.

101922.name: Shigeru Kamado
101922.desc: Shigeru was Tanjiro's second youngest brother.

101922.name: Takeo Kamado
101922.desc: Takeo was Tanjiro Kamado's first younger brother.

101922.name: Hanako Kamado
101922.desc: Hanako was Tanjiro Kamado's youngest sister.

101922.name: Saburou
101922.desc: Saburou is a villager from the village near Tanjiro's home.

101922.name: Tanjurou Kamado
101922.desc: Tanjuro Kamadou was the husband of Kie Kamado and the late father of Tanjiro, Nezuko, Takeo, Hanako, Shigeru, and Rokuta. Tanjuro was a quiet, calculating, forgiving, charismatic and loving person. He had a peaceful relationship with his family and regularly lectured Tanjiro about life. While he appeared calm on the outside, he showed a decent, noble aura with a quiet perception to his surroundings. According to his son, he did not like standing out or displaying his true abilities to others. However, if his family is in danger, he would not hesitate to protect them and shows no mercy towards the enemy. ~!Despite not being a Demon Slayer and having a tragic disease that makes his body incredibly frail, Tanjuro was shown to be a phenomenally strong individual. He was born with a demon slayer mark on his forehead, had the ability to access the transparent world, and was constantly using the selfless state.!~

101922.name: Kozo Kanamori
101922.desc: Kozo Kanamori is a swordsmith affiliated with the Demon Slayer Corps.

101922.name: Rokuta Kamado
101922.desc: Tanjiro's youngest sibling.

101922.name: Gotou
101922.desc: Goto is a member of the Kakushi, the clean-up brigade of the Demon Slayers. He is the one who found a near-dead Tanjiro, Inosuke, and Zenitsu in the aftermath of the Entertainment District Arc. He possesses deep respect for the three because of their capability and bravery. At one point in his life, he was found worthy of being a Demon Slayer, but for unknown reasons, he decided to become one of the Kakushi.

101922.name: Shoichi
101922.desc: Shoichi is a young boy saved by Tanjiro Kamado and Zenitsu Agatsuma when they approached him to help his older brother, Kiyoshi, escape from the Drum House. He also has a younger sister, Teruko.

101922.name: Kibutsuji no Musume
101922.desc: Muzan's Daughter

101922.name: Teruko
101922.desc: Teruko is a young girl, accompanied by her brother Shoichi, who approaches Tanjiro Kamado and Zenitsu Agatsuma to help save her older brother from the Drum House.

101922.name: Kiyoshi
101922.desc: Kiyoshi is the elder brother of Shoichi and Teruko, who gets kidnapped by the Drum House Demon, Kyogai.

101922.name: Tokie
101922.desc: Tokie is a resident of the village the Swamp Demon attacked and his final target.

101922.name: Toyo
101922.desc: Toyo is an udon street vendor.

101922.name: Tsunojou Oni
101922.desc: Tsunojou oni was a Demon that lived in the Drum House.

101922.name: Kamanue
101922.desc: Kamanue was a member of the Twelve Kizuki, having held the position of Lower Rank 6.

101922.name: Mukago
101922.desc: Mukago was a member of the Twelve Kizuki, having held the position of Lower Rank 4.

101922.name: Shita Oni
101922.desc: Shita Oni was a Demon that lived in the Drum House.

101922.name: Rokuro
101922.desc: Rokuro was a member of the Twelve Kizuki, having held the position of Lower Rank 2.

101922.name: Chachamaru
101922.desc: Chachamaru is a feline familiar that assists in Tamayo's medical research with Demon blood. ~!Chachamaru is seen during the battle with Muzan, after the Infinity Castle collapses. The cat jumps above the remaining Hashira in order to administer an antidote to stave off the poisonous effects of Muzan's attacks. As a result, it is sliced in half by the demon. However, it was later reassembled by Yushirou.!~

101922.name: Ozaki
101922.desc: Ozaki was a Demon Slayer and part of the Demon Slayer Corps.

101922.name: Wakuraba
101922.desc: Wakuraba was a member of the Twelve Kizuki, having held the position of Lower Rank Three.

101922.name: Asakusa Oni
101922.desc: The Asakusa Demon is a minor character in Kimetsu no Yaiba. He was a pedestrian in Asakusa who [Muzan Kibutsuji](https://anilist.co/character/129132/Muzan-Kibutsuji) turned into a demon.

101922.name: Satoko
101922.desc: Satoko was a villager betrothed to Kazumi. She was kidnapped and killed by the Swamp Demon.

101922.name: Yatsu
101922.desc: Yatsu is a minor character of Kimetsu no Yaiba. He is a civilian that [Muzan Kibutsuji](https://anilist.co/character/129132/Muzan-Kibutsuji) bumped into at an alleyway in Asakusa.

101922.name: Kazumi
101922.desc: Kazumi was a minor character in Kimetsu no Yaiba. He was a villager whose fiancée, Satoko, was kidnapped and eaten by the Swamp Demon.

113415.name: Megumi Fushiguro
113415.desc: __Species:__ Human __Height:__ 175 cm (5'9") __Occupation:__ Sorcerer, Student __Affiliation:__ Jujutsu High __Grade:__ Grade 2 Sorcerer __Cursed Technique:__ 10 Shadows Megumi is the deuteragonist of the Jujutsu Kaisen series. He is a first-year student at Jujutsu High and also a descendant of the Zenin Family. While outwardly stoic and calculating, Megumi wishes to help protect people he sees as good or kind. He believes that the world is unfair and that a Sorcerer is a tool to ensure kind people are given more chances to live. Claiming it to be his selfish and irrational desire, he does not see himself as a hero for doing this.

113415.name: Yuuji Itadori
113415.desc: **Species:** Human **Height:** 173 cm (5'8") **Occupation:** Sorcerer, Student, Vessel **Affiliation:** Jujutsu High Yuuji is a fair person who cares greatly for not only his comrades but anyone he views as people with their own wills, despite how deep or shallow his connection to them is. He cares greatly for the "value of a life" and to this end, he will ensure that others receive a "proper death." He is easy to anger in the face of pure cruelty and unfair judgment of other people. He doesn't have the born talent required to use cursed techniques, but he has incredible athletic abilities and he is considered very strong for his age, as shown by when he easily beat a coach in Steel Ball Throw.

113415.name: Satoru Gojou
113415.desc: __Height:__ 190 cm (6'3") __Occupation:__ Jujutsu Sorcerer, Teacher __Affiliation:__ Tokyo Metropolitan Curse Technical College, Gojou Family __Grade:__ Special Grade Sorcerer __Cursed Technique:__ Six Eyes, Limitless Satoru Gojou is one of the main protagonists of the Jujutsu Kaisen series. He is a special-grade jujutsu sorcerer and is widely recognized as the strongest in the world. Satoru is the pride of the Gojou Family, the first person to inherit both the Limitless and the Six Eyes in four hundred years. He works as a teacher at the Tokyo Jujutsu High and uses his influence to protect and train strong young allies

113415.name: Yuuta Okkotsu
113415.desc: __Species:__ Human __Occupation:__ Sorcerer, Student __Affiliation:__ Jujutsu High __Grade:__ Special Grade Sorcerer The main protagonist of Jujutsu Kaisen prequel series [Tokyo Metropolitan Curse Technical School](https://anilist.co/manga/105469/Tokyo-Toritsu-Jujutsu-Kodo-Senmon-Gakko). He was initially a Special Grade Cursed Victim haunted by his late childhood friend, [Rika Orimoto](https://anilist.co/character/208533/Orimoto-Rika). [Satoru Gojou](https://anilist.co/character/127691/Satoru-Gojou) mentored Yuuta and enrolled him at Tokyo Jujutsu High.

113415.name: Suguru Getou
113415.desc: __Species:__ Human __Height:__ 183 cm __Occupation:__ Curse User __Grade:__ Special Grade Curse User __Cursed Technique:__ Cursed Spirit Manipulation Suguru Getou is an antagonist in both the Jujutsu Kaisen series and its prequel Jujutsu Kaisen 0: Jujutsu High. ~!He was originally a student of [Masamichi Yaga](https://anilist.co/character/189237/Yaga-Masamichi)'s alongside [Satoru Gojo](https://anilist.co/character/127691/Gojou-Satoru) and [Shoko Ieiri](https://anilist.co/character/158154/Ieiri-Shouko) at Tokyo Jujutsu High. His experiences as a jujutsu sorcerer bred a deep hatred for non-sorcerers, leading to an incident where Suguru massacred over a hundred civilians in a single night, later being expelled from Jujutsu High and called for immediate execution as a result.!~

113415.name: Nobara Kugisaki
113415.desc: __Height:__ 160 cm (5'3") __Occupation:__ Jujutsu Sorcerer, Student __Affiliation:__ Tokyo Jujutsu High __Grade:__ Grade 3 Sorcerer She is a first-year student and grade 3 jujutsu sorcerer at Tokyo Jujutsu High studying under [Satoru Gojo](https://anilist.co/character/127691) alongside [Yuji](https://anilist.co/character/127212) and [Megumi](https://anilist.co/character/126635). Nobara is a confident and brash young woman with an unshakable character. More than anything, Nobara is determined to stay true to herself no matter what. She takes great pride in being both a pretty girl and a strong fighter, refusing to let anyone influence her. Initially, Nobara can appear to be a very obnoxious and arrogant person. She first introduced herself to Yuji and Megumi by expressing how inferior they were. She also argued with Yuji for the greater part of their first mission together. Despite her abrasive attitude, Nobara is actually an incredibly caring and dutiful person, but would never let most people see that side of her. After fighting alongside each other in several missions, Yuji and Megumi grow to become Nobara's closest allies.

113415.name: Sukuna
113415.desc: __Species:__ Human, Reincarnated Sorcerer According to the legend, Sukuna was a demon with four arms and two faces who lived in the golden era of sorcery 1000 years ago. Sorcerers of the era gave their all to defeat him, but to no avail. Without ever being defeated, his body was split into 20 separate indestructible cursed objects, which allowed him to live on and traverse the ages to come. In 2018, [Yuuji Itadori](https://anilist.co/character/127212/Itadori-Yuuji) consumed one of the aforementioned cursed objects, and Sukuna was reincarnated. ~!In reality, Sukuna was not a demon, but rather a deformed human sorcerer. His body was able to be split up into 20 cursed objects because he received assistance from [Kenjaku](https://anilist.co/character/289584).!~ Sukuna is hedonistic and has no regard for the suffering of others, believing that suffering is natural for the weak. He is selfish, and always wants to stay in control of the situation without caring about the consequences.

113415.name: Mahito
113415.desc: __Grade__: Special Grade __Cursed Technique:__ Idle Transfiguration Mahito is one of the primary antagonists of the Jujutsu Kaisen series. He is a Cursed Spirit allied with Suguru Geto, Jogo, Hanami and several others. Their ultimate goal is the eradication of humanity and ultimately replacing the population with Cursed Spirits.

113415.name: Kento Nanami
113415.desc: __Height:__ 184 cm (6'0½") __Occupation:__ Sorcerer __Affiliation:__ Jujutsu High __Grade:__ Grade 1 Sorcerer __Cursed Technique:__ Ratio He is a Grade 1 Jujutsu Sorcerer and a Tokyo Jujutsu High alumni. Nanami is a very intelligent and reserved man who at first appears to be someone who is just very serious about his work. He knows how to separate sentimentalism from service and claims he's only a Jujutsu Sorcerer because it's slightly less idiotic than regular careers. As one of [Yuji's](https://anilist.co/character/127212/Yuji-Itadori) mentors, Nanami is a complete contrast to [Gojo](https://anilist.co/character/127691/Satoru-Gojou), who is far more outspoken and easy-going.

113415.name: Maki Zenin
113415.desc: __Height:__ 170 cm (5'7") Maki Zenin is the older twin sister of [Mai Zenin](https://anilist.co/character/134168/Mai-Zenin). Maki is a grade 4 sorcerer and a second-year at Tokyo Metropolitan Jujutsu Technical High School. She is from the main branch of the Zenin clan, one of the "Prominent Three Families" of the Jujutsu world. She left the Zenin family in order to prove herself capable of being a Sorcerer after being deemed uncapable, since she lacks Cursed Energy. ~!Because Mai and Maki are monozygotic twins, their strength is considerably limited to one another. Monozygotic twins are considered as a single individual in the Jujutsu world and are a sign of bad omen.!~ ~!After the death of her twin sister Mai, Maki has lost all of her cursed energy and gained a Heavenly Restriction. This causes her skills and human capabilities to be on par with [Toji Fushiguro's](https://anilist.co/character/162722/Touji-Fushiguro).!~

113415.name: Mai Zenin
113415.desc: __Height:__ 170 cm (5'7") Mai Zenin is the younger twin sister of [Maki Zenin](https://anilist.co/character/134167/Maki-Zenin). Mai is a grade 3 sorcerer and a second-year at Kyoto Jujutsu Technical High School. As a child, Mai always relied on Maki since she was afraid of Cursed Spirits. ~!Because Mai and Maki are monozygotic twins, their strength is considerably limited to one another. Monozygotic twins are considered as a single individual in the Jujutsu world and are a sign of bad omen.!~ ~!In chapter 149, Mai decides to sacrifice herself in order to make Maki stronger.!~

113415.name: Panda
113415.desc: __Species:__ Cursed Corpse (varies among 3 personalities) __Occupation:__ Jujutsu Sorcerer, Student __Affiliation:__ Jujutsu High __Grade:__ 2 He is a second-year at Tokyo Prefectural Jujutsu High. As a Metamorphosed Cursed Corpse, he is the best creation of Principal [Masamichi Yaga](https://anilist.co/character/189237/Masamichi-Yaga). He is sentient and has three cores inside the doll body: the youngest brother "Panda", the eldest brother "Gorilla" and a sister.

113415.name: Aoi Toudou
113415.desc: __Species:__ Human __Height:__ 190 cm __Occupation:__ Sorcerer, Student __Affiliation:__ Kyoto Jujutsu Technical High School __Grade:__ Grade 1 Sorcerer Toudou is a third-year student at Kyoto Jujutsu Technical High School who possesses inhuman physical strength, durability, and speed. ~!He is able to use a technique called Boogie Woogie, in which he can switch the position of two things that posses a certain amount of curse energy within his range.!~

113415.name: Kasumi Miwa
113415.desc: __Species:__ Human __Occupation:__ Jujutsu Sorcerer, Student __Affiliation:__ Kyoto Metropolitan Curse Technical College __Grade:__ Grade 3 Sorcerer A second-year at Kyoto Metropolitan Curse Technical College. Kasumi is a hard-working, restrained, and considerate pacifist. She is also a big fan of [Satoru Gojo](https://anilist.co/character/127691). ~!She has a very close bond with [Mechamaru](https://anilist.co/character/210154), their friendship is first seen in the Tournament Arc when Miwa offers him a battery telling him not to eat it as [Mai](https://anilist.co/character/134168) and [Momo](https://anilist.co/character/157868) laugh in the background. In the Shibuya Arc, she is seen mourning his death on the train. Over the course of the Tournament Arc and Shibuya Arc it is very apparent their friendship grows as they both strived towards becoming closer to one another. As she mourns his death on the train she holds a mini Mechamaru speaker which tells her to find her happiness. After the recording finishes, she holds the speaker to her heart and cries. The entire Kyoto program seems very distressed by his death on the train. When later entering the battle Miwa is quick to activate her technique out of rage and sadness towards [Mahito](https://anilist.co/character/133702).!~

113415.name: Jougo
113415.desc: __Grade:__ Special Grade Cursed Spirit Jogou is an unregistered special grade cursed spirit aligned with Mahito, Hanami, and Dagon. He was born of humanity's fear and negative association with volcanoes and other fire-related natural disasters. This resulted in a highly intelligent cursed spirit with massive levels of cursed energy even for a special grade. Jogou believes curses are the true humans and desires a world where his kind dominates the earth.

113415.name: Toge Inumaki
113415.desc: __Species:__ Human __Occupation:__ Sorcerer, Student __Affiliation:__ Jujutsu High __Grade:__ Grade 2 Sorcerer __Cursed Technique:__ Cursed Speech He is a second-year at Tokyo Metropolitan Jujutsu Technical High School. Due to his curse ability, he is only willing to communicate with ingredients used to make rice balls.

113415.name: Chousou
113415.desc: Chousou is half human and half cursed spirit and the first of the Death Painting Wombs with a Special Grade rank. He and his two brothers, [Kechizu](https://anilist.co/character/210832/Kechizu) and [Eso](https://anilist.co/character/210831/Esou) are Cursed Womb: Death Paintings who have sided with [Mahito](https://anilist.co/character/133702/Mahito)'s group. Chousou bears strong attachments to his brothers and is very overprotective of them. ~!However, after receiving a vision during his battle with Itadori, Chousou was eventually convinced that Sukuna's vessel was actually one of his younger brothers. He then became furious at Mahito and the other cursed spirits for manipulating him into harming Itadori.!~ ~!Chousou is one of nine death painting wombs that came from a woman capable of giving birth to cursed spirit children. At some point, Chousou and his brothers were stored at the Jujutsu High, along with some of Sukuna's fingers. As stated by Chousou himself, Noritoshi Kamo, the man who experimented on his mother is in fact his third "parent" due to him having mixed in his own blood into Chousou when his mother was pregnant with him. Although seemingly not remembering much about his own past, it is evident that Chousou himself remembers Noritoshi and holds a grudge against him for toying with his mother and siblings' lives.!~

113415.name: Junpei Yoshino
113415.desc: A student at Satozakura High School.

113415.name: Mei Mei
113415.desc: __Height:__ 173 cm __Occupation:__ Jujutsu Sorcerer __Affiliation:__ Jujutsu High __Grade:__ Grade 1 Sorcerer __Family:__ [Ui Ui](https://anilist.co/character/217290) (Younger Brother) __Abilities__: ~! __Weapon Mastery__: Mei Mei wields a large battle-axe. __Cursed Technique__: Black Bird Manipulation - Mei Mei is able to control crows as well as see through their eyes, making her technique great for recon. __Bird Strike__: by forcing a crow to commit suicide, the trade-off is to erase the Cursed Energy limit of a typical weak bird and hurl it at the enemy. !~ Mei Mei is a grade 1 jujutsu sorcerer who works independently and only in exchange for money. She is also the older sister of Ui Ui. ~!She was the senpai of [Satoru Gojo](https://anilist.co/character/127691) and [Suguru Geto](https://anilist.co/character/133699) during their time at Jujutsu High.!~

113415.name: Utahime Iori
113415.desc: A first grade sorcerer and a teacher at Kyoto Jujutsu Technical High School.

113415.name: Takuma Ino
113415.desc: __Species:__ Human __Occupation:__ Sorcerer __Affiliation:__ Jujutsu High __Grade:__ Grade 2 Sorcerer Takuma Ino is a grade 2 jujutsu sorcerer and a close associate of Kento Nanami who operates out of Tokyo Jujutsu High. Takuma Ino is a genuine and cheerful person with a more positive outlook on things than most jujutsu sorcerers. He doesn't believe he's the smartest person around and has a lot of respect for Nanami. Whenever Ino finds himself in a tough situation, he asks himself what would Nanami do.

113415.name: Noritoshi  Kamo
113415.desc: __Cursed Technique:__ Blood Manipulation __Grade:__ Semi-Grade 1 Sorcerer He is a third-year at Kyoto Magic Technical College.

113415.name: Yoshinobu Gakuganji
113415.desc: The principal of Kyoto Jujutsu Technical High School.

113415.name: Momo Nishimiya
113415.desc: __Species:__ Human __Occupation:__ Jujutsu Sorcerer __Affiliation:__ Kyoto Magic Technical College __Grade:__ Semi-Grade 2 Sorcerer __Cursed Technique:__ Tool Manipulation She is a third-year at Kyoto Magic Technical College.

113415.name: Shouko Ieiri
113415.desc: __Height:__ 168 cm __Ability:__ Reverse Healing Cursed Technique Alumnus of Tokyo Jujutsu High, having been classmates with [Satoru Gojo](https://anilist.co/character/127691) and [Suguru Geto](https://anilist.co/character/133699). After graduating into a full-fledged jujutsu sorcerer, Shoko became the school's primary doctor.

113415.name: Hanami
113415.desc: __Species:__ Cursed Spirit Hanami is an antagonist intent on ridding the Earth of Humans and reviving Sukuna.

113415.name: Naobito Zenin
113415.desc: __Species:__ Human __Height:__ 184 cm __Age:__ Unknown __Hair Color:__ Grey __Occupation:__ The 26th head of House Zenin __Affiliation:__ House Zenin __Grade:__ Grade 1 Sorcerer

113415.name: Masamichi Yaga
113415.desc: He is the current principal of Tokyo Metropolitan Jujutsu Technical High School, the creator of Panda, and the headmaster of Satoru Gojo, Suguru Geto and Shoko Ieiri. ~!After the Shibuya incident Yaga is given a death penalty by the higher ups for inciting Gojo and Geto in the past and "causing the Shibuya incident".!~

113415.name: Kiyotaka Ijichi
113415.desc: An assistant manager at Tokyo Prefectural Jujutsu High School.

113415.name: Tsumiki Fushiguro
113415.desc: ~! Megumi's older sister.!~ ~! Tsumiki was unknowingly chosen by Kenjaku to be a participant of the Culling Game and made into the incarnated host of Yorozu !~

113415.name: Nagi Yoshino
113415.desc: __Species:__ Human Nagi Yoshino is the mother of Junpei Yoshino. Nagi is a friendly, laid-back woman who cared deeply for her son. She's eager for him to make friends and took a liking to Yuji immediately. As a mother, she has some irresponsible tendencies. She was a smoker and drinker who allowed Junpei to skip school if she wished. Nagi believes that her son could take a different avenue other than education to be successful in life. After just one meeting, Yuji recognized that Junpei's mother was a great person.

113415.name: Wasuke Itadori
113415.desc: Yuji's Grandfather is shown to be a selfless, caring man who taught Yuji to help others. He was also short tempered and stubborn, to the point he would yell at Yuji for visiting him every day and buying him flowers. This temper meant that nobody else wanted to visit him and he tells his grandson to avoid dying alone.

113415.name: Yuki Tsukumo
113415.desc: One of the four Special Grade Sorcerers.

113415.name: Nobuko Takada
113415.desc: __Height:__ 180 cm Aoi Toudou's favorite idol.

113415.name: Kinji Hakari
113415.desc: Kinji Hakari is a character in the Jujutsu Kaisen series. He is a third-year student at Tokyo Jujutsu High who is currently suspended for clashing with authority. While away from the school, Kinji is running a fight club between sorcerers for money.

113415.name: Setsuko Sasaki
113415.desc: Sasaki is a second-year student at Sugisawa Third High School and a member of school's Occult Research Club alongside her friends [Yuuji Itadori](https://anilist.co/character/127212/Yuuji-Itadori) and [Takeshi Iguchi](https://anilist.co/character/200767/Takeshi-Iguchi).

113415.name: Takeshi Iguchi
113415.desc: Iguchi is a second-year student at Sugisawa Third High School and a member of school's Occult Research Club alongside his friends [Yuuji Itadori](https://anilist.co/character/127212/Yuuji-Itadori) and [Setsuko Sasaki](https://anilist.co/character/200765).

113415.name: Takagi
113415.desc: Takagi is the athletics club advisor teacher at Sugisawa Third High School.

113415.name: Dagon
113415.desc: __Affiliation:__ Mahito’s group Dagon is a antagonist who starts off as a cursed womb but later turns into a powerful cursed spirit. He starts off by being accompanied by Jogo and Hanami.

113415.name: Sotomura
113415.desc: Sotomura is a teacher at Satozakura High School, where [Junpei Yoshino](https://anilist.co/character/157214/Junpei--Yoshino) attends.

113415.name: Juuzou Kumiya
113415.desc: A curse user who wields an axe.

113415.name: Haruta Shigemo
113415.desc: A curse user working with Mahito. He loves picking on the weak.

113415.name: Shouta Itou
113415.desc: Shouta is a high school student from Satozakura High School.

113415.name: Sam
113415.desc: Sam is a character from one of the movies Itadori has to see to train to maintain a steady output of cursed energy. It's a reference to Lord of the Rings

113415.name: Koukichi Muta
113415.desc: Koukichi Muta is a Semi-Grade 1 sorcerer and a second-year student at Kyoto Jujutsu High. He attends school by controlling the cursed corpse Ultimate Mechamaru, as Muta was born with a sickly and fragile body due to a Heavenly Restriction. In exchange, he has a nearly boundless amount of cursed energy that spreads over a vast range.

113415.name: Uraume
113415.desc: __Gender:__ Unknown A curse user from a thousand years ago who is a direct subordinate to Sukuna.

113415.name: Esou
113415.desc: __Cursed Technique__ Rot Eso is an antagonist in the Jujutsu Kaisen series. He is a Cursed Womb: Death Painting and the middle brother of Choso and Kechizu.

113415.name: Kechizu
113415.desc: __Cursed Technique:__ Rot Kechizu is an antagonist in the Jujutsu Kaisen series. He is a Cursed Womb: Death Painting and the youngest brother of Choso and Eso. Kechizu and Eso serve as the primary antagonists of the Death Painting Arc.

113415.name: Akari Nitta
113415.desc: Akari Nitta is an Auxiliary Manager at Jujutsu High.

113415.name: Takeda
113415.desc: Takeda is one of the faculty members at Saitama Urami East Junior High and has been since even before Megumi Fushiguro attended there.

113415.name: Kenjaku
113415.desc: __Species:__ Human __Height:__ 183 cm __Occupation:__ Curse User __Cursed Technique:__ Cursed Spirit Manipulation Kenjaku is one of the primary antagonists of the Jujutsu Kaisen series. He is an ancient sorcerer who pursues the goal of "evolving" humanity via cursed energy, thereby ushering in a new golden age of jujutsu sorcery paralleling the Heian Era. ~!Using his cursed technique that allows him to transplant his brain into different bodies to possess them, he has inhabited different people throughout the centuries, assuming different identities.!~

113415.name: Yubi no Kishu
113415.desc: Finger Bearers are a type of special grade cursed spirit that emerge from the cursed wombs spawned from eating one of [Sukuna](https://anilist.co/character/133701/Sukuna)'s fingers.
