He joined as a gladiator at the Corrida Colosseum. ~!After the final battle against Donquixote Doflamingo, Orlumbus pledged his loyalty to Monkey D. Luffy and became a pirate and bacame the captain of the seventh ship of the Straw Hat Grand Fleet. He is also one of the central characters from The Stories of the Self-Proclaimed Straw Hat Grand Fleet Cover Page Serial.!~

21.name: Kingbaum
21.desc: __Height:__ 2340 cm (76'9") __Affiliations:__ Big Mom Pirates Kingbaum is a tree homie, a member of the Big Mom Pirates and the master of the Seducing Woods on Whole Cake Island. Kingbaum takes his duties very seriously and will ensure that all intruders in the Seducing Woods are killed. He carries some pride with his position, viewing outside assistance as unnecessary and being confident in the abilities of himself and his subordinates.

21.name: Riku Doldo III
21.desc: __Height:__ 261 cm (8'6") Riku Dold III is the former king of Dressrosa before he was dethroned by Donquixote Doflamingo. He entered the Corrida Colosseum to compete for the Mera Mera no Mi under the alias of "Ricky". He is the father of the late Scarlett and Viola, and is the grandfather of Rebecca.

21.name: Zeus
21.desc: __Height:__ 232 cm (7'7") (as a cloud) __Affiliations:__ Big Mom Pirates ~!Straw Hat Pirates (Currently)!~ Zeus the Thundercloud is a homie from [Big Mom](https://anilist.co/character/54495/Charlotte-Linlin) that she summom from her left hand. He is a special kind of homie, as he received a soul fragment from Big Mom herself, serving as one of her personal weapons alongside [Prometheus](https://anilist.co/character/233910/Prometheus) and [Napoleon](https://anilist.co/character/332667/Napoleon). ~!During the escape from Totto Land, Zeus was captured by the Straw Hat Pirates and forced to become [Nami](https://anilist.co/character/723/Nami)'s servant. He lived inside her Sorcery Clima-Tact until he was reclaimed by Big Mom in Wano Country.!~ ~!However, Big Mom later abandoned Zeus for good after he struggled during the fighting on Onigashima, replacing him with another homie named [Hera](https://anilist.co/character/332661/Hera). Zeus then went back to Nami's ownership for good, with his soul currently inhabiting her Sorcery Clima-Tact.!~

21.name: Prometheus
21.desc: __Height:__ 239 cm (7'10") Prometheus the Sun is a sun homie that Big Mom summons from her right hand. He is a special kind of homie, as he received a soul fragment from Big Mom herself, and serves as one of her personal weapons alongside Napoleon and Zeus.

21.name: Bian
21.desc: __Affiliations:__ Tontatta Kingdom ~!Tontatta Pirates; Straw Hat Grand Fleet!~ __Devil Fruit:__ Mushi Mushi no Mi, Model: Suzumebachi (Bug-Bug Fruit, Model: Hornet) __Devil Fruit Type:__ Zoan Bian is a dwarf from Tontatta Kingdom who serves as the leader of the Pink Bee Squad. ~! Sometime after the Straw Hats left Dressrosa, Bian became part of Leo's newly-formed pirate group, the Tontatta Pirates.!~

21.name: Hack
21.desc: __Height:__ 280 cm (9'2") Hack is a Japanese soldierfish Fish-Man and member of the Revolutionary Army. He went to Dressrosa to investigate the arms trafficking there and competed at the Corrida Colosseum for the Mera Mera no Mi.

21.name: Ideo
21.desc: __Height:__ 225 cm (7'5") __Affiliations:__ Ideo Pirates ~!Straw Hat Grand Fleet!~ Ideo is a XXX rank boxer and member of the Longarm Tribe who is the captain of the Ideo Pirates. He joined as a gladiator at the Corrida Colosseum to compete for the Mera Mera no Mi, where he met three other gladiators who he would form the then-XXX Gym Martial Arts Alliance. He is confident enough in his abilities to enter the Corrida Colosseum tournament. During the Block C battle royale, he states his one desire: to become stronger, which is the main reason he wants to win the Mera Mera no Mi. ~!He is an ally of Luffy during the Dressrosa Arc, whom he eventually pledged his loyalty towards, turning into the captain of the fourth ship of the Straw Hat Grand Fleet. He's also one of the central characters from The Stories of the Self-Proclaimed Straw Hat Grand Fleet Cover Page Serial.!~

21.name: Hajrudin
21.desc: __Height:__ 2200 cm (72'2") __Affiliations:__ New Giant Warrior Pirates ~!Buggy's Delivery (Former); Straw Hat Grand Fleet!~ Hajrudin is a giant warrior described as the "new generation" from Elbaph. He is the son of the late King Harald, King of War-Land, and the older brother of Prince Loki. ~!A century after the Giant Warrior Pirates' disbandment, Hajrudin founded the New Giant Warrior Pirates in an attempt to revive the legendary crew; they formerly served as S-class pirate mercenaries for Buggy's Pirate Dispatch Organization. Hajrudin competed as a gladiator in the Corrida Colosseum on Dressrosa for the Mera Mera no Mi, where he would team up with Monkey D. Luffy and the Straw Hat Pirates to overthrow Donquixote Doflamingo's regime. Following this, Hajrudin swore his crew's allegiance to Luffy and became the captain of the sixth ship of the Straw Hat Grand Fleet.!~

21.name: Machvise
21.desc: __Height:__ 440 cm (14'5") __Affiliations:__ Donquixote Pirates __Devil Fruit:__ Ton Ton no Mi __Devil Fruit Type:__ Paramecia __Bounty:__ ~!11,000,000!~ Machvise is an officer of the Donquixote Pirates' Diamante Army. Machvise was born in North Blue. He ate the Ton Ton no Mi at a young age, but many people tried to take the fruit's power by killing him, forcing him to live on the run from frequent pursuers. The pirate Donquixote Doflamingo also took interest in Machvise's Devil Fruit, and after Machvise was unable to escape him, he joined Doflamingo's crew. Like many One Piece characters, Machvise has a distinct laugh: "Nihihihihihi".

21.name: Giolla
21.desc: __Height:__ 221 cm (7'3") __Affiliations:__ Donquixote Pirates __Devil Fruit:__ Ato Ato no Mi (Art-Art Fruit) __Devil Fruit Type:__ Paramecia Giolla is an officer of the Donquixote Pirates' Trebol Army. Giolla is quite full of herself and has a habit of mishearing what her adversaries say to her as compliments. She is very passionate about art and her ability to bring her visions to life. However, her passion for the arts seems to somewhat cloud her judgment. She is also very cruel when she wishes to be, At age 45, Giolla was seen acting as a mother-like figure for younger members of the crew, such as baby Dellinger and little Baby 5 and Buffalo.

21.name: Buffalo
21.desc: Buffalo is the alias of a combatant of the Donquixote Pirates and an officer of the Pica Army.

21.name: Kabu
21.desc: Kabu is a dwarf from Tontatta Kingdom who is the leader of the Yellow Kabu Squad and a member of the Tontatta Pirates.

21.name: Streusen
21.desc: "Gourmet Knight" Streusen is the executive chef of the Big Mom Pirates, and is also the co-founder of the crew alongside Big Mom herself. Prior to his current position, he was the chef of a pirate crew that has since fallen apart. Except for his outstanding culinary expertise, Streusen is is also a very skilled opera singer. ~!Streusen ate the Kuku Kuku no Mi, a Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that allows him to turn any object into food. By plunging his sword into an object, even an incredibly massive object, such as an entire castle, it becomes any kind of food of Streusen's choosing. !~

21.name: Shuu
21.desc: Captain Shu was one of the Marine captains that helped in the Buster Call on Enies Lobby.

21.name: Sharinguru
21.desc: Captain Sharinguru is a Marine captain who helped in the Buster Call on Enies Lobby.

21.name: Berry Good
21.desc: Captain Very Good was one of the Marines who helped to attack the Straw Hats during the Buster Call at Enies Lobby.

21.name: Nusstorte Charlotte
21.original: シャーロット・ヌストルテ
21.desc: The 12th son and 21st child of the Charlotte Family and the eldest triplet brother of Basskarte and Dosmarche.

21.name: Nola
21.desc: Nola, known to many as the Master of the Sky, is a giant snake who lives on Upper Yard in Skypiea. Having lived for over four centuries, the snake was once the companion of Kalgara and Mont Blanc Noland back when Upper Yard was still part of Jaya. It is the grandchild of the snake Kashigami, whom the Shandia once worshiped as a god. Thanks to its large size, Nola is capable of swallowing humans and even buildings as a whole, and can cause large-scale destruction to any structure it makes contact with. Nola can transmit venom through its fangs; the venom is powerful enough to instantly corrode trees. ~!When the snake slammed headfirst into base of the immensely large Giant Jack at high speed after the beanstalk had been slightly weakened by Zoro, the force was strong enough to slightly tilt it. Despite Nola's size, the snake can move very quickly, making it very difficult for its prey to elude it. Nola's scales are extremely tough and durable, as Wyper was unable to damage it even with multiple blasts of his powerful Burn Bazooka. However, a large thunderbolt from Enel proved powerful enough to knock Nola unconscious. Nola can transmit venom through its fangs; the venom is powerful enough to instantly corrode trees.!~

21.name: Zepo
21.desc: Zepo was a polar bear mink who was Bepo's older brother and a member of the Nox Pirates. ~! He was killed by Big Mom in Totto Land five years ago after he spun the roulette wheel. !~

21.name: Fukurokuju
21.desc: __Height:__ 221 cm (7'3") __Debut:__ Chapter 931, Episode 925 __Affiliations:__ Kurozumi Family, Beasts Pirates (former); Orochi Oniwabanshu (former), Kozuki Family (former) __Occupations:__ Ninja, Captain of the Orochi Oniwabanshu (former) __Origin:__ Wano Country __Residence:__ Flower Capital, Wano Country Fukurokuju is a ninja and the previous captain of the Orochi Oniwabanshu, before they joined the Beasts Pirates. He is currently working with Kurozumi Orochi.

21.name: Bonk Punch
21.desc: Bonk Punch is an officer of the Red Hair Pirates. In his first appearance in Luffy's childhood, he was considerably slimmer and displayed a different attire, like a striped shirt and a sash.

21.name: Bakkin
21.desc: __Height:__ 68 cm (2'3") __Occupations:__ Pirate (former) Miss Bakkin is a former pirate, the self-proclaimed lover of Edward Newgate, and the mother of Edward Weevil, a former Warlord of the Sea. Claiming herself to be Whitebeard's lover, she believes that she and her son have the right to inherit Whitebeard's fortune. She seems to be quite greedy and manipulative, believing that money is what matters in the world, and swaying her son to follow her plans rather than his own for her alleged lover's "fortune". She also finds revenge unnecessary, because there is no money to be gained from it.

21.name: Ushimaru Shimotsuki
21.desc: Shimotsuki Ushimaru was a member of the Shimotsuki Family, and the last daimyo of Ringo in Wano Country. He ruled until the takeover of Kurozumi Orochi as shogun 20 years ago. He was a direct descendant of the legendary samurai Shimotsuki Ryuma.

21.name: Uta
21.desc: __Height:__ 169 cm __Occupations:__ Singer Uta is the most beloved singer in the world. Her voice, which she sings with while concealing her true identity, has been described as “otherworldly.” ~!In ONE PIECE FILM: RED, she is revealed to be [Shanks](https://anilist.co/character/727/Shanks)' adopted daughter.!~ ~!Uta and [Luffy](https://anilist.co/character/40/Luffy-D-Monkey) met when they were children, and they seem to have been friends since then.!~

21.name: Anana Charlotte
21.original: シャーロット・アナナ
21.desc: 39th daughter of the Charlotte Family, as well as the 85th and youngest overall child, and is a member of the Big Mom Pirates.

21.name: Monster
21.desc: __Affiliations:__ Red Hair Pirates Monster is an officer of the Red Hair Pirates. He first appeared playing with his crew at the Partys Bar.

21.name: Hongo
21.desc: __Affiliations:__ Red Hair Pirates Hongo is an officer of the Red Hair Pirates.

21.name: Building Snake
21.original: ビルディング・スネイク
21.desc: __Affiliations:__ Red Hair Pirates Building Snake is an officer of the Red Hair Pirates.

21.name: Limejuice
21.desc: __Affiliations:__ Red Hair Pirates Limejuice is an officer of the Red Hair Pirates.

21.name: Howling Gab
21.desc: __Affiliations:__ Red Hair Pirates Howling Gab is an officer of the Red Hair Pirates.

21.name: Aramaki
21.desc: __Affiliations:__ Marines __Occupations:__ Admiral __Devil Fruit:__ ~!Mori Mori no Mi (Woods-Woods Fruit)!~ __Devil Fruit Type:__ ~!Logia!~ Ryokugyu is an admiral in the Marines. He was conscripted through a World Military Draft during the two-year timeskip, and was appointed to his rank to fill the two admiral vacancies caused by Aokiji's resignation and Sakazuki's promotion. ~!From what little has been seen so far, Ryokugyu comes off as an extremely laid-back, lazy man not unlike former admiral [Aokiji](https://anilist.co/character/2752/Kuzan). He did not want to make the effort of following [Sakazuki's](https://anilist.co/character/22687/Sakazuki) orders to expel [Fujitora](https://anilist.co/character/82259/Isshou) from Mary Geoise, both out of alleged concern for the damage a fight between them would wreak and because it would be too much trouble for him. More than that, Ryokugyu views even the act of eating itself as too much work, given his apparent ability to survive without food. Also, he appears to have a liking for beautiful women, talking about how he would eat if a "young lady" were to feed him.!~ ~!Ryokugyu appears to have eaten a Devil Fruit of an unknown type that enables him to generate various plant life from his body at will and freely control it. The plants he creates can be grown rapidly and moved around freely, seemingly not being limited by any rigidity that some plants, such as trees, normally possess.!~

21.name: Megalo
21.desc: Megalo is a shark that lives on Fishman Island. He is the beloved pet of Princess Shirahoshi and former pet of the Neptune Army.

21.name: Maynard
21.desc: __Debut:__ Chapter 705; Episode 634 __Affiliation:__ Marines __Occupation:__ Vice Admiral Maynard is a vice admiral who appears in the Dressrosa Arc. He was registered as a gladiator to compete at the Corrida Colosseum for the Mera Mera no Mi, but was defeated before he could participate. As a Marine, Maynard has a strong sense of justice. He wanted to expose Doflamingo's acts to the world after escaping from the Colosseum. It is unknown whether he believes in absolute justice or moral justice.

21.name: Sarahebi
21.desc: __Devil Fruit__: ~!Snake SMILE!~ __Devil Fruit Type__: ~!Artificial Zoan!~ Sarahebi is a Gifter of the Beasts Pirates who works under Black Maria. She is also a school teacher in the Flower Capital. ~!Sarahebi is loyal to her crew, her captain and Kurozumi Orochi as she teaches children propaganda that portrays Kaidou and Orochi as heroes while vilifying Kozuki Oden and the Nine Red Scabbards.!~ (Source: One Piece Wiki)

21.name: All-Hunt Grount
21.original: オールハント・グラント
21.desc: All-Hunt Grount is the main antagonist Luffy fights in the "Marine Rookie Arc". He was found by Admiral Aokiji on an island that was destroyed by him and his beast like arm. He was recently promoted to naval captain from Navy HQ when he was transferred to the marine base on Fron Island.

21.name: Smiley
21.desc: Smiley, was a pet of [Caesar Clown](https://anilist.co/character/61603/Clown-Caesar). It was created by gathering and compressing the poisonous H2S gas that spread throughout Punk Hazard and using Vegapunk's process of Zoan devil fruit animation to bring it to life. Smiley, as its other name "Slime" suggests, was an enormous gelatinous red-violet mass that was compared to a mountain in size. Thanks to its Devil Fruit power it took on the shape of an axolotl with eyes, a mouth, legs, caudal fin and external gills.

21.name: Vegapunk
21.desc: __Affiliations:__ Marines __Occupation:__ Scientist Dr. Vegapunk is the leading scientist in the employment of the Marines. His work includes discovering the secrets and uses of seastone, the secrets of how Devil Fruit powers work, the co-discovery of the Lineage Factor and its applications, and various other scientific achievements that are said to be at least 500 years ahead of current technology. He hails from the technologically advanced Karakuri Island. ~!Before being employed under the World Government, Vegapunk was part of an outlaw scientific research known as MADS, where he worked alongside other notable scientists such as [Caesar Clown](https://anilist.co/character/61603/Caesar-Clown), [Judge Vinsmoke](https://anilist.co/character/127895/Judge-Vinsmoke) and [Queen](https://anilist.co/character/131427/Queen) before being arrested and then integrated into and made the leader of the Marines' science unit SSG (Special Science Group).!~

21.name: Bellett
21.desc: Bellett was once the prince of a kingdom, until his father visited the Kamabakka Kingdom and returned a woman. As a result, Bellett's kingdom suffered a great loss, which forced him to become a pirate until his eventual imprisonment in Impel Down. Bellett sought revenge against Ivankov for his father's transition, although his revenge plan failed when Ivankov transformed him into a woman. After Bellett's transformation, Ivankov offered that she could join him and his followers. Instead, Bellett ran off in embarrassment.

21.name: Lassoo
21.desc: __Affiliations:__ Baroque Works~!(former); New Spiders Cafe!~ __Devil Fruit:__ Inu Inu no Mi, Model: Dachshund (Mutt-Mutt Fruit) __Devil Fruit Type:__ Zoan Lassoo is [Mr. 4's](https://anilist.co/character/13109/Babe) gun that consumed a Devil Fruit through some unknown method which allows it to become a living dog. He is a sandy-brown gun, similar to a bazooka, that has handles on the sides and a contoured barrel. Lassoo is always suffering from some kind of cold that makes him have a running nose and sneeze (which makes him fire cannonballs). He seems to be very loyal to his master, as he did everything he said without question. (Source: One Piece Wiki)

21.name: Matsuge
21.desc: __Height:__ 190 cm (6'3") __Affiliations:__ Super Spot-Billed Duck Troops, Straw Hat Pirates (temporary) __Origin:__ Alabasta Kingdom (Grand Line) Matsuge is a camel who accompanied the Straw Hat Pirates during the Alabasta Arc. He is classified as a Type-A creature, "Big Friendly". Matsuge has noticeable eyelashes on the bottom of his eyes, which he is named after. Matsuge seems to like women as he only allowed [Nami](https://anilist.co/character/723/Nami) and [Vivi](https://anilist.co/character/726/Vivi-Nefertari) to ride him.

21.name: Ivan X
21.desc: __Height:__ 228cm __Affiliations:__ Super Spot-Billed Duck Troops The largest of the Super Spot-Billed Duck Troops. He wears a horned helmet with brown goggles. Luffy rode on him when the Straw Hats were going back to the Going Merry.

21.name: Stomp
21.desc: __Height:__ 202cm __Affiliations:__ Super Spot-Billed Duck Troops The spot-billed duck with a reversed cap, and a very timid expression on his face. He is also very thin. [Usopp](https://anilist.co/character/724/Usopp) rode on him on the way back to the Going Merry.

21.name: Cowboy
21.desc: __Height:__ 155cm __Affiliations:__ Super Spot-Billed Duck Troops The spotted-billed duck with the cowboy hat and glasses. He always seems to be relaxed, no matter the situation. [Sanji](https://anilist.co/character/305/Sanji) rode on him on the way back to the Going Merry.

21.name: Bourbon Jr.
21.desc: __Height:__ 133cm __Affiliations:__ Super Spot-Billed Duck Troops The spotted-billed duck with sunglasses, a hat, and a bottle around his neck. [Nami](https://anilist.co/character/723/Nami) rode on him back to the Going Merry. (Source: One Piece Wiki)

21.name: Kentauros
21.desc: __Height:__ 157cm __Affiliations:__ Super Spot-Billed Duck Troops The spot-billed duck that smokes cigars, wears a dark Roman legionary's helmet, and always seems angry. He was [Zoro's](https://anilist.co/character/62/Zoro-Roronoa) duck on the way back to the Going Merry.

21.name: Hikoichi
21.desc: __Height:__ 138cm __Affiliations:__ Super Spot-Billed Duck Troops The spot-billed duck with a conical Asian hat, who has a rather surprised look on his face. [Chopper](https://anilist.co/character/309/Chopper-Tony-Tony) rode on him back to the Going Merry. (Source: One Piece Wiki)

21.name: Gimlet
21.desc: The infant son of [Senor Pink](https://anilist.co/character/141930) and [Russian](https://anilist.co/character/290147).

21.name: Anjou
21.desc: Anjou is a pirate admirer who witnessed the execution of [Gold Roger](https://anilist.co/character/4883/Roger-Gold). He has a tattoo of a jolly roger on his right arm.

21.name: Islewan
21.desc: __Affiliations:__ Whitebeard Pirates (former) Islewan was an early member of the Whitebeard Pirates, before becoming an infamous New World pirate captain of his own crew subordinate to [Whitebeard](https://anilist.co/character/2751/Newgate-Edward). He is a huge man with a face resembling that of a walrus and seems to be very courageous and to have a really strong bond with his crew.

21.name: Miss Friday
21.desc: __Affiliations:__ Baroque Works ~! (former) !~ __Occupations:__ Assassin ~! (former) !~ Miss Friday is a vulture and a member of the criminal organization Baroque Works, being a part of The Unluckies along with [Mr. 13](https://anilist.co/character/225866/Mr-13). They are a team that served as messengers for [Mr. 0](https://anilist.co/character/2749/Crocodile) and are also responsible for executing any Baroque Works agents that fail their missions.

21.name: Lilith
21.desc: ~!One of the six satellites of [Dr. Vegapunk](https://anilist.co/character/282077), embodying his aspect of "evil".!~

21.name: Atlas
21.desc: ~!One of the six satellites of [Dr. Vegapunk](https://anilist.co/character/282077), embodying his aspect of "violence".!~

21.name: Scarlett
21.desc: Scarlett was the first daughter of the Riku Family and the former crown princess of Dressrosa. ~!She was Violet's elder sister, Kyros' wife, and Rebecca's mother. She was killed by Diamante when Donquixote Pirates took over Dressrosa ten years ago.!~

21.name: Skull
21.desc: Skull is a member of the Spade Pirates and, subsequently, the Whitebeard Pirates. Skull has expert knowledge on pirates and their weapons. Because of this, he is easily able to recognize his enemies' weapons and quickly disarm them, and he wears a sword on his right hip. It is unknown how proficient he is with using it.

21.name: Kotatsu
21.desc: Kotatsu is a large lynx, and a member of the Spade Pirates. When he belonged in the freak show, Kotatsu was very cowardly. However, he grew to become more encouraged after spending time with his crew. As a large feline, Kotatsu is one of the main fighters of the Spade Pirates and fights with his claws.

21.name: Mihal
21.desc: "Indoor" Mihal is a member of the Spade Pirates and, subsequently, the Whitebeard Pirates. Mihal is a private person, as he'd rather be indoors reading than engaging in his crew's antics. He dislikes outdoor activities, earning the epithet "Indoor." Instead, he read books. He is also very selfless, as he became a teacher to help children who cannot get an education.

21.name: Doll
21.desc: Doll is a Marine Vice Admiral and Commander of the G-14 Marine Base.

21.name: Jaygarcia Saturn Sei
21.original: ジェイガルシア・サターン聖
21.desc: __Residence:__ Mary Geoise __Affiliations:__ Gorosei, World Government __Debut:__ Chapter 233 __Named:__ Chapter 1073 A member of the Gorosei, the de jure rulers of the World Government. ~!In reality, the Gorosei answer to the world's sovereign: Imu.!~ ~!Out of the Gorosei, he has the most lines on introduction. His words are themed around time, with him noting that preventing the awakening of the Hito Hito no Mi Model: Nika was a top priority, because "it is always important to eliminate dangerous variables."!~ ~!He showed regret during the Ohara incident, and found Vegapunk's refutation of the World Government's authority to be a matter of shame.!~

21.name: Bastille
21.desc: Bastille is a Vice Admiral in the Marines.

21.name: Zunesha
21.desc: Zunesha is a Naitamie-Norida elephant that was affiliated with Joy Boy 800 years ago. It now wanders through the New World and carries the island of Zou (home of the Mink Tribe) on its back as punishment for an unspecified crime it committed in the past. Zunesha is comparable to an island in sheer scale; its two-jointed legs are disproportionately and extremely long, such that it can walk on the sea floor while its upper body, including about a third of each leg, remains above the water. Zunesha has comparatively small eyes (shown to have turquoise, ringed irises in the anime) sunken deep into their sockets, being barely visible at most times and giving the impression that it has no eyes at all.

21.name: Ginny
21.desc: __Debut:__ Chapter 1095 __Affiliations:__ ~!Revolutionary Army (East Army); Freedom Fighters (former).!~ __Occupations:__ ~!East Army Captain of the Revolutionary Army, Slave (former).!~ __Residence:__ South Blue (Sorbet Kingdom) ~!Ginny is a former slave who was forced to take part in the Native Hunting Competition on God Valley 38 years ago. She and Ivankov are responsible for orchestrating the God Valley Incident 38 years ago as a mean to escape the Native Hunting Competition in God Valley.!~ ~!She was the mother of [Jewelry Bonney](https://anilist.co/character/20295/Jewelry-Bonney).!~ ~!She was captured by the World Government and became a wife to a World Noble. After contracting the Sapphire Scales disease, Ginny was released from slavery and used the little time remaining to her to return to the Sorbet Kingdom with her child, dying as a result.!~

21.name: Rolling Logan
21.original: ローリング・ローガン
21.desc: Rolling Logan is an army commander of the Majiatsuka Kingdom. As an army commander, Rolling Logan must have some experience in battle. He can crush opponents with his arm strength. ~!He joined as a gladiator at the Corrida Colosseum to compete for the Mera Mera no Mi. During the tournament in Dressrosa, he is sadistic and hungry for positive attention, bragging about how he was going to crush Rebecca just to receive cheers from the audience who despised her. However, he does have some sense of honor, as he chose to risk his own life in order to protect Monkey D. Luffy from Donquixote Doflamingo and give Luffy time to regain his strength and defeat the Warlord of the Sea.!~

21.name: York
21.desc: ~!One of the six satellites of [Dr. Vegapunk](https://anilist.co/character/282077), embodying his aspect of "greed".!~

21.name: Shaka
21.desc: ~!One of the six satellites of [Dr. Vegapunk](https://anilist.co/character/282077), embodying his aspect of "good".!~

21.name: Edison
21.desc: ~!One of the six satellites of [Dr. Vegapunk](https://anilist.co/character/282077), embodying his aspect of "thinking".!~

21.name: Pythagoras
21.desc: ~!One of the six satellites of [Dr. Vegapunk](https://anilist.co/character/282077), embodying his aspect of "wisdom".!~

21.name: Misery
21.desc: Misery is a homie created by Big Mom as an attack during the Raid on Onigashima. She is formed from the Maser Saber combination of Prometheus, Hera, and Napoleon.

21.name: Pandora
21.desc: Pandora is a sun homie that was created by Carmel, who placed a portion of her soul into a fire on Elbaf with the power of the Soru Soru no Mi.

21.name: Hera
21.desc: Hera is a thundercloud homie created by Big Mom at Wano Country as a replacement for Zeus. She is a special kind of homie, having received a soul fragment from Big Mom herself, and serves as one of her personal weapons alongside Prometheus and Napoleon.

21.name: Napoleon
21.desc: Napoleon the Bicorne is a homie taking the form of a bicorne hat that is worn by Big Mom. He can also become a sword homie that Big Mom uses in combat. He is a special kind of homie, as he received a soul fragment from Big Mom herself, and serves as one of her personal weapons alongside Prometheus and Hera, and formerly Zeus.

21.name: S-Snake
21.desc: S-Snake is a Seraphim-clone of [Boa Hancock](https://anilist.co/character/16342/Hancock-Boa) used by the world government as a weapon of justice. She uses the same devil fruit powers as her original counterpart and is a minor antagonist of the Final Saga.

21.name: Joy Boy
21.desc: Joy Boy was a man from the Great Kingdom born at the start of the Void Century. ~!Joy Boy ate the Hito Hito no Mi, Model: Nika, a Mythical Zoan-type Devil Fruit that allowed him to become an incarnation of the ever-playful sun god, Nika. It gave him a body with the properties of rubber, giving him the freedom to fight however he wanted.!~

21.name: Guernica
21.desc: __Affiliation:__ CP-0 __Debut:__ Chapter 705, Episode 635

21.name: Kujaku
21.desc: __Affiliations:__ Marines (SWORD) __Occupations:__ Rear Admiral __Devil Fruit:__ ~!Muchi Muchi no Mi (Whip-Whip Fruit)!~ __Devil Fruit Type:__ ~!Paramecia!~ Kujaku is a Marine Rear Admiral stationed at Marine Base G-14 and also a member of SWORD. She is the granddaughter of Marine Vice Admiral Tsuru. She is a domineering woman who often employs flirtatious, yet abusive language, not shying away to use it on her fellow Marines or even superiors.

21.name: Prince Grus
21.desc: __Affiliations:__ Marines (SWORD) __Occupations:__ Rear Admiral __Devil Fruit:__ ~!Gunyo Gunyo no Mi (Glorp-Glorp Fruit)!~ Prince Grus is a Marine Rear Admiral stationed at Marine base G-14 and a member of SWORD.

21.name: Hibari
21.desc: __Affiliations:__ Marines (SWORD) __Occupations:__ Commander Hibari is a Marine Commander and a member of SWORD. She is an emotional young woman who is willing to put herself in danger for the sake of an ally. She is kind and considerate towards others, but somewhat bashful and embarrassed over how a boy like Koby may interpret her gestures. She speaks with a Hiroshima dialect.

21.name: Maha
21.desc: __Affiliation:__ CP-0 __Debut:__ Chapter 929, Episode 922

21.name: Gismonda
21.desc: __Affiliation:__ CP-0 __Debut:__ Chapter 705, Episode 635

21.name: Joseph
21.desc: __Affiliation:__ CP-0 __Debut:__ Chapter 705, Episode 635

21.name: Loki
21.desc: __Debut:__ Chapter 1130 __Occupation:__ Prince __Origin:__ Grand Line (Elbaph) __Residence:__ Elbaph __Bounty:__ ~!2,600,000,000!~ Loki is a prince of Elbaph, being the son of King Harald, and the younger brother of Hajrudin. He was once arranged to marry Charlotte Lola, which would have allied Elbaph with the Big Mom Pirates, until Lola ran away. ~!Known as the "Accursed Prince" and the "Shame of Elbaph", he is currently imprisoned after killing his father in order to obtain an unspecified Devil Fruit. Loki refers to himself as the Sun God, a deity worshiped by Elbaph's populace, and claims he will be the one to "end the world".!~

21.name: Mishoin Cashible
21.original: ミショイン・キャシブル
21.desc: Salesman based in Water 7 who rents Bulls to ferry people around the canals.

21.name: Shamrock Figarland
21.original: フィガーランド・シャムロック
21.desc: Shamrock Figarland is the commander of the Holy Knights and a World Noble of the Figarland Family, being the son of [Saint Figarland Garling](https://anilist.co/character/354399).

21.name: Gunko Manmayer
21.desc: __Devil Fruit:__ Aro Aro no Mi (Arrow-Arrow Fruit) Gunko is a World Noble and a member of the Knights of God. ~!She was previously known as Princess Shuri, the daughter of King Reuven and Queen Candelle of Esperia Kingdom, and was acquainted with Brook, although her memories of the past are seemingly repressed by Nerona Imu. She is believed to have killed Reuven, who was Brook's benefactor.!~

21.name: Figarland Garling Sei
21.original: フィガーランド・ガーリング聖
21.desc: Saint Figarland Garling is one of the Five Elders who publicly head the World Government, holding the title Warrior God of Science and Defense. A World Noble who hails from the Figarland Family, Garling is the father of [Shamrock](https://anilist.co/character/354397/Shamrock-Figarland), a commander of the God's Knights.

21.name: Marcus Mars Sei
21.desc: Saint Marcus Marsis is a World Noble and one of the Five Elders who publicly head the World Government, holding the title of Warrior God of Environment.

21.name: Ethanbaron V Nusjurou Sei
21.original: イーザンバロン・V・ナス寿郎聖
21.desc: Saint Ethanbaron V. Nusjurou is a World Noble and one of the Five Elders who publicly head the World Government, holding the title of Warrior God of Finance.

21.name: Shepherd Juu Peter Sei
21.original: シェパード・十・ピーター聖
21.desc: Saint Shepherd Ju Peter is a World Noble and one of the Five Elders who publicly head the World Government, holding the title of Warrior God of Agriculture.

21.name: Topman Warcury Sei
21.original: トップマン・ウォーキュリー聖
21.desc: Saint Topman Warcury is a World Noble and one of the Five Elders who publicly head the World Government, holding the title of Warrior God of Justice.

21.name: S-Hawk
21.desc: S-Hawk is one of the Seraphim and a clone of Dracule Mihawk.

21.name: Onimaru
21.desc: Onimaru is a komagitsune who was once the companion of the late daimyo of Ringo, Shimotsuki Ushimaru. After the death of his master, he joined forces with Kawamatsu in collecting weapons for the final battle against Kaidou and protecting them from robbers. After Kawamatsu was captured, Onimaru posed as a human known as Gyukimaru on Oihagi Bridge, stealing weapons from people while continuing to guard the graves.

21.name: Emet
21.desc: Robot created around the time of the Void Century who was a friend of Joy Boy.

21.name: Hildon
21.desc: Hildon is a wild zombie that looks like a stitched up vampire.

21.name: Bjorn
21.desc: Bjorn is a member of the Giant Warrior Pirates.

21.name: Sig
21.desc: Sig is a member of the Giant Warrior Pirates.

21.name: Thormann
21.desc: Thormann is a member of the Giant Warrior Pirates.

21.name: Piper
21.desc: Piper is a giant owl owned by Gerd.

21.name: Lily Enstomach
21.original: リリー・エンストマック

21.name: Aegir

20605.name: Ken Kaneki
20605.desc: __Height:__ 169 cm (5'6") Ken Kaneki was originally a human and a normal college student until he encountered a female ghoul named [Rize](https://anilist.co/character/88413/Rize-Kamishiro) who was posing as a human at the time. Rize, using Kaneki's crush on her as leverage, managed to lure him into an alley and tried to eat him but ended up dying when construction beams fell on top of her. Kaneki, already in a half-dead state from Rize's attempts at killing him, ends up in a hospital and has some of Rize's organs transplanted into his body. This results in him absorbing some of Rize's powers and characteristics, such as a ghoul eye, powers of regeneration, and the inability to stomach human food. Terrified and lost, Kaneki's life takes a dramatic turn from then on as he tries to find a place for himself in the world, realizing he now belongs to neither the human nor ghoul world and refusing to eat humans to sustain himself. Meeting some of the ​other ghouls, as well as humans, makes him realize that things aren't just black and white and that there are more to ghouls and humans than originally thought.

20605.name: Touka Kirishima
20605.desc: __Height:__ 156 cm (5'1") Touka is a ghoul successfully posing as a human and working as a waitress at a cafe which serves as a gathering place for other ghouls, as well as a food resource. She saves [Kaneki](https://anilist.co/character/87275/Kaneki-Ken)'s life at one point and acts as a reluctant guide to him and his adaptation to the ghoul society. She doesn't like Kaneki much and has no qualms about expressing her dislike for him. She is very serious, tough and hard-working, trying to keep their district as safe for ghouls and humans as possible. Her powers and strength are also quite great and she makes for a formidable opponent.

20605.name: Hinami Fueguchi
20605.desc: __Height:__ 148 cm - 152 cm (4'10" - 4'11") Hinami is a child ghoul whose parents were killed by ghoul investigators. Before, she and her mother seek help from the owner of the Antique Cafe to acquire food. Hinami is initially quite shy, but when she opens up, she is cheerful and earnest. [Ken](https://anilist.co/character/87275/Kaneki-Ken) helps her learn kanji, as she cannot attend school, and is very eager to learn. Currently, she is living together with [Touka Kirishima](https://anilist.co/character/87277/Kirishima-Touka).

20605.name: Koutarou Amon
20605.desc: __Height:__ 191 cm (6'3") A first class police investigator who investigates Ghouls, also known as a Dove. He comes to the 20th ward with his mentor, [Mado Kureo](https://anilist.co/character/88423), to investigate Ghoul incidents in the area. He has a strong sense of justice, fervently believing it is the right and moral thing to do to exterminate the Ghouls. He hunts the Ghouls in order to prevent more human children from becoming orphaned like himself, and he often works after hours to achieve his goals. He wields a "Quinque" (a weapon made from the "Kagune" of a Ghoul) that has the appearance of a pole-arm with a large cylindrical bludgeon at the end.

20605.name: Yukinori Shinohara
20605.desc: A Special Class Ghoul Investigator. In the past, he acted as Koutarou Amon's instructor at the Academy.

20605.name: Nishiki Nishio
20605.desc: __Height:__ 177 cm (5'9") Nishiki Nishio is a ghoul whose original feeding ground was taken from Rize. He is a sophomore in the Pharmaceutical Department of Kamii University and Kimi Nishino's boyfriend.

20605.name: Kimi Nishino
20605.desc: Kimi Nishino is a assistant for Akihiro Kanou who aids in his ghoulification experiments, the previous human lover of Nishiki Nishio and a medical student at Kamii University.~!Although she is aware of his ghoul nature, she remained loyal to him and kept his secret. After the Owl Suppression Operation, he left her in order to keep her safe.!~

20605.name: Ayato Kirishima
20605.desc: __Height:__ 159 cm (5'2") Ayato Kirishima is [Touka Kirishima](https://anilist.co/character/87277/Touka-Kirishima)'s younger brother. He grew up with his sister in the 20th ward but at some point of time, he disappeared. Currently, he is an executive of Aogiri Tree. An arrogant youth with a similar harsh attitude that resembles his sister. Other than physical looks, he shares many similarities with Touka such as his cold, hotblooded attitude and a habit for kicking people. However, he's more harsh compared to her and surprisingly nicer than his Aogiri superiors.

20605.name: Juuzou Suzuya
20605.desc: __Height:__ 160 cm (5'3") A Rank 3 Ghoul Investigator. In the past, he went by the name Rei Suzuya. He is the partner of [Yukinori Shinohara](https://anilist.co/character/88408). He is a young man with androgynous appearance. He has many stitches used as both first-aid and fashion. His hair is tied with a stitching string in a roman numeral 13 pattern, with large pupils that leaves an eerie and frightening impression.

20605.name: Rize Kamishiro
20605.desc: __Height:__ 164 cm Rize Kamishiro is a ghoul that was hanging out at Anteiku. She set her eyes on [Ken Kaneki](https://anilist.co/character/87275/Kaneki-Ken), but moments before eating him, she died in an accident and her organs were transplanted in Ken Kaneki, making him half-ghoul.

20605.name: Uta
20605.desc: __Height:__ 177 cm A ghoul that has his own art studio where he makes masks for other ghouls. He has a lot of piercings and tattoos on his body, making him look pretty intimidating, even as a normal-looking human. He's the one who also made a mask for Kaneki.

20605.name: Itori
20605.desc: Itori is an old friend of Yomo and Uta. She can be found in Helter Skelter bar, where she makes her share in the information web of the underworld. Itori is over friendly and talkative. She likes having fun and even doing pranks. Her bad point might be her using people like toys to get the information she wants.

20605.name: Enji Koma
20605.desc: Enji Koma is a ghoul and a waiter at Anteiku. He is an expert coffee brewer. In his youth, he was known as the Devil Ape and led the Apes ghoul gang.

20605.name: Taro-chan
20605.desc: Taro is a scrapper of the Ghoul Restaurant and owned by Madam A.

20605.name: Tatara
20605.desc: A direct subordinate of the One-Eyed King and one of Aogiri Tree's leaders. He was a former member of the Chinese ghoul organization Chi She Lian. As one of the Aogiri Tree leaders and a trusted subordinate working under the One-Eyed King, Tatara comes off as a rather loyal individual. He is portrayed as composed and stoic mostly. He often monitors the activities of the Aogiri executives, but kills in cold-blood when embarking on a mission. He is also proud of his immense stamina when fighting and the accuracy of his calculations as well. Tatara seems to have a taste for precision; as shown when he turns down Kaneki considering he's an artificial one-eyed ghoul. He appears to hold a grudge against Houji, to the extent that even the Quinque associated with him, is enough to make him enraged and lose his near unflappable composure. As the second-in-command of Aogiri, it can be inferred that he is quite powerful.

20605.name: Nico
20605.desc: __Species:__ Ghoul __Height:__ 175 cm __Affiliations:__ Clown Mask Ghoul Gang A gay ghoul (okama) in love. He was once acting together with Yamori and participating in Aogiri Tree.

20605.name: Hideyoshi Nagachika
20605.desc: __Race:__ Human Hideyoshi is a normal human and the best friend of [Ken Kaneki](https://anilist.co/character/87275/Kaneki-Ken). Hide is incredibly observant and can figure things out about people in a almost sherlock-like manner. He also becomes interested in things and works hard on them until he finds something else to interest him.

20605.name: Ryouko Fueguchi
20605.desc: [Hinami](https://anilist.co/character/88293/Hinami-Fueguchi)'s mother.

20605.name: Kureo Mado
20605.desc: __Height:__ 177 cm A senior first class investigator, or a "Dove," who hunts Ghouls. He is Amon's mentor and partner. He hunts Ghouls with a maniacal glee, and believes that all Ghouls are lesser than humans, calling them "trash," and mocking them for trying to "imitate" human behavior. Mado is a fanatic about collecting Ghoul's "Kagune" (their extra limbs) and making them into "Quinque," or weapons that Doves use to kill Ghouls.

20605.name: Shuu Tsukiyama
20605.desc: __Height:__ 180 cm Shuu Tsukiyama was the infamous Gourmet ghoul of the 20th ward. He was a fourth-year student studying Social Welfare at the Department of Human Sciences at Seinan Gakuin University. He comes from the extremely wealthy and influential Tsukiyama family which his father, Mirumo Tsukiyama was the head of. Tsukiyama himself became the head of his family after the Tsukiyama Family Extermination Operation. He was also a member of the Ghoul Restaurant, known as MM until he betrayed them. He joined Kaneki's group with the hidden intention of eating Ken Kaneki, obsessed with his scent and taste but eventually came to genuinely care for Kaneki. Two years later, his severe depression and anorexia after Kaneki's apparent demise left him emaciated and required constant care from his family servants. After finding out Kaneki was alive and meeting him, he recovers, being able to walk and eat on his own as well as take measures to help Kaneki regain his memories.

20605.name: Yakumo Oomori
20605.desc: A white-haired brute with sharp lizard eyes. Yamori is ghoul who is as scary as he looks. Normally in a entirely white suit and black dress shirt, he resembles a typical gangster.

20605.name: Akira Mado
20605.desc: __Species:__ Human __Height:__ 164 cm __Affiliations:__ CCG __Quinque:__ Amatsu (Koukaku/Bikaku) __Likes:__ making quinques, solving puzzles and cats Akira Mado is a Rank 2 Ghoul Investigator and Kureo's daughter. She is currently partnered with Koutarou Amon. She is an intelligent woman and seems to be always serious about work and her daily routine in general. Like her father, she has deep insight and intuition that helps her in investigation and determining what is going on around her while on the field. She shares her father's "quinque-mania," but it is not as extreme as his was. Akira remains professional in most situations, no matter who she is faced with, and she isn't one to admit her own feelings on a subject unless provoked to a certain degree. Seen through her interactions with others, it is most likely that she would prefer to make a quinque rather than to interact with someone else.

20605.name: Kishou Arima
20605.desc: __Height:__ 180 cm __Quinque:__ IXA (Koukaku), Narukami (Ukaku), Yukimura 1/3 (Koukaku) Kishou Arima is a famed Special Class Ghoul Investigator known as the CCG's Reaper. He is undefeated as a Ghoul Investigator and at some point was formerly partnered with Take Hirako. His investigative skills and prowess in combat has led many investigators such as [Koutarou Amon](https://anilist.co/character/88407/Koutarou-Amon) to admire him. __Tokyo Ghoul:Re__ ~!He later passes down his Yukimura 1/3 (Koukaku) quinque to [Sasaki Haise](https://anilist.co/character/87275/Ken-Kaneki), a rank 1 investigator and mentor of Quinx squad. Along with [Akira Mado](https://anilist.co/character/88838/Akira-Mado), he is the overseer of the Quinx squad and keeps a check on Sasaki Haise along with the Quinx members.!~

20605.name: Noro
20605.desc: He is one of the direct subordinates of the King of an Eye and one of the leaders of the Aogiri Tree, next to Tatara. In the past he was called Noroi and was responsible for raising Eto, when Kuzen surrendered in District 24. He is a giant who intimidates with an overwhelming silence, seems to communicate only through actions, not words.

20605.name: Seidou Takizawa
20605.desc: __Height:__ 171 cm Takizawa is a Rank 2 Ghoul Investigator. A classmate of [Akira Mado](https://anilist.co/character/88838/Akira-Mado) at the Academy, he is partnered with Kousuke Houji and assigned to the 20th ward to investigate the Gourmet. He greatly respects [Kishou Arima](https://anilist.co/character/88946/Kishou-Arima) and [Koutarou Amon](https://anilist.co/character/88407/Koutarou-Amon) and admires their achievements. ~!Though he was declared among the casualties of the raid in the 20th Ward, it is revealed that he had actually survived as artificial one-eyed ghoul. He is now a member of Aogiri Tree. As an artificial one-eyed ghoul, he is known as Owl. After betraying Aogiri and killing [Tatara](https://anilist.co/character/88418/Tatara), Takizawa reunited with Akira Mado, and became a member of Ken Kaneki's organization, Goat. !~

20605.name: Yoshimura
20605.desc: Yoshimura is a ghoul and the manager of the Anteiku cafe. He tries to help every ghoul, especially those who can't hunt themselves. He takes in Ken Kaneki and tries to help him survive being a ghoul. ~!He is Eto's father.!~

20605.name: Itsuki Marude
20605.desc: Itsuki is a Special Class Ghoul Investigator. He is the commander of the 11th Ward Special Countermeasures Unit and Chief of Division II.

20605.name: Kousuke Houji
20605.desc: Kousuke is a Special Class Investigator and a former partner of Kureo Mado prior to a major assignment in China. He was previously assigned to the 20th Ward as the partner of Seidou Takizawa and worked on the Gourmet case. He's devoted to the mastery of quinque and is said to have surpassed Kureo. Currently, he serves as a member of the illustrious S3 Squad. (Source: Tokyo Ghoul Wikia)

20605.name: Renji Yomo
20605.desc: __Height:__ 182 cm (5'11") Renji Yomo is a worker at Anteiku and the right hand of [Yoshimura](https://anilist.co/character/136024/Yoshimura). He is an old friend of [Uta](https://anilist.co/character/88414/Uta) and [Itori](https://anilist.co/character/88415/Itori). Because of his scavenging habits and long-beaked, avian mask, he has the nickname of "Raven."

20605.name: Akihiro Kanou
20605.desc: Akihiro Kanou, often referred to as Professor Kanou, is a physician at Kanou General Hospital.

20605.name: Arata Kirishima
20605.desc: Father of Touka Kirishima and Ayato Kirishima. Virtuous and gentle, Arata is a pacifist ghoul who is content to live peacefully with humans and wants the same for his children. ~!Arata's status is currently unknown. However, it is known that his kagune is currently being used as CCG's new exoskeleton armor.!~

20605.name: Yoriko Kosaka
20605.desc: A university friend of Touka's. In :re she is revealed to be working in a bakery, often frequented by Rank1 Ghoul Inspector Takeomi Kuroiwa, son of the Special Class Ghoul Investigator Iwao Kuroiwa. ~!Takeomi proposes to Yoriko in chapter 104 of :re!~

20605.name: Kuramoto Itou
20605.desc: __Height:__ 172 cm Kuramoto Itou is a First Class Ghoul Investigator and the deputy squad leader of the Hirako Squad.

20605.name: Hetare
20605.desc: Hetare is a cockatiel parrot who lived in Anteiku prior to its destruction. Hetare is a plump bird with pale, yellow feathers and grey wings. As is common with cockatiels, he has orange circles on his cheeks, and a wispy crest protruding from the top of his head. His most notable feature is the star mark on his left wing, hence Renji Yomo's alternate nickname for him.

20605.name: Maiko Abe
20605.desc: __Height:__ 160 cm Maiko is a member of the Ghoul Restaurant

20605.name: Asaki Fueguchi
20605.desc: Hinami's father.

20605.name: Kaya Irimi
20605.desc: Kaya Irimi is a waitress working at Anteiku.

20605.name: Ayumu Hogi
20605.desc: Ayumu is a First Class Investigator from the CCG and Vice-Chief of Chuu Hachikawa's squad. Ayumu was part of the Squad 3 in the Anteiku raid.

20605.name: Misato Gori
20605.desc: Misato Gori is a Rank 2 Ghoul Investigator. She is currently affiliated with the 13th ward.

20605.name: Ippei Kusaba
20605.desc: Ippei Kusaba was a Rank 3 Bureau Investigator working at CCG's branch in the 20th ward and the partner of Yasunori Nakajima.

20605.name: Yasunori Nakajima
20605.desc: Yasunori Nakajima is a bureau investigator working at CCG's branch in the 20th ward and was the partner of Ippei Kusaba.

20605.name: Older Bin-Brother
20605.desc: Masked ghoul brothers and executives of Aogiri Tree. Most of the ghouls in the 11th ward of Aogiri Tree are their subordinates. It is said they strongly believe in the one eyed king's ideology. Their Kagune is of the Bikaku type.

20605.name: Bin Kyoudai
20605.desc: Masked ghoul brothers and executives of Aogiri Tree. Most of the ghouls in the 11th ward of Aogiri Tree are their subordinates. It is said they strongly believe in the one eyed king's ideology. Their Kagune is of the Bikaku type.

20605.name: Katsuya Mabuchi
20605.desc: Katsuya Mabuchi is a ghoul investigator. He is the subordinate of Itsuki Marude and is normally seen standing beside Marude.

20605.name: Taguchi
20605.desc: Taguchi is a nurse at Kanou General Hospital.

20605.name: Souta
20605.desc: Souta was a member of the Ghoul Restaurant, where he went by the alias PG. He hides his face with a clown mask.

20605.name: Kazuo Yoshida
20605.desc: __Species:__ Ghoul __Height:__ 179 cm Kazuo Yoshida is a ghoul who Ken met in a dark alley and moments later was killed by Nishiki Nishio since he was feeding on his turf. He also appeared in omake at the end of some volumes and worked as Chief Instructor in the Fitness Club "ZEN."

20605.name: Hisashi Ogura
20605.desc: Hisashi Ogura is a ghoul researcher. He often goes on TV programs to speak about them.

20958.name: Narrator
20958.desc: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

20958.name: Mikasa Ackerman
20958.original: ミカサ・アッカーマン
20958.desc: __Height:__ 170 cm (5'7") - 176 cm (5'9½") __Position:__ 104th Training Corps, Survey Corps __Relatives:__ [Birth Mother](https://anilist.co/character/84341/Mikasa-no-Haha) (Deceased), [Birth Father](https://anilist.co/character/84339/Mikasa-no-Chichi) (Deceased), [Grisha Yaeger](https://anilist.co/character/62477/Grisha-Yeager) (Foster Father), [Carla Yaeger](https://anilist.co/character/62475/Carla-Yeager) (Foster Mother, Deceased), [Eren Yeager](https://anilist.co/character/40882/Eren-Yeager) (Foster Brother) Mikasa is Eren Yaeger's foster sister and mutual childhood friend of [Armin Arlert](https://anilist.co/character/46494), living with the two of them in Shiganshina District within the southern region of Wall Maria. When she was young, her parents were killed by human traffickers, and she was kidnapped. Eren discovered this and helped her escape her captors. Later, Eren gave her his scarf, which she constantly wears and shares an emotional attachment to. She was adopted by the Yaeger family soon after. Because of these past events, Mikasa shares an unbreakable bond with Eren and lives to protect him, constantly worrying for Eren's well-being. After the Titans broke through Wall Maria and killed her and Eren's mother, she chose to follow Eren into the military to try and keep him safe from danger. Even as a child, Mikasa possessed impressive fighting skill and strength, and that skill was only honed further during her training. Mikasa is considered a genius among all th

20958.name: Eren Yeager
20958.desc: __Height:__ 170 cm (5'7") - 183 cm (6'0") __Affiliation:__ 104th Trainees Squad, Survey Corps. Eren was born to [Carla](https://anilist.co/character/62475/Yeager-Carla) and [Grisha Yeager](https://anilist.co/character/62477/Yeager-Grisha) in Shiganshina District within the southern region of Wall Maria. He grew up in the town with his parents and foster sister [Mikasa](https://anilist.co/character/40881/Ackerman-Mikasa), who moved in with the Yeagers as a child. Eren spent most of his time with Mikasa and their mutual best friend [Armin Arlert](https://anilist.co/character/46494/Arlert-Armin), whom the pair often defended from neighborhood bullies. Eren is a passionate, determined, hardheaded, and impulsive young man. When they were children, Armin showed him a book depicting the wonders of the outside world. Eren grew to share Armin's curiosity of the world beyond the Walls and resolved to see it for himself. This dream inspired his admiration of the Survey Corps and his desire to join their ranks as soon as he became eligible for enrollment. When the Titans suddenly broke through Wall Maria into Shiganshina, Eren was forced to watch on as his mother became trapped under the rubble of their house and eaten by a titan. Forever changed from this event, Eren vows to kill every last titan.

20958.name: Levi
20958.desc: __Height:__ 160 cm (5'3") Squad Captain of the Special Operations Squad (known as Squad Levi) within the Survey Corps. He is known as humanity's strongest soldier. Levi is abrasive, blunt, and has a strong respect for structure and discipline. He is a clean-freak, demanding spotless cleanliness of himself, his equipment, and his environment. Rumors say he was involved in underground crime in his life before coming a soldier. Despite his emotionless and unfriendly demeanor, Levi cares deeply for his squad and greatly values human life.

20958.name: Sasha Blouse
20958.desc: __Initial Height:__ 168cm __Affiliations__: 104th Cadet Corps, Survey Corps; Soldier __Relatives__: [Artur Blouse](https://anilist.co/character/131281/Artur-Blouse) (Father), [Lisa Blouse](https://anilist.co/character/134952/Lisa-Blouse) (Mother) Originally from Dauper, a remote and scarcely populated village of hunters located in a mountain forest in the southern area of Wall Rose, Sasha joined the military as a cadet of the 104th Training Corps, where she ranked 9th upon graduation. After graduating, she'd choose to enlist in the Scouting Regiment. Sasha is a friendly and fun-loving girl. She speaks with a local accent from her home village, but initially hid it out of embarrassment by using overly formal and polite speech. She is a constant food hoarder and is known to have an incredible appetite; eating provided her with considerable gratification and relief, especially during times of great stress, and food was often the only thing on her mind when at ease. Raised as an animal hunter, Sasha specializes in archery, horseback riding, and tracking, although her eccentricity and unconventional methods tend to make her a poor fit for group operations. ~!She later saves a child named [Kaya](https://anilist.co/character/132738/Kaya) from a titan attack, who her family ends up adopting.!~

20958.name: Reiner Braun
20958.desc: __Height__: 185 cm (6'1") Member of the Survey Corps and former cadet of the 104th Training Corps. Reiner is a passionate and strong-willed young man with a strong sense of duty. He ranked 2nd in his training class upon graduation, finishing behind only [Mikasa](https://anilist.co/character/40881). His comrades have great trust in him, and he is stated to be the "big brother" of the 104th cadets.

20958.name: Connie Springer
20958.original: コニー・スプリンガー
20958.desc: __Height__: 158 cm (5'2") __Relatives:__ [Mother](https://anilist.co/character/137287/Conny-no-Haha), Martin Springer (Brother), Sunny Springer (Sister) Connie Springer is a graduate of the 104th Training Corps, having ranked 8th in class. He is known to be one of the quickest soldiers while using ODM gear and is skilled at making very sharp turns. He hails from the rural Ragako Village within Wall Rose, his greatest ambition being to make his family and village proud of him. Upon graduation, he chose to join the Survey Corps. Upbeat and naive, Connie is rather unfocused outside of combat, and enjoys goofing around and messing with his friends, but can also be a bit dense at times, as he can have some difficulty comprehending new developments as they appear. Connie always tries to remain optimistic, consistently caring for the well-being of his friends, family and village, and being willing to help in any way he can. However, this soft spot and the struggles he goes through as a member of the Survey Corps takes a toll on him, as he often responds to grief and loss with anger, irritation and hatred, causing him to at times make rash, impulsive decisions. He will do anything to protect his family, whether it be his biological family or his closest friends.

20958.name: Bertolt Hoover
20958.original: ベルトルト・フーバー
20958.desc: __Height__: 192 cm (6'3") __Affiliation__: Survey Corps Member of the Survey Corps and former cadet of the 104th Training Corps. Bertoldt ranked 3rd in his training class upon graduation, finishing behind only [Mikasa](https://anilist.co/character/40881) and his hometown friend [Reiner](https://anilist.co/character/46484). He is a quiet young man who identifies himself as someone with a weak will that follows popular opinion. Despite ranking 3rd in his class, his training commandant noted him to be a person with great potential, but an utter lack of initiative. Bertoldt originally he enlisted in the military with aspirations of joining the Military Police and living in the safety of the inner wall, but after the Battle of Trost he instead decided to join the Survey Corps.

20958.name: Annie Leonhart
20958.desc: __Height__: 153 cm (5") A member of the 104th Southern Division in the Cadet Corps. After graduating from the 104th, ranked 4th place in the top 10, she ends up joining the Military Police. She is roommates with [Hitch Dreyse](https://anilist.co/character/86017). A stoic girl, Annie is considered to be an isolated, solitary type, being rarely seen smiling or socializing and often having an emotionless expression. She is apathetic and somnolent, with little desire to put in any effort into meaningless disciplines or activities. Nonetheless, what drives Annie more than anything is her desire for a normal life.

20958.name: Hannes
20958.desc: A soldier who saves Eren and Mikasa during the prologue. He owes a debt to the Yeager family.

20958.name: Armin Arlert
20958.original: アルミン・アルレルト
20958.desc: __Height:__ 163 cm (5'4") __Position:__ 104th Trainees Squad, Survey Corps __Relatives:__ [Grandfather](https://anilist.co/character/84313/Armin-no-Ojiisan) Armin is a young boy who was born and raised in the Shiganshina District within the walls, being childhood friends with both [Eren Yeager](https://anilist.co/character/40882/Eren-Yeager) and [Mikasa Ackerman](https://anilist.co/character/40881). After Wall Maria was breached, he chose to join Mikasa and Eren in joining the military, both to try to make a good and meaningful impact on the world, and to fulfill his dream of seeing the outside world. Even when he was young, the naturally curious Armin has always had a deep fascination with the world beyond the Walls. As a child, he found and studied an illegal book about the outside world that was owned by his grandfather. He often shared the book and information contained in it with Eren Yeager, his best friend, and his dreams of seeing the world outside the walls. Armin was branded a heretic by other children for his unusual interest in the outside world and was thus frequently picked on. Too timid to defend himself, Armin would often rely on his friends Eren and Mikasa Ackerman to protect him from local bullies. This, coupled with his frail physique, was a deep shame for Armin, leading him to have poor self-esteem and to believe that he is a burden to others. Because of this, Armin has always been very eager to prove his worth, especially towards his close friends. Armin

20958.name: Erwin Smith
20958.desc: **Height:** 188 cm **Position:** 13th Commander, Survey Corps Discerning, intelligent, and widely respected, Erwin is the unshakable and calculated 13th commander of the Survey Corps. While he cares deeply for his men, he does not hesitate to sacrifice them for the good and prosperity of mankind, and his men have proven more than willing to stake their lives at his order. Erwin developed the Long-Distance Enemy Scouting Formation.

20958.name: Jean Kirstein
20958.original: ジャン・キルシュタイン
20958.desc: __Height__: 175 cm (5'8") __Relatives__: [Mother](https://anilist.co/character/131444/Jean-no-Haha) Jean Kirschtein is a graduate of the 104th Cadet Corps, among whom he ranked 6th for his skills with ODM gear and ability to look at things through a more tactical lense. Jean hails from Wall Rose's Trost District, and joined the military with hopes of living a peaceful life within the walls as part of the Military Police. However, he would later find himself joining the Survey Corps after being convinced both by his close friend [Marco Bott's](https://anilist.co/character/62479/Marco-Bott) words, and after witnessing the death of several of his comrades. Jean has a blunt personality. He holds no restraint when it comes to speaking his mind, even when he knows it would not be wise to do so or when it could spark conflict. Jean is also pragmatic: he has a strong aversion to exposing himself to dangerous situations. During his time as a cadet, Jean was extremely hot-headed, easily becoming frustrated and quick to resort to violence when pushed. Jean was also very cynical about defeating the Titans, believing that humanity has no chance against them and openly mocking more idealistic individuals like [Eren Yeager](https://anilist.co/character/40882/Eren-Yeager), and saw resisting the Titans as a hopeless cause. However, despite these things, and although he presents himself as self-centered, Jean places high value on the lives of his comrades, and is willing to risk his life to pr

20958.name: Carla Yeager
20958.desc: Eren's mother. ~!She's eaten alive in the second chapter.!~ Note: Carla Yeager is the official English translation by Kodansha.

20958.name: Marco Bott
20958.desc: __Height__: 178 cm (5'9") __Affiliations__: 104th Training Corps Originally from Jinae District. Marco ranked 7th in the 104th Training Corps and is widely respected by other cadets of the 104th. Marco is a very kind, calm, and idealistic person, valuing the good of the group above his own interests, as well as understanding and coping with his own shortcomings and limitations. He is seen as a natural leader, and desires to join the Military Police to serve near the King. *Note: Marco Bott is the official English translation by Kodansha.*

20958.name: Krista Lenz
20958.desc: __Height__: 145 cm (4'8") __Affiliations__: 104th Trainees Squad, Survey Corps Ranked tenth in the trainee class, Krista is a very shy and kind, caring person, often being described as a "goddess" or "angel" by her peers. She is good friends with [Ymir](https://anilist.co/character/71479/Ymir).

20958.name: Dot Pixis
20958.desc: The highest-ranked Administrator of the Southern Region. Head of the Garrison's Southern Territories, Pixis is a cunning leader with astute insights. However, he is also an alcoholic who is constantly watched over by his aid, [Anka](https://anilist.co/character/84331/Anka-Rheinberger), who constantly scolds him for sleeping and drinking during critical moments.

20958.name: Mike Zacharias
20958.desc: Squad Captain of his own squad, Squad Mike, a major division within the Survey Corps. He has been described by others as "humanity's second strongest soldier", being only behind [Levi](https://anilist.co/character/45627/Levi). Mike is an extremely strong and durable soldier and an acknowledged leader with a brave heart and a tactical mind. He also has a remarkably good sense of smell, which allows him to detect Titans from great distances. During times of ease, Mike is shown to be a quiet and reserved man, rarely speaking unless it concerned a more serious matter. He also has a bizarre habit of "sniffing" people when he meets them.

20958.name: Hange Zoe
20958.desc: __Height:__ 170 cm (5'7") __Affiliation:__ Survey Corps; Section Commander, Squad Leader. Leader of the Survey Corps' Fourth Squad, Hange is also in charge of conducting research on Titans, and pursues this knowledge so passionately that they have become obsessed with Titans as a result. After originally holding a deep hatred for the creatures, Hange decided to take on a new outside-the-box approach to their research by letting go of their resentment towards Titans and approaching the test subjects with compassion. Hange is an energetic, freethinking and quirky scientist, with a unique way of conducting both themselves and their work. Hange is a genius outside of just Titan research too, using their brain to create weapons, tactical plans, and inventions for the benefit of humanity. As a leader, Hange is thoughtful of their comrades, and can easily figure out complex problems in order to create plans for their teammates to carry out.

20958.name: Nick
20958.desc: Pastor Nick is a member of a religion that worships the Walls as holy. He claims that he lost his family as a result of addiction to Vine. As a religious leader, Pastor Nick used his influence to oppose any modification of the walls, be it permanently sealing the gates or even mounting cannons on the top. Though he claimed it was blasphemy for humans to "maim" the wall, ~!the real reason was to reduce the risk of workers discovering the Titans within during renovations.!~ (Source: Shingeki no Kyojin Wikia) Note: Minister Nick is the official English translation by Kodansha.

20958.name: Keiji
20958.desc: Member of the Scouting Legion.

20958.name: Marlo Freudenberg
20958.original: マルロ・フロイデンベルク
20958.desc: __Affiliations:__ Military Police, 104th Cadet Corps. Recruit of the Military Police stationed in Stohess District. While most who join the Military Police Regiment do so because they want a safe position far from the danger of the Titans, Marlo did so because he claims to want "to uphold justice and do what's right.", much to the amusement of his fellow officer, [Hitch Dreyse](https://anilist.co/character/86017/Hitch-Dreyse), whom he often clashes with due to them being near complete opposites. His goal is to rise to the top of the organization so he can stop the pilfering of taxes and misappropriation of land. Though steadfast in his idealism, he could make moral compromises to achieve his goal, confessing a willingness to act like "scum" in order to move up in rank. Due to his passion towards his ideals, he had often been compared to [Eren Yeager](https://anilist.co/character/40882/Eren-Yeager) by people who know both of them.

20958.name: Ymir
20958.desc: __Height:__ 172 cm (5'7") __Affiliations:__ 104th Trainees Squad, Scouting Legion Member of the Scouting Legion. She seems selfish, cynical, bossy, sly, uncooperative, exploitative, and confrontational, but she can apparently be kind, especially to [Krista](https://anilist.co/character/62481/Krista-Lenz).

20958.name: Nanaba
20958.desc: __Height:__ 172 cm __Affiliation:__ Scouting Legion Survey Corps

20958.name: Gelgar
20958.desc: Member of Scouting Legion. Has an undying love for alcohol. (Source: Attack on Titan Wiki)

20958.name: Henning
20958.desc: Member of Scouting Legion that fought the Castle Utgard's battle.

20958.name: Rene
20958.desc: Member of Scouting Legion that fought the Castle Utgard's battle.

20958.name: Daz
20958.desc: Daz is a member of the 104th Trainees Squad. ~!In Ch. 40, Ymir and Historia Reiss recount a story about Dazz from training. Wanting praise and recognition, Dazz undertook harsh physical training in the snowy mountains. However, he wasn't strong enough to endure it, and nearly died. Ymir told Krista to leave him behind or her own life would be endangered; when Krista refused, Ymir used her Titan shifter powers to bring Dazz back to the camp safely. In Ch. 12, when Dot Pixis announces the plan to reconquer Trost District, Dazz has a breakdown and starts screaming that he doesn't want to die. Though Marco Bott tries to quiet him, a commanding officer overhears and threatens to execute him. Dazz replies that execution would be better then being eaten by a Titan. However, Dot Pixis then announces that all deserters will be pardoned -- but have to live with the guilt that they abandoned their families to the Titans. Dazz is unable to leave his family to that fate, and returns to participate in the operation to plug the breach. After the mission, he briefly appears in Chapter 21 standing next to Sasha Blouse when Irvin Smith gives a speech urging the 104th Training Squad members to join the Scouting Legion. As he is not present in the group of trainees who join, he presumably opted for the Stationary Guard instead.!~ (Source: Shingeki no Kyojin Wikia)

20958.name: Kitz Weilman
20958.original: キッツ・ヴェールマン
20958.desc: The Captain of the Garrison's 1st Division Elite Forces

20958.name: Anka Rheinberger
20958.original: アンカ・ラインベルガー

20958.name: Rico Brzenska
20958.original: リコ・ブレツェンスカ
20958.desc: The Squad Leader of the 1st Division Elite Force of the Stationary Guard. ~!She is the sole survivor of the elite squads assigned to protect Eren during the liberation of Trost District. She does not trust Eren and still views him as a traitor.!~

20958.name: Hitch Dreyse
20958.desc: **Height:** 168 cm __Affiliations:__ 104th Cadet Corps. Recruit of the Military Police stationed in Stohess District. She was roommates with [Annie Leonhart](https://anilist.co/character/46490/Annie-Leonhart). Hitch acts immature in certain ways, she has a sarcastic, easygoing personality and seems to mischievously enjoy teasing and needling her fellow officers, especially [Marlo Freudenberg](https://anilist.co/character/71457/Marlo-Freudenberg). She claims she chose to join the Military Police out of laziness, as it is well known that the senior staff are incredibly corrupt and she wanted to benefit from the system herself; however, she did not take into account that, as a new recruit, her superiors would dump all their work on her. Though she may act a bit air-headed at times, Hitch is not selfish and cares about those around her, especially her fellow comrades.

20958.name: Zeke
20958.desc: __Height__: 183 cm Zeke is the current inheritor of the Beast Titan, and is considered by [Reiner Braun](https://anilist.co/character/46484/Reiner-Braun) to be the strongest Warrior, contrasting [Levi's](https://anilist.co/character/45627/Levi) title of "humanity's strongest soldier".

20958.name: Nifa
20958.desc: __Height:__ 165 cm (5'5") Nifa is a soldier in the Survey Corps' Fourth Squad under the command of [Hange Zoe](https://anilist.co/character/71121/Hange-Zoe). Nifa appears to be a loyal and trustworthy member of Fourth Squad, as she is often tasked to record the details of important meetings and entrusted to deliver vital information to others within the Scouting Regiment. She acts serious most of the time, however, she has been seen drinking alcoholic beverages before giving out more intense reports and info.

20958.name: Moblit Berner
20958.original: モブリット・バーナー
20958.desc: __Height:__ 176 cm (5'9") __Affiliation:__ Survey Corps; Executive Officer, Fourth Squad. A veteran member of the Survey Corps and [Hange Zoe](https://anilist.co/character/71121/Hange-Zoe)'s second-in-command within the Survey Corps' Fourth Squad. He also serves as Hanji's assistant and messenger. He comes across as an intelligent and responsible person, which may be the reason he was tasked to keep his overzealous and eccentric superior out of trouble. Much of the time, this leaves him in a state of near-panic, having to constantly remind Hange to be more careful or yanking them to safety. That he remains at Hange's side constantly suggests he is a loyal person, and that he cares deeply for his superior's safety, regardless of the stress involved with being under their command. He is also able to show signs of a serious nature when it comes to missions, going out of his way to investigate problems and put himself in danger before others.

20958.name: Abel
20958.desc: Goggles is a soldier in the Scout Regiment fourth squad under the command of Hange Zoë, who is noted for his trademark glasses, or "goggles". He participated in the 57th Exterior Scouting Mission and often accompanies higher ups, such as Hange and Levi, on serious missions. (Source: Shingeki no Kyojin Wikia)

20958.name: Marcel Galliard
20958.original: マルセル・ガリアード
20958.desc: ~!Marcel was a comrade and childhood friend of Reiner Braun, Bertolt Hoover, and Annie Leonhart. He was part of the group sent by Marley to attack the Eldians of Paradis in year 845, but his mission was cut short by the sudden appearance of Ymir in her mindless Titan form.!~ (Source: Shingeki no Kyojin Wikia)

20958.name: Phil
20958.desc: A member of the Garrison.

20958.name: Rashad
20958.desc: Rashad is a team captain in the Survey Corps' Fourth Squad under the command of [Hange Zoe](https://anilist.co/character/71121). While Rashad is shown to be a brave and conditioned soldier, he also has shown himself to be a rather considerate man, watching over fellow wounded soldiers along with [Nifa](https://anilist.co/character/126849/Nifa). He is also shown to prioritize his fellow soldiers' well-being over immediate threats to himself, retrieving water to soothe burned soldiers while engaged with the [Colossal Titan].

20958.name: Artur Blouse
20958.original: アルトゥル・ブラウス
20958.desc: __Relatives:__ [Lisa Blause](https://anilist.co/character/134952/Lisa-Blouse) (Wife), [Sasha Blause](https://anilist.co/character/45887/Sasha-Blouse) (Daughter). Artur Blouse is the father of Sasha Blouse and a hunter in the Dauper village. It was his words that motivated Sasha to leave home and join the military. Artur appears to be a mature father figure who is deeply devoted to his clan. Though he appreciates his way of life, he realizes that many people's homes were taken by Titans and that they must share the forest for the greater good. He appears to be very wise, willing to accept change and move beyond their traditions if it meant a better way of life for everyone, and is very clearly a selfless person who puts others before himself. Like his daughter, he has a native Dauper accent. ~!ㅤ After his daughter Sasha saved [Kaya](https://anilist.co/character/132738/Kaya), he and his wife decided to adopt her and open their home up to other orphaned children whose family was slain by the titans, going so far as to refer to them as his "family."!~

20958.name: Tomas
20958.desc: He is a member of the Scout Regiment in Squad Miche. ~!He brought the news of Wall Rose's breach to Commander Erwin.!~

20958.name: Lauda
20958.desc: He is a team leader in the Scout Regiment Fourth Squad under the command of Hange Zoë.

20958.name: Kaya
20958.desc: A civilian living within Wall Rose. She was saved by Sasha Blouse from a Titan during the Wall Rose invasion, and now lives with the Blouse family.

20958.name: Kaya no Haha
20958.desc: ~!During the Wall Rose invasion, she is left stranded in her town with her traumatized daughter as a Titan slowly eats her. Sasha Blouse arrives in the town to alert its citizens and finds the two women in the house they were left in. Sasha unsuccessfully attempts to cut the Titan's nape with an axe, and then notices the child in the room. Sasha apologizes to the mother as she decides to abandon her, and successfully takes her child to safety. The woman later dies from her wounds!~

20958.name: Conny no Haha
20958.desc: She is the mother of Conny Springer and a resident of Ragako village. ~!She was transformed into a Titan by the Beast Titan during Wall Rose's supposed breach.!~

5114.name: Edward Elric
5114.original: エドワード・エルリック
5114.desc: __Birthplace:__ Resembool, Amestris __Height:__ 1,65m __Family:__ [Alphonse Elric](https://anilist.co/character/12/Alphonse-Elric) (brother), [Van Hohenheim](https://anilist.co/character/9792/Van-Hohenheim) (father), [Trisha Elric](https://anilist.co/character/10085/Trisha-Elric) (mother, deceased) __Affiliations:__ State Military, [Pinako Rockbell](https://anilist.co/character/65/Pinako-Rockbell), [Izumi Curtis (teacher)](https://anilist.co/character/67/Izumi-Curtis), [Roy Mustang (Commander)](https://anilist.co/character/68/Roy-Mustang) __Occupation:__ State Alchemist Edward "Fullmetal Alchemist" Elric is a young alchemical prodigy. He is the youngest State Alchemist ever to be recognized by the Amestris State Military, having received the title at the age of 12. Ed's primary motivation throughout the series is to return his younger brother, Alphonse, to his original body, which was lost in a failed human transmutation. Edward, despite his occasional bouts of immaturity, is a selfless boy who gains a reputation as a "hero of the people" throughout his youth. Notably, he doesn't seem concerned about returning his own arm and leg, instead focusing entirely on Al's suffering. Edward is small for his age, standing at only 149 cm (4'11"), however his body is that of an experienced martial artist, with noticeable muscles and a wealth of agility. Although he lacks both his right arm and left leg, Ed's ability to fight is not impaired, and is in fact improved, as he will often use

5114.name: Alphonse Elric
5114.original: アルフォンス・エルリック
5114.desc: __Birthplace:__ Resembool __Family:__ [Edward Elric](https://anilist.co/character/11) (brother), [Trisha Elric](https://anilist.co/character/10085) (mother, deceased) __Occupation:__ Alchemist Alphonse Elric is a human child who lost his body during a forbidden alchemical transmutation to bring his deceased mother back to life, and had his soul transmuted into a suit of armor by his brother, Edward Elric. Al's blood seal lies just below the base of the neck at the back of the suit, on the inside. It is drawn with Ed's blood. According to Edward, he needs to be careful whenever he reconstructs Alphonse's body because he must keep the blood seal intact during the transmutation. If the blood seal is removed, Al's soul will be lost.

5114.name: Winry Rockbell
5114.original: ウィンリィ・ロックベル
