When Dot Pyxis states that he finds killing humans to be madness, the aristocrat laughs at this notion, displaying his disregard for others in the process.!~ ~!After a successful uprising led by Scout Regiment commander Erwin Smith, he is imprisoned by the military.!~

99147.name: Roderich
99147.desc: He is garbed in the robes of the Order of the Walls and a member of the King Fritz's assembly. ~!After a successful uprising led by Scout Regiment commander Erwin Smith, he is imprisoned by the military.!~

99147.name: Deltoff
99147.desc: A member of the King Fritz's assembly. ~!After a successful uprising led by Scout Regiment commander Erwin Smith, he is imprisoned by the Military.!~

99147.name: Roger
99147.desc: An anime-original character who's a member of the Military Police Regiment and part of the First Interior Squad.

99147.name: Carsten
99147.desc: Occupation: Soldier Rank: Captain Affiliation: Garrison Regiment The captain in charge of the Garrison's forces in the Orvud District.

99147.name: Harold
99147.desc: A team leader in the Scout Regiment.

99147.name: Dirk
99147.desc: A member of the Scout Regiment and a team leader during the mission to reclaim Wall Maria.

99147.name: Roy
99147.desc: As a veteran journalist, Roy has come to accept and conform to the restrictive nature of the monarchy, fearing retaliation for defiance.

99147.name: Pierre
99147.desc: As a rookie reporter, Pierre has not yet become jaded like his superior Roy. He is very bold in his reporting, unafraid of asking questions of Military Police officers that would otherwise be considered "off-limits." He takes his job of reporting the truth very seriously, becoming frustrated when he is kept from printing news that would be scandalous for the government.

99147.name: Klaus
99147.desc: A member of the Scout Regiment and a team leader during the mission to retake Wall Maria.

99147.name: Marlene
99147.desc: A member of the Scout Regiment and a team leader during the mission to reclaim Wall Maria.

99147.name: Waltz
99147.desc: He is a member of the Military Police Regiment who serves as Nile Dawk's aide

99147.name: Sandra
99147.desc: She is a recruit of the Survey Corps. She joined at some point after the crowning of Historia Reiss during the two months between the attack at Orvud District and the expedition returning to Shiganshina District, where she was assigned to Squad Klaus.

99147.name: Dimo no Tsuma
99147.desc: ~!The wife and daughter of Dimo Reeves are seen mourning his death. When Erwin Smith approaches the body of Reeves, they tell him to stay away, believing it was the Survey Corps who are responsible for his death. Erwin responds by acknowledging Reeves' dedication to the people of Trost, and vowing to avenge Reeves' death!~

99147.name: Gordon
99147.desc: He is a recruit of the Scout Regiment. He joined the regiment after the crowning of Historia Reiss.

99147.name: Abel Reiss
99147.desc: Abel Reiss was one of the younger daughters of [Rod Reiss](https://anilist.co/character/127360/Rod-Reiss) and his wife.

21856.name: Katsuki Bakugou
21856.desc: __Height:__ 172 cm (5'7") __Quirk:__ Explosion Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Katsuki is a crude, arrogant, short-tempered, and aggressive person, especially at the beginning of the series. Due to the constant praise of his abilities and powerful Quirk, Katsuki has developed a superiority complex, and because of that, he desires to be the first and best at everything. He loves to win above all else and cannot stand it when he doesn't, leading him to lose his already short temper if he achieves anything but a complete victory. Katsuki is not only very athletic and talented at fighting, but also very intelligent and extremely perceptive, capable of strategic planning and improvisation. Additionally, his grades are among the highest of his class. Katsuki also possesses surprising talent in other areas, such as cooking and music, even though he doesn't show a particular interest in them. Overall, Katsuki is considered a natural-born genius with the potential to be one of the best Pro Heroes. Katsuki's Quirk "Explosion" allows him to secrete nitroglycerin-like sweat from the palms of his hands and ignite it on command, allowing him to create strong explosions. The more Katsuki sweats, the stronger his explosions become. Not only can Katsuki use the explosions for attacking, he can also use them to propel himself and navigate through the air at high speeds, allowing him to fly at his opponents without giving them time to react, as well as evade incoming attacks, even whi

21856.name: Izuku Midoriya
21856.desc: __Height:__ 166 cm (5'5¼") __Quirk:__ One For All Student in Class 1-A at U.A High School. Although he was born without a Quirk, Izuku's innate heroism and strong sense of justice manages to catch the attention of the legendary hero [All Might](https://anilist.co/character/89224). Izuku has since become All Might's closest pupil. Izuku is a very timid, reserved, and polite boy. Although initially portrayed as insecure, tearful, and vulnerable, Izuku gradually matures into a more confident and braver person. His infectious leadership skills, combined with his passion and strategic abilities, have turned Izuku into a central figure of Class 1-A. He is caring and emotional, never hesitating to help or rescue someone in danger, even if he knows that he might not be strong or otherwise qualified enough to do it. Izuku is extremely (and sometimes scarily) enthusiastic about topics related to heroes. His dream drives him to write down notes about everything he learns about heroes' Quirks and fighting capabilities. Thanks to this practice, Izuku has developed a great analytical mind and can form complex battle plans in a few seconds, factoring in the best ways he can utilize the Quirks of allies and enemies alike for his own advantage. Izuku's Quirk "One For All" was transferred to him from All Might. His Quirk allows him to stockpile an enormous amount of raw power, allowing him to significantly enhance all of his physical abilities to various boundless levels. This results in unbel

21856.name: Shouto Todoroki
21856.desc: __Height:__ 176 cm (5'9") __Affiliation:__ U.A. High School __Quirk:__ Half-Cold Half-Hot Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School, where he got in through official recommendations. He is the youngest son of the top hero [Endeavor](https://anilist.co/character/126158). Shouto initially has a cold, aloof personality, which stemmed from his complicated family life. Focused and unemotional, Shouto preferred to keep things to himself instead of hanging out with others. After the events of the U.A. Sports Festival, however, he notably became more sociable and kinder than ever before. He even gained a sense of humor and would occasionally smile, although still retaining some fragments of his previous distant attitude and nonchalant demeanor. While usually quiet and reserved, Shouto initially possessed a moderate level of arrogance, which, combined with his solitary tendencies, sometimes made him take the initiative without considering the opinions of others. Shouto's Quirk Half-Cold Half-Hot gives him the ability to generate ice from the right side of his body, and flames from his left side. Due to years of rejecting his father, Shouto has developed a habit of favoring ice, even when fire would be a better option. This grudge also caused him to have difficulty controlling his flames. If he overuses one element without utilizing the other, then his own body temperature will suffer.

21856.name: Ochako Uraraka
21856.desc: __Height:__ 156 cm (5'1") __Quirk:__ Zero Gravity Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School Ochako is an outgoing, lively person who thinks about everything positively, though she is objective enough to see flaws and virtues. She gets excited over little things very easily. Ochaco has been described by other students as "the most laidback girl" among her class, being very bubbly and kind of an airhead at times. She is often incredibly blunt without being aware of it. She is on good terms with everyone and is particularly close friends with several class members, including [Izuku](https://anilist.co/character/89028/Midoriya-Izuku), [Tenya Ida](https://anilist.co/character/89222/Iida-Tenya), and [Tsuyu](https://anilist.co/character/89223/Asui-Tsuyu). Ochaco's Quirk gives her the power to manipulate gravity upon touching solid things with the pads on her fingertips. The targets lose their gravitational pull, effectively making them weightless. She is able to activate or cancel her Quirk's effects by closing her fingers together, and is shown to be careful with her hands in order to avoid accidental quirk activation.

21856.name: Tenya Iida
21856.desc: __Height:__ 179 cm (5'10") __Quirk:__ Engine Class representative of Class 1-A at U.A. High School Tenya may look severe, but he's actually just a very serious person, who takes everything, even the most insignificant thing, seriously. A testament to his generally hyperactive and intense behavior, Tenya often exhibits plenty of peculiar tics, such as moving his arms around in strange chopping patterns or sometimes twitching his body uncontrollably. Tenya is very humble, willing to admit to his mistakes, apologize for rude behavior, and improve in areas he lacks. Being part of the highly-esteemed Ida Family of Heroes, Tenya is proud of his lineage and works hard to meet his expectations. He greatly admires his older brother, Tensei (also known as the Turbo Hero: Ingenium), and aspires to become a similar hero. Tenya's Quirk Engine gives him car-like engines in each of his calves, giving him incredible running speed and extreme kicking power. Tenya needs to fuel his engines by drinking orange juice. Tenya's engines have multiple gears; it is currently unknown how many, but it has been implied that there are more than three.

21856.name: Tsuyu Asui
21856.desc: __Affiliation:__ U.A. High School __Quirk:__ Frog Tsuyu is a very straight-forward girl that always says what's on her mind and what she thinks about others. She prefers to be called by her first name.

21856.name: Toshinori Yagi
21856.desc: __Height:__ 220 cm (7'2") __Quirk:__ One for All All Might is the No. 1 Hero and the "Symbol of Peace." In his hero form, All Might is a very tall and over-muscular man whose design resembles the american hero comics. His hair spikes on top of his head and his whole body has more shadows than a normal human being. However, in his true form, he is an overly-skinny man who spits a lot of blood out of his mouth and his clothes appear loose.

21856.name: Shouta Aizawa
21856.desc: __Height: __183 cm (6') __Occupation:__ Pro Hero, Teacher __Affiliation:__ U.A. High School __Quirk:__ Erasure Aizawa's hero name, Eraserhead, was coined by [Present Mic](https://anilist.co/character/127425) when they were younger. Using the binding cloth, Aizawa has a unique fighting style that allows him to immobilize his enemies. He is known to expel students that don't meet his standards, however it should be noted that he did not expel anyone from Class 1-A. Aizawa is extremely vocal, able to voice his opinions very easily. Although seeming emotionless and reserved, he has a soft spot for his students and genuinely cares for them.

21856.name: Tomura Shigaraki
21856.desc: __Height:__ 175 cm (5'9) __Quirk:__ Decay Leader of the League of Villains and protégé of [All For One](https://anilist.co/character/125956/All-For-One). He was raised by his master, All For One, with the goal of killing [All Might](https://anilist.co/character/89224/Yagi-Toshinori), and ultimately destroying the society he represents. Tomura is a very twisted, malevolent, and maliciously warped young man, who is considered to be the polar opposite of [Izuku Midoriya](https://anilist.co/character/89028/Midoriya-Izuku). He doesn't care for his or almost anyone else's life, having no qualms about performing evil deeds like murdering innocent people. Tomura was initially perceived to be a "man-child": arrogant, selfish, dependent, and demanding, becoming angry if things didn't go his way and likening reality to some sort of video game. Unlike his mentor, Tomura lacked subtlety, preferring to eliminate problems through force. Much like a child, Tomura seemed unable to cope with his own feelings, instead lashing out and abusing both others or himself, tearing at his own neck when he becomes frustrated. Initially, Tomura seemingly caused destruction just for the sake of it and felt directionless about the League's path forward after [Stain](https://anilist.co/character/126067/Akaguro-Chizome)'s arrest. It would take a fateful meeting with Izuku in a mall for him to develop an epiphany and become aware of his true convictions: to crumble hero society through All Might's death. Tomur

21856.name: Momo Yaoyorozu
21856.desc: __Height:__ 173 cm (5'8") __Quirk:__ Creation Vice class representative of Class 1-A at U.A. High School. She was admitted to the school through official recommendations. Momo is a very prudent, dedicated person who acts as a natural leader. She is generally level-headed and calm in dangerous situations, but she isn't above falling into a panic. Momo can be blunt with her comments about people's mistakes and miscalculations, tending to be very direct and wishing to help her peers improve enough to become great heroes. Momo's Quirk gives her the ability to create any non-living material/object from her exposed skin by transforming the molecular structure of her fat cells. In order to create something, she needs to understand the molecular structure of which the material/object is made.

21856.name: Hitoshi Shinsou
21856.desc: __Height:__ 177 cm (5'9½") __Quirk:__ Brainwashing Student at U.A. High School, attending Class 1-C of the Department of General Education. Hitoshi is a stoic and straightforward person with an innate ability to spark conversation with anyone despite holding a reserved and quiet attitude most of the time. He is shown to be rather clever, knowing just the right words to manipulate others into replying to his comments, allowing him to activate his Quirk. He does not mind doing something underhanded to claim victory in a fight. Due to having his Brainwashing Quirk perceived as evil throughout his life, Hitoshi has been somewhat feared by those aware of his power and has been discriminated against solely because of the Quirk he was born with. This persecution led him to become resentful of those who had Quirks more associated with hero work. Regardless of his drawbacks, however, Hitoshi desires to become a Pro Hero more than anything. Hitoshi's Quirk Brainwashing allows him to put someone in a state where they are forced to obey whatever he commands. He can only activate this power when his target verbally responds to something he says. Brainwashing must be intentionally activated and will not take effect if Hitoshi doesn't want it to. Using a megaphone or anything that makes his voice artificial will not allow his Quirk to activate, as the said devices would transform his voice into an electronic signal.

21856.name: Eijirou Kirishima
21856.desc: __Height:__ 170 cm (5'7") __Quirk:__ Hardening Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Eijiro is a boisterous and outgoing guy with a fondness for manliness, often using the terms "manly" and "unmanly" to describe things and people he does or doesn't like, respectively. Eijiro is very honest and kind-hearted, having a straightforward way of thinking and following a specific code of chivalry that motivates him to live without regret. He is determined and selfless, bravely putting the safety of others before himself. He is also a big fan of Crimson Riot, a retro hero from whom he takes inspiration, including personal values and his hero name. Although Eijiro may not be as hot-blooded and competitive as [Katsuki Bakugou](https://anilist.co/character/88892), he does not shy away from comparing himself to him, with [Izuku](https://anilist.co/character/89028) stating that the two have managed to develop a relationship between equals. As a result, Eijiro is notably one of the few people that Katsuki holds in higher esteem. Eijiro's Quirk gives him the power to harden and sharpen any or all parts of his body, causing his flesh to become jagged and rock-like. There is a limit to how much damage his hardened body can withstand, which causes the Hardening itself to slowly dissipate, and Eijiro to lose stamina from struggling to keep his Quirk active.

21856.name: Minoru Mineta
21856.desc: __Height:__ 108 cm (3' 6½") __Quirk:__ Pop Off __Affiliation:__ U.A. High School __Fighting Style:__ Medium Ranged Support Minoru Mineta, also known as the Fresh-Picked Hero: Grape Juice, is a student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School, training to become a Pro Hero.

21856.name: Mina Ashido
21856.desc: __Height:__ 159 cm (5'3") __Quirk:__ Acid Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Mina is a cheerful and easygoing girl who usually displays a smile. Highly social and excitable, she loves to hang out with her friends and is shown to become very upset when denied an opportunity to be at a gathering. She possesses a strong fashion sense and likes to go shopping. Due to her athleticism and energy, Mina enjoys and is very skilled at dancing. Mina is extremely courageous and is viewed as an ideal personality for hero work. Mina's Quirk Acid allows her to produce a corrosive liquid from her body. She can control the solubility and viscosity of this corrosive liquid. There is a limit to how long she can produce the corrosive liquid until her skin gradually loses its natural resistance to it. Overusing her Quirk or pushing it too far can also be fatal, as it dehydrates her body very fast. Mina can use her acid offensively, but has shown utility with it as well, such as melting handholds for herself to climb with. She is also known to secrete a non-corrosive version of the acid from her feet in order to slide around.

21856.name: Mei Hatsume
21856.desc: __Height:__ 157 cm (5'2") __Quirk:__ Zoom Mei is a smart, off-setting, and assertive girl, often making those around her uncomfortable. She loves creating gadgets, which she refers to as her "super cute babies". Mei has a habit of "going straight to the point" and is very shameless and opportunistic when it comes to advertising her inventions. While talking to people, she has a habit of getting awkwardly close to them, which usually causes them to back away from her but she still moves up to them.

21856.name: Denki Kaminari
21856.desc: __Height:__ 168 cm (5'6") __Quirk:__ Electrification Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Denki is a friendly, social, and energetic boy who enjoys hanging out with others. He is rather casual when interacting with other people, including the generally unfriendly [Katsuki Bakugou](https://anilist.co/character/88892/Bakugou-Katsuki). Denki's Quirk Electrification allows him to store and discharge electricity. While he can also discharge this energy over a distance, Denki has little to no control over it, meaning it will go everywhere indiscriminately. Denki is also able to absorb and neutralize electricity and other lightning-based Quirks. Whenever Denki exceeds his wattage limit, he loses his ability to discharge energy, with his entire personality changing into that of a giggling idiot for a certain period until he reverts to normal. In this state, he is always giving thumbs-ups as a way to let others know that he is okay.

21856.name: Hanta Sero
21856.desc: __Height:__ 177 cm (5' 9¾") __Quirk:__ Tape Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Hanta is amicable and has proven to be one of the more sociable members of Class 1-A. He can sometimes be loud and showy, often trying to impress his peers with his Quirk. He is often the only person to call his classmates out when they act crazy. He is pretty humorous and usually makes jokes with his classmates. However, when push comes to shove, Hanta is a brave hero-in-training who wishes to prosper on his own while helping others do the same. Hanta's Quirk is that he has tape dispenser-like organs in his elbows, from which he can shoot long cellophane tape-like strips; he can also retract them. They appear to be somewhat sturdier than regular tape. Overuse of his Quirk will cause his skin to dry out. He can use his tape to wrap people, swing long distances, and create traps, among other applications.

21856.name: Mashirao Ojiro
21856.desc: __Height:__ 169 cm (5'6") __Quirk:__ Tail Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Mashirao has a very calm and noble attitude and a profound sense of dignity, which prevents him from accepting results he doesn't feel he earned with his own abilities. He is also described as a hard worker. Along with a strong sense of dignity, Mashirao can be described as sheepish and bashful, not very often enjoying the spotlight and being easily embarrassed. A recurring joke is that others view Mashirao as "plain," which profoundly upsets him. Mashirao's Quirk is that he has a long, powerful, sturdy tail. His tail effectively functions as a third arm that he can use to grab things. Furthermore, it's attack power is strong enough to break objects made of metal, he can wrap it around enemies, and it can support Mashirao's body weight. Mashirao is incredibly adept at using his tail, combining it with his knowledge of martial arts to engage enemies in close-range combat, performing fast and acrobatic moves. His tail can also increase his speed and mobility by whipping it down against the ground to use it like a springboard. (Source: My Hero Academia Wiki)

21856.name: Kyouka Jirou
21856.desc: __Height:__ 154 cm (5'1") __Quirk:__ Earphone Jack __Affiliation:__ U.A. High School __Fighting Style:__ Medium Ranged + Support Combat Kyoka is a petite, fair-skinned girl with a slender build. She has triangular, lazy-looking onyx eyes with notably long lower eyelashes, and rather small eyebrows. Kyoka has a pragmatic, unenthusiastic and teasing personality that is mostly shown to those she finds irritating. Kyoka is not always like this though, as she does enjoy socializing with others, in which case she is usually nice and friendly. Kyoka's Quirk (Earphone Jack) allows her to plug the jacks that hang from her earlobes into all sorts of things and channel the sound of her heartbeat into them; causing havoc inside the plugged objects. It's also used to catch sounds and vibrations from her surroundings.

21856.name: Fumikage Tokoyami
21856.desc: __Height:__ 158 cm __Quirk:__ Dark Shadow Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Fumikage is reserved, serious, and focused, albeit noble and valiant. Though not talkative, Fumikage will directly ignore questions or requests that seem in some way pointless. During combat, Fumikage is known to be fierce and dependable, with his strength and capabilities rarely being questioned. Fumikage is fond of darkness and other related concepts, considering himself a "creature of the dark" and employing archaic-sounding speeches that paint him slightly creepy or dramatic. Fumikage's Quirk "Dark Shadow" allows him to manifest a sentient shadow monster from his body that he can materialize and contract freely. Dark Shadow's energy is limited and can be drained by bright light. Dark Shadow retracts into Fumikage's body when it runs out of energy. The shadow entity's personality, strength, defense, and control depend on the lack of light. In bright light, Dark Shadow is weaker and smaller but still has considerable strength and defense and is easier to control, but in total darkness, Dark Shadow's size and parameters are drastically enhanced. It is powerful enough to rip out and cut down multiple full-grown trees easily. However, Dark Shadow is more difficult to control in the dark, causing it to rampage based on its own free will.

21856.name: Mezou Shouji
21856.desc: __Height:__ 187 cm (6'2") __Quirk:__ Dupli-Arms Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Shouji is friendly and gentle, and he will work nicely with anyone. He is not the type to hold grudges, showing no ill will towards those that harm him unwillingly. Shouji is entirely selfless and willing to risk his life for anyone. He can be empathetic and understanding, but still shows a sense of maturity and responsibility that prevents him from acting under emotional impulses. He is very protective of his classmates, especially if they are hurt or injured. He is also quite thick-skinned, as he said he is used to being feared due to his appearance. Shouji's Quirk grants him a set of tentacles alongside his arms. He can transform the tips of these tentacles to replicate other parts of his body (ex: mouth, ears, eyes). The duplicated body parts are more efficient than the originals; as a result, Mezo is able to hear better, see-through more angles at a time, and they grant him much higher degrees of strength. He uses these arms to talk most of the time through duplicate mouths, rather than his actual mouth.

21856.name: Tooru Hagakure
21856.desc: __Height:__ 152 cm (5'0") __Quirk:__ Invisibility Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Tooru is a bubbly, cheery, and easygoing girl who does most things with an upbeat attitude. She is very socially eager and likes shopping, and her room suggests that she likes plushies and other cute things. Tooru's Quirk is that her body is completely invisible. In addition to the stealth capabilities granted to her by her invisible body, Tooru can refract light that passes through her, allowing her to intensify the light into a blinding flash. She has further refined this application of her Quirk, achieving the ability to manipulate and redirect light-based attacks, such as [Yuuga Aoyama](https://anilist.co/character/127042/Aoyama-Yuuga)'s Navel Laser.

21856.name: Kouji Kouda
21856.desc: __Height:__ 186 cm (6'1") __Quirk:__ Anivoice Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Contrary to his strong and powerful appearance, Kouji is very timid and quiet. He rarely speaks and prefers using sign language to communicate with his classmates. He hates violence due to his kind-hearted nature. Kouji appears to greatly enjoy the company of animals, as his Quirk allows him to interact with animals in ways others cannot. He owns a small rabbit as a pet. Kouji's Quirk "Anivoice (生き物ボイス, Ikimono Voice)" gives him the ability to command any creature in the animal kingdom by speaking to them. Whatever command he gives, the animal will carry it out. However, he cannot exert control if they cannot hear his command. The target must also be a real animal and not merely animal-like. Kouji can also exchange information with the animals to find the locations of various people and potential enemies faster. Kouji has been shown to use the Quirk effectively with flocks of birds to create a smokescreen of animals and to attack an opponent, along with his use of insects to distract and attack his opponents. He has now also overcome his fear of bugs, so he often uses bugs to swarm opponents with numbers.

21856.name: Rikidou Satou
21856.desc: __Height:__ 185 cm (6'1") __Quirk:__ Sugar Rush Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Rikidou is interested in sweets and baking, a valuable skill due to his Quirk. He is surprisingly talented at making sweets. Rikidou's Quirk Sugar Rush allows him to increase his strength five-fold for three minutes. To activate his Quirk, he needs to consume 10 grams of sugar. When converting sugar into strength, his cognitive functions gradually drop, making him sleepy afterward. For every additional 10 grams of sugar he ingests, he extends the time of increased strength by another three minutes.

21856.name: Yuu Takeyama
21856.desc: __Height:__ 162 cm (5'4") (Normal form); 2062cm (67'8") (Transformed) __Quirk:__ Gigantification __Occupation:__ Pro Hero Pro Hero. Her Quirk allows her to grow to a gigantic size. She cannot variate between her base-height and the gigantified height achieved via her Quirk, making her only able to be either her normal height of 162cm (5 feet 4 inches) or her enlarged height of 2,062cm (67 feet 8 inches) tall.

21856.name: Sirius
21856.desc: Sirius is a pro hero and sidekick of Selkie.

21856.name: Neito Monoma
21856.desc: __Height:__ 170cm __Quirk:__ Copy Student in Class 1-B at U.A. High School. Neito has a rather complex personality since it differs depending on who he is addressing; he is particularly mocking, loud, and sarcastic with Class 1-A, but outside of these interactions, he is a calm, kind, and intelligent person. He envies Class 1-A with a passion over how they became the center of attention among U.A.'s first years because of the U.S.J. Incident. Truthfully, he only wants his class to stand out as they do, and he vents this feeling by throwing countless taunts towards his rivals, gloating over Class 1-B's successes and disparaging 1-A for their failures. Neito's Quirk is Copy, which allows him to duplicate and use another person's Quirk after coming into physical contact with the user. He can hold four Quirks simultaneously and maintain copied powers for ten minutes. After the time limit runs out, he loses the copied Quirk until he once again touches the original user.

21856.name: Himiko Toga
21856.desc: __Height:__ 157 cm __Quirk:__ Transform Himiko Toga is a villain affiliated with the League of Villains and part of its Vanguard Action Squad. She originally joined the group as a means to get closer to [Stain](https://anilist.co/character/126067). Himiko is a very cheerful girl, to the point of smiling even after having presumably killed someone, displaying apparent sadistic tendencies. She has a very twisted perception of love and friendship Himiko's Quirk Transform grants her the ability to transform into a physical lookalike of another individual, as well as copy their voice. She can only transform into people whose blood she has ingested. The more blood she drinks, the longer she has access to that person's form. For example, 1 cup of blood allows her to transform for a total of 18 hours. She can even switch between the appearances of multiple people if she drinks the blood of more than one person.

21856.name: All For One
21856.original: オール・フォー・ワン
21856.desc: __Quirk:__ All For One __Occupation:__ Villain __Fighting Style:__ Close Range and Long Range All For One is the true leader and benefactor of the League of Villains. Once Japan's most powerful villain and All Might's arch-nemesis, his true motives are unclear and his true identity unknown. His current goal is to raise Shigaraki to become his eventual successor.

21856.name: Itsuka Kendou
21856.desc: __Height:__ 166 cm (5'5") __Quirk:__ Big Fist Class representative of Class 1-B at U.A. High School, Itsuka is a spirited girl who is thoughtful of others. She does not hesitate to criticize even her classmates if she feels what they are doing is not correct. Due to Itsuka's cheerful personality, she can bring all of Class 1-B together, thus making her the "big sister" of Class 1-B. Itsuka's Quirk Big Fist grants her the ability to enlarge both of her hands to a gigantic size. With the increased size comes enhanced striking power and gripping capabilities.

21856.name: Chizome Akaguro
21856.desc: __Height:__ 182 cm (6'0) __Quirk:__ Bloodcurdle Villain and former vigilante that was notorious for having killed many Pro Heroes. He attacks and kills heroes who he believes do not fit his definition of a "true hero." Chizome is a cruel, unforgiving, and merciless man with a sense of duty to cleanse society of false heroes. He believes that those who become Heroes for fame or money are unworthy of being called the name and only [All Might](https://anilist.co/character/89224/Yagi-Toshinori) is a true hero. Due to his strong ideology, he took it upon himself to become the Hero Killer: Stain to stain his own hands with blood to purge fake heroes and change the current society. Despite his extremist views and beliefs, Stain did have genuine ideals about heroism, which he stood by firmly. He did not hesitate to save people he deemed worthy of being called Heroes, did not like killing without reason, and would even give advice to his enemies. Stain acknowledged that what he did was morally wrong but believed that for society to be put on the right path, someone must be what he was, suggesting that he saw himself as a martyr. Stain's Quirk "Bloodcurdle" allows him to paralyze his target upon tasting a sample of their blood. The amount of time a victim remains paralyzed depends on their blood type; in ascending order from shortest to longest duration, they are: O, A, AB, and B. The maximum amount of time that anyone can be paralyzed is eight minutes. _In My Hero Academia: Vigilantes

21856.name: Enji Todoroki
21856.desc: __Height:__ 195 cm (6' 4¾") __Occupation:__ Pro Hero __Quirk:__ Hellflame Endeavor is a tall man with a muscular physique. He has short and spiky, red hair with bright blue eyes. His beard and mustache appear to be made of fire, but when he turns off his flames on his face voluntarily, his stubble shows. ~!His desire to surpass the number one hero has driven him in family matters. Enji put [Shouto](https://anilist.co/character/89220/Todoroki-Shouto) through ruthless "training" which caused Shouto a severe degree of physical and emotional pain. Shouto, harboring a bitter hatred towards his father on account of this, refuses to use his fire powers in battles until [Izuku Midoriya](https://anilist.co/character/89028/Midoriya-Izuku) reminded him of his mother's encouragement. Later, Enji understood his mistakes and told his son he would try to be a better hero and father. He hopes for Shouto and the rest his family to forgive him in the future.!~ ~!He's the former No.2 Hero, but later becomes the new No.1 Hero after [All Might](https://anilist.co/character/89224/Yagi-Toshinori) loses his Quirk!~

21856.name: Dabi
21856.desc: __Height:__ 176 cm (5'9¼") __Quirk:__ Blueflame Dabi is a villain affiliated with the League of Villains and a member of the organization's Vanguard Action Squad. Dabi is a stoic, aloof, confident, and focused individual who rarely shows emotion. While rather crude and violent, he's also shown to be quite cautious. Overall, Dabi is a highly enigmatic individual who trusts no one, preferring to do things alone and in his way. He also gives off the impression of knowing more about certain people than he lets on. Dabi's Quirk grants him the ability to generate and control highly destructive blue flames from his body. He has very well-developed control of his flames and can project them far from himself and in large amounts. However, Dabi's body has a low tolerance for his flame, and he will get burned if he uses them for prolonged periods. ~!It is later revealed that Dabi is Touya Todoroki (轟燈矢), the eldest son of the Pro Hero [Endeavor](https://anilist.co/character/126158/Todoroki-Enji) and his wife [Rei](https://anilist.co/character/150628/Todoroki-Rei), and the older brother to [Shouto Todoroki](https://anilist.co/character/89220/Todoroki-Shouto). For a significant period of time, his whereabouts were unknown.!~

21856.name: Yuuga Aoyama
21856.desc: **Height:** 168 cm (5'6") **Quirk:** Navel Lazer Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Yuuga appears to be vain and prideful, thinking of himself as superior to the rest of his classmates, especially regarding his Quirk. He exhibits flamboyant mannerisms, is fond of posing, and likes to grab the attention of those around him despite frequently getting ignored by his peers. He also plays up his French heritage, occasionally implementing French words into his sentences. Yuuga's Quirk allows him to shoot a powerful sparkling laser cannon from his navel. It is so powerful, it can blast through two meters of solid concrete. If he fires the laser for more than 1 second at a time, he will suffer intestinal distress.

21856.name: Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu
21856.desc: __Height:__ 174cm (5'9") __Quirk:__ Steel Student in Class 1-B at U.A. High School. Tetsutetsu is defined by his very hotheaded and outspoken personality. He is confident, stubborn, and straightforward in his motivations and actions. He tends to be very vocal about his intentions and has a one-track mind, often looking for the simplest solution to problems to solve them most directly. Tetsutetsu's direct personality shows through his tenacious and upfront fighting style during battles. Tetsutetsu's Quirk allows him to turn his body into steel. This power grants Tetsutetsu both augmented defensive abilities to withstand attacks and the increased strength of his unarmed physical attacks.

21856.name: Hizashi Yamada
21856.desc: __Height:__ 185cm (6'1") __Quirk:__ Voice Pro Hero. He also works as an English teacher at U.A. High School and as a radio talk show host. Yamada maintains the eccentric persona of a radio host. He often poses when he talks and maintains a certain level of excitement or volume, regardless of the situation. Though he tends to be a jovial individual, Hizashi is capable of great rage when it comes to his friends and colleagues. Yamada's Quirk "Voice" allows him to increase the volume of his voice, giving him an ability that is similar to a sonic scream. The sound from his Quirk is strong enough to cause people's ears to bleed from far away. The only known weakness of this Quirk is that the loud sounds do not travel well underground, making this Quirk ineffective against anything that is underground or separated from him by layers of earth.

21856.name: Ibara Shiozaki
21856.desc: __Height:__ 167cm (5'6") __Quirk:__ Vine Student in Class 1-B at U.A. High School. Ibara is a very modest and courteous person. Although graceful and soft-spoken, she is not afraid to make her pure intentions known. She seems highly religious due to her talking about heaven and divine beings in passing on multiple occasions, and her ultimate moves having somewhat religious names such as "Faith's Shield" and "Crucifixion". Ibara's Quirk "Vine (ツル, Tsuru) gives her hair-like vines that grow on her head. She can lengthen and manipulate the vines, allowing her to attack, defend and grapple. She also can detach them at will. The vines will grow back, provided her head receives proper sunlight and water. (Source: MyHero Academia Wiki)

21856.name: Nemuri Kayama
21856.desc: __Height:__ 175 cm (5'9") __Quirk:__ Somnambulist Pro Hero. She also works as a Modern Hero Art History teacher at U.A. High School. Nemuri is a very playful and flirtatious person with an unpredictably serious and temperamental side to her. She gets angry whenever someone interrupts her or insults her. She is especially sensitive about her age. Despite her flirtatious personality, Nemuri was intelligent, perceptive, and articulate. While she comes off as a hero who enjoys her fame derived from her beauty and sex appeal, Nemuri has demonstrated true heroism and bravery, willing to fight on the front lines and put her life at risk for others. Nemuri's Quirk "Somnambulist" allows her to put nearby people to sleep by exuding a sleep-inducing aroma from her body. Her Quirk works better on males than females.

21856.name: Sorahiko Torino
21856.desc: __Height:__ 128 cm (4'2") __Affiliation:__ Yuuei (Retired) __Quirk:__ Jet A retired hero who is one of All Might's colleagues and his former homeroom teacher. He was the one who taught All Might to control One For All during the his early days, and his training was so intense that All Might fears him to the point he subconsciously tried to forget about him until Grantorino sent his recommendation for Izuku to help him improve One For All, becoming his work place mentor. His Quirk is "Jet," allowing him to take in air through the sole of his foot to allow him to jump higher. (Source: Wikipedia)

21856.name: Tensei Iida
21856.desc: __Quirk:__ Engine Tensei Iida, also known as Turbo Hero "Ingenium", is the older brother of Tenya Iida and a former Pro Hero. Outside of his hero armor Tensei looks much like his younger brother Tenya, with square features and short black spiked hair. A differing feature is that he possesses arrow-shaped eyebrows and has a slightly longer face. Similar to his brother, he has engine exhausts protruding from his body, but out of the ends of his elbows instead of his calves. **Also in Illegals:** Tensei meets with Koichi during an early morning run. Tensei is impressed with Koichi's Quirk and offers him a place in his agency, even expressing a desire for a sidekick with a fast mobility quirk. Later, when Tensei discovers Koichi has been working as a vigilante hero, he withdraws his offer to Koichi, but only because he believes him to be already in the right place.

21856.name: Shinji Nishiya
21856.desc: __Height:__ 168 cm (5'6") __Quirk:__ Arbor Pro Hero. Underneath his helmet, he has puffy red leaf-like hair, though his face has remained unseen since he has only been shown while wearing his mask. Shinji is a very serious and focused person when it comes to being a hero in his hero duties; however, he easily feels down when someone takes his glory or credit. Shinji's Quirk "Arbor" (樹木, Jumoku) allows him to enlarge and control his wooden body parts into strong tree branches. These branches are excellent for binding.

21856.name: Natsuo Todoroki
21856.desc: __Height:__ 181 cm Natsuo Todoroki is a college student. He is the son of [Enji](https://anilist.co/character/126158/Todoroki-Enji) and [Rei Todoroki](https://anilist.co/character/150628/Todoroki-Rei), the younger brother of Toya and [Fuyumi](https://anilist.co/character/150627/Todoroki-Fuyumi), and the older brother of [Shoto](https://anilist.co/character/89220/Todoroki-Shouto). Natsuo is a young man of average height, sporting white spiky hair with two small pieces of hair hanging down by his forehead. He greatly resembles his father at his age. Natsuo seems to be a care-free individual, as seen in his interactions with him and his family. However, he can be serious, and cares deeply for his family, except his father who he resents for his abusive treatment to his family. He does not feel forgiving to his father, blaming him for his mother Rei's hospitalization and Shoto's suffering.

21856.name: Naomasa Tsukauchi
21856.desc: Naomasa Tsukauchi is a police detective in the Police Force. Naomasa is a tall man with short black hair and black eyes. As a member of the police force, he is normally seen in his uniform. He wears a signature tan overcoat and a matching hat. He also sports a black suit underneath with matching slacks and dress shoes. Detective Tsukauchi is an earnest, hardworking individual who has earned the right to be a close friend of All Might. Enough so, that he was even entrusted with the truth about One For All and the latter's true form. He appears to have a close relationship with All Might, as he even leaked sensitive information to the hero just because he felt it was the right thing to do.

21856.name: Inko Midoriya
21856.desc: __Height:__ 160 cm (5'3'') Izuku Midoriya's mother. Her quirk allows her to pull small objects towards her.

21856.name: Kurogiri
21856.desc: __Affiliation:__ League of Villains __Quirk:__ Warp Gate Kurogiri has a level-headed personality, which often serves to ground Tomura Shigaraki's immaturity. He is intensely loyal to both All For One and Tomura. He is very polite and well-spoken, even to enemies. ~! Kurogiri is actually an intelligent Nomu made from the corpse of Eraserhead and President Mics high school friend Oboro Shirakumo made to serve Tomura Shigaraki. Although he remains unaware of his previous identity after Eraserheads efforts to talk to him it’s shown that a small part of Oboro is still in Kurogiri!~

21856.name: Giran
21856.desc: Giran is a B-rank villain and broker in affiliation with the League of Villains, working to scout new recruits for their organization

21856.name: Emi Fukukado
21856.desc: __Height:__ 5'5 __Quirk:__ Outburst Pro Hero and a teacher of 2nd year, Class 2 at Ketsubutsu Academy High School.

21856.name: Togaru Kamakiri
21856.desc: __Height:__ 158 cm (6'2") __Quirk:__ Razor Sharp __Affiliation:__ Yuuei __Occupation:__ Student Togaru Kamakiri is a student in Class 1-B at U.A.

21856.name: Shinya Kamihara
21856.desc: __Height:__ 170 cm (5'7") __Quirk:__ Foldabody: Shinya's Quirk allows him to make his body and limbs extremely thin and long, effectively allowing him to transform himself into a razor sharp string. He is able to transform faster than the speed of sound. Shinya is a calm and focused individual, who is able to maintain a level head even when in a crisis situation, and encourages his teammates when they begin to panic. He is proven to be quite intelligent and is good at analyzing situations and strategy. He is the former Number 5 Pro-Hero, and is currently Number 4.

21856.name: Tsunagu Hakamada
21856.desc: __Height:__ 190cm (6'3") __Quirk:__ Fiber Master Pro Hero, ranked in the top 4. He is the recipient of the "Best Jeanist" award for eight consecutive years. Tsunagu is an elegant man with flamboyant tendencies. He believes very strongly that people with influence must maintain a positive appearance both physically and socially. Tsunagu often uses metaphors referencing jeans, denim, and various other sewing and fabric-based phrases, often inspiring his recruits with speeches, telling them to keep their life straight like their jeans. Tsunagu takes the role of being a hero very seriously. He is selfless, brave, and charismatic, and he aims to spread a sense of a peace to all people, no matter how dire the situation. Tsunagu's Quirk "Fiber Master (ファイバーマスター)" allows him to freely manipulate the threads in any nearby piece of fabric. He has power over all types of cloth, but his Quirk works best with denim and is less effective on sweats. Fiber Master also works on other types of fiber not related to fabric, such as carbon fibers. He primarily uses this power to restrain his targets, either by using their own clothing against them, or simply unravels portions of his own clothing into strings.

21856.name: Nezu
21856.desc: __Height:__ 85 cm __Quirk:__ High Spec Nezu, also known as Mr. Principal is a Pro Hero and the principal of U.A. High School. He is an extremely rare case of an animal who manifested a Quirk. He can be very long-winded at times when explaining or educating.

21856.name: Gigantomachia
21856.desc: Gigantomachia is a villain associated with the League of Villains.[1] He is one of All For One's faithful servants and his former bodyguard, cultivated to be of use to Tomura Shigaraki if anything were to happen to him.

21856.name: Thirteen
21856.desc: Thirteen is a wise, well-mannered person. As a rescue hero, Thirteen has displayed how passionate they are about saving people through their teachings. They even developed their own training facility - the Unforeseen Simulation Joint - to train future heroes in search and rescue tactics. They are very passionate about Quirks, specifically on the topic of using Quirks for creation and assistance rather than for destruction and battle. Thirteen has also been shown to be very brave. Despite not being a combat type, they do not hesitate to use their Quirk to fight against villains in the name of protecting others

21856.name: Pony  Tsunotori
21856.desc: __Quirk:__ Horn Cannon Pony is a timid girl. As a foreigner, she does not have much knowledge of the language in Japan. She is shown to be rather naive and innocent in personality, learning nasty phrases from Neito Monoma without realizing what those words mean, as shown when Neito tells Pony unkind phrases to tell Class 1-A. Pony is a thoughtful and diligent person. She is the one who made her team not lose against Class 1-A because of her strategy and perseverance. She is highly observant and seems to be a careful person. Despite this, she made some unkind comments towards Mezo Shoji in their battle, calling him an "octopus" and saying she doesn't like looking at him. Pony's Quirk allows her to send her horns flying and remotely control them at will. She is able to control up to four horns that are sent flying. She has also been shown to be able to balance on them as they carry her around, much like Hawks' wings. When Pony gets angry, she starts speaking in her native language: English.

21856.name: Ryou Inui
21856.desc: Ryo Inui is a Pro Hero and serves as the Lifestyle Guidance Counselor at U.A. High School.

21856.name: Setsuna Tokage
21856.desc: Setsuna Tokage is a student in Class 1-B at U.A. High School, and is one of four students admitted through recommendations; one being her fellow 1-B classmate Juzo Honenuki, as well as rival Class 1-A students Shoto Todoroki and Momo Yaoyorozu.

21856.name: Kinoko  Komori
21856.desc: Kinoko Komori is a student in Class 1-B, and is training to be a Pro Hero. Her quirk, Mushroom, allows her to spread spores that sprout mushrooms wherever they land, including inside of people's bodies.

21856.name: Yui Kodai
21856.desc: Yui Kodai is a student in Class 1-B of U.A. High School. She is a quiet girl, but nevertheless cares about her fellow classmates.

21856.name: Juzo Honenuki
21856.desc: __Height:__ 174 cm (5'8½") __Affiliation:__ U.A High __Quirk:__ Softening Juzo Honenuki is a student in Class 1-B at U.A. High School, and is one of four students admitted through recommendations; one being his fellow 1-B classmate [Setsuna Tokage](https://anilist.co/character/149179/Tokage-Setsuna), the others being rival 1-A students [Shoto Todoroki](https://anilist.co/character/89220/Todoroki-Shouto) and [Momo Yaoyorozu](https://anilist.co/character/89241/Yaoyorozu-Momo). Juzo's Quirk allows him to soften any non-living thing he touches. For example, he can soften the ground to make it similar to quicksand, hindering movements and mobility. If Juzo makes contact again, he can undo the effect. He is also capable of swimming through softened material.

21856.name: Desutegoro
21856.desc: Death Arms is a Pro Hero. He took part in the fight against the Sludge Villain, and later witnessed the U.A. Sports Festival from outside the arena, along with Mt. Lady and Kamui Woods.

21856.name: Ken Ishiyama
21856.desc: Cementoss is a Pro Hero as well as a teacher at U.A. High School. During the U.A. Sports Festival, he acted as the proctor for the 1-on-1 fights in case things got out of hand. He also faced off against Eijiro Kirishima and Rikido Sato in their Final Exam.

21856.name: Fuyumi Todoroki
21856.desc: The only daughter of Eiji and Rei. Fuyumi is the younger sister of Touya and the older sister of Natsuo and Shouto. Fuyumi is a hard working girl, often making meals for the family and works as a teacher at an unnamed school. Unlike her family members, she doesn't resent her father and just wishes they could all be a happy family, though she realizes such a thing is unlikely. Upon hearing Shouto gains friends, however, Fuyumi gets quite excited over it and is happy for him. In the past, Fuyumi took care of Shouto after their mother went to a hospital and never came back. To this day, her wish that she could have done something for Shouto still lingers within her.

21856.name: Rei Todoroki
21856.desc: The damaged mother of the Todoroki family. Rei has an ice related quirk, which is believed to be powerful, as Eiji would not have had kids with her otherwise. In the past, Rei was very supportive towards Shouto and his dreams to become like All Might. She used to always say that his blood does not define him for him and for herself. Rei, who was once a kind and caring woman, is now in a mental ward. After all the abuse she faced from Eiji, she began to become mentally unstable. Over time, she had slowly began to snap, until she finally poured boiling water onto Shouto's left side after seeing it. Immediately after burning Shouto, Rei began to apologize and attempt to comfort him when she realized what she had done. Due to her snapping, she was placed into a mental ward for her own safety. Even though Rei is in a mental ward, she has since returned to her former self. When Shouto visited, she was immensely happy and apologized for what she had done to him. Fuyumi and Natsuo also visit her as well, though she has yet to meet Eiji face to face again out of fear.

21856.name: Ectoplasm
21856.desc: __Height:__ 180 cm (5' 11") __Affiliation:__ Yuuei __Quirk:__ Clones Ectoplasm has the ability to produce ectoplasm from his mouth and transform it into clones of himself. He can create up to thirty clones at once, and push his limit to thirty-six if he's feeling good. He can also produce a giant clone of himself, although this sacrifices his ability to produce normal-sized ones for the time being. His clones can be defeated with a strong blow, but otherwise, only Ectoplasm can dispel them.

21856.name: Chiyo  Shuuzenji
21856.desc: __Quirk:__ Heal __Occupation:__ Pro Hero, Nurse Chiyo has a very kind and compassionate personality, where she treats everyone kindly, though she does have a strict and reproaching attitude towards those that have done something foolish. She's mostly like this with All Might for not teaching Izuku how to use his Quirk properly or with Izuku for using his Quirk recklessly.

21856.name: Sen Kaibara
21856.desc: __Height:__ 172 cm (5'7½") __Quirk:__ Gyrate Kaibara Sen is a student from 1-B. His quirk "Gyrate" allows Kaibara to rotate any part of his body.

21856.name: Gunhead
21856.desc: Gunhead is a pro hero. We meet him when Ochaco Uraraka does an internship at the Battle Hero's Office. Gunhead is a very professional individual whose kindness and friendliness makes him a great teacher. Despite his outward appearance he has cute tendencies such as posing cutely.

21856.name: Snipe
21856.desc: __Quirk:__ Homing Snipe is a Pro Hero and a member of the teaching staff at U.A. High School. Snipe has the appearance of a stereotypical western cowboy Snipe's Quirk allows him to lock on to any target he can see within six hundred meters and make any projectile he releases chase after said target

21856.name: Higari Maijima
21856.desc: Higari Maijima, also known as the Excavation Hero: Power Loader, is a Pro Hero and faculty member at U.A. High School.

21856.name: Sekijiro Kan
21856.desc: Sekijiro Kan, also known by his hero name, Blood Hero: Vlad King, is a Pro Hero and the homeroom teacher of U.A. High School's Class 1-B.

21856.name: Shihai Kuroiro
21856.desc: Shihai is a sly, deceitful schemer, who prefers to catch people off guard. He appears to enjoy dark concepts and has a penchant for dramatic speech

21856.name: Juurouta Shishida
21856.desc: Juurouta seems to be an intellectual as he uses a fairly verbose way of speaking and often addresses others by respectful titles such as 'sir' and 'miss'. This is because he was brought up in a very well mannered and doting family. While transformed, however Juurouta is rather boisterous and energetic, which is likely a side effect of his Quirk.

21856.name: Nirengeki Shoda
21856.desc: Nirengeki has a very humble attitude, as he will not take credit for something he does not feel he earned by his own strength.

21856.name: Kousei Tsuburaba
21856.desc: __Height:__ 170 cm (5'7") __Affiliation:__ U.A High __Quirk:__ Solid Air Kousei is a very enthusiastic and competitive individual who holds himself to a high standard as he makes an effort to avoid descending to the level of his rivals.

21856.name: Manga Fukidashi
21856.desc: Manga appears to be an expressive and dramatic person. He is a regular man with a white speech bubble head that can change shape and display his thoughts in written form.

21856.name: Yosetsu Awase
21856.desc: Although he is not as social as some others, Yosetsu is foul-mouthed and tense, except for serious or life-or-death situations, in which he becomes very easily startled and much more talkative, although he retains his harsh way of speech.

21856.name: Hiryu Rin
21856.desc: **Height:** 170 cm (5'7") __Quirk:__ Scales He is a Class 1-B student in U.A. High School, training to become a Pro Hero. It's notable that Hiryu possesses a serious demeanor when it comes to playing out his abilities into action. He is rather diligent in terms of academic abilities and Quirk functions as well. Hiryu has shown to be a very competent combatant, with a great handle on the applications of his Quirk. Thanks to the versatile nature of his Scales Quirk, Hiryu excels in both close and long-range combat, effectively switching between hand-to-hand combat, and shooting off his scales when it’s most convenient to him.

21856.name: Reiko Yanagi
21856.desc: Reiko is a quiet and emotionless teenager who often shows an odd body posture.

21856.name: Kojiro Bondo
21856.desc: An easy going guy and described as a gentle giant.

21856.name: Selkie
21856.desc: Can do pretty much everything a spotted seal can do. He can even make sonar-like sound and use the echo to determine his opponent's position. He is also very strong even if he believes that he can make a very cute seal face (which most people think is not).

21856.name: Masaki Mizushima
21856.desc: __Height:__ 176 cm __Occupation:__ Pro Hero Masaki Mizushima, also known as Normal Hero: Manuais, is the current No. 222 Pro Hero. He is based out of Hosu City.

21856.name: Uwabami
21856.desc: Uwabami is a Pro Hero.

21856.name: Mitsuki Bakugou
21856.desc: Mitsuki Bakugou is Katsuki Bakugou's mother and the wife of Masaru Bakugou.

21856.name: Kenji Tsuragamae
21856.desc: Kenji is the Chief of the Police Force.

21856.name: Sansa Tamakawa
21856.desc: Sansa is a member in the Police Force.

21856.name: Fuutou Nahashira
21856.desc: Student in U.A. High School's Business Course. Strongly influenced by Best Jeanist.

21856.name: Josei Kisha
21856.desc: Television news reporter.

110277.name: Narrator
110277.desc: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

110277.name: Mikasa Ackerman
110277.original: ミカサ・アッカーマン
110277.desc: __Height:__ 170 cm (5'7") - 176 cm (5'9½") __Position:__ 104th Training Corps, Survey Corps __Relatives:__ [Birth Mother](https://anilist.co/character/84341/Mikasa-no-Haha) (Deceased), [Birth Father](https://anilist.co/character/84339/Mikasa-no-Chichi) (Deceased), [Grisha Yaeger](https://anilist.co/character/62477/Grisha-Yeager) (Foster Father), [Carla Yaeger](https://anilist.co/character/62475/Carla-Yeager) (Foster Mother, Deceased), [Eren Yeager](https://anilist.co/character/40882/Eren-Yeager) (Foster Brother) Mikasa is Eren Yaeger's foster sister and mutual childhood friend of [Armin Arlert](https://anilist.co/character/46494), living with the two of them in Shiganshina District within the southern region of Wall Maria. When she was young, her parents were killed by human traffickers, and she was kidnapped. Eren discovered this and helped her escape her captors. Later, Eren gave her his scarf, which she constantly wears and shares an emotional attachment to. She was adopted by the Yaeger family soon after. Because of these past events, Mikasa shares an unbreakable bond with Eren and lives to protect him, constantly worrying for Eren's well-being. After the Titans broke through Wall Maria and killed her and Eren's mother, she chose to follow Eren into the military to try and keep him safe from danger. Even as a child, Mikasa possessed impressive fighting skill and strength, and that skill was only honed further during her training. Mikasa is considered a genius among all th

110277.name: Eren Yeager
110277.desc: __Height:__ 170 cm (5'7") - 183 cm (6'0") __Affiliation:__ 104th Trainees Squad, Survey Corps. Eren was born to [Carla](https://anilist.co/character/62475/Yeager-Carla) and [Grisha Yeager](https://anilist.co/character/62477/Yeager-Grisha) in Shiganshina District within the southern region of Wall Maria. He grew up in the town with his parents and foster sister [Mikasa](https://anilist.co/character/40881/Ackerman-Mikasa), who moved in with the Yeagers as a child. Eren spent most of his time with Mikasa and their mutual best friend [Armin Arlert](https://anilist.co/character/46494/Arlert-Armin), whom the pair often defended from neighborhood bullies. Eren is a passionate, determined, hardheaded, and impulsive young man. When they were children, Armin showed him a book depicting the wonders of the outside world. Eren grew to share Armin's curiosity of the world beyond the Walls and resolved to see it for himself. This dream inspired his admiration of the Survey Corps and his desire to join their ranks as soon as he became eligible for enrollment. When the Titans suddenly broke through Wall Maria into Shiganshina, Eren was forced to watch on as his mother became trapped under the rubble of their house and eaten by a titan. Forever changed from this event, Eren vows to kill every last titan.

110277.name: Levi
110277.desc: __Height:__ 160 cm (5'3") Squad Captain of the Special Operations Squad (known as Squad Levi) within the Survey Corps. He is known as humanity's strongest soldier. Levi is abrasive, blunt, and has a strong respect for structure and discipline. He is a clean-freak, demanding spotless cleanliness of himself, his equipment, and his environment. Rumors say he was involved in underground crime in his life before coming a soldier. Despite his emotionless and unfriendly demeanor, Levi cares deeply for his squad and greatly values human life.

110277.name: Sasha Blouse
110277.desc: __Initial Height:__ 168cm __Affiliations__: 104th Cadet Corps, Survey Corps; Soldier __Relatives__: [Artur Blouse](https://anilist.co/character/131281/Artur-Blouse) (Father), [Lisa Blouse](https://anilist.co/character/134952/Lisa-Blouse) (Mother) Originally from Dauper, a remote and scarcely populated village of hunters located in a mountain forest in the southern area of Wall Rose, Sasha joined the military as a cadet of the 104th Training Corps, where she ranked 9th upon graduation. After graduating, she'd choose to enlist in the Scouting Regiment. Sasha is a friendly and fun-loving girl. She speaks with a local accent from her home village, but initially hid it out of embarrassment by using overly formal and polite speech. She is a constant food hoarder and is known to have an incredible appetite; eating provided her with considerable gratification and relief, especially during times of great stress, and food was often the only thing on her mind when at ease. Raised as an animal hunter, Sasha specializes in archery, horseback riding, and tracking, although her eccentricity and unconventional methods tend to make her a poor fit for group operations. ~!She later saves a child named [Kaya](https://anilist.co/character/132738/Kaya) from a titan attack, who her family ends up adopting.!~

110277.name: Reiner Braun
110277.desc: __Height__: 185 cm (6'1") Member of the Survey Corps and former cadet of the 104th Training Corps. Reiner is a passionate and strong-willed young man with a strong sense of duty. He ranked 2nd in his training class upon graduation, finishing behind only [Mikasa](https://anilist.co/character/40881). His comrades have great trust in him, and he is stated to be the "big brother" of the 104th cadets.

110277.name: Connie Springer
110277.original: コニー・スプリンガー
110277.desc: __Height__: 158 cm (5'2") __Relatives:__ [Mother](https://anilist.co/character/137287/Conny-no-Haha), Martin Springer (Brother), Sunny Springer (Sister) Connie Springer is a graduate of the 104th Training Corps, having ranked 8th in class. He is known to be one of the quickest soldiers while using ODM gear and is skilled at making very sharp turns. He hails from the rural Ragako Village within Wall Rose, his greatest ambition being to make his family and village proud of him. Upon graduation, he chose to join the Survey Corps. Upbeat and naive, Connie is rather unfocused outside of combat, and enjoys goofing around and messing with his friends, but can also be a bit dense at times, as he can have some difficulty comprehending new developments as they appear. Connie always tries to remain optimistic, consistently caring for the well-being of his friends, family and village, and being willing to help in any way he can. However, this soft spot and the struggles he goes through as a member of the Survey Corps takes a toll on him, as he often responds to grief and loss with anger, irritation and hatred, causing him to at times make rash, impulsive decisions. He will do anything to protect his family, whether it be his biological family or his closest friends.

110277.name: Bertolt Hoover
110277.original: ベルトルト・フーバー
110277.desc: __Height__: 192 cm (6'3") __Affiliation__: Survey Corps Member of the Survey Corps and former cadet of the 104th Training Corps. Bertoldt ranked 3rd in his training class upon graduation, finishing behind only [Mikasa](https://anilist.co/character/40881) and his hometown friend [Reiner](https://anilist.co/character/46484). He is a quiet young man who identifies himself as someone with a weak will that follows popular opinion. Despite ranking 3rd in his class, his training commandant noted him to be a person with great potential, but an utter lack of initiative. Bertoldt originally he enlisted in the military with aspirations of joining the Military Police and living in the safety of the inner wall, but after the Battle of Trost he instead decided to join the Survey Corps.

110277.name: Annie Leonhart
110277.desc: __Height__: 153 cm (5") A member of the 104th Southern Division in the Cadet Corps. After graduating from the 104th, ranked 4th place in the top 10, she ends up joining the Military Police. She is roommates with [Hitch Dreyse](https://anilist.co/character/86017). A stoic girl, Annie is considered to be an isolated, solitary type, being rarely seen smiling or socializing and often having an emotionless expression. She is apathetic and somnolent, with little desire to put in any effort into meaningless disciplines or activities. Nonetheless, what drives Annie more than anything is her desire for a normal life.

110277.name: Armin Arlert
110277.original: アルミン・アルレルト
110277.desc: __Height:__ 163 cm (5'4") __Position:__ 104th Trainees Squad, Survey Corps __Relatives:__ [Grandfather](https://anilist.co/character/84313/Armin-no-Ojiisan) Armin is a young boy who was born and raised in the Shiganshina District within the walls, being childhood friends with both [Eren Yeager](https://anilist.co/character/40882/Eren-Yeager) and [Mikasa Ackerman](https://anilist.co/character/40881). After Wall Maria was breached, he chose to join Mikasa and Eren in joining the military, both to try to make a good and meaningful impact on the world, and to fulfill his dream of seeing the outside world. Even when he was young, the naturally curious Armin has always had a deep fascination with the world beyond the Walls. As a child, he found and studied an illegal book about the outside world that was owned by his grandfather. He often shared the book and information contained in it with Eren Yeager, his best friend, and his dreams of seeing the world outside the walls. Armin was branded a heretic by other children for his unusual interest in the outside world and was thus frequently picked on. Too timid to defend himself, Armin would often rely on his friends Eren and Mikasa Ackerman to protect him from local bullies. This, coupled with his frail physique, was a deep shame for Armin, leading him to have poor self-esteem and to believe that he is a burden to others. Because of this, Armin has always been very eager to prove his worth, especially towards his close friends. Armin

110277.name: Jean Kirstein
110277.original: ジャン・キルシュタイン
110277.desc: __Height__: 175 cm (5'8") __Relatives__: [Mother](https://anilist.co/character/131444/Jean-no-Haha) Jean Kirschtein is a graduate of the 104th Cadet Corps, among whom he ranked 6th for his skills with ODM gear and ability to look at things through a more tactical lense. Jean hails from Wall Rose's Trost District, and joined the military with hopes of living a peaceful life within the walls as part of the Military Police. However, he would later find himself joining the Survey Corps after being convinced both by his close friend [Marco Bott's](https://anilist.co/character/62479/Marco-Bott) words, and after witnessing the death of several of his comrades. Jean has a blunt personality. He holds no restraint when it comes to speaking his mind, even when he knows it would not be wise to do so or when it could spark conflict. Jean is also pragmatic: he has a strong aversion to exposing himself to dangerous situations. During his time as a cadet, Jean was extremely hot-headed, easily becoming frustrated and quick to resort to violence when pushed. Jean was also very cynical about defeating the Titans, believing that humanity has no chance against them and openly mocking more idealistic individuals like [Eren Yeager](https://anilist.co/character/40882/Eren-Yeager), and saw resisting the Titans as a hopeless cause. However, despite these things, and although he presents himself as self-centered, Jean places high value on the lives of his comrades, and is willing to risk his life to pr

110277.name: Grisha Yeager
110277.original: グリシャ・イェーガー
110277.desc: Father of [Eren Yaeger](https://anilist.co/character/40882/Eren-Yeager) and caretaker of [Mikasa Ackerman](https://anilist.co/character/40881/Mikasa-Ackerman). He is a renowned doctor who was well respected in the District of Shiganshina after he saved the village from a mysterious viral epidemic by developing vaccines. He also provides a medical house call service to the people of Shiganshina and to various towns in addition to having a network of contacts within the Corps of the Shiganshina District. He is married to [Carla Yaeger](https://anilist.co/character/62475). ~!In the basement of the Yeager family house, he hides a secret which he refers to as the "truth". Upon finding Eren after the fall of Wall Maria, he injects him with a series of chemicals and amnesiacs and entrusts him with the key to the "truth", before mysteriously disappearing. This strange serum resulted in Eren gaining the ability to transform into a titan.!~

110277.name: Marco Bott
110277.desc: __Height__: 178 cm (5'9") __Affiliations__: 104th Training Corps Originally from Jinae District. Marco ranked 7th in the 104th Training Corps and is widely respected by other cadets of the 104th. Marco is a very kind, calm, and idealistic person, valuing the good of the group above his own interests, as well as understanding and coping with his own shortcomings and limitations. He is seen as a natural leader, and desires to join the Military Police to serve near the King. *Note: Marco Bott is the official English translation by Kodansha.*

110277.name: Krista Lenz
110277.desc: __Height__: 145 cm (4'8") __Affiliations__: 104th Trainees Squad, Survey Corps Ranked tenth in the trainee class, Krista is a very shy and kind, caring person, often being described as a "goddess" or "angel" by her peers. She is good friends with [Ymir](https://anilist.co/character/71479/Ymir).

110277.name: Thomas Wagner
110277.desc: Thomas Wagner was from Trost District. A member of the 104th Trainees Squad, he first met Eren Yeager while questioning him about the Colossal Titan. Later, he operated the training gear for the Three Dimensional Maneuver Gear during Eren's second attempt at his aptitude test. At Keith Shadis' orders, Thomas exchanged gear with Eren and it was discovered that Eren's gear was defective. After graduating, Thomas planned to join the Scouting Legion. ~!After the second attack of the Colossal Titan, he was assigned to the middle guard along with Eren Yeager and Armin Arlert. Initially tasked with working under the training corps, they eventually were incorporated into the front guard due to the number of titans. Catching the group unaware, a titan lunged at the rooftop they were standing on. The group scattered but unfortunately, Thomas wasn't fast enough. He was caught and swallowed whole, while his teammate, Eren, looked on in terror.!~

110277.name: Dot Pixis
110277.desc: The highest-ranked Administrator of the Southern Region. Head of the Garrison's Southern Territories, Pixis is a cunning leader with astute insights. However, he is also an alcoholic who is constantly watched over by his aid, [Anka](https://anilist.co/character/84331/Anka-Rheinberger), who constantly scolds him for sleeping and drinking during critical moments.

110277.name: Hange Zoe
110277.desc: __Height:__ 170 cm (5'7") __Affiliation:__ Survey Corps; Section Commander, Squad Leader. Leader of the Survey Corps' Fourth Squad, Hange is also in charge of conducting research on Titans, and pursues this knowledge so passionately that they have become obsessed with Titans as a result. After originally holding a deep hatred for the creatures, Hange decided to take on a new outside-the-box approach to their research by letting go of their resentment towards Titans and approaching the test subjects with compassion. Hange is an energetic, freethinking and quirky scientist, with a unique way of conducting both themselves and their work. Hange is a genius outside of just Titan research too, using their brain to create weapons, tactical plans, and inventions for the benefit of humanity. As a leader, Hange is thoughtful of their comrades, and can easily figure out complex problems in order to create plans for their teammates to carry out.

110277.name: Nile Dok
110277.desc: Chief of the Military Police.

110277.name: Darius Zackly
110277.desc: The head of all three divisions of the army. __ _Note:___ Darius Zackly is the official English translation by Kodansha.

110277.name: Ymir
110277.desc: __Height:__ 172 cm (5'7") __Affiliations:__ 104th Trainees Squad, Scouting Legion Member of the Scouting Legion. She seems selfish, cynical, bossy, sly, uncooperative, exploitative, and confrontational, but she can apparently be kind, especially to [Krista](https://anilist.co/character/62481/Krista-Lenz).

110277.name: Keith Shadis
110277.original: キース・シャーディス
110277.desc: Keith Shadis was the head instructor of the 104th Trainees Squad. He seemed to be a friend or have some sort of relationship with Dr. Grisha, as he knew Eren is the son of the doctor and praised Eren for his effort.

110277.name: Anka Rheinberger
110277.original: アンカ・ラインベルガー

110277.name: Hitch Dreyse
110277.desc: **Height:** 168 cm __Affiliations:__ 104th Cadet Corps. Recruit of the Military Police stationed in Stohess District. She was roommates with [Annie Leonhart](https://anilist.co/character/46490/Annie-Leonhart). Hitch acts immature in certain ways, she has a sarcastic, easygoing personality and seems to mischievously enjoy teasing and needling her fellow officers, especially [Marlo Freudenberg](https://anilist.co/character/71457/Marlo-Freudenberg). She claims she chose to join the Military Police out of laziness, as it is well known that the senior staff are incredibly corrupt and she wanted to benefit from the system herself; however, she did not take into account that, as a new recruit, her superiors would dump all their work on her. Though she may act a bit air-headed at times, Hitch is not selfish and cares about those around her, especially her fellow comrades.

110277.name: Pieck Finger
110277.desc: __Height__: 155 cm Pieck is an Eldian who serves as one of Marley's Warriors. She is shown to be somewhat sweet and kind, consistently shown to care about her fellow Warriors and the Warrior candidates. ~!She is the current inheritor of the Cart Titan.!~

110277.name: Gabi Braun
110277.desc: __Height__: 138 cm Gabi Braun is an Eldian living in the Liberio internment zone and the cousin of [Reiner Braun](https://anilist.co/character/46484/Reiner-Braun). She is friends with her fellow warrior candidates [Udo](https://anilist.co/character/125663), [Zofia](https://anilist.co/character/125664/Zofia), and [Falco Grice](https://anilist.co/character/125660). Gabi is very passionate and head-strong, expressing her emotions and opinions without inhibition. She is also brave, possessing boundless determination, and willing to put her life on the line to complete a goal for a perceived greater good. However, these attributes can also make her somewhat overbearing and domineering. This causes her to be tactless at times, forcing her opinions on others and taking charge regardless of whether it was asked for or not. She mostly shows this side around her fellow Warrior candidates, considering herself their de facto leader to an extent, and even threatening to 'punish' them when they disagree with her. Nonetheless, she is friendly enough that they have no issue with spending their leisure time with her. Aside from her resolve and determination, Gabi is care-free even on the battlefield, making remarks about her cuteness and claiming her commander loves her too much to sacrifice her. ~!She is a Warrior candidate that is likely to inherit the Armored Titan.!~

110277.name: Falco Grice
110277.desc: __Height__: 140 cm __Position__: Warrior Candidate Falco Grice is an Eldian Warrior candidate working for the Marley government and is the younger brother of [Colt Grice](https://anilist.co/character/125665/Colt-Grice). Falco is close friends with his fellow warrior candidates; [Udo](https://anilist.co/character/125663/Udo), [Zofia](https://anilist.co/character/125664/Zofia), and [Gabi](https://anilist.co/character/125659/Gabi-Braun). While not as physically strong as his fellow soldiers, he makes up for it with his quick wit and improvisation. He is a very merciful and compassionate person, going out of his way to protect and save other people lives, even enemy soldiers. He is also very polite and respectful towards others, and is an empathetic person, being willing to hear people out and properly understand things from their points of view. ~!He is a candidate to inherit the power of the Armored Titan. He has the desire to become the Armored Titan in order to prevent Gabi Braun from inheriting it, as he has a crush on her and wants them to live a long life.!~

110277.name: Zeke
110277.desc: __Height__: 183 cm Zeke is the current inheritor of the Beast Titan, and is considered by [Reiner Braun](https://anilist.co/character/46484/Reiner-Braun) to be the strongest Warrior, contrasting [Levi's](https://anilist.co/character/45627/Levi) title of "humanity's strongest soldier".

110277.name: Porco Galliard
110277.desc: __Height:__ 175 cm __Position:__ Marley's Warrior Porco Galliard is an Eldian and the younger brother of Marcel Galliard. ~!He is one of Marley's Warriors and inherited the Jaw Titan from Ymir.!~

110277.name: Udo
110277.desc: __Height__: 146 cm __Position__: Warrior Candidate Udo is an Eldian Warrior candidate working for the Marley government. ~!He is a candidate to inherit the Armored Titan power.!~

110277.name: Zofia
110277.desc: __Height__: 142 cm __Position__: Warrior Candidate Zofia is an Eldian Warrior candidate working for the Marley government. ~!She is a candidate to inherit the Armored Titan power.!~

110277.name: Colt Grice
110277.desc: __Height__: 180 cm __Position__: Warrior Candidate Colt Grice is an Eldian living in Marley and the older brother of [Falco Grice](https://anilist.co/character/125660). ~!He is a Warrior candidate who is selected to be the next wielder of the Beast Titan power.!~

110277.name: Kenny Ackerman
110277.original: ケニー・アッカーマン
