110277.desc: __Affiliation:__ Military Police; Captain of Anti-Personnel Control Squad. __Relatives:__ [Kuchel Ackerman](https://anilist.co/character/127940/Kuchel-Ackerman) (Sister), [Unnamed Grandfather](https://anilist.co/character/128589/Kenny-no-Ojiisan), Kenny Ackerman is a member of the Military Police Brigade's First Interior Squad and also the Anti-Personnel Control Squad. Decades prior, however, Kenny was known as an infamous serial killer that stalked victims in the capitol. Despite his dark field of work, Kenny appears to be rather jovial and takes pleasure in taunting his adversaries during battle. When fighting, he becomes animated and lively, often making a scene or otherwise throwing insults and witticisms. However, he also fought with control and was able to effortlessly sneak up on his targets when they least expected him. His preferred method of killing during his time as a serial killer was to slit the throats of his victims which earned him his infamous handle "Kenny the Ripper", and it was rumored that he murdered over 100 members of the Military Police Brigade. However, decades later his killings ceased and the terror that he once inspired dwindled into an Urban Legend. He eventually was found working under the Royal Government, the reasoning for his sudden shift in behavior being a mystery. Kenny is ultimately, despite his comical personality, very cold and calculated, sparing little emotional attachment or loyalty to anyone, with only a few exceptions. ~!ㅤ He nota

110277.name: Flagel  Reeves
110277.original: フレーゲル・リーブス
110277.desc: Flegel Reeves is the son of Dimo Reeves

110277.name: Marcel Galliard
110277.original: マルセル・ガリアード
110277.desc: ~!Marcel was a comrade and childhood friend of Reiner Braun, Bertolt Hoover, and Annie Leonhart. He was part of the group sent by Marley to attack the Eldians of Paradis in year 845, but his mission was cut short by the sudden appearance of Ymir in her mindless Titan form.!~ (Source: Shingeki no Kyojin Wikia)

110277.name: Djel Sannes
110277.desc: Djel Sannes is a member of the Military Police Regiment and part of the First Interior Squad.

110277.name: Floch Forster
110277.original: フロック・フォルスター
110277.desc: Floch is a new recruit in the Survey Corps. He joined the Survey Corps during the two months between the attack at Orvud District and the return to Shiganshina District. ~!After the rest of the Yeagerists are killed during the port battle, Floch hides on the ship to Marley. After shooting holes in the fuel tank of the flying boat, Floch is ultimately killed by Mikasa.!~

110277.name: Roy
110277.desc: As a veteran journalist, Roy has come to accept and conform to the restrictive nature of the monarchy, fearing retaliation for defiance.

110277.name: Pierre
110277.desc: As a rookie reporter, Pierre has not yet become jaded like his superior Roy. He is very bold in his reporting, unafraid of asking questions of Military Police officers that would otherwise be considered "off-limits." He takes his job of reporting the truth very seriously, becoming frustrated when he is kept from printing news that would be scandalous for the government.

110277.name: Annie no Chichi
110277.desc: Father and trainer of Annie Leonhart. He relentlessly trained Annie to fight, using mostly kicks and the attacker's weight against them. ~!Memories of his pleas for forgiveness later create an opening for Annie to crystallize herself before Eren Jaeger has the chance to capture her!~

110277.name: Artur Blouse
110277.original: アルトゥル・ブラウス
110277.desc: __Relatives:__ [Lisa Blause](https://anilist.co/character/134952/Lisa-Blouse) (Wife), [Sasha Blause](https://anilist.co/character/45887/Sasha-Blouse) (Daughter). Artur Blouse is the father of Sasha Blouse and a hunter in the Dauper village. It was his words that motivated Sasha to leave home and join the military. Artur appears to be a mature father figure who is deeply devoted to his clan. Though he appreciates his way of life, he realizes that many people's homes were taken by Titans and that they must share the forest for the greater good. He appears to be very wise, willing to accept change and move beyond their traditions if it meant a better way of life for everyone, and is very clearly a selfless person who puts others before himself. Like his daughter, he has a native Dauper accent. ~!ㅤ After his daughter Sasha saved [Kaya](https://anilist.co/character/132738/Kaya), he and his wife decided to adopt her and open their home up to other orphaned children whose family was slain by the titans, going so far as to refer to them as his "family."!~

110277.name: Willy Tybur
110277.desc: ~!An Eldian noble living in Marley. He was the head of the Tybur family and controlled Marley behind the shadows, although he chose not to interfere with Marley's military decisions.!~

110277.name: Theo Magath
110277.desc: A commander of the Eldian Unit of the Marley army. Formerly one of the chief overseers of the first Warrior candidates during their training, he later led the Eldian Warriors in the Marley Mid-East War against the Mid-East Allied Forces, playing a key role in Marley's victory. ~!Through the support of Willy Tybur and the governmental party of Marley, along with the death of General Calvi, Magath is next in line to become the general of the Marleyan military forces.!~ ~!He sacrifices himself by blowing up the Marleyan ship to prevent the Yeagerists from catching the allies!~ (Source: Attack on Titan Wiki)

110277.name: Kaya
110277.desc: A civilian living within Wall Rose. She was saved by Sasha Blouse from a Titan during the Wall Rose invasion, and now lives with the Blouse family.

110277.name: Kaya no Haha
110277.desc: ~!During the Wall Rose invasion, she is left stranded in her town with her traumatized daughter as a Titan slowly eats her. Sasha Blouse arrives in the town to alert its citizens and finds the two women in the house they were left in. Sasha unsuccessfully attempts to cut the Titan's nape with an axe, and then notices the child in the room. Sasha apologizes to the mother as she decides to abandon her, and successfully takes her child to safety. The woman later dies from her wounds!~

110277.name: Dina Fritz
110277.desc: ~!Dina is the first wife of Grisha Yeager. One year after their marriage, she gave birth to their son, Zeke Yeager. Dina is of royal blood as member of the Fritz family. When the 145th Fritz King built the walls and decided to move to the island Paradis, her branch of the Fritz family stayed behind due to disagreements with the King's choice. She joined the Eldia Restorationists on Marley, in order to revive the pride and power of Eldia. In this group, she also met Grisha Yeager, whom she eventually married. She gave birth to their son, Zeke Yeager. At the age of 7, there son reported his parents to the Marley government. As a result, all the Eldia Restorationists were sent to Utopia. Sergeant Major Gross injected Dina with the Titan serum and she was thrown off the Borderline wall to Utopia, as Grisha, in horror, watched his wife turn into a Titan.!~ ~!After the Colossus Titan breaches Shiganshina District in Wall Maria, many Titans proceed inside and among them is Dina. She embarks inside the town and is seen by Eren and Mikasa as they try to free Carla Yeager, who is trapped under the debris of their house. Though Hannes initially comes to their aid and decides to face Dina, he stands catatonic in fear of her frightening appearance. After he realizes that he is too afraid to face it, he opts to instead take Eren and Mikasa to safety, leaving Eren's mother behind. Afterwards, Eren witnesses Dina pull Carla out of the debris, as it proceeds to violently incapacitate her and

110277.name: Yelena
110277.desc: Yelena is the leader of the Anti-Marleyan Volunteers working under [Zeke Yeager](https://anilist.co/character/125661/Zeke). She was one of the Marleyan soldiers on board the first survey fleet to Paradis Island after Marley's failed attack operation. She is a very tall woman with her blonde hair styled in a short bob with straight bangs. She has large dark eyes and somewhat androgynous features due to her build and style. Yelena is a fervent follower of Zeke Yeager, holding great admiration and respect for him. She is usually calm and collected, her demeanour remaining unchanged even when [Jean Kirstein](https://anilist.co/character/46498/Kirstein-Jean) yelled at her for failing to see her job through. Nonetheless, she is willing to take responsibility and apologizes should she fail in her task. Yelena appears to maintain a very relaxed demeanour while having dry, humorous undertones to much of her actions. ~!It is later revealed that Yelena was born into an unassuming family in Marley, and eventually became disillusioned with her own country. After meeting Zeke Yeager, Yelena concocted a plan to solidify herself in history by helping Zeke save the world. As part of her narrative, Yelena created a false background for herself, claiming that her homeland was invaded and conquered by Marley. She was forcibly drafted as a soldier to fight in the Marleyan military, where she met similar-minded soldiers and organized them into the Anti-Marleyan Volunteers to fight against Marley.!

110277.name: Niccolo
110277.desc: Nicolo is a former Marleyan soldier who served on Marley's Navy and was part of the first survey fleet to Paradis Island after the failed Paradis Island Operation. After being taken captive, he begins working on the island as a chef for the military. Niccolo was at first a very typical Marleyan, fearing the Eldians of Paradis Island and calling them devils. He was very disgusted with having been captured by them and having to live by their side, but after spending a lot of time with the Survey Corps, he and his comrades have developed grudging respect and shaky friendships with the ones they once thought of as devils. He notably grew a soft spot for a Survey Corp member, [Sasha Blouse](https://anilist.co/character/45887/Sasha-Blouse), after she complimented him on his cooking skills. Over time, the two gradually grew closer, enough for [Kaya](https://anilist.co/character/132738/Kaya) to believe they were in love. Niccolo credits Sasha with saving him from the war and teaching him that he can cook to make people happy.

110277.name: Lisa Blouse
110277.desc: The mother of [Sasha Blouse](https://anilist.co/character/45887/Sasha-Blouse) and wife of [Mr. Blouse](https://anilist.co/character/131281).

110277.name: Grice
110277.desc: He is a member of the Restorationists.

110277.name: Grisha no Chichi Yeager
110277.original: グリシャの父・イェーガー
110277.desc: He is the father of [Fay](https://anilist.co/character/133214/) and [Grisha Yeager](https://anilist.co/character/62477/), as well as the grandfather of [Eren Yeager](https://anilist.co/character/40882/).

110277.name: Grisha no Haha Yeager
110277.original: グリシャの母・イェーガー
110277.desc: She is the mother of [Fay](https://anilist.co/character/133214/) and [Grisha Yeager](https://anilist.co/character/62477/), as well as the grandmother of [Eren Yeager](https://anilist.co/character/40882/).

110277.name: Tom Ksaver
110277.desc: He is a man who knew Grisha Jaeger when he was growing up.

110277.name: Onyankopon
110277.desc: Onyankopon is one of the Anti-Marleyan Volunteers and aids the Survey Corps during the Raid on Liberio. He pilots an airship following orders from [Hange](https://anilist.co/character/71121/) for the Corps to use during their retreat.

110277.name: Koslow
110277.desc: He is a Marleyan officer who fought in the war against the Mid-East Allied Forces before Marley's victory. (Source: Attack on Titan Wiki)

110277.name: Karina Braun
110277.desc: Karina Braun is the mother of [Reiner Braun](https://anilist.co/character/46484/).

110277.name: Calvi
110277.desc: Calvi is the general of the Marleyan military forces.

110277.name: Nambia
110277.desc: is an ambassador from a foreign land and a childhood friend of Willy Tybur. She serves as one of several ambassadors for her nation during the Liberio festival following the Marley Mid-East War.

110277.name: Ogweno
110277.desc: Ogweno is an ambassador from a foreign land and a friend of Willy Tybur. He serves as one of several ambassadors for his nation during the Liberio festival following the Marley Mid-East War.

110277.name: Kiyomi Azumabito
110277.desc: Kiyomi is an ambassador of Hizuru and an ally to the Eldians on Paradis Island.

110277.name: Reiner Chichi
110277.desc: A Marleyan man who had an illegal relationship with the Eldian woman Karina Braun. He is the estranged father of Reiner Braun.

110277.name: Lara Tybur
110277.desc: She is Willy Tybur's sister. ~!She was the previous inheritor of the War Hammer Titan.!~

110277.name: Carlo
110277.desc: Carlo is a soldier of the Marleyan military and a member of the Panzer Unit.

110277.name: Karl Fritz
110277.desc: The first ruler of humanity inside the Walls and prior to that he ruled also as the 145th Fritz King of Eldia. ~!He possessed the Founding Titan which he used to create the Walls and alter the memories of humanity inside.!~

110277.name: Louise
110277.desc: A young girl who was in Trost with her mother attempting to flee when the Titans invaded. After being saved by [Mikasa Ackerman](https://anilist.co/character/40881/Mikasa-Ackerman) and the other 104th Cadets, she was inspired by their heroic actions and later joins the military herself as a Survey Corps recruit, hoping to get closer to Mikasa, her idol. Louise believes that strength is the most important attribute one can have in the world, to the point that she almost seems to have a "might equals right" mentality. Much of this mindset stems from her experiences during the Battle of Trost District, where she claims to have learned from watching Mikasa Ackerman fight in the face of adversity to achieve victory. She believes that the ends justify the means, and has no qualms about breaking rules if she believes that disobeying others will get her what she wants.

110277.name: Fine Tybur
110277.desc: is the oldest daughter of Willy Tybur.

110277.name: Lobov
110277.desc: A Scout Regiment recruit and former commander of the garrison who participated in the Raid on Liberio.

110277.name: Greiz
110277.desc: Former Marleyan soldier who served on Marley's Navy and is part of a survey fleet sent to Paradis Island after the failed Paradis Island Operation. After being taken captive on the island, he begins working as a waiter in a restaurant inside the Walls.

110277.name: Roeg
110277.desc: High ranking Military Police Regiment soldier.

110277.name: Varis
110277.desc: Varis is a Scout Regiment soldier who participated in the Raid on Liberio. Varis is a very loyal and trusted member of the Scout Regiment, being one of the few members trusted to help Levi Ackermann guard Zeke Jaeger, and remaining loyal to his superiors even after other soldiers defected to become members of the Jaegerists.

101759.name: Norman
101759.desc: __Height:__ 145 cm __Farm Identifier:__ 22194 Norman seems to be logical, well-meaning, and devoted, with a slightly naive side. He can easily plan his actions in advance and he anticipates on other's actions. He is one of the top 3 ranking orphans, along with [Emma](https://anilist.co/character/121725/Emma) and [Ray](https://anilist.co/character/121724/Ray). Norman loves Emma and he is helpful and loyal towards her.

101759.name: Isabella
101759.desc: __Height:__ 170 cm __Farm Identifier:__ 73584 Isabella worked as a Mama at Grace Field House, taking care of the orphans that reside within.

101759.name: Krone
101759.desc: Sister Krone runs the Grace Field House orphanage with [Madam Isabella](https://anilist.co/character/121701/Isabella). She has the desire to usurp the position of "Mama" from Isabella.

101759.name: Ray
101759.desc: __Height:__ 150 cm __Farm Identifier:__ 81194 As one of the three perfect students at the orphanage, Ray is very logical, smart, cunning, extremely patient and is usually shown to read books by himself. Although he is extremely book smart he says that he never liked to study. According to data obtained by sister [Krone](https://anilist.co/character/121702/Krone), his weakness is that he gives up easily.

101759.name: Emma
101759.desc: __Height:__ 145 cm __Farm Identifier:__ 63194 Emma acts as an older sister to the other children and loves her family very intensely. She is sweet, heroic, caring, and has a big heart. She can also be naive and reckless, and doesn't hesitate to put herself at risk to ensure the safety of the group. The other kids describe her as having monster reflexes and an astounding ability to learn, which enables her to think fast in difficult situations and makes her a very good strategist. She could be considered a beacon of hope for the rest of the children.

101759.name: Don
101759.desc: __Age (2045):__ 10 yo __Farm Identifier:__ 16194 __D.O.B:__ 2035/7/4 __Height (2045-2049):__ 155 - 174 cm Don has dark skin and a tall and slender appearance. He has short, messy black hair with an undercut and brown eyes. He wears the standard white uniform. Like [Emma](https://anilist.co/character/121725/Emma), Don cares deeply about his siblings. Don is portrayed as a cheerful and slightly careless boy, however, he too is fairly intelligent, coming around 5th place in the everyday test, after [Gilda](https://anilist.co/character/126455/Gilda). He also has talents in pick pocketing. His physical ability is also fairly strong.

101759.name: Gilda
101759.desc: __Farm Identifier:__ 65194 __Height (2045-2049):__ 138 - 155 cm Gilda has short olive drab hair kept in a Chinese bob hairstyle and wears circular-lensed glasses. Gilda is an intuitive young girl. She also has a caring personality. She seems to be an introvert, however she also has her moments of bravery. She can also be quite threatening.

101759.name: Phil
101759.desc: __Height:__ 100 cm __Farm Identifier:__ 34394 (Grace Field House) __D.O.B:__ 2041 Phil is very active and can always be seen running around. ~!He is also shown to be very mature and intelligent for his age, even suspecting something was wrong when [Emma](https://anilist.co/character/121725/Emma) and the other older orphans were trying to find out ways to escape.!~

101759.name: Anna
101759.desc: __Age (2045):__ 9 yo __Farm Identifier:__ 48194 (Grace Field House) __D.O.B:__ 2036/4/25 __Height (2045-2049):__ 135 - 162 cm Just like every other orphans of Grace Field, she wears the standard Grace Field Orphanage uniform. Anna grows to be a surprisingly big boned, tall girl. She has blonde hair tied into twin braids. ~!Later, she cuts her hair in order to help with the escape.!~~!During her time at the B06-32 shelter, she spends a lot of time studying medicine in order to help her family.!~

101759.name: Lannion
101759.desc: __Age (2045):__ 7 yo __Farm Identifier:__ 54294 (Grace Field House) __D.O.B:__ 2038/4/28 __Height (2045-2049):__ 125 - 144 cm Lani is a mischievous and resourceful boy, who enjoys pulling pranks with his best friend, [Thoma](https://anilist.co/character/129784/Thoma). He is a bit cowardly, but also blunt and straightforward.

101759.name: Thoma
101759.desc: __Height:__ 123 cm __Farm Identifier:__ 55294 (Grace Field House) Thoma is a resourceful and mischievous boy, who enjoys pulling pranks alongside his best friend [Lani](https://anilist.co/character/129783). He is blunt, but can also be quite cowardly.

101759.name: Conny
101759.desc: __Height:__ 115cm __Farm Identifier:__ 48294 Conny is nice and lovely towards Emma, Don and the other orphans. She always carried her stuffed rabbit Little Bernie around with her. Her intellect level seemed to be average for her age.

101759.name: Nat
101759.desc: __Age (2045):__ 9 yo __Farm Identifier:__ 48194 (Grace Field House) __D.O.B:__ 2036/12/18 __Height (2045-2049):__ 133 - 156 cm Nat is a rather frail boy, with brown eyes and a tall nose line (which he takes great pride in). He wears the standard orphanage uniform. Even though he can be easily intimidated, he does have his moments of bravery.

101759.name: Sobo
101759.desc: Grandmother is a high-ranking human and once worked as [Isabella's](https://anilist.co/character/121701/Isabella) Mama although she treated her more as a pawn than a human. ~!On January 27, 2046, it was revealed that all of Isabella's mistakes and responsibilities, as in letting the children escape, were placed on Grandma Sarah. Although Isabella wasn't able to manage her products, Sarah wasn't able to manage Isabella. As a result, Sarah was shipped out to be served at the upcoming Tifari in order to make up for the escapees. Isabella took the role of Grandmother after that.!~

101759.name: Leslie
101759.desc: __Farm Identifier:__ 71584 Leslie was Isabella's childhood friend and is shown to be very kind and loves music.

101759.name: Jemima
101759.desc: __Age (2045):__ 5 yo __Farm Identifier:__ 31394 (Grace Field House) __Height (2045-2049):__ 107 - 134 cm Jemima is cheerful and well-behaved. Though, she can display acts of mischievousness. She is seen to have a strong bond with [Alicia](https://anilist.co/character/199115).

20755.name: Koro-sensei
20755.desc: __Height:__ ~300cm (~9'10") He is a teacher for class 3-E of Kunugigaoka Junior High School and the main antihero of Ansatsu Kyoushitsu. He claims responsibility for blowing up the moon into a permanent crescent shape and plans to destroy the Earth in a year after teaching the students of class 3-E the art of assassination. His name comes from korosenai (殺せない), meaning "cannot be killed", and sensei (先生), meaning teacher. In this way, he is literally called the unkillable teacher. ~!Later in the story he is revealed to have been original reaper named Ryushi Korogane.!~

20755.name: Nagisa Shiota
20755.desc: __Height:__ 159 cm (5'2.5") __Class:__ Class 3-E He is one of the students in Class 3-E. Nagisa is seen as one of the weakest students in the class due to his small stature and mediocre physical abilities that are comparable to a girl. However, he is actually the most talented to become an assassin out of all the students, something acknowledged by [Korosensei](https://anilist.co/character/65643) and [Karasuma](https://anilist.co/character/73881). He is able to draw closer while hiding his bloodlust to make a surprise attack and able to make his opponents falter through his bloodlust alone. Nagisa usually writes down Korosensei's weaknesses that at first seen minor (since it doesn't look like major weaknesses), but eventually revealed to be useful since once they're able to almost kill Korosensei because of one of his weaknesses that is the same as the one that Nagisa has written down in his note. Outwardly friendly and polite to his friends and everyone, he hides a somewhat darker side of him as an assassin that won't be able to be found out during daily classes and will only be shown during training and assassination time. According to Karasuma, whenever Nagisa unleashes his killing intent, he isn't training and truly goes for a kill. ~!In the end, he kills [Koro-Sensei](https://anilist.co/character/65643/Korosensei).!~ ~!In the epilogue, 7 years later, Nagisa becomes a teacher of Paradise High School's Class 3-5, Deciding to follow in Koro-sensei's steps.!~

20755.name: Karma Akabane
20755.desc: **Height:** 175 cm A student in [Koro-sensei](https://anilist.co/character/65643)'s class 3-E of Kunugigaoka Junior High School who had been suspended from school due to his violent behavior. He excels at using weaponry and foul play and is the only student thus far to have successfully injured Korosensei. Despite this, he is actually rather smart and manages a perfect score on one of Korosensei's tests. He and [Nagisa](https://anilist.co/character/65645) were in the same class during their 1st and 2nd years at Kunugigaoka.

20755.name: Tadaomi Karasuma
20755.desc: He is a government worker associated with the Ministry of Defense. He first appeared announcing Korosensei's deal with the government and their mission to assassinate him before the end of the year. He later became the assistant teacher and P.E. instructor of class 3-E, using his lessons to train the students in assassination techniques. He is well known among militaries for his outstanding reputation and is a powerful individual, which he has proven when he easily overpowered Irina's master, who is a retired professional hitman, and even Korosensei himself is afraid upon seeing his capability for the first time. He is strict, but kind man, though he keeps a distance between himself and the students due to his status as an agent and his own professionalism. He is one of a few who is very perceptive enough to see Nagisa's talent as an assassin. He seems to know Korosensei's past, though he has no intention to indulge into it further.

20755.name: Irina Jelavic
20755.original: イリーナ・イェラビッチ
20755.desc: __Occupation:__ Professional Hitman, Part-time Foreign Language Teacher She is a professional hitwoman who is hired to kill [Korosensei](https://anilist.co/character/65643/Koro-sensei) by becoming a part-time foreign language teacher in class 3-E. She uses her charms to seduce Korosensei, making him at first obeys to whatever she asks. However, her first assassination attempt was foiled when Korosensei able to suppressed her 3-men's attacks, ending in her humiliation and swore revenge. She teaches the students how to seduce people from other countries, so that with this method, they can learn foreign languages, and usually would punish male students who failed answering her questions during her lesson by kissing them. Irina is a deceitful, wily and beguiling individual; she frequently uses her charm to influence and manipulate her targets. She can easily befriend people, if she so chooses, and entice them to let down their defenses and become vulnerable to her. Seduction is primarily the technique she employs, and it is her area of expertise. Irina is a professional assassin who excels at handling infiltration and approaching targets. She possesses strong conversational skills in ten languages, and a proven track record of eleven jobs in countries all over the world.

20755.name: Ritsu
20755.desc: An artificial intelligence developed in Norway and sent to Class 3-E as a transfer student to dispose of [Korosensei](https://anilist.co/character/65643/Korosensei), able to learn his movement patterns and perfect her shooting skills in order to eventually kill him. After receiving a few modifications from Korosensei, she develops a conscience and becomes friends with the rest of class 3-E, who give her her shortened nickname. Thanks to her processing power, she frequently helps with Intel gathering and communications and usually interacts with others via a smartphone application developed by her classmates. She is portrayed by Kanna Hashimoto in the live action movie.

20755.name: Kaede Kayano
20755.desc: She is one of [Nagisa](https://anilist.co/character/65645/Shiota-Nagisa)'s classmates and close friends, being the one who is mostly seen with him. She hasn't shown any capabilities during her training to become an assassin, and so far has only been shown to discuss [Koro-sensei](https://anilist.co/character/65643/Korosensei)'s weaknesses along with Nagisa. She experiences a slight inferiority complex when it comes to sex appeal, resulting her to get angry whenever there's a woman with big breasts and readily protest. ~!it's revealed later in the story that she's [Aguri Yukimura's](https://anilist.co/character/207936/Aguri-Yukimura) younger sister, Akari Yukimura and her real birthday is on November 9.!~

20755.name: Itona Horibe
20755.desc: Transfer student who aims to kill [Koro-sensei](https://anilist.co/character/65643). He is the second assassin transfer student to arrive at Class 3-E, following the previous assassin, [Ritsu](https://anilist.co/character/74832). He initially served as the secondary antagonist, before ultimately joining Class E for good. After being abandoned by [Shiro](https://anilist.co/character/176246) and befriending [Terasaka](https://anilist.co/character/85809) and his gang, Itona has since become more mellow and humble, and is now able to admit people are stronger than him, while still retaining his brutal honesty. He has also shown to be a very observant and creative individual.

20755.name: Manami Okuda
20755.desc: She is a student in class 3-E of Kunugigaoka Junior High School, taught by Korosensei. Okuda is shy and rather introverted. She admits that she isn't really good with surprise attacks and expressing things in language. She excels in chemistry and capable of making poisons for assassinations.

20755.name: Tomohito Sugino
20755.desc: He is one of the students and Nagisa's close friends. He used to be a basketball player in their school's basketball club until he was assigned into class 3-E, making him kicked out from the club. He dreams to become a professional baseball player like his idol, Arita, and emulates his techniques to improve his own performance in baseball and is shown to very dedicated to it. He also sometimes used his baseball techniques in his attempts to kill Korosensei. He has a crush on Yukiko.

20755.name: Megu Kataoka
20755.desc: She is a student of Kunugigaoka Junior High School. She is assigned to Class 3-E, where she trains to become a professional assassin, with her teacher as the target. She is one of the two class representatives of Class 3-E, with the other being [Yūma Isogai](https://anilist.co/character/85801/Isogai-Yuma). (Source: Ansatsu Kyoushitsu Wikia)

20755.name: Yuma Isogai
20755.desc: He is a student and class rep in class 3-E of Kunugigaoka Junior High School, taught by Korosensei.

20755.name: Yukiko Kanzaki
20755.desc: She is a student of Kunugigaoka Junior High School. She is assigned to Class 3-E, where she trains to become a professional assassin, with her teacher as the target. Yukiko is diligent, ladylike, and cordial; although she does not particularly stand out, she is popular with her classmates. A very considerate individual, she had, on one occasion, volunteered to buy drinks for everyone in her class. Yukiko is deliberative and an excellent organizer. She was responsible for structuring the schedule for Class 3-E's trip to Kyoto, and her work had impressed Korosensei. Furthermore, she is adept in considering all factors before making a decision, which is why she had chosen the virtually unoccupied Gion District as the ideal setting for the assassination to take place.

20755.name: Takuya Muramatsu
20755.desc: Takuya Muramatsu is a student of Kunugigaoka Junior High School. He is assigned to Class 3-E, where he trains to become a professional assassin, with his teacher as the target. His partners are Ryōma Terasaka and Taiji Yoshida. Muramatsu is an inconsiderate individual, unmindful to the consequences of his actions. He is willing to resort to any means in order to escape contemptible circumstances. He collaborates with Ryōma Terasaka and Taiji Yoshida, and together they pressure others to act according to their bidding.

20755.name: Sousuke Sugaya
20755.desc: He is a student of Kunugigaoka Junior High School. He is assigned to Class 3-E, where he trains to become a professional assassin, with his teacher as the target. Sousuke is exceptionally skilled at drawing and sculpting. His proficiency ranges from posters to disguise masks; he can make them with relative ease. He is also strongly individualistic, and launches attacks against Korosensei in a capricious, unpredictable manner; for instance, he offers to draw a Henna tattoo on Korosensei, but secretly had the Anti-Sensei bullets grounded into a fine powder and then mixed with the Henna paint. (Source: Assassination Classroom wikia)

20755.name: Ryouma Terasaka
20755.desc: He is a student of Kunugigaoka Junior High School. He is assigned to Class 3-E, where he trains to become a professional assassin, with his teacher as the target. His partners are Takuya Muramatsu and Taiji Yoshida. Terasaka is a rash, selfish and impatient individual. Desperate to escape from the miserable circumstances of being part of the dropout class, he is willing to resort to any means, even if the methods may be immoral. He holds no regards for the injuries of his comrades who provide assistance. However, Terasaka possesses relative leadership skills, as he is usually accompanied by his peers, Takuya Muramatsu and Taiji Yoshida. He persuades others to do his bidding by being direct and intrusively forward, as indicated when he pressures Nagisa Shiota to carry out an assassination of Korosensei by reminding him of the harsh conditions they live in.

20755.name: Taisei Yoshida
20755.desc: He is a student of Kunugigaoka Junior High School. He is assigned to Class 3-E, where he trains to become a professional assassin, with his teacher as the target. His partners are Ryōma Terasaka and Takuya Muramatsu. Yoshida is an inconsiderate individual, unmindful to the consequences of his actions. He is willing to resort to any means in order to escape contemptible circumstances. He collaborates with Ryōma Terasaka and Takuya Muramatsu, and together they pressure others to act according to their bidding.

20755.name: Taiga Okajima
20755.desc: He is a student in Korosensei's class 3-E of Kunugigaoka Junior High School. Okajima is the class pervert and is rather open about it. As with Rio Nakamura, Okajima is known to like peeping. He likes to read erotica magazines and even claimed to be a brother of Korosensei and Itona Horibe for doing so. At the start of July, he enjoys looking at the girls' more exposed skin.

20755.name: Yuzuki Fuwa
20755.desc: She is a student in class 3-E of Kunugigaoka Junior High School, taught by Korosensei. Fuwa has an imaginative personality, as evidenced with her like of reading the Weekly Shōnen Jump magazine.

20755.name: Gakuhou Asano
20755.desc: He is the board chairman and administrative head of Kunugigaoka Junior High School. He has made the academy into the foremost in Japan in the ten years since its founding. Gakuhō is a reasonable, prudent, and shrewd individual; he is primarily known for his cool-headed rationalism. He is a proponent of logic and efficiency, and handles matters accordingly. An able and competent administrator, he is resolved in removing factors that may upset the intended balance.

20755.name: Touka Yada
20755.desc: She is a student in Korosensei's Class 3-E. She is the big sister of Class 3-E and one of the most enthusiastic students about learning the art of infiltration from [Irina](https://anilist.co/character/73883/Jelavic-Irina). She's been described as being adult-like and cool to the point that [Kayano](https://anilist.co/character/85291/Kayano-Kaede) admits that she's attracted to her despite her large bust. Yada does not like violence, which is why she commits herself to negotiation in order avoid fighting.

20755.name: Sumire Hara
20755.desc: She is a student in Korosensei's Class 3-E. Hara is one of the most passive members of the class where she frequently acts as support in assassination attempts with her ability to assess the situation and herself. She is usually regarded as a motherly figure, due to her ability to cook and care for the class.

20755.name: Hiroto Maehara
20755.desc: He is a student in Korosensei's Class 3-E. Maehara is a nice guy and in every sense of the word, a playboy. He has a "live the moment" attitude about life in general. He is one of the few that is popular in the whole school despite being in the E Class. Despite that attitude, he is a caring person and isn't the type to pick on someone weaker than him. He also falls into the type of being honest, and often reacts strongly to things.

20755.name: Rio Nakamura
20755.desc: She is a student in Korosensei's Class 3-E of Kunugigaoka Junior High School. She was a former elementary school genius but felt lonely and longed to be normal. When she got to middle school, she began shirking off her studies which landed her in Class 3-E. She loves teasing the other students in her class (sometimes together with Karma Akabane)

20755.name: Kirara Hazama
20755.desc: She is a student in Korosensei's Class 3-E. Hazama is a quiet girl who loves reading, preferring to sit in the shade with a book rather than swim during summer gym classes and wants to become a librarian. She even recommended to Itona the novel, The Count of Monte Cristo, though accidentally spoiled the ending. She prefers dark stories and horror novels, and because of this also has an interest in the occult which she displayed when she attempted to use a curse on Korosensei.

20755.name: Koutarou Takebayashi
20755.desc: He is a student in Korosensei's Class 3-E. Takebayashi is mostly a quiet person. However, he seems somewhat eccentric in his behavior and stands out as the oddball in the class. He also seems to be clumsy at physical activity, having ping pong balls hit his glasses while playing with others and nearly losing balance in one of Tadaomi Karasuma's lessons. He is also obsessed with anime, at one point stating "A girl isn't a true girl until she loses the third D" implying he likes anime girls more than real women. He also enjoys going to maid cafes.

20755.name: Kouki Mimura
20755.desc: He is a student in Korosensei's Class 3-E.

20755.name: Masayoshi Kimura
20755.desc: He is a student in Korosensei's Class 3-E. Kimura is one of the relatively proactive students when it comes to assassination and aims to claim the 10 billion yen reward.

20755.name: Hinano Kurahashi
20755.desc: She is a student in Korosensei's Class 3-E. Hinano's personality is an energetic and positive girl and is always seen with a smile on her face regardless of whether she's trying to assassinate Korosensei, or whatever else. Hinano is also a passionate animal and nature lover.

20755.name: Hinata Okano
20755.desc: She is a student in Korosensei's Class 3-E. In her initial appearances, Okano was often shown to be serious with a relatively neutral expression. As the series goes on, she's later shown to also be playful in addition to being serious. She is also described as someone who acts before she thinks.

20755.name: Ryuunosuke Chiba
20755.desc: __Height::__ 172 cm (5’8”) __School:__ Kunugigaoka Junior High School __Class:__ 3-E __Seat Number:__ 15 He is a student in Korosensei's Class 3-E of Kunugigaoka Junior High School. Chiba is a serious and stoic boy. He's very calm and doesn't talk a lot. He is the best marksman among all of Class 3-E. He excels in spatial calculation and, as such, is unmatched in long distance shooting. His abilities have even earned him the praises of [Lovro](https://anilist.co/character/265570/Brovski-Lovro), a hitman dealer and a retired assassin.

20755.name: Rinka Hayami
20755.desc: She is a student in Korosensei's Class 3-E. Rinka is a very stoic, businesslike and professional girl who has been compared to a working adult along with Chiba. As a result of her serious demeanor, she can be quite straightforward and direct.

20755.name: Gakushuu Asano
20755.desc: A student in class 3-A in Kunugigaoka Junior High School. He is the student council president and the son of the Board Chairman, Gakuhou Asano. He is a genius student who, like many main building students, look down upon class 3-E.

20755.name: Kunudon
20755.desc: Kunudon is the mascot of Kununigoaka. He hates E class and is a propaganda tool used by the director.

20755.name: Ren Sakakibara
20755.desc: is a student in Class 3-A in Kunugigaoka Junior High School and one of the Big Five. He is also the Student Council secretary.

20755.name: Grip
20755.desc: One of three assassins in Okinawa along with Smog and Gastro. Grip is a foreigner with wavy platinum blond hair and light blue eyes. He boasts great physical strength, which he utilizes in his assassinations.

20755.name: Smog
20755.desc: One of three assassins in Okinawa along with Gastro and Grip. He specializes in creating/making poisons.

20755.name: Gastro
20755.desc: One of three assassins in Okinawa, along with Smog and Grip. He loves the taste of a gun so much that he uses it as a utensil.

20755.name: Akira Takaoka
20755.desc: A trained soldier who served with Tadaomi Karasuma. When he was in the military, he was able to produce elite loyal troops in a short span of time by connecting with them as a tightly-knit family and standing as a violent father at the same time.

20755.name: Yuuji Norita
20755.desc: A rich teenage boy. Although he is initially lazy and rides on his father's coattails, with encouragement from Nagisa he decides to change himself for the better.

20755.name: Shiro
20755.desc: A mysterious man in white clothes who hides secrets about Koro-sensei's past. ~!His real name is Kotarou Yanagisawa!~

20755.name: Natsuhiko Koyama
20755.desc: Natsuhiko Koyama is a student in Class 3-A in Kunugigaoka Junior High School and the president of the Biology Club who is one of the Big Five.

20755.name: Aguri Yukimura
20755.desc: Aguri Yukimura is the former teacher of Class 3-E.

20755.name: Tomoya Seo
20755.desc: Tomoya Seo is a student in Class 3-A in Kunugigaoka Junior High School and one of the Five Virtuosos. He is also the Student Assembly Chairman.

20755.name: Red Eye
20755.desc: Sniper hired to kill Koro-sensei during the Kyoto trip.

20755.name: Kazutaka Shindo
20755.desc: Kazutaka Shindou is a student in Class 3-A in Kunugigaoka Junior High School and plays in the baseball team.

20755.name: Lovro Brovski
20755.desc: Lovro is a hitman dealer who was once a talented assassin. He is the Japanese government's only link with the world of hitmen.

20755.name: Chousuke Takada
20755.desc: Chosuke Takada is a student in Class 3-D of Kunugigaoka Junior High School who is often seen with Nobuta Tanaka.

20755.name: Nobuta Tanaka
20755.desc: Nobuta Tanaka is a student in Class 3-D of Kunugigaoka Junior High School who is often seen with Chosuke Takada.

127230.name: Denji
127230.desc: __Height:__ 173 cm (5'8"), Devil Form - 180 cm (5'11") Denji is Chainsaw Man's Human Form. He became Chainsaw Man after his dead body was resurrected by his pet dog, [Pochita](https://anilist.co/character/170266/Pochita). He is a Public Safety Devil Hunter who works under [Makima](https://anilist.co/character/137080/Makima) as a member of an experimental squad in Special Tokyo Division 4. He works alongside his partner [Power](https://anilist.co/character/137079/Power) and under the supervision of [Aki Hayakawa](https://anilist.co/character/137081/Aki-Hayakawa). Denji's personality is both brash and naive as a result of being unable to have a formal education and socialize due to living in severe poverty. He comes off as rude and harsh, yet in an almost childish way. He doesn't know how to be clever or wise but he knows how to lighten the mood. As the Chainsaw Devil, he has the ability to grow chainsaws out of his body.

127230.name: Power
127230.desc: __Height:__ 170 cm (5'7") Power is a fiend, a dead body possessed by a devil. She is a Public Safety Devil Hunter who works (against her will) under [Makima](https://anilist.co/character/137080/Makima) as a member of an experimental squad in Tokyo Special Division 4. She works alongside her partner [Denji](https://anilist.co/character/130102/Denji), and under supervision by [Aki Hayakawa](https://anilist.co/character/137081/Aki-Hayakawa). Power is childish, greedy, and almost entirely self-motivated. She tends to fights if she has something to gain and is certain of her victory and has no problems in running away from a fight where she is outmatched. She also feels the need to boast her superiority over her fellow Devil Hunters due to her status as a fiend. She has no loyalty to humanity, openly admitting that she will join the winning side. Power is often rude, unkempt, and feels as though those around her should clean up after her. She self-admittedly rarely bathes or flushes the toilet and sees humans as being sensitive for caring about their hygiene so much. As the Blood Fiend, she has the power to freely manipulate the blood within her own body.

127230.name: Makima
127230.desc: __Height:__ 168 cm (5'6") __Affiliation:__ Public Safety Devil Hunters Makima is a Public Safety Devil Hunter, who took [Denji](https://anilist.co/character/130102/Denji) as her human pet. She is one of the leading figures of Public Safety in Japan and has a considerable reputation among experienced Devil Hunters.

127230.name: Aki Hayakawa
127230.desc: __Height:__ 182 cm (6'0") __Devil Contracts:__ [Fox Devil](https://anilist.co/character/290671/Kitsune-no-Akuma), [Curse Devil](https://anilist.co/character/174265/Noroi-no-Akuma), ~![Future Devil](https://anilist.co/character/172887/Mirai-no-Akuma)!~ __Relatives:__ [Hahaoya Hayakawa](https://anilist.co/character/291241/Hayakawa-Hahaoya) (Mother), [Chichioya Hayakawa](https://anilist.co/character/291240/Hayakawa-Chichioya) (Father), [Taiyou Hayakawa](https://anilist.co/character/174261/Taiyou) (Younger Brother). A Public Safety Devil Hunter working under [Makima](https://anilist.co/character/137080/Makima) as a member of Tokyo Special Division 4. He is partnered with [Himeno](https://anilist.co/character/144596/Himeno) and tasked with supervising both [Power](https://anilist.co/character/137079/Power) and [Denji](https://anilist.co/character/130102/Denji). Aki Hayakawa generally appears to be a very stoic person. He acts mature and dependable when he's with his fellow Devil hunters but is actually very soft when he is alone. He has a tendency to get attached to others easily, and hates to see people get hurt, especially his close friends. Aki's primary goal and reasoning for becoming a Devil Hunter is to kill the [Gun Devil](https://anilist.co/character/208942/Juu-no-Akuma) to get revenge for his family. ~!He later loses his contract with the Fox Devil and gains a new contract with the Future Devil!~

127230.name: Yuutarou Kurose
127230.desc: __Height:__ 165 cm (5'5") __Devil Contract:__ ~![Punishment Devil](https://anilist.co/character/306237/Batsu-no-Akuma)!~ A Public Safety Devil Hunter from Kyoto. He is partnered with [Michiko Tendou](https://anilist.co/character/144595/Michiko-Tendou).

127230.name: Kishibe
127230.desc: __Height:__ 194 cm __Devil Contracts:__ ~!Claw Devil, Knife Devil, Needle Devil!~ A Public Safety Devil Hunter from Special Division 1. ~!After the assault on the Special Divisions, he became captain of the Special Division 4.!~ Kishibe is a grizzled man with scraggly facial hair and a stitched scar running across his left cheek from his mouth. He normally wears the standard Public Safety devil hunter uniform with a large overcoat. He has two piercings on his left ear, and one on his right ear. He is often seen with a hip flask which he frequently drinks from. Kishibe is a stoic, straightforward individual. Due to his immense strength and skill, he often undertakes his work with a calm formality, displaying little emotion as he does so. Though he tends to speak in a relaxed, polite manner, his actions often showcase an immense brutality garnered through many years of Devil Hunting. Though he sometimes expresses emotions such as surprise and sadness at certain events, his face and voice remain entirely neutral. Kishibe has been hunting devils for a long time, making him somewhat insane. He espouses a belief that the most fearsome devil hunters to devils isn't the brave or the strong, but the craziest as they are the ones without fear. He admits that he enjoys booze, women and killing devils. ~!He is the former partner of [Quanxi](https://anilist.co/character/162123/Quanxi).!~

127230.name: Kobeni Higashiyama
127230.desc: __Height:__ 155 cm A Public Safety Devil Hunter, she is a new recruit working under [Makima](https://anilist.co/character/137080/Makima) as a member of Tokyo Special Division 4. She is partnered with [Hirokazu Arai](https://anilist.co/character/174263). She is not very courageous and gets scared easily by devils. Kobeni is shown to easily crack under pressure and break into tears during serious moments. Even though Kobeni is timid, she is pretty talented as a devil hunter. When Kobeni gets into action, she has proven to be cool-headed and efficient in battle, only breaking down in a panic once the fighting is over. Kobeni chooses to keep her devil contract a secret.

127230.name: Michiko Tendou
127230.desc: __Height:__ 175 cm (5'9") __Devil Contracts:__ ~![Punishment Devil](https://anilist.co/character/306237/Batsu-no-Akuma)!~ A Public Safety Devil Hunter from Kyoto. She is partnered with [Yuutarou Kurose](https://anilist.co/character/144592/Yuutarou-Kurose).

127230.name: Himeno
127230.desc: __Height:__ 175 cm (5'9") __Devil Contract:__ [Ghost Devil](https://anilist.co/character/174262/Yuurei-no-Akuma) __Relatives:__ [Unnamed Younger Sister](https://anilist.co/character/174283/Himeno-no-Imouto) A Public Safety Devil Hunter, working under [Makima](https://anilist.co/character/137080/Makima) as a member of Tokyo Special Division 4. She is partnered with [Aki Hayakawa](https://anilist.co/character/137081/Aki-Hayakawa), whom she shares a close personal bond with. Himeno is shown to be a mature and experienced superior to the new recruits working under her. She generally carries herself with an upbeat body language and is capable of staying calm under extremely stressful situations. Himeno is very efficient and blunt in her duty as a Devil Hunter. Himeno is also shown to be a rather caring and empathetic person, however she does have a sterner side and little tolerance for behavior from new recruits that would endanger or harm her subordinates. Himeno holds an extremely pessimistic worldview as a result of having witnessed multiple partners die suddenly in her line of work. Her knowledge that Devil Hunters typically die as a result of their career combined with the teachings of her [master](https://anilist.co/character/144593/Kishibe) eventually lead to her developing a nicotine addiction as a coping mechanism. She also tends to acts extremely aloof and sexual, enjoying a hedonistic lifestyle. However, similarly to her smoking addiction, her hedonistic ways are not us

127230.name: Reze
127230.desc: Reze is a young girl who met [Denji](https://anilist.co/character/130102/Denji) in a phone cabin. She works at a local café and is a kind and gentle girl who seems to have a crush on Denji soon after meeting him. She laughs at his jokes and isn't afraid to get close to and intimate with him. ~!‌‌‌‌‌‌‌‌She is secretly the Bomb Devil hybrid, owned by the Soviet Union and allied to the Gun Devil. Her true personality is manipulative and brutal, as she is shown killing many Devil Hunters without care or mercy. She does, however, not enjoy killing and prefers to avoid it, unless necessary for her mission. Her objective is to retrieve the Chainsaw Heart from Denji, but the feelings she developed for him quickly made things more complicated.!~

127230.name: Tenshi no Akuma
127230.desc: __Height:__ 155 cm Angel Devil is a devil who embodies the fear of angels, and a Public Safety Devil Hunter from Special Division 4. The Angel Devil is a unique case among devils having virtually no hostility towards humans. He dislikes being ordered around and doesn't seem inclined towards combat. His extreme laziness holds him back from being a strong fighter and he often refuses to work, even claiming to prefer dying to working.

127230.name: Bouryoku no Majin
127230.desc: He is a Fiend and Public Safety Devil Hunter from Special Division 4. Despite his moniker as the Violence Fiend, he is extremely polite and straightforward. He apologized to [Beam](https://anilist.co/character/157232/Beam) after hitting him in self-defense and told the [Spider Devil](https://anilist.co/character/157277/Prinz) to evacuate the area when he mistook her for a human lady. ~!He is later partnered with [Kobeni Higashiyama](https://anilist.co/character/144594/Higashiyama-Kobeni) following the events of the Katana Man Arc!~

127230.name: Beam
127230.desc: __Height:__ 165 cm (With fin: 176 cm) He is a Shark Fiend and a Public Safety Devil Hunter from Special Division 4. Beam is very eccentric. He often goes along with [Denji](https://anilist.co/character/130102/Denji)'s plans no matter how crazy they are due to having a lot of respect for the [Chainsaw Devil](https://anilist.co/character/170266/Pochita).

127230.name: Eien no Akuma
127230.desc: The Eien no Akuma is a devil that embodies the fear of eternity. He is the primary antagonist of the titular Eternity Devil arc.

127230.name: Samurai Sword
127230.desc: Samurai Sword is a human-devil hybrid who merged with the Katana Devil. His [grandfather](https://anilist.co/character/289198/Yakuza) was killed by [Denji](https://anilist.co/character/130102/Denji) when they initially fused with [Pochita](https://anilist.co/character/170266/Pochita), and because of that, he affiliated with the [Gun Devil](https://anilist.co/character/208942/Juu-no-Akuma) to get revenge on Denji. He works alongside [Akane Sawatari](https://anilist.co/character/174264/Akane-Sawatari) and other fellow members of the Yakuza.

127230.name: Prinz
127230.desc: She is a devil who embodies the fear of spiders, and is a Public Safety Devil Hunter from Special Division 4. The Spider Devil usually takes a human shape so she tends to be friendly to humans and works as a devil hunter herself, however she will still kill people for just looking at her the wrong way.

127230.name: Pochita
127230.desc: Pochita appears to be a small red canine with a chainsaw like appendage protruding from the center of his head. Handles emerge from his body allowing him to be wielded like a chainsaw and his short tail is in the shape of a chainsaw's pull cord. Unlike most devils, Pochita communicated solely through barks and whines like an actual dog.

127230.name: Fushi
127230.desc: A Public Safety Devil Hunter.

127230.name: Mirai no Akuma
127230.desc: The Future Devil is a devil that embodies the fear of the future. ~!After seeing [Aki Hayakawa](https://anilist.co/character/137081/Aki-Hayakawa)'s future, it made a contract with him, so he can see that future himself.!~

127230.name: Taiyou
127230.desc: [Aki Hayakawa](https://anilist.co/character/137081)'s younger brother.

127230.name: Yuurei no Akuma
127230.desc: The Ghost Devil is a devil that embodies the fear of ghosts. **Known Contractors:** ~![Himeno](https://anilist.co/character/144596/Himeno)!~

127230.name: Hirokazu Arai
127230.desc: __Devil Contract:__ [Fox Devil](https://anilist.co/character/290671/Kitsune-no-Akuma) A Public Safety Devil Hunter, he is a new recruit working under [Makima](https://anilist.co/character/137080/Makima) as a member of Tokyo Special Division 4. He is partnered with [Kobeni Higashiyama](https://anilist.co/character/144594/Kobeni-Higashiyama). Hirokazu is shown to have high moral standards and cares a lot about his teammates and their wellbeing, going out of his way to assist and support others whenever possible, especially towards those who are sick. He was trained by [Himeno](https://anilist.co/character/144596) for half a year. Himeno has stated that what he lacks in ability, he makes up for in drive. He likes writing haikus in his free time as a hobby.

127230.name: Akane Sawatari
127230.desc: __Devil Contract:__ [Snake Devil](https://anilist.co/character/174269/Hebi-no-Akuma) An enigmatic former Private Detective Hunter, she pledged her allegiance with the [Gun Devil](https://anilist.co/character/208942/Juu-no-Akuma) after making a contract with him and as a result, she seeks to obtain [Denji](https://anilist.co/character/130102/Denji)'s heart for her master. To that end, she conspires with members of the yakuzas, including the likes of [Katana Man](https://anilist.co/character/157241/Samurai-Sword), while acting as a weapons dealer for them in order to obtain Denji's heart easier.

127230.name: Noroi no Akuma
127230.desc: The Curse Devil is a Devil that embodies the fear of curses. __Known Contractors:__ ~![Aki Hayakawa](https://anilist.co/character/137081/Aki-Hayakawa), [Tolka's Master](https://anilist.co/character/172888/Tolka-no-Shishou)!~

127230.name: Madoka
127230.desc: A Public Safety Devil Hunter. ~!After the assault on the Devil Hunters by the [Gun Devil](https://anilist.co/character/208942/Juu-no-Akuma-)'s associates, he was one of the few survivors and decided to leave his job as a Devil Hunter.!~

127230.name: Namako no Akuma
127230.desc: The Sea Cucumber Devil is a devil that embodies the fear of sea cucumbers.

127230.name: Nyaako
127230.desc: [Power](https://anilist.co/character/137079/Power)'s cat. ~!Now currently owned by [Denji](https://anilist.co/character/130102/Denji).!~

127230.name: Koumori no Akuma
127230.desc: The Bat Devil is a devil who embodies the fear of bats. ~!He is the primary antagonist of the titular Bat Devil arc and a minor antagonist in the Justice Devil arc.!~

127230.name: Hiru no Akuma
127230.desc: The Leech Devil is a devil that embodies the fear of leeches. ~!She is the secondary antagonist of the Bat Devil arc.!~

127230.name: Zombie no Akuma
127230.desc: A devil contracted by [Denji's](https://anilist.co/character/130102/Denji) yakuza employer at the beginning of the series and the first that Denji killed as the Chainsaw Man. Any person it bit would become a zombie.

127230.name: Himeno no Imouto
127230.desc: [Himeno](https://anilist.co/character/144596/Himeno)'s sister.

127230.name: Tomato no Akuma
127230.desc: The Tomato Devil is a devil that embodies the fear of tomatoes. ~!The Tomato Devil was walking around a house, when [Denji](https://anilist.co/character/130102/Denji) with the help of [Pochita](https://anilist.co/character/170266/Pochita) went and killed him.!~

127230.name: Minkan no Devil Hunter
127230.original: 民間のデビルハンター

127230.name: Kitsune no Akuma
127230.desc: The Fox Devil is a devil that embodies the fear of foxes. It is friendly with humans, allowing numerous Devil Hunters to make contracts with itself. However it only grants attractive people the ability to summon its head, showing a rather superficial side of itself. **Known Contractors:** ~! [Aki Hayakawa](https://anilist.co/character/137081/Aki-Hayakawa), [Hirokazu Arai](https://anilist.co/character/174263/Hirokazu-Arai), [Nomo](https://anilist.co/character/174266/Nomo)!~

127230.name: Hayakawa Chichioya
127230.desc: Aki Hayakawa's father.

127230.name: Hayakawa Hahaoya
127230.desc: Aki Hayakawa's mother.

127230.name: Shiina
127230.desc: Kanagawa prefectural police

127230.name: Denji no Chichi
127230.desc: This unnamed man was the father of [Denji](https://anilist.co/character/130102/Denji). ~!When Denji was young he killed his father in self defense, as his father was in a drunken aggressive state and he feared for his life. His father's murder was ruled a suicide by the adults in Denji’s life as acknowledging his death as a murder would mean they would be unable to get any money from his death. After his death, Denji inherits his debt to the Yakuza.!~

127230.name: Shuuzou Mishima
127230.desc: Shuzo Mishima is a civilian working for [Samurai Sword](https://anilist.co/character/157241/Samurai-Sword) and [Akane Sawatari](https://anilist.co/character/174264/Akane-Sawatari).

127230.name: Takashi Inoue
127230.desc: Takashi Inoue is a civilian working for [Samurai Sword](https://anilist.co/character/157241/Samurai-Sword) and [Akane Sawatari](https://anilist.co/character/174264/Akane-Sawatari).

21507.name: Narrator
21507.desc: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

21507.name: Puri-Puri Prisoner
21507.desc: __Occupation:__ Superhero __Level:__ S-Class; Rank 17 Puri-Puri Prisoner is a flamboyant, openly homosexual superhero. He takes an interest in other, up-and-coming heroes and criminals; an interest which led to his titular jail sentence, as he kept attacking them. Criminals that he apprehends are then added to his harem.

21507.name: Arataka Reigen
21507.desc: __Height:__ 179 cm (5'10.5") [Mob's](https://anilist.co/character/89616) mentor and boss in the Mob Psycho 100 series. He owns a business exorcising ghosts and is a self-proclaimed psychic. He is Mob's moral compass. He was the first person to ever consider Mob as normal and his teachings have never failed Mob.

21507.name: Shigeo Kageyama
21507.desc: **Height:** 157 cm He is the assistant and disciple of [Arataka Reigen](https://anilist.co/character/89334/Reigen-Arataka). He is also the newest member of the Body Improvement Club. Shigeo is a quiet and polite individual who tries to live a normal life despite having strong telepathic power, he wants to be seen as a good human among the people in his social life. This often makes him naive and gullible when those with malicious intent want to use him for a laugh or to cause trouble but Shigeo has very strong beliefs to never use his powers to hurt another person because of an altercation he faced once as a child.

21507.name: Ekubo
21507.desc: Ekubo is a self-proclaimed upper-class evil spirit who has aligned himself with [Mob](https://anilist.co/character/89616) after being defeated by him. Ekubo wants to be a god. Specifically, he wants to be worshipped by all humanity. ~!Despite having that kind of ego, he didn't hesitate to put himself at Mob's mercy in the hopes of using the boy to his advantage. At first, he wanted to steal Mob's body and use it to become a god, but he eventually decided to try to make Mob a god instead.!~

21507.name: Ritsu Kageyama
21507.desc: __Height:__ 159.4 cm Ritsu is very clever and apparently serious, he also serves on the student council and excels in academics and everything else he tries. None of that matters to him as much as psychic power, however, his brother is more important to him than anyone or anything else. ~!Before he awoke his own psychic powers, he longed for the esper abilities his brother has always had and was frustrated by his own inability to do things like bend spoons. He may have a habit of carrying spoons around with him, for bending purposes. He is a perfectionist with a not-so-hidden dark side. Unlike [Mob](https://anilist.co/character/89616/Kageyama-Shigeo), he finds it okay to use psychic violence against people when necessary.!~

21507.name: Tenga Onigawara
21507.desc: Tenga Onigawara is the leader of Salt Middle School and an unofficial member of the Body Improvement Club.

21507.name: Tome Kurata
21507.desc: __School:__ Salt Middle School __School club:__ Telepathy Club (President) Tome seems to be a slacker but is passionate about the possibility of using telepathy to contact extraterrestrials. However, when the Telepathy Club's research into the matter bears no results, she quickly gives up. When she learns that [Mob](https://anilist.co/character/89616/Kageyama-Shigeo) is an Esper, her passion is revitalized.

21507.name: Teruki Hanazawa
21507.desc: __Height:__ 161.4 cm Hanazawa Teruki is an esper who was first introduced as an antagonist, but later became [Mob](https://anilist.co/character/89616/Kageyama-Shigeo)'s friend after being defeated by him. He was the shadow leader (urabanchou) of Black Vinegar Middle School, using his psychic powers to rule over the delinquents at his own school, as well as to defeat those from other schools. Teruki is a talented, quick-thinking, and hardworking esper. In terms of raw power, he is nowhere near Mob's level, but he compensates for this by putting in effort and training diligently. He is able to analyze other espers' techniques and their weaknesses in a short amount of time, and often incorporates said techniques in his own fights. He is constantly training to improve himself, and is remarked by various espers as possessing a keen and powerful set of skills.

21507.name: Ichi Mezato
21507.desc: Ichi Mezato is a school girl who goes to Salt Middle School and is part of the News Club. She is in class 2-1.

21507.name: Tsubomi Takane
21507.desc: She is a middle schooler at Salt Middle School. Mob harbors a large crush on her. ~!Most of what we know about Tsubomi's personality in the manga is from what Mob and other characters say about her. However, in the anime adaptation, there are extra scenes of Tsubomi that add to her character and personality and make her a more compassionate individual.!~

21507.name: Shou Suzuki
21507.desc: ~!Sho Suzuki is the son of the leader of Claw. He led a direct resistance against his father's world domination plan.!~

21507.name: Musashi Gouda
21507.desc: Musashi Goda is a student of Salt Middle School and the Body Improvement Club's President. Musashi has a strong sense of justice but strongly disagrees with senseless violence

21507.name: Gou Asahi
21507.desc: Gou is an esper and one of the children who was invited to the Awakening Lab.

21507.name: Rei Kurosaki
21507.desc: Rei is an esper and one of the children who was invited to the Awakening Lab

21507.name: Takeshi Hoshino
21507.desc: Takeshi is an esper and one of the children who was invited to the Awakening Lab

21507.name: Matsuo
21507.desc: Matsuo is an esper and a former member of Claw. He was part of the upper echelon called "Scar".

21507.name: Yusuke  Sakurai
21507.desc: The partner of Koyama who is also one of the executives of the Tsume group.

21507.name: Ishiguro
21507.desc: The chief of the seventh branch of Tsume.

21507.name: Miyagawa
21507.desc: Miyagawa is an esper and a former member of Claw. He was part of the upper echelon called "Scar".

21507.name: Takeuchi
21507.desc: Takeuchi is an esper and a former member of Claw. He was part of the upper echelon called "Scar".

21507.name: Muto
21507.desc: Muto is an esper and a former member of Claw. He was part of the upper echelon called "Scar".

21507.name: Muraki
21507.desc: Muraki is an esper and a former member of Claw. He was part of the upper echelon called "Scar"

21507.name: Megumu Koyama
21507.desc: Megumu is an esper and a former member of Claw. He was part of the upper echelon called "Scar".

21507.name: Tsuchiya
21507.desc: Tsuchiya is an esper and a former member of Claw. She was part of the upper echelon called "Scar".

21507.name: Mukai
21507.desc: Mukai is an esper and a former member of Claw. She was the youngest member of the upper echelon called "Scar".

21507.name: Toichirou Suzuki
21507.desc: Toichiro is an extremely powerful esper and the founder and leader of Claw.

21507.name: Kaito Shiratori
21507.desc: Kaito is an esper, the twin brother of [Daichi Shiratori](https://anilist.co/character/133206/Shiratori-Daichi), and one of the children who was invited to the Awakening Lab.

21507.name: Daichi Shiratori
21507.desc: Daichi is an esper, the twin brother of [Kaito Shiratori](https://anilist.co/character/133205/Shiratori-Kaito), and one of the children who was invited to the Awakening Lab.

21507.name: Souchou
21507.desc: Shouchou was a spirit who appeared early on in the anime adaptation. He was the leader of a biker gang. They all died while riding through Honeido Tunnel when the rider at the front slipped on a banana peel and caused an explosive pile-up

21507.name: Terada
21507.desc: Terada is an esper and a former member of Claw. He was part of the upper echelon called "Scar".

21507.name: Mob no Chichi
21507.desc: Mob's Father.

21507.name: Kenji  Mitsuura
21507.desc: He is the founder of the Awakening Lab.

21507.name: Shinji Kamuro
21507.desc: He is the president of the student council at Salt Middle School.

21507.name: Hikaru Tokugawa
21507.desc: He is the vice-president of the school council of Salt Mid.

21507.name: Tenjouyaburi
21507.desc: He was a spirit who appeared early on in the series. He was the first ghost to appear and be exorcized.

21507.name: Hiroshi Kumagawa
21507.desc: He is part of the Body Improvement Club and a student of Salt Middle School.

21507.name: Hideki  Yamamura
21507.desc: He is a student of Salt Middle School and a member of the Body Improvement Club.

21507.name: Momozou  Takenaka
21507.desc: Takenaka is originally introduced as an image-conscientious character pushed into the Telepathy Club similarly to Mob. However, once it is revealed that he is a Telepath, he is shown to be standoffish despite his humor and tendency to tease others. He feels lonely given his telepathy and is overwhelmed by the consciousness of society. ~!Takenaka had previously filled a gap in the Telepathy Club to maintain the minimum number of members needed for the club. He had no interest in the club or in telepathy. He worried about how people looked at him because of his club membership, so he decided to leave the club. As a result of him leaving the club, Tome Kurata had to find a new member to keep the club open. He is later revealed to have joined the tennis club. In chapter 98 he is revealed to be a telepath. He returned to their former club room investigate the telepathic ringing generated by Mob and Shiratori brothers. He is subsequently recruited to help contact extraterrestrial life, although he only joins out of obligation. Later, he is revealed to have actually memorized the summoning formation and incantation despite knowing it to be a hoax, as he didn't want to ruin their memory. He proceeds to spend his New Years' with the others after successfully coming into contact with alien lifeforms.!~

21507.name: Jun Sagawa
21507.desc: He is a student of Salt Middle School and the president of the Body Improvement Club.

21507.name: Hanako
21507.desc: She is Reigen's first client to appear in the series. ~!Hanako had engaged in a sort of test of courage before coming to see Reigen; consequently, a ghost has been haunting her in her dreams. She had asked many psychics to help her and get rid of the ghost and eventually, accompanied by her boyfriend Taro, she asks for help from Arataka Reigen. She guides Reigen and Taro to the building with the ghost in question, after much scepticism about Reigen coming from her boyfriend. She recounts a tale of a man who struck his head on the ceiling of the building after seeing a cockroach, frightening Reigen. The ghost, Ceiling Crasher, haunting her appears, leading Reigen to attempt to exorcise it (unsuccessfully). Reigen calls in Mob, who exorcizes​ the ghost in front of her.!~

21507.name: Tarou
21507.desc: Tarou is Hanako's lover and a character that appears early on in the series. He is an aggressive skeptic of the supernatural and of psychics. He seems protective or relatively concerned about his lover.

21507.name: Nioikagi
21507.desc: He was a spirit who appeared and made his home terrorizing the students at a private girls' high school.

21507.name: Haruto  Kijibayashi
21507.desc: He is a third-year middle school student and a member of the Telepathy Club.

21507.name: Shirihiko Saruta
21507.desc: He is a first-year middle school student and a member of the Telepathy Club.

21507.name: Yamazaki
21507.desc: Yamazaki is a student of the Salt Middle School and a member of Tenga Onigawara's gang.

21507.name: Mameta  Inukawa
21507.desc: He is a second-year middle school student and a member of the Telepathy Club.

21507.name: Ryohei Shimura
21507.desc: He is a student of Salt Middle School and a member of the Body Improvement Club.

21507.name: Mari
21507.desc: She is a student of the Highso Private Girls' Academy and was a client of Arataka Reigen.

21507.name: Hitoshi
21507.desc: He was a client of Arataka Reigen, he wanted to speak with his deceased father about a password to a safe. ~!He attempted to stab Reigen to get the combo but was knocked out by Reigen.!~

21507.name: Akagi
21507.desc: Akagi is the gang leader of the Pasta Soup Middle School.

21507.name: Fuji
21507.desc: Fuji is the gang leader of the Miso Middle School.

21507.name: Gozu
21507.desc: Gozu is the gang leader of the Mayo Middle School. He attempts to fight Koyama, but is defeated.

21507.name: Bandai
21507.desc: Bandai is the gang leader of the Soy Sauce Middle School.

21355.name: Emilia
21355.desc: **Height:** 164 cm (5'5") She is a silver-haired half-elf girl who is one of the candidates to become the next ruler in the royal election. [Subaru](https://anilist.co/character/88573/Natsuki-Subaru) first meets her when her insignia is stolen by [Felt](https://anilist.co/character/88574/Felt) as she needs to possess it to be eligible to participate in the election. She introduces herself as Satella when she and Subaru met during the first timeline before introducing herself by her real name when she got her insignia back. Emilia is good natured and likes to take care of others, though she herself refuses to admit it, instead thinking of it as her own selfishness. She is indifferent to her own appearance, leaving [Puck](https://anilist.co/character/90187/Puck) to take care of her clothes and hair. Because her appearance is similar to the [Witch of Envy](https://anilist.co/character/127242/Satella), she has received unfair discrimination from others. She sometimes acts like a child and is unacquainted with the world as she used to live in the woods with other Elves, though despite this she still works hard to become a ruler.

21355.name: Subaru Natsuki
21355.desc: __Height:__ 173 cm (5'8") On the way home from the convenience store, he suddenly finds himself transported into another world. He has the ability that he calls "Return by Death" to go back in time when he dies. Despite being a hikikomori and gamer in his real world, Subaru does a bit of workout and seems to know basic hand-to-hand combat, making him not completely weak. While Subaru tends to not read the situation, he is loyal to those he holds dear, willing to help them, even if that means taking the thorny path. He has his resolve confirmed through the many situations and circumstances he faces in the fantasy world, originally having been one to always take the "easy" route. As a hikikomori, he is hopeful of the possibilities that being sucked into a new realm brings, but later realizes the realities of the predicament he is in. Ultimately, he resolves himself to be faithful and protective of the ones that he cares most about.

21355.name: Felt
21355.desc: **Height:** 150 cm (4'11") A thief that lives in the slums. Felt stole [Emilia's](https://anilist.co/character/88572/Emilia) insignia, hoping for quick, easy cash. Though Felt can usually handle her own, she does consider [Rom](https://anilist.co/character/124117/Rom) to be like family. ~!After being chosen by the insignia, she is forced to participate in the Royal Selection and is currently a candidate to become the 42nd King of Lugunica.!~

21355.name: Rem
21355.desc: __Height:__ 154 cm (5'1") Rem is one of the twin maids working for [Roswaal L Mathers](https://anilist.co/character/90182/Mathers-L-Roswaal). She has medium length sky blue hair that covers her right eye, large light blue eyes, and young features. She also has hair clips towards left side of her hair, flower-shaped ribbon on the same side of her hair, and a maid hairband. She looks nearly identical to her sister [Ram](https://anilist.co/character/88576) apart from her hair, eyes, and ribbon coloring. She usually wears a maid uniform, and since her chest is slightly larger than her sister's, she secretly changes the measurements to hide it. Rem tends to speak in a superficially polite manner and sometimes acts without thinking. She holds both respect to the point of worship and guilt toward her sister for an incident in the past. Because of her respect and guilt toward her sister, she used to think of herself as inferior.

21355.name: Ram
21355.desc: __Height:__ 154 cm (5’1”) Ram is one of the twin maids working for [Roswaal L Mathers](https://anilist.co/character/90182). She has medium length light pink hair that covers her left eye, large darkish pink eyes, and young features. She also has hair clips towards right side of her hair, flower-shaped ribbon on the same side of her hair, and a maid hairband. She looks nearly identical to her sister [Rem](https://anilist.co/character/88575/Rem) apart from her hair, eyes, and ribbon coloring. Ram is seemingly self-centered and does things at her own pace, however in actuality she maintains a distance from people to ascertain them. She believes that Roswaal is the greatest and no one else is as precious except for her sister Rem. She is slightly more outgoing in comparison to the generally taciturn Rem, who generally allows Ram to take the lead in their sisterly bond.

21355.name: Reinhard van Astrea
21355.original: ラインハルト・ヴァン・アストレア
21355.desc: __Height__: 184 cm (6'0") Reinhard van Astrea is the current Sword Saint and a member of the Royal Guard, currently acting as [Felt](https://anilist.co/character/88574/Felt)'s knight. As the Sword Saint and the Knight of the Royal Guard, Reinhard embodies chivalry and elegance, treating everyone with exceptional respect. He is fair, brave, and always acts in the name of justice, whether on duty or simply strolling through the Royal Capital. As a knight, Reinhard only uses his sword when necessary, since, in addition to being a rule, his iron-clad rule is to not inflict pain to others if not absolutely necessary, be it a normal thug or a member of the Witch Cult.

21355.name: Petelgeuse Romanee-Conti
21355.original: ペテルギウス・ロマネコンティ
21355.desc: Sin Archbishop of the Witch Cult, representing sloth. ~!He was later killed by [Natsuki Subaru](https://anilist.co/character/88573/Natsuki-Subaru) with the help of [Julius Juukulius](https://anilist.co/character/90183/Euclius-Julius).!~ ~!A hundred years earlier, Petelgeuse was a moderate, upright and rational man. He was close friends with [Fortuna](https://anilist.co/character/183732/Fortuna) and [Emilia](https://anilist.co/character/88572/Emilia), enough to be described as being like a family. However, when [Regulus](https://anilist.co/character/174098/Corneas-Regulus) and [Pandora](https://anilist.co/character/137522/Pandora) attacked their village, he accidentally killed Fortuna through Pandora's power, causing him to go mad.!~

21355.name: Anastasia Hoshin
21355.original: アナスタシア・ホーシン
21355.desc: Anastasia Hoshin is the head of the Hoshin Trading Company and a candidate to become the 42nd King of Lugnica. Her knight is Julius Juukulius. Despite her surname being "Hoshin", she's not directly related to Hoshin of the Wilderness. She chose the name because she was inspired by his legacy.

21355.name: Aldebaran
21355.desc: **Height:** 173 cm (5'8") Aldebaran, commonly known as Al, is [Priscilla Barielle](https://anilist.co/character/90186/Priscilla-Barielle)'s knight, though he claims to just be a subordinate. He has a frivolous personality and acts aloof, but shows insecurity regarding his disfigured face and wears a helmet to conceal it. Due to that, he is a man of both eccentric appearance and behavior. ~!Like Subaru, he is revealed to be from Japan and was summoned roughly 18 years before Subaru. Shortly after he was summoned, he lost his left arm in an unfortunate incident in the Empire of Vollachia. !~

21355.name: Wilhelm van Astrea
21355.original: ヴィルヘルム・ヴァン・アストレア
21355.desc: __Height:__ 178 cm (5'10") Wilhelm van Astrea né Trias, is a member of the Crusch Camp and was [Theresia van Astrea](https://anilist.co/character/124116/van-Astrea-Theresia)'s husband. Wilhelm is a refined man with a highly gentle and humble demeanor. However unearth that even temperament belied a fierce warrior who often is the first to help when something happens.
