It is logical to assume that he and Rōshi knew each other as they were both jinchūriki of the same village.

1735.name: Chojuro
1735.desc: Seems to be one of the Seven Swordsmen. He is protecting the Mizukage while on their journey to the Kage Summit. He seems to be unsure about himself. He appears to wield some form of dual weapon (presumably a Sword) linked together by the handles. (Source: Narutopedia)

1735.name: Ao
1735.desc: Ao is a shinobi of Kirigakure. Ao is a middle aged gentleman with a eyepatch over his right eye; he also wears to talismens on his ears.

1735.name: Danzou Shimura
1735.desc: Danzou Shimura was an elder of Konohagakure. As the founder and leader of Root, Danzou gained notoriety as The Darkness of the Shinobi (忍の闇) because of his frequent unsanctioned actions and his often-suspected (but rarely proven) undermining of specific Konoha personnel. Despite his decades of suspicious deeds, Danzō only ever acted in what he believed were the village's best interests. He was appointed the Sixth Hokage Candidate (六代目火影候補) after Pain's assault on the village. (Source: Narutopedia)

1735.name: Akatsuchi
1735.desc: Akatsuchi is a large shinobi from Iwagakure who escorts the Tsuchikage. Akatsuchi is very jovial and childish in nature and always seems to have a cheerful disposition. He was excited at the prospect of flying once again, even though there was the possibility that they were going off to a battle.

1735.name: Kurotsuchi
1735.desc: Kurotsuchi is a female shinobi who along with Akatsuchi escorts the Third Tsuchikage, who is her grandfather. She refers to Deidara as Deidara-nii (nii-san = big brother), either as family or a sign of respect. ~!Some time after the Fourth Shinobi World War her grandfather retired and she became the Fourth Tsuchikage!~

1735.name: Oonoki
1735.desc: Oonoki is the current Tsuchikage of Iwagakure. As a young man, Ōnoki was a student to the Second Tsuchikage, Muu who taught him how to use the Dust Release techniques. Later in life, he himself would become a teacher to Deidara. Though he often implied that Deidara's ideologies and fighting style annoyed him, he was still proud of him. At some time in the past, Oonoki fought with Madara Uchiha, the only living Kage to do so. His knowledge of Madara's power made him wary of him, and was thus surprised that the latter would choose to carry out his designs behind the shadows through Akatsuki. Oonoki is very proud but appears frail, with constant complaints referring to his hips and back. He also refuses to retire and choose a successor as Tsuchikage despite his frailty, insisting that he is still strong enough to continue to rule the village. Kurotsuchi describes him as a "stubborn old man". His pride has him give very little respect for those younger than him. He is a powerful and capable Tsuchikage. He is physically frail, however, and as such he isn't suited for taijutsu fighting. He has a great deal of experience, having fought Madara Uchiha and survived, thus his knowledge is invaluable to the Allied Shinobi Forces.

1735.name: Darui
1735.desc: Darui is a jōnin-level shinobi from Kumogakure. He is also the Commander of the First Division of the Allied Shinobi Forces. __Personality__ Darui is portrayed as being easy-going and mellow; when compared to the Fourth Raikage's over-the-top exit through a window, he tells C that he'll just use the door. Whilst having a laid-back demeanour, Darui isn't lazy, leaping to the Raikage's defence when the bodyguards of the other Kage overreact to the Raikage's actions. He also has a habit of referring to things or events as being "dull" a play on his name. Darui is also very apologetic, even apologizing for other people's actions, a trait he'd never noticed himself; this attribute led him to say "sorry" just as much as "dull". He is also very loyal to the Raikage who considers Darui his "second right hand". He adresses the Raikage with "boss" rather than "Raikage-sama". __Abilities__ Darui is a highly skilled and capable shinobi. He learned how to create Black Lightning under the tutelage of the Third Raikage, making his lightning techniques even more powerful. His chakra reserves are great enough to not die of chakra exhaustion after using three of the Treasured Tools of the Sage of the Six Paths and still have enough chakra left to continue fighting. His abilities have earned him the praise and recognition of the Fourth Raikage himself, who appointed Darui as his personal bodyguard and considers him his right-hand man. Kenjutsu Darui wields a long and fairly broad sword that is

1735.name: Shii
1735.desc: Shii is a Kumogakure shinobi who escorts the Raikage along with Darui. C is a young man with short blond hair and dark eyes. He wears a sleeveless black shirt with a one-strap-over-one-shoulder white flak jacket, forehead protector, black elbow length arm guards, and red and white Kumogakure shin-guards. In contrast to his easy-going partner, C is portrayed as serious and putting Kumo's well being above all else. This is briefly shown when he told Darui there was no time for rest upon their return from the Kage Summit. He also seems to have a slight dislike of Konoha ninja, calling Naruto's group "Konoha Dogs". C is a sensor type shinobi, allowing him to sense the chakra of others even from extended distances. He is also a medic-nin and seems to be very knowledgeable on foreign shinobi techniques, as he is shown recognizing Sasuke's Mangekyō Sharingan along with Amaterasu. C was able to deduce how Sasuke's Blaze Release worked after only seeing it once. He is also a skilled genjutsu user, as he was shown using Lightning Illusion Flash of Lightning Pillar, followed by a second genjutsu within the first. All of these abilities also imply a mastery of multiple skills requiring very fine chakra control. Also of note is when he went to defend the Raikage from the bodyguards of the other Kage he took a defence taijutsu stance, implying he is competent in close combat as well

1735.name: Mei Terumi
1735.desc: Mei Terumi is the Fifth Mizukage and the leader of Kirigakure. As Mizukage, her word holds sway over all political and military issues that present themselves regarding Kirigakure and its inhabitants. She became Mizukage in recent years, after the dreadful reign of [Yagura](https://anilist.co/character/23222/Yagura) ended. Mei is a slender, young woman in her thirties. She has ankle-length, auburn hair styled into a herringbone pattern at the back, a top-knot tied with a dark-blue band, and with four bangs at the front. Two bang are short, with one covering her right eye, and two are long, crossing each other on her chest, just below her chin. Her eyes are light green. She dresses in a long-sleeved dark-blue dress, that falls just below the knees. It seems to be closed at the front with a zip and is kept open on the front-right side from the waist down. The dress only covers up to the upper part of her upper arms and the underside of her breasts. Underneath, she wears a mesh shirt that covers more of her upper body than her dress, but stops short of covering her shoulders and still leaving a sizable cleavage. She also wears shorts in the same colour as dress and, underneath those, mesh leggings reaching down over her knees. Around her waist, she wears a belt with a pouch attached to the back on the left.

1735.name: Guruko
1735.desc: Kakashi's ninken.

1735.name: Torune Aburame
1735.desc: Torune was a ninja of Konohagakure, a member of the Aburame clan, and a high-ranking member of the Root. Except for the lower half of his face, his features were covered by a mask. Glasses were built into the mask obscuring his eyes as is common for the Aburame clan. He wore a short black jacket with red strands hanging over the shoulders, similar to Sai's and his partner, Fū's. This most likely shows allegiance to Root. He also wore a high collared, all black outfit with a red sash around his waist and what appeared to be an apron over his pants, similar to that of Neji Hyūga's. He also carried several pouches with him and wore a pair of black gloves. When first introduced, Torune's appearance was that of a regular Konoha ANBU, complete with a white cloak and mask. Danzō stated that he and Fū are two of the most-skilled ninjas in Root. Torune is part of the Aburame clan, and like the other members, he is skilled at using insects in combat. However, his bug techniques are rare even among the Aburame. He controls the many nano-sized, venomous insects that covers his body, allowing him to infect anyone with a mere touch. Due to this he wears gloves and keeps his skin almost completely covered when not in battle. The insects spread onto the opponent's skin causing severe pain which can potentially lead to death. Torune can call off the insects with a touch of a finger and remove the venom using an antidote. Shikuro Aburame is said to be the only one with an antidote for the inse

1735.name: Mifune
1735.desc: Mifune is the leader of the Iron Country.

1735.name: Fukasaku
1735.desc: Fukasaku is the husband of Shima and an elder toad from Myōbokuzan. As the heirs of the Great Toad Sage, he and his wife are revered as the Two Great Sage Toads. Together with Shima, he taught Jiraiya how to use Senjutsu and later he alone taught Naruto the same. He has a leading position among the toads.

1735.name: Shima
1735.desc: Shima (シマ) is the wife of Fukasaku and an elder toad from Myōbokuzan. As the heirs of the Great Toad Sage, she and her husband are revered as the Two Great Sage Toads. Together with Fukasaku, she taught Jiraiya how to use Senjutsu.

1735.name: Gamaken
1735.desc: Gamaken is a giant toad that first appeared in Part II. He wields a Sasumata-like weapon and a shield. He seemed to be a skilled fighter while fighting alongside Naruto. He also seems to be wearing the same robe as Gamabunta.

1735.name: Hotaru
1735.desc: Hotaru (ホタル) is the granddaughter of the former leader of the Tsuchigumo clan, En no Gyōja. One day Hotaru was under attack by a group of ninja who were actually after Utakata. Utakata saved Hotaru from the ninja, but was wounded in the battle. Hotaru ran for help from her fort, saving Utakata's life, causing him to become indebted to her. After this, he became a sort of master to Hotaru in order to hide from anyone who is after him. Later she finds him sleeping under a tree and Utakata got angry when Hotaru called him master, saying that the relationship between a master and a student is not something you can count on. Utakata reluctantly begins to teach her the Water Walking Exercise first, believing that she wouldn't master it. In the morning, she shows that she was able to stand on top of the water by training all night. Next, Utakata taught her Water Release: Violent Water Wave, once again believing that she would not be able to master it without water-natured chakra only to discover she does possess water-natured chakra. She later found Utakata under a tree and showed him the she again mastered the technique much to his suprise. When a group ninja came looking for the Tsuchigumo clan's kinjutsu, Tonbee had Hotaru, along with Utakata, take the clan's forbidden jutsu so that ninja could not retrieve it. While traveling, Utakata got upset at Hotaru for calling him master (師匠, shishō), at which point Naruto arrived, believing Utakata to be attacking Hotaru. Hotaru broke up

1735.name: En no Gyouja
1735.desc: En no Gyouja was the former leader of the Tsuchigumo clan and the grandfather of Hotaru.

1735.name: Tonbei
1735.desc: Tonbee (遁兵衛) is an elderly man who is a servant to Hotaru. Voiced by Shōzō Sasaki. Source: naruto.wikia.com

1735.name: Nangou
1735.desc: Nangō (ナンゴウ) is a ninja who was helping Akaboshi to collect the Tsuchigumo clan's kinjutsu. Voiced by Nobuaki Kanemitsu. Source: naruto.wikia.com

1735.name: Chuusin
1735.desc: Chūshin (チュウシン) is a ninja who was helping Akaboshi to collect the Tsuchigumo clan's forbidden jutsu. Voiced by Yōhei Tadano Source: naruto.wikia.com

1735.name: Benten
1735.desc: Benten (ベンテン) is a ninja who was helping Akaboshi to collect the Tsuchigumo clan's kinjutsu. Voiced by Chikara Ōsaka. Source: naruto.wikia.com

1735.name: Akaboshi
1735.desc: Akaboshi (アカボシ) is ninja who aims the learn the Tsuchigumo clan's forbidden jutsu. He appears to be the leader of his group. Voiced by Akimitsu Takase. Source: naruto.wikia.com

1735.name: Shiranami
1735.desc: Shiranami (シラナミ) is the boss of the Magaki group. He wants to steal the forbidden jutsu of the Tsuchigumo Clan. Source: naruto.wikia.com

1735.name: Dai Gama Sennin
1735.desc: The Great Toad Sage is the oldest and most respected toad of all the inhabitants of Mount Myōboku. Because of his age, the other toads affectionately call him Great Honorable Geezer. He is famed for his highly accurate prophecies. Being several thousand years old, he is the oldest and most respected among the population of Mount Myōboku. At his great age, the Great Toad Sage seems to constantly smile and tends to have his eyes closed or squinting. He is portrayed and described as being senile, and sometimes out of touch with his present situation, so he does tend to forget things easily and quite quickly. However, when reminded, he is still able to remember things and can easily tell things very precisely. As a sage, he is also very wise, and is quick to stop Shima and Fukasaku from bickering and encourages harmony. It would seem that unlike most other toads, he actually has respect for Jiraiya, and has urged both Shima and Fukasaku to cooperate with him

1735.name: Harusame
1735.desc: Harusame was the former master of Utakata. He was once Utakata's master and he had trusted him until Harusame tried to remove the Six-Tailed Slug from his body which resulted in Utakata transforming into the Six-Tails and killing him. Since then, Utakata has held a great grudge against Harusame and made him think a student and master bond is not something to be counted on. Tsurugi states that Harusame tried to remove the Six-Tails to save Utakata, but Utakata believes otherwise. (source: narutopedia)

1735.name: Tsurugi
1735.desc: Tsurugi was the head of Kirigakure's Hunter-nin.

1735.name: Yuura
1735.desc: Yūra was a sleeper agent of Sasori. As a Sunagakure ninja, he served as a trusted member of the Kazekage advisory council of Suna for four years. He was also assigned to command the defense of Suna at the time Gaara, the Fifth Kazekage, was kidnapped. He was in charge of guarding the gate when Sasori lifted the jutsu that was blocking memories of him, Yūra killed all the guards to allow Sasori's partner, Deidara, into the village. Yūra was later used by Pain as a sacrifice for the Shapeshifting Technique, becoming a replica of Itachi Uchiha. This replica was defeated by Naruto with the Great Ball Rasengan. His corpse was later devoured by Zetsu.

1735.name: Ebizou
1735.desc: Ebizō is called "Honoured Grandfather Ebizō" by the Sand villagers. He and his older sister, Chiyo, are highly revered in Sunagakure, and were known as the Honoured Siblings. He is Sasori's paternal granduncle.

1735.name: Jouseki
1735.desc: Jōseki is a senior from Sunagakure. His foremost concern was the peacefulness of the village. He wasn't comfortable with Gaara's appointment to Kazekage, seeing him as little more than a failed and highly dangerous experiment. When the Kazekage was kidnapped by the Akatsuki, he mused it might be for the best and wanted to quickly elect a new Kazekage.

1735.name: Ittetsu
1735.desc: Ittetsu is a genin from Sunagakure. He admired the Kazekage from the bottom of his heart and was part of the group of Suna shinobi who went to rescue the Kazekage from the Akatsuki. When he heard the Kazekage was revived, he was so relieved he had to cry, which Matsuri slugged him for.

1735.name: Yakku
1735.desc: Yakku meets with Temari and Team 7 when they arrive in Sunagakure. He gives them the latest information concerning Gaara's abduction and escorts them to Kankurō.

1735.name: Sari
1735.desc: Sari is a Genin from Sunagakure. She's close friends with Matsuri and like her, she has a strong admiration for the Kazekage. She adores the Kazekage more than anyone except for her friend Matsuri and was willing to do anything to rescue him, even going to volunteer for the mission to save him.

1735.name: Fudou
1735.desc: Fudō was part of the group of grave robbers who dug up four of the dead Twelve Guardian Ninja. He was the brute force of the group, and was usually shown paired up with Fuen.

1735.name: Fuen
1735.desc: Fuen was a kunoichi who was part of the group of grave robbers who dug up four of the dead Twelve Guardian Ninja. She was the strategist and trap expert of the group, and was widely thought of as the weakest member of the team.

1735.name: Mabui
1735.desc: The Fourth Raikage's assistant acts as a go-between for the Raikage and Kumogakure's forces, giving them his orders and keeping him updated on their progress. She's a dark-skinned girl who is seen wearing a very formal attire during work hours, long earrings, and properly pulling her light-gray hair back into a bun except for the frontal part of it, which consists of two flat side bangs that fall along the sides of her face. (Source: Narutopedia)

1735.name: Kihou
1735.desc: Kihō (鬼鳳) is a shinobi who appears in the second Naruto Shippūden filler arc. He seemed rather blunt and went along with Rinji's strategies without complaints. Kihō also feared death to which he referred to as "going bon".

1735.name: Gozu
1735.desc: Gozu (牛頭) is a shinobi who appeared in the second Naruto Shippūden filler arc. He is a subordinate of Guren He is unsociable and quiet, making people unable to figure out what he is thinking, but his battle skills are without a doubt very dexterous. He relies on taijutsu and brute strength and preferred fighting alone. He holds a special sentiment towards Guren and was her most loyal subordinate, even stating "I will accompany you no matter where you go". The reason for this was that Guren saved his life while he was imprisoned by Orochimaru, giving him water when he was dying of thirst.

1735.name: Kigiri
1735.desc: Kigiri was a shinobi who appeared in the second Naruto Shippūden filler arc. Kigiri appeared quite laid-back compared to other members of the group. Also, he addressed Rinji as Aniki (Brother) on occasion. In addition, he seemed to be a bit of a gambler as he was shown playing cards with Rinji while in the hideout.

1735.name: Nurari
1735.desc: Nurari (濡羅吏) was a shinobi who appeared in the second Naruto Shippūden filler arc. Nurari enjoyed toying with his foes and constantly mocked them. He also was shown to be a bit of a drag queen when he whimpered feminine shrieks or moans whenever he was in danger. Another example was when Rinji, and later Kabuto, gave him a mocking stare, to which he remarked was rude.

1735.name: Bisuke
1735.desc: Bisuke (ビスケ; English TV "Biscuit") is a ninken and a summoning of Kakashi Hatake. He bears an uncanny resemblance to Gaara with a kanji imprinted on his head and dark rings around his eyes. However, where Gaara has the kanji for "love" (愛, ai), Bisuke has the kanji for "shinobi" (忍). (Naruto wiki)

1735.name: Denka
1735.desc: Denka (デンカ) is a ninja cat that lives with Nekobaa at an Uchiha supply base. Suigetsu mistakes him for a tanuki. His senses are sharp after sensing Sasuke's chakra and remembering him after the years apart

1735.name: Hina
1735.desc: Hina (ヒナ) is a ninja cat that lives with Nekobaa at an Uchiha supply base. Suigetsu mistakes her for a tanuki.

1735.name: Kousuke
1735.desc: Kōsuke (こうすけ) was a young toad that wore goggles. On Kōsuke's back is the kanji word for "gold" (金, kin). He seemed to be a very happy and cheerful toad, and took orders almost directly.

1735.name: Manda
1735.desc: Manda is the personal summon of Orochimaru. Manda was the largest snake in the world, before being recently out-sized by his clone, Manda II. He easily towers over buildings, trees, and large rock formations. Due to his length, he is even larger than Gamabunta and Katsuyu, easily coiling around Katsuyu and having more length behind him, and he could open his jaws wide enough to swallow Gamabunta whole. He is colored purple, and has black rings running down intervals on his body. He has massive fangs, though they are arranged in a way similar to that of a constrictor snake instead of a viper or other venomous snake species, presumably carrying venom in them from the way they were designed, and green eyes. He also has four horn-like protrusions on his head.

1735.name: Gameru
1735.desc: Gameru is a ninja who possesses one of Iou's prototype ninja tools, Dako. Him along with Kusune came to Iou to get ninja tools but he refused to give some to outsiders. Gameru and Kusune fight Naruto Uzumaki and Neji Hyūga who are no match against Iou's ninja tools. When Iou gives Tenten his latest invention, Jidanda, Tenten easily defeats the two. (source: Narutopedia)

1735.name: Iou
1735.desc: Iou is a ninja tool inventor from Konoha and Shoseki helps him make these tools. Most of his tool creations are shown either be impossible to carry or serves no purpose at all. It is assumed he was relocated to the outskirts of the village due to the random explosions which he claims are "challenges" during his inventing. Team Guy (minus Might Guy and Naruto Uzumaki replacing Rock Lee) go to the Konoha Research Lab to retrieve more tools for the village. When checking up on their progress, they see that Iou and his assistant went down the research lab to work on Iou's newest weapon. Suddenly two ninja, Gameru and Kusune arrive to the research lab and demand new weapons from Iou. They both possessed two of his prototype weapons that Shoseki sold to them. Iou gave Tenten his newest weapon, Jidanda, which she used to defeat both the ninja. Iou took Jidanda back from Tenten after the ninja were defeated, saying more work needed to be done on the weapon. Years later, Tenten and Neji Hyūga return to the research lab to retrieve more tools for the village after its destruction. (source: Narutopedia)

1735.name: Kusune
1735.desc: Kusune is a ninja who possesses Iou's ninja tool, Tsuru-Kame. Him along with Gameru asked for ninja tools from Iou but he refused to give his ninja tools to outsiders. Naruto Uzumaki and Neji Hyūga fought Kusune and Gameru but were stalemated by Iou's prototype ninja tools. Kusune and Gameru were defeated by Tenten when she used Iou's latest ninja tool, Jidanda. (source: Narutopedia)

1735.name: Shouseki
1735.desc: Shoseki (笙関, Shoseki) is the apprentice of tool maker Iou. He is an apprentice of Iou, and is helping him in his tool-making job. He often complains about hard work. One time he mistakenly sold Gameru and Kusune two ninja tools Iou created: Tsuru-Kame and Dako, to increase their budget. (source: Narutopedia)

1735.name: Yaoki
1735.desc: Yaoki (屋沖, Yaoki) is a ninja from Sunagakure and a subordinate of Gaara along with his partner Korobi. He is shown to be cowardly and wimpy around Gaara, due to him formally be a murderous maniac. When Konoha and Suna started to get along again, Yaoki was assigned on a team with Gaara to take out a group of bandits located between Suna and Konoha, which Team 7 was also assigned to. When Gaara was captured by an assassination squad from their village, Gaara tells them to leave because the squad after only him. Naruto runs into Yaoki and Korobi, seeing Gaara is not with them and asking them why they abandoned their friend. The two both wonder if Gaara is their friend. Yaoki and Korobi both assisted Naruto in Gaara's rescue and they tell him they're his friends. When their mission was accomplished, Gaara asked Yaoki and Korobi what they said and they happily tell him they're his friends. (source: Narutopedia)

1735.name: Korobi
1735.desc: Korobi is a ninja from Sunagakure and a subordinate of Gaara, along with Yaoki. Korobi was assigned on a mission along with Yaoki and Gaara to stop a group of bandits that were located between Suna and Konoha which Team 7 were also assigned to. He was shown to be cowardly and wimpy when Gaara due to Gaara's killing impulses which he got rid of after Suna's invasion. When Gaara was caught in a trap by Suna's assassination squad, he told Korobi and Yaoki to get away. Naruto runs into them, learning that Gaara was captured and asks them why they abandoned their friend. Korobi and Yaoki both wondered if Gaara is their friend. Korobi and Yaoki both assisted Naruto in rescuing Gaara. After their mission was finished, Gaara asks Korobi and Yaoki what they said to him and they happily say they're his friends. (source: Narutopedia)

1735.name: Katazu
1735.desc: Katazu is a swordsman who took his twin brother Kageki's identity after the accidental death of Shikazo. Kageki had loaned money to Shikazo but after the birth of his child, he asked to be repaid by him but Shikazo refused and a scuffle broke out which resulted him hitting his head on a rock hard enough to kill him. Kageki went to Katazu after that and he took his brother's identity while Kageki and his family went into hiding. Katazu purposely attracted Shikazo's pursuers while they went into hiding. Since then, Tsukado was tasked by his clan to carry out a vendetta against him but failed to defeat Katazu 34 times. The next day, Kanabun brought Katazu to Tsukado to profit off their fight. With Naruto's help, Tsukado was able to get the advantage but Naruto stopped their fight, noticing that Katazu couldn't have killed Shikazo. Katazu reveals the truth to Tsukado and he decides not to kill him. Kanabun and his gang try to force the two to fight again but the swordsmen and Team 7 chase them out of town. (source: Narutopedia)

1735.name: Kanabun
1735.desc: Kanabun is the boss of the Kanabun Gang. Him and his gang watched Tsukado's fight and loss against Katazu who killed his distant relative, Shikazo. After seeing his hidden swordsman's skills after the fight, Kanabun brings Katazu the next day to Tsukado so him and his gang can profit off their fight. When Katazu reveals that he didn't kill Shikazo and the fight ends, Kanabun and his gang try to get them fight again by force but are chased out of town by the two swordsmen, Team 7 and Mr. Ostrich with Kanabun saying they'll be sorry. (source: Narutopedia)

1735.name: Tsukado
1735.desc: Tsukado is a master swordsmen of an unnamed clan who had a vendetta against a man that killed a relative of his, Shikazo. Tsukado was chosen with the task of avenging him by the killing the man who killed him, Katazu. He failed 34 times to defeat him. One day, Team 7 meets Tsukado and seeing his poor revenge skills, Naruto decides to train him. Though his lessons were unusual, he managed to get the upper hand in his next fight with the killer. Naruto stops the fight after noticing Katazu's sword wasn't even sharpened, saying he couldn't possibly kill his relative. He says that it was his twin brother, Kageki who killed his relative but it was an accident. Since then, he has been taking his brother's identity. The Kanabun Gang, who were profiting off their fight, try to get the two to fight again but with the help of Team 7 manage to chase them out of town. Tsukado is shown to be able to use chakra flow when using his sword. (source: Narutopedia)

1735.name: Furofoki
1735.desc: Furofoki is a Konoha medical ninja examining Jofuku flower in Jofuku Forest on the mountain of the same name. When queried by Naruto about her decision to live and work all alone on the mountain, she told him that's what she decided and it wasn't his business. She has a great understanding of the flowers and seems to have gathered quite a few of them, indicating that she may have either fought off the flowers' defenses or discovered a way to safely harvest them, either one being testament to her ability. (source: naruto.wikia.com)

1735.name: Kandachi
1735.desc: Kandachi (カンダチ, Kandachi) is a missing-nin from Amegakure and was Hanzō's right hand man. Sometime after Pain killed Hanzō, Kandachi and a group of Ame ninja fled the country and went into hiding by taking over a village surrounded by a magnetic force that affects a person's chakra flow to the brain similar to genjutsu. Like his superior Hanzō, he fights mainly using the Summoning Technique. He can command the Conch King with hand seals. All of the hand seals performed also give the Conch King a signal to use a specified technique. Kandachi has shown a rare ability to cast a genjutsu on his opponent though the Conch King. The magnetic field caused by the tree strengthens this genjutsu, as the magnetism disrupts a person's chakra flow, similar to a genjutsu. Kandachi can also command the Conch King to propel above water by using Wind Release. When Jiraiya brought Naruto Uzumaki to the forest for training, they encounter Tanishi who tells them of Kandachi's takeover. Naruto (disguised as Tanishi) and Jiraiya, pretending to be captured, meet with Kandachi, surprised to see Jiraiya again. Naruto's cover is blown when the real Tanishi arrives and Kandashi decides to feed the villagers to the Conch King. Naruto fights against Kandachi and the Conch King but their techniques knocks Naruto down every time. In the end, Naruto defeats them both with his first Great Ball Rasengan.

1735.name: Sukune
1735.desc: Sukune was a brave man who never gave up hope of defending his village against Kandachi. He was similar to Kaiza, and died in the similar manner trying to do the best for his countrymen. His son Tanishi at first, detested him, but when he saw the meaning of his death, began to love him. He was buried in the village's graveyard. Jiraiya mentions that Sukune and his family were very kind to him when he visited the Genjutsu Tree Village the first time, and is sad to hear of his death when he returns with Naruto later. He is known to be respected in the village. The husband of Yone and the father of Tanishi. No noticeable skills- he is shown to be fairly strong from the civilian's standpoint, but his skills are not nearly equal to those of a ninja.

1735.name: Tanishi
1735.desc: Tanishi is a boy from the Genjutsu Tree Village. Kandachi, a missing-nin from Amegakure, attacks and takes over the village, and kills Tanishi's father, Sukune, in the process.

1735.name: Yone
1735.desc: Yone is the wife of Sukune and mother of Tanishi. She, along with the other women and children, was held hostage by Kandachi and his men when they killed Sukune and took over their village. Jiraiya stated that she and her husband Sukune were very kind to him the first time he visited the Genjutsu Tree Village.

1735.name: Kosuke Maruboshi
1735.desc: Kosuke Maruboshi is a genin of Konohagakure, whom others called the Ten-Thousand-Year Genin (万年下忍, Mannen Genin). Kosuke has been a genin for over fifty years, thus the reason others called him the Ten-Thousand-Year Genin. When he was still a child, he made a reckless decision that cost him the lives of his teammates. Feeling ashamed of this, he felt he was not worthy of being promoted beyond the rank of genin. Despite this, he continued to train arduously to improve his skills, something that was insisted upon him by Tobirama Senju. During his time as a ninja, he had served under the Second, Third, and Fourth Hokage and now apparently even the Fifth Hokage. At other points, he fought alongside Jiraiya and Sakumo Hatake. Kosuke is an elderly man with his once black hair now grayed which he wears in a short ponytail. He wears a mesh armor shirt under a short brown sleeveless kimono as well as gray pants. He is usually seen with a smile on his face. He carries a metal pan that he uses for multiple reasons ranging from cooking in while out on missions to a weapon during battle. He also carries a ladle and a sword sheathed horizontally across his lower back. Even though his official ranks is that of genin, he is skilled enough to become a Jōnin; a promotion he declined time and time again. He has shown considerable taijutsu skill, able to use only his cooking-ware to defend and maneuver against enemy attacks. He is also a skilled kenjutsu fighter and wields a sword and a hidden b

1735.name: Hayama Shirakumo
1735.desc: Hayama Shirakumo (白雲ハヤマ, Shirakumo Hayama) is a jōnin of Konohagakure that protected its borders after the Invasion of Konoha. Hayama has long dull purple hair held in a ponytail. He also has a scar running down the right side of his mouth. He wears the standard Konoha shinobi outfit, albeit his uniform has short sleeves. He also wears a pair of fingerless gloves and carries a thin katana strapped horizontally to his back. Hayama is very adept at Kenjutsu. With his sword he can use the Vacuum Sword technique which was able to fend off many Iwagakure ninja as well as weapons. He is assigned to patrol the northern borders along with Tekuno, Naruto Uzumaki, and Kosuke Maruboshi after the Invasion of Konoha. Not long after they were ambushed by a battalion of ninja from Iwagakure. Hayama stayed behind to allow the other members of the squad time to escape and report to the village. He summoned a crossbow with explosive tags attached to the projectiles and along with Tekuno wiped out the majority of the ninja. Together the team was able to wipe out dozens of Iwa ninja. He is seen alongside his fellow village ninja aiding in the restoration of the village after Pain's invasion.

1735.name: Tekuno Kanden
1735.desc: Tekuno Kanden (感電テクノ, Kanden Tekuno) is a shinobi of Konohagakure that protected its borders after the Invasion of Konoha. Tekuno has a robust build and has shaggy brown hair. He wears the standard attire of a Konoha shinobi along with fingerless gloves. He also wears his flak jacket unzipped under which he wears a utility sash with his several scrolls. His abilities primarily revolve around the use of heavy explosive artillery and is also highly skilled at setting traps. He was also very skilled at using wires, often incorporating them into his traps. He was so proficient with them that he is able to lay them all over the battlefield then manipulate them in such a way that he could trap multiple enemy in them at once. During a mission he was shown summoning a crossbow that he used to fire projectiles with exploding tags attached to them. Along with this weapon he also summoned a few katana, so it can be assumed that he is skilled at using them. He was assigned to a squad along with Hayama Shirakumo, Kosuke Maruboshi and Naruto Uzumaki to protect the norther boundaries of the village after Suna and Otogakure's invasion of the village. During their mission he was assigned to set traps around the area. Not long after they were ambushed by a battalion of ninja from Iwagakure. Tekuno's traps proved useful in hindering the progress of the ninja but when they had breached these securities, he stayed behind to allow the other members of the squad time to escape and report to the vil

1735.name: Fu Yamanaka
1735.desc: Fu is a member in Root. Manga Debut: Chapter #454 Anime: Naruto Shippūden Episode #198 ~!He is one of Danzo's chosen bodyguards.!~

1735.name: Hanare
1735.desc: Hanare is a kunoichi from the Jōmae Village. She was an orphan who longed to see her parents and find a home she could call her own. As a young child, Hanare was said to be very lonely since she never knew her family or seen her own village. She was trained from an early age in the art of espionage. One day, she was found crying in a place near her village by the young Kakashi, who spotted her and carried her on his back. He then explained to her that she can look up to the clouds above and find her way. They both then were seen by a ninja from Hanare's village and Kakashi put her down on her feet, said goodbye and left. She was then excited that someone like Kakashi was able to help her in her life. Hanare's abilities allow her to read someone's mind by using her right eye to literally look into it. She is even able to use this ability on those who are looking at her thoughts. She can also erase all of her thoughts that she had gathered. To use this technique, she weaves signs by moving her eye in specific patterns. Hanare's special technique can help her in collecting and gathering information in various things. She has also been trained to have an immensely strong will, unyielding to seemingly any form of torture, even by the likes of Ibiki Morino, a master manipulator of the human psyche.

1735.name: Nekomata
1735.desc: Nekomata (猫又, Nekomata) is giant cat who is the boss of the ninja cat underworld. Appearance: Konoha History Arc - Episode 189 (Filler Arc) During Sasuke Uchiha's childhood, Itachi Uchiha made a game of collecting paw prints of quick, nimble cats from a normal cat to a lion and the last paw print to be collected was Nekomata's. Itachi once defeated Nekomata and his ninja cats and requested him to fight Sasuke with all his might when he gets older. (Source: Narutopedia)

1735.name: Fuguki Suikazan
1735.desc: Fuguki Suikazan was a high-ranking shinobi of Kirigakure and a former member of the Seven Ninja Swordsmen of the Mist. Manga Debut: Chapter #507 Anime Debut: Naruto Shippuuden Episode #251 (source: Narutopedia)

1735.name: Baji
1735.desc: Baji was a leader of a group of bandits. ~!He kidnapped the Headman's granddaughter and held her hostage. After Team 7 and Team 10 had infiltrated his fortress, he asked to make a hostage exchange between Tōfu and Shikamaru Nara. With the help of Chōji Akimichi and Ino Yamanaka, Shikamaru managed to gain the upper hand over him. Knowing there was no escape, he threatened to kill himself using Exploding Tags wrapped all over his body, but was stopped by Shikamaru's Shadow Imitation Technique. !~ Debut: Naruto Shippūden Episode #195 (source: http://naruto.wikia.com/wiki/Baji)

1735.name: Jakou
1735.desc: Jakou is a thief that stole some treasure from a daimyō's sister. ~!He, along with his group of bandits that were traveling with treasure stolen from the daimyō's sister. The treasure was later recovered by Naruto Uzumaki and Sasuke Uchiha, who later defeated him and his team. !~ Debut: Naruto Shippūden Episode #194

1735.name: Kisuke Maboroshi
1735.desc: Kisuke Maboroshi (まぼろし奇介, Maboroshi Kisuke) was a member of Konohagakure's ANBU. ~!The leaders of Konoha had suspicions that there was a spy within their midst and Kisuke was assigned with the task of finding out who that person was. His investigations led him to an upcoming shinobi, Sabiru. One night, he tracked down Sabiru in a forest, and after discovering he was the spy he engaged him in battle. After a short fight, Sabiru deceived him with a shadow clone and threw him in the river below. He managed to grab a rock, but Sabiru appeared on top of it, saying he had already killed his wife and burned down his house. He then proceeded to extract Kisuke's soul from his body, sealing it in a tag, which was left attached to the rock. The tag was eventually found and accidentally removed by Naruto, resulting in Kisuke's soul appearing before him a short time later as a ghost, with no memories of his past life. After asking around Konoha, he and Naruto discovered Kisuke's comatose body in Konoha Hospital: the body was later killed by Sabiru, resulting in a second "death" for Kisuke. With Naruto's help, the now deceased ANBU found out the location of his home, which they found burned down. In this place, by seeing a tulip, Kisuke had his memory back, and revealed what had happened. With Naruto's and Kakashi's help, Kisuke managed to prevent Sabiru from operating his dangerous security project, which would have caused troubles to the village. By possessing Naruto's body and using his

1735.name: Naho
1735.desc: Naho (ナホ, Naho) is a relative of the Fire Daimyō. ~!While she was playing with her ball, she dropped it and started rolling. She tried to catch it, but slipped off a cliff. Sasuke Uchiha managed to save her and like many before her, she also seems to have an infatuation with Sasuke. Naruto Uzumaki and Sakura Haruno were assigned by Tsunade to escort her to Shizume village. She rejected saying that she wanted Sasuke to be her bodyguard. They started their journey with Naruto transformed as Sasuke in order to fool her. They encountered an enemy with an impenetrable body. After a fight with the criminal and other ninja, the criminal quickly defeats Naruto and Sakura and captured the three. Later that night, Sasuke locates the three and battles the criminal. he eventually defeated him with Chidori but continued to beat him. Naho noted Sasuke's coldness and became scared of him, however Naruto said that she should forgive him because Sasuke is really a good person, and that he will bring him to her as soon as he becomes his former self. !~ Debut: Naruto Shippūden Episode #196 (Source: Naruto Fandom Wiki)

1735.name: Sabiru
1735.desc: Sabiru (サビル, Sabiru) was a young high level shinobi in Konohagakure's tactical division. He was later discovered to be a traitor and a spy. ~!Sabiru was part of Konohagakure's tactical and defence division during the Third Hokage's administration. He had seemingly come up with a plan that would fortify Konohagakure's defences so much that the Third stated that it would fortify the peace in Konohagakure forever. He however was discovered to be a traitor of the village by Kisuke Maboroshi, a member of the ANBU. When Kisuke confronted Sabiru, he removed Kisuke's soul essentially putting him into a comatose state. After murdering Kisuke by deactivating his life support system Naruto Uzumaki tried to expose him as a spy. Later with help from Kakashi Hatake he was found liable, but before they could extract any information from him he was taken out by a hidden Kabuto Yakushi. !~ Debut: Naruto Shippūden Episode #193 (source: http://naruto.wikia.com/wiki/Sabiru)

1735.name: Sadai
1735.desc: Sadai (サダイ, Sadai) is an assailant who entered Land of Fire to capture Naho. He was on the national wanted list. ~!Sadai and his group intercepted Naruto Uzumaki, Sakura Haruno and Naho. Naruto managed to defeat his comrades, but his Shadow Clone Techniques and Rasengan didn't work on him. After he captured the group, Sasuke Uchiha came and battled him. After discovering his taijutsu skills weren't enough, he used Fire Release: Great Fireball Technique to burn assailants armour, thus showing his true face. Sasuke defeated him using Chidori, and even after his defeat, Sasuke punched him severely because of his words about Itachi Uchiha and the Uchiha Clan Massacre and about weak Sasuke. Sasuke was only stopped by Kakashi, who reminded him that they should bring Sadai back for questioning. !~ Debut: Naruto Shippūden Episode #196 (source: http://naruto.wikia.com/wiki/Sadai)

1735.name: Suguro
1735.desc: Suguro is a thief that was part of Jako's gang. ~!He is the first of the thieves to find and attack Naruto Uzumaki and Sasuke Uchiha after they were linked together by Jako's Chakra Liquid technique, when Naruto wanted to pee and Sasuke refused to go with him (as they were both linked). They started arguing when they came across Suguro who was apparently himself peeing. He quickly dashed towards them and attacked them with his Manriki-gusari, but was later defeated by both of them. !~ Debut: Naruto Shippūden Episode #194 (source: http://naruto.wikia.com/wiki/Suguro)

1735.name: Toufu
1735.desc: Tōfu (トウフウ, Toufuu) is a self-proclaimed ex-bandit. ~!Although claiming to be an ex-bandit, he was actually a spy working for a gang leader, as his double agent in the village. His major work involved gathering information. He was arrested by a Konohagakure joint team after the gang was defeated. !~ Debut: Naruto Shippūden Episode #195 (source: http://naruto.wikia.com/wiki/Tofu)

1735.name: Ukon
1735.desc: Ukon is the twin brother of Sakon. He usually resides in Sakon's body (where he's said to be sleeping), with only his head protruding on Sakon's back. Ukon, unlike his brother, is very impatient and prefers to finish a fight quickly.

1735.name: Muta Aburame
1735.desc: Muta had long brown hair and like all other Aburame, his eyes were obscured by dark sunglasses. His attire consisted of a long sleeved light tan jacket with a high, upturned collar. The remainder of his form was largely obstructed by the low hemlines and overlaying clothes. He also had a pouch fastened to the back of his outfit which he used to carry around a jar in which he carried additional Kikaichū bugs.

1735.name: Land of Fire Daimyo
1735.desc: The Fire Daimyō has a fickle and indecisive nature and is easily swayed in his decisions through biases as well as external influences. When situations call for fast, important decisions, he makes his advisers do the whole work: the one who convinces him most is the "winner". He seemingly had a liking for Jiraiya, wanting to choose him as the next Hokage, and was also impressed by Kakashi Hatake's reputation. (Source: Naruto.wikia)

1735.name: Gerotora
1735.desc: Gerotora is a scroll toad, a rare species that closely guards whatever secret has been written on its scroll-abdomen until his contractor dies. He resides in the belly of his contractor, and is known for his excellent endurance. (Source: Naruto.wikia)

1735.name: Yuusuke
1735.desc: Yuusuke (ユウスケ, Yūsuke) is a fisherman in the Land of Fire. When he was a child, he and his father tried to catch a giant summoned marlin, they failed, resulting in his father's death. Yuusuke became determined to avenge his father by catching the marlin.

1735.name: Ship's Captain
1735.desc: Captain of the ship in which Hishaku was part of. (episode 225)

1735.name: Honoka
1735.desc: A kunoichi working with the researchers on a remote island.While researchers worked on the Ultimate Summoning Animal, Honoka was assigned to restrain the beast using her sealing techniques. However, at some point in time the beast got too powerful for her technique to restrain it and killed everyone. Honoka had dark eyes and long red hair in which she wore a white band. She wore a purple, sleeveless kimono blouse with yellow trimmings held close by a traditional obi with a long, streaming bow tied to it, mesh armour underneath it and a short white skirt. She seemed to prefer going barefoot. Honoka had some aptitude for sealing techniques as she was assigned to restrain the Ultimate Summoning Animal. She could use a sealing technique that caused the sealing formula to form into chains to restrain a target.

1735.name: Hibachi
1735.desc: Hibachi was a student at the Ninja Academy, assigned to Iruka Umino's class. Hibachi picked on Naruto when he failed to perform the Clone Technique but was stopped by Iruka, saying not to bother with a kid like him. (Source: naruto.wikia (Narutopedia))

1735.name: Igii
1735.desc: Appears in episode 233.

1735.name: Banna
1735.desc: Appears in episode 233.

1735.name: Suika
1735.desc: A jōnin of Takigakure prior to his defection from the village. He afterwards operated as a bandit. Anime Debut: Naruto Shippūden Episode #236

1735.name: Shizuka
1735.desc: A kunoichi and future leader of the Nadeshiko Village. She was destined to marry a student of Jiraiya that can defeat her, because of a law from her village. Shizuka is a highly capable and powerful kunoichi. She has shown great weapons proficiency, incorporating kunai into her techniques such as the Nadeshiko-Style Deep Crimson Dance Performance, a technique that Tokiwa praised Naruto for being able to dodge as well as the Dance Performance: Second Step where she spins in the air while releasing a volley of kunai at the enemy, greatly increasing her range. #Anime debut: Naruto: Shippuuden Episode #235

1735.name: Tokiwa
1735.desc: Tokiwa (トキワ, Tokiwa) is a kunoichi from the Nadeshiko Village. Anime debut: Naruto Shippūden Episode #235

1735.name: Kokuyou
1735.desc: Appears in episode 235.

1735.name: Nadeshiko Previous Leader
1735.desc: Former leader of the Nadeshiko Village. Decades ago she encountered Jiraiya who has entered her village to do "research" for his next novel. After he escaped she pursued him and challenged him to a duel for his hand in marriage. This match was however postponed, as neither party was making headway against the other. Jiraiya promised that their students instead should one day seek each other out and fight if the two never met again. This promise fell to her pupil Shizuka and Jiraiya's last pupil Naruto Uzumaki. She's presumed to be Shizuka's mother but is not confirmed neither named as such in the credits, instead she's named as "Previous Head of the village (先代里長)". Appears in episode 235. (Source: Narutopedia)

1735.name: Madara Uchiha
1735.desc: __Classification:__ Missing-nin __Occupation:__ Co-founder of Konohagakure, Leader of the Uchiha clan __Clan:__ Uchiha clan Madara Uchiha is a legendary ninja who led the Uchiha clan prior to and after the formation of Konohagakure. Madara eventually began to suffer from overuse of the Mangekyō Sharingan, leaving him blind. In order to regain his sight he took [Izuna](https://anilist.co/character/16406)'s eyes for himself, granting him an "eternal" Mangekyō Sharingan. ~!After he was rejected for the position of Hokage and was abandoned by his clan, Madara left the Hidden Leaf Village, and sought out [Nine-Tails](https://anilist.co/character/7407).!~ ~!He later returned in order to challenge [Hashirama](https://anilist.co/character/12464) in battle. Madara was defeated, despite having Nine-Tails at his side. Control of Nine-Tails was ultimately taken from him and Madara was believed to have died.!~

1735.name: Motoi
1735.desc: Motoi (モトイ, Motoi) is a Kumogakure shinobi who is stationed on the Island Turtle. Manga debut: Chapter #492 Anime debut: Naruto Shippūden Episode #243 When Motoi was five-years-old, he and Killer B were good friends. After Motoi's father was killed during an attempt to subdue the Eight-Tails that had broken free from its previous jinchūriki, Motoi came to hate the Eight-Tails. B was soon chosen to be the beast's next jinchūriki and Motoi, just as many other Kumo villagers did, focused his anger towards B because he was to be the vessel of the beast. He once tried to assassinate B to avenge his father, but was disarmed by B easily. Despite having his face covered, Motoi assumed that B knew it was him, as B ungrudgingly greeted him as they used to with a fist bump. After this, Motoi could never bring himself to face B, and hadn't spoken to him for thirty years, but in time he came to admire B as a village hero.

1735.name: Gyuuki
1735.desc: The Eight-Tails is a tailed beast sealed within Killer B of Kumogakure after his cousin, cousin's uncle and cousin's father failed before him. Since Killer B is one of the few jinchūriki to gain control over his tailed beast, his relationship with the Eight-Tails is very relaxed. Where the Nine-Tailed Demon Fox constantly threatens its jinchūriki and must be either restrained or confined to be spoken to, B and the Eight-Tails can talk leisurely, with Killer B even sitting on its nose. However, B tends to annoy the Eight-Tails to comical effect; his serious and no-nonsense demeanour often contrasts with B's tendency to goof off whenever he likes, adding fuel to the Tailed Beast's irritation to his vessel. The Eight-Tails is not above bad-mouthing B as a result. The Eight-Tails is also known to scold him in serious occasions as shown when it criticised B for rapping in his fight with Kisame when he should have been completely focused on their opponent. Because of this, the Eight-Tails appears to be much more note worthy than B as far as responsibility is concerned. Before B learned to control it, the Eight-Tails was infamous to be wild, and violent. It also went on many rampages whenever its former jinchūriki would lose control of it. Despite the Eight-Tails' strong relationship with Killer B, its main goal, like the other beasts, is self preservation. For example, it was more than willing to be released and attack Kisame Hoshigaki despite Sabu and Ponta being close by. The Eig

1735.name: Taji
1735.desc: Taji (タジ, Taji) was a Konoha ANBU and medical-nin of Konohagakure. Manga Debut: Chapter #500 Anime Debut: Naruto Shippuuden Episode #247 (source: Narutopedia)

1735.name: Mito Uzumaki
1735.desc: A kunoichi who originated from Uzushiogakure's Uzumaki clan and later married into Konohagakure's Senju clan. She was also the first jinchūriki of Kurama the Nine-Tailed Demon Fox.

1735.name: Biwako Sarutobi
1735.desc: Biwako Sarutobi (猿飛ビワコ, Sarutobi Biwako) was the wife of Hiruzen Sarutobi. Manga Debut: Chapter #500 Anime Debut: Naruto Shippuuden Episode #247 (source: Narutopedia)

1735.name: Kurenai no Chichi
1735.desc: Kurenai's father, he is a shinobi from Konohagakure. Manga Debut: Chapter #503 Anime Debut: Naruto Shippuuden Episode #248 (source: Narutopedia)

1735.name: Iruka no Chichi
1735.desc: Iruka's father, he was a Konohagakure shinobi. Manga Debut: Chapter #503 Anime Debut: Naruto Shippuuden Episode #177 (source: Narutopedia)

1735.name: Iruka no Haha
1735.desc: Iruka's mother, she was a kunoichi from Konohagakure. Manga Debut: Chapter #503 Anime Debut: Naruto Shippuuden Episode #177 (source: Narutopedia)

1735.name: Matatabi
1735.desc: Matatabi (又旅, Matatabi), more commonly known as the Two-Tails (ニ尾, Nibi), is a tailed beast sealed within Yugito Nii of Kumogakure. It has been captured by Hidan and Kakuzu, then extracted and sealed by Akatsuki.

1735.name: Isobu
1735.desc: Isobu (磯撫, Isobu), more commonly known as the Three-Tails (三尾, Sanbi), is a tailed beast that was formerly sealed in Yagura of Kirigakure. It has been captured by Deidara and Tobi, then sealed by Akatsuki.

1735.name: Saiken
1735.desc: Saiken (犀犬, Saiken), more commonly known as the Six-Tails (六尾, Rokubi), is a tailed beast sealed within Utakata of Kirigakure. It has been captured by Pain in the anime, then extracted and sealed by Akatsuki.

1735.name: Son Goku
1735.desc: Son Gokū (孫悟空, Son Gokū), more commonly known as the Four-Tails (四尾, Yonbi), is a tailed beast sealed within Rōshi of Iwagakure. It was captured by Kisame Hoshigaki, then extracted and sealed by Akatsuki.

1735.name: Kokuou
1735.desc: Kokuō (穆王, Kokuō), more commonly known as the Five-Tails (五尾, Gobi), is a tailed beast sealed within Han from Iwagakure. It has been captured, extracted, and sealed by Akatsuki. In the anime, Kokuō is indicated to have been one of the two tailed beasts that Akatsuki captured before the start of Part II.

1735.name: Choumei
1735.desc: Choumei, more commonly known as the Seven-Tails, is a tailed beast sealed within [Fuu](https://anilist.co/character/23220) from Takigakure. It has been captured, extracted, and sealed by Akatsuki. In the anime, Choumei is indicated to have been one of the two tailed beasts that Akatsuki captured before the start of Part II.

1735.name: Hagoromo Ootsutsuki
1735.desc: The Sage of the Six Paths (六道仙人, Rikudō Sennin) was the legendary figure who founded the arts of ninjutsu and created the ninja world. He defeated the Ten-Tails and sealed it within his own body, thus becoming the first jinchūriki.

1735.name: Tenga
1735.desc: Tenga (天画, Tenga) is a shinobi of Kumogakure. Manga Debut: Chapter #488 Anime Debut: Naruto Shippūden Episode #218

1735.name: Ranka
1735.desc: Ranka (ランカ, Ranka; Viz "Lanka") is a ninja from Konohagakure. Manga Debut: Chapter #489 Anime Debut: Naruto Shippūden Episode #197

1735.name: Tokuma Hyuuga
1735.desc: Tokuma Hyuuga is a shinobi from Konohagakure's Hyūga clan. Manga Debut: Chapter #489 Anime Debut: Naruto Shippūden Episode #197

1735.name: Gari
1735.desc: Gari (ガリ, Gari) was a famed Iwagakure shinobi and a member of the Explosion Corps along with Deidara. Gari is able to use Explosion Release, a kekkei genkai that allows him to combine two unknown chakra natures to utilise explosive chakra, as seen when he used Explosion Release: Landmine Fist to obliterate an Allied Shinobi ninja simply by punching him. Manga Debut: Chapter #515 Anime Debut: Naruto Shippuuden Episode #256 (Source: Narutopedia)

1735.name: Chuukichi
1735.desc: Chuukichi (中吉, Chūkichi) was a famed Kirigakure shinobi. He was a well noted shinobi during his lifetime, enough to justify his inclusion as a sensor and a backup within Akatsuki's Surprise Attack and Diversion Platoon, alongside Deidara, Sasori and Shin. Manga Debut: Chapter #516 Anime Debut: Naruto Shippūden Episode #261 (Source: Narutopedia)

1735.name: Ganryuu
1735.desc: Ganryuu (巌流, Ganryū) is a jōnin-level shinobi of Kirigakure. Anime Debut: Naruto Shippūden Episode #242 (Source: Narutopedia)

1735.name: Hoheto Hyuuga
1735.desc: Hoheto Hyuuga (日向ホヘト, Hyūga Hoheto) is a shinobi from Konohagakure's Hyūga clan. Manga Debut: Chapter #515 Anime Debut: Naruto Shippūden Episode #256 (Source: Narutopedia)

1735.name: Ittan
1735.desc: Ittan (イッタン, Ittan) is an Iwagakure shinobi. Manga Debut: Chapter #515 Anime Debut: Naruto Shippūden Episode #256 (source: Narutopedia)

1735.name: Kiri
1735.desc: Kiri (キリ, Kiri) is a medical-nin from Kirigakure. Manga Debut: Chapter #515 Anime Debut: Naruto Shippūden Episode #242 (source: Narutopedia)

1735.name: Kitsuchi
1735.desc: Kitsuchi (黄ツチ, Kitsuchi) is a shinobi from Iwagakure. Manga Debut: Chapter #515 Anime Debut: Naruto Shippūden Episode #256 (source: Narutopedia)

1735.name: Tango
1735.desc: __Manga Debut:__ Chapter #515 __Anime Debut:__ Naruto Shippūden Episode #261 Tango is a Kumogakure shinobi.

1735.name: Yukata
1735.desc: Yukata (ユカタ, Yukata) is a young kunoichi from Sunagakure. Anime Debut: Naruto Shippūden Episode #261 (source: Narutopedia)

1735.name: Zaji
1735.desc: Zaji (ザジ, Zaji) is a shinobi from Konohagakure. Manga Debut: Chapter #515 Anime Debut: Naruto Shippūden Episode #256 (source: Narutopedia)

1735.name: Pakura
1735.desc: Manga Debut: Chapter #516 Anime Debut: Naruto Shippūden Episode #261 Pakura was a famed Sunagakure kunoichi during her lifetime. She possesses a kekkei genkai known as Scorch Release. By combining two unknown chakra natures, she can create heat orbs that "mummify" her enemies, killing them seemingly by evaporating all the moisture in their bodies. Pakura displays this ability when using Scorch Release: Extremely Steaming Murder; combined with her incredible agility, she managed to kill many Allied Shinobi Forces members in a short amount of time. (Source: Narutopedia)

1735.name: Gatou
1735.desc: Gatou was a shipping magnate and founder of Gatō Company. He also was secretly a drug dealer as well as the owner of a smuggling business and attempted to take control of the Land of Waves. Manga Debut: Chapter #10 Anime Debut: Naruto Episode #6 (Source: Narutopedia)

1735.name: Iwa Kakure no Jounin
1735.desc: Appears in Naruto Shippuuden Episode #190. An Iwagakure kunoichi that led a battalion of Iwagakure ninja to attack Konohagakure's border after its invasion by Sunagakure and Otogakure. She is shown to be very cruel as she sacrificed many Iwagakure genin during her fight with Kosuke Maruboshi. She also has a liking of cutting her opponents into pieces. She has long brown-coloured hair which she ties in such a fashion as to form a ball on top of her head, using what appears to be a knitting-needle, while two large locks with darkened tips frame the remainder of her face. Her typical attire is similar to Ino Yamanaka's in that it consists of a short sleeveless dress, further adorned by the presence of numerous bandages that encircle various portions of her body, including her waist and thighs. ~!She was defeated when Kosuke used his Water Release: Water Dragon Bullet Technique to overpower her Earth Release: Earth and Stone Dragon.!~

1735.name: Suiren
1735.desc: Suiren (スイレン, Suiren) was a kunoichi of Kirigakure. Ten years prior to the formation of the Allied Shinobi Forces, Suiren was part of Ganryū's team that was tasked with retrieving a scroll along with a team from Iwagakure taken by Kumogakure shinobi. After retrieving the document, Suiren was excited for the prospects of peace that a mission like this would bring. She was however wrong as Iwagakure betrayed them. After Junsai was killed, Suiren sacrificed herself in order to protect Ganryū. This incident which come to be known as the Tragedy of Yosuga Pass marked the begining of hostility between Kirigakure and Iwagakure. Suiren was a kind and loving person who dearly held onto the ideals of peace. After their mission was seemingly completed she spoke openly of what an alliance like this between Kirigakure and Iwagakure would mean for the shinobi world. She was a very beautiful kunoichi with brown eyes and long blonde hair with two strands framing her face. She wore a pair of earrings along with the standard attire of the Kirigakure-nin complete with forehead protector and flak jacket, along with the jade-green bangle that was worn by her team. Source: http://naruto.wikia.com/wiki/Suiren

1735.name: Maki
1735.desc: Maki (マキ, Maki) is a kunoichi from Sunagakure. Manga Debut: Chapter #270 Anime: Naruto Shippūden Episode #12 (source: Narutopedia)

1735.name: Ensui Nara
1735.desc: Ensui Nara is a member of Konohagakure's Nara clan. Manga Debut: Chapter #523 Anime: Naruto Shippūden Episode #266 (source: Narutopedia)

1735.name: Santa Yamanaka
1735.desc: Santa Yamanaka is a shinobi from Konohagakure's Yamanaka clan. Manga Debut: Chapter #523 Anime: Naruto Shippūden Episode #266 (source: Narutopedia)

1735.name: Muu
1735.desc: Muu (無, Mū) was the Second Tsuchikage (二代目土影, Nidaime Tsuchikage; Literally meaning "Second Earth Shadow") of Iwagakure. Mū is capable of becoming perfectly camouflaged with the surrounding environment. His camouflage is so good that he has become renowned as the "Non-Person" (無人, Mujin), a title which he gained for seemingly having neither form nor chakra, while the technique was active. It is impossible to detect him by normal means and so, Mū considers anyone with the ability to sense his presence worthy of praise. Mū is one of the few people capable of using a kekkei tōta, an advanced and extremely powerful form of kekkei genkai. In particular, he possesses the Dust Release, which allows him to combine the fire, earth and wind natures to reduce his opponents to nothing more than mere dust, destroying them down to even a molecular level. Compared with fellow dust-user, Ōnoki, his power is implied to be on equal terms, as when the two initiated Dust Release: Detachment of the Primitive World Technique, the disastrous outcome although chaotic, demonstrated no evident victor in regards to strength. This may be due to the fact that Mū's power hadn't waned since his lifetime, a fact later affirmed by Ōnoki. Manga Debut: Chapter #515 Anime Debut: Naruto Shippūden Episode #256 (Source: Narutopedia)

1735.name: Kushimaru Kuriarare
1735.desc: Kushimaru Kuriarare was one of the former members of the Seven Ninja Swordsmen of the Mist and Kirigakure's ANBU. Kushimaru possessed the unique longsword Nuibari. With it, he was not only able to precisely pierce multiple enemies in quick succession, but also stitch them together utilising a substantial length of wire attached to the blade. This aptly demonstrated his proficient dexterity while handling this particular needle-like sword, as he was able to repeatedly catch it securely just mere moments after previously forcing the blade through his adversaries. Manga Debut: Chapter #522 Anime: Naruto Shippūden Episode #265 (Source: Narutopedia)

1735.name: Jinpachi Munashi
1735.desc: Jinpachi Munashi was a former member of the Seven Ninja Swordsmen of the Mist of Kirigakure. Utilising the unique "explosion" sword Shibuki, Jinpachi intuitively combined expert swordsmanship with destructive explosions, due to the significant quantity of explosive tags incorporated into the platform-like edge. Once these tags detonate an integrated scroll deposits another set along the same edge, allowing the sword to be used consecutively. However, the capabilities of this weapon do not come without risk, as the user themselves can potentially be caught in the resultant blast but Jinpachi's skill is such that this does not occur. Manga Debut: Chapter #522 Anime: Naruto Shippūden Episode #265 (Source: Narutopedia)

1735.name: Ameyuri Ringo
1735.desc: __Height:__ 143.5 cm (4'9") One of the former members of the Seven Ninja Swordsmen of the Mist. Ameyuri was very skilled at utilising the Kiba, twin swords imbued with lightning, which are claimed to be the sharpest sword that were made, having the ability to cut through anything, by apparently functioning in a similar manner to Lightning Release-based chakra flow which she wielded with great dexterity. In the anime, it was shown that she uses the Kiba in combination with agile spinning movements, sweeping through her targets while rotating around herself, hitting all enemies around her.

1735.name: Jinin Akebino
1735.desc: Jinin Akebino was one of the former members of the Seven Ninja Swordsmen of the Mist. He was evidently very skilled at utilising Kabutowari, a blunt sword that consists of a single sided axe and a hammer joined by a leather strap, which is said to be capable of breaking through any defence. This is achieved by first striking with the axe, before hammering it through the remainder of the obstruction with the hammer, resulting in the axe functioning much like a wedge. The 'swords' construction still allows the weapons to retain their individual capabilities and thanks to Jinin's expertise, both the axe and the hammer can be exploited to their fullest. Manga Debut: Chapter #522 Anime: Naruto Shippūden Episode #265 (Source: Narutopedia)

1735.name: Third Raikage
1735.desc: The Third Raikage (三代目雷影, Sandaime Raikage; Literally meaning "Third Lightning Shadow") was the leader of Kumogakure thirty years prior to the Fourth Shinobi World War. Manga Debut: Chapter #494 Anime: Naruto Shippūden Episode #244 (source: Narutopedia)

1735.name: Gengetsu Hoozuki
1735.desc: __Manga Debut:__ Chapter #525 __Anime:__ Naruto Shippūden Episode #267 The Second Mizukage was the leader of Kirigakure and a member of the Hoozuki clan.

1735.name: Kinkaku
1735.desc: Kinkaku (金角, Kinkaku) is one of Kumogakure's infamous Gold and Silver Brothers alongside his brother Ginkaku. Manga Debut: Chapter #525 Anime: Naruto Shippūden Episode #267 (source: Narutopedia)

1735.name: Ginkaku
1735.desc: Ginkaku (銀角, Ginkaku) is one of Kumogakure's infamous Gold and Silver Brothers alongside his brother Kinkaku. Manga Debut: Chapter #525 Anime: Naruto Shippūden Episode #267 (source: Narutopedia)

1735.name: Atsui
1735.desc: He is a shinobi from Kumogakure. In stark contrast to his sister Samui, Atsui has a rather hot-headed and spirited attitude, which is evident even in battle. He prefers attacking his enemies head on, leaving him entirely devoid of any support at times. He has a tendency of saying the word "hot" (あつい, atsui) and admits that he has created a substantial amount of "hot-shot" catchphrases. Like many other Kumogakure shinobi, Atsui is extremely proficient in kenjutsu, incorporating a long white katana as part of his main fighting style. When this blade is utilised in conjunction with his Fire Release nature transformation techniques, through the application of Chakra Flow, he is capable of incinerating a significant quantity of opponents in a single instant. The anime also showed that he is able to conjure flames with each swing of his sword.

1735.name: Land of Wind Daimyo
1735.desc: He is the current daimyō of the Land of Wind, replacing the former wind daimyō. During a meeting of the Five Great Shinobi Countries' daimyō he was the third daimyō out of the five, who consented to allow the Allied Shinobi Forces to officially form, being wary of "Madara Uchiha"'s position as the leader of Akatsuki.

1735.name: Land of Earth Daimyo
1735.desc: He appears to have an impatient attitude, as seen when he and the other daimyō awaited the response of the uncertain Water Daimyō. He prompted him to respond quickly due to the urgency of the impending war.

1735.name: Land of Frost Daimyo
1735.desc: He is an elderly man with short, pale purple hair that spikes up at the back, a bristling moustache and a long beard. He wears a hat of sorts which has the symbol of his village on it, similar to a forehead protector. He also squints and wears what appears to be a purple kimono.

1735.name: Land of Lightning Daimyo
1735.desc: He is the daimyō of the Land of Lightning. During a meeting of the Five Great Shinobi Countries' daimyō, he agreed to the creation of the Allied Shinobi Forces. In the anime, he was requested to convene a Daimyō Summit by the Fourth Raikage. Manga Debut: Chapter #488 Anime Debut: Naruto Shippūden Episode #217 (source: Narutopedia)

1735.name: Land of Water Daimyo
1735.desc: He is the daimyō of the Land of Water. During a meeting of the Five Great Shinobi Countries' daimyō he was cautious that the alliance would give shinobi too much power. This prompted the Earth Daimyō to suggest he didn't trust the ninja of his country. He eventually gave his consent to the formation of the alliance, albeit reluctantly. Manga Debut: Chapter #488 Anime Debut: Naruto Shippūden Episode #218 (source: Narutopedia)

1735.name: Okisuke
1735.desc: Okisuke (オキスケ, Okisuke) is a samurai from the Land of Iron and one of Mifune's right-hand-man alongside Urakaku. Manga Debut: Chapter #456 Anime Debut: Naruto Shippūden Episode #199 (source: Narutopedia)

1735.name: Kizashi Haruno
1735.desc: Kizashi Haruno (春野キザシ, Haruno Kizashi) is a shinobi of Konohagakure and the husband of Mebuki and father of Sakura Haruno. Anime Debut: Naruto Shippūden Episode #271 Movie Debut: Naruto: Shippuuden Movie 6 - Road to Ninja (source: Narutopedia)

1735.name: Mebuki Haruno
1735.desc: Mebuki Haruno (春野メブキ, Haruno Mebuki) is a kunoichi of Konohagakure and the wife of Kizashi and mother of Sakura Haruno. Anime Debut: Naruto Shippūden Episode #271 Movie Debut: Naruto: Shippuuden Movie 6 - Road to Ninja (source: Narutopedia)

1735.name: Condor
1735.desc: He is an average sized ostrich who wears three pink bows on his neck. a runaway pet that Team 7 was tasked with retrieving but later became a member of the Four Ninja Animal Warriors.

1735.name: Ran
1735.desc: Ran has a short crop of brown hair and blue eyes. She wore a midriff blouse and a skirt along with a customised midriff Kumogakure flak jacket. She also wore red wrist warmers, stockings and a pair of sandals with the forehead protector of the Allied Shinobi Forces.

1735.name: Fukai
1735.desc: A's cousin. He was a high-ranking Kumogakure shinobi as well as the predecessor of Killer B as the jinchuuriki of Gyuuki, the Eight-Tails. Manga Debut: Chapter #494 Anime Debut: Naruto Shippuuden Episode #244 (Source: Narutopedia)

1735.name: Chouji no Haha
1735.desc: She is a citizen of Konohagakure, the mother of Chouji Akimichi, and the wife of Chouza Akimichi. She is also a member of the Allied Mothers Force. Anime Debut: Naruto Shippuuden Episode #82 (Source: Narutopedia)

1735.name: Dodai
1735.desc: Dodai (ドダイ, Dodai) is a Kumogakure shinobi. Manga Debut: Chapter #541 Anime Debut: Naruto Shippuuden Episode #282 (Source: Narutopedia)

1735.name: Ino no Haha
1735.desc: She is a citizen of Konohagakure, the wife of Inoichi Yamanaka, and mother of Ino Yamanaka. She is also a member of the Allied Mothers Force. Anime Debut: Naruto Shippuuden Episode #281 (Source: Narutopedia)

1735.name: Urakaku
1735.desc: Urakaku (ウラカク, Urakaku) is a samurai from the Land of Iron and one of Mifune's right-hand-man alongside Okisuke. Manga Debut: Chapter #456 Anime Debut: Naruto Shippuuden Episode #199 (Source: Narutopedia)

1735.name: Watase
1735.desc: Watase (ワタセ, Watase) is a genin-level shinobi from Konohagakure. Manga Debut: Chapter #494 Anime Debut: Naruto Shippuuden Episode #244 (Source: Narutopedia)

1735.name: Gamahiro
1735.desc: Gamahiro is a giant toad that resides on Mount Myoboku. He sometimes called: "Hiro". When Gamahiro first appears in the anime, his skin is colored green and brown. This is updated to a light-blue-greenish color for the Invasion of Pain Arc, keeping up with the manga's coloration. Though he was first summoned in part I, he was not named until he was summoned again in part II. Though Gamahiro has spoken in the anime, he has yet to do so in the manga.

1735.name: Aoda
1735.desc: Species: Snake Classification: Summon Affiliation: Ryuuchi Cave Aoda is an inhabitant of the Ryuuchi Cave and the personal summon of Sasuke Uchiha. In stark contrast to Manda, a snake of similar size to it, Aoda seems to be very mild mannered and respectful to its summoner, as shown when it addresses Sasuke with the "-sama" suffix and dutifully follows all his orders without needing to be controlled. Aoda also asked Sasuke how he could be of service the instant he was summoned. He was also described as simple.

1735.name: Yota
1735.desc: Yota was born on a unknown date into a poor walking traveling unknown named clan who could manipulate weather, and use their skills to make a living. Five years before the start of the series, Yota died at a young age of natural causes due to his frailty yet weak body. But he was later on reincarnated by Orochimaru as a test subject for or in his research on Impure World Reincarnation.

1735.name: Kaguya Ootsutsuki
1735.desc: __Race:__ Celestial Being Kaguya Ootsutsuki was the matriarch of an Ootsutsuki clan branch family and mother of Hagoromo and Hamura. Long before the founding of the hidden villages, during an era of endless war, Kaguya consumed the fruit of the God Tree and became the first wielder of chakra on Earth, before later merging with the tree to become the Ten-Tails.

1735.name: Duy Might
1735.desc: __Ninja Rank:__ Genin Guy's father.

1735.name: Hamura Ootsutsuki
1735.desc: Hamura Ootsutsuki is the son of Princess Kaguya‎‎ Ootsutsuki, the fraternal twin brother of Hagoromo; both of whom were the first people born with the ability to wield chakra. Hamura was the ancestor of the Hyuuga clan and the founder of the shinobi of the Moon.

1735.name: Tonton
1735.desc: Tonton is Tsunade's ninja pig, often kept in the care of Shizune. She is always seen wearing a pearl collar and a dark red jacket. Tonton's sense of smell is noted to be even finer than that of a ninja dog. She has reportedly smelled debt collectors coming and saved Tsunade from them countless time. She was also able to direct Shizune, Jiraiya, and Naruto to Tsunade's location after she was locked in battle. Also, despite her small size, she is strong enough to carry several crates at least as large as her. In the anime, Tonton once performed a Transformation Technique to appear as Tsunade. However, while doing so, she was still unable to speak.

1735.name: Indra Ootsutsuki
1735.desc: Indra Ootsutsuki‎ was the first born son of Hagoromo Ootsutsuki. He was initially thought to be the most suitable successor of his father's teachings, however, it was his younger brother Asura that ended up inheriting this mantle — a decision that would lead the two brothers to fight against each other. Indra is also credited with being the creator of ninjutsu, and the progenitor of the Uchiha clan.

1735.name: Izumi Uchiha
1735.desc: Izumi Uchiha was a kunoichi from Konohagakure and a member of the Uchiha Clan. She was a friend of Itachi Uchiha since their childhood and deeply cared about him, being so close to him as to be seen as his lover.

1735.name: Makibi
1735.desc: Makibi is the president of the Makibi Company and a patron at the Coliseum. He was spectating the fight between Raimei—the shinobi he contracted—and Suzuran when [Sasuke](https://anilist.co/character/13), [Orochimaru](https://anilist.co/character/2455), Chino and Nowaki arrived. Upon Raimei's victory, Makibi was seen very pleased with the outcome of the fight. ~!During Sasuke and Futsu's fight, he fell victim to Chino's Ketsuryūgan, but was saved by Sasuke's Sharingan before he exploded. He was eventually taken into custody when Kumogakure and Sasuke raided the Coliseum.!~

1735.name: Himeyuri
1735.desc: Himeyuri is the president of the Himeyuri Company and a patron at the Coliseum. She was spectating the fight between Suzuran—the shinobi she contracted—and Raimei when [Sasuke](https://anilist.co/character/13), [Orochimaru](https://anilist.co/character/2455), Chino and Nowaki arrived. Upon Suzuran's defeat, Himeyuri began aggressively scolding him. ~!During Sasuke and Futsu's fight, she fell victim to Chino's Ketsuryūgan, causing her to explode and die.!~

1735.name: Nonou Yakushi
1735.desc: An ex member of Konoha's Anbu sub-division Root. She was an expert in the area of intelligence gathering, but left the organisation to run Konoha's orphanage instead.

1735.name: Ashura Ootsutsuki
1735.desc: Ashura Ootsutsuki was the youngest son of Hagoromo Ootsutsuki and heir to his teachings. He is also the ancestor of the Senju clan, as well as the Uzumaki clan.

1735.name: Chino
1735.desc: Chino is a kunoichi from the Chinoike clan. She was a member of the Lightning Group.

1735.name: Nowaki
1735.desc: Nowaki was once the leader of the Lightning Group. At the time, he went by the name Fuushin.

1735.name: En Oyashiro
1735.desc: En Oyashiro is a shinobi and arms dealer from the Chinoike clan. He would occasionally attend the Coliseum as a patron in order to collect kekkei genkai.

1735.name: Ashina Uzumaki
1735.desc: Ashina Uzumaki was the leader of the Uzumaki clan during the founding of Konohagakure. He was an elderly man that was still able to fight battles even during his 60s. He was very strong in Fuinjustu and kenjutsu.

21234.name: Sonohokasei
21234.desc: This character page is set to represent and list credits for voice roles without a specific character name/role attributed. Character roles named specifically should be added separately.

21234.name: Satoru Fujinuma
21234.desc: A struggling manga author with a supernatural power that enables, or rather, forces him to prevent deaths and catastrophes that happen near him by sending him back in time when an accident occurs, repeating the scene until the accident is prevented. ~!He falls into a coma for 15 years after he was nearly murdered by Yashiro!~

21234.name: Kayo Hinazuki
21234.desc: A 10-year-old girl and the first victim of the serial killer/kidnapper. She went missing on the 2nd of March 1988. Her body was found a few days later once the snow had thawed.

21234.name: Sachiko Fujinuma
21234.desc: Sachiko is Satoru's mother and former news announcer. She possesses a sharp eye and is quick to observe any irregularities. She knows about the cold cases of serial kidnapping in her town but decided to keep quiet and ignore it due to her child's growth and safety.

21234.name: Airi Katagiri
21234.desc: Airi Katagiri is a high school student and Satoru's co-worker at Oasi Pizza. She becomes involved in Satoru's life when he manages to prevent life-threatening incidents from occurring.

21234.name: Kazu
21234.desc: Kazu is one of Satoru's primary school classmates.

21234.name: Kenya Kobayashi
21234.desc: Kenya is one of Satoru's primary school classmates. He has a strong sense of justice and has a sharp eye for abnormalities. ~!He becomes a lawyer in the future.!~

21234.name: Osamu
21234.desc: Osamu is one of Satoru's primary school classmates.

21234.name: Jun Shiratori
21234.desc: Jun Shiratori was a food delivery worker in Satoru's hometown and often approached lone students around his house. He was nicknamed "Yuuki" because he was always encouraging the children to be courageous. He was originally framed as the killer of the three kidnapped students in the town and sentenced to death.

21234.name: Hiromi Sugita
