21234.desc: Hiromi is one of Satoru's primary school classmates. ~!He was one of the original victims in the serial kidnapping case.!~

21234.name: Gaku Yashiro
21234.desc: Gaku is Satoru's homeroom teacher during primary school. ~!In the original timeline, Yashiro successfully murdered two children at Mikoto Elementary School—Kayo Hinazuki and Hiromi Sugita—as well as another student from Izumi Primary named Aya Nakanishi. After being a school teacher, he inherited his father-in-law's constituency and became a council member in his place. During his time as a council member, he is seen by Sachiko Fujinuma during his attempt to abduct another child. After Sachiko remembers his identity, she is immediately murdered and her son, Satoru, is framed for the murder.!~ ~! In the third Revival, while Satoru is unaware of Yashiro's true identity as the murderer, he completely renders Yashiro's plans useless. Yashiro attempts to murder Satoru by drowning him in a car in which he is locked in tight by a seatbelt. Satoru somehow survives, and Yashiro is left entertained about Satoru's persistence. Satoru goes into a coma for 15 years, and Yashiro watches over him until he wakes up again. Upon Satoru's awakening, Yashiro again tries to frame Satoru for murder, only to be caught by a plan formulated by Satoru.!~

21234.name: Misato
21234.desc: Misato is one of [Satoru](https://anilist.co/character/89275/Satoru-Fujinuma)’s primary school classmates. She holds a grudge against [Kayo](https://anilist.co/character/89276/Kayo-Hinazuki).

100166.name: Katsuki Bakugou
100166.desc: __Height:__ 172 cm (5'7") __Quirk:__ Explosion Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Katsuki is a crude, arrogant, short-tempered, and aggressive person, especially at the beginning of the series. Due to the constant praise of his abilities and powerful Quirk, Katsuki has developed a superiority complex, and because of that, he desires to be the first and best at everything. He loves to win above all else and cannot stand it when he doesn't, leading him to lose his already short temper if he achieves anything but a complete victory. Katsuki is not only very athletic and talented at fighting, but also very intelligent and extremely perceptive, capable of strategic planning and improvisation. Additionally, his grades are among the highest of his class. Katsuki also possesses surprising talent in other areas, such as cooking and music, even though he doesn't show a particular interest in them. Overall, Katsuki is considered a natural-born genius with the potential to be one of the best Pro Heroes. Katsuki's Quirk "Explosion" allows him to secrete nitroglycerin-like sweat from the palms of his hands and ignite it on command, allowing him to create strong explosions. The more Katsuki sweats, the stronger his explosions become. Not only can Katsuki use the explosions for attacking, he can also use them to propel himself and navigate through the air at high speeds, allowing him to fly at his opponents without giving them time to react, as well as evade incoming attacks, even whi

100166.name: Izuku Midoriya
100166.desc: __Height:__ 166 cm (5'5¼") __Quirk:__ One For All Student in Class 1-A at U.A High School. Although he was born without a Quirk, Izuku's innate heroism and strong sense of justice manages to catch the attention of the legendary hero [All Might](https://anilist.co/character/89224). Izuku has since become All Might's closest pupil. Izuku is a very timid, reserved, and polite boy. Although initially portrayed as insecure, tearful, and vulnerable, Izuku gradually matures into a more confident and braver person. His infectious leadership skills, combined with his passion and strategic abilities, have turned Izuku into a central figure of Class 1-A. He is caring and emotional, never hesitating to help or rescue someone in danger, even if he knows that he might not be strong or otherwise qualified enough to do it. Izuku is extremely (and sometimes scarily) enthusiastic about topics related to heroes. His dream drives him to write down notes about everything he learns about heroes' Quirks and fighting capabilities. Thanks to this practice, Izuku has developed a great analytical mind and can form complex battle plans in a few seconds, factoring in the best ways he can utilize the Quirks of allies and enemies alike for his own advantage. Izuku's Quirk "One For All" was transferred to him from All Might. His Quirk allows him to stockpile an enormous amount of raw power, allowing him to significantly enhance all of his physical abilities to various boundless levels. This results in unbel

100166.name: Shouto Todoroki
100166.desc: __Height:__ 176 cm (5'9") __Affiliation:__ U.A. High School __Quirk:__ Half-Cold Half-Hot Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School, where he got in through official recommendations. He is the youngest son of the top hero [Endeavor](https://anilist.co/character/126158). Shouto initially has a cold, aloof personality, which stemmed from his complicated family life. Focused and unemotional, Shouto preferred to keep things to himself instead of hanging out with others. After the events of the U.A. Sports Festival, however, he notably became more sociable and kinder than ever before. He even gained a sense of humor and would occasionally smile, although still retaining some fragments of his previous distant attitude and nonchalant demeanor. While usually quiet and reserved, Shouto initially possessed a moderate level of arrogance, which, combined with his solitary tendencies, sometimes made him take the initiative without considering the opinions of others. Shouto's Quirk Half-Cold Half-Hot gives him the ability to generate ice from the right side of his body, and flames from his left side. Due to years of rejecting his father, Shouto has developed a habit of favoring ice, even when fire would be a better option. This grudge also caused him to have difficulty controlling his flames. If he overuses one element without utilizing the other, then his own body temperature will suffer.

100166.name: Ochako Uraraka
100166.desc: __Height:__ 156 cm (5'1") __Quirk:__ Zero Gravity Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School Ochako is an outgoing, lively person who thinks about everything positively, though she is objective enough to see flaws and virtues. She gets excited over little things very easily. Ochaco has been described by other students as "the most laidback girl" among her class, being very bubbly and kind of an airhead at times. She is often incredibly blunt without being aware of it. She is on good terms with everyone and is particularly close friends with several class members, including [Izuku](https://anilist.co/character/89028/Midoriya-Izuku), [Tenya Ida](https://anilist.co/character/89222/Iida-Tenya), and [Tsuyu](https://anilist.co/character/89223/Asui-Tsuyu). Ochaco's Quirk gives her the power to manipulate gravity upon touching solid things with the pads on her fingertips. The targets lose their gravitational pull, effectively making them weightless. She is able to activate or cancel her Quirk's effects by closing her fingers together, and is shown to be careful with her hands in order to avoid accidental quirk activation.

100166.name: Tenya Iida
100166.desc: __Height:__ 179 cm (5'10") __Quirk:__ Engine Class representative of Class 1-A at U.A. High School Tenya may look severe, but he's actually just a very serious person, who takes everything, even the most insignificant thing, seriously. A testament to his generally hyperactive and intense behavior, Tenya often exhibits plenty of peculiar tics, such as moving his arms around in strange chopping patterns or sometimes twitching his body uncontrollably. Tenya is very humble, willing to admit to his mistakes, apologize for rude behavior, and improve in areas he lacks. Being part of the highly-esteemed Ida Family of Heroes, Tenya is proud of his lineage and works hard to meet his expectations. He greatly admires his older brother, Tensei (also known as the Turbo Hero: Ingenium), and aspires to become a similar hero. Tenya's Quirk Engine gives him car-like engines in each of his calves, giving him incredible running speed and extreme kicking power. Tenya needs to fuel his engines by drinking orange juice. Tenya's engines have multiple gears; it is currently unknown how many, but it has been implied that there are more than three.

100166.name: Tsuyu Asui
100166.desc: __Affiliation:__ U.A. High School __Quirk:__ Frog Tsuyu is a very straight-forward girl that always says what's on her mind and what she thinks about others. She prefers to be called by her first name.

100166.name: Toshinori Yagi
100166.desc: __Height:__ 220 cm (7'2") __Quirk:__ One for All All Might is the No. 1 Hero and the "Symbol of Peace." In his hero form, All Might is a very tall and over-muscular man whose design resembles the american hero comics. His hair spikes on top of his head and his whole body has more shadows than a normal human being. However, in his true form, he is an overly-skinny man who spits a lot of blood out of his mouth and his clothes appear loose.

100166.name: Shouta Aizawa
100166.desc: __Height: __183 cm (6') __Occupation:__ Pro Hero, Teacher __Affiliation:__ U.A. High School __Quirk:__ Erasure Aizawa's hero name, Eraserhead, was coined by [Present Mic](https://anilist.co/character/127425) when they were younger. Using the binding cloth, Aizawa has a unique fighting style that allows him to immobilize his enemies. He is known to expel students that don't meet his standards, however it should be noted that he did not expel anyone from Class 1-A. Aizawa is extremely vocal, able to voice his opinions very easily. Although seeming emotionless and reserved, he has a soft spot for his students and genuinely cares for them.

100166.name: Tomura Shigaraki
100166.desc: __Height:__ 175 cm (5'9) __Quirk:__ Decay Leader of the League of Villains and protégé of [All For One](https://anilist.co/character/125956/All-For-One). He was raised by his master, All For One, with the goal of killing [All Might](https://anilist.co/character/89224/Yagi-Toshinori), and ultimately destroying the society he represents. Tomura is a very twisted, malevolent, and maliciously warped young man, who is considered to be the polar opposite of [Izuku Midoriya](https://anilist.co/character/89028/Midoriya-Izuku). He doesn't care for his or almost anyone else's life, having no qualms about performing evil deeds like murdering innocent people. Tomura was initially perceived to be a "man-child": arrogant, selfish, dependent, and demanding, becoming angry if things didn't go his way and likening reality to some sort of video game. Unlike his mentor, Tomura lacked subtlety, preferring to eliminate problems through force. Much like a child, Tomura seemed unable to cope with his own feelings, instead lashing out and abusing both others or himself, tearing at his own neck when he becomes frustrated. Initially, Tomura seemingly caused destruction just for the sake of it and felt directionless about the League's path forward after [Stain](https://anilist.co/character/126067/Akaguro-Chizome)'s arrest. It would take a fateful meeting with Izuku in a mall for him to develop an epiphany and become aware of his true convictions: to crumble hero society through All Might's death. Tomur

100166.name: Momo Yaoyorozu
100166.desc: __Height:__ 173 cm (5'8") __Quirk:__ Creation Vice class representative of Class 1-A at U.A. High School. She was admitted to the school through official recommendations. Momo is a very prudent, dedicated person who acts as a natural leader. She is generally level-headed and calm in dangerous situations, but she isn't above falling into a panic. Momo can be blunt with her comments about people's mistakes and miscalculations, tending to be very direct and wishing to help her peers improve enough to become great heroes. Momo's Quirk gives her the ability to create any non-living material/object from her exposed skin by transforming the molecular structure of her fat cells. In order to create something, she needs to understand the molecular structure of which the material/object is made.

100166.name: Hitoshi Shinsou
100166.desc: __Height:__ 177 cm (5'9½") __Quirk:__ Brainwashing Student at U.A. High School, attending Class 1-C of the Department of General Education. Hitoshi is a stoic and straightforward person with an innate ability to spark conversation with anyone despite holding a reserved and quiet attitude most of the time. He is shown to be rather clever, knowing just the right words to manipulate others into replying to his comments, allowing him to activate his Quirk. He does not mind doing something underhanded to claim victory in a fight. Due to having his Brainwashing Quirk perceived as evil throughout his life, Hitoshi has been somewhat feared by those aware of his power and has been discriminated against solely because of the Quirk he was born with. This persecution led him to become resentful of those who had Quirks more associated with hero work. Regardless of his drawbacks, however, Hitoshi desires to become a Pro Hero more than anything. Hitoshi's Quirk Brainwashing allows him to put someone in a state where they are forced to obey whatever he commands. He can only activate this power when his target verbally responds to something he says. Brainwashing must be intentionally activated and will not take effect if Hitoshi doesn't want it to. Using a megaphone or anything that makes his voice artificial will not allow his Quirk to activate, as the said devices would transform his voice into an electronic signal.

100166.name: Eijirou Kirishima
100166.desc: __Height:__ 170 cm (5'7") __Quirk:__ Hardening Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Eijiro is a boisterous and outgoing guy with a fondness for manliness, often using the terms "manly" and "unmanly" to describe things and people he does or doesn't like, respectively. Eijiro is very honest and kind-hearted, having a straightforward way of thinking and following a specific code of chivalry that motivates him to live without regret. He is determined and selfless, bravely putting the safety of others before himself. He is also a big fan of Crimson Riot, a retro hero from whom he takes inspiration, including personal values and his hero name. Although Eijiro may not be as hot-blooded and competitive as [Katsuki Bakugou](https://anilist.co/character/88892), he does not shy away from comparing himself to him, with [Izuku](https://anilist.co/character/89028) stating that the two have managed to develop a relationship between equals. As a result, Eijiro is notably one of the few people that Katsuki holds in higher esteem. Eijiro's Quirk gives him the power to harden and sharpen any or all parts of his body, causing his flesh to become jagged and rock-like. There is a limit to how much damage his hardened body can withstand, which causes the Hardening itself to slowly dissipate, and Eijiro to lose stamina from struggling to keep his Quirk active.

100166.name: Minoru Mineta
100166.desc: __Height:__ 108 cm (3' 6½") __Quirk:__ Pop Off __Affiliation:__ U.A. High School __Fighting Style:__ Medium Ranged Support Minoru Mineta, also known as the Fresh-Picked Hero: Grape Juice, is a student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School, training to become a Pro Hero.

100166.name: Mina Ashido
100166.desc: __Height:__ 159 cm (5'3") __Quirk:__ Acid Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Mina is a cheerful and easygoing girl who usually displays a smile. Highly social and excitable, she loves to hang out with her friends and is shown to become very upset when denied an opportunity to be at a gathering. She possesses a strong fashion sense and likes to go shopping. Due to her athleticism and energy, Mina enjoys and is very skilled at dancing. Mina is extremely courageous and is viewed as an ideal personality for hero work. Mina's Quirk Acid allows her to produce a corrosive liquid from her body. She can control the solubility and viscosity of this corrosive liquid. There is a limit to how long she can produce the corrosive liquid until her skin gradually loses its natural resistance to it. Overusing her Quirk or pushing it too far can also be fatal, as it dehydrates her body very fast. Mina can use her acid offensively, but has shown utility with it as well, such as melting handholds for herself to climb with. She is also known to secrete a non-corrosive version of the acid from her feet in order to slide around.

100166.name: Mei Hatsume
100166.desc: __Height:__ 157 cm (5'2") __Quirk:__ Zoom Mei is a smart, off-setting, and assertive girl, often making those around her uncomfortable. She loves creating gadgets, which she refers to as her "super cute babies". Mei has a habit of "going straight to the point" and is very shameless and opportunistic when it comes to advertising her inventions. While talking to people, she has a habit of getting awkwardly close to them, which usually causes them to back away from her but she still moves up to them.

100166.name: Denki Kaminari
100166.desc: __Height:__ 168 cm (5'6") __Quirk:__ Electrification Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Denki is a friendly, social, and energetic boy who enjoys hanging out with others. He is rather casual when interacting with other people, including the generally unfriendly [Katsuki Bakugou](https://anilist.co/character/88892/Bakugou-Katsuki). Denki's Quirk Electrification allows him to store and discharge electricity. While he can also discharge this energy over a distance, Denki has little to no control over it, meaning it will go everywhere indiscriminately. Denki is also able to absorb and neutralize electricity and other lightning-based Quirks. Whenever Denki exceeds his wattage limit, he loses his ability to discharge energy, with his entire personality changing into that of a giggling idiot for a certain period until he reverts to normal. In this state, he is always giving thumbs-ups as a way to let others know that he is okay.

100166.name: Jin Bubaigawara
100166.desc: __Height:__ 178 cm (5'10") __Quirk:__ Double Villain affiliated with the League of Villains, and part of its Vanguard Action Squad. Jin has an incredibly unique personality: explosive, and lively with a very comedic demeanor. He enjoys assuming dramatic poses and eccentric facial expressions. Jin constantly contradicts himself, making a statement in one voice and immediately saying the opposite in another. This juxtaposition iss part of a mental instability that Jin embraces as a villain. He believes understanding your own identity is the most essential aspect in life, an understanding he lost during the 9-day conflict with his own clones that left him unsure whether he was the original or not. Now, if his mask is removed, he panics and threatens to "split" until he put his mask back on to become "whole". Jin's Quirk allows him to create an exact duplicate of anything, living or not. To duplicate something, he needs to know its precise measurements and characteristics. The clones he makes do not disappear; instead, they disintegrate into a mud-like substance after taking a certain amount of damage. The duplicates are less durable than the original, and the second duplicate is even less durable than the first. When Jin creates duplicates of a person, he has no control over the clones because they have their own autonomy, personalities, and abilities that are utterly identical to the original.

100166.name: Hanta Sero
100166.desc: __Height:__ 177 cm (5' 9¾") __Quirk:__ Tape Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Hanta is amicable and has proven to be one of the more sociable members of Class 1-A. He can sometimes be loud and showy, often trying to impress his peers with his Quirk. He is often the only person to call his classmates out when they act crazy. He is pretty humorous and usually makes jokes with his classmates. However, when push comes to shove, Hanta is a brave hero-in-training who wishes to prosper on his own while helping others do the same. Hanta's Quirk is that he has tape dispenser-like organs in his elbows, from which he can shoot long cellophane tape-like strips; he can also retract them. They appear to be somewhat sturdier than regular tape. Overuse of his Quirk will cause his skin to dry out. He can use his tape to wrap people, swing long distances, and create traps, among other applications.

100166.name: Mashirao Ojiro
100166.desc: __Height:__ 169 cm (5'6") __Quirk:__ Tail Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Mashirao has a very calm and noble attitude and a profound sense of dignity, which prevents him from accepting results he doesn't feel he earned with his own abilities. He is also described as a hard worker. Along with a strong sense of dignity, Mashirao can be described as sheepish and bashful, not very often enjoying the spotlight and being easily embarrassed. A recurring joke is that others view Mashirao as "plain," which profoundly upsets him. Mashirao's Quirk is that he has a long, powerful, sturdy tail. His tail effectively functions as a third arm that he can use to grab things. Furthermore, it's attack power is strong enough to break objects made of metal, he can wrap it around enemies, and it can support Mashirao's body weight. Mashirao is incredibly adept at using his tail, combining it with his knowledge of martial arts to engage enemies in close-range combat, performing fast and acrobatic moves. His tail can also increase his speed and mobility by whipping it down against the ground to use it like a springboard. (Source: My Hero Academia Wiki)

100166.name: Kyouka Jirou
100166.desc: __Height:__ 154 cm (5'1") __Quirk:__ Earphone Jack __Affiliation:__ U.A. High School __Fighting Style:__ Medium Ranged + Support Combat Kyoka is a petite, fair-skinned girl with a slender build. She has triangular, lazy-looking onyx eyes with notably long lower eyelashes, and rather small eyebrows. Kyoka has a pragmatic, unenthusiastic and teasing personality that is mostly shown to those she finds irritating. Kyoka is not always like this though, as she does enjoy socializing with others, in which case she is usually nice and friendly. Kyoka's Quirk (Earphone Jack) allows her to plug the jacks that hang from her earlobes into all sorts of things and channel the sound of her heartbeat into them; causing havoc inside the plugged objects. It's also used to catch sounds and vibrations from her surroundings.

100166.name: Fumikage Tokoyami
100166.desc: __Height:__ 158 cm __Quirk:__ Dark Shadow Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Fumikage is reserved, serious, and focused, albeit noble and valiant. Though not talkative, Fumikage will directly ignore questions or requests that seem in some way pointless. During combat, Fumikage is known to be fierce and dependable, with his strength and capabilities rarely being questioned. Fumikage is fond of darkness and other related concepts, considering himself a "creature of the dark" and employing archaic-sounding speeches that paint him slightly creepy or dramatic. Fumikage's Quirk "Dark Shadow" allows him to manifest a sentient shadow monster from his body that he can materialize and contract freely. Dark Shadow's energy is limited and can be drained by bright light. Dark Shadow retracts into Fumikage's body when it runs out of energy. The shadow entity's personality, strength, defense, and control depend on the lack of light. In bright light, Dark Shadow is weaker and smaller but still has considerable strength and defense and is easier to control, but in total darkness, Dark Shadow's size and parameters are drastically enhanced. It is powerful enough to rip out and cut down multiple full-grown trees easily. However, Dark Shadow is more difficult to control in the dark, causing it to rampage based on its own free will.

100166.name: Mezou Shouji
100166.desc: __Height:__ 187 cm (6'2") __Quirk:__ Dupli-Arms Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Shouji is friendly and gentle, and he will work nicely with anyone. He is not the type to hold grudges, showing no ill will towards those that harm him unwillingly. Shouji is entirely selfless and willing to risk his life for anyone. He can be empathetic and understanding, but still shows a sense of maturity and responsibility that prevents him from acting under emotional impulses. He is very protective of his classmates, especially if they are hurt or injured. He is also quite thick-skinned, as he said he is used to being feared due to his appearance. Shouji's Quirk grants him a set of tentacles alongside his arms. He can transform the tips of these tentacles to replicate other parts of his body (ex: mouth, ears, eyes). The duplicated body parts are more efficient than the originals; as a result, Mezo is able to hear better, see-through more angles at a time, and they grant him much higher degrees of strength. He uses these arms to talk most of the time through duplicate mouths, rather than his actual mouth.

100166.name: Tooru Hagakure
100166.desc: __Height:__ 152 cm (5'0") __Quirk:__ Invisibility Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Tooru is a bubbly, cheery, and easygoing girl who does most things with an upbeat attitude. She is very socially eager and likes shopping, and her room suggests that she likes plushies and other cute things. Tooru's Quirk is that her body is completely invisible. In addition to the stealth capabilities granted to her by her invisible body, Tooru can refract light that passes through her, allowing her to intensify the light into a blinding flash. She has further refined this application of her Quirk, achieving the ability to manipulate and redirect light-based attacks, such as [Yuuga Aoyama](https://anilist.co/character/127042/Aoyama-Yuuga)'s Navel Laser.

100166.name: Kouji Kouda
100166.desc: __Height:__ 186 cm (6'1") __Quirk:__ Anivoice Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Contrary to his strong and powerful appearance, Kouji is very timid and quiet. He rarely speaks and prefers using sign language to communicate with his classmates. He hates violence due to his kind-hearted nature. Kouji appears to greatly enjoy the company of animals, as his Quirk allows him to interact with animals in ways others cannot. He owns a small rabbit as a pet. Kouji's Quirk "Anivoice (生き物ボイス, Ikimono Voice)" gives him the ability to command any creature in the animal kingdom by speaking to them. Whatever command he gives, the animal will carry it out. However, he cannot exert control if they cannot hear his command. The target must also be a real animal and not merely animal-like. Kouji can also exchange information with the animals to find the locations of various people and potential enemies faster. Kouji has been shown to use the Quirk effectively with flocks of birds to create a smokescreen of animals and to attack an opponent, along with his use of insects to distract and attack his opponents. He has now also overcome his fear of bugs, so he often uses bugs to swarm opponents with numbers.

100166.name: Rikidou Satou
100166.desc: __Height:__ 185 cm (6'1") __Quirk:__ Sugar Rush Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Rikidou is interested in sweets and baking, a valuable skill due to his Quirk. He is surprisingly talented at making sweets. Rikidou's Quirk Sugar Rush allows him to increase his strength five-fold for three minutes. To activate his Quirk, he needs to consume 10 grams of sugar. When converting sugar into strength, his cognitive functions gradually drop, making him sleepy afterward. For every additional 10 grams of sugar he ingests, he extends the time of increased strength by another three minutes.

100166.name: Yuu Takeyama
100166.desc: __Height:__ 162 cm (5'4") (Normal form); 2062cm (67'8") (Transformed) __Quirk:__ Gigantification __Occupation:__ Pro Hero Pro Hero. Her Quirk allows her to grow to a gigantic size. She cannot variate between her base-height and the gigantified height achieved via her Quirk, making her only able to be either her normal height of 162cm (5 feet 4 inches) or her enlarged height of 2,062cm (67 feet 8 inches) tall.

100166.name: Sirius
100166.desc: Sirius is a pro hero and sidekick of Selkie.

100166.name: Mirio Togata
100166.desc: __Height:__ 181 cm (5'11") __Occupation:__ Student __Affiliation:__ U.A. High School __Quirk:__ Permeation He is third-year student at U.A. High School and is part of The Big 3 _(the strongest three hero students in all of Japan)_. Before [Izuku Midoriya](https://anilist.co/character/89028/Midoriya-Izuku), Mirio was the top candidate for [All Might](https://anilist.co/character/89224/Yagi-Toshinori)'s successor and inheritor of One For All. His Quirk, Permeation, gives him the ability to become intangible, letting him pass through any tangible matter; he can phase through walls and/or the ground, as well as let enemy attacks pass through him harmlessly.

100166.name: Neito Monoma
100166.desc: __Height:__ 170cm __Quirk:__ Copy Student in Class 1-B at U.A. High School. Neito has a rather complex personality since it differs depending on who he is addressing; he is particularly mocking, loud, and sarcastic with Class 1-A, but outside of these interactions, he is a calm, kind, and intelligent person. He envies Class 1-A with a passion over how they became the center of attention among U.A.'s first years because of the U.S.J. Incident. Truthfully, he only wants his class to stand out as they do, and he vents this feeling by throwing countless taunts towards his rivals, gloating over Class 1-B's successes and disparaging 1-A for their failures. Neito's Quirk is Copy, which allows him to duplicate and use another person's Quirk after coming into physical contact with the user. He can hold four Quirks simultaneously and maintain copied powers for ten minutes. After the time limit runs out, he loses the copied Quirk until he once again touches the original user.

100166.name: Himiko Toga
100166.desc: __Height:__ 157 cm __Quirk:__ Transform Himiko Toga is a villain affiliated with the League of Villains and part of its Vanguard Action Squad. She originally joined the group as a means to get closer to [Stain](https://anilist.co/character/126067). Himiko is a very cheerful girl, to the point of smiling even after having presumably killed someone, displaying apparent sadistic tendencies. She has a very twisted perception of love and friendship Himiko's Quirk Transform grants her the ability to transform into a physical lookalike of another individual, as well as copy their voice. She can only transform into people whose blood she has ingested. The more blood she drinks, the longer she has access to that person's form. For example, 1 cup of blood allows her to transform for a total of 18 hours. She can even switch between the appearances of multiple people if she drinks the blood of more than one person.

100166.name: Tamaki Amajiki
100166.desc: __Height:__ 177 cm (5'10") __Quirk:__ Manifest Third-year student in Class 3-A at U.A. High School and part of The Big 3 (the strongest three hero students in all of Japan). Tamaki is extremely shy, aloof, depressed, "intimidating", and introverted, especially around big audiences. He gets nervous very easily when talking to other people. If his anxiety gets the best of him, Tamaki will often face away and lean into a wall to hide his face from others. While his physical abilities and Quirk are outstanding, Tamaki is socially awkward and lacks confidence in his powers. Despite his timid heart, Tamaki can show flashes of bravery. Even though he's always been a shy and reserved boy, Tamaki was able to hone his skills and climb the ranks into one of U.A.'s Big 3. [Mirio Togata](https://anilist.co/character/123527/Togata-Mirio) is a big inspiration for Tamaki. Tamaki's Quirk Manifest grants him the ability to manifest the physical characteristics of anything he's eaten; for example, if he eats takoyaki, he can transform his fingers into octopus tentacles. Additionally, anything Tamaki manifests is significantly stronger than normal. The more of a substance Tamaki eats, the stronger his manifestation will be. He can only manifest the traits of substances still in his system and loses access to those traits once the substance is fully digested. He must resupply his Quirk daily and decide what foods to eat beforehand.

100166.name: Melissa Shield
100166.desc: Melissa is a Quirkless girl and the daughter of Scientist [David Shield](https://anilist.co/character/125952/).

100166.name: All For One
100166.original: オール・フォー・ワン
100166.desc: __Quirk:__ All For One __Occupation:__ Villain __Fighting Style:__ Close Range and Long Range All For One is the true leader and benefactor of the League of Villains. Once Japan's most powerful villain and All Might's arch-nemesis, his true motives are unclear and his true identity unknown. His current goal is to raise Shigaraki to become his eventual successor.

100166.name: Shuuichi Iguchi
100166.desc: __Height:__ 174 cm __Occupation:__ Villain __Affiliation:__ League of Villains (formerly), Paranormal Liberation Front (Lieutenant of Brown Regiment) __Quirk:__ Gecko Shuuichi is a villain affiliated with the League of Villains and part of its Vanguard Action Squad. He is completely obsessed with the ways of [Stain](https://anilist.co/character/126067) to the point where he copies his clothing and weaponry style, aiming to follow the same ideals as him and make his dreams come true.

100166.name: Itsuka Kendou
100166.desc: __Height:__ 166 cm (5'5") __Quirk:__ Big Fist Class representative of Class 1-B at U.A. High School, Itsuka is a spirited girl who is thoughtful of others. She does not hesitate to criticize even her classmates if she feels what they are doing is not correct. Due to Itsuka's cheerful personality, she can bring all of Class 1-B together, thus making her the "big sister" of Class 1-B. Itsuka's Quirk Big Fist grants her the ability to enlarge both of her hands to a gigantic size. With the increased size comes enhanced striking power and gripping capabilities.

100166.name: Chizome Akaguro
100166.desc: __Height:__ 182 cm (6'0) __Quirk:__ Bloodcurdle Villain and former vigilante that was notorious for having killed many Pro Heroes. He attacks and kills heroes who he believes do not fit his definition of a "true hero." Chizome is a cruel, unforgiving, and merciless man with a sense of duty to cleanse society of false heroes. He believes that those who become Heroes for fame or money are unworthy of being called the name and only [All Might](https://anilist.co/character/89224/Yagi-Toshinori) is a true hero. Due to his strong ideology, he took it upon himself to become the Hero Killer: Stain to stain his own hands with blood to purge fake heroes and change the current society. Despite his extremist views and beliefs, Stain did have genuine ideals about heroism, which he stood by firmly. He did not hesitate to save people he deemed worthy of being called Heroes, did not like killing without reason, and would even give advice to his enemies. Stain acknowledged that what he did was morally wrong but believed that for society to be put on the right path, someone must be what he was, suggesting that he saw himself as a martyr. Stain's Quirk "Bloodcurdle" allows him to paralyze his target upon tasting a sample of their blood. The amount of time a victim remains paralyzed depends on their blood type; in ascending order from shortest to longest duration, they are: O, A, AB, and B. The maximum amount of time that anyone can be paralyzed is eight minutes. _In My Hero Academia: Vigilantes

100166.name: Enji Todoroki
100166.desc: __Height:__ 195 cm (6' 4¾") __Occupation:__ Pro Hero __Quirk:__ Hellflame Endeavor is a tall man with a muscular physique. He has short and spiky, red hair with bright blue eyes. His beard and mustache appear to be made of fire, but when he turns off his flames on his face voluntarily, his stubble shows. ~!His desire to surpass the number one hero has driven him in family matters. Enji put [Shouto](https://anilist.co/character/89220/Todoroki-Shouto) through ruthless "training" which caused Shouto a severe degree of physical and emotional pain. Shouto, harboring a bitter hatred towards his father on account of this, refuses to use his fire powers in battles until [Izuku Midoriya](https://anilist.co/character/89028/Midoriya-Izuku) reminded him of his mother's encouragement. Later, Enji understood his mistakes and told his son he would try to be a better hero and father. He hopes for Shouto and the rest his family to forgive him in the future.!~ ~!He's the former No.2 Hero, but later becomes the new No.1 Hero after [All Might](https://anilist.co/character/89224/Yagi-Toshinori) loses his Quirk!~

100166.name: Nana Shimura
100166.desc: Shimura Nana was the seventh user of the One For All Quirk, [All Might](https://anilist.co/character/89224)'s mentor, and a close friend of [Gran Torino](https://anilist.co/character/127428). ~!It was revealed that she is the grandmother of [Shigaraki](https://anilist.co/character/89226)!~

100166.name: Kai Chisaki
100166.desc: __Height:__ 179 cm (5'10") __Quirk:__ Overhaul Kai Chisaki, also known by the villain name Overhaul, is the Yakuza Captain of the Shie Hassaikai. Overhaul is a mysophobic, antisocial sociopath obsessed with returning the world to the way it was before the Quirk phenomenon. Due to a combination of an old theory claiming Quirks derived from rats and his own mysophobia, Overhaul believes that Quirks are actually a plague on humanity, having infected people with "syndromes" of heroism and villainy. He looks down upon those that use their abilities for either purpose, referring to acts of heroic sacrifice or petty crime as "sicknesses". Overhaul is extremely determined to his ambition of eradicating Quirks, not only due to his own personal phobias, but also because such a thing would allow the yakuza to reclaim the power they once held over society. Kai's Quirk "Overhaul" grants him the ability to disassemble anything he touches, as well as reassemble it in any configuration he desires, effectively giving him full control over matter. Kai can disassemble people to kill them or reassemble them to heal their wounds. He can also do this to himself and even merge his body with others, even allowing him to use their Quirks

100166.name: Dabi
100166.desc: __Height:__ 176 cm (5'9¼") __Quirk:__ Blueflame Dabi is a villain affiliated with the League of Villains and a member of the organization's Vanguard Action Squad. Dabi is a stoic, aloof, confident, and focused individual who rarely shows emotion. While rather crude and violent, he's also shown to be quite cautious. Overall, Dabi is a highly enigmatic individual who trusts no one, preferring to do things alone and in his way. He also gives off the impression of knowing more about certain people than he lets on. Dabi's Quirk grants him the ability to generate and control highly destructive blue flames from his body. He has very well-developed control of his flames and can project them far from himself and in large amounts. However, Dabi's body has a low tolerance for his flame, and he will get burned if he uses them for prolonged periods. ~!It is later revealed that Dabi is Touya Todoroki (轟燈矢), the eldest son of the Pro Hero [Endeavor](https://anilist.co/character/126158/Todoroki-Enji) and his wife [Rei](https://anilist.co/character/150628/Todoroki-Rei), and the older brother to [Shouto Todoroki](https://anilist.co/character/89220/Todoroki-Shouto). For a significant period of time, his whereabouts were unknown.!~

100166.name: Camie Utsushimi
100166.desc: __Height:__ 161 cm (5'3") __Affiliation:__ Shiketsu High School (Second-Year Student) __Quirk:__ Glamour Camie seems to be very talkative, especially when learning more about people who pique her interest. She was thrilled upon seeing Shoto Todoroki for the first time, delighted at the fact that she would both meet a handsome man as well as undergo training. According to Inasa Yoarashi, she has impressive "interaction techniques" because she asked for Todoroki's contact info. She also tends to speak in a unique way and incorporates a strange type of slang in it, which tends to confuse those around her. According to herself she also loves children. Camie's Quirk allows her to create both visual and auditory illusions for a short period of time.

100166.name: Saiko Intelli
100166.desc: Affiliation: Seiai Academy (Second-Year Student) Quirk: IQ After she drinks tea, when she closes her eyes, her IQ multiplies. Her IQ is already 150 to start with, so she becomes a super genius. There's a difference in effect based on the brand of tea she drinks.

100166.name: Nejire Hadou
100166.desc: __Height:__ 164 cm (5'4") __Occupation:__ Student __Quirk:__ Wave Motion (ability to convert body's vitality into energy that can discharge as blast waves) She is third-year student at U.A. High School and is part of The Big 3 _(the strongest three hero students in all of Japan)_. Nejire is very enthusiastic, affable and cheery, and is always seen moving. She shows great interest in people's unique physical features and is easily distracted by them. She seems to like knowing more than others, but not in a proud way, as she just enjoys explaining things to people and sharing her knowledge. Despite her happy-go-lucky personality, Nejire is fierce in battle. When the situation calls for it, Nejire can be very calm and focused. Her curiosity never seems to extend to the enemy and she always maintains her focus on taking them down.

100166.name: Inasa Yoarashi
100166.desc: **Height:** 190 cm (6'3") **Affiliation:** Shiketsu High School (First-Year Student) **Quirk:** Whirlwind Inasa is an energetic and enthusiastic young man who expresses himself with vigor. He's very loud, oddly polite, and values passion over anything else. Inasa believes that all heroes have "hot spirits" that enable them to motivate and help others. He disapproves of heroes who do not embody the spirit of passion, which is why he has negative feelings about Endeavor and his son.

100166.name: Yuuga Aoyama
100166.desc: **Height:** 168 cm (5'6") **Quirk:** Navel Lazer Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Yuuga appears to be vain and prideful, thinking of himself as superior to the rest of his classmates, especially regarding his Quirk. He exhibits flamboyant mannerisms, is fond of posing, and likes to grab the attention of those around him despite frequently getting ignored by his peers. He also plays up his French heritage, occasionally implementing French words into his sentences. Yuuga's Quirk allows him to shoot a powerful sparkling laser cannon from his navel. It is so powerful, it can blast through two meters of solid concrete. If he fires the laser for more than 1 second at a time, he will suffer intestinal distress.

100166.name: Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu
100166.desc: __Height:__ 174cm (5'9") __Quirk:__ Steel Student in Class 1-B at U.A. High School. Tetsutetsu is defined by his very hotheaded and outspoken personality. He is confident, stubborn, and straightforward in his motivations and actions. He tends to be very vocal about his intentions and has a one-track mind, often looking for the simplest solution to problems to solve them most directly. Tetsutetsu's direct personality shows through his tenacious and upfront fighting style during battles. Tetsutetsu's Quirk allows him to turn his body into steel. This power grants Tetsutetsu both augmented defensive abilities to withstand attacks and the increased strength of his unarmed physical attacks.

100166.name: Hizashi Yamada
100166.desc: __Height:__ 185cm (6'1") __Quirk:__ Voice Pro Hero. He also works as an English teacher at U.A. High School and as a radio talk show host. Yamada maintains the eccentric persona of a radio host. He often poses when he talks and maintains a certain level of excitement or volume, regardless of the situation. Though he tends to be a jovial individual, Hizashi is capable of great rage when it comes to his friends and colleagues. Yamada's Quirk "Voice" allows him to increase the volume of his voice, giving him an ability that is similar to a sonic scream. The sound from his Quirk is strong enough to cause people's ears to bleed from far away. The only known weakness of this Quirk is that the loud sounds do not travel well underground, making this Quirk ineffective against anything that is underground or separated from him by layers of earth.

100166.name: Ibara Shiozaki
100166.desc: __Height:__ 167cm (5'6") __Quirk:__ Vine Student in Class 1-B at U.A. High School. Ibara is a very modest and courteous person. Although graceful and soft-spoken, she is not afraid to make her pure intentions known. She seems highly religious due to her talking about heaven and divine beings in passing on multiple occasions, and her ultimate moves having somewhat religious names such as "Faith's Shield" and "Crucifixion". Ibara's Quirk "Vine (ツル, Tsuru) gives her hair-like vines that grow on her head. She can lengthen and manipulate the vines, allowing her to attack, defend and grapple. She also can detach them at will. The vines will grow back, provided her head receives proper sunlight and water. (Source: MyHero Academia Wiki)

100166.name: Nemuri Kayama
100166.desc: __Height:__ 175 cm (5'9") __Quirk:__ Somnambulist Pro Hero. She also works as a Modern Hero Art History teacher at U.A. High School. Nemuri is a very playful and flirtatious person with an unpredictably serious and temperamental side to her. She gets angry whenever someone interrupts her or insults her. She is especially sensitive about her age. Despite her flirtatious personality, Nemuri was intelligent, perceptive, and articulate. While she comes off as a hero who enjoys her fame derived from her beauty and sex appeal, Nemuri has demonstrated true heroism and bravery, willing to fight on the front lines and put her life at risk for others. Nemuri's Quirk "Somnambulist" allows her to put nearby people to sleep by exuding a sleep-inducing aroma from her body. Her Quirk works better on males than females.

100166.name: Sorahiko Torino
100166.desc: __Height:__ 128 cm (4'2") __Affiliation:__ Yuuei (Retired) __Quirk:__ Jet A retired hero who is one of All Might's colleagues and his former homeroom teacher. He was the one who taught All Might to control One For All during the his early days, and his training was so intense that All Might fears him to the point he subconsciously tried to forget about him until Grantorino sent his recommendation for Izuku to help him improve One For All, becoming his work place mentor. His Quirk is "Jet," allowing him to take in air through the sole of his foot to allow him to jump higher. (Source: Wikipedia)

100166.name: Shinji Nishiya
100166.desc: __Height:__ 168 cm (5'6") __Quirk:__ Arbor Pro Hero. Underneath his helmet, he has puffy red leaf-like hair, though his face has remained unseen since he has only been shown while wearing his mask. Shinji is a very serious and focused person when it comes to being a hero in his hero duties; however, he easily feels down when someone takes his glory or credit. Shinji's Quirk "Arbor" (樹木, Jumoku) allows him to enlarge and control his wooden body parts into strong tree branches. These branches are excellent for binding.

100166.name: Mirai Sasaki
100166.desc: __Height:__ 200 cm (6'6¾") __Birthplace:__ Tokyo, Japan __Quirk:__ Foresight A Pro Hero and [Mirio Togata](https://anilist.co/character/123527)'s mentor. He was formerly [All Might](https://anilist.co/character/89224)'s sidekick and was considered to be the brains behind All Might's hero operation before opening his own hero agency. Sir Nighteye is a lean but muscular man with a clean, well-kept appearance. Unlike most Pro Heroes, he seems to prefer plain office clothes (a plain white suit with gold buttons, a white dress shirt, and a red tie with white dots) instead of an elaborate hero costume. Sir Nighteye maintains a stoic and intimidating presence, with a cold and sharp glare, but that is only the side of his personality that he shows in public. He greatly values humor and actually requires people to make him laugh before he acknowledes them. Nighteye believes that humor and energy are vital elements for the future of society and punishes subordinates that fail to display those qualities.

100166.name: Naomasa Tsukauchi
100166.desc: Naomasa Tsukauchi is a police detective in the Police Force. Naomasa is a tall man with short black hair and black eyes. As a member of the police force, he is normally seen in his uniform. He wears a signature tan overcoat and a matching hat. He also sports a black suit underneath with matching slacks and dress shoes. Detective Tsukauchi is an earnest, hardworking individual who has earned the right to be a close friend of All Might. Enough so, that he was even entrusted with the truth about One For All and the latter's true form. He appears to have a close relationship with All Might, as he even leaked sensitive information to the hero just because he felt it was the right thing to do.

100166.name: Shikkui Makabe
100166.desc: __Height:__ 180cm __Quirk:__ Stiffening Second year student at Ketsubutsu Academy, his quirk, 'stiffening', allows him to harden objects with his hands by rubbing or kneading them

100166.name: Itejirou Touteki
100166.desc: __Height:__ 171cm __Affiliation:__ Ketsubutsu Academy __Quirk:__ Boomerang A second year student at Ketsubutsu Academy. His Quirk, "Boomerang," allows him to plan the trajectory of any given object he can throw, including underground.

100166.name: Seiji Shishikura
100166.desc: A second year student at Shiketsu High. His Quirk, "Meatball," allows him to roll all living flesh up into meatballs, as well as manipulate his own flesh to his liking. He can remotely control his own flesh after detaching it.

100166.name: Tatami Nakagame
100166.desc: __Height:__ 155cm __Occupation:__ Student __Affiliation:__ Ketsubutsu Academy __Quirk:__ Telescopic A second year student as Ketsubutsu Academy. Her Quirk, "Telescopic," allows her to fold her limbs into her body, similar to a turtle.

100166.name: You Shindou
100166.desc: __Height:__ 176 cm (5'9") __Affiliation:__ Ketsubutsu Academy High School __Quirk:__ Vibrate A second year at Ketsubutsu Academy. His quirk, "Vibrate," allows him to create large tremors similar to earthquakes, but firing off strong attacks leaves him immobile.

100166.name: Nagamasa Moura
100166.desc: A second year student at Shiketsu High. His quirk, "Extend-o-Hair," allows him to manipulate and extend his own body hair for both offense and defense.

100166.name: Kouta Izumi
100166.desc: __Height:__ 107cm (3'5") Kota Izumi is the nephew of Shino Sosaki and the son of the hero team Water Hose.

100166.name: Inko Midoriya
100166.desc: __Height:__ 160 cm (5'3'') Izuku Midoriya's mother. Her quirk allows her to pull small objects towards her.

100166.name: Kurogiri
100166.desc: __Affiliation:__ League of Villains __Quirk:__ Warp Gate Kurogiri has a level-headed personality, which often serves to ground Tomura Shigaraki's immaturity. He is intensely loyal to both All For One and Tomura. He is very polite and well-spoken, even to enemies. ~! Kurogiri is actually an intelligent Nomu made from the corpse of Eraserhead and President Mics high school friend Oboro Shirakumo made to serve Tomura Shigaraki. Although he remains unaware of his previous identity after Eraserheads efforts to talk to him it’s shown that a small part of Oboro is still in Kurogiri!~

100166.name: Mustard
100166.desc: Mustard is a B-rank villain affiliated with the League of Villains and a member of the organization's Vanguard Action Squad. He and the rest of his team serve as the main antagonists of the Forest Training Camp Arc.

100166.name: Kenji Hikiishi
100166.desc: Hikiishi Kenji, also known as Magne was a villain affiliated with the League of Villains and part of its Vanguard Action Squad. She and the rest of her team serve as the main antagonists of the Forest Training Camp Arc. Magne preferred to go by female pronouns despite her masculine presentation.

100166.name: Atsuhiro  Sako
100166.desc: Mr. Compress's Quirk allows him to "compress" anything in a spherical area into a small marble without actually damaging it. The weight of the target is reduced alongside them, making them very easy to carry. If used on a person, it effectively entraps them, terminating the fight instantly and allowing Mr. Compress to abduct them without difficulty. The Quirk can also be used on select body parts, maiming the target.

100166.name: Giran
100166.desc: Giran is a B-rank villain and broker in affiliation with the League of Villains, working to scout new recruits for their organization

100166.name: Muscular
100166.desc: Befitting his appearance, Muscular has a very sadistic and bloodthirsty personality. He openly admits that he wants to use his Quirk freely to kill. Muscular enjoys killing and tormenting those he fights, often saying "show me your blood!". Unlike most of the other members of the Vanguard Action Squad, he joined the League of Villains just to let loose his brutal tendencies, rather than following Stain's ideology

100166.name: Moonfish
100166.desc: Blade-Tooth (歯刃 Shijin?): Moonfish's quirk gives him the ability to enlarge and manipulate his teeth into powerful blade. Being one of the most powerful people in the Vanguard action squad being able to take on numerous powerful heros at once

100166.name: Kaoruko Awata
100166.desc: Quirk: Bubble (バブル Baburu) With this Quirk, Kaoruko can make bubbles filled with an aroma that she had smelled at least once before. She can make both sweet-smelling bubbles and foul-smelling ones. When she’s too nervous, she produces very unpleasant-smelling bubbles that are self-destructing She is a dedicated hero as well as Sir Nighteyes sidekick

100166.name: Emi Fukukado
100166.desc: __Height:__ 5'5 __Quirk:__ Outburst Pro Hero and a teacher of 2nd year, Class 2 at Ketsubutsu Academy High School.

100166.name: Togaru Kamakiri
100166.desc: __Height:__ 158 cm (6'2") __Quirk:__ Razor Sharp __Affiliation:__ Yuuei __Occupation:__ Student Togaru Kamakiri is a student in Class 1-B at U.A.

100166.name: Shinya Kamihara
100166.desc: __Height:__ 170 cm (5'7") __Quirk:__ Foldabody: Shinya's Quirk allows him to make his body and limbs extremely thin and long, effectively allowing him to transform himself into a razor sharp string. He is able to transform faster than the speed of sound. Shinya is a calm and focused individual, who is able to maintain a level head even when in a crisis situation, and encourages his teammates when they begin to panic. He is proven to be quite intelligent and is good at analyzing situations and strategy. He is the former Number 5 Pro-Hero, and is currently Number 4.

100166.name: Tomoko Shiretoko
100166.desc: Her Quirk allowed her to observe and monitor up to 100 people at a time, including their location and weak points.

100166.name: Tsunagu Hakamada
100166.desc: __Height:__ 190cm (6'3") __Quirk:__ Fiber Master Pro Hero, ranked in the top 4. He is the recipient of the "Best Jeanist" award for eight consecutive years. Tsunagu is an elegant man with flamboyant tendencies. He believes very strongly that people with influence must maintain a positive appearance both physically and socially. Tsunagu often uses metaphors referencing jeans, denim, and various other sewing and fabric-based phrases, often inspiring his recruits with speeches, telling them to keep their life straight like their jeans. Tsunagu takes the role of being a hero very seriously. He is selfless, brave, and charismatic, and he aims to spread a sense of a peace to all people, no matter how dire the situation. Tsunagu's Quirk "Fiber Master (ファイバーマスター)" allows him to freely manipulate the threads in any nearby piece of fabric. He has power over all types of cloth, but his Quirk works best with denim and is less effective on sweats. Fiber Master also works on other types of fiber not related to fabric, such as carbon fibers. He primarily uses this power to restrain his targets, either by using their own clothing against them, or simply unravels portions of his own clothing into strings.

100166.name: Shino Sousaki
100166.desc: Telepath: This Quirk allows Shino to utilize a mental transmission and send telepathic messages directly into people's minds. Shino, has displayed the ability to send a message to tens of people at a time. She can send messages, but she can't receive them

100166.name: Yawara Chatora
100166.desc: Pliabody: Yawara's Quirk allows him to stretch, flatten, and bend his body in ways that would normally be impossible

100166.name: Nezu
100166.desc: __Height:__ 85 cm __Quirk:__ High Spec Nezu, also known as Mr. Principal is a Pro Hero and the principal of U.A. High School. He is an extremely rare case of an animal who manifested a Quirk. He can be very long-winded at times when explaining or educating.

100166.name: Ryuuko Tsuchikawa
100166.desc: __Height:__ 167cm (5'6") __Quirk:__ Earth Flow Ryuko Tsuchikawa also known as Pixie-Bob, is a Pro Hero and a member of the Wild, Wild Pussycats. She is a very hyperactive and loud person with little regard for how she may come off to other people and also is very self-conscious about her age. Ryuko's Quirk allows her to freely manipulate the earth for a variety of effects.

100166.name: Hari Kurono
100166.desc: __Age:__ Unknown __Status:__ ~!Imprisoned!~ __Quirk:__ Chronostasis: Kurono's Quirk allows him to slow down the movements of anything he hits with his clock hand-like hair. The minute hands slows a targets movements for one minute and the hour hand slows a targets movements for one hour. Kurono can extend his hair, but only if he is not moving. Hari Kurono, also known as Chronostasis, is a yakuza member afflicted with the Shie Hassaikai, and the assistant/right hand man to Overhaul. He is one of the main antagonists of the Shie Hassaikai Arc.

100166.name: Pony  Tsunotori
100166.desc: __Quirk:__ Horn Cannon Pony is a timid girl. As a foreigner, she does not have much knowledge of the language in Japan. She is shown to be rather naive and innocent in personality, learning nasty phrases from Neito Monoma without realizing what those words mean, as shown when Neito tells Pony unkind phrases to tell Class 1-A. Pony is a thoughtful and diligent person. She is the one who made her team not lose against Class 1-A because of her strategy and perseverance. She is highly observant and seems to be a careful person. Despite this, she made some unkind comments towards Mezo Shoji in their battle, calling him an "octopus" and saying she doesn't like looking at him. Pony's Quirk allows her to send her horns flying and remotely control them at will. She is able to control up to four horns that are sent flying. She has also been shown to be able to balance on them as they carry her around, much like Hawks' wings. When Pony gets angry, she starts speaking in her native language: English.

100166.name: Ryou Inui
100166.desc: Ryo Inui is a Pro Hero and serves as the Lifestyle Guidance Counselor at U.A. High School.

100166.name: Setsuna Tokage
100166.desc: Setsuna Tokage is a student in Class 1-B at U.A. High School, and is one of four students admitted through recommendations; one being her fellow 1-B classmate Juzo Honenuki, as well as rival Class 1-A students Shoto Todoroki and Momo Yaoyorozu.

100166.name: Kinoko  Komori
100166.desc: Kinoko Komori is a student in Class 1-B, and is training to be a Pro Hero. Her quirk, Mushroom, allows her to spread spores that sprout mushrooms wherever they land, including inside of people's bodies.

100166.name: Yui Kodai
100166.desc: Yui Kodai is a student in Class 1-B of U.A. High School. She is a quiet girl, but nevertheless cares about her fellow classmates.

100166.name: Juzo Honenuki
100166.desc: __Height:__ 174 cm (5'8½") __Affiliation:__ U.A High __Quirk:__ Softening Juzo Honenuki is a student in Class 1-B at U.A. High School, and is one of four students admitted through recommendations; one being his fellow 1-B classmate [Setsuna Tokage](https://anilist.co/character/149179/Tokage-Setsuna), the others being rival 1-A students [Shoto Todoroki](https://anilist.co/character/89220/Todoroki-Shouto) and [Momo Yaoyorozu](https://anilist.co/character/89241/Yaoyorozu-Momo). Juzo's Quirk allows him to soften any non-living thing he touches. For example, he can soften the ground to make it similar to quicksand, hindering movements and mobility. If Juzo makes contact again, he can undo the effect. He is also capable of swimming through softened material.

100166.name: Kuugo Sakamata
100166.desc: Gang Orca is the current No. 11 Pro Hero, dropping from his previous No. 10 place. He took part in the assault on All For One and the League of Villains at Kamino Ward, and later served as a makeshift villain during the Provisional Hero License Exam.

100166.name: Ken Ishiyama
100166.desc: Cementoss is a Pro Hero as well as a teacher at U.A. High School. During the U.A. Sports Festival, he acted as the proctor for the 1-on-1 fights in case things got out of hand. He also faced off against Eijiro Kirishima and Rikido Sato in their Final Exam.

100166.name: Fuyumi Todoroki
100166.desc: The only daughter of Eiji and Rei. Fuyumi is the younger sister of Touya and the older sister of Natsuo and Shouto. Fuyumi is a hard working girl, often making meals for the family and works as a teacher at an unnamed school. Unlike her family members, she doesn't resent her father and just wishes they could all be a happy family, though she realizes such a thing is unlikely. Upon hearing Shouto gains friends, however, Fuyumi gets quite excited over it and is happy for him. In the past, Fuyumi took care of Shouto after their mother went to a hospital and never came back. To this day, her wish that she could have done something for Shouto still lingers within her.

100166.name: Chiyo  Shuuzenji
100166.desc: __Quirk:__ Heal __Occupation:__ Pro Hero, Nurse Chiyo has a very kind and compassionate personality, where she treats everyone kindly, though she does have a strict and reproaching attitude towards those that have done something foolish. She's mostly like this with All Might for not teaching Izuku how to use his Quirk properly or with Izuku for using his Quirk recklessly.

100166.name: Yokumiru Mera
100166.desc: Yokumiru Mera is a worker for the Hero Public Safety Commission. He suffers from sleep deprivation due to overwork, something that he complains about frequently.

100166.name: Snipe
100166.desc: __Quirk:__ Homing Snipe is a Pro Hero and a member of the teaching staff at U.A. High School. Snipe has the appearance of a stereotypical western cowboy Snipe's Quirk allows him to lock on to any target he can see within six hundred meters and make any projectile he releases chase after said target

100166.name: Higari Maijima
100166.desc: Higari Maijima, also known as the Excavation Hero: Power Loader, is a Pro Hero and faculty member at U.A. High School.

100166.name: Sekijiro Kan
100166.desc: Sekijiro Kan, also known by his hero name, Blood Hero: Vlad King, is a Pro Hero and the homeroom teacher of U.A. High School's Class 1-B.

100166.name: Nirengeki Shoda
100166.desc: Nirengeki has a very humble attitude, as he will not take credit for something he does not feel he earned by his own strength.

100166.name: Yosetsu Awase
100166.desc: Although he is not as social as some others, Yosetsu is foul-mouthed and tense, except for serious or life-or-death situations, in which he becomes very easily startled and much more talkative, although he retains his harsh way of speech.

100166.name: Hiryu Rin
100166.desc: **Height:** 170 cm (5'7") __Quirk:__ Scales He is a Class 1-B student in U.A. High School, training to become a Pro Hero. It's notable that Hiryu possesses a serious demeanor when it comes to playing out his abilities into action. He is rather diligent in terms of academic abilities and Quirk functions as well. Hiryu has shown to be a very competent combatant, with a great handle on the applications of his Quirk. Thanks to the versatile nature of his Scales Quirk, Hiryu excels in both close and long-range combat, effectively switching between hand-to-hand combat, and shooting off his scales when it’s most convenient to him.

100166.name: Reiko Yanagi
100166.desc: Reiko is a quiet and emotionless teenager who often shows an odd body posture.

100166.name: Uwabami
100166.desc: Uwabami is a Pro Hero.

100166.name: Masaru Bakugou
100166.desc: Masaru Bakugou is Katsuki Bakugou's father and the husband of Mitsuki Bakugou.

100166.name: Mitsuki Bakugou
100166.desc: Mitsuki Bakugou is Katsuki Bakugou's mother and the wife of Masaru Bakugou.

100166.name: Kyoutoku Jirou
100166.desc: Kyotoku Jiro is Kyoka Jiro's father.

100166.name: Cathleen Bate
100166.original: キャスリーン・ベイト
100166.desc: __Height:__ 193 cm __Quirk:__ New Order The current No. 1 Pro Hero of the United States of America. She is stated to be the strongest woman in the whole world. Cathleen's Quirk allows her to set a rule onto her surroundings, allowing her to manipulate and bestow new properties onto herself and the world around her. In order to activate her Quirk, she has to first make physical contact with the target and speak its name, then explains the rule she wishes to impose. She could only impose two rules at any given time.

100166.name: Mika Jirou
100166.desc: The mother of Kyoka Jiro.

9253.name: Luka Urushibara
9253.desc: __Height:__ 161 cm (5'3") Second year in Kasensou Private Prepatory Academy. Mayuri's classmate. Luka has the personality of a polite, well-groomed, and justified kind of person. Uses honorifics specifically with Rintarou. Luka doesn't push their opinions much upon others, but when they do they become quite bashful and blush quite a bit. Because they're quite serious by nature, they simply believe what others say. Thanks to that, Luka thinks all the ridiculous stuff Rintarou talks about is real. Rintarou makes them out to be his student on their own, and is currently in the middle of brainwashing them. A very shy person, Luka often turns down Mayuri's requests to cosplay. ~!In Episode 8, Luka succeeded in changing their sex to female by sending a message to their mother's pager, telling them to consume more vegetables to alter their sex.!~ ~!In exchange of dating Rintarou, Luka undid their message which turned back their sex to male again. !~

9253.name: Kurisu Makise
9253.desc: __Height:__ 160 cm (5'3") Kurisu is a research member in Viktor Chondria University's Brain Research Program. Her age group matches that of third-year high schoolers, but she skipped a grade through America's educational system. She is also famous in America for writing theses papers, part of which is covered in the news. Thanks to skipping a grade in America as a girl, she was envied by people around her, and ended up building a strong personality. She does not want to show weakness to others, so she always has a stern expression. However, she is very curious, and when she builds interest, she pokes into things. Occasionally, she has views that differ from regular opinions, such as, "The experiment data is more important than the subject's privacy." [Rintarou](https://anilist.co/character/35252) often tells her, "Hey, you've got a pretty good sense of being a Mad Scientist," but she is not one to agree to such things personally. She is a tsundere.

9253.name: Rintarou Okabe
9253.desc: __Height:__ 177 cm (5'10") Okabe Rintarou is a first-year student attending Tokyo Denki University and calls himself a Crazy Mad Scientist. He acts like a villain​ but is rather immature as he frequently shows traits of Chuunibyou syndrome despite being a grown-up man. After enrolling in university, he established a laboratory in Akihabara named the "Future Gadget Research Establishment", where he invents gadgets which tend to be of little use. He often speaks to himself on his cellphone, often not making any sense. Supposedly, he has very few friends that can understand what he's talking about. The phrase he uses to end conversations, particularly with himself, is "El Psy Kongroo" (エル・プサイ・コングルゥ). Steins;Gate: ~!Eventually, he falls in love with, and confesses to, [Makise Kurisu](https://anilist.co/character/34470).!~ Steins;Gate 0: ~!In the future of the Alpha world line, Okabe became the leader of the resistance against SERN's rule, and was known as an international terrorist (in the side story "The Distant Valhalla", it's revealed that SERN released Okabe and [Daru](https://anilist.co/character/35258) so that they could found the resistance, thus completing the cycle of fate). Okabe got captured by SERN's Rounder unit in 2025 and was tortured to death.!~

9253.name: Mayuri Shiina
9253.desc: __Height:__ 151 cm (4'11") Second year in Kasensou Private Prepatory Academy. Childhood friend of [Rintarou](https://anilist.co/character/35252/Okabe-Rintarou)'s, and slow by nature. Speaks in a very wavy manner, and seems to always be smiling and having fun. She's quite the optimist. She has trouble understanding complicated theories, but doesn't mind as long as it's enjoyable. Doesn't like people arguing, and is depressed when things are unpleasant. Though she'd like to ease the situation in such cases, she's not really good at reading between the lines. She often went with her grandmother to see the stars on her grandmother's back. Because of that, she has a habit of reaching her arm out to the sky at times, which has led Rintarou to naming it the "Stardust Shakehand". She abruptly does this (even if she's talking with someone), which surprises everyone around her.

9253.name: Suzuha Amane
9253.desc: __Height__: 163 cm (5'4") A girl that really likes riding bicycles, and is quite energetic, though a little crude. If you stick around her, she's surprisingly cautious. Very helpful. A little too familiar with things, but doesn't dig too deep. Not quite comfortable with having other people help her. For that reason, she spends as little time as possible. Her personality drastically changes when it comes to her own interests. Proactive. Has a habit of using strange and difficult vocabulary at times, but somehow you can tell she's purposely doing so. Ended up hanging out with the Future Gadget Laboratory since she started working at the CRT TV Workshop. ~!It is revealed in Episode 14 that she came from the year 2036 to save the world from SERN's rule. Therefore, she used the name John Titor on Internet boards so that Okabe and the others would notice. She was the one who sent the time machine crashing into Akihabara in 2010, right when the Phone Microwave was being developed. This time machine, revealed to have been created by Daru, could only go back in time, but could never go to the future. In order to find the IBN 5100, Suzuha decides to go back to 1975 and then bring it to Okabe to stop SERN. In deciding so, she would have to leave 2010 and wouldn't be able to come back. Dedicated to her mission, she decides to go. A few hours after her departure, Okabe and the others receive a letter from her, written in the year 2000. It revealed that she had failed to retrieve the PC, d

9253.name: Rumiho Akiha
9253.desc: __Height__: 143 cm (4'8") Second year in Kanaria Private Academy. Faris is someone who works part-time at a maid cafe called "MayQueen+Nyan2". Mayuri works with her. She's quite child-like. Acts like a childish devil towards men. Also adds embarrassing "meows" to her speech. Has an ability to see into people's hearts just by looking into their eyes (which she calls the "Cheshire Break"). Respects her father a lot, as well as having a father complex. ~!She sends a D-Mail to her dad to prevent his death. In the timeline that her dad is alive, he doesn't let her open MayQueen+Nyan2, the maid cafe that has brought moe to Akihabara, so the city does not have anything moe in this timeline.!~

9253.name: Moeka Kiryuu
9253.desc: __Height:__ 167 cm (5'6") A tall girl that Rintarou bumps into in Akihabara and is on a search for the IBN 5100 personal computer. Moeka is extremely protective of her mobile phone and becomes agitated if someone tries to take it from her hands. She is very shy and prefers to talk to someone by sending them a text message instead of speaking. ~!In Episode 12 it is revealed that she's in fact a Rounder member, a unit belonging to SERN. Her codename is M4. In multiple timelines of the Alpha attractor field, she is the one who kills Mayuri.!~

9253.name: Itaru Hashida
9253.desc: __Height:__ 164 cm (5'5") First-year student at Tokyo Denki University. Pro-active otaku, who's got a thing for both 2-D and 3-D girls. Plenty of statements he makes could be taken as sexual harassment. He and [Rintarou](https://anilist.co/character/35252/Okabe-Rintarou) have known each other since high school. He usually dismissed Rintarou's ridiculous requests as "annoying", but actually completes them well, and trusts Rintarou as a friend. Has great confidence in his programming and hacking abilities (he doesn't mind being called a Super Hacker, but doesn't like it when people call him Super Haker). He's always in front of the computer.

9253.name: Yuugo Tennouji
9253.desc: Owner of the CRT TV Workshop set up in the first floor of the Oohiyama building. Also the landlord. Widower. Has an only daughter by the name of Nae, though he's the only one who loves CRTs. Hates LCDs with a passion, and perhaps anarchic. Though he's not quite enthusiastic in the CRT TV Workshop, for some reason he doesn't seem like he'd go bankrupt anytime soon. Nicknamed "Mr. Brown" by Rintarou, due to the loan word "Braun" used in the Japanese term for CRTs (ブラウン管). ~! In episode 20, it is revealed that he's actually a veteran SERN henchman. In the Alpha world line, he was acquainted with Suzuha (who traveled back to 1975 and took the name "Hashida Suzu") and was taken care of by her for some time. He commands the Rounder unit (including Moeka) in Akihabara, under SERN's order to search for the IBN 5100. After Moeka successfully stole it, he was responsible for transferring the computer to SERN. In the anime, after Moeka and Rintarou found out about his identity, he confessed that he got close to Suzuha due to SERN's order. As Rounder members were to kill themself after finishing their mission, in order to protect his daughter, he killed Moeka and himself. In the VN, after he found out the relation Hashida Suzu had to the time machine and the future, he regretted his actions, and committed suicide. His death caused Nae to become vengeful, especially against Okabe and Moeka. She later became the Rounder commander, and killed Okabe in 2025, then time-leaped 15,000 times bac

9253.name: Nae Tennouji
9253.desc: [Tennouji Yuugo's](https://anilist.co/character/38558) only daughter, in grade school. Really loves her father, and often shows up at the CRT TV Workshop on the way home from school. She's a bit docile. Thinks of Mayuri as her "older sister", but is often frightened by Itaru and Rintarou. On [__Robotics;Notes__](https://anilist.co/anime/13599/RoboticsNotes/) Nae returns in Robotics;Notes as an important member of the cast and while not part of the Robot Research Club she provides assistance to them via ties at her job at JAXA (Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency)

9253.name: Dr. Nakabachi
9253.desc: He is the professor who gives the lecture about time travels in Episode 1. ~!It is revealed in episode 23, that he is Shouichi Makise, Kurisu's father and also the one who stabbed her in the first episode. Due to his deep-seated jealousy with his daughter's talents, which has strained their relationship for years, Nakabachi stole her papers on the creation of the time machine and took it as his own. He later defected to Russia, and with the papers put to practice, in the future the time machine race will break out, and World War III will doom the Alpha worldline. In the Drama CD, it's revealed that he and Akiha Yukitaka (Feiris's dad) were students of Hashida Suzu, aka Amane Suzuha, and the three of them were devoted to the research on time machine. Shouichi changed his surname to Nakabachi, a mentor of his, in order to continue the research without being tracked down by organizations with the same interest. Also in this Drama CD, it's shown that Nakabachi used to love Kurisu, and was very proud of her prodigious intellect, displayed as early as two. However, as Kurisu became more intrigued by his works, she started to learn by herself and soon surpassed him. When she was eleven, she was able to disprove his time machine theory, and the shame drove Nakabachi to cut off his relationship with her, and never gave her the 11th birthday present he bought, an incident he later confessed to Yukitaka that he deeply regretted. He became more resolved to build a time machine "that coul

9253.name: John Titor
9253.desc: Based on a 'real' person, John Titor is the name used on several bulletin boards during 2000 and 2001 by a poster claiming to be a time traveler from the year 2036. In these posts he made numerous predictions (a number of them vague, some quite specific) about events in the near future, starting with events in 2004. ~! In Steins;Gate, it is a codename used by Amane Suzuha on the internet. !~

20464.name: Shouyou Hinata
20464.desc: __Teams:__ Yukigaoka Junior High (Former); Karasuno High (Current) __Number:__ 1 (Junior High 3rd Year); 10 (High School 1st year); 5 (High School 3rd year) __Position:__ Captain (Junior High); Outside Hitter (Junior High); Middle Blocker (High School) Hinata has an unusually high ability to jump. Since he was young, Hinata trained his legs to compensate for his lack of height. He joins the Karusuno High School Volleyball team and amazes the team with his natural affinity as a spiker. Although he is a complete beginner and never had any experience playing in a volleyball team, he grows rapidly through each match. ~!After graduating from high school, Hinata traveled to Brazil to gain experience by playing beach volleyball. This is when he got the name, Ninja Shoyo. Upon returning to Japan, he became a member of the MSBY Black Jackals, a Division 1 team in the V-League. He became a member of the Japan Men’s National Volleyball Team during the 2021 Olympics. Currently, that is the year 2022, he is a member of Asas São Paulo, a professional team in the Brazil Super League.!~

20464.name: Tobio Kageyama
20464.desc: __Team:__ Karasuno High, Kitagawa Daiichi Junior High (former) __Height:__ 180.6 cm __Year:__ 1st Year, class 3 __Number:__ 9 __Position:__ Setter A famous setter in his middle school who joins the Karusuno High Volleyball team. He was known as the "King of the Court" in his middle school because of his arrogant demeanor and the way he would order around his teammates. Although he still carries an overbearing attitude, he begins to change when he starts to play with [Hinata Shouyou](https://anilist.co/character/64769) who views him as a rival.

20464.name: Koushi Sugawara
20464.desc: __Height:__ 174 cm Being the vice captain, Sugawara has a soothing personality for his teammates and acts as a pillar of support for them. Even though he isn't Karasuno's official setter anymore, he doesn't dream of giving up on playing in general. As such, he encourages himself and all of his teammates not to give up, no matter how rough the situation might be. Sugawara's dedication to volleyball is clear when he decides to continue club activities even when most third years choose to retire to focus on their futures.
