In a meeting, his teacher asked Sugawara why he's so determined to continue playing even though he's not a starting member, and Sugawara replied that he doesn't want to have regrets in the future. He is also quite perceptive as he noticed how [Tanaka](https://anilist.co/character/67325/Tanaka-Ryuunosuke) asked for the key to the gym (back during the first years' 3-on-3 match) even though he always comes in late, so Sugawara knew that something was up. He is also intelligent as he can come up with helpful tactics during the game. An example of this is when he came up with the idea of saying "bring it" and "send it to me" for [Kageyama](https://anilist.co/character/64771/Kageyama-Tobio) and [Hinata](https://anilist.co/character/64769/Hinata-Shouyou)'s combo.

20464.name: Daichi Sawamura
20464.desc: __Team:__ Karasuno High __Height:__ 176.8 cm __Year:__ 3rd year, class 4 __Number:__ 1 __Position:__ Wing Spiker The captain of the Karasuno High volleyball club.

20464.name: Ryuunosuke Tanaka
20464.desc: __Height:__ 177.2 cm __Team:__ Karasuno High __Number:__ 5 __Position:__ Wing Spiker

20464.name: Yuu Nishinoya
20464.desc: __Team:__ Karasuno High, Chidoriyama Junior High (former) __Height:__ 159.3 cm (5'2") __Year:__ 2nd year, Class 3 __Number:__ 4 __Position:__ Libero Yuu is a very energetic and temperamental person. His boisterous nature and crazy shenanigans can attract unwanted attention quite easily, which often bodes ill for him. Although he hardly ever worries about the consequences of his actions (and may even revert to violence in order to vent out his anger on certain occasions), he is surprisingly considerate of his friends' feelings and insecurities. Yuu can be extremely impatient, excitable and impulsive. As [Ryuunosuke Tanaka](https://anilist.co/character/67325) puts it, "he simply gets too fired up for his own good." He doesn't bother to filter his words, and is therefore prone to blurting out whatever he's thinking in a loud and tactless manner. In-game, however, his attitude changes drastically: he becomes incredibly focused and serious, remaining calm and doing everything in his power to provide the support his team needs until the very end. For this reason, everyone in the volleyball club respects him greatly.

20464.name: Kei Tsukishima
20464.desc: **Height:** 188 cm **Team:** Karasuno High **Year:** 1st year, class 4 **Number:** 11 **Position:** Middle Blocker A member of the Karasuno High volleyball club. Tsukishima is very blunt and will sometimes rile his teammates up due to his antagonistic nature (most notably being [Hinata](https://anilist.co/character/64769/Hinata-Shouyou), [Kageyama](https://anilist.co/character/64771/Kageyama-Tobio), [Nishinoya](https://anilist.co/character/67327/Nishinoya-Yuu), and [Tanaka](https://anilist.co/character/67325/Tanaka-Ryuunosuke)) and sometimes other teams because of his casual smug attitude, taking pride in and relishing when his opponents see him as a nuisance as seen with [Tendou](https://anilist.co/character/126073/Tendou-Satori) and [Shirabu](https://anilist.co/character/137537/Shirabu-Kenjirou). Tsukishima is standoffish and has an arrogant and condescending personality, but he has low self-esteem and thinks of himself as inferior. Although he is only outwardly close with [Yamaguchi](https://anilist.co/character/71609/Yamaguchi-Tadashi), he can be seen occasionally caring about his other club members.

20464.name: Chikara Ennoshita
20464.desc: __Team:__ Karasuno High __Height:__ 175.4 cm __Year:__ 2nd year, class 4 __Position:__ Wing Spiker Ennoshita seems quiet and reserved but can behave boldly towards the other 2nd years. He's smart and hasn't received a failing mark before. Similarly to Sugawara, he is always smiling. He's supposedly the only one within the 2nd years to be able to control Tanaka and Nishinoya. He's also able to understand different people, as stated a few times by Tanaka and when he knew what to do to give Yamaguchi some courage before his jump float serve.

20464.name: Asahi Azumane
20464.desc: __Team:__ Karasuno High __Height:__ 184.7 cm __Year:__ 3rd year, class 3 __Number:__ 3 __Position:__ Wing Spiker In contrast to his appearance, he is rather quiet and gentle and has his difficulties realizing that he is Karasuno's ace as he initially doesn't feel that way. He shows to be weak-willed at the beginning when he leaves the team before the first years come, feeling that he let down his entire team when they lost against Date Tech High even though they counted on him. After coming back to Karasuno, he realizes that his will to play volleyball is much stronger than he thought and with the help of his teammates, he acknowledges his position as Karasuno's ace (even though he is still mocked sometimes by Daichi for not having any "ace-like presence") and gains self-confidence.

20464.name: Kiyoko Shimizu
20464.desc: __Team:__ Karasuno High __Height:__ 166.2 cm __Year:__ 3rd Year, class 2 The manager of the Karasuno High volleyball club.

20464.name: Kouji Sekimukai
20464.desc: Hinata's good friend back when they still were attending Yukigaoka Junior High. He's playing soccer.

20464.name: Yukitaka Izumi
20464.desc: Hinata's good friend from Yukigaoka Junior High. He's playing basketball, but often helped out Hinata with practicing volleyball.

20464.name: Keishin Ukai
20464.desc: **Height:** 178.2 cm **Team:** Karasuno High Karasuno High School volleyball club's alumnus, currently coaching volleyball club and helping out his mother at the shop.

20464.name: Kenma Kozume
20464.desc: __Height:__ 169.2 cm The setter of the Nekoma High School volleyball club. Kenma is [Kuroo](https://anilist.co/character/71269)'s childhood friend and keeps playing volleyball because of him. He has a very calm personality and is usually doing things at his own pace. Often seen playing video games and being introverted. Nekoma's backbone, brain and heart.

20464.name: Tetsurou Kuroo
20464.desc: __Team:__ Nekoma High School __Height:__ 187.7 cm __Year:__ 3rd Year, class 5 __Number:__ 1 __Position:__ Middle Blocker The captain of the Nekoma High School volleyball club. Kuroo has a somehow manipulative and cunning personality, but cares about his friends and teammates very deeply. As Nekoma's captain he has a sense of responsibility and confidence. Even though Kuroo's a middle blocker, he often uses offensive plays too.

20464.name: Tadashi Yamaguchi
20464.desc: __Team:__ Karasuno High __Height:__ 179.5cm - 180.0cm __Year:__ 1st year, class 4 __Number:__ 12 __Position:__ Middle Blocker Yamaguchi always hangs out with Tsukishima and is very protective of him. He has trained himself hard to use a jump float serve. He is also a substitute ace server of the Karasuno Volleyball team.

20464.name: Tooru Oikawa
20464.desc: __Height:__ 184 cm The setter and captain of the Aoba Josai High School volleyball club. He was [Kageyama](https://anilist.co/character/64771/Tobio-Kageyama)'s senpai when they were attending Kitagawa Daiichi. According to Kageyama, he is a very talented setter and volleyball player with a ​complex personality. His favourite food is milk bread.

20464.name: Taketora Yamamoto
20464.desc: __Team:__ Nekoma High School __Height:__ 176.7 cm __Year:__ 2nd Year, class 1 __Number:__ 4 __Position:__ Wing Spiker Yamamoto is proud and short tempered wing spiker of the Nekoma High School volleyball club. He usually doesn't think what he says and is somewhat similar to Tanaka.

20464.name: Sou Inuoka
20464.desc: __Team:__ Nekoma High School __Height:__ 185.3 cm __Year:__ 1st Year, class 1 __Number:__ 7 __Position:__ Middle Blocker Middle blocker of the Nekoma High School volleyball club. He has friendly personality and becomes friends with Hinata after their game.

20464.name: Yuuki Shibayama
20464.desc: __Team:__ Nekoma High School __Height:__ 162.5 cm __Weight:__ 53.3 kg __Year:__ 1st Year, class 4 __Number:__ 12 __Position:__ Libero One of the libero of the Nekoma High School volleyball club.

20464.name: Ittetsu Takeda
20464.desc: __Team:__ Karasuno High __Height:__ 166.5 cm Volleyball club faculty advisor of the Karasuno High School. Takeda is inexperienced in volleyball, but still became an advisor for Karasuno. He often doesn't understand rules and that's why he takes notes about every new thing he learns. Takeda has an enthusiastic and brave personality.

20464.name: Yuutarou Kindaichi
20464.desc: __Team:__ Aoba Josai High, Kitagawa Daiichi (former) __Height:__ 189.2 cm __Year:__ 1st year __Position:__ Middle Blocker Middle blocker of the Aoba Josai High School volleyball club. He was Kageyama's teammate back in junior high school. Kindaichi was one of the players who hated Kageyama's selfish plays and refused to understand him.

20464.name: Nobuyuki Kai
20464.desc: __Team__: Nekoma High School __Height__: 176.5 cm __Weight__: 68.9 kg __Year__: 3rd Year, class 4 __Number__: 2 __Position__: Wing Spiker

20464.name: Morisuke Yaku
20464.desc: __Team:__ Nekoma High School __Height:__ 165.2 cm __Year:__ 3rd Year, class 5 __Number:__ 3 __Position:__ Libero Currently playing libero of the Nekoma High School volleyball club.

20464.name: Shouhei Fukunaga
20464.desc: __Team:__ Nekoma High School __Height:__ 178.3 cm __Year:__ 2nd Year, class 2 __Number:__ 6 __Position:__ Wing Spiker

20464.name: Manabu Naoi
20464.desc: __Team:__ Nekoma High School The coach of the Nekoma High School volleyball club and Ukai's old acquaintance.

20464.name: Yasufumi Nekomata
20464.desc: __Team:__ Nekoma High School The coach of the Nekoma High School volleyball club and Ukai's rival. He doesn't like to lose.

20464.name: Hajime Iwaizumi
20464.desc: __Height:__ 179.3 cm __Team:__ Aobajousai High School __Year:__ 3rd Year, class 5 __Number:__ 4 __Position:__ Wing Spiker __Ability Parameters (out of 5):__ Power = 5; jump = 4; stamina = 4; intellect = 3; technique = 3; speed = 4 Is a third-year student from Aoba Johsai High; he is the volleyball team's ace, vice-captain and a wing spiker. He is also [Tōru Oikawa](https://anilist.co/character/71611/Oikawa-Tooru)'s childhood friend and "pillar". Iwaizumi often gets irritated by Oikawa's behavior and tells him that guys who have girls going kyaa kyaa over them irritates him the most.

20464.name: Hayato Ikejiri
20464.desc: __Team:__ Tokonami High School __Height:__ 177.2 cm __Year:__ 3rd Year, class 1 __Number:__ 4 __Position:__ Wing Spiker Ikejiri went to the same junior high school as Daichi where they played volleyball together.

20464.name: Wakatoshi Ushijima
20464.desc: __Height:__ 189.5 cm (6' 2.6") __Team:__ Shiratorizawa Academy __Number:__ 1 __Position:__ Wing Spiker Wakatoshi Ushijima is a third year at Shiratorizawa Academy and the captain and ace of the school's boys' volleyball team. Currently, he is the number one ace in Miyagi Prefecture and one of the country's top three aces, along with Sakusa and Kiryu. Left handed. His favourite food is hayashi rice.

20464.name: Yui Michimiya
20464.desc: __Height:__ 159 cm (5' 2") __Team:__ Karasuno Girls' Volleyball Club __Year:__ 3rd Year, class 1 __Number:__ 1 The captain of the Karasuno High girls volleyball club. Michimiya is shown to be a very active person, always smiling and cracking jokes. She is a very determined person, who cares a lot for her team, giving them motivational speeches, and always tries to stay composed in front of them; she only cries when she's away from her teammates. However, she herself had stated that she isn't strict enough. Around [Daichi](https://anilist.co/character/67323/Sawamura-Daichi) though she can become flustered and clumsy, repeating words to try and find the right thing to say.

20464.name: Kaname Moniwa
20464.desc: **Height:** 176 cm **Team:** Datekougyou High School **Number:** 2 **Position:** Setter The captain of the Datekougyou High School volleyball club.

20464.name: Kenji Futakuchi
20464.desc: __Team:__ Datekougyou High School __Height:__ 184.2 cm According to Moniwa, Futakuchi is a problematic kouhai with a very easy going personality. He's often seen arguing with Kamasaki who is the ​complete opposite of Futakuchi.

20464.name: Takanobu Aone
20464.desc: __Team:__ Datekougyou High School __Height:__ 191.8 cm __Year:__ 2nd Year, class A __Number:__ 7 __Position:__ Middle Blocker Main pillar of Datekou. Even though Aone never smiles and seems serious and scary, he actually has a very kind heart. Futakuchi said that Aone has a habit of "locking on" to you if he knows his opponent is an ace.

20464.name: Nobuteru Irihata
20464.desc: The coach of the Aoba Josai High School volleyball club.

20464.name: Yuusuke Takinoue
20464.desc: Height: 185.6 cm Position: Middle Blocker Karasuno High School volleyball club's alumnus. He and Shimada are part of the Karasuno Neighborhood Association team. And they often come to watch current Karasuno's games as well as to root for them. Yuusuke's working at Takinoue Electric Goods.

20464.name: Makoto Shimada
20464.desc: __Height:__ 177.7cm Karasuno High School volleyball club's alumnus. He and Takinoue are part of the Karasuno Neighborhood Association team. And they often come to watch current Karasuno's games as well as to root for them. Makoto's working at Shimada Mart.

20464.name: Hisashi Kinoshita
20464.desc: __Height:__ 174cm Narita, Ennoshita and Kinoshita are 2nd years who couldn't keep up with the training when old Ukai returned and that's why they left volleyball club. However after some time they came back because they realized that they still want to play volleyball, though coach Ukai was no longer there. Ennoshita called them ''disgraceful'' 2nd years.

20464.name: Kazuhito Narita
20464.desc: __Team:__ Karasuno High __Height:__ 180.2 cm __Year:__ 2nd Year, class 4 Narita, Ennoshita and Kinoshita are 2nd years who couldn't keep up with the training when old Ukai returned and that's why they left volleyball club. However after some time they came back because they realized that they still want to play volleyball, though coach Ukai was no longer there. Ennoshita called them ''disgraceful'' 2nd years.

20464.name: Akira Kunimi
20464.desc: __Team:__ Aobajōsai (former Kitagawa Daīchi) (first year at Aoba Johsai) __Height:__ 182.8 cm __Number:__ 13 __Position:__ Wing Spiker He is a quiet and indifferent person, though it's mostly out of laziness. He occasionally skips practice as well and doesn't seem to put his full effort into matches; however, his true strength lies in his late game plays. Kunimi dislikes loud, energetic people and was dismayed when Koganegawa yelled at him to "go all out", which is one of his least liked phrases. He also refers to Hinata, Koganegawa, and Hyakuzawa as the "idiot squad" because of their energy. Kageyama has also mentioned that Kunimi is smart, though it's unknown if that refers to his game sense or general studies.

20464.name: Issei Matsukawa
20464.desc: Issei is a 3rd year student from Aobajohsai High; he is one of the middle blockers.

20464.name: Shinji Watari
20464.desc: Shinji is a second year libero in Aobajohsai High.

20464.name: Takahiro Hanamaki
20464.desc: Takahiro is a 3rd year wing spiker at Aobajohsai High.

20464.name: Sadayuki Mizoguchi
20464.desc: Sadayuki is the coach of Aobajohsai High.

20464.name: Shigeru Yahaba
20464.desc: Shigeru is a 2nd year setter at Aobajohsai High.

20464.name: Tamahiko Teshiro
20464.desc: Tamahiko is a first year setter and a pinch server at Nekoma High.

20464.name: Takurou Oiwake
20464.desc: Takurou is the coach of Date Tech High's volleyball team.

20464.name: Yutaka Obara
20464.desc: Yutaka is a second year wing spiker of the Date Tech High Volleyball Club.

20464.name: Kousuke Sakunami
20464.desc: Kousuke is a first year libero at Date Tech High.

20464.name: Takehito Sasaya
20464.desc: Takehito is a third year Wing Spiker at Date Tech High.

20464.name: Ikkei Ukai
20464.desc: Ikkei is the former coach of Karasuno High's Boys' Volleyball Club. He once led the team to nationals and was well-known. After being hospitalized, he resigned from coaching the team.

20464.name: Taiga Sakurai
20464.desc: Taiga is a third year at Tokonami High. He plays as a libero.

20464.name: Kazuma Chaya
20464.desc: Kazuma is a third year at Tokonami High. He plays as a middle blocker.

20464.name: Yoshiharu Haga
20464.desc: __Height:__ 174 cm (5' 8.5") __Uniform Number:__ 9 Third-year student at Tokonami High and setter on the boys' volleyball team.

20464.name: Hikaru Komaki
20464.desc: Hikaru is a third year at Tokonami High. He plays as a wing spiker and is the captain of the volleyball team.

20464.name: Rikuto Shibuya
20464.desc: Rikuto is a second year at Tokonami High. He plays as a middle blocker.

20464.name: Hiroki Tamagawa
20464.desc: Hiroki is a third year at Tokonami High. He plays as a wing spiker.

20464.name: Natsu Hinata
20464.desc: Shouyou Hinata's younger sister.

20464.name: Hidenori Uchizawa
20464.desc: A wing spiker on the Karasuno Neighborhood Association Team.

20464.name: Yukinari Mori
20464.desc: A college student and a middle blocker in the Karasuno Neighborhood Association Team.

20464.name: Asuka Hirama
20464.desc: One of the girls who came to cheer for Aoba Johsai, especially Oikawa, during the Interhigh Preliminary match against Karasuno. Throughout the match, she shows that she isn't too familiar with the rules and plays of volleyball and relies on [Takinoue](https://anilist.co/character/80511/Yuusuke-Takinoue) and [Shimada](https://anilist.co/character/80513/Makoto-Shimada) to explain things to her. She would later appear during Seijoh's rematch against Karasuno.

20464.name: Manaka Ujiie
20464.desc: One of the girls who came to cheer for Aoba Johsai, especially [Oikawa](https://anilist.co/character/71611/Tooru-Oikawa), during the InterHigh Preliminary. Throughout the match, she shows that she isn't too familiar with the rules and plays of volleyball and relies on [Takinoue](https://anilist.co/character/80511/Yuusuke-Takinoue) and [Shimada](https://anilist.co/character/80513/Makoto-Shimada) to explain things to her. She would later appear during Seijoh's rematch against Karasuno.

20464.name: Chizuru Sasaki
20464.desc: __Uniform Number:__ 11 Third-year student at Karasuno High and wing spiker for the girls' volleyball team. She is close friends with [Michimiya](https://anilist.co/character/77165/Yui-Michimiya) and Aihara.

20464.name: Yasushi Kamasaki
20464.desc: __Height:__ 186.8cm (6' 1.5") __Uniform Number:__ 1 __Position:__ Middle Blocker __Ability Parameters (out of 5):__ Power = 5; Jump = 2; Stamina = 4; Game Sense 2; Technique = 2; Speed = 4 Third-year student at Datekougyou High School. Prior to retiring, he played on the boys' volleyball team as a middle blocker and the vice-captain. He is loud, strict, and often argues with and threatens his problematic kouhai [Futakuchi](https://anilist.co/character/77415/Kenji-Futakuchi). However, he is incredibly supportive of his team and often attends their official and practices matches with [Moniwa](https://anilist.co/character/77413/Kaname-Moniwa) and [Sasaya](https://anilist.co/character/137486/Takehito-Sasaya) after retiring.

20464.name: Kyoutou
20464.desc: Vice Principal of Karasuno High School. He is balding and attempts to keep his head covered with a toupee. He is said to have a bad relationship with the volleyball club that has gotten worse since Hinata and Kageyama joined the club. However, once the team starts to win again, he begins supporting the club more.

20464.name: Mao Aihara
20464.desc: __Uniform Number:__ 2 Third-year student at Karasuno High School. She played on the girls' volleyball team as the team's ace and vice-captain. She is good friends with and very supportive of [Michimiya](https://anilist.co/character/77165/Yui-Michimiya).

97940.name: Narrator
97940.desc: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

97940.name: Noelle Silva
97940.desc: __Height:__ 161 cm (5'3") Noelle Silva is a member of the Black Bulls and was inducted into the squad around the same time as [Asta](https://anilist.co/character/123285). She is the second daughter of one of the Clover Kingdom's royal families, House Silva, and the younger sister of the captain of the Silver Eagles, [Nozel Silva](https://anilist.co/character/124442). She likes sweets. ~!Her family disowned her due to her lack of control on her magic and having [their mother](https://anilist.co/character/124972) die while giving birth to her.!~

97940.name: Yuno
97940.desc: __Height:__ 172 cm (5'7") Yuno was left, along with Asta, in front of a church in a village called Hage when he was an infant. He grew up at the church and spends most of his day with Asta. Sometime later, a thug tries to take his necklace away from him and sell it for money. Fortunately, Asta steps in and tries to take it back. In the end, the thug decided to leave without the necklace after Asta keeps charging at him. He is the wielder of a five-leaf clover anti-magic grimoire and is a 3rd Class Junior Magic Knight of the Clover Kingdom's Black Bull and Royal Knights squads.

97940.original: シャーロット・ローズレイ
97940.desc: __Height:__ 171 cm Charlotte is a noblewoman of House Roselei and the captain of Clover Kingdom's Blue Rose squad of the Magic Knights. She appears as a quiet, cold, and indifferent woman who keeps her emotions controlled and well hidden. She is constantly shown to appear as a rather stern woman, despite inwardly having an inward monologue that constantly appears to say calm down, especially around [Yami Sukehiro](https://anilist.co/character/124440/Sukehiro-Yami). She often does not respond to situations that go out of hand, preferring to appear indifferent and let things play out. She does respond well to emergencies and pressing concerns, performing her duties and moving swiftly to take care of any problems that come up. However, she still is capable of losing her composure and becoming annoyed, which almost always involves Yami teasing of her. She is also a lightweight when it comes to alcohol, barely able to finish a pint before becoming drunk. Charlotte considers her duty to the kingdom to be her foremost responsibility, with little interest in the social aspects of life. Her beauty is quite noticeable when she chooses to show it, but she is more comfortable in plate mail than silk dresses and cares little for the opinions of most others. She also has a hard time being open with most people and expressing herself on occasion. That said, she often quips back at her fellow captains when they make rash decisions or do something she considers stupid, particularly Yami. Howe
