97940.desc: Rick is a 3rd Class Intermediate Magic Knight of Clover Kingdom's Coral Peacock squad.

97940.name: Francis
97940.desc: Francis is a member of the Clover Kingdom's Azure Deer squad of the Magic Knights.

97940.name: Liebe
97940.desc: ~!Liebe is the devil who resides within Licht's former grimoire, which is currently Asta's grimoire. He is the source behind Asta's Anti Magic.!~

97940.name: Licita
97940.desc: Licita was the foster mother of Liebe, the devil that currently recides within Asta's grimoire. She died protecting him from Lucifero. ~!In chapter 270, it was confirmed that she is Asta's mother.!~

97940.name: Loyce Grinberryall
97940.original: ロイス・グリンベリオール
97940.desc: Loyce Grinberryall was the King of the Spade Kingdom, alongside his wife Ciel Grinberryall, untill the Zogratis Siblings attacked the palace and overthrew the royal family. ~!It is later revealed by Ralph Niaflem, that he is the father of Yuno.!~

97940.name: Ciel Grinberryall
97940.original: シエルグ・リンベリオール
97940.desc: Ciel Grinberryall was the Queen of the Spade Kingdom, alongside her husband Loyce Grinberryall until the Zogratis Siblings attacked the palace and overthrew the royal family. ~!It is later revealed by Ralph Niaflem, that she is the mother of Yuno.!~

97940.name: Bou Nokude
97940.desc: Bow Nocde is an exiled commoner of the Clover Kingdom and a member of the Devil Believers. She works as an apothecary in Tiulyu.

97940.name: Dazuu Tayaku
97940.desc: Dazu Tayak is an exiled commoner of the Clover Kingdom and a member of the Devil Believers.

97940.name: Svenkin Gatard
97940.original: ガタードスヴェンキン

97940.name: Moris Libardirt
97940.desc: Moris Libardirt is a Magic Scholar who is controlling the king of the Diamond Kingdom. After being forced out by Mars, Moris begins working for the Dark Triad of the Spade Kingdom.

97940.name: Halbet Chevour
97940.original: シュヴールハールベート

97940.name: Willie
97940.desc: Willie is a member of the Clover Kingdom's Green Mantis squad of the Magic Knights.

97940.name: Nix
97940.desc: Nix is a member of Clover Kingdom's Green Mantis squad of the Magic Knights.

97940.name: Galleo
97940.desc: Galleo is the commander of the Diamond Kingdom assassination squad.

97940.name: Sarado
97940.desc: Sarado is a Spirit Guardian of the Heart Kingdom.

97940.name: Smurik
97940.desc: Smurik is a Spirit Guardian of the Heart Kingdom.

97940.name: Floga
97940.desc: Floga is a Spirit Guardian of the Heart Kingdom.

97940.name: Potrof
97940.desc: Potrof is a Spirit Guardian of the Heart Kingdom.

97940.name: Abari
97940.desc: Abari is a rogue mage and a member of the Eye of the Midnight Sun.

97940.name: Nilenia Agrippa
97940.original: ニレニア・アグリッパ
97940.desc: Nilenia Agrippa is a commoner of the Clover Kingdom and the grandmother of Gordon Agrippa.

97940.name: Helene Barbary
97940.original: エレーヌ・バーバリー

97940.name: Ben Benfunk
97940.desc: Ben Benfunk is a member of Clover Kingdom's Crimson Lion squad of the Magic Knights. He is a 4th Class Senior Magic Knight.

97940.name: Charla
97940.desc: Charla belonged to the elf tribe 500 years prior to the present events. ~!After the reincarnation spell takes place, Charla possesses Charlotte Roselei and fights Yami Sukehiro to briefly incapacitate him at the Royal Capital before meeting each other again at the Shadow Palace, this time to team-up against the devil Zagred.!~

97940.name: Jonna Agrippa
97940.desc: Jonna Agrippa is a commoner of the Clover Kingdom and the mother of Gordon Agrippa.

97940.name: Roxanne Agrippa
97940.original: ロクサーヌ・アグリッパ
97940.desc: Roxanne Agrippa is a commoner of the Clover Kingdom and the sister of Gordon Agrippa.

97940.name: Kabwe Carillon
97940.desc: Kabwe Carillon is a guard for the Clover Kingdom's Magic Parliament and a member of the Devil Banishers.

97940.name: Drowa
97940.desc: Drowa is an elf and one of the ten Apostles of Sephirah.

101291.name: Sakuta Azusagawa
101291.desc: __Height:__ 172 cm (5'7") A strange 2nd year student in high school, who doesn't have a cellphone in this day and age. He is currently an outcast at school due to rumors of a violent past... but doesn't seem to care. ~!Sakuta eventually starts dating [Mai Sakurajima](https://anilist.co/character/127222)!~ (Source: Aniplex USA)

101291.name: Mai Sakurajima
101291.desc: __Height:__ 162 cm (5'4") A 3rd-year student at Minegahara High School. She is serious and polite, but has a strong will. Well known, famous actress, who is currently on hiatus. Because her life had always revolved around her work in entertainment, she remains isolated at school. (Source: Aniplex USA)

101291.name: Kaede Azusagawa
101291.desc: __Height:__ 5'4" (162 cm) She is the younger sister of Sakuta Azusagawa. ~!Suffered amnesia and gained a different personality after her ordeal with Adolescence Syndrome stemming from online bullying. Since then, she has lived with Sakuta and has not attended school.!~

101291.name: Rio Futaba
101291.desc: __Height:__ 155 cm (5'1") __Talent:__ Explaining any strange phenomenon with science She is [Sakuta](https://anilist.co/character/127221/Azusagawa-Sakuta)'s classmate, who is always cool and calm, always willing to give various advice on puberty syndrome. She is also the sole member of the Science Club, and known as an eccentric person at the school. (Source: Aniplex USA)

101291.name: Tomoe Koga
101291.desc: __Height:__ 150 cm (4'11") A typical 1st year high-school student at Minegahara High School who can take hints, but is slightly scatterbrained. Being overly concerned about how people look at her, she hides her Hakata accent, which comes out when she panics or is relaxed. (Source: Aniplex USA, edited)

101291.name: Nodoka Toyohama
101291.desc: __Height:__ 158cm (5'2") __Talent:__ Changing clothes quickly Mai's half-sister, related through her father. A member of the idol group "Sweet Bullet" and designated as the most fashionable within the group. Despite her flashy looks, she attends an elite all girls' high school. She is confident and can be competitive. (Source: Aniplex USA)

101291.name: Shouko Makinohara
101291.desc: __Height:__ 150 cm (4'11") __Talent:__ Early to bed, early to rise A girl who has the same first and last name as [Sakuta](https://anilist.co/character/127221/Azusagawa-Sakuta)'s first crush. She is a shy middle school girl, but reliable and kind. She bumps into Sakuta, while holding an umbrella over an abandoned cat in the rain. ~!It is later revealed that the older Shouko that Sakuta encounters is from the future, and is able to return to the past due to her puberty syndrome.!~

101291.name: Saki Kamisato
101291.desc: [Yuuma](https://anilist.co/character/130307/Yuuma-Kunimi)'s girlfriend. Popular within the school and can be a standoffish person, but she shows great affection towards Yuuma. She is quite protective of him and often clashes with [Sakuta](https://anilist.co/character/127221/Sakuta-Azusagawa) as a result. ~!It is revealed that Saki has an older sister whom her parents often compare her to, causing her to develop low self-esteem. Sakuta believes this to be the reason why she is so protective of Yuuma's image and her own, as in her eyes she already has a fragile self-image.!~ ~!After graduating she attends the same college as Sakuta and goes into health studies, in the hopes of becoming a nurse in order to help Yuuma whenever she can due to his decision to partake in firefighter training.!~

101291.name: Yousuke Maesawa
101291.desc: A member of the school basketball team. He has an attractive and charming demeanor, but he is ultimately not above slandering other students. Maezawa has bad-mouthed all of his past girlfriends.

101291.name: Mai no Haha
101291.desc: She is the mother of Mai Sakurajima.

101291.name: Yuuma Kunimi
101291.desc: A good friend of [Sakuta Azusagawa](https://anilist.co/character/127221/Sakuta-Azusagawa) and [Rio Futaba](https://anilist.co/character/127633/Rio-Futaba), as well as the boyfriend of [Saki Kamisato](https://anilist.co/character/130304). He is a member of Minegahara High's basketball team, being quite athletic and popular within the school.

101291.name: Uzuki Hirokawa
101291.desc: The lead singer of idol group Sweet Bullet. Her nickname is Zukky.

101291.name: Nana Yoneyama
101291.desc: She is a classmate of Tomoe Koga.

101291.name: Nodoka no Haha
101291.desc: She is the mother of Nodoka Toyohama.

140960.name: Narrator
140960.desc: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

140960.name: Anya Forger
140960.original: アーニャ・フォージャー
140960.desc: __Height:__ 99.5 cm (3'2") __Occupation:__ First-Grade Student, Test Subject (Formerly) __Affiliation:__ Eden Academy, Unknown Organization (Formerly) __Relatives:__ Loid Forger (Adoptive Father), Yor Forger (Adoptive Mother) Anya Forger is the deuteragonist of the SPY x FAMILY series. She is a young girl who Twilight finds at an orphanage. Believing her to be a smart child, he decides to adopt her for his mission. What he doesn't know is that Anya is an esper who escaped from the Lab that gave her the power to read minds. Starving for excitement in her life after spending most of it so far in a lab, Anya actively sought to be the one adopted by Loid and then make sure Loid and Yor got together, so she could have a spy and assassin for parents. Anya is the only Forger aware of just about everyone's Secret Identities, but keeps it to herself out of fear that if her psychic powers are exposed she'll be put in a lab again.

140960.name: Loid Forger
140960.original: ロイド・フォージャー
140960.desc: __Height:__ 187 cm __Occupation:__ Psychiatrist, Spy (Covertly) __Affiliation:__ Berlint General Hospital, WISE (Covertly) __Relatives:__ Yor Forger (Wife), Anya Forger (Adoptive Daughter) Loid Forger is the main protagonist of the SPY x FAMILY series. He is the top spy of the Westalian Intelligence Bureau, who is only known by his code name Twilight. In order to investigate the activities of a highly ranked politician, Donovan Desmond , Twilight has assumed the identity of a psychiatrist named Loid Forger. Further, to appear like a normal family man and get close to his target, Loid then adopted a young orphan girl, Anya , and entered a Marriage of Convenience with an Ostanian woman named Yor Briar ... who unknown to Twilight are themselves a Telepath and Professional Killer respectively.

140960.name: Yor Forger
140960.desc: __Height:__ 170 cm __Occupation:__ City Hall Clerk, Assassin (Covertly) __Affiliation:__ Berlint City Hall, Garden (Covertly) __Relatives:__ [Loid Forger](https://anilist.co/character/138101/Loid-Forger) (Husband), [Anya Forger](https://anilist.co/character/138100/Anya-Forger) (Adoptive Daughter), [Yuuri Briar](https://anilist.co/character/150425/Yuuri-Briar) (Younger Brother) Yor Forger is the tritagonist of the SPY x FAMILY series. She is a clerical employee at the Berlint City Hall. She is soft-spoken and mild-mannered, but has a strong sense of humor. She has a bad drinking habit and falls into a coma when she drinks. At home, she struggles to be a good wife and a kind mother. Although her cooking skills are not very good, she likes to keep clean and is good at cleaning. While she works in the capital of Ostania's city hall... or at least that's her civilian cover. In truth, she is an infamous Professional Killer known as "Thorn Princess". After becoming overly fixated on the idea her cover might be blown after a coworker ribs her about not being married or even having a boyfriend, Yor suggests to Loid a Marriage of Convenience, which he accepts, as he needs a mother for Anya for his own mission. ~!As of Mission (Chapter) 44, it is revealed that Yor is part of Garden, a powerful paramilitary assassin organization operating within Ostania.!~

140960.name: Becky Blackbell
140960.original: ベッキー・ブラックベル
140960.desc: __Affiliation:__ Blackbell Family, Blackbell Heavy Industries, Eden Academy, Cecile Hall __Occupation:__ Student The daughter of the CEO of Blackbell, a major military manufacturer. Attends Eden Academy as part of Cecil House, Group 3. Best friends with Anya Forger. Becky is a very kind child but with her being the daughter of a major military manufacturer, she is shown to be somewhat prideful and tries to be mature, attempting to take Anya under her wing as an act of benevolence when she views Anya as a brat. She does not attempt to get close to Damian Desmond despite his social position, even looking down on their classmates who try to befriend Damian and Anya who is initially bullied by Damian's group. Anya's confident smile later wins over Becky's admiration.

140960.name: Damian Desmond
140960.original: ダミアン・デズモンド
140960.desc: __Height:__ 110 cm (3′7″) __Affiliation:__ Desmond Family, Eden Academy, Cecile Hall __Occupation:__ Student The second son of [Donovan Desmond](https://anilist.co/character/180192/Desmond-Donovan) and attends Eden Academy as part of Cecile House, Group 3. A young child with an arrogant and rude personality, caused by him being the second son of Donovan Desmond, the leader of the National Unity Party, a group important and powerful enough to threaten the peace between the East and the West. This has caused Damian to gain a highly respected status among his peers and making him incredibly arrogant, assuming [Anya](https://anilist.co/character/138100/Forger-Anya) gained a crush on him when she stared at him. He is shown to prefer being called Lord Damian when spoken to. He gets angry when he is looked down upon by Anya's smile, quickly resorting to insulting her with his limited vocabulary and harassing Anya.

140960.name: Yuuri Briar
140960.desc: __Height:__ 179 cm (5′10") __Affiliation:__ Ostania, Ministry for Foreign Affairs (Cover), State Security Service __Occupation:__ Diplomat (Formerly, Cover), Counterintelligence Agent Yor Briar's younger brother who works in the State Security Service (SSS). He keeps his job at the SSS a secret from Yor, while pretending to be a normal civil servant at the foreign ministry. Yuri has a sister-complex, and even at an early age, he would be doing everything he could to get Yor to praise him with affection. Though this could be due to his mother dying at a very early stage in his life causing him to get very attached to Yor as a mother figure.

140960.name: Sylvia Sherwood
140960.original: シルヴィア・シャーウッド
140960.desc: She is [Twilight](https://anilist.co/character/138101/Forger-Loid)'s main contact at WISE.

140960.name: Franky Franklin
140960.original: フランキー・フランクリン
140960.desc: __Height:__ 166 cm (5′5") __Affiliation:__ Ostania __Occupation:__ Tobacco Store Clerk (False Front), Informant, Soldier (formerly) Franky is an informant who seemingly works at a tobacco store and presumably works for Loid Forger's agency. He gets information regarding Eden Academy's exam and Anya Forger's past records for Loid Forger. Franky is a kind person willing to help Loid out when he's in a pinch even though the danger is high. He frequently warns Loid Forger not to get too close to other people in their line of work. He frequently falls in love with other women but his love life typically fails due to lack of mutual interest or they are already with someone else.

140960.name: Bond
140960.desc: Bond is the recently adopted pet of the Forger Family. Formally known as Subject 8, Bond has been used for experiments that resulted in the dog gaining precognition abilities.

140960.name: Henry Henderson
140960.original: ヘンリー・ヘンダーソン
140960.desc: __Affiliation:__ Eden Academy __Occupation:__ History Teacher, Housemaster of Cecile Hall Henry is a mature and noble person, who places a high importance on "elegance". To him, elegance seems to be the way a person conducts themselves, and is not afraid to correct inelegant behavior in others.

140960.name: Camilla
140960.desc: One of Yor Forger's three co-workers at Berlint City Hall.

140960.name: Donovan Desmond
140960.original: ドノバン・デズモンド
140960.desc: Donovan Desmond is the President of the Nation Unity Party and Twilight's current target.

140960.name: Ewen Egeburg
140960.original: ユーイン・エッジバーグ
140960.desc: Best Friend of Damian and Student at Eden Academy. He is a loyal person, devotedly following Damian, almost always holding his bag when they walk to class. He also genuinely cares for Damian as a friend, getting concerned for Damian when he is hurt or pushing himself too hard.

140960.name: Emile Elman
140960.original: エミールぅ・エルマン
140960.desc: Best Friend of Damian and Student at Eden Academy.

140960.name: Bondman
140960.desc: The protagonist of Spy Wars and the number one spy in the show. He frequently has to take down enemies from the League of Evil in order to save Princess Honey.

140960.name: Edgar
140960.desc: The father of Karen and the boss of an unknown organization in Ostania. He expresses strong hostility towards Westalis and their people. He antagonizes Twilight by kidnapping Anya Forger in an attempt to blackmail Twilight into working for him.

140960.name: Karen
140960.desc: The daughter of Edgar. Twilight formerly dated her as "Robert" with the intention of investigating her father. Karen is known to have participated in a fair amount of criminal activity, enough to get her in trouble if Loid so wishes.

140960.name: Murdoch Swan
140960.desc: The Economics Teacher and the Housemaster of Dormitory 2, Cline Hall at Eden Academy. He is the only son of the former Headmaster of Eden Academy. His wife filed for divorce a month before the Eden Academy admissions interview, where she won full custody of their only daughter.

140960.name: Walter Evans
140960.original: ウォルター・エバンス
140960.desc: The English Teacher and the Housemaster of Dormitory 5, Malcom Hall at Eden Academy. He is regarded as gentle, reliable, conservative and well-liked by his students.

140960.name: Benedict Goodfellow
140960.original: ベネディクト・アイヴァン・グッドフェラー
140960.desc: Current headmaster of Eden Academy. During the entrance ceremony for the new Eden Academy students, he gives a speech welcoming them. According to some facility members, he does not accept "donations" from parents and cannot be bought.

140960.name: Honey-hime
140960.desc: Princess of the kingdom where Spy Wars takes place. She is frequently saved by Bondman which has caused her to develop feelings for him.

140960.name: Jim Hayward
140960.desc: He was an informant for WISE working at Berlint City Hall in the financial department. He was caught selling documents to WISE agents in photographs by [Yuuri Briar](https://anilist.co/character/150425/Yuuri-Briar).

140960.name: Burns
140960.desc: Section chief of Berlint City Hall, overseeing the work of [Yor Forger](https://anilist.co/character/138102/Yor-Forger), [Camilla](https://anilist.co/character/180191/Camilla), [Millie](https://anilist.co/character/270958/Millie), and [Sharon](https://anilist.co/character/270959/Sharon).

140960.name: Bill Watkins
140960.desc: The 6-year-old son of a major in the National Army who attends Eden Academy as part of Wald Hall. He was given the nickname "Bazooka Bill" by his peers for his mental and physical domination in sports since nursery school.

140960.name: Kokkahoankyoku Chuui
140960.desc: A scarred man who is a lieutenant and a higher position than [Yuuri Briar](https://anilist.co/character/150425/Yuuri-Briar) in the SSS. He seems to be fairly close to Yuuri and is aware of his drinking habits and sister complex, advising Yuri to get over his sister and focus on his work.

140960.name: Kokkahoankyoku Kyokuchou
140960.desc: The boss of the SSS who dotes on [Yuuri](https://anilist.co/character/150425/Yuuri-Briar) because he finds him adorable like a puppy.

140960.name: Kojiin no Shujin
140960.desc: An inebriated middle-aged man who is the owner of the orphanage where Anya Forger is adopted by Loid Forger. He is apathetic about his orphanage, as shown by the neglected state of the children and his indifference to Loid's given background. He thinks of Anya as a "creepy little brat", attempting to give her away to Loid upon hearing he wants a literate child. (Source: Spy x Family Wiki)

140960.name: Bondman no Shirei-kan
140960.desc: He is the headman of Bondman's organization.

140960.name: Shitateya no Tenin
140960.desc: An elderly lady who works as a clerk at Mona & Monacca.

140960.name: Shitateya no Tenshu
140960.desc: The owner of Mona & Monacca, a tailor shop in Berlint. She was one of [Loid](https://anilist.co/character/138101/Forger-Loid)'s candidates as an unmarried woman, but was rejected due to having been arrested for political activities in the past and her somewhat older age. When the Forgers come to her shop to purchase Eden Academy's uniforms for [Anya](https://anilist.co/character/138100/Forger-Anya), she warns them about the bullying and kidnappings in Eden Academy. She also appears to be familiar with [Yor](https://anilist.co/character/138102/Forger-Yor) as she is suggested to be a regular at the shop.

101921.name: Narrator
101921.desc: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

101921.name: Kaguya Shinomiya
101921.desc: __Height:__ 158 cm The vice president of the student council of Shuchiin Academy, member of the wealthy Shinomiya family, she is a multi-talented genius who can do anything if she sets her mind to it. Due to the way she was raised, she instinctively looks down on others and thinks of ways to use them for her own benefit. Kaguya rarely interacted with other people before she joined the student council, but that has begun to change. She is an incredibly sheltered girl, resulting in her lacking in several pieces of what might be considered common sense. She still doesn’t understand love very well, and her main objective is to make [Miyuki Shirogane](https://anilist.co/character/121101) fall in love and confess to her. Later in the series: ~!She confesses her love to Miyuki Shirogane and they start dating.!~ ~!In a Oshi no Ko special chapter, it was revealed that she married Miyuki and changed her surname to Kaguya Shirogane!~

101921.name: Miyuki Shirogane
101921.desc: __Height:__ 175 cm He is a second year student at Shuchi'in Academy and the president of the student council. Miyuki is a handsome young man with blond hair and blue eyes. Due to his constant sleep deprivation and nearsightedness, his eyes appear to glare. He usually wears the regular Shuchi'in Academy black male uniform adorned with the Aiguilette, the golden chain-like accessory around his neck. The Aiguilette symbolizes his authority as student council president. Shirogane is a diligent student who, despite his underprivileged background, climbed his way to the top of his class through hard work and determination. Shirogane holds himself in high regard, consistently working to maintain his perfect image. He is textbook workaholic, enjoying his part-time job and often putting his own health at risk for the sake of his work. Due to his poor background, Shirogane values money greatly and goes to great lengths to not be wasteful, and generally dislikes expensive gifts. ~!Miyuki's mother left his family when he was a child. Miyuki's father's factory was shut down and currently has no stable employment. They live in an apartment that costs ￥50,000 (Approx $450) a month. Due to this grisly past, he has been led to a lifestyle of part time jobs and hard work. He passed the Level 2 Kanji Kentei exam and has passed Grade Pre 1 on Eiken. He has also got second place on the National mock exam.!~ ~!Miyuki transferred into Shuchi'in Academy during his first year of high school on a scho

101921.name: Yuu Ishigami
101921.desc: The treasurer of the student council of the Shuchiin Academy. He's extremely valued by [Miyuki](https://anilist.co/character/121101), given that he single-handedly manages all the school's funds. He's also terrified of [Kaguya](https://anilist.co/character/120649), though no one else is sure why that is. Yuu keeps to himself and rarely speaks up, often getting into trouble when he does. He has a depressed outlook on life while having an inferiority complex. In contrast to his attitude, he is willing to help those in need and will sacrifice his pride if need be. Unlike his high school self, he had a much different outlook and demeanor during middle school. Later in the series: ~!Ishigami develops a crush on Tsubame that he inadvertently confesses his feelings for her at the school's cultural festival. Ishigami does not realize that his actions were perceived as a confession by the rest of the student body and is therefore oblivious to the implications of having given Tsubame a heart-shaped gift (considered akin to a confession in Shuchiin tradition). After some convincing by Kaguya, Tsubame decides to seriously consider Ishigami's confession, with her original intention being to let him down as gently as possible. It isn't until Ishigami watches Tsubame's performance of the traditional play that gave rise to the aforementioned tradition that he realizes his actions had unintended meaning. Even then, Ishigami's thickheaded nature prevented him from recognizing the full meaning

101921.name: Chika Fujiwara
101921.desc: The secretary of the Shuchiin Academy student council. She could not be predicted, her thoughts could not be read. A natural disaster who unconsciously threw everything into chaos simply by being present, also known as __Subject F__. ~!In chapter 222 of the manga, Chika reveals that she played piano because she wanted to be perfect, and she becomes a prodigy at the piano. The expectations of her family and her fans rose, forcing her to practice more. She quit piano after Kaguya told her to just quit if she didn't like the piano. Soon after Chika challenged Kaguya to a game battle and if she won, she would get to become Kaguya's friend. In the end, she becomes Kaguya's first friend.!~

101921.name: Ai Hayasaka
101921.desc: Ai Hayasaka is a second-year student at Shuchiin Academy and a valet of the Shinomiya family. She is a member of the Hayasaka family, who have served the Shinomiya family for generations, gaining their trust. Having been personally assigned to enter Shuchiin Academy with her, Ai supports [Kaguya Shinomiya](https://anilist.co/character/120649) in her high school life and has been a part of Kaguya's life for ten years. Because of their close relationship, Ai is one of the few people around to which Kaguya's amiability is not an act. Even if she demonstrates maturity as a valet, Ai still has the concerns of a young girl, such as caring to be in fashion and going out with friends, even if she does not have much time for herself due to work. Ai helps Kaguya with the struggles about her feelings for [Shirogane](https://anilist.co/character/121101). ~!She later leaves her job as a maid to Kaguya but still continues her friendship.!~ ~!In the Doujin-ban universe, she starts dating and later gets engaged to Shirogane!~

101921.name: Miko Iino
101921.desc: __Height:__ 147 cm (4'7") She is a freshman at Shuchiin Private Academy and the Auditor of the Student Council. Miko has a strong sense of justice and will correct others on what's right and wrong. Unfortunately, this led to her being bullied, though she still continues to uphold her idea of "right". She idolizes [Chika Fujiwara](https://anilist.co/character/121103), listening to anything she says, even if it's for Chika's enjoyment.

101921.name: Kei Shirogane
101921.desc: Kei Shirogane is [Miyuki Shirogane's](https://anilist.co/character/121101) little sister. She attends Shuchiin middle school and is the treasurer for the middle school student council. She is a hard worker just like her brother and can be very prideful at times. She also inherited his sense of righteousness and hates it when someone doesn't do the right thing in a given situation. Like her brother, she likes helping out those who are in trouble even if it means going out of her way to do it. Since she grew up in a family that places emphasis on saving money, she normally carries coupons and works hard for the things she wants to buy. She developed a prickly attitude towards her brother due to his over protectiveness. She's also entered a rebellious phase and due to her pride and she cannot get herself to have a lighthearted conversation with Miyuki, leading into the similar mind games that Miyuki and [Kaguya](https://anilist.co/character/120649) play against each other, but her objective is to talk to Miyuki without making it look like she has a brother complex. She rarely speaks and most of the time it is only when she exchanges formalities at school or when she hurls abuses at her brother.

101921.name: Erika Kose
101921.desc: She is a member of the mass media club at Shuchi'in Academy.

101921.name: Karen Kino
101921.desc: She is a member of the mass media club at Shuchi'in Academy.

101921.name: Tsubasa Tanuma
101921.desc: He is a student in Shuchi'in highschool and always asks [Miyuki Shirogane](https://anilist.co/character/121101) for advice about love. [Kashiwagi](https://anilist.co/character/134330)'s boyfriend.

101921.name: Maki Shijo
101921.desc: Maki is a classmate and friend of [Nagisa](https://anilist.co/character/134330). She has short hair styled in short pigtails. She is friends with Nagisa and is secretly jealous of Nagisa's relationship with her boyfriend, as she too liked Kashiwagi's Boyfriend, but could not confess before. As a branch member of the Shinomiya clan, she is [Kaguya](https://anilist.co/character/120649)'s second cousin twice removed so she sometimes refers to Kaguya as "Auntie". [Miyuki](https://anilist.co/character/121101) and [Yuu](https://anilist.co/character/121102/Yuu-Ishigami) observe she acts very tsundere (cold on the outside but wanting to be affectionate), and similar to Kaguya in personality. She declares Yuu and Miyuki as her friends, due to their support in helping her process her failed romance, much to Kaguya's horror

101921.name: Moeha Fujiwara
101921.desc: Moeha is [Chika](https://anilist.co/character/121103)'s little sister who is in junior high. She is the student council vice-president at the junior high. She admires [Miyuki](https://anilist.co/character/121101) as well and hopes to confess someday. She has a habit of voicing dark ideas, which unnerve [Kaguya](https://anilist.co/character/120649) a great deal.

101921.name: Nagisa Kashiwagi
101921.desc: Nagisa is a classmate who occasionally asks [Kaguya](https://anilist.co/character/120649) about what to do in her relationships. [Tsubasa](https://anilist.co/character/134327)'s girlfriend.

101921.name: Kobachi Osaragi
101921.desc: Kobachi is [Miko](https://anilist.co/character/125886)'s classmate with the glasses and a member of the disciplinary committee. She has been looking after Miko for over 10 years. ~!Though she doesn't love him in a romantic way, she has liked Yu Ishigami since middle school. She believes that Tsubame Koyasu is a kind person and is therefore supportive of Ishigami's feelings for Tsubame, despite her friend Miko being in love with Ishigami as well.!~

101921.name: Betsy Beltoise
101921.original: べルトクーズ・べツィー
101921.desc: The vice president of Shuchi'in Academy's sister school in France.

101921.name: Adolphe Pescarolo
101921.original: アドルフ・ペスカローロ
101921.desc: The Principal of Shuchi'in Academy He's strict regarding school regulations, but knows how to garner the favor of students nonetheless. He helped Yu Ishigami get enrolled to Shuchi'in despite not finishing his task of making an apology letter. Despite being an authority figure within the school, he has shown comical disregard for school rules and discipline when it comes to his own actions, having been openly caught playing Pokemon Go on more than one occasion on school grounds while chastising nearby students for doing the same.

101921.name: Shirogane no Chichi
101921.desc: Father of [Miyuki](https://anilist.co/character/121101) and [Kei Shirogane](https://anilist.co/character/126144). ~!His wife left him and their factory shut down leaving him to not have any stable employment.!~ ~!He later becomes a youtuber.!~

101921.name: Saburo Odajima
101921.desc: One of the Four Ramen Emperors of Tokyo. In the past, Saburo was in a relationship with [The Glutton Girl of Jinbocho](https://anilist.co/character/276380/Jinbouchou-no-Glutton-Girl), but he broke up with her over their polar opposite ramen styles, believing they'll eventually end up at each other's throats.

101921.name: Toyomi Fujiwara
101921.desc: Toyomi Fujiwara is Chika Fujiwara and Moeha Fujiwara's eldest sister. Toyomi is a girl that likes to wear revealing outfits, her hair is similar to Chika's except that she tied hers with a flower shaped clip to go down on her left shoulder. She usually wears an aloof expression on her face. Toyomi is the laid back older sister type, who is very seductive and does whatever she likes, even against her own parents wishes.

101921.name: Ienaga
101921.desc: An elementary school student

101921.name: J Suzuki
101921.desc: A taxi driver and one of the Four Ramen Emperors of Tokyo.

101921.name: Miki
101921.desc: An elementary school student

101921.name: Pes
101921.desc: Pes is the beloved pet dog of [Chika Fujiwara](https://anilist.co/character/121103/Chika-Fujiwara). He is quite a large dog, with golden fur and floppy ears. He has piercing eyes like [the president](https://anilist.co/character/121101/Miyuki-Shirogane)

101921.name: Maki
101921.desc: Hoped to hangout with Takkun, but he prioritized soccer instead. She does wanna cheer for him.

101921.name: Tenchou
101921.desc: A ramen chef

101921.name: Shitsuji
101921.desc: One of the butler's assigned to [Kaguya](https://anilist.co/character/120649/Kaguya-Shinomiya)

101921.name: Subaru Suruga
101921.desc: One of [Ai Hayasaka](https://anilist.co/character/121104/)'s closest friends. She wears her Shuchi'in Academy school uniform modified to match up with kogal fashion. She is the daughter of the president of an IT company.

101921.name: Mirin Hinokuchi
101921.desc: One of [Ai Hayasaka](https://anilist.co/character/121104/)'s closest friends. She wears her Shuchi'in Academy school uniform modified to match up with kogal fashion. She is the daughter of an advertising executive.

105333.name: Ryokan Kurita
105333.desc: Position: Center / Defensive Tackle / Long snapper Jersey: 77 40 yard dash: 6.5 seconds Bench Press: 160 kg (352 lb) Height: 195 cm (6' 4") Weight: 145 kg (319 lb) Graduated From: Mao 13th Middle School 2nd Year Student (Grade 11) The largest and strongest player in the Deimon American Football club. Kurita lives in a temple with his father, who is the director of a Buddhist sect. His father believed that to grow up big and strong, a young boy had to eat a lot, but unfortunately it seems he has overfed his son. Kurita, as his name would suggest, has a head shaped like a chestnut. He is a very sweet, kind-hearted individual and the only thing bigger than his body is his heart. He became Sena's second friend after entering Deimon High School. When playing, Kurita shouts his kiai "Funnuraba!" when exerting extra effort. Before coming to Deimon, he attended the Shinryuji school, but was forced out because Kongo Agon was chosen over him for the special athletic scholarship, so he came to Deimon High along with Hiruma and Musashi. Like Hiruma. Kurita is crazy about American football and tries to encourage everyone to join though he does not go to the same extremes as his demonic compatriot. He can get so worked up that he's been known to begin morning practice as early as 2:00 AM. His "apprentice" is Komusubi, who practices with him whenever he can. His biggest dream is to compete in the Christmas Bowl. He is somewhat dim-witted (nearly giving away Sena's other identity) and is ins

105333.name: Narrator
105333.desc: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

105333.name: Senkuu Ishigami
105333.desc: __Height:__ 171 cm (5'7") Senkuu is a genius with a vast amount of scientific knowledge. He is able to invent various kinds of tools and gadgets in a short amount of time with ease. As a child, he designed and built a functioning miniature rocket ship. Senkuu also possesses an analytical mind, being able to correctly discern the situation he is in. Even in his pre-teens, he was intelligent and sharp-minded enough to create advanced machines. Senkuu's physical abilities are very low and he would lose against someone like [Kohaku](https://anilist.co/character/124143) in a brawl, something he himself admits. ~!In "Village Games Arc" Senku unintentionally won and married [Ruri](https://anilist.co/character/143272), but divorced immediately afterwards.!~

105333.name: Kohaku
105333.desc: __Height:__ 160 cm (5'3") Kohaku is a young woman who is a descendant of modern humans. She is Ruri's younger sister and the daughter of Kokuyo. She appears to be well known in her village due to her combative abilities, as both Kinro and Ginro were afraid of her. Kohaku excels at fighting, hunting, and general survival skills. She is a tomboy by nature, having little interest in more typical feminine activities and has little knowledge about them, although she does seem to enjoy some lavish clothing that was provided to her. She possesses a sharp instinct and intellect. Kohaku is a kind young woman, caring deeply for her sickly older sister, willing to participate in the tournament for her hand in marriage just to protect her. This care extends to her comrades, and anyone she's loyal to. In addition to this, she has a reckless and hotheaded personality, often reacting in anger to being called a gorilla or lioness due to her strength and physicality. She also acts on her emotions at times, going against rational thought. She also has a bit of a teasing side, asking Chrome if he could fall for her to her resemblance to her sister.

105333.name: Tsukasa Shishiou
105333.desc: __Height:__ 195 cm (6'4") According to [Taiju](https://anilist.co/character/124146/Ooki-Taiju), Tsukasa has the reputation as "The Strongest High School Primate" due to his tremendous fighting abilities. Tsukasa is essentially violent, but extremely careful and aware of his actions. He is a very kind, thoughtful, and polite man outside of his pessimistic ideals towards humanity. He offers help in the beginning to [Senku](https://anilist.co/character/124142/Ishigami-Senkuu) and Taiju after they revive him and becomes their hunter for food, using his skills as a prominent athlete to aid them. It’s revealed later that Tsukasa plans to purge humanity of adults who hurt the young and weak, then thinks Senku will go along with him, but instead Senku rejects him. After this point, Tsukasa becomes fairly determined in carrying out his plans even to the point of leaving their group.

105333.name: Chrome
105333.desc: __Height:__ 170 cm (5'7") Chrome is the alleged sorcerer - eventually turned scientist - of Ishigami Village. As part of the Kingdom of Science, Chrome serves as the unofficial right hand of [Senku](https://anilist.co/character/124142/Ishigami-Senkuu); this trust is what makes him one of the Five Wise Generals. Chrome is a highly energetic person with a lot of passion and curiosity. He is genuinely interested in science, although at first, he only knows it as sorcery. He is confident in his intellect, enough so to go toe to toe with Senku despite getting destroyed in a battle of wits. He also has a tendency to refer to something as "bad" when he thinks it is cool or amazing. Chrome has a deep love of science, though he admits his expertise and knowledge lies mainly in exploration, particularly pertaining to rocks and minerals and gathering them. He is loyal and selfless to his friends and, while lacking in physical abilities, he is still able to think of clever solutions out of dangerous situations. He is also exceedingly brave, and in addition, while he is usually a loudmouth, he knows when to keep his mouth shut. He loves science and, in many ways, is an accomplished scientist in his own right, managing to create chemical reactions from the rocks he collected through frequent trial and error (reactions which were only made known in the seventeenth century), despite never knowing this knowledge before Senku's arrival.

105333.name: Taiju Ooki
105333.desc: __Height:__ 189 cm (6'2½") Taiju is an outgoing, friendly, and kind person. He's enthusiastic about performing even small tasks and a diligent worker. He is very determined when something is important to him. He tends to yell loudly and is enthusiastic regardless of the task so long as he proves useful. He is persistent and determined. Despite being emotional and expressive, he has great control of his temper, never losing his cool or acting impulsively. Taiju possesses an extremely sturdy body, something his friend [Senku](https://anilist.co/character/124142) vouches him for. He is the first human to be able to withstand a kick from [Tsukasa](https://anilist.co/character/124144) without losing consciousness. He also possesses immense stamina, able to cross 80 kilometers in 5 hours.

105333.name: Yuzuriha Ogawa
105333.desc: Yuzuriha is the love interest of [Taiju](https://anilist.co/character/124146) and a friend of [Senkuu](https://anilist.co/character/124142). Yuzuriha is a young woman with brown hair, brown eyes, and a slim build. She has two noticeable petrification scars, both in the shape of spirals, located on her shoulder and neck. Before her petrification, Yuzuriha wears a standard High School Uniform. After her depetrification, she wears a white cloth dress that's spit at her sides and matching cloth shoes. Noticeably, Yuzuriha wears a white hairband that's vaguely shaped like wrap-around headphones, both before and after her petrification.

105333.name: Suika
105333.desc: __Height:__ 119 cm (3'10") Suika is a young girl who lives in the village with the other stone age humans. Her most notable feature is the large watermelon on her head, which she can climb inside to disguise herself as the fruit. [Senku](https://anilist.co/character/124142/Ishigami-Senkuu) first meets Suika when he, [Chrome](https://anilist.co/character/124145/Chrome), and [Kohaku](https://anilist.co/character/124143/Kohaku) were searching for iron sand in a nearby river. Suika is eager to help Senku build his kingdom of science because she's never been useful to anyone before. She comes to work as an information gatherer for the kingdom of science, occasionally being referred to as 'Ace Detective Suika.'

105333.name: Gen Asagiri
105333.desc: __Height:__ 175 cm (5'9") Gen Asagiri is an enemy turned ally of [Senku](https://anilist.co/character/124142/Ishigami-Senkuu). Originally de-petrified by [Tsukasa Shishio](https://anilist.co/character/124144/Shishiou-Tsukasa), he was sent to find Senku, only to defect to the Kingdom of Science. Gen later becomes one of the Five Wise Generals. He is somewhat full of himself and his abilities, taking pride in his status as a magician and a mentalist, along with his knowledge of the human psyche. Gen is rather quirky and can often be seen speaking in Pig Latin. He tends to be lazy, self absorbed, and perverted, and he is also perfectly capable of lying without a hint of stress or change in expression. While he frequently portrays an aura of selfishness, hard self-interest, manipulation and deviousness, Gen is intrinsically a good person who can't bring himself to harm others. His outward appearance is masked by his mastery in psychology, but his actions tell of loyalty, determination, kindness and even sacrifice at times. While not nearly as intelligent in terms of science compared to Senku, he proves to be his equal and one of his most vital allies due to his ability to understand the human psyche and manipulate people through lies in contrast to Senku's more honest nature. He uses his abilities to promote cooperation and enthusiasm, motivate allies, conduct negotiations, and outsmart enemies. He tends to shift between acting as a ditzy airhead when it suits him (such as to avo

105333.name: Kaseki
105333.desc: __Height:__ 155 cm (5'1") Kaseki is an elderly craftsman from the Ishigami Village. When Senku arrives at Ishigami village, Kaseki is introduced as an artisan, and through Senku, his dedication to his craft is reignited tenfold.

105333.name: Ginrou
105333.desc: Ginrou is [Kinrou](https://anilist.co/character/143271/Kinrou)'s younger brother and one of the village guards. He is shorter and scrawnier than his brother, with short blonde hair and green eyes. He usually wears a karate gi-like uniform and belt and carries his spear wherever he goes. He and his brother were two of the first villagers to join the Kingdom of Science. ~!During the adventure on Treasure Island, Ginrou manages to convince [Matsukaze](https://anilist.co/character/188816/Matsukaze) to serve him due to the resemblance Ginrou bears to his late master.!~

105333.name: Kinrou
105333.desc: Kinrou is the elder brother of [Ginrou](https://anilist.co/character/143270/Ginrou) and the son of Tetsuken and Shirogane. Originally having served as one of the guards of Ishigami Village alongside Ginrou, he quickly joined [Senku](https://anilist.co/character/124142/Ishigami-Senkuu) as a member of the Kingdom of Science. Kinrou is a muscular young man of average height, with a scar on the right side of his face and a cluster of hair hanging in between his eyes. He wears a sleeveless karate gi-like uniform with a belt and a buckler with a star pattern on his back. After the Grand Bout, Kinrou begins wearing a pair of glasses to correct his nearsightedness.

105333.name: Ruri
105333.desc: Ruri is [Kohaku](https://anilist.co/character/124143/Kohaku)'s elder sister and the daughter of [Kokuyo](https://anilist.co/character/150509/Kokuyo), and serves as the priestess of Ishigami Village. She is similar to Kohaku in appearance but has longer hair and a more hourglass-shaped body. She wears a black sundress and a piece of rope around her neck.

105333.name: Hyouga
105333.desc: __Height:__ 189cm (6'2") Hyoga is a survivor who was revived by Tsukasa Shishio. Initially, he was an elite member of the Tsukasa Empire since he was depetrified by Tsukasa. ~!He ultimately betrays Tsukasa by attempting to take over his leadership and threatens Senku into joining, only to be defeated by the duo in the decisive battle for the Kingdom of Science. When the situation calls for it, he is depetrified once again and summoned to battle - now as a begrudging ally of the Kingdom of Science with a similar but slightly mellowed goal in mind. Since his third depetrification, Hyoga's goals are unknown.!~ Hyoga has an easy going attitude towards everything. Even in situation that do not work in his favour, he still remains calm. While he claims to share the same values as Tsukasa when it comes to only reviving the young and creating a community where no one takes from others, Hyoga himself is an elitist who believes in social darwinism. He categorizes humans as either enlightened (or strong) and unenlightened (or weak). He believes that the "brainless incompetent masses" should not be allowed to live and that only those who excel should be allowed to live. While he does follow a form of social darwinism, he does not believe it is only the physically strong who should survive, as he wanted Senku to join him in his endeavors and become the strongest duo, indicating he respected Senku's intelligence and understood his capabilities. He is very manipulative and cunning, seems to

105333.name: Nikki Hanada
105333.desc: __Height:__ 180 cm (5'11") Nikki is a survivor that was revived by [Tsukasa](https://anilist.co/character/124144/Tsukasa-Shishiou), who assigned her to keep watch over [Taiju](https://anilist.co/character/124146/Taiju-Ooki) and [Yuzuriha](https://anilist.co/character/124147/Yuzuriha-Ogawa). She later defected from the Tsukasa Empire and joined the Kingdom of Science, where her unofficial role is that of disciplinarian. She has great physical strength, constantly being shown keeping people like [Magma](https://anilist.co/character/145095/Magma) and [You](https://anilist.co/character/145061/You-Uei) in line. Nikki is a massive fan of [Lillian Weinberg](https://anilist.co/character/149274/Lillian-Weinberg). In the modern world she was having a rough time at school and listening to Lillian's songs saved her.

105333.name: Ukyou Saionji
105333.desc: __Height:__ 173 cm (5'8") Ukyou is a survivor that was revived by [Tsukasa Shishiou](https://anilist.co/character/124144/Tsukasa-Shishiou). He is pacifistic and dislikes needless bloodshed.

105333.name: Homura Momiji
105333.desc: __Height:__ 145 cm (4'9") Homura acts as the right-hand man of [Hyouga](https://anilist.co/character/145062/Hyouga) in [Tsukasa](https://anilist.co/character/124144/Tsukasa-Shishiou)'s army. She was a competitive gymnast before the petrification.

105333.name: Magma
105333.desc: Magma is a villager from the Ishigami village. Magma is known for being the strongest of all the Villagers in terms of strength.

105333.name: Minami Hokutouzai
105333.desc: __Height:__ 166 cm (5'4") Minami is a Pre-Petrification human and former reporter before the Petrification occurred. ~!Originally a member of [Tsukasa](https://anilist.co/character/124144/Shishiou-Tsukasa)'s army before Tsukasa's downfall at the hands of [Hyoga](https://anilist.co/character/145062/Hyouga)'s betrayal, she later joins and helps the Kingdom of Science.!~

105333.name: Chalk
105333.desc: Dog from Ishigami Village. He is Suika's friend.

105333.name: Mantle
105333.desc: Mantle is a villager of Ishigami Village who idolizes Magma.

105333.name: Jasper
105333.desc: An inhabitant of Ishigami Village who is a stickler for the rules. He serves alongside [Turquoise](https://anilist.co/character/150511/Turquoise) as guard for the village's priestess.

105333.name: Lillian Weinberg
105333.original: リリアン ・ ワインバーグ
105333.desc: A famous American diva and songstress whose name is known by the whole world. Her passion in adventuring lead her aboard the International Space Station (ISS) alongside Senku's father, Byuakuya Ishigami.

105333.name: Byakuya Ishigami
105333.desc: Byakuya Ishigami was a Japanese astronaut who was residing on the International Space Station when the Petrification on Earth's surface occurred. He was a kind, playful, and mischievous man who always found a way to amuse himself and keep things lighthearted, no matter the stakes. ~!He was [Senku Ishigami](https://anilist.co/character/124142/Senkuu-Ishigami)'s adoptive father.!~

105333.name: Shamil  Volkov
105333.original: シャミール・ヴォルコフ
105333.desc: __Height:__ 180 cm Shamil was a Russian Cosmonaut residing on the International Space Station (ISS) when the Petrification on Earth's surface occurred. He returned to Earth's surface along with the rest of the ISS crew, helping to establish Ishigami Village. After returning to Earth, Shamil married fellow ISS astronaut [Connie Lee](https://anilist.co/character/150510/Connie-Lee) and had several children together. His personality was the opposite of [Byakuya](https://anilist.co/character/149275/Byakuya-Ishigami)'s, being a stoic, serious, pragmatic man of few words.

105333.name: Darya Nikitina
105333.desc: __Height:__ 163 cm Russian cosmonaut and doctor who was on board the International Space Station (ISS) alongside her husband [Yakov Nikitin](https://anilist.co/character/150512/Yakov-Nikitin). While in space, she witnessed the petrification of all human life on Earth's surface.

105333.name: Kokuyo
105333.desc: Father of [Kohaku](https://anilist.co/character/124143/Kohaku) and [Ruri](https://anilist.co/character/143272/Ruri). He was the village chief of Ishigami Village at the time of [Senku](https://anilist.co/character/124142/Senkuu-Ishigami)'s reawakening. ~!Kokuyo at first refuses to accept Senku as the new village chief, even though Senku won the Grand Bout. After witnessing Senku's antibiotic cure Ruri he officially crowns Senku the new leader of Ishigami Village. Despite not being the chief anymore, he serves as something of a co-leader of Ishigami Village, focusing on more practical concerns like food gathering, while Senku focuses on scientific advancement.!~

105333.name: Connie Lee
105333.desc: NASA personnel who was one of the astronauts on the International Space Station at the time when the people of Earth were petrified.

105333.name: Turquoise
105333.desc: A member of the Ishigami village. She serves alongside Jasper as one of Ruri's guards.

105333.name: Yakov Nikitin
105333.desc: __Height:__ 167 cm Russian cosmonaut, doctor, and husband of Darya Nikitina who was one of the astronauts on the International Space Station at the time when the people of Earth were petrified

105333.name: Ganen
105333.desc: Ganen is a villager from Ishigami Village. He is the son of Sagan and En.

105333.name: Sapphire
105333.desc: Villager from Ishigami Village. She is one of the three Sparkly Sisters along with her siblings Garnet and Ruby. Her parents are Alabaster and Dia.

105333.name: Unmo
105333.desc: Villager from Ishigami Village.

105333.name: Garnet
105333.desc: Villager from Ishigami Village. She is one of the three Sparkly Sisters along with her siblings Sapphire and Ruby. Her parents are Alabaster and Dia.

105333.name: Gozan
105333.desc: One of the troops from the Tsukasa Empire that Hyoga took on his two raids to Ishigami Village.

105333.name: Genbu
105333.desc: Villager from Ishigami Village.

105333.name: Sagan
105333.desc: Villager from Ishigami Village. He is the husband of En and the father of Ganen.

105333.name: Shovel
105333.desc: Villager from Ishigami Village.

105333.name: Titan
105333.desc: Titan is a villager from Ishigami Village.

105333.name: Sulfurina
105333.desc: Sulfurina is the name of the embodiment of the Emerald Green Spring, a hot spring that emits a deadly poisonous gas consisting of hydrogen sulfide and sulfur dioxide. The group has to tread to retrieve sulfuric acid from the spring to make sulfanilamide to cure Ruri of her illness. Silver can be used to detect hydrogen sulfide to see where the poison gas is and to avoid it. Senku nicknames her Ryuu-san because in Japanese the word for sulfuric acid is ryuusan (硫酸). (Source: Dr. Stone Fandom)

105333.name: Carbo
105333.desc: Villager from Ishigami Village. He is the son of [Natri](https://anilist.co/character/255670) and [Alumi](https://anilist.co/character/255671/), and he is the husband of [Beryl](https://anilist.co/character/255672).

105333.name: Natri
105333.desc: Villager from Ishigami Village. He is the father of [Carbo](https://anilist.co/character/255669) and the husband of [Alumi](https://anilist.co/character/255671/).

105333.name: Alumi
105333.desc: Villager from Ishigami Village. She is the mother of Carbo and the wife of Natri.

105333.name: Beryl
105333.desc: Villager from Ishigami Village. She is the wife of [Carbo](https://anilist.co/character/255669).

105333.name: Ruby
105333.desc: Villager from Ishigami Village. She is one of the three Sparkly Sisters along with her siblings Garnet and Sapphire. Her parents are Alabaster and Dia.

105333.name: En
105333.desc: Villager from Ishigami Village. She is the wife of Sagan and the mother of Ganen.

105333.name: Kujaku
105333.desc: Villager from Ishigami Village.

105333.name: Azura
105333.desc: Villager from Ishigami Village.

105333.name: Argo
105333.desc: Villager from Ishigami Village.

105333.name: Wasilewski
105333.desc: Scientist at NASA who succeeded in an experiment to make magnets using lightning.

105333.name: Hagane
105333.desc: Villager from Ishigami Village.

105333.name: Alabaster
105333.desc: Villager from Ishigami Village. He is the husband of Dia and the father of Ruby, Sapphire, and Garnet.

105333.name: Kyouchirou
105333.desc: One of the troops from the Tsukasa Empire that Hyoga took on his two raids to Ishigami Village.

105333.name: Akashi
105333.desc: One of the troops from the Tsukasa Empire that Hyoga took on his two raids to Ishigami Village.

105333.name: Morito
105333.desc: One of the troops from the Tsukasa Empire that Hyoga took on his two raids to Ishigami Village.

21827.name: Violet Evergarden
21827.original: ヴァイオレット・エヴァーガーデン
21827.desc: __Height:__ 161 cm Violet is described as a very beautiful young woman, being almost doll-like in appearance, with light-blue eyes, a fair complexion, and a slender frame. She is noted for her womanly semblance. She has waist-length golden hair with locks that frame her face. She either has her hair untied, in a low ponytail, or, after becoming a Doll, pulled up into two braided buns with two red ribbons. Due to losing her arms in the war, Violet received maneuverable prosthetic arms made of adamant silver. After the end of the war and on normal occasions, Violet is often seen wearing a white blouse, a green skirt and a pair of heeled brown boots. ~!Growing up as an orphaned child soldier in the army who was treated as a mere tool, Violet was not educated like a regular human being and did not understand human feelings well. She was raised and grew up as a person who had feelings, but couldn't perceive or express them. For this reason, she could be mistaken as emotionless, or apathetic. Even before she was found and taken into the army, she couldn't speak or understand speech, only understanding orders to kill. She did not possess any sense of right or wrong from the start; she didn't understand what could be considered righteous or erroneous. She merely chased after the adults who gave her orders. She followed the idea of "kill or be killed," thus she could kill countless people without feeling guilt or remorse. She did anything that was asked of her and always followed orde

21827.name: Cattleya Baudelaire
21827.original: カトレア・ボードレール
21827.desc: Cattleya Baudelaire is a character in the Violet Evergarden series. Being a figurehead Auto Memories Doll who works for the CH Postal Company, Cattleya never stops being requested and often takes on clients with love troubles. She works alongside [Violet](https://anilist.co/character/90169/Evergarden-Violet) and has been close with [Hodgins](https://anilist.co/character/124799/Hodgins-Claudia) since before the company was established, joining as one of its initial employees.

21827.name: Benedict Blue
21827.original: ベネディクト・ブルー
21827.desc: Benedict Blue (ベネディクト・ブルー, Benedikuto Burū?) is a character in the Violet Evergarden series. He is a postman working at the CH Postal Company. He has known Hodgins since before the company's establishment and has had a brusque attitude towards him since he started working there.

21827.name: Dietfried Bougainvillea
21827.original: ディートフリート・ブーゲンビリア
21827.desc: Dietfried Bougainvillea is a naval captain in the navy and [Gilbert](https://anilist.co/character/124790/)'s older brother. He was the one who found [Violet](https://anilist.co/character/90169/) and made her into Gilbert's "weapon" on his promotion to a major in the army. (Source: Violet Evergarden wiki)

21827.name: Gilbert Bougainvillea
21827.original: ギルベルト・ブーゲンビリア
21827.desc: Gilbert Bougainvillea is a character in the Violet Evergarden series. He is a major in the Leidenschaftlich army who values Violet more than anything, seeing her as a human being rather than a tool. ~!Violet was "given" to Gilbert as a gift to commemorate his promotion, having being promoted to a major in light of his wartime achievements and expectations from his bloodline. Dietfried, not wanting to take care of Violet, pushed this task to his younger brother. Gilbert then decided to enlist her on a militant unit that he had been appointed to take overall command of in his promotion to major. He later received permission to conduct private experiments at the training grounds as to whether Violet could be officially classified as a "weapon."!~

21827.name: Bridget
21827.original: ブリジット

21827.name: Erica Brown
21827.original: エリカ・ブラウン
21827.desc: Erica Brown is a character in the Violet Evergarden series. She is an Auto Memories Doll who has been working at the CH Postal Company for a while. She is not good at communicating and isn't confident in her work. ~!Erica is an anime-original character.!~

21827.name: Iris Cannary
21827.original: アイリス・カナリー
21827.desc: Iris Cannary is a character in the Violet Evergarden series. A rookie Auto Memories Doll with an unyielding spirit who works at CH Postal Company, Iris admires young working women and is enthusiastic about quickly making a name for herself in the industry. ~!As a child, she became friends with a boy named Emonn Snow and the two were very close. Iris was in love with him, and she had also supposedly convinced herself that her feelings were reciprocated. Because of that, she confessed to him before they graduated school, but he rejected her confession. The emotional pain caused by Emonn's rejection was what caused her to leave her hometown to become an Auto Memories Doll.!~

21827.name: Iberis Conoway
21827.original: イベリス・コノウェ

21827.name: Tiffany Evergarden
21827.original: ティファニー・エヴァーガーデン
21827.desc: An old woman who wants to take in Violet after being contacted by Gilbert. She has lost her son during the war.

21827.name: Dansei Kyaku
21827.original: 男性客
21827.desc: Appears in episode 2 of the anime.

21827.name: Claudia Hodgins
21827.original: クラウディア・ホッジンズ
21827.desc: A former army commander. He founded the CH postal company and serves as president. (Source: Wikipedia)

21827.name: Lilian
21827.original: リリアン

21827.name: Iris no Mei
21827.original: アイリスの姪

21827.original: スペンサー・モールバラ

21827.name: Bluebell Unoa
21827.original: ブルーベル・ユノア

21827.original: ローランド

21827.name: Oliver
21827.original: オリバー

21827.name: Nerine
21827.original: ネリネ

21827.name: Luculia Marlborough
21827.original: ルクリア・モールバラ
21827.desc: Luculia is a graduate of the Auto Memories Doll Training School and a novice Auto Memories Doll. Luculia and Violet became friends as fellow classmates at the training school, and she is the one who helped Violet graduate and earn her licence. She is shown to be a kind and considerate person who is willing to go out of her way to assist others, such as her offering Violet some of her food the first day they met as well as attempting to help her write a letter to Gilbert. Despite a tragic backstory, she is shown to carry a positive attitude and cheerful demeanor when around other people, but tends to be more quiet and solemn when alone. She is expressive and sociable, but she struggles to communicate her own feelings, particularly regarding her brother.

21827.name: Leon Stephanotis
21827.original: レオン・ステファノティス

21827.name: Charlotte Abelfreyja Drossel
21827.original: シャルロッテ・エーベルフレイヤ・ドロッセル
21827.desc: She is the princess of Drossel, and the narrator for the 5th episode of Violet Evergarden.

21827.name: Toby Selwyn
21827.original: トビー・セルウィン

21827.name: Aidan Field
21827.original: エイダン・フィールド
21827.desc: Aidan is a soldier who appeared in episode 11 and was the one who requested the Auto Memories Doll in Ctrigall.

21827.name: Ann Magnolia
21827.original: アン・マグノリア
21827.desc: Ann Magnolia is a character in the Violet Evergarden series and the protagonist of the second chapter of the first volume of the light novel. She is a young girl who lives with her terminally ill [mother](https://anilist.co/character/223026/Clara-Magnolia).

21827.name: Rhodanthe
21827.original: ローダンセ
21827.desc: She is the instructor at the Auto Memories Doll Training School.

21827.name: Damian Baldur Flugel
21827.original: ダミアン・バルドゥール・フリューゲル
21827.desc: He is the prince of the Kingdom of Flugel who is set to marry princess Charlotte of the Kingdom of Drossel.

21827.name: Oscar Webster
21827.original: オスカー・ウェブスター
21827.desc: A playwright who used to seclude himself due to the deaths of his wife and daughter. However, after deciding to write his very first children's play to dedicate it to his daughter's memory, he entrusts Violet with the task of putting his ideas on paper.

21827.name: Olivia Webster
21827.original: オリビア・ウェブスター
21827.desc: She is the beloved daughter of Oscar and the insipration behind Olive, the main character in her father's first children's play.

21827.name: Clara Magnolia
21827.original: クラーラ・マグノリア
21827.desc: She is the mother of [Ann](https://anilist.co/character/213148/Ann-Magnolia), who had a terminal illness and predicted that her fate was close.

21827.name: Illias Vandal
21827.original: イライアス・ヴァンダル

21827.name: Eckhart Munter
21827.original: エックハルト・ミュンター

21827.name: Merkulov
21827.original: メルクーロフ

21827.name: Alberta
21827.original: アルベルタ
21827.desc: A court lady in the service of the royal family of the kingdom of Drossel, she has been taking care of Charlotte since she was born, and she is more important to Charlotte than her own parents.

101348.name: Thorfinn Karlsefni
101348.original: トルフィン・カルルセヴニ
101348.desc: __Birthyear:__ 996 __Height:__ 100 cm (6-7 years old), 153 cm (16-18 years old), 155 cm (19 years old) Thorfinn is a courageous young man armed with two twin blades he inherited from his deceased [father](https://anilist.co/character/13021). He's traveling with [Askeladd](https://anilist.co/character/13020), who is the leader of a ruthless group of mercenaries who take jobs from whoever they think can offer them a reasonable reward. Besides, Askeladd is the man who killed Thorfinn's father, Thors, and the only reason Thorfinn is traveling with Askeladd is so he can defeat him in a duel and win back his father's pride. Thorfinn only wants to win his father's pride with a fair duel. Askeladd only agrees to these duels when Thorfinn completes a certain task (like bringing him the head of the opposing armies general on the battlefield). He does not fight for the love of battle, but is still prone to losing his composure when in combat. This hotheadedness often costs him battles against more experienced opponents.

101348.name: Askeladd
101348.desc: Askeladd is the commander of a small but powerful Viking band, which owed its success to Askeladd's exceptional intelligence. Ten years before the main Vinland Saga storyline, Askeladd accepted a contract to assassinate [Thors](https://anilist.co/character/13021), father of [Thorfinn](https://anilist.co/character/10138). During the Viking invasion and war in England, he manipulated Thorfinn's desire for revenge against him as a way of keeping the gifted young fighter in his service. Askeladd is one of the most skilled fighters in the series, and is particularly adept at predicting his opponents' moves in combat. Askeladd shares the name of Askeladden, a Norwegian folk character known for his cleverness. ~!He is half-Danish and half-Welsh, being the son of a Welsh princess captured by a Viking raider. He believes in the legend of Avalon, which inspired him to support Prince [Canute](https://anilist.co/character/17438)'s bid for kingship of the Danes and ultimately sacrifices himself assassinating King [Sweyn](https://anilist.co/character/27957) in order to install Canute as the Danish King and to ensure the safety of Wales from Denmark.!~

101348.name: Thors Snorresson
101348.original: トールズ・スノーレソン
101348.desc: __Height:__ 180 cm (5'11") Thors is the father of [Thorfinn](https://anilist.co/character/10138), a Jomsviking general whose phenomenal combat prowess earns him the epithet "The Troll of Jom". Thors grows weary of battle after the birth of his children, fakes his own death, and retires to become a pacifist farmer. Thors is largely considered the greatest fighter to appear in the series, having defeated the likes of Askeladd and [Thorkell](https://anilist.co/character/17440) in single combat. Such was his strength that Floki was unwilling to engage him directly, even with an entire squadron of Jomsviking warriors. Unlike his son, Thors has no explicit or implied historical basis.

101348.name: Canute Svenson
101348.desc: __Birthyear:__ 996 __Height:__ 170 cm Canute is the prince of the Danes. He is initially portrayed as timid and womanly, with a bishounen appearance and inability to function without his retainer [Ragnar](https://anilist.co/character/82533). These traits, along with his strong Christianity, earn him the mockery of the Vikings with whom he works. ~!After Ragnar's death, however, he has a sharp reversal of personality, becomes strong and kingly, and develops an ambition to create utopia on earth before God's return. Towards this end, he plots to overthrow his father [Sweyn Forkbeard](https://anilist.co/character/27957) and take the crown of the Danes. Canute is based on the historical King Canute the Great, the most prominent Danish ruler of England.!~

101348.name: Thorkell
101348.desc: __Height:__ 230 cm (7'7") Thorkell is a Jomsviking general and brother of the Jomsviking Chief. A giant man who loves combat, Thorkell defected from the Danish army to become a mercenary for the English, believing that fighting his fellow Vikings will give him a better challenge. This same love of war leads him to support Prince [Canute](https://anilist.co/character/17438)'s bid for kingship of the Danes. Before [Thors](https://anilist.co/character/13021)' defection he works with and highly respects the man, and bears a fondness for his son [Thorfinn](https://anilist.co/character/10138) in the main plot. He duels twice with Thorfinn and dominates each time, though he loses two fingers in the first duel and an eye in the second. In battle, Thorkell typically wields a pair of axes as his primary weapons, but his greatest asset is probably his vast physical strength. During a skirmish with [Askeladd](https://anilist.co/character/13020)'s band, he hurled a spear with such force that it skewered three men at once, despite having been thrown from several hundred feet away. Thorkell's character is based on Thorkell the Tall, a historical Jomsviking lord who is a mentor to Canute in the Flateyjarbók. ~!Joined Canute as his servant after seeing him change in front of Askeladd and Thorfinn.!~

101348.name: Bjorn
101348.desc: Bjorn is [Askeladd](https://anilist.co/character/13020)'s second in command, a burly man who fights for the love of combat. He is a berserker, able to enter powerful rages through the consumption of certain mushrooms.

101348.name: Leif Erikson
101348.desc: __Birthyear:__ 965 __Height:__ 152 cm (4'11") ~!An explorer who joins [Thorfinn](https://anilist.co/character/10138) in his quest to find paradise.!~

101348.name: Willibald
101348.desc: A 23-year-old Friar who travels with and mentors Prince [Canute](https://anilist.co/character/17438). He enjoys alcohol and is searching for true love.

101348.name: Ylva
101348.desc: She is [Thorfinn](https://anilist.co/character/10138)'s older sister. After Thorfinn has set on a journey to avenge his father, [Thors](https://anilist.co/character/13021), she takes care of household and [her mother](https://anilist.co/character/141589).

101348.name: Sweyn
101348.desc: Danish king who managed to conquer almost the entirety of England and Wales, all the while keeping control of his more northern kingdoms. Father of [Canute](https://anilist.co/character/17438). ~!After being provoked by Sweyn, [Askeladd](https://anilist.co/character/13020) executes the king by cutting off his head with a sword.!~

101348.name: Narrator
101348.desc: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

101348.name: Ragnar
101348.desc: He is the main adviser for Prince [Canute](https://anilist.co/character/17438). Ragnar is bald apart from very long, black, curly hair on the sides of his head. He has very thick black eyebrows that lie close to his deepset eyes. His wrinkles are also very deep, especially in his cheeks, just above his thick beard. (Source: Vinland Saga Wiki)

101348.name: Floki
101348.desc: A Jomsviking commander whom contracted [Askeladd](https://anilist.co/character/13020) to assassinate [Thors](https://anilist.co/character/13021), Floki's former comrade.

101348.name: Halfdan
101348.desc: Halfdan is a wealthy and powerful landowner and moneylender known for his ruthlessness, earning the nickname "Iron Chain" for his skilled use of one as a weapon and symbol of his philosophy of chaining others.

101348.name: Ari
101348.desc: __Height:__ 170 cm Ari is from [Thorfinn](https://anilist.co/character/10138/Thorfinn-Karlsefni)’s village in Iceland.~!He is the husband of [Ylva](https://anilist.co/character/27876) and the father of their four children.!~

101348.name: Helga
101348.desc: She is the mother of [Thorfinn](https://anilist.co/character/10138) and [Ylva](https://anilist.co/character/27876), and the wife of [Thors](https://anilist.co/character/13021). ~!She's the daughter of the Jomsviking Chief.!~

101348.name: Asgeir
101348.desc: __Height:__ 170cm [Thorkell](https://anilist.co/character/17440)'s first mate. Asgeir is one of the few characters Thorkell outwardly respects, meeting him at eye-level in conversation, listening to his advice, and putting him in charge of strategies and planning. Asgeir is often shown yelling at Thorkell and becoming easily worried and even panicked when Thorkell is in danger.

101348.name: Torgrim
101348.desc: He is [Atli](https://anilist.co/character/141592)'s older brother.

101348.name: Atli
101348.desc: He is [Torgrim](https://anilist.co/character/141591)'s younger brother.

101348.name: Mimi
101348.desc: A member of [Askeladd](https://anilist.co/character/13020)'s band whose remarkable hearing allows him estimate distance and marching speed of enemy troops just by pressing his ear to the ground. He needs complete silence to work, and snow dampens sound enough to severely limit this ability.

101348.name: Lydia
101348.desc: a Welsh noblewoman who was captured and enslaved by the Norse warrior Olaf

101348.name: Olaf
101348.desc: Norse warrior and the father of Askeladd.

101348.name: Asser
101348.desc: is a Welsh envoy

101348.name: Gorm
101348.desc: is a feudal lord in a village located on the Jutland Peninsula, Denmark. He really loves gold and it brightens his heart, just by looking at it.

101348.name: Faxi
101348.desc: is a young boy from Thorfinn's village.

101348.name: Mols
101348.desc: [Leif](https://anilist.co/character/19486)'s traveling partner.

101348.name: Áki
101348.desc: A member of Askeladd's band.

101348.name: Jabbathe
101348.desc: is a frank nobleman, who with the help of Askeladd was able to overtake a strong frank fortress.

101348.name: Magni
101348.desc: is a young man from Thorfinn's village.

101348.name: Grim
101348.desc: A young man from Thorfinn's village.

101348.name: Haldor
101348.desc: Haldor is a warrior living in England.

101348.name: Tore
101348.desc: is a member of Askeladd's band.

101348.name: Gratianus
101348.desc: Gratianus is a Welsh warrior serving as a captain of Morgannwg's military.

101348.name: Gunnar
101348.desc: He is Ragnar's Brother. ~!now he is a politician who currently serves as an adviser to King Canute.!~

101348.name: Mord
101348.desc: Mord is a young man from Thorfinn's village.

101348.name: Hakon
101348.desc: A young man from Thorfinn's village.

19815.name: Sora
19815.desc: __Race:__ Human Abandoned by his parents, Sora is a brilliant NEET (Not in Education, Employment, or Training) hikikomori (shut-in) gamer along with his stepsister, [Shiro](https://anilist.co/character/82525/Shiro). He does not take life very seriously and is pretty much a good-for-nothing gamer. One day, he and his sister are called into an alternate world and they have to become Saviors of Humanity! Despite being a NEET and a shut-in, Sora is extremely outgoing and confident, and is not afraid to play games with people face to face, even when they're cheating. He is also extremely manipulative - which he refers to as using negotiating skills. This fits in with his play style as while Shiro is excellent at logic and computing, Sora can read people and predict what their next move is, using this knowledge to beat them. However, if he is separated from Shiro by so much as a closed door he becomes a spineless, cowardly wreck, and only returns to his former self if he is able to see her. He views his sister as his equal and partner, but is also protective of her, shown by actions such as putting his body between her and the ground when he thought they were going to hit hard when first arriving on Disboard. Sora is extroverted and has no problems dealing with people. While not as intelligent as Shiro, he is shown to have a brilliant IQ. Rather than computing numbers like Shiro, Sora can rapidly compute what his opponents are going to do based on observing their behavior and motiv

19815.name: Shiro
19815.desc: Shiro is the main female protagonist. She's a genius NEET (Not in Education, Employment, or Training) hikikomori (shut-in) gamer along with her step-brother, [Sora](https://anilist.co/character/82523/Sora) and together they formed 『 』. Between both siblings she is the calm and collective half which makes her the brain of the group.

19815.name: Stephanie Dola
19815.original: ステファニー・ドーラ
19815.desc: __Race:__ Imanity Stephanie is expressive and emotional, to the point where she cannot hide her emotions during a poker game. She loved her grandfather dearly and is angered when people call her grandfather a fool. She fell in love with [Sora](https://anilist.co/character/82523/Sora) due to the pledges forcing her to, and she often has violent outbursts to try to break free of it. She loves her kingdom and the world and believes in the potential of Imanity.

19815.name: Jibril
19815.desc: __Race:__ Flügel Jibril is the youngest and strongest of the Flügel race. Her love toward knowledge starts even before the declaration of the Ten Oaths. She is against the book sharing law, and left her homeland to win the main library of the human world from the previous king in a game. ~!Unlike [Steph](https://anilist.co/character/82527), Jibril is happy to become the siblings underling, and is shown growing feelings toward [Sora](https://anilist.co/character/82523).!~

19815.name: Chlammy Zell
19815.desc: __Height:__ 158cm A human who allied with several different races in order to win the king's contest, due to her belief that humans will never be strong and must depend on others in order to survive.

19815.name: Fiel Nilvalen
19815.original: フィール・ニルヴァレン
19815.desc: __Race__: Elf Fiel Nilvalen who usually has her name shortened to Fii, is an Elf girl who is [Chlammy Zell](https://anilist.co/character/88001/Chlammy-Zell)'s game partner, as well as the one who helps her cheat using her elven magic. She is very protective of Chlammy and would go to great lengths to keep her safe. She is a hexa-caster (able to cast and maintain up to six spells at once), a very rare capability that only an extraordinary few possess. She is part of the Nilvalen family which may be a factor of her strong magic as a result of being a descendant of [Shinku Nilvalen](https://anilist.co/character/123694/Shinku--Nilvalen).
