19815.name: Izuna Hatsuse
19815.desc: __Race:__ Werebeast Izuna Hatsuse is a Werebeast girl and the former ambassador of the Werebeast race to Immanity. After [Sora](https://anilist.co/character/82523/Sora) and [Shiro](https://anilist.co/character/82525/Shiro) forced the werebeasts to join the Commonwealth of Elkia, Izuna was directed by [Miko](https://anilist.co/character/137440/Miko) to follow and learn from them. [Steph](https://anilist.co/character/82527/Dola-Stephanie) has noted that she actually shares similarities to Sora and Shiro, such as lacking common sense, being arrogant towards others, and being extremely smart and competent at gaming. She mostly exhibits an innocent personality pertaining to her age yet is very competent at playing games to the point of representing the Werebeasts in national games against other races. She possesses all the incredible physical abilities found in all Werebeasts as well as the rare Blood Break found in a select few Werebeast individuals.

19815.name: Tet
19815.desc: __Race__: None (Formerly: Old Deus) Tet is the One True God of Disboard. Tet does not belong to any of the 16 races, although the closest affiliation to him would be Immanity. To challenge Tet for the title of the One True God, one must collect all pieces of different chess from 16 races. This means that, under the tenth rule of the Ten Covenants, one must defeat or unite all 16 races before being able to play against him. ~!He was born from [Riku](https://anilist.co/character/123691/Riku-Dola)'s wish and the overwhelming presence of incredible magic energy. Claiming the Suniaster and becoming the One True God, Tet immediately used his absolute power to repair the damage done to the planet and set forth the Ten Covenants, thus ending the Great War.!~

19815.name: Mahakoht Dola
19815.desc: The previous ruler of Imanity, as well as Steph's grandfather. His reign led to many losses for Imanity, thus many people call him a, "Foolish King." He is terrible at games, being unable to win a majority. However, he is able to give Imanity a chance by finding out opponent's secrets. When he was near the end of his life, he entrusted Steph with, "The Key to Imanity's Hope;" which is to be given to someone who is capable of saving Imanity.

19815.name: Azriel
19815.desc: The first Flügel created by Artosh and Representative of the Council of Eighteen Wings. As such, her title allows her to have first say in emergencies. She calls Jibril her "little sister". During the war, she conveyed Artosh's will among other Flügel. After the war, she passed the law in which Flügel shared books among each other. Azriel has a somewhat split personality, being peppy and bubbly to a cold, relentless state. Prior to Jibril's creation, Azriel was merciless and considered other Flügel expendable; afterwards, however, she turned into a sister figure when Jibril came to be. Even so, she continues to have a condescending attitude towards lower exceed races. She is extremely powerful as the first Flügel to be created, being able to pull off many feats. This is further enhanced by her mental connection with Avant Heim, while also being its representative. Even with her strength, Jibril considers Azriel to be rather stupid compared to other Flügel. Despite this, Azriel is clever when it comes to mind games and deception. What she lacks is an understanding of learning, trying, and failing; preventing her from learning from her mistakes.

19815.name: Queen
19815.desc: Queen is the in-game name of a character, who was not mentioned in the original light novel, who is said to be the strongest member of 『Night Opera』, a guild of 1,200 players. She appears in the first episode of the anime. She finds 『 』 to be cool and smart since they were able to dodge her attacks despite her using dishonest means (cheating) to cast consecutive spells.

19815.name: Miko
19815.desc: __Race:__ Werebeast Miko is the representative of the Werebeasts and rules over the Eastern Union. She lost her real name during the formation of the country when placing it as a wager. She looked down on Immanity at first, but after forming a truce with Sora and joining the Commonwealth of Elkia, she starts to have faith in the siblings who represent Immanity. She contains the rare Werebeast ability, Blood Break. Also, being a Blood Break capable individual, she ages very slowly. Sora had hypothesized Miko's age to be at least 58 years old, but her true age remains unknown. Despite her true age, Miko holds the appearance of a woman in her 20's. ~!Miko had to spend at least 50 years to unite the various Werebeast tribes into what is currently the Eastern Union, in which she lost her original name in a bet and gained her title as she contacted a certain Old Deus.!~

19815.name: Ino Hatsuse
19815.desc: A werebeast and Izuna's grandpa. He is protective of Izuna and dislikes it when she is close to Sora and Shiro. According to Miko, Hatsuse has thirty wives, much to Sora's chagrin. Hatsuse acts in a formal manner, being friendly around guests and officials. However, if he's around rude or condescending people, he will usually reciproctate their attitudes back. Hatsuse also is very perverted, telling many dirty jokes while not on a job. He was also banished from his tribe due to having experiences with every woman in his tribe. As he has 30 wives, he wishes for polygamy to be legal in the Eastern Union; which is one reason why he works under Miko.

4224.name: Taiga Aisaka
4224.desc: __Height:__ 145 cm Taiga is a girl in [Ryuuji's](https://anilist.co/character/12295) class. She has a well-regulated and beautiful appearance though is unable to stomach company from others. Due to her often snapping at others in brutal ways and her short stature, she is given the nickname "Palmtop Tiger". Her under-developed body and the added nickname has given her a complex which in turn serves to give her a negative attitude and facial expression. Essentially, Taiga gets upset easily and is considerably clumsy. She is also brutally honest, typically when she is lashing out at someone. Due to her cute looks (described as a doll by Ryuuji), she often gets confessions of love by boys, but she turns down every one of them, including [Yuusaku Kitamura](https://anilist.co/character/12306) (which she later regrets). Despite coming from a well-to-do family, her life with them is very difficult because of various problems. [Her father's](https://anilist.co/character/62271) business went bankrupt and he ran away, leaving Taiga in the care of [her mother](https://anilist.co/character/80715) who was already remarried and had a new family of her own. Taiga has difficulty getting along with her step-father and half-sibling and since then, she has taken to living on her own. Since she came from a privileged household, she does not know how to do any domestic chores. When she meets Ryuuji and learns of his domestic talents, she ends up relying on Ryuuji to clean up after her. Aside from

4224.name: Ryuuji Takasu
4224.desc: __Height:__ 172 cm (5'7") The series' main protagonist, Ryuuji is a seventeen-year-old high school student in his second year, class 2-C. Due to biological inheritance, his sanpaku eyes make him look like an intimidating delinquent and causes many misunderstandings. He lives in a fatherless family with just his mother, and due to this, Ryuuji has learned to be self-sufficient. He is good at cooking and keeps everything in his house clean (to the point of obsession), and also excels at sewing. He holds a crush on [Minori Kushieda](https://anilist.co/character/12305), a girl in his class. He has a pet, parakeet named "[Inko-chan](https://anilist.co/character/17059)" ("inko" literally means "parakeet" in Japanese). Ryuuji often helps [Taiga](https://anilist.co/character/12064) with domestic chores which she is unable to perform. At school, he is known as "the only person able to stop the palmtop tiger", referring to Taiga's nickname. Due to the misunderstandings of his look, he tends to look down on himself and lacks self-confidence. Despite this, he is rather calm in most situations. He is responsible, smart and has great grades, even when compared to [Yuusaku Kitamura](https://anilist.co/character/12306), his best friend. He is dense when it comes to girls' feelings, especially about things between him, Taiga, Minori and [Ami](https://anilist.co/character/13725). His feelings and relationship to Taiga begin to change as he spends more time with her throughout the series.

4224.name: Minori Kushieda
4224.desc: __Height:__ 163 cm Minori is a girl in [Ryuuji](https://anilist.co/character/12295/Takasu-Ryuuji)'s class, and is a close friend to [Taiga](https://anilist.co/character/12064/Aisaka-Taiga). She is also known by the pet name "Minorin". In contrast to the negative Taiga, Minori is always smiling and cheerful, but is also a natural airhead, though it is suggested that her airhead ways may be a facade. She is very athletic and is the captain of the girl's softball club at school, though at the same time she holds many part-time jobs. She is a glutton when it comes to food, but is also constantly combating dieting. ~!Toward the end of the anime, she reveals that she also likes Ryuuji but has given up on him in order to let Ryuuji and Taiga be together.!~

4224.name: Yuusaku Kitamura
4224.desc: Yuusaku is a male student in Ryuuji's class, and is his best friend. He is the vice-president of the student council, the class representative, and captain of the boy's softball club at school. Yuusaku wears glasses, and has a diligent personality. He thinks he is poor at talking to girls, though Ryuuji observes otherwise. During his time as the vice-president of the student council, he eventually falls in love with the student council president, Sumire Kanou. A running gag is that he will appear out of nowhere behind Taiga and Ryuuji when they are discussing a "plan of attack" to get their crushes. Like Minori, he has an unusual personality, but oftentimes it is an expression of his friendship and appreciation. ~!Yuusaku also had feelings for Taiga, but was rejected straight away.!~

4224.name: Yasuko Takasu
4224.desc: Yasuko is [Ryuuji](https://anilist.co/character/12295/Takasu-Ryuuji)'s thirty-three-year-old mother, though she refers to herself as eternally twenty-three. Soon after Ryuuji was born, her husband died which left her to raise her son by herself. She works at a hostess bar named Bishamonten Kuni where she goes by the name "Mirano" and single-handedly supports her two-member family financially. However, she has a childish personality and since she works, she entrusts the household chores to Ryuuji. She instantly takes a liking to [Taiga](https://anilist.co/character/12064/Aisaka-Taiga) and already regards her as a member of her family. ~!Later in the show, Yasuko reveals that Ryuuji's father didn't die. He basically abandoned the two of them, leaving Yasuko to raise their son by herself.!~

4224.name: Ami Kawashima
4224.desc: __Height:__ 165 cm Ami is [Yuusaku](https://anilist.co/character/12306)'s childhood friend who transfers into his class midway through their second year of high school. She is very beautiful and even works as a model, though after she transfers school, she temporarily stops modeling. However, she still continues to go to the gym readily and maintains a slim figure. She is always kind and generous towards others, though this is merely a deception. In truth, she is arrogant and will not hesitate to use others for her own benefit. During her first meeting with [Taiga](https://anilist.co/character/12064), Ami showed her true colors, but the tables were turned when Taiga threw a counterattack back at her. Since then, Ami and Taiga have been enemies, though Ami still sometimes envies Taiga since she can always be honest. It's hinted at, mostly through her childhood friend Yuusaku, that she's like this because she hasn't really known any other life than her modeling, which is part of the reason she moved to their hometown to attend school there. Which is why, through her affiliations with Taiga and [Ryuuji](https://anilist.co/character/12295), Ami eventually develops more of a "middle ground" personality, signified with her losing her temper and taking out her frustrations on a stalker fan. While this doesn't mean that she automatically becomes friends with Taiga, the two of them also meet halfway to some extent, thus running into arguments far less frequently. She can still be some

4224.name: Yuri Koigakubo
4224.desc: Yuri is the twenty-nine-year-old homeroom teacher of Ryūji's class (though she turns thirty in the fifth volume of the light novels). She likes to do things at her own pace and is timid towards Taiga's way of speaking out. Since her twenties are almost over, Yuri is in a hurry to get married soon and she even tries to dress well so as to be able to get into a relationship quicker. After she becomes thirty without getting married, she develops a twisted and depressed personality, which does not help that when Taiga talks about her, she emphases her single status. She is fairly concerned over the well-being and grades of her students and tries her best to help them. During the Winter, she banned Haruta from Christmas Activities to get him to study for exams.

4224.name: Sumire Kanou
4224.desc: Sumire is the student council president and always manages to get the top grades in school; she is in fact a scholarship student and has horrible eyesight. She has a strong-minded personality which she depends on to be a figure those will follow. Her younger sister is Sakura and her parents own a supermarket. Sumire likes Yuusaku and as a result is the object of an one-sided hostility from Taiga.

4224.name: Inko-chan
4224.desc: Ryuuji Takasu's parakeet. Her name is Japanese for parakeet. Though apparently healthy, she sometimes looks sickly. Despite struggling to say her simple name (a running gag throughout the series), she has a good understanding of human speech and can interact with her owners and pronounce words much more difficult than her name. She seems to be mentally inept.

4224.name: Maya Kihara
4224.desc: Maya is a female student in Ryūji's class who often hangs out with Nanako. She is a kogal. She has a crush on Yūsaku, and she circuitously opposes the idea of Taiga and Yūsaku being a couple, although she wants Taiga and Ryūji to be together.

4224.name: Kouji Haruta
4224.desc: Kōji is a male student in Ryūji's class who has long hair and is on good terms with him. He is regarded as a class 'idiot' and that opinion is deepened by his poor school marks and overly energetic behavior. His childish pranks often target Taiga and he has been the victim of her violent outbursts.

4224.name: Hisamitsu Noto
4224.desc: Hisamitsu is a male student in Ryuuji's class who wears glasses. He was also in Ryuuji's class the previous year and is on good terms with him. Noto begins to develop feelings for Maya Kihara which become more apparent following an argument they had during the class winter ski trip.

4224.name: Nanako Kashii
4224.desc: Nanako is a female student in Ryūji's class who often hangs out with Maya and Ami.

4224.name: Sakura Kanou
4224.desc: Sakura is Sumire's younger sister who attends the same high school as Sumire though her grades are horrible. She can unconsciously flirt with people, and like her sister, she hates snakes.

4224.name: Sena Hamada
4224.desc: A 3rd Grade junior in an art university. Lives alone in an apartment. Meets with Haruta right after breaking up with her boyfriend, Ryousuke. Without knowing anything about Ryousuke, she plans of reuniting with the help of Haruta. First appears briefly in novel vol.9 along with Haruta when Takasu and Taiga are selling chocolates. (and in anime EP23 relatively) Her main story is told in novel Spin-off vol.2 "Let's go to Gunma when it's spring! (春になったら群馬に行こう！)" chapter.

4224.name: Kuroma
4224.desc: Gym teacher at Takasu's school.

4224.name: Rikurou Aisaka
4224.desc: Taiga's father, shown for the first time in chapter 12. He threatens to stop giving Taiga her living expenses if she continues to ignore his calls. He tries to re-unite with his estranged daughter after a separation with his newest (and much younger) wife, admitting it was wrong to let her go. ~!During their short stint, he tells Ryuuji's mom that they are moving away to a bigger place together. A few episodes later in the middle of the season, he promises to come to the Cultural Festival to watch Taiga perform in her class's Wrestling Show and to see her perform in the pageant. He ends up being a no-show (after an embarrassing intro where Taiga and Ami both ask him to speak up and greet the crowd), sending Ryuuji a text message to tell Taiga that he had important business and they couldn't move in together. This leaves Ryuuji and Minori to pick up the pieces as Taiga tries to act as though she would be fine on her own.!~

4224.name: Yuriko Mitsui
4224.desc: Mitsui Yuriko, A student from class 1-A who was a contestant of the Ohashi high school culture festival.

4224.name: Kouta Tomiie
4224.desc: Kota Tomiie is a first-year student and he works as a secretary for the student council.

4224.name: Murase
4224.desc: Murase is a male student in Class 2-A who also works as the secretary in the student council.

4224.name: Yuu Aisaka
4224.desc: Taiga Aisaka's mother.

4224.name: Seiji Takasu
4224.desc: Ryuuji's Grandfather.

4224.name: Sonoko Takasu
4224.desc: Ryuuji's Grandmother.

4224.name: Stalker Otoko
4224.desc: The stalker of Ami Kawashima.

20447.name: Yato
20447.desc: __Race:__ God __Height:__ 174 cm (5’8”) __Occupation:__ God of War, Delivery God, God of Calamity (previously) Yato is one of the three main protagonists of Noragami. An obscure god who considers himself a God of Fortune / Happiness and War, he has been labeled a God of Calamity and Depression in the past. Yato's dream is to become a famous god, whom everyone worships. Yato can be mischievous, crude, and unpredictable in his behavior. He often has a low tolerance for something he wants, usually causing those around him to become upset. Furthermore, he is rather childish and gullible at times. Yato will often indulge in fantasies of being a very successful God with more followers than any other deity; shrines full of luxury and shrine maiden at his fingertips. As his existence would end if he were to be forgotten, he has developed Athazagoraphobia. ~!It is revealed that Yato's real name is Yaboku (夜卜) Yaboku contains the kanji ya (夜 night) and boku (卜 divination). [Sakura](https://anilist.co/character/189754/Sakura) mistakenly read 卜 as the katakana ト to because of the similarities, thus giving the well-known alias name Yato.!~

20447.name: Hiyori Iki
20447.desc: __Race:__ Hanyou (Half Phantom, Half Human) __Height:__ 162,5 cm (~5'4") Hiyori Iki is a Half-Phantom who can leave her human body, being like this since she "saved" [Yato](https://anilist.co/character/84677/Yato) from an incoming bus. Despite being raised to be completely lady-like in a rich household, Hiyori is a huge martial arts fan and has a fixation on a martial artist called Touno, whom she adores and copies her attacks from. She often becomes inspired and acts on his words. Hiyori is a very pure, kind-hearted, and brave girl who will go out of her way to help someone in danger, even strangers, regardless of the severe consequences, including suffering from blight. She has a strong moral compass and is not above calling people out if she feels their actions are wrong. Hiyori is also extremely perceptive of those around her, but despite that she can be a bit air-headed too. She also has a strong liking to Yato's smell and even called it her favorite smell on one occasion, but she becomes rather embarrassed by how much she likes it and dodges the subject whenever it is brought up.

20447.name: Yukine
20447.desc: __Race:__ Shinki __Height:__ 147 cm (4'10") While wandering about as a spirit, Yukine was picked up by [Yato](https://anilist.co/character/84677) and made into a Shinki. When called "Sekki" he transforms into a katana. ~!He died at a young age, making him miss his normal life as a middle schooler. He acts like his age, and was once stealing money from people with the excuse that it's okay since he's dead. After being "saved" by [Hiyori](https://anilist.co/character/84679/Iki-Hiyori), he becomes more obedient and respects Yato and Hiyori. When he was alive he had trouble with his father as seen by Yato when he first obtains Yukine.!~ In a katana form, he finds Yato's sweaty hands so disgusting that he calls him "Drippy."

20447.name: Bishamon
20447.desc: __Race:__ God __Occupation:__ Goddess of Fortune and Goddess of War Bishamon is one of the Seven Gods of Fortune and also officially a Goddess of War and Warriors. She is intent on keeping order among the gods. Due to her past with [Yato](https://anilist.co/character/84677/Yato), she is bent on vengeance and decided to destroy anything he held dear to himself. Despite being a goddess, Bishamon is shown to be quite generous towards her Shinki. She willingly accepts any wandering and troubled spirit, useful or not, and adds them to her family. Due to her failure in the past involving Shinki, Bishamon decides to be more distant from them, depicting herself as a fierce goddess and making sure that they are not worried about her, which only resulted to them being more insecure and lonely. In the anime, Bishamon's hair is depicted as blonde, as opposed of the silver hair in the manga.

20447.name: Kazuma
20447.desc: __Race:__ Shinki Kazuma is a calm, serious, and sensible person. He is one of [Bishamon's](https://anilist.co/character/88239/Bishamon) Shinki and cares about her deeply. When he is called by his shinki name, "Chouki", Kazuma transforms into a cherry blossom-shaped earring with the ability to navigate and track others. ~!He is a Blessed Regalia.!~

20447.name: Kofuku Ebisu
20447.desc: Originally introduced as [Yato's](https://anilist.co/character/84677/Yato) girlfriend that he frequently shakes down for money, Kofuku is later revealed to be the infamous Binbougami - a Japanese Goddess of Poverty. She goes by the cover name "Kofuku Ebisu" in order to make it seem as though she is a god of fortune. She has a Shinki named [Daikoku](https://anilist.co/character/88691/Daikoku).

20447.name: Tenjin
20447.desc: He is the infamous god of academics. He has several shinki, all of them women (including Yato's former shinki); and has his own shrine, much to Yato's envy. He would sometimes assume human form to intervene if, for example, Yato goes out of control playing around.

20447.name: Rabo
20447.desc: Rabo is an enigmatic character and appears only in the anime. He is often seen conversing with Nora and has been known to be able to control Phantoms.

20447.name: Daikoku
20447.desc: Daikoku is [Kofuku's](https://anilist.co/character/88241) somewhat overprotective shinki. He regards himself as Kofuku's husband.

20447.name: Nora
20447.desc: __Race:__ Shinki __Occupation:__ Stray __Nora__ is a former shinki of [Yato](https://anilist.co/character/84677/Yato). "Nora," meaning "stray," is how the gods call any shinki who has many masters and many names, most notable owners of Nora are ~! [Ebisu](https://anilist.co/character/89120/Ebisu) and [Takemikazuchi](https://anilist.co/character/159592/Takemikazuchi) !~ Nora, at first comes off as very gentle and kind. She seems to care deeply for Yato, and continually prompts him to use her, because she was once a human and all she wanted was to have a family that cared about her. ~!Later, it is revealed how manipulating and cruel she is. She tries to kill Yukine, as well as taunt him, due to the fact that he was impure, but also because she wants Yato to use her instead of him. She also tries to kill Hiyori due to how close she has gotten to Yato and believing she has softened him. She is depicted to show interest in anything with beauty, as shown when she commented on Yukine's eyes. She, just as Yato, is influenced and controlled by the actions and demands of "Father". Although she is initially seen as a villain, she is another puppet in the grand scheme of Yato's father. !~

20447.name: Ebisu
20447.desc: __Race:__ God __Age:__ Ancient __Occupation:__ God of Fishing and Commerce __Ebisu__ is one of the Seven Gods of Fortune. He is the humorless God of Fishing and Commerce. Initially, Ebisu appears very stoic, always bearing a near-emotionless facial expression and speaking in a reserved, polite, yet aloof tone. He is also highly pragmatic and resourceful, constantly progressing towards his goals and willing to go to great lengths to achieve what he is after. Despite his aloof appearance and personality, he can actually be a silly person, making him appear rather comically serious at times. He is a kind god at heart. ~!Ebisu is later revealed to be attempting to gain control over phantoms; a severe taboo if not sin in the eyes of the heavensl.!~

20447.name: Kuraha
20447.desc: Kuraha is a current Regalia to Bishamon. His regalia form is a male lion with a scar on his right eye.

20447.name: Tsuguha
20447.desc: Tsuguha is one of Bishamon's Ten Shinki. She transforms into Bishamon's bikini battle attire. Her vessel name is Shouki. ~!She becomes an ayakashi and is killed by Kazuma after finding out her birth name.!~

20447.name: Aimi Tabata
20447.desc: __Nationality:__ Japanese __Occupation:__ High School Student Aimi Tabata is one of Hiyori's friends from school. Not much has been shown about her personality. However, it is known that she is kind and supportive of Hiyori. She seems to be reasonable, calm, and mature. She often worries for Hiyori when she falls asleep (due to her soul slipping out of her body).

20447.name: Mayu
20447.desc: __Race:__ Shinki Mayu has a very honest personality and a strong sense of justice. During the time she worked for Yato, she couldn’t stand his attitudes because not only he always lazed around, but he also often talked about killing and didn’t seem to care about humans that needed his help. Because of this she complained a lot and always insulted and badmouthed Yato after she quit. Despite her attitudes towards Yato, she also respects Yato and cares for him. She often gets worried whenever Yato got into trouble even when she is serving Tenjin. At one point she volunteered herself to help Yato, who was impure due to Yukine’s actions.

20447.name: Hashimoto
20447.desc: Appeared briefly in episode 8. He was bullying Manabu Ogiwara. ~!After Manabu confronts him, he peed his pants out of fear.!~

20447.name: Tsuyu
20447.desc: Tsuyu is the spirit of a plum tree who lived with Tenjin for 1,000 years. She is not a shinki, but rather stayed with Tenjin out of a lasting love.

20447.name: Hiyori no Papa
20447.desc: Hiyori's dad. Has his own hospital

20613.name: Akame
20613.desc: __Height:__ 164 cm (5'4") Akame is one of the members of the Assassin's group, Night Raid. She is the first member to attack [Tatsumi](https://anilist.co/character/64749), and comes very close to killing him. She initially appears very serious and cold-hearted, but she is actually caring and worries about the safety of her comrades. She has a younger sister named [Kurome](https://anilist.co/character/65297), who is a member of the Jaegers, and loyal to the Empire. Her Teigu is the One-Cut Killer: Murasame, a katana known for being coated in an immensely deadly poison that could kill those cut by it within seconds, as the poison itself has no antidote. ~!When she was a child, her parents had sold both her and Kurome to the Empire. There, they were placed and raised as Assassins from childhood. Akame in particular became infamous enough to earned the top rank in the Imperial Assassin Division. At some point, many of her comrades had died and she become dissatisfied and resentful towards the government. It was not until she was sent to kill former General Najenda that Akame finally defected to the Rebels after being swayed by her.!~

20613.name: Tatsumi
20613.desc: Tatsumi is a swordsman from a small village. He set out to the capital with two of his companions in hope of raising money for the village. He got separated from his friends and reaches the capital. Tatsumi was not aware of the type of place the capital really was. After a series of events centered around his naivety of the true nature of the capital he found himself being saved be Night Raid (Assassination Group) and later join them to rid the capital of its corrupt inhabitants.

20613.name: Leone
20613.desc: __Height:__ 170 cm (5'7) Leone is one of the older members of the assassination group, Night Raid. She has a very relaxed and a cheerful personality, which tends to display a lack of ladylike manners, such as shoving [Tatsumi](https://anilist.co/character/64749/Tatsumi) into her breasts, putting her feet on the table, or consuming large amounts of Sake. She serves as a sort of big sister figure to Tatsumi and the younger members in Night Raid, often referring to herself as "Onee-San". Despite the morally dodgy nature, she can sometimes display, Leone is not one to tolerate injustice and can be especially vicious to those who commit the vilest acts. She excels at gathering information and exercising calm judgement when necessary. Her teigu is Lionel, a teigu is in the form of a belt, when activated, it enhanced her speed, reflexes, strength, and regeneration, as well as giving her animal-like characteristics.

20613.name: Mine
20613.desc: __Height:__ 155 cm (5'1) Mine is a self-proclaimed "Genius Sniper", as well as being a sharp-tongued and quick-witted member of the assassin's group, Night Raid. She is often quick to anger, and easily irritated with those she does not know well. Despite this cold exterior, she has shown to be warm and kind to those she has opened up to. Mine wields a powerful Teigu in the form of a rifle called the "Roman Artillery: Pumpkin" that fires highly concentrated piercing shots of spirit energy. Her proficiency in its use allows her to strike any target with extreme precision. When Pumpkin's user is in a dangerous situation, the power of its shots is​ magnified. Manga spoilers: ~!Tatsumi and Mine retired from service and settled down away from civilization where they married and had a child.!~

20613.name: Lubbock
20613.desc: Lubbock is a member of the assassin group, Night Raid. He is often shown being a pervert, including trying to peep on Leone while bathing, usually these attempts end in failure. In the city, his cover is an owner of a bookstore. Lubbock's teigu is, Infinite Uses: Cross Tail, a wire based teigu able to be used offensively and defensively ~!Rabac was 4th son born into a wealth merchant family in a region in the Empire. During his childhood as a boy he met Najenda who just moved into the region for the first time. Falling in love at first sight he left the privileged life he no longer desired to follow her into the army. Using his talent, Rabac rose through the ranks to the point where he could serve and be by her side. He would also join Najenda in her deflection to the rebellion, even going as far risk his life to change the military records of both him and her to K.I.A. Because of this he shares a somewhat antagonistic relationship Susanoo who he views as a rival for Najenda's affections.!~

20613.name: Sheele
20613.desc: __Age:__ Mid 20's __Height:__ 160cm (5'3) Sheele is one of the members of the Assassin's group, Night Raid. While she seems to be clumsy and ditzy on the surface, she's a very caring and sweet person. She bears the Teigu "Ecstasy", a huge pair of scissors that can cut through anything. ~!Growing up in the low districts of the Capital, her clumsy nature caused many people throughout her life often consider her useless, isolating her from nearly everyone. At one point in her past, she had a friend who didn't mind her personality but was attacked by her ex-boyfriend. Sheele killed the boyfriend in order to protect her, revealing that she had a strange talent for killing. However, in the end, this broke their friendship. Soon after, a gang-related to the man she killed earlier sought revenge against her and had already murdered her parents. Sheele defeated the group and was later scouted by the Revolutionary Army who learned of her ability. By joining, she wanted to use her talent in a way that would make her useful to others by helping fix society. She is one of the first members to warm up to Tatsumi, comforting him while he mourned his deceased friends from his home village. Later, she is attacked by Seryuu, and killed while saving Mine from harm.!~ (Source: Akame ga Kill! Wiki)

20613.name: Bulat
20613.desc: Bulat was once a high-ranking Imperial Officer known as "100 Man-Slayer Bulat". He later decided to betray the Empire when his superior was framed for not giving in to the Prime Minister's agenda. Bulat became disgusted with the Empire that cared more for bribes, than merit regardless of how hard he worked. After leaving the Empire, he joined the Revolutionaries, and eventually Night Raid. Bulat's teigu is the Demon Armor: Incursio an Armor-type teigu that took on the form of a short sword with a chain link tassel in its sealed form. Once released, the user was enveloped in a full body armor. ~!He died in battle, before his death at the hands of his former boss he entrusted the Incursio to [Tatsumi](https://anilist.co/character/64749/).!~

20613.name: Chelsea
20613.desc: A seasoned assassin working for the Revolutionary Army, having successfully carried out countless missions. While she is somewhat aloof and carefree when not on the job, she is also extremely objective and is often quite blunt when voicing her opinions. Her Teigu, 'Gaea Foundation', is a cosmetics box that allows her to instantly change her appearance and build at will. Later in the series: ~!she develops a crush on Tatsumi.!~

20613.name: Esdeath
20613.desc: __Height:__ 170 cm (5'7) Esdeath is a high-ranking general of the Empire, and leader of the Jaegers. She enjoys torturing her enemies slowly, seen when she used her Teigu to put large blocks of ice in a cauldron so that the people inside would die slower and suffer more. Despite her sadistic actions, she is actually shown to have a compassionate heart when it comes to the lives of her men and others close to her. Her Teigu is called Demons Extract, which allows her to manipulate ice and mold it from nothing. ~!She is looking for love and although her expectations were high when she saw [Tatsumi](https://anilist.co/character/64749)'s skill, she smiled and fell in love with him instantly !~

20613.name: Kurome
20613.desc: Kurome is a member of the Jaegers, and the younger sister of [Akame](https://anilist.co/character/63351/Akame). Like her sister, she has a big appetite and is often seen eating, usually candy. She stubbornly refuses to share her candy with even her comrades. Kurome wields an offensive Teigu like her sister, in the form of a sword named "March of the Dead: Yatsuhusa", which allows her to enslave up to 8 enemies killed with the Teigu. Also like her sister, she is extremely skilled in the art of the sword and assassination. ~!When she was a child, her parents had sold both Akame and her to the Empire.!~

20613.name: Wave
20613.desc: Wave is a member of the Jaegers who is very similar to Tatsumi. He is from a small town on the coast where he served in the Imperial Navy, and brought a massive bag full of seafood with him when he joined the Jaegers. Also similar to Tatsumi, he is often used for Comic Relief. When he first arrived at the meeting room for his new group, he first encountered Bors, who ignored him shyly until the rest of the crew showed up. Like Tatsumi, Wave uses a sword in combat and has formidable skills. He Wields the Armor type Teigu, " Grand Chariot ", which is a newer version of Incursio. (Source: Akame ga Kill! Wiki)

20613.name: Susanoo
20613.desc: __Age:__ Approx. 1000 __Faction:__ Night Raid __User:__ Najenda Susanoo is one of the new members of Night Raid that [Najenda](https://anilist.co/character/72267/Najenda) brought back with her from the Revolutionary Army HQ. He is a tall man with distinctive bull horns coming out of the sides of his head. He saves the members of Night Raid (except Tatsumi), who were all under the effects of a powerful poison created by Dr. Stylish. He is then caught in an explosion created by Stylish's exploding minions, and it is revealed that he is a Human Teigu, regenerating his lost limbs immediately.

20613.name: Bors
20613.desc: A member of Jaegars, he was formerly a member of the Incineration Squad. His Teigu is Rubicante, a flamethrower type Teigu. Despite his looks he is married to an attractive woman and has a child. He always wears a mask and tries to hide his face; yet Esdese forcefully removes his mask at one point and claims there is nothing wrong with his face. ~!He is killed by Chelsea while trying to retreat.!~

20613.name: Najenda
20613.desc: Najenda, also known as The Hunk of the Rebellion is the head of the assassin group Night Raid. Taciturn, sharp-minded and level-headed, she leads the group with a surprisingly gentle but firm air. Her years of experience serving in the Empire as a general have made her a highly capable leader. Najenda is sometimes mistaken as a man due to her boyish appearance, even sometimes being nicknamed 'The Hunk of the Rebellion" by her cohorts. She tends to have a habit of telling "cold jokes" and making bad puns. Her teigu is a biological type teigu named [Susanoo](https://anilist.co/character/65559/Susanoo)

20613.name: Seryuu Ubiquitous
20613.original: セリュー・ユビキタス
20613.desc: Seryuu is a member of the Jaegers, formerly of the Imperial Guard. She has a strong fixation upon "Justice", originating from her father's service in the Emperial Army and subsequent death. She also highly respected Ogre the Demon, her superior and teacher, and was heavily anguished by his death as well. Her opinion of justice is blunt, she believes the Night Raid are evil for their actions as assassins, but believes killing in service to justice is always right, which ultimately makes her opinion of murder similar to theirs if not the complete same thing. However, Seryuu has a twisted sense of right and wrong, bordering on a completely black and white view of the world. All people who serve the empire, despite the deeds they do both publicly and not, are considered good by her, while those who oppose it, even those forced to against their will, are pure evil. Her twisted view of justice has caused a level of distrust towards her by her own teammates, as well as generally the entire emperial forces, on occasion, as she brutally murdered a group of prisoners long before they could interrogate the group. (Source: Akame ga Kill! Wiki)

20613.name: Run
20613.desc: Run is a member of the Jägers. He's a lover of literature. His teigu Banri Hishou Mastema is a wing type. Run is the kind of Esdeath's adviser, because he's probably the smartest person of Jägers.

20613.name: Spear
20613.desc: Spear was the daughter of the former Prime Minister Chouri, and a disciple of the "Temple of the Imperial Fist". (Source: Akame ga Kill! Wiki)

20613.name: Suzuka
20613.desc: Suzuka is a member of the Four Rakshasa Demons, who served as the Prime Minister's squad of executioners. (Source: Akame ga Kill! Wiki)

20613.name: Gozuki
20613.desc: Gozuki is the leader of the newly formed assassination squad of the Empire, the Elite Seven. (Source: Akame ga Kill! Wiki)

20613.name: Mez
20613.desc: Mez is the daughter of Gozuki as well as a member of the Four Rakshasa Demons, who served as the Prime Minister's squad of executioners. (Source: Akame ga Kill! Wiki)

20613.name: Daidara
20613.desc: Daidara is a member of Esdeath's former bodyguards, known as "The Three Beasts". He's a battle fanatic who will fight anyone who seems strong, and constantly takes every opportunity to improve himself when he can. He is first introduced attacking and assassinating the former Prime Minister, along with Liver and Nyau. Later, they are ordered by Esdeath to assassinate another political rival on a cruise ship. There they encountered Tatsumi and Bulat.

20613.name: Dr. Stylish
20613.desc: Dr. Stylish was a member of the Jaegers, and formerly was a Doctor in the service of the Empire. He was obsessed with being Stylish and looking good. He is however at heart a classic mad scientist caring nothing for the lives of his subjects and more concerned for his own experiments than anything else. He was however very intelligent being able to see through Tatsumi's cover even when Esdeath could not. He has also been heavily hinted to be homosexual.

20613.name: Budou
20613.desc: Described as a man who rarely leaves the battlefield, General Budou is a hardened man, with years of training and military hardship shaping him to his current state. As a general born from a celebrated lineage, Budou takes great pride in his honor, and that of the empire. Unlike most generals, he doesn't affiliate himself with the Prime Minister, and the general downright detests the pig. He even went on to state that once the rebels would be crushed, those who caused chaos in the country would incur his wrath. His teigu is called "Adrammelech," but its abilities are unknown.

20613.name: Air
20613.desc: Air was one of three girls who were sold to Bach, due to their village being deeply in debt by the over taxation of the Empire.

20613.name: Aria
20613.desc: Aria was a girl from the capital that offered Tatsumi a place to stay when she found him on the streets after being conned by Leone. She came from a wealthy family and had a habit of offering strays a place to stay in her mansion. ~!Apparently, she and her family had an interest of luring people from the country to their place and tortured them to death. Night Raid killed her family, and Aria was killed by Tatsumi after he witnessed the death of his two friends, Sayo and Ieyasu, at the hands of Aria's family.!~

20613.name: Dooya
20613.desc: Dooya was an assassin sent from the Northern Tribes. She was killed by Kurome and her dead body was turned into a puppet under Kurome's command. As mentioned by Kurome, she was a confident and cheerful person and she still exhibits her confidence even as a corpse puppet. She wields two hand guns. She is shown to be an expert marksman even was able to overwhelm Mine, a self-titled "genius marksman," for a while. Because of her state as a resurrected puppet, she does not feel pain or fatigue, enabling her to fight stronger opponents such as Teigu users without possessing a Teigu herself.

20613.name: Gamal
20613.desc: Gamal was a corrupt oil merchant who was eventually targeted by Night Raid under contract, and killed by Leone and Akame.

20613.name: Ibara
20613.desc: Ibara is one of the Four Temple Rakshasa Demons, a group of executioners who serve the Prime Minister. He can freely control his body to stretch his body parts and manipulate them. Ibara seems to have a cocky and bloodthirsty personality, nearly attacking Seryu upon the first meeting of the Demons and the Jaegers. He admonishes Seryu for her skepticism of the Four Demon's abilities, and tells her that she and the Jaegers should "Just sit back and drink wine in this mansion".

20613.name: Fal
20613.desc: Fal was one of three girls who were sold to Bach, due to their village being deeply in debt by the over taxation of the Empire.

20613.name: Hana
20613.desc: Hana was a member of Team Stylish. Hana (鼻 ・はな) mean "nose" in japanese

20613.name: Honest  Daijin
20613.desc: A large man with a demonic appearance, including a crown of horns that give the idea that they are growing out of his head. He manipulates Emperor Makoto and runs the Empire behind the scenes this way. He is the primary antagonist of the series, and hates Night Raid and the Revolutionary Army strongly. He is often shown eating. He cares very little for anything and will do anything to maintain his own power. It is stated that Emperor Makoto only won the battle of succession due to the Prime Minister's influence and planning. The Prime Minister before him was Chouri. A man that was a kindhearted but strong will. A strong adviser to the former emperor, who desired to return to the capital to stop the decline of the empire. When the Prime Minister became aware of this he had Esdeath's force's (The "Three Beasts") to kill him. He is known to have one son named Syura who is currently the leader of the secret police Wild Hunt, and he is also known to have one blood relative named Iwokaru, who was killed by Night Raid.

20613.name: Luna
20613.desc: Luna was one of three girls who were sold to Bach, due to their village being deeply in debt by the over taxation of the Empire.

20613.name: Liver
20613.desc: Liver was the leader of Esdeath's personal bodyguards and the strongest group in her army, known as "The Three Beasts". He was a refined and battle-hardened man, who was deeply loyal to Esdeath. He once was an accomplished General in the Empire's army and Bulat's superior years ago. During the Empire's war against the Southern Lands, he was dismissed from his post due to being framed on false charges when he did not give in to the Prime Minister's bribes. At the military tribunal he attempted to valiantly defend himself using his records and merits, but it fell on deaf ears. After ultimately being left to rot prison for the rest of his life Esdeath appeared, and in a surprising move she freed him on the condition that he would join her army. She valued his abilities and achievements, thinking that it would be a waste to leave him imprisoned. Esdeath also offered him patronage against the Prime Minister and his other enemies. Grateful for being saved and granted a new life back in the military, he became indebted to Esdeath, leading some of her most loyal men. When he and Bulat met once again for the first time in years on the cruise ship "Ryussen" with their paths in life having diverged, they battled to the death with their loyalty and ideals on the line.

20613.name: Horimaka
20613.desc: Owner of the teigu: Adayasu, a scythe teigu whose abilities are a mystery. Because the empire is unaware of this teigu, Horimaka is Bolick's trump card.

20613.name: Kubikiri Zank
20613.desc: Zank was once an imperial executioner. Possess the Imperial Arm Spectator, that has the form of a headpiece with a large eye attached to it. He was known for severing the heads of his victims. Night Raid was contracted to track him down and kill him.

20613.name: Me
20613.desc: Me was a member of Team Stylish. Me (目 ・め) means "eye" in japanese

20613.name: Nyau
20613.desc: Nyau is a member of Esdeath's bodyguard "The Three Beasts". Despite his playful personality and innocent looks, he was by far the most sadistic member of the group with his hobby of collecting human faces. Like the other members he was charged by Esdeath to lure out Night Raid while getting rid of the Prime Minister's political enemies in secret. He battled with Tatsumi and Bulat aboard the cruise ship "Ryuusen" where he caused all the passengers to fall asleep by using his Teigu, Scream. ~!He was the last of the Three Beasts to fall, killed by Tatsumi in one blow after activating Incursio.!~

20613.name: Ogre
20613.desc: Ogre was a captain from the Capital Guard, and the former superior of Seryuu. He was also the one that recommended Dr. Stylish to Seryuu, as she wanted to become stronger. He had been accepting bribes from an oil merchant named Gamal and other criminals, and often framed innocent people to take the fall for the criminals. ~!Ogre was killed by Tatsumi, after he threatened to annihilate the client and her family.!~

20613.name: Rokugou
20613.desc: Rokugou was a general serving The Empire before his attempt of defection which failed. He was assassinated by Kurome and became one of her puppets.

20613.name: Trooma
20613.desc: He is a member of Team Stylish. Trooma is one of Dr. Stylish's stronger henchmen. It is unknown whether he had Dr. Stylish perform experiments on him or not.

20613.name: Koutei
20613.desc: Koutei is the young ruler of the empire. He is shown to be a naive young boy who wishes to lead his people to a bright future. Unfortunately, due to the Prime Minister's influence, he is largely ignorant to the suffering of his people, and is actually contributing to the collapse of The Empire.

20613.name: Shura
20613.desc: Shura is a mysterious individual who has recently begun to make his move. He seems to share his father's lust for power as well as his corruption but wishes to surpass him in terms of being rotten. He created and is leading the majorly corrupt and twisted Secret Police "Wild Hunt" to aid the Jägers and to compensate for their losses; however, he regards the empire as a toy. The incident in the theater implies he solely enjoys causing carnage. Also much like Cosmina, Champ, and Enshin, Shura took part in the mass rape during the Umatora Theater incident where the producer denies the accusation of it's plays criticizing the Empire and tries to bribe Shura, but he declines the money in a heartbeat declaring the death sentence on them leading to the entire team being raped and killed by Wild Hunt in which Shura shows his twisted side by calling this action an investigation. He then mentions that this is all because Esdeath was not present in the Capital. After his devilish act, Shura joyfully tells his father how much of a kick he gets from leading Wild Hunt telling he made preparations to take out Night Raid. Along with his father, he watches the Great General Budo arrive. ~!In Chapter 52, he tortures what he thinks is an unarmed Lubbock; however, Lubbock manages to trick Shura into removing his shackles. He then pulls some string out of his mouth and immediately kills Shura. !~

20613.name: Shoui
20613.desc: He is the baron of the Empire.

20613.name: Natala
20613.desc: Natala was a member of the Empire's assassination group Group of Terror appearing in the prequel series Akame Ga Kill!: Zero until his death. He is now serving as one of Kurome's main corpse puppets. Natala is one of the members of Kurome's group of assassins. He died some time before the main story and his deceased body was reanimated by Kurome using Yatsufusa. He is later use in a battle against Night Raid, defending Kurome from her enemies. After the battle, Natala became one of the last two puppets, the other being Dooya. Natala wielded Trisula. Mine mistakenly thought it was a Teigu, but it is in fact a Shingu. Because the weapon's design allows it to expand and contract at will, its style of killing is to cut the opponent's body in two. Natala bifurcated Chelsea with this weapon.

20613.name: Kaku
20613.desc: Kaku was a member of Team Stylish. He was considered to be one of the strongest among Dr. Stylish's minions.

20613.name: Mimi
20613.desc: Mimi was a member of Team Stylish. Mimi (耳・みみ) means "ear" in japanese

20613.name: Chouri
20613.desc: The former prime minister and the father of Spear.

20613.name: Numa Seika
20613.desc: Numa Seika was the Prince of the Northern Tribes. Know for his in combat and tactics abilities.

20613.name: Sten
20613.desc: Sten is one of the Four Rakshasa Temple Demons who serve as the Prime Minister's squad of executioners. He seems to think of murdering as "releasing one's soul." Sten is a large man with a heavily muscled build similar to Ibara. He has a long braided hairstyle with hair sticking far out at the sides and bald at the top of his head. He has long bushy beard and mustache, bushy eyebrows, and dark prominent circles around his eyes. Similar to his fellow Rakshasa Demons, he wears armor plating on his forearms. He also wears a large Iron pauldron on his left shoulder. ~!In Chapter 36, Lubbock hits him with a spear made of threads. Sten is able to withstand the attack, but Lubbock uses the threads that pierced Sten's body to cut his heart into pieces.!~

20613.name: Toby
20613.desc: Toby was a member of Team Stylish.

20613.name: Ieyasu
20613.desc: Ieyasu was a childhood friend of Tatsumi and Sayo that set out on a journey to the capital to earn money for their village. He seemed to have a bad sense of direction and was a known troublemaker. During their journey, they were attacked by night bandits which separated them. He managed to stay with Sayo and got invited by Aria to her mansion. They were served with a meal that made them lose consciousness. He was put on drugs which made him suffer from the "Lubora disease." He survived until Tatsumi and Night Raid arrived at the place where he, Sayo, and other people that were lured by Aria and her family, were imprisoned. He seems to be glad when Tatsumi killed Aria. He then succumbed to the last stages of "Lubora disease." Ieyasu was shown to wield an axe. He presumably possessed combat abilities on par with Tatsumi, as they and Sayo trained together since they were little.

20613.name: Sayo
20613.desc: She set out with Tatsumi and Ieyasu to earn money for their village. On the way, they were attacked by night bandits and got separated. Sayo managed to stay with Ieyasu while Tatsumi was separated from them. She and Ieyasu were then invited by Aria to her mansion, and she provided them with a meal that was drugged, making them lose consciousness. Sayo was then tortured to death, although she didn't submit to Aria and her family even until the moment of her death. Tatsumi personally slays Aria after he is told the truth about Aria and her sadistic family. There is a chance that Tatsumi was in love with her, as the illusion that Zank showed revealed her to be the most important person in the world to him. Sayo was seen carrying a bow and a stack of arrows. She seemed to have good combat abilities and presumably was a well-trained archer, as Tatsumi stated that both she and Ieyasu were strong.

20613.name: Gebaze
20613.desc: __Eye Color:__ Black __Hair Color:__ Black __Gebaze__ was the Head of Public Finance of The Empire. He was a large man with dark hair and a small mustache who wore clothing resembling those of a sultan. Additionally around his neck he wore a golden jeweled necklace.

20613.name: Shihandai
20613.desc: __Eye Color:__ Dark Blue __Hair Color:__ Blond __Shihandai__ is a rather tall man with long, blond hair which he wore in a braid. His outfit consists of a lightly armored, long white shirt and grey pants. He also wears a belt around his wasit and around his chest to attach his shoulder pieces. He was one of the bodyguards in charge of Iokal's protection, and a former instructor at the martial arts temple of The Empire.

20613.name: Esdeath no Chichi
20613.desc: Esdeath's Father was a tribal leader of the Partas Clan. He taught Esdeath her primary survival skills and honed her hunting abilities. He is a tall middle-aged man with light blue hair worn in a mullet-like style, as well as a short beard, and blue eyes. He wears tribal clothing consisting of a black short-sleeved turtleneck shirt, a long white kimono, and a red vest on top of it, with a sash on his waist and a golden medallion around his neck. He also wears a black headband with his clan's symbol on it.

20613.name: Gin
20613.desc: __Eye Color:__ Cyan (Manga), Grey (Anime) __Hair Color:__ Blonde (Manga), Silver (Anime) __Introduction:__ Gin was a member of the Empire's assassination group Group of Terror. __Appearance:__ She is a young girl with silver hair worn in a long ponytail. She wears a sleeveless trench coat with a dark belt, black tights, boots and gloves.

20613.name: The First Emperor
20613.desc: __Eye Color:__ Green __Hair Color:__ Green __Introduction:__ The First Emperor was the Empire's founder over a thousand years prior to the massive rebellion and the one who the prompted for the creation of more advanced weaponry that would serve as a means to protect his country. __Appearance:__ He is a middle-aged man with green hair, green eyes, and a beard. He wears what is now a standard attire for an Emperor, which consists of a blue mantle, a large headdress, and a golden scepter.

20613.name: Kaiser Frog
20613.desc: __Abilities:__ Dissolving Acid, Enhanced Tongue __Introduction:__ Kaiser Frog is a giant, frog type Danger Beast species __Appearance:__ It has the appearance of a giant, frog creature. It is green with red spots and yellow eyes. It was considered the strongest of all frogs in the world and was known to have incredibly strong stomach acid that can dissolve anything they swallow. It also has a long tongue which can be used to grab prey. ~! Thie particular Kaiser Frog was revealed during Kurome and Bols' battle against Night Raid to be one of Kurome's newest puppets. !~

20613.name: Cornelia
20613.desc: __Height:__ 168 cm (5'6'') __Eye Color:__ Blue __Hair Color:__ Blonde __Introduction:__ Cornelia was a member of the Empire's Assassination group (former group of Akame). __Appearance:__ Cornelia is a young girl with long blonde hair and blue eyes. She wears a long white shirt with black pants and shoes. She also wears silver hoop earrings.

20613.name: Henter
20613.desc: __Henter__ was a survivor of the Ban Tribe. He was known to possess remarkable skill with knives, and for his tricky movement. He was killed by Kurome and was turned into one of her corpse puppets.

20613.name: Kije
20613.desc: __Age:__ Mid 20s __Eye Color:__ Purple __Hair Color:__ Light Brown Kije is Bols' wife. She is known to be cheerful, very loving and caring towards Bols.

20613.name: The Lord
20613.desc: __Eye Color:__ Purple __Hair Color:__ White The Lord is the leader of the largest religious organization in the east of the Empire, The Path of Peace. He is a tall, slender man with the Path of Piece necklace around his forehead and long white hair. He wears priest-like clothing. He is said to be part Danger Beast, however, the details of this heritage are unknown.

20613.name: Najasho
20613.desc: __Height:__ 162 cm (5'4'') __Eye Color:__ Golden __Hair Color:__ Blond Najasho is a member of the Empire's Assassination group (former group of Akame). He is the leader of the Elite Seven and is called "Chief" by the members.

20613.name: Ritone
20613.desc: Ritone is one of the spies for the Revolutionary Army. He is partnered up with [Pais.](https://anilist.co/character/166798)

20613.name: Pais
20613.desc: Pais is one of the spies for the Revolutionary Army. She's partnered with [Ritone](https://anilist.co/character/166797).

20613.name: Bill
20613.desc: Bill (otherwise known as Uncle Bill) was the leader of The Empire's assassination group, Group of Terror.

20613.name: Death Tagool
20613.desc: __Class:__ Super Class __Abilities:__ Energy Beams, Enhanced Physical Abilities Death Tagool is a giant dinosaur-like Danger Beast species.

20613.name: Logue
20613.desc: Bols' daughter.

20613.name: Guy
20613.desc: Guy was a member of the Empire's Assassination group (former group of Akame).

20613.name: Jijo
20613.desc: The Palace maid was one of the revolutionaries who was tasked with assisting Tatsumi and Lubbock with infiltrating the royal palace.

20613.name: Green
20613.desc: Green is a member of the Empire's Assassination group (former group of Akame)

20613.name: Tsukushi
20613.desc: Tsukushi was a member of the Empire's Assassination group (former group of Akame).

20613.name: Iokal
20613.desc: Iokal was a blood relative of the Prime Minister Honest.

20613.name: Bolic
20613.desc: Bolic was a spy working for the Prime Minister Honest posing as a high-ranking individual of the Path of Peace. His goal was to kill the leader of the Path of Peace without revealing his true identity and take his place, so that the Empire could manipulate the religious organization for its own purposes.

20613.name: Apeman
20613.desc: Apeman is a large, gorilla-like Danger Beast species.

20613.name: Wall
20613.desc: Wall was a famous guardsmanwho used a riot shield as his main weapon.

20613.name: Poney
20613.desc: Poney is a member of The Empire's assassination group Elite Seven (former group of Akame). She uses the Shingu Yocto-bottoms.

20613.name: Hekatonkheires
20613.desc: Magical Beast Transformation: Hekatonkheires, also known by its nickname Koro, was a biological Teigu owned by Seryu Ubiquitous who was often seen with her.

124080.name: Kyouko Hori
124080.desc: __Height:__ 163 cm (5'4") Kyouko Hori is one of the main protagonists of [Horimiya](https://anilist.co/anime/124080/Horimiya/), along with [Izumi Miyamura](https://anilist.co/character/66173/Izumi-Miyamura). She is a student in Class 3-1 of Katagiri Senior High School. Kyouko is mostly a very energetic and popular person who always creates a happy atmosphere around herself. She is a hard-worker in all aspects of her life, and, according to Izumi Miyamura, she scores above 90% for all her tests.

124080.name: Izumi Miyamura
124080.desc: __Height:__ 169 cm Miyamura is often mistaken for an otaku for his sneaky character. The truth behind his long hair and clothes is to hide his piercings and his excessive amount of tattoos. This is a secret that only [Hori](https://anilist.co/character/66171) and [Ishikawa](https://anilist.co/character/66961) know. Izumi is a very thoughtful kid. He is a person who looks weak but is very strong.

124080.name: Tooru Ishikawa
124080.desc: __Height__: 174 cm Tooru is friendly with everyone, and has a calm personality. He attends Katagiri Senior Highschool. ~!At first he hates Miyamura due to his close relationship with Hori, who he had a crush on at the time. He confessed to her and was immediately rejected. In time he became a great friend of Miyamura.!~

124080.name: Yuki Yoshikawa
124080.desc: A close friend of [Kyouko Hori's](https://anilist.co/character/66171/Kyouko-Hori) who attends the same high school as her.

124080.name: Remi Ayasaki
124080.desc: __Height:__ 158 cm A member of the Student Council and she is known as the girlfriend of Kakeru Sengoku who attends Katagiri Senior High School where she is enrolled in class 3-5. She is more of a mascot in the student council, and is shown to do little to no work at all. Remi is usually shown as a rather childish and immature girl who has a very straightforward personality, and often wears her emotions on her sleeve. And seems to rely on other people's help. She's also not very smart, often compared to [Miyamura](https://anilist.co/character/66173/Miyamura-Izumi) about which one is more of an idiot. She loves insects, though she's bad with dragonflies. Her room is filled with her insect collection, and she has been nicknamed the Insect Queen. She also enjoys reading, especially fairy tales. She's also comically bad at cooking, just like [Kakeru Sengoku](https://anilist.co/character/72447/Sengoku-Kakeru).

124080.name: Shuu Iura
124080.desc: **Height:** 172 cm (5'8") He is a friend of [Izumi Miyamura](https://anilist.co/character/66173/Miyamura-Izumi) and pretty much everyone at school. He has his own way of thinking and always seems excited; he is a colleague from another class.

124080.name: Souta Hori
124080.desc: Kyouko's young brother. He sees Kyouko as a motherly figure because she has been the one taking care of him since he was born because of the nature of their parents' work. In the beginning of the story, he is brought back to the Hori household by Izumi after he had fallen down on the street. Since then he has been very affectionate towards Izumi, going as far as calling him a non blood-related brother.

124080.name: Yuuna Okuyama
124080.desc: Yunna is a classmate of Souta. She bullies him but actually really likes him. Kyoko Hori is her role model. ~!In the manga timeskip she's best friend and in a relationship with Souta Hori.!~

124080.name: Reiko Terajima
124080.desc: She is a chemistry teacher at Katagiri High School and the homeroom teacher of class 3-1.

124080.name: Shin Yasuda
124080.desc: __Occupation:__ English Teacher __Affiliation:__ Student Council (Manager), Katagiri Senior High School He is one of the supporting characters for [Horimiya](https://anilist.co/anime/124080/Horimiya/). Yasuda loves high school girls and makes no attempt to hide this either. However, he never actually touches any of the girls, just acts overly friendly towards them and overly cold towards the guys. He often demands that any guys with girlfriends (mainly [Miyamura](https://anilist.co/character/66173/Izumi-Miyamura) and [Sengoku](https://anilist.co/character/72447/Kakeru-Sengoku)) break up with them, so that he can have them instead. Any time he is with only male students, he constantly bemoans the fact, loudly asking why they, and not some girls, are there. He also does not tend to remember the names of his male students, saying that he has no need to learn useless information. Many of Yasuda's female students also like him as well, thinking he's a cool, young, good looking teacher who's kind to them. Many of them like to visit with him in the counseling room. Yasuda even went out of his way to tell [Kyouko Hori](https://anilist.co/character/66171) to keep her ‘chin up’, and his little known fact about him is that he’s into ‘flat-chested’ girls, in an attempt to cheer her up with ‘confidence’.

124080.name: Kakeru Sengoku
124080.desc: __Height:__ 170 cm He is the charismatic president of the student council of Katagiri Senior High School who is enrolled in class 3-3, the childhood friend of [Kyouko Hori](https://anilist.co/character/66171/Hori-Kyouko) and the boyfriend of [Remi Ayasaki](https://anilist.co/character/66965/Ayasaki-Remi). Sengoku is a rather shy boy who gets embarrassed easily and he is a very wimpy where the slightest thing will make him cower in fear, especially things to do with horror or insects. Sengoku is very smart and serious, normally ranked #1 in the school (and #2 in phys ed). He enjoys reading and has an incredible level of concentration while doing so, the point of ignoring everything else going around him. He is generally not very expressive with his emotions. The sole exception is his anger or irritation, which he shows all the time as he is the Student Councils President. Even though he makes threats and gets angry towards those breaking the rules, he doesn't actually like doing so. Sengoku is very insecure when it comes to his body. Thinking his slender body is embarrassing and always refusing to show it in various occasions, even going as far as to make up extravagant lies to get out of it. He wears multiple layers of clothing to hide his body type.

124080.name: Sakura Kouno
124080.desc: __Height:__ 163 cm She is the vice-president of the student council. She is very competent and often does​ support work. ~!She has a crush on Tooru Ishikawa, in chapter 28, she confessed to him.!~

124080.name: Akane Yanagi
124080.desc: __Height:__ 168 cm He is a 3rd year at Katagiri High School​ and a member of Hori and Miyamura's regular group of friends. He is enrolled in class 3-6. He has very bad eyesight and cannot see properly without his glasses.

124080.name: Ichirou Watabe
124080.desc: __Height:__ 170 cm He is a friend of [Izumi Miyamura](https://anilist.co/character/66173/Izumi-Miyamura). He attends the same high school, and is enrolled in class 3-1.

124080.name: Daiki Mizouchi
124080.desc: __Height:__ 176 cm He is one of Hori and Miyamura's classmates. He attends the same school and is enrolled in the same class, 3-1.

124080.name: Honoka Sawada
124080.desc: __Height:__ 150 cm Sawada is a very clingy towards Kyouko Hori. Due to her attachment to Hori, she often gets angry when Hori is together with Izumi Miyamura, choosing to push him away. She views Miyamura as a love rival, but also as a brotherly figure. She was very close to her older brother who passed away some years ago. She also appears to have mild androphobia, often freezing up, running away, or hiding when approached by men. However, ever since she got to know Miyamura, she would hide behind him instead whenever a male approaches her. She is slowly getting used to being around Miyamura's male friends. ~!She is one of the side characters that make​ an appearance in chapter 29. She is first seen stalking Miyamura, causing many people, including Hori, to assume she has a crush on Miyamura. However, it is revealed that the person she has a crush on is Hori.!~

124080.name: Kouichi Shindou
124080.desc: __Height:__ 173 cm He is a supporting character in the series. He attended the same junior high school as Izumi and Makio.

124080.name: Chika Ichijou
124080.desc: __Height:__ 154 cm Chika is a 3rd year at Yasaka High School.

124080.name: Makio Tanihara
124080.desc: __Height:__ 168 cm He is a 3rd-year​ high school student attending Kashi High School. He attended the same junior high school as Miyamura and Shindou.

124080.name: Motoko Iura
124080.desc: __Height:__ 150 cm She is [Shuu Iura](https://anilist.co/character/66967/Iura-Shuu)'s younger sister. Self-described as an untalkative, gloomy type, Motoko is the opposite of Shuu. She tends to keep to herself and has a hard time making friends. However, unlike Shuu, this personality also carries over to her school life, though she is much more forceful and violent towards her brother than others. She is also pretty smart but lacks the confidence to use it too well.

124080.name: Yuriko Hori
124080.desc: She is the mother of Kyouko and Souta.

124080.name: Kyousuke Hori
124080.desc: __Height:__ 180 cm Kyousuke is Kyouko's father who is often not home because of work.

124080.name: Iori Miyamura
124080.desc: __Occupation:__ Owner and manager of the Miyamura family's store She's is the wife of Naozumi Miyamura and the mother of [Izumi Miyamura](https://anilist.co/character/66173/Izumi-Miyamura).

124080.name: Miki Yoshikawa
124080.desc: [Yuki's](https://anilist.co/character/66963) older sister.

124080.name: Keigo Izumi
124080.desc: A friend from Souta's elementary school.

124080.name: Kayo Yashiro
124080.desc: **Height:** 176 cm Caretaker of the Ishikawa household.

104276.name: Katsuki Bakugou
104276.desc: __Height:__ 172 cm (5'7") __Quirk:__ Explosion Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Katsuki is a crude, arrogant, short-tempered, and aggressive person, especially at the beginning of the series. Due to the constant praise of his abilities and powerful Quirk, Katsuki has developed a superiority complex, and because of that, he desires to be the first and best at everything. He loves to win above all else and cannot stand it when he doesn't, leading him to lose his already short temper if he achieves anything but a complete victory. Katsuki is not only very athletic and talented at fighting, but also very intelligent and extremely perceptive, capable of strategic planning and improvisation. Additionally, his grades are among the highest of his class. Katsuki also possesses surprising talent in other areas, such as cooking and music, even though he doesn't show a particular interest in them. Overall, Katsuki is considered a natural-born genius with the potential to be one of the best Pro Heroes. Katsuki's Quirk "Explosion" allows him to secrete nitroglycerin-like sweat from the palms of his hands and ignite it on command, allowing him to create strong explosions. The more Katsuki sweats, the stronger his explosions become. Not only can Katsuki use the explosions for attacking, he can also use them to propel himself and navigate through the air at high speeds, allowing him to fly at his opponents without giving them time to react, as well as evade incoming attacks, even whi

104276.name: Izuku Midoriya
104276.desc: __Height:__ 166 cm (5'5¼") __Quirk:__ One For All Student in Class 1-A at U.A High School. Although he was born without a Quirk, Izuku's innate heroism and strong sense of justice manages to catch the attention of the legendary hero [All Might](https://anilist.co/character/89224). Izuku has since become All Might's closest pupil. Izuku is a very timid, reserved, and polite boy. Although initially portrayed as insecure, tearful, and vulnerable, Izuku gradually matures into a more confident and braver person. His infectious leadership skills, combined with his passion and strategic abilities, have turned Izuku into a central figure of Class 1-A. He is caring and emotional, never hesitating to help or rescue someone in danger, even if he knows that he might not be strong or otherwise qualified enough to do it. Izuku is extremely (and sometimes scarily) enthusiastic about topics related to heroes. His dream drives him to write down notes about everything he learns about heroes' Quirks and fighting capabilities. Thanks to this practice, Izuku has developed a great analytical mind and can form complex battle plans in a few seconds, factoring in the best ways he can utilize the Quirks of allies and enemies alike for his own advantage. Izuku's Quirk "One For All" was transferred to him from All Might. His Quirk allows him to stockpile an enormous amount of raw power, allowing him to significantly enhance all of his physical abilities to various boundless levels. This results in unbel

104276.name: Shouto Todoroki
104276.desc: __Height:__ 176 cm (5'9") __Affiliation:__ U.A. High School __Quirk:__ Half-Cold Half-Hot Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School, where he got in through official recommendations. He is the youngest son of the top hero [Endeavor](https://anilist.co/character/126158). Shouto initially has a cold, aloof personality, which stemmed from his complicated family life. Focused and unemotional, Shouto preferred to keep things to himself instead of hanging out with others. After the events of the U.A. Sports Festival, however, he notably became more sociable and kinder than ever before. He even gained a sense of humor and would occasionally smile, although still retaining some fragments of his previous distant attitude and nonchalant demeanor. While usually quiet and reserved, Shouto initially possessed a moderate level of arrogance, which, combined with his solitary tendencies, sometimes made him take the initiative without considering the opinions of others. Shouto's Quirk Half-Cold Half-Hot gives him the ability to generate ice from the right side of his body, and flames from his left side. Due to years of rejecting his father, Shouto has developed a habit of favoring ice, even when fire would be a better option. This grudge also caused him to have difficulty controlling his flames. If he overuses one element without utilizing the other, then his own body temperature will suffer.

104276.name: Ochako Uraraka
104276.desc: __Height:__ 156 cm (5'1") __Quirk:__ Zero Gravity Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School Ochako is an outgoing, lively person who thinks about everything positively, though she is objective enough to see flaws and virtues. She gets excited over little things very easily. Ochaco has been described by other students as "the most laidback girl" among her class, being very bubbly and kind of an airhead at times. She is often incredibly blunt without being aware of it. She is on good terms with everyone and is particularly close friends with several class members, including [Izuku](https://anilist.co/character/89028/Midoriya-Izuku), [Tenya Ida](https://anilist.co/character/89222/Iida-Tenya), and [Tsuyu](https://anilist.co/character/89223/Asui-Tsuyu). Ochaco's Quirk gives her the power to manipulate gravity upon touching solid things with the pads on her fingertips. The targets lose their gravitational pull, effectively making them weightless. She is able to activate or cancel her Quirk's effects by closing her fingers together, and is shown to be careful with her hands in order to avoid accidental quirk activation.

104276.name: Tenya Iida
104276.desc: __Height:__ 179 cm (5'10") __Quirk:__ Engine Class representative of Class 1-A at U.A. High School Tenya may look severe, but he's actually just a very serious person, who takes everything, even the most insignificant thing, seriously. A testament to his generally hyperactive and intense behavior, Tenya often exhibits plenty of peculiar tics, such as moving his arms around in strange chopping patterns or sometimes twitching his body uncontrollably. Tenya is very humble, willing to admit to his mistakes, apologize for rude behavior, and improve in areas he lacks. Being part of the highly-esteemed Ida Family of Heroes, Tenya is proud of his lineage and works hard to meet his expectations. He greatly admires his older brother, Tensei (also known as the Turbo Hero: Ingenium), and aspires to become a similar hero. Tenya's Quirk Engine gives him car-like engines in each of his calves, giving him incredible running speed and extreme kicking power. Tenya needs to fuel his engines by drinking orange juice. Tenya's engines have multiple gears; it is currently unknown how many, but it has been implied that there are more than three.

104276.name: Tsuyu Asui
104276.desc: __Affiliation:__ U.A. High School __Quirk:__ Frog Tsuyu is a very straight-forward girl that always says what's on her mind and what she thinks about others. She prefers to be called by her first name.

104276.name: Toshinori Yagi
104276.desc: __Height:__ 220 cm (7'2") __Quirk:__ One for All All Might is the No. 1 Hero and the "Symbol of Peace." In his hero form, All Might is a very tall and over-muscular man whose design resembles the american hero comics. His hair spikes on top of his head and his whole body has more shadows than a normal human being. However, in his true form, he is an overly-skinny man who spits a lot of blood out of his mouth and his clothes appear loose.

104276.name: Shouta Aizawa
104276.desc: __Height: __183 cm (6') __Occupation:__ Pro Hero, Teacher __Affiliation:__ U.A. High School __Quirk:__ Erasure Aizawa's hero name, Eraserhead, was coined by [Present Mic](https://anilist.co/character/127425) when they were younger. Using the binding cloth, Aizawa has a unique fighting style that allows him to immobilize his enemies. He is known to expel students that don't meet his standards, however it should be noted that he did not expel anyone from Class 1-A. Aizawa is extremely vocal, able to voice his opinions very easily. Although seeming emotionless and reserved, he has a soft spot for his students and genuinely cares for them.

104276.name: Tomura Shigaraki
104276.desc: __Height:__ 175 cm (5'9) __Quirk:__ Decay Leader of the League of Villains and protégé of [All For One](https://anilist.co/character/125956/All-For-One). He was raised by his master, All For One, with the goal of killing [All Might](https://anilist.co/character/89224/Yagi-Toshinori), and ultimately destroying the society he represents. Tomura is a very twisted, malevolent, and maliciously warped young man, who is considered to be the polar opposite of [Izuku Midoriya](https://anilist.co/character/89028/Midoriya-Izuku). He doesn't care for his or almost anyone else's life, having no qualms about performing evil deeds like murdering innocent people. Tomura was initially perceived to be a "man-child": arrogant, selfish, dependent, and demanding, becoming angry if things didn't go his way and likening reality to some sort of video game. Unlike his mentor, Tomura lacked subtlety, preferring to eliminate problems through force. Much like a child, Tomura seemed unable to cope with his own feelings, instead lashing out and abusing both others or himself, tearing at his own neck when he becomes frustrated. Initially, Tomura seemingly caused destruction just for the sake of it and felt directionless about the League's path forward after [Stain](https://anilist.co/character/126067/Akaguro-Chizome)'s arrest.
