It would take a fateful meeting with Izuku in a mall for him to develop an epiphany and become aware of his true convictions: to crumble hero society through All Might's death. Tomur

104276.name: Momo Yaoyorozu
104276.desc: __Height:__ 173 cm (5'8") __Quirk:__ Creation Vice class representative of Class 1-A at U.A. High School. She was admitted to the school through official recommendations. Momo is a very prudent, dedicated person who acts as a natural leader. She is generally level-headed and calm in dangerous situations, but she isn't above falling into a panic. Momo can be blunt with her comments about people's mistakes and miscalculations, tending to be very direct and wishing to help her peers improve enough to become great heroes. Momo's Quirk gives her the ability to create any non-living material/object from her exposed skin by transforming the molecular structure of her fat cells. In order to create something, she needs to understand the molecular structure of which the material/object is made.

104276.name: Hitoshi Shinsou
104276.desc: __Height:__ 177 cm (5'9½") __Quirk:__ Brainwashing Student at U.A. High School, attending Class 1-C of the Department of General Education. Hitoshi is a stoic and straightforward person with an innate ability to spark conversation with anyone despite holding a reserved and quiet attitude most of the time. He is shown to be rather clever, knowing just the right words to manipulate others into replying to his comments, allowing him to activate his Quirk. He does not mind doing something underhanded to claim victory in a fight. Due to having his Brainwashing Quirk perceived as evil throughout his life, Hitoshi has been somewhat feared by those aware of his power and has been discriminated against solely because of the Quirk he was born with. This persecution led him to become resentful of those who had Quirks more associated with hero work. Regardless of his drawbacks, however, Hitoshi desires to become a Pro Hero more than anything. Hitoshi's Quirk Brainwashing allows him to put someone in a state where they are forced to obey whatever he commands. He can only activate this power when his target verbally responds to something he says. Brainwashing must be intentionally activated and will not take effect if Hitoshi doesn't want it to. Using a megaphone or anything that makes his voice artificial will not allow his Quirk to activate, as the said devices would transform his voice into an electronic signal.

104276.name: Eijirou Kirishima
104276.desc: __Height:__ 170 cm (5'7") __Quirk:__ Hardening Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Eijiro is a boisterous and outgoing guy with a fondness for manliness, often using the terms "manly" and "unmanly" to describe things and people he does or doesn't like, respectively. Eijiro is very honest and kind-hearted, having a straightforward way of thinking and following a specific code of chivalry that motivates him to live without regret. He is determined and selfless, bravely putting the safety of others before himself. He is also a big fan of Crimson Riot, a retro hero from whom he takes inspiration, including personal values and his hero name. Although Eijiro may not be as hot-blooded and competitive as [Katsuki Bakugou](https://anilist.co/character/88892), he does not shy away from comparing himself to him, with [Izuku](https://anilist.co/character/89028) stating that the two have managed to develop a relationship between equals. As a result, Eijiro is notably one of the few people that Katsuki holds in higher esteem. Eijiro's Quirk gives him the power to harden and sharpen any or all parts of his body, causing his flesh to become jagged and rock-like. There is a limit to how much damage his hardened body can withstand, which causes the Hardening itself to slowly dissipate, and Eijiro to lose stamina from struggling to keep his Quirk active.

104276.name: Minoru Mineta
104276.desc: __Height:__ 108 cm (3' 6½") __Quirk:__ Pop Off __Affiliation:__ U.A. High School __Fighting Style:__ Medium Ranged Support Minoru Mineta, also known as the Fresh-Picked Hero: Grape Juice, is a student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School, training to become a Pro Hero.

104276.name: Mina Ashido
104276.desc: __Height:__ 159 cm (5'3") __Quirk:__ Acid Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Mina is a cheerful and easygoing girl who usually displays a smile. Highly social and excitable, she loves to hang out with her friends and is shown to become very upset when denied an opportunity to be at a gathering. She possesses a strong fashion sense and likes to go shopping. Due to her athleticism and energy, Mina enjoys and is very skilled at dancing. Mina is extremely courageous and is viewed as an ideal personality for hero work. Mina's Quirk Acid allows her to produce a corrosive liquid from her body. She can control the solubility and viscosity of this corrosive liquid. There is a limit to how long she can produce the corrosive liquid until her skin gradually loses its natural resistance to it. Overusing her Quirk or pushing it too far can also be fatal, as it dehydrates her body very fast. Mina can use her acid offensively, but has shown utility with it as well, such as melting handholds for herself to climb with. She is also known to secrete a non-corrosive version of the acid from her feet in order to slide around.

104276.name: Mei Hatsume
104276.desc: __Height:__ 157 cm (5'2") __Quirk:__ Zoom Mei is a smart, off-setting, and assertive girl, often making those around her uncomfortable. She loves creating gadgets, which she refers to as her "super cute babies". Mei has a habit of "going straight to the point" and is very shameless and opportunistic when it comes to advertising her inventions. While talking to people, she has a habit of getting awkwardly close to them, which usually causes them to back away from her but she still moves up to them.

104276.name: Denki Kaminari
104276.desc: __Height:__ 168 cm (5'6") __Quirk:__ Electrification Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Denki is a friendly, social, and energetic boy who enjoys hanging out with others. He is rather casual when interacting with other people, including the generally unfriendly [Katsuki Bakugou](https://anilist.co/character/88892/Bakugou-Katsuki). Denki's Quirk Electrification allows him to store and discharge electricity. While he can also discharge this energy over a distance, Denki has little to no control over it, meaning it will go everywhere indiscriminately. Denki is also able to absorb and neutralize electricity and other lightning-based Quirks. Whenever Denki exceeds his wattage limit, he loses his ability to discharge energy, with his entire personality changing into that of a giggling idiot for a certain period until he reverts to normal. In this state, he is always giving thumbs-ups as a way to let others know that he is okay.

104276.name: Jin Bubaigawara
104276.desc: __Height:__ 178 cm (5'10") __Quirk:__ Double Villain affiliated with the League of Villains, and part of its Vanguard Action Squad. Jin has an incredibly unique personality: explosive, and lively with a very comedic demeanor. He enjoys assuming dramatic poses and eccentric facial expressions. Jin constantly contradicts himself, making a statement in one voice and immediately saying the opposite in another. This juxtaposition iss part of a mental instability that Jin embraces as a villain. He believes understanding your own identity is the most essential aspect in life, an understanding he lost during the 9-day conflict with his own clones that left him unsure whether he was the original or not. Now, if his mask is removed, he panics and threatens to "split" until he put his mask back on to become "whole". Jin's Quirk allows him to create an exact duplicate of anything, living or not. To duplicate something, he needs to know its precise measurements and characteristics. The clones he makes do not disappear; instead, they disintegrate into a mud-like substance after taking a certain amount of damage. The duplicates are less durable than the original, and the second duplicate is even less durable than the first. When Jin creates duplicates of a person, he has no control over the clones because they have their own autonomy, personalities, and abilities that are utterly identical to the original.

104276.name: Hanta Sero
104276.desc: __Height:__ 177 cm (5' 9¾") __Quirk:__ Tape Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Hanta is amicable and has proven to be one of the more sociable members of Class 1-A. He can sometimes be loud and showy, often trying to impress his peers with his Quirk. He is often the only person to call his classmates out when they act crazy. He is pretty humorous and usually makes jokes with his classmates. However, when push comes to shove, Hanta is a brave hero-in-training who wishes to prosper on his own while helping others do the same. Hanta's Quirk is that he has tape dispenser-like organs in his elbows, from which he can shoot long cellophane tape-like strips; he can also retract them. They appear to be somewhat sturdier than regular tape. Overuse of his Quirk will cause his skin to dry out. He can use his tape to wrap people, swing long distances, and create traps, among other applications.

104276.name: Mashirao Ojiro
104276.desc: __Height:__ 169 cm (5'6") __Quirk:__ Tail Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Mashirao has a very calm and noble attitude and a profound sense of dignity, which prevents him from accepting results he doesn't feel he earned with his own abilities. He is also described as a hard worker. Along with a strong sense of dignity, Mashirao can be described as sheepish and bashful, not very often enjoying the spotlight and being easily embarrassed. A recurring joke is that others view Mashirao as "plain," which profoundly upsets him. Mashirao's Quirk is that he has a long, powerful, sturdy tail. His tail effectively functions as a third arm that he can use to grab things. Furthermore, it's attack power is strong enough to break objects made of metal, he can wrap it around enemies, and it can support Mashirao's body weight. Mashirao is incredibly adept at using his tail, combining it with his knowledge of martial arts to engage enemies in close-range combat, performing fast and acrobatic moves. His tail can also increase his speed and mobility by whipping it down against the ground to use it like a springboard. (Source: My Hero Academia Wiki)

104276.name: Kyouka Jirou
104276.desc: __Height:__ 154 cm (5'1") __Quirk:__ Earphone Jack __Affiliation:__ U.A. High School __Fighting Style:__ Medium Ranged + Support Combat Kyoka is a petite, fair-skinned girl with a slender build. She has triangular, lazy-looking onyx eyes with notably long lower eyelashes, and rather small eyebrows. Kyoka has a pragmatic, unenthusiastic and teasing personality that is mostly shown to those she finds irritating. Kyoka is not always like this though, as she does enjoy socializing with others, in which case she is usually nice and friendly. Kyoka's Quirk (Earphone Jack) allows her to plug the jacks that hang from her earlobes into all sorts of things and channel the sound of her heartbeat into them; causing havoc inside the plugged objects. It's also used to catch sounds and vibrations from her surroundings.

104276.name: Fumikage Tokoyami
104276.desc: __Height:__ 158 cm __Quirk:__ Dark Shadow Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Fumikage is reserved, serious, and focused, albeit noble and valiant. Though not talkative, Fumikage will directly ignore questions or requests that seem in some way pointless. During combat, Fumikage is known to be fierce and dependable, with his strength and capabilities rarely being questioned. Fumikage is fond of darkness and other related concepts, considering himself a "creature of the dark" and employing archaic-sounding speeches that paint him slightly creepy or dramatic. Fumikage's Quirk "Dark Shadow" allows him to manifest a sentient shadow monster from his body that he can materialize and contract freely. Dark Shadow's energy is limited and can be drained by bright light. Dark Shadow retracts into Fumikage's body when it runs out of energy. The shadow entity's personality, strength, defense, and control depend on the lack of light. In bright light, Dark Shadow is weaker and smaller but still has considerable strength and defense and is easier to control, but in total darkness, Dark Shadow's size and parameters are drastically enhanced. It is powerful enough to rip out and cut down multiple full-grown trees easily. However, Dark Shadow is more difficult to control in the dark, causing it to rampage based on its own free will.

104276.name: Mezou Shouji
104276.desc: __Height:__ 187 cm (6'2") __Quirk:__ Dupli-Arms Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Shouji is friendly and gentle, and he will work nicely with anyone. He is not the type to hold grudges, showing no ill will towards those that harm him unwillingly. Shouji is entirely selfless and willing to risk his life for anyone. He can be empathetic and understanding, but still shows a sense of maturity and responsibility that prevents him from acting under emotional impulses. He is very protective of his classmates, especially if they are hurt or injured. He is also quite thick-skinned, as he said he is used to being feared due to his appearance. Shouji's Quirk grants him a set of tentacles alongside his arms. He can transform the tips of these tentacles to replicate other parts of his body (ex: mouth, ears, eyes). The duplicated body parts are more efficient than the originals; as a result, Mezo is able to hear better, see-through more angles at a time, and they grant him much higher degrees of strength. He uses these arms to talk most of the time through duplicate mouths, rather than his actual mouth.

104276.name: Tooru Hagakure
104276.desc: __Height:__ 152 cm (5'0") __Quirk:__ Invisibility Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Tooru is a bubbly, cheery, and easygoing girl who does most things with an upbeat attitude. She is very socially eager and likes shopping, and her room suggests that she likes plushies and other cute things. Tooru's Quirk is that her body is completely invisible. In addition to the stealth capabilities granted to her by her invisible body, Tooru can refract light that passes through her, allowing her to intensify the light into a blinding flash. She has further refined this application of her Quirk, achieving the ability to manipulate and redirect light-based attacks, such as [Yuuga Aoyama](https://anilist.co/character/127042/Aoyama-Yuuga)'s Navel Laser.

104276.name: Kouji Kouda
104276.desc: __Height:__ 186 cm (6'1") __Quirk:__ Anivoice Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Contrary to his strong and powerful appearance, Kouji is very timid and quiet. He rarely speaks and prefers using sign language to communicate with his classmates. He hates violence due to his kind-hearted nature. Kouji appears to greatly enjoy the company of animals, as his Quirk allows him to interact with animals in ways others cannot. He owns a small rabbit as a pet. Kouji's Quirk "Anivoice (生き物ボイス, Ikimono Voice)" gives him the ability to command any creature in the animal kingdom by speaking to them. Whatever command he gives, the animal will carry it out. However, he cannot exert control if they cannot hear his command. The target must also be a real animal and not merely animal-like. Kouji can also exchange information with the animals to find the locations of various people and potential enemies faster. Kouji has been shown to use the Quirk effectively with flocks of birds to create a smokescreen of animals and to attack an opponent, along with his use of insects to distract and attack his opponents. He has now also overcome his fear of bugs, so he often uses bugs to swarm opponents with numbers.

104276.name: Rikidou Satou
104276.desc: __Height:__ 185 cm (6'1") __Quirk:__ Sugar Rush Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Rikidou is interested in sweets and baking, a valuable skill due to his Quirk. He is surprisingly talented at making sweets. Rikidou's Quirk Sugar Rush allows him to increase his strength five-fold for three minutes. To activate his Quirk, he needs to consume 10 grams of sugar. When converting sugar into strength, his cognitive functions gradually drop, making him sleepy afterward. For every additional 10 grams of sugar he ingests, he extends the time of increased strength by another three minutes.

104276.name: Yuu Takeyama
104276.desc: __Height:__ 162 cm (5'4") (Normal form); 2062cm (67'8") (Transformed) __Quirk:__ Gigantification __Occupation:__ Pro Hero Pro Hero. Her Quirk allows her to grow to a gigantic size. She cannot variate between her base-height and the gigantified height achieved via her Quirk, making her only able to be either her normal height of 162cm (5 feet 4 inches) or her enlarged height of 2,062cm (67 feet 8 inches) tall.

104276.name: Mirio Togata
104276.desc: __Height:__ 181 cm (5'11") __Occupation:__ Student __Affiliation:__ U.A. High School __Quirk:__ Permeation He is third-year student at U.A. High School and is part of The Big 3 _(the strongest three hero students in all of Japan)_. Before [Izuku Midoriya](https://anilist.co/character/89028/Midoriya-Izuku), Mirio was the top candidate for [All Might](https://anilist.co/character/89224/Yagi-Toshinori)'s successor and inheritor of One For All. His Quirk, Permeation, gives him the ability to become intangible, letting him pass through any tangible matter; he can phase through walls and/or the ground, as well as let enemy attacks pass through him harmlessly.

104276.name: Neito Monoma
104276.desc: __Height:__ 170cm __Quirk:__ Copy Student in Class 1-B at U.A. High School. Neito has a rather complex personality since it differs depending on who he is addressing; he is particularly mocking, loud, and sarcastic with Class 1-A, but outside of these interactions, he is a calm, kind, and intelligent person. He envies Class 1-A with a passion over how they became the center of attention among U.A.'s first years because of the U.S.J. Incident. Truthfully, he only wants his class to stand out as they do, and he vents this feeling by throwing countless taunts towards his rivals, gloating over Class 1-B's successes and disparaging 1-A for their failures. Neito's Quirk is Copy, which allows him to duplicate and use another person's Quirk after coming into physical contact with the user. He can hold four Quirks simultaneously and maintain copied powers for ten minutes. After the time limit runs out, he loses the copied Quirk until he once again touches the original user.

104276.name: Himiko Toga
104276.desc: __Height:__ 157 cm __Quirk:__ Transform Himiko Toga is a villain affiliated with the League of Villains and part of its Vanguard Action Squad. She originally joined the group as a means to get closer to [Stain](https://anilist.co/character/126067). Himiko is a very cheerful girl, to the point of smiling even after having presumably killed someone, displaying apparent sadistic tendencies. She has a very twisted perception of love and friendship Himiko's Quirk Transform grants her the ability to transform into a physical lookalike of another individual, as well as copy their voice. She can only transform into people whose blood she has ingested. The more blood she drinks, the longer she has access to that person's form. For example, 1 cup of blood allows her to transform for a total of 18 hours. She can even switch between the appearances of multiple people if she drinks the blood of more than one person.

104276.name: Tamaki Amajiki
104276.desc: __Height:__ 177 cm (5'10") __Quirk:__ Manifest Third-year student in Class 3-A at U.A. High School and part of The Big 3 (the strongest three hero students in all of Japan). Tamaki is extremely shy, aloof, depressed, "intimidating", and introverted, especially around big audiences. He gets nervous very easily when talking to other people. If his anxiety gets the best of him, Tamaki will often face away and lean into a wall to hide his face from others. While his physical abilities and Quirk are outstanding, Tamaki is socially awkward and lacks confidence in his powers. Despite his timid heart, Tamaki can show flashes of bravery. Even though he's always been a shy and reserved boy, Tamaki was able to hone his skills and climb the ranks into one of U.A.'s Big 3. [Mirio Togata](https://anilist.co/character/123527/Togata-Mirio) is a big inspiration for Tamaki. Tamaki's Quirk Manifest grants him the ability to manifest the physical characteristics of anything he's eaten; for example, if he eats takoyaki, he can transform his fingers into octopus tentacles. Additionally, anything Tamaki manifests is significantly stronger than normal. The more of a substance Tamaki eats, the stronger his manifestation will be. He can only manifest the traits of substances still in his system and loses access to those traits once the substance is fully digested. He must resupply his Quirk daily and decide what foods to eat beforehand.

104276.name: All For One
104276.original: オール・フォー・ワン
104276.desc: __Quirk:__ All For One __Occupation:__ Villain __Fighting Style:__ Close Range and Long Range All For One is the true leader and benefactor of the League of Villains. Once Japan's most powerful villain and All Might's arch-nemesis, his true motives are unclear and his true identity unknown. His current goal is to raise Shigaraki to become his eventual successor.

104276.name: Shuuichi Iguchi
104276.desc: __Height:__ 174 cm __Occupation:__ Villain __Affiliation:__ League of Villains (formerly), Paranormal Liberation Front (Lieutenant of Brown Regiment) __Quirk:__ Gecko Shuuichi is a villain affiliated with the League of Villains and part of its Vanguard Action Squad. He is completely obsessed with the ways of [Stain](https://anilist.co/character/126067) to the point where he copies his clothing and weaponry style, aiming to follow the same ideals as him and make his dreams come true.

104276.name: Itsuka Kendou
104276.desc: __Height:__ 166 cm (5'5") __Quirk:__ Big Fist Class representative of Class 1-B at U.A. High School, Itsuka is a spirited girl who is thoughtful of others. She does not hesitate to criticize even her classmates if she feels what they are doing is not correct. Due to Itsuka's cheerful personality, she can bring all of Class 1-B together, thus making her the "big sister" of Class 1-B. Itsuka's Quirk Big Fist grants her the ability to enlarge both of her hands to a gigantic size. With the increased size comes enhanced striking power and gripping capabilities.

104276.name: Eri
104276.desc: __Height:__ 110 cm __Quirk:__ Rewind Eri is a child with bandages all over her body. She wears a white short sleeve dress and has a small horn on the right side of her forehead and has white, long, choppy, unkempt hair. She also has red eyes. Under her bandages, her arms are shown to have numerous scars. ~!Eri is the key source to [Kai Chisaki's](https://anilist.co/character/126357/Kai-Chisaki) operation to manufacture a Quirk-Destroying Drug. She is the granddaughter of the Eight Precepts of Death's boss!~

104276.name: Enji Todoroki
104276.desc: __Height:__ 195 cm (6' 4¾") __Occupation:__ Pro Hero __Quirk:__ Hellflame Endeavor is a tall man with a muscular physique. He has short and spiky, red hair with bright blue eyes. His beard and mustache appear to be made of fire, but when he turns off his flames on his face voluntarily, his stubble shows. ~!His desire to surpass the number one hero has driven him in family matters. Enji put [Shouto](https://anilist.co/character/89220/Todoroki-Shouto) through ruthless "training" which caused Shouto a severe degree of physical and emotional pain. Shouto, harboring a bitter hatred towards his father on account of this, refuses to use his fire powers in battles until [Izuku Midoriya](https://anilist.co/character/89028/Midoriya-Izuku) reminded him of his mother's encouragement. Later, Enji understood his mistakes and told his son he would try to be a better hero and father. He hopes for Shouto and the rest his family to forgive him in the future.!~ ~!He's the former No.2 Hero, but later becomes the new No.1 Hero after [All Might](https://anilist.co/character/89224/Yagi-Toshinori) loses his Quirk!~

104276.name: Kai Chisaki
104276.desc: __Height:__ 179 cm (5'10") __Quirk:__ Overhaul Kai Chisaki, also known by the villain name Overhaul, is the Yakuza Captain of the Shie Hassaikai. Overhaul is a mysophobic, antisocial sociopath obsessed with returning the world to the way it was before the Quirk phenomenon. Due to a combination of an old theory claiming Quirks derived from rats and his own mysophobia, Overhaul believes that Quirks are actually a plague on humanity, having infected people with "syndromes" of heroism and villainy. He looks down upon those that use their abilities for either purpose, referring to acts of heroic sacrifice or petty crime as "sicknesses". Overhaul is extremely determined to his ambition of eradicating Quirks, not only due to his own personal phobias, but also because such a thing would allow the yakuza to reclaim the power they once held over society. Kai's Quirk "Overhaul" grants him the ability to disassemble anything he touches, as well as reassemble it in any configuration he desires, effectively giving him full control over matter. Kai can disassemble people to kill them or reassemble them to heal their wounds. He can also do this to himself and even merge his body with others, even allowing him to use their Quirks

104276.name: Dabi
104276.desc: __Height:__ 176 cm (5'9¼") __Quirk:__ Blueflame Dabi is a villain affiliated with the League of Villains and a member of the organization's Vanguard Action Squad. Dabi is a stoic, aloof, confident, and focused individual who rarely shows emotion. While rather crude and violent, he's also shown to be quite cautious. Overall, Dabi is a highly enigmatic individual who trusts no one, preferring to do things alone and in his way. He also gives off the impression of knowing more about certain people than he lets on. Dabi's Quirk grants him the ability to generate and control highly destructive blue flames from his body. He has very well-developed control of his flames and can project them far from himself and in large amounts. However, Dabi's body has a low tolerance for his flame, and he will get burned if he uses them for prolonged periods. ~!It is later revealed that Dabi is Touya Todoroki (轟燈矢), the eldest son of the Pro Hero [Endeavor](https://anilist.co/character/126158/Todoroki-Enji) and his wife [Rei](https://anilist.co/character/150628/Todoroki-Rei), and the older brother to [Shouto Todoroki](https://anilist.co/character/89220/Todoroki-Shouto). For a significant period of time, his whereabouts were unknown.!~

104276.name: Camie Utsushimi
104276.desc: __Height:__ 161 cm (5'3") __Affiliation:__ Shiketsu High School (Second-Year Student) __Quirk:__ Glamour Camie seems to be very talkative, especially when learning more about people who pique her interest. She was thrilled upon seeing Shoto Todoroki for the first time, delighted at the fact that she would both meet a handsome man as well as undergo training. According to Inasa Yoarashi, she has impressive "interaction techniques" because she asked for Todoroki's contact info. She also tends to speak in a unique way and incorporates a strange type of slang in it, which tends to confuse those around her. According to herself she also loves children. Camie's Quirk allows her to create both visual and auditory illusions for a short period of time.

104276.name: Nejire Hadou
104276.desc: __Height:__ 164 cm (5'4") __Occupation:__ Student __Quirk:__ Wave Motion (ability to convert body's vitality into energy that can discharge as blast waves) She is third-year student at U.A. High School and is part of The Big 3 _(the strongest three hero students in all of Japan)_. Nejire is very enthusiastic, affable and cheery, and is always seen moving. She shows great interest in people's unique physical features and is easily distracted by them. She seems to like knowing more than others, but not in a proud way, as she just enjoys explaining things to people and sharing her knowledge. Despite her happy-go-lucky personality, Nejire is fierce in battle. When the situation calls for it, Nejire can be very calm and focused. Her curiosity never seems to extend to the enemy and she always maintains her focus on taking them down.

104276.name: Inasa Yoarashi
104276.desc: **Height:** 190 cm (6'3") **Affiliation:** Shiketsu High School (First-Year Student) **Quirk:** Whirlwind Inasa is an energetic and enthusiastic young man who expresses himself with vigor. He's very loud, oddly polite, and values passion over anything else. Inasa believes that all heroes have "hot spirits" that enable them to motivate and help others. He disapproves of heroes who do not embody the spirit of passion, which is why he has negative feelings about Endeavor and his son.

104276.name: Yuuga Aoyama
104276.desc: **Height:** 168 cm (5'6") **Quirk:** Navel Lazer Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Yuuga appears to be vain and prideful, thinking of himself as superior to the rest of his classmates, especially regarding his Quirk. He exhibits flamboyant mannerisms, is fond of posing, and likes to grab the attention of those around him despite frequently getting ignored by his peers. He also plays up his French heritage, occasionally implementing French words into his sentences. Yuuga's Quirk allows him to shoot a powerful sparkling laser cannon from his navel. It is so powerful, it can blast through two meters of solid concrete. If he fires the laser for more than 1 second at a time, he will suffer intestinal distress.

104276.name: Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu
104276.desc: __Height:__ 174cm (5'9") __Quirk:__ Steel Student in Class 1-B at U.A. High School. Tetsutetsu is defined by his very hotheaded and outspoken personality. He is confident, stubborn, and straightforward in his motivations and actions. He tends to be very vocal about his intentions and has a one-track mind, often looking for the simplest solution to problems to solve them most directly. Tetsutetsu's direct personality shows through his tenacious and upfront fighting style during battles. Tetsutetsu's Quirk allows him to turn his body into steel. This power grants Tetsutetsu both augmented defensive abilities to withstand attacks and the increased strength of his unarmed physical attacks.

104276.name: Hizashi Yamada
104276.desc: __Height:__ 185cm (6'1") __Quirk:__ Voice Pro Hero. He also works as an English teacher at U.A. High School and as a radio talk show host. Yamada maintains the eccentric persona of a radio host. He often poses when he talks and maintains a certain level of excitement or volume, regardless of the situation. Though he tends to be a jovial individual, Hizashi is capable of great rage when it comes to his friends and colleagues. Yamada's Quirk "Voice" allows him to increase the volume of his voice, giving him an ability that is similar to a sonic scream. The sound from his Quirk is strong enough to cause people's ears to bleed from far away. The only known weakness of this Quirk is that the loud sounds do not travel well underground, making this Quirk ineffective against anything that is underground or separated from him by layers of earth.

104276.name: Nemuri Kayama
104276.desc: __Height:__ 175 cm (5'9") __Quirk:__ Somnambulist Pro Hero. She also works as a Modern Hero Art History teacher at U.A. High School. Nemuri is a very playful and flirtatious person with an unpredictably serious and temperamental side to her. She gets angry whenever someone interrupts her or insults her. She is especially sensitive about her age. Despite her flirtatious personality, Nemuri was intelligent, perceptive, and articulate. While she comes off as a hero who enjoys her fame derived from her beauty and sex appeal, Nemuri has demonstrated true heroism and bravery, willing to fight on the front lines and put her life at risk for others. Nemuri's Quirk "Somnambulist" allows her to put nearby people to sleep by exuding a sleep-inducing aroma from her body. Her Quirk works better on males than females.

104276.name: Sorahiko Torino
104276.desc: __Height:__ 128 cm (4'2") __Affiliation:__ Yuuei (Retired) __Quirk:__ Jet A retired hero who is one of All Might's colleagues and his former homeroom teacher. He was the one who taught All Might to control One For All during the his early days, and his training was so intense that All Might fears him to the point he subconsciously tried to forget about him until Grantorino sent his recommendation for Izuku to help him improve One For All, becoming his work place mentor. His Quirk is "Jet," allowing him to take in air through the sole of his foot to allow him to jump higher. (Source: Wikipedia)

104276.name: Keigo Takami
104276.desc: __Height:__ 172 cm (5' 7¾") __Occupation:__ Pro Hero (No.3 - former, No.2 - current) __Quirk:__ Fierce Wings __Affiliation:__ Hero Public Safety Commission, ~!Paranormal Liberation Front (as a spy)!~ Hawks is carefree, jovial, and dislikes formalities, often acting in a spontaneous and unpredictable way while being cocky and taunting. He believes that popular approval is the most important metric a Pro Hero should be judged for, and does not appear to take the official rankings seriously, showing a preference for the lower ranks as it would allow him to act more freely and avoid the burdens of being a top hero. He states his wish to patrol in a leisurely fashion and "take it easy". It is hinted that Hawks was a fan of [Endeavor](https://anilist.co/character/126158/Todoroki-Enji) from an early age, as depicted by the drawing of him as a child holding an Endeavor figurine.

104276.name: Taishirou Toyomitsu
104276.desc: __Height:__ 250 cm (8'2") (Fat form) __Quirk:__ Fat Absorption In his fat form, Taishiro is a big round man, easily towering over other adults. In this form, his mouth is big, and his nose is smaller, which alongside his odd body proportions, give him an odd look. After burning through his fat, however, it is revealed that he is quite muscular, and his body adapts conventional proportions. His hero costume consists of black pants and an orange zippered hood, which has the initials of his alias on the front of Fat Gum. Alongside them, he also wears gloves, metallic boots, and a mask that covers his eyes and his forehead.

104276.name: Manami Aiba
104276.desc: __Quirk:__ Love Manami is a short woman who wears an elaborate outfit with several heart motifs, such as heart-shaped earrings, belt buckles, and a bowtie. She also wears a buttoned shirt with frilly cuffs, gloves, small high-heeled boots and, similar to Danjuro Tobita, a pair of poofy pinstriped pants, though hers boast a unique heart design near her inner thighs. Manami's hair is arranged in pigtails with one large side-swept bang in the middle, and her eyes are big with ringed pupils. She appears to have dark circles around them.

104276.name: Shinji Nishiya
104276.desc: __Height:__ 168 cm (5'6") __Quirk:__ Arbor Pro Hero. Underneath his helmet, he has puffy red leaf-like hair, though his face has remained unseen since he has only been shown while wearing his mask. Shinji is a very serious and focused person when it comes to being a hero in his hero duties; however, he easily feels down when someone takes his glory or credit. Shinji's Quirk "Arbor" (樹木, Jumoku) allows him to enlarge and control his wooden body parts into strong tree branches. These branches are excellent for binding.

104276.name: Natsuo Todoroki
104276.desc: __Height:__ 181 cm Natsuo Todoroki is a college student. He is the son of [Enji](https://anilist.co/character/126158/Todoroki-Enji) and [Rei Todoroki](https://anilist.co/character/150628/Todoroki-Rei), the younger brother of Toya and [Fuyumi](https://anilist.co/character/150627/Todoroki-Fuyumi), and the older brother of [Shoto](https://anilist.co/character/89220/Todoroki-Shouto). Natsuo is a young man of average height, sporting white spiky hair with two small pieces of hair hanging down by his forehead. He greatly resembles his father at his age. Natsuo seems to be a care-free individual, as seen in his interactions with him and his family. However, he can be serious, and cares deeply for his family, except his father who he resents for his abusive treatment to his family. He does not feel forgiving to his father, blaming him for his mother Rei's hospitalization and Shoto's suffering.

104276.name: Danjuurou Tobita
104276.desc: __Height:__ 181cm (5'11") __Quirk:__ Elasticity Danjuro is a man with a refined appearance. He has a slicked back hairdo with a curl at the front. He sports a handlebar mustache along with a well-kept, medium-sized beard. Danjuro's clothes are also quite extravagant, featuring a jacket with enlarged collars and coattails, a pair of loose pinstriped pants and two belts. He also wears a pair of cuffs and a woolly scarf, and he uses a cane to walk.

104276.name: Mirai Sasaki
104276.desc: __Height:__ 200 cm (6'6¾") __Birthplace:__ Tokyo, Japan __Quirk:__ Foresight A Pro Hero and [Mirio Togata](https://anilist.co/character/123527)'s mentor. He was formerly [All Might](https://anilist.co/character/89224)'s sidekick and was considered to be the brains behind All Might's hero operation before opening his own hero agency. Sir Nighteye is a lean but muscular man with a clean, well-kept appearance. Unlike most Pro Heroes, he seems to prefer plain office clothes (a plain white suit with gold buttons, a white dress shirt, and a red tie with white dots) instead of an elaborate hero costume. Sir Nighteye maintains a stoic and intimidating presence, with a cold and sharp glare, but that is only the side of his personality that he shows in public. He greatly values humor and actually requires people to make him laugh before he acknowledes them. Nighteye believes that humor and energy are vital elements for the future of society and punishes subordinates that fail to display those qualities.

104276.name: Naomasa Tsukauchi
104276.desc: Naomasa Tsukauchi is a police detective in the Police Force. Naomasa is a tall man with short black hair and black eyes. As a member of the police force, he is normally seen in his uniform. He wears a signature tan overcoat and a matching hat. He also sports a black suit underneath with matching slacks and dress shoes. Detective Tsukauchi is an earnest, hardworking individual who has earned the right to be a close friend of All Might. Enough so, that he was even entrusted with the truth about One For All and the latter's true form. He appears to have a close relationship with All Might, as he even leaked sensitive information to the hero just because he felt it was the right thing to do.

104276.name: Seiji Shishikura
104276.desc: A second year student at Shiketsu High. His Quirk, "Meatball," allows him to roll all living flesh up into meatballs, as well as manipulate his own flesh to his liking. He can remotely control his own flesh after detaching it.

104276.name: Kouta Izumi
104276.desc: __Height:__ 107cm (3'5") Kota Izumi is the nephew of Shino Sosaki and the son of the hero team Water Hose.

104276.name: Kurogiri
104276.desc: __Affiliation:__ League of Villains __Quirk:__ Warp Gate Kurogiri has a level-headed personality, which often serves to ground Tomura Shigaraki's immaturity. He is intensely loyal to both All For One and Tomura. He is very polite and well-spoken, even to enemies. ~! Kurogiri is actually an intelligent Nomu made from the corpse of Eraserhead and President Mics high school friend Oboro Shirakumo made to serve Tomura Shigaraki. Although he remains unaware of his previous identity after Eraserheads efforts to talk to him it’s shown that a small part of Oboro is still in Kurogiri!~

104276.name: Kenji Hikiishi
104276.desc: Hikiishi Kenji, also known as Magne was a villain affiliated with the League of Villains and part of its Vanguard Action Squad. She and the rest of her team serve as the main antagonists of the Forest Training Camp Arc. Magne preferred to go by female pronouns despite her masculine presentation.

104276.name: Atsuhiro  Sako
104276.desc: Mr. Compress's Quirk allows him to "compress" anything in a spherical area into a small marble without actually damaging it. The weight of the target is reduced alongside them, making them very easy to carry. If used on a person, it effectively entraps them, terminating the fight instantly and allowing Mr. Compress to abduct them without difficulty. The Quirk can also be used on select body parts, maiming the target.

104276.name: Giran
104276.desc: Giran is a B-rank villain and broker in affiliation with the League of Villains, working to scout new recruits for their organization

104276.name: Kaoruko Awata
104276.desc: Quirk: Bubble (バブル Baburu) With this Quirk, Kaoruko can make bubbles filled with an aroma that she had smelled at least once before. She can make both sweet-smelling bubbles and foul-smelling ones. When she’s too nervous, she produces very unpleasant-smelling bubbles that are self-destructing She is a dedicated hero as well as Sir Nighteyes sidekick

104276.name: Shinya Kamihara
104276.desc: __Height:__ 170 cm (5'7") __Quirk:__ Foldabody: Shinya's Quirk allows him to make his body and limbs extremely thin and long, effectively allowing him to transform himself into a razor sharp string. He is able to transform faster than the speed of sound. Shinya is a calm and focused individual, who is able to maintain a level head even when in a crisis situation, and encourages his teammates when they begin to panic. He is proven to be quite intelligent and is good at analyzing situations and strategy. He is the former Number 5 Pro-Hero, and is currently Number 4.

104276.name: Tomoko Shiretoko
104276.desc: Her Quirk allowed her to observe and monitor up to 100 people at a time, including their location and weak points.

104276.name: Tsunagu Hakamada
104276.desc: __Height:__ 190cm (6'3") __Quirk:__ Fiber Master Pro Hero, ranked in the top 4. He is the recipient of the "Best Jeanist" award for eight consecutive years. Tsunagu is an elegant man with flamboyant tendencies. He believes very strongly that people with influence must maintain a positive appearance both physically and socially. Tsunagu often uses metaphors referencing jeans, denim, and various other sewing and fabric-based phrases, often inspiring his recruits with speeches, telling them to keep their life straight like their jeans. Tsunagu takes the role of being a hero very seriously. He is selfless, brave, and charismatic, and he aims to spread a sense of a peace to all people, no matter how dire the situation. Tsunagu's Quirk "Fiber Master (ファイバーマスター)" allows him to freely manipulate the threads in any nearby piece of fabric. He has power over all types of cloth, but his Quirk works best with denim and is less effective on sweats. Fiber Master also works on other types of fiber not related to fabric, such as carbon fibers. He primarily uses this power to restrain his targets, either by using their own clothing against them, or simply unravels portions of his own clothing into strings.

104276.name: Shino Sousaki
104276.desc: Telepath: This Quirk allows Shino to utilize a mental transmission and send telepathic messages directly into people's minds. Shino, has displayed the ability to send a message to tens of people at a time. She can send messages, but she can't receive them

104276.name: Yawara Chatora
104276.desc: Pliabody: Yawara's Quirk allows him to stretch, flatten, and bend his body in ways that would normally be impossible

104276.name: Nezu
104276.desc: __Height:__ 85 cm __Quirk:__ High Spec Nezu, also known as Mr. Principal is a Pro Hero and the principal of U.A. High School. He is an extremely rare case of an animal who manifested a Quirk. He can be very long-winded at times when explaining or educating.

104276.name: Gigantomachia
104276.desc: Gigantomachia is a villain associated with the League of Villains.[1] He is one of All For One's faithful servants and his former bodyguard, cultivated to be of use to Tomura Shigaraki if anything were to happen to him.

104276.name: Ryuuko Tsuchikawa
104276.desc: __Height:__ 167cm (5'6") __Quirk:__ Earth Flow Ryuko Tsuchikawa also known as Pixie-Bob, is a Pro Hero and a member of the Wild, Wild Pussycats. She is a very hyperactive and loud person with little regard for how she may come off to other people and also is very self-conscious about her age. Ryuko's Quirk allows her to freely manipulate the earth for a variety of effects.

104276.name: Thirteen
104276.desc: Thirteen is a wise, well-mannered person. As a rescue hero, Thirteen has displayed how passionate they are about saving people through their teachings. They even developed their own training facility - the Unforeseen Simulation Joint - to train future heroes in search and rescue tactics. They are very passionate about Quirks, specifically on the topic of using Quirks for creation and assistance rather than for destruction and battle. Thirteen has also been shown to be very brave. Despite not being a combat type, they do not hesitate to use their Quirk to fight against villains in the name of protecting others

104276.name: Shin Nemoto
104276.desc: Shin Nemoto is one of the Eight Expendables who works for Shie Hassaikai. Shin's Quirk, Confession, allows him to force people to answer his questions with their true feeling. Shin appears to be a very cynic man as a result of the fact that he could never find anyone worthy of his trust and friendship thanks to his Quirk. He states that emotions are unnecessary to carry out objectives, but it is unknown if he actually believes this or if it was just a way to demoralize Mirio Togata as he fought Overhaul. As Overhaul is the only truly sincere person he’s ever met, Shin is extremely devoted to him. Since he is granted knowledge about his boss's plans, Shin holds himself in high-esteem among the Eight Expendables, viewing himself as special and the only one of the group worthy of walking alongside Overhaul. Shin's loyalty to Overhaul is enough to make him follow his boss even after getting completely overwhelmed in battle.

104276.name: Hari Kurono
104276.desc: __Age:__ Unknown __Status:__ ~!Imprisoned!~ __Quirk:__ Chronostasis: Kurono's Quirk allows him to slow down the movements of anything he hits with his clock hand-like hair. The minute hands slows a targets movements for one minute and the hour hand slows a targets movements for one hour. Kurono can extend his hair, but only if he is not moving. Hari Kurono, also known as Chronostasis, is a yakuza member afflicted with the Shie Hassaikai, and the assistant/right hand man to Overhaul. He is one of the main antagonists of the Shie Hassaikai Arc.

104276.name: Deidoro Sakaki
104276.desc: __Age:__ Unknown __Status:__ ~!Imprisoned!~ __Quirk:__ Sloshed: Deidoro's Quirk allows him to subject nearby people to severe dizziness and inhibit their sense of balance, putting them in a state similar to being drunk. He is often seen drinking shortly before using his Quirk, meaning the strength of Sloshed could directly correlate with how much alcohol Deidoro consumes. This may have contributed to his alcoholic nature, or could be a completely independent variable. Deidoro Sakaki is one of the Eight Expendables who works for the Shie Hassaikai.

104276.name: Yuu Houjou
104276.desc: Yu Hojo is one of the Eight Expendables who works for Shie Hassaikai. Quirk Crystallization: Yu's Quirk grants him the ability to produce crystals on his body. This is effective for both close-ranged offense and defense. He can also grow his crystals to form a sword around his arm

104276.name: Kendou Rappa
104276.desc: __Quirk:__ Strongarm One of the Eight Bullets who serves Overhaul and the Shie Hassaikai. Kendou is a very hot-blooded man who thrives on violence and bloodshed. He has a warrior-like mentality, and he only cares about seeking a battle that can satisfy him. Kendou believes it's unbecoming for a fighter to use weapons and that everyone should fight with the power of their bodies. Unlike most of the Eight Bullets, Kendou only serves Overhaul because he hopes to one day defeat him. Kendo's Quirk allows him to rotate his shoulders at extreme speeds, allowing him to attack his targets with a near-endless barrage of bullet punches.

104276.name: Rikiya Katsukame
104276.desc: Rikiya Katsukame is one of the Eight Expendables who works under Overhaul for Shie Hassaikai. Quirk Enhanced Strength: Even without activating his Quirk, Rikiya exhibits superhuman brawn, befitting his massive build. On two separate occasions, he effortlessly burst through a wall and a locked gate, knocking several policemen into the air while doing so, and casually damaged the jamb while readying his next punch.

104276.name: Soramitsu Tabe
104276.desc: Soramitsu Tabe is one of the Eight Expendables who works for Shie Hassaikai. Quirk Food: Soramitsu's Quirk allows his teeth and jaws to easily chew and consume anything. His stomach is also able to digest what he has eaten with no trouble.

104276.name: Hekiji Tengai
104276.desc: Hekiji Tengai is one of the Eight Expendables who works for Shie Hassaikai under Overhaul. Quirk Barrier Hekiji's Quirk allows him to create telekinetic barriers in the shape of a dome around him, for defensive purposes

104276.name: Joui Irinaka
104276.desc: Joi Irinaka also known as Mimic ミミック is a Yakuza and the general manager of Shie Hassaikai. Quirk Mimicry: Joi's Quirk allows him to transfer his body and mind into an object, allowing him full control over it. This Quirk, however, only works on objects that are about the size of a refrigerator or smaller

104276.name: Touya Setsuno
104276.desc: Toya Setsuno is one of the Eight Expendables who works for Shie Hassaikai. Quirk Larceny: Toya is capable of instantly moving objects in the possession of someone directly into his hands, in a manner similar to teleportation. However, the limits to his Quirk depend on the size of what he can steal,which must also be within his sight

104276.name: Juuzou Moashi
104276.desc: __Quirk:__ Centipede: Juuzou's Quirk grants him long, centipede-like limbs, which he can use to attack or restrain enemies from afar. Moashi is a sidekick affiliated with [Sir Nighteye](https://anilist.co/character/129761/)'s Hero Office. Juuzou is a gentleman and a very well mannered person

104276.name: Ryuuko Tatsuma
104276.desc: When she activates her Quirk, her body transforms into that of a large, winged dragon with pale gray scales, although she still has the same skin tone, hair and eyes, and her hero costume remains visible bar her boots.

104276.name: Ken Takagi
104276.desc: Quirk: Lock Down:/Ken can immobilize anything not living, locking it into a particular place. However, it can be overwhelmed by force and cannot apply to large areas. Ken is a man of average height, with a darker complexion and dark, curly hair. He has pierced ears with padlocks in them. Notably, his fingertips have protrusions that resemble key teeth. Part of his hero costume is a small white mask that covers his eyes. He wears a necklace around his neck with five keys dangling from it. Rock Lock wears a two-colored, short-sleeved shirt with a black section and a white print on it, resembling a keyhole. He wears two light-colored shoulder pads with a dark keyhole shape on both of them.

104276.name: Rumi Usagiyama
104276.desc: Rumi is the No. 5 Pro Hero. She has an athletic build with muscular arms and legs. She has dark skin, red eyes which are tilted slightly inwards, and straight white hair reaching down past her waist. On her head, she has a pair of long white rabbit ears pointing upwards with a slight crook. Along with these, she also has a round white tail, which gives her overall design a definite resemblance to an albino rabbit. Her hero costume consists of a sleeveless white leotard with dark purple trim around her shoulders and waist, a wide, yellow crescent moon design over her chest, and two thick metal plates on her midriff. She wears purple thigh-high boots to compliment her leotard, with more plating around the heel and toe areas, making her feet look like those of a rabbit. She also has white gloves on her hands, with long cuffs, sporting small triangular protrusions around the edges.

104276.name: Ryou Inui
104276.desc: Ryo Inui is a Pro Hero and serves as the Lifestyle Guidance Counselor at U.A. High School.

104276.name: Kuugo Sakamata
104276.desc: Gang Orca is the current No. 11 Pro Hero, dropping from his previous No. 10 place. He took part in the assault on All For One and the League of Villains at Kamino Ward, and later served as a makeshift villain during the Provisional Hero License Exam.

104276.name: Desutegoro
104276.desc: Death Arms is a Pro Hero. He took part in the fight against the Sludge Villain, and later witnessed the U.A. Sports Festival from outside the arena, along with Mt. Lady and Kamui Woods.

104276.name: Ken Ishiyama
104276.desc: Cementoss is a Pro Hero as well as a teacher at U.A. High School. During the U.A. Sports Festival, he acted as the proctor for the 1-on-1 fights in case things got out of hand. He also faced off against Eijiro Kirishima and Rikido Sato in their Final Exam.

104276.name: Fuyumi Todoroki
104276.desc: The only daughter of Eiji and Rei. Fuyumi is the younger sister of Touya and the older sister of Natsuo and Shouto. Fuyumi is a hard working girl, often making meals for the family and works as a teacher at an unnamed school. Unlike her family members, she doesn't resent her father and just wishes they could all be a happy family, though she realizes such a thing is unlikely. Upon hearing Shouto gains friends, however, Fuyumi gets quite excited over it and is happy for him. In the past, Fuyumi took care of Shouto after their mother went to a hospital and never came back. To this day, her wish that she could have done something for Shouto still lingers within her.

104276.name: Rei Todoroki
104276.desc: The damaged mother of the Todoroki family. Rei has an ice related quirk, which is believed to be powerful, as Eiji would not have had kids with her otherwise. In the past, Rei was very supportive towards Shouto and his dreams to become like All Might. She used to always say that his blood does not define him for him and for herself. Rei, who was once a kind and caring woman, is now in a mental ward. After all the abuse she faced from Eiji, she began to become mentally unstable. Over time, she had slowly began to snap, until she finally poured boiling water onto Shouto's left side after seeing it. Immediately after burning Shouto, Rei began to apologize and attempt to comfort him when she realized what she had done. Due to her snapping, she was placed into a mental ward for her own safety. Even though Rei is in a mental ward, she has since returned to her former self. When Shouto visited, she was immensely happy and apologized for what she had done to him. Fuyumi and Natsuo also visit her as well, though she has yet to meet Eiji face to face again out of fear.

104276.name: Ectoplasm
104276.desc: __Height:__ 180 cm (5' 11") __Affiliation:__ Yuuei __Quirk:__ Clones Ectoplasm has the ability to produce ectoplasm from his mouth and transform it into clones of himself. He can create up to thirty clones at once, and push his limit to thirty-six if he's feeling good. He can also produce a giant clone of himself, although this sacrifices his ability to produce normal-sized ones for the time being. His clones can be defeated with a strong blow, but otherwise, only Ectoplasm can dispel them.

104276.name: Taneo Tokuda
104276.desc: Taneo Tokuda is a freelance journalist working for Juzo News, a magazine publisher. He is an anime-exclusive character

104276.name: Hassaikai Kumichou
104276.desc: Without revealing his name a man known as “The Boss originally ran the organization known as The Shie Hassaikai. The Boss always believed his gang should follow a set or code and morals, The Boss would be known for raising Kai Chisaki with Chisaki turning on him later to run the organization to follow his own views with him putting the boss into a comatose state. The Boss would be the one to introduce Kai Chisaki to his grand daughter Eri.

104276.name: Chiyo  Shuuzenji
104276.desc: __Quirk:__ Heal __Occupation:__ Pro Hero, Nurse Chiyo has a very kind and compassionate personality, where she treats everyone kindly, though she does have a strict and reproaching attitude towards those that have done something foolish. She's mostly like this with All Might for not teaching Izuku how to use his Quirk properly or with Izuku for using his Quirk recklessly.

104276.name: Yokumiru Mera
104276.desc: Yokumiru Mera is a worker for the Hero Public Safety Commission. He suffers from sleep deprivation due to overwork, something that he complains about frequently.

104276.name: Sajin Higawara
104276.desc: __Quirk:__ SandStorm Sajin Higawara also known as Sand Hero: Snatch was a Pro Hero and a bodyguard for the Police Force.

104276.name: High End
104276.desc: __Affiliation:__ League of Villains High End Nomu was an intelligent Nomu created and is shown to be obedient to its master. They were one of the main antagonists in the Pro Hero Arc.

104276.name: Snipe
104276.desc: __Quirk:__ Homing Snipe is a Pro Hero and a member of the teaching staff at U.A. High School. Snipe has the appearance of a stereotypical western cowboy Snipe's Quirk allows him to lock on to any target he can see within six hundred meters and make any projectile he releases chase after said target

104276.name: Bibimi Kenranzaki
104276.desc: Bibimi Kenranzaki is a student of U.A. High School's Department of Support from Class 3-G and is the two time winner of the U.A. School Festival's Miss Con.

104276.name: Yosetsu Awase
104276.desc: Although he is not as social as some others, Yosetsu is foul-mouthed and tense, except for serious or life-or-death situations, in which he becomes very easily startled and much more talkative, although he retains his harsh way of speech.

104276.name: Reiko Yanagi
104276.desc: Reiko is a quiet and emotionless teenager who often shows an odd body posture.

104276.name: Kenji Tsuragamae
104276.desc: Kenji is the Chief of the Police Force.

104276.name: Kyoutoku Jirou
104276.desc: Kyotoku Jiro is Kyoka Jiro's father.

104276.name: Hiroshi Tameda
104276.desc: __Height:__ 170cm Hiroshi Tameda also known as "Can't You See?" kid, is a loyal fan of Endeavor.

104276.name: Crust
104276.desc: __Quirk:__ Shield __Occupation:__ Pro Hero (No.6) __Fighting Style:__ Close-ranged combat

104276.name: Yoroi Musha
104276.desc: __Quirk:__ Unknown __Occupation:__ Pro Hero ~!(Retired)!~ No. 9 Pro Hero. ~!He retired due to the high backlash against Heroes following the Paranormal Liberation War.!~

104276.name: Yuuyu Haya
104276.desc: __Height:__ 160 cm Third-year student in U.A. High School's Hero Course. She has an unnamed Electric Arrow quirk.

104276.name: Komari Ikoma
104276.desc: __Height:__ 157cm School teacher at Masegaki Primary School. Komari is often exasperated by her students' near-constant rude antics, and describes them as being "problem children". She is very distressed, nearly to the point of crying, when they constantly ignore her instructions. However, after seeing her students behaving differently at the Provisional Hero License Course, she was inspired to not give up.

104276.name: Tamashiro
104276.desc: Student from Masegaki Primary School.

104276.name: Josei Kisha
104276.desc: Television news reporter.

20789.name: Narrator
20789.desc: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

20789.name: Meliodas
20789.desc: __Race:__ ~!Demon!~ __Height:__ 152cm (5'0") Meliodas the leader of the Seven Deadly Sins and the Sin of Wrath with the symbol of the Dragon. He is the main protagonist of the Nanatsu no Taizai and the owner of the Boar Hat bar.

20789.name: Elizabeth Liones
20789.original: エリザベス・リオネス
20789.desc: Elizabeth Liones is the third adoptive princess of the Kingdom of Liones Originally an alleged survivor of Danafor's destruction, Elizabeth was adopted and raised by the king [Bartra Liones](https://anilist.co/character/131565/Bartra-Liones). After the Holy Knights rebel, she sets on journey to find Seven Deadly Sins, becoming a waitress for [Meliodas](https://anilist.co/character/72921/Meliodas-)' tavern Boar Hat. ~!She is 107th and current incarnation of the Goddess Elizabeth, and the lover of Meliodas, captain of the Seven Deadly Sins. She is the deuteragonist of the series.!~

20789.name: Gilthunder
20789.desc: __Height:__ 185 cm (6'1") One of the holy knights of the Britannia kingdom. He is a Diamond-ranked Holy Knight.

20789.name: Diane
20789.desc: Diane is a member of the Seven Deadly Sins and is The Sin of Envy with the symbol of the Serpent. She is also a member of the Giant's Clan. She is a fair maiden with pink eyes and medium length brown hair which is tied up into Mega Twintails. Despite being a beautiful looking maiden, she is in fact a giant from the giant clan, and is several times larger than ordinary humans. She wears a one piece orange suit, boots that extend almost up to the knees, and a metal armband which is embedded with shiny metal pebbles. Her current outfits and attire is believed to be the most fashionable ones. She wears an orange colored short sleeved bodysuit and boots. As the Serpent's Sin of Envy, her main traits are jealousy and envy. She shows strong affection for Meliodas, so when she met him together with Elizabeth, she grew very jealous and threw him away whilst calling him a cheater. In contrary with Elizabeth who wants to be strong and powerful, she wants to be small.

20789.name: Ban
20789.desc: __Height:__ 210 cm Ban is a member of the Seven Deadly Sins and is The Sin of Greed with the symbol of the Fox. He was imprisoned in the Baste Dungeon.

20789.name: King
20789.desc: __Height:__ 165 cm King is a member of the Seven Deadly Sins and is the Sin of Sloth with the symbol of the Grizzly. He is also Oslo's master. King's real identity is Fairy King Harlequin, the king of the fairy race.

20789.name: Guila
20789.desc: Geera is a Holy Knight who left herself in a near-death state to have access to the Capital of the Dead and kill the Deadly Sins who had gone there. She is a young female with a slim build. She has long black hair and her eyes are depicted as if they are closed.

20789.name: Dreyfus
20789.desc: Dreyfus is one of the current Great Holy Knights, thus also making him one of the two people who have command over the entirety of Britannia after the coup d'état. His attire consists of a standard set of a Holy Knight's armor that has a spike on each shoulder. He has long black hair that reaches up to his shoulder, with a short beard.

20789.name: Hendricksen
20789.desc: Hendricksen is one of the current Great Holy Knights, thus also making him one of the two people who have command over the entirety of Britannia after the coup d'état. He wears a set of and covers it with a robe on top. He has short light-colored hair and also a goatee. Hendricksen is a serious man, who, like Dreyfus, appears to be willing to capture the king and enslave the citizens to prepare for the Holy War. However, he also seems to be plotting something.

20789.name: Elaine
20789.desc: Elaine is King's sister, and the Guardian Saint of the Fountain of Youth. She has long and thin eyelashes, and cut hair that reaches her neck. She wears a single white one-piece dress which is tied together with a butterfly knot at the back. Elaine is shown to be a kind, caring and forgiving girl.

20789.name: Hawk
20789.desc: Hawk is a talking pig and Meliodas's companion. He is introduced as the cleaner of the Boar Hat bar who helps clean the disgusting food scraps. He is a relatively large pink pig who wears an earring with the word star boar on his left ear. His body is well rounded and his legs are fairly short. He has a unique patch of black spots shaped like a four-leafed clover. His body and appearance are fairly similar to a typical Gloucestershire Old Spots Pig.

20789.name: Howzer
20789.desc: Hauser is a Holy Knight, a colleague and partner of Gilthunder, and a subordinate of the Great Holy Knight, Dreyfus. He wears a set of Holy Knight armor and has short light-colored curled up hair. Hauser demonstrates a lot of self confidence and is very optimistic, which is the complete opposite of Gilthunder's personality; he is also shown to be somewhat naive and stupid.

20789.name: Veronica Liones
20789.desc: Veronica is the second princess of Britannia. The younger sibling of the first princess, [Margaret](https://anilist.co/character/126382/Liones-Margaret), and elder to her adopted sister; the third princess, [Elizabeth](https://anilist.co/character/72923/Liones-Elizabeth). She has a tomboyish appearance, short light colored hair and a slim build. She wears a stylish fur coat, a knight-styled attire, a belt and a pair of long boots. She is described to be a tomboy, who, as a child, liked to and often used to play with swords with the boys, and would be scolded by her father for doing so. Sharing the Holy Knights' attitude about enslaving the citizens, she also cares about her younger sister, Elizabeth.

20789.name: Jericho
20789.desc: Jericho is an apprentice Holy Knight who served under the Weird Fangs. She was stationed at the Baste Dungeon, where the Deadly Sin, Ban was imprisoned. She is young woman of slim build, with light hair that is swept over the left side of her face and tied into a ponytail at the back. She wears a black coat over her armor, adorned with a cross on the left side and larger cross covering the back. Underneath her armor are similarly fashioned black clothes. Metal gauntlets cover her arms, while metal greaves and sabatons cover her legs and feet. Jericho is a proud and serious individual. She is stern in her command over the guards of Baste Dungeon and overconfident in her abilities, appearing arrogant at times, which led to her humiliation by Ban.

20789.name: Griamor
20789.desc: Griamor is a Holy Knight who comes from a lineage of Holy Knights that have served the kingdom of Lyonesse for many generations. He is Veronica's bodyguard, and shows absolute loyalty towards her. Griamor is a very tall and muscular individual who is at least twice the height of ordinary civilians, and has grey shoulder length hair. His attire consists of a single-spiked helmet, full leg armor and no upper body clothing, except a mysterious metal plate strapped around his chest with two straps. He also wears a glove on one hand and a sleeve-armor on the other arm. He, like many other Holy Knights, is heartless and cruel. Although he is ruthless, he shows absolute loyalty to Veronica and cannot allow himself to displease her, having started to serve her at a quite young age, even role-playing as a horse for her to ride on as a child.

20789.name: Gowther
20789.desc: __Height:__ 175 cm (5'9") (Human size), 23 - 24 cm (0'9") (doll) He is shown to be completely clueless and unaware of others' feelings, not understanding the meaning of friendship. He often states things factually, not understanding how what he says can upset people. He decides to assist [Elizabeth](https://anilist.co/character/72923/Liones-Elizabeth) on her journey, not because of a desire for justice, but because he felt obligated as a member of the Seven Deadly Sins. Since Gowther doesn't understand emotions, he goes to great length to understand them. For example, observing [Meliodas](https://anilist.co/character/72921/Meliodas) and [Ban](https://anilist.co/character/77605/Ban)'s friendship.

20789.name: Merlin
20789.desc: She is a member of the Seven Deadly Sins. She has the mark of the boars sin of gluttony. She was regarded as the greatest mage in Britannia and is the master of [Vivian](https://anilist.co/character/131564) as well as a teacher of [King Arthur of Camelot](https://anilist.co/character/122210). She came to the aid of the sins in their battle against [Hendirkson](https://anilist.co/character/86679) but had to leave to tend to the King. She has not officially rejoined the sins but said she would as soon as she was finished with her other business.

20789.name: Arthur Pendragon
20789.original: アーサー・ペンドラゴン
20789.desc: Named the king of Camelot after pulling a sword from the stone that hundreds of holy knights could not. Arthur is a polite, young man who is still adjusting to his role as king. He takes his responsibilities very seriously, but usually undertakes them with a smile and has a very warm, and happy-go-lucky demeanor. He marched toward the kingdom of Liones with an army of illusions created by Merlin in hopes of meeting with the king; however, he was confronted by Hendricksen who tried to kill him before Meliodas came to his aide. (Source: MyAnimeList)

20789.name: Margaret Liones
20789.original: マーガレット・リオネス
20789.desc: The first princess of the Kingdom of Liones. The elder sibling of the second princess, Veronica and of her adopted sister; the third princess, Elizabeth.

20789.name: Zaratras
20789.desc: Zaratras was a Great Holy Knight and was once the strongest in the order of Liones' Holy Knights before his death ten years prior to the beginning of series. He is also the father of the Holy Knight, Gilthunder, and was the Seven Deadly Sins' superior.

20789.name: Liz
20789.desc: Liz, or Elizabeth, was a knight from an enemy kingdom of Danafor, which attempted night ambush at Danafor, but got captured and sentenced to death. She was saved by Meliodas, the leader of the Holy Knights of Danafor and ended up living in Danafor and eventually also became Meliodas' lover. She is believed to have been killed during Danafor's complete annihilation.

20789.name: Vivian
20789.desc: Vivian is an enigmatic Holy Knight once directly serving under Great Holy Knight [Hendrickson](https://anilist.co/character/86679/Hendricksen) and used to be an apprentice of [Merlin](https://anilist.co/character/89180/Merlin), the Boar's Sin Gluttony. Vivian is regarded as the kingdom of Liones' greatest mage.

20789.name: Bartra Liones
20789.desc: The eleventh king of Liones and father of Elizabeth. He was held captive after the Seven Deadly Sins were framed for killing the great holy knight Zaratras.

20789.name: Gustav
20789.desc: Gustaf is a Ruby ranked Holy Knight and Jericho's older brother.

20789.name: Zeal
20789.desc: Guila's younger brother

20789.name: Slader
20789.desc: Slader was kidnapped and raised as a child by savages who held no regard for his worth as a human. After being freed by the king of Liones he pledged loyalty and resolved to hunt down any who wronged the kingdom. He is a member of Dawn Roar who holds a rivalry against Gowther of the Seven Deadly Sins.

20789.name: Golgius
20789.desc: A holy knight of the weird fangs. Golgius uses underhanded and deceitful tactics in order to get his way. Contracts a doctor to poison Melodidas while holding his daughter hostage and making off with Elizabeth and his sword, also tries to assassinate Melodidas while holding his hands up in surrender. He has the power of transparency, which he claims to be teleportation

20789.name: Cain Barzard
20789.desc: Cain is a short elderly man with combed hair, and a long mustache and beard. He also wears a clock, and his eyes seem to be always closed. Under his cloak, Cain wears trousers, and a long shirt that bears the crest of Danafor. He seem like a drunk, and strange, weak old man but deep down he might be a powerful fighter and wanted to have revenge on Meliodas for destroying their kingdom long time ago, he seem to be shock when he found out he wasn't Meliodas' son and that he didn't age.

20789.name: Mead
20789.desc: Mead is an orphan, adopted by the villagers of Bernia after his parents, who were travelers, became victim to an epidemic when they stopped by Bernia.

20789.name: Ellen
20789.desc: She is the sister of Luigi. She knows the way into the Capital of the Dead.

20789.name: Weinheidt
20789.desc: Weinheidt was a member from the group of Holy Knights, Dawn Roar and was the marksman of the team. Weinheidt was a well-built man with a short beard and mustache and wears a set of medieval archer clothing with a small cloak draped around his shoulders. Like the other Dawn Roar members, Weinheidt was willing to kill anybody for the mission. He was faithful to whatever mission his team is assigned to and doesn't care about the motives behind the mission as long as the job gets done, although he can be curious sometimes. Despite the Holy Knights' coup, Weinheidt retains his loyalty to the king along with his teammates when Baltra ordered Dawn Roar to stop Slader from hurting himself, to which Weinheidt complied.

20789.name: Friesia
20789.desc: Friesia is a Holy Knight with the ability to manipulate insects. Belonging to the infamous Weird Fangs stationed at Baste Dungeon, she aided in the capture of the Deadly Sin, Ban.

20789.name: Dale
20789.desc: A Holy Knight and father of Guila and Zeal. Although Dale is labeled as a traitor after his disappearance, the incident is shrouded in mystery

20789.name: Jude
20789.desc: A Holy Knight, and one of the four Weird Fangs of Baste Dungeon who captured and imprisoned Ban. Jude is known to have tortured Ban mercilessly during the Sin's imprisonment.

20789.name: Taizoo
20789.desc: is a mountain bandit-turned merchant, and a three-time champion of Vaizel's annual fight festival

20789.name: Ruin
20789.desc: A holy knight of the weird fangs whom wishes to bring ruin to the seven deadly sins. Claims his body is his true armor, and more durable than steel. Hypnotizes both Melodidas and Diane into fighting each other with his bell. Easily defeated by Melodidas after Elizabeth tore the hypnotizing bell off his staff.

20789.name: Twigo
20789.desc: Twigo is an apprentice Holy Knight who is stationed near Caines Village. ~!After his defeat by Meliodas, he, wanting to gain greater powers, drank the demon's blood, but died since he was incompatible.!~

20789.name: Dana
20789.desc: is an elderly doctor who resides in Dalmary Town, and has a daughter named Sennett. Dr. Dana is a level-headed person and is extremely dedicated to his work as he did not stop "treating" Meliodas even when Friesia was destroying the town.He cares deeply about his daughter as he was willing to even poison Meliodas to have her released from imprisonment

20789.name: Marmas
20789.desc: Marmas is a Holy Knight. He led Guila and Jericho in the assault on Byzel

20789.name: Alioni
20789.desc: Alioni is a member of the group of knights, Beard of the Mountain Cat, which was garrisoned at the base of the mountain in Kaynes Village, and claimed to serve under a Holy Knight. He was first seen beside his fellow knights trying to capture to capture the enigmatic and infamous Rust Knight who had appeared at the mysterious bar, the Boar Hat.

20789.name: Simon
20789.desc: is a Holy Knight and a member of Dawn Roar

20789.name: Sennett
20789.desc: is the daughter of an elderly doctor, Dana who works at Dalmary Town. Sennett is a polite and caring person. She loves her father very much, and was worried about him when she left; she was extremely happy when he is revealed to be alive.She also cares about her dagger as it is a memento of her mother

20789.name: Luigi
20789.desc: He is the brother of Ellen.

20789.name: Hawk Mama
20789.desc: She is Hawk's mother and the extremely large, green pig who transports the Boar Hat bar. She is introduced to live underground and transports the bar Boar Hat with her head. So far, her name remains unknown but she has gained many aliases.

20789.name: Helbram
20789.desc: Helbram is a Holy Knight, Geera's master, and the subordinate of the Great Holy Knight, Hendricksen. He wears a set of copper-colored full body armor, adorning it with a purple coat on top. He usually covers his face with a unique helm with a skyblue crest on it. Helbram has a serious personality, but also a playful side, which is seen when he jokes that Meliodas' decoration of Geera's face was not very bad. Helbram was also shown to like doing research, even taking notes during battle. ~!During the fighting festival in the Byzel Arc, he disguised himself as a referee with the alias of Love Helm.!~

21202.name: Megumin
21202.desc: Megumin is an archmage and the self-proclaimed top genius of the Crimson Demons, an order of magicians who are born with high intelligence and magical powers. Despite being an archwizard, she can only use the high level skill 'Explosion', the strongest of all offensive magic, and only once a day as it consumes tremendous magical power. Due to this she is more often a liability than an asset. Megumin speaks and dresses as a Chuunibyou and her only desire is to unleash explosion magic in the face of her enemies.

21202.name: Aqua
21202.desc: Aqua is a goddess of water. She guides humans who die young to the afterlife. Due to her cocky attitude towards [Kazuma](https://anilist.co/character/89364), she ends up being dragged to another world with him to defeat the Demon King. Aqua chose the advanced job of archpriest, as being a goddess she's naturally a strong wielder of healing magic. However, she spends most of her skillpoints on party trick skills.

21202.name: Darkness
21202.desc: A crusader and a masochist. Despite being an advanced knight, she is extremely clumsy and none of her attacks ever hit their mark. However, she has great endurance and stamina and acts as the frontline of the party. She often throws herself in front of enemies to "shield" her party, but in reality it's just her masochism.

21202.name: Kazuma Satou
21202.desc: __Height:__ 162 cm (5'4") A hikikomori (shut-in), otaku and NEET, Kazuma arrives in the afterlife after a traffic accident and decides to go to another world to defeat the Demon King, taking [Aqua](https://anilist.co/character/89362) with him. He has the weakest job of 'Adventurer', but has decent intelligence and extraordinarily high luck. This is demonstrated whenever he uses his 'steal' skill.

21202.name: Yunyun
21202.desc: Yunyun is a member of the Crimson Magic Clan, and she and [Megumin](https://anilist.co/character/89361) are friends as well as rivals.

21202.name: Wiz
21202.desc: Wiz is the owner of a famous Magic Item Shop in Axel that has many unsalable items with quirky defects. She used to be a renowned Arch Wizard, but has since retired. At night, she has a secret identity as a kind-hearted lich who helps lingering spirits pass on. She is also the only harmless Demon King's General and prefers to live as a human.

21202.name: Luna
21202.desc: Part of the Guild Staff, she is the go-to woman for adventurers visiting the guild. Luna is a very kind, caring and cheerful young woman who has a rather ''Onee-chan'' (big sister) aura about her. She has common sense which is a rarity in the Fantasy World. Luna is also a calm person, taking everything in stride.

21202.name: Eris
21202.desc: Eris is the Goddess of Fortune and [Aqua's](https://anilist.co/character/89362) junior. Eris is a very kind and gentle girl who treats others with kindness and respect. She is also very caring and she always interest her adherents. She has a very cheerful attitude but at times can act a bit childish.
