Strangely, despite his apathy towards humans and willingness to kill them, he has been shown to be more compassionate for other living beings. In Switzerland, he sliced a car that was about to hit a puppy in half, and later on maneuvered himself during a long fall to miss a patch of flowers near the bottom of the cliff. Cars' power is that of light; he is able to produce bladed appendages from his arms and use these to reflect blinding light toward his enemies. He also has the same powers over his body that all the Pillar Men share. ~!When he gains the power of the stone mask, he becomes invulnerable to sunlight, and also gains some abilities on a genetic level; he can produce living creatures and control them, and can mutate his body into various forms. He outlasts his comrades and eventually does gain almost unlimited power as the ultimate "evolved" man through the Red Stone of Aja and a stone mask. In a final confrontation, he succeeds in severing Joseph's hand but is eventually blown into space by a volcanic eruption as well as an ultimate Ripple attack from Joseph. Being immortal, he does not die; however he is unable to return to Earth after being thrown out of orbit. Trapped in the void of space for eternity, he eventually stops thinking and desires death.!~ He is named after the 80's new wave group The Cars. (Source: Wikipedia)

14719.name: Narrator
14719.desc: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

14719.name: Dire
14719.desc: Dire is a minor ally featured in Phantom Blood. Dire is a Ripple disciple under the Ripple Master Tonpetty and is a very close friend of Will Anthonio Zeppeli.

14719.name: Tompetty
14719.desc: Tonpetty is a minor ally featured in Part I: Phantom Blood. He is a Ripple master who trained Will Anthonio Zeppeli as well as Straizo and Dire.

14719.name: Dario Brando
14719.desc: Dario is the father of [Dio Brando](https://anilist.co/character/4004/Brando-Dio). An alcoholic and abusive man, he is primarily responsible for contributing to Dio's descent into evil. After a tragic misunderstanding, [George Joestar I](https://anilist.co/character/21956/Joestar-I-George) decides to give him a favor and adopts his son Dio into the Joestar Family.

14719.name: Wang Chung
14719.desc: Wang Chan is a minor antagonist featured in Part I: Phantom Blood personally as a human, Wang Chan has shown a greedy personality, selling a poison to Dio Brando without any regard for its use and heading back to the Joestar mansion to salvage for treasures and antiques. Upon becoming a vampire, however, he becomes entirely devoted to Dio's wishes. Synopsis Originally only known as the "Oriental Man", he owned a curiosity shop on Ogre Street. Wang Chang sold Dio the poison which Dio used in his murder of Dario Brando and his attempted murder of George Joestar, although Wang was not concerned with what the poison was to be used for. He told Dio, without much, if any, intent to provoke him, of a man in his own land who had a similar birthmark to Dio's who had had a harsh life, but in the end lived to be over 183. Sometime after, he was was captured by Jonathan Joestar and taken to the the Joestar Manor. When he is used in an attempt to force Dio to go with the police, he again mentions his fortune telling, saying that Dio is far too lucky to fully have to give up this early. Dio uses George's blood to become a vampire, taking Wang Chan as his subordinate when the latter goes to search the Joestar manor for valuables. Dio trusts him enough to be responsible for his head and implanting it onto Jonathan's body. This did not go according to plan, however as Jonathan use the last of his strength to crush Wang Chan's head and sent a ripple to take control of his body, and made him si

14719.name: Jack
14719.desc: Jack is a serial killer who meets Dio Brando and is transformed into a Zombie sent to fight the Joestar Group. He was inspired by the historical figure of the same name. (Source: JoJo Wikia)

14719.name: Tarkus
14719.desc: Tarkus the "Dark Knight" was a knight from 16th Century Great Britain who was executed after losing a war. Resurrected as a Zombie by Dio Brando, he is wholeheartedly loyal to his new master and fights the Joestar Group. (Source: JoJo Wikia)

14719.name: Bruford
14719.desc: Bruford is an antagonist featured in Part I: Phantom Blood. He is a vampire made from the centuries-old corpse of a brave and powerful warrior of ancient Britain. Along with Tarkus, Bruford was one of "The Dark Knights". He also had unusual battle prowess and powers associated with his dark hair. ~!Bruford and Tarkus were successful in the Challenge of the 77 in 1563, two of only five challengers to succeed in history. Prior to their corruption, Bruford and Tarkus were members of the Tudor Dynasty and retainers of Mary Stuart. Eventually they were beheaded for supporting Mary against her political rival, Elizabeth. However, Elizabeth's deception to force them to surrender led to a strong sense of betrayal that made them susceptible to manipulation by Dio.!~ ~!The pair were eventually resurrected as vampires by Dio Brando to oppose Jonathan Joestar, Will A. Zeppeli, and Robert Speedwagon. Bruford's manipulation of his hair poses much challenge to Jonathan, eventually leading to them fighting underwater, until Jonathan swims downward to find air bubbles beneath the rocks, enabling him to draw breath and hit Bruford with a ripple overdrive. Moments before he disintegrates from the ripple, Bruford gives Jonathan his sword, Luck and Pluck. However, his corpse is kicked aside by a wrathful Tarkus, who attempts to finish off Jonathan and party on his own.!~

14719.name: Holly Kuujou
14719.desc: Holly Kuujou née Joestar is the daughter of [Joseph Joestar](https://anilist.co/character/6356/) and mother of [Joutarou Kuujou](https://anilist.co/character/4003/).

14719.name: Mary Joestar
14719.original: メアリー・ジョースタ
14719.desc: Mary Joestar is the late mother of Jonathan Joestar and wife of George Joestar. Never shown in person in the series, the only thing known about her story is that she accompanied her husband during a trip to London and died protecting her baby when her carriage had an accident and fell into a ravine. (Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

14719.name: Tattoo
14719.desc: Tattoo is a rugged looking grown man with a medium sized beard and unkempt hair. His wardrobe consists mainly of a fringed leather jacket, pants, and belt. His most noticeable feature, and the obvious source of his name, is a large tattoo stretching from cheek to cheek and from forehead to nose dorsum - the tattoo appears to be either a butterfly or a design similar to a Rorschach test image. (Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

14719.name: Doobie
14719.desc: Doobie is a minor antagonist featured in Phantom Blood. He is a musclebound masked zombie that Dio Brando sics on Poco's Sister after she refuses to serve him. Doobie grabs the girl and rips her dress in an attempt to assault her, but his plan is quickly ruined by an anvil thrown by Jonathan Joestar. (Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

14719.name: Poco
14719.desc: Poco was a cowardly boy who got bullied by other kids, but was protected by his sister. When confronted by her about when he was going to fight back and live on his own, Poco answered that he would do this "tomorrow", which causes her to slap him. (Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

14719.name: Donovan
14719.desc: Donovan is a mature athletic man whose dark hair is slicked back. His skin is colored differently around his eyes, starting from a wide area on his hairline and converging to the side of the root of his nose. Donovan wears a sleeveless officer outfit. (Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

14719.name: Mario Zeppeli
14719.original: マリオ ・ ツェペリ
14719.desc: Mario Zeppeli is characterized as hard-working, trustworthy, and a wholesome family man. Although he loved his family, Mario had to abandon them in order to investigate the Pillar Men. (Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

14719.name: Loggins
14719.desc: Loggins is a tall, muscular man with chiseled features and somewhat glazed eyes. He wears a tunic, an over-sized fez, and armbands. Loggins displays a very demanding demeanor when instructing Joseph and Caesar, often forcing them to do tough trials during their Ripple training. Despite this, he seems to have, along with Messina, a sense of humor as the two would often tease their disciples. (Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

14719.name: George II Joestar
14719.original: ジョージ・ジョースター 2世
14719.desc: George resembles his father Jonathan and his son Joseph. He is only seen wearing a military dress uniform. Assumed to be a capable fighter pilot, George was one of the first to fly an aircraft during World War I. It's hinted that he may have had a talent for the Ripple much like his father and son, though he was never given any training to properly use it. (Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

14719.name: Messina
14719.desc: Messina is a tall muscular man with short hair tied into a ponytail and a Fu Manchu mustache. He wears a long hat, a sleeveless tunic, and armbands. Though much of Messina's personality isn't focused upon, he displays the characteristics of a stern, yet effective instructor to Joseph and Caesar. Despite this, Messina seems to have a sense of humor as he, along with Loggins, would often tease his disciples during their training. (Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

14719.name: Poco no Ane
14719.desc: She's the older sister of Poco and was held captive in the castle by Dio

14719.name: Styx
14719.desc: An alcoholic priest who discovers Dio's coffin in the boat Jonathan and Erina board.

14719.name: Danny
14719.desc: Minor character appearing in Phantom Blood. He is [Jonathan Joestar](https://anilist.co/character/8087/Joestar-Jonathan)'s dog and childhood best friend. [George Joestar I](https://anilist.co/character/21956/Joestar-I-George) bought Danny when he was a puppy when Jonathan was five years old. Danny was very afraid of unfamiliar places and strange people causing him to bite Jonathan when the young boy first approached him. For a while, Jonathan also antagonized Danny by throwing stones at him. One day, while swimming in a river, Jonathan started drowning and was saved by Danny, which made them the best of friends. ~!Danny's death at the hands of [Dio Brando](https://anilist.co/character/4004/Brando-Dio) serves as one of the primary catalysts in the lifelong rivalry between Jonathan and Dio.!~

14719.name: Mark
14719.desc: Mark is a German soldier and a friend of Caesar Zeppeli who participated in the effort for stopping the Pillar Men's awakening.

14719.name: Kisha
14719.desc: She arrives at the cafe where Joseph and Straizo are fighting and begins to take photos, saying it would reach the front page of the newspaper. Straizo catches her off guard and uses her as a hostage to approach Joseph, vowing to kill her if the Joestar runs off. Though Joseph attempts to bluff his way out by calling her a "floozie" he won't risk his life to save, Straizo forces Joseph to fight him when he rips the reporter's tooth out. After being saved, the reporter punches Joseph for insulting her and then kicks him in the knee. The adrenaline from the ordeal then wears off and she screams from the delayed pain of losing her tooth. This content comes from JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia (https://jojowiki.com), and must be attributed to its authors, as specified in the license. JoJo's Bizarre Wiki (the FANDOM wiki) is prohibited from using it, for repeatedly copying without giving attribution.

14719.name: Chuugoku Kenpouka
14719.desc: He originally tries to rob Jonathan Joestar in Ogre Street alongside Robert E. O. Speedwagon and Tattoo

14719.name: Elizabeth I
14719.desc: Elizabeth I is a queen of England and a monarch from the Tudor dynasty. In 1565, she battles her first cousin once removed, Mary Stuart, over the throne. Her betrayal of Bruford and Tarkus, two retainers of Mary, led to the two knights cursing humanity; Dio Brando uses this resentment to his advantage over three hundred years later when he revives them as zombies. (Source: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Wiki)

14719.name: Shitsuji
14719.desc: A butler of the Joestar Family.

14719.name: Wired Beck
14719.desc: He is a Vampire created by Kars tasked with guarding the hotel Kars is hiding in and briefly battles Lisa Lisa.

14719.name: Adams
14719.desc: Adams is a former human and villager from Windknight's Lot who becomes a Zombie created by Dio Brando.

154587.name: Frieren
154587.desc: Frieren is the protagonist of _Sousou no Frieren_ and [Fern](https://anilist.co/character/183965)'s master. She was the Mage of the Hero Party and traveled alongside Hero [Himmel](https://anilist.co/character/184311/Himmel), Warrior [Eisen](https://anilist.co/character/184312/Eisen), and Priest [Heiter](https://anilist.co/character/184310/Heiter) in a 10-year journey to defeat the Demon King. She was a magic prodigy at a young age, with an impressive quantity of mana, which caught the interest of [Flamme](https://anilist.co/character/219733/Flamme), a human wizard who taught her everything there is to know about magic and mana control until she passed away. Frieren persists in collecting magic knowledge no matter how trivial it may be.

154587.name: Fern
154587.desc: Fern is the young mage apprentice of [Frieren](https://anilist.co/character/176754/Frieren) and accompanies her as a member of her party. She is an orphaned war refugee originally from the Southern Lands, later adopted by [Heiter](https://anilist.co/character/184310/Heiter) and placed under Frieren's care.

154587.name: Heiter
154587.desc: A priest who is a part of the Hero's party. He later took care of [Fern](https://anilist.co/character/183965/Fern) until [Frieren](https://anilist.co/character/176754/Frieren) arrived.

154587.name: Himmel
154587.desc: Hero and Leader of the party that defeated the Demon King, and a self-proclaimed handsome narcissist. He cares about his friends and can't help but help those in need. He had a great influence on [Frieren](https://anilist.co/character/176754/Frieren), with whom he had adventures for 10 years.

154587.name: Eisen
154587.desc: Dwarf warrior who was a part of the Hero's party, later became a mentor to [Stark](https://anilist.co/character/184313/Stark).

154587.name: Stark
154587.desc: Stark is a warrior who fights alongside [Frieren](https://anilist.co/character/176754/Frieren) and [Fern](https://anilist.co/character/183965/Fern). After his village was attacked by demons, he fled and became [Eisen](https://anilist.co/character/184312/Eisen)'s apprentice. At Eisen's instruction, he joined Frieren's party as their vanguard.

154587.name: Sein
154587.desc: Sein is a Priest from a small village in the Alt Woods. After [Frieren](https://anilist.co/character/176754/Frieren) spotted his talent, he joined her group for a period of time with the goal of reuniting with his childhood friend Gorilla.

154587.name: Aura
154587.desc: Aura is one of the Seven Sages of Destruction directly serving the Demon King. ~!She later was killed by [Frieren](https://anilist.co/character/176754/Frieren) after being commanded to kill herself using her own Auserlese.!~

154587.name: Kraft
154587.desc: He is an elf that Frieren's group meets in a cabin in the mountains. He's a monk and believed to be the last elf alive until meeting Frieren.

154587.name: Flamme
154587.desc: She lived a millennium before the story and was [Frieren](https://anilist.co/character/176754/Frieren)'s teacher.

154587.name: Serie
154587.desc: An elven mage who is said to possess knowledge about nearly every magic that exists. She was Flamme's master. She founded the Continental Magic Association around 20 years before Himmel's death. First-class mages get the privilege of meeting her and can ask for any magic they desire.

154587.name: Methode
154587.desc: A mage that can use restraint and mental manipulation magic. Good at detecting mana and can use simple recovery magic.

154587.name: Genau
154587.desc: First-class mage who was a proctor for the first examination.

154587.name: Laufen
154587.desc: A third-class mage. Specializes in magic that makes her move at high speed. Treats [Denken](https://anilist.co/character/246058/Denken) as her grandfather.

154587.name: Übel
154587.desc: Übel is a third-class mage. Was disqualified in an earlier examination due to killing a first-class wizard. Specializes in magic that allows her to copy the spells of people she can empathize with. Relies mostly on her intuition and is not bound by logical reasoning. ~!Becomes a first-class mage after the examination.!~

154587.name: Denken
154587.desc: Denken is an imperial mage of the second-class. In his youth he belonged to an army but became an imperial mage after winning a power struggle. Often calm and calculating, however he still has a fire burning within despite his old age. He saw [Frieren](https://anilist.co/character/176754/Frieren) as his motivation to become a mage. ~!Becomes a first-class mage after the examination.!~

154587.name: Lawine
154587.desc: Lawine is a third-class mage in the Second Party of the First Class Mage Examinations. She specializes in manipulating ice.

154587.name: Kanne
154587.desc: Kanne is a third-class mage who graduated from the Academy of Magic. She is childhood friends and classmates with [Lawine](https://anilist.co/character/293727), and the two entered the first-class mage exam together. In the first stage of the exam, she was paired with Lawine and [Frieren](https://anilist.co/character/176754).

154587.name: Qual
154587.desc: A feared and powerful demon who served the Demon King.

154587.name: Ou-sama
154587.desc: The King resides in the Royal Capital in the Central Lands. The King's influence reaches across the Central and Northern Lands. When the Hero Party first set out on their journey to defeat the Demon King, he provided them with ten copper coins.

154587.name: Yakusou-ka
154587.desc: A herbalist that lives in a village in the Turk Region.

154587.name: Arakuremono A
154587.desc: An adventurer that hangs out in a tavern in Warm.

154587.name: Arakuremono B
154587.desc: An adventurer that hangs out in a tavern in Warm.

154587.name: Roujin
154587.desc: An elder wearing a straw hat in the village by where Qual is sealed. Himmel would talk with him when he visited to check on the condition of the seal.

154587.name: Sonchou A
154587.desc: An elder that lives in the Granz Channel. He offers [Frieren](https://anilist.co/character/176754/Frieren) and [Fern](https://anilist.co/character/183965/Fern) a fake of one of the [Great Mage Flamme](https://anilist.co/character/219733/Flamme)'s grimoires as payment for cleaning up the shore of the channel by the New Year's Anniversary and checks up on them throughout their stay in town.

154587.name: Pan-ya Tenshu
154587.desc: A kind woman that owns a bakery in the Granz Channel. She gives [Fern](https://anilist.co/character/183965/Fern) extra bread for being a regular customer while [Frieren](https://anilist.co/character/176754/Frieren) and Fern stay in town to clean up the shore.

154587.name: Edel
154587.desc: Edel is a second-class mage in the Seventeenth Party, alongside Blei and Dunst, of the First Class Mage Exam. She specializes in Hypnosis Magic.

154587.name: Murabito A
154587.desc: A old lady that is seen taking care of two young children in Riegel Canyon.

154587.name: Murabito C
154587.desc: A man who live in the village [Stark](https://anilist.co/character/184313/Stark) protected in Riegel Canyon.

154587.name: Kodomo A
154587.desc: A child from Riegel Canyon. He adores [Stark](https://anilist.co/character/184313/Stark) and seek his attention.

154587.name: Lügner
154587.desc: Lügner was a demon who served [Aura the Guillotine](https://anilist.co/character/219110/Aura).

154587.name: Linie
154587.desc: Linie is a Demon working under [Aura](https://anilist.co/character/219110/Aura). Under Aura's instruction, she was sent to assist [Lügner](https://anilist.co/character/316985/Lgner) alongside [Draht](https://anilist.co/character/316987/Draht) to perform negotiations with [Graf Granat](https://anilist.co/character/318147/Granat-Hakushaku).

154587.name: Draht
154587.desc: Draht was a demon who served [Aura the Guillotine](https://anilist.co/character/219110/Aura).

154587.name: Granat Hakushaku
154587.desc: Ruler of Graf Granat's Domain, a fortified city in the Northern Lands constantly at war with Aura.

154587.name: Akuma no Ko
154587.desc: A young demon girl that ate the daughter of two villagers in a town the Hero Party visited. She called for "mother" when Himmel attempted to kill her, and the village chief takes her in as his own family and tries to give her a chance to atone.

154587.name: Stoltz
154587.desc: Stark's older brother, referred to as the strongest warrior in the village.

154587.name: Tsurugi no Sato no Satoosa
154587.desc: The current chief of the Village of the Sword. Her position was inherited. She is young for the position and postures to try to make up for her lack of height, but when faced with danger or matters regarding the Hero's Blade, she is collected and calm.

154587.name: Wirbel
154587.desc: Second-class mage and the leader of the eighth party during the first stage of the First Class Mage Exam. He is the captain of the Northern Magic Corps and is thus a very experienced mage. Specializes in magic that restrains the opponent when their body is in full-view.

154587.name: Richter
154587.desc: Second-class mage who participates in the First Class Mage Exam at the same time as Frieren and Fern. He owns a magical store in Äußerst where he specializes in repairing broken staves.

154587.name: Ehre
154587.desc: Second-class mage in the Eighth Party, alongside Wirbel and Scharf, in the First Class Mage Exam. Fern feels that she is the strongest within both the Fourth and Eighth parties.

154587.name: Land
154587.desc: Second-class mage in the Fourth Party of the First Class Mage Examination. He specializes in illusion magic.

154587.name: Sense
154587.desc: First-class mage that is proctoring the Second Exam of the First Class Mage Examination. She is a solemn person who rarely speaks.

154587.name: Blei
154587.desc: Participant in the examination for the title of mage first class. ~!Sacrificed himself to help Dunst deliver important information to his comrades in the lower level of the dungeon.!~

154587.name: Falsch
154587.desc: First class mage. Acts as an observer in magical exams.

154587.name: Länge
154587.desc: Participant in the examination for the title of mage first class. Slightly distracted girl. Likes to read books and learn new spells.

154587.name: Tenshu
154587.desc: A woman who live in the village [Stark](https://anilist.co/character/184313/Stark) protected in Riegel Canyon.

154587.name: Mago
154587.desc: A child from Riegel Canyon. He adores [Stark](https://anilist.co/character/184313/Stark) and seek his attention.

154587.name: Stark no Chichi
154587.desc: [Stark](https://anilist.co/character/184313/Stark)'s father is a harsh, militant man. He considers Stark a failure. He is also strict with the other warriors of the village, scolding them for their pathetic display against a monster and praising [Stoltz](https://anilist.co/character/319598/Stoltz), who he considered the pride of the village, for defeating it while keeping his white cape pristine.

154587.name: Senshi Gorilla
154587.desc: Childhood friend of [Sein](https://anilist.co/character/205177) who dreamed of going on an adventure and becoming a legendary hero. A long time ago, he asked Sein to start adventuring with him, which Sein refused and regretted since.

154587.name: Orden
154587.desc: Nobleman presiding over the Vorig Fortified City and the current head of the Orden family, one of the Three Great Knightly Houses of the Northern Lands.

154587.name: Gabel
154587.desc: Servant of [Lord Orden](https://anilist.co/character/326825).

154587.name: Mut
154587.desc: Lord Orden's youngest son and the next heir of the Orden family.

154587.name: Wirt
154587.desc: Lord Orden's oldest son. Wirt passed away in a melee against demon forces but managed to kill the enemy general.

154587.name: Voll Jii
154587.desc: Elderly Dwarf warrior and a long-time friend of Frieren. He resides in a village in the Klar Region.

154587.name: Lernen
154587.desc: An old friend of Denken. First Class Mage and Serie's apprentice. Rarely acts directly, preferring stealth. ~!Helped in the extraction and transfer of information necessary for the liberation of Denken's hometown.!~

154587.name: Scharf
154587.desc: Scharf is a third-class mage and member of the eighth party along with Wirbel and Ehre for the First Class Mage Examination.

154587.name: Toun
154587.desc: Participant in the examination for the title of mage first class. Distrustful and self-confident mage.

154587.name: Lecker
154587.desc: The head chef for the restaurant Bell in Äußerst.

154587.name: Dünste
154587.desc: Participant in the First Class Mage Exam.

20931.name: Light Yagami
20931.desc: __Height:__ 179 cm (5'10") Light is a third year high school student (12th Grade) at Daikoku Private Academy who also attends supplemental classes at Gamou Prep Academy in the beginning of the story. Light has a father, [Soichiro Yagami](https://anilist.co/character/1927/Yagami-Souichirou), who is the head of the Police Force. Light also has a mother, [Sachiko Yagami](https://anilist.co/character/14735/Yagami-Sachiko), and a younger sister, [Sayu Yagami](https://anilist.co/character/8135/Yagami-Sayu). In Spring 2004, he becomes a first-year student (freshman) at To-Oh University and gets one of the top scores of its entrance exam. Nicknamed "Kira", he uses the Death Note to create his ideal world of justice under him; its new God. Though he looks frail, Light is an extremely athletic person, with an aptitude to find an opponent's weak point. He is a genius, which adds to his notion that only he is fit to judge humanity and steer it on a proper moral course.

20931.name: Decim
20931.desc: Decim is the bartender of Quindecim and also the arbiter of floor 15. His faction deals with people who have died at the same time. He can create threads and use them to restrict rude customers from moving, or use them to hang things. They are strong enough to stop a person in their tracks and swing them hard against the wall.

20931.name: Kurokami no Onna
20931.desc: __Height:__ 170 cm She is an amnesiac woman taken in by [Nona](https://anilist.co/character/88681/Nona) to Quindecim and hired as [Decim](https://anilist.co/character/81853/Decim)'s assistant. When she first awoke, she appeared to be an innocent but skeptical woman. However, once she became accustomed to living in Quindecim, she acted as a strong-willed woman who always spoke her mind whenever she felt it was necessary. She is not afraid to disagree with Decim if she believes he is wrong.

20931.name: Nona
20931.desc: Nona is the manager of the Arbiter system, as well as the bartender of Nona Ginta located on the ninetieth floor. She is the boss of Decim, Ginti, Clavis, along with the rest of the other arbiters.

20931.name: Ginti
20931.desc: Ginti is bartender of a bar named Viginti, which is located on the 20th floor. (Source: Death Parade Wiki)

20931.name: Clavis
20931.desc: He is an elevator operator in the arbiter system, as well as a personal valet to Nona. His task is to transport arbiters and guests between floors. Also, he smiles a lot.

20931.name: Castra
20931.desc: She is an organization clerk who measures coefficients of the dead and classifies them in various fields in order to determine their bar destination.

20931.name: Oculus
20931.desc: Occulus is the founder of the post-death arbitration system. He spends most of his time playing billiards, especially with Nona, whose presence he appreciates for discussion. Oculus is strictly opposed to the idea that referees can have human feelings because he says "humans cannot judge humans." The lotus flower under his chin can be enlarged, allowing him to see through the memories of the people he "absorbs" with.

20931.name: Quin
20931.desc: Quin works in the information processing section, and is now in charge of sending the “memories of the dead” to arbiters. She used to work as an arbiter and was the owner of Quindecim prior to Decim's appointment there.

20931.name: Harada
20931.desc: One of the main dancers in Cross Heart Attack. He is a great dancer and a womanizer. ~!In the living world, Harada dated a fan of his named Kana. He broke up with Kana and left her devastated. When Kana explained how terrible she felt when he broke up with her, Harada laughed and apologized. This led to Kana committing suicide. It is later revealed that he was killed by Kana's sister with a bomb as revenge for Kana's death. It is implied that Harada and Kana's sister slept together before he was killed by her.!~

20931.name: Mayu Arita
20931.desc: Mayu is a student who is a huge fan of the idol group C.H.A, of which Harada is a member. She is a happy go lucky girl who is also a bit of a klutz. Her death was what would be called a freak accident, where while entering the bath she slipped on a bar of soap lying on the floor, hit her head and died instantly.

20931.name: Kana
20931.desc: She previously dated Harada, the member of the boy group C.H.A. After they ended their relationship, she became hysterical about how Harada was too cheerful about it. She later committed suicide because of their breakup.

20931.name: Tria
20931.desc: Arbiter who is employed on an unknown floor.

20931.name: Takashi
20931.desc: ~!It is later realized that the reason for their death was because of Takashi's jealousy. Early in the game, he finds out that Machiko is pregnant, only to figure out later that it isn't his and that she was having an affair. He then proceeds to try attacking Machiko with one of the darts, but is stopped by Decim. He then passes out and gets sent back into the elevators; there, he is sent to be reincarnated.!~

20931.name: Yousuke Tateishi
20931.desc: Hikikomori who works part time as a security guard, he spends most of his free time locked up in his room where he does nothing but read manga, watch anime and play games. His parents' divorced when he was still child left him devastated and depressed that he has been a loner ever since. Though his father has remarried, he is very hostile towards his stepmother despite her attempts to become close to him. He met Misaki in Quindecim, where both of them are forced to play an arcade game that will decide their fates. He later remembers that he committed suicide after jumping off several stories from his apartment complex. The last thing he saw before dying was his stepmother, who was crying and begging him to hold on as they drove to the hospital in the back of an ambulance.

20931.name: Mai Takada
20931.desc: Part time attendant at a local bowling alley where Miura and his friends frequent. ~!She found herself at Quindecim where she was later joined by Miura. They were forced to play a game of bowling that would decide their fate. During the game, the two of them realized that they had died in a bus accident. She starts to remember the time when she was with with Miura and Chisato during their childhood days. At first she had her memories are confused, believing that she was Chisato; however, it was revealed that she had plastic surgery to look like Chisato. Little is know as what their fate has become, but is was strongly implied that the two were to be reincarnated.!~

20931.name: Lisa
20931.desc: Kana's sister. She dated Harada in order to decieve him and avenge her sister's suicide. Lisa murders Harada by planting a bomb in his room while he slept.

20931.name: Machiko
20931.desc: Machiko along with her husband Takashi take part in the death game of darts. ~!It is later found out that she was having an affair and carrying the baby of her boyfriend, which leads to Takashi trying to attack her with a dart. After Takashi passes out, Machiko re-enters one of the elevators which takes her to the void. However, in Onna's opinion, the baby she carries actually belongs to Takashi and she acted guilty because she truly loves the latter, where later on Decim realizing that he made a mistake but it was too late for any rectification.!~

20931.name: Shigeru Miura
20931.desc: College student and the childhood friend of Chisato Miyazaki and Mai Takada.

20931.name: Chisato Miyazaki
20931.desc: Miura and Mai's childhood friend who moved out when they were little.

20931.name: Novem
20931.desc: Arbiter who is employed on an unknown floor.

20931.name: Shimada
20931.desc: Brother of Sae Shimada.

20931.name: Sae Shimada
20931.desc: Sister of Shimada. ~!After losing both her parents at a young age, her brother Shimada supported her. She was attacked and raped by an unnamed assailant and unknowingly saw Tatsumi watching, thinking he was a partner. After the attack this leaves her hateful and broken going as far as telling her brother that she wants her attackers dead.!~

20931.name: Misaki Tachibana
20931.desc: Actress and a single mom, who has underwent a lot of failed relationships. She and Yousuke both arrive at Quindecim where they were force to play an arcade game to decide their fate. At first she thought that she is in some kind of reality show only to discover in the midst of the game that she was strangle to death by her manager whom she antagonised and slapped.

20931.name: Tatsumi
20931.desc: Detective

20931.name: Memine
20931.desc: Memine is a cat who lives on Viginti together with Ginti, and helps him with his duties as an arbiter.

97668.name: Butagami
97668.desc: __Race:__ Human __Occupation:__ Superhero __Abilities:__ Superhuman Physical Prowess, Inhuman Digestive System, Elasticity __Level:__ S-Class: Rank 10 __Personality:__ Pig God is a glutton and is constantly eating food. He is also very direct, or simply lazy. However he is a very caring individual and also appears to be very humble, as he usually doesn't mind helping others or openly embracing other heroes' advices. He also does not mind paying for people in secret. __Abilities:__ As an S-Class hero, Pig God is very powerful, he has the ability to digest swallowed monsters almost instantly, he also seems to have complete control over his digestive system. Pig God has a thick layer of fat capable of absorbing all types of impact and he is also immune to poison.

97668.name: Kuseno Hakase
97668.desc: The doctor responsible for Genos' repairs and upgrades. He was pursing the cyborg that destroyed Genos' town. Genos begged for him to make him into a cyborg after promising the destroy the cyborg that destroyed his home.

97668.name: Saitama
97668.desc: __Height:__ 175 cm (5'9") Saitama is the main protagonist of One Punch Man, and the most powerful hero alive. Having apparently trained himself to superhuman condition, Saitama faces an existential crisis as he is now too powerful to gain any thrill from his heroic deeds. He is registered with the Heroes Association as a B-Class Superhero and is tasked to defend Z-City against Mysterious Beings. For a superhero, Saitama is rather laid-back. Because even the mightiest foes pose no challenge to him, he doesn't take his hero work very seriously. In spite of this, he is constantly searching for an opponent that can challenge him, since his superhero work is beginning to bore him because it's too easy. The combination of his attitude, unstoppable strength, and distinctively simple and 'unimpressive' appearance often cause his battles to become anticlimactic. Saitama will usually allow his opponents to rant about their motives and power up into their strongest forms before suddenly and nonchalantly obliterating them with one punch.

97668.name: Genos
97668.desc: __Height:__ 178 cm (5'10") __Debut:__ Chapter 6 / Episode 1 __Race:__ Cyborg __Location:__ Z-City __Abilities:__ Enhancements Physical feats, Full Cyborg Weaponry, Highly Skilled and Strategist Combatant __Weapons:__ Cyborg Body __Occupation:__ Superhero __Level:__ S-Class; Rank 16 (beginning), Rank 14 (current) __Affiliation:__ The Heroes Association A cyborg and a self-proclaimed disciple of [Saitama](https://anilist.co/character/73935). He is always aiming to become stronger and fights for justice. Genos is an extremely serious character. He has a strong motivation to become stronger and is always looking at Saitama as an example of the ultimate hero. Constantly trying to be like him even if it results in reckless fights.

97668.name: Onsoku no Sonic
97668.desc: __Height:__ 174 cm __Race:__ Human __Location:__ Z-City __Abilities:__ Superhuman Speed and Agility __Weapons:__ Ninja equipment __Occupation:__ Bodyguard (former, now a villain) __Affiliation:__ Mr. Monier (former) Sonic is a villain in the series, first appearing as a bodyguard hired by Mr. Monier. He views [Saitama](https://anilist.co/character/73935/Saitama) as his eternal rival. Sonic is a villain who, despite his normally calm appearance, loves fighting strong opponents as shown by when he gets a "child-like smile" on his face when he first meets Saitama and has two of his attacks blocked, earlier calling this his "bad habit." He seems to be very quick to act as he attacks Saitama on their first meeting without letting him explain the situation.

97668.name: Sneck
97668.desc: __Race:__ Human __Occupation:__ Superhero __Level:__ A-Class; Rank: 38 __Affiliation:__ Heroes Association Sneck is an A-Class Superhero, rank 38. He was tasked with welcoming the new heroes for the National Superhero Registry Test that Saitama and Genos were a part of.

97668.name: Bang
97668.desc: __Height:__ 165 cm (5'5") __Race:__ Human __Occupation:__ Superhero __Level:__ S-Class __Rank:__ 3 __Affiliation:__ Heroes Association Bang is an S-Class, rank 3, superhero for the Heroes Association, settled in Z-City. Bang owns a dojo passed down from generations, and uses the fighting style the Rock-Smashing Water Stream Fist. __Abilities:__ Bang being in the top 3 of the S-Class ranking, he is acknowledged by the public and heroes to be a strong fighter. Not much is known about Bang's abilities other than that he uses a martial art called "Rock-Smashing Water Stream Fist".

97668.name: Tatsumaki
97668.desc: __Race:__ Human __Abilities:__ Psychokinesis __Occupation:__ Superhero __Level:__ S-Class; Rank: 2 __Affiliation:__ Heroes Association __Family:__ [Fubuki](https://anilist.co/character/81931/) (sister) Tatsumaki is a petite woman, commonly mistaken for being much younger than she really is. She has an adolescent face with emerald green eyes and green hair that naturally curls up on the ends. She wears a long dress that separates into 4 sections slightly above the hips and low-heeled black shoes. __Personality:__ She has a rather brash, moody, hotheaded, and impatient personality. She is disrespectful towards most people, especially to those she deems incompetent. Despite her arrogant personality, she feels obligated to defeat monsters and considers her job as a hero to be a duty, accepting any of the Hero Association's requests to defeat monsters, due to the fact that she tends to get bored when she is not fighting monsters. She also seeks them to fight in her own time. She has a bit of a soft side towards her little sister Fubuki, but she is also very overprotective. __Abilities:__ As the most powerful esper in One-Punch Man and one of the most powerful heroes, Tatsumaki possesses extreme skill in wielding her psychic abilities, whether it be for offense, defense, or miscellaneous uses. Tatsumaki's knowledge about psychic powers is also as vast as her skill in wielding them, which is enough to lift an entire city. She's also called as the Association's ultimate weapon.

97668.name: Fubuki
97668.desc: __Race:__ Human __Occupation:__ Superhero __Height:__ 167 cm (5'5¾") __Level:__ B-Class Rank 1 __Affiliation:__ Hero Association __Family:__ Tatsumaki (sister) __Abilities:__ Psychokinesis Fubuki, also known by her hero alias Blizzard of Hell, is the B-Class Rank 1 professional hero of the Hero Association. She is an esper, the younger sister of Tatsumaki, and the leader of the Blizzard Group, a B-Class hero faction. She and her sister are known as the Psychic Sisters. Fubuki is currently trying to recruit [Saitama](https://anilist.co/character/73935/Saitama) into her group. She's also a self-declared member of the Saitama Group.

97668.name: Bofoi
97668.desc: __Race:__ Human __Alias:__ Metal Knight __Location:__ Z-City __Abilities:__ Weapons; Large remotely controlled robot, with lots of firepower __Occupation:__ Superhero __Level:__ S-Class; Rank: 6 __Affiliation:__ The Heroes Association S-Class Rank 6 of the Hero Association. Besides fighting, Bofoi also provides many services for the Hero Association, such as weaponry sponsorships and facility construction.

97668.name: Satoru
97668.desc: __Race:__ Human __Location:__ Z-City __Weapons:__ Gauntlets __Occupation:__ Superhero __Level:__ C-Class; Rank: 1 __Affiliation:__ Heroes Association License-less Rider is a C-Class Hero from Z-City. He has the #1 rank of the C-Class.

97668.name: Darkness Blade
97668.desc: __Race:__ Human __Abilities:__ Weapons __Superhero Level:__ B-Class __Rank:__ 61 __Affiliation:__ Heroes __Association Debut:__ OPM Extra Chapter Darkness Blade is a rookie B-Class Superhero, rank 61. He tried to stand up against the 170,000-Year Magicicada Larva but was quickly defeated and returned to Shelter Nr. 7. He has an intimidating aura and is confident of his own power. He speaks in a very sophisticated way, almost poetic and very heroic, but as commented on by Red Muffler, sounds pretty stupid.

97668.name: Tanktop Tiger
97668.original: タンクトップタイガー
97668.desc: **Race:** Human **Occupation:** Superhero **Level:** C-Class; Rank: 6 **Affiliation:** The Heroes Association Tanktop Tiger (タンクトップタイガー Tankutopu Taiga) is a C-Class superhero, rank 6, and the younger brother of Tanktop Black Hole. __Appearance:__ Tanktop Tiger is a large, muscular man who has tiger stripes running through his hair and eyebrows. He wears a tiger stripped tanktop. Tanktop Tiger is especially loud and obnoxious. He is confident in his own power and looks down upon superhero newbies, making him quite arrogant and hostile.

97668.name: Tanktop Black Hole
97668.original: タンクトップブラックホール
97668.desc: __Race:__ Human __Alias:__ Tanktop Black Hole __Occupation:__ Superhero __Level:__ B-Class __Affiliation:__ The Heroes Association __Partner:__ Tanktop Tiger Tanktop Black Hole is a B-Class hero and the older brother of Tanktop Tiger. Tanktop Black Hole is a large, well-built man with short black hair. He wears a very simple costume of pants and a black tanktop. He has a rather confident and stubborn personality. He refuses to believe a C-Class hero could ever be capable of destroying the meteor. He is also a rather charismatic person, shown by his ability to bend a crowd to his will.

97668.name: Ougon Ball
97668.desc: __Race:__ Human __Weapons:__ Slingshot __Abilities:__ Shape Memory Gold __Occupation:__ Superhero __Level:__ A-Class; Rank: 29 __Affiliation:__ Heroes Association Golden Ball is an A-Class Superhero, rank 29. He was partnered with Spring Mustache to investigate the Kombu Infinity rumor in Z-City. He is a rather confident man, who believes he does not need to prepare for a fight.

97668.name: Banken Man
97668.desc: Watchdog Man (番犬マン Banken-man) is a S-Class Rank 12 professional hero who is in charge of Q-City. Watchdog Man has been shown to be very blunt and nonchalant. He acts like a dog at all times, speaking sparingly, sitting on his haunches while alert or loitering, and curling up in a dog bed while asleep. He takes a stance on all fours while fighting, rather than standing upright to confront enemies.

97668.name: Puri-Puri Prisoner
97668.desc: __Occupation:__ Superhero __Level:__ S-Class; Rank 17 Puri-Puri Prisoner is a flamboyant, openly homosexual superhero. He takes an interest in other, up-and-coming heroes and criminals; an interest which led to his titular jail sentence, as he kept attacking them. Criminals that he apprehends are then added to his harem.

97668.name: Ikemen Kamen Amai Mask
97668.original: イケメン仮面アマイマスク
97668.desc: __Race:__ Human ~!Mysterious Being (Ugmon)!~ __Occupation:__ Superhero __Level:__ A-Class; Rank 1. Sweet Mask is a tall and lean-built young man with messy, shoulder-length light blue hair and yellow eyes. He is considered to be very handsome by the public. Aside from being a hero he is also a famous model, actor and singer, being the most popular one in the world. Sweet Mask has stated that he believes that heroes are to protect the citizens, and if they can't do that, they must become strong enough to be able to do so. He also genuinely cares for the well-being of the citizens around him and actually wishes happiness upon every living thing in the universe. However, befitting the darker side of Sweet Mask's name is his hidden merciless nature. He is shown to have a burning hatred for anything that he sees as evil. Anything that he declares as evil must be swiftly and thoroughly exterminated. Sweet Mask is shown to adhere to any method that makes heroes popular. He notes that only promotions to S-Class or A-Class are fit for his attention, as they are the heroes who draw the most attention from the public, and hence, any heroes in those ranks who earn themselves negative reputations would drag his reputation down as well. Because of this, Sweet Mask stays in the A-Class Rank 1 position to prevent unworthy heroes from promoting to S-Class. Sweet Mask is very narcissistic about "beauty overwhelming the power", as he said about his philosophy that "heroes have to be beautiful a

97668.name: Max
97668.desc: Max (マックス, Makkusu), also known by his hero alias Lightning Max (イナズマックス, Inazumakkusu), is the A-Class Rank 19 professional hero for the Hero Association. Max is shown to think ahead and spy on his target to know how to defeat them but it is shown that he has some doubt in his abilities.

97668.name: Banehige
97668.desc: __Level:__ A-Class; Rank: 33 Spring Mustachio is an intelligent, serious man who doesn't back down, as shown by his persistence in fighting Kombu Infinity, even after being beaten up rather badly. He also shares a bond with fellow A-Class hero Golden Ball, as they regularly pair up to hunt monsters and share drinks in their spare time.

97668.name: Genji
97668.desc: __Height:__ 165cm Genji, also known by his hero alias Lightning Genji, is the A-Class Rank 17 professional hero of the Hero Association.

97668.name: King
97668.desc: __Race:__ Human __Occupation:__ Superhero __Level:__ S-Class; Rank 7 __Affiliation:__ The Heroes Association Despite not being the highest ranked hero of the Heroes Association, he is considered to be the most powerful man on Earth, and it is due to this strength that he receives praise and respect from fellow heroes. His strength is so feared that criminals and mysterious beings will surrender before having to fight him. Appearance: King has slightly long, blonde, brushed back hair along with three long scars on the left side of his face. He wears a turtleneck sweater, has sunken cheeks, a defined jawline and a squarish chin. Notably, a loud drumming sound may be heard in his proximity. The King Engine is a rumbling sound that others claim occurs when King readies for battle or when he is generally serious having an intimidating effect on his opponents. ~! In actuality, it is simply the sound of King's heartbeat which, when he is frightened, is so loud that it can be heard outside his body, but because of King's intimidating reputation people mistake it for bloodlust. King is able to appear to remain calm in threatening situations as well as put out an extremely threatening aura. Despite the intimidating personality King projects, he is actually a coward and an otaku. He has been shown to get very excited about buying a dating game. Saitama saved his life many times, but always end up getting all the credits that was supposed to be for the latter. With this misunderstanding,

97668.name: Bad
97668.desc: Bad (バッド, Baddo), also known by his hero alias Metal Bat (金属バット, Kinzoku Batto), is the S-Class Rank 15 professional hero for the Hero Association. Metal Bat is a young man with black hair styled in a pompadour, and dark eyes that emphasize his hot temper. Metal Bat has a great deal of confidence in himself, stating that he did not care whether a threat is a Demon or Dragon level. Like [Saitama](https://anilist.co/character/73935/Saitama), he doesn't care about his rank, and accidentally kills his enemies faster than he intended.

97668.name: Garou
97668.desc: __Height:__ 177 cm (5'9") Garou is a former disciple of [Bang](https://anilist.co/character/81141), but was kicked out from his dojo for going on a rampage. He's one of the strongest characters in the series and plays a major role as the main villain in the Hero Hunt arc. Garou is introduced as an evil character with a hatred for heroes and a confident, vindictive personality. He hates being insulted and will attack or kill any who offend him. He thinks highly of himself and uses that assertion to threaten high ranking personal such as heroes and [Shicchi](https://anilist.co/character/137876/Sitch). He does not consider other human villains to be allies, wiping out a large group of them along with the heroes present. He will also attack low ranked hero and hero staff members if he encounters them. A large aspect of his personality seems to be some sort of disdain for his former master, Bang, enough to avoid using the Water Stream Rock Smashing Fist he was taught unless seriously cornered. He has no remorse even for people who aid him, as he smashed [Licenseless Rider](https://anilist.co/character/81935)'s face soon after the latter defended him. Although Garou is an evil character, he possesses some kind of morality: he lets heroes live so that they can grow stronger and fight him again. In some ways, Garou can be considered the opposite to [Saitama](https://anilist.co/character/73935). Where Saitama wanted to be a hero who fought villains from his childhood, Garou wanted to

97668.name: Kuroi Seishi
97668.desc: Black Sperm is an arrogant yet insecure monster. He is very confident in his abilities, shown in his willingness to take on Monster King [Orochi](https://anilist.co/character/126979/Orochi), but he dislikes when other people "look down on him" for his appearance or personality, and if he senses that someone is doing so, he becomes furious. At the same time, he is willing to work with others in order to take on a stronger opponent, shown by his cooperation with the Monster Association.

97668.name: Choze
97668.desc: Choze was a Martial Artist and user of The Fist Of The Pure Blood Master Race. After eating Monster Cells offered by Gouketsu, Choze became a Mysterious Being and a member of the Monster Association.

97668.name: Orochi
97668.desc: "Monster King" Orochi, also called Lord Orochi, is the leader of the Monster Association.

97668.name: Suiryu
97668.desc: Suiryu is a Martial Artist and user of the Void Fist. He is said to be a top contender in the Super Fight tournament. Suiryu is an easygoing and carefree man usually seen smiling and is a notorious playboy, who would rather spend time with women than training. He is also very eager to fight strong opponents and believes the reason for fighting is to live an easy life without worry. During fights, Suiryu holds back in an effort to make any fight more interesting, only using his legs during his fights and later defeating his opponents with one kick. While fighting he tries to make small talk and after he defeats his opponents, he sarcastically apologizes to them for being too strong. Suiryu is a martial arts prodigy. Despite having spent most of his time goofing off or not taking his lessons seriously, he still ultimately became one of the most revered martial artists in the world, considered a legend for winning four Super Fight tournaments in a row.

97668.name: Zombieman
97668.desc: __Race:__ Human-Mutant __Abilities:__ Regeneration __S-Class:__ Rank 8 __Affiliation:__ Hero Association __Personality:__ Zombieman is stated to be nihilistic, possibly due to the fact that he has "died" several times, therefore he is always calm. In addition, he prefers to work as a lone wolf and dislikes gathering, although he still respects common courtesy. However, he appears to have a sadistic side, since he enjoys killings that create rivers of blood, he is also shown to be a rather smart individual, with detective-like thinking. In comparison to the other S-Class heroes, Zombieman is more thoughtful and respectful. __Abilities__: Zombieman possesses one of the best regeneration capabilities in the series. He is able to regenerate any part of his body no matter how severe the injury is, and he was able to heal his broken arms in an instant. He needs only a few minutes to recover from an extremely mutilated state and regrow his left arm, however this regeneration does not give Zombieman full immortality, as he will die if he is reduced to mincemeat. Zombieman has an incredible threshold for extensive physical activity, displaying one of the most impressive feats of stamina in the series and being able to fight for hours on end while his expedient recovery rate handles the more serious of injuries he suffers.

97668.name: Isamu
97668.desc: __Height:__ 135cm (4'5") __Race:__ Human __Occupation:__ Superhero __Level:__ S-Class; Rank: 5 __Affiliation:__ Heroes Association Child Emperor is a young boy with large eyes. He wears a plain T-shirt with two buttons both of which are buttoned, along with a black school bag on his back. As a genius, the Child Emperor values education, which can be seen when he mentions about going to cram school even after hearing about the Earth being in danger. He easily becomes infuriated when being labeled as childish by others. He is very analytical, observing the situation and formulating plans in a calm and collected manner.

97668.name: Sitch
97668.desc: Sitch (シッチ, Shicchi) is the Minister Officer of Justice for the Hero Association.

97668.name: Charanko
97668.desc: Charanko is a Martial Artist and Bang's last and only disciple before he was expelled during Garou's hero hunt.

97668.name: Kudou Kishi
97668.desc: Drive Knight (駆動騎士, Kudō Kishi) is the S-Class Rank 9 professional hero for the Hero Association.Drive Knight has long black hair and wears a white mask. His mask has a single horizontal slit for the eyes, and a single red shining eye in the center of the slit. The mask has three small vertical slits where his mouth should be. His armor is rather simplistic, being similar to a medieval black knights' armor.

97668.name: Senkou no Flash
97668.desc: __Race__: Human __Age__: 25 __Abilities__: Superhuman Speed and Agility, Master Swordsman, Ninjutsu Master __Occupation__: Superhero __S-Class__: Rank 13 __Personality__: Flashy Flash is a calm and serious man but he also appears to be quite arrogant. Despite his collected composure, Flashy Flash has a tendency to be hasty and reckless. __Abilities__: As an S-Class hero, Flashy Flash is very powerful. In terms of speed, Flashy Flash is arguably the fastest S-Class hero in the association, except for Blast and Saitama. Flashy was shown to be strong enough to combat and kill two Dragon-level threats simultaneously. He can deliver powerful kicks that can stun Dragon-level monsters. He can also easily cut massive pieces of stone and create giant explosions throughout his fighting.

97668.name: Bomb
97668.desc: Bomb is Bang's older brother as well as a dojo master. He and Bang are the two greatest masters of the Martial Arts world.[2] He's one of the few people who are aware of Saitama's true strength and is part of the Saitama Group.

97668.name: Kamikaze
97668.desc: __Race:__ Human __Abilities:__ Superhuman Physical Prowess, Master Swordsmanship __Occupation:__ Superhero, Swordsmanship Teacher __Affiliation:__ Hero Association, Council of Swordmasters __Level:__ S-Class Rank 4 __Personality:__ Atomic Samurai has a rather prideful and jocular personality as seen when he refused to shake Saitama's hand, telling him that he only acknowledges the strong, and telling Saitama that he would greet him properly only if he makes it to the higher ranks of S-Class. Atomic Samurai also enjoys his swordplay and makes a game out of it, often taunting monsters and showing off as he cuts them to pieces, Kamikaze also is straightforward to a humorous degree in many ways, and is incredibly confident and cocky. __Abilities:__ Atomic Samurai is one of the top S-Class heroes. He is regarded as one of the most powerful of them, and the strongest backup hero in the Hero Association, he is also considered Earth's strongest swordsman. Atomic Samurai possesses extreme levels of speed, being able to cut his opponents to pieces in the blink of an eye using his sword.

97668.name: Tanktop Master
97668.original: タンクトップマスター
97668.desc: **Race:** Human **Occupation:** Superhero **Level:** S-Class; Rank: 14 **Affiliation:** The Heroes Association Much like the other heroes with the Tanktop motif, Tanktop Tiger and Tanktop Black Hole, Tanktop Master is a muscular man with a tanktop and short hair. However, unlike the other Tanktop heroes, no known color is associated with Tanktop Master's name. In the first anniversary color spread of the manga, he is shown with blonde hair and a blue tank top. Tanktop Master has a chivalrous nature, which can be seen when he noted that even if Tornado is ranked 2nd, he should not let a "little girl" handle dangerous enemies on her own, despite the fact that Tornado is actually an adult. He is also unafraid to admit defeat, for example, when he was outclassed by Tornado during the encounter of Dark Matter Thieves' aircraft.

97668.name: Chougoukin Kurobikari
97668.desc: **Race:** Human **Occupation:** Superhero Superalloy Blackluster is a large, bald man with round eyes and a defined jawline. He is very muscular, with a thick neck, large and well-defined pectoral and abdominal muscles and large, muscular arms.

97668.name: Kaijin Hime Do-S
97668.desc: Kaijin Hime Do-S is a female dominatrix monster of the Monster Association who uses her whip to turn her opponents into love slaves. She is able to enslave the Blizzard Bunch, but Blizzard herself is able to resist.

97668.name: Nigamushi
97668.desc: Sour Face is a Martial Artist and user of the Sour Face Style Martial Arts.

97668.name: Pineapple
97668.desc: Pineapple is a B-Class professional hero for the Hero Association.

97668.name: Mohican
97668.desc: Mohican is a C-Class professional hero for the Hero Association.

97668.name: Lin Lin
97668.desc: Lin Lin is a Martial Artist and user of the Palm Bell Fist.

97668.name: Narinki
97668.desc: Narinki is a high-raking executive and one of the primary sponsors of the Hero Association. His fund contributes to 7% of the operation at the association.

97668.name: Mukade Chourou
97668.desc: Elder centipede was a Dragon-level Mysterious Being and an executive member of the Monster Association.

97668.name: Nyan
97668.desc: Nyan was once a house cat, who became a monster due to hatred of his owner. He disliked her affection and monsterized, becoming a Dragon-Level monster of the Monster Association as well as becoming a cadre of the MA. He has super strength, durability, speed and other usual powers. However his stand-out ability is his elasticity, which allows him to travel through cracks that are bigger than 3 millimeters.

97668.name: Marshall Gorilla
97668.desc: Marshall Gorilla is a Tiger-Level monster who works for the Monster Association. He uses a knife to slash opponents and even though he was only a Tiger-Level threat, single handedly defeated Heavy Kong, who was an A class hero. However he got knocked out in one punch by Armored Gorilla.

97668.name: Zenko
97668.desc: Zenko is the hot-headed younger sister of Metal Bat. She hates violence and does not stand for it at all. She's also very protective and caring for her big brother.

97668.name: Tanktop Vegetarian
97668.original: タンクトップベジタリアン
97668.desc: Tanktop Vegetarian is the A-Class Rank 9 professional hero of the Hero Association. He is second in command in the Tank Topper Army.

97668.name: Tanktop Hatter
97668.original: タンクトップハッター
97668.desc: Tanktop Hatter is a muscular man with a tank top, he also has medium length hair and sports a bowler hat. Tanktop Hatter started wearing a hat as his lucky charm because an oracle told him so.

97668.name: Nichirin
97668.desc: Head of the Council of Swordsmasters. In the past he was also the sensei of Spring Mustachio. His weapon of choice is a cane katana.

97668.name: Amahare
97668.desc: A member of the Council of Swordsmasters. He carries twin jian swords in battle. He also has a pair of double blades mounted on his footwear. Father of [Yuta](https://anilist.co/character/310063/).

97668.name: Zanbai
97668.desc: A member of the Council of Swordmasters. Father of [Shidou](https://anilist.co/character/310064).

97668.name: Haragiri
97668.desc: A former member of the Council of Swordsmasters who used a Katana, He unfortunately ate a Monster Cell and was killed by Atomic Samurai shortly afterwards.

97668.name: Waganma
97668.desc: Narinki's son.

97668.name: Gyoro Gyoro
97668.desc: A monster and military advisor of the Monster Association. He is [Orochi](https://anilist.co/character/126979)'s closest advisor.

97668.name: Exma
97668.desc: Executive for the Hero Association. She is the deputy chief of the Hero Disciplinary Supervision Division

97668.name: Sekingar
97668.desc: Executive in the Hero Association. He commands the mission to rescue Waganma.

97668.name: Blue Fire
97668.desc: Blue Fire is an A-Class Rank 6 professional hero for the Hero Association.

97668.name: Smile Man
97668.desc: Smile Man is a A-Class Rank 27 professional hero for the Hero Association.

97668.name: Kakusei Gokiburi
97668.desc: Awakened Cockroach is a demon level Mysterious Beings and a member of the Monster Association.

97668.name: Kusari Ga Ma
97668.desc: Chain'n'toad is an A-Class professional hero for the Hero Association.

97668.name: Wild Horn
97668.desc: Wild Horn is a B-Class professional hero of the Hero Association.

97668.name: Zeimeet
97668.desc: Zeimeet is an officer for the Hero Association.

97668.name: Hitotorigusa
97668.desc: Venus Mantrap is a Mysterious Being that attacks Narinki, the sponsor of the Hero Association with Junior Centipede.

97668.name: Tareo
97668.desc: Tareo is a child that Garou occasionally talks to.

97668.name: Shitanobiiru
97668.desc: Tongue Stretcher is a Mysterious Being that assaults beautiful women.

97668.name: Zakos
97668.desc: Zakos is a competitor in the martial arts tournament. He introduces the rules of the tournament to Saitama. He comes out ridiculed from his fight against Saitama. Faced with the association of monsters, he refused to transform himself and was beaten.

97668.name: Rosie
97668.desc: Rosie is a martial artist and user of the Psycho Analysis Martial Arts.

97668.name: Hamukichi
97668.desc: Hamukichi is a Martial Artist and user of the Sunflower Dojo's Gentle Self Defense. He ran a dojo to teach women and children self-defense.

97668.name: Kata Pads
97668.desc: Shoulderpads is a C-Class professional hero for the Hero Association.

97668.name: Phoenix Otoko
97668.desc: Phoenix Man is a Mysterious Being who first appears during the attack in S-City accompanying Elder Centipede as an ally. He is a member of the Monster Association.

97668.name: Suppon
97668.desc: Suppon is a Mysterious Being.

97668.name: Mentai
97668.desc: Mentai is a Martial Artist and user of the Spice Fist.

97668.name: Sairesuraa
97668.desc: Rhino Wrestler is a Mysterious Being belonging to the Monster Association.

97668.name: Mukade Senpai
97668.desc: Senior Centipede is a Mysterious Being.

97668.name: Hedorokurage
97668.desc: A mysterious being.

97668.name: Maiko Plasma
97668.desc: Maiko Plasma is one of the two Monster Association monsters assigned to attack D-City.

97668.name: Mukade Kouhai
97668.desc: Junior Centipede is a Mysterious Being that attacks Narinki and his son Waganma.

97668.name: Yamazaru
97668.desc: Mountain Ape is the B-Class Rank 3 Hero of the Hero Association. He is part of the Blizzard Group, a group of B-Class heroes led by Fubuki, ranking behind only Fubuki herself and Eyelashes.

97668.name: Tejina Man
97668.desc: Magic Trick Man is an A-Class Rank 7 professional hero for the Hero Association.

97668.name: Gouka no Flame
97668.desc: Hellfire Flame is a ninja partner of Gale Wind who both came from the 37th Graduation Class "Golden" of The Village . In the past, they joined the Monster Association to become stronger.

97668.name: Jakumen
97668.desc: Jakumen is a Martial Artist and user of the Giga Pro Wrestling.

97668.name: Juu Sensha Fundoshi
97668.desc: Heavy Tank Loincloth is the A-Class professional hero for the Hero Association.

97668.name: Gouketsu
97668.desc: Gouketsu was a Dragon-level Mysterious Being and an executive member of the Monster Association. He is the primary antagonist of the Super Fight Arc.

97668.name: Gun Gun
97668.desc: Gun Gun is a B-Class professional hero for the Hero Association with a Western-theme outfit and specializes in dual revolvers.

97668.name: Gyoffrey
97668.desc: Gyoffrey is a Mysterious Being and a member of the Monster Association.

97668.name: Gatlin
97668.desc: Gatlin is a Martial Artist and user of the Multi-Hit Style.

97668.name: Megane
97668.desc: Glasses is the B-Class Rank 20 professional hero for the Hero Association. He is part of the Blizzard Group, a group of B-Class heroes led by Fubuki. ~!Glasses is one of the few professional heroes aware of Saitama's true strength, after witnessing him easily destroy a monster that even Tatsumaki could not deal with. This encounter changed Glasses' perspective on heroism and led him to leave the Blizzard Group in order to pursue strength of his own.!~

97668.name: Hayete no Wind
97668.desc: Ninja from the Ninja Village. He is from the 37th graduating class like Hellfire Flame. He and Flame joined the Monster Association sometime in the past to rule the world.

97668.name: Kaohagi
97668.desc: Face Ripper is a Demon-level mysterious being and a member of the Monster Association.

97668.name: G4
97668.desc: A machine god create by the "Organization" who had been assigned to destroy King in order to record battle data and further increase his power. His power is so great that he has been given the disaster level Demon. He was created by Doctor Stench. Not much is known about his battle style other than he prefers to flail punches around, but it is known that he wields a sword, he also can use a built in jet pack to recover from falls.

97668.name: Butterfly DX
97668.desc: Butterfly DX is the A-Class Rank 16 professional hero of the Hero Association.

97668.name: Benpatsu
97668.desc: Benpatsu is a Martial Artist and user of the Harsh Path Style.

97668.name: Ganriki
97668.desc: Eyesight was a Demon-level Mysterious Beings that attacked Y-City during the Monster Raid. Eyesight was a member of the Monster Association.

97668.name: Bakuzan
97668.desc: Bakuzan is a Martial Artist and user of the Dark Hell Assassination. He was said to be a top contender in the martial arts tournament.

1.name: Spike Spiegel
1.original: スパイク・スピーゲル
1.desc: __Height:__ 185 cm Spike Spiegel is a tall and lean 27-year-old bounty hunter born on Mars.

1.name: Faye Valentine
1.original: フェイ・バレンタイン
1.desc: One of the members of the bounty hunting crew in the anime series Cowboy Bebop. Although appearing to be no more than her 23 years alive suggests, Faye is actually upwards of 74-years-old, having been put into cryogenic freeze after a space shuttle accident. During the course of the series (set in 2071), Faye manages to cross paths with [Spike](https://anilist.co/character/1) and [Jet](https://anilist.co/character/3) twice before she finally makes herself at home aboard their ship the second time, much to the consternation and disapproval of the two men, both of whom have their own reservations about women in general. Faye herself is brash, egotistical, and quite lazy, despite taking plenty of time to pamper and care for her own appearance. Faye has also been placed under arrest several times in the series and spends much time in handcuffs on the ship. She, at times, expects the boys to take care of bounties for her, while she sits by idly to reap the benefits and eat all their food, another source of conflict. Seemingly little more than a thorn in her partners’ sides, Faye is actually a well-rounded member of the team. She can handle herself exceptionally well for a woman of her slight appearance, displaying at least once in the series that she packs quite a mean punch. Adept at flying, Faye has stood her ground just as well as Spike has in an aerial dogfight in her ship Red Tail, at times even against Spike in an aerial dogfight. She also excels with guns, and is first seen

1.name: Jet Black
1.desc: Jet, known on his home satellite as the "Black Dog" for his tenacity, is a 36-year-old former cop from Ganymede (a Jovian satellite) and acts as [Spike](https://anilist.co/character/1/Spiegel-Spike)'s foil during the series. Physically, Jet is very tall with a muscular build. He wears a beard with no mustache, and is completely bald save for the back of his head. Spike acts lazy and uninterested, whereas Jet is hard working and a jack-of-all-trades. Jet was once an investigator in the Inter Solar System Police (ISSP) for many years until he lost his arm in an investigation that went awry when his corrupt partner (and friend at the time) betrayed him. His arm was replaced with a cybernetic limb (later revealed to be by choice, as biological replacements were possible, he wanted the fake arm as a reminder of what happened), yet his loss of limb coupled with the general corruption of the police force prompted Jet to quit the ISSP in disgust and become a freelance bounty hunter. Jet also considers himself something of a renaissance man: he cultivates bonsai trees, cooks, enjoys jazz/blues music (he named his ship the Bebop, referring to a type of jazz), especially Charlie Parker, and even has interest in Goethe. As a character, Jet is the quintessential oyaji or "dad" even though he often wishes people would view him as a more brotherly figure (so as not to seem old). Jet is skilled with handguns, typically carrying a pre-2004 Walther P99, as well as the use of the netgun. He is

1.name: Ein
1.desc: Ein is a Pembroke Welsh Corgi brought aboard the Bebop by Spike after a failed attempt to capture a bounty. Ein is a "data dog": while the televised series only briefly hints on the fact that this means Ein's brain was somehow enhanced drastically, the manga shows Ed accessing data stored in Ein's brain via a virtual reality-type interface with which she has a conversation with a human proprietor. It is obvious that Ein is abnormally intelligent, as he is able to answer the telephone, drive a car (just the wheel), use the SSW, play shōgi, and generally do a number of other things that an average canine should not be able to do, but he never talks in a human language during the show. He does, however, speak in Session 18 "Speak Like A Child" after the credits Ein tells Spike "Next Episode: Wild Horses". He is able to "speak" to other species, as demonstrated in Session 17, "Mushroom Samba" (he spoke to a cow with a subtitled bark of "Thanks", to which the cow has a subtitled moo back of "No problem"). It is likely that Ed is the only crew member with any idea of Ein's capabilities, as the other crew members are quick to dismiss Ein, and never seem to acknowledge him as more than a pet. Ein initially takes a shine to Jet, but when Ed joins the crew, he comes around to her as well. Frequently the two trade roles, with Ein expressing very human sentiments via facial expression and Ed regressing to a feral state. He went with Ed after she left the crew, probably because of his att

1.name: Edward Wong Hau Pepelu Tivrusky IV
1.original: エドワード・ウォン・ハウ・ペペル・チブルスキー4世
1.desc: Ed is an eccentric, resourceful, childlike, tomboyish, and intelligent teenager. Ed first encounters the Bebop and its crew when she hacks the ship on its way to Earth. After Ed helps the Bebop crew cash in the Earth hacker bounty, she insists on joining the crew. When [Faye](https://anilist.co/character/2/Valentine-Faye) tries to leave Earth without her, Ed hacks the Bebop and holds it hostage until she is permitted to join. ~!Later in the story when the Bebop is back on Earth, the crew stumbles across an orphanage that Ed used to live in. After seeing some old friends there, Ed is informed that her father has come looking for her recently. Ed decides to make up a bounty on her father to convince [Spike](https://anilist.co/character/1/Spiegel-Spike) to find him. When Spike finds him, Ed decides to leave the Bebop with [Ein](https://anilist.co/character/4/Ein) to live with her father on Earth.!~

1.name: Vicious
1.desc: It's all in the name with Vicious: he is ruthless, bloodthirsty, cunning and ambitious, willing to do anything in order to secure a position of power. He is a member of the Red Dragon Crime Syndicate in Tharsis, and is often referred to or depicted as a venomous snake. His weapon of choice is not a firearm, but a katana which he wields skillfully, even against gun-wielders. ~!After [Spike](https://anilist.co/character/1/Spiegel-Spike)'s supposed death, Vicious also leaves the Red Dragons briefly to fight in the Titan War of 2068 although his precise motivations for enlisting are debated.!~

1.name: Julia
1.desc: Julia is a beautiful and mysterious woman from both Spike and Vicious' pasts. A love triangle among the three caused Spike to leave the syndicate rather than challenge Vicious. Spike had wanted to take her with him when he left the syndicate, but she was blackmailed by Vicious into almost shooting Spike. Vicious found out they were planning to run away together and confronted Julia, telling her that she would have to kill Spike, or both of them would be killed. To protect not only herself but also the man she loved, she ran away, never meeting Spike at the cemetery as both of them had planned. (from Wikipedia)

1.name: Grencia Mars Elijah Guo Eckener
1.desc: Gren was once a soldier for the war on Titan, and appears in the two-part episodes of 'Jupiter Jazz'. On Titan he fought beside Vicious, who he admired and found encouragement in, during the war. After the war, Gren came back hoping to be a jazz musician, but that plan was cut short when he was arrested on the pretense of being a spy. In prison, Gren heard that Vicious testified against him; this and the isolation drove him mad. The prison used prisoners for drug experiments, and he was forced to become a test subject. (from Wikipedia) Height: 6ft 2 inches Age : 29 Weight : 172 pounds

1.name: Punch
1.desc: Co-hosts the TV show Big Shot along with Judy. The show features the duo in western attire and provides information on popular Bounty Heads throughout the star system. Punch speaks with a faked western/Mexican accent, and tends to spout out various old-West sayings.

1.name: Judy
1.desc: Co-hosts the TV show Big Shot along with Punch. The show features the duo in western attire and provides information on popular Bounty Heads throughout the star system. Judy acts like a stereotypical dumb-blonde, and wears a very revealing outfit. After Punch announces that the show has been cancelled, Judy reacts violently and exclaims that "The station will hear from her agent about this!" Later, it is revealed that she is engaged to be married to her agent.

1.name: Appledelhi Siniz Hesap Lütfen
1.original: アップルデリー・シニズ・ヘサップ・リュトフェン
1.desc: __Height:__ 6'0" __Birthplace:__ Earth Afedersiniz Hesap Lutfen (which means "excuse me, check please" in Turkish), is Ed's father. He is a cartographer on Earth (a questionable occupation on a planet which undergoes changes to its landscape daily due to asteroid impacts). In episode 24 of Cowboy Bebop, Ed put a 50.000 000 Oolong bounty on him, which Jet and Spike saw as 50 million Oolongs (it is in fact only 50) and decided to collect his bounty. This allowed Edward to find her father, who asked her if she wanted to come along with her, but left without hearing her answer because a meteor struck.

1.name: Bob
1.desc: "Bob" is an ISSP policeman based on Ganymede to whom Jet frequently goes to for inside information when looking for bounty heads. Throughout the series, and especially in the film, Bob provides (sometimes reluctantly) crucial information. (wikipedia)

1.name: Bull
1.desc: A kind old shaman, apparently of Native American descent. Laughing Bull lives on Mars, and figures prominently in a number of Cowboy Bebop sessions. Spike goes to Laughing Bull for advice in Session 1 while looking for bounty head Asimov; in "The Real Folk Blues, Part 2", Jet goes to him for information on Spike's whereabouts. Laughing Bull also succors Spike after his fight with Vincent in Cowboy Bebop: The Movie. Laughing Bull has a son, to whom he occasionally imparts his wisdom. Laughing Bull refers to Spike as "Swimming Bird", and calls Jet "Running Rock". (wikipedia)

1.name: Wen
1.desc: Wen was a victim of the Astral Gate accident that caused his body to stop aging. He was a gifted harmonica player that became jaded over time and held people hostage, like Zebra, in order to keep his condition a secret.

1.name: Udai Taxim
1.desc: Udai Taxim was an assassin and former member of the European syndicate. He was involved in a plot to kill or injure the former ISSP agent Jet Black, who was one of the few police officers not on the syndicate payroll. As a result Jet lost his arm and was forced to use a prosthetic one. In 2071 Udai was transferred on a transport prison ship to Pluto when an electrically short-circuiting allowed him and his fellow inmates to hijack the ship. Jet and his former partner at the ISSP, Fad, tracked the ship down and boarded it. Fad killed Udai after he revealed that his partner was the shooter that took Jet's arm. He uses the same knives as Navajas, the knife thrower from Desperados (1995).

1.name: Roco Bonnaro
1.desc: Rocco Bonnaro is a member of Piccaro Calvino's gang. He is involved in organized crime in order to support his blind younger sister, Stella Bonnaro and does everything he can to help her regain her sight. Rocco sees Spike effortlessly take out several hijackers on a spaceliner and begs Spike to teach him how to fight. He befriends Spike although he does not tell him about the bounty on his head. Everything goes awry when Rocco gives Spike a package to hold onto, which contains a plant called "Grey Ash" that he stole from Calvino. This plant, worth millions upon millions of woolongs, is capable of curing "Venus Sickness", the disease which has blinded Stella. Rocco has a rendezvous with Spike and they fight against Calvino's gang. ~!He ends up dead protecting the plant.!~

1.name: Rhint Celonias
1.desc: Rhint is the boyfriend of Jet's old girlfriend that killed an loan shark in Jet's hometown. He has an bounty on his head and he ends up caught by Jet and goes to jail.
