1.name: Andy Von de Oniyate
1.original: アンディ・フォン・デ・オニアテ
1.desc: Andy is a hunter who went after a criminal called Teddy Bomber whom he thought to be Spike. He is always with his mare, Onyx. He's a member of YMCA, Young Man's Cowboy Association. After fighting and losing he gives his cowboy title to Spike and turns into a samurai.

1.name: Tongpu
1.desc: Mad "Tongpu" Pierrot is an assassin who targets high ranking syndicate officials. He is highly skilled with all manner of firearms and is armed with an armory equal to a military platoon under his large coat. He takes a child-like enjoyment in killing and causing destruction, always arriving and leaving with a smile, always laughing when "working". ~!Mad Pierrot was a patient in a program to develop a super soldier. The process was, however, too much for him to handle, and his mental state degraded to an almost vegetative state. As he was transported to his permanent holding cell after being removed from the program, he freed himself and killed everybody he encountered in the facility - all while smiling. Since the experiment made him bulletproof, Pierrot has never felt pain, and thus his mind collapsed when Spike made him suffer a minor leg wound. Pierrot died in a theme park, squashed by a giant robotic dog's foot. !~

1.name: Abdul Hakim
1.desc: The notorious serial pet thief who went after Ein. His appearance and fighting style were modeled after the NBA star Kareem Abdul-Jabbar. source: http://cowboybebop.wikia.com/wiki/Abdul_Hakim

1.name: Katerina Solensan
1.desc: Katerina Solensan was a drug smuggler and woman of the criminal Asimov Solensan. She dreamed of leaving the Tijuana asteroid for a better life on Mars, but died in her escape attempt alongside Asimov.

1.name: Shin
1.desc: Shin is Lin's brother who proves to be more loyal to his friends than to the Red Dragon Crime Syndicate. He appeared in Session 25: The Real Folk Blues (Part One), where he assists Spike in a duel against members of the Syndicate. He is the one who informs Spike that Vicious has tried to seize control of the organization and was sentenced to death. Shin also states that everyone close to Spike is being hunted down.

1.name: Teddy Bomber
1.desc: Ted Bower, more commonly known as the "Teddy Bomber," was a terrorist who used explosive teddy bears to destroy what he viewed as symbols of capitalism. He viewed himself as an activist, trying to warn the public about the dangers of unchecked capitalism. He sees the tallest skyscrapers of Mars as symbols of these capitalistic dangers and has resolved to destroy them, starting with the tallest. (Source: Cowboy Bebop Fandom)

1.name: Fad
1.desc: [Jet Black](https://anilist.co/character/3/)'s former ISSP partner.

1.name: Victoria Terpsichore
1.desc: Victoria Terpsichore is a tough-talking, and widowed space trucker, whose deceased husband, Ural Terpsichore, is a man that fellow bounty hunters regard as a "legendary bounty hunter." Always with her cat, Zeros, she appears in the episode "Heavy Metal Queen".

1.name: Whitney Hagas Matsumoto
1.original: ウィットニー・ハガス・マツモト

1.name: Asimov Solensan
1.original: アシモフ・ソーレンサン

1.name: Pet Shop no Owner
1.original: ペットショップのオーナー

1.name: MPU
1.desc: Artificial Intelligence of abandoned satellite appeared in episode 9.

1.name: Videomania
1.desc: A clerk in a video store on Mars who Spike and Jet came to see about a beta cassette in episode 18. He was enthusiastic about antique technology and old 20th century television shows. He also thought that shows were not as good as they used to be.

1.name: Shaft
1.desc: The younger brother of the two Shaft Brothers. Shaft learned that his older brother bought some psychedelic mushrooms from a mushroom dealer called Domino Walker and, after eating one, he laughed himself to death, prompting Shaft to swear revenge on Walker.

1.name: Domino Walker
1.desc: A dealer of hallucinogenic mushrooms and bounty head.

1.name: Alisa
1.desc: Alisa is a business owner on Ganymede. Alisa had a relationship with Jet Black for a long time in the early 2060s when he worked for the ISSP. However, she became increasingly unsatisfied, as she felt she had no independence outside of their relationship. One day, she decided she had to end it and left Jet, leaving for him a watch and a note that simply said, "Farewell." Alisa started to run a bar called La Fin by 2071. However, business became slow as the area was much less trafficked than it used to be. Alisa decided to take out a loan with Law Rentzuo in order to keep the bar open. (Source: Cowboy Bebop Fandom Wikia)

1.name: Sally Yung
1.desc: Sally Yung was one of [Faye Valentine's](https://anilist.co/character/2) high school classmates. Yung was a friend of Faye in the early 21st century. They made some videos which were recorded on beta cassette. Yung would later marry, have children, and eventually grandchildren including [a girl](https://anilist.co/character/214420). (Source: Cowboy Bebop Wikia)

1.name: Hahaoya
1.desc: Alfredo's mother.

1.name: Ani
1.desc: Appears in episode 18.

1.name: Shoujo A
1.desc: Appears in episode 18.

1.name: Shoujo B
1.desc: Appears in episode 18.

1.name: Jobim
1.desc: A friend of [Antonio](https://anilist.co/character/240935/) and [Carlos](https://anilist.co/character/240936/).

1.name: Antonio
1.desc: A friend of [Jobim](https://anilist.co/character/240934/) and [Carlos](https://anilist.co/character/240936/).

1.name: Carlos
1.desc: A friend of [Jobim](https://anilist.co/character/240934/) and [Antonio](https://anilist.co/character/240935/).

1.name: Gordon
1.desc: Gordon was a criminal casino owner who recruited Faye Valentine in an illegal business transaction that made use of her skill as a cheater and a gambler. The plan was to acquire a special chip (with the ability to decrypt and unlock virtually any security code) from one of the patrons in Gordon's casino, but the plan goes awry due to the intervention of Spike Spiegel. Gordon makes an arrangement with Spike and Jet Black to exchange the chip, currently in the hands of Spike and Jet, for 30 million Woolongs. Gordon and his henchmen intend to turn on them, but are quickly outwitted.

1.name: Huey
1.desc: One of the three hijackers who appears in Waltz For Venus, named after Donald Duck's nephews.

1.name: Duhan
1.desc: A crotchety aviation junkie, the man who built Swordfish II. He lives on Earth with his assistant Miles.

1.name: Dewey
1.desc: One of the three hijackers who appears in Waltz For Venus, named after Donald Duck's nephews.

1.name: Jeffly Frank
1.original: ジェフリー・フランク
1.desc: Sgt. Jeffly Frank is an officer on Io (the innermost major moon of Jupiter) who interrogates the bounty huntress Coffee in Session 17: "Mushroom Samba".

1.name: Elroy
1.desc: One of the inmates on board the hijacked prison transport ship. Has a noticeable "x" scar on his cheek. Used to be a police captain on Venus.

1.name: Dig
1.desc: A violent prisoner on board the hijacked prison ship.

1.name: Piccaro Calvino
1.original: ピッカロカルヴィーノ

1.name: Giraffe
1.desc: Giraffe was one of the leaders of the Self-Defense Volunteer Squads. Following a conflict with a group of space raiders, Giraffe was found blindfolded in a silo, presumably betrayed by his partner, Zebra. The Bebop crew later began tracking Giraffe, who was a 3 million Woolong bounty head. Giraffe, meanwhile, is trailing Zebra and Wen, and follows them to a sky rise hotel. After an unseen altercation, Giraffe goes crashing through the window, being caught by Spike Spiegel's Swordfish II.

1.name: Yuuri Kellerman
1.desc: A psychic expert appearing in episode 9. He was a guest on a news channel hosted by Tom Wiles when mysterious land graffiti was reported being from attack satellites. Kellerman was convinced that aliens were responsible, either by manipulating the satellites themselves or by influencing people's minds. Either way, according to him aliens were responsible. His name is a parody on the famous psychic Uri Geller. (Source: Cowboy Bebop Fandom)

1.name: Twinkle Maria Murdock
1.original: トゥインクル・マリア・マードック
1.desc: Maria Murdock was a bounty head wanted as the leader of the terrorist organizations, The Space Warriors. As an eco-terrorist, she attacked Ganymede for harvesting the endangered Ganymede Sea Rat population.

9919.name: Rin Okumura
9919.desc: __Height:__ 173 cm (5'8") The fifteen-year-old protagonist of the story, Rin is the son of [Satan](https://anilist.co/character/48449) born from a human woman and is the inheritor of Satan's powers. His powers were sealed at birth into the demon-slaying blade Kurikara, or Koumaken, by [Mephisto Pheles](https://anilist.co/character/30432), allowing him to live a normal human life for about 15 years.

9919.name: Yukio Okumura
9919.desc: __Height:__ 180 cm (5'11") Yukio is Rin Okumura's twin and younger brother and Shiro Fujimoto's adopted son. He is a Middle First Class Exorcist who has started his training to become an Exorcist at seven by his father suggestion and, since then, gained the titles of Dragoon and Doctor at only fourteen, becoming the youngest Exorcist in the True Cross Order history. Yukio is also the youngest teacher of the True Cross' Exorcist Cram School, at which he teaches pharmacology. Before he was born, he has had a weak body that couldn't bear the power of the blue flames, causing the power of Satan to be fully inherited by Rin. He is seen as an ​example and prodigy by the ones who live together with him and is friends with Shiemi Moriyama, who calls him Yuki-chan.

9919.name: Ryuuji Suguro
9919.desc: __Height:__ 181 cm He is [Rin](https://anilist.co/character/24482/Okumura-Rin)'s rival and the prodigy in the class. He was the child of the Cursed Temple which was destroyed by [Satan](https://anilist.co/character/48449/Satan) 16 years ago. Bon takes everything seriously and is trying his hardest in order to become an Exorcist powerful enough so he could one day defeat Satan ( a goal he claims Rin stole from him) and rebuild his Temple. Currently Bon is trying to acquire the title of Meister in both Aria (a person who recites holy texts to kill certain demons) and Dragoon (a person who fights with heavy artillery). He is currently an Exwire. He is good at memorization, cleaning and Zen meditation. (Sources: Wikipedia and the Blue Exorcist volume two manga extras)

9919.name: Shiemi Moriyama
9919.desc: __Height:__ 165 cm (5'4") Slightly allergic to pollen. Shiemi is [Rin](https://anilist.co/character/24482/Okumura-Rin)'s classmate and friend. Before she met Rin, Shiemi tended her grandmother's garden while her mother ran an Exorcist only shop inside True Cross Academy. During her encounter with Rin and [Yukio](https://anilist.co/character/24734/Okumura-Yukio), they were able to discover that Shiemi was having her life force leached out by a Demon. After Yukio exorcised the demon, Shiemi finally decided to become an Exorcist and started to attend class. It was later revealed that Shiemi had talent in becoming a Tamer, as she was able to summon a Greenman Spirit during class. It is apparently a rare talent to possess amongst the Exorcists, where there are only a few who can control demons and fight.

9919.name: Shirou Fujimoto
9919.desc: __Height:__ 177 cm (5'8") Shirou Fujimoto was [Rin](https://anilist.co/character/24482/Okumura-Rin) and [Yukio](https://anilist.co/character/24734/Okumura-Yukio)'s guardian and was also considered to be one of the most powerful Exorcists in the world. He was thought to be the only man in the world that was able to sustain possession by [Satan](https://anilist.co/character/48449/Satan) himself and thus Satan was constantly after his body. Fujimoto had a familiar sith cat demon, which he called [Kuro](https://anilist.co/character/43187/Kuro), that Rin had inherited. He was a confirmed Aria, Dragoon and tamer and could possibly have been a Knight and a Docter as two of those who have studied under him have become these. He was said to be the strongest exorcist on the planet and was the only one to gain the rank of Paladin, the highest rank of the exorcists.

9919.name: Mephisto Pheles
9919.original: メフィスト・フェレス
9919.desc: __Height:__ 195 cm (6'5") Pheles is the Chairman of True Cross Academy and also an Exorcist. After Fujimoto's death Pheles was ordered to kill Rin, however he accepted Rin's proposal in becoming an Exorcist and entered him into True Cross Academy. It has been heavily implied that he is the son of Satan along with his brother, the Earth King, Amaimon. He possesses the unique and peculiar ability of transforming into a small dog after counting down from three in German. How powerful he is has not been shown but he has mentioned that he is an honorary knight, the position two ranks below Paladin. He has been shown responsible for allowing several higher class demons onto campus. His name is an obvious pun on the word Mephistopheles, which is name for the another infamous devil, similar to his father Satan.

9919.name: Amaimon
9919.desc: __Race:__ Demons __Height:__ 172 cm (5'7") Also known as the "Earth King." Amaimon is supposedly the second son of Satan and another Demon Prince of Gehenna. Unlike his father and elder brother Mephisto, Amaimon had little interest in Rin after their first encounter. He is a human-like demon. He has a spike of hair that is lightly colored compared to the rest of his dark green hair. He wears a jacket that has cross-bones as buttons. He also wears a long-sleeved green shirt under his jacket, which is ripped at the ends. He appears to be calm and collected, but very confident in his powers. However, he shows great anger and annoyance when someone gets in the way of his fun. He is very playful and doesn't take things seriously when it comes to fighting strong combatants which hint that he is very skilled in combat.

9919.name: Shura Kirigakure
9919.desc: Shura Kirigakure is a Knight and an Upper-First Class Exorcist. Having trained under the guidance of Shirou Fujimoto, she officially works as an inspector for the Vatican, but has infiltrated True Cross Academy, first as a student under the name Yamada, and later as a teacher for the Exwires. She is currently the mentor of Rin Okumura.

9919.name: Izumo Kamiki
9919.desc: __Height:__ 164 cm Izumo Kamiki is a top student at the Exorcism Cram School of True Cross Academy who comes from a long line of shrine maidens.

9919.name: Arthur Auguste Angel
9919.original: アーサー・オーギュスト・エンジェル
9919.desc: The newly appointed Paladin. He was ordered by the Grigori to to interrogate Mephisto and captured Rin as evidence. According to Shura he's a saint on the outside and a devil inside. Uses the demon sword Caliburn. Not much is known about Arthur so far, except that he is extremely loyal to the True Cross Order. He follows the orders of his superiors without questioning them at all, even attempting to kill people when they interfere with his work. He believes that anything related to Satan must be destroyed, as it could only cause harm to let them live. Arthur also seems to be slightly sadistic, as he stabbed Rin completely through the leg to immobilize him during Rin's trial, while remarking that the wound would heal soon enough. According to Shura, he is a saint on the outside and a devil on the inside, hinting that he may have a malicious personality.

9919.name: Renzou Shima
9919.desc: __Height:__ 176 cm Renzou is a very carefree character, yet he has a fear of many things, mainly bugs. He's very loyal to Bon, his childhood friend. They grew up together along with Konekomaru in Kyoto. He is also has a big obsession with women. Plans to become a Meister in Aria He is the 5th and youngest son of his family, and tells Konekomaru he's glad of this because it means he has less responsibilities. His older brother Juuzou says he's the pervert out of the brothers. Renzou is a carefree character and was the first person to actually befriend Rin since the revealing of the blue flames, which shows Renzou is the friendly-type. He is also afraid of bugs, yet he is known as the pervert out of the Shima brothers.

9919.name: Konekomaru Miwa
9919.desc: __Height:__ 155 cm Konekomaru Miwa hails from Kyoto along with Ryuji Suguro and Renzo Shima and is an Exwire of the True Cross Order, a student of the Exorcist Cram School, and the surviving head of the Miwa family.

9919.name: Igor Neuhaus
9919.original: イゴール・ネイガウス
9919.desc: __Nationality:__ Polish An Upper First Class Exorcist as well as lecturer in the Academy, who obtained the titles of Tamer, Doctor and Aria. He wears an eyepatch over his left eye, while he has Aria incantations tattooed on both arms. He had a run-in with Satan when he was younger, which robbed him of his family and his left eye's sight, which is why he holds immense hatred for Satan and demons that are related to Satan. Yet ironically, he is extremely loyal to Mephisto, willing to listen to any command of his, which is why he stopped his attacks on Rin prior to the latter becoming an Exorcist.

9919.name: Reiji Shiratori
9919.desc: He's a boy of Rin's age who's about to go to True Cross Academy, but since he's a bit of a delinquent in his free time he finds that he must pay Rin to keep his mouth shut about it since Rin saw him when he was about to kill some birds with a crossbow. ~!He's later possessed by a demon named Astaroth. When he finds out that Rin's also a demon, he tries to get him so he can bring Rin to Gehenna.!~

9919.name: Tatsuma Suguro
9919.desc: Ryuuji Suguro's father. Survivor of the Blue Night, when scores of clergymen were massacred by Satan. Known as the "Priest of the Cursed Temple." (source: BlueExorcist.com)

9919.name: Kuro
9919.desc: A two-tailed cat demon (nekomata). Formerly Fujimoto's familiar but is now Rin's familiar. Kuro is a Cat Sith who was once worshipped as a protective deity for silkworms. He usually takes the appearance of a kitten, but he can reach an enormous size at will.

9919.name: Noriko Paku
9919.desc: Noriko is Izumo's best friend but quits the cram school because she did not understand the classes and she was failing.

9919.name: Nemu Takara
9919.desc: __Height:__ 163 cm Takara is a quiet, mysterious character. He is also somewhat of a ventriloquist. He hasn't talked much, and when he does, it's usually through ventriloquism. He is short, only slightly taller than Konekomaru, and wears the typical True Cross Academy uniform. Has yet to be shown opening his eyes and is always seen with his rabbit puppet. Not much is known about him he also did not contribute to the group effort in the Exwire exam. However, when he speaks with his rabbit puppet, the voice and tone is usually very rude.

9919.name: Youhei
9919.desc: He appeared in the 11th episode of the anime.

9919.name: Nii-chan
9919.desc: Nii-chan is Shiemi Moriyama's Familiar that she summons during the demonstration after Izumo Kamiki summoned two spirit foxes. It is a baby Greenman spirit that takes a liking to Shiemi often sitting on top of her head. Nii-chan aids Shiemi by producing plant from it's body such as aloe and sprouts tree branches as barriers. Nii-chan appears protective of Shiemi as he shields her from the falling debris during a mission in the amusement park with tree barriers. Possibly because it's still an infant, it does not think of Shiemi or the humans as a threat. It speaks by saying the phrase "Nii!"

9919.name: Satan
9919.desc: Satan is the king of Gehenna. It has been said that he is the creator of every demon in existence. There is no body in Assiah powerful enough to host him because of his incredible powers.

9919.name: Yuri Egin
9919.desc: Yuri Egin is the daughter of the Candial and Yukio and Rin's Mother. ~!Yuri let herself voluntarily be possessed by Satan and give birth to his children to prove that humans and demons could live and love together. She died after she gave birth to Rin and Yukio. !~

9919.name: Ernst Frederick Egin
9919.original: エルンスト・フレデリク・エギン
9919.desc: Yuri's father and Rin and Yukio's grandfather. He is an anime-only character.

9919.name: Michelle Neuhaus
9919.original: ミシェル・ネイガウス
9919.desc: The wife of Igor Neuhaus, she was killed on the Blue Night. ~!But was brought back to life by someone. She was also the masked man who hunt Rin and kept the True Cross Academy students hostage. She only appears in the anime.!~ (Source: Blue Exorcist Wikia)

9919.name: Kaoru Tsubaki
9919.desc: The Physical Education (P.E.) teacher in the cram school. Called by some students as "Ol' Sideburns", he is well known to abruptly cancel and/or leave class upon recieving a call from a woman currently identified only as 'Kitten', which is the name he calls her. (Source: BlueExorcist.wikia)

9919.name: Yoshikuni XI
9919.desc: A descendant of the one who forged the Kurikara, Rin's sword. She seems easygoing and friendly. She is especially nice towards Ryuji, and calls him "Ryu-chan". The two are childhood friends, and she even embarrasses him by mentioning that he was in love with her and asked her to marry him. She remains nameless and is an anime only character. (Source: BlueExorcist.wikia)

9919.name: Ukobach
9919.desc: Ukobach is Mephisto's familiar and a stove spirit who prepares Rin and Yukio's meals. He developed a close bond with Rin through their mutual love for cooking. Ukobach is a minotaur like demon. He has been seen to transform into a bigger minotaur and appears from thunder strikes (for a comedic effect of some sort). Ukobach is proud of his cooking skills, but also fiercely protective of his food and his domain, the dorm kitchen. As such he was enraged at Rin for using the dorm kitchen without his permission and for a while he refused to cook for the brothers. He also tried to cook 3 girls for ruining his lunch for Rin and Yukio. He is often silent, but Rin has been able to communicate with the little demon and the two get along well due to their mutual love of cooking.

9919.name: Miketsu
9919.desc: Miketsu, or simply Mike, is a Byakko and Eighth in rank amongst his peers. He is Izumo Kamiki's familiar, having previously served her mother, Tamamo Kamiki.

9919.name: Ukemochi
9919.desc: Ukemochi or simply Uke, is a Byakko and Izumo Kamiki's familiar. He previously served her mother, Tamamo Kamiki.

9919.name: Shiemi no Sobo
9919.desc: Shiemi's Grandmother was a gardener at the Exorcist shop Futsumaya, located on the campus of the True Cross Academy.

99263.name: Naofumi Iwatani
99263.desc: A university student that was summoned to another world as the Shield Hero. Typically unsociable, he's friendly and easy-going to those close to him. ~!After being abandoned by [Malty](https://anilist.co/character/129808) and being treated as a criminal by the people of the world, He unlocked the curse series. The sin he has unlocked is Wrath (against the people of the world).!~

99263.name: Raphtalia
99263.desc: **Race:** Raccoon & Tanuki Raphtalia is a Tanuki-type Demi-Human who was the first real member of the Shield Hero's party after he purchased her as a slave. ~!Raphtalia later obtain one of the eight vassal weapons from another world granting her the title of Vassal Weapon Wielder and Katana Hero. Due to the passive effects of the Vassal Weapons her slave curse seal was removed.!~

99263.name: Filo
99263.desc: **Age:** <1 (mentally), 10 (physically) **Race:** Filolial Filo was originally hatched from a monster egg which Naofumi purchased from the slave trader. Filo grew at an abnormally fast rate and in just a few days grown into a fully grown Filolial later developing into a rare species of Filolial Queen where she was later given the ability to transform into a humanoid form strongly resembling a Angel and the ability to talk due to her association with the Shield Hero and the effects of the Legendary Shield.

99263.name: Malty Melromarc
99263.original: マルティ・メルロマルク
99263.desc: The first princess of Melromarc who betrayed [Naofumi Iwatani](https://anilist.co/character/88817) in the beginning of the series. She is notorious for manipulating other people in order to satisfy her selfish desires.

99263.name: Motoyasu Kitamura
99263.desc: A university student summoned to another world as the Spear Hero. He is an easy-going and handsome womanizer. ~!After being abandoned by [Malty](https://anilist.co/character/129808), He has developed an obsession for Filolials. After Fio tried to cheer him up, he can now only see women as pigs in the literal sense. He raised three Filolials, called Kuu, Marin and Midori because he couldn't get Fios attention. He also unlocks the curse series. His sins are Lust (for Fio) and Envy (for Naofumis position of being loved by Fio).!~

99263.name: Ren Amaki
99263.desc: A high school student who was summoned to another world as the Sword Hero. He's considered a bishounen and tends to stay quiet. ~!After his companions die, he fell into despair, and, thus, he followed [Malty](https://anilist.co/character/129808) when she offered kind words to him. After being abandoned by her, he had a brief stint as a bandit, after which he came under the Female Knight's tutelage. He also unlocked the curse series after being abandoned by Malty. His sins are Greed (For Power) and Gluttony (For Power).!~

99263.name: Melty Q Melromarc
99263.original: メルティ・Q・メルロマルク
99263.desc: The second princess of Melromarc. Melty is in many ways the exact opposite of her sister, [Malty](https://anilist.co/character/129808/Melromarc-Malty). This includes their personality, appearance, magic specialty (water vs fire), and color schemes (blue and white against red and brown).

99263.name: Itsuki Kawasumi
99263.desc: A high school student summoned to another world as the Bow Hero. He is usually calm and well-mannered. However, He has a messiah complex, and is pretty much a justice maniac. He vanquishes evildoers without thinking of the consequences of his actions. However, this is just because he is immature. He doesn't actually have any bad intentions. ~!When the Spirit Turtle revived, Itsuki and the party was forced to challenge it, but the party ran away, leaving him as a sacrifice to the Turtle.!~

99263.name: Beloukas
99263.desc: The slave dealer that sells Naofumi Iwatani many slaves. He also conducts slave and monster seal rituals. Despite his appearance and his trade, he is an honest salesman. Upon Naofumi’s request, he searches for and collects slaves who were former villagers of Raphtalia’s village

99263.name: Aultcray Melromarc XXXII
99263.original: オルトクレイ＝メルロマルク３２世
99263.desc: The king of Melromarc. He shows obvious favoritism towards his daughter [Malty](https://anilist.co/character/129808) and animosity towards the Shield Hero [Naofumi Iwatani](https://anilist.co/character/88817). ~! It was revealed that Aultcray is the Wand Hero who led his country in a war against demi-humans and beastmen. Through that experience, he holds hatred towards non-human species and promotes the idea of human supremacy in Melromarc. He shows biased hatred towards Naofumi because the Shield Hero is revered as the protector of demi-humans and beastmen. When Queen Mirelia Q Melromarc comes back to Melromarc after resolving diplomatic issues, she strips Aultcray of his authorities due to his ineptitude to properly lead the people and officially changed his name to Trash as punishment for his abuse of power.!~ ~!The king's real name was Luge Lances Forbrey and used the alias Luge Lancarose to hide the fact that he was of royal blood when he battled in the front lines during the war. The name Aultcray Melromarc XXXII was adopted when he married Mirelia and became king. He was the third legitimate heir to the throne of Forbrey, but lost that privilege when the Hakuko race killed his parents and loved ones. Due to that fact that Forbrey did nothing to retaliate against the Hakuko residing in Siltvelt due to political reasons, Luge began to despise both countries and moved to the human supremacy-promoting country of Melromarc. He later challenged and defeated the Hakuko king.!

99263.name: Erhard
99263.desc: Erhard is a blacksmith and a weapon shop owner in the castle town of Melromarc. His shop is the only shop in Melromarc to sell shields while others don't for religious reasons.

99263.name: Yakkyoku no Owner
99263.desc: The old man that runs the medicinal shop has a relatives that live in Riyuuto Village. Because Naofumi saved many people during the second wave, the old man happily assist Naofumi whenever he's needed.

99263.name: Biscas  T. Balmus
99263.original: ビスカス . T . バルマス
99263.desc: The highest priest of the Three Heroes Cult. ~!He used his deep connections in the nation to do away with any opposing authority in the kingdom. He was so narrow-minded that he calls all of his actions "the will of God". He also claims that his followers who died in the fight against the Shield Hero will go to Heaven as a holy reward. When wielding the replica of the Legendary Weapons, Biscas shows a visible "God complex," as he proclaimed himself God while labeling evil anyone who opposed him. he masterminded many events and tried to kill all of the heroes. He killed the queen's right-hand man who happens to be Eclair's father so that the authority rest with King Aultcray Melromarc XXXII, who was at the time was very gullible and easy to manipulate.!~

99263.name: Mirellia Q Melromarc
99263.desc: The queen of Melromarc. She holds the true power of the crown and is generally a just ruler. She is known for her diplomacy and negotiation skills.

99263.name: Yousaiya
99263.desc: She is the owner of the tailor store. Her name was never mentioned so she is referred to as the Tailor. She made her debut in both the light novel and anime​ but never made her debut in the manga. She was only mentioned by the Magic Shop Owner as being a friend of hers.

99263.name: Mahouya
99263.desc: She is an older woman who runs a magic book store at Castle Town of Melromarc. She was mentioned to be a witch by herself. She gave magic books free of cost for Naofumi and his party to learn magic.

99263.name: Elrasla  Grilaroc
99263.desc: Elrasla Grilaroc more commonly known as Granny is an old woman who states that her level is the same as her age. She hit the level cap a long time ago. The sole successor of the Mushin Tensou style of martial arts.

99263.name: Fitoria
99263.desc: Fitoria is the queen of the Filolials, who rules over them all. She has silver hair with thin streaks of light blue, cut in a short bob with three tufts of hair standing up vertically from the crown of her head, like cowlicks. Her eyes are red and her face is small and well composed. She's dressed in a red and white gothic lolita-style dress. She's about the same height as Filo.

99263.name: Keel
99263.desc: __Race:__ Wanui ~!Gender: Female!~ Keel was born and raised in the same village as Raphtalia. Naofumi purchased them as a slave in order to rebuild the village destroyed by the first wave.

99263.name: L'arc  Berg
99263.desc: L'arc has spiked red hair and is muscular. He has a tattoo of a scythe on his upper arm and appears to be handsome He is carefree and laid back, taking a very relaxed path to every problem. He is, according to Naofumi, an older-brother kind of character. Even though he has become a king, he likes his freedom. Just like Glass, he has a warrior spirit which is shown during his fight with Naofumi. He is a good judge of character just by looking at someone. He did have a childish side which shown by the way, when he acted too excited for the ship ride to Cal Mira island. He had the habit of calling the younger persons "Kiddo". He has high morals and doesn't want to hurt any others who are irrelevant to his mission.

99263.name: Rishia Ivyred
99263.original: リーシア＝アイヴィレッド
99263.desc: __Race__: Human Rishia is the daughter of the House of Ivyred, a noble family. Due to an unfortunate string of events, the family had grown poor and she was forcefully taken as ransom by a neighboring family in exchange for gold. She was rescued by The Bow Hero, whom she would later devote her life to. ~!To show her gratitude and support for her savior, Rishia would go on to join Itsuki's party. She would then be treated as an errand girl, carrying food and supplies for the Bow Hero's party, leaving her talent in magic unused and untapped.!~

99263.name: Glass
99263.desc: A mysterious girl who seems to be an enemy. ~!She was able to defeat the Sword, Lance and Bow Heroes single-handedly, but lost to Naofumi. She was mistaken as a calamity when she first appeared.!~

99263.name: Therese Alexandrite
99263.original: テリス・アレキサンドライト
99263.desc: A companion of Lar'c Berg. She has a white skin which looked like ivory. Her hair was bluish green which sparkled in sunlight.Her hair was pulled back into a braid of three thick strands and draped. She wears bangles with massive gem on both hands. As a jewel she's able to obtain energy from the different gems that she owns and use it to cast powerful spells.

99263.name: Hickwaal
99263.desc: He is the accessory Merchant protected by the shield hero from Bandits and was also the founder and first president of the Hickwaal Company.

99263.name: Kishi Danchou
99263.desc: The Leader of Melromarc Knight is the highest rank of Knights in Melromarc. His actual name was never revealed in the series.

99263.name: Roudy
99263.desc: He is the bandit who has the most frequent unfortunate encounter with Naofumi. Later, he founded the Chivalrous Thief Guild with the guidance of Naofumi.

99263.name: Ake
99263.desc: He is one of the Juvenile Knights of Melromarc.. He accompanied the Knight squads to Lute Village in times of the wave, to assists the heroes.

99263.name: Van Reichnott
99263.original: ヴァン・ライヒョット
99263.desc: He is a member of a wealthy family who happened to have close relations with Lord Seaetto. He is respected by the Demi-humans of his region. His name was not mentioned and Naofumi nicknames him as "Nice Guy."

99263.name: Rifana
99263.desc: She is the childhood friend of both Keel and Raphtalia. She was resided in the demi-human protected village in Melromarc.

99263.name: Idol Rabier
99263.desc: He is a Melromarc nobleman and Raphtalia's previous abusive owner.

99263.name: Mald
99263.desc: The leader of the revolutionary army against the Shield Hero. ~!He was in Itsuki's party. However, when the Spirit Turtle was revived, he and the rest of the party abandoned Itsuki and ran away.!~

99263.name: Mamoru Shirono
99263.desc: Mamoru Shirono is a Shield Hero of Raphtalia's World in the ancient past. He was one of two Legendary Heroes summoned to defend against the waves.

101280.name: Rimuru Tempest
101280.desc: __Species:__ Human (past life) → Slime __Kind:__ Reincarnated, Otherworlder Rimuru Tempest, formerly known as Satoru Mikami, is the main protagonist of Tensei Shitara Slime Datta Ken. They are the founder and King of the monster country Tempest, situated in the Great Jura Forest, and the partner and sworn friend of Storm Dragon, [Veldora Tempest](https://anilist.co/character/128034/Veldora-Tempest).

101280.name: Shion
101280.desc: "War Lord" Shion is Rimuru’s first servant to be in charge of his care as his personal secretary. She is also the leader of the Yomigaeri and also one of Rimuru's strongest fighters and is coveted by many of the Demon Lords who have met her.

101280.name: Veldora Tempest
101280.original: ヴェルドラ＝テンペスト
101280.desc: __Height:__ 210 cm (human form), 100 m (dragon form) __Species:__ True Dragon __Blessing / Divine Protection:__ Storm Dragon's Grace, Demon Lord's Ally __Disaster Rank:__ Catastrophe Veldora Tempest is the youngest of the four strongest dragons (True Dragons). He is connected with [Rimuru](https://anilist.co/character/123962) by an agreement and was known to rampage here and there. He was the one to name Rimuru and Rimuru gave him his last name, since they share the same last name, Rimuru could technically be classified as Veldora's adoptive brother.

101280.name: Ranga
101280.desc: "Star Lord" Ranga is a Wind Spirit Wolf and a loyal follower of [Rimuru](https://anilist.co/character/123962/Tempest-Rimuru). The leader of the Star Wolf Clan, and the son of the previous boss of the Direwolves. He is also one of Rimuru's Twelve Patrons who has been given the title of a "Lord".

101280.name: Milim Nava
101280.desc: __Kind:__ Inhabitant "Destroyer" Milim Nava is one of the oldest and strongest Demon Lords. She is a Dragonoid. Her nickname, Destroyer, is not just for show. She is a demon lord one should never fight against.

101280.name: Shizu
101280.desc: Shizu was the companion of the previous Hero and a Japanese Summoned One. She is also known as the "Explosive Monarch", an A ranked Adventurer of the Freedom Association's Headquarters, and the formal homeroom teacher of the Freedom Academy's S Class students. She was also the mentor of several excellent pupils whom became important figures of society.

101280.name: Benimaru
101280.desc: Benimaru is one of the third group of subordinate Monsters to be named by Rimuru Tempest. Originally an Ogre, he was uncertain of his servitude and intended for it to be temporary, but after being named, he evolved into a Kijin, immediately becoming Rimuru's most powerful subordinate for a time, and decided to serve him permanently. He lives in the Capital city of the Jura Tempest Federation: Rimuru City. Soon after, and became Commander-in-Chief, giving him direct command over Tempest's military forces. Upon Rimuru's ascension to a True Demon Lord, Benimaru evolved into a Fair Oni and reached the strength of a Disaster-Class Monster.

101280.name: Souei
101280.desc: __Height__: 180 cm (Kijin), 190 cm (Ogre) Souei is an Ogre that was among the third group of subordinates to be named by Rimuru Tempest. He is Rimuru's faithful shadow and the leader of the Shadow Squad of the Jura Tempest Federation.

101280.name: Shuna
101280.desc: Shuna is one of the third group of subordinate Monsters to be named by [Rimuru](https://anilist.co/character/123962), evolving her from an Ogre to a Kijin. She was originally the princess of the Ogre tribe and even though she had the talent for using Magic, she was a sheltered girl, but quickly got along with the Goblinas Shuna is the daughter of the late ogre chieftain and she is also [Benimaru](https://anilist.co/character/128038)'s younger sister, which is why she's nicknamed "Oni Princess" by Rimuru. Very skilled and knowledgeable in domestic matters, she essentially becomes Rimuru's chief economic advisor together with [Rigurd](https://anilist.co/character/129348).

101280.name: Daikenja
101280.desc: Unique Skill Great Sage is one of the first two Unique Skills (the other being Predator) that [Rimuru Tempest](https://anilist.co/character/123962/Rimuru-Tempest) had upon being born into his new world. It had evolved from Extra Skill Sage during his death, as he thought since he was approaching his forties as a virgin, he must be something much greater than a mere wizard. ~!During Rimuru's evolution into Demon Lord this Unique Skill evolved into the Ultimate Skill: Wisdom King Raphael.!~ ~!Rimuru gave her a name and she evolved into a manas with the name Ciel!~

101280.name: Rigurd
101280.desc: Formerly the chief of the goblin village Rimuru comes across. He's now the acting prime minister of the Jura Tempest Federation. He evolved into a hobgoblin when Rimuru named him.

101280.name: Rigur
101280.desc: Rigur was named after his late elder brother. Rigur, after making Gobuta the garrison squad leader, has been supporting his father Rigurdo.

101280.name: Gobta
101280.desc: Gobta is a hobgoblin and is one of Rimuru Tempest's followers. Though he seems to be air-headed he tends to be a hard-worker and dependable when the time calls for it.

101280.name: Myrd
101280.desc: Myrd is younger brother of Garm and Dord. Though he was a dwarf of few words, he was an expert at what he does. Having knowledge in construction, and well-versed in the arts, he is a one of a kind genius. Myrd was appointed as the captain of the construction team.

101280.name: Kaijin
101280.desc: Kaijin was a blacksmith of the Dwarven Kingdom, and the brother of Kaidou. After he was exiled from his own country, he became Rimuru Tempest's subordinate, and helped build the Monster City "Tempest", he acted as a builder, blacksmith, and craftsmen. He also was the former commander of the Dwargon Engineering Corps.

101280.name: Gido
101280.desc: Gido is a member of Cabal's Party who serves as the 'thief' role. ~!However, he is actually serving as one of the bodyguards of Lady Elyune secretly while under the guise of an adventurer.!~ (Source: Tensei Shitara Slime Datta Ken Wikia)

101280.name: Dord
101280.desc: Dord, the middle brother of Garm and Mild. He is known for his first-­rate craftsmanship. Dord focuses more on dyes and high class attire.

101280.name: Kaval
101280.desc: Kaval is the leader of his adventure's party, where he serves as the 'fighter' role. ~!Alongside Gido, he is also tasked as the secret bodyguard of Lady Elyune under the guise of an adventurer.!~ (Source: Tensei Shitara Slime Datta Ken Wikia)

101280.name: Ellen
101280.desc: Eren is an adventurer and a member of Kaval's Party. ~!She is actually the daughter of the Duke of Sorcerer's Dynasty Sarion Elalude, who ran off to be an adventurer due to her selfishness and free-spirited personality.!~ (Source: Tensei Shitara Slime Datta Ken Wikia)

101280.name: Garm
101280.desc: Garm, the elder brother of Doldo and Mild. He is a skilled blacksmith. Garm is in charge of everyday clothing and underwear. (Source: Tensei Shitara Slime Datta Ken Wikia)

101280.name: Diablo
101280.desc: Diablo is the Black Primordial and a loyal servant of [Rimuru Tempest](https://anilist.co/character/123962/Tempest-Rimuru). Before he met Rimuru, he went by the nicknames Black or Noir, the latter which he received from his fellow Primordial kin. After receiving the name Diablo from Rimuru, he evolved to a Demon Peer.

101280.name: Ramiris
101280.desc: Ramiris is a fairy that resides inside of Tempest's Underground Labyrinth. She is also one of the Eight-Star Demon Lords.

101280.name: Frey
101280.desc: "Sky Queen" Frey is an ex-Demon Lord and currently a subordinate of [Demon Lord Milim Nava](https://anilist.co/character/128036/Nava-Milim). She often scolds Milim for playing around when she is supposed to be working.

101280.name: Gabiru
101280.desc: The captain of the Hiryuu of Tempest, and the former lizardmen raid leader. He suffers from a superiority complex. The root of Gabil's pride and confidence​ is the thought that he is the chosen one.

101280.name: Hakurou
101280.desc: Hakurou is a Fair Oni and is a loyal follower of Rimuru Tempest. He was one of the survivors of the Orc attack. He was also the teacher of the Dwarven King.

101280.name: Karion
101280.desc: ~!Karion is one of the ten demon lords that existed before Rimuru became a demon lord. During the Walpurgis Banquet where Rimuru killed Clayman. Karion became a subordinate of Milim.!~

101280.name: Leon Cromwell
101280.original: レオン・クロムウェル
101280.desc: Leon Cromwell is a former hero and a current Demon Lord of the Eight-pointed Star Octagram. He is the ruler of El Dorado, an island nation located south-west of the world.

101280.name: Kurobee
101280.desc: Kurobee is a Fair Oni and a loyal follower of Rimuru Tempest. Kurobee was originally one of the Oni that survived the Orc attack. He evolved after being named by Rimuru.

101280.name: Clayman
101280.desc: Demon Lord Clayman, is one of the ten demon lords that ~!existed before Rimuru became a demon lord. He turned into Kazaream's underling when Kazaream turned him into a demon lord.!~

101280.name: Vesta
101280.desc: Bester (ベスター Besutā) is a former minister of Dwargon and is currently the lead researcher of Tempest. ~!After joining Tempest he has become more reliable. He got rid of that sharp personality and mellowed out.!~

101280.name: Gazel Dwargo
101280.desc: Species: Dwarf Blessing / Divine Protection: Divine Protector of Ancestor Title: King of Armament Nation Dwargon. The king of Dwargon, Gazel Dwargo, the third generation king of Dwargon, but possesses a similar aura to that of his grandfather in his younger days. He is renowned as a great hero and celebrated as a wise king for his impartial rule.

101280.name: Treyni
101280.desc: Treyni is a dryad that resides in the Jura Forest.

101280.name: Souka
101280.desc: Gabil's younger sister, and the daughter of Abil. After the Orc Lord incident, she swears her allegeiance to Rimuru. She attends to Souei as a spy.

101280.name: Abil
101280.desc: Relatives: Gabil (Son) Souka (Daughter) Occupations: Lizardmen Chief He has a bold personality, but with enough humility. He is a serious person, but he also has many good qualities about him and is a good leader.

101280.name: Alice Rondo
101280.desc: One of the children who were incompletely summoned. At 9 years old, Alice is the youngest of the group, and she's also a bit of a tomboy.

101280.name: Garde-Myourmiles
101280.original: ガルド・ミョルマイル
101280.desc: An influential merchant from the kingdom of Burumund. Myorumairu is both the chairman of the Burumund shopping district and also a loan shark.

101280.name: Kenya Misaki
101280.desc: A member of a group of children who were incompletely summoned. He is the leader of the pack and has a lively disposition.

101280.name: Ryouta Sekiguchi
101280.desc: One of the children who were incompletely summoned. Ryota has a shy personality, but he generally gets along well with Kenya.

101280.name: Yuuki Kagurazaka
101280.desc: A former student of Shizu who originally came from Japan and ~!one of the main antagonists of the series. !~ Yuuki serves as the Guild Master of the Adventurers' Guild in the kingdom of Ingracia, and he loves manga. ~!Although Yuuki first comes as a friendly person he is actually a master in manipulating others without hesitation to achieve his goal of a just world that treats everyone fairly. Even though Rimuru and Yuuki get along at first he later addresses Rimuru as a very serious threat to his plans. !~

101280.name: Gale Gibson
101280.desc: One of the children who were incompletely summoned. At 11 years old, he is the eldest of the group.

101280.name: Chloe Aubert
101280.desc: One of the children who were incompletely summoned. Chloe is a quiet child who loves books.

101280.name: Gelmud
101280.desc: A majin that served Demon Lord Clayman of the Ten Great Demon Lords. He wanted to make Orc Lord the new Demon Lord and manipulate him but instead was devoured by it.

101280.name: Geld
101280.desc: He is one of the fourth group of subordinates to be named by Rimuru Tempest. As the right-hand man of the deceased Orc Lord, he was given the same name as him, as a memento and token of appreciation, similar to how Rigur was named after his older brother. As an Orc King, he is the leader of the Yellow Corps, that acts as both the last line of defense for Tempest as well as the main team of the country's Department of Construction and Manufacturing. Later on, he was given the Title of a "Lord" as one of Rimuru's Twelve Patrons.

101280.name: Tear
101280.desc: Member of the Moderate Jesters alongside Laplace and Footman, and as that loyal subordinate of Demon Lord Kazaream.

101280.name: Miho Sawatari
101280.desc: She is Tamura's fiancee.

101280.name: Kaidou
101280.desc: He is the captain of the guards of Dwargon, and Kaijin's younger brother.

101280.name: Fuze
101280.desc: He is the Brumund Kingdom's Freedom Association, Guild Master.

101280.name: Velyard
101280.desc: Baron Velyard is one of Blumund’s ministers. He is a landless baron.

101280.name: Youm Farmenas
101280.original: ヨウム・ファルメナス
101280.desc: The Hero-King Farmenas of the Farmenas Kingdom. Formerly the Farmas Kingdom, Count Nidole Maigam’s Territory's, Frontier Garrison Captain Youm.

101280.name: Ifrit
101280.desc: Ifrit is a high-ranking spirit; the ruler of flame which was sealed within Shizue Izawa by Demon Lord Leon Cromwell. He used to live in Dwelling of the Spirit before he was stolen by the "Blonde Demon" Leon Cromwell. After that, he was sealed within Shizue Izawa. As a result of this, it gave Shizue an extended lifespan.

101280.name: Haruna
101280.desc: She is a resident of the goblin village.

101280.name: Tamura
101280.desc: He is a junior at the same company where Satoru Mikami worked at. The two also went to the same university. He is Miho Sawatari's fiancé.

101280.name: Laplace
101280.desc: He is the vice-president of the Moderate Jesters and as that a loyal subordinate of Demon Lord Kazaream.

101280.name: Phobio
101280.desc: __Species:__ Leopard Lycanthrope He is one of the "Beastketeers" of the Demon Lord Karion. He is proclaimed to be the strongest warrior of the 3 "Beastketeers".

101280.name: Footman
101280.desc: Footman is a Majin who is part of the Moderate Harlequin Alliance

101280.name: Gobzo
101280.desc: A Goblin in Tempest thats friends with Gobuta

101280.name: Ririna
101280.desc: Ririna is one of the 400 Goblins that migrated to Rimuru's Goblin Village while he was away in Dwargon. After being named by Rimuru, she evolved to a Goblina. She is entrusted by him to manage Tempest's production affair as its supervisor.

101280.name: Touka
101280.desc: Souka's subordinate. She forms part of the Shadow Squad, where she mostly gathers information. She used to live in the Lizardmen marshes but moved to Tempest by Abiru's order.

101280.name: Hokusou
101280.desc: Souka's subordinate. He forms part of the Shadow Squad, where he mostly gathers information. He used to live in the Lizardmen marshes but moved to Tempest by Abiru's order.

101280.name: Nansou
101280.desc: Souka's subordinate. He forms part of the Shadow Squad, where he mostly gathers information. He used to live in the Lizardmen marshes but moved to Tempest by Abiru's order.

101280.name: Saika
101280.desc: Souka's subordinate. She forms part of the Shadow Squad, where she mostly gathers information. She used to live in the Lizardmen marshes but moved to Tempest by Abiru's order.

101280.name: Orthos
101280.desc: Orthos was the true king of the Kingdom of Filtwood. He was a Demon who was thought to be sealed away by a champion named Orthos, but that story was either entirely fabricated, or the demon managed to kill, and later impersonate the champion.

101280.name: Yashichi
101280.desc: __Race:__ Dragonewt One of [Gabiru](https://anilist.co/character/131041)'s subordinates and friends. Yashichi fervently supports Gabiru through victory and defeat.

101280.name: Kakushin
101280.desc: __Race:__ Dragonewt One of [Gabiru](https://anilist.co/character/131041)'s subordinates and friends. Yashichi fervently supports Gabiru through victory and defeat.

101280.name: Sukerou
101280.desc: __Race:__ Dragonewt One of [Gabiru](https://anilist.co/character/131041)'s subordinates and friends. Yashichi fervently supports Gabiru through victory and defeat.

101280.name: Trya
101280.desc: Trya is a Dryad that resides in the Jura Forest. She is the sister of Treyni.

98314.name: Yumeko Jabami
98314.desc: __Height:__ 166 cm (5'5") A girl who transfers into Hyakkaou Private Academy. She might look like an attractive young lady, but she is actually a "Kakegurui," someone who finds pleasure in taking risks. Attractive, smooth as silk, and silver-tongued, Yumeko is a natural-born gambler. Gathering the attention of her peers and the entire student council, there's no denying she enjoys the attention she receives. Despite all odds in a gambling match, she somehow manages to turn the tables in the most daring ways, often times using her perceptiveness to decipher her opponent's tricks.

98314.name: Mary Saotome
98314.desc: __Height:__ 162 cm (5'4") Mary Saotome is a deuteragonist of _Kakegurui_, and also the main protagonist of the spin-off series _Kakegurui Twin_. She is a student at Hyakkaou Private Academy, and a classmate of [Yumeko Jabami](https://anilist.co/character/121889) and [Ryota Suzui](https://anilist.co/character/122688) who is the first character in the entire series that challenges Yumeko and loses against her. At first, Mary is shown to be incredibly sadistic and twisted, such as how she treats her classmate Ryota Suzui after he turned into a "housepet", due to his low social status within the academy, and is shown cruelly taunting her fellow opponents during their gambling matches. She's also shown to be extremely egotistical both in and out of matches, often being confident in her victory. Mary also possesses a habit of mocking her opponents and laughing at them, especially when match seems to be her win. After losing to Yumeko Jabami and experiencing the life of being a housepet, Mary became desperate to regain her status within the academy, having no other goal in her mind. Soon after being humiliated, Mary eventually loses her pride, having a mental breakdown during a match against [Yuriko](https://anilist.co/character/122694/Nishinotouin-Yuriko) and falling into the state of grief and shame. After regaining her status, she seems to be no longer this arrogant and cruel, sometimes being only nettled by Ryota's cowardice or Yumeko's reckless behavior, but still deeply caring

98314.name: Ryouta Suzui
98314.desc: __Height:__ 173 cm (5'8") Yumeko’s classmate. Cowardly and poor, he quickly ends up being treated as Meari’s livestock, and is called ‘Pochi’ (a common name for a dog). However, he is saved from this predicament by Yumeko.

98314.name: Sayaka Igarashi
98314.desc: Secretary of the Student Council and the right hand of Student council president. She is determined to become Kirari's 'Number 1,' and thinks of Yumeko as a plague. Sayaka is intelligent, serious and deeply cares about school and Student Council. She's endlessly loyal to the Student Council President, Kirari Momobami and will do anything for her. It seems that she has a crush on Kirari, as she expressed concern and sadness when she drove off without telling her where she went and what she was doing. While she seems to be reserved and calm, her subduing of a violent student, Jun Kiwatari and telling him what he now owes in the debt recollection game shows that she's every bit as terrifying as the rest of the Student Council.

98314.name: Midari Ikishima
98314.desc: A third-year student and head of the Student Council Beautification Committee. She gets pleasure from taking risks such as starting games of Russian roulette by herself. ~! As she plays a dangerous game with Yumeko while putting both of their lives on the line, she realizes taking risks is such an amazing feeling thanks to Yumeko and her past life. She lost her left eye by stabbing herself with a pen in front of the Student Council, in order to pleasure the President.!~

98314.name: Kaede Manyuda
98314.desc: A second-year student and student council treasurer. He has a strong desire for power and is very ambitious, to the point where he is plotting to overthrow his seniors, even in the student council, as soon as he has a chance. He is the manipulative Treasurer of the Student Council, having his own goal to take down Kirari Momobami. ~!Became a Housepet with 10 billion Yen debt after losing to Jabami. As a result from his gamble with Yumeko Jabami, his hair turned white. This is an alleged condition called Marie Antoinette syndrome that causes the hair to turn white after facing an abundance of emotional stress.!~

98314.name: Kirari Momobami
98314.desc: Kirari Momobami is the 105th student council president at Hyakkaou Private Academy, and as well as the one responsible for the current hierarchy on the academy.

98314.name: Yuriko Nishinotouin
98314.desc: A third-year student, member of the student council, and president of the Tradition Culture Research Society. She ends up challenging [Yumeko](https://anilist.co/character/121889/Jabami-Yumeko) to an original gambling match.

98314.name: Itsuki Sumeragi
98314.desc: She's a first-year student belonging to the "flower" class at Hyakkaou Private Academy and a member of the Student Council. Her father is the president of a prominent toy company in Japan. Her hobby is collecting other people’s nails. ~!Since [Kaede](https://anilist.co/character/122692/Manyuda-Kaede) betted his lifeplan [Yumeko](https://anilist.co/character/121889/Jabami-Yumeko) received it, but gave it to Itsuki. Its apparent, that she actually has feelings for him. She watches over him, as he lays in bed, still under shock. She goes on to collect quite a few votes during the election. And she is also present during Yumemis battle against Kawaru!~

98314.name: Runa Yomozuki
98314.desc: She is a member of the Student Council and also a leader of the Election Committee, serving as a referee during election gambling matches. ~!Runa is a sadistic and two-faced person, who seems to be very cute and nice at first but in reality she enjoys watching other people fail and loves to mock them.!~

98314.name: Ririka Momobami
98314.desc: She is the vice president of the student council and is seen almost entirely throughout the whole time wearing a mask that covers her whole face. Ririka is a very quiet and stoic person. She often acts as an observer.

98314.name: Yumemi Yumemite
98314.desc: A second-year student in charge of PR for the student council. She also works as an idol, but there’s a huge gap between her facade and her true face. Yumemi has a two-faced personality. On the outside, she is a sweet and lovely girl who loves her fans above all. However, in reality, she's an arrogant, calculated and sadistic person, who will do everything to be on top. She's also disgusted by her fans as she often calls them 'pigs' but at the same time, she doesn't want to turn in meetings with them, due to her dream of becoming a famous actress in Hollywood and winning an Academy Award. Yumemi never enjoys the dancing routines the fan club comes up with and has shown to be disgusted by their 'sweaty gross palms'. She is motivated by stating on top and achieving an academy reward which is why she involves herself with the fans as much as she can. Even though she is mostly focused on herself, she manages to remember the birthday dates of all her fans in her fan club which she tries using to her advantage when she gets herself caught in a gamble with [Yumeko Jabami](https://anilist.co/character/121889/Jabami-Yumeko). ~!She soon develops a more humble personality later on in Season 2 during her encounter with [Kawaru Natari](https://anilist.co/character/136599/Warakubami-Sumika), an A-List Japanese Hollywood actress whose real identity is Sumika Warakubami.!~

98314.name: Nanami Tsubomi
98314.desc: She's a house pet​, who gambled against Yumeko Jabami, Mary Saotome, and Jun Kiwatari in order to lower her debt.

98314.name: Jun Kiwatari
98314.desc: Jun is portrayed as a typical bully. He is aggressive, arrogant and sadistic person, who loves dominating others. ~!Rank: Housepet Debt: 310 Million Yen He made use of Tsubomi Nanami's housepet status and cut her long hair, probably only because she really valued them and threatened Yumeko Jabami when she didn't strip in front of him and his friends. He battle's Nanami, Yumeko and Mary. In that battle, he was cheating with Nanami. That's the reason why Yumeko and Mary were allies. In the end, he lost and end up being a Housepet.!~

98314.name: Saori
98314.desc: She is the manager of the Student Council's Head of Public Relations, Yumemi Yumemite. She is the daughter of a big time producer

98314.name: Kumagusu
98314.desc: She cares a lot about Yuriko Nishinotouin and is very worried, when Yuriko collapsed after being poisoned by Miyo Inbami.

108465.name: Sylphiette
108465.desc: Sylphiette is [Rudeus](https://anilist.co/character/88348/Rudeus-Greyrat)' childhood friend who is part human, elf, and beast race. ~!Following the teleportation incident, during which her hair turned white from mana exhaustion, she became Princess Ariel's personal bodyguard under the alias Fitz.!~ ~!She is Rudeus' first wife and gives birth to their daughter [Lucy](https://anilist.co/character/188846/Greyrat-Lucy) and son [Sieghardt](https://anilist.co/character/273377/Greyrat-Saladin-Sieghardt). She is one of the three goddesses Rudeus worships in his religion. A cloth stained with her virgin blood that serves as a relic for the Goddess of Love is enshrined in the basement.!~

108465.name: Paul Greyrat
108465.original: パウロ・グレイラット
108465.desc: Paul Greyrat is the father of [Rudeus Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/88348/Rudeus-Greyrat), [Norn Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/145458/Greyrat-Norn) and [Aisha Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/145459/Greyrat-Aisha). He is both a talented man that became advanced in all three sword arts at a young age and a lustful man that attracts and sleeps with many women before [Zenith](https://anilist.co/character/179855/Zenith-Greyrat) chained him down.

108465.name: Rudeus Greyrat
108465.original: ルーデウス・グレイラット
108465.desc: __Height:__ 175 cm (5'9") Rudeus is a tall, well-built, and cool-looking man. However, before his reincarnation, he was originally an overweight 34-year-old Japanese NEET who became a recluse following his high-school persecution. Because of his former life, he is careful not to get carried away and become arrogant. As a result, he is extremely self-aware and humble because he does not want to revert to his old self. He is a kind person, helping his friends and protecting his family whenever needed. Due to being capable in many fields, people have high expectations of him. His body possesses a high affinity for magic. Rudeus is very polite to others, often to the point of making them uncomfortable. Rudeus is one of the few people capable of using voiceless magic, and even rarer as someone who can use voiceless incantation with melded magics. He cannot use voiceless incantation for healing magic due to his lack of understanding in regards to how mana is manipulated to heal. A normal Magician takes at least five seconds for a simple spell, while for higher-level spells it's thirty to sixty seconds. Rudeus can do it almost instantly no matter what the difficulty of the spell, with the exception of healing magic.

108465.name: Eris Boreas Greyrat
108465.original: エリス・ボレアス・グレイラット
108465.desc: Eris Boreas Greyrat is a noble girl and distant relative of [Rudeus](https://anilist.co/character/88348/Rudeus-Greyrat). She is a tsundere with a short temper but has potential in the Sword-God style. ~!She is Rudeus' third wife and gives birth to their son [Ars](https://anilist.co/character/273378/Greyrat-Ars) and daughter [Christina](https://anilist.co/character/278862/Greyrat-Christina). She is one of the three goddesses Rudeus worships in his religion. A wooden sword that serves as a relic for the Goddess of War is enshrined in the basement.!~

108465.name: Roxy Migurdia
108465.original: ロキシー・ミグルディア
108465.desc: Roxy Migurdia is a talented mage from the Migurd race, and a former magic tutor. Because she can't use telepathy, she left her village due to feeling isolated from her peers. Unable to make a stable living as an adventurer, she became a travelling tutor and eventually becomes [Rudeus'](https://anilist.co/character/88348/Rudeus-Greyrat) teacher. ~!She is Rudeus' second wife and gives birth to their daughter [Lara](https://anilist.co/character/273376/Greyrat-Lara) & [Lily](https://anilist.co/character/321620/Greyrat-Lily). She is one of the three goddesses Rudeus worships in his religion. Her panties that serves as a relic for the Goddess of Wisdom is enshrined in the basement.!~

108465.name: Ruijerd Superdia
108465.original: ルイジェルド・スペルディア
108465.desc: Ruijerd Superdia is the former leader of the Superd's Warrior group whom once served under Laplace with unwavering loyalty. He was accompanying [Rudeus](https://anilist.co/character/88348/Rudeus-Greyrat) and [Eris](https://anilist.co/character/88349/Eris-Boreas-Greyrat). ~!Laplace betrayed his group by giving them each a devil spear which made them ecstatic from killing, even their own family. After giving his son a fatal wound, his son managed to destroy the devil spear and Ruijerd finally wakes up from the brainwash. He considered committing suicide but decided not to and everyone of that warrior group swore revenged on Laplace. He finally got his revenge after several years of hiding. He interfered in the battle between Laplace and the three heroes. But even if Laplace was defeated, there was no way to change the things that had already transpired. After exacting his revenge, he now has a goal of removing the infamy the Superd race has.!~

108465.name: Shizuka Nanahoshi
108465.desc: __Light Novel Volume 9 spoiler__ ~! Nanahoshi Shizuka is a Japanese girl that was saved by [Rudeus](https://anilist.co/character/88348/Rudeus-Greyrat) in his past life, but instead of reincarnating like Rudeus, she was teleported to Asura Kingdom and was saved by [Orsted](https://anilist.co/character/187382/Orsted). !~

108465.name: Norn Greyrat
108465.original: ノルン・グレイラット
108465.desc: Norn Greyrat is the daughter of [Zenith Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/179855/Zenith-Greyrat) and [Paul Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/88347/Paul-Greyrat) and is the younger sister of [Rudeus Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/88348) and older half-sister of [Aisha Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/145459/Aisha-Greyrat).

108465.name: Aisha Greyrat
108465.original: アイシャ・グレイラット
108465.desc: Aisha Greyrat is the daughter of [Lilia](https://anilist.co/character/179854/Lilia) and [Paul Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/88347/Paul-Greyrat) and is the younger half-sister of [Rudeus Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/88348/Rudeus-Greyrat) and [Norn Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/145458/Norn-Greyrat).

108465.name: Lilia
108465.desc: Lilia is a maid of the Greyrat household. She was [Paul](https://anilist.co/character/88347/Paul-Greyrat)'s classmate in a swordsman dojo. A crippling injury forces her to leave her position as a princess guard, and she becomes a maid to Paul and [Zenith](https://anilist.co/character/179855/Zenith-Greyrat). ~!After working through the revelation with the family, she is taken in as Paul's second wife and becomes closer friends with Zenith. Lillia gets pregnant with Paul's daughter and becomes the mother of [Aisha Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/145459/Aisha-Greyrat)!~

108465.name: Zenith Greyrat
108465.original: ゼニス・グレイラット
108465.desc: Zenith Greyrat is the wife of [Paul Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/88347) and the mother of [Rudeus Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/88348) and [Norn Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/145458/Norn-Greyrat). ~!Zenith was born in the Holy Country of Milis, as the second daughter of an earl of Milis. She grew up following the Milis Church religion, never breaking the rules, getting good grade in school, and had nickname Milis young lady standard. But, when Zenith reached the age of 15, she rebelled against her parents and ran away from home. While trying to find a job as a Healer, she was a solo adventurer for a time. However she was frequently conned out of a large amount of money due to the little knowledge she had on how expensive healer's are, but was saved by Paul Greyrat. She then join Paul's party, the Fangs of the Black Wolf, as a healer. She spent a long time in the party as a healer and gradually began to fall in love with Paul and wanted to marry him. However Paul was a womanizer who frequently slept with multiple women and she didn't want to be with someone like that so she told him if he promised to be faithful to her then she would sleep with him, to which he agreed. Shortly after, she became pregnant with Rudeus and as a result both her and Paul retired from adventuring and settled down in the countryside.!~ __Light Novel Volume 13 Spoiler__ ~!After being freed from the Teleport Labyrinth, she does not express emotions actively since she sees the wo

108465.name: Elinalise Dragonroad
108465.original: エリナリーゼ・ドラゴンロード
108465.desc: Elinalise is a former member of Paul's party. She has an erotic nature due to her curse. She is a warrior that is good at managing monster aggro but isn't a great fighter.

108465.name: Kishirika Kishirisu
108465.desc: Kishirika Kishirisu is The Great Empress of the Demon Realm. She is the demon empress known for her demon eyes' powers and the ability to bestow others with demon eyes. She is engaged to [Badigadi](https://anilist.co/character/262620/Badigadi), the demon lord of immortality. __Light Novel Volume 4 Spoiler__ ~!Kishirika Kishirisu is the person that is responsible for giving [Rudeus](https://anilist.co/character/88348/Rudeus-Greyrat) his demon eye, among other favors!~

108465.name: Orsted
108465.desc: Orsted is the current Dragon God, 2nd-ranked of the 7 World Powers, and the sworn enemy of [Hitogami](https://anilist.co/character/211165/Hitogami). Similar to other Dragon Race people such as [Perugius](https://anilist.co/character/209572/Perugius-Dola), he has silver hair and golden sanpaku eyes with an overpowering look. He carries no visible equipment and wears a white coat adorned with fur. Orsted has a curse that makes every living being feel an overwhelming fear just from being within his presence. Strangely enough, this curse does not affect [Rudeus](https://anilist.co/character/88348/Rudeus-Greyrat) or [Nanahoshi](https://anilist.co/character/137816/Nanahoshi-Shizuka).

108465.name: Ghislaine Dedoldia
108465.original: ギレーヌ・デドルディア
108465.desc: __Ghislaine Dedoldia__ is the daughter of Gustav the former Doldia village chief, and the mentor of [Eris](https://anilist.co/character/88349/Eris-Boreas-Greyrat) and she is also the student of [Rudeus Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/88348/Rudeus-Greyrat) in magic and other subjects. She is one of the few people who have become a Sword King.

108465.name: Pax Shirone
108465.original: パックス・シーローン

108465.name: Philip Boreas Greyrat
108465.original: フィリップ・ボレアス・グレイラット
108465.desc: **Philip Boreas Greyrat** is the son of Sauros and father of Eris. He holds the position as mayor of Roa.

108465.name: Sauros Boreas Greyrat
108465.original: サウロス・ボレアス・グレイラット
108465.desc: __Sauros Boreas Greyrat__ was the Landlord of the Fittoa Region, Asura Kingdom and the grandfather of [Eris](https://anilist.co/character/88349/Eris-Boreas-Greyrat). ~!After the Teleport Incident, he was blamed for the loss of the Fittoa Region and was executed.!~ (Source: Mushoku Tensei Wiki)

108465.name: Hilda Boreas Greyrat
108465.original: ヒルダ・ボレアス・グレイラット
108465.desc: **Hilda Boreas Greyrat** is the mother of Eris and the wife of Philip.

108465.name: Edna Leylune
108465.desc: **Edna Rayrune** is a middle-aged woman who is Eris' tutor in etiquette.

108465.name: Almanfi
108465.desc: Almanfi is one of eleven servants of Perugius.

108465.name: Perugius Dola
108465.desc: Perugius Dola is one of the heroes who banished Demon God Laplace.

108465.name: Hitogami
108465.desc: Hitogami is the Man God, having the power to see into the future, and the sworn enemy of [Orsted](https://anilist.co/character/187382). He has a blank white face coupled with a grin that eludes memory, which gives off the feeling that his face is covered in a mosaic. He helps [Rudeus](https://anilist.co/character/88348/Rudeus-Greyrat) throughout key points in his journey. ~!Hitogami later becomes the overarching antagonist of the series following the revelation that he actually sought to prevent the birth of Rudeus' children, who are prophesied to kill him one day.!~ ~!Hitogami's exact origins are unknown, however it is known that after the Creator God's death, unbeknownst to anyone, he was born within the Void World. At some point in the distant past, the being who would come to be known as Hitogami killed or otherwise usurped the original Man God and took his form. He then began manipulating the Dragon God and his five Dragon Generals into destroying the other four worlds and then proceeded to help the survivors of those ruined world to flee into the human world.!~

108465.name: Rokari Migurdia
108465.original: ロカリー・ミグルディア
108465.desc: [Roxy](https://anilist.co/character/88350)'s mother and [Rowin](https://anilist.co/character/211181)'s wife.

108465.name: Rowin Migurdia
108465.original: ロイン・ミグルディア
108465.desc: [Roxy](https://anilist.co/character/88350)'s father and [Rokari](https://anilist.co/character/211180)'s husband.

108465.name: Rokkus Migurdia
108465.original: ロックス・ミグルディア
108465.desc: The Elder of the Migurd Village

108465.name: Nokopara
108465.desc: A greedy adventurer Rudeus encounters on the Demon Continent. ~!He catches on to Rudeus' plans, which violates guild procedures, and tries to blackmail him out of his money, but upon facing the wrath of Ruijerd, he pitifully begs for his life before falling unconscious.!~

108465.name: Blaze
108465.desc: An arrogant adventurer Rudeus meets on the Demon Continent. ~!He gets killed in action in the middle of a quest.!~

108465.name: Perutko
108465.desc: An arrogant adventurer Rudeus meets on the Demon Continent.

108465.name: Kurt
108465.desc: A young adventurer Rudeus encounters on the Demon Continent, and the leader of the Tokurabu Toughs. He aspires to make his party famous.

108465.name: Bachirou
108465.desc: An adventurer Rudeus encounters on the Demon Continent and a member of Kurt's party.

108465.name: Gablin
108465.desc: An adventurer Rudeus encounters on the Demon Continent and a member of Kurt's party.

108465.name: Vizquel
108465.desc: An adventurer Rudeus encounters on the Demon Continent while looking for a lost cat. She was involved in a scheme where pets were poached and once the owners sent a petition to the adventure's guild looking for them, she would return them, thus earning the reward.

108465.name: Jalil
108465.desc: An adventurer Rudeus encounters on the Demon Continent while looking for a lost cat. He was involved in a scheme where pets were poached and once the owners sent a petition to the adventure's guild looking for them, he would return them, thus earning the reward.

108465.name: Lohman
108465.desc: An adventurer Rudeus encounters on the Demon Continent while looking for a lost cat. He was involved in a scheme where pets were poached and once the owners sent a petition to the adventure's guild looking for them, he would return them, thus earning the reward.

108465.name: Talhand
108465.desc: A dwarf that was member of the Party "Fang of the Black Wolf", with Elinalise and Roxy. He is slow and not agile, so he wears sturdy armor, wields an axe, and uses magic against enemies.

108465.name: Uketsukejou
108465.desc: Receptionist at the Rikarisu City Adventurer's Guild

108465.name: Somar
108465.desc: One of the kids from Buena Village who bullied [Sylphiette](https://anilist.co/character/88346).

20594.name: Kazuto Kirigaya
20594.desc: __Height:__ 172 cm __Weapon(s) of choice:__ Anneal Blade (1st Level), Queen's Knightblade (9th Level), Elucidator (50th level) and Dark Repulser (forged by Lisbeth) Kirito is a "solo" player, a player who hasn't joined a guild and usually works alone. He is also one of the very few people to have had the privilege to play in the beta testing period of Sword Art Online. His game alias, Kirito, is created by taking the syllables of the first and last Kanji of his real last and first names respectively: (Kirigaya Kazuto). In the real world, he lives with his mother and younger sister in a family of 3. When [Kayaba](https://anilist.co/character/36829) announced the start of the death game, he is surprised, but unlike everyone else he quickly gets over it and accepts it to an extent. He invited his friend [Klein](https://anilist.co/character/36830) to go with him but Klein had to find his friends in the game. He was invited to join them but he declined as he couldn't take the pressure of protecting them even with his beta testing knowledge of the game.

20594.name: Asuna Yuuki
20594.desc: __Height:__ 160-168 cm __Weapons of choice:__ Wind Fleuret (1st Floor), Lambent Light (Forged by [Lisbeth](https://anilist.co/character/43906/Shinozaki-Rika)) Asuna is a friend of [Kirito](https://anilist.co/character/36765/Kirigaya-Kazuto) and is a sub-leader of the guild Knights of the Blood (KoB), a medium-sized guild of about thirty players, also called the strongest guild in Aincrad. Being one of the few girls that are in SAO, and even more so that she's extremely pretty, she receives many invitations and proposals. She is a skilled player earning the title "Lightning Flash" for her extraordinary sword skill that is lightning fast. Her game alias is the same as her real world name.

20594.name: Ryoutarou Tsuboi
20594.desc: A friendly player that meets Kirito at the start of the game and quickly befriends and learns from him. He and Kirito later separate because he has friends who were also new to the game so he couldn't leave them. He survives for the past two years and managed to protect his friends the whole time, something Kirito regretted not doing. He is a katana user and the leader of the small guild Fuurinkazan who participates in the boss battles. As one of the few people close to Kirito, he always keeps him in check and wants Kirito to survive the game. He chose the Salamader race on ALO ~! In the side story Caliber, he fell in love at first sight with the girl on the cage named Freyja and agreed that he will help her find her tribe's treasure which is a hammer, though the decision still remains to be a team's decision. The team said yes on Caliber and it turned out that the girl they saved was Thor. It was revealed that Thor disguised as a beautiful girl to get close to Giant King Þrym and retrieve his hammer. Thor defeated Giant King Þrym and that stopped the medallion from being corrupted and ending the quest. !~

20594.name: Suguha Kirigaya
20594.desc: [Kazuto](https://anilist.co/character/36765)'s sister in the real world. She is 15 years old and in her third year of junior high, as well as a member of the Kendou club. She's a diligent worker and has been practicing Kendou for 8 years. ~!In the VRMMO game *Alfheim Online*, she is known as Leafa, a Sylph fairy. She stumbled onto Kazuto by accident one night and decided to travel with him to the World Tree. She eventually fell in love with him because he showed that he really loves playing VR games as if living in it and is very honest in everything. In the real world she slowly got closer to her brother (actually a cousin) but because they're family and because he already got [Asuna](https://anilist.co/character/36828) as a girlfriend she decided to give up on him and fall in love with Kazuto instead. But soon afterwards she realized that they're the same person. After being convinced by Kazuto to have a fierce duel which ended up in them flying in each others' arms, she decided to help Kazuto in rescuing Asuna.!~

20594.name: Keiko Ayano
20594.desc: She is a middle level dagger user. She is a very cheerful and sweet girl. She has a very rare familiar, a feathery dragon that she named [Pina](https://anilist.co/character/212810/Pina) after her cat in the real world. She treasured Pina a lot and was the reason she survived in the game. Aside from being a female player, she is also a Beast Tamer and thus perceived as an idol amongst the middle level players. She received endless invitations from parties and guilds who wanted an idol player to join them to get more fame. Because of the attention she got, she became overly proud of herself and left a party one time after a misunderstanding. She got surrounded by monsters and lost Pina in the end. She was then rescued by [Kirito](https://anilist.co/character/36765/Kirigaya-Kazuto) who was passing by and helped her to resurrect the dead familiar.

20594.name: Yui
