20594.desc: A young and cheerful girl with long black hair who looks no older than 10 years old. [Kirito](https://anilist.co/character/36765) and [Asuna](https://anilist.co/character/36828) found her in a forest on the 22nd floor of Aincrad. ~!Her true identity is actually a players' self-regulation program for mental maintenance, Mental Health Counseling Program or MHCP. After being forbidden by the game master [Akihiko Kayaba](https://anilist.co/character/36829) to come close to the players at the beginning of the death game, she was flooded with errors and broke down. In the process she became an AI that possesses actual intelligence. When the Cardinal system governing *Sword Art Online* decided to erase her, Kirito turned her into a tear shaped crystal pendant. He actually converted her to a part of environmental data for the client program and was saved to his NerveGear's local memory.!~ ~!In *ALfheim Online*, she was able to return to her normal form because ALO was based on a copy of the SAO server. She supports Kirito there as a Navigation Pixie. Kirito and Asuna still treat her as their daughter.!~

20594.name: Rika Shinozaki
20594.desc: A mace wielder that runs a blacksmith shop in Aincrad on the 48th floor. She made [Asuna](https://anilist.co/character/36828)’s rapier ‘Lament Light’ and one day got a request from [Kirito](https://anilist.co/character/36765) to make him a sword with similar or better quality than his one handed long sword ‘Elucidator’ that he got from a monster drop. She told him that if she had the right materials she could make weapons that would break any sword, so they formed a party and went on a journey to find the material she needed. Because of that journey she came to the conclusion that she felt lonely and yearned for warmth. In ALO she is Leprechaun race blacksmith. ~!She comes to realize that she loves Kirito but after finding out that the one Asuna had feelings for was in fact Kirito she decided to give up on him despite how she feels so Asuna could express her feelings, however during the moments after Kirito's victory and SAO's announcement that the game has been cleared she shouts at the top of her lungs that she loves Kirito and that she will meet him again in the real world, which after the ALO incident she actually does, going to school with him and Asuna.!~

20594.name: Kyouko Yuuki
20594.desc: She is Asuna's mother, she hates FullDive programs after her daughter was trapped in one for 2 years. She is strictly with Asuna as she decides her daughters future and gets angry very fast. She once tried a FullDive program but she logged off in just a few minutes saying that she was dizzy.

20594.name: Andrew Gilbert Mills
20594.original: アンドリュー・ギルバート・ミルズ
20594.desc: __Height:__ 180cm A merchant stationed at city Algate, located at the 50th floor of Aincrad. His shop motto is "Buy cheap and sell cheap". He is a very strong axe-wielding warrior in the frontlines. Kirito sometimes stays in his shop as sort of a disaster shelter, which he gets annoyed with but later ignores as Asuna also visits, which results in some publicity for his shop. ~!In the real world he is married and owns a Bar called Dicey Cafe!~ ~!In the side story Aria in the Starless Night, he is among the few players who participated in the first floor boss fight and supported Kirito when he knew of the latter's status as a beta tester and later called a Beater. !~ ~!Upon returning to the real world he helps Kirito implement Kayaba's "seed" which allows VR games to be easier accessed throughout the world, also vastly decreasing the large licensing cost that companies would pay in servers.!~

20594.name: Shino Asada
20594.desc: Shino is a skilled VRMMO player. She goes by the name Sinon in *Gun Gale Online* and *Alfheim Online*. She is nicknamed Hecate, after her gun PGM Ultima Ratio Hecate II, a .50 caliber anti-material rare sniper rifle. She is one of the main characters of volumes five and six and first female player that [Kirito](https://anilist.co/character/36765/Kazuto-Kirigaya) meets in *GGO*. She plays *GGO* to overcome her trauma concerning guns. Calm and cool are the two words that best describe Sinon's personality. In battle and most of the time in the game, she keeps a cool head that actually makes other female players admire her. However, Sinon has a violent temper once angered something that is best seen with her interactions with Kirito. It is actually said that Kirito is the first one to make her extremely angry. Despite all this, Sinon, while may be hard to approach, is generally a friendly person and doesn't mind helping others. ~!She becomes a Cait Sith archer in *ALO* where she is capable of hitting targets from 200m away despite her bow being limited to 100m.!~

20594.name: Yuuki Konno
20594.desc: She is a new player who appears in ALO in volume 7, she leads the Sleeping Knights and quickly becomes known as one of the strongest in the game winning 67 straight matches. ~!Her guild the Sleeping Knights is a group of terminally ill patients who play using the FullDive Technology MediCuboid, Yuuki's disease is AIDS which she obtained through a bad blood transfer she received as a child due to dystocia, the disease took form when she was bullied in school after it was known she was a carrier; she was then later taken to the hospital where she lived the next 3 years in the new medical FullDive Technology called MediCuboid; it is due to this that her experience in the VR world exceeds even the survivors of SAO, and for this reason even makes her a match for [Kirito](https://anilist.co/character/36765/Kirigaya-Kazuto) when he is not Dual wielding. She quickly becomes friends with [Asuna](https://anilist.co/character/36828/Yuuki-Asuna) due to the reason that she looks similiar to her elder twin sister who died one year prior to her meeting with Asuna.!~

20594.name: Vassago Casals
20594.desc: Leader and founder of the red guild "Laughing Coffin", known for his large knife and catch phrase "It's show time." His guild was later destroyed by other players in SAO, but his whereabouts are missing. He is presumed to be alive because he wasn't listed as one of the dead players. (Source: SAO Wiki)

20594.name: Shouichi Shinkawa
20594.desc: One of the top members in the red guild Laughing Coffin. He was a master of the Estoc Thorn Sword that was bathed in the color of red. He holds a grudge against [Kirito](https://anilist.co/character/36765) and the clearers that defeated Laughing Coffin in the anti-PK raid. He was also partners with Johnny Black, and together served as a combination where they poisoned and killed. ~!After his release from *Sword Art Online*, through the recommendation of his brother [Kyouji](https://anilist.co/character/73151), he began to play *Gun Gale Online*. The two looked to another Laughing Coffin member and began to plot a ingenious plan to kill players in both the virtual world and the real world. He enters the Bullet of Bullets tournament under the name Sterben to prove his "true" killing ability to the rest of the world. He would stun people with special shells from his L115A3 Silent Assasin sniper rifle and then get up close to shoot them with his Death Gun, a 7.62 X 25 handgun. While he commited the kill in-game, his brother and the other Laughing Coffin member would inject the players in the real world with a syringe that stopped the heart. They had obtained the address by hiding under a Metamaterial Optical Camouflage while they watched the other players type their real addresses during the BoB registration process. His plans were foiled by Kirito and [Sinon](https://anilist.co/character/55147), and eventually goes to prison after the incident had passed.!~

20594.name: Atsushi Kanamoto
20594.desc: Johnny Black was a survivor of Sword Art Online, he's a member of the infamous red guild Laughing Coffin and is partnered with Xaxa. He is well known for using poisons and such in battles.

20594.name: Seijirou Kikuoka
20594.desc: Seijirou Kikuoka is a member of the Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications, Technology, Second Separated Advanced Network Division, or «Virtual Division». He uses the nickname «Chrysheight» in «ALfheim Online»

20594.name: Alicia Rue
20594.desc: Alicia Rue is the leader of the Cait Sith. She was elected by popular vote. She is also training her dark magic capable of using Moonlight Mirror. She forms an alliance with the Sylphs to finish the Conquer the World Tree Quest. ~!During the meeting with Sylph , the groups are attacked by Salamanders lead by General Eugene. Kirito dives in to save the day and fights off Eugene although Kirito has inferior equipment. Later, along with Sylph reinforcements, she aid Kirito's ascension of the World Tree after using collected funds to purchase armor of at least Ancient grade for all of her warriors.!~ (Source: SAO Wiki)

20594.name: Eugene
20594.desc: General Eugene is the head of the Salamander armed forces. ~!He was considered the strongest player in ALfheim Online until he was defeated by Kirito during the Conference of the Lords.!~ (Source: SAO Wiki)

20594.name: Sigurd
20594.desc: Sigurd is a Sylph warrior in the VRMMORPG «ALfheim Online». He lost to Lyfa in the Sylph tournament yet he still retained high ambitions to hold power among the Sylph. He later tries to betray the Sylph to the Salamander. He is later caught and exiled by Sakuya, after the botched assassination attempt. (Source: Wikipedia)

20594.name: Kyouji Shinkawa
20594.desc: Kyouji is a player of the American produced VRMMORPG Gun Gale Online. He uses the AGI powered character Spiegel. He is Asada Shino's friend and the one introduced her to GGO. ~!He is a son of the director of a hospital. He later develops a hatred towards Zekushido, as well as other STR-oriented players, for destroying Spiegel's development by suggesting AGI as the way to power provoking him to boost AGI, but being unable to wield heavy guns due to his lack in STR. He also later develops a stalker attachment towards Shino, resulting in him attempting a homicide and suicide together with her, only to be foiled by Kirito, almost being killed in the process. He also played the role of Death Gun when Zenkushido and Usujiro Takaro were killed. In the end, he and his brother were arrested by the police.!~ (Source: SAO Wiki)

20594.name: Sakuya
20594.desc: Leader of the Sylph race and an exceptional swordswoman. She was elected as the leader of the Sylph race by popular vote (80% voice of the vote). Her statistics are not very high due to her status as a Lord not allowing her to do much training. Despite her low stats, she is a formidable opponent in the Sylph dueling tournaments. ~!During a meeting with the Cait Sith, she is attacked by Salamanders led by General Eugene. At the same moment, Kirito flies in to challenge the intruder to a duel. After Kirito wins the battle, she attempts to seduce him along with Alicia Rue. Lyfa smothers their attempt, saying that he is accompanying her to the World Tree. At the end of the arc, Lady Sakuya leads a combined force of Cait Sith and Sylph against the World Tree in an attempt to aid Kirito along his journey.!~ (Source: SAO Wiki)

20594.name: Natsuki Aki
20594.desc: is a nurse who works for the Japan Ground Self-Defense Force (JGSDF) and was assigned by Kikuoka Seijirou to oversee Kirigaya Kazuto's medical condition at «Chiyoda Hospital» when he was hospitalized as well as during his rehabilitation. She is later assigned to watch over Kazuto during the «Death Gun» incident and after Kazuto is injected with succinylcholine.

20594.name: Dyne
20594.desc: Dyne is a player in the VRMMO game, Gun Gale Online. He is the leader of a PvP (anti-personnel) squadron that primarily targets weaker low-risk opponents.

20594.name: Pale Rider
20594.desc: Pale Rider was one of the participants of the third Bullet of Bullets(BoB) tournament in the Gun Gale Online. Pale Rider was a STR-type player, who had three dimensional mobility. Pale Rider was a tall, skinny male who wore blue and white camouflage clothing. Due to his black helmet, his face could not be seen. Pale Rider used an ArmaLite AR17 Shotgun.

20594.name: Behemoth
20594.desc: A high-ranked mercenary player in the VRMMO, Gun Gale Online, who is usually hired as a bodyguard for player groups with money but no perseverance. Behemoth uses a heavy GE M134 Minigun as his weapon of choice.

20594.name: Nori
20594.desc: She is a medium-range, damage-dealer member of the Sleeping Knights, a guild of terminally ill patients who met in Serene Garden and played various virtual reality games as a form of palliative care. Nori had played a variety of virtual reality games, until the guild eventually arrived to ALfheim Online, where Nori chose to be a Spriggan.

20594.name: Freyja
20594.desc: An Npc that appears in the scalibur sword plot, being locked up and being Klein who falls in love with her and frees her

20594.name: Thrym
20594.desc: is an NPC that appears in ALfheim Online. He is the king of the Frost Giants and the main antagonist of the Caliber Arc.

20594.name: Siune
20594.desc: She was the second sub-leader of the Sleeping Knights, a guild of terminally ill patients who met in Serene Garden and played various virtual reality games as a form of palliative care. An Si-eun had played a variety of virtual reality games, including Insect Site, until the guild eventually arrived to ALfheim Online, where An Si-eun chose to be an Undine.

20594.name: Tecchi
20594.desc: He is a close-range, tank-build member of the Sleeping Knights, a guild of terminally ill patients who met in Serene Garden and played various virtual reality games as a form of palliative care. Tecchi had played a variety of virtual reality games, until the guild eventually arrived to ALfheim Online, where Tecchi chose to be a Gnome.

20594.name: Talken
20594.desc: He is a medium-range, damage-dealer member of the Sleeping Knights, a guild of terminally ill patients who met in Serene Garden and played various virtual reality games as a form of palliative care. Talken had played a variety of virtual reality games, until the guild eventually arrived to ALfheim Online, where Talken chose to be a Leprechaun.

20594.name: Jun
20594.desc: He is a close-range tank-build swordsman member of the Sleeping Knights, a guild of terminally ill patients who met in Serene Garden and played various virtual reality games as a form of palliative care. Jun had played a variety of virtual reality games, until the guild eventually arrived to ALfheim Online, where Jun chose to be a Salamander.

20594.name: Yamikaze
20594.desc: Is an AGI-type player in Gun Gale Online and a participant in the 2nd and 3rd Bullet of Bullets.

20594.name: Tamotsu Shigemura
20594.desc: He is a Gun Gale Online player who ranked first in the second Bullet of Bullets tournament.

20594.name: Aiko Konno
20594.desc: She is the older sister of [Yuuki Konno](https://anilist.co/character/64523). She is the founder of the Sleeping Knights Guild, a group of terminally ill patients who play VRMMOs.

20594.name: Verdandi
20594.desc: NPC that are part of the Excalibur mission.

20594.name: Skuld
20594.desc: She is one of the NPCs that are part of the Excalibur mission.

20594.name: Urd
20594.desc: It is an NPC that appears in one of the missions of ALfheim Online which consists of rescuing the Holy Sword Excalibur from Þrymheimr. She is friends with the Evil-type animal creatures that inhabit Jötunheimr.

20594.name: Pina
20594.desc: is Silica's Feathered Little Dragon and the first known monster to be tamed in Sword Art Online. It understands Silica's commands and will protect her in any way it can, as it is her «Tamed Monster». It is also present in ALfheim Online as her Cait Sith familiar.

20594.name: Kurahashi
20594.desc: He is in charge of the long-term care department at the Yokohama Kōhoku General Hospital and was Konno Yuuki's doctor since she was little. He had been helping her overcome her human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) and was the one who persuaded her to use the Medicuboid

20594.name: Ginrou
20594.desc: He is a member of Dyne's PvP (anti-personnel) squad that targets weaker, low-risk opponents. Ginrou's evasion skills in face-to-face combat is known to be above average

20594.name: Avatar Buyer
20594.desc: A GGO player dedicated to purchasing skins from new players

20594.name: Juushi X
20594.desc: A player in the VRMMO game, Gun Gale Online, and a participant in the 3rd Bullet of Bullets. She is one of the four players in the finals of the tournament who had not participated in the finals of the previous two tournaments.

20594.name: Akiyo Sada
20594.desc: Housekeeper working for the Yuuki family

20594.name: Shishi Ou Richie
20594.desc: Richie participated in the 2nd Bullet of Bullets tournament, during which he occupied the highest point in the area and used his machine gun to keep other players away. However, Richie had to withdraw after running out of ammunition.

101338.name: Narrator
101338.desc: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

101338.name: Arataka Reigen
101338.desc: __Height:__ 179 cm (5'10.5") [Mob's](https://anilist.co/character/89616) mentor and boss in the Mob Psycho 100 series. He owns a business exorcising ghosts and is a self-proclaimed psychic. He is Mob's moral compass. He was the first person to ever consider Mob as normal and his teachings have never failed Mob.

101338.name: Shigeo Kageyama
101338.desc: **Height:** 157 cm He is the assistant and disciple of [Arataka Reigen](https://anilist.co/character/89334/Reigen-Arataka). He is also the newest member of the Body Improvement Club. Shigeo is a quiet and polite individual who tries to live a normal life despite having strong telepathic power, he wants to be seen as a good human among the people in his social life. This often makes him naive and gullible when those with malicious intent want to use him for a laugh or to cause trouble but Shigeo has very strong beliefs to never use his powers to hurt another person because of an altercation he faced once as a child.

101338.name: Ekubo
101338.desc: Ekubo is a self-proclaimed upper-class evil spirit who has aligned himself with [Mob](https://anilist.co/character/89616) after being defeated by him. Ekubo wants to be a god. Specifically, he wants to be worshipped by all humanity. ~!Despite having that kind of ego, he didn't hesitate to put himself at Mob's mercy in the hopes of using the boy to his advantage. At first, he wanted to steal Mob's body and use it to become a god, but he eventually decided to try to make Mob a god instead.!~

101338.name: Ritsu Kageyama
101338.desc: __Height:__ 159.4 cm Ritsu is very clever and apparently serious, he also serves on the student council and excels in academics and everything else he tries. None of that matters to him as much as psychic power, however, his brother is more important to him than anyone or anything else. ~!Before he awoke his own psychic powers, he longed for the esper abilities his brother has always had and was frustrated by his own inability to do things like bend spoons. He may have a habit of carrying spoons around with him, for bending purposes. He is a perfectionist with a not-so-hidden dark side. Unlike [Mob](https://anilist.co/character/89616/Kageyama-Shigeo), he finds it okay to use psychic violence against people when necessary.!~

101338.name: Tenga Onigawara
101338.desc: Tenga Onigawara is the leader of Salt Middle School and an unofficial member of the Body Improvement Club.

101338.name: Tome Kurata
101338.desc: __School:__ Salt Middle School __School club:__ Telepathy Club (President) Tome seems to be a slacker but is passionate about the possibility of using telepathy to contact extraterrestrials. However, when the Telepathy Club's research into the matter bears no results, she quickly gives up. When she learns that [Mob](https://anilist.co/character/89616/Kageyama-Shigeo) is an Esper, her passion is revitalized.

101338.name: Teruki Hanazawa
101338.desc: __Height:__ 161.4 cm Hanazawa Teruki is an esper who was first introduced as an antagonist, but later became [Mob](https://anilist.co/character/89616/Kageyama-Shigeo)'s friend after being defeated by him. He was the shadow leader (urabanchou) of Black Vinegar Middle School, using his psychic powers to rule over the delinquents at his own school, as well as to defeat those from other schools. Teruki is a talented, quick-thinking, and hardworking esper. In terms of raw power, he is nowhere near Mob's level, but he compensates for this by putting in effort and training diligently. He is able to analyze other espers' techniques and their weaknesses in a short amount of time, and often incorporates said techniques in his own fights. He is constantly training to improve himself, and is remarked by various espers as possessing a keen and powerful set of skills.

101338.name: Ichi Mezato
101338.desc: Ichi Mezato is a school girl who goes to Salt Middle School and is part of the News Club. She is in class 2-1.

101338.name: Tsubomi Takane
101338.desc: She is a middle schooler at Salt Middle School. Mob harbors a large crush on her. ~!Most of what we know about Tsubomi's personality in the manga is from what Mob and other characters say about her. However, in the anime adaptation, there are extra scenes of Tsubomi that add to her character and personality and make her a more compassionate individual.!~

101338.name: Shou Suzuki
101338.desc: ~!Sho Suzuki is the son of the leader of Claw. He led a direct resistance against his father's world domination plan.!~

101338.name: Musashi Gouda
101338.desc: Musashi Goda is a student of Salt Middle School and the Body Improvement Club's President. Musashi has a strong sense of justice but strongly disagrees with senseless violence

101338.desc: The partner of Koyama who is also one of the executives of the Tsume group.

101338.name: Mukai

101338.name: Toichirou Suzuki
101338.desc: Toichiro is an extremely powerful esper and the founder and leader of Claw.

101338.name: Kaito Shiratori
101338.desc: Kaito is an esper, the twin brother of [Daichi Shiratori](https://anilist.co/character/133206/Shiratori-Daichi), and one of the children who was invited to the Awakening Lab.

101338.name: Daichi Shiratori
101338.desc: Daichi is an esper, the twin brother of [Kaito Shiratori](https://anilist.co/character/133205/Shiratori-Kaito), and one of the children who was invited to the Awakening Lab.

101338.name: Terada
101338.desc: Terada is an esper and a former member of Claw. He was part of the upper echelon called "Scar".

101338.name: Mob no Chichi
101338.desc: Mob's Father.

101338.name: Kenji  Mitsuura
101338.desc: He is the founder of the Awakening Lab.

101338.name: Shinji Kamuro
101338.desc: He is the president of the student council at Salt Middle School.

101338.name: Hikaru Tokugawa
101338.desc: He is the vice-president of the school council of Salt Mid.

101338.name: Hiroshi Kumagawa
101338.desc: He is part of the Body Improvement Club and a student of Salt Middle School.

101338.name: Hideki  Yamamura
101338.desc: He is a student of Salt Middle School and a member of the Body Improvement Club.

101338.name: Banshoumaru Shinra
101338.desc: He is the self-proclaimed "greatest psychic of the century" and a member of the Sun Psychic Union led by Kirin Shoudou.

101338.name: Minori Asagiri
101338.desc: Minori Asagiri is a middle-school girl and the daughter of a wealthy businessman. Asagiri is very spoiled and very cruel. The first we see of her, she throws a tantrum due to dissatisfaction over lavish birthday presents. This is her true personality, according to her father, that existed before she was possessed by Mogami. Within the world Mogami created and trapped Mob in, she acts very similarly. She bullies, isolates and abuses Mob. Apparently, she does this because she wants to prove herself superior, and by preying on those who are weaker and can't stand up for themselves, she establishes her position. However, after being saved by Mob, she is brought to tears and resolves to become a better person because of him.

101338.name: Jun Sagawa
101338.desc: He is a student of Salt Middle School and the president of the Body Improvement Club.

101338.name: Kirin Shodou
101338.desc: He is a haughty psychic and the President of the Sun Psychic Union. ~!Like many other self-proclaimed psychics, Shodo possesses no special abilities. However, he was able to produce a noticeable aura in his ultimately fruitless attempt to exorcize​ Keiji Mogami from Minori Asagiri's body.!~

101338.name: Emi
101338.desc: She is a student at Salt Middle School. Emi first appears as a questionably nice girl who shows an interest in Mob. She has an interest in books and writing novels. ​However, she seems to be easily influenced by her friends and quickly interprets things others say about her negatively, even if they weren't meant that way. She was grateful to Mob for retrieving and restoring her writings after they were torn up.

101338.name: Haruto  Kijibayashi
101338.desc: He is a third-year middle school student and a member of the Telepathy Club.

101338.name: Keiji Mogami
101338.desc: Keiji Mogami is "This Century's Greatest Psychic" and a former Psychic who turned into an evil spirit upon death. Keiji Mogami is a very bitter man, sick of the greed and selfishness of humanity. Because of the private dealings he did while alive, he has lost his moral compass and has become a twisted variant of his former self. After becoming an evil spirit, he vowed to use his power for his own intentions and fix the world by possessing people who appear to gather grudges around them. To that end, Mogami is willing to destroy a girl's body and brutally impale her father to achieve his whims.

101338.name: Katsuya Serizawa
101338.desc: He is an extremely powerful Esper who was formerly a part of the Super 5 of Claw. He now works at the agency alongside Reigen and Mob.

101338.name: Kunekune
101338.desc: was an upper-class evil spirit who made his home ruining the crops of a farmer.

101338.name: Mameta  Inukawa
101338.desc: He is a second-year middle school student and a member of the Telepathy Club.

101338.name: Ryohei Shimura
101338.desc: He is a student of Salt Middle School and a member of the Body Improvement Club.

101338.name: Masashi Asagiri
101338.desc: He is a businessman​ and the client who hired psychics to get rid of the spirit possessing his daughter Minori Asagiri.

101338.name: Nozomu Hatori
101338.desc: He is a powerful Esper and a former member of the terrorist organization​ Claw as part of the Ultimate 5.

101338.name: Toshiki Minegishi
101338.desc: He is a powerful esper, a former member of the terrorist organization​ Claw and once part of the Ultimate 5.

101338.name: Ryou Shimazaki
101338.desc: He is a powerful esper, member of the now defunct terrorist organization​ Claw and a former part of the Ultimate 5.

101338.name: Sakakibara
101338.desc: He is an esper and former leader of actually disbanded terrorist organization Claw's 5th Division.

101338.name: Furutachi
101338.desc: He is an esper and former leader of 2nd Division of Claw.

101338.name: Igarashi
101338.desc: He is an esper and former leader of actually disbanded terrorist organization Claw's 6th Division.

101338.name: Udo
101338.desc: He is a mercenary and an Esper.

101338.name: Tamaki
101338.desc: He is an esper and former leader of 1st Division of Claw.

101338.name: Hitoshi
101338.desc: He was a client of Arataka Reigen, he wanted to speak with his deceased father about a password to a safe. ~!He attempted to stab Reigen to get the combo but was knocked out by Reigen.!~

101338.name: Ebiwara
101338.desc: He is an esper and former leader of actually disbanded terrorist organization Claw's 3rd Division.

101338.name: Fukuda
101338.desc: He is an esper and one of Sho Suzuki's subordinates.

101338.name: Miguel
101338.desc: He is an esper and mercenary.

101338.name: Higashio
101338.desc: He is an esper and one of Sho Suzuki's subordinates.

101338.name: Otsuki

101338.name: Yanagawa
101338.desc: He is an esper and former leader of actually disbanded terrorist organization Claw's 4th Division.

101338.name: Joseph
101338.desc: He is an esper mercenary and assassin hired by the government.

101338.name: Hiroshi Yabe
101338.desc: He is a Prime Minister abducted by Shimazaki.

101338.name: Hiroshi Shibata
101338.desc: He is a (formerly powerful) esper and a former member of the terrorist organization​ Claw as a part of the Ultimate 5.

101338.name: Ishihara
101338.desc: He is an esper and former member of actually disbanded terrorist organization Claw's 4th Division

98659.name: Kiyotaka Ayanokouji
98659.desc: __Height:__ 176 cm (5'9") Ayanokouji is an inconspicuous and unobtrusive student. He is shown to be extremely intelligent and possesses a profound insight to study the emotions of people around him. Almost everything about his life prior to the entrance exams is unknown. He is shown to be extremely calculating and possessing superhuman intellect, perception, and strength. He's skilled at fighting and is able to easily manipulate the people around him. He is quite fond of his friends and protects those that he can without standing out. He has little regard for others' feelings and will coldly let them suffer to succeed, occasionally even his friends.

98659.name: Suzune Horikita
98659.desc: __Height:__ 156 cm (5'1") A beautiful girl who sits next to [Ayanokouji](https://anilist.co/character/123212/Ayanokouji-Kiyotaka). She is the opposite of Ayanokouji when it comes to friendship; she disregards it and thinks of making friends unnecessary, thus she does not communicate much with her classmates. She is not convinced that she was placed in the D class, therefore she aims to get promoted to the A class.

98659.name: Kikyou Kushida
98659.desc: __Height:__ 155 cm She boasts tremendous popularity among men and women as the D class' idol. She aims to be friends with everyone not just in D class. She wants to get along well with her classmate, [Horikita](https://anilist.co/character/123213/Horikita-Suzune).

98659.name: Airi Sakura
98659.desc: __Height:__ 153 cm (5'0") A girl who is into photography. She hates standing out and likes to take modeling pictures.

98659.name: Honami Ichinose
98659.desc: __Height:__ 159 cm (5'2") If there was one sentence to describe Honami, it would be that she is genuinely kind-hearted, benevolent, and a pacifist to the core who is against using underhanded means and violence. One of her main traits is her unselfish and supportive personality, combined with her excellent social skills and her being naturally people-oriented. Honami is also a charismatic and energetic person, and extends her sweet and benign character even to those of the lower classes, unlike many other upper-class students.

98659.name: Sae Chabashira
98659.desc: __Height:__ 160 cm The homeroom teacher of the protagonist's class (D). She is originally indifferent to her class, doing almost nothing to help them in the battle between classes, and remains unmotivated for the most part.

98659.name: Yousuke Hirata
98659.desc: __Height:__ 174 cm (5'8") The social leader of the D class. He has excellent academic and athletic ability, and is considered extremely handsome by his classmates, he is shown to be extremely compassionate and puts others before himself, considering everybody equal. He is considered a perfect male student and his placement in the D-class is originally considered a mystery.

98659.name: Manabu Horikita
98659.desc: __Height:__ 178 cm (5'10") He is the leader of the school council and is [Horikita Suzune](https://anilist.co/character/123213/Horikita-Suzune)'s elder brother.

98659.name: Arisu Sakayanagi
98659.desc: __Height:__ 150 cm (4'11") Arisu Sakayanagi is one of the class representatives of class 1-A along with [Kohei Katsuragi](https://anilist.co/character/207026). She suffers from congenital heart disease which limits her physical ability. She appears to possess a "go with the flow" attitude as she accepts most situations with no protest though she voices her dislike of boring situations after Katsuragi noted of the class scores. Unlike Kohei Katsuragi, who has a conservative stance, Arisu possesses an innovative attitude. Together, the pair effectively lead class A through the school years. She enjoys situations she finds interesting as shown when she smiled at [Kakeru Ryuen](https://anilist.co/character/159627)'s declaration to rule the school or when she listened to the speech of [Suzune Horikita](https://anilist.co/character/123213) and found it amusing. In the light novels, Arisu enjoys toying with people as seen when she cryptically hinted to [Kiyotaka Ayanokoji](https://anilist.co/character/123212) of knowing him while he had voiced he never saw her before. Later on, while being together with [Honami Ichinose](https://anilist.co/character/123216), she also had the chance to show her confidence and complacency after [Teruhiko Yukimura](https://anilist.co/character/173450) of Ayanokoji Group boldly claimed that D-Class has the plan to overtake A-Class soon. Additionally, although she has an easygoing personality, it was shown in the later part of the series that she's easil

98659.name: Mei-Yu Wang
98659.desc: Mei-Yu is of Chinese descent and is shown to be one of the academically gifted students. She has a visible crush on Hirata Yosuke.

98659.name: Kei Karuizawa
98659.desc: __Height:__ 154 cm (5'0") She is a girl with a bad attitude who is located at the top of the D class hierarchy. She fights with [Kushida](https://anilist.co/character/123214/Kushida-Kikyou) for their class' top 2 places. Even though she gives off the impression of someone who is careless, arrogant, and messy, Kei's true self is very logical and astute with a sharp mind. She has remarkable ability to read the environment and the people around her, and makes the correct decision often.

98659.name: Rokusuke Kouenji
98659.desc: Rokusuke Kouenji is one of the students of class 1-D. He came from a well-known family of scholars. However, he ended up in D-Class for his egotistical behavior. ~!In Year 1, Volume 11, he watches a scuffle between [Hirata](https://anilist.co/character/123218/Hirata-Yousuke) and [Mii-Chan](https://anilist.co/character/136233/Wang-MeiYu), which ended with Hirata pushing a desperate Mii-Chan, who was trying to help him, on the ground. Kouenji then intervenes and states his annoyance at Hirata "for treating a girl wrong" referring him as "like a fly, very irritating". His friendship with Mii-Chan is then showed to progress in Year 2, Volume 5, when they are seen walking together often, and Mii-chan referring to him as "someone easy to talk to" when asked about their relationship by [Satou](https://anilist.co/character/163519/Satou-Maya) and [Matsushita](https://anilist.co/character/191401/Matsushita-Chiaki).!~ ~!During the Second Year Uninhabited Island Special Exam, he strikes an agreement with [Suzune Horikita](https://anilist.co/character/123213/Horikita-Suzune), in which he would try for a first-place finish and Suzune would reward him with complete protection from class vote expulsion until graduation and exempt him from being forced to co-operate with the rest of the class, which he wins.!~

98659.name: Kakeru Ryuuen
98659.desc: __Height:__ 173 cm (5'8") Kakeru Ryuuen is the class representative of class 1-C and is known for being an infamous delinquent. He does not lead his class by trust, but rather by fear. He has a group of henchmen who do his dirty work, which contributes to his fearsome reputation.

98659.name: Haruka Hasebe
98659.desc: Haruka is a pretty normal person, but she is not very open to other people as shown when she didn't participate in the class's swimming session where she tends to prefer keeping to herself and not bothering people, simply to avoid trouble. She is considered to have good looks and is often viewed lustfully by boys, thus wanting to seclude herself. She is mostly seen wearing the school's uniform, with the difference that she has the upper button of her shirt undone and her tie relatively loosened. She prefers giving people nicknames the moment she meets them, which is said by Kushida to be a method for her "to appear closer to the people she isn't close to". ~! In Year 2, Volume 5, Haruka is told off by Kushida when she tries to help the latter. She is then seen aggressively opposing the motion by Ayanokoji to expel Airi Sakura, being her closest friend, to no avail. She is one of the 4 remaining members and the sole remaining girl of the Ayanokoji Group.!~

98659.name: Hiyori Shiina
98659.desc: Hiyori Shiina is one of the students of Class 1-C who is a loner. She's a quiet girl, though sometimes she is seen occasionally smiling. She always carries books with her in her bag in case she meets someone who shares the same interest in literature as her. Since nobody in class 1-C is into literature, she doesn't have anyone to talk to. She always speaks politely. She dislikes how the classes are competing with each other, wanting everyone to be friends. ~! She encounters Kiyotaka in the library, and they find themselves having the same taste in books. As she always wanted a friend who has similar interests as her, their friendship gradually blossoms and she refers to him as her "reading buddy". She slowly starts developing romantic feelings for Kiyotaka.!~

98659.name: Maya Satou
98659.desc: She is a student of class 1-D. ~!In Volume 7.5, Maya asks for [Kei Karuizawa](https://anilist.co/character/141122/Karuizawa-Kei)'s help to plan her "date" with [Kiyotaka Ayanokouji](https://anilist.co/character/123212/Ayanokouji-Kiyotaka). Kei was surprised and suggested other boys to her, but she refused, and said that she only liked Kiyotaka. She told her plan to Kei and made some changes according to her suggestions. She then later asked Kei if they could make it a "double-date", by including her and [Yousuke Hirata](https://anilist.co/character/123218/Hirata-Yousuke) in the plan. Eventually, Kei agreed and decided to schedule the double date on December 25. She confessed to Kiyotaka after the double date during Christmas, but was rejected and ran away crying. They promised each other that they will hang out again in the future and wants to see each other again but Maya couldn’t hold her feelings and excused herself first as she didn’t want him to see her in a pathetic state. She was hinted to have cried an innumerable amount of times behind closed doors after being rejected as the next time we saw her, she was able to frankly tell her friends she was rejected without being choked up. Her friends summarised that this could only had happened if she had come to terms with the rejection showing an immense amount of willpower to move on. That said, she still harbours feelings for Kiyotaka and has admitted that she finds him way cooler and hotter than Hirata not holding against

98659.name: Teruhiko Yukimura
98659.desc: Teruhiko Yukimura is a student of class 1-D. Despite his excellent academic ability, he was placed there due to his poor athletic ability and lack of social skills. During the formation of the Ayanokoji Group, it is revealed that he does not like his first name Teruhiko, given to him by his mother who left their family. He prefers the name his father gave him: Keisei

98659.name: Mio Ibuki
98659.desc: Mio Ibuki is a student of class 1-C. Not only does she possess excellent academic qualities, but her physical ability is also not to be underestimated. She is skilled in combat, having the knowledge of several martial skills that can rival those of many martial artists.

98659.name: Chiaki Matsushita
98659.desc: Matsushita is one of the students of class 2-D. She has a quiet older sister type of personality. She is generally kind to all the boys and girls alike, but she does not actively go out to make friends. ~!Chiaki had believed from early on in the first year that Class D had no hopes of ever reaching Class A and thus resigned herself to a carefree school life, never putting in any real effort into her academics. She considers herself to be a major underachiever, believing that she could easily score in the top 10% of her class if she truly tried to, but believed it to be pointless as long as she was in Class D. Later on in the light novels, she starts seeing improvements in the class and becomes willing to start contributing to the class. She is also known to be skilled at mental arithmetic and can calculate quickly. She even held her own against Kouhei Katsuragi from Class A in the Mental Arithmetic event in the Event Selection Exam.!~ ~!Later, in her monologue, she states that she had started to pay close attention to Kiyotaka after the end of year special exam, but she was not romantically interested in him. According to her, she was probably among the top 10% of students in their year, but had not revealed her abilities since she did not want people to be jealous of her. She had thought that even if she tried her best, the chance of Class-D being able to rank up the classes was minimal. However, after closely observing Kiyotaka, she had arrived at the conclusion that Class-

98659.name: Akane Tachibana
98659.desc: Akane Tachibana is a former student of Advanced Nurturing High School who has graduated from Class 3-A and the former secretary of the Student Council.

98659.name: Yume Kobashi
98659.desc: Yume Kobashi is one of the students in class 1-B.

98659.name: Satsuki Shinohara
98659.desc: Satsuki Shinohara is one of the students of class 2-D. She is considered to have below-average looks. She has an outspoken personality and can often be seen arguing with Ike.

98659.name: Masumi Kamuro
98659.desc: Masumi Kamuro is a student of Class 2-A and a member of the Art Club. She is one of the members of the inner circle of Sakayanagi faction but is shown to be only interested in doing so as Sakayanagi has some information about her criminal history.

98659.name: Chie Hoshinomiya
98659.desc: Chie Hoshinomiya is the homeroom teacher of class 1-B. She has a cheerful, flirty personality and is referred to as "never having grown from her high school days" by Ayanokoji. She shows glimpses of a more serious side of hers upon matters relating to reaching Class-A. She was a classmate of her colleague Sae Chabashira during their time in the Advanced Nurturing High School.

98659.name: Ryuuji Kanzaki
98659.desc: __Height:__ 174 cm (5'8½") Apart of Class 1-B and Honami Ichinose's right hand man. Not much is known about Ryūji, but he appears to be a diligent student who behaves seriously and he is a very helpful person as shown when he aided Honami Ichinose in the case of Ken Sudō. He is a friendly person as he does not look down on D-Class and gets along with them.

98659.name: Haruki Yamauchi
98659.desc: Haruki is apart of Class 1-D. He is apart of the three idiots of Class D along with Ike and Sudou. He has a tendency to lie and his grades are the lowest in the class. Similar to his friends, Haruki has a perverted side who is attracted to Kikyō Kushida as he was willing to peep on the girls. He is also very attracted to Airi Sakura and Haruka Hasebe, mainly for their well-endowed bodies and quiet nature. ~!Haruki got expelled during the Class Vote Exam.!~

98659.name: Akito Miyake
98659.desc: In middle school, Akito became fond of archery and joined the club there and even participated in country-level competitions. However, he began to neglect other activities or duties, such as studies, in the process. At that time he started to create some ruckus by causing quarrels with other people. That, and the fact that he neglected his studies lead to his evaluation as a D-Class student. In high school, he once again became a member of the Archery Club. He is a good friend of Kiyotaka and is apart of the Ayanokouji friend group.

98659.name: Ken Sudou
98659.desc: __Height:__ 183 cm (6'0") Ken is apart of Class 1-D and is apart of the Basketball Club. Due to his poor academic ability, he is referred to as one of the 3 Idiots of D-Class. Regardless of this, his athletic ability is without a doubt one of the best among the school. He has a crush on Suzune after receiving help from her. Under the constant supervision of Suzune, he gradually matures and begins to improve academically rising out of the bottom ladder of class and earning her trust.

98659.name: Kouhei Katsuragi
98659.desc: **Height:** 180 cm (5'11") Kōhei is an intelligent student who worked very hard to reach Class 1-A that he became one of its representatives alongside Arisu Sakayanagi. He is a serious man who adheres to the rules of manners and good conduct. He has a feud with Sakayanagi for control of the class, leading him to oppose her with his faction. He is bald due to an illness. He has a twin sister and they were originally orphans. Volume 2 Year 2 ~!He's transferred to Ryuuen's Class !~

98659.name: Masayoshi Hashimoto
98659.desc: Masayoshi is a very self-serving individual with no real loyalty to anyone other than himself. He always sides with and places his bets on the winning team, in order to always stay on top. When the Class-A leadership conflict breaks out at the beginning of the first year, Masayoshi determines that Arisu Sakayanagi is the better candidate for the position of leader and quickly joins her faction and becomes part of her inner circle.

98659.name: Tomonari Mashima
98659.desc: Mashima is an English teacher and the homeroom teacher of class 1-A. Mashima is a man who takes his job seriously and puts his students first.

98659.name: Kanji Ike
98659.desc: Kanji Ike is one of the students of Class 1-D who is known as one of the 3 Idiots of D-Class. While his intelligence is poor, his communication skills are excellent.

98659.name: Albert Yamada
98659.desc: Albert Yamada is one of the students of Class 1-C.

98659.name: Yahiko Totsuka
98659.desc: Yahiko Totsuka is a student of Class 1-A and belongs to Katsuragi Faction.

98659.name: Hayato Kitou
98659.desc: Hayato Kitou is one of the students of Sakayanagi’s class.

98659.name: Mako Amikura
98659.desc: Mako Amikura is one of the students of Ichinose’s class.

98659.name: Kayano Onodera
98659.desc: Kayano Onodera is one of the students of Horikita’s class. She is a member of the Swimming Club and she is the best swimmer out of the girls in her class.

98659.name: Kokoro Inogashira
98659.desc: Kokoro Inogashira is one of the students of Horikita’s class.

98659.name: Sou Shibata
98659.desc: Sou Shibata is one of the students of Ichinose’s class.

98659.name: Hideo Sotomura
98659.desc: Hideo Sotomura is one of the students of Horikita’s class.

98659.name: Chihiro Shiranami
98659.desc: Chihiro Shiranami is one of the students of Ichinose’s class.

98659.name: Nene Mori
98659.desc: Nene Mori is one of the students of Horikita’s class.

120120.name: Hinata Tachibana
120120.desc: __Height:__ 153 cm Hinata Tachibana is the girlfriend of [Takemichi Hanagaki](https://anilist.co/character/145342/Hanagaki-Takemichi) who is the primary reason for Takemichi's desire to change the past. In 2005, Hinata is a 14 year old girl. Hinata has light brown eyes and wears her rosy brown hair a little longer than before: it goes beyond her shoulders. She is seen wearing a long black dress with embroidered flowers. She also wears a necklace around her neck, materializing her relationship with Takemichi Hanagaki during their middle school years. Hinata has a very outgoing and upbeat personality who is highly optimistic and always finds ways to make undesirable situations better. Even when others become demoralized or despair, Hinata remains strong in order to push them forward. ~!On July 4, 2017, Hinata will be killed during a brawl between two Tokyo gangs, along with her brother [Naoto Tachibana](https://anilist.co/character/167843/Tachibana-Naoto).!~

120120.name: Manjirou Sano
120120.desc: __Height:__ 162 cm He is a founding member and the leader of Tokyo Manji Gang. Mikey is usually a carefree teenager who loves to joke and play pranks around those he considers his close friends. He cares for them greatly and is determined to protect their honor. He rarely shows any sign of weakness, as he believes himself to be the foundation and support for Toman, and if the pillar himself were to display weakness, Toman would also be weakened. ~!Younger brother of [Shinichiro](https://anilist.co/character/221297/Shinichirou-Sano), older half brother of [Emma](https://anilist.co/character/171924/Emma-Sano) and younger "adoptive" brother of [Izana](https://anilist.co/character/170484/Izana-Kurokawa)!~ ~!In the future, it is revealed that Mikey is the leader of the gang "Bonten" ,which is considered Japan's current worst criminal organization.!~ ~!During the high school timeline it is revealed that Mikey is the leader of the "Kanto Manji Gang".!~

120120.name: Takemichi Hanagaki
120120.desc: __Height:__ 165 cm Takemichi learns that the girl he dated in middle school—the only girl he ever dated—has died. Then, after an accident he finds himself in a time leap back to his middle school years. He vows to change the future and save the girl, and to do that he aims to rise to the top of the Kantou region's most brutal delinquent gang. ~!After the fight with Valhalla he becomes the First division Capitan of Toman.!~ ~!He later became the eleventh President of the Black Dragons as well as the captain of the First Division of the Tokyo Manji Gang, and a member of Brahman.!~ ~!Takemichi is also the president and founder (with [Chifuyu Matsuno](https://anilist.co/character/145344/Matsuno-Chifuyu)) of the Thousand Winters (later renamed as Tokyo Manji), created to defeat Kanto Manji.!~

120120.name: Keisuke Baji
120120.desc: __Height:__ 175 cm Captain of the 1st division and one of the founders of the Tokyo Manji Gang. Baji has a wild personality. He loves the thrill of adrenaline and [Mikey](https://anilist.co/character/145341) himself says that he would punch someone out on the street for no apparent reason, only because he feels like it. In combat, he is never without his trademark grin.

120120.name: Chifuyu Matsuno
120120.desc: __Height:__ 168 cm Chifuyu is the vice-captain of the First Division of Tokyo Manji gang and [Baji](https://anilist.co/character/145343)'s best friend. ~!He is the first one to get to know about [Takemichi](https://anilist.co/character/145342)'s time leap ability. After that, he regularly helps Takemichi to think about saving the future.!~ ~!Takemichi sought his help in order to team up and face Kanto Manji, the newest [Mikey](https://anilist.co/character/145341)'s gang. He also demands that their team should be called Thousand Winters. Chifuyu also made the uniforms.!~

120120.name: Ken Ryuuguji
120120.desc: __Height:__ 185 cm (6'1") Draken is [Mikey](https://anilist.co/character/145341/Manjirou-Sano)'s best friend and one of the founders of Toman. Draken is a muscular teenager who is exceptionally tall for his age. His head is shaven on the sides and back to expose his signature dragon tattoo on his left temple. His blonde hair is long on the top of his head and kept in a neat braid. Draken is a serious teen who lives in a brothel, he does not know his biological parents and was 'taken in' by the owners of the brothel. ~!His mother was a prostitute who abandoned him at birth and died when he was two years old.!~ ~!In the future, Draken owns a bike shop, and is a member of Brahman.!~

120120.name: Takashi Mitsuya
120120.desc: __Height:__ 170 cm Mitsuya is the Captain of the Second Division of the Tokyo Manji Gang. He is a calm, levelheaded person who is also the source of positivity in the gang. Despite his rough upbringing, he tackles every day with a smile. Mitsuya is a pacifist, preferring to not get into an altercation if possible, but at the same time, will not hesitate to fight in order to protect what is dear to him. Older brother of [Luna Mitsuya](https://anilist.co/character/272864/Mitsuya-Luna) & Mana Mitsuya. He is a childhood friend of [Draken](https://anilist.co/character/145345/Ken-Ryuuguji).

120120.name: Hakkai Shiba
120120.desc: __Height:__ 183 cm Vice Captain of the Second Division of the Tokyo Manji Gang. The younger brother of [Yuzuha](https://anilist.co/character/170482/Yuzuha-Shiba) and the younger brother of [Taiju](https://anilist.co/character/167845/Taiju-Shiba), the leader of the 10th Generation Black Dragons. Hakkai is shown to be a timid but friendly guy. When it comes to his personality he is nothing like his older brother Taiju who is disciplined and bloodlusted. Hakkai has deep admiration for [Takashi Mitsuya](https://anilist.co/character/167841/Takashi-Mitsuya)

120120.name: Naoto Tachibana
120120.desc: __Height:__ 148 cm (past), 175 cm (present) Hinata's younger brother. He very much resembles his father. Naoto is a righteous individual who is also determined to also save his sister. He has a no-nonsense personality and is usually unamused by others' humorous advances. He is also willing to embrace far-fetched possibilities, such as the fact that Takemichi can time-travel, and even make his own hypotheses about it. ~!Before the first time travel, he died together with Hinata. However, after he was warned of his death by Hanagaki and was subsequently saved, he grew up to become a detective and ended up playing a key role in Hanagaki's ability to travel through time.!~ ~!Naoto is the key to activating Takemichi's supernatural time-travel ability. Whether in the past or present, as long as the two shake hands, Takemichi will be transferred to the present (if he is in the past), or the past (if he is in the present). He is also the only person who is aware of the consequences caused by Takemichi's time-traveling aside from Takemichi thus far.!~

120120.name: Kazutora Hanemiya
120120.desc: __Height:__ 174 cm One of the founders of the Tokyo Manji Gang and former number 3 of Valhalla. Kazutora is a very broken soul; as a child, he was forced to pick between his mom and dad in a case of domestic violence. As a result of his fundamentally non-existent family life, he scorned upon other happy families. Something as simple as seeing children having tender moments with their parents, triggered a sore spot within Kazutora and irritated him deeply. ~!He sat 2 years in juvie for the murder of Shinichirou Sano , and he is expected to face at least 10 years in juvie, for stabbing Keisuke Baji. Even though they were the most important people in Mikey's life, he still forgave Kazutora, and told him that he is a part of Toman.!~

120120.name: Souya Kawata
120120.desc: __Height:__ 170cm Vice captain of the Fourth Division of the Tokyo Manji Gang. He's the younger twin brother of [Nahoya Kawata](https://anilist.co/character/168679/Nahoya-Kawata).

120120.name: Nahoya Kawata
120120.desc: __Height:__ 170 cm Captain of the Fourth Division of the Tokyo Manji Gang. Brother to [Souya Kawata](https://anilist.co/character/168678/Souya-Kawata).

120120.name: Seishuu Inui
120120.desc: __Height:__ 177 cm Former tenth generation Black Dragons commander and the current vice captain of the Black Dragons. Inupi is usually a stoic and quiet individual. However, he isn't afraid to voice his thoughts and opinions even if it hurts him in the end. He is very committed to the Black Dragon and loyal to Kokonoi, whom he considers his best friend. When he finds people he trusts, he devotes himself to them. He is brave, but will be willing to show his vulnerable side and open up.

120120.name: Hajime Kokonoi
120120.desc: __Height:__ 174 cm Koko sees the world as a series of calculations. He acts solely in his own interests; every move of his is to benefit himself. He cozies up to those more powerful than he, but will turn his back on them the moment they lose their instrumentality. ~!Former tenth generation Black Dragons commander!~ ~!His goal was to collect 40 million yen to save his loved one, Akane but unfortunately, he was too late.!~

120120.name: Tetta Kisaki
120120.desc: Kisaki is the principal antagonist of Tokyo Revengers. He's especially known for rising to the top of the Toman at full speed. Kisaki is a ruthless, cunning, and ambitious individual who will stop at nothing to achieve his goals. Although average in stature, his power to rule with fear makes even those stronger than he obey him. The entirety of his actions in the entire story revolves around becoming the most powerful and influential criminal in Tokyo. ~! He is also known for organizing the murder of Hinata Tachibana many times. !~ ~!He is later ran over and killed by a truck after a long chase!~

120120.name: Atsushi Sendou
120120.desc: One of Takemichi's best friends in middle school. ~! It's revealed that he is the person who pushed Takemichi in front of the train at the start of the story.!~

120120.name: Masataka Kiyomizu
120120.desc: Kiyomasa is the leader of the the third years in Shibuya Third Mid school and a former member of Toman. ~! He is no longer a member of Toman because Tomans leader and vice presidents, Draken and Mikey busted his underground boxing job. !~

120120.name: Takuya Yamamoto
120120.desc: Takuya Yamamoto is one of Takemichi's middle school friends and also his childhood friend.

120120.name: Nobutaka Osanai
120120.desc: Osanai is the former president of the Moebius gang. ~!Toman's leader, Mikey, knocked Osanai out with three kicks when he tried to ambush them with his gang and Draken announced that Moebius will now be under Toman's command, following which Osanai gets stabbed by Pah, much to everyone's shock.!~

120120.name: Emma Sano
120120.desc: __Height:__ 150 cm ~![Mikey](https://anilist.co/character/145341/Manjirou-Sano)'s younger half-sister.!~~!Killed by [Tetta Kisaki](https://anilist.co/character/170483/Tetta-Kisaki).!~

120120.name: Haruki Hayashida
120120.desc: He is one of the founding members of the Tokyo Manji Gang and its former third divisions captain. ~!He ends up getting sentenced to one year in jail after he stabbed Osanai during the Toman and Moebius confrontation in the hangar or garage. His arrest led to internal conflicts in Toman and the gang getting split in two. !~

120120.name: Makoto Suzuki
120120.desc: Takemichis friend and a member of the Mizo Middle Five

120120.name: Kazushi Yamagishi
120120.desc: One of Takemichi's best friends in middle school.

120120.name: Yasuhiro Mutou
120120.desc: Toman Gang Fifth Division Captain. ~!He later leaves Toman and becomes a Tenjiku Gang executive.!~

120120.name: Ran Haitani
120120.desc: __Height:__ 183 cm A Tenjiku executive. [Rindou](https://anilist.co/character/203563/Haitani-Rindou)'s elder brother. ~!He is a member of the S62 generation. He was one of Tenjiku’s 4 Heavenly Kings, and is a Bonten executive in the future.!~

120120.name: Rindou Haitani
120120.desc: __Height:__ 172 cm A Tenjiku executive. Ran's younger brother. ~!He's a Bonten executive in the future.!~

120120.name: Ryouhei Hayashi
120120.desc: __Height:__ 176 cm He is the third division vice-captain of the Tokyo Manji Gang.

120120.name: Shuuji Hanma
120120.desc: __Height:__ 192cm He is the former acting leader of Moebius following Osanai's defeat. Hanma's single purpose is to find excitement, relieving his boredom by street violence. Hanma slowly sinks in to apathy since he was winning fights easily, without any resistance, that's why he sooner ally with [Kisaki Tetta](https://anilist.co/character/170483).

120120.name: Shinichirou Sano
120120.desc: Older brother of [Mikey](https://anilist.co/character/145341/Manjirou-Sano).

120120.name: Haruchiyo Sanzu
120120.desc: __Height:__ 172 cm Vice captain of the 5th division in the Tokyo Manji Gang.

120120.name: Ryouko Tachibana
120120.desc: Mother of Hinata and Naoto.

120120.name: Chonbo
120120.desc: ~!Chonbo is one of the Valhalla captains and expert fighters. !~

120120.name: Chome
120120.desc: ~!Chome is one of the Valhalla captains and also one of its expert fighters. !~

120120.name: Hansen
120120.desc: Hansen is a character affiliated with the Ikebukuro Criminal Black Members.

120120.name: Gariman
120120.desc: Gariman is the leader of Night Dust, a top gang in tokyo, which governs the Ueno territory.

120120.name: Choji Ahane
120120.desc: Choji is one of Valhalla's Captains and Kisaki's cronies.

120120.name: Masaru
120120.desc: [Takemichi](https://anilist.co/character/145342/)'s cousin and a third year student in Shibuya Middle School. He claimed to be the leader of the delinquents at his school, only to be exposed as the servant of [Kiyomasa](https://anilist.co/character/171921) and his friends.

6547.name: Kanade Tachibana
6547.desc: __Height:__ 150 cm Kanade Tachibana is the Afterlife School's student council president. She is often referred to as "Tenshi" by the SSS, based on both [Yuri's](https://anilist.co/character/22370/Nakamura-Yuri) belief that she must be a representative of god and the SSS members not knowing her name initially. Though, they continue to call her "Tenshi" after discovering her real name. Her position often puts her at odds with Yuri and the other SSS members as her responsibilities require her to suppress delinquency and disruptive activities. Her given name, Kanade, as described by [Otonashi](https://anilist.co/character/24502/Otonashi-Yuzuru), literally means "Playing music". Tenshi has a variety of self-defense skills at her disposal, which she calls "Guard Skills". (Episode 13 spoilers) ~! It is revealed that Kanade was the receiver of the donor heart from Otonashi. Her regret in life was her inability to thank the one who gave her the heart. After the credits, there is a short scene featuring what is assumed to be her and Otonashi reuniting in the real world !~

6547.name: Yuri Nakamura
6547.desc: __Height__: 165 cm Yuri Nakamura is the founder and leader of the Afterlife-based school organization Shinda Sekai Sensen (SSS). She leads the campaign of the many students who fight against God, whom they blame for their cruel fates. ~!She met [Hinata](https://anilist.co/character/24503/Hideki-Hinata) before Angel discovered him, and managed to convince him to form the SSS (Shinda Sekai Sensen) with her.!~ ~!When she was alive, she had three younger siblings, whom she tried to protect, but unfortunately died during a burglary in her house. It has not been revealed how exactly she died, though it is strongly implied that it was via a gun.!~

6547.name: Yuzuru Otonashi
6547.desc: __Height:__ 176 cm Otonashi lost his memory in an accident and thus thinks his life has no meaning. Things start to change for him as the story progresses. He is the main male protagonist of Angel Beats! Armaments Glock 19 ~!In episode 7, Naoi is asked by Yuri to hypnotize him so he can regain his memories. This turns out successful revealing he had a very ill younger sister who was his sole reason for living. After her death, Otonashi decides to become a doctor to cure others who are ill like his sister and starts to study frantically. On his way to take an exam, his train crashes because of a snow storm. This hints that he died at that moment. However in episode 9, it is shown he survives the crash and starts helping the other few survivors as much as he can, since he was studying medicine. He and the survivors are stuck in a dark tunnel and it is only after 7 days that a rescue team arrives. A few minutes before losing all hope, Otonashi signs a paper to donate his organs (and inspires the other survivors to do the same). Otonashi dies soon after, just seconds before the rescue team arrived. Over the course of the anime, he is the first of the SSS to try and understand Tenshi (Kanade). In the final episode, he confesses his love to her. However, it is revealed that Kanade's reason for coming to that world was she was unable to thank the person who let her live on - the person that donated their heart for a heart transplant. Kanade reveals that she knew it was Otonashi all

6547.name: Hideki Hinata
6547.desc: Hinata is a bright young guy and everyone likes him for his kindness. He is very popular to new students as he has a helping attitude towards his juniors and newcomers at school. He is comedy relief in some situations and a pervert in others. He will always try to save his comrades if he can and is a reliable force in the team. ~!He is the co-founder of SSS along with [Yuri](https://anilist.co/character/22370/Nakamura-Yuri). Hinata is found by Yuri in the afterlife right after his death, and she kept harassing him because she was amused by his reaction. The reason why he nicknamed Yuri "Yurippe" is because she shares same name of his mother during the time he was alive. In Episode 4, a hint from his past shows that he could have possibly died of drug abuse, though in Track Zero, it is revealed that his cause of death is getting hit by a truck. When Yui wanted to get married, Hinata stepped up and proposed, seriously, that he wanted to get married to Yui so that she can be happy. This fulfilled Yui's desire and so she disappeared.!~

6547.name: Takamatsu
6547.desc: Takamatsu is a very calm and composed kind of a guy. He dislikes commotion and wants to avoid trouble as much as possible. His character is mysterious. ~!In Episode 5, it is revealed that he has a very well built muscular figure compare to his 'genius' looks In Episode 11, he was eaten by the new enemy, "Shadow", and turned into an NPC. During that, he lost his glasses, which is something he never does. He is destined to remain in the world without a soul, performing daily tasks like other NPCs. In Episode 13, he recovered from being an NPC because of his strong will as stated during the conversation of Yuri and Hinata.!~ ~!Takamatsu's weapons include a SIG SG 552 assault rifle and a Desert Eagle pistol, both of which availed him little in the events of episode 8.!~

6547.name: Noda
6547.desc: Noda is a self-reliant boy who executes the strategies formed by the SSS and fights with a halberd. He does not listen to anyone other than Yuri, whom he has adoration for, and is antagonistic to almost everyone else. He has a rivalry between Otonashi and himself. He is a complete idiot whose weakness is education. He is not afraid to kill or harm anyone who gets in Yuri's way. ~!He appears to have a crush on Yuri because he is always trying to impress her, and even has a photograph of her to carry around.!~

6547.name: Eri Shiina
6547.desc: Shiina is a "self-proclaimed female ninja" who fights with traditional Japanese weapons such as dual-wielding kodachi and shuriken. Shiina also wears the special uniform of the SSS, along with a long black scarf covering the bottom part of her face and her neck. Her skirt is slightly different from the usual, as it has two short slits which is probably to aid her in movement. She usually puts up a tough and quiet front, but she is extremely fond of cute things, especially stuffed animals. She is able to sense when danger is coming. She is very strict in her training and would continue with her training even when she is needed to do something else. Shiina's training mostly consist of balancing objects such as broomsticks, scissors and mops on her fingertip, sometimes balancing one on each of her fingers simultaneously while doing something else. She also usually says the phrase "how shallow-minded" when she remarks on her colleagues' actions. ~!It is revealed in Chapter 24 in Angel Beats: Heaven's Door that Shiina is from ancient Japan. She said she didn't make up a name for herself, so she went by her callsign C7. Yuri invented the name "Shiina" because of the simalarity of the pronunciation of C7. Her life was to train everyday on how to kill people.!~

6547.name: Yusa
6547.desc: Yusa is a girl with long blond hair tied into two pigtails secured in place by a red ribbon each. Just like most of the members of the SSS, Yusa wears the standard uniform of the group. She also wears brown stockings and black loafers. She is also seen wearing an earpiece with a microphone attached to it or carrying a walkie-talkie. Yusa is an observer during the missions and her ability is transmitting information to help her team. She is a calm and gentle mannered girl. She also has a straight-forward and tsukkomi character. She doesn't show any emotion, and called scary by Hinata and Otonashi (in an omake). She also can't calm down without her headphone.

6547.name: Fujimaki
6547.desc: Fujimaki is fight-holic and the 'bad-boy' of the anime. He has a snobbish attitude and picking up fights is in his blood. He's almost always seen carrying a wooden scabbard which contains a katana sword. He can't swim. He is the member of the main force with the least screen time and even says himself that people would probably forget about him if he were to have disappeared.

6547.name: TK
6547.desc: He is a mysterious character who speaks in nonsensical English phrases depending on the situation of the scene, though he does not know English fluently. He saves the team many times and does know some Japanese but rarely speaks it, and it seems he understands what the others say to him. And he is talented in almost anything (mostly in dancing). He was always seen dancing even though fighting his enemies. His real identity and his name are still unknown, so they identify him as "TK", a nickname he gave himself. One particular trait of his is his inability to remain still, as he is in constant movement whenever he is not doing anything at all (although at times he can be seen not in constant movement).

6547.name: Godan Matsushita
6547.desc: Matsushita is a Judo expert. He has a well-built body and narrow eyed, which earned him the reputation of being the 'Kuma-san' or Mr. Bear. He is a level '5 dan' in Judo. ~!It is shown in episode 12 that after several days of training in the mountains Matsushita is no longer overweight.!~

6547.name: Ooyama
6547.desc: Ooyama is an ordinary school boy and unlike others, does not possess any angel ability like fighting skills or special powers. He is scared of fighting and is the shota-type guy of the anime. ~!Before joining the SSS, Ooyama was Hinata's roommate, and was originally mistaken to be an NPC whom Hinata frequently talks to about his experiences with Yuri. However, when Ooyama began to show human emotion and worries about Hinata's well-being, Hinata realizes that Ooyama is actually a human. Ooyama is also the third person to join the SSS. !~

6547.name: Masami Iwasawa
6547.desc: Always giving a cool look, she is a talented vocalist and plays guitar. She formed a band in the Afterlife called Girls Dead Monster with her best friend Hisako. She also writes songs and composes music for her band. She is beautiful and has a warm heart. The electric guitar that she is seen using is a Fender American Standard Stratocaster with the color of Sienna Sunburst. ~! In Episode 3, it is revealed that she is brought up in a family where her father and mother keeps on having quarrels & fights against one another. It lead her to a fear that keeps everything to herself, which made her become a lonely person. It was until one day she hears a band, Sad Machine, that sang words she related to what she had experience through her life. That was then she decided to sing out to express herself - She found an acoustic guitar that was thrown away, which she picked up and got it fixed and used it to perform. She decided to leave home and continue to pursue her dream as a performer while also holding part time jobs In the same episode, she revealed that she died in the hospital due to a stroke in her head that paralyzed her body - It was during the fights between her parents when a beer bottle hit her head by accident. After singing her ballad during the concert, she accepts her fate and vanishes, leaving only her acoustic guitar behind. It was then the gang realized that they don't have to really obey what Angel says in order to enter another life, which they do not want.!~

6547.name: Hisako Fuchita
6547.desc: She is the co-founder of the band with Iwasawa, and the band's guitarist. She is smart, energetic and loves to pick on Sekine. Mahjong is one of her other interests alongside music. ~!It is implied that Hisako and Iwasawa harbored romantic feelings for one another, as they often blushed in each other’s presence and made gestures of affection towards one another. They once inadvertently led Angel to believe that they had sex when the latter walked in on the two in Hisako’s bedroom, to Hisako’s immense chagrin and Iwasawa’s oblivion at the situation!~

6547.name: Yui Yoshioka
6547.desc: Yui loves to play her guitar. She is a member of [Iwasawa](https://anilist.co/character/24512/Iwasawa-Masami) and [Hisako](https://anilist.co/character/24513/Fuchita-Hisako)'s band. She is full of life and life of the band itself. She wants to become a pro-musician. ~!After Iwasawa's disappearance in episode 3, Yui convinces Yuri and the other characters of letting her become the leader of Iwasawa's band. She then takes over guitar and vocals for the band. Yui was the main focus in Episode 10. Otonashi had decided for her to disappear first in his and Angel's secret plan to help everyone move on by fulfilling any regret they had in life by giving them a chance to experience a normal youth. In order to find more about Yui, Otonashi needed some time alone with her. It is revealed that when she was little, she was hit in the back by a car and had been paralyzed from the neck down since. When asked what else she wanted to do when she couldn't move her body, she had wanted to perform a German Suplex, pass 5 people and score a goal in soccer, and hit a home run in baseball. Eventually, she's able to succeed in her first two goals with Otonashi's help, but after 3 days of attempting to hit a home run, Yui gladly gives up since she is satisfied that she was able to move and do activities every day. When asked again if all the things she wanted to do when she couldn't move her body came true, she said she had wanted to get married since it was a woman's ultimate happiness. Sadly sayin

6547.name: Miyuki Irie
6547.desc: Irie is fond of ghost stories but has the worst of it when it comes to anything about ghosts. She is cute and enjoys everything as much as she can. She plays drums in Iwasawa and Hisako's band. She enjoys her time the most when Sekine is around.

6547.name: Shiori Sekine
6547.desc: Sekine and Irie are best friends and both are in the same band formed by Iwasawa and Hisako. She is the bassist. She is not a gifted musician like the rest of the band members but gives her best. Despite that, Hisako always acts as her senpai and teaches her 'dos and don'ts' in a band.

6547.name: Chaa
6547.desc: Chaa supplies the weapons that the SSS uses. Despite looking much older, he is about the same age as Otonashi and the others attending the afterlife school. ~! In the light novel, it is written that Chaa was the one who discovered how to make weapons out of "dirt"(It was actually stone). We first see him when he tries to break into the principal's office, armed with a gun, but Kanade manages to subdue him. Later on, he duels with Yurippe, and after he loses, he joins the forming SSS. Chaa also mentions that Yurippe is similar to his wife. !~

6547.name: Ayato Naoi
6547.desc: The Vice Student Council President. ~!He became the Student Council President after Kanade got demoted, though becomes the Vice Student Council President again after Kanade is given her status as the Student Council President back. Naoi was the son of a famous potter. He had always lived in the shadow of his talented older brother, who was named heir to their family at a young age. Naoi spent most of his time isolated in his room, until his brother died in an accident. After his brother's death, Naoi was told that "It was you who died," and thus he took on the role of his brother, undergoing strict training in order to live up to his brother's standards. Naoi, however, could not compare to his brother, but he worked hard and eventually won an award. He believed that he would continue to work with his father and eventually become the best potter in Japan. However, his father was bedridden, and Naoi was forced to tend to his Father, and so was not able to continue working. Naoi believed that his life was meaningless because he was always living for either his father or his brother. Naoi then "joins" the Battlefront and still acts as the School Vice President. He seems to greatly admire Otonashi, and always listens to him, giving Otonashi the "Older Brother" role to Naoi. Naoi also seems to be younger than Otonashi and Yuri, which makes him an underclassman like Yui. He refers to Otonashi as "Otonashi-san" and the rest of the Battlefront he usually refers to them as "You" and "T

6547.name: Takeyama
6547.desc: A super genius hacker. Prefers to be called "Christ."

6547.name: Hatsune Otonashi
6547.desc: She is diagnosed with an unknown illness and has been bedridden for two years. Within this period, Otonashi (Yuzuru) acts as her guardian, usually visiting her to give her manga to read and to keep her company. Compared to her brother, Hatsune enjoys studying and hanging out with her friends. However, her sickness kept her from going outside. She is also gifted by her brother's love, who despite having a meager income out of part-time jobs still has enough money to bring her comic books which she enjoys reading. Her gestures of gratitude, in turn, reassures him. ~!Upon her last request to go outside to see the decorations outside the hospital where she stayed, she passed away, clinging on to her brother's back on her final moments.!~

6547.name: Saitou
6547.desc: Saitou is a member of the Guild. He is proficient in fishing, as well as in weapons.

6547.name: Igarashi
6547.desc: He is a young man who was injured in the same train crash like Otonashi. Igarashi befriends Otonashi and the two work hard to save the people in the train wreck. ~!When Otonashi decided to donate his organs, he motivated Igarashi to do so too, and soon everybody underground did that. His words of encouragement made Otonashi realize that he was somebody who helped others in his real life.!~

6547.name: Nazo no Seinen
6547.desc: A mysterious boy that appears in episode 12. ~!He was the one who stole the computers from the lab, and used Angel Player to send Shadows after the Battlefront. Apparently, he was programmed, by the developer of Angel Players, to appear when there was "love in this world." He confronts Yuri, giving her the chance to make an important choice. !~

6547.name: Hitomi
6547.desc: Yuri's classmate in her dream world during Episode 12.

151807.name: Narrator
151807.desc: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

151807.name: Jin-U Seong
