151807.desc: __Class:__ Mage __Relatives:__ [Park Kyung-Hye](https://anilist.co/character/209396/KyungHye-Park) (Mother), [Seong Jin-Ah](https://anilist.co/character/138791/JinAh-Sung) (Sister), ~![Seong Il-Hwan](https://anilist.co/character/138790/IlHwan-Sung) (Father), [Cha Hae-In](https://anilist.co/character/138789/HaeIn-Cha) (Wife), [Seong Su-Ho](https://anilist.co/character/306654/Suho-Sung) (Son)!~ ~!__Guild:__ Ahjin Guild (Guild Master) __Affiliation:__ Korean Hunters Association (helper), White Tiger Guild (helper), Hunters Guild (helper), Knights Guild (helper), Ahjin Guild (Guild Master)!~ Seong Jin-U is known as an infamously weak E-Rank Hunter. He is a humble and benevolent individual who cares deeply for his family and has an ardent desire to become stronger. As a result, he shares a close relationship with his sister and his mother, and rarely wastes an opportunity to refine his skills and gain more power. ~!He becomes an S-Rank hunter after being given a chance to become stronger by the System.!~

151807.name: Chi-Yul Song
151807.desc: __Magic Type:__ Fire Korean C-Rank Hunter and kumdo teacher. He is also one of Jinwoo's old friends, having known him since he was a E-Rank Hunter.

151807.name: Ju-Hui Lee
151807.desc: She is a healer with rank B.

151807.name: Dong-Su Hwang
151807.desc: Hwang Dong-su is an​ S-class hunter who works for Scavenger's Guild in America.

151807.name: Jin-Ho Yu
151807.desc: __Class:__ Tanker __Guild:__ ~!Ahjin Guild (Vice-Guild Master)!~ Yoo Jin-Ho is a D rank hunter and is [Jin-U Seong](https://anilist.co/character/129928/JinWoo-Sung)'s faithful assistant and combat partner.

151807.name: Yun-Ho Baek
151807.desc: He is a S rank hunter and master of the White Tiger guild.

151807.name: Jin-Cheol U
151807.desc: An A rank hunter that works for Hunter's association of Korea.

151807.name: Hae-In Cha
151807.desc: __Guild:__ Hunters Guild __Class:__ Sword Fighter __Affiliations:__ Jeju Island Raid Party, [Song Chi-Yul](https://anilist.co/character/136073/ChiYul--Song)’s Dojo (Disciple) Cha Hae-In is the Vice-Guild Master of the Hunters Guild. She is an S rank hunter and the 9th ranked hunter in South Korea. She possesses the unique ability of mana smell and hates the smell of hunters except for [Sung Jin-Woo](https://anilist.co/character/129928/JinWoo-Sung).

151807.name: Jin-A Seong
151807.desc: [Jin-U](https://anilist.co/character/129928)'s younger sister.

151807.name: Geon-Hui Go
151807.desc: Go Gun-Hee (고건희) is a South Korean S-Rank Hunter and the Chairman of the Korean Hunters Association.

151807.name: Song-I Han
151807.desc: Han Song-I is an E-Rank hunter who quit school after gaining money through the Yoo Jin-Ho and Sung Jin-Woo motley group of party. She is friends with Sung Jin-Ah. She first appeared when Jin-Ah visited Jin-Woo in the hospital but she didn't know him then.

151807.name: Jong-In Choi
151807.desc: Choi Jong-In is one of the 10 S-Rank Hunters of South Korea. He is also the Guild Master of the Hunters Guild.

151807.name: Igris
151807.desc: Igris is one of the first Shadows that [Sung Jin-Woo](https://anilist.co/character/129928/Seong-Jin-U) acquired. He was initially protecting an empty throne in an Instant Dungeon where Jin-Woo was doing his Job Quest in the Job Change Quest Dungeon. After two failed attempts of Shadow Extraction, Sung Jin-Woo convinced him to protect him instead of protecting an Empty throne, obtaining him as a Knight Grade Shadow.

151807.name: Byeong-Gu Min
151807.desc: Min Byung-Gu was a retired hunter and one of the 10 S-Rank and only S-Rank Healer of South Korea. He was a close friend with the White Tiger's Guild Master Baek Yoon-Ho. He took part in the 4th Jeju Island Reclamation Raid and was a member of the Korean Raid Team tasked with killing the boss of the Jeju Island Gate.

151807.name: Tae-Shik Kang
151807.desc: B-rank Hunter and An inspector working for South Korea's Hunter Association, Monitoring Division.

151807.name: Myung-Han Yu
151807.desc: Yu Myung-Han (유명한) is Jin-Ho's father and the CEO of Yoojin Construction.

151807.name: Hee-Jin Park
151807.desc: Park Hee-Jin (박희진) is a member of White Tiger Guild that Sung Jin-Woo helped when they got stuck inside the Red Gate.

151807.name: Ki-Hoon Son
151807.desc: Son Ki-Hoon (손기훈) is the Team Leader of Attack Force B of the Hunters Guild.

151807.name: Iron
151807.desc: A shadow Sung Jin-Woo gained after entering the Red Gate. ~!Before being reawakened as a Shadow he was Chul Kim (김철), an A-Rank Hunter of the White Tiger Guild.!~

151807.name: Kyung-Hye Park
151807.desc: Park Kyung-He is the mother of Jin-U and Jin-Ah. She was in the hospital because of the Eternal Sleep. Her sickness served as the primary motivation for Jin-U becoming a hunter alongside his desire to support his sister with the absence of their father.

151807.name: Gina
151807.desc: Gina is an A-Rank mage and was one of the Raid Members in Son Ki-Hoon's Party in an A-Ranked Gate. She has long blonde hair and deep red eyes. Her height is average and she has a very attractive body. Gina has a serious personality this can be seen when she answers Son Ki-Hoon's question about if she was responsible for killing one of the High Orcs.

151807.name: Laura
151807.desc: Laura is the secretary of Scavenger Guild, the strongest guild in the USA. She is a composed individual who rarely ever shows any emotion.

151807.name: Sin Sang
151807.desc: Statue of God is the hidden boss of the Double Dungeon. It is first introduced during the D-Rank Dungeon Arc as Jin-Woo and other hunters entered the Cartenon Temple unaware of the dangers that were present inside.

151807.name: Kyu-Hwan Jo
151807.desc: Cho Kyuhwan is a C-rank Hunter and a member of Dongsuk Hwang's raid party.

151807.name: Sang-Min Ahn
151807.desc: Sangmin Ahn is the chief of the White Tiger Guild's 2nd Division Management Department.

151807.name: Dong-Suk Hwang
151807.desc: Hwang Dongsuk is a C-rank Hunter and the older brother of [Dong-Su Hwang](https://anilist.co/character/136075/DongSu-Hwang).

151807.name: Beom-Shik Park
151807.desc: Park Gi-Sool is a Korean D-Rank Hunter and a good friend of Sangshik Kim. ~!He was tragically killed during the first Double Dungeon Incident when a statue sliced him clean in half from behind.!~

151807.name: Sang-Sik Kim
151807.desc: Sang-Sik Kim is a Korean D-Rank Hunter. ~!He was a survivor of the Double Dungeon. He was tragically killed by [Tae-Shik Kang](https://anilist.co/character/181155/TaeShik-Kang) after accidentally witnessing him kill a man during a raid.!~

151807.name: Cheol-Jin Lee
151807.desc: Korean C-Rank Hunter and a member of Dong-Suk Hwang's strike squad.

151807.name: Myung-Hwan Go
151807.desc: Myung-Hwan Go is a Korean C-Rank Hunter under the White Tiger Guild.

151807.name: Ki-Cheol Hyeon
151807.desc: Kichul Hyun is the deputy manager of the White Tiger Guild's 2nd Division Management Department and Sangimn Ahn's assistant.

151807.name: Eun-Seok
151807.desc: Former Korean S-Rank Hunter. ~!About one year before the events of the main storyline, Eunseok participated in the 3rd Jeju Island Raid alongside Baek Yoonho and Min Byung-Gyu. Unfortunately, the raid went sideways and Eunseok was killed under unknown circumstances.!~

151807.name: Bo-Ra Lee
151807.desc: A-Rank Mage from the Hunters Guild who specializes in summoning magic.⁣ She is straightforward, very meticulous, and believes that the only way to overcome difficulties is by laying out the known facts.

131681.name: Mikasa Ackerman
131681.original: ミカサ・アッカーマン
131681.desc: __Height:__ 170 cm (5'7") - 176 cm (5'9½") __Position:__ 104th Training Corps, Survey Corps __Relatives:__ [Birth Mother](https://anilist.co/character/84341/Mikasa-no-Haha) (Deceased), [Birth Father](https://anilist.co/character/84339/Mikasa-no-Chichi) (Deceased), [Grisha Yaeger](https://anilist.co/character/62477/Grisha-Yeager) (Foster Father), [Carla Yaeger](https://anilist.co/character/62475/Carla-Yeager) (Foster Mother, Deceased), [Eren Yeager](https://anilist.co/character/40882/Eren-Yeager) (Foster Brother) Mikasa is Eren Yaeger's foster sister and mutual childhood friend of [Armin Arlert](https://anilist.co/character/46494), living with the two of them in Shiganshina District within the southern region of Wall Maria. When she was young, her parents were killed by human traffickers, and she was kidnapped. Eren discovered this and helped her escape her captors. Later, Eren gave her his scarf, which she constantly wears and shares an emotional attachment to. She was adopted by the Yaeger family soon after. Because of these past events, Mikasa shares an unbreakable bond with Eren and lives to protect him, constantly worrying for Eren's well-being. After the Titans broke through Wall Maria and killed her and Eren's mother, she chose to follow Eren into the military to try and keep him safe from danger. Even as a child, Mikasa possessed impressive fighting skill and strength, and that skill was only honed further during her training. Mikasa is considered a genius among all th

131681.name: Eren Yeager
131681.desc: __Height:__ 170 cm (5'7") - 183 cm (6'0") __Affiliation:__ 104th Trainees Squad, Survey Corps. Eren was born to [Carla](https://anilist.co/character/62475/Yeager-Carla) and [Grisha Yeager](https://anilist.co/character/62477/Yeager-Grisha) in Shiganshina District within the southern region of Wall Maria. He grew up in the town with his parents and foster sister [Mikasa](https://anilist.co/character/40881/Ackerman-Mikasa), who moved in with the Yeagers as a child. Eren spent most of his time with Mikasa and their mutual best friend [Armin Arlert](https://anilist.co/character/46494/Arlert-Armin), whom the pair often defended from neighborhood bullies. Eren is a passionate, determined, hardheaded, and impulsive young man. When they were children, Armin showed him a book depicting the wonders of the outside world. Eren grew to share Armin's curiosity of the world beyond the Walls and resolved to see it for himself. This dream inspired his admiration of the Survey Corps and his desire to join their ranks as soon as he became eligible for enrollment. When the Titans suddenly broke through Wall Maria into Shiganshina, Eren was forced to watch on as his mother became trapped under the rubble of their house and eaten by a titan. Forever changed from this event, Eren vows to kill every last titan.

131681.name: Levi
131681.desc: __Height:__ 160 cm (5'3") Squad Captain of the Special Operations Squad (known as Squad Levi) within the Survey Corps. He is known as humanity's strongest soldier. Levi is abrasive, blunt, and has a strong respect for structure and discipline. He is a clean-freak, demanding spotless cleanliness of himself, his equipment, and his environment. Rumors say he was involved in underground crime in his life before coming a soldier. Despite his emotionless and unfriendly demeanor, Levi cares deeply for his squad and greatly values human life.

131681.name: Sasha Blouse
131681.desc: __Initial Height:__ 168cm __Affiliations__: 104th Cadet Corps, Survey Corps; Soldier __Relatives__: [Artur Blouse](https://anilist.co/character/131281/Artur-Blouse) (Father), [Lisa Blouse](https://anilist.co/character/134952/Lisa-Blouse) (Mother) Originally from Dauper, a remote and scarcely populated village of hunters located in a mountain forest in the southern area of Wall Rose, Sasha joined the military as a cadet of the 104th Training Corps, where she ranked 9th upon graduation. After graduating, she'd choose to enlist in the Scouting Regiment. Sasha is a friendly and fun-loving girl. She speaks with a local accent from her home village, but initially hid it out of embarrassment by using overly formal and polite speech. She is a constant food hoarder and is known to have an incredible appetite; eating provided her with considerable gratification and relief, especially during times of great stress, and food was often the only thing on her mind when at ease. Raised as an animal hunter, Sasha specializes in archery, horseback riding, and tracking, although her eccentricity and unconventional methods tend to make her a poor fit for group operations. ~!She later saves a child named [Kaya](https://anilist.co/character/132738/Kaya) from a titan attack, who her family ends up adopting.!~

131681.name: Reiner Braun
131681.desc: __Height__: 185 cm (6'1") Member of the Survey Corps and former cadet of the 104th Training Corps. Reiner is a passionate and strong-willed young man with a strong sense of duty. He ranked 2nd in his training class upon graduation, finishing behind only [Mikasa](https://anilist.co/character/40881). His comrades have great trust in him, and he is stated to be the "big brother" of the 104th cadets.

131681.name: Connie Springer
131681.original: コニー・スプリンガー
131681.desc: __Height__: 158 cm (5'2") __Relatives:__ [Mother](https://anilist.co/character/137287/Conny-no-Haha), Martin Springer (Brother), Sunny Springer (Sister) Connie Springer is a graduate of the 104th Training Corps, having ranked 8th in class. He is known to be one of the quickest soldiers while using ODM gear and is skilled at making very sharp turns. He hails from the rural Ragako Village within Wall Rose, his greatest ambition being to make his family and village proud of him. Upon graduation, he chose to join the Survey Corps. Upbeat and naive, Connie is rather unfocused outside of combat, and enjoys goofing around and messing with his friends, but can also be a bit dense at times, as he can have some difficulty comprehending new developments as they appear. Connie always tries to remain optimistic, consistently caring for the well-being of his friends, family and village, and being willing to help in any way he can. However, this soft spot and the struggles he goes through as a member of the Survey Corps takes a toll on him, as he often responds to grief and loss with anger, irritation and hatred, causing him to at times make rash, impulsive decisions. He will do anything to protect his family, whether it be his biological family or his closest friends.

131681.name: Bertolt Hoover
131681.original: ベルトルト・フーバー
131681.desc: __Height__: 192 cm (6'3") __Affiliation__: Survey Corps Member of the Survey Corps and former cadet of the 104th Training Corps. Bertoldt ranked 3rd in his training class upon graduation, finishing behind only [Mikasa](https://anilist.co/character/40881) and his hometown friend [Reiner](https://anilist.co/character/46484). He is a quiet young man who identifies himself as someone with a weak will that follows popular opinion. Despite ranking 3rd in his class, his training commandant noted him to be a person with great potential, but an utter lack of initiative. Bertoldt originally he enlisted in the military with aspirations of joining the Military Police and living in the safety of the inner wall, but after the Battle of Trost he instead decided to join the Survey Corps.

131681.name: Annie Leonhart
131681.desc: __Height__: 153 cm (5") A member of the 104th Southern Division in the Cadet Corps. After graduating from the 104th, ranked 4th place in the top 10, she ends up joining the Military Police. She is roommates with [Hitch Dreyse](https://anilist.co/character/86017). A stoic girl, Annie is considered to be an isolated, solitary type, being rarely seen smiling or socializing and often having an emotionless expression. She is apathetic and somnolent, with little desire to put in any effort into meaningless disciplines or activities. Nonetheless, what drives Annie more than anything is her desire for a normal life.

131681.name: Hannes
131681.desc: A soldier who saves Eren and Mikasa during the prologue. He owes a debt to the Yeager family.

131681.name: Armin Arlert
131681.original: アルミン・アルレルト
131681.desc: __Height:__ 163 cm (5'4") __Position:__ 104th Trainees Squad, Survey Corps __Relatives:__ [Grandfather](https://anilist.co/character/84313/Armin-no-Ojiisan) Armin is a young boy who was born and raised in the Shiganshina District within the walls, being childhood friends with both [Eren Yeager](https://anilist.co/character/40882/Eren-Yeager) and [Mikasa Ackerman](https://anilist.co/character/40881). After Wall Maria was breached, he chose to join Mikasa and Eren in joining the military, both to try to make a good and meaningful impact on the world, and to fulfill his dream of seeing the outside world. Even when he was young, the naturally curious Armin has always had a deep fascination with the world beyond the Walls. As a child, he found and studied an illegal book about the outside world that was owned by his grandfather. He often shared the book and information contained in it with Eren Yeager, his best friend, and his dreams of seeing the world outside the walls. Armin was branded a heretic by other children for his unusual interest in the outside world and was thus frequently picked on. Too timid to defend himself, Armin would often rely on his friends Eren and Mikasa Ackerman to protect him from local bullies. This, coupled with his frail physique, was a deep shame for Armin, leading him to have poor self-esteem and to believe that he is a burden to others. Because of this, Armin has always been very eager to prove his worth, especially towards his close friends. Armin

131681.name: Erwin Smith
131681.desc: **Height:** 188 cm **Position:** 13th Commander, Survey Corps Discerning, intelligent, and widely respected, Erwin is the unshakable and calculated 13th commander of the Survey Corps. While he cares deeply for his men, he does not hesitate to sacrifice them for the good and prosperity of mankind, and his men have proven more than willing to stake their lives at his order. Erwin developed the Long-Distance Enemy Scouting Formation.

131681.name: Jean Kirstein
131681.original: ジャン・キルシュタイン
131681.desc: __Height__: 175 cm (5'8") __Relatives__: [Mother](https://anilist.co/character/131444/Jean-no-Haha) Jean Kirschtein is a graduate of the 104th Cadet Corps, among whom he ranked 6th for his skills with ODM gear and ability to look at things through a more tactical lense. Jean hails from Wall Rose's Trost District, and joined the military with hopes of living a peaceful life within the walls as part of the Military Police. However, he would later find himself joining the Survey Corps after being convinced both by his close friend [Marco Bott's](https://anilist.co/character/62479/Marco-Bott) words, and after witnessing the death of several of his comrades. Jean has a blunt personality. He holds no restraint when it comes to speaking his mind, even when he knows it would not be wise to do so or when it could spark conflict. Jean is also pragmatic: he has a strong aversion to exposing himself to dangerous situations. During his time as a cadet, Jean was extremely hot-headed, easily becoming frustrated and quick to resort to violence when pushed. Jean was also very cynical about defeating the Titans, believing that humanity has no chance against them and openly mocking more idealistic individuals like [Eren Yeager](https://anilist.co/character/40882/Eren-Yeager), and saw resisting the Titans as a hopeless cause. However, despite these things, and although he presents himself as self-centered, Jean places high value on the lives of his comrades, and is willing to risk his life to pr

131681.name: Carla Yeager
131681.desc: Eren's mother. ~!She's eaten alive in the second chapter.!~ Note: Carla Yeager is the official English translation by Kodansha.

131681.name: Grisha Yeager
131681.original: グリシャ・イェーガー
131681.desc: Father of [Eren Yaeger](https://anilist.co/character/40882/Eren-Yeager) and caretaker of [Mikasa Ackerman](https://anilist.co/character/40881/Mikasa-Ackerman). He is a renowned doctor who was well respected in the District of Shiganshina after he saved the village from a mysterious viral epidemic by developing vaccines. He also provides a medical house call service to the people of Shiganshina and to various towns in addition to having a network of contacts within the Corps of the Shiganshina District. He is married to [Carla Yaeger](https://anilist.co/character/62475). ~!In the basement of the Yeager family house, he hides a secret which he refers to as the "truth". Upon finding Eren after the fall of Wall Maria, he injects him with a series of chemicals and amnesiacs and entrusts him with the key to the "truth", before mysteriously disappearing. This strange serum resulted in Eren gaining the ability to transform into a titan.!~

131681.name: Marco Bott
131681.desc: __Height__: 178 cm (5'9") __Affiliations__: 104th Training Corps Originally from Jinae District. Marco ranked 7th in the 104th Training Corps and is widely respected by other cadets of the 104th. Marco is a very kind, calm, and idealistic person, valuing the good of the group above his own interests, as well as understanding and coping with his own shortcomings and limitations. He is seen as a natural leader, and desires to join the Military Police to serve near the King. *Note: Marco Bott is the official English translation by Kodansha.*

131681.name: Krista Lenz
131681.desc: __Height__: 145 cm (4'8") __Affiliations__: 104th Trainees Squad, Survey Corps Ranked tenth in the trainee class, Krista is a very shy and kind, caring person, often being described as a "goddess" or "angel" by her peers. She is good friends with [Ymir](https://anilist.co/character/71479/Ymir).

131681.name: Dot Pixis
131681.desc: The highest-ranked Administrator of the Southern Region. Head of the Garrison's Southern Territories, Pixis is a cunning leader with astute insights. However, he is also an alcoholic who is constantly watched over by his aid, [Anka](https://anilist.co/character/84331/Anka-Rheinberger), who constantly scolds him for sleeping and drinking during critical moments.

131681.name: Petra Ral
131681.desc: __Height:__ 158 cm (5'2") __Affiliation:__ Survey Corps; Soldier, Special Operations Squad. __Relatives:__ [Father](https://anilist.co/character/131987/Petra-no-Chichi) Petra Ral is a soldier of the Survey Corps hand-picked by [Captain Levi](https://anilist.co/character/45627/Levi) to join the Special Operations Squad. Petra is a very kind and caring woman, going out of her way to look after and guiding [Eren Yaeger](https://anilist.co/character/40882/Eren-Yeager) when he was first admitted to the squad. She seemed to have the most attachment to Eren among Levi Squad, as she was often the only one shown to actually worry about him and his wellbeing, at least at first. Although all of Levi's squad wished for Eren's unconditional trust, it was ultimately Petra who convinced him to do so. Despite her kind nature, Petra was a conditioned soldier with a quick reaction time against perceived danger. She displays extreme loyalty to her leaders, superiors and their orders, and cares deeply for her team, although she tends to be at odds with [Oluo Bozad](https://anilist.co/character/71687/Oluo-Bozard) due to his irritating tendency to try and imitate Levi. She greatly looks up to Levi as her superior and is deeply devoted to him, willing to completely dedicate her life to his cause. It is implied that she may harbor romantic feelings for her captain.

131681.name: Mike Zacharias
131681.desc: Squad Captain of his own squad, Squad Mike, a major division within the Survey Corps. He has been described by others as "humanity's second strongest soldier", being only behind [Levi](https://anilist.co/character/45627/Levi). Mike is an extremely strong and durable soldier and an acknowledged leader with a brave heart and a tactical mind. He also has a remarkably good sense of smell, which allows him to detect Titans from great distances. During times of ease, Mike is shown to be a quiet and reserved man, rarely speaking unless it concerned a more serious matter. He also has a bizarre habit of "sniffing" people when he meets them.

131681.name: Hange Zoe
131681.desc: __Height:__ 170 cm (5'7") __Affiliation:__ Survey Corps; Section Commander, Squad Leader. Leader of the Survey Corps' Fourth Squad, Hange is also in charge of conducting research on Titans, and pursues this knowledge so passionately that they have become obsessed with Titans as a result. After originally holding a deep hatred for the creatures, Hange decided to take on a new outside-the-box approach to their research by letting go of their resentment towards Titans and approaching the test subjects with compassion. Hange is an energetic, freethinking and quirky scientist, with a unique way of conducting both themselves and their work. Hange is a genius outside of just Titan research too, using their brain to create weapons, tactical plans, and inventions for the benefit of humanity. As a leader, Hange is thoughtful of their comrades, and can easily figure out complex problems in order to create plans for their teammates to carry out.

131681.name: Nile Dok
131681.desc: Chief of the Military Police.

131681.name: Dieter Ness
131681.desc: A member of the Scout Regiment and a team leader in the 57th Exterior Scouting Mission. ~!He encounters the Female Titan, who catches Ness's line and whips it to the ground, killing him instantly.!~

131681.name: Luke Siss
131681.desc: Luke Siss was a skilled member of the Survey Corps and a participant during the 57th Expedition Outside the Walls.

131681.name: Ymir
131681.desc: __Height:__ 172 cm (5'7") __Affiliations:__ 104th Trainees Squad, Scouting Legion Member of the Scouting Legion. She seems selfish, cynical, bossy, sly, uncooperative, exploitative, and confrontational, but she can apparently be kind, especially to [Krista](https://anilist.co/character/62481/Krista-Lenz).

131681.name: Eld Gin
131681.desc: __Height:__ 182 cm (6'0") Eld Gin is an elite soldier in the Survey Corps. He was hand-picked by [Captain Levi](https://anilist.co/character/45627/Levi) and placed in the Special Operations Squad, of which he is second-in-command. Eld is a responsible and firm leader with a strong sense of duty. He does not talk much, but when he does, he did so bluntly and in a straightforward manner. He also seems to have been a veteran of sorts as he teased [Petra Ral](https://anilist.co/character/62501) and [Oluo Bozad](https://anilist.co/character/71687/Oluo-Bozard) about how they acted during their first expedition. He also seems to hold some sort of belief of what makes a true soldier, saying that a kill record alone does not make a great soldier.

131681.name: Gunther Schultz
131681.desc: __Height:__ 183 cm (6'0") __Relatives:__ [Mother](https://anilist.co/character/131990/Gunther-no-Haha), [Grandfather](https://anilist.co/character/131986/Gunther-no-Ojsan). Gunther Schultz is one of the Survey Corps soldiers hand-picked by [Captain Levi](https://anilist.co/character/45627/Levi) to join the Special Operations Squad, both for his strength and his distrust for [Eren Yaeger](https://anilist.co/character/40882/Eren-Yeager). Being a soldier of the Survey Corps who survived multiple encounters with Titans significantly affected Gunther's personality, making him deeply obedient and loyal to his superiors. Within the Special Operations Squad, Gunther seems to be the most reasonable one. However, he is shown to get irritated when his comrades joke around with one another, showing he also possesses a stern side and does not take kindly if a soldier doesn't focus on the task at hand.

131681.name: Keith Shadis
131681.original: キース・シャーディス
131681.desc: Keith Shadis was the head instructor of the 104th Trainees Squad. He seemed to be a friend or have some sort of relationship with Dr. Grisha, as he knew Eren is the son of the doctor and praised Eren for his effort.

131681.name: Samuel Linke-Jackson
131681.original: サムエル・リンケ-ジャクソン
131681.desc: Samuel is a member of the 104th Trainees Squad. He appears in Ch. 3. When the Colossal Titan appears outside Trost District, the burst of steam from its body knocks a number of trainees off the Wall. While most are able to switch to their Three Dimensional Maneuver Gear and anchor themselves to the Wall, Samuel is struck in the head by a piece of falling rock and stunned. Sasha saves him from falling to his death by firing one of her grappling hooks into his leg. Eren tells Sasha to take Samuel somewhere safe, then instructs the other trainees to attack the Colossal Titan. ~!He is killed by Connie after being shot three times in the head.!~

131681.name: Franz Kefka
131681.desc: Franz is a member of the 104th Trainees Squad. Franz first appears Ch.3 in walking through Trost District with Eren and Hannah. Eren refers to Hannah and Franz as a couple, which they both embarrassedly deny. ~!At some point following the breach of the Wall by the Colossal Titan, Franz is attacked by a Titan. He is bitten in half and dies. Armin finds Hannah futilely attempting CPR on what remains of Franz's corpse. He tells her it's useless, and advises her to retreat to the Wall before it's too late.!~ (Source: Shingeki no Kyojin Wikia)

131681.name: Daz
131681.desc: Daz is a member of the 104th Trainees Squad. ~!In Ch. 40, Ymir and Historia Reiss recount a story about Dazz from training. Wanting praise and recognition, Dazz undertook harsh physical training in the snowy mountains. However, he wasn't strong enough to endure it, and nearly died. Ymir told Krista to leave him behind or her own life would be endangered; when Krista refused, Ymir used her Titan shifter powers to bring Dazz back to the camp safely. In Ch. 12, when Dot Pixis announces the plan to reconquer Trost District, Dazz has a breakdown and starts screaming that he doesn't want to die. Though Marco Bott tries to quiet him, a commanding officer overhears and threatens to execute him. Dazz replies that execution would be better then being eaten by a Titan. However, Dot Pixis then announces that all deserters will be pardoned -- but have to live with the guilt that they abandoned their families to the Titans. Dazz is unable to leave his family to that fate, and returns to participate in the operation to plug the breach. After the mission, he briefly appears in Chapter 21 standing next to Sasha Blouse when Irvin Smith gives a speech urging the 104th Training Squad members to join the Scouting Legion. As he is not present in the group of trainees who join, he presumably opted for the Stationary Guard instead.!~ (Source: Shingeki no Kyojin Wikia)

131681.name: Ian Dietrich
131681.original: イアン・ディートリッヒ
131681.desc: Ian is a member of the Stationary Guard in Trost District. Ian first appears in Ch. 5 after Trost District is breached by the Colossal Titan. He compliments Mikasa for killing a Titan that was attacking a group of evacuating civilians. ~!In Ch. 12, a plan is formed for Eren to use his Titan powers to seal the breach with a boulder. Ian is placed in charge of the elite squad assigned to protect Eren on his mission. When Eren loses control of his Titan form in Ch. 13, Mitabi and Rico advise Ian to abort the mission and retreat. However, Ian orders his soldiers to continue to defend Eren down to the last man, as Eren is their only hope against the Titans. In Ch. 14, Eren regains his senses due to Armin's intervention, and Ian orders his soldiers to protect him until he reaches the breach even at the cost of their own lives. Ian uses himself as bait to lure Titans away from Eren, sacrificing his life in order to ensure the success of the mission.!~ (Source: Shingeki no Kyojin Wikia)

131681.name: Hitch Dreyse
131681.desc: **Height:** 168 cm __Affiliations:__ 104th Cadet Corps. Recruit of the Military Police stationed in Stohess District. She was roommates with [Annie Leonhart](https://anilist.co/character/46490/Annie-Leonhart). Hitch acts immature in certain ways, she has a sarcastic, easygoing personality and seems to mischievously enjoy teasing and needling her fellow officers, especially [Marlo Freudenberg](https://anilist.co/character/71457/Marlo-Freudenberg). She claims she chose to join the Military Police out of laziness, as it is well known that the senior staff are incredibly corrupt and she wanted to benefit from the system herself; however, she did not take into account that, as a new recruit, her superiors would dump all their work on her. Though she may act a bit air-headed at times, Hitch is not selfish and cares about those around her, especially her fellow comrades.

131681.name: Pieck Finger
131681.desc: __Height__: 155 cm Pieck is an Eldian who serves as one of Marley's Warriors. She is shown to be somewhat sweet and kind, consistently shown to care about her fellow Warriors and the Warrior candidates. ~!She is the current inheritor of the Cart Titan.!~

131681.name: Gabi Braun
131681.desc: __Height__: 138 cm Gabi Braun is an Eldian living in the Liberio internment zone and the cousin of [Reiner Braun](https://anilist.co/character/46484/Reiner-Braun). She is friends with her fellow warrior candidates [Udo](https://anilist.co/character/125663), [Zofia](https://anilist.co/character/125664/Zofia), and [Falco Grice](https://anilist.co/character/125660). Gabi is very passionate and head-strong, expressing her emotions and opinions without inhibition. She is also brave, possessing boundless determination, and willing to put her life on the line to complete a goal for a perceived greater good. However, these attributes can also make her somewhat overbearing and domineering. This causes her to be tactless at times, forcing her opinions on others and taking charge regardless of whether it was asked for or not. She mostly shows this side around her fellow Warrior candidates, considering herself their de facto leader to an extent, and even threatening to 'punish' them when they disagree with her. Nonetheless, she is friendly enough that they have no issue with spending their leisure time with her. Aside from her resolve and determination, Gabi is care-free even on the battlefield, making remarks about her cuteness and claiming her commander loves her too much to sacrifice her. ~!She is a Warrior candidate that is likely to inherit the Armored Titan.!~

131681.name: Falco Grice
131681.desc: __Height__: 140 cm __Position__: Warrior Candidate Falco Grice is an Eldian Warrior candidate working for the Marley government and is the younger brother of [Colt Grice](https://anilist.co/character/125665/Colt-Grice). Falco is close friends with his fellow warrior candidates; [Udo](https://anilist.co/character/125663/Udo), [Zofia](https://anilist.co/character/125664/Zofia), and [Gabi](https://anilist.co/character/125659/Gabi-Braun). While not as physically strong as his fellow soldiers, he makes up for it with his quick wit and improvisation. He is a very merciful and compassionate person, going out of his way to protect and save other people lives, even enemy soldiers. He is also very polite and respectful towards others, and is an empathetic person, being willing to hear people out and properly understand things from their points of view. ~!He is a candidate to inherit the power of the Armored Titan. He has the desire to become the Armored Titan in order to prevent Gabi Braun from inheriting it, as he has a crush on her and wants them to live a long life.!~

131681.name: Zeke
131681.desc: __Height__: 183 cm Zeke is the current inheritor of the Beast Titan, and is considered by [Reiner Braun](https://anilist.co/character/46484/Reiner-Braun) to be the strongest Warrior, contrasting [Levi's](https://anilist.co/character/45627/Levi) title of "humanity's strongest soldier".

131681.name: Porco Galliard
131681.desc: __Height:__ 175 cm __Position:__ Marley's Warrior Porco Galliard is an Eldian and the younger brother of Marcel Galliard. ~!He is one of Marley's Warriors and inherited the Jaw Titan from Ymir.!~

131681.name: Colt Grice
131681.desc: __Height__: 180 cm __Position__: Warrior Candidate Colt Grice is an Eldian living in Marley and the older brother of [Falco Grice](https://anilist.co/character/125660). ~!He is a Warrior candidate who is selected to be the next wielder of the Beast Titan power.!~

131681.name: Nifa
131681.desc: __Height:__ 165 cm (5'5") Nifa is a soldier in the Survey Corps' Fourth Squad under the command of [Hange Zoe](https://anilist.co/character/71121/Hange-Zoe). Nifa appears to be a loyal and trustworthy member of Fourth Squad, as she is often tasked to record the details of important meetings and entrusted to deliver vital information to others within the Scouting Regiment. She acts serious most of the time, however, she has been seen drinking alcoholic beverages before giving out more intense reports and info.

131681.name: Rod Reiss
131681.desc: ~!is the true king of humanity, currently masquerading as a noble living in Wall Sina. He is a member of the Reiss family and Historia's illegitimate father.!~

131681.name: Frieda Reiss
131681.desc: Frieda was Rod Reiss' eldest daughter and Historia's oldest half-sister. ~!She was the true queen of humanity from 842 to 845. She is known to appear in Eren and Historia's obtained memories. In his Titan form, Grisha invaded an underground cavern under the Reiss family chapel, where the family had gathered to pray. He battled Frieda and consumed her, thus gaining her powers and memories. He then slaughtered her mother and siblings, and finally destroyed the chapel. When Eren later eats Grisha, Frieda's memories are transferred to him along with Grisha's.!~

131681.name: Abel
131681.desc: Goggles is a soldier in the Scout Regiment fourth squad under the command of Hange Zoë, who is noted for his trademark glasses, or "goggles". He participated in the 57th Exterior Scouting Mission and often accompanies higher ups, such as Hange and Levi, on serious missions. (Source: Shingeki no Kyojin Wikia)

131681.name: Marcel Galliard
131681.original: マルセル・ガリアード
131681.desc: ~!Marcel was a comrade and childhood friend of Reiner Braun, Bertolt Hoover, and Annie Leonhart. He was part of the group sent by Marley to attack the Eldians of Paradis in year 845, but his mission was cut short by the sudden appearance of Ymir in her mindless Titan form.!~ (Source: Shingeki no Kyojin Wikia)

131681.name: Floch Forster
131681.original: フロック・フォルスター
131681.desc: Floch is a new recruit in the Survey Corps. He joined the Survey Corps during the two months between the attack at Orvud District and the return to Shiganshina District. ~!After the rest of the Yeagerists are killed during the port battle, Floch hides on the ship to Marley. After shooting holes in the fuel tank of the flying boat, Floch is ultimately killed by Mikasa.!~

131681.name: Fritz
131681.desc: He is the king of the wall. ~!he was a puppet king who acted as a substitute for Rod Reiss, the real king at the time. He is arrested after the coup d'état.!~

131681.name: Annie no Chichi
131681.desc: Father and trainer of Annie Leonhart. He relentlessly trained Annie to fight, using mostly kicks and the attacker's weight against them. ~!Memories of his pleas for forgiveness later create an opening for Annie to crystallize herself before Eren Jaeger has the chance to capture her!~

131681.name: Artur Blouse
131681.original: アルトゥル・ブラウス
131681.desc: __Relatives:__ [Lisa Blause](https://anilist.co/character/134952/Lisa-Blouse) (Wife), [Sasha Blause](https://anilist.co/character/45887/Sasha-Blouse) (Daughter). Artur Blouse is the father of Sasha Blouse and a hunter in the Dauper village. It was his words that motivated Sasha to leave home and join the military. Artur appears to be a mature father figure who is deeply devoted to his clan. Though he appreciates his way of life, he realizes that many people's homes were taken by Titans and that they must share the forest for the greater good. He appears to be very wise, willing to accept change and move beyond their traditions if it meant a better way of life for everyone, and is very clearly a selfless person who puts others before himself. Like his daughter, he has a native Dauper accent. ~!ㅤ After his daughter Sasha saved [Kaya](https://anilist.co/character/132738/Kaya), he and his wife decided to adopt her and open their home up to other orphaned children whose family was slain by the titans, going so far as to refer to them as his "family."!~

131681.name: Theo Magath
131681.desc: A commander of the Eldian Unit of the Marley army. Formerly one of the chief overseers of the first Warrior candidates during their training, he later led the Eldian Warriors in the Marley Mid-East War against the Mid-East Allied Forces, playing a key role in Marley's victory. ~!Through the support of Willy Tybur and the governmental party of Marley, along with the death of General Calvi, Magath is next in line to become the general of the Marleyan military forces.!~ ~!He sacrifices himself by blowing up the Marleyan ship to prevent the Yeagerists from catching the allies!~ (Source: Attack on Titan Wiki)

131681.name: Kaya
131681.desc: A civilian living within Wall Rose. She was saved by Sasha Blouse from a Titan during the Wall Rose invasion, and now lives with the Blouse family.

131681.name: Yelena
131681.desc: Yelena is the leader of the Anti-Marleyan Volunteers working under [Zeke Yeager](https://anilist.co/character/125661/Zeke). She was one of the Marleyan soldiers on board the first survey fleet to Paradis Island after Marley's failed attack operation. She is a very tall woman with her blonde hair styled in a short bob with straight bangs. She has large dark eyes and somewhat androgynous features due to her build and style. Yelena is a fervent follower of Zeke Yeager, holding great admiration and respect for him. She is usually calm and collected, her demeanour remaining unchanged even when [Jean Kirstein](https://anilist.co/character/46498/Kirstein-Jean) yelled at her for failing to see her job through. Nonetheless, she is willing to take responsibility and apologizes should she fail in her task. Yelena appears to maintain a very relaxed demeanour while having dry, humorous undertones to much of her actions. ~!It is later revealed that Yelena was born into an unassuming family in Marley, and eventually became disillusioned with her own country. After meeting Zeke Yeager, Yelena concocted a plan to solidify herself in history by helping Zeke save the world. As part of her narrative, Yelena created a false background for herself, claiming that her homeland was invaded and conquered by Marley. She was forcibly drafted as a soldier to fight in the Marleyan military, where she met similar-minded soldiers and organized them into the Anti-Marleyan Volunteers to fight against Marley.!

131681.name: Niccolo
131681.desc: Nicolo is a former Marleyan soldier who served on Marley's Navy and was part of the first survey fleet to Paradis Island after the failed Paradis Island Operation. After being taken captive, he begins working on the island as a chef for the military. Niccolo was at first a very typical Marleyan, fearing the Eldians of Paradis Island and calling them devils. He was very disgusted with having been captured by them and having to live by their side, but after spending a lot of time with the Survey Corps, he and his comrades have developed grudging respect and shaky friendships with the ones they once thought of as devils. He notably grew a soft spot for a Survey Corp member, [Sasha Blouse](https://anilist.co/character/45887/Sasha-Blouse), after she complimented him on his cooking skills. Over time, the two gradually grew closer, enough for [Kaya](https://anilist.co/character/132738/Kaya) to believe they were in love. Niccolo credits Sasha with saving him from the war and teaching him that he can cook to make people happy.

131681.name: Lisa Blouse
131681.desc: The mother of [Sasha Blouse](https://anilist.co/character/45887/Sasha-Blouse) and wife of [Mr. Blouse](https://anilist.co/character/131281).

131681.name: Onyankopon
131681.desc: Onyankopon is one of the Anti-Marleyan Volunteers and aids the Survey Corps during the Raid on Liberio. He pilots an airship following orders from [Hange](https://anilist.co/character/71121/) for the Corps to use during their retreat.

131681.name: Koslow
131681.desc: He is a Marleyan officer who fought in the war against the Mid-East Allied Forces before Marley's victory. (Source: Attack on Titan Wiki)

131681.name: Ymir Fritz
131681.desc: Ymir Fritz was the progenitor of the Eldians. When she was a young girl, she awakened the power of the Titans and became the first Titan, the Founding Titan. After she died, her spirit was split into the Nine Titans. She is observed to be a quiet character that does not reveal her true intentions/motives. ~! She submitted to the Eldian king in life, building him his empire, brutally destroying his enemies, and bearing his children as he commanded. Ymir even went so far as to sacrifice her own life for his. Even in death, her soul remained blindly obedient to the Eldian royal family, creating Titans by hand for about 2,000 years in the unknown land surrounding the Coordinate. She has only shown signs of embracing her own free will after she encountered Eren Yeager. However, it is possible she always had some free will, as she had intentionally freed a group of pigs from their pen and let them run free as a slave. According to Eren, Ymir waited thousands of years for someone to come to her and free her from the love she felt for King Fritz. That person was Mikasa. !~ (Source: Attack on Titan Wiki)

131681.name: Karina Braun
131681.desc: Karina Braun is the mother of [Reiner Braun](https://anilist.co/character/46484/).

131681.name: Kiyomi Azumabito
131681.desc: Kiyomi is an ambassador of Hizuru and an ally to the Eldians on Paradis Island.

131681.name: Louise
131681.desc: A young girl who was in Trost with her mother attempting to flee when the Titans invaded. After being saved by [Mikasa Ackerman](https://anilist.co/character/40881/Mikasa-Ackerman) and the other 104th Cadets, she was inspired by their heroic actions and later joins the military herself as a Survey Corps recruit, hoping to get closer to Mikasa, her idol. Louise believes that strength is the most important attribute one can have in the world, to the point that she almost seems to have a "might equals right" mentality. Much of this mindset stems from her experiences during the Battle of Trost District, where she claims to have learned from watching Mikasa Ackerman fight in the face of adversity to achieve victory. She believes that the ends justify the means, and has no qualms about breaking rules if she believes that disobeying others will get her what she wants.

131681.name: Roeg
131681.desc: High ranking Military Police Regiment soldier.

131681.name: Surma
131681.desc: A member of the Jaegerists and a former cadet of the 109th Cadet Corps.

131681.name: Maria Fritz
131681.desc: ~!Tthe eldest daughter of Ymir Fritz the Founder. She would later become the namesake of the outermost wall of Karl Fritz's three Titan Walls, Wall Maria.!~

131681.name: Rose Fritz
131681.desc: ~!Tthe second daughter of Ymir Fritz the Founder. She would later become the namesake of the middle wall of Karl Fritz's three Titan Walls, Wall Rose!~

131681.name: Sina Fritz
131681.desc: ~!The youngest daughter of Ymir Fritz the Founder. She would later become the namesake of the innermost wall of Karl Fritz's three Titan Walls, Wall Sina!~

131681.name: Fritz
131681.desc: ~!He was the king of Eldia around 2,000 years ago. When one of his slaves, Ymir, gained the Power of the Titans, he used her to expand Eldia into an empire and destroy his enemies. As a "reward," he made her his concubine and had three daughters with her. He and Ymir are the ancestors of every Subject of Ymir. Upon Ymir's death, Fritz forced his daughters to eat their mother's body to preserve her power. Upon his own death, he commanded his daughters to continue reproducing and eating each other, so that Ymir's people will never die out and Eldia could rule the world with its Titans forever.!~

131681.name: Abel Reiss
131681.desc: Abel Reiss was one of the younger daughters of [Rod Reiss](https://anilist.co/character/127360/Rod-Reiss) and his wife.

112641.name: Narrator
112641.desc: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

112641.name: Kaguya Shinomiya
112641.desc: __Height:__ 158 cm The vice president of the student council of Shuchiin Academy, member of the wealthy Shinomiya family, she is a multi-talented genius who can do anything if she sets her mind to it. Due to the way she was raised, she instinctively looks down on others and thinks of ways to use them for her own benefit. Kaguya rarely interacted with other people before she joined the student council, but that has begun to change. She is an incredibly sheltered girl, resulting in her lacking in several pieces of what might be considered common sense. She still doesn’t understand love very well, and her main objective is to make [Miyuki Shirogane](https://anilist.co/character/121101) fall in love and confess to her. Later in the series: ~!She confesses her love to Miyuki Shirogane and they start dating.!~ ~!In a Oshi no Ko special chapter, it was revealed that she married Miyuki and changed her surname to Kaguya Shirogane!~

112641.name: Miyuki Shirogane
112641.desc: __Height:__ 175 cm He is a second year student at Shuchi'in Academy and the president of the student council. Miyuki is a handsome young man with blond hair and blue eyes. Due to his constant sleep deprivation and nearsightedness, his eyes appear to glare. He usually wears the regular Shuchi'in Academy black male uniform adorned with the Aiguilette, the golden chain-like accessory around his neck. The Aiguilette symbolizes his authority as student council president. Shirogane is a diligent student who, despite his underprivileged background, climbed his way to the top of his class through hard work and determination. Shirogane holds himself in high regard, consistently working to maintain his perfect image. He is textbook workaholic, enjoying his part-time job and often putting his own health at risk for the sake of his work. Due to his poor background, Shirogane values money greatly and goes to great lengths to not be wasteful, and generally dislikes expensive gifts. ~!Miyuki's mother left his family when he was a child. Miyuki's father's factory was shut down and currently has no stable employment. They live in an apartment that costs ￥50,000 (Approx $450) a month. Due to this grisly past, he has been led to a lifestyle of part time jobs and hard work. He passed the Level 2 Kanji Kentei exam and has passed Grade Pre 1 on Eiken. He has also got second place on the National mock exam.!~ ~!Miyuki transferred into Shuchi'in Academy during his first year of high school on a scho

112641.name: Yuu Ishigami
112641.desc: The treasurer of the student council of the Shuchiin Academy. He's extremely valued by [Miyuki](https://anilist.co/character/121101), given that he single-handedly manages all the school's funds. He's also terrified of [Kaguya](https://anilist.co/character/120649), though no one else is sure why that is. Yuu keeps to himself and rarely speaks up, often getting into trouble when he does. He has a depressed outlook on life while having an inferiority complex. In contrast to his attitude, he is willing to help those in need and will sacrifice his pride if need be. Unlike his high school self, he had a much different outlook and demeanor during middle school. Later in the series: ~!Ishigami develops a crush on Tsubame that he inadvertently confesses his feelings for her at the school's cultural festival. Ishigami does not realize that his actions were perceived as a confession by the rest of the student body and is therefore oblivious to the implications of having given Tsubame a heart-shaped gift (considered akin to a confession in Shuchiin tradition). After some convincing by Kaguya, Tsubame decides to seriously consider Ishigami's confession, with her original intention being to let him down as gently as possible. It isn't until Ishigami watches Tsubame's performance of the traditional play that gave rise to the aforementioned tradition that he realizes his actions had unintended meaning. Even then, Ishigami's thickheaded nature prevented him from recognizing the full meaning

112641.name: Chika Fujiwara
112641.desc: The secretary of the Shuchiin Academy student council. She could not be predicted, her thoughts could not be read. A natural disaster who unconsciously threw everything into chaos simply by being present, also known as __Subject F__. ~!In chapter 222 of the manga, Chika reveals that she played piano because she wanted to be perfect, and she becomes a prodigy at the piano. The expectations of her family and her fans rose, forcing her to practice more. She quit piano after Kaguya told her to just quit if she didn't like the piano. Soon after Chika challenged Kaguya to a game battle and if she won, she would get to become Kaguya's friend. In the end, she becomes Kaguya's first friend.!~

112641.name: Ai Hayasaka
112641.desc: Ai Hayasaka is a second-year student at Shuchiin Academy and a valet of the Shinomiya family. She is a member of the Hayasaka family, who have served the Shinomiya family for generations, gaining their trust. Having been personally assigned to enter Shuchiin Academy with her, Ai supports [Kaguya Shinomiya](https://anilist.co/character/120649) in her high school life and has been a part of Kaguya's life for ten years. Because of their close relationship, Ai is one of the few people around to which Kaguya's amiability is not an act. Even if she demonstrates maturity as a valet, Ai still has the concerns of a young girl, such as caring to be in fashion and going out with friends, even if she does not have much time for herself due to work. Ai helps Kaguya with the struggles about her feelings for [Shirogane](https://anilist.co/character/121101). ~!She later leaves her job as a maid to Kaguya but still continues her friendship.!~ ~!In the Doujin-ban universe, she starts dating and later gets engaged to Shirogane!~

112641.name: Miko Iino
112641.desc: __Height:__ 147 cm (4'7") She is a freshman at Shuchiin Private Academy and the Auditor of the Student Council. Miko has a strong sense of justice and will correct others on what's right and wrong. Unfortunately, this led to her being bullied, though she still continues to uphold her idea of "right". She idolizes [Chika Fujiwara](https://anilist.co/character/121103), listening to anything she says, even if it's for Chika's enjoyment.

112641.name: Kei Shirogane
112641.desc: Kei Shirogane is [Miyuki Shirogane's](https://anilist.co/character/121101) little sister. She attends Shuchiin middle school and is the treasurer for the middle school student council. She is a hard worker just like her brother and can be very prideful at times. She also inherited his sense of righteousness and hates it when someone doesn't do the right thing in a given situation. Like her brother, she likes helping out those who are in trouble even if it means going out of her way to do it. Since she grew up in a family that places emphasis on saving money, she normally carries coupons and works hard for the things she wants to buy. She developed a prickly attitude towards her brother due to his over protectiveness. She's also entered a rebellious phase and due to her pride and she cannot get herself to have a lighthearted conversation with Miyuki, leading into the similar mind games that Miyuki and [Kaguya](https://anilist.co/character/120649) play against each other, but her objective is to talk to Miyuki without making it look like she has a brother complex. She rarely speaks and most of the time it is only when she exchanges formalities at school or when she hurls abuses at her brother.

112641.name: Erika Kose
112641.desc: She is a member of the mass media club at Shuchi'in Academy.

112641.name: Karen Kino
112641.desc: She is a member of the mass media club at Shuchi'in Academy.

112641.name: Tsubame Koyasu
112641.desc: Tsubame is a third-year student who is vice-captain of the cheer squad and a rhythmic gymnast. She is very popular. She encourages [Yuu](https://anilist.co/character/121102) in the cheering activities.

112641.name: Tsubasa Tanuma
112641.desc: He is a student in Shuchi'in highschool and always asks [Miyuki Shirogane](https://anilist.co/character/121101) for advice about love. [Kashiwagi](https://anilist.co/character/134330)'s boyfriend.

112641.name: Maki Shijo
112641.desc: Maki is a classmate and friend of [Nagisa](https://anilist.co/character/134330). She has short hair styled in short pigtails. She is friends with Nagisa and is secretly jealous of Nagisa's relationship with her boyfriend, as she too liked Kashiwagi's Boyfriend, but could not confess before. As a branch member of the Shinomiya clan, she is [Kaguya](https://anilist.co/character/120649)'s second cousin twice removed so she sometimes refers to Kaguya as "Auntie". [Miyuki](https://anilist.co/character/121101) and [Yuu](https://anilist.co/character/121102/Yuu-Ishigami) observe she acts very tsundere (cold on the outside but wanting to be affectionate), and similar to Kaguya in personality. She declares Yuu and Miyuki as her friends, due to their support in helping her process her failed romance, much to Kaguya's horror

112641.name: Moeha Fujiwara
112641.desc: Moeha is [Chika](https://anilist.co/character/121103)'s little sister who is in junior high. She is the student council vice-president at the junior high. She admires [Miyuki](https://anilist.co/character/121101) as well and hopes to confess someday. She has a habit of voicing dark ideas, which unnerve [Kaguya](https://anilist.co/character/120649) a great deal.

112641.name: Nagisa Kashiwagi
112641.desc: Nagisa is a classmate who occasionally asks [Kaguya](https://anilist.co/character/120649) about what to do in her relationships. [Tsubasa](https://anilist.co/character/134327)'s girlfriend.

112641.name: Kobachi Osaragi
112641.desc: Kobachi is [Miko](https://anilist.co/character/125886)'s classmate with the glasses and a member of the disciplinary committee. She has been looking after Miko for over 10 years. ~!Though she doesn't love him in a romantic way, she has liked Yu Ishigami since middle school. She believes that Tsubame Koyasu is a kind person and is therefore supportive of Ishigami's feelings for Tsubame, despite her friend Miko being in love with Ishigami as well.!~

112641.name: Adolphe Pescarolo
112641.original: アドルフ・ペスカローロ
112641.desc: The Principal of Shuchi'in Academy He's strict regarding school regulations, but knows how to garner the favor of students nonetheless. He helped Yu Ishigami get enrolled to Shuchi'in despite not finishing his task of making an apology letter. Despite being an authority figure within the school, he has shown comical disregard for school rules and discipline when it comes to his own actions, having been openly caught playing Pokemon Go on more than one occasion on school grounds while chastising nearby students for doing the same.

112641.name: Shirogane no Chichi
112641.desc: Father of [Miyuki](https://anilist.co/character/121101) and [Kei Shirogane](https://anilist.co/character/126144). ~!His wife left him and their factory shut down leaving him to not have any stable employment.!~ ~!He later becomes a youtuber.!~

112641.name: Rei Onodera
112641.desc: She is a supporting character in the series. She was a member of Shuchi'in's Red Cheer Team and is a classmate of Yu Ishigami and Miko Iino. She is a fairly calm girl under normal circumstances and is fairly open-minded, but when involved with the Cheer Team or the culture festival committee, she becomes far more energetic.

112641.name: Kyoko Ootomo
112641.desc: She was [Ishigami](https://anilist.co/character/121102/)'s classmate in their last middle school year. She dated Kou Ogino, who cheated on her without her knowledge.

112641.name: Kou Ogino
112641.desc: Former president of Shuchiin Junior High's theater club. Kyoko Ootomo's ex-boyfriend.

112641.name: Kazeno
112641.desc: Kazeno is a third year high school student at Shuchi'in Academy and was the captain of the Cheer Club during the Sports Festival. He is a very energetic and caring person,cheering on his team and giving support to Yu Ishigami.

112641.name: Kozue Makihara
112641.desc: Makkii-senhai is a first-year high school student at Shuchi'in Academy and the president of the Tabletop Gaming Club, As the president of the Tabletop Gaming Club, Kozue loves games. She also has a somewhat sadistic sense of humor, as shown by her cheerfully torturing Miko while gathering audio for their class' event during the culture festival. She is shown to be very intelligent, regularly ranking among the top ten students in the freshman class during the end of semester exams.

112641.name: Terashima
112641.desc: She's a third-year high school student at Shuchi'in Academy and a member of the Tabletop Gaming Club which Chika Fujiwara is also a part of. Terashima, being demoted from Terako to Gigako, is a pun on metric prefixes

112641.name: Daichi Fujiwara
112641.desc: A politician and the father of Toyomi, Chika and Moeha Fujiwara. Daichi is very well mannered and professional. He’s also overly protective of his daughters.

112641.name: Shouzou Tanuma
112641.desc: Shouzou Tanuma is a world famous heart surgeon and the physician of the Shinomiya family. He is also Tsubasa's grandfather

112641.name: Gou Kazamatsuri
112641.desc: Like Shirogane, he attended an outside middle school before entering Shuchiin. He enrolled in order to look for clues regarding the disappearance of his older brother. He serves as an assistant to the "Investigator of the financial world" Hajime Echizen and, after solving many difficult cases has finally been reunited with his brother.

112641.name: Pes
112641.desc: Pes is the beloved pet dog of [Chika Fujiwara](https://anilist.co/character/121103/Chika-Fujiwara). He is quite a large dog, with golden fur and floppy ears. He has piercing eyes like [the president](https://anilist.co/character/121101/Miyuki-Shirogane)

112641.name: Saburou Toyosaki
112641.desc: In the past, he used underhanded tactics to sabotage [Shirogane](https://anilist.co/character/121101/)'s grades, but he now fights fair and square. He only opens his eyes when he shows his "true power."

112641.name: Subaru Suruga
112641.desc: One of [Ai Hayasaka](https://anilist.co/character/121104/)'s closest friends. She wears her Shuchi'in Academy school uniform modified to match up with kogal fashion. She is the daughter of the president of an IT company.

112641.name: Mirin Hinokuchi
112641.desc: One of [Ai Hayasaka](https://anilist.co/character/121104/)'s closest friends. She wears her Shuchi'in Academy school uniform modified to match up with kogal fashion. She is the daughter of an advertising executive.

112641.name: Nayotake Shimizu
112641.desc: ~![Kaguya Shinomiya](https://anilist.co/character/120649/)'s mother. She died 30th of January, 29 days after giving birth to Kaguya.!~ ~!In Chapter 242, it was revealed that she worked in Gion's red light district as a prostitute.!~

131573.name: Satoru Gojou
131573.desc: __Height:__ 190 cm (6'3") __Occupation:__ Jujutsu Sorcerer, Teacher __Affiliation:__ Tokyo Metropolitan Curse Technical College, Gojou Family __Grade:__ Special Grade Sorcerer __Cursed Technique:__ Six Eyes, Limitless Satoru Gojou is one of the main protagonists of the Jujutsu Kaisen series. He is a special-grade jujutsu sorcerer and is widely recognized as the strongest in the world. Satoru is the pride of the Gojou Family, the first person to inherit both the Limitless and the Six Eyes in four hundred years. He works as a teacher at the Tokyo Jujutsu High and uses his influence to protect and train strong young allies

131573.name: Yuuta Okkotsu
131573.desc: __Species:__ Human __Occupation:__ Sorcerer, Student __Affiliation:__ Jujutsu High __Grade:__ Special Grade Sorcerer The main protagonist of Jujutsu Kaisen prequel series [Tokyo Metropolitan Curse Technical School](https://anilist.co/manga/105469/Tokyo-Toritsu-Jujutsu-Kodo-Senmon-Gakko). He was initially a Special Grade Cursed Victim haunted by his late childhood friend, [Rika Orimoto](https://anilist.co/character/208533/Orimoto-Rika). [Satoru Gojou](https://anilist.co/character/127691/Satoru-Gojou) mentored Yuuta and enrolled him at Tokyo Jujutsu High.

131573.name: Suguru Getou
131573.desc: __Species:__ Human __Height:__ 183 cm __Occupation:__ Curse User __Grade:__ Special Grade Curse User __Cursed Technique:__ Cursed Spirit Manipulation Suguru Getou is an antagonist in both the Jujutsu Kaisen series and its prequel Jujutsu Kaisen 0: Jujutsu High. ~!He was originally a student of [Masamichi Yaga](https://anilist.co/character/189237/Yaga-Masamichi)'s alongside [Satoru Gojo](https://anilist.co/character/127691/Gojou-Satoru) and [Shoko Ieiri](https://anilist.co/character/158154/Ieiri-Shouko) at Tokyo Jujutsu High. His experiences as a jujutsu sorcerer bred a deep hatred for non-sorcerers, leading to an incident where Suguru massacred over a hundred civilians in a single night, later being expelled from Jujutsu High and called for immediate execution as a result.!~

131573.name: Kento Nanami
131573.desc: __Height:__ 184 cm (6'0½") __Occupation:__ Sorcerer __Affiliation:__ Jujutsu High __Grade:__ Grade 1 Sorcerer __Cursed Technique:__ Ratio He is a Grade 1 Jujutsu Sorcerer and a Tokyo Jujutsu High alumni. Nanami is a very intelligent and reserved man who at first appears to be someone who is just very serious about his work. He knows how to separate sentimentalism from service and claims he's only a Jujutsu Sorcerer because it's slightly less idiotic than regular careers. As one of [Yuji's](https://anilist.co/character/127212/Yuji-Itadori) mentors, Nanami is a complete contrast to [Gojo](https://anilist.co/character/127691/Satoru-Gojou), who is far more outspoken and easy-going.

131573.name: Maki Zenin
131573.desc: __Height:__ 170 cm (5'7") Maki Zenin is the older twin sister of [Mai Zenin](https://anilist.co/character/134168/Mai-Zenin). Maki is a grade 4 sorcerer and a second-year at Tokyo Metropolitan Jujutsu Technical High School. She is from the main branch of the Zenin clan, one of the "Prominent Three Families" of the Jujutsu world. She left the Zenin family in order to prove herself capable of being a Sorcerer after being deemed uncapable, since she lacks Cursed Energy. ~!Because Mai and Maki are monozygotic twins, their strength is considerably limited to one another. Monozygotic twins are considered as a single individual in the Jujutsu world and are a sign of bad omen.!~ ~!After the death of her twin sister Mai, Maki has lost all of her cursed energy and gained a Heavenly Restriction. This causes her skills and human capabilities to be on par with [Toji Fushiguro's](https://anilist.co/character/162722/Touji-Fushiguro).!~

131573.name: Mai Zenin
131573.desc: __Height:__ 170 cm (5'7") Mai Zenin is the younger twin sister of [Maki Zenin](https://anilist.co/character/134167/Maki-Zenin). Mai is a grade 3 sorcerer and a second-year at Kyoto Jujutsu Technical High School. As a child, Mai always relied on Maki since she was afraid of Cursed Spirits. ~!Because Mai and Maki are monozygotic twins, their strength is considerably limited to one another. Monozygotic twins are considered as a single individual in the Jujutsu world and are a sign of bad omen.!~ ~!In chapter 149, Mai decides to sacrifice herself in order to make Maki stronger.!~

131573.name: Panda
131573.desc: __Species:__ Cursed Corpse (varies among 3 personalities) __Occupation:__ Jujutsu Sorcerer, Student __Affiliation:__ Jujutsu High __Grade:__ 2 He is a second-year at Tokyo Prefectural Jujutsu High. As a Metamorphosed Cursed Corpse, he is the best creation of Principal [Masamichi Yaga](https://anilist.co/character/189237/Masamichi-Yaga). He is sentient and has three cores inside the doll body: the youngest brother "Panda", the eldest brother "Gorilla" and a sister.

131573.name: Aoi Toudou
131573.desc: __Species:__ Human __Height:__ 190 cm __Occupation:__ Sorcerer, Student __Affiliation:__ Kyoto Jujutsu Technical High School __Grade:__ Grade 1 Sorcerer Toudou is a third-year student at Kyoto Jujutsu Technical High School who possesses inhuman physical strength, durability, and speed. ~!He is able to use a technique called Boogie Woogie, in which he can switch the position of two things that posses a certain amount of curse energy within his range.!~

131573.name: Kasumi Miwa
131573.desc: __Species:__ Human __Occupation:__ Jujutsu Sorcerer, Student __Affiliation:__ Kyoto Metropolitan Curse Technical College __Grade:__ Grade 3 Sorcerer A second-year at Kyoto Metropolitan Curse Technical College. Kasumi is a hard-working, restrained, and considerate pacifist. She is also a big fan of [Satoru Gojo](https://anilist.co/character/127691). ~!She has a very close bond with [Mechamaru](https://anilist.co/character/210154), their friendship is first seen in the Tournament Arc when Miwa offers him a battery telling him not to eat it as [Mai](https://anilist.co/character/134168) and [Momo](https://anilist.co/character/157868) laugh in the background. In the Shibuya Arc, she is seen mourning his death on the train. Over the course of the Tournament Arc and Shibuya Arc it is very apparent their friendship grows as they both strived towards becoming closer to one another. As she mourns his death on the train she holds a mini Mechamaru speaker which tells her to find her happiness. After the recording finishes, she holds the speaker to her heart and cries. The entire Kyoto program seems very distressed by his death on the train. When later entering the battle Miwa is quick to activate her technique out of rage and sadness towards [Mahito](https://anilist.co/character/133702).!~

131573.name: Toge Inumaki
131573.desc: __Species:__ Human __Occupation:__ Sorcerer, Student __Affiliation:__ Jujutsu High __Grade:__ Grade 2 Sorcerer __Cursed Technique:__ Cursed Speech He is a second-year at Tokyo Metropolitan Jujutsu Technical High School. Due to his curse ability, he is only willing to communicate with ingredients used to make rice balls.

131573.name: Mei Mei
131573.desc: __Height:__ 173 cm __Occupation:__ Jujutsu Sorcerer __Affiliation:__ Jujutsu High __Grade:__ Grade 1 Sorcerer __Family:__ [Ui Ui](https://anilist.co/character/217290) (Younger Brother) __Abilities__: ~! __Weapon Mastery__: Mei Mei wields a large battle-axe. __Cursed Technique__: Black Bird Manipulation - Mei Mei is able to control crows as well as see through their eyes, making her technique great for recon. __Bird Strike__: by forcing a crow to commit suicide, the trade-off is to erase the Cursed Energy limit of a typical weak bird and hurl it at the enemy. !~ Mei Mei is a grade 1 jujutsu sorcerer who works independently and only in exchange for money. She is also the older sister of Ui Ui. ~!She was the senpai of [Satoru Gojo](https://anilist.co/character/127691) and [Suguru Geto](https://anilist.co/character/133699) during their time at Jujutsu High.!~

131573.name: Takuma Ino
131573.desc: __Species:__ Human __Occupation:__ Sorcerer __Affiliation:__ Jujutsu High __Grade:__ Grade 2 Sorcerer Takuma Ino is a grade 2 jujutsu sorcerer and a close associate of Kento Nanami who operates out of Tokyo Jujutsu High. Takuma Ino is a genuine and cheerful person with a more positive outlook on things than most jujutsu sorcerers. He doesn't believe he's the smartest person around and has a lot of respect for Nanami. Whenever Ino finds himself in a tough situation, he asks himself what would Nanami do.

131573.name: Noritoshi  Kamo
131573.desc: __Cursed Technique:__ Blood Manipulation __Grade:__ Semi-Grade 1 Sorcerer He is a third-year at Kyoto Magic Technical College.

131573.name: Momo Nishimiya
131573.desc: __Species:__ Human __Occupation:__ Jujutsu Sorcerer __Affiliation:__ Kyoto Magic Technical College __Grade:__ Semi-Grade 2 Sorcerer __Cursed Technique:__ Tool Manipulation She is a third-year at Kyoto Magic Technical College.

131573.name: Shouko Ieiri
131573.desc: __Height:__ 168 cm __Ability:__ Reverse Healing Cursed Technique Alumnus of Tokyo Jujutsu High, having been classmates with [Satoru Gojo](https://anilist.co/character/127691) and [Suguru Geto](https://anilist.co/character/133699). After graduating into a full-fledged jujutsu sorcerer, Shoko became the school's primary doctor.

131573.name: Masamichi Yaga
131573.desc: He is the current principal of Tokyo Metropolitan Jujutsu Technical High School, the creator of Panda, and the headmaster of Satoru Gojo, Suguru Geto and Shoko Ieiri. ~!After the Shibuya incident Yaga is given a death penalty by the higher ups for inciting Gojo and Geto in the past and "causing the Shibuya incident".!~

131573.name: Kiyotaka Ijichi
131573.desc: An assistant manager at Tokyo Prefectural Jujutsu High School.

131573.name: Atsuya Kusakabe
131573.desc: Atsuya Kusakabe is a character in Jujutsu Kaisen. He is a Grade 1 Sorcerer, and a teacher at Jujutsu High. ~!At the end of the Shibuya Incident Arc he blocks Kenjaku's Maximum Uzumaki Technique.!~

131573.name: Rika Orimoto
131573.desc: Rika Orimoto is the childhood friend of Yuta Okkotsu who tragically died when she was hit by a car. Her spirit was cursed, transforming her into a powerful Special Grade Vengeful Cursed Spirit worthy of the moniker "Queen of Curses".

131573.name: Koukichi Muta
131573.desc: Koukichi Muta is a Semi-Grade 1 sorcerer and a second-year student at Kyoto Jujutsu High. He attends school by controlling the cursed corpse Ultimate Mechamaru, as Muta was born with a sickly and fragile body due to a Heavenly Restriction. In exchange, he has a nearly boundless amount of cursed energy that spreads over a vast range.

131573.name: Akari Nitta
131573.desc: Akari Nitta is an Auxiliary Manager at Jujutsu High.

131573.name: Mimiko Hasaba
131573.desc: Mimiko Hasaba is a character in Jujutsu Kaisen and Jujutsu Kaisen 0: Jujutsu High. She is an ally of Suguru Geto.

131573.name: Nanako Hasaba
131573.desc: Nanako Hasaba is a character in Jujutsu Kaisen and Jujutsu Kaisen 0: Jujutsu High. She is [Mimiko](https://anilist.co/character/228986/Mimiko-Hasaba)'s twin sister and they were both allies of Suguru Geto.

131573.name: Larue
131573.desc: A large, shirtless muscular man and an ally of [Suguru Getou](https://anilist.co/character/133699/).

131573.name: Miguel
131573.desc: He was initially one of Suguru Geto's commanders who wished to see him become king. Following the Night Parade of a Hundred Demons, Miguel was forcefully recruited by Satoru Gojo. He returned to his homeland of Africa and the community of sorcerers there to train Yuta Okkotsu.

131573.name: Manami Suda
131573.desc: Curse user who used to be [Suguru Getou](https://anilist.co/character/133699/Suguru-Getou)'s secretary as well as a commander in his "family" of sorcerers. ~!After Suguru's death, Manami and Toshihisa Negi both decided to carry on his will by joining the entity to who stole his body.!~

131573.name: Toshihisa Negi
131573.desc: Curse user who used to be a commander in [Suguru Getou](https://anilist.co/character/133699/Suguru-Getou)'s "family" of sorcerers. After Suguru's death, Negi and Manami Suda both decided to carry on his will by joining the entity to who stole his body.

131573.name: Kakunou Jurei
131573.desc: A cursed spirit that can store many different objects within its body. First seen as the servant of Touji Fushiguro, it contains Touji's entire wide arsenal of weapons.

20997.name: Kanade Tachibana
20997.desc: __Height:__ 150 cm Kanade Tachibana is the Afterlife School's student council president. She is often referred to as "Tenshi" by the SSS, based on both [Yuri's](https://anilist.co/character/22370/Nakamura-Yuri) belief that she must be a representative of god and the SSS members not knowing her name initially. Though, they continue to call her "Tenshi" after discovering her real name. Her position often puts her at odds with Yuri and the other SSS members as her responsibilities require her to suppress delinquency and disruptive activities. Her given name, Kanade, as described by [Otonashi](https://anilist.co/character/24502/Otonashi-Yuzuru), literally means "Playing music". Tenshi has a variety of self-defense skills at her disposal, which she calls "Guard Skills". (Episode 13 spoilers) ~! It is revealed that Kanade was the receiver of the donor heart from Otonashi. Her regret in life was her inability to thank the one who gave her the heart. After the credits, there is a short scene featuring what is assumed to be her and Otonashi reuniting in the real world !~

20997.name: Yuu Otosaka
20997.desc: __Height:__ 174 cm (5' 8½") __Ability:__ ~!Looting: an ability that allows its user to take over another person for 5 seconds. However, it can also be used to take abilities from other ability-wielders if they are possessed.!~ __Affiliations:__ Hoshinoumi Academy student council Yuu is a first-year student at Hoshinoumi Academy. He is rude and bad at studying. He usually behaves as if he were smart, but he is actually a chronic cheater. He says things which sound clever, and he is a narcissist. He has the ability to take over another person's body for five seconds.

20997.name: Nao Tomori
20997.desc: __Height:__ 154.5 cm (5’ 1") __Ability:__ Imperfect Invisibility __Affiliations:__ Hoshinoumi Academy student council Nao is a first-year student and also the student council president of Hoshinoumi Academy. She has the ability to make herself invisible to any one person of her choosing at a time. She is a huge fan of the band Zhiend. She hates people who use their power for no good.

20997.name: Joujirou Takajou
20997.desc: A first-year student and member of the student council. He can move at such high speeds that he looks like he's teleporting. However, he's not totally able to control where he stops, so he has to wear protective gear under his school uniform to prevent injury. ~!Takajou lets his ability be plundered by Yuu for his plan to succeed. He no longer possesses his ability.!~ (Source: Crunchyroll, edited)

20997.name: Yusa Kurobane
20997.desc: Yusa is a first-year student and the vocalist for the band How-Low-Hello. She is able to speak to the dead. She uncontrollably channels her dead older sister Misa, who occasionally possesses her. When this occurs, her appearance changes, such as her eye color turning from blue to red. ~!Misa lets Yuu plunder her abilities after hearing his plan from Nao. Before that she had written a letter to Yusa, after her ability is taken she reads it and starts crying knowing that she was with her and everyone the whole time. She no longer possesses any powers.!~ (Source: Crunchyroll, edited)

20997.name: Misa Kurobane
20997.desc: Misa is Yusa's older sister by one year. She died in a motorcycle accident. She's the exact opposite of her sister: she has a sharp tongue, doesn't trust people easily and is mischievous but she really cares a lot about her sister. That's also the reason why she's now something like a ghost following her sister around. Thanks to her sister's ability she can possess her and use her body. She only does that to protect Yusa. In Yusa's body she can also use her pyrokinetic ability meaning she can control fire at her will. She had two friends, one nicknamed Sho. Sho was also in love with her.
