She remains at her sister's side helping her when she's in trouble. ~!In episode 12, she bids farewell to her sister since Yuu got her and Yusa's ability in order to save everyone, specifically the ability wielders so they may return to their normal lives.!~

20997.name: Ayumi Otosaka
20997.desc: A middle-school student and [Yuu](https://anilist.co/character/88950/Otosaka-Yuu)'s younger sister. She likes stars. She is also a huge fan of the Idol [Yusa Nishimori](https://anilist.co/character/88953/Kurobane-Yusa). ~!She awakens the ability to make everything around her collapse, but ultimately, this awakening leads to her death. In episode 6, during a lunch break at school, Ayumi is threatened with a box cutter by a jealous classmate; she begins to run, but is soon cornered. Instinctively, she uses her ability, which collapses both the roof above her and the floor below; killing her.!~ ~!In episode 10, she is saved by her brother Yuu who traveled back in time using their brother [Shunsuke](https://anilist.co/character/125388/Otosaka-Shunsuke)'s ability of time leap. Her ability was plundered by Yuu after he had time leaped backwards, so she no longer has the ability.!~

20997.name: Arifumi Fukuyama
20997.desc: Arifumi is a student and a pitcher for the baseball team in Kannai Academy. He has the ability telekinesis, which he uses to his advantage in baseball games. After losing to the Hoshinoumi Academy baseball team and the Student Council in a baseball match, he agrees to stop using his ability. ~!His ability was taken by Yuu.!~ (Source: Wikipedia)

20997.name: Furuki
20997.desc: Furuki is a fellow comrade of Shunsuke's syndicate, and a hired driver in the new facility. ~!In episode 11, he was the one who was told to bring Kumagami and then Yuu Otosaka to the group of foreigners in an abandoned factory after being threatened about his family that was kidnapped and would kill them if he did not do so. The group of foreigners then dropped the Condo key to Furuki to free his family after he brought Yuu Otosaka over to the abandoned factory that they are located.!~

20997.name: Konishi
20997.desc: Ayumi's classmate. ~!During episode 6, Konishi attempts to hurt Ayumi using a box cutter due to her enviousness. She is soon cornered until Ayumi uses her ability ''collapse'' which collapses both the roof above her and the floor below, killing her. Konishi, on the other hand, runs as the collapse started so that she would be able to escape the building in time.!~ ~!In episode 10, Konishi attempts to hurt Ayumi, though fails due to Yuu saving Ayumi.!~

20997.name: Kouta
20997.desc: A friend of Shou and Misa.

20997.name: Takehito Kumagami
20997.desc: Kumagami is a mysterious student at Hoshinoumi Academy. His ability is being able to locate anyone who possesses an ability. He has to get soaking wet while fully clothed in order to use his ability. He helps the student council find ability users. ~!In episode 9, it is revealed that he was one of two people who were held captive in research lab. He is one of Yuu's friends who helped him prison break his brother Shunsuke.!~ ~!In episode 11, he is kidnapped and tortured in a factory by mysterious people. After Yuu accidentally uses his collapse to bring the factory down, Pooh saves an unconscious Nao from the debris. He succumbs to death from his injuries while in Shunsuke's arms.!~

20997.name: Maedomari
20997.desc: Shunsuke's friend. He has the ability to erase people's memories. But this ability is limited because it takes a long time to search and erase the memories from someone's body. ~!Maedomari is the one who erased Yuu and Ayumi's memories about Shunsuke.!~

20997.name: Medoki
20997.desc: Shunsuke's friend who has an ability to make someone sleep.

20997.name: Mishima
20997.desc: Yumi's best friend.

20997.name: Nomura
20997.desc: Ayumi's friend.

20997.name: Oikawa
20997.desc: Ayumi's classmate. He asked her out once and was rejected.

20997.name: Shunsuke Otosaka
20997.desc: Shunsuke is the older brother of Ayumi and Yuu. ~!In his first appearance during a future flashback in Episode 9, it is revealed that he has the power of Time Leap, but is limited to whether or not he is able to see with both eyes.!~ ~!In the current timeline, he is blind. He tells Yuu and the others that every time he used his time leaping ability, his vision got progressively worse, until it finally blinded him completely. As a consequence, he is unable to use his powers anymore. Fortunately, Yuu is still able to steal the power to go back in time to save Ayumi.!~

20997.name: Sara Shane
20997.desc: The vocalist of the band ZHIEND. She is blind. ~!In episode 8, Yuu brings Sara with him to check on Tomori Nao's older brother, Tomori Kazuki, he believes that Sara may be able to help him in some way. When they arrive, Sala sings her song "Fallin'" to calm Kazuki down from his rage, allowing him to recognize others once again.!~

20997.name: Kazuki Tomori
20997.desc: Nao's older brother who was a member of a band. Previously, he had the ability to make air vibrate which he used on live performances to change his guitar sound. But scientists experimented on him, and now he stays at the hospital. He didn't even recognize Nao as his little sister anymore. He's the reason that Nao is a fan of band ZHIEND. ~!In episode 8, due to the singing from the lead vocalist of ZHIEND he calms down. During this time, Yuu Otosaka speaks with him, which leads him to remembering Nao.!~

20997.name: Yumi Shirayanagi
20997.desc: Yumi Shirayanagi is the madonna of Yuu's previous high school who initially falls for Yuu after he saves her from a traffic accident (which he himself caused); however, she dumps him after he transfers to Hoshiumi Academy.

20997.name: Shou
20997.desc: Sho was a friend of Misa and Kota back when Misa was alive, He along with Kota helped Yusa about the Problem with the TV Producer. He rode with her during her Incident 6 months ago. He has feelings for Misa and he confessed to her.

20997.name: Shichino
20997.desc: Shunsuke's friend who has the ability to pass through walls but gets very tired after passing through an object each time.

20997.name: Yoshiyuki Oomura
20997.desc: Yoshiyuki Oomura is the president of the Student Council in Hinomori High School.

20997.name: Udou
20997.desc: Udou is a student from Class 2-E of Nanba High School, and the captain of the archery club.

20997.name: Tomori no Haha
20997.desc: Nao and Kazuki's mother.

20997.name: Sokoban Narration
20997.original: そこばんナレーション

10620.name: Yukiteru Amano
10620.desc: __Occupation__: Middle School Student __Alternate Name__: First __Likes__: Having friends, writing in diary __Height__: 161 cm The main male protagonist of the series and the First Diary user. Also known as Yuki (ユッキー, Yukkī), he is a 14-year-old middle schooler who is a rather quiet boy with an anti-social behavior who doesn't talk much. He mostly sees things around him as a bystander and writes it down in his cell phone diary. Yuki becomes involved in the Diary Game when to his shock that Deus, a god-like being whom he thought was an imaginary friend turns out to be real, selects him as one of twelve contestants in a 90 day battle royale where they must kill each other using their special diaries where the last survivor becomes Deus' new heir. Yuki's diary is called the Random Diary, which written from his point of view, gives a detailed explanation of his surroundings very accurately whether it be the present or the future. While versatile in any situation, the main disadvantage of the Random Diary is that it doesn't tells him what is happening to himself which leaves him vulnerable. Furthermore, since the diary is written from his point of view, Yuki can be tricked into thinking something he sees is true without realizing it which is a disadvantage for other people who use the Random Diary. Unlike most of the contestants, Yuki doesn't want any part of the game as he just wants to live peacefully and doesn't want to kill anyone, but is forced to play to survive and will on

10620.name: Yuno Gasai
10620.desc: __Occupation:__ Middle School Student __Height:__ 159 cm (5'2") Yuno Gasai is obsessively in love with [Yukiteru](https://anilist.co/character/4962). Yukiteru's condition and actions are recorded every ten minutes in her "Yukiteru" diary, it also provides small commentary made by Yuno in some of the entries. Its most obvious weakness is that it does not show Yuno's future at all -- her condition, situation, or surroundings — unless it somehow involves Yuki. Working with Yukiteru's "Random Diary" diary, however, covers both of their diaries' individual flaws; as it has been said the two make for a perfect combo. Smart, beautiful and diligent — those who don't truly know Gasai Yuno would simply see the model student role she plays while at school. She is secretly obsessed with Yukiteru and would do anything within her power to assist him. She can be quite clingy and is highly fond of stalking him. When obstacles arise that either endangers Yukki's life or threatens their relationship, her thoughts turn murderous and she lets nothing get in the way of her path. Yuno is also able to quickly analyze and adapt to unexpected situations that may arise, and she puts thoughts into action without hesitation, performing what needs to be done without ever losing her nerves. She is named after the Roman goddess Juno.

10620.name: Deus Ex Machina
10620.original: デウス・エクス・マキナ
10620.desc: The god of time and space, Yukiteru's supposed imaginary friend and the mastermind behind the game. He is looking for a successor, which is why he gave future diaries to twelve candidates and placed them in a game of life and death. He seems to favor Yukiteru the most out of all the other candidates as his next possible successor due to the miracles Yukiteru is able to pull off, not paying attention to the fact that Yuno is helping him. _Deus_ means God in Latin.

10620.name: Mur Mur
10620.desc: __Occupation__: Deus's Servant __Height__: 95 cm Deus' servant, Mur Mur is often seen with the eliminated candidates in omake panels. As of chapter twenty-four it is revealed her favorite is Yuno Gasai, and she is betting on her to win the game. She has a rather playful and nonchalant attitude toward Deus despite his warnings to her. In a spin-off series she accidentally destroyed Yuno from existence, so she currently has taken Yuno's place as the Second till the damage can be fixed. ~!In the final chapter of Mirai Nikki Paradox, Akise Aru goes into Mur Mur's memories. Before the paradox is restored she is seen conspiring with the fake Gasai Yuno, next to the corpse of the real Yuno.!~

10620.name: Minene Uryuu
10620.desc: __Occupation__: International Wanted Terrorist __Height__: 168 cm Minene Uryuu is a terrorist bomber. Like the Fourth, her "Escape" diary goes along with the type of profession she is involved in. Whenever Minene faces a dire situation, the diary will chart out the best course of actions she can take in order to get out of a tight spot. Based on the function of her diary, it might even help reduce the chances of her receiving a Dead End and it is probably one of the best diaries to have in Deus' game of survival. The diary's only shortcoming is that there are some circumstances where the odds are too heavily stacked against Minene to the point where the diary won't be able to secure an escape route for her. An infamous atheistic terrorist, Minene is a young woman who bears a strong hatred for organized religion, particularly God. ~!Her hatred of religion stems from her past when she and parents were traveling in a city in the Middle East but got caught in a battle, which is hinted between Israelis and Palestinians, where her parents were killed in the crossfire. Blaming God for her parents death, she leads a crusade of destruction against those associated with God. Minene got involved in the Diary game when after a failed assassination to kill a Catholic Cardinal, she tried to escape but almost fell to her death but was saved by Deus who gave her an offer to save her if she join his game. Minene's diary is the Escape Diary, which will chart out the best course of actions for

10620.name: Tsubaki Kasugano
10620.desc: __Occupation:__ Maiden Alternate __Height:__ 157 cm Tsubaki Kasugano is a maiden and figurehead of the Omekata religion. Her "Thousand League Eyes" diary is unlike the other diaries, as it is a scroll, rather than a cell phone. As its name would suggest, it is able to report the future of all her followers. Unlike Yukiteru's diary, it is not limited to just her surroundings, but also sees far events, such as seeing the events Yuki had accomplished a great distance away from where she resides. Her diary can also record near events; the short-term future that will occur after only a few seconds away from the present. This provides Tsubaki with massive amounts of information to work with. However, it can pose as a hindrance in times where a situation changes constantly or when she needs to react quickly. ~! She was born with bad eyesight, only able to see a few feet in front of her. Her parents capitalized on this by setting her up as an "oracle" and creating a cult around her. After her parents died in a car crash, however, she became a plaything for the Omekata and was even raped by it's members. As a result of her experiences, she has become jaded with the world beyond her vision, and wishes for it to disappear. Tsubaki wants Yukiteru's abilities in order to avoid the prediction her diary made about herself. As she is able to control her worshippers, Tsubaki does not make use of any weaponry. !~ ~!When Yuki and Yuno travel in time to the next world their actions shape a futur

10620.name: Keigo Kurusu
10620.desc: __Occupation__: Police Officer __Height__: 183 cm Keigo Kurusu is a police officer, so it follows with reason that his diary relates to his work. The "Investigation" diary gives Keigo information of future crimes and activities committed anywhere within the prefecture he is assigned to. Whether or not this means his diary can record events that will happen simultaneously in different locations is still up in the air. Its major flaw is a location issue; his diary is rendered useless at predicting anywhere outside his patrolling district. ~!Calm, cool and collected, Keiga at first does not appear to care about winning the game. His goal is only to stop the murders being caused by it. He makes an effort to recruit some of the other diary holders into his cause, including First and Second. As the series progresses however, MurMur gives him information of his sons imminent death before he should have known to make him more active in the game. He was chosen by Deus to balance out the criminals and maniacs that are also taking part in the game.!~ He is named after Mercury — roman god of merchants and travelers.

10620.name: Reisuke Houjou
10620.desc: Houjou Reisuke is a seemingly harmless 4-year-old child. His parents were killed during the Sacred Eye incident and so he was asked to be taken care of by a co-worker of theirs, Yukiteru's mother Amano Rea. ~!Accompanied by some drawings, his "Super Vision" diary is a coloring book that gives a small summary of the activities he will perform for the day. However, not only is there a large time gap between the entries, the diary only shows three of them per day: morning, noon and night. It does have a certain advantage of giving Reisuke all three entries at the same time, which allows him ample time to carefully plot his next move. He was killed by Second, supporting her to become God. Reisuke comes from an unhappy background where his parents neglected him and his family was gradually falling apart. He is highly intelligent for his age, yet still possesses both a child's innocence as well as a child's cruelty. Often, his actions make it difficult to tell which of the two traits is the more dominant. During his time at the Amano household, Reisuke grows fond of Yukiteru and especially Yuno; calling them brother and sister. Due to his size, Reisuke improvises with non-visual weaponry such as poison syringe and cyanide gas.!~ He is named after Ceres —the Roman goddess of fertility.

10620.name: Aru Akise
10620.desc: __Height:__ 163 cm (5'4") A classmate in Yukiteru's school, Aru Akise dreams of one day becoming the world's greatest detective. The student detective is able to correctly deduce the culprit behind the serial dog murders even before the police. Mirai Nikki Paradox He is the main character in a spin off series (Mirai Nikki Paradox) where Murumuru accidentally destroyed Yuno from existence, meaning Yukiteru is still vulnerable from the Third. So until the damage is fixed, Aru collaborates with Murumuru and together, take the place of the First and Second.

10620.name: Takao Hiyama
10620.desc: Takao Hiyama is a teacher in Yuki's school and is the serial killer reported within its vicinity. Not much is known about Takao character-wise, since the man was only given four lines of dialogue in the series, all related with finding and being surprised by Yukiteru. He is the Third diary owner. His "Killer" diary records the location of his next intended victim. It is a handy diary if one knew the true identity of the other diary holders and wishes to take the offensive in the game, but it does little in the way of anything else. Takao wears a heavy trenchcoat complete with a hat and mask that hides his identity when stalking prey, and carries a large machete as his weapon of choice. He is named after Vulcan — roman god of blacksmithing.

10620.name: Yomotsu Hirasaka
10620.desc: Yomotsu Hirasaka is a blind man who makes use of a tape recorder that he dubs the "Justice" diary, where it records the wrong-doings of future events he thinks need correcting. It's a pretty misleading name since Yomotsu considers the evil deeds committed by a religion cult as much of an injustice as finding random trash on the floor. His diary's actual functions are actually similar to the Sixth's "Thousand League Eyes," but rather it's the "Thousand League Hearing." He is able to create illusions using hypnosis granted by his diary. ~!While trying to kill himself, Yukiteru, Yuno, and Tsubaki through the use of a bomb, Yuno manages to stop Yomotsu and he ends up killing only himself as the bomb explodes. !~ Yomotsu is quite possibly insane and fancies calling himself a Hero of Justice. He talks using katakana and not the more common hiragana. He defines justice as always being on the side of the winner. He wears spandex along with a toy transformation belt as seen in many super sentai series, as well as a strange one-hole mask which bears similarities to a large eyeball. He is named after Pluto (Hades) —the Roman god of the Afterlife.

10620.name: Hinata Hino
10620.desc: __Occupation__: Middle School Student __Height__: 168 cm A classmate of Yukiteru and Yuno. ~!The Tenth's daughter, Hinata is aware that her father is instigating the carnivorous hound attacks. In order to shake off suspicion from her father's pursuer, she accepts the "Rearing" Diary and uses it in her father's place. Hinata is a classmate in Yukiteru's homeroom and is the first person to reach out to him and become his friend.!~

10620.name: Mao Nonosaka
10620.desc: __Occupation__: Middle School Student __Likes__: Hinata Hino __Height__: 160 cm Another of Yukiteru's classmates, Mao is good friends with Hinata. ~!A willing accomplice in Hinata's scheme to kill Akise Aru. She is overly obsessed with Hinata's breast size and considers her more than a friend. Always has a camera handy.!~

10620.name: Masumi Nishijima
10620.desc: __Position__: Chief Investigator __Height__: 174 cm Chief Investigator and Keigo's subordinate, Masumi was part of the investigation team assigned to protect Father Haiman from the terrorist, Minene Uryuu. Masumi had feelings for Minene and, much to Minene's confusion and dismay, would take every opportunity to ask "her" out for breakfast, lunch and dinner. ~!He proposes to Minene, who, by that time, has also fallen for him. However, before they could officially get married, he is shot to death. In the last episode Minene from Second World and Nishijima from the Third lives together, though it may be considered as 'happy end' for them!~

10620.name: Ouji Kousaka
10620.desc: Another one of Yukiteru's classmate, Ouji is in Yukki and Yuno's classroom during the previous semester and is one of the first people to betray him during the terrorist bombing incident. He writes down a list of all of his proudest accomplishments in a blog he dubs the "Kousaka King Diary", often using the phrase "I'm Shining!" after each sentence. ~!Due to having blogged many times on his cellphone, which is connected to the Eighth's diary, he becomes a "Diary Holder Apprentice". His diary helps him save his friends, but it only reveals his successes, not his failures, which makes Yuno able to shoot him with a crossbow. Since he is inadvertently working as the Eighth's spy, Yukki destroys his diary in chapter twenty-seven, though does not die because it was not a true future diary. !~ (Source: Wikipedia)

10620.name: Rea Amano
10620.desc: __Age__: Unknown, Estimated 32 years old __Occupation__: Video Game Programmer __Likes__: Yukiteru and Yuno's relationship __Height__: 164 cm __Weight__: 53 kg Yukiteru's mother, Rea is rarely at home because of her work as a video game programmer. Despite this, she maintains a very casual and close relationship with Yukiteru and approves of Yuno as a potential bride for her son.

10620.name: Kurou Amano
10620.desc: Yukiteru's father who is divorced with Yukiteru's mother due to a debt amounting to three million yen which he could not pay. Initially, he appears in chapter thirty claiming to just want to check on his son. ~!It turns out that he has only returned to destroy Yukiteru's diary in order to fulfill a deal with the Eleventh. Despite his only clear desire being to free himself from his debts, he does try to save Yukki when the latter almost falls to his death, but takes the parachute away from Yukki before the tower crumbles soon after. He then stabs his wife when she tries to take him to the police and escapes, though is stabbed to death himself two chapters later by the Eleventh's men.!~ (Source: Wikipedia)

10620.name: John Bacchus
10620.desc: The mayor of Sakurami. ~!He the 11th diary holder. He uses his influence as mayor to take down the other diary holders. His Diary, The Watcher Diary, has the ability to look at other diary entries, whether they are true or not, which leads to his weakness. He is able to move the voters with his words alone to demolish Mother's Home and even convince Deus to remove the First and Second because of their absences. His true goal has later been revealed that he wished to use the 8th's diary to hook up with a super computer, given everyone in the city the potential to becoming a Apprentice Diary Holder to hope to make a new and great kingdom that he will rule. Interesting, the Eighth considers him to be a gentleman. !~ He is named after Bacchus —the Roman god of winery. (Source: Wikipedia)

10620.name: Karyuudo Tsukishima
10620.desc: This man loves and values his dogs more than himself; as shown when he cooked them steak and give them thirty-year-old wine for dinner, while he himself was content with eating cup ramen. ~!He is the owner of the Tenth diary, The Breeder's Diary, which allows him to check on the status of his beloved dogs and control them in squads via voice commands. The dogs can be used to chase and kill people. The diary's weakness seems to be issuing the order of chasing multiple targets, which would require greater concentration in herding the dogs and would also leave the user vulnerable to attack as the holder would be alone. As he was concerned about a stalker and potential diary user, the Tenth literally placed his future in the hands of his daughter, Hinata Hino, who recognized the stalker as a classmate of hers, Akise. Armed with the diary and her father's dogs, Hinata set an elaborate trap to capture Akise, using Yukiteru as bait. The Tenth was killed by Keigo. !~ He is named after Diana —the Roman goddess of hunting. (Source: Wikipedia)

10620.name: Kamado Ueshita
10620.desc: Kamado Ueshita is the woman in charge of an orphanage named "Mother's Home". ~!Kamado is the eighth diary owner. Kamado's diary seems to be in the form of a website where she can rent out blog space to others and can automatically promote its users' rank based on the number of posts the user makes. For instance, Ouji Kousaka, in chapter twenty-five, submits enough entries to be promoted from "commoner" to "apprentice diary holder". The latter rank appears to give users the same abilities that the original diary holders possess without the drawback of the user dying if his or her diary is destroyed. The only apparent problem with this diary's effects is that the apprentices have to stay connected to the server, or else they will lose use of their diaries. She is currently in the process of having her orphanage about to be demolished as part of the Eleventh's plan. Noted by the children in her orphanage, she has no motivation to become God, where it is her "children" who wish to make her God so she won't be killed. All of her "children", who also each possessed an apprentice diary, are killed by Yuno during a failed attempt to kill the 11th. She is later recruited by the 11th, in hoping to use her Diary combined with the Holon III, a massive computer system for Sakurami, to turn the whole city into Apprentice Diary Holders. !~ She is named after Vesta —the Roman goddess of the hearth, home, and family. (Source: Wikipedia)

10620.name: Marco Ikusaba
10620.desc: ~!Originally assumed to be two separate Diary users, Marco and Ai are in fact both the Seventh Diary user. When first introduced, Marco and Ai were using apprentice diaries which were assume by Yuki and his allies as their real Future diaries with Marco's The Unbeatable Brawler Diary predicting attacks before they happened, while Ai's Flirting Diary locates any man she wants to flirt in the future. Their real diaries is the Exchange Diaries which report each other's immediate future. The couple displays excellent teamwork as they use their diaries to cover each other's weaknesses. Marco and Ai are orphans who fell in love with each other after Ai was adopted by Kamado Ueshita, Marco's guardian. Their devotion is so strong that they want to win the game so they can become God and live for eternity together. Marco and Ai are named after the Roman gods Mars and Venus, respectively. !~

10620.name: Ai Mikami
10620.desc: ~!Originally assumed to be two separate Diary users, Marco and Ai are in fact both the Seventh Diary user. Ai appeared early in the series working undercover as member of the Onukata cult with her friend Orin Miyashiro to spy on Tsubaki. She returns later, this time with her boyfriend, Marco to eliminate the threat that is Yuki and Yuno. When first introduced, Marco and Ai were using apprentice diaries which were assume by Yuki and his allies as their real Future diaries with Marco's The Unbeatable Brawler Diary predicting attacks before they happened, while Ai's Flirting Diary locates any man she wants to flirt in the future. Their real diaries is the Exchange Diaries which report each other's immediate future. The couple displays excellent teamwork as they use their diaries to cover each other's weaknesses. Marco and Ai are orphans who fell in love with each other after Ai was adopted by Kamado Ueshita, Marco's guardian. Their devotion is so strong that they want to win the game so they can become God and live for eternity together. Apparently she was raped during high school due to a group of girls who were "annoyed" with the way she acted at school. Marco and Ai are named after the Roman gods Mars and Venus, respectively. !~

10620.name: Orin Miyashiro
10620.desc: An assistant to the 8th. ~!She eventually trusts Yuki when they agree to attack the 11th together and leads the attack with her "Orphanage Diary", but is killed by Yuno when Yuki and her suddenly turn on the 8th. Despite of her appearence, she is very intelligent, having an IQ of 200 as stated by Akise Aru in "Mirai Nikki Mosaic" chapter 5.!~

10620.name: Tarou Nanba
10620.desc: An orphan living in the Mother's Village orphanage. He owns the Apprentice Diary, the "Copy Diary".

10620.name: Ryuji  Kurosaki
10620.desc: The secretary of John Bacchus, mayor of Sakurami City. Ryuji is the holder of an Apprentice Diary, the "Secretary Diary".

10620.name: Funatsu
10620.desc: The second in command of the Omekata Cult led by The Sixth, Tsubaki Kasugano. Serving as a minor villain, he himself appears little in the series, but played a crucial role by twisting Tsubaki and Reisuke Houjou to the point of insanity. He appears in Future Diary: Paradox, serving as a secondary villain to Aru Akise and Tsubaki.

10620.name: Saika  Gasai
10620.desc: Adoptive mother of Yuno Gasai and the wife of Ushio Gasai. A minor character with major relevance, she serves as the direct cause of Yuno's descent into insanity.

10620.name: Ushio  Gasai
10620.desc: The adoptive father of Yuno Gasai and the husband of Saika Gasai. A minor character with major importance, he serves as an indirect cause for Yuno's descent into insanity.

132405.name: Narrator
132405.desc: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

132405.name: Marin Kitagawa
132405.desc: __Height:__ 164 cm (5'3") Marin is an extravagant, messy, and while quite mature, she's also clumsy. She isn't very skilled at handiwork. Marin is a cosplayer and a huge otaku, being a fan of magical girl anime and adult video games. She is very kind, friendly, cheerful and outgoing. She loves eating but still despite that she manages to maintain her slender figure. ~!Marin realizes she is in love with [Wakana](https://anilist.co/character/133678), and throughout the series, continually does whatever she can to invite him to places and spend time with him.!~

132405.name: Sajuna Inui
132405.desc: A famous cosplayer that [Marin Kitagawa](https://anilist.co/character/133676) looks up to. Her younger sister is [Shinju](https://anilist.co/character/207937/Shinju-Inui).

132405.name: Wakana Gojou
132405.desc: __Height:__ 185 cm (6'1") __Hobbies:__ Hina Dolls Wakana Gojou is a fifteen-year-old high-schooler who is not very social, and doesn't fit in well with his fellow classmates, leading to him having no friends at the start of the story. Gojou has a strong appreciation for hina dolls and loves making them, although he is not as skilled as he wants to be. This changes when Gojou ends up meeting someone who doesn't find his love for doll making weird, and instead is amazed at his artistic ability and craftsmanship.

132405.name: Nobara
132405.desc: [Wakana](https://anilist.co/character/133678) was a childhood friend of hers, but when she discovered that Wakana, a man, was obsessed with hina dolls, she called him "disgusting" and ended their relationship.

132405.name: Miori Gojou
132405.desc: Miori is the cousin of [Wakana Gojou](https://anilist.co/character/133678/Wakana-Gojou). She supports him on his seemingly bizarre behavior (buying stockings).

132405.name: Shion Nikaidou
132405.desc: Shion is the main character from the in-story anime 'Flower Princess Blaze'. Sajuna wants Gojou to make a cosplay outfit based on this characters' 'Black Lily' form.

132405.name: Neon Nikaidou
132405.desc: Shion's sister and main enemy from the in-story anime 'Flower Princess Blaze'.

132405.name: Neon no Flower Pet
132405.original: ネオンのフラワーペット

132405.name: Liz
132405.desc: A character from the manga "I'm a Mega-Best-Selling High-School-Student Light Novel Author That Has a Succubus Thirsting for Me Every Night and I Don't Know What to Do."

132405.name: Mirai Tengeji
132405.desc: The main heroine of fictional anime Flower Princess Retsu!!

132405.name: Kaname
132405.desc: The main character of the in-universe "SuccIDK" manga series.

132405.name: Suzuka Itou
132405.desc: Suzuka is a photographer who often attends cosplay events. She gets overly excited by a variety of cosplay. She gets especially excited by cross-playing.

132405.name: Kensei Morita
132405.desc: Kensei Morita is a member of class 1-5 who is a friend and classmate of [Marin Kitagawa](https://anilist.co/character/133676/Marin-Kitagawa) and later [Wakana Gojou](https://anilist.co/character/133678/Wakana-Gojou).

21311.name: Yukichi Fukuzawa
21311.desc: __Height:__ 186 cm (6'1") The president of the Armed Detective Agency, who manages the hooligans. Although he doesn't often come out, at a critical moment, he triumphantly takes command. Because Yukichi is a man of dignity and status, it seems even the frivolous Ranpo will actually work if he orders it. (Source: Bungou Stray Dogs wiki)

21311.name: Atsushi Nakajima
21311.desc: __Height:__ 170 cm (5'7") __Ability:__ Beast Beneath the Moonlight He came to Yokohama after being driven out of a poor orphanage that was attacked by a man-eating tiger. On the verge of starvation, he meets [Dazai](https://anilist.co/character/89198/Dazai-Osamu) and gets a job helping at the detective agency. Because he's never had friends or family and was labeled as "useless," he lacks self-confidence.

21311.name: Osamu Dazai
21311.desc: **Height:** 181 cm (5'11") **Ability:** No Longer Human A member of the Armed Detective Agency. He's a suicide enthusiast who searches for a place to die. However, he doesn't like pain, and would prefer a lovers' suicide with a beautiful woman. He's aimless, elusive, nonchalant, and jokes around normally, but, when he is serious, it is clear that he is an insightful and intelligent individual. He loves to annoy his fellow Agency member, [Kunikida](https://anilist.co/character/89200). ~!He was a former Executive of the city's worst underworld organization, the Port Mafia.!~

21311.name: Ryuunosuke Akutagawa
21311.desc: __Height:__ 172cm (5'8") __Likes:__ Curios and antiques, tea, figs __Dislikes:__ Bonsai trees, dogs, baths "The weak will die. Die, and make way for others." A member of the notorious "Port Mafia" that operates by the harbor. Akutagawa has a black and white "survival of the fittest" view of the world, claiming that weak people should die and give way to the stronger ones. His ability is called "Rashōmon" (羅生門). He is not afraid of pain and defeat, if only to hear a word from a "certain person". His ruthless, vicious nature makes him one of the Port Mafia's most dangerous members, feared by both ally and foe. Much of the obedience he receives from subordinates of Black Lizard , and the Mafia in general, largely stems from fear of his short temper and general intolerance of incompetence. In chapter 87, ~!it is revealed that Akutagawa doesn't have much time left to live, as he is suffering from a vital lung disease.!~ In chapter 88 of the manga, ~!Akutagawa turns undead, being bitten by Bram Stoker after a fatal blow which results in his death.!~ (Source: Bungou Stray Doys Wiki, Anime News Network)

21311.name: Doppo Kunikida
21311.desc: __Height:__ 189 cm (6'2") __Ability:__ The Matchless Poet A member of the Armed Detective Agency. He carries a notepad with the word "Ideal" written on the cover, and what is written inside are guides for life. He has a straight-laced personality and hates nothing more than schedules going awry. As a partner to the free-spirited [Dazai](https://anilist.co/character/89198/Dazai-Osamu), his troubles never end.

21311.name: Ranpo Edogawa
21311.desc: __Height:__ 168 cm (5'6") The great detective of the Armed Detective Agency. He possesses sharp observation skills that are acknowledged by his coworkers, and he settles difficult cases at the request of the police. Because of his self-confidence, his speech is brazen and child-like. His motto is "If you'll have me, everything will be ok!" He likes logical thinking and fantastic tales.

21311.name: Junichirou Tanizaki
21311.desc: __Height:__ 174 cm (5'8.5") __Ability:__ Light Snow He is a member of the Armed Detective Agency and the older brother of [Naomi](https://anilist.co/character/89209/Tanizaki-Naomi).

21311.name: Kenji Miyazawa
21311.desc: __Height:__ 158 cm (5'2") __Ability:__ Undefeated by the Rain A member of the Armed Detective Agency. Before he was scouted, he lived in a rural area without electricity. He knows no suspicion, and will be understanding and considerate no matter who he is talking to. He has a lot of friends who call him "Ken-chan." He likes music, tempura soba, and Mitsuya cider. (Source: Bungou Stray Dogs Wikia)

21311.name: Akiko Yosano
21311.desc: __Height:__ 166 cm (5'5") __Ability:__ Thou Shalt Not Die A modern woman with a bob cut who's a member of the Armed Detective Agency. Although she's an excellent doctor who is indispensable to the Agency, all members of the the Agency are scared to be placed into her care. It's recommended that you don't use outdated misogynistic expressions in front of her.

21311.name: Naomi Tanizaki
21311.desc: Naomi Tanizaki is a member of the Armed Detective Agency and the younger sister of Junichirou.

21311.name: Chuuya Nakahara
21311.desc: __Height:__ 160 cm (5'3") Chuuya is a Port Mafia member who detests [Osamu Dazai](https://anilist.co/character/89198) for betraying the mafia and joining the Armed Detective Agency. He's also constantly teased by Dazai what makes him hate Dazai even more. Chuuya is short but he's quick and uses powerful martial arts. His ability, "For The Tainted Sorrow," revolves around gravity manipulation, allowing him to manipulate and alter the gravity of anything he touches, keeping it that way until a certain period of time.

21311.name: Motojirou Kajii
21311.desc: __Height:__ 180 cm (5'11") A member of Port Mafia. He's a bomber wanted for the explosion at the Maruzen Building. He's an enthusiastic scientist who boasts that "death" is the "ultimate experiment."

21311.name: Ichiyou Higuchi
21311.desc: A beautiful and intelligent woman who wears pants. She belongs to a commando unit that answers to the leader of Port Mafia, and has authority over the military group "Black Lizard." She adores Akutagawa and calls him "senpai."

21311.name: Kyouka Izumi
21311.desc: __Height:__ 148cm (4'10") A docile young lady who dresses in a kimono, but also a member of Port Mafia. As she holds a killing ability, she was found by the organization and raised as an assassin. ~!She later joins the Armed Detective Agency.!~

21311.name: Francis Fitzgerald
21311.original: フランシス・スコット・キー・フィッツジェラルド
21311.desc: __Height:__ 191 cm (6'3") __Ability:__ The Great Fitzgerald Francis poses as the leader for an american secret society, ''The Guild''. Said organization is composed by rich and notorious individuals, who all have some type of powerful influence in the USA. His ability, ''The Great Fitzgerald'', allows him to power up his own atributes and traits, according to the money he spent from his countless fortune. A fierce man, who loves his family, and would do pretty much anything to achieve his goals.

21311.name: Ougai Mori
21311.desc: __Height:__ 175 cm __Ability:__ Vita Sexualis Ougai Mori is the boss of the Port Mafia. Ougai is analytical and tactical. He often puts on overdramatic acts but rarely breaks his composure internally. He has been shown to be somewhat ruthless and unfaltering when it comes to violence. He hasn't, however, shown any particular enjoyment from killing. His ruthlessness comes from his pragmaticism. Although he can be intimidating at times and emit a scary formal aura, he is often polite to the point of seeming approachable. He is polite to allies and enemies alike.

21311.name: Lucy Montgomery
21311.original: ルーシー・モード・モンゴメリ
21311.desc: __Height:__ 165 cm (5'5") A member of Ability User Society "Fellowship of The Guild." Her ability is known as "Anne of Abyssal Red". ~!She helped [Atsushi](https://anilist.co/character/89197/Nakajima-Atsushi) escape the Guild because they bonded over their past trauma and loneliness.!~

21311.name: Michizou Tachihara
21311.desc: __Height:__ 176 cm __Ability:__ Midwinter Memento A commander of the Black Lizards, the Port Mafia's squad of hitmen. Though he puts up a tough and violent front, he cares deeply for his friends. Very skilled gunner, especially when dual wielding.

21311.name: Gin Akutagawa
21311.desc: Ryuunosuke's younger sister and a member of the "Black Lizards" Assault Unit. It seems she is in good terms with Dazai.

21311.name: Elise
21311.desc: Member of Port Mafia, a young girl usually seen with Ougai Mori. ~!She is the ability of Mori Ougai!~

21311.name: Ryuurou Hirotsu
21311.desc: __Height:__ 178cm __Ability:__ Falling Camellia Member of Port Mafia, "Black Lizards" Assault Unit Captain. His ability, Falling Camellia, cause things that he touches to fly backward with immense force.

21311.name: Yamagiwa
21311.desc: She was an officer who was murdered, whose body was found floating in the river. The case of her murder was investigated by Ranpo Edogawa of the Armed Detective Company, along with Atsushi and Dazai.

21311.name: Nobuko Sasaki
21311.desc: a lecturer at a university in Tokyo.

21311.name: Rokuzou Taguchi
21311.desc: An information broker who provided info for the Armed Detective Company.

21311.name: Minoura
21311.desc: Member of the Japanese Police Force. Successor of Yasui-san whom Ranpo had worked with previously on cases.

21311.name: Junsa Sugimoto
21311.desc: He is is a rookie police officer who served under Yamagiwa and Minoura, also being the former's killer.

18679.name: Ryuuko Matoi
18679.desc: She transfers into Honnouji Academy as a second-year student, an Academy ruled by power and authority. She wields a huge single-bladed scissor, and demands to know the owner of the other half. As she remembers, the wielder of the lost half of the scissor blade is the same person who killed her father. ~!Her body has been fused with life fibers, making her a "life fiber monster"!~ ~!She is the daughter of Kiryuuin Ragyou, making Kiryuuin Satsuki her older sister!~

18679.name: Satsuki Kiryuuin
18679.desc: Satsuki Kiryuin is another main heroine of the anime, "Kill La Kill." She is an 18-year-old woman, and is the Student Council President of Honnouji Academy. She rules the school with an iron first, and assesses the students' abilities, holding the position/authority to draw out power surpassing that of humans. ~!She seems to have information regarding the death of Ryuko's father, putting the two at odds immediately after her arrival.!~ ~!She later states that she was the one to send Harime Nui to kill her father, however that was a lie, as the entire murder was orchestrated by Kiryuuin Ragyou and Harime Nui.!~ ~!After betraying her mother, she shares the same goal as Ryuuko Matoi.!~ ~!She is the sister of Ryuuko Matoi.!~

18679.name: Senketsu
18679.desc: A living sailor uniform [Ryuuko](https://anilist.co/character/83797/Matoi-Ryuuko) finds beneath her house. Senketsu is a Kamui (神衣 lit. "God Clothes"), an outfit that provides its wearer with godlike abilities in exchange for their blood. He has the power to transform into an indestructible suit of armor, albeit with a skimpy appearance, much to Ryūko's embarrassment. His name, given to him by Ryūko, literally means 'fresh blood'. ~!After defeating Kiryuuin Ragyou, while falling through the earth's stratosphere, Senketsu burns up protecting Ryuuko.!~

18679.name: Mako Mankanshoku
18679.desc: Mako is a second year student at Honnouji Academy. She is an uber air-head, so her unbelievable actions never cease to shock and awe the people around her. She strongly believes that she and [Ryuko](https://anilist.co/character/83797) are best of friends even though they have just met.

18679.name: Ira Gamagoori
18679.desc: Gamagoori Ira is one of Four Kings. He is the Head of the Public Morals Committee. He sworn absolute loyalty to the Student Council President.

18679.name: Houka Inumuta
18679.desc: Houka Inumuta is one of Four Kings, as he is the Student Council Secretary and Intelligence and Strategic Analyst. He always tries to use the least effort to achieve the greatest results. ~!After the events of episode 17, He and the other 4 kings join Nudist Beach!~

18679.name: Nonon Jakuzure
18679.desc: Nonon Jakuzure is one of the main characters in Kill la Kill and one of the Student Council's Elite Four. She regulates the school's non-athletic groups, such as the gardening and biology clubs. Nonon also runs the school's Rakugo Club, 100 Poems by 100 Poets Club and most likely the marching band. Nonon's Three-Star Goku Uniform resembles that of a drum majorette. Her baton is not just for show, as Nonon is a conductor as well. ~!After the events of episode 17, she and the other 4 kings join Nudist Beach!~

18679.name: Matarou Mankanshoku
18679.desc: Mako's little brother. He acts as the leader of the local troublemakers who mostly loiters around the Honnouji Town cul-de-sac.

18679.name: Barazou Mankanshoku
18679.desc: Mako's father. He is the town’s unlicensed doctor. He's killed more patients than actually saved them.

18679.name: Sukuyo Mankanshoku
18679.desc: Mako's carefree mother.

18679.name: Aikurou Mikisugi
18679.desc: A mysterious male teacher who develops an interest in Ryuko soon after she arrives at Honnouji Academy. ~!He is secretly an operative of the terrorist organization Nudist Beach, working to prevent Satsuki Kiryuin's influence from spreading any further. He also knew Ryuko's father before he was murdered. Has a tendency to strip, as fitting with his organization's name.!~

18679.name: Maiko Oogure
18679.desc: Oogure Maiko is the Head of Trap development.

18679.name: Uzu Sanageyama
18679.desc: Sanageyama Uzu is one of Four Kings. He is the Head of the Sports Club. ~!After losing a battle to Ryuuko Matoi, he resolves himself to ask Iori Shirou to sew his eyes shut.!~ ~!After the events of episode 17, he and the other 4 kings join Nudist Beach.!~

18679.name: Takaharu Fukuroda
18679.desc: The Boxing Club Captain.

18679.name: Omiko Hakodate
18679.desc: Omiko Hakodate is a Third Year Class T student and Captain of the Tennis Club.

18679.name: Takiji Kuroido
18679.desc: The head steward to the Kiryuin Family. He has been entrusted to care for the Kiryuin mansion in Satsuki’s mother’s absence.

18679.name: Shirou Iori
18679.desc: The president of the Honnouji Academy Sewing Club. The Sewing Club is responsible for manufacturing the Goku Uniforms.

18679.name: Guts
18679.desc: The Mankanshoku family’s pet.

18679.name: Nui Harime
18679.desc: **Hair Color**: Blonde **Eye Color**: Dark Blue **Occupation**: Grand Couturier **Affiliation**: Revocs Corporation ~! **Race**: Life Fiber/Human hybrid **Relatives**: [Ragyo Kiryuin](https://anilist.co/character/126061/Ragyo-Kiryuin) (creator) !~ Nui Harime is the Grand Couturier of the Revocs Corporation. She is known for her cute appearance, sadistic yet childish nature, and incredible fighting power. Nui appears to be a young teenage girl of medium height. She has long blonde hair styled in drill-like pigtails, with smaller locks framing her face. Her eyes are sapphire blue, with highlights that resemble a smiling face. She wears a richly adorned pink lolita-styled dress with matching boots and fingerless gloves. She accentuates her ensemble with a parasol, a large pink hair bow, and a purple eyepatch. Her design has a prominent heart motif, such as on her collar, the center of her bow, her earrings, and even the highlights on her pigtails. Nui has a childlike, jovial, and happy-go-lucky demeanor; always smiling, and acting very friendly and even polite with everyone, demonstrating excessive intimacy towards even [Satsuki Kiryuin](https://anilist.co/character/83799/Satsuki-Kiryuin). According to [Ragyo Kiryuin](https://anilist.co/character/126061/Ragyo-Kiryuin), Nui is free-spirited and will do whatever she wants according to her whims. Her bubbly behavior and nonchalance towards anyone that stands in her way often puts her at odds with the main cast, and can easily becom

18679.name: Tsumugu Kinagase
18679.desc: A member of the organization called Nudist Beach whose main purpose is to rid the world of Life Fibers.

18679.name: Ragyou Kiryuuin
18679.desc: The head of the Kiryuuin family. ~!After being betrayed by Satsuki in the events of episode 17, she becomes the main antagonist!~

18679.name: Rei Hououmaru
18679.desc: Rei is originally from Africa but her hometown was caught in a civil war. Ragyou saved her and gave her the name she has now, “Rei Hououmaru”. She now works as secretary for Kiryuuin Ragyou at Revocs Corporation.

18679.name: Ryousuke Todoroki
18679.desc: Ryōsuke Todoroki is the president of the Automotive Airsoft Club, a club made from the merger of the Automotive and Airsoft Clubs.

18679.name: Aizenbou Fuguhara
18679.desc: Aizenbou Fuguhara is the president of the Ping Pong club.

18679.name: Jack Naitou
18679.desc: Jack Naitou is the Knife Throwing Club president.

18679.name: Isshin Matoi
18679.desc: [Ryuuko](https://anilist.co/character/83797/)'s deceased father who created [Senketsu](https://anilist.co/character/87510/S). He was also the creator of the scissor blade. ~!Previously known as Kiryuuin Souichirou, he had faked his death in order to escape from the clutches of Kiryuuin Ragyou, and founded the organization "Nudist Beach"!~

117193.name: Katsuki Bakugou
117193.desc: __Height:__ 172 cm (5'7") __Quirk:__ Explosion Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Katsuki is a crude, arrogant, short-tempered, and aggressive person, especially at the beginning of the series. Due to the constant praise of his abilities and powerful Quirk, Katsuki has developed a superiority complex, and because of that, he desires to be the first and best at everything. He loves to win above all else and cannot stand it when he doesn't, leading him to lose his already short temper if he achieves anything but a complete victory. Katsuki is not only very athletic and talented at fighting, but also very intelligent and extremely perceptive, capable of strategic planning and improvisation. Additionally, his grades are among the highest of his class. Katsuki also possesses surprising talent in other areas, such as cooking and music, even though he doesn't show a particular interest in them. Overall, Katsuki is considered a natural-born genius with the potential to be one of the best Pro Heroes. Katsuki's Quirk "Explosion" allows him to secrete nitroglycerin-like sweat from the palms of his hands and ignite it on command, allowing him to create strong explosions. The more Katsuki sweats, the stronger his explosions become. Not only can Katsuki use the explosions for attacking, he can also use them to propel himself and navigate through the air at high speeds, allowing him to fly at his opponents without giving them time to react, as well as evade incoming attacks, even whi

117193.name: Izuku Midoriya
117193.desc: __Height:__ 166 cm (5'5¼") __Quirk:__ One For All Student in Class 1-A at U.A High School. Although he was born without a Quirk, Izuku's innate heroism and strong sense of justice manages to catch the attention of the legendary hero [All Might](https://anilist.co/character/89224). Izuku has since become All Might's closest pupil. Izuku is a very timid, reserved, and polite boy. Although initially portrayed as insecure, tearful, and vulnerable, Izuku gradually matures into a more confident and braver person. His infectious leadership skills, combined with his passion and strategic abilities, have turned Izuku into a central figure of Class 1-A. He is caring and emotional, never hesitating to help or rescue someone in danger, even if he knows that he might not be strong or otherwise qualified enough to do it. Izuku is extremely (and sometimes scarily) enthusiastic about topics related to heroes. His dream drives him to write down notes about everything he learns about heroes' Quirks and fighting capabilities. Thanks to this practice, Izuku has developed a great analytical mind and can form complex battle plans in a few seconds, factoring in the best ways he can utilize the Quirks of allies and enemies alike for his own advantage. Izuku's Quirk "One For All" was transferred to him from All Might. His Quirk allows him to stockpile an enormous amount of raw power, allowing him to significantly enhance all of his physical abilities to various boundless levels. This results in unbel

117193.name: Shouto Todoroki
117193.desc: __Height:__ 176 cm (5'9") __Affiliation:__ U.A. High School __Quirk:__ Half-Cold Half-Hot Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School, where he got in through official recommendations. He is the youngest son of the top hero [Endeavor](https://anilist.co/character/126158). Shouto initially has a cold, aloof personality, which stemmed from his complicated family life. Focused and unemotional, Shouto preferred to keep things to himself instead of hanging out with others. After the events of the U.A. Sports Festival, however, he notably became more sociable and kinder than ever before. He even gained a sense of humor and would occasionally smile, although still retaining some fragments of his previous distant attitude and nonchalant demeanor. While usually quiet and reserved, Shouto initially possessed a moderate level of arrogance, which, combined with his solitary tendencies, sometimes made him take the initiative without considering the opinions of others. Shouto's Quirk Half-Cold Half-Hot gives him the ability to generate ice from the right side of his body, and flames from his left side. Due to years of rejecting his father, Shouto has developed a habit of favoring ice, even when fire would be a better option. This grudge also caused him to have difficulty controlling his flames. If he overuses one element without utilizing the other, then his own body temperature will suffer.

117193.name: Ochako Uraraka
117193.desc: __Height:__ 156 cm (5'1") __Quirk:__ Zero Gravity Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School Ochako is an outgoing, lively person who thinks about everything positively, though she is objective enough to see flaws and virtues. She gets excited over little things very easily. Ochaco has been described by other students as "the most laidback girl" among her class, being very bubbly and kind of an airhead at times. She is often incredibly blunt without being aware of it. She is on good terms with everyone and is particularly close friends with several class members, including [Izuku](https://anilist.co/character/89028/Midoriya-Izuku), [Tenya Ida](https://anilist.co/character/89222/Iida-Tenya), and [Tsuyu](https://anilist.co/character/89223/Asui-Tsuyu). Ochaco's Quirk gives her the power to manipulate gravity upon touching solid things with the pads on her fingertips. The targets lose their gravitational pull, effectively making them weightless. She is able to activate or cancel her Quirk's effects by closing her fingers together, and is shown to be careful with her hands in order to avoid accidental quirk activation.

117193.name: Tenya Iida
117193.desc: __Height:__ 179 cm (5'10") __Quirk:__ Engine Class representative of Class 1-A at U.A. High School Tenya may look severe, but he's actually just a very serious person, who takes everything, even the most insignificant thing, seriously. A testament to his generally hyperactive and intense behavior, Tenya often exhibits plenty of peculiar tics, such as moving his arms around in strange chopping patterns or sometimes twitching his body uncontrollably. Tenya is very humble, willing to admit to his mistakes, apologize for rude behavior, and improve in areas he lacks. Being part of the highly-esteemed Ida Family of Heroes, Tenya is proud of his lineage and works hard to meet his expectations. He greatly admires his older brother, Tensei (also known as the Turbo Hero: Ingenium), and aspires to become a similar hero. Tenya's Quirk Engine gives him car-like engines in each of his calves, giving him incredible running speed and extreme kicking power. Tenya needs to fuel his engines by drinking orange juice. Tenya's engines have multiple gears; it is currently unknown how many, but it has been implied that there are more than three.

117193.name: Tsuyu Asui
117193.desc: __Affiliation:__ U.A. High School __Quirk:__ Frog Tsuyu is a very straight-forward girl that always says what's on her mind and what she thinks about others. She prefers to be called by her first name.

117193.name: Toshinori Yagi
117193.desc: __Height:__ 220 cm (7'2") __Quirk:__ One for All All Might is the No. 1 Hero and the "Symbol of Peace." In his hero form, All Might is a very tall and over-muscular man whose design resembles the american hero comics. His hair spikes on top of his head and his whole body has more shadows than a normal human being. However, in his true form, he is an overly-skinny man who spits a lot of blood out of his mouth and his clothes appear loose.

117193.name: Shouta Aizawa
117193.desc: __Height: __183 cm (6') __Occupation:__ Pro Hero, Teacher __Affiliation:__ U.A. High School __Quirk:__ Erasure Aizawa's hero name, Eraserhead, was coined by [Present Mic](https://anilist.co/character/127425) when they were younger. Using the binding cloth, Aizawa has a unique fighting style that allows him to immobilize his enemies. He is known to expel students that don't meet his standards, however it should be noted that he did not expel anyone from Class 1-A. Aizawa is extremely vocal, able to voice his opinions very easily. Although seeming emotionless and reserved, he has a soft spot for his students and genuinely cares for them.

117193.name: Tomura Shigaraki
117193.desc: __Height:__ 175 cm (5'9) __Quirk:__ Decay Leader of the League of Villains and protégé of [All For One](https://anilist.co/character/125956/All-For-One). He was raised by his master, All For One, with the goal of killing [All Might](https://anilist.co/character/89224/Yagi-Toshinori), and ultimately destroying the society he represents. Tomura is a very twisted, malevolent, and maliciously warped young man, who is considered to be the polar opposite of [Izuku Midoriya](https://anilist.co/character/89028/Midoriya-Izuku). He doesn't care for his or almost anyone else's life, having no qualms about performing evil deeds like murdering innocent people. Tomura was initially perceived to be a "man-child": arrogant, selfish, dependent, and demanding, becoming angry if things didn't go his way and likening reality to some sort of video game. Unlike his mentor, Tomura lacked subtlety, preferring to eliminate problems through force. Much like a child, Tomura seemed unable to cope with his own feelings, instead lashing out and abusing both others or himself, tearing at his own neck when he becomes frustrated. Initially, Tomura seemingly caused destruction just for the sake of it and felt directionless about the League's path forward after [Stain](https://anilist.co/character/126067/Akaguro-Chizome)'s arrest. It would take a fateful meeting with Izuku in a mall for him to develop an epiphany and become aware of his true convictions: to crumble hero society through All Might's death. Tomur

117193.name: Momo Yaoyorozu
117193.desc: __Height:__ 173 cm (5'8") __Quirk:__ Creation Vice class representative of Class 1-A at U.A. High School. She was admitted to the school through official recommendations. Momo is a very prudent, dedicated person who acts as a natural leader. She is generally level-headed and calm in dangerous situations, but she isn't above falling into a panic. Momo can be blunt with her comments about people's mistakes and miscalculations, tending to be very direct and wishing to help her peers improve enough to become great heroes. Momo's Quirk gives her the ability to create any non-living material/object from her exposed skin by transforming the molecular structure of her fat cells. In order to create something, she needs to understand the molecular structure of which the material/object is made.

117193.name: Hitoshi Shinsou
117193.desc: __Height:__ 177 cm (5'9½") __Quirk:__ Brainwashing Student at U.A. High School, attending Class 1-C of the Department of General Education. Hitoshi is a stoic and straightforward person with an innate ability to spark conversation with anyone despite holding a reserved and quiet attitude most of the time. He is shown to be rather clever, knowing just the right words to manipulate others into replying to his comments, allowing him to activate his Quirk. He does not mind doing something underhanded to claim victory in a fight. Due to having his Brainwashing Quirk perceived as evil throughout his life, Hitoshi has been somewhat feared by those aware of his power and has been discriminated against solely because of the Quirk he was born with. This persecution led him to become resentful of those who had Quirks more associated with hero work. Regardless of his drawbacks, however, Hitoshi desires to become a Pro Hero more than anything. Hitoshi's Quirk Brainwashing allows him to put someone in a state where they are forced to obey whatever he commands. He can only activate this power when his target verbally responds to something he says. Brainwashing must be intentionally activated and will not take effect if Hitoshi doesn't want it to. Using a megaphone or anything that makes his voice artificial will not allow his Quirk to activate, as the said devices would transform his voice into an electronic signal.

117193.name: Eijirou Kirishima
117193.desc: __Height:__ 170 cm (5'7") __Quirk:__ Hardening Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Eijiro is a boisterous and outgoing guy with a fondness for manliness, often using the terms "manly" and "unmanly" to describe things and people he does or doesn't like, respectively. Eijiro is very honest and kind-hearted, having a straightforward way of thinking and following a specific code of chivalry that motivates him to live without regret. He is determined and selfless, bravely putting the safety of others before himself. He is also a big fan of Crimson Riot, a retro hero from whom he takes inspiration, including personal values and his hero name. Although Eijiro may not be as hot-blooded and competitive as [Katsuki Bakugou](https://anilist.co/character/88892), he does not shy away from comparing himself to him, with [Izuku](https://anilist.co/character/89028) stating that the two have managed to develop a relationship between equals. As a result, Eijiro is notably one of the few people that Katsuki holds in higher esteem. Eijiro's Quirk gives him the power to harden and sharpen any or all parts of his body, causing his flesh to become jagged and rock-like. There is a limit to how much damage his hardened body can withstand, which causes the Hardening itself to slowly dissipate, and Eijiro to lose stamina from struggling to keep his Quirk active.

117193.name: Minoru Mineta
117193.desc: __Height:__ 108 cm (3' 6½") __Quirk:__ Pop Off __Affiliation:__ U.A. High School __Fighting Style:__ Medium Ranged Support Minoru Mineta, also known as the Fresh-Picked Hero: Grape Juice, is a student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School, training to become a Pro Hero.

117193.name: Mina Ashido
117193.desc: __Height:__ 159 cm (5'3") __Quirk:__ Acid Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Mina is a cheerful and easygoing girl who usually displays a smile. Highly social and excitable, she loves to hang out with her friends and is shown to become very upset when denied an opportunity to be at a gathering. She possesses a strong fashion sense and likes to go shopping. Due to her athleticism and energy, Mina enjoys and is very skilled at dancing. Mina is extremely courageous and is viewed as an ideal personality for hero work. Mina's Quirk Acid allows her to produce a corrosive liquid from her body. She can control the solubility and viscosity of this corrosive liquid. There is a limit to how long she can produce the corrosive liquid until her skin gradually loses its natural resistance to it. Overusing her Quirk or pushing it too far can also be fatal, as it dehydrates her body very fast. Mina can use her acid offensively, but has shown utility with it as well, such as melting handholds for herself to climb with. She is also known to secrete a non-corrosive version of the acid from her feet in order to slide around.

117193.name: Mei Hatsume
117193.desc: __Height:__ 157 cm (5'2") __Quirk:__ Zoom Mei is a smart, off-setting, and assertive girl, often making those around her uncomfortable. She loves creating gadgets, which she refers to as her "super cute babies". Mei has a habit of "going straight to the point" and is very shameless and opportunistic when it comes to advertising her inventions. While talking to people, she has a habit of getting awkwardly close to them, which usually causes them to back away from her but she still moves up to them.

117193.name: Denki Kaminari
117193.desc: __Height:__ 168 cm (5'6") __Quirk:__ Electrification Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Denki is a friendly, social, and energetic boy who enjoys hanging out with others. He is rather casual when interacting with other people, including the generally unfriendly [Katsuki Bakugou](https://anilist.co/character/88892/Bakugou-Katsuki). Denki's Quirk Electrification allows him to store and discharge electricity. While he can also discharge this energy over a distance, Denki has little to no control over it, meaning it will go everywhere indiscriminately. Denki is also able to absorb and neutralize electricity and other lightning-based Quirks. Whenever Denki exceeds his wattage limit, he loses his ability to discharge energy, with his entire personality changing into that of a giggling idiot for a certain period until he reverts to normal. In this state, he is always giving thumbs-ups as a way to let others know that he is okay.

117193.name: Jin Bubaigawara
117193.desc: __Height:__ 178 cm (5'10") __Quirk:__ Double Villain affiliated with the League of Villains, and part of its Vanguard Action Squad. Jin has an incredibly unique personality: explosive, and lively with a very comedic demeanor. He enjoys assuming dramatic poses and eccentric facial expressions. Jin constantly contradicts himself, making a statement in one voice and immediately saying the opposite in another. This juxtaposition iss part of a mental instability that Jin embraces as a villain. He believes understanding your own identity is the most essential aspect in life, an understanding he lost during the 9-day conflict with his own clones that left him unsure whether he was the original or not. Now, if his mask is removed, he panics and threatens to "split" until he put his mask back on to become "whole". Jin's Quirk allows him to create an exact duplicate of anything, living or not. To duplicate something, he needs to know its precise measurements and characteristics. The clones he makes do not disappear; instead, they disintegrate into a mud-like substance after taking a certain amount of damage. The duplicates are less durable than the original, and the second duplicate is even less durable than the first. When Jin creates duplicates of a person, he has no control over the clones because they have their own autonomy, personalities, and abilities that are utterly identical to the original.

117193.name: Hanta Sero
117193.desc: __Height:__ 177 cm (5' 9¾") __Quirk:__ Tape Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Hanta is amicable and has proven to be one of the more sociable members of Class 1-A. He can sometimes be loud and showy, often trying to impress his peers with his Quirk. He is often the only person to call his classmates out when they act crazy. He is pretty humorous and usually makes jokes with his classmates. However, when push comes to shove, Hanta is a brave hero-in-training who wishes to prosper on his own while helping others do the same. Hanta's Quirk is that he has tape dispenser-like organs in his elbows, from which he can shoot long cellophane tape-like strips; he can also retract them. They appear to be somewhat sturdier than regular tape. Overuse of his Quirk will cause his skin to dry out. He can use his tape to wrap people, swing long distances, and create traps, among other applications.

117193.name: Mashirao Ojiro
117193.desc: __Height:__ 169 cm (5'6") __Quirk:__ Tail Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Mashirao has a very calm and noble attitude and a profound sense of dignity, which prevents him from accepting results he doesn't feel he earned with his own abilities. He is also described as a hard worker. Along with a strong sense of dignity, Mashirao can be described as sheepish and bashful, not very often enjoying the spotlight and being easily embarrassed. A recurring joke is that others view Mashirao as "plain," which profoundly upsets him. Mashirao's Quirk is that he has a long, powerful, sturdy tail. His tail effectively functions as a third arm that he can use to grab things. Furthermore, it's attack power is strong enough to break objects made of metal, he can wrap it around enemies, and it can support Mashirao's body weight. Mashirao is incredibly adept at using his tail, combining it with his knowledge of martial arts to engage enemies in close-range combat, performing fast and acrobatic moves. His tail can also increase his speed and mobility by whipping it down against the ground to use it like a springboard. (Source: My Hero Academia Wiki)

117193.name: Kyouka Jirou
117193.desc: __Height:__ 154 cm (5'1") __Quirk:__ Earphone Jack __Affiliation:__ U.A. High School __Fighting Style:__ Medium Ranged + Support Combat Kyoka is a petite, fair-skinned girl with a slender build. She has triangular, lazy-looking onyx eyes with notably long lower eyelashes, and rather small eyebrows. Kyoka has a pragmatic, unenthusiastic and teasing personality that is mostly shown to those she finds irritating. Kyoka is not always like this though, as she does enjoy socializing with others, in which case she is usually nice and friendly. Kyoka's Quirk (Earphone Jack) allows her to plug the jacks that hang from her earlobes into all sorts of things and channel the sound of her heartbeat into them; causing havoc inside the plugged objects. It's also used to catch sounds and vibrations from her surroundings.

117193.name: Fumikage Tokoyami
117193.desc: __Height:__ 158 cm __Quirk:__ Dark Shadow Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Fumikage is reserved, serious, and focused, albeit noble and valiant. Though not talkative, Fumikage will directly ignore questions or requests that seem in some way pointless. During combat, Fumikage is known to be fierce and dependable, with his strength and capabilities rarely being questioned. Fumikage is fond of darkness and other related concepts, considering himself a "creature of the dark" and employing archaic-sounding speeches that paint him slightly creepy or dramatic. Fumikage's Quirk "Dark Shadow" allows him to manifest a sentient shadow monster from his body that he can materialize and contract freely. Dark Shadow's energy is limited and can be drained by bright light. Dark Shadow retracts into Fumikage's body when it runs out of energy. The shadow entity's personality, strength, defense, and control depend on the lack of light. In bright light, Dark Shadow is weaker and smaller but still has considerable strength and defense and is easier to control, but in total darkness, Dark Shadow's size and parameters are drastically enhanced. It is powerful enough to rip out and cut down multiple full-grown trees easily. However, Dark Shadow is more difficult to control in the dark, causing it to rampage based on its own free will.

117193.name: Mezou Shouji
117193.desc: __Height:__ 187 cm (6'2") __Quirk:__ Dupli-Arms Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Shouji is friendly and gentle, and he will work nicely with anyone. He is not the type to hold grudges, showing no ill will towards those that harm him unwillingly. Shouji is entirely selfless and willing to risk his life for anyone. He can be empathetic and understanding, but still shows a sense of maturity and responsibility that prevents him from acting under emotional impulses. He is very protective of his classmates, especially if they are hurt or injured. He is also quite thick-skinned, as he said he is used to being feared due to his appearance. Shouji's Quirk grants him a set of tentacles alongside his arms. He can transform the tips of these tentacles to replicate other parts of his body (ex: mouth, ears, eyes). The duplicated body parts are more efficient than the originals; as a result, Mezo is able to hear better, see-through more angles at a time, and they grant him much higher degrees of strength. He uses these arms to talk most of the time through duplicate mouths, rather than his actual mouth.

117193.name: Tooru Hagakure
117193.desc: __Height:__ 152 cm (5'0") __Quirk:__ Invisibility Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Tooru is a bubbly, cheery, and easygoing girl who does most things with an upbeat attitude. She is very socially eager and likes shopping, and her room suggests that she likes plushies and other cute things. Tooru's Quirk is that her body is completely invisible. In addition to the stealth capabilities granted to her by her invisible body, Tooru can refract light that passes through her, allowing her to intensify the light into a blinding flash. She has further refined this application of her Quirk, achieving the ability to manipulate and redirect light-based attacks, such as [Yuuga Aoyama](https://anilist.co/character/127042/Aoyama-Yuuga)'s Navel Laser.

117193.name: Kouji Kouda
117193.desc: __Height:__ 186 cm (6'1") __Quirk:__ Anivoice Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Contrary to his strong and powerful appearance, Kouji is very timid and quiet. He rarely speaks and prefers using sign language to communicate with his classmates. He hates violence due to his kind-hearted nature. Kouji appears to greatly enjoy the company of animals, as his Quirk allows him to interact with animals in ways others cannot. He owns a small rabbit as a pet. Kouji's Quirk "Anivoice (生き物ボイス, Ikimono Voice)" gives him the ability to command any creature in the animal kingdom by speaking to them. Whatever command he gives, the animal will carry it out. However, he cannot exert control if they cannot hear his command. The target must also be a real animal and not merely animal-like. Kouji can also exchange information with the animals to find the locations of various people and potential enemies faster. Kouji has been shown to use the Quirk effectively with flocks of birds to create a smokescreen of animals and to attack an opponent, along with his use of insects to distract and attack his opponents. He has now also overcome his fear of bugs, so he often uses bugs to swarm opponents with numbers.

117193.name: Rikidou Satou
117193.desc: __Height:__ 185 cm (6'1") __Quirk:__ Sugar Rush Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Rikidou is interested in sweets and baking, a valuable skill due to his Quirk. He is surprisingly talented at making sweets. Rikidou's Quirk Sugar Rush allows him to increase his strength five-fold for three minutes. To activate his Quirk, he needs to consume 10 grams of sugar. When converting sugar into strength, his cognitive functions gradually drop, making him sleepy afterward. For every additional 10 grams of sugar he ingests, he extends the time of increased strength by another three minutes.

117193.name: Yuu Takeyama
117193.desc: __Height:__ 162 cm (5'4") (Normal form); 2062cm (67'8") (Transformed) __Quirk:__ Gigantification __Occupation:__ Pro Hero Pro Hero. Her Quirk allows her to grow to a gigantic size. She cannot variate between her base-height and the gigantified height achieved via her Quirk, making her only able to be either her normal height of 162cm (5 feet 4 inches) or her enlarged height of 2,062cm (67 feet 8 inches) tall.

117193.name: Sirius
117193.desc: Sirius is a pro hero and sidekick of Selkie.

117193.name: Mirio Togata
117193.desc: __Height:__ 181 cm (5'11") __Occupation:__ Student __Affiliation:__ U.A. High School __Quirk:__ Permeation He is third-year student at U.A. High School and is part of The Big 3 _(the strongest three hero students in all of Japan)_. Before [Izuku Midoriya](https://anilist.co/character/89028/Midoriya-Izuku), Mirio was the top candidate for [All Might](https://anilist.co/character/89224/Yagi-Toshinori)'s successor and inheritor of One For All. His Quirk, Permeation, gives him the ability to become intangible, letting him pass through any tangible matter; he can phase through walls and/or the ground, as well as let enemy attacks pass through him harmlessly.

117193.name: Neito Monoma
117193.desc: __Height:__ 170cm __Quirk:__ Copy Student in Class 1-B at U.A. High School. Neito has a rather complex personality since it differs depending on who he is addressing; he is particularly mocking, loud, and sarcastic with Class 1-A, but outside of these interactions, he is a calm, kind, and intelligent person. He envies Class 1-A with a passion over how they became the center of attention among U.A.'s first years because of the U.S.J. Incident. Truthfully, he only wants his class to stand out as they do, and he vents this feeling by throwing countless taunts towards his rivals, gloating over Class 1-B's successes and disparaging 1-A for their failures. Neito's Quirk is Copy, which allows him to duplicate and use another person's Quirk after coming into physical contact with the user. He can hold four Quirks simultaneously and maintain copied powers for ten minutes. After the time limit runs out, he loses the copied Quirk until he once again touches the original user.

117193.name: Himiko Toga
117193.desc: __Height:__ 157 cm __Quirk:__ Transform Himiko Toga is a villain affiliated with the League of Villains and part of its Vanguard Action Squad. She originally joined the group as a means to get closer to [Stain](https://anilist.co/character/126067). Himiko is a very cheerful girl, to the point of smiling even after having presumably killed someone, displaying apparent sadistic tendencies. She has a very twisted perception of love and friendship Himiko's Quirk Transform grants her the ability to transform into a physical lookalike of another individual, as well as copy their voice. She can only transform into people whose blood she has ingested. The more blood she drinks, the longer she has access to that person's form. For example, 1 cup of blood allows her to transform for a total of 18 hours. She can even switch between the appearances of multiple people if she drinks the blood of more than one person.

117193.name: Tamaki Amajiki
117193.desc: __Height:__ 177 cm (5'10") __Quirk:__ Manifest Third-year student in Class 3-A at U.A. High School and part of The Big 3 (the strongest three hero students in all of Japan). Tamaki is extremely shy, aloof, depressed, "intimidating", and introverted, especially around big audiences. He gets nervous very easily when talking to other people. If his anxiety gets the best of him, Tamaki will often face away and lean into a wall to hide his face from others. While his physical abilities and Quirk are outstanding, Tamaki is socially awkward and lacks confidence in his powers. Despite his timid heart, Tamaki can show flashes of bravery.
