Even though he's always been a shy and reserved boy, Tamaki was able to hone his skills and climb the ranks into one of U.A.'s Big 3. [Mirio Togata](https://anilist.co/character/123527/Togata-Mirio) is a big inspiration for Tamaki. Tamaki's Quirk Manifest grants him the ability to manifest the physical characteristics of anything he's eaten; for example, if he eats takoyaki, he can transform his fingers into octopus tentacles. Additionally, anything Tamaki manifests is significantly stronger than normal. The more of a substance Tamaki eats, the stronger his manifestation will be. He can only manifest the traits of substances still in his system and loses access to those traits once the substance is fully digested. He must resupply his Quirk daily and decide what foods to eat beforehand.

117193.name: All For One
117193.original: オール・フォー・ワン
117193.desc: __Quirk:__ All For One __Occupation:__ Villain __Fighting Style:__ Close Range and Long Range All For One is the true leader and benefactor of the League of Villains. Once Japan's most powerful villain and All Might's arch-nemesis, his true motives are unclear and his true identity unknown. His current goal is to raise Shigaraki to become his eventual successor.

117193.name: Shuuichi Iguchi
117193.desc: __Height:__ 174 cm __Occupation:__ Villain __Affiliation:__ League of Villains (formerly), Paranormal Liberation Front (Lieutenant of Brown Regiment) __Quirk:__ Gecko Shuuichi is a villain affiliated with the League of Villains and part of its Vanguard Action Squad. He is completely obsessed with the ways of [Stain](https://anilist.co/character/126067) to the point where he copies his clothing and weaponry style, aiming to follow the same ideals as him and make his dreams come true.

117193.name: Itsuka Kendou
117193.desc: __Height:__ 166 cm (5'5") __Quirk:__ Big Fist Class representative of Class 1-B at U.A. High School, Itsuka is a spirited girl who is thoughtful of others. She does not hesitate to criticize even her classmates if she feels what they are doing is not correct. Due to Itsuka's cheerful personality, she can bring all of Class 1-B together, thus making her the "big sister" of Class 1-B. Itsuka's Quirk Big Fist grants her the ability to enlarge both of her hands to a gigantic size. With the increased size comes enhanced striking power and gripping capabilities.

117193.name: Eri
117193.desc: __Height:__ 110 cm __Quirk:__ Rewind Eri is a child with bandages all over her body. She wears a white short sleeve dress and has a small horn on the right side of her forehead and has white, long, choppy, unkempt hair. She also has red eyes. Under her bandages, her arms are shown to have numerous scars. ~!Eri is the key source to [Kai Chisaki's](https://anilist.co/character/126357/Kai-Chisaki) operation to manufacture a Quirk-Destroying Drug. She is the granddaughter of the Eight Precepts of Death's boss!~

117193.name: Enji Todoroki
117193.desc: __Height:__ 195 cm (6' 4¾") __Occupation:__ Pro Hero __Quirk:__ Hellflame Endeavor is a tall man with a muscular physique. He has short and spiky, red hair with bright blue eyes. His beard and mustache appear to be made of fire, but when he turns off his flames on his face voluntarily, his stubble shows. ~!His desire to surpass the number one hero has driven him in family matters. Enji put [Shouto](https://anilist.co/character/89220/Todoroki-Shouto) through ruthless "training" which caused Shouto a severe degree of physical and emotional pain. Shouto, harboring a bitter hatred towards his father on account of this, refuses to use his fire powers in battles until [Izuku Midoriya](https://anilist.co/character/89028/Midoriya-Izuku) reminded him of his mother's encouragement. Later, Enji understood his mistakes and told his son he would try to be a better hero and father. He hopes for Shouto and the rest his family to forgive him in the future.!~ ~!He's the former No.2 Hero, but later becomes the new No.1 Hero after [All Might](https://anilist.co/character/89224/Yagi-Toshinori) loses his Quirk!~

117193.name: Nana Shimura
117193.desc: Shimura Nana was the seventh user of the One For All Quirk, [All Might](https://anilist.co/character/89224)'s mentor, and a close friend of [Gran Torino](https://anilist.co/character/127428). ~!It was revealed that she is the grandmother of [Shigaraki](https://anilist.co/character/89226)!~

117193.name: Dabi
117193.desc: __Height:__ 176 cm (5'9¼") __Quirk:__ Blueflame Dabi is a villain affiliated with the League of Villains and a member of the organization's Vanguard Action Squad. Dabi is a stoic, aloof, confident, and focused individual who rarely shows emotion. While rather crude and violent, he's also shown to be quite cautious. Overall, Dabi is a highly enigmatic individual who trusts no one, preferring to do things alone and in his way. He also gives off the impression of knowing more about certain people than he lets on. Dabi's Quirk grants him the ability to generate and control highly destructive blue flames from his body. He has very well-developed control of his flames and can project them far from himself and in large amounts. However, Dabi's body has a low tolerance for his flame, and he will get burned if he uses them for prolonged periods. ~!It is later revealed that Dabi is Touya Todoroki (轟燈矢), the eldest son of the Pro Hero [Endeavor](https://anilist.co/character/126158/Todoroki-Enji) and his wife [Rei](https://anilist.co/character/150628/Todoroki-Rei), and the older brother to [Shouto Todoroki](https://anilist.co/character/89220/Todoroki-Shouto). For a significant period of time, his whereabouts were unknown.!~

117193.name: Nejire Hadou
117193.desc: __Height:__ 164 cm (5'4") __Occupation:__ Student __Quirk:__ Wave Motion (ability to convert body's vitality into energy that can discharge as blast waves) She is third-year student at U.A. High School and is part of The Big 3 _(the strongest three hero students in all of Japan)_. Nejire is very enthusiastic, affable and cheery, and is always seen moving. She shows great interest in people's unique physical features and is easily distracted by them. She seems to like knowing more than others, but not in a proud way, as she just enjoys explaining things to people and sharing her knowledge. Despite her happy-go-lucky personality, Nejire is fierce in battle. When the situation calls for it, Nejire can be very calm and focused. Her curiosity never seems to extend to the enemy and she always maintains her focus on taking them down.

117193.name: Yuuga Aoyama
117193.desc: **Height:** 168 cm (5'6") **Quirk:** Navel Lazer Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Yuuga appears to be vain and prideful, thinking of himself as superior to the rest of his classmates, especially regarding his Quirk. He exhibits flamboyant mannerisms, is fond of posing, and likes to grab the attention of those around him despite frequently getting ignored by his peers. He also plays up his French heritage, occasionally implementing French words into his sentences. Yuuga's Quirk allows him to shoot a powerful sparkling laser cannon from his navel. It is so powerful, it can blast through two meters of solid concrete. If he fires the laser for more than 1 second at a time, he will suffer intestinal distress.

117193.name: Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu
117193.desc: __Height:__ 174cm (5'9") __Quirk:__ Steel Student in Class 1-B at U.A. High School. Tetsutetsu is defined by his very hotheaded and outspoken personality. He is confident, stubborn, and straightforward in his motivations and actions. He tends to be very vocal about his intentions and has a one-track mind, often looking for the simplest solution to problems to solve them most directly. Tetsutetsu's direct personality shows through his tenacious and upfront fighting style during battles. Tetsutetsu's Quirk allows him to turn his body into steel. This power grants Tetsutetsu both augmented defensive abilities to withstand attacks and the increased strength of his unarmed physical attacks.

117193.name: Hizashi Yamada
117193.desc: __Height:__ 185cm (6'1") __Quirk:__ Voice Pro Hero. He also works as an English teacher at U.A. High School and as a radio talk show host. Yamada maintains the eccentric persona of a radio host. He often poses when he talks and maintains a certain level of excitement or volume, regardless of the situation. Though he tends to be a jovial individual, Hizashi is capable of great rage when it comes to his friends and colleagues. Yamada's Quirk "Voice" allows him to increase the volume of his voice, giving him an ability that is similar to a sonic scream. The sound from his Quirk is strong enough to cause people's ears to bleed from far away. The only known weakness of this Quirk is that the loud sounds do not travel well underground, making this Quirk ineffective against anything that is underground or separated from him by layers of earth.

117193.name: Ibara Shiozaki
117193.desc: __Height:__ 167cm (5'6") __Quirk:__ Vine Student in Class 1-B at U.A. High School. Ibara is a very modest and courteous person. Although graceful and soft-spoken, she is not afraid to make her pure intentions known. She seems highly religious due to her talking about heaven and divine beings in passing on multiple occasions, and her ultimate moves having somewhat religious names such as "Faith's Shield" and "Crucifixion". Ibara's Quirk "Vine (ツル, Tsuru) gives her hair-like vines that grow on her head. She can lengthen and manipulate the vines, allowing her to attack, defend and grapple. She also can detach them at will. The vines will grow back, provided her head receives proper sunlight and water. (Source: MyHero Academia Wiki)

117193.name: Nemuri Kayama
117193.desc: __Height:__ 175 cm (5'9") __Quirk:__ Somnambulist Pro Hero. She also works as a Modern Hero Art History teacher at U.A. High School. Nemuri is a very playful and flirtatious person with an unpredictably serious and temperamental side to her. She gets angry whenever someone interrupts her or insults her. She is especially sensitive about her age. Despite her flirtatious personality, Nemuri was intelligent, perceptive, and articulate. While she comes off as a hero who enjoys her fame derived from her beauty and sex appeal, Nemuri has demonstrated true heroism and bravery, willing to fight on the front lines and put her life at risk for others. Nemuri's Quirk "Somnambulist" allows her to put nearby people to sleep by exuding a sleep-inducing aroma from her body. Her Quirk works better on males than females.

117193.name: Sorahiko Torino
117193.desc: __Height:__ 128 cm (4'2") __Affiliation:__ Yuuei (Retired) __Quirk:__ Jet A retired hero who is one of All Might's colleagues and his former homeroom teacher. He was the one who taught All Might to control One For All during the his early days, and his training was so intense that All Might fears him to the point he subconsciously tried to forget about him until Grantorino sent his recommendation for Izuku to help him improve One For All, becoming his work place mentor. His Quirk is "Jet," allowing him to take in air through the sole of his foot to allow him to jump higher. (Source: Wikipedia)

117193.name: Keigo Takami
117193.desc: __Height:__ 172 cm (5' 7¾") __Occupation:__ Pro Hero (No.3 - former, No.2 - current) __Quirk:__ Fierce Wings __Affiliation:__ Hero Public Safety Commission, ~!Paranormal Liberation Front (as a spy)!~ Hawks is carefree, jovial, and dislikes formalities, often acting in a spontaneous and unpredictable way while being cocky and taunting. He believes that popular approval is the most important metric a Pro Hero should be judged for, and does not appear to take the official rankings seriously, showing a preference for the lower ranks as it would allow him to act more freely and avoid the burdens of being a top hero. He states his wish to patrol in a leisurely fashion and "take it easy". It is hinted that Hawks was a fan of [Endeavor](https://anilist.co/character/126158/Todoroki-Enji) from an early age, as depicted by the drawing of him as a child holding an Endeavor figurine.

117193.name: Tensei Iida
117193.desc: __Quirk:__ Engine Tensei Iida, also known as Turbo Hero "Ingenium", is the older brother of Tenya Iida and a former Pro Hero. Outside of his hero armor Tensei looks much like his younger brother Tenya, with square features and short black spiked hair. A differing feature is that he possesses arrow-shaped eyebrows and has a slightly longer face. Similar to his brother, he has engine exhausts protruding from his body, but out of the ends of his elbows instead of his calves. **Also in Illegals:** Tensei meets with Koichi during an early morning run. Tensei is impressed with Koichi's Quirk and offers him a place in his agency, even expressing a desire for a sidekick with a fast mobility quirk. Later, when Tensei discovers Koichi has been working as a vigilante hero, he withdraws his offer to Koichi, but only because he believes him to be already in the right place.

117193.name: Natsuo Todoroki
117193.desc: __Height:__ 181 cm Natsuo Todoroki is a college student. He is the son of [Enji](https://anilist.co/character/126158/Todoroki-Enji) and [Rei Todoroki](https://anilist.co/character/150628/Todoroki-Rei), the younger brother of Toya and [Fuyumi](https://anilist.co/character/150627/Todoroki-Fuyumi), and the older brother of [Shoto](https://anilist.co/character/89220/Todoroki-Shouto). Natsuo is a young man of average height, sporting white spiky hair with two small pieces of hair hanging down by his forehead. He greatly resembles his father at his age. Natsuo seems to be a care-free individual, as seen in his interactions with him and his family. However, he can be serious, and cares deeply for his family, except his father who he resents for his abusive treatment to his family. He does not feel forgiving to his father, blaming him for his mother Rei's hospitalization and Shoto's suffering.

117193.name: Naomasa Tsukauchi
117193.desc: Naomasa Tsukauchi is a police detective in the Police Force. Naomasa is a tall man with short black hair and black eyes. As a member of the police force, he is normally seen in his uniform. He wears a signature tan overcoat and a matching hat. He also sports a black suit underneath with matching slacks and dress shoes. Detective Tsukauchi is an earnest, hardworking individual who has earned the right to be a close friend of All Might. Enough so, that he was even entrusted with the truth about One For All and the latter's true form. He appears to have a close relationship with All Might, as he even leaked sensitive information to the hero just because he felt it was the right thing to do.

117193.name: Inko Midoriya
117193.desc: __Height:__ 160 cm (5'3'') Izuku Midoriya's mother. Her quirk allows her to pull small objects towards her.

117193.name: Kurogiri
117193.desc: __Affiliation:__ League of Villains __Quirk:__ Warp Gate Kurogiri has a level-headed personality, which often serves to ground Tomura Shigaraki's immaturity. He is intensely loyal to both All For One and Tomura. He is very polite and well-spoken, even to enemies. ~! Kurogiri is actually an intelligent Nomu made from the corpse of Eraserhead and President Mics high school friend Oboro Shirakumo made to serve Tomura Shigaraki. Although he remains unaware of his previous identity after Eraserheads efforts to talk to him it’s shown that a small part of Oboro is still in Kurogiri!~

117193.name: Atsuhiro  Sako
117193.desc: Mr. Compress's Quirk allows him to "compress" anything in a spherical area into a small marble without actually damaging it. The weight of the target is reduced alongside them, making them very easy to carry. If used on a person, it effectively entraps them, terminating the fight instantly and allowing Mr. Compress to abduct them without difficulty. The Quirk can also be used on select body parts, maiming the target.

117193.name: Giran
117193.desc: Giran is a B-rank villain and broker in affiliation with the League of Villains, working to scout new recruits for their organization

117193.name: Kaoruko Awata
117193.desc: Quirk: Bubble (バブル Baburu) With this Quirk, Kaoruko can make bubbles filled with an aroma that she had smelled at least once before. She can make both sweet-smelling bubbles and foul-smelling ones. When she’s too nervous, she produces very unpleasant-smelling bubbles that are self-destructing She is a dedicated hero as well as Sir Nighteyes sidekick

117193.name: Togaru Kamakiri
117193.desc: __Height:__ 158 cm (6'2") __Quirk:__ Razor Sharp __Affiliation:__ Yuuei __Occupation:__ Student Togaru Kamakiri is a student in Class 1-B at U.A.

117193.name: Tsunagu Hakamada
117193.desc: __Height:__ 190cm (6'3") __Quirk:__ Fiber Master Pro Hero, ranked in the top 4. He is the recipient of the "Best Jeanist" award for eight consecutive years. Tsunagu is an elegant man with flamboyant tendencies. He believes very strongly that people with influence must maintain a positive appearance both physically and socially. Tsunagu often uses metaphors referencing jeans, denim, and various other sewing and fabric-based phrases, often inspiring his recruits with speeches, telling them to keep their life straight like their jeans. Tsunagu takes the role of being a hero very seriously. He is selfless, brave, and charismatic, and he aims to spread a sense of a peace to all people, no matter how dire the situation. Tsunagu's Quirk "Fiber Master (ファイバーマスター)" allows him to freely manipulate the threads in any nearby piece of fabric. He has power over all types of cloth, but his Quirk works best with denim and is less effective on sweats. Fiber Master also works on other types of fiber not related to fabric, such as carbon fibers. He primarily uses this power to restrain his targets, either by using their own clothing against them, or simply unravels portions of his own clothing into strings.

117193.name: Nezu
117193.desc: __Height:__ 85 cm __Quirk:__ High Spec Nezu, also known as Mr. Principal is a Pro Hero and the principal of U.A. High School. He is an extremely rare case of an animal who manifested a Quirk. He can be very long-winded at times when explaining or educating.

117193.name: Gigantomachia
117193.desc: Gigantomachia is a villain associated with the League of Villains.[1] He is one of All For One's faithful servants and his former bodyguard, cultivated to be of use to Tomura Shigaraki if anything were to happen to him.

117193.name: Juuzou Moashi
117193.desc: __Quirk:__ Centipede: Juuzou's Quirk grants him long, centipede-like limbs, which he can use to attack or restrain enemies from afar. Moashi is a sidekick affiliated with [Sir Nighteye](https://anilist.co/character/129761/)'s Hero Office. Juuzou is a gentleman and a very well mannered person

117193.name: Ryuuko Tatsuma
117193.desc: When she activates her Quirk, her body transforms into that of a large, winged dragon with pale gray scales, although she still has the same skin tone, hair and eyes, and her hero costume remains visible bar her boots.

117193.name: Pony  Tsunotori
117193.desc: __Quirk:__ Horn Cannon Pony is a timid girl. As a foreigner, she does not have much knowledge of the language in Japan. She is shown to be rather naive and innocent in personality, learning nasty phrases from Neito Monoma without realizing what those words mean, as shown when Neito tells Pony unkind phrases to tell Class 1-A. Pony is a thoughtful and diligent person. She is the one who made her team not lose against Class 1-A because of her strategy and perseverance. She is highly observant and seems to be a careful person. Despite this, she made some unkind comments towards Mezo Shoji in their battle, calling him an "octopus" and saying she doesn't like looking at him. Pony's Quirk allows her to send her horns flying and remotely control them at will. She is able to control up to four horns that are sent flying. She has also been shown to be able to balance on them as they carry her around, much like Hawks' wings. When Pony gets angry, she starts speaking in her native language: English.

117193.name: Daruma Ujiko
117193.desc: Daruma Ujiko is the pseudonym of a villain affiliated with the League of Villains, later the Paranormal Liberation Front. He is a faithful servant of All For One and later Tomura Shigaraki as well.

117193.name: Oboro Shirakumo
117193.desc: Oboro was a man of average stature with light, wavy hair that was swept back to flow upwards above his head, two shorter, ear-length tufts left hanging downwards to frame his face. He usually wore an expression of excitement, possessing a large, teeth-bearing grin and semicircular, inward-tilting eyes that were often squeezed shut. Quirk: **Cloud** (he is capable of moving through the air by creating clouds and riding on them.)

117193.name: Rumi Usagiyama
117193.desc: Rumi is the No. 5 Pro Hero. She has an athletic build with muscular arms and legs. She has dark skin, red eyes which are tilted slightly inwards, and straight white hair reaching down past her waist. On her head, she has a pair of long white rabbit ears pointing upwards with a slight crook. Along with these, she also has a round white tail, which gives her overall design a definite resemblance to an albino rabbit. Her hero costume consists of a sleeveless white leotard with dark purple trim around her shoulders and waist, a wide, yellow crescent moon design over her chest, and two thick metal plates on her midriff. She wears purple thigh-high boots to compliment her leotard, with more plating around the heel and toe areas, making her feet look like those of a rabbit. She also has white gloves on her hands, with long cuffs, sporting small triangular protrusions around the edges.

117193.name: Setsuna Tokage
117193.desc: Setsuna Tokage is a student in Class 1-B at U.A. High School, and is one of four students admitted through recommendations; one being her fellow 1-B classmate Juzo Honenuki, as well as rival Class 1-A students Shoto Todoroki and Momo Yaoyorozu.

117193.name: Kinoko  Komori
117193.desc: Kinoko Komori is a student in Class 1-B, and is training to be a Pro Hero. Her quirk, Mushroom, allows her to spread spores that sprout mushrooms wherever they land, including inside of people's bodies.

117193.name: Yui Kodai
117193.desc: Yui Kodai is a student in Class 1-B of U.A. High School. She is a quiet girl, but nevertheless cares about her fellow classmates.

117193.name: Juzo Honenuki
117193.desc: __Height:__ 174 cm (5'8½") __Affiliation:__ U.A High __Quirk:__ Softening Juzo Honenuki is a student in Class 1-B at U.A. High School, and is one of four students admitted through recommendations; one being his fellow 1-B classmate [Setsuna Tokage](https://anilist.co/character/149179/Tokage-Setsuna), the others being rival 1-A students [Shoto Todoroki](https://anilist.co/character/89220/Todoroki-Shouto) and [Momo Yaoyorozu](https://anilist.co/character/89241/Yaoyorozu-Momo). Juzo's Quirk allows him to soften any non-living thing he touches. For example, he can soften the ground to make it similar to quicksand, hindering movements and mobility. If Juzo makes contact again, he can undo the effect. He is also capable of swimming through softened material.

117193.name: Rikiya Yotsubashi
117193.desc: Rikiya, better known by his code name Re-Destro, is the president and CEO of the Detnerat Company, the son of the infamous villain Destro (for which he named his own code name after), as well as the secret leader of the villainous Meta Liberation Army, an organization that follows the philosophy that the usage of Quirks is a basic human right, and seeks to liberate society and allow for the free use of Quirks.

117193.name: Tatsuyuki Tokoname
117193.desc: A Pro Hero. ~!He is also secretly a member of the villainous Meta Liberation Army.!~

117193.name: Kuugo Sakamata
117193.desc: Gang Orca is the current No. 11 Pro Hero, dropping from his previous No. 10 place. He took part in the assault on All For One and the League of Villains at Kamino Ward, and later served as a makeshift villain during the Provisional Hero License Exam.

117193.name: Ken Ishiyama
117193.desc: Cementoss is a Pro Hero as well as a teacher at U.A. High School. During the U.A. Sports Festival, he acted as the proctor for the 1-on-1 fights in case things got out of hand. He also faced off against Eijiro Kirishima and Rikido Sato in their Final Exam.

117193.name: Fuyumi Todoroki
117193.desc: The only daughter of Eiji and Rei. Fuyumi is the younger sister of Touya and the older sister of Natsuo and Shouto. Fuyumi is a hard working girl, often making meals for the family and works as a teacher at an unnamed school. Unlike her family members, she doesn't resent her father and just wishes they could all be a happy family, though she realizes such a thing is unlikely. Upon hearing Shouto gains friends, however, Fuyumi gets quite excited over it and is happy for him. In the past, Fuyumi took care of Shouto after their mother went to a hospital and never came back. To this day, her wish that she could have done something for Shouto still lingers within her.

117193.name: Ectoplasm
117193.desc: __Height:__ 180 cm (5' 11") __Affiliation:__ Yuuei __Quirk:__ Clones Ectoplasm has the ability to produce ectoplasm from his mouth and transform it into clones of himself. He can create up to thirty clones at once, and push his limit to thirty-six if he's feeling good. He can also produce a giant clone of himself, although this sacrifices his ability to produce normal-sized ones for the time being. His clones can be defeated with a strong blow, but otherwise, only Ectoplasm can dispel them.

117193.name: Chiyo  Shuuzenji
117193.desc: __Quirk:__ Heal __Occupation:__ Pro Hero, Nurse Chiyo has a very kind and compassionate personality, where she treats everyone kindly, though she does have a strict and reproaching attitude towards those that have done something foolish. She's mostly like this with All Might for not teaching Izuku how to use his Quirk properly or with Izuku for using his Quirk recklessly.

117193.name: Sajin Higawara
117193.desc: __Quirk:__ SandStorm Sajin Higawara also known as Sand Hero: Snatch was a Pro Hero and a bodyguard for the Police Force.

117193.name: Chitose Kizuki
117193.desc: Chitose Kizuki, also known as Curious, is a journalist and a member of the Meta Liberation Army.

117193.name: Geten
117193.desc: Geten is a loyal warrior of the Liberation Army and a devout believer in its principles. He feels greatly indebted and thankful to Re-Destro for granting him more power and desires to create a world where the strongest superpowers stand at the top of the hierarchy.

117193.name: Moe Kamiji
117193.desc: Moe Kamiji, also known as her hero name Burnin, is a pro hero and one of over 30 sidekicks working at the Endeavor Hero Agency.

117193.name: Koku Hanabata
117193.desc: Koku Hanabata, also know as Trumpet, is a member of the Meta Liberation Army, a Paranormal Liberation Front lieutenant, and also the leader of the Hearts and Mind party.

117193.name: Tomoyasu Chikazoku
117193.desc: Tomoyasu Chikazoku, also known as Skeptic, is a member of the Meta Liberation Army.

117193.name: Sen Kaibara
117193.desc: __Height:__ 172 cm (5'7½") __Quirk:__ Gyrate Kaibara Sen is a student from 1-B. His quirk "Gyrate" allows Kaibara to rotate any part of his body.

117193.name: High End
117193.desc: __Affiliation:__ League of Villains High End Nomu was an intelligent Nomu created and is shown to be obedient to its master. They were one of the main antagonists in the Pro Hero Arc.

117193.name: Snipe
117193.desc: __Quirk:__ Homing Snipe is a Pro Hero and a member of the teaching staff at U.A. High School. Snipe has the appearance of a stereotypical western cowboy Snipe's Quirk allows him to lock on to any target he can see within six hundred meters and make any projectile he releases chase after said target

117193.name: Sekijiro Kan
117193.desc: Sekijiro Kan, also known by his hero name, Blood Hero: Vlad King, is a Pro Hero and the homeroom teacher of U.A. High School's Class 1-B.

117193.name: Shihai Kuroiro
117193.desc: Shihai is a sly, deceitful schemer, who prefers to catch people off guard. He appears to enjoy dark concepts and has a penchant for dramatic speech

117193.name: Juurouta Shishida
117193.desc: Juurouta seems to be an intellectual as he uses a fairly verbose way of speaking and often addresses others by respectful titles such as 'sir' and 'miss'. This is because he was brought up in a very well mannered and doting family. While transformed, however Juurouta is rather boisterous and energetic, which is likely a side effect of his Quirk.

117193.name: Nirengeki Shoda
117193.desc: Nirengeki has a very humble attitude, as he will not take credit for something he does not feel he earned by his own strength.

117193.name: Kousei Tsuburaba
117193.desc: __Height:__ 170 cm (5'7") __Affiliation:__ U.A High __Quirk:__ Solid Air Kousei is a very enthusiastic and competitive individual who holds himself to a high standard as he makes an effort to avoid descending to the level of his rivals.

117193.name: Manga Fukidashi
117193.desc: Manga appears to be an expressive and dramatic person. He is a regular man with a white speech bubble head that can change shape and display his thoughts in written form.

117193.name: Yosetsu Awase
117193.desc: Although he is not as social as some others, Yosetsu is foul-mouthed and tense, except for serious or life-or-death situations, in which he becomes very easily startled and much more talkative, although he retains his harsh way of speech.

117193.name: Hiryu Rin
117193.desc: **Height:** 170 cm (5'7") __Quirk:__ Scales He is a Class 1-B student in U.A. High School, training to become a Pro Hero. It's notable that Hiryu possesses a serious demeanor when it comes to playing out his abilities into action. He is rather diligent in terms of academic abilities and Quirk functions as well. Hiryu has shown to be a very competent combatant, with a great handle on the applications of his Quirk. Thanks to the versatile nature of his Scales Quirk, Hiryu excels in both close and long-range combat, effectively switching between hand-to-hand combat, and shooting off his scales when it’s most convenient to him.

117193.name: Reiko Yanagi
117193.desc: Reiko is a quiet and emotionless teenager who often shows an odd body posture.

117193.name: Kojiro Bondo
117193.desc: An easy going guy and described as a gentle giant.

117193.name: Selkie
117193.desc: Can do pretty much everything a spotted seal can do. He can even make sonar-like sound and use the echo to determine his opponent's position. He is also very strong even if he believes that he can make a very cute seal face (which most people think is not).

117193.name: Yoichi Shigaraki
117193.desc: All For One's younger brother.

117193.name: Daigorou Banjou
117193.desc: __Occupation:__ Pro Hero __Quirk:__ Blackwhip; One For All (formerly) The 5th user of One For All whose natural Quirk was Blackwhip. His Quirk allowed him to create tendrils of black energy from his arms, excellent for grappling and increasing his mobility.

117193.name: Aorio Kuraishisu
117193.desc: Aorio Kuraishisu is a Hero Expert.

117193.name: Ending
117193.desc: A villain who appears as an antagonist in the Endeavor Agency Arc. Seven years prior to the beginning of the story, Ending saw Endeavor capture a thief called Takami. Since then Ending was infatuated with Endeavor, desiring the latter to kill him.

117193.name: Cider House Leader
117193.original: サイダーハウスリーダー
117193.desc: The leader of a gang of pickpockets who operated mainly during the holiday season, having studied the patterns and routes of hero and civilian activity in a specific street for a whole month, with the intent of maximizing profits from their looted items while facing minimal resistance. He possesses a Quirk that allows him to control carbonated water. He also has connections with the black market, having acquired a pair of gauntlets provided by Detnerat that could convert his water blasts into gatling shots.

117193.name: Hiroshi Tameda
117193.desc: __Height:__ 170cm Hiroshi Tameda also known as "Can't You See?" kid, is a loyal fan of Endeavor.

117193.name: Mawata Fuwa
117193.desc: Mawata Fuwa, is a student in Class 2-A at U.A. High School, training to become a Pro Hero.

117193.name: Kotarou Shimura
117193.desc: Kotarou Shimura was the father of [Tenko](https://anilist.co/character/89226/Tomura-Shigaraki) and [Hana Shimura](https://anilist.co/character/290001/Shimura-Hana) and the son of [Nana Shimura](https://anilist.co/character/126319/Nana-Shimura).

117193.name: Onima
117193.desc: One of the many sidekicks who work at Endeavor's Agency.

117193.name: Kidou
117193.desc: __Occupation:__ Pro Hero (Sidekick) __Affiliation:__ Endeavor Agency (Team Flaming Sidekickers) __Quirk:__ Traject One of many sidekicks who works at Endeavor's Agency. His Quirk allows him to manipulate the trajectory of anything that passes through his bandages.

117193.name: Crust
117193.desc: __Quirk:__ Shield __Occupation:__ Pro Hero (No.6) __Fighting Style:__ Close-ranged combat

117193.name: Hana Shimura
117193.desc: Hana was the older sister of [Tenko Shimura](https://anilist.co/character/89226/Tomura-Shigaraki) and granddaughter of [Nana Shimura](https://anilist.co/character/126319/Nana-Shimura). ~!She was killed by her brother when his Quirk went out of control!~

117193.name: Nao Shimura
117193.desc: Nao was the wife of [Kotarou Shimura](https://anilist.co/character/251812/Kotarou-Shimura) and the mother of their two children, [Tenko](https://anilist.co/character/89226/Tomura-Shigaraki) and [Hana](https://anilist.co/character/290001/Hana-Shimura). ~!She died when her son's Quirk went out of control.!~

20850.name: Ken Kaneki
20850.desc: __Height:__ 169 cm (5'6") Ken Kaneki was originally a human and a normal college student until he encountered a female ghoul named [Rize](https://anilist.co/character/88413/Rize-Kamishiro) who was posing as a human at the time. Rize, using Kaneki's crush on her as leverage, managed to lure him into an alley and tried to eat him but ended up dying when construction beams fell on top of her. Kaneki, already in a half-dead state from Rize's attempts at killing him, ends up in a hospital and has some of Rize's organs transplanted into his body. This results in him absorbing some of Rize's powers and characteristics, such as a ghoul eye, powers of regeneration, and the inability to stomach human food. Terrified and lost, Kaneki's life takes a dramatic turn from then on as he tries to find a place for himself in the world, realizing he now belongs to neither the human nor ghoul world and refusing to eat humans to sustain himself. Meeting some of the ​other ghouls, as well as humans, makes him realize that things aren't just black and white and that there are more to ghouls and humans than originally thought.

20850.name: Touka Kirishima
20850.desc: __Height:__ 156 cm (5'1") Touka is a ghoul successfully posing as a human and working as a waitress at a cafe which serves as a gathering place for other ghouls, as well as a food resource. She saves [Kaneki](https://anilist.co/character/87275/Kaneki-Ken)'s life at one point and acts as a reluctant guide to him and his adaptation to the ghoul society. She doesn't like Kaneki much and has no qualms about expressing her dislike for him. She is very serious, tough and hard-working, trying to keep their district as safe for ghouls and humans as possible. Her powers and strength are also quite great and she makes for a formidable opponent.

20850.name: Hinami Fueguchi
20850.desc: __Height:__ 148 cm - 152 cm (4'10" - 4'11") Hinami is a child ghoul whose parents were killed by ghoul investigators. Before, she and her mother seek help from the owner of the Antique Cafe to acquire food. Hinami is initially quite shy, but when she opens up, she is cheerful and earnest. [Ken](https://anilist.co/character/87275/Kaneki-Ken) helps her learn kanji, as she cannot attend school, and is very eager to learn. Currently, she is living together with [Touka Kirishima](https://anilist.co/character/87277/Kirishima-Touka).

20850.name: Koutarou Amon
20850.desc: __Height:__ 191 cm (6'3") A first class police investigator who investigates Ghouls, also known as a Dove. He comes to the 20th ward with his mentor, [Mado Kureo](https://anilist.co/character/88423), to investigate Ghoul incidents in the area. He has a strong sense of justice, fervently believing it is the right and moral thing to do to exterminate the Ghouls. He hunts the Ghouls in order to prevent more human children from becoming orphaned like himself, and he often works after hours to achieve his goals. He wields a "Quinque" (a weapon made from the "Kagune" of a Ghoul) that has the appearance of a pole-arm with a large cylindrical bludgeon at the end.

20850.name: Yukinori Shinohara
20850.desc: A Special Class Ghoul Investigator. In the past, he acted as Koutarou Amon's instructor at the Academy.

20850.name: Nishiki Nishio
20850.desc: __Height:__ 177 cm (5'9") Nishiki Nishio is a ghoul whose original feeding ground was taken from Rize. He is a sophomore in the Pharmaceutical Department of Kamii University and Kimi Nishino's boyfriend.

20850.name: Kimi Nishino
20850.desc: Kimi Nishino is a assistant for Akihiro Kanou who aids in his ghoulification experiments, the previous human lover of Nishiki Nishio and a medical student at Kamii University.~!Although she is aware of his ghoul nature, she remained loyal to him and kept his secret. After the Owl Suppression Operation, he left her in order to keep her safe.!~

20850.name: Ayato Kirishima
20850.desc: __Height:__ 159 cm (5'2") Ayato Kirishima is [Touka Kirishima](https://anilist.co/character/87277/Touka-Kirishima)'s younger brother. He grew up with his sister in the 20th ward but at some point of time, he disappeared. Currently, he is an executive of Aogiri Tree. An arrogant youth with a similar harsh attitude that resembles his sister. Other than physical looks, he shares many similarities with Touka such as his cold, hotblooded attitude and a habit for kicking people. However, he's more harsh compared to her and surprisingly nicer than his Aogiri superiors.

20850.name: Juuzou Suzuya
20850.desc: __Height:__ 160 cm (5'3") A Rank 3 Ghoul Investigator. In the past, he went by the name Rei Suzuya. He is the partner of [Yukinori Shinohara](https://anilist.co/character/88408). He is a young man with androgynous appearance. He has many stitches used as both first-aid and fashion. His hair is tied with a stitching string in a roman numeral 13 pattern, with large pupils that leaves an eerie and frightening impression.

20850.name: Uta
20850.desc: __Height:__ 177 cm A ghoul that has his own art studio where he makes masks for other ghouls. He has a lot of piercings and tattoos on his body, making him look pretty intimidating, even as a normal-looking human. He's the one who also made a mask for Kaneki.

20850.name: Itori
20850.desc: Itori is an old friend of Yomo and Uta. She can be found in Helter Skelter bar, where she makes her share in the information web of the underworld. Itori is over friendly and talkative. She likes having fun and even doing pranks. Her bad point might be her using people like toys to get the information she wants.

20850.name: Enji Koma
20850.desc: Enji Koma is a ghoul and a waiter at Anteiku. He is an expert coffee brewer. In his youth, he was known as the Devil Ape and led the Apes ghoul gang.

20850.name: Tatara
20850.desc: A direct subordinate of the One-Eyed King and one of Aogiri Tree's leaders. He was a former member of the Chinese ghoul organization Chi She Lian. As one of the Aogiri Tree leaders and a trusted subordinate working under the One-Eyed King, Tatara comes off as a rather loyal individual. He is portrayed as composed and stoic mostly. He often monitors the activities of the Aogiri executives, but kills in cold-blood when embarking on a mission. He is also proud of his immense stamina when fighting and the accuracy of his calculations as well. Tatara seems to have a taste for precision; as shown when he turns down Kaneki considering he's an artificial one-eyed ghoul. He appears to hold a grudge against Houji, to the extent that even the Quinque associated with him, is enough to make him enraged and lose his near unflappable composure. As the second-in-command of Aogiri, it can be inferred that he is quite powerful.

20850.name: Nico
20850.desc: __Species:__ Ghoul __Height:__ 175 cm __Affiliations:__ Clown Mask Ghoul Gang A gay ghoul (okama) in love. He was once acting together with Yamori and participating in Aogiri Tree.

20850.name: Hideyoshi Nagachika
20850.desc: __Race:__ Human Hideyoshi is a normal human and the best friend of [Ken Kaneki](https://anilist.co/character/87275/Kaneki-Ken). Hide is incredibly observant and can figure things out about people in a almost sherlock-like manner. He also becomes interested in things and works hard on them until he finds something else to interest him.

20850.name: Shuu Tsukiyama
20850.desc: __Height:__ 180 cm Shuu Tsukiyama was the infamous Gourmet ghoul of the 20th ward. He was a fourth-year student studying Social Welfare at the Department of Human Sciences at Seinan Gakuin University. He comes from the extremely wealthy and influential Tsukiyama family which his father, Mirumo Tsukiyama was the head of. Tsukiyama himself became the head of his family after the Tsukiyama Family Extermination Operation. He was also a member of the Ghoul Restaurant, known as MM until he betrayed them. He joined Kaneki's group with the hidden intention of eating Ken Kaneki, obsessed with his scent and taste but eventually came to genuinely care for Kaneki. Two years later, his severe depression and anorexia after Kaneki's apparent demise left him emaciated and required constant care from his family servants. After finding out Kaneki was alive and meeting him, he recovers, being able to walk and eat on his own as well as take measures to help Kaneki regain his memories.

20850.name: Yakumo Oomori
20850.desc: A white-haired brute with sharp lizard eyes. Yamori is ghoul who is as scary as he looks. Normally in a entirely white suit and black dress shirt, he resembles a typical gangster.

20850.name: Akira Mado
20850.desc: __Species:__ Human __Height:__ 164 cm __Affiliations:__ CCG __Quinque:__ Amatsu (Koukaku/Bikaku) __Likes:__ making quinques, solving puzzles and cats Akira Mado is a Rank 2 Ghoul Investigator and Kureo's daughter. She is currently partnered with Koutarou Amon. She is an intelligent woman and seems to be always serious about work and her daily routine in general. Like her father, she has deep insight and intuition that helps her in investigation and determining what is going on around her while on the field. She shares her father's "quinque-mania," but it is not as extreme as his was. Akira remains professional in most situations, no matter who she is faced with, and she isn't one to admit her own feelings on a subject unless provoked to a certain degree. Seen through her interactions with others, it is most likely that she would prefer to make a quinque rather than to interact with someone else.

20850.name: Kishou Arima
20850.desc: __Height:__ 180 cm __Quinque:__ IXA (Koukaku), Narukami (Ukaku), Yukimura 1/3 (Koukaku) Kishou Arima is a famed Special Class Ghoul Investigator known as the CCG's Reaper. He is undefeated as a Ghoul Investigator and at some point was formerly partnered with Take Hirako. His investigative skills and prowess in combat has led many investigators such as [Koutarou Amon](https://anilist.co/character/88407/Koutarou-Amon) to admire him. __Tokyo Ghoul:Re__ ~!He later passes down his Yukimura 1/3 (Koukaku) quinque to [Sasaki Haise](https://anilist.co/character/87275/Ken-Kaneki), a rank 1 investigator and mentor of Quinx squad. Along with [Akira Mado](https://anilist.co/character/88838/Akira-Mado), he is the overseer of the Quinx squad and keeps a check on Sasaki Haise along with the Quinx members.!~

20850.name: Eto
20850.desc: __Height:__ 151 cm __RC Type:__ Ukaku __Rating:__ ~!S as Eto SSS as One Eyed Owl!~ Eto is an executive of Aogiri Tree from the 24th ward. Eto is often seen interacting with fellow Aogiri member [Tatara](https://anilist.co/character/88418/Tatara). ~!She is the daughter of [Yoshimura](https://anilist.co/character/136024/Yoshimura), and the half-Ghoul known as the One-Eyed Owl. Her human identity is Sen Takatsuki (高槻 泉), a best-selling horror novelist mentioned throughout the series. Her relation with the One-Eyed King is unclear. However the CCG and [Nico](https://anilist.co/character/88419/Nico) speculate that they are the same person.!~

20850.name: Naki
20850.desc: Naki is a ghoul who was imprisoned in Cochlea until Aogiri Tree's invasion on the prison. He was liberated by Aogiri Tree due to being a direct underling and supposedly the right hand man of Yamori. He was almost always accompanied by the Twins Gagi and Guge. He eventually climbs the ranks within Aogiri, and has become an Executive in his own right. The number of Ghouls following him has grown considerably, forming a gang known as the White Suits for their distinctive dressing style. Naki is left handed.

20850.name: Kurona Yasuhisa
20850.desc: Kurona Yasuhisa is an artificial one-eyed ghoul who impeded Ken Kaneki's pursuit of Madam A alongside her twin sister Nashiro. ~!After being abandoned by Akihiro Kanou, she vanished until her appearance during the Rushima Landing Operation. She merged with her sister and became known to the CCG as Floppy.!~

20850.name: Nashiro Yasuhisa
20850.desc: Nashiro Yasuhisa is an artificial one-eyed ghoul who impeded Ken Kaneki's pursuit of Madam A alongside her twin sister Kurona. ~!She was fatally wounded in battle, and abandoned to die by Akihiro Kanou. Her sister claimed that she survived on as a parasitic mass on her stomach, but Kanou claimed this to have been nothing but a delusion to cope with Nashiro's death.!~

20850.name: Noro
20850.desc: He is one of the direct subordinates of the King of an Eye and one of the leaders of the Aogiri Tree, next to Tatara. In the past he was called Noroi and was responsible for raising Eto, when Kuzen surrendered in District 24. He is a giant who intimidates with an overwhelming silence, seems to communicate only through actions, not words.

20850.name: Seidou Takizawa
20850.desc: __Height:__ 171 cm Takizawa is a Rank 2 Ghoul Investigator. A classmate of [Akira Mado](https://anilist.co/character/88838/Akira-Mado) at the Academy, he is partnered with Kousuke Houji and assigned to the 20th ward to investigate the Gourmet. He greatly respects [Kishou Arima](https://anilist.co/character/88946/Kishou-Arima) and [Koutarou Amon](https://anilist.co/character/88407/Koutarou-Amon) and admires their achievements. ~!Though he was declared among the casualties of the raid in the 20th Ward, it is revealed that he had actually survived as artificial one-eyed ghoul. He is now a member of Aogiri Tree. As an artificial one-eyed ghoul, he is known as Owl. After betraying Aogiri and killing [Tatara](https://anilist.co/character/88418/Tatara), Takizawa reunited with Akira Mado, and became a member of Ken Kaneki's organization, Goat. !~

20850.name: Take Hirako
20850.desc: __Species:__ Human __Height:__ 172 cm __Affiliations:__ CCG __Quinque:__ Nagomi 1/3 (Rinkaku) Take Hirako is a First Class Ghoul Investigator. In the past, he formed a duo with Kishou Arima. Hirako is of average height and his facial features have been described as "plain" or "bland." He usually has a blank expression on his face. Like all members of CCG, he usually wears formal attire. Like his mentor Kishou Arima, Hirako has a very calm personality and has inherited the same cold and calculating approach to fighting ghouls.He is skilled to the point of being able to suppress a S-class Ukaku type ghoul.

20850.name: Yoshimura
20850.desc: Yoshimura is a ghoul and the manager of the Anteiku cafe. He tries to help every ghoul, especially those who can't hunt themselves. He takes in Ken Kaneki and tries to help him survive being a ghoul. ~!He is Eto's father.!~

20850.name: Taishi Fura
20850.desc: Taishi Fura is a First-Class Ghoul Investigator. He is the protagonist of the side story Tokyo Ghoul: Jack, alongside Kishou Arima.

20850.name: Ui Koori
20850.desc: Koori is a Special Class Investigator and an Investigation Commander in Division I. He is the leader of S1 Squad, and a former protege of Kishou Arima and the partner of Hairu Ihei. He is in charge of the 4th ward.

20850.name: Renji Yomo
20850.desc: __Height:__ 182 cm (5'11") Renji Yomo is a worker at Anteiku and the right hand of [Yoshimura](https://anilist.co/character/136024/Yoshimura). He is an old friend of [Uta](https://anilist.co/character/88414/Uta) and [Itori](https://anilist.co/character/88415/Itori). Because of his scavenging habits and long-beaked, avian mask, he has the nickname of "Raven."

20850.name: Akihiro Kanou
20850.desc: Akihiro Kanou, often referred to as Professor Kanou, is a physician at Kanou General Hospital.

20850.name: Kuramoto Itou
20850.desc: __Height:__ 172 cm Kuramoto Itou is a First Class Ghoul Investigator and the deputy squad leader of the Hirako Squad.

20850.name: Maris-Stella
20850.desc: The grumpy cat of Akira Mado. She appears to be affectionate towards Akira, but hostile to anyone else.

20850.name: Chuu Hachikawa
20850.desc: An Associate Special Class Investigator from the CCG.

20850.name: Kouitsu Chigyou
20850.desc: Kouitsu Chigyou is the head ghoul researcher at CCG Laboratory Division. He used to be a researcher in the GFG in Germany.

20850.name: Kaya Irimi
20850.desc: Kaya Irimi is a waitress working at Anteiku.

20850.name: Ayumu Hogi
20850.desc: Ayumu is a First Class Investigator from the CCG and Vice-Chief of Chuu Hachikawa's squad. Ayumu was part of the Squad 3 in the Anteiku raid.

20850.name: Misato Gori
20850.desc: Misato Gori is a Rank 2 Ghoul Investigator. She is currently affiliated with the 13th ward.

20850.name: Kiyoko Aura
20850.desc: Kiyoko is a Special Class Investigator, and noteworthy for being the first woman to achieve that rank. She is assigned to the 1st Ward as the Chief of Division I . She was a classmate of Kasuka Mado, and is greatly admired by the female employees of CCG for her many achievements.

20850.name: Matasaka Kamishiro
20850.desc: Matasaka Kamishiro is a SS-rank ghoul and the former leader of the ghouls in the 6th ward. Most people refer to him by his nickname Orca or Shachi. He is a strong ghoul, well-versed in the martial arts. When he was the leader of the ghouls in the 6th ward, he trained and strengthened his followers. However, he was captured and sent to the Ghoul Detention Center. After he was freed during Aogiri Tree's attack, he decided to join the organization.

20850.name: Iwao Kuroiwa
20850.desc: Iwao Kuroiwa is a Special Class Ghoul Investigator. Currently, he serves as the vice commander of the 11th Ward Special Countermeasures Unit. Yukinori Shinohara calls him by the nickname Iwaccho.

20850.name: Roma Hoito
20850.desc: Roma Hoito is a ghoul and used to be a waitress at Anteiku.

20850.name: Katsuya Mabuchi
20850.desc: Katsuya Mabuchi is a ghoul investigator. He is the subordinate of Itsuki Marude and is normally seen standing beside Marude.

20850.name: Mougan Tanakamaru
20850.desc: Mougan is a Special Class Investigator and the Division I Branch Director of CCG's 2nd Ward Branch Office. He acted as the captain of Squad 2 in the Anteiku raid.

20850.name: Yoshitoki Washuu
20850.desc: Yoshitoki Washuu is the current Bureau Director of CCG's Main Office and Tsuneyoshi Washuu's son.

20850.name: Tsuneyoshi Washuu
20850.desc: Tsuneyoshi Washuu is the current chairman of CCG and Yoshitoki Washuu's father.

97986.name: Narrator
97986.desc: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

97986.name: Riko
97986.desc: **Occupation**: Delver **Relatives**: [Lyza](https://anilist.co/character/122465/Lyza) (mother), [Torka](https://anilist.co/character/161856/Torka) (father) Riko is the only child of the legendary White Whistle [Lyza](https://anilist.co/character/122465/Lyza), the Annihilator. When she was two, her mother began her last dive to the bottom of the abyss. She was left under the care of the Belchero Orphanage. Her dream is to become a White Whistle, a legendary type of Delver, and explore the depths of the abyss to learn its many secrets and find her mother. Riko is a good-natured, joyful, and energetic child. She has a quick and inquisitive mind, gathering and properly organizing all the information available on subjects that interest her. Growing up, she diligently studied to become a Delver like her mother was, enchanted by its mysteries and secrets. By the age of twelve, she had become an Apprentice Delver with the right to explore the shallowest level of the abyss on her own. Compared to [Reg](https://anilist.co/character/122444/Reg), she is fragile and lacking in physical prowess. However, her ability to keep a cool head under pressure to make rational decisions allows her to tackle the abyss.

97986.name: Reg
97986.desc: Reg is a robotic being who appears to be a little boy. His actual age, origins, and even name are unknown because he cannot recall anything about his life before his encounter with [Riko](https://anilist.co/character/122443/Riko). He is named after a dog Riko used to have. Having a seemingly artificial body, Reg might be the only being completely immune to the Curse of the Abyss. Because of this, he is sometimes referred to as "The Treasure of the Deep." Reg’s body is extremely durable, even to the point that [Ozen the Immovable](https://anilist.co/character/122464/Ouzen) couldn’t break him even when slamming him into the floor with all her strength. Despite his high durability, Reg is agile and weighs little. His wounds heal at a faster rate than a human’s, and has a very high pain tolerance. His senses of smell and hearing are strong, one comparable to a dog. His arms can extend up to 40 meters each and can shoot them to the top of cliffs or grab things very far away. The cords attached are very durable. He is also equipped with an incinerator, which is a powerful incendiary cannon built into his hands and feet, emitting a beam of light, indicating the area to eliminate, penetrating through objects. Objects within the range of the light break apart and are absorbed into the spinning axes. The incinerator is connected to the Abyss in an unknown way, having the power to rewrite the rules of the Abyss. Reg passes out for 2 hours upon use, but it can be fired multiple times in

97986.name: Nanachi
97986.desc: **Species**: Narehate Nanachi is a Narehate — a person who’s survived the 6th layer’s Curse of the Abyss and has been left deformed as a result. Unlike other Narehates, Nanachi has retained a sound mind, possessing vast knowledge of the Abyss — its ecosystem, vegetation and even the use of the medicines. Their gender is ambiguous, often using the gender-neutral pronoun "oira." when referring to themself. Most of the time, Nanachi is cool and reserved, keeping their distance emotionally and physically. Their attitude often borders on being sarcastic and even cynical. However, behind this mask, Nanachi hides a kind and gentle soul, capable of deep compassion and selfless devotion. They are also quite bashful when complimented, seen in their reaction to being called "fluffy". They also express discomfort at being petted, especially by [Reg](https://anilist.co/character/122444/Reg).

97986.name: Bondrewd
97986.desc: Bondrewd is a legendary white whistle delver who has made many great discoveries about the secrets of the Abyss. A researcher fascinated by the Abyss, he has often resorted to illegal and morally questionable means to get funds for and conduct his research, including selling artifacts illicitly, developing dangerous drugs, and even experimenting on living humans. Though how cruel, he still cared for the kids and people he brutally experimented on. His methods went against all the ethical principles of delvers, but he was allowed to continue due to his outstanding results. Ten years ago, he did the unthinkable by establishing a large base named the Idofront in the deepest area within the 5th Layer of the Abyss, as well as securing a route to the then-inviolable 6th layer. ~!During one of his experiments researching the Curse of the Abyss, Bondrewd offered children who wanted to unravel the secrets of the Abyss to come with him to the Ido Front. However, he never told them openly that they were going to be used as test subjects. Among the children were Nanachi and Mitty. As Bondrewd continued testing, more and more children were used up in his experiments until only Nanachi and Mitty were left. On his final test, he used both of them, resulting in Mitty being hit with the Curse of the Abyss, while Nanachi received the Blessing.!~

97986.name: Ouzen
97986.desc: Ouzen the Immovable is an elite White Whistle who lives at the Observation Base on the second level of the Abyss where she commands a small team of cave raiders known as "The Layabouts." Ouzen was a mentor and a close friend of [Riko](https://anilist.co/character/122443/Riko)'s mother [Lyza](https://anilist.co/character/122465/Lyza). Ouzen is a peerless fighter—her unique relic "Thousand Pins" grants her superhuman strength, speed and longevity (even though Ouzen appears to be young, she's attained the rank of a white whistle more than 50 years back). She's over 2 meters tall and has a peculiar hairstyle which conceals the scalp deformations caused by the extended exposure to the Curse of the Abyss. Ouzen has absolute control over her facial expressions and her actual feelings (or lack thereof) cannot be guessed with any certainty. The reasons behind her actions are unknowable as well—Ouzen rarely bothers to explain herself and even when she does it's impossible to know whether she's telling the truth or just toying with the audience.

97986.name: Lyza
97986.desc: Lyza the Annihilator is a legendary White Whistle who accomplished many great discoveries about the secrets of the Abyss. She is [Ozen's](https://anilist.co/character/122464/Ouzen) apprentice and [Riko's](https://anilist.co/character/122443/Riko) mother.

97986.name: Nat
97986.desc: **Gender**: Male **Species**: Human **Occupation**: Delver **Class**: Red Whistle **Relatives**: Unnamed sister Nat is an orphan from the Belchero Orphanage in the town at the edge of the Abyss, Orth. Like all the children of the orphanage, he's studied to become a Delver since a young age and attained the rank of Red Whistle Delver after his first descent. He wants to become a Moon Whistle Delver like [Jiruo](https://anilist.co/character/123188/Jiruo) and someday build an orphanage somewhere in Orth. Nat has short brown hair with bright blue eyes and wears, like his peers, a red whistle around his neck. He is often seen in his plain white sailor collar shirt, green pants, and track shoes. Nat cares about the people around him, especially [Riko](https://anilist.co/character/122443/Riko). He was against Riko descending into the Abyss with [Reg](https://anilist.co/character/122444/Reg); he spoke of the difficulties of dealing with the Abyss alone and that she wouldn't be able to see anyone in Orth again. Although he was helping Riko and Reg descend into the Abyss, before the departure, he struggled to express he would miss Riko. Nat used to live in the Wharf, where he lived in the slums. He didn't have any family besides his older sister. When his sister died, he was alone in the streets, but the orphanage took him in and he becoming a Delver.

97986.name: Shiggy
97986.desc: **Gender**: Male **Species**: Human **Occupation**: Delver **Class**: Red Whistle Shiggy is an orphan from the Belchero Orphanage in the town at the edge of the Abyss, Orth. Like all the children of the orphanage, he has studied to become a Delver since a young age and attained the rank of Red Whistle Delver after his first descent. Shiggy has short ashy black hair and bright-red eyes, wears rounded glasses, and bears a red whistle around his neck. He is often seen in his plain white sailor collar shirt and khaki green or black pants and track shoes. Shiggy has a great inquisitiveness, especially when it comes to the maps of the Abyss. He gives [Riko](https://anilist.co/character/122443/Riko) plenty of advice. When Riko tells her friends that she will delve into the Abyss to find [Lyza](https://anilist.co/character/122465/Lyza), Shiggy is skeptical and explains each layer via a depth chart. He decides to aid [Reg](https://anilist.co/character/122444/Reg) and Riko anyways and the three meet up the next morning in the South District. Shiggy advises them to enter the Abyss through the entry point at the wharf slums, which are not monitored as closely. (Source: Made in Abyss Wiki, edited)

97986.name: Marulk
97986.desc: Ozen's assistant and a Blue Whistle Diver.

97986.name: Hablog
97986.desc: Hablog (called Habo-san by Riko and the other children) is a well-known Black Whistle Delver and was the person who delivered Lyza's White Whistle and final notes to the surface. Hablog is a very bright and kind person with a rather high level of curiosity, as is seen when he first meets Reg.

97986.name: Jiruo
97986.desc: **Gender**: Male **Species**: Human **Occupation**: Delver, Delving Instructor **Class**: Moon Whistle Jiruo is a Moon Whistle Delver who serves as a teacher for Apprentice Delvers from the Belchero Orphanage in the town of Orth. While he works as an instructor for the children, he is also largely responsible for their upbringing and well-being. Jiruo is serious and stern and tends to come off as cold at times but takes his job as a teacher and instructor seriously and prioritizes the childrens' safety. At times he is very insightful and gives good advice, and does his best to support Riko after her mother's whistle was brought back to the surface. Jiruo was the apprentice of the legendary White Whistle Delver Lyza. Though he was only a red whistle at the time, before she made her last dive, Lyza entrusted him with watching over Riko and protecting her identity as a child of a White Whistle Delver. (Source: Made in Abyss Wiki, edited)

97986.name: Mitty
97986.desc: **Species**: Narehate Mitty is an amorphous Narehate who lived with Nanachi on the 4th layer of the Abyss. Mitty had been a regular human girl in the past and her appearance changed due to the result of the ascension from the 6th layer. ~!In Ilblu, it is revealed that Belaf paid compensation to have an exact replica of Mitty born into the village from the time a "masked man" brought her along to the village. This reproduction even has an exact copy of Mitty's soul from that moment in time.!~

97986.name: Simred
97986.desc: Black Whistle and a member of Ozen's expedition team. He is currently stationed at the Seeker Camp in the 2nd layer.

97986.name: Mio
97986.desc: Mio is a nurse that visits Orth on a merchant caravan. ~!She helps Kiwi get better from the Birthday-Death Disease.!~

97986.name: Laffi
97986.desc: Laffi is Hablog's wife and owner of a shop in Orth. She is well-liked by Riko and the other orphans, who frequent her shop. Riko often using her telescope to observe Abyssal wildlife.

97986.name: Tankutsuka
97986.desc: A Black Whistle who had a chance encounter with Reg in the 4th layer. ~!Reg and Nanachi save his life by fighting a deadly Abyss monster that was about to kill him. After this, Reg tells him to send a message up to Jiruo!~

97986.name: Zapo-jii
97986.desc: Blue Whistle and a member of Ozen's expedition team. He is currently stationed at the Seeker Camp in the 2nd layer.

97986.name: Yelme
97986.desc: Moon Whistle and a member of Ozen's expedition team. He is currently stationed at the Seeker Camp in the 2nd layer.

97986.name: Beruchero
97986.desc: **Gender**: Female **Race**: Human Belchero is the director of the Belchero Orphanage. She imposed strict rules within the Academy and the orphanage. Belchero has black hair with white strains in it, which ends in a topknot, and two long curls down each ear. She has a gaunt face and sharp eyes with a monocle on her right eye. She wears a black robe with black clothes beneath and black gloves. Belchero is very strict and enforces her rules strongly, but also only has the best interest of the orphans in mind. Belchero was once an active Delver but retired due to knee injuries. Belchero, together with Jiruo, teaches the orphans about the Abyss and other academic subjects. (Source: Made in Abyss Wiki, edited)

97986.name: Torka
97986.desc: Torka is Lyza's husband and Riko's father. He was one of the members of a survey team ordered from the government, with a special mission to retrieve the Greater Artifact Unheard Bell from the 4th layer of the Abyss. Lyza married Torka when she was a White Whistle Delver, while Torka was a Black Whistle Delver.

97986.name: Ilim
97986.desc: Ilim is one of the children brought down in the depths of the abyss by white whistle Bondrewd, together with Mitty and Nanachi. Later on, it's highly likely that she is one of the Narehate seen in the sixth layer of the abyss.

97986.name: Srajo
97986.desc: Srajo "The Obscure", is a legendary White Whistle Delver of the Abyss. Since she is a White Whistle, she is presumed to have made amazing discoveries within the pit and retrieved Artifacts that have changed the world. Like most White Whistle Delvers, she settled on the 5th layer and lived there for some time, since it is the last point of the Abyss where it is possible to return alive. ~!At some point and for unknown reasons, Srajo decided to take her "Last Dive" and descended to the 6th layer of the Abyss without even mentioning it to anyone else. [Bondrewd](https://anilist.co/character/122463/Bondrewd) was the only one that was made aware of her decision.!~

97986.name: Wakuna
97986.desc: Wakuna "The Chosen", also known as the "Lord of Guidance", is one of the legendary White Whistle Delvers in the Abyss, and is therefore presumed to have made outstanding discoveries down in the deep. He made his "Last Dive" to the 6th layer some time before Riko's journey.

20923.name: Souma Yukihira
20923.desc: __Height:__ 171 cm He is the son of [Jouichirou Yukihira](https://anilist.co/character/77495) and, until it closed, worked at his father's restaurant, Restaurant Yukihira. Souma fight his odds in the elite school to becoming the best chef in the world even with strong background discrimination of his academy. He is currently a student at Tootsuki Culinary Academy and a resident of Polar Star Dormitory. Souma is a rather energetic child who has the constant drive to move forward with his cooking, mostly due to his rivalry with his father. Due to his drive to move forward Souma is willing to try odd things with food including "Grilled Squid Tentacles Dressed in Peanut Butter," though these dishes usually don't go over too well. It is because the will of Soma to try to move forward, his dish often considered as creative and innovative by some peers and lecturers; lead his rivalry with all the students in the Tootsuki Culinary Academy even rough. Through all this Souma maintains a laid back attitude towards just about everything but cooking. Souma can cook many different foods in many different styles, though he prefers what he calls "Yukihira Style," which is the cooking style which he learned from his father. Souma shows an immense capability for cooking and a special adaption with learning from his mistakes and improvising through learning from said mistakes. It is due to his creativity and also resourcefulness, Souma is able to create the same dish with different ways of cook

20923.name: Erina Nakiri
20923.desc: __Height:__ 162 cm One of the two main heroines in the manga, Erina is initially the primary antagonist of [Souma Yukihira](https://anilist.co/character/75216), until this develops into more of a friendship. Erina is the only daughter of [Azami Nakiri](https://anilist.co/character/156421) and an unnamed mother who is [Senzaemon](https://anilist.co/character/76028)'s biological daughter. Erina often detests whoever is considered "common" due to her regal pedigree and status within the Toutsuki organization. Her "God Tongue" can accurately describe the taste and composition of any food, and she gives harsh critiques to chefs and students alike. However, there have been rare occasions where she gives credit to chefs with skill. She had been promoted as the Elite Ten's 10th seat as a middle-schooler.

20923.name: Megumi Tadokoro
20923.desc: __Height:__ 154 cm __Cuisine Style:__ Hospitality Megumi is from a cold harbor town in the Tōhoku region and enrolled into Tōtosuki's junior high program hoping to be able to help her family's bed-and-breakfast the Shokei'en Inn. Because of her stage fright and shyness she performs poorly and causes her to rank at the bottom of her class. Megumi is clumsy and timid, thoughtful, kind and honest girl with polite manners. She is always looking out for others and is willing to assist them in any way she can. According to Gin Dōjima, Megumi's greatest gift is her warm hospitality as she cooks. She highly idolizes her mother. Although Megumi is a capable chef, she does not fare well under pressure because she has stage fright. Because she is intimidated very easily, she makes simple mistakes when she cooks, causing many of her classmates to see her as a weak student. She is quick to panic when something goes awry and tends to over think situations when under pressure or stress, such as repeatedly packing and unpacking a suitcase to make sure she packed something, even though she did not need to pack a suitcase in the first place. ~!Megumi eventually even becomes the 10th seat of the Elite Ten Council of the Tōtsuki Culinary Academy after the Promotion Exams Arc.!~

20923.name: Senzaemon Nakiri
20923.desc: Senzaemon is headmaster of Tōtsuki Academy and [Erina](https://anilist.co/character/75284)'s grandfather. Known as the "Gastric Godfather", he has the tendency of stripping his upper body when he eats a good dish. Despite his appearance and reputation, he is reasonable and gives accurate commentary and assessment for the food he tastes without being overly critical to the losers. ~!Many years previously, Senzaemon and Gin noticed Jōichirō Saiba's critical condition at the start of a tournament, and took upon themselves some of the blame for pressuring Jōichirō into becoming mentally trapped in the creation of his dishes. Feeling Jōichirō's talent was beyond the tasks of the academy, Senzaemon freed his former student to travel abroad and learn independently, a proposal Jōichirō happily accepted, as well as Gin whom Senzaemon offered him as the head of resort planner as a mean to atone their sins to ensure no one will share a similar fate as what happened to Joichiro before. For a period thereafter, Senzaemon hired Jōichirō as his private chef.!~ ~!Six years ago, Senzaemon exiled his son-in-law, Azami, for abusing Erina with brainwashing, and turns out even worst and dangerous to rule the academy than Joichiro's previous ill-fate. Senzaemon became Erina's legal guardian and had Azami's name struck from the Tōtsuki records. However, in the year Erina enrolls in the academy, Azami returns and a majority of the Elite Ten vote to support Azami as headmaster, replacing Senzaemon. I

20923.name: Fumio Daimidou
20923.desc: She is the warden and guardian of Polar Star Dormitory.

20923.name: Roland Chapelle
20923.original: ローランド・シャペル
20923.desc: Roland Chapelle (Rōran Shaperu) is one of the stern lecturer in the Totsuki Culinary Academy, who was infamous for his extreme discipline. Earned the nickname as the Chef Who Never Smiles, Chapelle takes student's performance and presentation in a serious matter which every presentations counts as if it is their conduct in their future careers, not just in French cuisine but also others involves cookery. Whoever failed to reach his eligible standard shall faced his worst judgment upon them, making this veteran lecturer a judge, jury and even executioner in this prestige academy. He always has been this strict until Yukihira Soma, the Yukihira transfer student's resourceful and innovative cooking that made him smile for the first time with the impression Soma's version of Boeuf Bourguignon; making Soma is the first (and the only) rookie chef intrigued by this iron heart veteran. As the professional lecturer with French Cuisine is part of his forte and pride, Chapelle is very serious upon his native dish and he is not tolerate any fools (student or anyone alike) making fun of it. It is also believed that rigid discipline meant 100% success, Chapelle has a concept that any student whom didn't pass with the flying colors are considered people who failed to prove their worth. With his grumpy and no-nonsense attitude combined, Chapelle's strict discipline is so extreme that every students feared him as his judgement meant absolute end should the requirement didn't meet his expectat

20923.name: Jouichirou Yukihira
20923.desc: The father of Sōma Yukihira, and owner of the diner Yukihira in the Sumire Shopping District. His passion for cooking knows no bounds and his skill is world-class. As the sole parental-figure and family member in Sōma's life, he is a mentor, teacher, and rival to his son. Like Sōma, Jōichirō is laid-back but professional and has a serious side that emerges when he is cooking. The two share the same habit of creating horrible experimental dishes. Jōichirō is supportive of his son but does occasionally like to see Sōma stressed and frustrated by challenging him to many cook-offs – always ending in Jōichirō's victory – to show him how much he has to grow. He left home to work abroad and sent his son to Tōtsuki Academy, telling Sōma that he needs to succeed in Tōtsuki if he ever wants to surpass him.

20923.name: Kiyoshi Goudabayashi
20923.desc: Kiyoshi Gōdabayashi is a 91st Generation student of Tōtsuki Culinary Academy. He was the 76th president of the Chan RS before it was disbanded and destroyed as a result of a loss in a Shokugeki against Erina Nakiri.

20923.name: Satoshi Isshiki
20923.desc: He is a student at Totsuki Culinary Academy, a resident of Polar Star Dormitory and the current 7th seat of the Elite Ten Council. Aside from that, Satoshi's position as one of the Elite 10 also promote a strong determination for his kouhai(junior),Yukihira Soma to drive his dream to become one of the 10 seat and could be a potential challenge for Soma due to his natural cooking abilities.

20923.name: Ikumi Mito
20923.desc: She is one of the student of Tootsuki Culinary Academy whom is also a former rival to Yukihira Soma. As the sole successor of the meat culinary expert of the Mito family for abundance knowledge about the meat culinary (especially beef and donburi), Ikumi is responsible to hold the pride of her family's name and like any other students in Tootsuki Culinary Academy, Ikumi is extremely prejudice upon the society classes and use high class ingredient to make a high standard dish. It is said that Ikumi's rigid family rules and regulations had made her cooking skill more elegant and grace like playing piano. Using all graces of cooking by using the high grade materials as well as expensive, Ikumi can almost made the dish as elegant as it look to impressed her clients.

20923.name: Ryouko Sakaki
20923.desc: Ryouko is gentle and kind, responding to the eccentrics of the other Polar Star residents in a level-headed manner and comforting the other students when they are troubled. Ryōko's specialty is fermented foods due to her parents owning a well-known fermented-goods shop, and she maintains a workshop near the dorms to produce her own ingredients. She also keeps a bottle of "fermented rice drink" that she would sometimes bring out during parties and celebrations, which [Souma](https://anilist.co/character/75216/Yukihira-Souma) suspects is illegally brewed sake. ~!During the Autumn Elections, she presented a "curry soy-natto rice" using charcoal-fermented natto and homemade rice-sauce fermented with koji. The dish garnered praise from the judges, who suddenly felt as if they were in a festival due to the quintessentially Japanese and festive taste of the dish. She ultimately took 7th place in her block.!~

20923.name: Yuuki Yoshino
20923.desc: She is a student at Tōtsuki Culinary Academy and a resident of Polar Star Dormitory. She and the other resident students from his hostel befriended with their fellow roommate Yukihira Soma and also aware to Soma's talent as one of the finest and unique of all. She is also a roommate and friend to her fellow student, Tadokoro Megumi and Sakaki Ryoko. Yuki is more focus on animal meat as her main cuisine. Unlike Ikumi, the meat master in any meat culinary, Yuki often used the animal hunted game from domestic poultry to any other animals (like rabbits and deer) as her main theme. Yuki's cutting skill could be yet

20923.name: Shun Ibusaki
20923.desc: Shun is presumably known his senior, Isshiki Satoshi better than anyone else as he was stayed much longer than the rest of the Polar Star Gang. Unlike his passionate room mates, Shun is very realistic on the terms and very serious upon making his style in perfection. Shun is also a quiet student who prefer speak only whenever is considered as crucial by many. It is also once claimed that he is a calculative chef whose choose to act wisely over hesitation.

20923.name: Takumi Aldini
20923.original: タクミ・アルディーニ
20923.desc: __Height:__ 168 cm Takumi is the oldest nephew of the owner of the Trattoria Aldini, a trattoria (family-style restaurant) located in Florence, Italy. He is half-Japanese but, unlike his brother [Isami](https://anilist.co/character/85785/Aldini-Isami), appears more European – with blond hair and blue eyes – and is noted as being extremely handsome, having fan clubs in Toutsuki Academy and his hometown. He enrolled in Tōtsuki at the behest of his uncle, taking with him his mezzaluna (two-handed knife) and a bottle of homemade olive oil as a good luck charm. His specialty is Italian cuisine, although many professional chefs noted that he has a broad vision; like [Souma](https://anilist.co/character/75216/Yukihira-Souma), he will incorporate ingredients and methods from other culinary styles to create inventive dishes, and can modify his recipes while cooking. He is very kind and supportive of his less-skilled brother, to the point of risking his pride to defend Isami's honor. Takumi has a fierce (and somewhat one-sided) rivalry with Sōma. Takumi sees Sōma as someone similar to himself – both having grown-up working at small family restaurants – and a worthy rival, and jumps at any chance to compete with him. He frequently tries to challenge Sōma to informal cooking challenges (usually leading to an embarrassing situation for himself), hoping to one day defeat Sōma in a formal Shokugeki. Despite their rivalry, both he and Sōma greatly respect each other, and likely view each oth

20923.name: Hinako Inui
