20923.desc: One of the graduated students from Tootsuki Culinary Academy who turned professional, she is one of the respected legends of both her former school and alumni, among the few students who successfully graduated academy. Like most of the 10 alumni, Inui took the quality of the food very serious for it's freshness as well as. Fame for her nickname as the Mist Queen during her admission in the academy, Inui is able to know the quality of the food just by her nibble before she could bite into her mouth. With this, she can easily tell of the food is good or bad by just putting the food on her lips before finally eating them. Behind her mature, stern and professional personality however, Inui may be childish and rather whenever she confused of either decision which she could made. Considered as a joke member of all alumni, Inui actually make several jokes to cheer her peers. Inui's cooking style would preferred to the Japanese traditional style/ known as Washi. (Source: Shokugeki no Souma Wiki)

20923.name: Koujirou Shinomiya
20923.desc: Owner of a French cuisine restaurant called Shino's, Kojirou was a student of the 79th generation and held the first seat of the Elite Ten. He is commonly seen sporting glasses and red hair. Known as the "Legumes Magician", Kojirou was convinced he was going to be successful in France with his French–Japanese fusion restaurant, Shino's. However, his French staff refused to follow his recipes, even sabotaging his dishes. Facing financial ruin, he hardened himself emotionally and fired anyone who questioned his skills in the kitchen. Although this allowed him to reach the top, his proud and stubborn refusal to make exceptions resulted in his skills stagnating over the years. ~!Kojirou returns to Toutsuki as a guest teacher, and "fires" Megumi for altering his recipe despite there being an insufficient quantity of suitable ingredients. He threatens to do the same to Souma for coming to her defense, leading Souma to challenge him to an unofficial Shokugeki. During this match, Shinomiya makes a technically perfect dish that is the unanimous winner. However, Gin gives a bonus vote for Megumi's dish, prompting Shinomiya to try it and admit that her flexible cooking style suits the tastes of the customer. Shinomiya is reminded of his mother's kindness, and taking this to heart lets Megumi pass.!~ ~!Kojirou reappears in the story when Souma is assigned as a stagiaire (intern) at his new restaurant, Shino's Tokyo. His personality has noticeably softened since their last encounter, and

20923.name: Gin Doujima
20923.desc: Graduated from Tootsuki Culinary Academy, he is one of the respected legends of both his former school and Tootsuki Academy Alumni that is among the few who successfully graduated his academy with flying colors, thus became one of the proficient members of Tootsuki Resort as his graduation. As a living legend, Doujima is skillful in both culinary and board administration due to his talents in both culinary and managements that he handle the kitchen solo without the assistance of any chef around him. It is due to his professional discipline and tenacity, he is both respected and feared by many students and lecturers alike in his former academy. As the legend by the students of the Tootsuki Culinary Academy, Doujima is believed to possesses all styles of cooking to create much unique cuisine in different way. Usually handle the kitchen solo, Doujima has no problem to make 100 different meals thanks to his vast knowledge of ingredients as well of the varieties of cuisine. (Source: Shokugeki no Souma Wikia)

20923.name: Isami Aldini
20923.original: イサミ・アルディーニ
20923.desc: Isami is Takumi's brother, and the younger nephew of the owner of Trattoria Aldini. Unlike his brother, he has more of a Japanese appearance, with black hair and sharp eyes. Isami is originally shown to be overweight, with his eyes and mouth drawn in a simple fashion, although he briefly became much thinner during the Autumn Election preliminaries. Like Isami, he enrolled in Tōtsuki to hone his skills at the behest of their uncle. Although an equally talented chef, Isami is shown to be less sophisticated than his brother. He was scolded for trying to (and failing to) revise a dish that Takumi had made during their time in the trattoria, and constantly sought to be praised for his cooking like Takumi. Though Isami is supportive of his brother, he does aim to eventually surpass him as a cook. Nonetheless, the brothers are very close. ~!At the Autumn Election, he presented a tomato-curry calzone that was praised by the judges. He aimed to surpass his brother's score with the dish, but ultimately finished 5th in his block. He tried to support Takumi in his quarter-finals match against Subaru Mimasaka, and was devastated when Takumi lost to his own dish. He and Takumi opened a booth during the Moon Banquet Festival, naming it a branch of Trattoria Aldini, and gained first place in sales in their area. He is targeted as a rebel by the Azami Administration's Promotional Exams, defeated by Eishi on the third exam and expelled.!~ Isami and Takumi are featured in the Shokugeki no Soma

20923.name: Fuyumi Mizuhara
20923.desc: Italian restaurant "Ristorante F" chef. Withdrawn basically cynical personality.

20923.name: Hitoshi Seikimori
20923.desc: Hitoshi Sekimori is a 78th Generation Tōtsuki Academy Alumnus. He is the owner and head chef of the sushi restaurant, Ginza Hinowa.

20923.name: Goutoda Donato
20923.desc: Donato Gotōda is an 80th Generation Tōtsuki Academy Alumnus. He is the owner and head chef of the Auberge, Tesoro.

20923.name: Shingo Andou
20923.desc: Shingo Andō is one of the minor characters in the manga series and also one of 5 guest judges for the B Block Preliminary Round. Reputed for his silent yet serious personality, this food critic is infamous for the cruel yet truthful comments that will spell doom to any unlucky restaurant.

20923.name: Zenji Marui
20923.desc: He is a student at Totsuki Culinary Academyand a resident of Polar Star Dormitory. he and the other resident students from this hostel befriended with their fellow roommate/kouhai, Yukihira Soma whom also seen the amazing skill of the freshman. It is due to he rarely cooks, Zenji is considered as the weakest chef among the Polar Star Gang despite his brains has seemly possessed with infinite knowledge about cooking and black-&-white documents.

20923.name: Alice Nakiri
20923.desc: Alice Nakiri is a 92nd Tōtsuki Generation student and [Erina Nakiri](https://anilist.co/character/75284/Nakiri-Erina)'s cousin, whose cooking style is specialized in Molecular Gastronomy. Unlike her cousin though, Alice is much more friendly and cheery. She even will talk to her rivals casually, sometimes merely to poke fun at them, something she inherited from her mother. She is also a modern girl, eager to talk about love and gossip, even with the incredibly socially dense Erina. She is also very cunning, able to manipulate Erina using reverse psychology to keep her at a local public pool despite the latter's initial disgust at the location. She is quite bossy with [Ryō](https://anilist.co/character/88972/Kurokiba-Ryou), usually ordering him to do nearly everything for her. She tends to overreact when she is unhappy, throwing fits or snapping back at people. However, most of these are temporary and she will quickly return to normal in a few minutes.

20923.name: Ryou Kurokiba
20923.desc: Ryou Kurokiba is a 92nd Toutsuki Generation Student and Alice Nakiri's aide. Generally lazy and gloomy, Ryou's personality drastically shifts once he puts on his bandana, becoming aggressive, short-tempered, and brash. He grew up in a port town in Denmark, where he became the head chef of a pub due to his commanding personality and great skill. Due to his heritage, he is an expert in seafood and he can judge the quality of any and all seafood with only a glance. Mainly seen to be beside Alice Nakiri and has known her since childhood.

20923.name: Eizan Etsuya
20923.desc: He is a 91st Toutsuki Generation student of Toutsuki Culinary Academy and the current 9th Seat of the Elite Ten Council. He is known as the Alquimista aka "The Alchemist".

20923.name: Akira Hayama
20923.desc: An assistant of Professor [Jun Shiomi](https://anilist.co/character/144632/Shiomi-Jun), Akira comes from overseas; they met when he was an orphaned child and warned her about adultered spices in a market (presumably in India). Jun recognized the dormant talent in him and brought him back to Japan, where he was adopted by her teacher, Hayama. Akira quickly learned Japanese and studied spices and aroma under Shiomi. Jun became a mother figure for him, and his motivation to succeed at cooking stems from wanting to give something back to Jun. Akira specializes in curry dishes, with a wide knowledge of spices and aroma. He is a tall and handsome man with tanned skin and silver hair. Like [Sōma](https://anilist.co/character/75216/Yukihira-Souma), he aims to be at the top of the Elite Ten. His nose is very sharp when it comes to spices, capable of identifying ingredients and grade of cooking by the first smell, considered a worthy match of Erina's God's Tongue and being identified as an "Aroma Master". Although Jun and Akira are both experts in spices, she uses theoretical knowledge while he depends on his sense of smell. In contrast to Jun's naive, ditzy, easily angered and dependent persona, Akira is mature, reliable, street smart, cool and down-to-earth.

20923.name: Hisako Arato
20923.desc: Erina's secretary and close friend, Hisako specializes in medicinal-based dishes. She thinks of Erina as the best, that only she could be Erina's number two and nobody could ever get past her to Erina's level.

20923.name: Nao Sadatsuka
20923.desc: Nao Sadatsuka is a 92nd Tootsuki Generation student of Tootsuki Culinary Academy. Nao holds a deep harboring affection towards Erina Nakiri. Nao would do anything to get close to Erina including sending her 30 letters daily or watching her from afar using binoculars.

20923.name: Jun Shiomi
20923.desc: Shiomi is a 74th Generation Toutsuki Academy Alumnus and a former resident of the Polar Star Dormitory. She is one of the lecturers in Tootsuki Culinary Academy as well as the professor of the Shiomi Seminar. Shiomi Jun is leagal guardian of Hayama Akira. Jun is the youngest lecturer in the academy, but is actually older than she physically appears. Despite the fact that she in her 30s, she is shorter than both Souma and Megumi and has a noticeably youthful face, causing both Souma and Megumi to mistake her as a middle school student of the academy.

20923.name: Yaeko Minegasaki
20923.desc: Yaeko is an urban life planner and the first, albeit minor, antagonist of Shokugeki no Soma. She is a ruthless business woman who only cares about her job and she is willing to resort to dirty tactics to ensure that she has her way. Because of her job and callous behavior, she disregards many family-owned businesses, such as Restaurant Yukihira.

20923.name: Miyoko Houjou
20923.desc: A 92nd Totsuki Generation student. She is also the heiress to her family restaurant.

20923.name: Shouji  Satou
20923.desc: Shōji Satō is a 92nd Tōtsuki Generation student and a resident of Polar Star Dormitory.

20923.name: Daigo  Aoki
20923.desc: Daigo Aoki is a 92nd Tōtsuki Generation student and a resident of Polar Star Dormitory.

20923.name: Aki Koganei
20923.desc: Aki Koganei is a high school student and a close friend of Mayumi Kurase.

20923.name: Urara Kawashima
20923.desc: Urara is a 92nd Toutsuki Generation student and a popular idol at Toutsuki Culinary Academy. She is often an emcee for many of the academy's grand events.

20923.name: Osaji Kita
20923.desc: He was one of the 5 guest judges of Block "B" for the 43rd Annual Tōtsuki Autumn Election. A renowned entrepreneur and a founder of his own Gastronomy Club, Osaji's reputation in both his wealth and influence has made him a celebrity in the cooking industry.

20923.name: Natsume Sendawara
20923.desc: Natsume Sendawara is one of the heads of the Haubi Food Corporation along with her twin sister, Orie Sendawara, and one of the five judges of Block A in the 43rd Annual Tōtsuki Autumn Election Preliminaries

20923.name: Orie Sendawara
20923.desc: Orie Sendawara is one of the heads of the Haubi Food Cooperation along with her twin sister, Natsume Sendawara, and was one of the five judges of the B Block in the 43rd Annual Tōtsuki Autumn Election.

20923.name: Yua Sasaki
20923.desc: A 92nd Tōtsuki Generation student. Like her fellow schoolmate, Urara Kawashima, she is also an MC for hosting important events occurring around and within Tōtsuki Culinary Academy.

20923.name: Mayumi Kurase
20923.desc: Mayumi Kurase is Sōma Yukihira's close friend and one of his former classmates from kindergarten to middle school.

20923.name: Yuuya Tomita
20923.desc: Yūya Tomita is the chairman of the Sumiredōri Shopping District and the 2nd generation owner of Tomitaya.

20923.name: Shigeno Kuraki
20923.desc: Shigeno Kuraki is one of the three judges who appeared in Sōma Yukihira's Shokugeki against Ikumi Mito and she is also the president of the traditional Japanese restaurant called Kuraki.

20923.name: Tadokoro no Haha
20923.desc: The mother of [Tadokoro Megumi](https://anilist.co/character/76026/Megumi-Tadokoro).

20923.name: Shigenoshin Kouda
20923.desc: Shigenoshin Kouda is a gourmet critique and one of the five judges of Block A in the 43rd Annual Tōtsuki Autumn Election.

20923.name: Madoka Enomoto
20923.desc: Madoka Enomoto is a 92nd Tōtsuki Generation student and a member of the Miyazato Seminar. She adores [Marui](https://anilist.co/character/88721/Zenji-Marui).

20923.name: Tokihiko Sakuma
20923.desc: Tokihiko Sakuma is the Maître d'hôtel of the Tōtsuki Resort and one of the judges during the Egg Breakfast Buffet Challenge at the Tōtsuki Friendship and Rapport Training Camp.

20923.name: Yoshiaki Nikaidou
20923.desc: Yoshiaki Nikaidō is one of the students who attempted to enter Tōtsuki Culinary Academy alongside Sōma Yukihira. His family owns an unnamed French restaurant.

20923.name: Hiromi Sena
20923.desc: Hiromi Sena is the Vice Chef De Cuisine, Sous Chef to Gin Dōjima at Tōtsuki Resort, and a minor character of the series.

20923.name: Takao Miyazato
20923.desc: Takao Miyazato is one of the lecturers in Tōtsuki Culinary Academy as well as the professor of the Miyazato Seminar. He is among the few who recognizes Zenji Marui's true talent behind his frail endurance.

20923.name: Makito Minatozaka
20923.desc: Makito Minatozaka is an exclusive producer of a popular television program called Is That A Kitchen?. He is also one of the five judges in Block A in the 43rd Annual Tōtsuki Autumn Election

20923.name: Takumi Ishiwatari
20923.desc: Takumi Ishiwatari is a 92nd Tōtsuki Generation student.

20923.name: Yoshiki Bitou
20923.desc: Yoshiki Bitou is a Japanese black beef critic and one of the three judges involved in Sōma Yukihira's Shokugeki against Ikumi Mito.

20923.name: Katsunori Okamoto
20923.desc: Katsunori Okamoto is the television producer of First-Class Gluttons, and one of the three judges involved in Sōma Yukihira's Shokugeki against Ikumi Mito.

20923.name: Kyuusaku
20923.desc: Kyūsaku is the owner of Natural Cheese's Kyūsaku, a partner of the Tōtsuki Culinary Academy Manufacturer Division, and a food supplier to Tōtsuki Resort.

20923.name: Akari Miyano
20923.desc: Akari Miyano was a guest at the Tōtsuki Resort and participated as a judge for the breakfast buffet task for the 92nd Tōtsuki Generation's Tōtsuki Friendship and Rapport Training Camp.

20923.name: Kousuke
20923.desc: Kōsuke is the owner of Green Bean's Kōsuke, a partner of the Tōtsuki Culinary Academy Manufacturer Division, and a food supplier to Tōtsuki Resort.

20923.name: McFly
20923.desc: McFly is a doctor and one of Jōichirō Yukihira's customers abroad.

20832.name: Momonga
20832.desc: He is the guild master of Ainz Ooal Gown and regarded as the highest of the Almighty 41 Supreme Beings by the NPCs of the Great Tomb of Nazarick. He is also the creator of [Pandora's Actor](https://anilist.co/character/89154/Pandoras-Actor). A cautious and stingy person, Momonga always tries to plan and control details, avoiding any haphazard actions. Because he doesn't underestimate his opponents, he will usually overkill them. Since being transferred to a new world and becoming an actual Undead being, Momonga could feel himself becoming very cold and calculating, his emotions repressed. Loyal to his friends and creations, since becoming Lord ruler of Nazarick in the new world he acts with a certain degree of nobility for his devoted followers. Momonga only does things that will benefit Nazarick or himself, whether its information or prestige. Although he does have a sense of justice and doesn't hate humans as much as his followers, he holds no attachment to them, and he feels nothing toward their deaths. ~!His real name is Satoru Suzuki.!~

20832.name: Shalltear Bloodfallen
20832.original: シャルティア・ブラッドフォールン
20832.desc: The Guardian of the First, Second, and Third floors of Nazarick, she has the form of a beautiful vampire girl. She's also in love with [Momonga](https://anilist.co/character/89103). She and [Albedo](https://anilist.co/character/89122) constantly clash for his attention. While the two don't mind sharing Momonga, they still fight for superiority and who would ultimately appeal to Momonga. Shalltear is one of the most powerful guardians, allegedly capable of going toe-to-toe with Albedo. ~!Due to an incident where she is subjected to mind control by a member of the Black Scripture, she ends up unintentionally rebelling against Nazarick.!~

20832.name: Albedo
20832.desc: The overseer of the Floor Guardians and one of the most powerful NPC in Nazarick. She takes the form of a beautiful woman with fallen angel wings and horns. Because [Ainz](https://anilist.co/character/89103) modified her settings on a whim, she ends up madly in love with him. Albedo's romantic obsessions are so strong that if Ainz were to even glance at her body, she would immediately become excited. Albedo's obsession with Ainz has led him to greatly regret his actions. While she tries to act calm, as befitting of her role, any perceived insult against Ainz or Nazarick, real or imagined, sends her into a rage. Like most inhabitants of Nazarick, she despises humans which she refers to as "lower life-forms." ~!Though the reason is not yet known, Albedo holds a strong hatred towards all of the 41 Supreme Beings except for Ainz. It is hinted that she is scheming to annihilate all the other guild members if they are found.!~

20832.name: Solution Epsilon
20832.original: ソリュシャン・イプシロン
20832.desc: One of the Pleiades. She's a slime and one of the most dangerous Pleiades to humans, since she enjoys devouring humans alive. An assassin and poisoner who can decide to protect or dissolve things she absorbs, she can also control the speed of her digestion. She gets along with [Shalltear](https://anilist.co/character/89121) because of their similar tastes

20832.name: Demiurge
20832.desc: The Guardian of the Seventh floor of Nazarick, with the form of a demon wearing glasses. Demiurge is very intelligent, but is also considered the most evil NPC on Nazarick. He greatly enjoys the suffering of others, made clear by his vicious experiments on prisoners. He's in charge of tactics and defenses of Nazarick. Among the Guardians, he gets along the best with [Mare](https://anilist.co/character/89126/Bello-Fiore-Mare), since he understands the more cunning side of the Dark Elf.

20832.name: Mare Bello Fiore
20832.original: マーレ・ベロ・フィオーレ
20832.desc: One of the Guardians of the Sixth floor of Nazarick alongside his twin sister [Aura](https://anilist.co/character/89129). He's rather shy and calm in comparison to his sister, although he can fight and be ruthless when necessary. Like his sister, Mare is a Dark Elf. Mare specializes in Druid magic, capable of twisting the earth to his whims.

20832.name: Aura Bella Fiora
20832.original: アウラ・ベラ・フィオーラ
20832.desc: One of the Guardians of the Sixth floor of Nazarick, alongside her twin brother [Mare](https://anilist.co/character/89126). She's very energetic and extroverted, in contrast with her brother. Aura is a 70-year-old Dark Elf. Despite constantly fighting, she and Shalltear are quite close. Aura specializes in beast-taming and fights with a long, bladed whip.

20832.name: Cocytus
20832.desc: Cocytus is the guardian of the Fifth floor of Nazarick. An insectoid heteromorph, he was created by Warrior Takemikazuchi to be an honourable warrior and is tasked with keeping a cache of powerful weapons for Nazarick. He has a neutral alignment, which stands out against the many evil entities in Nazarick. An extremely skilled fighter, Cocytus is an expert at selecting the right combination of weapons for the fight, and dealing huge amounts of damage quickly. With the help of his extra arms, he is capable of wielding four of his twenty-one weapons at once, allowing him to deal the highest damage per second of any floor guardian.

20832.name: Narberal Gamma
20832.desc: One of the Pleiades, combat maids of the Tenth floor under [Sebas Tian](https://anilist.co/character/89155). She's a Doppelgänger and, because she's one of the most human-looking of the maids, she is [Momonga](https://anilist.co/character/89103)'s companion in his exploration of the new world disguised as adventurers. Narberal takes great pride in this duty, often "wearing" it like a badge of honor. However, like most in Nazarick, she holds great disdain towards humans. This proves troublesome, as she becomes incredibly violent when human males make advances on her. While operating as a member of the adventuring guild, "Darkness", Narberal operates under the alias of "Nabe", which becomes "Nabe, the Beautiful Lady" when Darkness becomes famous. Narberal's beauty has been compared to that of the "Golden Princess of Re-Estize" by many of the country's inhabitants.

20832.name: Pandora's Actor
20832.desc: __Height:__ 177cm __Race:__ Doppelgänger __Affiliation:__ Great Tomb of Nazarick __Occupation:__ Area Guardian of the Treasury __Creator:__ Ainz Ooal Gown (Momonga) __Hobby:__ Managing Magic Items The Area Guardian in charge of the Treasury and finances of Nazarick, who was created by Ains himself. He's a Doppelgänger whose face is a simple egghead with three holes dressed in a Neo-Nazi-esque uniform. In Momonga's original design, he's the combination of everything that he thought was cool, with exaggerated gestures and body language. His existence embarrasses Ains, but at the same time knows he's the NPC he can trust the most and the only one who can perform all his master's tasks without misunderstanding his intentions. He's on the same level as the Floor Guardians, and can copy the appearance and skills of anyone he has seen.

20832.name: Sebas Tian
20832.desc: The butler of the Tenth floor of Nazarick, who specializes in unarmed combat, with power comparable with the other Floor Guardians. He has the appearance of an elderly gentleman with a neat beard, but is actually of a species known as Dragonoids. He has a strong sense of justice, like his creator. Thus, he dislikes when the other Guardians kill humans needlessly. Because of their opposite personalities, he and [Demiurge](https://anilist.co/character/89125/Demiurge) don't get along.

20832.name: Entoma Vasilissa Zeta
20832.original: エントマ・ヴァシリッサ・ゼータ
20832.desc: One of the members of the battle maids originally created by Genjiro. ~!She has the appearance of a normal girl but her true form is that of an arachanid hybrid. She has bug mask to cover her real face. She uses a leech that recreates human voices after it kills them to disguise her original voice. She has insect focused abilities and uses talismans.!~

20832.name: Shizu Delta
20832.desc: One of the members of the battle maids originally created by someone except for Tabula Smaragdina. CZ2I28 Delta is an automaton battle maid and member of the "Pleiades Six Stars," the battle maid squad of the Great Tomb of Nazarick. CZ2128 appears emotionless and has a silent nature. Her Karma is relatively high, which makes her, along with Yuri Alpha, one of the two "safe" Pleiades to humans. Though she usually ignores conversations from humans, sometimes there is a possibility to communicate with her. She hates cannibalism and likes cute things, such as Eclair.

20832.name: Gazef Stronoff
20832.original: ガゼフ・ストロノーフ
20832.desc: __Race:__ Human __Affiliation:__ Re-Estize Kingdom __Occupation:__ Warrior Captain Gazeff Stronoff is the Warrior Captain of the Re-Estize Kingdom and King Ramposa III's personal bodyguard, and professes his utmost loyalty to him. Incredibly talented with the sword and well-versed in martial arts, he is famously considered the strongest warrior in the entire kingdom, and commands the respect and admiration of everyone who knows his name. Due to internal power struggles among the nobles in the kingdom, Gazeff is not knighted, so the King granted him the title of "Warrior Captain", which allows him to command his own unit comprised of "Warrior Troops". Born a commoner in a frontier village, he later became a mercenary. During his travels, he encountered a former adamantite-ranked adventurer who taught him his extraordinary swordsmanship. He participated in the grand tournament and defeated Brain Unglaus, becoming the champion and earning the King's trust.

20832.name: Lupusregina Beta
20832.original: ルプスレギナ・ベータ
20832.desc: A member of the "Pleiades Six Stars", the battle maid squad of the Great Tomb of Nazarick. She serves as the role of battle cleric and focuses on healing magic. In terms of combat ability, she possesses the highest physical defense and resistances among the Pleiades, and has balanced stats overall. Being a werewolf, she is weak to silver weapons, but is blessed with resistance against other metals. Her appearance is that of a brown-skinned beauty with amber-colored eyes, and red hair which she ties in two long braids. She wears a maid uniform with short sleeves and long black gloves, white stockings, and a skirt that has a long slit on its left side. She is usually seen carrying her signature weapon slung across her back, a menacing black and silver scepter which looks like and oversized religious symbol, the Crosier. Lupusregina boasts a very sociable and outgoing personality, and seems very friendly, even towards humans, a race considered unworthy of respect by other beings of Nazarick. For example, she adds "-chan" to the other maid's names, and often likes teasing [Enri](https://anilist.co/character/128405) with lewd jokes. The Homunculus Maids (the ordinary maids of Nazarick) are convinced she's the friendliest of the Pleiades and even believe that being approached by her can be a sign of good fortune. However, her fellow battle-maid [Yuri Alpha](https://anilist.co/character/128288) has commented that Lupusregina's friendliness is merely a facade, and that in reality she

20832.name: Touch Me
20832.desc: Touch Me is one of the original founding members of the Ainz Ooal Gown guild and one of the strongest warriors in YGGDRASIL. He is regarded as one of the Forty-One Supreme Beings by the NPCs of the Great Tomb of Nazarick. He is the creator of Sebas Tian. At some point in YGGDRASIL, Touch Me participated in an official martial tournament and defeated all of his adversaries. By winning the tournament, he was awarded a special prize that comes in two. Firstly, he was given a special job class known as the "World Champion" of Álfheimr, and in addition he was awarded with the pure white armor set called "Compliance with Law." Touch Me's outfit consists of shining white armor and a helm. His chest piece contains a huge sapphire embedded in the middle, which radiates with pure and divine light. He is also adorned with a reddish cape attached around his right shoulder. Additionally, he is armed with both sword and shield. Touch Me's actual facial appearance in real life is said to look exactly like Sebas Tian. As Touch Me played YGGDRASIL, he decided to assist the heteromorphic players during a time when they were being hunted down for fun through PKing. Thus, that was how he met Momonga, by saving him from a PK party; the two started becoming friends since then. There was also a time when Bukubukuchagama could not find a party to adventure with due to her appearance, so he was the one who approached her before anyone else. Afterwards, they formed a party together with other non-huma

20832.name: Brain Unglaus
20832.original: ブレイン・アングラウス
20832.desc: Brain is a warrior turned mercenary after he lost to Gazef Stronoff in a grand tournament to determine the strongest fighter in Re-Estize Kingdom. He has brown eyes with blue hair and the appearance of a wild beast. He is equipped with a chainmail and wears a necklace and ring which are infused with protection magic. His whole body is lean and his muscles are tough as steel and tempered through experience. Originally a farmer, he was gifted with what could only be described as a God-given talent in the mastery of the sword. He has always believed himself to be the strongest fighter inside the Kingdom, having never lost a fight before he entered the grand tournament to decide the King's guard captain. He easily fought his way to the final where he faced off against Gazef Stronoff. A grand and close battle ensued between the two, but eventually,​ he would taste his first defeat at the hand of Gazef. His fame was shattered and his confidence as an unbeatable warrior took a hit. He then decided to do everything he could to become stronger, so he would truly become unbeatable. At the same time, in order to make a living he started working as a mercenary for the Death Spreading Brigade. ~!When first introduced he is very arrogant, thinking that he is the most powerful, even though he earlier lost to Gazef. While a mercenary, he suffered a devastating defeat at the hand of Shalltear Bloodfallen when she attacked the hideout of the Death Spreading Brigade. After that, his personality

20832.name: Yuri Alpha
20832.desc: The Vice-Captain, but de facto leader of the Pleiades. She is a Dullahan who uses a choker to keep her head attached to the rest of her body, causing her to appear to be human. She specializes in unarmed combat and uses Gauntlets in battle. She is programmed to behave like a teacher, because her creator was one, and the other Pleiades look up to her like a big sister. Like Sebas, she holds a primarily neutral stance towards outsiders, but unlike him, her sense of justice is not so strong that she'd help people like him. (Source: Wikipedia)

20832.name: Clementine
20832.desc: __Race:__ Human __Affiliation:__ - Slane Theocracy (Former) - Black Scripture (Former) - Zurrernorn __Family:__ Quaiesse Hazeia Quintia (Brother) __Occupation:__ Warrior Clementine was a sadistic psychopath, obsessed with inflicting pain and torture on others. As a former member of the Black Scripture, Clementine was extremely confident in her abilities. She would go so far as to declare herself unbeatable until her unfortunate encounter with Ainz, who proved to be much more powerful than her. Before Clementine went rogue, she once held the position of 9th Seat in the Black Scripture. Besides betraying the Scripture, she also stole the magical Crown of Wisdom from one of the Six Miko Princesses of the Theocracy. Because of that, she has chosen to flee from her homeland and join Zurrernorn for protection.

20832.name: Nemu Emmot
20832.desc: Race: Human Affiliation: Sorcerer Kingdom Re-Estize Kingdom (Formerly) Family: Enri Emmot (Older Sister) Nfirea Bareare (Brother-In-Law) Occupation: Villager Residence: Carne Village Nemu has a childish and naive personality, but it seems that she may actually know more than her older sister. She used to be more bold and rebel, but after the attack to her village and the death of her parents she try to be more useful and obedient to help Enri. However, it seems that her boldness comes back when she gets emotional, like the time that she visited Nazarick

20832.name: Lizzie Bareare
20832.desc: Race: Human Affiliation: Sorcerer Kingdom Re-Estize Kingdom (Formerly) Family: Nfirea Bareare (Grandson) Occupation: Herbalist Potion Maker Residence E-Rantel (Formerly) Carne Village (Currently) is a pharmacist who used to operate in E-Rantel and the grandmother of Nfirea Bareare. When Nfirea was kidnapped by Zurrernorn, she made a deal with Ainz to rescue him in return for her services. Afterwards, she moved to Carne Village. Though a seemingly old woman, Lizzie Bareare is still quite sharp for her age. Highly knowledgeable about the make-up, properties and lore of potions. She also has a demanding and fastidious personality. Her intense gaze gives other people the shivers. Renown throughout the city of E-Rantel, Lizzie Bareare holds the title as the city's best pharmacist.

20832.name: Nfirea Bareare
20832.original: ンフィーレア・バレアレ
20832.desc: __Race:__ Human __Affiliation:__ Sorcerer Kingdom, Re-Estize Kingdom (Formerly) __Family:__ Lizzie Bareare (Grandmother), Enri Emmot (Wife), Nemu Emmot (Sister-In-Law) __Occupation:__ Herbalist, Potion Maker __Residence:__ E-Rantel (Formerly), Carne Village (Currently) __Birthday:__ Middle Wind Month 18th Day __Hobby:__ Alchemical Experiments. Nfirea is described as a nice, calm and timid person. He works hard at making potions with his grandmother every day. He also has a minor inferiority complex, due to comparing himself to Ainz. At a young age, Nfirea Bareare was raised by his grandmother Lizzie Bareare after his parents died; he only has murky impressions of them. His grandmother made him her apprentice and taught him everything she knew about herbs, alchemy, and potion-making. He met Enri Emmot while delivering potions to Carne Village and developed feelings for her.

20832.name: Enri Emmot
20832.desc: Race: Human Race Affiliation Sorcerer Kingdom Re-Estize Kingdom (Formerly) is the Chieftain of Carne Village and the older sister of Nemu Emmot. Raised by a loving family, Enri has grown up to be a kind person, but has shown to have a strong character. As seen when she is willing to sacrifice herself for the sake of her little sister's life. She shows great leadership, being the new village head and defending the town from monsters with the other villagers. Growing up in Carne Village and living there all her life, Enri has always lived the life of a simple farmer's daughter. Due to her healthy lifestyle, Enri has grown to be physically fit to the point where she is considered as one of the strongest five in the village.

20832.name: Hamusuke
20832.desc: Hamsuke resembles a giant Djungarian hamster with a long snake tail. Six sigils dot her silvery fur. Before being inducted in the Great Tomb of Nazarick, Hamusuke was very boastful and prideful of her ability and power as the "Virtuous King of the Forest." However, since meeting [Momonga](https://anilist.co/character/89103) and witnessing the power of the denizens of Nazarick, she has seen how vastly inferior she is. She accepts this and swears loyalty to Momonga, willing to do anything to please his master and earn his keep.

20832.name: Nigun Grid Luin
20832.original: ニグン・グリッド・ルーイン
20832.desc: Nigun Grid Luin (ニグン・グリッド・ルーイン) was the captain of the Sunlight Scripture of the Slane Theocracy. He was ordered by the Cardinals to assassinate the Re-Estize Kingdom's strongest warrior, Gazef Stronoff.

20832.name: Brita
20832.desc: Brita (ブリタ) is the leader of the Vigilance Committee of Carne Village and a former iron ranked adventurer whose hard-earned healing potion was broken by Momon but was compensated with a new but unknown one which fortunately saved her life.

20832.name: Dyne Woodwonder
20832.original: ダイン・ウッドワンダー

20832.name: Pluton Ainzach
20832.original: プルトン・アインザック

20832.name: Londres Di Clamp
20832.original: ロンデス・ディ・クランプ

20832.name: Herohero
20832.desc: Herohero (ヘロヘロ) is a guild member of Ainz Ooal Gown and regarded as one of the Forty-One Supreme Beings by the NPCs of the Great Tomb of Nazarick. He is the creator of Solution Epsilon and one of the creators of the Homunculus Maids groups that work in Nazarick.

20992.name: Makoto Nakashima
20992.desc: In *Kiben Gakuha, Yotsuya-senpai no Kaidan.* - Protagonist of the series where she accompanies her senpai in unraveling the fate of her missing friend. In *Haikyu!!* - Middle child of the Nakashima family. She often attends [Takeru](https://anilist.co/character/76818/Takeru-Nakashima)'s games and cheers enthusiastically along with the rest of her family.

20992.name: Shouyou Hinata
20992.desc: __Teams:__ Yukigaoka Junior High (Former); Karasuno High (Current) __Number:__ 1 (Junior High 3rd Year); 10 (High School 1st year); 5 (High School 3rd year) __Position:__ Captain (Junior High); Outside Hitter (Junior High); Middle Blocker (High School) Hinata has an unusually high ability to jump. Since he was young, Hinata trained his legs to compensate for his lack of height. He joins the Karusuno High School Volleyball team and amazes the team with his natural affinity as a spiker. Although he is a complete beginner and never had any experience playing in a volleyball team, he grows rapidly through each match. ~!After graduating from high school, Hinata traveled to Brazil to gain experience by playing beach volleyball. This is when he got the name, Ninja Shoyo. Upon returning to Japan, he became a member of the MSBY Black Jackals, a Division 1 team in the V-League. He became a member of the Japan Men’s National Volleyball Team during the 2021 Olympics. Currently, that is the year 2022, he is a member of Asas São Paulo, a professional team in the Brazil Super League.!~

20992.name: Tobio Kageyama
20992.desc: __Team:__ Karasuno High, Kitagawa Daiichi Junior High (former) __Height:__ 180.6 cm __Year:__ 1st Year, class 3 __Number:__ 9 __Position:__ Setter A famous setter in his middle school who joins the Karusuno High Volleyball team. He was known as the "King of the Court" in his middle school because of his arrogant demeanor and the way he would order around his teammates. Although he still carries an overbearing attitude, he begins to change when he starts to play with [Hinata Shouyou](https://anilist.co/character/64769) who views him as a rival.

20992.name: Koushi Sugawara
20992.desc: __Height:__ 174 cm Being the vice captain, Sugawara has a soothing personality for his teammates and acts as a pillar of support for them. Even though he isn't Karasuno's official setter anymore, he doesn't dream of giving up on playing in general. As such, he encourages himself and all of his teammates not to give up, no matter how rough the situation might be. Sugawara's dedication to volleyball is clear when he decides to continue club activities even when most third years choose to retire to focus on their futures. In a meeting, his teacher asked Sugawara why he's so determined to continue playing even though he's not a starting member, and Sugawara replied that he doesn't want to have regrets in the future. He is also quite perceptive as he noticed how [Tanaka](https://anilist.co/character/67325/Tanaka-Ryuunosuke) asked for the key to the gym (back during the first years' 3-on-3 match) even though he always comes in late, so Sugawara knew that something was up. He is also intelligent as he can come up with helpful tactics during the game. An example of this is when he came up with the idea of saying "bring it" and "send it to me" for [Kageyama](https://anilist.co/character/64771/Kageyama-Tobio) and [Hinata](https://anilist.co/character/64769/Hinata-Shouyou)'s combo.

20992.name: Daichi Sawamura
20992.desc: __Team:__ Karasuno High __Height:__ 176.8 cm __Year:__ 3rd year, class 4 __Number:__ 1 __Position:__ Wing Spiker The captain of the Karasuno High volleyball club.

20992.name: Ryuunosuke Tanaka
20992.desc: __Height:__ 177.2 cm __Team:__ Karasuno High __Number:__ 5 __Position:__ Wing Spiker

20992.name: Yuu Nishinoya
20992.desc: __Team:__ Karasuno High, Chidoriyama Junior High (former) __Height:__ 159.3 cm (5'2") __Year:__ 2nd year, Class 3 __Number:__ 4 __Position:__ Libero Yuu is a very energetic and temperamental person. His boisterous nature and crazy shenanigans can attract unwanted attention quite easily, which often bodes ill for him. Although he hardly ever worries about the consequences of his actions (and may even revert to violence in order to vent out his anger on certain occasions), he is surprisingly considerate of his friends' feelings and insecurities. Yuu can be extremely impatient, excitable and impulsive. As [Ryuunosuke Tanaka](https://anilist.co/character/67325) puts it, "he simply gets too fired up for his own good." He doesn't bother to filter his words, and is therefore prone to blurting out whatever he's thinking in a loud and tactless manner. In-game, however, his attitude changes drastically: he becomes incredibly focused and serious, remaining calm and doing everything in his power to provide the support his team needs until the very end. For this reason, everyone in the volleyball club respects him greatly.

20992.name: Kei Tsukishima
20992.desc: **Height:** 188 cm **Team:** Karasuno High **Year:** 1st year, class 4 **Number:** 11 **Position:** Middle Blocker A member of the Karasuno High volleyball club. Tsukishima is very blunt and will sometimes rile his teammates up due to his antagonistic nature (most notably being [Hinata](https://anilist.co/character/64769/Hinata-Shouyou), [Kageyama](https://anilist.co/character/64771/Kageyama-Tobio), [Nishinoya](https://anilist.co/character/67327/Nishinoya-Yuu), and [Tanaka](https://anilist.co/character/67325/Tanaka-Ryuunosuke)) and sometimes other teams because of his casual smug attitude, taking pride in and relishing when his opponents see him as a nuisance as seen with [Tendou](https://anilist.co/character/126073/Tendou-Satori) and [Shirabu](https://anilist.co/character/137537/Shirabu-Kenjirou). Tsukishima is standoffish and has an arrogant and condescending personality, but he has low self-esteem and thinks of himself as inferior. Although he is only outwardly close with [Yamaguchi](https://anilist.co/character/71609/Yamaguchi-Tadashi), he can be seen occasionally caring about his other club members.

20992.name: Chikara Ennoshita
20992.desc: __Team:__ Karasuno High __Height:__ 175.4 cm __Year:__ 2nd year, class 4 __Position:__ Wing Spiker Ennoshita seems quiet and reserved but can behave boldly towards the other 2nd years. He's smart and hasn't received a failing mark before. Similarly to Sugawara, he is always smiling. He's supposedly the only one within the 2nd years to be able to control Tanaka and Nishinoya. He's also able to understand different people, as stated a few times by Tanaka and when he knew what to do to give Yamaguchi some courage before his jump float serve.

20992.name: Asahi Azumane
20992.desc: __Team:__ Karasuno High __Height:__ 184.7 cm __Year:__ 3rd year, class 3 __Number:__ 3 __Position:__ Wing Spiker In contrast to his appearance, he is rather quiet and gentle and has his difficulties realizing that he is Karasuno's ace as he initially doesn't feel that way. He shows to be weak-willed at the beginning when he leaves the team before the first years come, feeling that he let down his entire team when they lost against Date Tech High even though they counted on him. After coming back to Karasuno, he realizes that his will to play volleyball is much stronger than he thought and with the help of his teammates, he acknowledges his position as Karasuno's ace (even though he is still mocked sometimes by Daichi for not having any "ace-like presence") and gains self-confidence.

20992.name: Kiyoko Shimizu
20992.desc: __Team:__ Karasuno High __Height:__ 166.2 cm __Year:__ 3rd Year, class 2 The manager of the Karasuno High volleyball club.

20992.name: Keishin Ukai
20992.desc: **Height:** 178.2 cm **Team:** Karasuno High Karasuno High School volleyball club's alumnus, currently coaching volleyball club and helping out his mother at the shop.

20992.name: Kenma Kozume
20992.desc: __Height:__ 169.2 cm The setter of the Nekoma High School volleyball club. Kenma is [Kuroo](https://anilist.co/character/71269)'s childhood friend and keeps playing volleyball because of him. He has a very calm personality and is usually doing things at his own pace. Often seen playing video games and being introverted. Nekoma's backbone, brain and heart.

20992.name: Tetsurou Kuroo
20992.desc: __Team:__ Nekoma High School __Height:__ 187.7 cm __Year:__ 3rd Year, class 5 __Number:__ 1 __Position:__ Middle Blocker The captain of the Nekoma High School volleyball club. Kuroo has a somehow manipulative and cunning personality, but cares about his friends and teammates very deeply. As Nekoma's captain he has a sense of responsibility and confidence. Even though Kuroo's a middle blocker, he often uses offensive plays too.

20992.name: Tadashi Yamaguchi
20992.desc: __Team:__ Karasuno High __Height:__ 179.5cm - 180.0cm __Year:__ 1st year, class 4 __Number:__ 12 __Position:__ Middle Blocker Yamaguchi always hangs out with Tsukishima and is very protective of him. He has trained himself hard to use a jump float serve. He is also a substitute ace server of the Karasuno Volleyball team.

20992.name: Tooru Oikawa
20992.desc: __Height:__ 184 cm The setter and captain of the Aoba Josai High School volleyball club. He was [Kageyama](https://anilist.co/character/64771/Tobio-Kageyama)'s senpai when they were attending Kitagawa Daiichi. According to Kageyama, he is a very talented setter and volleyball player with a ​complex personality. His favourite food is milk bread.

20992.name: Taketora Yamamoto
20992.desc: __Team:__ Nekoma High School __Height:__ 176.7 cm __Year:__ 2nd Year, class 1 __Number:__ 4 __Position:__ Wing Spiker Yamamoto is proud and short tempered wing spiker of the Nekoma High School volleyball club. He usually doesn't think what he says and is somewhat similar to Tanaka.

20992.name: Sou Inuoka
20992.desc: __Team:__ Nekoma High School __Height:__ 185.3 cm __Year:__ 1st Year, class 1 __Number:__ 7 __Position:__ Middle Blocker Middle blocker of the Nekoma High School volleyball club. He has friendly personality and becomes friends with Hinata after their game.

20992.name: Yuuki Shibayama
20992.desc: __Team:__ Nekoma High School __Height:__ 162.5 cm __Weight:__ 53.3 kg __Year:__ 1st Year, class 4 __Number:__ 12 __Position:__ Libero One of the libero of the Nekoma High School volleyball club.

20992.name: Ittetsu Takeda
20992.desc: __Team:__ Karasuno High __Height:__ 166.5 cm Volleyball club faculty advisor of the Karasuno High School. Takeda is inexperienced in volleyball, but still became an advisor for Karasuno. He often doesn't understand rules and that's why he takes notes about every new thing he learns. Takeda has an enthusiastic and brave personality.

20992.name: Yuutarou Kindaichi
20992.desc: __Team:__ Aoba Josai High, Kitagawa Daiichi (former) __Height:__ 189.2 cm __Year:__ 1st year __Position:__ Middle Blocker Middle blocker of the Aoba Josai High School volleyball club. He was Kageyama's teammate back in junior high school. Kindaichi was one of the players who hated Kageyama's selfish plays and refused to understand him.

20992.name: Nobuyuki Kai
20992.desc: __Team__: Nekoma High School __Height__: 176.5 cm __Weight__: 68.9 kg __Year__: 3rd Year, class 4 __Number__: 2 __Position__: Wing Spiker

20992.name: Morisuke Yaku
20992.desc: __Team:__ Nekoma High School __Height:__ 165.2 cm __Year:__ 3rd Year, class 5 __Number:__ 3 __Position:__ Libero Currently playing libero of the Nekoma High School volleyball club.

20992.name: Shouhei Fukunaga
20992.desc: __Team:__ Nekoma High School __Height:__ 178.3 cm __Year:__ 2nd Year, class 2 __Number:__ 6 __Position:__ Wing Spiker

20992.name: Manabu Naoi
20992.desc: __Team:__ Nekoma High School The coach of the Nekoma High School volleyball club and Ukai's old acquaintance.

20992.name: Yasufumi Nekomata
20992.desc: __Team:__ Nekoma High School The coach of the Nekoma High School volleyball club and Ukai's rival. He doesn't like to lose.

20992.name: Hajime Iwaizumi
20992.desc: __Height:__ 179.3 cm __Team:__ Aobajousai High School __Year:__ 3rd Year, class 5 __Number:__ 4 __Position:__ Wing Spiker __Ability Parameters (out of 5):__ Power = 5; jump = 4; stamina = 4; intellect = 3; technique = 3; speed = 4 Is a third-year student from Aoba Johsai High; he is the volleyball team's ace, vice-captain and a wing spiker. He is also [Tōru Oikawa](https://anilist.co/character/71611/Oikawa-Tooru)'s childhood friend and "pillar". Iwaizumi often gets irritated by Oikawa's behavior and tells him that guys who have girls going kyaa kyaa over them irritates him the most.

20992.name: Wakatoshi Ushijima
20992.desc: __Height:__ 189.5 cm (6' 2.6") __Team:__ Shiratorizawa Academy __Number:__ 1 __Position:__ Wing Spiker Wakatoshi Ushijima is a third year at Shiratorizawa Academy and the captain and ace of the school's boys' volleyball team. Currently, he is the number one ace in Miyagi Prefecture and one of the country's top three aces, along with Sakusa and Kiryu. Left handed. His favourite food is hayashi rice.

20992.name: Takeru Nakashima
20992.desc: Wakutaniminami High School's key player, he's in his 3rd year. He's the captain of the volleyball team.

20992.name: Yui Michimiya
20992.desc: __Height:__ 159 cm (5' 2") __Team:__ Karasuno Girls' Volleyball Club __Year:__ 3rd Year, class 1 __Number:__ 1 The captain of the Karasuno High girls volleyball club. Michimiya is shown to be a very active person, always smiling and cracking jokes. She is a very determined person, who cares a lot for her team, giving them motivational speeches, and always tries to stay composed in front of them; she only cries when she's away from her teammates. However, she herself had stated that she isn't strict enough. Around [Daichi](https://anilist.co/character/67323/Sawamura-Daichi) though she can become flustered and clumsy, repeating words to try and find the right thing to say.

20992.name: Kaname Moniwa
20992.desc: **Height:** 176 cm **Team:** Datekougyou High School **Number:** 2 **Position:** Setter The captain of the Datekougyou High School volleyball club.

20992.name: Kenji Futakuchi
20992.desc: __Team:__ Datekougyou High School __Height:__ 184.2 cm According to Moniwa, Futakuchi is a problematic kouhai with a very easy going personality. He's often seen arguing with Kamasaki who is the ​complete opposite of Futakuchi.

20992.name: Takanobu Aone
20992.desc: __Team:__ Datekougyou High School __Height:__ 191.8 cm __Year:__ 2nd Year, class A __Number:__ 7 __Position:__ Middle Blocker Main pillar of Datekou. Even though Aone never smiles and seems serious and scary, he actually has a very kind heart. Futakuchi said that Aone has a habit of "locking on" to you if he knows his opponent is an ace.

20992.name: Nobuteru Irihata
20992.desc: The coach of the Aoba Josai High School volleyball club.

20992.name: Yuusuke Takinoue
20992.desc: Height: 185.6 cm Position: Middle Blocker Karasuno High School volleyball club's alumnus. He and Shimada are part of the Karasuno Neighborhood Association team. And they often come to watch current Karasuno's games as well as to root for them. Yuusuke's working at Takinoue Electric Goods.

20992.name: Makoto Shimada
20992.desc: __Height:__ 177.7cm Karasuno High School volleyball club's alumnus. He and Takinoue are part of the Karasuno Neighborhood Association team. And they often come to watch current Karasuno's games as well as to root for them. Makoto's working at Shimada Mart.

20992.name: Hisashi Kinoshita
20992.desc: __Height:__ 174cm Narita, Ennoshita and Kinoshita are 2nd years who couldn't keep up with the training when old Ukai returned and that's why they left volleyball club. However after some time they came back because they realized that they still want to play volleyball, though coach Ukai was no longer there. Ennoshita called them ''disgraceful'' 2nd years.

20992.name: Kazuhito Narita
20992.desc: __Team:__ Karasuno High __Height:__ 180.2 cm __Year:__ 2nd Year, class 4 Narita, Ennoshita and Kinoshita are 2nd years who couldn't keep up with the training when old Ukai returned and that's why they left volleyball club. However after some time they came back because they realized that they still want to play volleyball, though coach Ukai was no longer there. Ennoshita called them ''disgraceful'' 2nd years.

20992.name: Koutarou Bokuto
20992.desc: __Height:__ 185.3 cm Bokuto is a third year student at Fukurodani Academy and is its volleyball team's captain and wing spiker. His spikes pack a powerful punch that others can struggle to receive. Despite this, Bokuto has a tendency to not doing well in the middle of games when getting shut out. Luckily, [Akaashi](https://anilist.co/character/88938) has a whole list of things Bokuto does and tries his best to bring Bokuto back up to his usual self. Besides Akaashi, Bokuto is friends with a few other rival team's players, such as [Kuroo](https://anilist.co/character/71269) and sorta friends with [Tsukishima](https://anilist.co/character/67329).

20992.name: Keiji Akaashi
20992.desc: __Height:__ 182.3 cm A second year at Fukurodani Academy, and its volleyball team's vice-captain and setter. Akaashi is often calm and collected, though he does have times where he begins to get worried about things. More often than not, he has to handle Bokuto and all of his antics during the game. When such happens, Akaashi usually thinks of some way to bring Bokuto into peak condition again, though there are times where he struggles with doing so.

20992.name: Hitoka Yachi
20992.desc: __Team:__ Karasuno High __Position:__ Manager __Occupation:__ High School Student (1st Year, Class 5) A 1st year who was recruited by [Shimizu](https://anilist.co/character/67689/Shimizu-Kiyoko) as a manager trainee. She appears to be very nervous, but easily befriends [Hinata](https://anilist.co/character/64769/Hinata-Shouyou). She's paranoid (which causes her to be intimidated easily), very curious, and is organized with her notes, including the ones that she takes from class; this is largely due to her mother being a graphic designer.

20992.name: Yuuji Terushima
20992.desc: **Team:** Johzenji **Height:** 177 cm **Number:** 1 **Position:** Wing Spiker **Role:** Captain The recently instated captain of the Johzenji volleyball team. Values spirit and fun over all else, contrary to the teams original motto "valor and simplicity." His ways of practice are often very hectic, and include mostly 2 vs 2.

20992.name: Akira Kunimi
20992.desc: __Team:__ Aobajōsai (former Kitagawa Daīchi) (first year at Aoba Johsai) __Height:__ 182.8 cm __Number:__ 13 __Position:__ Wing Spiker He is a quiet and indifferent person, though it's mostly out of laziness. He occasionally skips practice as well and doesn't seem to put his full effort into matches; however, his true strength lies in his late game plays. Kunimi dislikes loud, energetic people and was dismayed when Koganegawa yelled at him to "go all out", which is one of his least liked phrases. He also refers to Hinata, Koganegawa, and Hyakuzawa as the "idiot squad" because of their energy. Kageyama has also mentioned that Kunimi is smart, though it's unknown if that refers to his game sense or general studies.

20992.name: Lev Haiba
20992.desc: __Team:__ Nekoma High School __Height:__ 194 cm __Weight:__ 79,7 kg __Year:__ 1st Year __Position:__ Middle Blocker Lev is a half Russian, half Japanese. However he says he doesn't speak Russian because he was born and raised in Japan. His name in Russian means lion. Lev wasn't around when Karasuno and Nekoma had their first match together. He started playing volleyball in high school, that's why he was still a novice and spent whole time on bench at that time so he didn't come. Lev is blessed with natural physical ability, intuition and height. He declares that he's an ace even though he's a middle blocker. Kenma states that Lev is a good and honest guy. Lev is quite childish and cheerful, shown when he was making fun of Hinata's height. Lev's appearance, as well as his piercing eyes, causes people to believe he is much more intimidating and serious than he actually is. Though he can be blunt, he never seems to mean any harm and adopts a playful attitude towards most things. He is also shown to be enthusiastic about spiking as he gets excited about it very easily, and can be competitive with people he is interested in.

20992.name: Saeko Tanaka
20992.desc: Saeko Tanaka is a former student of Karasuno High and the older sister of Ryuunosuke Tanaka. She was also a classmate of the Small Giant during her high school years. The second years of the volleyball team views her as a cool older sister, especially Nishinoya, but Tanaka thinks of her as a nuisance whenever she bothers his study sessions. Like her brother, she's loud and outspoken. Her driving has been described by her brother as dangerous as he had once stated to Hinata and Kageyama that he can't guarantee their safety in her car.

20992.name: Akiteru Tsukishima
20992.desc: Kei Tsukishima's older brother.

20992.name: Kanji  Koganegawa
20992.desc: __Height:__ 191.5 cm __Team:__ Datekougyou High School __Year:__ 1st year __Number:__ 7 __Position:__ Setter Koganegawa is a first year setter at Date Tech High. He is very energetic and enthusiastic but often lacks the ability to think carefully about his actions. Despite being rather simple-minded, he's also shown to be determined to improve his abilities and support his team as their setter and with his height but tends to focus on improving the wrong areas.

20992.name: Kentarou Kyoutani
20992.desc: __Height:__ 178.8 cm __Team:__ Aoba Johsai High __Year:__ 2nd Year, Class 1 __Position:__ Right-Wing Spikers He is said to have the best ability among the second years at Aobajōsai High, but his brash attitude is cause for poor relationships with other members of the volleyball team. He doesn't seem to show any respect for the third years (besides Iwaizumi), irritating them and shocking the first years upon Kentaro's return to the team. He is extremely strong, and he can only hit the ball with his full strength or he "doesn't feel satisfied."

20992.name: Kazuma Bobata
20992.desc: Team: Johzenji High Height: 185.9 cm Weight: 71.8 kg Year: 2nd Year Number: 2 Position: Middle Blocker Bobata is a second year student in Johzenji High. He is one of the volleyball team's middle blockers. He appears to be very carefree and outgoing. Like his teammates, he has a reckless playing style and is confident about winning, but after losing to Karasuno, he seems to have calmed down a lot.

20992.desc: __Height:__ 163.2 cm (5'4") __Team:__ Jouzenji High __Position:__ Manager She is a third year student at Jouzenji High and was the manager of the volleyball team.

She would later appear during Seijoh's rematch against Karasuno.

20992.name: Chizuru Sasaki
20992.desc: __Uniform Number:__ 11 Third-year student at Karasuno High and wing spiker for the girls' volleyball team. She is close friends with [Michimiya](https://anilist.co/character/77165/Yui-Michimiya) and Aihara.

20992.name: Yasushi Kamasaki
20992.desc: __Height:__ 186.8cm (6' 1.5") __Uniform Number:__ 1 __Position:__ Middle Blocker __Ability Parameters (out of 5):__ Power = 5; Jump = 2; Stamina = 4; Game Sense 2; Technique = 2; Speed = 4 Third-year student at Datekougyou High School. Prior to retiring, he played on the boys' volleyball team as a middle blocker and the vice-captain. He is loud, strict, and often argues with and threatens his problematic kouhai [Futakuchi](https://anilist.co/character/77415/Kenji-Futakuchi). However, he is incredibly supportive of his team and often attends their official and practices matches with [Moniwa](https://anilist.co/character/77413/Kaname-Moniwa) and [Sasaya](https://anilist.co/character/137486/Takehito-Sasaya) after retiring.

20992.name: Kyoutou
20992.desc: Vice Principal of Karasuno High School. He is balding and attempts to keep his head covered with a toupee. He is said to have a bad relationship with the volleyball club that has gotten worse since Hinata and Kageyama joined the club. However, once the team starts to win again, he begins supporting the club more.

20992.name: Mao Aihara
20992.desc: __Uniform Number:__ 2 Third-year student at Karasuno High School. She played on the girls' volleyball team as the team's ace and vice-captain. She is good friends with and very supportive of [Michimiya](https://anilist.co/character/77165/Yui-Michimiya).

20992.name: Masayoshi Nakashima
20992.desc: Patriarch of the Nakashima family, who often attend [Takeru](https://anilist.co/character/76818/Takeru-Nakashima)'s matches. The family has grown to be known as Wakutani South's famous "cheering squad family". He is terribly in love with his wife and is often shown to be lovey-dovey with her, even in front of their 5 kids.

20992.name: Minaho Ono
20992.desc: Teacher at Karasuno High School. She is often seen teaching [Hinata](https://anilist.co/character/64769/Shouyou-Hinata)'s classes, overseeing tests, and working in the staff room. She supervises Hinata and [Kageyama](https://anilist.co/character/64771/Tobio-Kageyama) while they took their make-up exams and encourages them to do well afterward. When the Karasuno boys' team won an important match, she joined the students in opening the windows and cheering to welcome them back. She attends the Karasuno vs. Shiratorizawa match and tells the [Vice Principal](https://anilist.co/character/290203/Kyoutou) that their hastily-assembled cheering section had not been practiced enough.

20992.name: Gou Akaizawa
20992.desc: __Height:__ 182.5 cm (5' 11.8") Wing spiker for the Kaji Wild Dogs, a mens' volleyball team that [Akiteru Tsukishima](https://anilist.co/character/121624/Akiteru-Tsukishima) joins after high school. Gou has a competitive but friendly relationship with [Kei Tsukishima](https://anilist.co/character/67329/Kei-Tsukishima) after Tsukki trains with the Wild Dogs to prepare for the Spring High.

20992.name: Kiyoshi
20992.desc: Attends the Aoba Josei vs Karasuno match at the Spring High Preliminary to support [Kyoutani](https://anilist.co/character/135829/Kentarou-Kyoutani). He met Kyoutani at a volleyball open gym and is a large influence on the boy's development.

20992.name: Tsukishima no haha

20992.name: Yuu Ogasawara
20992.desc: One of the volleyball students attending Ikkei Ukai's training sessions. He and the other kids mistsake Hinata for a middle school student but were surprised at the height of his jump when he was told to block a spike.

15809.name: Satan Jacob
15809.desc: Satan Jacob is the main protagonist of the series. He was once the Demon King who declared war on Ente Isla in an attempt to annex the four continents. However, due to the actions of the Hero [Emilia Justina](https://anilist.co/character/70735) and her companions, he was forced to retreat to Earth, causing him to lose almost all of his powers. Satan was well-known throughout Ente Isla as the great overlord of his people, his name synonymous with the terror and cruelty his army brought to those unfortunate enough to fall victim. He allowed his minions the right to perform any heinous acts they deemed fit, showing immense cruelty through the slaughter of many innocent humans in his conquest. By contrast, on Earth Sadao Maou is shown to be a diligent and proactive employee, instead applying his strong drive and determination to better himself in his new life. Forced to spend time living as a human and interacting with those he previously considered to be lesser beings, he has since developed a kindhearted and cheerful disposition making him popular among both his colleagues and neighbors. He now strives to climb the corporate ladder at MgRonald's. ~!Though he is not the legendary Satan spoken of in the Ente Islan Bible, Satan Jacob was given the name at birth, as it has since become an extremely common name among demons. While he once belonged to a lowly goblin-class tribe, Satan's family and comrades were slaughtered in a conflict between demons, the enemy having left him behin

15809.name: Emilia Justina
15809.original: エミリア・ユスティーナ
15809.desc: Emilia is the main female protagonist and the Hero who defeated the [Demon King Satan](https://anilist.co/character/70733). After forcing the Demon King to retreat from Ente Isla, she followed him to modern day Japan to ensure his destruction. However, just like the Demon Lord, she lost most of her powers upon her arrival and was forced to assume a Japanese name. She was also forced to find employment, and so became a call center agent. She is a half human and half angel. Overall, Emi is a strong-willed and determined hero, displaying many admirable qualities befitting of one in her position; among which are a pure heart, boundless courage, unwavering loyalty to those closest to her, and a deep-seated desire to protect the innocent. Moreover, she lacks self-confidence and gets angry/frustrated easily. While initially hesitant to become the great hero of Ente Isla, the death of her father at the hands of [Lucifer](https://anilist.co/character/83103)'s Army ignited a fire in the heart of the young hero, giving her a motivation to train harder and strike down those who destroyed her village. Due to her personal losses, she sees all demons as her enemy, most of all their leader, Satan Jacob. ~!Emilia Justina was born to her parents, an ordinary farmer named Nord Justina and the archangel Lailah. Knowing she had committed a taboo by birthing a child to a human, her mother fled, leaving Emilia to be raised by her father on his farm located somewhere on the Western Continent. During

15809.name: Alciel
15809.desc: Alciel is one of Satan's Demon Generals and was also transported to modern day Japan with him. Extremely loyal to Maou, he takes care of the domestic duties at home and goes to the library to research ways for Maou and himself to regain their powers. Back in Ente Isla, Alciel was known widely as the right hand of King Satan and a master strategist, making him both a trusted adviser and top military commander to the ruler of the Demon Realm. However, he shared his leader's belief that humans lives are meaningless and expendable, considering demonkind to be superior beings and showing a strong sense of pride bordering on extreme arrogance. While living in Japan, Ashiya has come to accept his rather mundane life, though he still openly laments how low they have fallen since arriving on Earth, and still tends to consider humans as beneath him. Due to their lack of sufficient funds and personal comforts, Ashiya has become incredibly tightfisted and strict about the household budget. One part of him that has not changed, though, is his extreme dedication and loyalty to the Demon King. (Source: Hataraku Maou-sama Wikia, edited)

15809.name: Chiho Sasaki
15809.desc: Chiho is Maou's friend and a fellow employee at MgRonald's. She has a crush on Maou. She can hear and understand the language of Ente Isla, after receiving feedback from a hypnosis spell that Maou cast on her father, Inspector Sasaki. She has a strong will and a polite, friendly, pleasant all around personality. She is head over heels for Maou, and sometimes gets jealous when she sees Emi and Maou together. She is a part-time employee at MgRonald's along with Maou. Maou had met her father when he first landed on Earth, as her father is a policeman and caught him and Ashiya loitering around. Chiho attends school at Sasahata North High School. (Source: Hataraku Maou-sama Wikia)

15809.name: Mayumi Kisaki
15809.desc: She is Maou's immediate superior at MgRonalds where he works.

15809.name: Lucifer
15809.desc: Lucifer is a fallen angel and one of the Demon King's generals. After his defeat at the hands of Hero Emilia, he was secretly rescued by Olba Meyer, who promised to return Lucifer to heaven if they became allies in defeating the Demon Lord. After being defeated by the Demon Lord, Urushihara moved in with Sadao Maou and Ashiya. Lucifer is shown to be cunning and sneaky as well as a childish, preferring to surf the internet and play video games rather than help Ashiya with the housework. Due to his attitude, everyone tends to treat him lightly and pay no mind to many of his protests at being excluded from things. Lucifer is also self-proclaimed socially awkward, lazy to an extent, and has a short temper. However, it seems he has hidden feelings beneath his seemingly irresponsible and carefree attitude, and shows his serious side from time to time. To his irritation, Lucifer is usually referred to as a hikikomori even when among company. ~!Known as the "original sin" and the son of Ignora, Lucifer was born after the destruction of the angels' home-world, making him part of the second generation of his kind. Once an honored and revered archangel, he was tasked with the responsibility of leading the archangels. Lucifer eventually abandoned his job, feeling it was too boring in heaven for him to remain. Losing his former status and gaining black wings signifying his corruption, his powers became demonic, reclassifying him a fallen angel. Lucifer traveled to the Demon Realm where he

15809.name: Crestia Bell
15809.desc: She is the chief interrogator and executioner for the Church Investigation Commission, who came into the human realm from Ente Isla to check on reports about Emi's alliance with Maou. Unknown to Maou who she is, she becomes his next door neighbor and eventually became close, being a good cook she would drop by in Maou's apartment to prepare meals for everyone. She knows little about the human realm especially in Tokyo that she is having difficulty going around the city and understanding people's sense of fashion. ~! It seems since the start that Maou and Lucifer knew who she was. !~ (Source: Animefreak)

15809.name: Miki Shiba
15809.desc: **Miki** is the landlord at the place the Devil King stays, "Villa Rosa Sasazuka". She requested that her apartment be rented out to "shady characters" such as Maou and Alciel. She seems to have some knowledge of Ente Isla. ~!She is a guardian of the Earth and is thought to be incredibly powerful to the point where Sariel and Gabriel did not strike Villa Rosa Sasazuka out of fear of provoking her. She is older than any known archangels in history.!~ (Source: Hataraku Maou-sama Wikia)

15809.name: Rika Suzuki
15809.desc: Emi's coworker.

15809.name: Emeralda Etuva
15809.original: エメラダ・エトゥーヴァ
15809.desc: Emi's friend from Ente Isla.

15809.name: Albert Ende
15809.desc: One of the comrades of Yusa, Emi on attacking the Dark Lord's castle.

15809.name: Olba Meyer
15809.desc: ~!He is an ambitious high member of the church who came into the human world with Hanzou to seek and eliminate both Maou and Emi, so that he can be the sole ruler of Ente Isla.!~ (Source: ANN)

15809.name: Nord Justina
15809.original: ノルド・ユスティーナ
15809.desc: [Emilia's](https://anilist.co/character/70735) father. ~!He was thought to be dead, but it was revealed that he has been hiding in Japan under the name Sato Hiroshi!~

15809.name: Senichi Sasaki
15809.desc: Chiho's father.

15809.name: Riho Sasaki
15809.desc: Chiho's mother.

15809.name: Kaori Shouji
15809.desc: Chiho's classmate, who seemly has an affinity for boy's love.

15809.name: Robertio Iguno Valentia
15809.original: ロベルティオ・イグノ・ヴァレンティア
15809.desc: One of the Chief Inquisitors of The Church on Ente Isla.

15809.name: Servantes Reberiz
15809.original: セルヴァンテス・レベリーズ

15809.name: Mitsuki Sarue
15809.desc: He was introduced in ep. 8 as the manager of Sentucky Fired Chicken or SFC, MgRonald's rival fast food chain in Hatagaya district. He apparently has a thing for beautiful girls. ~!His true identity is the archangel Sariel, who came to Japan to retrieve Emi's sword, "Better Half".!~

15809.name: Watanabe
15809.desc: Sadao's acquaintance. Sadao met him while volunteering on the Neighborhood Cleanup.

15809.desc: **First appearance:** Episode 9.

20920.name: Hestia
20920.desc: __Race:__ God __Height:__ 140 cm (4'7") __Affiliation:__ Hestia Familia Hestia is an energetic, kind goddess who sees potential in [Bell](https://anilist.co/character/88860/Cranel-Bell). She is a hard worker, and works jobs to support the two while Bell goes off to the dungeon. Hestia tends to be shown as very petty and gets jealous easily when girls, namely [Aiz](https://anilist.co/character/87655/Wallenstein-Ais), show interest in Bell, because she is deeply in love with him, or they are the reason for his strength growth. Despite seeming mature and dependable toward Bell, Hestia is in truth, a lazy goddess, as she couldn't get a job or put effort into work. After descending to the Lower World, Hestia was taken care of by her friend [Hephaestus](https://anilist.co/character/142544/Hephaestus). Soon after, she was asked to live on her own after she kept freeloading off of Hephaestus' familia and was given a room at an abandoned church. Hestia tried to create her own familia, but wasn't able to recruit anyone. After failing to recruit for the 50th time, she noticed Bell and decided to secretly follow him. Hestia found out that Bell had been trying to enter a familia, but was rejected multiple times and seemed to be in the same boat. Hestia then took the chance to recruit him, which Bell happily agreed upon; becoming the first member of her familia. She took Bell to a bookstore, the location she already decided beforehand, and granted her Falna to her first dependent.

20920.name: Ais Wallenstein
20920.original: アイズ・ヴァレンシュタイン
20920.desc: __Height:__ 162 cm (5'4") Ais Wallenstein, also known as the Sword Princess, is a First-Class Adventurer and a key member of the Loki Familia. Among the small fraction of First-Class Adventurers, she is considered one of the strongest.

20920.name: Bell Cranel
20920.desc: __Race:__ Human __Height:__ 165 cm (5'5") Bell Cranel is the captain of the Hestia Familia. Bell was raised by his grandfather in a rural farming village deep within the mountains near the labyrinth city Orario. He had heard and read many stories about heroes from his grandfather, forming his dream of aspiring to be a mighty one himself. After his grandfather's death, he took it upon himself to leave the village, traveling to the land of Orario to fulfill his dreams. Upon his arrival in the city, Bell attempted to enter numerous Familia, but was rejected by each one. [Hestia](https://anilist.co/character/87654/Hestia), a Goddess, unable to find members willing to join her Familia, asked him if he'd like to become the first member of her Familia. Bell gladly accepted, and so started his new life, finally with a Goddess' blessing. Bell is a kind, straightforward, brave, yet shy boy who desires to be a hero like the ones he grew up reading about. He cares deeply for the people around him, especially his Goddess, Hestia, and his Familia. He considers them like family due to the death of his grandfather. Bell's goals didn't start out pure, as he wanted to be an adventurer in hopes of picking up girls, even thinking of starting a harem. However, after his experience with [Ais](https://anilist.co/character/87655/Wallenstein-Ais) and [Bete](https://anilist.co/character/122632/Loga-Bete), Bell seems to have forgone that dream and fell in love with Ais Wallenstein. He became determined

20920.name: Ryuu  Lion
20920.desc: __Race:__ Elf __Height:__ 165 cm (5'5") Ryuu Lion is a waitress at the Hostess of Fertility. Ryuu was a member of a family that cared for the sacred tree in their home forest of Ryumilua. As time passed, she began to think that beautiful Elves were the ugliest of all people, due to seeing her fellow Elves' behavior toward those of other races. No matter how much she tried to forget it, once she began thinking about it, the thought firmly planted itself in her mind. Eventually, the thought became enough to make her decide to leave the forest. Ryuu is calm and stoic but also cares deeply for her friends. When a person related to her or her friends are in danger or in need of help, she is always ready to step in and help no matter the cost. Like many Elves, Ryuu is selective with who may touch her. However, she has been advised by [Alise](https://anilist.co/character/288478) to not let go of a man that was able to grab her hands, and began to follow [Bell](https://anilist.co/character/88860) with her eyes. Unlike most Elves, she doesn't bear the same hatred towards the Crozzo family or their magic swords for their role in the destruction of the forests the Elves lived in, stating that the event took place many years ago and that her village wasn't directly affected. ~!After arriving in Orario, Ryuu became an adventurer known as Gale, belonging to the Astraea Familia. She was caught in a trap set by Evilus and all of her fellow Familia members were murdered. Overcome with vengean

20920.name: Eina Tulle
20920.desc: __Race__: Half Elf __Height:__ 164 cm (5'5") __Affiliation:__ Guild Eina Tulle is a receptionist at the Guild and Bell Cranel's advisor. Eina joined the Guild five years earlier at the age of 14 after she graduated from the school. Originally excited to work at the Guild, she quickly learned that it wasn't as fun as she thought it would be, eventually changing her personality into what it is now. She met Bell four years later and became his dungeon adviser. Eina shows a serious, calm demeanor, appearing as a very wise and sisterly figure towards Bell, even so far as getting worried whenever he went out to dangerous levels in the dungeon. She gets embarrassed when the subject of romance or love is mentioned, especially coming from Bell. Eina is passionate about her job as she doesn't want any adventurers under her care to die in the dungeon. She has a particular stance when it comes to advising adventurers; in addition to the usual Dungeon-prowling advice and regular meetings, she would also summon her adventurers to private lessons, where she crams as much Dungeon knowledge into their heads as possible. It was to the point where she gained a scary reputation among many adventurers, as she would often demand her pupils to perfectly draw out maps and monsters strategies from memory, with the threat of extra work if there were any mistakes. No one had lasted all the way to the end of her course, most ran away halfway through, and the only one known so far to be able to endure he

20920.name: Liliruca Arde
20920.desc: __Race:__ Pallum __Height:__ 110 cm (3'7") Liliruca Arde is a member of the Hestia Familia. Originally a member of the Soma Familia, she converted to the Hestia Familia after securing her freedom after the War Game. Lili was born to Hobbit parents belonging to the Soma Familia, making her a member of the Familia from birth. However, her parents didn't look after her and ordered her to earn money for them instead. A while later, her parents were killed in the dungeon, leaving her to fend for herself. The Soma Familia didn't take care of her and bullied her, making her lonely and isolated. To earn money, she tried to be an adventurer, but didn't have the talent, eventually switching to being a supporter. As a supporter, she was constantly looked down on by those she partied with, fueling the hatred of adventurers inside of her. After a while, Lili decided to run away from the Soma Familia and become a normal citizen.
