However, the Soma Familia found her and inflicted misery on the old couple who took care of her, destroying their store and stealing money. She began to hate Soma himself, wondering why he created a Familia if he wasn't going to take care of it. From that time on, Lili began using her hatred of adventurers as an excuse to trick and steal from them. She also treated Bell the same way, however, his actions repeatedly caused her to question her own attitude. After she is saved by Bell, she becomes much closer to him and develops romantic feelings for him. Lili often u

20920.name: Tiona Hiryute
20920.desc: __Race:__ Amazoness __Height:__ 165 cm (5'5") __Affiliation:__ Loki Familia __Level:__ 6 __Skills:__ Berserk • Intense Heat __Weapon: __Urga • Blade Rolan Tiona Hiryute is a first class adventurer and an executive member of the Loki Familia. She is the younger twin of the Hiryute Sisters. [Tione](https://anilist.co/character/127209/Hiryute-Tione) and Tiona were born in Telskyura and were forced to join the Kali Familia from the moment they were born. Both sisters didn't know who their parents were, but knew that they were sisters. She reached Level 2 on the same day Tione did after killing an Amazoness she knew in a fight to the death. Soon after, both sisters became students to Argana and Bache. Around a year after reaching Level 2, Tiona found her first hero story. The day before her seventh birthday, Tiona asked Kali to let her and Tione leave the country, which Kali granted a couple days later, much to the sisters' surprise. The sisters traveled across the land, temporarily joining different Familia for a year, during which both sisters reached Level 3. They arrived at Orario years later when they were 12 years old. After agreeing to join the Familia of the adventurer that defeated them, they proceeded to defeat everyone that challenged them, only to lose to [Finn](https://anilist.co/character/142538/Deimne-Finn) and [Gareth](https://anilist.co/character/142542/Landrock-Gareth) when they were challenged by the Loki Familia. Following a dungeon expedition they went on shor

20920.name: Mord Latro
20920.desc: __Race:__ Human __Height:__ 178 cm (5'10") __Affiliation:__ Ogma Familia __Level:__ 2 __Weapon:__ Double-Edged Sword Mord Latro is a Level 2 adventurer who was initially an enemy to Bell Cranel. Mord Latro is a loud and tough adventurer. He is also shown to be ill-tempered, holding a grudge against Bell for his rapid growth and fame. He is also shown to have a lustful nature, claiming that Bell should share Ryuu, Syr, and Lili while at the Hostess of Fertility because "they were friends". Despite Mord's dislike for Bell at first due to his growth and fame, he comes to respect Bell after his battle with him on the 18th floor, as well as witnessing Bell finish off the Floor Boss Black Goliath. Through various encounters, such as the El Dorado Resort incident, he also becomes much friendlier to him, even coming to his defense when an adventurer insulted him for helping monsters. He even bet 100,000 valis on the Hestia Familia during the War Game, showing his confidence in their abilities.

20920.name: Guile India
20920.desc: __Race:__ Human __Level:__ 2 __Weapon:__ Spike Mace __Equipment:__ Shield Crest Guile is one of Mord's loyal companions along with Scott Olds. He mainly follows the orders given to him such as watching over their hostage Hestia, but expressed the desire to go join the others at Mord's duel when they heard loud noises coming from that direction.

20920.name: Lunoire Faust
20920.desc: __Race:__ Human __Height:__ 161 cm (5'3") Lunoire Faust is a waitress at the Hostess of Fertility and a former bounty hunter known as Faust as a member of the Demeter Familia. Lunoire was born to parents that lived in a territory of the empire. However, her parents soon died because of a war, and she was forced to live her life as one of the street children. After living for some time in harsh conditions, she heard about the falna and joined a Familia, but later began traveling on her own a while later once her Goddess was forced back to heaven. After a while, she arrived at Orario nine years before the story and failed her first mission of killing the Gulliver Brothers, barely escaping with her life, and began refusing jobs to kill first class adventurers. Eventually, after failing to kill a wanted Ryuu, she joined the Hostess of Fertility. Lunoire has a straightforward and caring personality, as shown when she tried to distance herself from her own Familia in order to protect them. She once considered finding a husband that didn't need to be cool as long as he would care for her and let her laze around in a small house.

20920.name: Mia Grand
20920.desc: __Race:__ Dwarf __Height:__ 180 cm (5'11") __Affiliation:__ Hostess of Fertility • Freya Familia __Level:__ 6 Mia Grand is the owner of the Hostess of Fertility, and is later revealed to be the former captain of the Freya Familia. Several years ago, Mia joined the Freya Familia because she owed Freya a favor, eventually becoming the captain of the Familia. When Ottar joined the Familia, Freya asked her to take care of him. Sometime before Ais came to Orario, Mia partially left the Freya Familia to open the Hostess of Fertility, employing Anya there. As the proprietress of the Hostess of Fertility, she is strict both to her employees and customers alike. She doesn't tolerate any violence within the pub or slacking off by her employees and will punish any individuals accordingly, such as when she threatened Mord. Despite her rough personality, she is also shown to be kind, taking in girls with histories and protecting them. In addition, she likes money, telling Bell a couple of times to spend a lot of money.

20920.name: Bete Loga
20920.desc: __Race:__ Werewolf __Height:__ 183 cm (6'0") __Affiliation:__ Loki Familia __Level:__ 6 __Skills:__ Úlfheðinn • Fenris Wolf • Solmani __Magic:__ Hati __Weapon:__ Flosvirt • Dual Rolan Bete Loga is a first class adventurer and an executive member of the Loki Familia. He was the former captain of the Vidar Familia until they left the city. Bete was born to the leader of a clan of Werewolves and had a sister named Luna along with a childhood friend named Rene, who he later got in a relationship with. However, his whole clan was killed by a monster when he was 12, and he traveled to Orario where he eventually became the captain of the Vidar Familia. When he was 16, he temporarily left the city as a Level 3 to kill the monster that killed his clan, succeeding in doing so after a day of fighting. Unfortunately, he discovered upon his return that his Familia had failed their recent dungeon expedition, resulting in the deaths of the vice-captain, who he used to be in a relationship with, along with several others while others that survived gained wounds fatal for an adventurer. The Vidar Familia subsequently left the city, though he stayed behind, and later joined the Loki Familia after an incident with Finn and Gareth at a pub. Bete has a rough personality and a slight superiority complex. He completely hates the weak, especially those that don't do anything about their weakness, and is not afraid to express his opinions about it. He can be an idiot who can't read the atmosphere. Fu

20920.name: Lefiya Viridis
20920.original: レフィーヤ・ウィリディス
20920.desc: __Race:__ Elf __Height:__ 156 cm (5'1") __Affiliation:__ Loki Familia __Level:__ 4 __Skills:__ Fairy Canon • Double Canon __Magic:__ Arcs Ray • Fusillade Fallarica • Elf Ring __Weapon:__ Forest's Teardrop Lefiya Viridis is a second class adventurer and a member of the Loki Familia. She is a mage training to succeed Riveria Ljos Alf. She has a magic that allows her to use any Elf Magic, hence the alias Thousand Elf. Sometime in the past, Lefiya was an honor student at the School, leveling up after three years at eleven years of age. After graduating, she joined the Loki Familia at Level 2 and leveled up a year later. Lefiya is clumsy, but hard working. She occasionally zones out as her imagination runs rampant. She has a deep admiration for Ais and through her admiration, aims to become stronger so that she can stand next to Ais as an equal. She is often jealous of Bell due to his interactions with Ais. Lefiya maintains her elven pride, but is more open than normal Elves due to her own kind nature and growing up surrounded by people from other races. Lefiya struggled with her own worth as a member of the Loki Familia, having low confidence, self doubt, and other problems that began to get better once she befriended Filvis and learned concurrent chanting. Having a fear of being left completely alone due to her ineptitude, she highly valued her relationships, especially with Ais and Filvis. She can also mix between being kind and mean quickly, as she frequently switched between

20920.name: Tione Hiryute
20920.desc: __Race:__ Amazoness __Height:__ 165 cm (5'5") __Affiliation:__ Loki Familia __Level:__ 6 __Skills:__ Berserk • Backdraft __Magic:__ List Iorum __Weapon:__ Zolas • Filuka • Halberd Rolan Tione Hiryute is a first class adventurer and an executive member of the Loki Familia. She is the older twin of the Hiryute Sisters. Tione and Tiona were born in Telskyura and were forced to join the Kali Familia from the moment they were born. Both sisters didn't know who their parents were, but knew that they were sisters. She reached Level 2 on her fifth birthday after she unknowingly killed Seldas, a person that she had viewed as a mother and an older sister, in a daily fight to the death, resulting in her resentment of Telskyura. Soon after, both sisters became students to Argana and Bache. The day before Tione's seventh birthday, Tiona asked Kali to let them leave the country, which she granted a couple of days later, much to their surprise. The sisters traveled across the land, temporarily joining different Familia for a year, during which both sisters reached Level 3. They arrived at Orario years later when they were 12 years old. After agreeing to join the Familia of the adventurer that defeated them, they proceeded to defeat everyone that challenged them, only to lose to Finn and Gareth when they were challenged by the Loki Familia. Upon her defeat, Tione fell in love with Finn, and desperately tried to make herself into a woman he would like. Following a dungeon expedition they went

20920.name: Loki
20920.desc: __Race:__ God __Height:__ 165 cm (5'5") __Affiliation:__ Loki Familia Loki is the head of the Loki Familia. Loki acts in a very tomboyish manner. She very much enjoys living up to her nickname, trickster, and shows a lustful side toward females, namely Ais Wallenstein. She also has a breast complex and tends to get into fights with Hestia over breast size.

20920.name: Riveria Ljos Alf
20920.original: リヴェリア・リヨス・アールヴ
20920.desc: __Race:__ High Elf __Height:__ 170 cm (5'7") __Affiliation:__ Loki Familia __Level:__ 6 __Skills:__ Fairy Anthem • Alf Regina __Magic:__ Rea Laevateinn • Wynn Fimbulvetr • Veil Breath • Via Shilheim • Vas Windheim • Liv Ilusio • Fil Eldis • Luna Aldis • Van Alheim • Flare Burn __Weapon:__ Magna Alfs Riveria Ljos Alf is the daughter of Larfal Ljos Alf and the vice-captain of the Loki Familia. Riveria was born in the Alf's Royal Forest as a member of the High Elf family. She lived there for 71 years until she grew tired of her father's negative attitude toward her interest in the outside world and decided to leave. She left the forest with her childhood friend and former personal chamberlain Aina with the help of Finn and Loki. She is also a friend of Njord, as he took care of them before the early Loki Familia entered Orario. Riveria has a serious personality. She is one of the only people that didn't laugh at Bell and condemned the others for laughing at him. She is also a strict mentor to the lower leveled members of her Familia, training Lefiya in her studies as a mage and Ais when she was a child. She is calm and collected during the heat of battle, dealing with unexpected events in a leader-like fashion, as shown in the event of the Loki Familia being attacked by large numbers of Virga on the 50th floor. Despite this, Riveria is kind to others, especially to her fellow Loki Familia members, earning her the nickname of mama from Loki. Riveria hates to be called an "old wom

20920.name: Welf Crozzo
20920.desc: __Race:__ Human __Height:__ 175 cm (5'9") Welf Crozzo is a member of the Hestia Familia and Bell's personal blacksmith, later becoming one for the entire Hestia Familia after converting from the Hephaestus Familia. Welf was originally born in Rakia, a nation type Familia ruled by Ares. As a member of the Crozzo Family, he lived as a noble due to the successes his predecessors had in creating magic swords. However, his life changed the day his Skill Crozzo Blood appeared, which enabled him to create magic swords again. Despite his family's joy at the prospect of being able to create more magic swords, Welf despised his skill, causing him to escape Rakia with the help of his former Goddess Phobos. Welf Crozzo is a straightforward and honest person. He is generally casual to everyone that he associates with. He doesn't like to be associated with his family name, preferring to not be a part of the conversation when his name is brought up and even refuses people that come to him seeking magic swords.

20920.name: Hermes
20920.desc: __Race:__ God __Height:__ 177 cm (5'10") __Affiliation:__ Hermes Familia Hermes is the head of the Hermes Familia. At first glance, Hermes has a casual and playful personality. However, his true nature is someone who is sharp, shrewd, and cunning, becoming serious if needs be. He is eloquent in speech as he is skilled in holding his own when it comes to sounding other people. Later on, he gains an interest in [Bell](https://anilist.co/character/88860/Cranel-Bell) and does whatever he can to make him into a hero, such as convincing [Ryuu](https://anilist.co/character/88890/Lion-Ryuu) to help him or getting rid of [Ishtar](https://anilist.co/character/146789/Ishtar). If needs be, he will clash with allies, as shown when he was willing to sacrifice a number of Xenos in order to restore Bell's reputation despite working with [Ouranos](https://anilist.co/character/134228/Uranus) to protect them.

20920.name: Freya
20920.desc: __Race:__ God __Height:__ 170 cm (5'7"), ~!162 cm (5'4") (as Syr)!~ __Affiliation:__ Freya Familia, ~!Hostess of Fertility (as Syr), Maria's Orphanage (as Syr)!~ Freya Is the head of the Freya Familia. Long ago, Hera, at the request of [Zeus](https://anilist.co/character/142554/Zeus), asked Freya for help in their goal to save the world. Freya made her a challenge, telling her that she would help her if she won. Having lost the challenge, Freya was forced to stay in Orario as part of the deal, in addition to losing several members of her Familia as a result. Some time later, Freya met a girl named Syr. After telling her that she would rescue her, Freya asked the girl what she wanted. Hearing that she wanted to be like her, Freya decided to offer her a deal, which she accepted. Freya is flirtatious, loves to tease, and has an unending appetite for talented adventurers. She seeks the best and most talented adventurers and will obtain them no matter the cost. She holds an obsession over [Bell Cranel](https://anilist.co/character/88860/Cranel-Bell) and actively does anything in her power to see him grow as an adventurer. Freya doesn't like to be bound by anyone, though she doesn't wish to become an arrogant ruler either. She is very impatient. She constantly interferes with Bell's activities knowing it might kill him but wanting to see him grow as fast as possible. At the same time, she is just as willing to help Bell to see him grow, such as when she gave up a grimoire just to s

20920.name: Ottarl
20920.desc: __Race:__ Boaz __Height:__ 210 cm (6'11") __Affiliation:__ Freya Familia __Level:__ 7 __Skills:__ Vana Arganture • Stortus Ottar __Magic:__ Hildis Vini __Weapon:__ Supreme Black Sword • Greataxe • Great Hammer Ottar is the captain of the Freya Familia and is currently the only Level 7 in Orario. When Ottar was a child, he was abandoned without even having known his own name. Freya found him dying in an alley somewhere and told him he was beautiful and took him into her Familia. She also gave him his name at this time. Due to her material support and emotional warmth, Freya would become everything to Ottar. Two years after joining her Familia, Ottar would become Level 2. Around this time, Mia joined the Freya Familia at the request of Freya in order to train Ottar. Ottar clashed a few times with the Zeus and Hera Familias before they were defeated by the One Eyed Black Dragon and were forced out of Orario. Each time ended in him being defeated. At some point in the past, Ottar half-killed a Balor, the Monster Rex of the 49th floor. Later, after learning about Ais defeating Udaeus by herself, he also defeated Udaeus by himself while managing to obtain the Udaeus' sword. He reached Level 6 fifteen years before his battle with Udaeus and Level 7 after defeating Zald seven years before the same battle. Ottar is extremely loyal to Freya and will follow her orders. He is shown to not feel any jealousy toward Freya's interest in Bell and does not allow anyone to insult Freya, becomin

20920.name: Finn Deimne
20920.desc: __Race:__ Pallum __Height:__ 119 cm (3'11") __Affiliation:__ Loki Familia __Level:__ 6 __Skills:__ Pallum • Spirit Noble Brave • Dia Fianna • Command Howl • Ail mac Midna __Magic:__ Hell Finegas • Tir na Nog __Weapon:__ Fortia Spear • Spear Rolan Finn Deimne is the captain of the Loki Familia. Finn was born in a village located in a mountainous area and had bad memories of his life ever since he was born. He hated his parents and other Pallum as he wondered why they didn't try to use their intellect rather than submit to people who were stronger than them. Unlike them, he began to gather knowledge, secretly reading books at the village chief's house, and when he was caught, he was described to be like a sage. When he was ten years old, monsters attacked his village in the middle of the night, causing him to try to help the village, though he would have died if his parents hadn't protected him with their lives. Despite this, the other Pallum abandoned them, making him see despair through them. Nevertheless, he also saw courage through his parent's actions. After the other villagers arrived to get rid of the monsters, he ran off to cry, coming back the next morning to bury his parents himself. By that time, he had a firm resolve to become the Pallum's light and renamed himself Finn, his thumb beginning to tingle in the process. Finn has a sharp mind, being able to memorize complex things, judge correctly, and take action without hesitation. He cares for his Familia members' saf

20920.name: Ganesha
20920.desc: __Race:__ God __Height:__ 190 cm (6'3") __Affiliation:__ Ganesha Familia Ganesha Is the head of the Ganesha Familia. Ganesha appears to be very flamboyant, speaking in a loud voice and making poses. He even spent practically all of the Familia's money in making the Ganesha Familia home into huge shape of himself, also naming it after himself. When protecting the citizens, reputation and position means nothing to him; he will even get Gods and Goddesses involved, if he so desires. Ganesha also has a habit of repeatedly mentioning his name, such as "I am Ganesha". However, when the situation demands it, Ganesha has shown himself capable of adopting a more serious attitude and expressing concern for the well-being of others.

20920.name: Gareth Landrock
20920.original: ガレス・ランドロック
20920.desc: __Race:__ Dwarf __Height:__ 151 cm (5'0") __Affiliation:__ Loki Familia __Level:__ 6 __Skills:__ Dvergr Enhance • Ardigalea __Magic:__ Earth Raid __Weapon:__ Grand Axe • Axe Rolan Gareth Landrock is a first class adventurer and a top executive of the Loki Familia. Gareth is a good natured and kind person, acting as a father figure to members like Bete. Before Gareth joined the Loki Familia, he worked as a miner, working in various mines located in his homeland. He was known for going on business trips to dangerous volcanoes, finding several deposits of silver, and helping with work on an underground tunnel.

20920.name: Takemikazuchi
20920.desc: __Race:__ God __Height:__ 176 cm (5'9") , 183 cm (6'0") with geta __Affiliation:__ Takemikazuchi Familia Takemikazuchi is a God and the head of the Takemikazuchi Familia. Takemikazuchi is friendly with [Hestia](https://anilist.co/character/87654/Hestia) and has taught her many things such as the dogeza. He is kind to his Familia members. He is also a natural gigolo, and is clueless to how his actions affect others around him, which makes him come out as insensitive.

20920.name: Hephaestus
20920.desc: __Race:__ God __Height:__ 165 cm (5'5") __Affiliation:__ Hephaestus Familia Hephaestus is the head of the Hephaestus Familia. Hephaestus shows a strict and hardworking nature compared to her friend, Hestia, who was known as the lazy goddess. She is also known to care very much about her children. As a Goddess of Smithing, Hephaestus is a master at it. She was able to smith the Hestia Knife, a living weapon with Hestia's falna, even without her arcanum.

20920.name: Miach
20920.desc: __Race:__ God __Height:__ 188 cm (6'2") __Affiliation:__ Miach Familia Miach is the head of the Miach Familia. Miach is a kind, compassionate, and friendly God, and has good relations with Bell and the members of the Hestia Familia, often handing out free potions to him. He has a habit of handing out free potions, causing financial problems for his Familia, and is referred to as a "natural gigolo" along with Takemikazuchi due to his friendliness toward women. He is also caring of his own Familia member Naaza Erisuis, taking out a huge loan from the Dian Cecht Familia to have a silver arm created for her.

20920.name: Chigusa Hitachi
20920.desc: __Race:__ Human __Height:__ 154 cm (5'1") __Affiliation:__ Takemikazuchi Familia __Level:__ 2 Chigusa Hitachi is a member of the Takemikazuchi Familia. Despite having a timid and shy personality, she is loyal to her Familia, especially Ouka who she has feelings for.

20920.name: Zeus
20920.desc: __Race:__ God __Affiliation:__ Bell Cranel __Previous Affiliation:__ Zeus Familia Zeus is the adoptive grandfather of Bell Cranel and the former head of the Zeus Familia. Zeus was the head of one of the strongest Familia, which was weakened after their loss to the One-Eyed Black Dragon 15 years earlier, and he was subsequently forced out of Orario. He later became a farmer in a small village in the mountains north of the city, where he raised Bell, once protecting him from a Goblin attack. Zeus raised Bell until he decided to pretend he was dead for unknown reasons. He was later mentioned to have been shocked upon hearing that Bell had leveled up and asked Hermes to look after him. Zeus is a pervert as seen by his words to Bell about picking up girls and he once peeked on the Goddesses at the Divine Bathhouse. He acted as a kind father-like figure to Bell, taking care of him and telling him hero stories along with giving him handwritten storybooks on his birthdays of stories he had heard himself. Because of this, Zeus was the reason why Bell decided to become an adventurer.

20920.name: Mikoto Yamato
20920.desc: __Race:__ Human __Height:__ 157 cm (5'2") __Affiliation:__ Hestia Familia • Takemikazuchi Familia (temporary leave) __Level:__ 2 __Skills:__ Yatanokurogarasu • Yatanoshirogarasu __Magic:__ Futsunomitama __Weapon:__ Kotetsu • Chizan • Shunsan • Shakuya Yamato Mikoto is a member of the Hestia Familia and the Takemikazuchi Familia, having converted to aid the former during the War Game. Mikoto originally hails from the Far East. Her parents died several years after her birth. Tsukuyomi and [Takemikazuchi](https://anilist.co/character/142543/Takemikazuchi) took the young girl into their orphanage, where she lived for years, eventually joining the Takemikazuchi Familia. Mikoto and the other members of the Takemikazuchi Familia used to sneak [Sanjouno Haruhime](https://anilist.co/character/142551/Sanjouno-Haruhime) out of her mansion at night to play with her. They were eventually caught, damaging relations between Haruhime's father and the shrine. They pursued their nightly fun regardless. Two years before the story, Mikoto and the other Takemikazuchi Familia members moved to Orario to earn money to help support the shrine. Mikoto has a serious and honorable personality, unwilling to use cowardly tactics even in an emergency, as shown through her disapproval of Pass Parading the monsters that were chasing them onto the Hestia Familia. She also has a softer side as she cares for the well-being of her friends and is fiercely loyal to them.

20920.name: Anya Fromel
20920.original: アーニャ・フローメル
20920.desc: __Race:__ Cat People __Height:__ 150 cm (4'11") __Affiliation:__ Hostess of Fertility __Level:__ 4 Anya Fromel is a waitress at the Hostess of Fertility. When she was one year old, Anya lost her parents and her home. Because of this, her brother Allen was forced to wander the ruins of a kingdom while protecting her. So it was for two years until they met Freya, who offered them to go with her, which they accepted. Sometime before Ais came to Orario, Mia partially left the Freya Familia to open the Hostess of Fertility, employing Anya there. Anya is shown to be a foolish person whose unthoughtful actions stand out. She is terrible at singing, enough to be referred to as a "disaster". Despite being somewhat of an airhead, she is loyal to her friends, such as when she was openly hostile to Hermes for mentioning Ryuu's past, and when she helped the Elf by being Chloe's opponent while she fought Lunoire. She used to act like a senior to Ryuu at work, though she failed miserably due to her unthoughtful actions, such as when she accidentally brought Lunoire coffee when she ordered tea. Even so, she refuses to give up, as shown when she repeatedly tried to touch Ryuu even though the Elf kept on swatting her away, at which point Ryuu thought she saw flames of resolve around her. However, she is reluctant to talk about her past, becoming startled when Ryuu asked her and immediately changed the subject. Anya is the younger sister of Allen Fromel. However, they have both cut ties with ea

20920.name: Asfi Al Andromeda
20920.original: アスフィ・アル・アンドロメダ
20920.desc: __Race:__ Human __Height:__ 164 cm (5'5") __Affiliation:__ Hermes Familia __Level:__ 4 __Magic:__ Kalov Argol __Weapon:__ Canoval Dagger Asfi Al Andromeda is a member and the captain of the Hermes Familia. She is also one of the most famous item makers in Orario, known as Perseus. Asfi was the princess of an island nation that was stolen by a God. At some point, she was taken away by Hermes and became an adventurer and a member of his Familia. Asfi is serious and will follow Hermes' orders. She is a hard worker that is often pushed around by Hermes. Welf states that she may come from royalty somewhere due to her behavior, and in truth, she is the princess of a maritime nation. (Source: Danmachi Wiki)

20920.name: Chloe Rollo
20920.desc: __Race:__ Cat People __Height:__ 158 cm (5'2") __Affiliation:__ Hostess of Fertility • Njord Familia __Level:__ 4 __Magic:__ Pheles Cruz __Weapon:__ Violetta Chloe Rollo is a waitress at the Hostess of Fertility pub and a former assassin known as Rollo as a member of the Njord Familia. Chloe was born to parents who were members of a Familia that acted as a criminal organization. From the moment she was born, she was taught different methods of assassination, and was praised when she properly utilized them. However, she began to dislike her Familia after her mother died while protecting her. Her Goddess agreed to let her leave, though she was ordered to carry out a number of tasks before leaving, including assassinating a Level 3 knight of the empire using only a knife. Despite the extreme difficulty of her tasks, she was successful, leveling up in the process. After leaving her Familia, she traveled around for a while, until she came to Orario around nine years before the story. While there, she failed her first mission, which was to assassinate Shakti Varma, barely escaping with her life, and began refusing jobs to kill first class adventurers. Eventually, after failing to kill a wanted Ryuu, she joined the Hostess of Fertility. Chloe is known to have a crafty side and often gambles, which her fellow employees give a cold shoulder to. She is loyal to her fellow Hostess of Fertility coworkers, such as when she was openly hostile to Hermes for mentioning Ryuu's past. Despite b

20920.name: Kashima  Ouka
20920.desc: __Race:__ Human __Height:__ 190 cm (6'3") __Affiliation:__ Takemikazuchi Familia __Level:__ 2 __Weapon:__ Kougou Kashima Ouka is a member and captain of the Takemikazuchi Familia. Ouka is a strong and respected member of his familia. Being the leader, he often decides the course of action for his Familia members during dungeon trips. He is capable of instructing his companions and making harsh decisions in desperate situations. Despite his decisions, he shows deep care for his Familia due to them knowing each other from when they were children. Ouka is also headstrong and unafraid to express his thoughts to others, believing that he made the right decision in doing a Pass Parade. However, he later made up for it when he decided that he didn't want to be a man who was all talk. (Source: Danmachi Wiki)

20920.name: Misha  Flott
20920.desc: __Race:__ Human __Height:__ 150 cm (4'9") __Affiliation:__ Guild Misha Flott is a Guild worker and friend of Eina Tulle. Misha is a curious and slightly irresponsible girl. She likes teasing her friend, Eina, about her relationship with Bell; or any of her male relationships for that matter. Though she likes complaining, she still does her job; although whether it was done correctly or not is up for debate. (Source: Danmachi Wiki)

20920.name: Demeter
20920.desc: __Race:__ God __Height:__ 162 cm (5'4") __Affiliation:__ Demeter Familia Demeter is the head of the Demeter Familia. Demeter is a good natured Goddess that acts mature when talking to others whether they may be Gods or their children. She apparently can get carried away as she asked Lunoire not to praise her too much about her cooking. She is on good terms with other Gods like Hestia and enjoys teasing others as shown when she hugged Bell in front of her. She can be aware of the hidden motives of others, such as when she noticed Dionysus' expression during the God's banquet. Demeter also cares for her children, as she used to worry about Lunoire when she was a bounty hunter, and suggested for her work with the other members in the fields once she finished her work. (Source: Danmachi Wiki)

20920.name: Canoe Belway
20920.desc: __Race:__ Raccoon __Height:__ 155 cm (5'1") __Affiliation:__ Soma Familia __Level:__ 1 __Weapon:__ Magic Sword An adventurer from the Soma Familia. Canoe was crafty and greedy. He often beat Lili and stole the money and items that she had collected. He also betrayed Ged Raish after they ambushed Lili in the Dungeon, causing his death when he tried to escape, only to be killed by the approaching Killer Ants. His greed ultimately led to his demise as he let loose the Minotaur Ottar had tamed. (Source: Danmachi Wiki)

20920.name: Ged Raish
20920.desc: __Race:__ Human __Age:__ Around 20 __Height:__ 177 cm (5'10") __Affiliation:__ Unknown Familia __Level:__ 1 Deceased A former member of the Soma Familia. Ged showed little concern or patience for anyone who slowed him down from completing a quest or killing monsters. This was evident through his attitude toward Lili, calling her useless and even threatening to use her as a decoy. (Source: Danmachi Wiki)

20920.name: Scott Olds
20920.desc: __Race:__ Human __Level:__ 2 Scott Olds is one of Mord Latro's companions. (Source: Danmachi Wiki)

20920.name: Bom Cornwall
20920.original: ボム・コーンウォール
20920.desc: __Race:__ Spirit Bom Cornwall is the owner of the Gnome's General Store. Bom used to buy Lili's stolen goods even though he knew that she changed her appearance using Cinder Ella and didn't report her. He later showed his kindness again when he agreed to hide Lili from the Soma Familia.

9989.name: Jinta Yadomi
9989.desc: __Height:__ 165cm Jinta is the main character of the series. In the past, Jinta was an energetic, young boy and the leader of his group, the Super Peace Busters. When Naruko asked him if he had a crush on Menma, he said, "Why would I be in love with such an ugly—?" He had plans to apologize to her the next day, but she died later that night in a drowning accident. Unable to forgive himself, Jinta spent the next years of his life in a constant state of gloominess. He became withdrawn and eventually became a hikikomori, or a shut-in. He currently lives with his father. While he is enrolled at the same high school as Naruko, he stopped attending. ~!Jinta now lives a life of exclusion and wears a disguise (consisting of a pair of glasses and a beanie) in order to comfortably leave his house. He has also shown to be socially awkward amongst strangers. Perhaps Jinta's defining attribute is his ability to see Menma. While no one else can see her, Jinta can communicate with her as well as touch her. Menma says that Jinta needs to fulfill her wish, although neither he nor she can remember what this wish is; however, they do know that it has something to do with their entire childhood group. For Menma's sake, Jinta has been trying to reconnect and reunite with his old friends.!~

9989.name: Meiko Honma
9989.desc: __Height:__ 147cm Menma is a ghost girl who suddenly appears several years after her death to Jinta and asks him to reunite their group of friends so her wish can be granted. Yet, she does not seem to remember what is her wish, but she knows she has to reunite her friends in order to remember. Despite being "dead", she is a very positive, energetic and lively person. According to Jinta, she is quite selfless and cries very often for others when they are hurt or upset, but not for herself. Jinta calls her "the beast of the summer" as he relates her to being a manifestation of his stress instead of a ghost girl. ~!Matsuyuki admitted his love to her on the day that she died; however, she didn't return his confession in favor of chasing after Jinta. It is hinted that she has feelings for Jinta, and only Jinta is able to see her. This is confirmed when Menma wrote a letter for Jinta, which read, " _I love you, Jin-tan. It's the "I want to marry you!" type of "I love you."_" Menma is able to reveal her presence to her friends by carrying objects, flickering the lights, etcetera. She is also able to communicate with them by writing in her diary. She seems to think that her wish was to send a rocket to Heaven with a note to Jinta's mother, so the reunited Super Peace Busters attempt to create one. Menma also wishes to be reincarnated after passing on so she can be in the world again, back with her friends. Without her, Menma's family is falling apart. Her mother is unable to move on

9989.name: Naruko Anjou
9989.desc: __Height:__ 165 cm (5'5") Naruko is a childhood friend of Jinta and Menma. While she displays a cold attitude towards Jinta, she is secretly concerned for him. She is perhaps the closest to him at present and is enrolled the same school (although Jinta stopped attending school). Chiriko comments that Naruko has not changed over the years: she is still easily persuaded by everyone around her. Naruko seems to be popular in high school and gets along well with girls that Chiriko deems "sluts." While they have grown apart, Naruko seems cares deeply about her childhood friends. She works at a video game store and has a large collection of manga and video games herself. Because of this collection, she started reconnecting with Jinta and Poppo. Naruko Anjou is left handed ~!Naruko admits that, when she was a child, she was jealous of Menma. Insecure of her glasses and curly hair, she desperately wanted to have flowing hair like Menma. Moreover, she was jealous of Jinta's affection towards Menma. Naruko secretly had a crush on Jinta, which is why she asked him whether he had feelings for Menma. She blames herself for Menma's death, because her question ultimately precipitated in Menma's death. Presently, it is shown that Naruko still has lingering feelings for Jinta. Naruko is involved in a scandal when an older boy, whom she was hanging out with, tries to force her into a love hotel. When she wouldn't agree to have sex with him, he attempts to force her into the hotel to rape her; h

9989.name: Atsumu Matsuyuki
9989.desc: __Height:__ 181 cm (5' 11") Atsumu is a childhood friend of Jinta and Menma. In the present, Atsumu holds a condescending attitude towards Jinta. He becomes agitated when Menma is mentioned and is still distraught over her death. He, together with Chiriko, attend the same high school, which Jinta failed the entrance exams to enter. Atsumu and Chiriko were once mistaken as a pair. ~!Atsumu is still in love with Meiko despite her death and keeps one of her sundresses in his closet. He buys hair scrunchies and other trinkets to place at her grave. He revealed that he is able to see Menma too. But in the end of episode 4, it's been proven that he is a crossdresser and tried to fool everyone. Once they got him, Atsumu confessed his love for Meiko and that he felt guilty for her death. In episode 5, Atsumu seems to have a kind of interest for Naruko, asking her to go out with him and if she is a virgin.!~

9989.name: Chiriko Tsurumi
9989.desc: As a child, Chiriko was a shy girl and a member of the Super Peace Busters. Now, she is enrolled at an elite school with Matsuyuki. Currently, she is ranked fourth in her class. She is serious, stoic, and cocky. Upon meeting with Naruko, Chiriko insults both her and her friends; however, she has since made amends with Naruko. While the other members of the Super Peace Busters have fallen apart, Chiriko and Matsuyuki have remained friends after Menma's death. ~!Chiriko is shown to have feelings for Matsuyuki; however, he does not reciprocate her affection. Matsuyuki's heart belongs to Menma. He asks Naruko out, although the current status of their relationship is unknown. Chiriko overhears this conversation and is devastated.!~

9989.name: Tetsudo Hisakawa
9989.desc: Poppo is the first friend that Jinta reconnects with. As a child, Poppo was uncontrollably energetic and friendly and was always loyal to Jinta recognizing him as the leader of the group. These traits have not changed. Presently, Jinta reunited with him when he was searching for Menma. He visited their old clubhouse and found that Poppo was living there. Poppo explains that he works part-time jobs to earn money. When he makes enough, he goes on trips around the world. Because of this, Poppo has not attended school in several years. Poppo seems to have questionable interests: Jinta found several pornographic magazines upon entering the clubhouse. Poppo also seems to have an obsession for foreign girls, especially Vietnamese girls. Overall, he has a lewd personality. ~!One evening, Poppo saw Menma in the forest. He was the second reported person to have seen Menma after her death. Because of this, he decides to gather the old group of friends in order to fulfill Menma's wish. The reason he travels so much is due to the fact that he had seen Meiko's dead body drifting away in the river. He travels in an attempt to escape the past and get away from the clubhouse, the river, and the memory of Meiko's death. Despite his attempts to escape his past he finds himself always returning to the clubhouse and living there between trips. Upon fulfilling Meiko's wish Poppo is able to come to terms with his past. He returns to living a healthy life and begins studying and working part-time.!~

9989.name: Haruna
9989.desc: A friend and classmate of Naruko.

9989.name: Aki
9989.desc: One of the two friends that Naruko hangs out with at school.

9989.name: Irene Honma
9989.desc: Meiko Honma's mother. In the story, she has hatred towards Yadomi group, the "Super Peace Busters". ~!She is also found that she is stuck in the past and was unable to move forward until Yadomi's group made a move.!~

9989.name: Atsushi Yadomi
9989.desc: Jinta's father. A funny and gentle old man, he likes calling things cute.

9989.name: Touko Yadomi
9989.desc: Jinta's mother. She was hospitalized before Menma died. ~!She also made a promise with Menma that she'd help make Jinta cry.!~

9989.name: Minako
9989.desc: Appears in episode 6. It's revealed that she has feelings to Matsuyuki.

9989.name: Yama
9989.desc: He was in charge of making the fireworks. He helped Yadomi in making the firework.

3588.name: Maka Albarn
3588.desc: [Soul](https://anilist.co/character/8456/Soul-Eater-Evans)'s partner and the female protagonist of the series. Known to be cheerful, direct, confident, smart and hardworking, in stark contrast to Soul who is much more laid-back in comparison. Despite this, Maka has been noted by her partner to be stubborn and sometimes prone to making decisions without regarding others' feelings if she feels justified enough. Due to their differences, Maka often bickers with him and they tend to argue with one another, but despite all this they remain loyal partners and close friends.

3588.name: Tsubaki Nakatsukasa
3588.desc: A demon weapon partnered with [Black Star](https://anilist.co/character/8464/BlackStar) hailing from the Nakatsukasa Clan, a special weapons clan who are direct descendants of demon weapons created by the mother of magic weapons, Arachne Gorgon. Having inherited the unique Multi-Form Ability of her clan, she joined the DWMA to stop her brother from becoming a kishin, becoming fast friends with [Black Star](https://anilist.co/character/8464/BlackStar) in the process. Tsubaki is known to be very patient and forgiving, with a polite and gentle personality that often leads to her helping or comforting her friends when they are in need.

3588.name: Patricia Thompson
3588.original: パトリシア・トンプソン
3588.desc: A Demon Weapon and the younger sister of [Elizabeth Thompson](https://anilist.co/character/8445/Elizabeth-Thompson). Known as one of the "Demon Twin Guns", both her and her sister were known as the "Brooklyn Devils" and were petty thugs until being found by their current Meister, [Death the Kid](https://anilist.co/character/8455). Overtime, she reformed from her thieving and ruffian ways along with Liz and became Kid's weapon, later becoming DWMA students within the E.A.T Class.

3588.name: Elizabeth Thompson
3588.original: エリザベス・トンプソン
3588.desc: A demon weapon and the older sister of [Patricia Thompson](https://anilist.co/character/8444/Patricia-Thompson). Formerly a thuggish ruffian alongside her sister raised in the streets of New York, both her own and sister's life turn for the better when they encountered their future meister, Death the Kid. Eventually becoming Kid's weapon partner alongside her sister, she became a student of Death Weapon Meister Academy enrolled in the E.A.T Class.

3588.name: Franken Stein
3588.original: フランケン・シュタイン
3588.desc: The eccentric yet incredibly talented doctor and meister who is hailed as the DWMA's strongest graduate in history. He later joins the academy as an instructor. While he is intimidating due to the greater-than-typical amount of madness within him, he is highly relied upon by [Death](https://anilist.co/character/8457/Shinigami) and is well-liked by his students. Formerly partnered with [Spirit Albarn](https://anilist.co/character/8462/Spirit-Albarn), he is now partnered with [Marie Mjolnir](https://anilist.co/character/15769/Marie-Mjolnir).

3588.name: Death the Kid
3588.desc: The son of [Death](https://anilist.co/character/8457/Shinigami) himself and the Meister of the Demon Twin Guns, [Liz Thompson](https://anilist.co/character/8445/Elizabeth-Thompson) and [Patty Thompson](https://anilist.co/character/8444/Patricia-Thompson). Created from a piece of Death's soul, Death the Kid is known to be one of the top 3 students in the DWMA, albeit with a confounding obsession when it comes to symmetry.

3588.name: Soul Eater Evans
3588.original: ソウル・イーター・エヴァンス
3588.desc: [Maka](https://anilist.co/character/8439/Maka-Albarn)'s partner and the male protagonist of the series. Soul is a demon weapon who was born into a family of famous musicians. After discovering his weapon abilities as a Demon Weapon Soul joined the DWMA, where he partnered up with Maka. They often bicker and don't always see eye-to-eye, but in the end they remain partners and close friends.

3588.name: Shinigami
3588.desc: The grim reaper himself. He is by far the most powerful character in the series. He is a bit of a joker but when the time comes, he's all business. His number is 42-42-564 (shini-shini-koroshi), which literally means die-die-kill in Japanese. He has a special move called a “Direct Noggin Shinigami Chop” (which is normally shown when the Shinigami shows his hand, which is a large, flat, four-fingered hand appearing from his robe). This is both a joke and a real move. He constantly has to put up with Death Scythe’s antics when it comes to Maka or her progress. He seems to take on a more playful attitude when talking with his son, Death the Kid (he says he likes his son's three white stripes). Shinigami's soul wavelength is so large that it entirely covers Death city.

3588.name: Blair
3588.desc: A playful cat with powerful magic that Soul and Maka initially confused for a regular witch. Her life seems to largely revolve around doing whatever she deems fun at any given time, ranging from working as a hostess at Chupa♡Cabra's to aiding the DWMA's plans - however, she's also very sensitive to others' feelings, often comforting those in need out of kindness. She's also shown to enjoy long baths and exhibitionism, being very proud of her human form's body and often looking for opportunities to make others feel embarrassed. Her magic abilities are themed around pumpkins, and she also keeps a hat monster named Zwan (ズワン) as her familiar. Due to being a cat, she has nine lives, which is how she managed to survive her initial defeat at the hands of Soul and Maka. Additionally, her charms seem to transcend gender-altering magic, with her male form being able to seduce a succubus within the Book of Eibon.

3588.name: Spirit Albarn
3588.original: スピリット=アルバーン
3588.desc: He is the Shinigami’s current weapon and Maka’s father. He is very protective of Maka and is ready to jump to her aid any time she’s in trouble (he is always stopped by the Shinigami). His wife is Maka’s mother but they are divorced now due to his constant flirting with other women. Even though he visits clubs, he is still insanely loyal to his ex-wife and daughter. He usually runs yelling about much he loves Maka and her mother (he calls Maka’s mother Mama). He is extremely sad that his daughter hates him but he still tries to be a good father by looking out for her in his own silly way. He used to be Dr. Franken’s partner before partnering up with "Mama" who later became his wife (which obviously lead to the divorce); he still suffers nightmares about Dr. Franken trying to dissect him and still has memories from college when he and Stein were roommates. His old name was Spirit.

3588.name: Black☆Star
3588.desc: A shadow weapon meister and the last survivor of the infamous Star Clan, taken into the DWMA and raised by [Sid Barrett](https://anilist.co/character/16582/Sid-Barrett). His weapon partner is [Tsubaki Nakatsukasa](https://anilist.co/character/8443/Tsubaki-Nakatsukasa). He is known as one of the toughest students in the academy, being quite self-centered with a desire to always be in the spotlight.

3588.name: Crona
3588.desc: The demon sword [Ragnarok](https://anilist.co/character/11921/Ragnark)'s meister and the biological child of the witch [Medusa Gorgon](https://anilist.co/character/11924/Medusa-Gorgon). They're driven by their [mother](https://anilist.co/character/11924/Medusa-Gorgon)'s aim to turn them into a Kishin.

3588.name: Ragnarök
3588.desc: Ragnarok, also known as the Demon Sword, is the weapon partner of Crona. Born a normal demon weapon, it was melted by Medusa in a vat of Black Blood while in its weapon form and mixed into Crona's blood.

3588.name: Medusa Gorgon
3588.original: メデューサ・ゴーゴン
3588.desc: One of the major antagonists of the series, Medusa is a powerful witch and the middle sibling among the three Gorgon Sisters. She is the mother of Crona, who is also the crown jewel in her master plan: the destruction of the current world order to get the planet back on track. Lacking empathy for others, along with possessing a twisted sense of love for those who are like her in personality, Medusa views everyone as a potential specimen to experiment on or as a tool to suit her purpose.

3588.name: Mifune
3588.desc: Mifune, known by the epithet "God of the Sword", is an infamous samurai and bodyguard who acts as a guardian to the little witch, Angela Leon. He is later blackmailed into the service of Arachnophobia by its head, Arachne Gorgon. He becomes involved in a somewhat one-sided rivalry with Black Star after the latter encounters him on a mission.

3588.name: Excalibur
3588.desc: The legendary sword used by heroes and kings. It has a great power that is unmatched by any other weapon. It turns out that anyone can use Excalibur. However, no one can put up with its personality (it has a bigger ego than Black Star). The only reason that those who use it are called heroes is that they can put up with its annoying habits, such as a list of one-thousand things he demands to be completed, such as daily five-hour reading sessions. Excalibur was first introduced when Kid and Black Star found a book about him and thus sought him out, only to discover that the book had in fact been written by Excalibur himself. They quickly ditched him due to his personality. His other form is completely the opposite given his elegant weapon form, looking like a cartoon-ish gentlemen with an outrageous mustache and no pants. On the other hand, his legendary powers have been proven by a fellow Shibusen student who found completing the appointed tasks easy. Excalibur can grant great power, light speed and teleportation, and the wielder can easily defeat three of Shibusen's strongest combined. In the end, Excalibur was put back again because the student could not put up with his annoying sneeze. His existence throughout the story is purely comical, with the exception of the fact of how he informed Kid, the Thompsons, Buttataki, and Blair about the story of Eibon, backed by Shinigami. (From Wikipedia)

3588.name: Eruka Frog
3588.desc: Eruka Frog is a frog-themed witch who serves under Medusa Gorgon. Like many other witches, Eruka craves destruction and enjoys the fact that she was born a Witch. However, she is extremely cowardly, preferring to flee rather than fight, and never hesitates begging for mercy when cowed. She can also be considered clingy to her partner, Free, even becoming needy and docile. Despite her malicious intent, Eruka has an earnest disposition with other Witches, including Mizune, with whom she is close friends with. She can be demeaning to those whom she considers inferior, though. Magic: Transform: Eruka transforms into a frog. She can still talk in this form. Egg Bombs: Tadpole-like black balls with frog faces that can hop towards their target before detonating. Arithmetic Magic (Magic Calculation): Used as a 'place maker' for high level spells so they are more precise. (wikipedia)

3588.name: Angela Leon
3588.desc: The first real witch introduced in the series. She is nothing more than a kid witch that is not very good at magic, which is the reason Mifune is protecting her. She cares for Mifune and calls anyone that fights with him a bully (even if he started the fight). Her animal theme seems to be chameleons due to her hat's appearance, her last name, and the entrance of her castle. She is later shown attending the witch's meeting alongside Mifune, which greatly angers Eruka. The only magic she has shown so far is partial invisibility. She is being held captive by Arachne so that Mifune will fight for her but Angela doesn't seem to know it. In the past she was being used by a mafia family until Mifune was sent to kill her but he 'kidnapped' her instead as to protect her. (Source: Wikipedia)

3588.name: Justin Law
3588.desc: The Death Scythe in charge of Europe. Dressed in a priestly garb and earphones, Justin is devout in his services to the Shinigami. Justin is the youngest in the DWMA's history to become a Death Scythe at the age of thirteen, all without the aid of a partner. His weapon form, the guillotine, fits his title of "executioner". Justin has the ability to read lips but due to his constant use of earphones and the fact that the Shinigami wears a mask, he cannot understand the Shinigami. He tends to pray and give thanks to God for everything, and also tends to speak loudly due to his constant use of headphones. He travels by means of a dune buggy with a coffin on wheels connected to it. In the manga, he is colored with blonde hair and his hairstyle is a tonsure cut, usually worn by monks from European temples.

3588.name: Ox Ford
3588.desc: A top-class elite meister at Death Weapon Meister Academy, partner of Harvar D. Éclair, and a part of Kilik's team. Considered one of the top students in terms of grades within the DWMA, second only to [Maka Albarn](https://anilist.co/character/8439/Maka-Albarn). ~!Formerly one of the top one-star students, he later is promoted to a two-star status and is a member of the elite team, Spartoi.!~

3588.name: Kim Diehl
3588.desc: The partner and meister of [Jacqueline](https://anilist.co/character/14067/Jacqueline-O-Lantern-Dupre) and one of the top students in the EAT Class. She is the object of [Ox](https://anilist.co/character/14062/Ox-Ford)'s affections but she constantly turns him down. ~!She is later revealed to be a witch that fled from her homeland due to the discrimination she faced as a witch that did not fall victim to the destructive pull of magic, opting to hide her identity to become a meister at the DWMA.!~

3588.name: Kilik Rung
3588.desc: A popular EAT-Class Meister partnered with twin weapons, Fire and Thunder. He is considered one of the top three student fighters in the DWMA, and is good friends with [Ox](https://anilist.co/character/14062/Ox-Ford) and [Kim](https://anilist.co/character/14063/Kim-Diehl). Rather hot blooded and direct, with a fiery soul and enough compassion to put his own life on the line for his friends.

3588.name: Harvar D. Éclair
3588.original: ハーバー・ド・エクレール
3588.desc: Harvar D. Éclair is the demon weapon partner of Ox Ford and one of the top student at Death Weapon Meister Academy. As evident during the infiltration of the Arachnophobia castle, he is fiercely loyal to Ox and prioritizes his safety above all else while maintaining an ice-cold composure in battle, even when Ox does not. ~!He is later promoted to a two-star weapon and becomes a member of Spartoi after the fall of Arachnophobia.!~

3588.name: Jacqueline O. Lantern Dupre
3588.original: ジャクリーン・オー・ランタン・デュプレ
3588.desc: An honor student in the E.A.T Class and demon weapon partner of Kim Diehl. ~!Originally a part of Kilik's team, she is later promoted to a two-star weapon and is enlisted in Spartoi after Arachnophobia's defeat.!~

3588.name: Pot of Thunder
3588.original: ポット・オブ・サンダー
3588.desc: Pot of Thunder, or simply Thunder, is one of Kilik's two weapon partners and takes the form of a pot, although in weapon form it's shape is actually that of a glove. Fire and Thunder are young small twins, befitting their young age in comparison to other characters within the series. Both have a dark skin complexion and facial features consisting of blue eyes, rosy cheeks and mid-length blonde hair framing their faces. Their main differences are; Thunder is female and wears a yellow cap. Despite being powerful weapons, they are still kids and as such, are distracted and quarrel a lot.

3588.name: Free
3588.desc: A Werewolf and the last of the Immortal Clan, imprisoned by the Witch Order for stealing Witch Queen Maba's left eye. After being freed by Eruka Frog on Medusa Gorgon's orders, he renames himself in honor of his freedom and joins her group, acting as one of her operatives.

3588.name: Chiisana Oni
3588.desc: Called "Little Demon" by Soul Eater, he is a strange demonic imp that appeared before Soul inside his heart after his first encounter with Ragnarök. He told Soul "to be strong... follow me..." when soul decides to follow the imp states; "There will be insanity and ecstasy of joy." He may represent the power of the black blood and the insanity deep inside everyone's heart.

3588.name: Marie Mjolnir
3588.desc: The Death Scythe formerly in charge of Oceania. However, after the resurrection of [Asura](https://anilist.co/character/15840/Asura), her duties were reassigned to [Azusa](https://anilist.co/character/15770/Yumi-Azusa). She is currently partnered with [Stein](https://anilist.co/character/8446/Franken-Stein) and is an instructor at the DWMA. Tends to feel glum about her lack of success in marriage, but is a kind and genuine woman. Stein was her old crush when they were students at the DWMA, but she still seems to hold feelings towards him in some capacity. __Anime:__ ~!After Stein is overwhelmed by madness and [Medusa](https://anilist.co/character/11924/Medusa-Gorgon) manipulates him into joining her side, Marie goes to save him alongside [Crona](https://anilist.co/character/11919/Crona), using her healing wavelength to bring him back to his senses.!~ __Manga:__ ~!Marie's former betrothed, [Joe Buttataki](https://anilist.co/character/16944/Joe-Buttataki), is murdered during an internal investigation of the DWMA. Stein is framed for the murder due to his onset of madness at the time, orchestrated by Medusa, but Marie sets out with him to find the real killer, who is later revealed to be [Justin Law](https://anilist.co/character/14019/Justin-Law), a death scythe and a traitor to the DWMA.!~ ~!In the final chapter, it is revealed that Marie and Stein are officially in a relationship, with Marie also being pregnant with his child.!~

3588.name: Azusa Yumi
3588.desc: The Death Scythe in charge of East Asia. She comes off as being bookish and analytical, she is very respectful to all, she was the one that talked Marie out of marrying a toilet using wordplay. She was the student council president when Stein and the other Death Scythes were students, she was the person that scolded Spirit for his endless flirting and Stein's urge to dissect everything, she was said to have been a small, yet talkative child. She still treats the others as little kids like a teacher would (clapping to get their attention and telling them to line up and walk in a single file line) much to the embarrassment of the others. In recent chapters it is shown that she takes the form of a crossbow, able to fire high pressure spirit shots up to 10 km accurately. She is also suggested to have a genius IQ, and is an extremely competent information gatherer and tactician, easily finding one of Arachnephobia's labs.

3588.name: Asura
3588.desc: The first-generation Kishin and one of the Great Old Ones whose affinity to madness resides in fear. He formerly served as one of the Warlords of the Eight Reaper Legions, being its most powerful member until he betrayed the group and became a Kishin, killing innocents to gain power through their souls and even consuming his own demon weapon partner, as well as two other Great Old Ones. After his betrayal he was sealed away by [Death](https://anilist.co/character/8457/Shinigami), and remained sealed until his revival by [Medusa](https://anilist.co/character/11924)'s Faction. __Manga:__ ~!He is later revealed to be Death's eldest son and the older brother of [Death the Kid](https://anilist.co/character/8455/Death-the-Kid), specifically created as a fragment containing all of Death's fear in order for Death to become the God of Absolute Order.!~ ~!After Asura's battle with [Maka](https://anilist.co/character/8439/Maka-Albarn), [Black Star](https://anilist.co/character/8464/BlackStar) and Death the Kid, [Crona](https://anilist.co/character/11919/Crona) seals both Asura and themselves inside the moon to keep his madness locked away from the world. Asura gleefully asserts that this method will not last, and that one day he will return to terrorize the world again.!~

3588.name: Mizune
3588.desc: Mizune is the surname of a large family of witches who all look alike and whose animal theme are mice. They speak by saying, "chi" (sound of a mouse squeak). One witch from this family is initially introduced as a friend of Eruka's. Like Eruka, she does not like the fact that Medusa has so much freedom and that she brings Chrona to the witch meetings. Mizune and Eruka try to kill her for endangering all witches while she is staying at Shibusen. Mizune is killed by Medusa when Medusa set off her snake bombs that she had implanted in Mizune's body. Five members of the family join Medusa after Eruka tells them that their family member that Medusa killed was actually killed by a Shibusen student. The five family members can merge into a single being capable of actual speech. The form is of a good-looking young woman with short pink hair with a hat, long skirt, and a shirt showing her stomach and a good portion of her breasts; this exposed portion is most likely where the deceased Mizune covered. (ref: [Wiki](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Soul_Eater_characters#Mizune))

3588.name: Giriko
3588.desc: Giriko is an enchanter and demon weapon allied with the witch [Arachne Gorgon](https://anilist.co/character/16228/Arachne-Gorgon), and serves as one of Arachnophobia's most powerful members. Manga: ~!After the destruction of Arachnophobia, he allies with [Noah](https://anilist.co/character/16232/Noah) and becomes part of his group in an effort to avenge [Arachne](https://anilist.co/character/16228/Arachne-Gorgon)'s demise.!~ ~!Within the Book of Eibon he badly injures both [Maka](https://anilist.co/character/8439/Maka-Albarn) and [Soul](https://anilist.co/character/8456/Soul-Eater-Evans) as revenge for their killing of [Arachne](https://anilist.co/character/16228/Arachne-Gorgon), deciding to kill [Maka](https://anilist.co/character/8439/Maka-Albarn) by strangling her before his new body undergoes soul rejection, causing his soul to explode due to the vessel being unable to contain his centuries of bloodlust.!~

3588.name: Arachne Gorgon
3588.desc: Arachne Gorgon was the head of Arachnophobia who conspired to replace Death Weapon Meister Academy's position as a world power using madness with her in charge. She was also the eldest of the Gorgon Sisters, a former associate of both Death and Eibon of some sort, and considered the darkest blemish in the history of the Witch Order.

3588.name: Mira Nygus
3588.desc: Replaces Medusa as the school's interim doctor. She is Sid's partner, and looks like a mummy due to the fact she is covered in bandages (although she is seen without the bandages). She becomes a combat knife in weapon form. Her last name is a pun on how the word 'knives' is pronounced.

3588.name: Sid Barrett
3588.desc: A three-star meister partner to Mira Naigus, instructor of Death Weapon Meister Academy, and a high-ranking member of the DWMA Central Intelligence Agency. Though killed in action by Shaula Gorgon—youngest of the three Gorgon sisters—he is later resurrected as a zombie by Franken Stein.

3588.name: Joe Buttataki
3588.desc: Referred to as "Mole Hunter" Joe Buttataki, Joe makes his first appearance at the end of chapter thirty-seven of the manga when he is called to Shibusen to investigate the possibility of a spy. His name when literally translated is "kick the shit out of," a phrase he says at the end of chapter thirty-seven in the manga. He is able to detect the snake placed in Marie's body. He is the ex-boyfriend of Marie Mjolnir. Joe had apparently kept his distance from her, fearing that his "soul perception" may grow so powerful that he could see through her. Joe stated to Marie that he regretted his decision and asked her out for dinner. He considers his ability unpleasant since it only allows him to work a job where he can only mistrust his allies. Joe is the first technician to be able to pierce a witch's technique to appear human and his power is growing even now. -Wiki

3588.name: Hiro
3588.desc: During his one episode appearance, Hiro was a loser at Shibusen that couldn't do anything right, and was constantly picked on or used by other students. One day, Hiro learned of Excalibur, and seeked out to be his partner. During his time with Excalibur, he was able to defeat Black Star, Death the Kid, and Kilik at the same time, by simply saying the name of an attack, which was followed by an explosion. Hiro was also able to complete all 1,000 of Excalibur's tasks, but the one thing he could not stand was his incessant sneezing. He later dropped Excalibur and took up weight lifting.

3588.name: Masamune Nakatsukasa
3588.desc: The demon blade, Masamune, is an extremely dangerous weapon and Tsubaki's older brother. He wanders around, possessing others to use him as their weapon to collect any soul he wants. He speaks using ancient words and likes to write haiku. He plays on the fears of others to possess and use them until he takes over their soul. He believes only the strong survive and the weak live only to serve the strong. He developed this way of thinking when Tsubaki inherited the family's multiple weapon forms. He considers himself more worthy than her and believed that he should have gotten the multiple weapon forms. He later lets Tsubaki defeat and absorb him after he sees that she really does care about him. Which gives her his katana form and all of his abilities, simultaneously being the first soul that Tsubaki successfully absorbs. He now resides deep within Tsubaki in the form of a large deer. Attacks: He cannot use any attacks until he has possessed someone to wield him. * Soul Possession: Used by demon blades to overpower and control the soul of its user. * Shadow Puppet: Used by Demon Blade Masamune to control the shadow of the person he possessed for pincer attacks (the puppet can only say shadow). * Puppet Strike: By folding the Shadow Puppet onto the blade, Masamune can create a far reaching lunge thrust. * Split Branches: After the Puppet Strike, large spikes come out from the shadows body to skewer the enemy at close range. * Puppet's Rain: By using multiple Shadow Puppets to r

3588.name: Mosquito
3588.desc: Mosquito is a bloodsucker who acted as [Arachne's](https://anilist.co/character/16228/Arachne-Gorgon) steward and Arachnophobia's top henchman. He carries himself in an aristocratic manner and is a genuine believer in Arachnophobia and his mistress. He is capable of drinking blood in order to restore himself and can revert his body to multiple types of younger and powerful appearances.

3588.name: Fisher King
3588.desc: The Fisher King is an assassin for Arachnophobia. He is sent to capture a demon tool, but is easily defeated by Kid on the Runaway Express. His cannon arm is destroyed by a Mizune witch, and is killed by Sid. (Source: Wikipedia)

3588.name: White☆Star
3588.desc: He is the father of Black Star and the leader of the infamous Star Clan. Much like Black Star, he was very bent towards being the best and winning every battle. In the past, White Star was put into a very similar situation as Black Star in his battle with Mifune. They were both asked by Mifune about which path (path of a Warrior or path of a Demon) they'd rather take. White Star did not answer, but Mifune was easily able to tell that White Star already took the path of a Demon. Black Star simply said he'd make his own path. White Star was slain in battle by Mifune.

3588.name: Kirisaki Jack
3588.desc: A bloodthirsty and malicious killer who seemingly enjoys attempting to end the lives of others.

3588.name: Risa
3588.desc: Works at Chupa Kyaburasu Cabaret house. ~! It seems that she works for arachnophobia gathering information for mosquito!~

3588.name: Arisa
3588.desc: Works at Chupa Kyaburasu Cabaret house. ~! it seems that she works for arachnophobia gathering information for mosquito!~

3588.name: Alcapone
3588.desc: Alcapone (アルカポネ, Arukapone) was a Mafia leader who eats souls. He was to be killed by Black Star and Tsubaki, but he and all his family were killed by Mifune for trying to get his hands on the witch Angela's power. Wikia

3588.name: Lupin
3588.desc: Lupin (ルパン, Rupan) was a phantom thief (怪盗, kaitō) in the human world. In the anime, he is shown to have stolen a large bag of pure souls. He was to be defeated by Death the Kid, but due to Patti being a little off in a pose, he managed to escape while Kid berated her, fleeing after some difficulty into the sewer.

3588.name: Samantha
3588.desc: Samantha was a necromancer witch in an Egyptian pyramid, who resurrected a pharaoh but was latter consumed by the pharaoh. She was more of a generic witch, with no apparent animal theme. She also revived many mummies in the Pyramid of Anubis.

3588.name: Pharaoh
3588.desc: Referred to as "Pharaoh" (ファラオ, Farao), he was an unnamed ancient pharaoh who resided in the Pyramid of Anubis. He was resurrected by the witch Samantha. Kid could not bring himself to attack while in his symmetrical coffin but was gunned down mercilessly once Kid saw his real (and very mismatched) appearance, leaving only the button on his forehead, which was the only thing symmetrical.

3588.name: Rasputin
3588.desc: Rasputin was only shown in the series for a few minutes, but from the statements that Rasputin made it was implied that his body was invulnerable against any form of bullet.

3588.name: Sonson J.
3588.desc: Bloodthirsty killer of Emerald Lake Sonson J. (ソンソンJ, Sonson Jei) was an evil human soul.

3588.name: Ryoku
3588.desc: Ryoku is a young boy from Needle Village. Ryoku is one of the most level headed people in his village appearing as calm and collected through most occurrences, except when it comes to his fear/hatred of the Star Clan. Ryoku is fearful of their power and their ways of battle, even losing self confidence in himself while comparing himself to [Black☆Star.](https://anilist.co/character/8464/BlackStar) (Source: Soul Eater Wiki)

3588.name: Mabaa
3588.desc: Mabaa (魔婆, Mabaa) is the current leader of all witches. She is held in high regards for being almost as powerful as Shinigami-sama. Her left eye was taken by Free which is now covered by a bandage with 1/2 written across it. Her specialty is Spatial Magic.

3588.name: Flying Dutchman
3588.original: さまよえるオランダ人
3588.desc: The Flying Dutchman (さまよえるオランダ人, Samayoeru Orandajin) was the soul of the ghost ship Nidhogg (ニーズヘッグ, Nīzuheggu) that was being used by Medusa to gather more souls for kishin. He fought with a gun, just as Kid, though the term "gun" might not be a good enough comparison; the gun itself resembles a miniature cannon.

3588.name: Pot of Fire
3588.original: ポット・オブ・ファイア
3588.desc: Commonly called Fire and Thunder are Kirikou Rung's weapon partners and take the form of "Pots", although in weapon form they are actually gloves. Fire and Thunder are young small twins, befitting their young age in comparison to other characters within the series. Both have a dark skin complexion and facial features consisting of blue eyes, rosy cheeks and mid-length blonde hair framing their faces. Their main differences are; Fire is male and wears an orange cap. Despite being powerful weapons, they are still kids and as such, are distracted and quarrel a lot.

3588.name: Narrator
3588.desc: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

3588.name: Vajra
3588.desc: Asura's weapon. It was devoured by it's own master, Asura, after becoming a Kishin.

3588.name: Otama Jackson
3588.desc: Otama Jackson is a gigantic black tadpole with googly eyes, a long tail and a wide red-lipped mouth bearing a set of sharp teeth. He is a very loyal and hard-working familiar, always doing his best to serve Eruka, even if it means putting himself in harm's way. His main function is to act as a mount for Eruka, using his large size and capability to fly to aid his master in whatever way possible. However, Otama Jackson has very low stamina, and cannot fight at all, making him easily exhausted and extremely vulnerable to attack. Unlike other Witches with their familiars the two seem to share a close friendship with each other despite Eruka's apparent dominant role in the relationship, with even the normally docile Eruka reprimanding Free after he only slightly injures Jackson. Jackson in turn is extremely loyal to Eruka, going so far as to help pass her the needle of Black Blood that is supposed to reawaken Asura before Black Star can get at it, resulting in the tadpole getting beaten up by Black Star. Eruka laments over this, and decides to fulfill the mission solely for Jackson's sake.

3588.name: Eibon
3588.desc: Eibon is an enigmatic sorcerer and former acquaintance, if not friend of Shinigami, who is revered for the creation of numerous Demon Tools, including Brew. As one of the eight Great Old Ones , his "wisdom" and very existence drives men to madness. source - soul eater wikia

3588.name: Yousei
3588.desc: Resides in the Eternal Cave with [Excalibur](https://anilist.co/character/13046/Excalibur)

11111.name: Kouichi Sakakibara
11111.desc: __Occupation__: Middle School Student __Grade__: 3rd year, 3rd class __Height__: 167 cm (5'6") The new transfer student into Yomiyama North Middle School's third year's third class (in May, 1998). He is 15 years old and the only son in the Sakakibara family. His mother supposedly passed away 15 years ago after giving birth to him. He becomes very interested and curious about Mei Misaki and attempts to pursue a friendship with her, but little does he know of the trouble this is going to cause... ~!He has pneumothorax (collapsed lung), which is the reason why he is absent from the school for a month at the start of the story. This is also the reason why he doesn't know Misaki was treated as 'one who does not exist' that year.!~

11111.name: Mei Misaki
11111.desc: **Occupation**: Middle School Student **Grade**: 3rd year **Height**: 152 cm (5'0'') A mysterious, cute and isolated girl in Yomiyama North Middle School's third year's third class. Her left eye is covered by an eye patch. The girl with a mysterious presence and is always sketching alone. She is labelled as the one that "does not exist". ~!Her left eye is a doll's eye. It can see things that should remain unseen, that's why she keeps it covered. It can see people close to death or that are dead.!~

11111.name: Izumi Akazawa
11111.desc: __Occupation__: Middle School Student __Grade__: 3rd year, 3rd class ~! She holds a grudge against Mei and Kouichi for ignoring the rules, which makes the countermeasures useless, causing the deaths to continue.!~ __Novel__: ~! She dies from falling off a veranda and breaking her neck when pursued by the assassin during the summer trip. One of the seven "Deaths of August".!~ __Manga__: ~! Doesn't die just cuts her hair short.!~ __Anime__: ~! Same as novel but dies from broken glass while trying to kill Misaki, who she thinks is the extra person. !~

11111.name: Naoya Teshigawara
11111.desc: Teshigawara is the class' "mood maker". He is usually superficial in nature. He is shown to have a sympathetic side, since he was the first one to talk to Kouichi, who was still not used to the surroundings.

11111.name: Yukari Sakuragi
11111.desc: Yukari Sakuragi is one the class officers, the other being Kazami, of Yomiyama North Middle School's 9th grade class. ~!After hearing an important message from a teacher, she takes her umbrella and runs out of the classroom. After seeing Sakakibara with Misaki standing in the hallway she runs to the opposite direction. She runs downstairs and slips. Her umbrella falls out of her hand and she falls on it with her throat being pierced by the iron point of her umbrella and dies a few seconds later. We find out later on that her mother died on the same day, which could have been the reason why Sakuragi had left the classroom.!~ ~!Sakuragi appearance in the manga is completely different from her appearance in the anime. In the manga, Sakuragi has straight black hair. However, in the anime, she has curly brown hair.!~

11111.name: Sanae Mizuno
11111.desc: Sanae Mizuno is a nurse at Yomiyama Hospital. She is first seen at Kouichi's ward. She has a brother named Mizuno Takeru who went to the class 3-3 at Yomiyama North Middle School. ~!While on a call with Kouichi in an elevator, the elevator cable snaps and the elevator plummets to the basement of the hospital. She dies upon impact and is buried under falling debris.!~

11111.name: Reiko Mikami
11111.desc: Kouichi's aunt from Ritsuko's side ~!and class 3-3 deputy homeroom teacher. She gives her nephew advice on how to make it through Yomiyama through a series of "rules". One of them is to separate the private life from school life, thus Kouichi addresses her as Reiko at home, and Ms. Mikami at school.!~ ~! She is also revealed to be the extra/dead one. Reiko was murdered about an year and a half before the accidents started to happen.!~

11111.name: Yuuya Mochizuki
11111.desc: Mochizuki is a student at Yomiyama North Middle School, 9th Grade Class 3. He is a member of the art club.

11111.name: Tomohiko Kazami
11111.desc: He is 3-3 class officer,along with Yukari(and later Akazawa Izumi).Teshigawara is his childhood friend. ~! Teshigawara thinks he is the dead person and got into fight with him at the balcony. Suddenly he fell from the balcony but he doesn't die. In the manga, he broke his leg but in the anime, he went to Mochizuki room with an angry expression, but after that he went missing. Kazami believed that Kouichi is the dead one and goes insane, killing Anzu and Aki from behind. Later, when he tries to kill Kouichi saying that because of him Yukari is dead, Izumi knocked him out with an iron rod. She says he doesn't deserve to live as he killed two classmates, and when she's about to kill him saying that now he can follow Yukari in death, Izumi is stopped by Chibiki. However, Tomohiko dies later because of his injuries and Naoya seemed very affected by his death.!~ Source: Another Wiki

11111.name: Kirika
11111.desc: ~!Real name: Yukiyo Misaki (見崎 ユキヨ) She is Mei's adoptive mother.!~

11111.name: Tatsuji Chibiki
11111.desc: Librarian in charge of the No. 2 library room. ~!He was the teacher for class 3-3 the "first year", the year Misaki Yomiyama died. Some years later, he resigned the teaching and stayed as the master of the library. Since then he kept a record of the phenomena, the deceases and their connections, and shares his findings with Kōichi and Mei.!~

11111.name: Kubodera-sensei
11111.desc: 3-3 homeroom teacher. ~!He kills himself in front of the class after realizing that the countermeasures to the 3-3 phenomena didn't work. He is one of the "Deaths of July".!~

11111.name: Ikuo Takabayashi
