Cytomander's name is based on the DNA chemical cytosine and the elemental Salamander. His Gunmen, Shuzack, is based on the mythical Vermilion Bird, Suzaku

2001.name: Guame
2001.desc: Guame the Steady (グァーム, Gwāmu?) is one of the Spiral King's Four Divine Generals, who specialises in ground combat. His appearance is like that of a crocodile and armadillo and he looks the oldest of the four generals. In episode nine, he, along with the two other generals, reported the death of Divine General Thymilph to the Spiral King. He gives off the impression of one with a perverted mind and showed why when he made snide comments about the relationship between Thymilph and General Adiane. Guame appears to merely respect the Spiral King, unlike the other Beastmen, who worship him as a god. Cytomander makes an interesting statement in episode nine, saying that it was only Guame that could oppose the king. Guame merely said that he and the King had known each other for a long time, which gives off the impression that he has lived as long as or almost as long as the Spiral King has (he later referred to General Cytomander as a "two-hundred-years-younger upstart", implying that he is 200 years older than Cytomander). It was Guame who later made it known why Nia was abandoned and that she was not the first princess to be abandoned. Guame reappears, along with his flagship, the Dai-Gundo. Using Teppelin's power supply, Guame and the Dai-Gundo created a massive tornado, in order to destroy the Great Gurren Brigade and its allies, but his plans are ruined when the Gurren-Lagann tunnels underneath the fortress and impales Guame and the Dai-Gundo into its drill and onto the base

2001.name: Gimmy Adai
2001.desc: Personal Gunmen: Grapearl (Blue), ~!Gurren-Lagann (Epilogue)!~ Gimmy Adai is a boy from Adai Village, who used to be cared for by Rossiu. When new children were born into the village, the population exceeded its limit of 50, which mandated that two people be removed and sent to the surface. Since Gimmy and Darry had no parents, the village elder chose them to leave the village, however, Rossiu decided to go with them. The pair of twins have a very good bond with each other, and were often left to their own devices around Dai-Gurren, except when they were with older girls, such as Yoko or Nia. After the timeskip, Gimmy and Darry become important Grapearl pilots, often fighting together. Gimmy tends to be more impulsive and reckless, which sometimes puts the duo in trouble. ~! After Nia's death, Simon hands down Lagann's Core Drill to Gimmy and in the epilogue, he is seen alongside Darry, not only as commanders of the Grapearl squad, but as the new pilots of Gurren Lagann.!~

2001.name: Darry Adai
2001.desc: Darry is a girl from Adai Village, who used to be cared for by Rossiu. She is Gimmy's twin sister and has a good bond with him. As a young girl, she was shy and quiet and used to cling to a plush doll, which she carried with her at all times. After the timeskip, however, she is much more confident and has left her old personality behind. As a Grapearl pilot, she is careful, calm and perceptive, and puts more thought and planning into her actions than Gimmy. (Source: Wikipedia)

2001.name: Kittan Bachika
2001.desc: __Gender:__ Male __Origin:__ Bachika village The leader of the Black Siblings, Kittan, makes his first appearance in the fourth episode of Tengen Toppa Gurren Lagann. He joins Kamina and Simon in the Gurren Brigade after acquiring his own Ganman, the "King Kittan". As a Ganman Pilot, Kittan is a force to be reckoned with, and an asset to the Great Gurren Brigade. Despite his sometimes obnoxious attitude and eccentric behaviour, Kittan is brave, noble, and willing to do whatever it takes to ensure that his friends escape whatever dangers they may encounter, no matter what the cost. ~!After the war, Kittan became the Chief of the Legal Affairs Bureau in Kamina City, but resigned after discovering about Rossiu's plan to evacuate Earth using the Arc-Gurren, along a small fraction of the human population, and abandoning the rest to die, when the moon falls. Kittan is another character to have Spiral Power. He awakens it when he destroys the Death machine. It allowed him to use the King Kittan Giga Drill Break, which lead to his death.!~

2001.name: Kiyoh Bachika
2001.desc: Personal Gunmen: Dayakkaiser Kiyoh Littner (born Kiyoh Bachika) is the oldest of Kittan’s younger sisters, and possesses an extremely large bust. In episode six, when fighting her way out of an enemy Gunmen, she is shown to possess good combat ability. She was helping out in Dai-Gurren's control room until episode 13, when she starts aiding in the frontlines, piloting Dayakka's Dayakkaiser Gunmen, which she begins to use when Dayakka begins to command aboard Dai-Gurren. ~!After the timeskip, we discover that Kiyoh and Dayakka have married, and Kiyoh gives birth to a daughter, whom she names Anne. Anne happens to be the newborn that makes the human population reach one million, and as soon as she is born, the Human Extermination System begins.!~ ~!In the manga she, Kittan, and her other sisters appear earlier in the story (during Team Gurren's time in Littner Village) and explains to Simon that their home village, Bachika, was destroyed by Viral.!~

2001.name: Kinon Bachika
2001.desc: Kinon Bachika is the second oldest of Kittan’s younger sisters. After Team Dai-Gurren’s capture of Dai-Gunzan, she takes up a position within its control tower, monitoring the radar. She seems to be the calmest and smartest member of the Black Siblings. After the time-skip, she becomes one of Rossiu's main supporters. After Simon offered himself to protect the city using Gurren Lagann, even after being sentenced to death, Kinon volunteered to pilot Gurren and rig herself with bombs inside its cockpit, claiming that she would detonate them, killing her and Simon in the process, in case of him making an attempt to escape. Later, it is revealed that Kinon's resolve to follow Rossiu, despite betraying Simon and ordering his execution, was not only the fruit of her devotion to him, but because she thought it greatly pained Rossiu to do so. She strongly believes that he was not doing it for personal gain, but because the circumstances had forced him to it, though if such was really the case is the subject of debate. (Source: Wikipedia)

2001.name: Kiyal Bachika
2001.desc: Personal Gunmen: Kiyalunga Kiyal (キヤル, Kiyaru?) is the youngest member of the Black Siblings. Just like Kiyoh, she was helping out in the Dai Gurren's control room until episode 13, when she starts aiding in the front lines piloting her own Gunmen, Kiyalunga (named after herself), which can transform into a shield and lance which are wielded by Kittan's King Kittan. Kiyal's name comes from the word yaruki (やる気), meaning "willingness".

2001.name: Boota
2001.desc: Simon's sidekick. Boota is the mascot of Dai-Gurren Brigade, and Simon's pet. He seems to understand the language of humans, but is unable to speak on his own.

2001.name: Anti-Spiral
2001.desc: The Anti-Spiral is the collective form of a population of Spirals who chose to seal their bodies in suspended animation, preventing their own spiral energy from manifesting beyond their control and destroying the universe. The Anti-Spiral took it upon itself to control the population of other Spiral beings across the universe, to prevent the Spiral Nemesis, the threshold of Spiral energy being broken and destroying the universe, from occurring. Although the Anti-Spiral seeks to destroy Spiral life forms, the Anti-Spiral will show mercy to those who surrender. The Anti-Spiral will install an Extermination Systems around the home planet of those who surrender, which will destroy all Spiral life should their numbers become too great. It is then up to the Spiral warrior who surrendered to maintain the Spiral's numbers. The Anti-Spiral combats opposing Spirals using their highly advanced technology. Because Spiral energy is fueled by will power and determination, the Anti-Spiral will use methods to instill fear, hopelessness, and absolute despair to subdue any Spiral uprising. The Anti-Spiral technology is so great that it can bend the laws of physics and even alter probability.

2001.name: Lordgenome
2001.desc: Lordgenome is the ominous Spiral King, who rules the planet from his capitol city, Teppelin. An immortal human who lived for more than 1000 years so far, he cares little for people, treating the strange girls he surrounds himself with as dolls to be cast aside when they've outlived their interest to him. From Guame we find out that Lordgenome despises human consciousness and self-awareness although we are yet to be given a reason for this dislike. When Simon and Nia finally reach him, he claims that the act of trapping the humans underground and hunting down those who live on the surface is a means he has found to protect mankind, because according to him, when the population of humans on the surface reach one million, a terrible fate will fall upon them. He also shares the fact that he and Simon share the same "Spiral" powers, before being defeated via being stabbed in the chest by Simon's Core Drill. In episode 18, Lordgenome's memories are retrieved by Rossiu's research team, and he reveals to Rossiu the truth about the Anti-Spirals, and the reason why he forced mankind to live underground in order to control its population. It is also revealed that at one time Lordgenome had even been part of a group that fought against the Anti-Spirals, the Spiral Knights, who fought and protected the galaxy from the Anti-Spiral menace. In the end, however, the Spiral Tribe lost the war, and the Anti-Spiral Tribe (The Han-Rasen Tribe) gained control of the universe. Lordgenome's revived

2001.name: Koko-jii
2001.desc: Seems to appear out of nowhere to save Nia... Also seems to be a master chef, a man of little words but always gets his message across.

2001.name: Artenborough Cortich
2001.original: アーテンボロー・コアチッチ
2001.desc: Gunner of the Dai Gurren Brigade. Only knows one tactic: ”FIRE! FIRE! FIRE!”

2001.name: Leyte Jokin
2001.desc: The chief mechanic of the Dai Gurren Brigade. In post-time skip she is married to Makken.

2001.name: Thymilph
2001.desc: Thymilph the Crasher (チミルフ, Chimirufu?) is the first of the Spiral King's Four Divine Generals introduced in the story, representing the classical element of fire. He is Viral's initial superior officer and the commander of the Human Eradication Army Eastern Branch, which he monitors from the deck of the land battleship, the Dai-Gunzan. He is good friends with Divine General Adiane, though General Guame insinuates he had a closer relationship with her. He is a skilled tactician and proud warrior, and was ultimately killed when Kamina and Simon destroyed his personal Gunmen, the Byakou, with the Gurren-Lagann. Thymilph appears as a stoud but large, well-built imposing armored warrior with gorilla features. He is impressively strong, almost always seen as in the company of a large iron hammer he presumably uses in close-quarter combat. A seasoned and confident war veteran, Thymilph has a high respect for caution and shrewdness, but like Viral, possesses a warrior's code of honor. Guame implies that Thymilph was idolized by many Beastmen throughout the Beastmen Empire. Thymilph's name is based on the DNA chemical thymine and the elemental Sylph. His Gunmen, Byakou, is based on the mythical White Tiger, Byakko.

2001.name: Magin
2001.desc: The prophet of Adai village Rossiu, Gimmy and Darry came from.

2001.name: Zoushi Kanai
2001.desc: Personal Gunmen: Sozoshin Zorthy Kanai appears at the end of episode seven as a new addition to Team Dai-Gurren. His most recognizable quality is his smoking habit, which is unique to every other character in the series. from wikipedia

2001.name: Gabal Docker
2001.desc: Gabal Docker is Team Dai-Gurren's helmsman, in charge of Dai-Gurren's steering and maneuvering.

2001.name: Kid Coega
2001.desc: Personal Gunmen: Kidd Knuckle Kid Coega is another new member of Team Dai-Gurren. His Gunmen utilizes two pistols to attack enemies, the Kid Knuckle. Kid is killed during the first deep space battle versus the Anti-Spirals, when he and Iraak attempt to avenge Zorthy's death. Kid's post-timeskip design bears a striking resemblance to Lupin III. from wikipedia

2001.name: Iraak Coega
2001.original: アイラック・コイーガ
2001.desc: Personal Gunmen: Ainzer Iraak Coega is a member of Team Dai-Gurren. He pilots a Gunmen that serves Yoko as a mobile rifle platform. Together, they assaulted Dai-Gunzan with the rest of the Team Gurren. The name of his Gunmen is Ainzer. from wikipedia

2001.name: Tetsukan Littner
2001.original: テツカン・リットナー
2001.desc: Tetsukan Littner is a member of the control team for Dai-Gurren. He is in charge of monitoring the condition of the ship. After the timeskip, he becomes a part of Leeron's science team. Also due to being attracted to the fast-food restaurants that were built in the new city he became obese. In the "alternate universe" scenes in Episode 26, Tetsukan is seen sleeping in a bed with Cybela, implying that the two are involved in a relationship, or that one (or both) of them desire to be. In the epilogue, he is seen working under Viral's command alongside Cybela. (Source: Wikipedia)

2001.name: Dayakka Littner
2001.original: ダヤッカ・リットナー
2001.desc: Dayakka Littner is the former leader of Littner Village, abandoning his post, when most of Littner joined Team Dai-Gurren. His Gunmen is the Dayakkaiser, but after the seizure of Dai-Gunzan, he acted as the captain of Dai-Gurren during battles, while Kiyoh piloted the Dayakkaiser in his stead. ~!After the timeskip, we discover that Dayakka is appointed the Minister of Food Affairs for Kamina City, and he and Kiyoh have married and expecting a child. With the threat of the Anti-Spirals, Dayakka resigns his post and returns to his duties in Team Dai-Gurren.!~

2001.name: Jorgun Bakusa
2001.desc: Personal Gunmen: Twin Boukun Jorgun Bakusa and Balinbow Bakusa are the towering, twin brothers of Team Dai-Gurren, piloting the two-faced Gunmen, Twin Boukun. The two are always hyped and normally speak in manly grunts and monosyllabic phrases. They sport differently coloured sunglasses, which can be used to tell one brother from the other -- Jorgun wears red shades, while Balinbow sports blue ones. After the timeskip, the two were appointed Directors of the Public Affairs Department, in which they were responsible for the human population count. from wikipedia

2001.name: Balinbow Bakusa
2001.desc: Personal Gunmen: Twin Boukun Jorgun Bakusa and Balinbow Bakusa are the towering, twin brothers of Team Dai-Gurren, piloting the two-faced Gunmen, Twin Boukun. The two are always hyped and normally speak in manly grunts and monosyllabic phrases. They sport differently coloured sunglasses, which can be used to tell one brother from the other—Jorgun wears red shades, while Balinbow sports blue ones. After the timeskip, the two were appointed Directors of the Public Affairs Department, in which they were responsible for the human population count. (Source: Wikipedia)

2001.name: Makken Jokin
2001.original: マッケン・ジョーキン
2001.desc: Personal Gunmen: Moshogun Makken is a fairly silent man who is an important part of Team Dai-Gurren, but has rarely spoken or gotten much screen time whatsoever. He has his own Gunmen, Moshogun, which is based on an ancient samurai. After the timeskip, Makken is married to Leite with three children. ~!Sadly, he is killed in the first deep space battle versus the Anti-Spirals, after sacrificing himself to stop a large Anti-Spiral missile from destroying the Super Galaxy Dai-Gurren. In the epilogue, a memorial site, in the form of a sword, is seen in his honor right alongside Kamina and the other members of Team Dai-Gurren.!~ Makken has the same voice actor as Kamina, though he is credited as "Leo Kaminaga." Leo Kaminaga, when written in hiragana, is an anagram for "ore ga Kamina," or "I am Kamina." - Wikipedia

2001.name: Cybela Kuto
2001.desc: Cybela Kuto is mainly seen at a computer, where she can communicate with Grapearls or do analyzation tasks. Later, she joins Team Dai-Gurren, assuming a position at Super Galaxy Dai-Gurren's bridge. In the epilogue, she is seen still working there, now under Viral's command. Her name is an anagram of "shirabe", which means "to search".

2001.name: Guinble Kaito
2001.desc: Guinble Kaito, along with Kinon, seems to be one of the more important members of Rossiu's intelligence team. He and Kinon often accompany Rossiu, and stayed with him on Earth to watch out for the city while the rest of Team Dai-Gurren headed into space for their final battle against the Anti-Spirals.

2001.name: Anne Littner
2001.desc: ~!After the timeskip, we discover that Kiyoh and Dayakka have married, and Kiyoh gives birth to a daughter, whom she names Anne. Anne happens to be the newborn that makes the human population reach one million, and as soon as she is born, the Human Extermination System begins.!~ Source: Wikipedia

2001.name: Memu
2001.desc: Viral's fantasy daughter.

2001.name: Narrator
2001.desc: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

108632.name: Emilia
108632.desc: **Height:** 164 cm (5'5") She is a silver-haired half-elf girl who is one of the candidates to become the next ruler in the royal election. [Subaru](https://anilist.co/character/88573/Natsuki-Subaru) first meets her when her insignia is stolen by [Felt](https://anilist.co/character/88574/Felt) as she needs to possess it to be eligible to participate in the election. She introduces herself as Satella when she and Subaru met during the first timeline before introducing herself by her real name when she got her insignia back. Emilia is good natured and likes to take care of others, though she herself refuses to admit it, instead thinking of it as her own selfishness. She is indifferent to her own appearance, leaving [Puck](https://anilist.co/character/90187/Puck) to take care of her clothes and hair. Because her appearance is similar to the [Witch of Envy](https://anilist.co/character/127242/Satella), she has received unfair discrimination from others. She sometimes acts like a child and is unacquainted with the world as she used to live in the woods with other Elves, though despite this she still works hard to become a ruler.

108632.name: Subaru Natsuki
108632.desc: __Height:__ 173 cm (5'8") On the way home from the convenience store, he suddenly finds himself transported into another world. He has the ability that he calls "Return by Death" to go back in time when he dies. Despite being a hikikomori and gamer in his real world, Subaru does a bit of workout and seems to know basic hand-to-hand combat, making him not completely weak. While Subaru tends to not read the situation, he is loyal to those he holds dear, willing to help them, even if that means taking the thorny path. He has his resolve confirmed through the many situations and circumstances he faces in the fantasy world, originally having been one to always take the "easy" route. As a hikikomori, he is hopeful of the possibilities that being sucked into a new realm brings, but later realizes the realities of the predicament he is in. Ultimately, he resolves himself to be faithful and protective of the ones that he cares most about.

108632.name: Felt
108632.desc: **Height:** 150 cm (4'11") A thief that lives in the slums. Felt stole [Emilia's](https://anilist.co/character/88572/Emilia) insignia, hoping for quick, easy cash. Though Felt can usually handle her own, she does consider [Rom](https://anilist.co/character/124117/Rom) to be like family. ~!After being chosen by the insignia, she is forced to participate in the Royal Selection and is currently a candidate to become the 42nd King of Lugunica.!~

108632.name: Rem
108632.desc: __Height:__ 154 cm (5'1") Rem is one of the twin maids working for [Roswaal L Mathers](https://anilist.co/character/90182/Mathers-L-Roswaal). She has medium length sky blue hair that covers her right eye, large light blue eyes, and young features. She also has hair clips towards left side of her hair, flower-shaped ribbon on the same side of her hair, and a maid hairband. She looks nearly identical to her sister [Ram](https://anilist.co/character/88576) apart from her hair, eyes, and ribbon coloring. She usually wears a maid uniform, and since her chest is slightly larger than her sister's, she secretly changes the measurements to hide it. Rem tends to speak in a superficially polite manner and sometimes acts without thinking. She holds both respect to the point of worship and guilt toward her sister for an incident in the past. Because of her respect and guilt toward her sister, she used to think of herself as inferior.

108632.name: Ram
108632.desc: __Height:__ 154 cm (5’1”) Ram is one of the twin maids working for [Roswaal L Mathers](https://anilist.co/character/90182). She has medium length light pink hair that covers her left eye, large darkish pink eyes, and young features. She also has hair clips towards right side of her hair, flower-shaped ribbon on the same side of her hair, and a maid hairband. She looks nearly identical to her sister [Rem](https://anilist.co/character/88575/Rem) apart from her hair, eyes, and ribbon coloring. Ram is seemingly self-centered and does things at her own pace, however in actuality she maintains a distance from people to ascertain them. She believes that Roswaal is the greatest and no one else is as precious except for her sister Rem. She is slightly more outgoing in comparison to the generally taciturn Rem, who generally allows Ram to take the lead in their sisterly bond.

108632.name: Reinhard van Astrea
108632.original: ラインハルト・ヴァン・アストレア
108632.desc: __Height__: 184 cm (6'0") Reinhard van Astrea is the current Sword Saint and a member of the Royal Guard, currently acting as [Felt](https://anilist.co/character/88574/Felt)'s knight. As the Sword Saint and the Knight of the Royal Guard, Reinhard embodies chivalry and elegance, treating everyone with exceptional respect. He is fair, brave, and always acts in the name of justice, whether on duty or simply strolling through the Royal Capital. As a knight, Reinhard only uses his sword when necessary, since, in addition to being a rule, his iron-clad rule is to not inflict pain to others if not absolutely necessary, be it a normal thug or a member of the Witch Cult.

108632.name: Anastasia Hoshin
108632.original: アナスタシア・ホーシン
108632.desc: Anastasia Hoshin is the head of the Hoshin Trading Company and a candidate to become the 42nd King of Lugnica. Her knight is Julius Juukulius. Despite her surname being "Hoshin", she's not directly related to Hoshin of the Wilderness. She chose the name because she was inspired by his legacy.

108632.name: Wilhelm van Astrea
108632.original: ヴィルヘルム・ヴァン・アストレア
108632.desc: __Height:__ 178 cm (5'10") Wilhelm van Astrea né Trias, is a member of the Crusch Camp and was [Theresia van Astrea](https://anilist.co/character/124116/van-Astrea-Theresia)'s husband. Wilhelm is a refined man with a highly gentle and humble demeanor. However unearth that even temperament belied a fierce warrior who often is the first to help when something happens. However this wasn't always the case as in youth, Wilhelm was very opposite of who he was in his later years. Brash, afoot, short tempered, lonely and often cold with others. He was a troubled individual who devoted himself wholly to the sword and cared for little else. Even so, he knew how to analyze a situation, always finding a way out. Nonetheless, Theresia greatly influenced his personality, becoming increasingly sociable and protective, achieving more results during the Demi-human War. It was through her most of all that he would become the person he is today.

108632.name: Elsa Granhiert
108632.original: エルザ・グランヒルテ
108632.desc: An assassin-for-hire from the Northernmost nation, the Holy Kingdom of Gusteko, known as "The Bowel Hunter". Elsa wishes to make a trade for an insignia, as her client's wishes. ~!Elsa Granhiert was an assassin working together with [Meili](https://anilist.co/character/175577) for an individual they refer to as "Mother" until her death.!~

108632.name: Beatrice
108632.desc: __Height:__ 140 cm (4'7") __Age:__ ~!400+ (Actual)!~ The caretaker of the library in [Roswaal](https://anilist.co/character/90182)'s mansion. She has a distinct way of speaking, adding "I suppose" (かしら, kashira) and "in fact" (のよ, no yo) at the end of some of her sentences. ~!Around 400 years ago, Beatrice was created by [Echidna](https://anilist.co/character/129330). She helped her with her experiments, such as the Sanctuary Barrier, though she wasn't told everything as she didn't know that [Ryuuzu Meyer](https://anilist.co/character/174072) would be sealed in a crystal. Sometime later, Echidna ordered her to stand guard over the library while she waited for "that person," an order which she diligently followed.!~ ~!After numerous and painful attempts to convince her to leave the library [Subaru](https://anilist.co/character/88573) succeeded, and Beatrice became his contract spirit.!~

108632.name: Roswaal Mathers
108632.original: ロズワール・Ｌ・メイザース
108632.desc: ~!__Mental age:__ 400+!~ The lord of the Roswaal Mansion and a descendant of the original Roswaal. He comes across as an eccentric due to his flamboyant appearance and odd speaking style, the latter which he shares with his grandmother. However, he harbors a more calculating and reserved side with a sharp political mind and gaze that reads others quite well. ~!It is later revealed that he is in fact the original Roswaal, Roswaal A. Mathers, who has been possessing his descendants' bodies to meet his teacher Echidna again at any cost, even if that means sacrificing himself or those close to him.!~

108632.name: Julius Euclius
108632.original: ユリウス・ユークリウス
108632.desc: __Height:__ 179 cm (5'10") Julius Euclius is [Anastasia Hoshin's](https://anilist.co/character/90177/Hoshin-Anastasi) knight and a member of the Royal Guard. Julius lived with his family at the Euclius House. After his father, Klein Euclius died, he started to live with his uncle Alviero and he started to take care of Julius and became his adoptive father. As a member of Lugnica's nobility, Julius acts in a proper fashion, always having an air of nobility and conviction. He is also considerate and doesn't forget to show care toward others. He also shows a strict side, giving out accurate assessments of others whether they're good or bad, which is a result of his upbringing as an elite, and in actuality, he believes that he and others can do better than they currently are. Julius doesn't like those who forget their place, leading him to have bad relations with [Subaru](https://anilist.co/character/88573/Natsuki-Subaru) for a while. While both have apologized to each other after the battle with the Hakugei, Subaru told him he still hated him. Julius said he didn't intend to be friends. They both became very intimate very quickly during the planning and attacking the Witch Cult. In the end, Julius directly considered Subaru as his friend.

108632.name: Felix Argyle
108632.original: フェリックス・アーガイル
108632.desc: Felix Argyle commonly known as Ferris, is [Crusch Karsten](https://anilist.co/character/90185)'s knight. He is a beast human (demi-human).

108632.name: Crusch Karsten
108632.original: クルシュ・カルステン
108632.desc: Crusch Karsten is the Matriarch of House Karsten and a candidate to become the 42nd King of Lugnica. While normally calm and serious, Crusch is honest, sincere, right, being a type of person who is destined to stand above others, though she has talent and has worked hard to reach where she is now. She is already the head of her family, finishing her work better than her father. She prefers to act herself and has the pride of a warrior. Crusch is also gentle, often believing the false knowledge jokingly told to her by [Ferris](https://anilist.co/character/90184), and sometimes displays an airheaded side. Like her mother Helena Karsten, she is shown to be ruthless and reckless.

108632.name: Puck
108632.desc: __Height:__ 7 cm Puck is an Artificial Spirit that [Emilia](https://anilist.co/character/88572/Emilia) was formerly contracted with. He is the current Great Spirit of Fire. ~!He is currently known as the Beast of The End.!~ ~!Around 400 years ago, Puck was created by Echidna, though he had apparently left her by the time she moved into the Sanctuary. Seven years before the start of the election, Puck unfroze Emilia and began to act as her friend and mentor, and later on started to live at Roswaal's mansion where he was reunited with Beatrice.!~ Puck can be described as cute or adorable, thus his skin being pink around his cheeks. His fur is mostly grey with silver in certain spots (i.e. tip of the tail). His eyebrows are pretty small and rhombus-shaped. He also has a gold earring on his left ear. Sometimes, he carries a purple bag. Puck is generally a nice spirit. He is very happy and stays at Emilia's side to protect her, affectionately calling her "Lia". He occasionally goofs around and gets along especially well with [Beatrice](https://anilist.co/character/90181/Beatrice). ~!However, Puck's demeanor greatly changes in loops where Emilia dies, showing a complete disregard for anyone except her, and was even willing to destroy the world because of the condition in their contract.!~

108632.name: Otto Suwen
108632.original: オットー・スーウェン
108632.desc: Otto Suwen is a merchant appearing in Re:Zero. His remarkable misfortune always takes him to dangerous situations, from which he escapes thanks to his wit. Otto has gray hair that is mentioned to be as long as a gal game protagonist. He is said to be somewhat handsome if he has a serious expression. However, he is usually either retorting, shouting, or panicking, ruining his looks. He has a medium build, but has trained himself since he used to work as a merchant.

108632.name: Satella
108632.desc: Satella is one of the Witches of Sin, being the Witch of Envy. ~! Contrary to popular belief, Satella and the Witch of Envy are separate personalities. Both of them love Subaru, though the Witch of Envy is aggressive about it.!~

108632.name: Echidna
108632.desc: Echidna is one of the Witches of Sin, being the Witch of Greed. She has a strong thirst for knowledge along with a curiosity for the unknown, which defines her behavior. Echidna is described as black hearted, being unable to empathize with others and their feelings due to a lack of understanding. She will do anything to gain knowledge, be it deceit or employed sophistry.

108632.name: Garfiel Tinsel
108632.original: ガーフィール・ティンゼル
108632.desc: Garfiel Tinsel is the former guardian of the Sanctuary and a member of the Emilia Camp. Introduced during Arc 4, he became one of the main supporting characters of the season. He's a half-beast human and [Frederica Baumann's](https://anilist.co/character/143378/Baumann-Frederica) half-brother. He can transform himself in a giant golden tiger that can deal powerful attacks but with a cost of losing his reason, so he uses this ability when he's pushed to the limit. ~!Garfiel and Frederica lived together until she left when he was around 4 years old and he hadn't seen her since until their reunion 10 years later during the Sanctuary incident. After seeing his mother's "death" during the trial at a young age, he began to fear the outside world, causing him to try and protect the Sanctuary.!~

108632.name: Minerva
108632.desc: Minerva is one of the Witches of Sin, being the Witch of Wrath. Minerva dislikes conflict and wishes for all to be well. She also only cares about what's directly in front of her, not worrying about things she cannot see. Minerva has some history with the elves as she cares deeply for Emilia, along with the other elves. ~!Minerva's main ability is "Authority of Wrath". Unlike other authorities this ability is only a support skill. Minerva is able to heal others by attacking any part of their body with her own. The authority also gives her increased speed and strength. The drawback is that every time the authority is used it causes a calamity to happen in another part of the world. The calamity can range from many things such as an earthquake.!~

108632.name: Carmilla
108632.desc: Carmilla is one of the Witches of Sin, being the Witch of Lust. She has no self confidence, being timid, and tends to have downcast eyes. Despite this, others find her similar to a scared animal, making them attracted to her. ~!Carmilla's main ability is "Authority of Lust". With this Ability, Carmilla is able to captivate people, making them absorbed in her atmosphere to the point they wouldn't be able to know if someone were to hurt them. She can also make Individuals believe they are seeing and hearing what they want to see and hear, an example is when Subaru saw Rem and heard her when facing Carmilla.!~

108632.name: Typhon
108632.desc: Typhon is one of the Witches of Sin, being the Witch of Pride. She is said to judge people with the innocence and ruthlessness of a young girl. ~!Typhon's main ability is "Authority of Pride". With this authority, Typhon is able to tear apart an individuals body if she decides they are guilty of something. The authority is extremely subjective. If the individual feels guilty, Typhon can punish the individual, even if the act may not be something they should be punished for. The ability has one draw back of not being able to work if the individual has little to no thinking capacity.!~

108632.name: Sekhmet
108632.desc: Sekhmet is one of the Witches of Sin, being the Witch of Sloth. As her position suggests, she can be summed up to being extremely lazy, enough that she finds breathing to be a pain. ~! Sekhmet's main ability is "Authority of Sloth". With this Ability, Sekhmet is able to use a more advanced and improved version of the unseen hand used by Petelgeuse. Unlike Petelgeuse her unseen hand is able to hit individuals and objects with an invisible force without her moving and she can use this power in any direction she chooses. She is cited from Echidna to be the strongest of the witches of sin besides Satella !~

108632.name: Daphne
108632.desc: Daphne is one of the Witches of Sin, being the Witch of Gluttony. All she wants is to be full, it's her reason for living. Daphne enjoys giving people nicknames, such as Subarun for Subaru. ~! Daphne's main ability is "Authority of Gluttony". With this authority, Daphne is able to cause a individual to have and feel extreme levels of hunger by just touching them or looking at them. When Subaru encountered Daphne it only look one look from her left eye for him to start eating his arm and ignores everything that was going on around him. Echidna states that a look from Daphne's left eye isn't all impressive and the true terror of Daphne comes when she uses her right eye or eats her target. !~

108632.name: Petra Leyte
108632.desc: Petra is a bright and kind girl from Irlam Village. She likes [Subaru](https://anilist.co/character/88573/Natsuki-Subaru) very much after he saved her from the Wolgarm incident. ~!She became a maid at the Roswaal Mansion after Subaru came back from the witchcult incident. !~

108632.name: Frederica Baumann
108632.original: フレデリカ・バウマン
108632.desc: Frederica Baumann is a maid working for [Roswaal L. Mathers](https://anilist.co/character/90182/Mathers-Roswaal) and a member of the Emilia Camp. She quit her job as a maid a few months before [Subaru's](https://anilist.co/character/88573/Natsuki-Subaru) appearance, but returned after [Ram](https://anilist.co/character/88576/Ram) couldn't manage the mansion ~!after [Rem](https://anilist.co/character/88575/Rem) had her name and memories eaten. !~ ~!She is the half-sister of [Garfiel Tinsel](https://anilist.co/character/133847/Tinsel-Garfiel).!~

108632.name: Ryuuzu Meyer
108632.desc: Ryuuzu was a half-elf who lived in the Sanctuary during the era of the witches, 400 years ago. She was used by [Echidna](https://anilist.co/character/129330/Echidna) in order to activate the Sanctuary's barrier. During Echidna's immortality experiments, she created copies of Ryuzu and tasked them with protecting the Sanctuary.

108632.name: Rye Batenkaitos
108632.original: ライ・バテンカイトス
108632.desc: Rye Batenkaitos is a Sin Archbishop of the Witch Cult, representing the gourmet aspect of gluttony.

108632.name: Regulus Corneas
108632.original: レグルス・コルニアス
108632.desc: Regulus is a young man of a medium height. He has gold eyes, white hair and a middle to skinny build. Regulus Is a part of the Sin Archbishops of the Witch Cult and represents greed. Regulus is known for being very talkative and calls himself unselfish, while in fact he is very prideful and likes to act above others and reference himself as above others.

108632.name: Meili Portroute
108632.original: メィリィ・ポートルート
108632.desc: One of the children that lives in the village within [Roswaal](https://anilist.co/character/90182)'s region. She's timid, though is friendly, such as when she introduces a small dog to [Subaru](https://anilist.co/character/88573). ~!Meili Portroute is a Demon Beast User.!~

108632.name: Patrasche
108632.desc: [Subaru](https://anilist.co/character/88573/Natsuki-Subaru)'s Earth Dragon that he officially received from [Crusch Karsten](https://anilist.co/character/90185/Karsten-Crusch) for his efforts in the Hakugei battle. Despite being of a species known for being feisty, Patrasche is extremely loyal to Subaru, as she is willing to put her life on the line for him.

108632.name: Naoko Natsuki
108632.desc: [Subaru](https://anilist.co/character/88573/Natsuki-Subaru)'s mother.

108632.name: Kenichi Natsuki
108632.desc: Subaru's father. Subaru idolized his father and wanted to be like him. However, after this proved to be impossible, he went through a downward spiral that ultimately resulted in him becoming a shut-in. Kenichi is hard-working, diligent, and loved by all, which led to a huge amount of expectations being put on Subaru by his surroundings as he is "Kenichi's Son", which furthermore increased the burden on him. He was shown to be a very supportive dad which, although always trying to get his son to go out of the house or go back to school, never forgets to put his son's emotional state before it all through physical bonding and father-to-son talks.

108632.name: Rigel Natsuki
108632.desc: Natsuki Rigel is the non canon son of Natsuki Subaru and Rem.

21699.name: Megumin
21699.desc: Megumin is an archmage and the self-proclaimed top genius of the Crimson Demons, an order of magicians who are born with high intelligence and magical powers. Despite being an archwizard, she can only use the high level skill 'Explosion', the strongest of all offensive magic, and only once a day as it consumes tremendous magical power. Due to this she is more often a liability than an asset. Megumin speaks and dresses as a Chuunibyou and her only desire is to unleash explosion magic in the face of her enemies.

21699.name: Aqua
21699.desc: Aqua is a goddess of water. She guides humans who die young to the afterlife. Due to her cocky attitude towards [Kazuma](https://anilist.co/character/89364), she ends up being dragged to another world with him to defeat the Demon King. Aqua chose the advanced job of archpriest, as being a goddess she's naturally a strong wielder of healing magic. However, she spends most of her skillpoints on party trick skills.

21699.name: Darkness
21699.desc: A crusader and a masochist. Despite being an advanced knight, she is extremely clumsy and none of her attacks ever hit their mark. However, she has great endurance and stamina and acts as the frontline of the party. She often throws herself in front of enemies to "shield" her party, but in reality it's just her masochism.

21699.name: Kazuma Satou
21699.desc: __Height:__ 162 cm (5'4") A hikikomori (shut-in), otaku and NEET, Kazuma arrives in the afterlife after a traffic accident and decides to go to another world to defeat the Demon King, taking [Aqua](https://anilist.co/character/89362) with him. He has the weakest job of 'Adventurer', but has decent intelligence and extraordinarily high luck. This is demonstrated whenever he uses his 'steal' skill.

21699.name: Yunyun
21699.desc: Yunyun is a member of the Crimson Magic Clan, and she and [Megumin](https://anilist.co/character/89361) are friends as well as rivals.

21699.name: Komekko
21699.desc: Komekko is [Megumin](https://anilist.co/character/89361)'s adorable younger sister. She is a young Crimson Demon and the only Crimson Magic kid around her age.

21699.name: Chomusuke
21699.desc: Chomusuke acts as [Megumin](https://anilist.co/character/89361)'s familiar. She is a black cat with a red cross-shaped marking on her forehead and bat like wings. She cannot speak human language, but she seems to be fairly intelligent and can understand human speech to some extent. ~!She is actually the other half of Lady Wolbach, who was sealed in the Crimson Demon Village.!~

21699.name: Wiz
21699.desc: Wiz is the owner of a famous Magic Item Shop in Axel that has many unsalable items with quirky defects. She used to be a renowned Arch Wizard, but has since retired. At night, she has a secret identity as a kind-hearted lich who helps lingering spirits pass on. She is also the only harmless Demon King's General and prefers to live as a human.

21699.name: Luna
21699.desc: Part of the Guild Staff, she is the go-to woman for adventurers visiting the guild. Luna is a very kind, caring and cheerful young woman who has a rather ''Onee-chan'' (big sister) aura about her. She has common sense which is a rarity in the Fantasy World. Luna is also a calm person, taking everything in stride.

21699.name: Eris
21699.desc: Eris is the Goddess of Fortune and [Aqua's](https://anilist.co/character/89362) junior. Eris is a very kind and gentle girl who treats others with kindness and respect. She is also very caring and she always interest her adherents. She has a very cheerful attitude but at times can act a bit childish. She is insecure about her breast size and uses breast pads to compensate. Aqua often embarrasses her with this knowledge, as Eris wants as few people as possible to notice her lack in bust. She is also kind-hearted and gentle, and therefore, her scent is very fragrant, according to her peers and Aegis. ~!Eris disguises herself as Chris, a friend to [Darkness](https://anilist.co/character/89363) listed under the occupation of thief. Chris is an innocent, cheerful and energetic girl that is almost always seen with a big smile and boasting a bright personality. She also seems to have high confidence in herself. Though at times she acts quite childish and mischievous, Chris has a big, kind heart.!~

21699.name: Sena
21699.desc: Royal Prosecutor for the Kingdom of Belzerg.

21699.name: Arakuremono
21699.desc: An anime-exclusive character. The first person [Kazuma](https://anilist.co/character/89364) speaks with in Axel's guildhall. (Source: Wikipedia)

21699.name: Vanir
21699.desc: Demon King's army ex-general.

21699.name: Beldia
21699.desc: A dullahan and one of the Devil King's generals. He becomes hostile towards [Kazuma](https://anilist.co/character/89364)'s party after [Megumin](https://anilist.co/character/89361) keeps using his castle for explosion practice. ~!He is weak against water and is defeated by [Aqua](https://anilist.co/character/89362)'s purifying magic.!~

21699.name: Keith
21699.desc: A frivolous archer who is part of Taylor's party.

21699.name: Kyouya Mitsurugi
21699.desc: A Japanese citizen who was also reincarnated to the fantasy world by Aqua. He is one of Belzerg's strongest adventurers and wields the cursed sword Gram. The sword was his gift from Aqua.

21699.name: Dust
21699.desc: A warrior and a member of the party consisting of [Rin](https://anilist.co/character/240105/Rin), [Keith](https://anilist.co/character/136043/Keith), and [Taylor](https://anilist.co/character/242932/Taylor). He is a major supporting character in the main KonoSuba series, as well as the protagonist of the Limelight spinoff series alongside [Rin](https://anilist.co/character/240105/Rin). Dust is rumored to be one of the strongest adventurers in Axel, to the point where he could become a highly accomplished individual if not for his lazy personality. However, he appears to actively hide his true abilities, handicapping himself by using a longsword rather than a spear, his preferred weapon of choice. ~!In the Limelight spinoff series, Dust is revealed to be a formerly renowned knight born of lower-ranking nobility. Having been banished and stripped of his status after helping the princess [Leonor](https://anilist.co/character/340950/Leonor) avoid her wedding, he became a delinquent adventurer, joining [Taylor](https://anilist.co/character/242932/Taylor)'s party and quickly becoming close with [Rin](https://anilist.co/character/240105/Rin) due to her striking resemblance of [Leonor](https://anilist.co/character/340950/Leonor). Promising the princess to do so, he only makes use of his full abilities when those he cares about are at stake.!~

21699.name: Alderp Alexei Barnes
21699.original: アルダープ・アレクセイ・バーネス

21699.name: Wolbach
21699.desc: Wolbach is a goddess that presides over violence and sloth. She serves as one of the eight generals of the Demon King and has many worshippers within the Demon King's army. ~!She was a major antagonist, being one of the most predominately featured of the eight generals of the Demon King's army, and was the arch-nemesis of the adventurer Megumin. Wolbach was split into two beings and sealed within a complex sealing stone; one of these beings represented the sloth aspect of Wolbach while the other one represented the aspect of violence and took the form of a huge black beast. Approximately 8 years prior to the main series, a young Megumin was playing with the complex sealing stone and accidentally released Wolbach and her other half, which went on a rampage. Wolbach used Explosion to defeat the beast and save Megumin, then she sapped her violence aspect of most of its energy before resealing it, deciding to come back for it when it was more calm. Wolbach then taught Megumin the spell "Explosion" as thanks and left the Crimson Demon Village behind. Despite being an "evil god" and a general of the Demon King, Wolbach was shown to be of relatively high moral standing. Although she was a Goddess, Wolbach didn't talk down to Megumin (who at the time was a young girl) and elicited concern about the young girl's future as she thought Megumin dedicating her life to Explosion would be a waste. The aspect of violence was later unknowingly unsealed by Megumin's younger sister Komekko seve

21699.name: Keele
21699.desc: Was a former Arch Wizard who later became a Lich to save his love.

21699.name: Ignis  Dustiness Ford
21699.original: イグニス ダスティネス フォード
21699.desc: Is the father of Darkness and the current head of the Dustiness House.

21699.name: Walter Alexei Barnes
21699.original: バルター・アレクセイ・バーネス

21699.name: Rin
21699.desc: An intermediate wizard and a member of [Taylor](https://anilist.co/character/242932/Taylor)'s party, alongside [Keith](https://anilist.co/character/136043/Keith) and [Dust](https://anilist.co/character/136046/Dust). Rin is a highly capable magic user, although she is humble and describes herself as a rookie wizard. She is also a very direct and honest person, and although she's usually calm, she knows how to hit someone back when she is teased. Her level-headedness compared to the boys in her party often leads to her getting Dust out of trouble and scolding him for his actions. Despite her strict demeanor however she is a pleasant person, and at times shows genuine kindness and concern for Dust as well.

21699.name: Cedre
21699.desc: ~!He was one of the few people killed by Beldia and resurrected by Aqua.!~

21699.name: Garilhe
21699.desc: An adventurer. ~!He was one of the few people killed by Beldia and resurrected by Aqua.!~

21699.name: Heinz
21699.desc: He often teases Darkness for not being able to hit the enemy. ~!He was one of the few people killed by Beldia and was resurrected by Aqua.!~

21699.name: Kajiya
21699.desc: Blacksmith who creates Kazuma's armour and katana.

101347.name: Hyakkimaru
101347.desc: Hyakkimaru is the central character of Tezuka's best-known samurai story, Dororo. A powerful warrior, Hyakkimaru is traveling on a long quest to retrieve 48 parts of his body which were sold to demons by his father at his birth. This is a very dramatic adventure series, with a great variety of unusual mythological creatures and demons, as well as bandits and other fierce foes. Gradually the grim experiences of his travels make Hyakkimaru more and more distant and grim, so as he recovers more and more of his human body he becomes at the same time less and less human.

101347.name: Dororo
101347.desc: ~!__Gender__: Female!~ After seeing his swordsmanship, Dororo decides to follow Hyakkimaru. Dororo was a thief before meeting Hyakkimaru. ~!Dororo's bandit father Hibukuro was wounded by a samurai official and later died. Her mother froze to death while fleeing in the snow, but before she died she drew a map on Dororo's back to locate money hidden by her father at Bone Cape. Hyakkimaru learns that Dororo is female with the latter continuously insisting she is a boy, though this is because her parents raised her as one.!~

101347.name: Biwamaru
101347.desc: Biwamaru (sometimes Biwa Maru) is a blind, itinerant acupuncture doctor, who wanders around Japan curing all sorts of ailments with miraculous speed. He is extremely disheveled in appearance, dressed in rags and walking with a twisted stick as a cane, and a rough bundle on his back. Biwamaru is effective, like Black Jack, an unlicensed doctor, since his practices are considered to be quackery by the medical establishment, while Biwamaru considers it barbaric to cut open a patient to cure them. This, as with Dr. Kiriko, Biwamaru is another nemesis who is too similar to Black Jack for the two to forgive their differences. Biwamaru also features in Tezuka’s best-known samurai manga, Dororo. ~!When Biwamaru came to Black Jack's town in issue #126 'The Blind Doctor of Acupuncture,' (6/7/1976) it was hatred at first sight, as each dismissed the other as a quack, though neither was able to deny the effectiveness of the other’s treatments. To make matters worse, Biwamaru charges nothing for his services, in contrast with Black Jack's outrageous fees, leading to criticism of Black Jack by the local community. Their interaction here effectively degenerated into each attempting repeatedly to prove that the other was a quack, and generally failing, though teaching each other bitter lessons about the limitations of their methods. The two met again not long afterwards in issue #141, 'Death of Hyojisai' (The Master Forger, Two People at the Thermal Bath) when they met at a hot spring and di

101347.name: Kagemitsu Daigo
101347.desc: Daigo was the lord of Ishikawa domain which was ravaged by floods and starvation due to poor harvest. He made a deal with a group of 48 devils (12 in 2019 version) in order to save his domain and to aggrandise his power. He promises each devil a body part from his unborn child in exchange for the power to take over the land. ~!Towards the end of episode 24, while dying from the side effects of having made a pact with the demons, he is seen regretting having sold his son to the demons and realises that it was the will of Hyakkimaru to live on that the demons craved for and that perhaps, if he had succeeded his reign, the prosperity that he desired would have been fulfilled.!~

101347.name: Narrator
101347.desc: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

101347.name: Nuinokata
101347.desc: Daigo's wife, mother of Hyakkimaru and Tahoumaru.

101347.name: Jukai
101347.desc: A skilled doctor and surgeon who used healing magic and alchemical methods to give the child who became Hyakkimaru prostheses crafted from the remains of children who had died in the war.

101347.name: Tahoumaru Daigo
101347.desc: Brother of Hyakkimaru and the second son (successor) of Kagemitsu Daigo. Born after Hyakkimaru was abandoned.

101347.name: Mio
101347.desc: Mio is a young girl who lived in an abandoned temple with orphans who lost their parents in the war. She is kind and caring as she tends to put others in priority instead of herself.

101347.name: Osushi Niki
101347.desc: She is Tanosuke's younger sister and a girl who cares deeply for her brother. She begs Hyakkimaru to spare Tanosuke's life, but after her brother dies, she directs her resentment toward Hyakkimaru and drives him out of the village. In contrast, she bids Dororo a kind farewell, telling him to take care of himself.

101347.name: Itachi
101347.desc: A bandit who betrayed Dororo's father Hibukuro and sided with the authorities.

101347.name: Ojiya
101347.desc: She is a bandit along with her husband, Hibukuro. She is the mother of Dororo.

101347.name: Hibukuro
101347.desc: He is the leader of a bandit clan that is devoted into raiding samurai forts. He is the father of Dororo

101347.name: Saru
101347.desc: He is a young boy, whose parents died when he was little. He used to live in the mountains all alone​ before he met a kind woman named Oume who took him in.

101347.name: Souryo
101347.desc: His real name is unknown. He is a monk/priest who was in the temple Hall of Hell​ before Kagemitsu Daigo came and killed him.

101347.name: Oume
101347.desc: She is a kind woman who takes care of an orphan boy called Saru after she found him alone in the mountains.

101347.name: Sukeroku
101347.desc: He is the orphan that separates​ from his mother during the land split by the Banmon.

101347.name: Okaka
101347.desc: She is a young lady who lived in a small cottage which Dororo and Hyakkimaru encountered along their journey. She initially appeared to be a kind, compassionate individual, allowing the two to stay in her cottage for shelter. However, she was, in truth, the spirit of a Buddha Statue carver who lived a very long time ago

101347.name: Maimai-onba
101347.desc: She is one of the twelve demons that made a contract with Daigo Kagemitsu. She hypnotized Sabame to become his lover and do her bidding by killing Hyakkimaru and Dororo, so her offspring can eat them. However, she was unable to succeed.

101347.name: Sabame
101347.desc: He is the landlord of a mountain village. He had been hypnotized by the Maimai-onba to become her lover and being manipulated to kill Hyakkimaru and Dororo so that her offspring can eat them.

101347.name: Youkai Kozo
101347.desc: is the spirit of a deceased child who once lived in an orphanage in the mountains. Some time ago He along with the nun, the other orphans and the orphanage, burned down in a fire.

101347.name: Jisho Ama Yuurei
101347.desc: is the spirit of a deceased nun who once ran an orphanage in the mountains. Some time ago, She, along with the orphans and the orphanage, burned down in a fire.

101347.name: Shiranui
101347.desc: He s a lonely fisherman who seems to be the owner of two huge shark demons, Jiromaru and Saburomaru. But in reality, he is more of a slave to them.

101347.name: Munetsuna
101347.desc: He is the father of Okowa and is known as the best swordmaker in the region. Although he makes a living by making swords, he has expressed discontent with the products he has made and wishes that he would make a sword for peace and not bloodshed. He fix up and sharpen Hyakkimaru's blades.

101347.name: Okowa
101347.desc: She is the daughter of Munetsuna. She is the second love interest of Hyakkimaru after Mio. Okowa is a cheerful girl, but with childish attitude.

101347.name: Saburota
101347.desc: He claims to be a courageous man wanting to kill the demon. But in reality, he's a coward that submitted himself to Nue after being frightened to death from seeing people being devoured by the demon. From that day onwards, he even helped the beasts to lure any travellers into its territory and devour them bit by bit.

99750.name: Haruki Shiga
99750.desc: A guy who incidentally found a book in the hospital titled "Disease Coexistence Journal" which is owned by his classmate [Sakura Yamauchi](https://anilist.co/character/127118/Yamauchi-Sakura). ~!It is revealed in the last chapter of the novel that his name is Haruki Shiga (志賀春樹).!~

99750.name: Sakura Yamauchi
99750.desc: A high school student who suffers a pancreatic disease, having her lifespan cut in half. She has a diary called "Living with Dying" where she writes about her daily experiences, since her illness was first diagnosed. Despite her situation, she keeps her smile and even makes jokes about it. ~!She was later stabbed after being discharged from the hospital and sadly passed away.!~

99750.name: Issei Miyata
99750.desc: A classmate who started talking to Haruki, since meeting Haruki and Sakura. For some reason, he offers a piece of gum to Haruki whenever they talk.

99750.name: Takahiro
99750.desc: Class representative who is in love with Sakura. He is very obstinate and gets jealous easily yet hides it to keep face with his classmates.

99750.name: Haruki no Haha
99750.desc: As his mother, she quietly and protectively watches over Haruki. Though she rarely intervenes, she has very good instincts.

99750.name: Kyouko Takimoto
99750.desc: Sakura’s best friend since they were little. She is protective of Sakura and will not let anyone who may be harmful near her. Very assertive.

99750.name: Haruki no Chichi
99750.desc: A humble and genuinely nice father, whose relationship with Haruki is neither good nor bad. Has a good relationship with his wife.

99750.name: Sakura no Haha
99750.desc: A very kind hearted woman, who strives to grant all of Sakura’s wishes since her daughter’s diagnosis.

145139.name: Tanjirou Kamado
145139.desc: __Height:__ 165 cm (5'5") __Combat Style:__ Water Breathing & ~!Sun Breathing!~ Tanjirou is kind by nature and has been described by others as having very gentle eyes. He has a great deal of determination and will not give up once he has a goal to achieve, an example being finding a cure for [Nezuko](https://anilist.co/character/127518). Even though he is relatively strong on his own, he isn't opposed to asking others for help when he needs it. He is very protective of his friends and even more so of his younger sister. His biggest attribute is his ability to empathize with anyone, even demons. ~!Eventually, he discovers that he is a legendary Sun Breathing user.!~

145139.name: Nezuko Kamado
145139.desc: __Height:__ 153 cm (5'0") Transformed into a demon and left mute, Nezuko travels with her older brother [Tanjirou](https://anilist.co/character/126071/Kamado-Tanjirou) in a box on his back. She can change her size at will, and is a capable fighter when she needs to be, but has never killed or eaten any humans. Instead of gaining nourishment from humans, it seems that she recovers her energy by sleeping for long periods of time.

145139.name: Inosuke Hashibira
145139.desc: **Height:** 164 cm (5'4") __Combat Style:__ Beast Breathing Inosuke is usually seen wearing a grey boar mask, with a shirtless version of the Demon hunter uniform. Without the mask he has messy shoulder length black hair and large green eyes with long eyelashes. He is described as having a girly looking face which greatly contrasts with his muscular body. Inosuke is extremely short-tempered and proud, and makes a big deal out of fighting opponents stronger than him claiming that's his only hobby. He is a sore loser and is always trying to compete with Tanjiro and provoke him into fighting him, and usually failing. Due to growing up in the mountains by himself Inosuke has trouble interacting with others and only cares about himself most of the time. Though he's often seen with 2 swords in hand, Inosuke is left-handed.

145139.name: Zenitsu Agatsuma
145139.desc: __Height:__ 164 cm (5'4") __Combat Style:__ Thunder Breathing __Affiliation:__ Demon Slayer Corps __Occupation:__ Demon Slayer Zenitsu Agatsuma is one of the main protagonists of Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba and along with [Inosuke Hashibira](https://anilist.co/character/129130/Inosuke-Hashibira), a traveling companion of [Tanjiro Kamado](https://anilist.co/character/126071/Tanjirou-Kamado) and [Nezuko Kamado](https://anilist.co/character/127518/Nezuko-Kamado).

145139.name: Muzan Kibutsuji
145139.desc: __Height:__ 179 cm (5'10") He is the Demon King, the first of his kind, and the progenitor of all other demons in existence. Muzan is also the leader of the Twelve Kizuki, an organization of the twelve strongest demons in existence that serve directly under him. ~!A millennium ago, during the Heian Era, Muzan was turned into a demon during an experimental treatment trying to cure his terminal illness, and his goal since then was to live without the fear of death and become truly eternal. He believes that Sun Breathing users are his only threat. He has a grand total of seven hearts and five brains.!~

145139.name: Kyoujurou Rengoku
145139.desc: __Height:__ 177 cm (5'10") __Combat Style:__ Flame Breathing He is greatly enthusiastic in regard to his duties as Flame Pillar and often cheerfully eccentric. He is amiable, kind and boasts extraordinary flame techniques and swordsmanship stemming from strict practice and discipline. He is an honourable warrior who adheres to his code of morals and principles that was instilled into him by his mother at a young age - the most significant being that those who were born strong have a duty to protect the weak.

145139.name: Muichirou Tokitou
145139.desc: __Height:__ 160 cm (5'3") __Combat Style:__ Mist Breathing Muichiro is an air-headed individual who seems to constantly wander off in thought and never focus on one thing. Impassive and, at times, obtuse, he tends to think only for himself and operates on logic alone, never letting emotion guide him. Despite this, he has been shown to get serious when it is required and is devoted to his position as the Demon Slayer Corps' Mist Hashira. Alternatively, he seems to display a cold and arrogant side as well. ~!He later died at Kokushibo's hand.!~

145139.name: Tengen Uzui
145139.desc: __Height:__ 198 cm (6'6") __Combat Style:__ Sound Breathing A Demon Slayer, and the Sound Pillar of the Demon Slayer Corps. Tengen is a very eccentric person, always wanting to complete actions as flashy as possible. Although he has displayed an uncaring and forceful attitude towards some people, he also has a caring side that is mainly only shown towards his most treasured ones, most notably his three wives, [Makio](https://anilist.co/character/250554), [Suma](https://anilist.co/character/250555), and [Hinatsuru](https://anilist.co/character/250556). He also shows a somewhat nicer side towards [Tanjiro](https://anilist.co/character/126071) after their mission and starts to accept him more as the series goes on.

145139.name: Mitsuri Kanroji
145139.desc: __Height:__ 167 cm (5'5") __Combat Style:__ Love Breathing Demon Hunter and the Love Pillar of the Demon Killing Corps. Mitsuri is a soft and kind person. She is very emotional and passionate, constantly complimenting people in her head, which probably contributes to her nickname of "the Hashira of Love". Although she is rather shy and is easily flustered, she is always kind to others, most notably towards [Obanai](https://anilist.co/character/137777), whom she appears to share a strong bond with. Besides her rather emotional personality, she can also come off as somewhat childish at times. ~!She was taught by Rengoku to use the flame breathing. However, although Mitsuri has learnt it, she was not as skillful with it and cannot fight to her fullest using it, leading her to solely develop the Love Breathing.!~

145139.name: Sanemi Shinazugawa
145139.desc: __Height:__ 179cm (5'10½") Demon Hunter and the Wind Pillar of the Demon Killing Corps. He is the older brother of [Genya Shinazugawa](https://anilist.co/character/137776). Sanemi specializes in Wind Breathing, which has 9 forms. The technique consists of drawing the air from around the user to create whirlwind attacks that follow the user's movements. Form names include Dust Whirlwind Cutter, Claws-Purifying Wind, Clean Storm Wind Tree, Rising Dust Storm, Cold Mountain Wind, Black Wind Mountain Mist, Gale - Sudden Gusts, Primary Gale Slash, and Idaten Typhoon.

145139.name: Genya Shinazugawa
145139.desc: __Height:__ 180 cm (5'11") Genya Is a Demon Hunter of the Demon Killing Corps. He is also the younger brother of the Wind Pillar [Sanemi Shinazugawa](https://anilist.co/character/137774). ~! Due to his lack of breath forms he is dependent on using his shotgun and demon form. His shotgun pelts are made from sun steel to be effective against demons. His demon form is active when he digests anything from a demon to gain demon like strength and abilities. He is the only demon hunter to have this ability given that it is drastically rare !~

145139.name: Obanai Iguro
145139.desc: __Height:__ 162 cm (5'3") Obanai is a Demon Slayer and the Snake Pillar of the Demon Slayer Corps. A young man of short stature and a pale complexion. He has straight-edged black hair of varying lengths, the longest reaching down to his shoulders and the shortest stopping at his cheekbones, which he wears down with two shorter strands hanging between his eyes. He wears a navy blue version of the standard Demon Slayer uniform, along with a black and white pinstriped haori, the hem and cuffs of which are striped lengthways rather than vertically, which covers his hands. Obanai also sports bandages in place of the leg-wraps around his calves, as well as another set of bandages that cover his mouth, and blue-strapped zori on his feet. He is also always seen with his white snake, Kaburamaru, wrapped around his shoulders.

145139.name: Kagaya Ubuyashiki
145139.desc: He is the head of the Ubuyashiki Family and 97th leader of the Demon Slayer Corps known mainly as "Oyakata-sama" ("Master") by his subordinates and peers.

145139.name: Matsuemon Tennouji
145139.desc: Kasugai Crow assigned to Tanjirou Kamado. Very intelligent and seems to have a large ego.

145139.name: Yushirou
145139.desc: __Height:__ 157 cm (5'2") Yushiro is a traveling companion of Tamayo and close ally of Kamado Tanjirou. He was turned into a Demon by Tamayo. Yushiro was a human who was under the care of Tamayo as she was practicing as a medical practitioner. He was in the frail state fighting disease when Tamayo gave him the choice of succumbing to his illness or to live longer as a Demon. He agreed to become a Demon and has since stayed by Tamayo's side serving as an assistant as well as her guard. ~!Yushiro would become the last known survivor of the Demon race. In time he would dedicate himself to a life of art and become a world famous painter in the present day under the name of Yushiro Yamamoto, known for his paintings of Tamayo to wide critical acclaim!~

145139.name: Tamayo
145139.desc: __Height:__ 150 cm (4'11") Tamayo is a doctor and close ally of [Kamado Tanjirou](https://anilist.co/character/126071/Kamado-Tanjirou). She was turned into a Demon by [Kibutsuji Muzan](https://anilist.co/character/129132/Kibutsuji-Muzan).

145139.name: Hotaru Haganezuka
145139.desc: Hotaru Haganezuka is a swordsmith affiliated with the Demon Killing Corps.

145139.name: Kanao Tsuyuri
145139.desc: __Height:__ 156 cm (5'1½") Kanao Tsuyuri is a Demon Hunter and the Tsuguko, who is personally looked after by the Demon Killing Corps' Pillars. She uses Flower Breathing. ~!When Kanao is first introduced, she is an indecisive and quiet girl due to the abuse she endured in her past before meeting the Kocho sisters. She became unable to make decisions by herself and repressed her emotions as a defense mechanism. In order to help rectify this, Kanae gave her a coin to flip to decide which path to follow when she didn't know what to do. Later on, Tanjiro helps Kanao overcome her indecisiveness and Kanao soon becomes more confident in making decisions with or without her coin. Kanao and Tanjiro would eventually marry and start a family, having two great-great-grandchildren by the names of [Kanata Kamado](https://anilist.co/character/171144/Kanata-Kamado) and [Sumihiko Kamado](https://anilist.co/character/171145/Sumihiko-Kamado) between them.!~

145139.name: Kiriya Ubuyashiki
145139.desc: ~!Kiriya Ubuyashiki is the son and middle child of Kagaya Ubuyashiki. He is the current head of the Ubuyashiki Household and leader of the Demon Slaying Corps!~

145139.name: Nakime
145139.desc: Nakime is a mysterious Biwa Demon that dwells in the Dimensional Infinity Fortress. ~!Actually she is a member of the Twelve Demon Moons, replacing Hantengu and holding the position of Upper Moon Four.!~ (Source: Fandom)

145139.name: Akaza
145139.desc: __Height:__ 173 cm (5'8") A member of the Twelve Demon Moons, holding the position of Upper Moon Three.

145139.name: Kokushibo
145139.desc: __Height:__ 190 cm (6'3") __Combat Style:__ ~!Moon breathing!~ Kokushibo is a member of the Twelve Demon Moons, holding the position of Upper Moon One. ~!When he was a human he went by the name Michikatsu Tsugikuni. He is also the brother of Yoriichi Tsugikuni.!~

145139.name: Douma
145139.desc: __Height:__ 187 cm (6'1½") He is Upper Moon Two, making him the third-strongest demon after Muzan and Upper Moon One. He has a very friendly attitude, and fights with a pair of metal fans. He is the founder of a cult known as the "Eternal Paradise Cult," and eats his followers, allegedly in order to release them from the pain of living. ~!He is the demon who killed Shinobu Kochou's older sister and Shinobu, as well as Inosuke's mother.!~

145139.name: Naho Takada
145139.desc: She is a servant of the Butterfly Estate.

145139.name: Kiyo Terauchi
145139.desc: She is a servant of the Butterfly Estate.

145139.name: Aoi Kanzaki
145139.desc: She is a Demon Slayer, though she works as a servant in the Butterfly Estate rather than taking to the front lines.

145139.name: Sumi Nakahara
145139.desc: She is a servant of the Butterfly Estate.

145139.name: Yoriichi Tsugikuni
145139.desc: __Combat Style:__ Sun Breathing Yoriichi Tsugikuni is a major supporting character of Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba. He was a legendary Demon Slayer of the Demon Slayer Corps during the Sengoku Era. ~!Yoriichi is the younger twin brother of Michikatsu Tsugikuni, who later became a Demon and joined the Twelve Kizuki, holding the position of Upper Rank 1.!~ ~!Yoriichi is also the progenitor of Breathing Styles as a whole and was an immensely gifted individual who was fated and meant to defeat Muzan Kibutsuji, but failed.!~

145139.name: Nichika Ubuyashiki
145139.desc: Nichika Ubuyashiki is one of the older daughters of Kagaya Ubuyashiki.

145139.name: Hinaki Ubuyashiki
145139.desc: Hinaki Ubuyashiki is one of the older daughters of Kagaya Ubuyashiki.

145139.name: Kotetsu
145139.desc: Kotetsu is a young villager from the Swordsmith Village. His ancestors built the battle doll Yoriichi Type Zero.

145139.name: Gyokko
145139.desc: __Height:__ 150 cm (4'11") (Normal), 170 cm (5'7") (Molted) Gyokko is a major supporting antagonist in the Swordsmith Village Arc of Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba. He is also a member of the Twelve Kizuki, holding the position of Upper Rank 5.

145139.name: Kozo Kanamori
145139.desc: Kozo Kanamori is a swordsmith affiliated with the Demon Slayer Corps.

145139.name: Gotou
145139.desc: Goto is a member of the Kakushi, the clean-up brigade of the Demon Slayers. He is the one who found a near-dead Tanjiro, Inosuke, and Zenitsu in the aftermath of the Entertainment District Arc. He possesses deep respect for the three because of their capability and bravery. At one point in his life, he was found worthy of being a Demon Slayer, but for unknown reasons, he decided to become one of the Kakushi.

145139.name: Amane Ubuyashiki
145139.desc: __Height:__ 167cm (5'6") She is the wife and caretaker of [Kagaya Ubuyashiki](https://anilist.co/character/137808/Kagaya-Ubuyashiki) and the mother of Hinaki Ubuyashiki, Nichika Ubuyashiki, Kiriya Ubuyashiki, Kanata Ubuyashiki and Kuina Ubuyashiki. Her maiden name is Amane Himorogi.

145139.name: Hantengu
145139.desc: __Height:__ 166 cm (5'5¼") Demon of the 12 Kizuki with the rank of Upper Moon 4. ~!Through his Blood Demon Art, he is able to create clones that are manifestations of his emotions, each of them possessing an Upper Rank demon's level of strength.!~

145139.name: Chachamaru
145139.desc: Chachamaru is a feline familiar that assists in Tamayo's medical research with Demon blood. ~!Chachamaru is seen during the battle with Muzan, after the Infinity Castle collapses. The cat jumps above the remaining Hashira in order to administer an antidote to stave off the poisonous effects of Muzan's attacks. As a result, it is sliced in half by the demon. However, it was later reassembled by Yushirou.!~

145139.name: Yuuichirou Tokitou
145139.desc: Older twin brother of [Muichirou.](https://anilist.co/character/136069/Muichirou-Tokitou) He had a cold and harsh personality, speaking critically of his dead parents and brother. ~!He is killed when a demon attacks him and Muichiro, and his last words were encouragement toward Muichiro to live on.!~

145139.name: Tecchin Tecchikawahara
145139.desc: Chief of the Swordsmith Village.

145139.name: Sumiyoshi
145139.desc: Ancestor of the Kamado family and close acquaintance of [Yoriichi Tsugikuni](https://anilist.co/character/149220).

145139.name: Ginko
145139.desc: Kasugai Crow assigned to [Muichirou Tokitou](https://anilist.co/character/136069). Does not get along well with [Tanjirou](https://anilist.co/character/126071) and his crow or the other crows in general. She is very proud of Muichirou.

145139.name: Urara
145139.desc: Kasugai Crow assigned to [Mitsuri Kanroji](https://anilist.co/character/136072). Wears a clover-shaped crown similar to Mitsuri's Nichirin Sword tsuba. Often appears to be nervous and fidgety, and is rumored to have a sweet tooth as a result of how often she has tea time with Mitsuri.

145139.name: Suyako
145139.desc: Wife of [Sumiyoshi](https://anilist.co/character/302101) and ancestor of the Kamado family.

145139.name: Shizu Shinazugawa
145139.desc: Mother to the 7 Shinazugawa children, including Sanemi and Genya.

145139.name: Tetsuido
145139.desc: A swordsmith affiliated with the Demon Slayer Corps. He was responsible for Muichirou Tokitou's swords until he died from a heart attack.

145139.name: Kyougo Shinazugawa
145139.desc: Father of of the Shinazugawa family and husband to Shizu.

21170.name: Bobobo-bo Bo-bobo
21170.original: ボボボーボ・ボーボボ
21170.desc: This is the cool and incomprehensible hero, swarthy and musclebound, sporting sunglasses and a large golden afro. His hair is 24-karat gold but is usually said to be yellow or blonde; some viewers even argue about its true color. He is called Bo-bobo for short. He refuses to let people call him Bo. He fights with his nose hair using the Hanage Shinken (sometimes "Super Fist of the Nose Hair", other times "Snot Fou-You"), as well as simply confusing his enemies. His only weakness, which he discovered while visiting the world of Blabsalot, is the fact that he doesn't have as many deadly attacks. He believes that the Fist of the Nose Hair is sacred and that he shouldn't overuse it. He has three brothers and one sister. Bo-BoBo directs small "micromovies" in his own movie theatre "Bo-BoBo Gekijou" (Bo-BoBo Theater, but also called other names in the dub). He apparently has some control over an army of stuffed teddy bears which are seen in many episodes. There is an apparently large colony of tiny humans and humanoid boogers living in his nose. They sometimes aid him in battle.

21170.name: Tetsuya Kuroko
21170.desc: __Height:__ 168 cm (5'6") __School:__ Seirin High __Number:__ #11 __Speciality:__ Simple sleight of hand tricks The phantom sixth member of the "Generation of Miracles." He has a very weak presence and often seemingly appears out of nowhere as a result. At the first glance all of his abilities seem to be below average, but despite being bad at dribbling and shooting he can be a dangerous opponent. He specializes in circulating passes without being seen. Because of his largely complementary skill set, Kuroko considers himself a "shadow" whose goal is to help his "light" achieve greatness.

21170.name: Nika Tamiya
21170.desc: Nika is a person with the ability of a switch girl. She can change personalities just like that. There are only 2 people in her school that know this about her. Her best friend from childhood and a handsome guy who also has an On and Off mode like her.

21170.name: Koro-sensei
21170.desc: __Height:__ ~300cm (~9'10") He is a teacher for class 3-E of Kunugigaoka Junior High School and the main antihero of Ansatsu Kyoushitsu. He claims responsibility for blowing up the moon into a permanent crescent shape and plans to destroy the Earth in a year after teaching the students of class 3-E the art of assassination. His name comes from korosenai (殺せない), meaning "cannot be killed", and sensei (先生), meaning teacher. In this way, he is literally called the unkillable teacher. ~!Later in the story he is revealed to have been original reaper named Ryushi Korogane.!~

21170.name: Nagisa Shiota
21170.desc: __Height:__ 159 cm (5'2.5") __Class:__ Class 3-E He is one of the students in Class 3-E. Nagisa is seen as one of the weakest students in the class due to his small stature and mediocre physical abilities that are comparable to a girl. However, he is actually the most talented to become an assassin out of all the students, something acknowledged by [Korosensei](https://anilist.co/character/65643) and [Karasuma](https://anilist.co/character/73881). He is able to draw closer while hiding his bloodlust to make a surprise attack and able to make his opponents falter through his bloodlust alone. Nagisa usually writes down Korosensei's weaknesses that at first seen minor (since it doesn't look like major weaknesses), but eventually revealed to be useful since once they're able to almost kill Korosensei because of one of his weaknesses that is the same as the one that Nagisa has written down in his note. Outwardly friendly and polite to his friends and everyone, he hides a somewhat darker side of him as an assassin that won't be able to be found out during daily classes and will only be shown during training and assassination time. According to Karasuma, whenever Nagisa unleashes his killing intent, he isn't training and truly goes for a kill. ~!In the end, he kills [Koro-Sensei](https://anilist.co/character/65643/Korosensei).!~ ~!In the epilogue, 7 years later, Nagisa becomes a teacher of Paradise High School's Class 3-5, Deciding to follow in Koro-sensei's steps.!~

21170.name: Karma Akabane
21170.desc: **Height:** 175 cm A student in [Koro-sensei](https://anilist.co/character/65643)'s class 3-E of Kunugigaoka Junior High School who had been suspended from school due to his violent behavior.
