She explains that he was able to get away with it due to him having a condition known as being "criminally asymptotic", meaning that he could get scanned and have no problems found with him. It is believed that Shogo Makishima possesses the same condition due to his immunity to the Dominator. In Episode 16, after Shuusei and Gu-Song discover the true form of the Sybil System she appears to kill Gu-Song with the "Lethal Elimiinator". However, she is revealed to be a cyborg and then turns and shoots Shuusei before fading out, leaving thier fates unknown. She is actually a robotic body that the members of the Sibyl System use to run the MWPSB. The body is nothing but a shell, used by the members to do their whims. It is only operational when one of their brains occupies her body.!~

13601.name: Hiroko Fujii
13601.desc: Fuji is a fashionable woman with long, light brown hair and brown eyes. She wears a long red coat with a light colored scarf. She gets involved in the Helmet Riots.

13601.name: Risa Aoyanagi
13601.desc: ~!Possibly a container or vessel for the Sibyl System, as hinted on various episodes and scenes.!~

106286.name: Mitsuha Miyamizu
106286.desc: **Height:** 163 cm ~!**Age after timeskip:** 25-26!~ She lives in a small town called Itomori. She is a part of her family's shrine and participates in old traditions as a shrine maiden with her younger sister [Yotsuha](https://anilist.co/character/121518/Yotsuha-Miyamizu).

106286.name: Taki Tachibana
106286.desc: ~!**Age after timeskip:** 22-23!~ He lives in Tokyo, juggling between his part-time job at an Italian restaurant, his relation with his friends, and his dreams to eventually become an architect.

106286.name: Yotsuha Miyamizu
106286.desc: [Mitsuha](https://anilist.co/character/121514/Miyamizu-Mitsuha)'s younger sister, who lives with her and their [grandmother](https://anilist.co/character/121520/Miyamizu-Hitoha). She thinks her sister is somewhat crazy but loves her despite the situation. She participates in creating both kumihimo and kuchikamizake.

106286.name: Nagi Amano
106286.desc: He is [Hina](https://anilist.co/character/139710)'s younger brother who is an elementary student. Despite being young, he is popular with the girls due to his "mature behavior". (Source: Tenki no Ko Wikia, edited)

106286.name: Natsumi Suga
106286.desc: She is a curious student who works at a small editing studio.

106286.name: Keisuke Suga
106286.desc: He is a writer from a small editing studio.

106286.name: Hodaka Morishima
106286.desc: __Height__: >173 cm Hodaka is a high school student of average build with medium length black hair and light brown eyes. He is often seen wearing a plain black t-shirt and jeans along with his yellow knapsack that he carries along everywhere he goes. Hodoka ran away from his parents and home to live a new life in Tokyo as his previous life was too "suffocating" for him. However, after arriving in Tokyo, he struggled to live the new life he was hoping for and was forced to live in manga cafes and in the streets. Fortunately, he met [Keisuke Suga](https://anilist.co/character/139707/Keisuke-Suga), a writer for a small editing company, who took him in as an employee and gave Hodoka a roof over his head. Hodoka is a courageous boy as he was able to leave his home by himself and start a new life in Tokyo. Accompanying his courageous trait however is an impulsive nature which often leads him to make irrational choices that cause many misunderstandings.

106286.name: Hina Amano
106286.desc: __Height__: > 160 cm Hina is a young and cheerful girl with long black-blue hair tied into twin ponytails and large blue eyes. She wears a blue stone necklace and often wears a grey hoodie over a sleeveless dress. Hina takes in many jobs in other to support her younger brother who is still in elementary school. She possesses the ability to clear the weather for a short period of time in a desired area by praying to the sky which she obtained after praying and walking through a Torii (traditional Japanese gate) on the roof of an abandoned building. Hina is a cheerful, energetic, and strong-willed teen. She is also a caring and kind individual as seen when she gives Hodoka a free burger when she noticed he looked lost. She uses her power to clear the weather to brighten people's days and see the smiles on their face. ~!It was later revealed that she's only 15 years old.!~

106286.name: Ame
106286.desc: He's a stray kitten that is adopted by Hodaka Morishima later Keisuke Suga. ~!He became obese three years later.!~

106286.name: Kannushi
106286.desc: He is the caretaker of the Meteorological Shrine.

14741.name: Narrator
14741.desc: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

14741.name: Yuuta Togashi
14741.desc: A high school boy who used to be a delusional teen, believing himself to be the Dark Flame Master and becoming alienated from everyone as a result. Finding this to be embarrassing, he attempts to erase this past from existence, even choosing to go to a separate high school from all of his junior high school classmates. However, after encountering [Rikka](https://anilist.co/character/65865), his past delusions come back to haunt him.

14741.name: Rikka Takanashi
14741.desc: __Height:__ 150 cm (4'11") Rikka Takanashi is an active Chuunibyou, who still has the syndrome. Her delusional syndrome involves her right eye which she calls her "Wicked Eye," which, according to her, wields darkness tamed by the power of a pure heart. In reality, her so-called "Wicked Eye" is nothing more than a colored contact lens which she conceals underneath an eyepatch. Despite being quite attached to [Yuuta](https://anilist.co/character/65863/Togashi-Yuuta), she is cautious of strangers and adopts a battle pose whenever she meets someone for the first time. She is also rather clumsy, often tripping over and forgetting things. She also doesn't have many friends, as shown that in her mobile phone only has her sister's email. ~!Rikka's father died in the past, which she stubbornly denies. In the process, she one-sidedly met Yuuta, who was an active chuunibyou at that time, and was amazed by how cool Yuuta was as the Dark Flame Master. Her belief that her father is in the "horizon" is the cause of her chuunibyou.!~ ~!Rikka eventually falls in love with Yuuta and makes a contract with him.!~

14741.name: Makoto Isshiki
14741.desc: Yuuta's classmate and friend. He created a "cutie poll" which ranked all the girls in class in terms of cuteness. However, because of this, his head was shaved into a crew cut. Later on he joins Rikka's club and develops a crush on Kumin.

14741.name: Shinka Nibutani
14741.desc: A beautiful girl in [Yuuta](https://anilist.co/character/65863/Togashi-Yuuta)'s class. Shinka is Yuuta's classmate and class representative, who is also a cheerleader. One of the most popular girls in the class due to her looks, she is generally thought of a kind and gentle girl. ~!She too suffered a case of eighth-grader syndrome, going by the name of Forest Summer. Like Yuuta, she chose a school that none of her former classmates were going to so she could escape from her embarrassing past. When she is with Yuuta, [Rikka](https://anilist.co/character/65865/Takanashi-Rikka), and the others in the clubroom, her usual happy, sweet demeanor fades and she is blunt, edgy, and tends to fight with [Dekomori](https://anilist.co/character/67215/Dekomori-Sanae) quite a lot. This is because Dekomori admires Forest Summer (and does not believe Shinka is actually Forest Summer, constantly referring to Shinka as "fake Forest Summer") and has numerous copies of books, consisting of documents that Forest Summer had written, titled Mabinogion. Shinka seeks to destroy every last trace of her past, and Dekomori is a barrier against this, causing frequent fights between them.!~

14741.name: Kumin Tsuyuri
14741.desc: Kumin is [Yuuta](https://anilist.co/character/65863)'s chill and carefree senpai who loves adventures, cats, and pillows. Spends most of the time in the club room napping. She adores any chuunibyous and once said that it would've been fun to have some delusions herself.

14741.name: Sanae Dekomori
14741.desc: Sanae is an underclassman to the rest of the club members. She, like [Rikka](https://anilist.co/character/65865/Takanashi-Rikka), is a Chuunibyou. She claims that she is Rikka's servant and wants to take her master's place. Her "power" is Mjolnir, a pair of hair nunchucks. Despite being a Chuunibyou, she is top in her class. Little was known about her relatives but it's implied that she is from a rich family. ~!She eventually becomes the student council president with [Nibutani](https://anilist.co/character/65871/Nibutani-Shinka) as her vice president. Her "nunchucks" are filled with candy, since her previous attempt with cookies didn't go well.!~ (Source: Anime News Network)

14741.name: Kuzuha Togashi
14741.desc: Kuzuha is [Yuuta Togashi](https://anilist.co/character/65863/Togashi-Yuuta)'s younger sister who is in the first year of junior high school. She knows Yuuta very well, especially how he acted during his Chuunibyou days in middle school as Dark Flame Master, though she always considered him embarrassing. Kuzuha got used to her older brother's delusions since she was young. Every once in a while she would ponder if her brother's acts were actually cool before immediately dismissing the thought as Yuuta would spectacularly embarrass himself yet again.

14741.name: Touka Takanashi
14741.desc: Older sister to [Rikka Takanashi](https://anilist.co/character/65865). According to Rikka, she is the alleged powerful and overseeing Priestess of the Deep Horizon. She uses a ladle as a weapon against Rikka's crazy antics. She works as a cook. ~!Later in the story she moves to Italy for work and eventually marries there.!~

14741.name: Nanase Tsukumo
14741.desc: Yuuta and Rikka's homeroom teacher, who is often kind, if sometimes a little sadistic in teasing her students, particularly Rikka. She is called Nana-chan by Yuuta and Rikka.

14741.name: Chimera
14741.desc: Throughout the series she is seen wearing pink angel wings with a snake attached to them. Touka Takanashi is allergic to cats and refuses to let Chimera to be near her.

98460.name: Akira Fudou
98460.desc: __Height:__ 182 cm Akira is a shy, soft spoken, and somewhat cowardly teen. His father has recently went to work in America so he is currently living with his friend Miki's family. He hasn't seen his best friend Ryo in over a month since moving in with Miki's family. When they reunite he is in for a big surprise that will forever change him, his life, and all of mankind. ~!Devilman is Akira Fudo after he merged with Amon in order to save mankind from the demons. While he usually stays in his human form, he turns into Devilman when he needs to fight seriously. Akira still retains his human heart after he becomes Devilman, meaning he can feel love and empathy unlike demons, but his personality changes drastically as a result of the merge.!~

98460.name: Ryo Asuka
98460.desc: The best friend of Akira Fudo, the main character of Nagai Go's classical horror manga Devilman. As Akira is the strength, Ryo is the brain. His father discovered the existence of demons in our world and decided to fight them. He asked his friend Akira for help. Ryo knew that to be able to beat a demon, one had to become a demon. He and Akira went through a ritual to fuse with demons, but in the end, only Akira was able to do so and became Devilman, leaving Ryo remain as a normal human. ~!Ryo's true identity was much more horrible, much more terrifying than he or Akira could've ever imagined. Ryo turned out to be Satan himself, who sought to destroy the world. Satan is depicted as a beautiful hermaphroditic Seraphim angel with twelve wings. However, it is later revealed by Zenon that Satan is in fact in love with Akira. The Devil's love for Akira was developed through the human relationship between Akira and Ryo.!~

98460.name: Psycho Jenny
98460.desc: ~!Psycho Jenny is one of the leading figures in Satan's demon army.!~

98460.name: Miki Makimura
98460.desc: ~!Miki Makimura was a lifelong friend to Akira Fudo and had an attraction to him, but Akira often failed to notice, or they never admitted their feelings to one another before Miki’s tragic end. It is tragically rare for Miki to get a good ending. (Source: Go Nagai Wiki)!~

98460.name: Miki Kuroda
98460.desc: Mikiko Kawamoto is a supporting character in the original Devilman manga. In the 2017 anime adaptation, _Devilman Crybaby_, Miki Kuroda is on the running track team along with Akira Fudo and Miki Makimura.

98460.name: Amon
98460.desc: Amon's original human appearance resembled a light skinned male with messy black hair and dark eyes that featured markings coming down from those eyes. When on duty, he is always seen wearing black form fitting armor with a helmet that featured horns and small wings. He also featured spikes on his arms and a cape. However after becoming a demon he grew far taller while still retaining his human appearance. His skin depended on the artwork with most being blue, turquoise, pale white, and least of all red with legs covered in black fur and a long thin tail with a spiked spade on the end. Amon has yellow eyes which depending on the story had black pupils or none at all. He had thin fangs in his mouth and large bat like wings in place of his ears with a bright red crest in the middle, he also had a pair of antenna connecting to the top of his head.

98460.name: Silene
98460.desc: Once Amon's lover, Sirene is on a mission to destroy the being that took her beloved Amon away. Sirene has razor-sharp claws that can tear a man in two. She can also launch her arms at targets.

98460.name: Gelmar
98460.desc: Gelmar/Geruma is a devil with power over water. He is sent by Sirene to attack Miki. In truth, he is fodder sent by Sirene to weaken him so that she may finish him off with ease.

98460.name: Jinmen
98460.desc: Jinmen is a devil with a shell like turtle. However, the shell has the faces of all the humans he's ever consumed. Instead of killing them, they remain alive as a part of him. In the manga, Sachiko, who used to be Akira's neighbor, falls victim to Jinmen. In the OAV, it is Akira's mother.

98460.name: Zenon
98460.desc: Zennon is among the most powerful of the demon kind, and Satan's second-in-command alongside Psycho Jenny. While Satan was away, he assumed the role of the leader of the demon race. Zennon is highly respected and feared among his people, with most referring to him as Lord Zennon. (Source: Devilman Wiki)

98460.name: Agwell
98460.desc: Is a devil sent by Sirene to attack Akira.

98460.name: Kaim
98460.desc: Devil that sacrificed himself and merged with Silence in order to help her against Devilman.

98460.name: Babo
98460.desc: A member of Wamu’s gang, Babo is often seen with the gang but never speaks unless it is to rap. ~!He ultimately betrays the gang.!~ (Source: Wikipedia)

98460.name: Professor Fikira
98460.desc: Professor Fikira was a Russian scientist who had discovered evidence of demon kind. He replaces Professor Asuka (Ryo's father in the manga) within the anime.

98460.name: Koji Nagasaki
98460.desc: Koji Nagasaki is Makimura Miki's manager and photographer in the Devilman Crybaby. He came from a bad background and dreams of becoming a respected reporter. (Source: Devilman Wiki, edited)

98460.name: Wamu
98460.desc: Wamu is the leader of a small street gang in Devilman Crybaby consisting of Gabi, Hie, Babo, and Kukun. ~!He has feelings for Miki Makimura, and helps her and Akira Fudo when chaos digs its claws on the world.!~

98460.name: Gabi
98460.desc: Gabi is part of a group of rappers alongside Wamu, Kukun, Babo, and Hie. (Source: Devilman Wiki, edited)

98460.name: Kukun
98460.desc: Kukun is a rapper and label cleaner who lives near Miko's building. He often appears to make small-talk with her after seeing her continuously seeing her planting and watering flowers. (Source: Devilman Wiki)

98460.name: Hie
98460.desc: Hie is the beatboxer for a group of rappers alongside Wamu, Gabi, Babo, and Kukun. (Source: Devilman Wiki, edited)

98460.name: Moyuru Koda
98460.desc: Moyuru Koda is a track athlete from Kawa High. (Source: Devilman Wiki, edited)

98460.name: Tako
98460.desc: Tako is the pet cat of Makimura family. ~!It later transforms into "devilcat" and becomes Akira Fudo's aide. During final battle against Satan, he attempts to attack the angel directly, but getting killed again, this time by Satan's telepathic slash.!~

98460.name: Kaori Fudou
98460.desc: Akira's mother.

98460.name: Reijirou Fudou
98460.desc: Akira's father.

98460.name: Web Producer
98460.original: ウェブプロデューサー

98460.name: Kouzou Rainuma
98460.desc: Dr. Rainuma is a famous research biologist. After the attacks across the world by the Demon menace he became devoted to finding a way to combat the Demons and set up the Demon Busters.

98460.name: Sachiko
98460.desc: She is the girl that lived next to Fudou Akira.

12189.name: Houtarou Oreki
12189.desc: __Height:__ 172 cm (5'8") Oreki is a high-schooler with messy brown hair and green eyes. Due to his very lazy lifestyle, he almost always has a tired or bored look on his face. His hair is especially very messy when he wakes up. He is shown to be a quiet student, and never concerned about things that happens around him. Despite being shown as an average high school student, he is quite intelligent and perceptive. The reason for his usual laziness is because he wishes to "save energy". Even though he is shown to be quite lazy, he never leaves his homework undone, as pointed out by [Satoshi](https://anilist.co/character/55135). He's considered lazy and apathetic, always living on the "gray" side, and is not interested in any activities that might waste his time and energy. He actually never intended to join any club, but [his sister](https://anilist.co/character/56161) ordered him to join the Classics Club to save it from being disbanded. Even though he might not seem it, he's unbelievably good at solving mysteries and seems to be able to always find a solution if he gives it a thought. He has a habit of holding his bangs whenever he's thinking about a mystery.

12189.name: Eru Chitanda
12189.desc: __Height:__ 160 cm (5'3") Chitanda is a calm and happy person but can become very excited when new or interesting things happen, especially when it involves her club. She is described as a beautiful 16 year old girl with long black hair and purple eyes. She usually sports a cheerful expression as well as seen in her uniform. Eru is the single daughter of the Chitanda Family, one of the four remaining wealthy farming families in the area, according to [Satoshi](https://anilist.co/character/55135/Fukube-Satoshi). She joined the Classics Club due to "personal reasons", and is the president of the club due to it not retaining any members from the previous year. She likes mysteries and has a great curiosity, which often drags [Houtarou](https://anilist.co/character/55131/Oreki-Houtarou) into solving them. She often expresses her curiosity with the phrase "私気になります！" ("watashi kininarimasu"), often translated as "I'm curious!".

12189.name: Satoshi Fukube
12189.desc: __Height:__ 160cm (5'3") Satoshi went to the same middle school as Houtarou and Mayaka. He knows many things, but most of them are trivial. He's cheerful and a great match to befriend the apathetic Houtarou. He is active, already being a part of the Student Council and Handicraft Club before joining the Classics Club. He is the "database" of the club and has a very good memory. ~!It was later revealed that he is obsessed with not becoming obsessed with anything. Because of this, he steals Mayaka's Valentine's chocolates to prevent himself from becoming obsessed with her. However, he also admits that he wishes to be with her.!~

12189.name: Mayaka Ibara
12189.desc: __Height:__ 148 cm (4'10") An inseparable friend who's been in the same class with [Houtarou](https://anilist.co/character/55131/Oreki-Houtarou) since their first grade in elementary school. She is interested in [Satoshi](https://anilist.co/character/55135/Fukube-Satoshi), which leads her to join the classic literature club. She is also a member of the Library and Manga Society. She has a blunt and frank personality and usually makes nicknames for some of her friends (i.e: Fuku-chan, Chi-chan).

12189.name: Fuyumi Irisu
12189.desc: Member of Class 2-F who had been assigned late leadership of the non-official titled movie, "Mystery". She is famous through her families success in owning the general hospital. She is also an old family friend of Chitanda. ~!She manipulates Houtarou into writing the rest of the movie script.!~

12189.name: Youko Itoigawa
12189.desc: The school's 61 yr-old librarian and was the Classic Club's first president during the time of the incident. ~!Her maiden name is Kouriyama.!~

12189.name: Tomoe Oreki
12189.desc: She is the older sister of Houtarou and is the reason he joined the Classics Club. Her face is barely shown, especially her eyes.

12189.name: Masashi Tohgaito
12189.desc: Masashi, as an upperclassman to the main characters, acts a bit mature and composed. He has some secrets behind his back that he can't bare to be found wherein he even resorts to lying, just like anyone who wants to uphold their family's honor. He also the president of News Poster Club.

12189.name: Kaho Juumonji
12189.desc: A first-year student of Kamiyama High School, belonging to Class 1-D, and the only member of the school's Fortune Telling Club. She is introduced during the Kamiyama High School Festival, where her name was linked to a series of lost items during the event's duration. (Source: wiki)

12189.name: Kurako Eba
12189.desc: A close friend of Hongou's. She seems shy and reserved, and also describes Hongou as "diligent, careful, has a strong sense of responsibility, ridiculously kind, and easily moved."

12189.name: Rie Zenna
12189.desc: A relative of Maya's, and Kayo's older sister. She has a habit of writing names on her own items, not allowing her sister using them.

12189.name: Kayo Zenna
12189.desc: A relative of Maya and Rie's younger sister. Unlike her sister Rie, she tends to not put her name on anything that is rightfully hers. She is also more shy and quiet than her sister.

12189.name: Tomohiro Haba
12189.desc: The Props Master in Fuyumi Irisu's independent film. He also was one of the three detectives involved in solving the mystery of Hongou's unfinished script.

12189.name: Misaki Sawakiguchi
12189.desc: The Publicity Manager in Fuyumi Irisu's independent film. She was one of the three detectives involved in solving the mystery of Hongou's unfinished script.

12189.name: Omichi
12189.desc: Class A's math teacher. He's described by Satoshi as 'Strict but only because he's strict on himself.'

12189.name: Junya Nakajou
12189.desc: Assistant Director in Fuyumi Irisu's independent film. He was one of the three detectives involved in solving the mystery of Hongou's unfinished script.

12189.name: Jirou Tanabe
12189.desc: He is the Executive Committee President. ~!He setup the theft and the mystery incident at the annual festival.!~

12189.name: Matsushiro
12189.desc: Manga Society member. Appears in episode 13.

12189.name: Iizuka
12189.desc: Manga Society member. Appears in episode 16.

12189.name: Sawai
12189.desc: Manga Society member. Appears in episode 16.

10087.name: Artoria Pendragon
10087.original: アルトリア・ペンドラゴン
10087.desc: __Height:__ 154 cm (5'1) Artoria Pendragon, better known as Arthur Pendragon and King Arthur, is regarded as a male in history but is actually female. She is the "Once and Future King" and a legendary hero of Britain known as the King of Knights. She used to wield the sword from the stone, Caliburn, but it was eventually destroyed and the Lady of the Lake gifted her with Excalibur and Avalon. __In Fate/Prototype:__ ~!He is presented as male instead, conserving his original name of Arthur Pendragon. Also called Prototype Saber, he is the Saber-class Servant under the control of [Ayaka Sajyou](https://anilist.co/character/54223).!~ __In Fate/stay night:__ ~!Saber is summoned in the Fifth Holy Grail War as the Servant of [Shirou Emiya](https://anilist.co/character/496). Shirou had been having dreams of Excalibur in the days leading up to the start of the Holy Grail War after receiving his Command Spells and, while stumbling in his shed during his escape from [Lancer](https://anilist.co/character/499), Avalon, hidden inside him, reacts to the traces of a magic circle and summons Artoria as his Servant.!~ __In Fate/stay night: Heaven's Feel:__ ~! Corrupted by [Angra Mainyu](https://anilist.co/character/120855), Artoria is vastly different from her normal self. She is also called Saber Alter/Black Saber. The results of her alteration is not only within Artoria's interior but also extends to her outward appearance. The color of her skin becomes pale, and the pupil of her eyes that w

10087.name: Rin Tohsaka
10087.desc: __Height:__ 124 cm (Fate/Zero), 159 cm (Fate/stay night) Rin is a model student and idol of [Shirou](https://anilist.co/character/496)'s school. She barely talks to other students in her school and exhibits a desire to be left alone, as exemplified by her tendency to stay on the school's rooftop, away from the rest of the students. She is also secretly a Magus and a Master in the Fifth Holy Grail War. In the beginning of the anime, she summons [Archer](https://anilist.co/character/2087) for her Servant, although she originally wanted to summon Saber. Rin is reared as the successor to her family's magecraft, instructed by her father, [Tokiomi Tohsaka](https://anilist.co/character/16017), to prioritize sorcery over her own interests. After her father is killed, Rin continues to perfect her sorcery, with some guidance from her guardian, [Kirei Kotomine](https://anilist.co/character/506). She strives to earn the admiration of her peers to avoid drawing attention to her private life, even though she is secretly stingy, tomboyish, and a perfectionist. She is perceptive, resourceful and avidly competitive. ~!Rin is [Sakura](https://anilist.co/character/500/Matou-Sakura)'s older sister, but the two were forced to live apart by their father, Tokiomi. Rin once had a good relationship with Sakura before their separation, evident by a ribbon Sakura always kept. Rin later convinced herself that Sakura was living a happier life with the Matou family than she was living as the Tohsaka famil

10087.name: Sakura Matou
10087.desc: __Height:__ 120 cm (Fate/Zero), 156 cm (Fate/stay night) A student in her first year of high school, Sakura is the sister of [Shinji Mato](https://anilist.co/character/501). After [Shirou](https://anilist.co/character/496)'s father [Kiritsugu](https://anilist.co/character/10010) died, Sakura often visited Shirou's home to help him with his daily chores. She is outwardly shy and timid, but possesses great inner strength. Sakura has a long standing and obvious crush on Shirou Emiya.

10087.name: Illyasviel von Einzbern
10087.original: イリヤスフィール・フォン・アインツベルン
10087.desc: **Height:** 133 cm **Birthday in [Fate/kaleid](https://anilist.co/manga/33526/): **Jul 20 A young Teutonic aristocrat, she traveled to Japan to participate in the Holy Grail War as a Master. Illyasviel has an angelic appearance and an unsurpassed degree of magical power. She lives in a castle on the outskirts of Fuyuki City, accompanied only by her Servant and two maids. Illyasviel asks those she feels comfortable around to simply call her "Illya".

10087.name: Kirei Kotomine
10087.desc: __Height:__ 185 cm (Fate/Zero), 193 cm (Fate/stay night) ~!Through an agreement between the Mages' Association and the Church, the Holy Grail Wars are moderated by a priest. Kirei's father was the mediator for the 4th Holy Grail War, and when he died, Kirei felt obligated to replace him. His selection as mediator is unusual, for Kirei is a member of both the Church and Mages' Association, organizations on hostile terms with one another. Since the death of [Rin](https://anilist.co/character/498/Tohsaka-Rin)'s father, he has also acted as an indirect caretaker for Rin.!~

10087.name: Gilgamesh
10087.desc: __Height:__ 182 cm Gilgamesh is the King of Uruk, said to have reigned during the Sumer Dynasty in Mesopotamia 5000 years ago. He's the namesake Hero described in the Epic of Gilgamesh, making him the most ancient Hero on which all the others legends were modeled. This grants him the title of King of Heroes and, within his Gates of Babylon, the prototypes of all the Noble Phantasms of the Heroes yet to come. Born from the human Lugalbanda, the King of Uruk, and the goddess Rimat-Ninsun, he was a being so perfect and transcendent to the point that he was two-thirds deity and one-third human. He was the chosen one that would guide humanity on the earth that was slowly abandoning the Age of Gods, but instead he grew up to be a selfish and arrogant despot. His only friend and being he considered his equal was [Enkidu](https://anilist.co/character/60059). __In Fate/Zero:__ ~! Initially summoned as the Archer-class Servant of [Tokiomi Toosaka](https://anilist.co/character/16017/Tokiomi-Toosaka) in the 4th Holy Grail War, using the fossil of the first skin ever shed by a snake as a catalyst, he soon becomes bored with his Master and takes interest in Kirei Kotomine. Together they plot to kill Tokiomi and forge a new pact, with Gilgamesh pushing Kotomine to accept his true desires. He also takes interest in Iskandar as a worthy opponent to kill, and in Artoria, a tragic figure to take as his bride. In the end, invested by the pollution of the Holy Grail, he is gifted a mortal body an

10087.name: Kiritsugu Emiya
10087.desc: __Height:__ 175 cm __Sidearm:__ Thompson contender in conjunction with his Mystic Code Origin Bullets [Shirou](https://anilist.co/character/496)'s foster father and his savior from the aftermath of the massive Fuyuki fire. During his lifetime, Kiritsugu was disillusioned with becoming a Hero of Justice, a defender of humanity who could save everyone. Although he feels he failed to do so, his efforts were a source of inspiration for Shirou. Prior to his fateful meeting with Shirou, Kiritsugu was notorious as the "Magus Killer," a freelancer who would hunt down heretical magi. Although he was a magus with Magic Circuits and abilities he was considered unorthodox in that he would utilize modern technology and weaponry along with his magecraft to track down and kill magi. Although mentioned and seen in flashbacks in Fate/stay night, Kiritsugu is one of the main protagonists in its prequel Fate/Zero. ~!It is hinted at in certain parts of Fate/stay night and confirmed in its prequel Fate/Zero that Kiritsugu is in fact [Illyasviel von Einzbern](https://anilist.co/character/503/von-Einzbern-Illyasviel)'s biological father, making Shirou and her step-siblings.!~

10087.name: Lancelot
10087.desc: __Height:__ 191 cm __Weight:__ 81 kg In Fate/Zero ~!Berserker is the Servant of Matou Kariya during the 4th Holy Grail War. Berserker is known to have three distinct Noble Phantasms, as shown on his status page. However, due to the enchantment that obscured his identity, his status page was shown blurred, making it impossible to identify the specific names and natures of his Phantasms, save for the sword Arondight. In addition, this Berserker is uniquely able to make anything he chooses into his own Noble Phantasm and effectively wield them, from telephone poles to the Noble Phantasms of other Servants. Berserker's real identity is Lancelot of the Lake. Until his identity was revealed, he had been known simply as the Black Knight. Lancelot, known as the Knight of the Lake, had been loyal to Artoria, knowing both the king and the secrets of her sword well. Lancelot's downfall began when he loved Artoria's queen. Though the king was actually a woman, Artoria had married in order to present the image of a stable royal family before the kingdom and to maintain the illusion that she was a man in the face of the general public. Her queen willingly sacrificed her own life as a woman in order to fulfill the ideal of the stable government. However, Lancelot and the queen fell in love. Though he wanted to take her away, Lancelot's loyalty to Artoria and his sense of duty to serve the kingdom prevented him from doing so. When political enemies of the king exposed Lancelot and the queen'

10087.name: Irisviel von Einzbern
10087.original: アイリスフィール・フォン・アインツベルン
10087.desc: __Height:__ 158 cm Irisviel von Einzbern is the partner of [Saber](https://anilist.co/character/497/Pendragon-Artoria) as well as the intended vessel for the Holy Grail. She is the mother of [Illyasviel von Einzbern](https://anilist.co/character/503/von-Einzbern-Illyasviel). Like her daughter, Irisviel is a homunculus, an artificial being created by the Einzbern. She was raised to be a puppet with no desires, but found happiness in her existence when she gave birth to Illyasviel. She is married to [Kiritsugu Emiya](https://anilist.co/character/10010/Emiya-Kiritsugu), the biological father of her daughter.

10087.name: Tokiomi Toosaka
10087.desc: The father of [Rin](https://anilist.co/character/498/) and [Sakura](https://anilist.co/character/500/), two of the heroines from Fate/stay night. As a member of the Tohsaka family, he entered the Fourth Holy Grail War as the Master of Archer ([Gilgamesh](https://anilist.co/character/2514/)). [Kiritsugu Emiya](https://anilist.co/character/10010/) identifies Tokiomi as one of the two most threatening magi involved in the war after assessing all the Masters involved. Tokiomi is an arrogant and manipulative man who strives, as all-powerful magi do, to reach Akasha, or "the root of all knowledge". Although he cares for his daughters and his wife, he appears to be oblivious to the problems and pain they face due to his decisions.

10087.name: Aoi Tohsaka
10087.desc: __Height:__ 160 cm Aoi Tohsaka is the childhood friend of Kariya Matou, and became the wife of Tokiomi Tohsaka, adopting his surname. She is the mother of Tokiomi's two daughters, Rin and Sakura. Aoi is a passive and loyal woman who does not interfere with her husband's affairs, described by Kirei Kotomine as the ideal version of a traditional wife. She accepted Tokiomi's proposal with full knowledge of what it meant to marry a mage. While Kariya loved her as well, he peacefully gave up pursuing her affections because she seemed happy accepting Tokiomi's proposal. It is implied that Aoi and Kariya remained in touch, given that her daughters, especially Sakura, were fond of Kariya's company.

10087.name: Ryuunosuke Uryuu
10087.desc: __Height:__ 174 cm __Weight:__ 65 kg The master of Caster, Ryuunosuke is a serial killer who summons Caster after murdering a family and using their blood as a component in the summoning ritual. Though he is not a magus, he was selected by the Holy Grail to fulfill the war's requirement of seven Masters and seven Servants. Ryuunosuke knows nothing about magic or the fourth Holy Grail War; his involvement in the war is simply to watch Caster kill people in unique and thrilling ways to relieve boredom. (source: Type-Moon Wiki)

10087.name: Maiya Hisau
10087.desc: __Height:__ 161 cm A young woman who acts as [Kiritsugu Emiya](https://anilist.co/character/10010/Emiya-Kiritsugu)'s assistant during the fourth Holy Grail War. She is cold and professional, which makes it easier for Kiritsugu to act as he needs to. Little is known about her history, save that Kiritsugu had rescued her from a war-torn land many years ago. When Maiya was a child, she was forced into the army and trained to be a soldier. She later reveals to [Irisviel von Einzbern](https://anilist.co/character/15164/von-Einzbern-Irisviel), Kiritsugu's wife, that she had been raped by other soldiers and later lost her child. After rescuing her, Kiritsugu became Maiya's mentor and taught her his way of life.

10087.name: Iskandar
10087.desc: __Height:__ 212 cm __Master:__ [Waver Velvet](https://anilist.co/character/16023/Waver-Velvet) __Catalyst:__ Mantle once worn by Iskandar himself __Holy Grail War No.:__ 4th Holy Grail War In Fate/Zero ~!Rider was originally meant to be summoned by Lord Kayneth El-Melloi Archibald, but due to some circumstances, he ended up being Waver Velvet's servant. Iskandar, or how he refers to himself, the King of Conquerors is a noble and courageous man, who prefers to conquer his enemies by winning without killing and controlling without humiliating. He is known as a marvelous ruler who once almost conquered the whole known world. He is not pragmatic, but is a person who lets history run its course and acts according to his impulses. While he is wild and somewhat inconsiderate to others, his greed ultimately resulted in the happiness of the people he ruled over. In the new era, Rider is mostly amazed by ordinary modern things, and usually spends his free time exploring modern war vehicles and machinery.!~

10087.name: Diarmuid  Ua Duibhne
10087.original: ディルムッド・オディナ
10087.desc: __Height:__ 184 cm __Weight:__ 85 kg __Master:__ Kayneth Archibald El-Melloi In Fate/Zero ~!Lancer is the Servant of Kayneth Archibald El-Melloi during the 4th Holy Grail War. Lancer is generally even-tempered, and absolutely loyal to his Master. He is known for his chivalry and sense of honor, in contrast to the arrogant personality of Kayneth. He shares a bond of mutual respect with rival Servant Saber, his greatest wish being to face her in fair combat. Lancer is summoned by Kayneth Archibald El-Melloi in the 4th Holy Grail War, who originally intended to summon Rider-class Servant, Iskandar. Because his pupil Waver Velvet stole the artifact he had meant to use as a catalyst, Kayneth summoned Diarmuid Ua Duibhne in Iskandar's stead. Lancer's contract with Kayneth is unique in that, while Kayneth holds the Command Spells, the energy to materialize the Servant is maintained by Sola-Ui, Kayneth's fiancée. His true identity is Diarmuid Ua Duibhne, the son of Donn, foster son of Aengus Óg and a warrior of the Fianna. Known as Diarmuid of the Love Spot, the appellation resulted from an encounter with Gráinne, a woman who caused a magical love spot to appear on his head. Any woman who looked upon his face would instantly fall in love with him.!~ (Source: Wikipedia)

10087.name: Waver Velvet
10087.original: ウェイバー・ベルベット
10087.desc: __Height:__ 157 cm ~!185 cm (As Lord El-Melloi II)!~ Waver Velvet is a nineteen year old student at Clock Tower, an institute of the Magus Association, and mage with a recognized magical lineage of three generations. While he is talented, he is not recognized by his peers or lecturers. An intelligent young man, Waver came up with the revolutionary concept that a mage's power could be increased through effort, experience, and knowledge rather than increasing magical potential through that of a mage's heirs. His idea is dismissed by his lecturer, the nobleman [Kayneth Archibald El-Melloi](https://anilist.co/character/16028), who tears up Waver's manuscript without another thought. ~!The Fourth Holy Grail War drastically changed his life, and before he realized it, he was suffering under the weight of the El-Melloi family’s mantle as one of the twelve Lords that rule and manage the Clock Tower, and the current head of the El-Melloi family. He wears his long hair straight, but it is kept quite well.!~ ~!He also became a famous lecturer in the Clock Tower. Despite being hopeless as a magus, his skill as a lecturer dominates the rest, and is the best person at detecting the hidden talent of others and training it. There are no magi that were his students that hadn't obtained the rank of Grand, and it's even been said that if he gathered his students together, the power chart in the Clock Tower would change.!~

10087.name: Gilles de Rais
10087.desc: __Height:__ 196 cm In Fate/Zero ~!He is the Servant of Ryuunosuke Uryuu during the 4th Holy Grail War. Caster derives pleasure from first providing his victims with a moment of relief and hope, before killing them in a variety of horrific manners. Caster was summoned shortly before the Fourth Holy Grail War began. His Master was Ryuunosuke Uryuu, a serial killer who unwittingly performed a successful summoning ritual using the blood of a murdered family. Like his Master, he is almost devoid of any morality and has no interest in obtaining the Holy Grail. He enjoys offering his victims brief moments of respite, or even the hope of release or escape, before inflicting death through gruesome and horrific means. According to Caster, allowing his victims hope will amplify the despair and terror upon their moment of death, a fact that he revels in. He also uses his magic to warp and twist humans into contraptions for his Master's entertainment, such as turning a girl into a pipe organ. In his past life, he was a French nobleman who was once a comrade-in-arms of Jeanne of Arc. He first introduces himself to his Master as Bluebeard, which is the name of a fictional character based on Gille himself.!~

10087.name: Hassan-i-Sabbah
10087.desc: One of the nineteen leaders of the Hashshashin sect and the 19th who took the name of Hassan-i-Sabah and the mantle of Old man of the Mountain. This particular individual suffered from Multiple Personality Disorder which he utilized to compartmentalize his abilities. This gave his Noble Phantasm the ability to manifest his different personalities as separate and autonomous entities. Though they differ in terms of build and sex, the different personas share similar characteristics: they have dark brown skin, purple hair (for those who have it) and wear white skeletal masks. Like all other Hassan-i-Sabah, he can be summoned only in the Assassin Class with the class itself acting as a catalyst. __Personas:__ • Asako (アサ 子) • Big Assassin (でかアサシン) • Child Assassin (ちびアサシン) • Macour the Quick (迅速のマクール) • Strange Arm Gozour (怪腕のゴズール) • Zayd the Base (基底のザイード) • more... __In Fate/Zero__ ~! Assassin serves as the Servant of Kirei Kotomine in the 4th Holy Grail War being mainly occupied with reconnaissance duties. The main personality that interfaces with Kirei is a young woman by the name of Asako.!~

10087.name: Kariya Matou
10087.desc: __Height:__ 173 cm Kariya Matou is the uncle of [Shinji Matou](https://anilist.co/character/501), and the first scion of his family to be born with magical potential in several generations. Despite this, he grew disgusted with his family, particularly [Zoken Matou](https://anilist.co/character/16030), and cut all ties with them more than ten years prior to the 4th Holy Grail War. Disappointed with the lack of magical abilities in Shinji, Zoken resented Kariya for allowing the family's magical lineage to decline, especially since a Matō with magical powers was necessary to act as a Master during the Holy Grail Wars. Kariya maintained contact with his childhood friend and love interest [Aoi Zenjou](https://anilist.co/character/16018), though he had willingly given up trying to pursue her affections after she married [Tokiomi Tohsaka](https://anilist.co/character/16017). Aoi would later have two daughters, [Rin](https://anilist.co/character/498) and [Sakura](https://anilist.co/character/500), who were both fond of Kariya. ~!On the last day of the 4th Holy Grail War, [Berserker](https://anilist.co/character/12732) faces off against [Saber](https://anilist.co/character/497), culminating in a battle so ferocious that Berserker draws more mana than Kariya can provide. His Servant killed, Kariya survives long enough to make his way back to the Matou estate, where he is approached by Sakura. He tells her that he has come to rescue her, but collapses at her feet soon after. Kariya dies

10087.name: Jubstacheit von Einzbern
10087.original: ユーブスタクハイト・フォン・アインツベルン
10087.desc: The eighth and current head of the Einzbern family. He wasn't around during Justica's era, but he has kept himself alive for nearly two centuries by continuously prolonging his life. He has a white beard that makes one think of a frozen waterfall, and Emiya Kiritsugu notices an astute light from his eyes that makes it impossible to see any senility and constantly brings about a feeling of bias and pressure every time Acht's gaze meets him. (Source: Wikipedia)

10087.name: Kayneth Archibald El-Melloi
10087.original: ケイネス・エルメロイ・アーチボルト
10087.desc: __Height:__ 181 cm __Weight:__ 62 kg A nobleman and a renowned mage from the Magus Association, Kayneth was a prodigy among magi, possessing exceptional magical potential and skills. He held the title of Euryphis lecturer within the Clock Tower, a notable mage academy, despite his young age. His magical lineage, going back nine generations, further enhanced his status. His magical abilities were attributed to wind and water, and he is proficient in the magical arts of summoning, alchemy, and spiritual evocation. He is also a teacher of Waver Velvet's, and was responsible for rejecting and tearing up Waver's radical thesis concerning magical potential. This act was in turn directly responsible for driving Waver to, in retaliation, enter the fourth Holy Grail War by stealing a valuable artifact from Kayneth. Lord El-Melloi is, with regard to magical ability, arguably the most skilled Master in the Fourth Holy Grail War. He excels in magic involving mercury, which he employs to create a variety of attack and defence forms, such as barriers strong enough to resist point blank Claymore Mine blasts and flying blades capable of slicing through stone walls. Lord El-Melloi's mastery is great enough such that his enchanted mercury can react without his conscious control, automatically forming shields against surprise attacks. Kiritsugu Emiya initially regards Kayneth as one of the two most threatening magi involved in the war alongside Tokiomi Tōsaka, though neither are considered the

10087.name: Risei Kotomine
10087.desc: Kirei Kotomine's 80 year old father, Risei is a priest in the Church and the regulator of the third and fourth Holy Grail Wars. A friend of Tokiomi Tōsaka's, Risei actively supports him and conspires to ensure that Tokiomi will obtain the Holy Grail in the war, despite the fact that as a member of the Church, he should be ensuring only someone who is worthy of the a powerful artifact like the Grail should be obtaining it. While he is proud of his son, who has demonstrated himself to be a perfect heir, Risei fails to understand Kirei in any sense. He believes that his son, who has recently lost his wife of two years, may be able to find some purpose in life again by aiding Tokiomi during the Holy Grail War. Both Risei and Tokiomi, upon discovering that Kirei's command mantra had appeared three years before the start of the war, both came to believe that Kirei was destined to provide Tokiomi with an additional Servant and associated command spells for the upcoming war. Without informing Kirei as to the true nature of the mark that appeared, they transfer Kirei from the Church to the Mages Association as Tokiomi's pupil. Neither man reveals to Kirei that he can also obtain the Holy Grail, instead telling the young man that he is performing a mission for the Church. ~!According to Kirei Kotomine in Fate, his father died trying to protect him. As revealed in Fate/Zero, after Caster's defeat, Kayneth Archibald El-Melloi approached Risei to obtain additional command spells. After Ri

10087.name: Zouken Matou
10087.desc: A shrewd, powerful, but ancient sorcerer, Zoken is the patriarch of the Matou family and is known to be the grandfather of Shinji and Sakura. He has amassed a large and extensive library of sorcerous knowledge, yet his lessons are strict and harsh. Zoken considers Shinji to be a disgrace of a sorcerer and believes Sakura may have more potential than her brother.

10087.name: Sola-Ui Nuada-Re Sophia-Ri
10087.original: ソラウ・ヌァザレ・ソフィアリ
10087.desc: __Height:__ 165 cm The daughter of the head of the spiritual evocation division of the Clock Tower of the Magus Association. She is engaged to Kayneth Archibald El-Melloi as a result of a strategic marriage arrangement. As her older brother (to whom the Sophia-Ri family had entrusted its magic crest) had achieved little success as a mage, her family sought to marry her to the celebrated Lord El-Melloi in an attempt to salvage the family name. Sola-Ui is introduced in Volume 2 of Fate/Zero as Kayneth's fiancée - and apparently one who does not get along with her intended husband. While Kayneth acts as Lancer's Master, Sola-Ui is revealed to be the one supplying the Servant with magical energy. Sola-Ui openly calls Kayneth a coward for not facing the other Masters face-to-face, and criticizes his tactics when commanding Lancer in battle. However, she is chastised by Lancer, who resents her reprimanding of his Master, and immediately backs down. Kayneth in turn views her apparent submission to Lancer as evidence of her developing affections for the Servant. (Source: Wikipedia)

10087.name: Natalia Kamiński
10087.original: ナタリア・カミンスキー
10087.desc: A freelance mercenary who sold information concerning Noritaka and his research on vampires. She rescues a young Kiritsugu and takes him as her apprentice. During her last mission, she is able to successfully kill a Dead Apostle, ~!but dies when Kiritsugu shoots down the plane she is on to prevent the infected passengers from infecting others when the plane landed. Kiritsugu's last words to her reveal that he viewed her as his mother.!~

10087.name: Leysritt
10087.desc: Leysritt is a homunculus created by the Einzbern family to serve as a maid much like Sella. Despite her appearance, she is only about two years old. Regardless of her thin ego, she developed a sense of reason due to her alignment with Illya. As a result, Leysritt often says what she thinks without any consideration and this gets her often into a verbal conflict with Sella. She and Illya are actually very close friends and should Illya die, Leysritt would die as well. In contrast to Sella, she possesses a casual personality but has difficulty expressing her emotions and comes across as robotic at times. However, she appears to enjoy teasing Sella and also takes a liking to Shirou because his presence makes Illya happy.

10087.name: Martha Mackenzie
10087.original: マーサ・マッケンジー

10087.name: Glen Mackenzie
10087.original: グレン・マッケンジー

10087.name: Fionn mac Cumhaill
10087.desc: Fionn mac Cumhaill is leader of the Fianna knights of legend and lord of Diarmuid Ua Duibhne, the Lancer of the 4th Holy Grail War. ~! He was the intended husband of Princess Grainne, whom Diarmuid inadvertently charmed with his Mystic Face. He was thus forced to elope with her, and Fionn, driven by jealousy, sent many pursuers after them. After some times, Fionn acknowledged their marriage, and reconciled with Diarmuid. Still, his resentment remained, and eventually drove him to leave Diarmuid for death when the warrior was fatally injured by a boar during their hunting trip. Even after his death, Diarmuid resented neither Fionn nor Grainne, and regretted only that he could not follow his path of loyalty to Fionn. For this reason, Diarmuid participated in the War, in order to have a second chance of fighting for his master. !~

10087.name: Grainne
10087.desc: Princess Gráinne, daughter of the High King of Ireland Cormac mac Airt is the betrothed of Fionn mac Cumhaill, leader of the Fianna knight and lord of Diarmuid Ua Duibhne, the Lancer of the 4th Holy Grail War. ~! True to the legend, she fell in love with Diarmuid under the influcence of his Mystic Face (originated from the beauty mark under his right eye), and placed a geis on him so that he would run away with her on the night of her wedding to Fionn. As Diarmuid considered the geis a test of his honor, and knew that Gráinne fell prey to his curse, Diarmuid accepted her proposal and the two fled, besieged by Fionn's many warriors on the way. Finally, when Fionn accepted their marriage, Diarmuid was overjoyed to return to his service. During a wild boar hunt, Diarmuid was fatally injured, and nothing but water drunk from Fionn's hands could save him. However, due to his lingering resentment, Fionn let the water slipped from his hands twice, and when he brought the water back to Diarmuid for the third time, Diarmuid was dead.!~

10087.name: Kotone
10087.desc: Rin's classmate.

10087.name: Mordred Pendragon
10087.desc: Mordred is the "son" of [King Arthur](https://anilist.co/character/497/Pendragon-Artoria) though, in reality, she is a woman. [Morgan le Fay](https://anilist.co/character/239533/le-Fay-Morgan), Artoria's sister, created Mordred as a homunculus clone of the King. Morgan grew Mordred in secret, inculcating her the desire to usurp the King and ascend to the throne as the rightful heir. To achieve this objective Mordred was made to be one of the Knights of the Round Table. With time Mordred grew to idolize her "father", but the King refused to recognize her as a rightful heir. These clashing feelings of love and hate made Mordred play an important role in the fall of Camelot. __In Fate/Apocrypha:__ ~!Mordred is the Saber-class Servant of [Kairi Shishigou](https://anilist.co/character/122397/Shishigou-Kairi) as part of the Red Faction in the Turifas Holy Grail War.!~

10087.name: Jeanne  d'Arc
10087.desc: __Height:__ 159 cm (5'3) Ruler's True Name is Jeanne d'Arc, the Saint of Orleans. A Catholic saint born in Domrémy, France, and the heroine of France who liberated Orléans in the Hundred Years' War. A Ruler Class Servant is the Standard-Bearer who Correctly Guides the Holy Grail War. Jeanne is a special Heroic Spirit summoned by the Holy Grail itself to act as the administrator of the Holy Grail War instead of the Church. Being summoned in the Ruler class also allows her to retain the memories of each repeating "game" unlike other Servants. Jeanne d'Arc was a common farmer's daughter. She claims she had received the command of God to fight. She heard the Lord’s lament that the world changed straight into hell. The Lord wept into sorrow as no one could stop it and people were not even allowed to live simply, and were compelled to become either beasts or food. Conflict never ended, and blood continued to rain incessantly and soak the land. She received a revelation from the Lord, the voice contained no glory or victory, no obligation or sense of purpose but only the Lord laments. She caught his small, feeble murmurs that everyone else failed to hear. Jeanne also has a minor cameo in the second season of Fate/Zero.

10087.name: Dekorou
10087.desc: He’s a soldier from Iskandar’s Ionioi Hetairoi.

10087.name: Eumenes
10087.desc: Eumenes is a soldier of Iskandar's army. He is a Non-classed Servant summoned by Iskandar's Noble Phantasm Ionioi Hetairoi. Eumenes has long dark hair and closely resembles Lord El-Melloi II, Iskandar's Master.

10087.name: Chuu Wake
10087.desc: A soldier from Iskandar’s Ionioi Hetairoi.

10087.name: Ptolemy
10087.desc: Ptolemy is a soldier of Iskandar's army. He is a Non-classed Servant summoned by Iskandar's Noble Phantasm Ionioi Hetairoi. Like all of his fellow comrades in Ionioi Hetairoi, he is unquestionably loyal to Iskander and always supports his cause. While this younger version embodies his youth as a soldier under Alexander the Great, his older version embodies him as an old man and the ruler of Egypt.

20474.name: Joutarou Kuujou
20474.desc: __Height:__ 195 cm (6'5") __Occupation:__ Student, Marine Explorer, Oceanographer __Nationality:__ Japanese Joutarou is Holly Kujo's son and [Joseph Joestar](https://anilist.co/character/6356)'s grandson. In Part 3, he has a recognizable attire of a blue trenchcoat-length school uniform jacket with yellow chains on the collar. He also wears a trademark hat which, while torn in the back, often seems to blend with his hair. When Joutarou first appears, he turned himself in to the police because he believes his Stand is an evil spirit possessing him. After he is released from jail, and learns what his Stand is, Joutarou gets used to Star Platinum -- a fierce, muscular, vaguely Aztec-looking spirit with "the precision of a machine" and the ability to destroy virtually anything with a sledgehammer barrage of fists. He has a very tough exterior, and is even rather rough and delinquent, but he also is very dedicated, intense, and loyal. He is very intelligent, but usually lets his (or Star Platinum's) fists do the talking with the enemy, even though he often has to rely on his wits to deal with stand users' attacks. He is also known for a quick and short temper. His catchphrase is "Yare yare daze." It generally relates of being bored or exasperation. In Part 3, he is the main target of [Dio](https://anilist.co/character/4004), who realizes that Joutarou is his greatest threat. One of the strongest stands in the JoJo universe; Star Platinum possesses super human senses, strength, sta

20474.name: Dio Brando
20474.desc: __Height:__ 195 cm (6'5") __Race:__ Human (formerly), Vampire (onwards) __Nationality:__ British Dio is an immortal vampire and the arch rival of the Joestar clan. __Series 1: Phantom Blood__ ~!Dio is the son of [Dario Brando](https://anilist.co/character/74099/Brando-Dario), an alcoholic and abusive father. Back when Dio was just a boy, he was brought into the household of [George Joestar](https://anilist.co/character/21956/Joestar-I-George) after the mysterious death of his father, so as to repay the debt he owed Dio's father for saving his life. But soon Dio's personality caused trouble for George's young son, [Jonathan Joestar](https://anilist.co/character/8087/Joestar-Jonathan). Even more of a sociopath than his father, Dio was resolute to shatter Jonathan's spirit and take his place as the favored son, even going so far as to arrange for Jonathan's dog [Danny](https://anilist.co/character/222601/Danny) to be burned to death. Initially, Dio is able earn the trust of the patriarch of the Joestar family through deceit (and at Jonathan's expense). However, his plans of taking over the Joestar household were discovered by Jonathan when he discovered that not only had Dio poisoned his biological father to death, he was doing the same to his adoptive father, all to take the Joestar estate for his own. Determined not to be stopped, and understanding the potential to enjoy power over all things instead of just the Joestar estate, Dio wears and activates the Stone Mask, becoming

20474.name: Jean-Pierre Polnareff
20474.original: ジャン＝ピエール・ポルナレフ
20474.desc: __Height:__ 185 cm (6'1") Jean-Pierre Polnareff is a Frenchman who joins the Joestar group on their journey to Egypt after being freed from Dio's control by the group. He aims to avenge the murder of his sister. His brash nature and overconfidence combined with his general tomfoolery is often the source of trouble throughout the journey, and other members of the group often remark on his tendency to endanger himself and others. ~!Polnareff reappears in 2001 (Part 5), now 36 years old and wheelchair-bound, to assist [Giorno](https://anilist.co/character/10529/Giovanna-Giorno) and the rest of Passione in their fight against the boss.!~ He also serves as the inspiration for many characters in other franchises such as [Guile](https://anilist.co/character/9312/Guile) (Street Fighter), [Paul](https://anilist.co/character/285435/Phoenix-Paul) (Tekken), [Benimaru Nikaido](https://anilist.co/character/61203/Nikaido-Benimaru) (King of Fighters).

20474.name: Joseph Joestar
20474.original: ジョセフ・ジョースター
20474.desc: __Height__: 195 cm (6'5") Joseph Joestar begins as a young Englishman in New York, with his grandmother [Erina](https://anilist.co/character/21937). However, an attack by [Straits](https://anilist.co/character/21961) and the disappearance of [Robert Edward O Speedwagon](https://anilist.co/character/21938) soon involve him in the greater chain of events.

20474.name: Jonathan Joestar
20474.original: ジョナサン・ジョースター
20474.desc: __Height:__ 195 cm __Nationality:__ British __Occupation:__ Archaeologist Born the unique son of the wealthy businessman [George Joestar I](https://anilist.co/character/21956), Jonathan is an honest, kind, and positive man whose life is fraught with tragedy after meeting his adopted older brother - and series antagonist - [Dio Brando](https://anilist.co/character/4004). In his battle against Dio, Jonathan becomes a Ripple user under the tutelage of the master [Will Anthonio Zeppeli](https://anilist.co/character/18062). **Part 5:**~!Jonathan is the biological father of [Giorno Giovanna](https://anilist.co/character/10529), the protagonist of Vento Aureo, as well as a handful of other illegitimate offspring.!~

20474.name: Noriaki Kakyouin
20474.desc: __Height:__ 178 cm (5'10") __Stand:__ Hierophant Green Kakyoin is a high school student and user of the stand Hierophant Green. Unlike most stand users, Kakyoin was born with his stand, though it caused him to feel like an outsider for most of his life due to not knowing any other stand users. Until meeting the rest of the main characters, Hierophant was Kakyoin’s only real friend. Hierophant is not physically strong, but is elastic and can able to unravel into tentacles which can capture opponents. It can also enter an enemy’s body to possess them, though Kakyoin rarely uses this ability. Hierophant’s signature power is emerald splash, which hurls emeralds that slice opponents. Kakyoin remains calm and collected even in dangerous situations, and is good at seeing through opponents’ strategies. During a trip to Egypt with his family, he encountered [Dio](https://anilist.co/character/4004/Brando-Dio), who controlled him using a flesh bud. It was later removed by [Jotaro](https://anilist.co/character/4003/Kuujou-Joutarou) and Kakyoin joined the Joestar group.

20474.name: Mohammed Avdol
20474.original: モハメド・アヴドゥル
20474.desc: __Height:__ 188 cm (6'2") __Stand:__ Magician's Red Avdol is a fortune teller and friend of [Joseph Joestar](https://anilist.co/character/6356/Joestar-Joseph). They met three years before the events of the story. He was born with a stand, Magician’s Red, which controls fire. This stand’s abilities include Crossfire Hurricane, which shoots fire in the shape of an Ankh, and Crossfire Hurricane Special, which splits into multiple Ankh-shaped flames. He can also create flame tracker that detects a person’s energy. Avdol presents himself as a serious person but can sometimes let his emotions get the best of him. He often acts as the voice of reason among the Joestar group and exhibits strong loyalty by frequently placing himself in danger to protect his friends. He is knowledgeable about geography and stands, enjoys India’s chaotic atmosphere, and respects [Polnareff](https://anilist.co/character/4368/Polnareff-JeanPierre)'s chivalrous attitude that he displayed when they first met. Avdol gives [Jotaro](https://anilist.co/character/4003/Kuujou-Joutarou)'s stand its name. ~!Avdol encountered [DIO](https://anilist.co/character/4004/Brando-Dio) in Egypt before the main events of the story, but was able to escape unscathed.!~ ~!At one point he is shot by [Hol Horse](https://anilist.co/character/16557/Horse-Hol) and presumed dead, but he was actually in hiding and rejoins the Joestar group later. He is killed protecting Polnareff and [Iggy](https://anilist.co/character/21089/Iggy) from

20474.name: Hol Horse
20474.desc: **Height**: 188cm *(anime)* Hol Horse is a minor antagonist in JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Stardust Crusaders (first seen in Chapter 141 and Episode 10), as well as one of the main characters of Crazy Diamond's Demonic Heartbreak. He is a tall, blonde-haired cowboy-themed mercenary, serving under Dio and his army of other Stand Users. He considers himself "The #2", preferring to work as support with a partner due to his cowardice and caution. He also respects women, no matter how pretty, or how ugly, as seen with his ex, Nena. His Stand is Emperor, named after the Tarot Card of the same name. It manifests itself as a retro-futuristic pistol, which functions as a normal firearm, although the bullets are able to change their trajectory to Hol Horse's command. ~!He is seemingly fatally injured by his own Stand's bullets in Chapter 221 (and episode 37 of the anime), but manages to survive and go into hiding, fearing Dio's punishment for failing his mission of killing the Joestar group.!~

20474.name: Iggy
20474.desc: __Height:__ 33.3 cm __Nationality:__ American Iggy is a boston terrier who wields a stand known as The Fool, which is able to manipulate sand. Since The Fool is made of sand, damaging it will not hurt Iggy. He creates various objects out of sand including the wings of a glider and a statue of DIO. Iggy is depicted as rude and disobedient, as shown by his tendency to chew on people’s hair while farting on them. He loves coffee-flavored gum. Iggy was previously owned by a rich man, but he ran away and became a stray in New York. Avdol caught him and brought him to Egypt to help the Joestar group defeat DIO. He frequently chews Polnareff’s hair and once put chewed gum inside Jotaro’s hat. ~!At first, Iggy seems indifferent towards the Joestar’s quest to defeat DIO. Then he accidentally finds DIO’s mansion and is attacked and injured by Pet Shop, causing his hatred for DIO to grow. He is killed after saving Polnareff from Vanilla Ice.!~ He was initially drawn as realistic dog, but as the story progressed, his face gradually became more similar to a human’s. He is named after Iggy Pop.

20474.name: Suzie Q
20474.desc: __Height:__ 168 cm The female assistant to Lisa Lisa. Suzie Q is a slightly ditzy girl who worries for her friends. Evidently this carefree personality has not diminished even in the events of Stardust Crusaders, when she is shown enthusiastically recording her sightings in Japan on a camcorder when on a trip to see her daughter. ~!She is introduced as the female assistant to Lisa Lisa. When she first appears, she is taken over by the remains of Esidisi and attacks her friends. Thanks to a combination attack by Caesar and Joseph, she is saved with only minor injury. She marries Joseph in 1939.!~

20474.name: Narrator
20474.desc: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

20474.name: J. Geil
20474.desc: J. Geil is the man responsible for the murder of Polnareff's sister, earning him Polnareff's desire for revenge. J. Geil expend most of his time hiding from plain view, preferring to have a partner in which to rely on. This made him a perfect candidate for Hol Horse who like him believe working in pairs. He would hide in the shadows while Hol Horse broke the glass needed for his stand to work and sometimes they would do combination attack, such as Hal Horse breaking glass and J. Geil attacking while Hol Horse shot a bullet from his Stand, the Emperor, locking the enemy in a mortal circle. Like his mother he had a deformity that give him two right hands. (Source: JJBA Wikia)

20474.name: Enya Geil
20474.desc: Enya Geil is one of Dio's most loyal supporters, and the one who originally gave him the Stand Arrow, which she obtained from Diavolo. She is the mother of J. Geil. Her stand is Justice, which is able to control people through their wounds, whether alive or dead. For legal reasons, her name is changed in the American version of both the game and the manga, to N-Yah Gail and Enyaba Geil respectively. In the OVA: ~!She is able to change her appearance from that of a young woman to an old lady at will. No explanation as to why is ever given.!~

20474.name: Rubber Soul
20474.desc: Rubber Soul is a medium-height curly haired man, with his Stand granting him the ability to grow larger and to change appearance at will. He was hired by Dio with the promise of earning 100 millions as a reward for killing Jotaro. Rubber Soul does, however, have a rather disturbing personality: he is extremely rude and impolite, showing no respect nor mercy for people and animals, as they are beings that he only sees as food for his Yellow Temperance. He does not seem to be particularly intelligent, though he has a really bad temper: he wanted to ambush Jotaro with Kakyoin's appearance, but his unusual behavior blew his cover. Rubber Soul is also very violent: he attempts to kill a pickpocket by breaking his back, and remorselessly eats a dog under the eyes of its master with his Stand. In order to grow bigger, he did not hesitate to eat bugs either. From: http://jjba.wikia.com/wiki/Rubber_Soul

20474.name: Boingo
20474.desc: Boingo is a young Stand User whose Stand is Tohth. As part of the Egypt 9 Glory Gods, he attempts to assassinate the Joestar Group in Egypt alongside his older brother Oingo and later Hol Horse. Boingo is a young child of ordinary build, but his characteristics include an unusually large mouth and a large afro held together by a topless cap, leaving a few stray hair locks. His attire consists of a bright shirt and trousers over which he wears shorts and a jacket, plus a coat and simple shoes. Tohth is an Artificial Non-Humanoid Stand that takes the form of a manga. The book, titled, Oingo Boingo Brothers Adventure, will show predictions of the future. When an image appears, the prediction(s) then become fate and are destined to come to fruition. However, nobody, not even Boingo, can control the Image projected onto Tohth.

20474.name: Nena
20474.desc: Nena is a minor antagonist appearing in Stardust Crusaders. She first appears in India alongside Hol Horse and tries to assassinate Joseph Joestar while passing as an ordinary woman. She is a Stand User who uses Empress. Nena first looks like a beautiful young Indian woman in typical Indian attire. However, this is only a disguise and Nena is truly a short, ugly and overweight woman wearing a bikini. Nena also possesses a bud on her tongue. Nena used her Stand Empress to kill a beautiful young woman and wore her skin to hide her true form. (Source: Jojo Wiki)

20474.name: Holly Kuujou
20474.desc: Holly Kuujou née Joestar is the daughter of [Joseph Joestar](https://anilist.co/character/6356/) and mother of [Joutarou Kuujou](https://anilist.co/character/4003/).

20474.name: Forever
20474.desc: Forever is a malicious orangutan in DIO's service who confronts the group in the South China Sea aboard a freighter. Said ship happens to be possessed by Forever's Stand: Strength.

20474.name: Sherry Polnareff
20474.original: シェリー・ポルナレフ
20474.desc: Sherry Polnareff is Jean Pierre Polnareff's little sister who was raped and murdered by J. Geil, prompting Polnareff to seek revenge against her killer.

20474.name: Anne
20474.desc: Anne is a minor character appearing in Stardust Crusaders. Joining the Joestar Group before departing for Singapore, she somehow follows them from there to Pakistan and appears regularly alongside the main characters.

20474.name: Gray Fly
20474.desc: Gray Fly is an assassin sent by DIO who attacks the group aboard a plane traveling from Tokyo to Cairo, eventually crashing it into the ocean near Hong Kong. He is a Stand User and wields Tower of Gray.

20474.name: Steely Dan
20474.original: 鋼入りのスティーリーダン
20474.desc: Steely Dan is a Stand User using the microscopic Lovers. Steely Dan is sent to assassinate Enya the Hag and then confronts the Joestar Group in Pakistan.

20474.name: Devo
20474.desc: Devo the Cursed is an infamous Native American shaman and assassin in DIO's service. Devo ambushes Jean Pierre Polnareff in his hotel room in Singapore. He is a Stand User and uses Ebony Devil.

20474.name: Cameo
20474.desc: Cameo (カメオ Kameo) is a minor antagonist featured in Stardust Crusaders. He isolates Polnareff from the Joestar Group on a secluded island in the Red Sea while they are there to retrieve Avdol. Cameo is one of DIO's henchmen, and the Stand User behind the genie Stand, Judgement.

20474.name: Mannish Boy
20474.desc: Mannish Boy is an evil genius baby and Stand user in DIO's service. He tries to murder the Joestar Group inside the nightmare-world of his Death Thirteen.

20474.name: Arabia Fats
20474.desc: Arabia Fats is another of DIO's goons, who ambushes the Joestar Group in the middle of the Arabian desert with his Stand: Sun.

20474.name: Roses
20474.desc: Roses is the butler of Joseph Joestar and Suzi Q, also acting as the latter's personal chauffeur and bodyguard.

20474.name: ZZ
20474.desc: ZZ is another of DIO's assassins who confronts the Joestar Group. He is a Stand User who drives his Wheel of Fortune.

20474.name: Nise Captain Tennille
20474.original: 偽キャプテン・テニール
20474.desc: The impostor Captain Tennille is a minor antagonist appearing in Stardust Crusaders. He is an assassin sent by DIO who fights the Joestar Group in the middle of the ocean on their way to Egypt. He is a Stand User and wields Dark Blue Moon.

20474.name: Midler
20474.desc: Midler is the last of DIO's assassins the heroes encounter before entering Egypt. She is a Stand User, and her High Priestess attacks the group as they travel by submarine in the Red Sea.

5081.name: Koyomi Araragi
5081.desc: __Height:__ 165 cm A third year high school student who is close to failing every class except math. He is a laid-back person whose only real friend at school is [Tsubasa Hanekawa](https://anilist.co/character/22055/Tsubasa-Hanekawa). Due to events prior to Kizumonogatari and Bakemonogatari, Koyomi avoided having friends and seemed to have lost faith and trust in people and himself. ~!During spring break, he gave [Kiss-Shot](https://anilist.co/character/23602/Shinobu-Oshino) his blood and became a vampire. Although [Meme Oshino](https://anilist.co/character/22552/Meme-Oshino) helped him become human again, there are a few lingering side effects; he can see in the dark and far distances, and he heals faster than the average human. He is still scared of morning sunlight even though it no longer has any effect on him.!~

5081.name: Hitagi Senjougahara
5081.desc: __Height:__ 165 cm Hitagi, the main female character, is a weak-looking girl with an "incurable disease". She is in the same class as [Koyomi Araragi](https://anilist.co/character/22036/Koyomi-Araragi), but he has almost never heard her speak. When she was in the first year of high school, she encountered a mysterious crab, after which she became weightless. Ever since, she has avoided contact with everyone else, threatening everyone who discovers her secret. She called herself a tsundere and always speaks in an abusive style. ~!At the end of Mayoi Snail, she admits that she loves Koyomi, and subsequently enters into a relationship with him.!~ ~!After the events in Tsukihi Phoenix, she overcame all of her trauma, and became a rather cheerful and normal girl. She starts calling Araragi with a cute nickname, chuckling at small things and sending e-mails full of Emojis, although her sharp tongue is still there, but toned down.!~ ~!Hitagi has told [Hanekawa](https://anilist.co/character/22055/Hanekawa-Tsubasa) that she suffers from an Electra Complex (when a girl has intense sexual attraction towards her father). Whether this was a joke or a sincere admission has remained unrevealed!~

5081.name: Nadeko Sengoku
5081.desc: __Height:__ 153 cm Nadeko, the main character of Nadeko Snake, is [Tsukihi](https://anilist.co/character/24195/Tsukihi-Araragi)’s friend back in elementary school. She always wears a waist pouch, always casts her eyes downward, has her bangs covering her eyes, has a shy personality, and can be easily amused. [Koyomi](https://anilist.co/character/22036/Koyomi-Araragi) played with her a lot whenever she visited his house after being invited by his sisters. She refers to Koyomi as Koyomi onii-chan and appears to have feelings for him. ~!She was cursed two times by a classmate who liked the boy she rejected, and the rejected boy. While the first one is banished, Koyomi is forced to battle the second to keep it from killing Nadeko.!~ She's quite protective of her hair (particularly her forelocks) thinking that it's her place to guard more than her panties. When she finally combed her forelocks aside in Nisemonogatari, Koyomi commented that she has a glare just like a serpent, probably foreshadowing the story of Nadeko Medusa. In Nademonogatari, ~!Nadeko gains a power to draw, create, and then materialize shikigami, making her useful in the eyes of [Izuko Gaen](https://anilist.co/character/87115/Izuko-Gaen) and gets offered a job, thanks to [Yotsugi Ononoki](https://anilist.co/character/57499/Yotsugi-Ononoki)!~

5081.name: Mayoi Hachikuji
5081.desc: Mayoi is a fifth-grade elementary school girl. She always carries a big backpack, wears a hairband, and sports ponytails. ~!Ten years ago she was involved in a traffic accident and died because of it. After that she became a ghost and considers herself a "lost snail". She will unwillingly cause the people around her to become lost and unable to find their way home. The only people who can see her are people who don't want to go home in the first place. However, after [Araragi](https://anilist.co/character/22036/Koyomi-Araragi) and [Senjougahara](https://anilist.co/character/22037/Hitagi-Senjougahara) help her find the home she was looking for, she changed from an "earthbound spirit" to a "wandering spirit", a fact that she considers to be a bonus, as well as granting her to be free to wander wherever she desires. At the end of Nisemonogatari, she said goodbye to Koyomi, implying that she will not be seeing him again, which will be the basis of the next story, Mayoi Jiangshi. Her family name before her parents got divorced was Tsunade.!~

5081.name: Suruga Kanbaru
5081.desc: Suruga, the main character of Suruga Monkey, is [Koyomi](https://anilist.co/character/22036/Koyomi-Araragi)'s underclassman, ace of the school's basketball team and one of [Hitagi](https://anilist.co/character/22037/Hitagi-Senjougahara)'s acquaintances from back in junior high school. Immediately after she entered senior high school, she became aware of Hitagi's secret and was threatened by her, just like Koyomi was. She's an admitted lesbian, fujoshi, lolicon and masochist. ~!Back in elementary school, she inherited what she thought was a Monkey's Paw but was actually a Rainy Devil from her mother. She started stalking Koyomi after she discovered he was dating Hitagi. She becomes friends with Koyomi and Hitagi after Koyomi rids her of the Rainy Devil.!~ She also has been growing her hair longer since. Her next story was revealed to be Suruga Devil.

5081.name: Tsubasa Hanekawa
5081.desc: __Height__: 158 cm She styles her hair into two braids and ties them with a hair ribbon that has a cat design. She is always seen dressed in the uniform of Naoetsu Private High School, even outside of school days, and is rarely seen on any other type of clothing, except for a set of sleepwear which she wore during Tsubasa Cat Arc. Hanekawa Tsubasa is [Araragi](https://anilist.co/character/22036/Koyomi-Araragi)'s classmate and the class president. Araragi describes her as "the class president of all class presidents". Her catchphrase is "I don’t know everything, I just know what I know". Hanekawa currently lives with her stepfather and stepmother.
