Hanekawa Family's Past: ~!Her biological mother was 17 years old when she got pregnant, the biological father is unknown because she apparently had many lovers. Before she gave birth to Tsubasa, she married another man who was a "workaholic". Right after giving birth, Tsubasa's biological mother commited suicide. The workaholic stepfather, unable to raise a child, remarried again to a woman who is Tsubasa's current mother. The workaholic father soon died from overwork and the current mother married another man who is now Tsubasa's current father. !~ Hanekawa Story's overview in Nekomonogatari/Bakemonogatari: ~!Prior to the beginning of Bakemonogatari, Hanekawa was possessed by the mischievous spirit of a dead cat during Golden Week due to stress over her family. The matter was eventually resolved with the help of Shinobu at the cost

5081.name: Meme Oshino
5081.desc: Meme is a middle-aged man who lives in an abandoned building. Being an expert in apparitions field, he solves [Koyomi](https://anilist.co/character/22036/Koyomi-Araragi) and others' problems. Although he sometimes expects compensation, he does not require it always and seems to help those in need from good nature. Due to his vast knowledge of supernatural studies and general oddities, he serves as Araragi's informant during his stay in the city. Meme is a graduate of Shinto studies in college, although he never pursued the career of being a Shinto priest. Despite that, he is perfectly capable to accomplish spiritual works of a Shinto priest, such as exorcising entities and solving paranormal mysteries. He occasionally wears a Priest's outfit, as seen with the session with [Senjougahara](https://anilist.co/character/22037/Hitagi-Senjougahara) and the heavy crab. Meme's other notable accessories include an earring on his right ear and a necklace, both consisting of an inverted cross.

5081.name: Shinobu Oshino
5081.desc: A girl who lives with [Oshino Meme](https://anilist.co/character/22552/Meme-Oshino) in an abandoned building. She loves donuts from the Mister Donut chain. At the beginning of Hitagi Crab, she was renamed "Shinobu" by Meme, who suggested that the name Shinobu (忍), comprised of a heart (心) under a blade (刃), matched her original persona. ~!She appears to be an eight year old girl, but was originally a beautiful vampire who had lived for more than 500 years. After the events of Koyomi Vamp, she was left in a weakened condition with no powers or traces of her original personality, and therefore had to abandon her "Kiss-Shot Acerola-Orion Heart-Under-Blade" name. Prior to being a vampire, she was a princess of unparalleled beauty. She was referred to as "Princess Beauty" or "Acerola" during this time, the latter being her original name. Eventually, she was turned into a vampire by Deathtopia Virtuoso Suicide-Master to save her from the curse of beauty.!~

5081.name: Karen Araragi
5081.desc: __Height:__ 170 cm Karen, the main character of Karen Bee, is one of [Koyomi](https://anilist.co/character/22036/Koyomi-Araragi)'s sisters. She is older than [Tsukihi](https://anilist.co/character/24195/Tsukihi-Araragi) and always doing outdoor activities. Despite being younger, Karen is taller than Koyomi, much to Koyomi's dismay. ~!In Karen Bee, her hot-headed personality and her habit of acting before thinking lead her to be stung by a bee which leads to being poisoned with a terrible fever that lasted for 3 days. Like [Hitagi](https://anilist.co/character/22037/Hitagi-Senjougahara), she refused any help from anyone which eventually leads to her and Koyomi fighting each other. Later it was revealed that it was set up by [Kaiki](https://anilist.co/character/53641/Deishuu-Kaiki). Karen and Tsukihi are nicknamed Tsuga no Ki Nichū no Fire Sisters (栂の木二中のファイヤーシスターズ, lit. Fire Sisters of Tsuga no Ki 2nd Junior High). It was revealed that the reason she and Tsukihi found boyfriends was so that Koyomi would become jealous. They found boyfriends in Koyomi's image with Karen's boyfriend being shorter than her. She and Tsukihi also thought that Koyomi's girlfriend was [Tsubasa](https://anilist.co/character/22055/Tsubasa-Hanekawa). Koyomi, Karen and Tsukihi's parents were revealed to be police officers. !~

5081.name: Tsukihi Araragi
5081.desc: __Height:__ 156 cm Tsukihi, the main character of Tsukihi Phoenix, is one of [Koyomi](https://anilist.co/character/22036/Koyomi-Araragi)'s sisters. She's the youngest of Araragi family. Unlike her sister, [Karen](https://anilist.co/character/24194/Karen-Araragi), she is always doing indoor activities. Contrary to her personality, she constantly changes her hair style and is short-tempered to the point that Koyomi describes her as having hysteria. ~!She is actually the reincarnation of a phoenix and has been since before she was even born. The phoenix entered the baby's body when it was still in the womb and by now both beings' minds have become one. She is immortal and the only thing that end her life is a natural death from old age. It was hinted that [Kaiki](https://anilist.co/character/53641/Deishuu-Kaiki) was the one who sent [Kagenui](https://anilist.co/character/57501/Yozuru-Kagenui) and [Ononoki](https://anilist.co/character/57499/Yotsugi-Ononoki) to go after Tsukihi. Tsukihi and Karen are nicknamed Tsuga no Ki Nichū no Fire Sisters (栂の木二中のファイヤーシスターズ). It was revealed that the reason she and Karen found boyfriends was so that Koyomi would become jealous. They found boyfriends in Koyomi's image with Tsukihi's boyfriend being taller than her. She and Karen also thought that Koyomi's girlfriend was [Tsubasa](https://anilist.co/character/22055/Tsubasa-Hanekawa). Koyomi, Karen and Tsukihi's parents were revealed to be police officers. !~

5081.name: Senjougahara no Chichi
5081.desc: The father of Hitagi Senjougahara. He is often working due to being in debt after he and Hitagi's mother split. Upon noticing that Hitagi is more cheerful after being with Koyomi Araragi, he is happy that she is able to enjoy herself once again and thankful for Koyomi.

5081.name: Dramaturgy
5081.desc: Dramaturgy is a giant man over 2 meters tall and carries two flamberge swords. He is the one who took [Kiss-shot's](https://anilist.co/character/23602/Oshino-Shinobu) right leg. It's implied he may be German in Tsubasa Sleeping. He is also a Vietnam War veteran. ~!Even though he is a vampire hunter, he is a vampire himself!~

5081.name: Episode
5081.desc: A young vampire hunter who wields a giant cross as a weapon. He stole [Kiss-Shot](https://anilist.co/character/23602/Oshino-Shinobu)'s left leg. Despite his physical appearance, he's only 6 years old. Episode often says, "Gotta love it," or, "That's hilarious," as a catchphrase. He has an aggressive and arrogant personality, and has a tendency to get carried away when fighting. ~!Episode is a half-vampire, he doesn't belong to humans or vampires; due to this, he is spiteful towards both sides.!~

5081.name: Guillotine Cutter
5081.desc: Guillotine Cutter is the archbishop of a new religion he created in which believes that he is god. He is one of the three vampire hunters with Episode and Dramaturgy, who ~!stole both of Kiss-shot's arms.!~ ~!After he was defeated by Araragi, he attempts to slay a full-powered Kiss-Shot but is killed and consumed.!~

19.name: Kenzou Tenma
19.desc: Doctor Kenzo Tenma is a Japanese neurosurgeon working at the Eisler Memorial Hospital in Düsseldorf. At the beginning of Monster he is favored by the department director for his prodigious surgical skill. After a crisis of conscience, he chooses to save the life of a young boy instead of the city's mayor, and is unjustly demoted as a result; he then becomes suspect for murder when the department director and several prominent doctors are killed weeks later. It is only after nine years that Dr. Tenma learns the perpetrator of the hospital murders is none other than the boy he saved years before, [Johan Liebert](https://anilist.co/character/719). Plagued by guilt, he resolves to find Johan and end the life of this "monster" he feels responsible for creating. Despite his mission, Dr. Tenma is a humanitarian who genuinely cares about the lives of others. These acts of kindness make him very influential with the people he meets.

19.name: Johan Liebert
19.desc: Johan Liebert is the older twin son of the Lieberts, whose father Michael was an East German trade advisor who defected to the West. He is the titular "monster" and the main antagonist of the series. The mystery of his past is the focus of the plot. He is called a monster, the next Adolf Hitler and the devil himself. Johan was shot in the head as a child when his parents were killed in their home, but saved from death by [Dr. Tenma](https://anilist.co/character/718). Because of this, he regards Dr. Tenma almost as though he was his father. He claims to love his twin sister [Anna](https://anilist.co/character/720), and has some loyalty to her. Johan has spent parts of his life in different places under different names. He possesses charisma and intelligence but is also cunning, manipulative and deceitful; while he is seemingly kind, compassionate and loving to children, he is actually cold, cruel and fundamentally incapable of empathy. He uses his talents to manipulate and corrupt others, often with no apparent end than to cause suffering and destruction. His goal, as he stated when he was young, is to kill everyone that knows of his existence, and be the last one standing at the end of the world. He identifies with other killers, discovering their secrets. One of the themes of Monster is how individuals are capable of transforming into monsters; Johan often acts as both a direct and indirect catalyst for this transformation. ~! During his "perfect suicide" he was shot in the

19.name: Anna Liebert
19.desc: [Johan](https://anilist.co/character/719/Liebert-Johan)'s twin sister and the only unharmed survivor of the night when both her parents and her brother were shot in what appeared to be a botched burglary. At first she showed signs of amnesia due to the psychological trauma of the incident. After she and her brother disappeared, she was adopted by the Fortner family from Heidelberg, who were unaware of her previous identity as Anna Liebert. As Nina Fortner, she was a hardworking law student at an unnamed university (likely the University of Heidelberg), as well as an adept practitioner of Aikido. She lived her life in peace until Johan made contact with her on her twentieth birthday. She comes to pursue Johan, albeit by different methods and for a different reason than [Tenma](https://anilist.co/character/718/Tenma-Kenzou).

19.name: Heinrich Runge
19.original: ハインリッヒ・ルンゲ
19.desc: Inspector Runge is a dedicated detective belonging to the BKA, which is like the FBI of Germany. When [Dr. Tenma](https://anilist.co/character/718/Tenma-Kenzou) is accused of murder in Düsseldorf, Inspector Runge is assigned to Tenma's case. Runge moves his hand to "store" information from his cases. He has such a successful track record for solving his cases that he believes that he can't be wrong.

19.name: Wolfgang Grimmer
19.original: ヴォルフガング・グリマー
19.desc: A freelance journalist who is researching Kinderheim 511; he is also soon drawn into the search for [Johan](https://anilist.co/character/719), as he decides to help [Tenma](https://anilist.co/character/718). ~!As a former subject in 511 Kinderheim, he had developed another personality: an aggressive fighter that comes out and protects him whenever he is under dire stress, inspired by his childhood adoration for an Incredible Hulk-type TV character whom he refers to as the Magnificent Steiner. He also received training as a spy after his time in Kinderheim 511.!~

19.name: Eva Heinemann
19.desc: Eva Heinemann is [Doctor Tenma](https://anilist.co/character/718/Tenma-Kenzou)'s fiancée and the daughter of the Director of Eisler Memorial Hospital. She leaves Doctor Tenma after he is demoted by the Director for disobeying his orders. After Director Heinemann is murdered by [Johan](https://anilist.co/character/719/Liebert-Johan), she tries to return to Tenma, then recently promoted Chief of Surgery due to holes created in the staff by the murder. After being rejected by Doctor Tenma, she later becomes an extremely embittered alcoholic, a three time divorcee who uses the money from divorce settlements to finance her lavish lifestyle. After burning her house down in a drunken rage, she wanders throughout Germany and is also caught up in the investigation of the Monster. Although she does not personally suspect Dr. Tenma as having caused her father's death, one of the things she lives for is to see him suffer in prison in retribution for his rejection of her, as she had previously turned over evidence incriminating Dr. Tenma to [Inspector Runge](https://anilist.co/character/721/Runge-Heinrich). Her relationship with Tenma can be characterized as obsessive. During the series, she becomes a main target of [Roberto](https://anilist.co/character/8611/Roberto).

19.name: Dieter
19.desc: Dieter is a young boy when found by Tenma to be under the care of a man named Hartmann. Upon meeting Dieter, Tenma notices that the young boy is covered in bruises. It turns out that Hartmann was trying to make Dieter into another Johan, a kind of leader that had not been produced from 511 Kinderheim before. Dieter later becomes more optimistic after being saved by Doctor Tenma from Hartmann's physical and mental abuse. He follows Doctor Tenma in his search for Johan, partially to prevent Tenma from becoming a murderer, but also because he is fond of Tenma. He later teams up with Nina, to give her moral support whenever her traumatic memories resurface as he was also subjected to similar abuse.

19.name: Roberto
19.desc: A big, burly man and one of the many people from the orphanage 511 Kinderheim that [Johan](https://anilist.co/character/719/Liebert-Johan) controls. He admires Johan very much, and often acts as Johan's bodyguard and henchman. He is also a professional hitman with substantial proficiency. ~!His true name, already forgotten by himself, is Adolf Reinhart. [Wolfgang Grimmer](https://anilist.co/character/3096/Grimmer-Wolfgang) is the only person who remembered him and also considered him as a friend in the their childhood at the orphanage. He was shot by Tenma in chapter 73 and seemed to fall into a sea of flames, but he comes back in chapter 108 as an attorney for Tenma under the name of 'Baul', still faithful to Johan. He appears the most out of any of Johan's henchmen in the series and is a recurring enemy. He later appears in the final gunfight in the series as second-in-command of the operation. He enters a fight with Lunge and is shot in the gut, he escapes and kills Franz Bonaparte and dies of his earlier wound. First seen in Chapter 37.!~

19.name: Akanbou
19.desc: First mentioned in Chapter 25, the "Baby" is a short, elderly man, and an infamous Neo-Nazi leader. He worships Johan as an ideal Aryan leader who would be able to become the next Hitler to lead Germany into prominence. He also works for the four individuals who would gladly welcome Johan as a political leader. To this end, he hoped to use Nina as bait to coerce Johan, but also as a precautionary measure to protect him (and the other group members) from Johan. ~! This fails as Johan kills one of the first of four members in the organization. In the second half of the series he grows depressed and confides in a prostitute, he is later killed by this prostitute in a scheme engineered by Johann.!~ The characteristics of the "Baby" is heavily influenced by the character "[The Man from Another Place](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Man_from_Another_Place)" from [Twin Peaks](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Twin_Peaks). His first appearance, in Chapter 26/Episode 15, is also nearly identical, appearing to Nina Fortner from behind a red curtain (akin to the Black Lodge's waiting room) while dancing to the tune "Be My Baby". (Source: Wikipedia)

19.name: Helmut Wolf
19.original: ヘルムート・ヴォルフ
19.desc: A very old soldier who was the first one to find the twins, he is the second of the four individuals behind the organization. He gave Johan his name, the name from the boy in the picture book called "The Monster without a Name". General Wolf is actually the only one of four individuals that did not want to make Johan a new Fuhrer. Wolf's family and acquaintances have all been killed by Johan, thus teaching him true loneliness as seen through Johan's eyes. He dies of natural causes, before he dies he begs Dr. Tenma to yell out his name as proof that he existed. First mentioned in Chapter 27, first seen in Chapter 29. *Wikipedia

19.name: Christof Sievernich
19.original: クリストフ・ジーヴァーニッヒ
19.desc: Johan's disciple and another survivor of 511 Kinderheim. He and Johan decided to meet each other again in 10 years after they escaped the orphanage, and in the end they meet at a party with the guidance of Eva Heinemann, who was hired to point Johan out. His deceased stepfather was one of the four individuals of Neo-Nazi, and he was likely to succeed the post. He possesses qualities similar to Johan's and intimidated Martin, Eva Heinemann's bodyguard, by reminding him of what happened to his mother and wife. Nothing else is known about Christoph, other than that either Johan or the organization of the four individuals tried to change him into the second monster. He first appears in chapter 124. (Source: Wikipedia)

19.name: Franz Bonaparta
19.original: フランツ・ボナパルタ
19.desc: ~!Relatives: Johan Liebert (Half nephew), Anna Liebert (Half Niece), Viera Černá (Sister in law)!~ Franz Bonaparta is considered to be the one responsible for the eugenics experiment that led to the birth of the Liebert twins and is also attributed as the author of the storybooks used to indoctrinate the children of Rose Mansion. Most notable of them was The Nameless Monster, from which Johan took both is name and his mode of operation. Other famous books of his included The Big Eyed Man and the Big Mouthed Man, The God of Peace, and The Quiet Village. His storybooks deal very heavily in metaphor and symbolism, often with monsters as important characters in them. Most also deal with the idea that human nature contains the ability to become good or evil, though his works tend to denounce humanity rather than uplift it. ~!He repents for all his actions after witnessing the death of Grimmer, he confronts Johan with the intention of killing him but he is in turn killed by Roberto before he can go through with it. !~ ~!While his real name is Klaus Poppe, other names that he has used include Emil Scherbe and Jakov Vyrobek.!~ (Source: Wikipedia)

19.name: Petr Čapek
19.desc: The last individual of the organization is the mysterious man with glasses who is responsible for a large amount of incidents during Monster. He is the highest in the organization, and tried to control the devil by letting him meet with Christoph Sievernich. ~!In his youth Peter was actually Franz Bonaparta's apprentice who took part in the experiment on the Liebert twins. Peter thinks that everything is going the right way according to his plan, but Johan tells him clearly later that everything is going the right way according to his own plan. In his paranoia he kills his bodyguard when he goes for his lighter thinking he was trying to kill him, in retribution Čapek is executed by his other bodyguards. He first appeared in chapter 121, but his face isn't shown until the end of chapter 123. He was a childhood friend with Milan Kolacsh. Peter killed the loved ones that live with Milan and he tried to kill Peter at the convention but police shot Milan before he was able to take revenge. !~ Source: Wikipedia

19.name: Rudy-Ulrich Gillen
19.desc: A criminologist, and one of Tenma's former classmates; he helped Tenma by saving him from arrest and also acquiring information about Johan from all the criminals that Johan had met. He also helped Nina to recall her past, to the point of endangering his life. Rudy is able to get into some insight about Johan and how he works but despite all that he knows, he is still baffled by Johan's actions. Dr. Gillen is also a former student of Dr. Reichwein. First seen in Chapter 33. *Wikipedia

19.name: Jan Suk
19.desc: A detective with the Prague police, he tries to find the mystery involving the death of his superior, Filip Zeman. Zeman was investigating the death of a former headmaster of 511 Kinderheim with Grimmer as a possible suspect, when Suk discovered that Zeman was working with the former Czechoslovakian secret police. When three more officers are murdered, he too is cast under suspicion, and when police attempt to monitor Suk's movements, two more are killed. Suk manages to obtain a tape made by the former headmaster of 511 Kinderheim, but is badly wounded by those seeking the tape. While all this is happening, he confides to someone who he believes is Anna Liebert, a beautiful blonde woman he meets at a bar. *Wikipedia

19.name: Fritz Vardemann
19.original: フリッツ・ヴァーデマン
19.desc: A lawyer hired by residents in Dusseldorf after Tenma was arrested in Prague at one point. Vardemann has made a name for himself proving the innocence of his clients, including his father, who died in prison before being exonerated. He is married and during the series his wife gives birth to a daughter. He enjoys listening to Over the Rainbow from The Wizard of Oz. However, it is revealed later on that Vardemann found notes written by his father which may indicate that he was guilty in the first place. He then teams up with Suk in order to find out the truth regarding an author named Franz Bonaparta in the hopes of discovering the truth about his father's past as well. *Wikipedia

19.name: Hans Georg Schuwald
19.original: ハンス・ゲオルグ・シューバルト
19.desc: Known as the "Bayern Vampire", Schuwald is a recluse. He is also a successful businessman, and his success allows him to donate his book collection to the University of Munich. He also has several students from the university in his employ, reading him Latin. However, he does have a past, namely, he fathered a son with a prostitute named Margot Langer. Incidentally, Margot Langer had a friend in Prague who mothered twins. While his book dedication ceremony was targeted by Johan in a scheme to unleash terror and pandemonium, authorities believe that Schuwald is the real target and that Dr. Tenma is indeed responsible. Schuwald is first seen in Chapter 47. *Wikipedia

19.name: Karl Neumann
19.desc: A male college student at the University of Munich, who is the son of Schuwald and Langer. He is trying to get close to his father without actually letting him know that he is his son. At the same time, he is also caught up in the mystery of a dead student, and the disappearance of Johan Liebert after his father's book collection is burned in a massive inferno during a ceremony at the University Library. After he reconciles with his father, he stays on as Schuwald's personal assistant.

19.name: Lotte Frank
19.desc: A female college student also at the University of Munich who is trying to go after Karl Neumann's heart and thus aids his investigation into his father and late mother. When Karl rejects her by getting a proxy to go on a date with her, she is immensely crushed and is comforted by Nina. Given that moment, Nina and Lotte become fast friends. She too wants to know about the mysteries behind Johan Liebert as well as the death of the student who worked with them for Schuwald. First seen in Chapter 47. (Source: Wikipedia)

19.name: Otto Heckel
19.desc: A common thief who runs into Tenma in Chapter 17 when he breaks into a murder victim's house where Tenma is investigating. Heckel is not interested in solving the mystery surrounding the monster, he is more preoccupied in making quick cash by any means necessary. Nonetheless, both Tenma and Heckel must rely on each other in order to survive. (Source: Wikipedia)

19.name: Julius Reichwein
19.original: ユーリウス・ライヒワイン
19.desc: A psychologist who deals in counseling as well as assisting recovering alcoholics. He is caught up in the mystery surrounding the Monster after one of his patients, Richard Braun, supposedly dies in a drunken accident while investigating Johan Liebert. Later on, he becomes guardian to Dieter and aids Tenma in any way he can while defending Tenma's character. He also provides psychological care to Nina, Eva, and others. The Character of Dr. Reichwein bears a physical resemblance to the American Actor Wilford Brimley and Shunsaku Ban from Astroboy. Naoki Urasawa has also used the physical appearance of Brimley in the Pluto manga as well. First seen in Chapter 49.

19.name: Martin Reest
19.original: マルティン・レースト
19.desc: Martin Reest works for Baby and has worked for him for three years. He says he'll do any job as long as it doesn't involve women. He went to prison for eight years, charged for killing his girlfriend and her lover. Peter Čapek calls Martin up for a job; to look after and protect Eva Heinemann as her bodyguard after she was being targeted by Roberto. Very reluctantly Martin accepts the job and spends time looking after Eva, during which he becomes closer to her. ~!When ordered to kill her, he refuses and escapes with her.!~

19.name: Jaromír Lipský
19.original: ヤロミール・リプスキー
19.desc: Lispky appears in episode 56. He lives in Czechoslovakia and is a puppeteer, although nobody watches his performance. To earn money, he works in a restaurant to clean dishes in the evening. ~! When Anna collapses at the Mansion of Red Roses, he finds her and takes her and Dieter at his place. He cares for her for three months and after having made a puppet that looks like Anna, she and Dieter leaves to continue their journey. Lipsky is the son of Franz Bonaparta. He was a student at the Mansion of Red Roses where his father would give children reading sessions Roses, but Lipsky was considered as useless. !~

19.name: Peter Jürgens
19.original: ペーター・ユルゲンス
19.desc: ~!Commited suicide after seeing a picture of Johan.!~

19.name: Richard Braun
19.original: リヒァルト・ブラウン
19.desc: A private investigator hired by Hans Georg Schubert to investigate the supposed suicide of Edmund Farren. His alcoholism after shooting a criminal resulted in his wife and daughter leaving him. Since then, he was trying everything to piece his life back together and reconcile with his family. ~!When it came to encountering Johan Liebert after finding his tombstone, Johan lured him to the roof of a building about his role of killing a criminal in his last case. Johan manipulates Richard into a state of deep regret after which he offers Richard a bottle of whiskey. It's unknown if he took the bottle or not. Richard is later found dead after falling from the building, presumably an accident. However it is hinted that Johan may have murdered him and made it appear as if he had fallen. One clue to support that Johan murdered him is that he offered and left a broken bottle of whiskey when Dr. Reichwein knew very well that Richard only drank scotch. Both his wife and daughter are seen at his funeral mourning him.!~

19.name: Blue Sophie
19.desc: Retired prostitute turned con artist. Blue Sophie takes over the identity of Margot Langer in order to scam regret money from the deceased's lover, Hans Georg Schuwald.

19.name: Helenka Novakova
19.original: ヘレンカ・ノヴァコバー
19.desc: A prostitute who gave birth to Hans Georg Schuwald's child, Karl Neumann. After successfully leaving Prague, she worked as a high price call girl who eventually became Schuwald's lover. (source: wikipedia)

19.name: Milan Kolacsh
19.desc: Milan is a dentist who saved Tenma from being caught by the police in the Turkish Quarter in Frankfurt. He took Tenma to his place after Tenma was hit by a van while trying to escape. ~!Milan was a childhood friend with [[Peter Čapek]] and his main purpose was to kill Čapek which resulted in his death.!~

19.name: Adolf Junkers
19.original: アドルフ ユンケルス
19.desc: Adolf Junkers is a lock pick responsible for opening the doors of four houses belonging to victims of the middle-aged couple serial murders across Germany between the years of 1993 and 1995. (Source Naoki Urasawa's Monster Wiki)

19.name: Max Steindorf
19.original: マックス・シュタインドルフ

19.name: Bodyguard
19.desc: Baby's bodyguard who appears in episodes 15 and 16 of the anime.

19.name: Gunther Goedelitz
19.original: ギュンター・ゲーデリッツ

19.name: Wim Knaup
19.desc: Wim Knaup is a boy frequently bullied by his young neighbours in Ruhenheim because of his father being a good-for-nothing drunkard. Wim works as pageboy at Hotel Versteck, running errands for Mr. Klaus Poppe. Whenever he gets his salary from running errands, he takes it home for his and his father's maintenance. Most of the time, his payment goes to his father's drinking vice. For this reason, he is always bullied by some kids on the neighborhood and steal his wages.

19.name: Herbert Knaup
19.desc: Herbert Knaup is a known alcoholic in Ruhenheim. He is the father of Wim Knaup. He lives in Ruhenheim, with his son Wim Knaup. His wife left him as a result of his drunkenness. Around the time Mr. Konrad went missing, he has been kicked out from a bar, because the bartender refused to let anyone like him who gets money from his son who works for it. Herbert heard the guests inside, talking about how he is suspicious, however guys just laughed at that fact and said that he has no guts to fire a gun and that he is just a cowardly drunk. Those comments made Herbert provoked and he noticed an elderly couple, offering him a gun (a couple was ordered by Johan to give guns to the certain people in the town). He rushed into a bar, but when he arrived, everyone was already dead. He had felt that the "devil" has come to the town to destroy it. ~! He was the one who shot Johan Liebert at the end. Herbert later described him as a "monster with seven heads and many horns" who was threatening his son. He was later taken to the police for the further questioning. !~

19.name: Viera Černá
19.desc: Viera Černá is the mother of Johan Liebert and Nina Fortner. After the Eugenics Experiment spearheaded by Franz Bonaparta, she is given a new name: Anna. ~!At the end of the series, she is found in Southern France.!~

19.name: Karel Ranke
19.desc: Nationality: Czech Occupation: Retired Colonel of the Czech Secret Police A former Captain of the Czechoslovakian Secret Police. He was involved in the reading seminars conducted by Franz Bonaparta and Peter Čapek, and remained the sole care-taker of the Red Rose Mansion until Inspector Heinrich Lunge asked to examine the house during his stay in Prague.

19.name: Messener
19.desc: Nationality: German Occupation: Police Detective ~! Detective Messener is a look-out during the murder of the Fortners. He was Detective Müller’s partner until they were ordered to murder the Fortner couple by an anonymous man who knew about their drug trading. !~

19.name: Michael Müller
19.desc: Nationality:German Occupation: Police detective, art dealer (in his later appearance) ~!Together with Detective Messener, was the police officer hired by Johan to murder Nina’s foster parents.!~

19.name: Mikhail Ivanovich Petrov
19.original: ミハイル・イワーノヴィチ・ペドロフ
19.desc: Nationality: German (formerly), Russian Formely known as Reinhard Biermann. Having been part of the inner circle of the Kinderheim 511 experiments, he tried to recreate their experiments by bringing up the Czech orphan children in the opposite way the 511 children were brought up.

19.name: Milosz
19.desc: One of the orphan boys living in the Czech orphanage

19.name: Weissbach
19.desc: A Police Inspector from North Rhine-Westphalia. He is one of the officers assigned to solving the unrelated murders happening in that region of Germany.

19.name: Kronecker-kyouju
19.desc: Professor Kronecker is Anna's professor of Law at the Heidelberg University

19.name: Rosso
19.desc: Mr. Rosso is well-known and Nina Fortner's chief in his restaurant. ~!He's a former hitman.!~He employed Nina as a waitress there, and Anna's radiance and beauty gathered many customers who flocked to his restaurant. He always puts five sugars in his coffee and he loves movies and regrets not having enough free time to watch them when he was younger.

115230.name: Twenty-Fifth Baam
115230.desc: __Species:__ Human __Height:__ 168 cm (Part 1), 180 cm (Part II) __Rank:__ Irregular __Position:__ Wave Controller __Born:__ ~!Floor of Death!~__Occupation:__ ~!FUG Slayer Candidate!~ Twenty-Fifth Baam is an Irregular and one of the main protagonists of Tower of God. Bam entered in search of his best friend [Rachel](https://anilist.co/character/135466/Rachel), and after passing Headon's test he was deemed worthy to climb the Tower. In Part I, he is a highly empathetic and caring young man, understanding little of life, having had virtually no contact with people before meeting Rachel and later entering the Tower. He hates loneliness and other people's loneliness. He is considered very naive and knows little about the Tower. During Part I, his only reason for climbing the Tower is to be with Rachel. In Part II: ~! He was forced to join FUG, and received then the name of Jue Viole Grace (쥬 비올레 그레이스), the Slayer Candidate, to keep his real identity hidden. As Viole, he is far more violent. He now has friends to protect and will not hesitate to fight if it means protecting them. He now completely understands that in order to climb the Tower, he must be pre-emptive and prepared to engage in combat and eradicate all opposition. He's become more introverted, rarely ever speaking or displaying any signs of emotion. He's also quite cold and calculating, interacting with others only out of necessity and will take advantage of a situation to defeat his opponents. Later in the Part as FU

115230.name: Headon
115230.desc: Headon is the Guardian of the First Floor and is the caretaker of the Tower. He has an appearance reminiscent of a white rabbit because of his long ears. Headon talks in a friendly tone, but has been shown to have a cruel and manipulative streak. He presents his ideas and opinions in a logical and pragmatic manner, but his goals and desires themselves are not understood. He is perfectly willing to manipulate dozens of lives and create the nucleus of civil unrest to attain his mysterious goal. Although most Administrators normally stay on their Floors, Headon seems to be the only Administrator with the ability to visit other Floors of the Tower. It is said that Headon is the most experienced Administrator of the Tower. Although that only means he was the first Administrator Zahard met and therefore the first one to carry out the roles of a Administrator, that doesn't mean he's the oldest.

115230.name: Yuri Ha Jahad
115230.desc: Ha Yuri Jahad, more commonly known as Yu​ri Jahad (lacking her family name), is a High Ranker and Princess from the Ha Family. Notably, she is one of the most famous Princesses and therefore highly favored, with much political influence throughout The Tower. ~!She is the owner of Black March and Green April, two of the 13 Month Series. She is the first Princess to own two 13 Months at the same time since Garam Jahad. Notably, she is one of the most famed Princesses, and perhaps one of the most favored.!~

115230.name: Aguero Agnis Khun
115230.desc: __Species:__ Human __Height:__ 170 cm __Rank:__ Regular __Position:__ Light Bearer Khun Aguero Agnis is a E-Rank Regular from Khun Family, and is often referred to simply as "Khun". He is a best friend of [Twenty-Fifth Bam](https://anilist.co/character/84769/TwentyFifth-Bam), one of the main protagonists of Tower of God. Khun relies heavily on his master intellect, however, this is not his only strong field. He also has exceptional physical attributes and is a skilled Light Bearer. His powers in combat cannot be denied.

115230.name: Rak Wraithraiser
115230.desc: __Species:__ Wraithraiser, ~!Native One!~ __Height:__ 3m (Decompressed) __Rank:__ Regular C-Rank __Position:__ Spear Bearer Rak Wraithraiser is a Regular. He unwillingly teamed up with [Baam](https://anilist.co/character/84769/TwentyFifth-Baam) and [Khun](https://anilist.co/character/84781/Khun-Aguero-Agnis) during the first test on the Second Floor and passed other tests with them. He was selected for the Spear Bearer position. He is a large and powerful warrior and a very confident individual. Rak is originally a 3 meter tall creature, but after he mocked the Ranker [Yu Han Sung](https://anilist.co/character/141286/Sung-Yu-Han), the Second Floor Test Director, his body was shrunken by them. He eventually found out how to get back to his original size. As a being who can control their body size, he is a Compression Licenser. He is a direct descendant of the Native One, a type of being that is able to rule over the elements in the Tower. Rak doesn't come off as particularly smart; he thinks he's superior to almost everyone else and so refers to other people as "turtles". He occasionally calls himself "Rakleader" when he is feeling particularly full of himself, although Khun may be to blame for indulging him. He tries to make himself appear tough, although he's actually a bit of a baby sometimes. However, he does seem to have a little of a caring side in him.

115230.name: Endorsi Jahad
115230.desc: __Height:__ 167 cm Endorsi Jahad is a Regular and one of Jahad's Princesses, currently climbing the Tower. Among Regulars, Endorsi is unmatched in terms of physical ability. Among the Jahad's Princesses, she is fairly warm and more human. Her parents weren't around when she was born. She was then adopted by a couple from the Middle Area before she became a princess. Later, her adoptive parents were killed by Snake Charmer. Her character concept is that of a 'Normal modern girl' taking great care of her looks, stressed about her weight, wanting to hear she is pretty while acting confident. A girl who is yet to mature fully. Endorsi doesn't believe in being friends with a guy at first and says that guys and girls cannot be friends and can only be boyfriend and girlfriend and later states that she is not allowed to date anyone because she is a Princess of Jahad, but later on she catches feelings for [Bam](https://anilist.co/character/84769/TwentyFifth-Baam) and calls Bam her boyfriend.

115230.name: Rachel
115230.desc: __Species:__ Human __Rank:__ Extra Rachel, also known as Michelle Light was Baam's best and only friend as she was the only one to visit him in his "cave". She longs to see the stars which is one of the fabled rewards waiting at the top of the Tower, because she "fears the Night". ~!Like Baam she is an Irregular.!~

115230.name: Hwaryun
115230.desc: __Species:__ Red Witch __Height:__ 168 cm __Rank:__ Regular __Position:__ Wave Controller, Scout, Guide Hwaryun is a quiet person who says little and she has a gloomy and ominous aura. She is also quite manipulative. In Part II, she's depicted as mischievous and teasing, as she clearly mocked the Viole impostor and repeatedly called him "Pig". She almost always smiles in mischief and probably a little bit of arrogance. She also tends to be extremely blunt, caring very little about other peoples' feelings; though this could be considered her way of spurring a person on. This leads her to seem very harsh. Hwaryun is Viole's Guide but is also the Guide for FUG's Rankers notably Ha Jinsung. ~!It was revealed that she went into the Floor of Death first, instructing another Red-haired lady to lead the way for Yuri and Khun's team.!~

115230.name: Anaak Jahad
115230.desc: Anaak is introduced in the second floor, where she forms a team with Shibisu and Hatz. ~!She introduces herself as one of Jahad's Princesses, but it's later revealed that she's actually the daughter of the real Anaak Jahad, who was impregnated by her lover and ran into hiding. Though she is only a demi-princess because of the diluted Jahad's blood in her, she used to possess two of the 13 Month Series at one point; something only a few Princesses have accomplished. She is climbing the Tower for revenge.!~

115230.name: Lero-Ro
115230.desc: Lero-Ro is a former Examiner of the Second Floor. He is an exceptionally strong Ranker, to the point that even Quant, also a former Test Administrator (and a haughty one), would constantly boast about his strength. He was supposedly the strongest Second Floor Test Administrator and is particularly skilled in the use of Shinsoo. He was also the Light Bearer position instructor. He is fairly old, older than Yuri Zahard, as he stated that Anak Zahard didn't live up to a Princess's chaotic expectations like Yuri Zahard did, whom he met when they were both Regulars. He and Quant are awkwardly described as a "Set Menu", explained by the fact that Lero-Ro and Quant climbed the Tower together like a team. He is apparently quite famous, and he took over 300 years to climb the Tower.

115230.name: Evan Edrok
115230.desc: Evan Edrok is a High Ranker as well the Chief Guide of Zahard Royalty, which is a unique position in the Tower. He always seems to follow his partner, Ha Yuri Zahard.

115230.name: Quant Blitz
115230.desc: Quant Blitz is a Ranker. He instructed the Scout position while he was a Test Admin on the Second Floor.

115230.name: Hatz
115230.desc: __Species:__ Human __Height:__ 167cm __Position:__ Scout Hatsu (하츠, Hahcheu; or "Hatz") is a Regular and a "devoutly" practising swordsman. He is a quiet and calm warrior, who has been making good progress in the tests merely by doing exactly what each test entails. ~!He teamed up with [Anaak Jahad](https://anilist.co/character/135470/Anaak-Jahad) and [Shibisu](https://anilist.co/character/137957/Shibisu) during the first test on the 2nd Floor and later signed Khun's friend list.!~ ~!He was last seen on the 52nd Floor having helped [Bam](https://anilist.co/character/84769/Twentyfifth-Bam) and his allies.!~

115230.name: Shibisu
115230.desc: Shibisu is a D-rank Regular. He is relatively weak, yet possesses a great ability to deduce and an intellect on par with Khun's. Nonetheless, he made it past all of the tests on the Second Floor, where he was assigned the Scout position and is now climbing the Tower as the leader of his team.

115230.name: Lauroe Phonsekal
115230.desc: Phonsekal Lauroe is a Regular and a talented Wave Controller of the Eurasia Family. He loves to sleep and goes everywhere with blanket and his pillows. Despite his sloth, he is an exceptional Wave Controller, capable of firing powerful long-range blasts.

115230.name: Yu Han Sung
115230.desc: Yu Han Sung is an Advanced Ranker and the former Test Director of the Second Floor. Notably, he is a key member of FUG in taking Viole to the top. He is the main antagonist of Part I. He is a well known ranker partly because he rejected becoming a High Ranker.

115230.name: No Rang
115230.desc: Yellow is an exam assistant. She gave instructions to the Regulars for Yu Han Sung 's examination, The Door Test.

115230.name: Dede Kancho
115230.desc: Dede Kancho is a Regular found in the Second Floor. ~!He made it through most of the Second Floor tests, teaming up with Shopin and Kon, but eventually failed. !~

115230.name: Levin
115230.desc: Levin is a Regular. He has grey skin and sharp teeth and, rather than fighting, he used to snipe using a Sniper Rifle. He was assigned the Light Bearer position. He is quite sly, but is extremely annoyed if someone removes him from his sniping area. He seems quite sadistic, as he enjoys to watch anyone commit violent acts or see someone writhe in agony.

115230.name: Serena Rinnen
115230.desc: Serena Rinnen is a Regular who passed most of the tests on the Second Floor and was assigned the Scout position.

115230.name: Inoa Yoran
115230.desc: Inoa Yoran is a Regular assigned to the Spear Bearer position. He played a very minor role in Part I before being eliminated from testing.

115230.name: Sunwoo Nare
115230.desc: Sunwoo Nare is a Regular who came to the Tower for money. She made it through all the tests on the Second Floor and was assigned the Scout position.

115230.name: Kon
115230.desc: Kon (콘) is a Regular assigned to the Fisherman position.

115230.name: Shopin
115230.desc: Shopin (쇼핀) is a Regular who made it through most of the Second Floor tests and was assigned the Scout position.

115230.name: First Emperor
115230.desc: First Emperor (초패왕, Chopaewang) is a Regular assigned to the Scout Position.

115230.name: Riron 3
115230.desc: He is a Regular assigned to the Light Bearer position.

115230.name: Leo Clocker
115230.desc: Leo Cloakeris a Regular that was assigned to the Fisherman position.

115230.name: Catan
115230.desc: Catan is a Regular assigned to the Scout Position.

115230.name: Rozeal
115230.desc: She is a Regular, who was assigned to the Wave Controller position.

115230.name: Palgyon
115230.desc: Palgyunis is a F-Rank Regular, who was assigned to the Scout position.

115230.name: Full Black
115230.desc: Full Black is a Regular and a Light Bearer

115230.name: Hoh
115230.desc: Hoh is a seemingly cheerful person who is actually quite conflicted. Making his way up the tower, dealing with flashbacks of the past in his homeplace, and making friends, he struggles to make his way.

115230.name: Hyun Seung
115230.desc: Hyun Seung is a Regular who was assigned to the Spear Bearer position.

115230.name: Chungchung
115230.desc: Chungchung is an extremely small and fast Regular who was assigned the Light Bearer position.

115230.name: Deod
115230.desc: Deod is a Regular that was assigned to the Fisherman position. He teamed up with Leo Cloaker and First Emperor after the "Deathmatch" Test.

115230.name: Geomeun Samwol
115230.desc: Black March is a B-rank Needle and Ignition Weapon lent to Baam for a short time by Yuri Jahad. Black March is one of the 13 Month Series made by the craftsmaster, Ashul Edwaru. The weapon is sentient and has a spirit inside it and when ignited, it is capable of unleashing extreme power like the other 13 Month Series.

115230.name: Mr. Neon Bag
115230.desc: He is a Test Assistant in the Door Test. He and his team pretended to be a Regular in order to give hints to all the teams before they took the door-selection exam under the order of the Test Director Yu Han Sung.

115230.name: Hachuling Khun
115230.desc: Khun Hachuling, or simply just Hachuling, is a Ranker, a defected member of the Khun Family and one of the numerous children related to Khun Eduan. He is also a member of Wolhaiksong and is sometimes referred to as Blueberry.

115230.name: Aleksai Amigochaz
115230.desc: Aleksai Amigochaz is the red-winged Regular from early 2nd Floor who had been climbing the Tower with Shibisu, Anak Zahard and Androssi Zahard as a member of Team Isu. His position is a Spear Bearer.

115230.name: Azadni
115230.desc: Azadni is a Regular assigned to the Spear Bearer Position.

115230.name: Baunian
115230.desc: Baunian is a Regular assigned to the Light Bearer position.

115230.name: Bok-Dol Yu
115230.desc: Yu Bok-Dol is a Ranker. He is the Position Instructor for the Spear Bearers on the Second Floor and therefore one of the judges during the Hide-and-Seek test as well as the judge for the Spear Bearers during the Position Test.

115230.name: Le-Ara
115230.desc: Le-Ara is a Regular assigned to the Light Bearer position.

115230.name: Kurdan
115230.desc: Kurudan is a Ranker and member of Wolhaiksong. He travelled with Yuri Zahard and her group, whose objective was to navigate the more dangerous parts of the Middle Area in order to infiltrate the Second Floor so she could retrieve the Black March.

115230.name: Anaak-ui Eomma
115230.desc: ~!She is the real Anaak Jahad. Her daughter decided to take her name while going up the tower to avenge her.!~

115230.name: Hax
115230.desc: Hax is a Ranker. She is the Position Instructor for the Fishermen on the Second Floor and was, therefore, one of the judges during the Hide-and-Seek test as well as the judge for the Fishermen during the overall Position Test.

115230.name: Chunhwa Hong
115230.desc: Hong Chunhwa is a Regular. He passed all of the Second Floor tests and was assigned to the Fisherman position. He seems to be quite close to Sunwoo Nare.

115230.name: Kukaku Rakukakuka
115230.desc: Kukaku Rakukakuka is a Regular who participated on the 2nd Floor tests. He was one of the people who were "stored" in Khun's bag throughout the first "Deathmatch" Test. He participated in the Crown Game with his teammates Blarouse and Grey, and helped Khun by attacking the other Regulars. He was then assigned to the Light Bearer position.

115230.name: Changsoo Yeon
115230.desc: Yung Changsoo is a Regular assigned to the Fisherman position.

115230.name: Blarouse
115230.desc: Blarouse is a Regular who participated on the 2nd Floor tests. He was one of the people who were "stored" in Khun's bag throughout the first "Deathmatch" Test.

115230.name: Hoshi
115230.desc: Hoshi is Regular who was assigned the Scout position.

115230.name: Grey
115230.desc: Grey is a Regular who participated on the 2nd Floor tests. She was one of the three people who were "stored" in Khun's bag throughout the first "Deathmatch" Test.

115230.name: Goon
115230.desc: Goon is a Regular who was assigned to the Spear Bearer position.

115230.name: Parakewl
115230.desc: Parakewl is a rather unintelligent and useless Regular.

115230.name: Angnyeong
115230.desc: A mysterious regular that first appeard during the Crown game on the Floor of tests. ~!It was later revealed that he was a Bodyguard assigned by Headon to help Rachel climb the Tower.!~

113936.name: Senkuu Ishigami
113936.desc: __Height:__ 171 cm (5'7") Senkuu is a genius with a vast amount of scientific knowledge. He is able to invent various kinds of tools and gadgets in a short amount of time with ease. As a child, he designed and built a functioning miniature rocket ship. Senkuu also possesses an analytical mind, being able to correctly discern the situation he is in. Even in his pre-teens, he was intelligent and sharp-minded enough to create advanced machines. Senkuu's physical abilities are very low and he would lose against someone like [Kohaku](https://anilist.co/character/124143) in a brawl, something he himself admits. ~!In "Village Games Arc" Senku unintentionally won and married [Ruri](https://anilist.co/character/143272), but divorced immediately afterwards.!~

113936.name: Kohaku
113936.desc: __Height:__ 160 cm (5'3") Kohaku is a young woman who is a descendant of modern humans. She is Ruri's younger sister and the daughter of Kokuyo. She appears to be well known in her village due to her combative abilities, as both Kinro and Ginro were afraid of her. Kohaku excels at fighting, hunting, and general survival skills. She is a tomboy by nature, having little interest in more typical feminine activities and has little knowledge about them, although she does seem to enjoy some lavish clothing that was provided to her. She possesses a sharp instinct and intellect. Kohaku is a kind young woman, caring deeply for her sickly older sister, willing to participate in the tournament for her hand in marriage just to protect her. This care extends to her comrades, and anyone she's loyal to. In addition to this, she has a reckless and hotheaded personality, often reacting in anger to being called a gorilla or lioness due to her strength and physicality. She also acts on her emotions at times, going against rational thought. She also has a bit of a teasing side, asking Chrome if he could fall for her to her resemblance to her sister.

113936.name: Tsukasa Shishiou
113936.desc: __Height:__ 195 cm (6'4") According to [Taiju](https://anilist.co/character/124146/Ooki-Taiju), Tsukasa has the reputation as "The Strongest High School Primate" due to his tremendous fighting abilities. Tsukasa is essentially violent, but extremely careful and aware of his actions. He is a very kind, thoughtful, and polite man outside of his pessimistic ideals towards humanity. He offers help in the beginning to [Senku](https://anilist.co/character/124142/Ishigami-Senkuu) and Taiju after they revive him and becomes their hunter for food, using his skills as a prominent athlete to aid them. It’s revealed later that Tsukasa plans to purge humanity of adults who hurt the young and weak, then thinks Senku will go along with him, but instead Senku rejects him. After this point, Tsukasa becomes fairly determined in carrying out his plans even to the point of leaving their group.

113936.name: Chrome
113936.desc: __Height:__ 170 cm (5'7") Chrome is the alleged sorcerer - eventually turned scientist - of Ishigami Village. As part of the Kingdom of Science, Chrome serves as the unofficial right hand of [Senku](https://anilist.co/character/124142/Ishigami-Senkuu); this trust is what makes him one of the Five Wise Generals. Chrome is a highly energetic person with a lot of passion and curiosity. He is genuinely interested in science, although at first, he only knows it as sorcery. He is confident in his intellect, enough so to go toe to toe with Senku despite getting destroyed in a battle of wits. He also has a tendency to refer to something as "bad" when he thinks it is cool or amazing. Chrome has a deep love of science, though he admits his expertise and knowledge lies mainly in exploration, particularly pertaining to rocks and minerals and gathering them. He is loyal and selfless to his friends and, while lacking in physical abilities, he is still able to think of clever solutions out of dangerous situations. He is also exceedingly brave, and in addition, while he is usually a loudmouth, he knows when to keep his mouth shut. He loves science and, in many ways, is an accomplished scientist in his own right, managing to create chemical reactions from the rocks he collected through frequent trial and error (reactions which were only made known in the seventeenth century), despite never knowing this knowledge before Senku's arrival.

113936.name: Taiju Ooki
113936.desc: __Height:__ 189 cm (6'2½") Taiju is an outgoing, friendly, and kind person. He's enthusiastic about performing even small tasks and a diligent worker. He is very determined when something is important to him. He tends to yell loudly and is enthusiastic regardless of the task so long as he proves useful. He is persistent and determined. Despite being emotional and expressive, he has great control of his temper, never losing his cool or acting impulsively. Taiju possesses an extremely sturdy body, something his friend [Senku](https://anilist.co/character/124142) vouches him for. He is the first human to be able to withstand a kick from [Tsukasa](https://anilist.co/character/124144) without losing consciousness. He also possesses immense stamina, able to cross 80 kilometers in 5 hours.

113936.name: Yuzuriha Ogawa
113936.desc: Yuzuriha is the love interest of [Taiju](https://anilist.co/character/124146) and a friend of [Senkuu](https://anilist.co/character/124142). Yuzuriha is a young woman with brown hair, brown eyes, and a slim build. She has two noticeable petrification scars, both in the shape of spirals, located on her shoulder and neck. Before her petrification, Yuzuriha wears a standard High School Uniform. After her depetrification, she wears a white cloth dress that's spit at her sides and matching cloth shoes. Noticeably, Yuzuriha wears a white hairband that's vaguely shaped like wrap-around headphones, both before and after her petrification.

113936.name: Suika
113936.desc: __Height:__ 119 cm (3'10") Suika is a young girl who lives in the village with the other stone age humans. Her most notable feature is the large watermelon on her head, which she can climb inside to disguise herself as the fruit. [Senku](https://anilist.co/character/124142/Ishigami-Senkuu) first meets Suika when he, [Chrome](https://anilist.co/character/124145/Chrome), and [Kohaku](https://anilist.co/character/124143/Kohaku) were searching for iron sand in a nearby river. Suika is eager to help Senku build his kingdom of science because she's never been useful to anyone before. She comes to work as an information gatherer for the kingdom of science, occasionally being referred to as 'Ace Detective Suika.'

113936.name: Gen Asagiri
113936.desc: __Height:__ 175 cm (5'9") Gen Asagiri is an enemy turned ally of [Senku](https://anilist.co/character/124142/Ishigami-Senkuu). Originally de-petrified by [Tsukasa Shishio](https://anilist.co/character/124144/Shishiou-Tsukasa), he was sent to find Senku, only to defect to the Kingdom of Science. Gen later becomes one of the Five Wise Generals. He is somewhat full of himself and his abilities, taking pride in his status as a magician and a mentalist, along with his knowledge of the human psyche. Gen is rather quirky and can often be seen speaking in Pig Latin. He tends to be lazy, self absorbed, and perverted, and he is also perfectly capable of lying without a hint of stress or change in expression. While he frequently portrays an aura of selfishness, hard self-interest, manipulation and deviousness, Gen is intrinsically a good person who can't bring himself to harm others. His outward appearance is masked by his mastery in psychology, but his actions tell of loyalty, determination, kindness and even sacrifice at times. While not nearly as intelligent in terms of science compared to Senku, he proves to be his equal and one of his most vital allies due to his ability to understand the human psyche and manipulate people through lies in contrast to Senku's more honest nature. He uses his abilities to promote cooperation and enthusiasm, motivate allies, conduct negotiations, and outsmart enemies. He tends to shift between acting as a ditzy airhead when it suits him (such as to avo

113936.name: Kaseki
113936.desc: __Height:__ 155 cm (5'1") Kaseki is an elderly craftsman from the Ishigami Village. When Senku arrives at Ishigami village, Kaseki is introduced as an artisan, and through Senku, his dedication to his craft is reignited tenfold.

113936.name: Ginrou
113936.desc: Ginrou is [Kinrou](https://anilist.co/character/143271/Kinrou)'s younger brother and one of the village guards. He is shorter and scrawnier than his brother, with short blonde hair and green eyes. He usually wears a karate gi-like uniform and belt and carries his spear wherever he goes. He and his brother were two of the first villagers to join the Kingdom of Science. ~!During the adventure on Treasure Island, Ginrou manages to convince [Matsukaze](https://anilist.co/character/188816/Matsukaze) to serve him due to the resemblance Ginrou bears to his late master.!~

113936.name: Kinrou
113936.desc: Kinrou is the elder brother of [Ginrou](https://anilist.co/character/143270/Ginrou) and the son of Tetsuken and Shirogane. Originally having served as one of the guards of Ishigami Village alongside Ginrou, he quickly joined [Senku](https://anilist.co/character/124142/Ishigami-Senkuu) as a member of the Kingdom of Science. Kinrou is a muscular young man of average height, with a scar on the right side of his face and a cluster of hair hanging in between his eyes. He wears a sleeveless karate gi-like uniform with a belt and a buckler with a star pattern on his back. After the Grand Bout, Kinrou begins wearing a pair of glasses to correct his nearsightedness.

113936.name: Ruri
113936.desc: Ruri is [Kohaku](https://anilist.co/character/124143/Kohaku)'s elder sister and the daughter of [Kokuyo](https://anilist.co/character/150509/Kokuyo), and serves as the priestess of Ishigami Village. She is similar to Kohaku in appearance but has longer hair and a more hourglass-shaped body. She wears a black sundress and a piece of rope around her neck.

113936.name: You Uei
113936.desc: __Height:__ 177 cm (5'10") You is a pre-petrification human and former policeman who is revived by [Tsukasa](https://anilist.co/character/124144/Tsukasa-Shishiou). He faked his death after [Chrome](https://anilist.co/character/124145/Chrome)'s escape to avoid the blame, then eventually joins the Kingdom of Science after the stone wars are over. As penance, he worked with [Yuzuriha](https://anilist.co/character/124147/Yuzuriha-Ogawa) to rebuild the statues that were destroyed by Tsukasa. He is constantly butting heads with [Magma](https://anilist.co/character/145095/Magma) due to each other's naivety of their respective worlds.

113936.name: Hyouga
113936.desc: __Height:__ 189cm (6'2") Hyoga is a survivor who was revived by Tsukasa Shishio. Initially, he was an elite member of the Tsukasa Empire since he was depetrified by Tsukasa. ~!He ultimately betrays Tsukasa by attempting to take over his leadership and threatens Senku into joining, only to be defeated by the duo in the decisive battle for the Kingdom of Science. When the situation calls for it, he is depetrified once again and summoned to battle - now as a begrudging ally of the Kingdom of Science with a similar but slightly mellowed goal in mind. Since his third depetrification, Hyoga's goals are unknown.!~ Hyoga has an easy going attitude towards everything. Even in situation that do not work in his favour, he still remains calm. While he claims to share the same values as Tsukasa when it comes to only reviving the young and creating a community where no one takes from others, Hyoga himself is an elitist who believes in social darwinism. He categorizes humans as either enlightened (or strong) and unenlightened (or weak). He believes that the "brainless incompetent masses" should not be allowed to live and that only those who excel should be allowed to live. While he does follow a form of social darwinism, he does not believe it is only the physically strong who should survive, as he wanted Senku to join him in his endeavors and become the strongest duo, indicating he respected Senku's intelligence and understood his capabilities. He is very manipulative and cunning, seems to

113936.name: Nikki Hanada
113936.desc: __Height:__ 180 cm (5'11") Nikki is a survivor that was revived by [Tsukasa](https://anilist.co/character/124144/Tsukasa-Shishiou), who assigned her to keep watch over [Taiju](https://anilist.co/character/124146/Taiju-Ooki) and [Yuzuriha](https://anilist.co/character/124147/Yuzuriha-Ogawa). She later defected from the Tsukasa Empire and joined the Kingdom of Science, where her unofficial role is that of disciplinarian. She has great physical strength, constantly being shown keeping people like [Magma](https://anilist.co/character/145095/Magma) and [You](https://anilist.co/character/145061/You-Uei) in line. Nikki is a massive fan of [Lillian Weinberg](https://anilist.co/character/149274/Lillian-Weinberg). In the modern world she was having a rough time at school and listening to Lillian's songs saved her.

113936.name: Ukyou Saionji
113936.desc: __Height:__ 173 cm (5'8") Ukyou is a survivor that was revived by [Tsukasa Shishiou](https://anilist.co/character/124144/Tsukasa-Shishiou). He is pacifistic and dislikes needless bloodshed.

113936.name: Homura Momiji
113936.desc: __Height:__ 145 cm (4'9") Homura acts as the right-hand man of [Hyouga](https://anilist.co/character/145062/Hyouga) in [Tsukasa](https://anilist.co/character/124144/Tsukasa-Shishiou)'s army. She was a competitive gymnast before the petrification.

113936.name: Magma
113936.desc: Magma is a villager from the Ishigami village. Magma is known for being the strongest of all the Villagers in terms of strength.

113936.name: Minami Hokutouzai
113936.desc: __Height:__ 166 cm (5'4") Minami is a Pre-Petrification human and former reporter before the Petrification occurred. ~!Originally a member of [Tsukasa](https://anilist.co/character/124144/Shishiou-Tsukasa)'s army before Tsukasa's downfall at the hands of [Hyoga](https://anilist.co/character/145062/Hyouga)'s betrayal, she later joins and helps the Kingdom of Science.!~

113936.name: Mirai Shishiou
113936.desc: __Initial Age (mental):__ 6 __Initial Age (physical):__ 12 __Height__: 139 cm (4'7") Mirai is the beloved little sister of [Tsukasa](https://anilist.co/character/124144/Tsukasa-Shishiou). Mirai was clinically brain dead prior to the Petrification, the doctors saying she'd never wake up. Tsukasa refused to give up on her and took on his MMA matches to keep paying the medical bills that kept her on life support. ~!She was depetrified by [Senku](https://anilist.co/character/124142/Senkuu-Ishigami) as part of the deal to end the war between the Kingdom of Science and the Tsukasa Empire.!~

113936.name: Chalk
113936.desc: Dog from Ishigami Village. He is Suika's friend.

113936.name: Mantle
113936.desc: Mantle is a villager of Ishigami Village who idolizes Magma.

113936.name: Lillian Weinberg
113936.original: リリアン ・ ワインバーグ
113936.desc: A famous American diva and songstress whose name is known by the whole world. Her passion in adventuring lead her aboard the International Space Station (ISS) alongside Senku's father, Byuakuya Ishigami.

113936.name: Byakuya Ishigami
113936.desc: Byakuya Ishigami was a Japanese astronaut who was residing on the International Space Station when the Petrification on Earth's surface occurred. He was a kind, playful, and mischievous man who always found a way to amuse himself and keep things lighthearted, no matter the stakes. ~!He was [Senku Ishigami](https://anilist.co/character/124142/Senkuu-Ishigami)'s adoptive father.!~

113936.name: Kokuyo
113936.desc: Father of [Kohaku](https://anilist.co/character/124143/Kohaku) and [Ruri](https://anilist.co/character/143272/Ruri). He was the village chief of Ishigami Village at the time of [Senku](https://anilist.co/character/124142/Senkuu-Ishigami)'s reawakening. ~!Kokuyo at first refuses to accept Senku as the new village chief, even though Senku won the Grand Bout. After witnessing Senku's antibiotic cure Ruri he officially crowns Senku the new leader of Ishigami Village. Despite not being the chief anymore, he serves as something of a co-leader of Ishigami Village, focusing on more practical concerns like food gathering, while Senku focuses on scientific advancement.!~

113936.name: Natri
113936.desc: Villager from Ishigami Village. He is the father of [Carbo](https://anilist.co/character/255669) and the husband of [Alumi](https://anilist.co/character/255671/).

113936.name: Tetsuya Kinomoto
113936.desc: __Height:__ 155 cm A modern member of the Kingdom of Science. He was a manga artist prior to the Petrification. He was revived to test the feasibility of reviving a broken statue, and was later tasked with helping bring back entertainment to the Stone World.

21776.name: Kobayashi
21776.desc: Kobayashi is a computer programmer and office worker. She finds herself living with a dragon named [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970/Tohru). Even though Kobayashi maintains a cool demeanor, she has been regarded as kind-hearted and reliable among her friends and colleagues. Level-headed and pragmatic, she stands as the source of reason when dealing with her dragon friends. However, when intoxicated, she tends to become rowdy and aggressive, especially in her interests in maids, and is not above subjecting Tohru to her drunken whims. Before meeting Tohru, Kobayashi would don a stoic expression on her face. Now, she is more approachable and open to others, often seen smiling contentedly. Kobayashi often chastised Tohru for her lack of propriety on human standards. However, as time passes by, she grows accustomed to Tohru's quirks and would sometimes show small signs of affection and gratitude for the dragon, such as holding Tohru's hand or going out of her way to fulfill some of Tohru's wishes to ease her troubles.

21776.name: Tohru
21776.desc: __Faction__: Chaos __Relatives__: [Damocles](https://anilist.co/character/172721/Damocles) (father) Tohru is a female dragon with the ability to transform into a human girl. After [Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969/Kobayashi) rescues her, she falls in love with her and decides to work for her as a maid. As a Chaos Dragon, Tohru was raised to hate humans and was supposed to be a fierce and dangerous force of evil with nothing other than destruction in mind. However, this all changed when she met Kobayashi. She is now cheerful and kind to every human she meets, except for those who are real, or as it is in most cases, imaginary, threats to her love interest Kobayashi (such as [Makoto Takiya](https://anilist.co/character/120976/Makoto-Takiya)). She is also quickly influenced by what she sees on television or the internet and shares a fiery relationship with her rival, [Elma](https://anilist.co/character/120977/Elma). As Kobayashi's maid, Tohru is a hard worker and cares deeply for the household, tending to all aspects of daily life, although this will often lead to trouble, such as when Tohru tries to feed her tail to Kobayashi, or when she molests Kobayashi's dirty laundry. Still, Kobayashi always shows her appreciation for Tohru's efforts and does her best to guide Tohru in the ways of modern life and human culture on Earth. Tohru is very protective of [Kanna](https://anilist.co/character/120974/Kanna-Kamui) and is essentially her mother figure and big sister comb

21776.name: Fafnir
21776.desc: An old friend of [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970/Tohru), he is a male dragon with a strong distrust for humans which leads to him questioning much of Tohru's actions and ideals in his earlier appearances. He shares some resemblance to the traits of his namesake, such as his cold demeanour and disdainful mentality. He appears as a refined young man with long black hair and red eyes in his human form. ~!After Tohru's attempts to find a place to stay for him (under the name Takeshi Ooyama), Fafnir eventually comes to live with [Takiya](https://anilist.co/character/120976/Takiya-Makoto), becoming obsessed with video games and popular culture.!~

21776.name: Riko Saikawa
21776.desc: **Relatives**: [Georgie Saikawa](https://anilist.co/character/120978/Georgie-Saikawa) (older sister) Riko Saikawa is [Kanna](https://anilist.co/character/120974/Kanna-Kamui)'s friend and classmate in elementary school. A running gag involves her becoming overwhelmingly flushed with bliss every time she and Kanna make physical contact, along with her shiny forehead. At first glance, Riko seems bossy and mean, but over time, she seems nicer as shown with Kanna, and very polite around people like [Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969/Kobayashi), although she originally mistook Kobayashi for Kanna's mother. She has a crush on Kanna and enjoys being around her. When being touched by Kanna or when she receives praise from her, she tends to grin goofily and get red in the face, becoming overwhelmed with excitement. Though she initially tries to pick a fight with Kanna for her sudden popularity on the first day of her transfer to the school, she quickly becomes good friends with her. They often spend time with each other, walking home together from school and picking the other as their partner during school activities.

21776.name: Shouta Magatsuchi
21776.desc: __Relatives:__ [Mr. Magatsuchi](https://anilist.co/character/248474) (father), Saori Magatsuchi (mother) Shouta Magatsuchi is a young boy born into a family of mages in the modern world. He has shown to possess enough knowledge on the arcane arts to attempt summoning a demon. [Lucoa](https://anilist.co/character/120975) came out of a summoning portal Shouta created and starts living with him. Shouta is an elementary school boy in 5th grade with both purple hair and eyes. His bangs reach well below his eyebrows. His appearance looks partly androgynous. Shouta is quiet and shy most of the time when seen with Lucoa. When Lucoa attempts to seduce Shouta, he would run away with embarrassment and accuse Lucoa of being a demon. As his father is [Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969)'s manager, she's asked to look after Shouta at times.

21776.name: Kanna Kamui
21776.desc: [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970)'s friend from the dragon realm who got exiled from her world and wound up living with [Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969) as well. She is very young by dragon standards, equivalent to a primary school student, which she attends as a third-year student bearing Kobayashi's surname later in the series. She initially assumes that Kobayashi seduced Tohru into staying and wanted her to return to their original world. ~!She grows attached to Kobayashi as the series progresses, viewing her as a mother figure.!~ Kanna's basis and tribal attire are inspired by the culture of the indigenous natives of Hokkaido and claims to be from Ushishir. She bears feather-like horns and a thin tail ending in a bulb, and is capable of charging with electricity.

21776.name: Quetzalcoatl
21776.desc: **Faction**: Spectation Quetzalcoatl often referred to as Lucoa, is a former dragon goddess and an old friend of [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970/Tohru). She was exiled from her seat after consuming cursed liquor that led her into a scandalous affair. As a member of the spectating faction, she does not interfere with any events involving the dragons or gods. She's by far the most powerful dragon in the series. Quetzalcoatl appears to be laid-back and carefree who is rarely seen without a smile. She is wise, kind, and nurturing who often has advice for her younger kin. As a former goddess, she is better tuned to human customs, as seen when she explains to Tohru why Kobayashi was not receptive to Tohru's initial cleaning regimen. Despite this, however, Lucoa seems to lack some sense of dignity severely. She is not above using her body as a means of getting what she wants, as shown when she attempts to use her alluring figure as an offering to [Shouta](https://anilist.co/character/120973/Shouta-Magatsuchi), hoping to allow her to stay in his home. Quetzalcoatl lives with Shouta but does not work for her stay. The two have a complicated relationship as Shouta sees Quetzalcoatl as a succubus or demon rather than a dragon. Quetzalcoatl will often try to get Shouta's attention, but due to her massive breasts, she often ends up flustering and embarrassing him instead.

21776.name: Makoto Takiya
21776.desc: [Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969)'s co-worker who is initially believed by [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970) to be a rival for Kobayashi's affections, but is really just an otaku who likes to talk about maids with her. Kobayashi helps him set up during Comiket every year. ~![Fafnir](https://anilist.co/character/120971) eventually decides to live with him to stay in the human world.!~

21776.name: Elma
21776.desc: **Faction**: Harmony Elma is a female dragon from the Harmony faction, the opposing faction of Chaos, which [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970/Tohru) belongs to. She adopts the name Elma Joui as her human alias after she finds that she is unable to return to her world. Elma is the only dragon of the main cast who lives on her own in the human world. Elma usually takes the form of a human woman with short black hair, large breasts, blue eyes, and a long spiral unicorn-like horn (which she can freely hide). In the anime and [Elma’s Office Lady Diary](https://anilist.co/manga/100756/Miss-Kobayashis-Dragon-Maid-Elmas-Office-Lady-Diary/), her hair also has purple tips. At work, she wears round glasses. She also wears a business suit which consists of a white shirt, light blue tie, a loose blue sweater, a grey blazer, and a dark grey knee-length skirt with light grey socks and black heels. Her casual attire in the anime consists of olive-green skin-tight trousers, a light blue jacket, a dark blue vest, and a yellow scarf. Her first outfit, which she also wears in her world while in human form, consists of a light tan scarf with a dark blue (sometimes black) leotard. She wears a purple kimono with pink piping and a dark blue sash over the leotard, with the top pulled down. She has bandages around her legs and sandals. She can be seen with a cobalt blue and turquoise tail (which she can freely hide). Sometimes, she carries around a long, brown trident. In Elma's dragon form,

21776.name: Georgie Saikawa
21776.desc: **Relatives**: [Riko Saikawa](https://anilist.co/character/120972/Riko-Saikawa) (younger sister), unnamed parents Georgie Saikawa is the older sister of Riko Saikawa. Her real name is Nae Saikawa (才川苗). She likes to pretend to be a housemaid. Georgie wears an orange polka-dot maid outfit with a white apron. She also has a white cap and has her red hair in twin-pigtails. Her stockings are black striped. Georgie is a sweet and gentle lady. She always supports Riko and her family. She seems to know a lot about maids and has a huge passion for them. She mentions that she's wanted to be one since she was a kid when she read a book about maids, but no one accepted her job offers, so decided to be one for her family. Georgie and [Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969/Kobayashi) automatically have a close bond as they both share an interest in maids. [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970/Tohru) isn't fond of her and shows jealousy as she sees her as a rival through impersonating as a maid to win over Kobayashi. (Source: Miss Kobayashi's Dragon Maid Wiki, edited)

21776.name: Damocles
21776.desc: Damocles is the father of Tohru and is known as the Emperor of Demise and is considered one of the strongest dragons shown. Damocles is callous and stern, hating humans and viewing them as inferior and evil - a belief he tried to impart on Tohru. However, unlike other Chaos Dragons, he respects the non-interference laws preventing dragons from killing humans of Earth, although when angered, he attacks Kobayashi and threatens to leave her at the brink of death. Despite this, he cares for his daughter and is concerned for her safety and happiness.

21776.name: Sone
21776.desc: Sone is one of Kobayashi's neighbors.

21776.name: Yana
21776.desc: Yana is one of Kobayashi's neighbors.

21776.name: Touzoku no Shoujo
21776.desc: She is a girl that Tohru met back in her world.

142838.name: Narrator
142838.desc: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

142838.name: Anya Forger
142838.original: アーニャ・フォージャー
142838.desc: __Height:__ 99.5 cm (3'2") __Occupation:__ First-Grade Student, Test Subject (Formerly) __Affiliation:__ Eden Academy, Unknown Organization (Formerly) __Relatives:__ Loid Forger (Adoptive Father), Yor Forger (Adoptive Mother) Anya Forger is the deuteragonist of the SPY x FAMILY series. She is a young girl who Twilight finds at an orphanage. Believing her to be a smart child, he decides to adopt her for his mission. What he doesn't know is that Anya is an esper who escaped from the Lab that gave her the power to read minds. Starving for excitement in her life after spending most of it so far in a lab, Anya actively sought to be the one adopted by Loid and then make sure Loid and Yor got together, so she could have a spy and assassin for parents. Anya is the only Forger aware of just about everyone's Secret Identities, but keeps it to herself out of fear that if her psychic powers are exposed she'll be put in a lab again.

142838.name: Loid Forger
142838.original: ロイド・フォージャー
142838.desc: __Height:__ 187 cm __Occupation:__ Psychiatrist, Spy (Covertly) __Affiliation:__ Berlint General Hospital, WISE (Covertly) __Relatives:__ Yor Forger (Wife), Anya Forger (Adoptive Daughter) Loid Forger is the main protagonist of the SPY x FAMILY series.
