He is the top spy of the Westalian Intelligence Bureau, who is only known by his code name Twilight. In order to investigate the activities of a highly ranked politician, Donovan Desmond , Twilight has assumed the identity of a psychiatrist named Loid Forger. Further, to appear like a normal family man and get close to his target, Loid then adopted a young orphan girl, Anya , and entered a Marriage of Convenience with an Ostanian woman named Yor Briar ... who unknown to Twilight are themselves a Telepath and Professional Killer respectively.

142838.name: Yor Forger
142838.desc: __Height:__ 170 cm __Occupation:__ City Hall Clerk, Assassin (Covertly) __Affiliation:__ Berlint City Hall, Garden (Covertly) __Relatives:__ [Loid Forger](https://anilist.co/character/138101/Loid-Forger) (Husband), [Anya Forger](https://anilist.co/character/138100/Anya-Forger) (Adoptive Daughter), [Yuuri Briar](https://anilist.co/character/150425/Yuuri-Briar) (Younger Brother) Yor Forger is the tritagonist of the SPY x FAMILY series. She is a clerical employee at the Berlint City Hall. She is soft-spoken and mild-mannered, but has a strong sense of humor. She has a bad drinking habit and falls into a coma when she drinks. At home, she struggles to be a good wife and a kind mother. Although her cooking skills are not very good, she likes to keep clean and is good at cleaning. While she works in the capital of Ostania's city hall... or at least that's her civilian cover. In truth, she is an infamous Professional Killer known as "Thorn Princess". After becoming overly fixated on the idea her cover might be blown after a coworker ribs her about not being married or even having a boyfriend, Yor suggests to Loid a Marriage of Convenience, which he accepts, as he needs a mother for Anya for his own mission. ~!As of Mission (Chapter) 44, it is revealed that Yor is part of Garden, a powerful paramilitary assassin organization operating within Ostania.!~

142838.name: Becky Blackbell
142838.original: ベッキー・ブラックベル
142838.desc: __Affiliation:__ Blackbell Family, Blackbell Heavy Industries, Eden Academy, Cecile Hall __Occupation:__ Student The daughter of the CEO of Blackbell, a major military manufacturer. Attends Eden Academy as part of Cecil House, Group 3. Best friends with Anya Forger. Becky is a very kind child but with her being the daughter of a major military manufacturer, she is shown to be somewhat prideful and tries to be mature, attempting to take Anya under her wing as an act of benevolence when she views Anya as a brat. She does not attempt to get close to Damian Desmond despite his social position, even looking down on their classmates who try to befriend Damian and Anya who is initially bullied by Damian's group. Anya's confident smile later wins over Becky's admiration.

142838.name: Damian Desmond
142838.original: ダミアン・デズモンド
142838.desc: __Height:__ 110 cm (3′7″) __Affiliation:__ Desmond Family, Eden Academy, Cecile Hall __Occupation:__ Student The second son of [Donovan Desmond](https://anilist.co/character/180192/Desmond-Donovan) and attends Eden Academy as part of Cecile House, Group 3. A young child with an arrogant and rude personality, caused by him being the second son of Donovan Desmond, the leader of the National Unity Party, a group important and powerful enough to threaten the peace between the East and the West. This has caused Damian to gain a highly respected status among his peers and making him incredibly arrogant, assuming [Anya](https://anilist.co/character/138100/Forger-Anya) gained a crush on him when she stared at him. He is shown to prefer being called Lord Damian when spoken to. He gets angry when he is looked down upon by Anya's smile, quickly resorting to insulting her with his limited vocabulary and harassing Anya.

142838.name: Yuuri Briar
142838.desc: __Height:__ 179 cm (5′10") __Affiliation:__ Ostania, Ministry for Foreign Affairs (Cover), State Security Service __Occupation:__ Diplomat (Formerly, Cover), Counterintelligence Agent Yor Briar's younger brother who works in the State Security Service (SSS). He keeps his job at the SSS a secret from Yor, while pretending to be a normal civil servant at the foreign ministry. Yuri has a sister-complex, and even at an early age, he would be doing everything he could to get Yor to praise him with affection. Though this could be due to his mother dying at a very early stage in his life causing him to get very attached to Yor as a mother figure.

142838.name: Sylvia Sherwood
142838.original: シルヴィア・シャーウッド
142838.desc: She is [Twilight](https://anilist.co/character/138101/Forger-Loid)'s main contact at WISE.

142838.name: Franky Franklin
142838.original: フランキー・フランクリン
142838.desc: __Height:__ 166 cm (5′5") __Affiliation:__ Ostania __Occupation:__ Tobacco Store Clerk (False Front), Informant, Soldier (formerly) Franky is an informant who seemingly works at a tobacco store and presumably works for Loid Forger's agency. He gets information regarding Eden Academy's exam and Anya Forger's past records for Loid Forger. Franky is a kind person willing to help Loid out when he's in a pinch even though the danger is high. He frequently warns Loid Forger not to get too close to other people in their line of work. He frequently falls in love with other women but his love life typically fails due to lack of mutual interest or they are already with someone else.

142838.name: Bond
142838.desc: Bond is the recently adopted pet of the Forger Family. Formally known as Subject 8, Bond has been used for experiments that resulted in the dog gaining precognition abilities.

142838.name: Henry Henderson
142838.original: ヘンリー・ヘンダーソン
142838.desc: __Affiliation:__ Eden Academy __Occupation:__ History Teacher, Housemaster of Cecile Hall Henry is a mature and noble person, who places a high importance on "elegance". To him, elegance seems to be the way a person conducts themselves, and is not afraid to correct inelegant behavior in others.

142838.name: Camilla
142838.desc: One of Yor Forger's three co-workers at Berlint City Hall.

142838.name: Donovan Desmond
142838.original: ドノバン・デズモンド
142838.desc: Donovan Desmond is the President of the Nation Unity Party and Twilight's current target.

142838.name: Fiona Frost
142838.desc: __Height:__ 172 cm __Occupation:__ Hospital Assistant (secretly a spy) A spy who works undercover as an assistant to [Loid Forger](https://anilist.co/character/138101/Loid-Forger) at Berlint General Hospital to provide him with mission details. Fiona is deeply in love with Loid, even telling Loid to replace [Yor](https://anilist.co/character/138102/Forger-Yor) and let her take over the role of the Forger wife.

142838.name: Ewen Egeburg
142838.original: ユーイン・エッジバーグ
142838.desc: Best Friend of Damian and Student at Eden Academy. He is a loyal person, devotedly following Damian, almost always holding his bag when they walk to class. He also genuinely cares for Damian as a friend, getting concerned for Damian when he is hurt or pushing himself too hard.

142838.name: Emile Elman
142838.original: エミールぅ・エルマン
142838.desc: Best Friend of Damian and Student at Eden Academy.

142838.name: Bondman
142838.desc: The protagonist of Spy Wars and the number one spy in the show. He frequently has to take down enemies from the League of Evil in order to save Princess Honey.

142838.name: Honey-hime
142838.desc: Princess of the kingdom where Spy Wars takes place. She is frequently saved by Bondman which has caused her to develop feelings for him.

142838.name: Kokkahoankyoku Chuui
142838.desc: A scarred man who is a lieutenant and a higher position than [Yuuri Briar](https://anilist.co/character/150425/Yuuri-Briar) in the SSS. He seems to be fairly close to Yuuri and is aware of his drinking habits and sister complex, advising Yuri to get over his sister and focus on his work.

142838.name: Keith Kepler
142838.desc: The leader of a terrorist group consisting of isolationist college students from Berlint University, intending on assassinating Foreign Minister Brantz to start a war between Westalis and Ostania.

142838.name: Kris
142838.desc: A student at Berlint University and a member of the Berlint Terrorist group led by [Keith Kepler](https://anilist.co/character/280308/Keith-Kepler).

142838.name: Kurt
142838.desc: A student at Berlint University and a member of the Berlint Terrorist group led by [Keith Kepler](https://anilist.co/character/280308/Keith-Kepler).

142838.name: Monica McBride
142838.original: モニカ・マクブライド
142838.desc: Works at Mokumoku Club, a cigar club on Fifth Street.

142838.name: Brantz Daijin
142838.desc: A foreign minister from Westalis. He is the target of [Keith Kepler](https://anilist.co/character/280308/Keith-Kepler)'s assassination plan.

142838.name: Shinonome
142838.desc: An Ostanian spy who thinks of himself as a rival to [Twilight](https://anilist.co/character/138101/Loid-Forger). He is shown to be a highly untalented, yet lucky, spy.

142838.name: George Glooman
142838.original: ジョージ・グルーマン
142838.desc: A student at Eden Academy and a member of Cecile Hall. He is the son of the CEO of Glooman Pharmaceuticals, a company later bought by the Desmond Group.

142838.name: George no chichi
142838.desc: Father of George Glooman. He was the CEO of Glooman Pharmaceuticals until the company was bought by The Desmond Group.

142838.name: Carrol Campbell
142838.original: キャロル・キャンベル

142838.name: Cavi Campbell
142838.original: キャビー・キャンベル
142838.desc: After obtaining a fortune in the energy sector, he became known as one of the world's foremost collectors of classical art. He is one of the organizers of Campbelldon, an underground tennis competition.

142838.name: Erik Zacharis
142838.desc: Colonel Zacharis was in the East's Military Intelligence Division during the war and played a major role in ending the war. He previously owned the Lady In The Sun painting that holds a clue to the location of the Zacharis Dossier, rumored to contain information that could "reignite the war."

142838.name: Martha Marriott
142838.desc: Butler of the Blackbell family and typically acts as [Becky](https://anilist.co/character/150423)'s caretaker.

142838.name: Demetrius Desmond
142838.original: デミトリアス・デズモンド
142838.desc: First son of the Desmond family and the older brother of [Damian Desmond](https://anilist.co/character/150424/). He is an Imperial Scholar and is noted by [Loid Forger](https://anilist.co/character/138101/) to be an exceptional student, barely getting a single question wrong on the midterm exams.

20829.name: Yuuichirou Hyakuya
20829.desc: __Height:__ 170 cm (5'7") Yuuichirou is a member of the Japanese Imperial Demon Army and Shinoa Hiragi's squad in the Moon Demon Company. He, along with Mikaela Hyakuya, possesses the "Seraph" gene, which is relevant to the forbidden taboo and the focal point of the story, "Seraph of the End". Yuuichirou seems to be an excellent swordsman, as he was trained by Guren himself. He is also a "seraph of the end" with 1/10th of him being not human; he may have been experimented on by the Hyakuya, but this is unclear since the adults in charge of him were killed minutes after he arrived at the orphanage.

20829.name: Shinoa Hiiragi
20829.desc: __Height:__ 150 cm (4'11") Shinoa Hiiragi is Guren's sergeant and one of the squad leaders of the Moon Demon Company. She is appointed to supervise [Yuuichirou](https://anilist.co/character/83015/Hyakuya-Yuuichirou) during his suspension from the Japanese Imperial Demon Army for his reckless behavior. She is sarcastic and enjoys teasing others, especially Yuuichirou. Her Demon Weapon is Shikama Douji (Four-Scythe Child), a manifestation-type demon weapon which takes the form of a large scythe, but can be condensed into a pen-like object. She can call out the demon, which she fondly addresses as "Shi," inhabiting it out of the weapon to attack an enemy. Her primary ability is to detect anything that comes within the attack radius of her scythe. Despite being a member of the distinguished Hiiragi family, Shinoa is uninterested in their internal power struggle. Moreover, due to her sister's legacy, she is generally shunned by the upper echelon of the army. However, she is loyal to Guren and to the members of her squad. A childhood lacking in familial warmth left Shinoa with little understanding of the importance of friendship and camaraderie. She is moved by Yuuichirou's unwavering loyalty to the members of his squad, who he considers his family, and wants to foster the same feelings for them herself.

20829.name: Mikaela Hyakuya
20829.desc: __Height:__ 173 cm (5'8") The deuteragonist of the Owari no Seraph series. He is an incomplete vampire and a servant of Third Progenitor [Krul Tepes](https://anilist.co/character/88899/Tepes-Krul). He was human until Krul Tepes forced him to drink her blood. He, along with [Yuuichirou Hyakuya](https://anilist.co/character/83015/Hyakuya-Yuuichirou), possesses the "Seraph" gene, which is relevant to the forbidden taboo and the focal point of the story, "Seraph of the End." He wields a red colored sword. When he orders it to drink his blood, it sprouts thorny vines that pierce his hand. His strength grows in proportion to the amount of his blood the sword drinks.

20829.name: Ashuramaru
20829.desc: The demon into the black series demon blade used by [Yuuchirou](https://anilist.co/character/83015/Hyakuya-Yuuichirou). It often warns Yuuchirou about how humans are dangerous and can't be trusted.

20829.name: Krul Tepes
20829.desc: __Height:__ 145 cm (4'9") Krul Tepes is a third progenitor among the vampires and the former vampire queen of Japan. Just like all other vampires, she views the humans as nothing more than livestock. She sees them as foul and endlessly greedy creatures who will do anything for their own personal gain. When [Ferid Bathory](https://anilist.co/character/88990/Bathory-Ferid) slaughters the Hyakuya Sect orphans she carefully hid in Sanguinem and protected as livestock, she becomes enraged because he fatally wounded one of the seraph and allowed another to escape. She never mentions a word about the orphans and displays no interest in them. She saves [Mika](https://anilist.co/character/87287/Hyakuya-Mikaela)'s life against his will by turning him into a vampire, but this appears to have been done for her own personal interests. He refuses to drink human blood, so she gives her blood to him in exchange for making him dependent on her. Even so, she is the only vampire who shows him kindness, and there are several moments when she hugs him or treats him gently. After developing a close bond with Mika, she shows concern for his family member, [Yuuichirou Hyakuya](https://anilist.co/character/83015/Hyakuya-Yuuichirou). She claims to like both Mika and Yu. However, it is uncertain if this is due to her close relation with Mika and concern for Mika's sake or if this is because she wants to use the seraph for her own purposes. She also appears to trust Mika, and only she and Mika appear to

20829.name: Shihou Kimizuki
20829.desc: __Height:__ 177 cm (5'9") __Race__: Human Kimizuki is a serious and diligent person. He is competitive against Yuuichirou Hyakuya. He earned the highest test scores in their class, and he is angry when Yuuichirou appears out of nowhere and may earn Cursed Gear before him. He is hot-headed and tends to get in fights with both Mitsuba and Yuuichirou. He is tidy and skilled at cooking. When his friends are unconscious or injured, he is the first to take care of them, whether it be nursing them or giving them his jacket to keep them warm. Although the other members of his squad quickly refer to each other on a first-name basis, he is the only member the others address with his surname. Kimizuki has very high intelligence and was at the top of his class in all subjects, and regularly earned perfect scores. He earned 100s on each of his Latin, English, and Japanese spellcraft exams. He is on par with Yuichiro on skills of swordsmanship.

20829.name: Yoichi Saotome
20829.desc: __Height:__ 165 cm (5'5") __Race__: Human __Affiliation__: Japanese Imperial Demon Army __Section__: Moon Demon Squad __Demon Weapon Series__: Black Demon Series __Demon__: Gekkouin He is a member of the Japanese Imperial Demon Army and Shinoa Hīragi's squad in the Moon Demon Company. Yoichi has an equilibrium of kindness and altruism, giving him an optimistic and sweet personality. This gives him a strong mental balance against his demon, who takes the form of his sister. He lacked passion to kill vampires and fight and avenge his sister originally, but as he got to know his new "family", he began to see the reason that he was there. Yoichi does dislike conflict amongst friends, but conflict on the battle field doesn't bother him anymore. As time passed, Yoichi is shown to be much more confident with his skills, sniping down three Horsemen at ease by himself. Yoichi is usually the peace maker around Shinoa's Squad. Yuichiro and Kimizuki are usually fighting, and Yoichi often ends up in the middle of it. He has developed a love for his "family" that impacted his personality greatly. He used to get very nervous and stutter a lot, but the closer he got to the Squad, the more confident he got. He doesn't question his self-worth as much as before, and instead focuses more on protecting his new "family".

20829.name: Ferid Bathory
20829.original: フェリド・バートリー
20829.desc: He is a seventh progenitor among the vampires. He is the one who killed Yuuichirou's family, thus fueling his desire for revenge against all vampires. On the outside, Ferid acts kind and polite. However, he keeps many secrets which he has ready to deploy, and tells equally as many lies, similarly to use as and when they are best served. Extremely sadistic, Ferid will go to lengths to prepare, and then carry about murderous acts on a whim. A sense of pleasure appears to be gained in patiently manipulating others in order to torment them. Preferring the blood of beautiful boys and girls, he has kept many mansions filled with them over the centuries. Once he loses interest in one to the point of forgetting the child's name, Ferid kills him or her. Chatty, Ferid strikes up conversations with other vampires, and will speak calmly even in tense scenarios where he has the air of very much being in control of a situation.

20829.name: Mito Juujou
20829.desc: She is a Colonel of the Japanese Imperial Demon Army and a member of [Guren](https://anilist.co/character/88993/Ichinose-Guren)'s squad in the Moon Demon Company. She is also the daughter of the prestigious Jujo family.

20829.name: Shinya Hiiragi
20829.desc: __Height:__ 183 cm (6'0") __Race:__ Human __Affiliation:__ Japanese Imperial Demon Army __Section:__ Moon Demon Squad __Demon Weapon Series:__ Black Demon Series __Demon:__ Byakomaru A Major General of the Japanese Imperial Demon Army. Although he has a high capacity for spellcraft since childhood, Shinya is not comfortable with being with the Hiiragi Family. Shinya is shown to be a gentle and cool man. He does not get angry easily, even when being insulted by [Seishirou](https://anilist.co/character/89785/Hiiragi-Seishirou). He is seen smiling pleasantly all the time, even in tough spots. He has a lighthearted and breezy personality. Shinya is shown to be very loyal to his friends, such as [Guren](https://anilist.co/character/88993/Ichinose-Guren). He is also very observant and perceptive, and easily grasps Guren's emotions.

20829.name: Guren Ichinose
20829.desc: __Height:__ 183 cm (6'0") __Race:__ Human __Section:__ Moon Demon Squad __Demon Weapon Series:__ Black Demon __Demon:__ Mahiru-no Yo He is a Lieutenant Colonel of the Japanese Imperial Demon Army and the commanding officer of the Vampire Extermination Unit, Moon Demon Company. Guren would become a wise leader who values teamwork, co-operation and friends, and determined those were necessary to ensure the survival of the human race from demons and vampires. Sometimes pretending to be lazy, in truth, he really works hard. He keeps many secrets to himself, and has no difficulty lying about them. When enduring hardships in battle, he will focus on winning and take the most direct path to that.

20829.name: Seishirou Hiiragi
20829.desc: Seishiro Hiiragi is a Major General of the Japanese Imperial Demon Army.

20829.name: Tenri Hiiragi
20829.desc: Tenri Hiiragi is the general of the Japanese Imperial Demon Army. (Source: MAL)

20829.name: Crowley Eusford
20829.original: クローリー・ユースフォード
20829.desc: Crowley is a Thirteenth Progenitor among vampires and a member of Seventh Progenitor Ferid Bathory's faction. However, he hides his strength under Ferid's orders and is actually equal in strength to a Seventh Progenitor. Crowley is calm and brave which makes him a patient vampire who enjoys fighting any opponent. Even when he is in a tight spot, he remains calm with a pleasant smile. Despite sticking to Ferid, he appears to be emotionally detached from him, such as throwing the latter out of the bus as "revenge". Crowley also appears to be quite unimpressed with Ferid half of the time, calling his antics "stupid" and even sympathizing for the children getting dragged into the mess that Ferid created. He also doesn't appear to trust Ferid and is not afraid to be blunt to him for it.

20829.name: Kureto Hiiragi
20829.desc: __Race:__ Human __Height:__ 187 cm (6'1") __Section:__ Shibuya Main Army __Demon Weapon Series:__ Black Demon __Demon:__ Raimeiki He is the Lieutenant General of the Japanese Imperial Demon Army. His goal is to exterminate all the vampires in Japan and find the person who is manipulating the Hīragi family. He and Mahiru were in competition to be the next head of the Hīragi family. He was the student council president of First Shibuya High. He maintained his position as top of his class since first entering the school. He mentions to [Guren](https://anilist.co/character/88993/Ichinose-Guren) that his decisions hold more weight at the school than the principal's. ~!He later becomes​ the head of the Hīragi Family as well as the Japanese Imperial Demon Army, by killing his own father.!~

20829.name: Norito  Goshi
20829.desc: __Race:__ Human __Height:__ 185 cm (6'1") __Affiliation:__ Order of the Imperial Demons, Japanese Imperial Demon Army __Section:__ Moon Demon Company, Guren Squad __Rank:__ Colonel Colonel in the Japanese Imperial Demon Army.

20829.name: Sayuri  Hanayori
20829.desc: __Race:__ Human __Height:__ 160 cm (5'3") (Catastrophe), 165 cm (5'5") (Vampire Reign) __Affiliation:__ Order of the Imperial Moon, Japanese Imperial Demon Army, [Guren Ichinose](https://anilist.co/character/88993/Ichinose-Guren)'s Aides __Section:__ Moon Demon Company, Guren Squad __Rank:__ Second Lieutenant She is a second lieutenant of the Japanese Imperial Demon Army and a member of Guren's squad in the Moon Demon Company. While serving as a member of the Moon Demon Company, she is also an Army instructor for the training classes. Sayuri belongs to a retainer house that serves the Ichinoses. Sayuri is shown to be quite perceptive at times, observing how [Yuu](https://anilist.co/character/83015/Hyakuya-Yuuichirou) and his friends are much stronger than she is, when she was 16. ~!She had a crush on Guren and was his emotional support.!~

20829.name: Mitsuba Sanguu
20829.desc: __Birthday:__ July 7, 2004 __Height:__ 155 cm (5'1") __Race:__ Human __Affiliation:__ Japanese Imperial Demon Army __Section:__ Moon Demon Squad __Demon Weapon Series:__ Dakini __Demon:__ Tenjiryū A member of the Japanese Imperial Demon Army and a member of [Yuu](https://anilist.co/character/83015/Hyakuya-Yuuichirou)'s team of the Moon Demon Squad. She also the younger sister of Aoi Sanguu. Mitsuba is shown to be a serious and by-the-book soldier, who dislikes those who break the formation and commit to individual action. In reality, she is a talkative, selfish girl. Despite this, she gets jealous easily. Mitsuba appears to be the most talkative girl in her group.

20829.name: Shigure Yukimi
20829.desc: __Race:__ Human __Height:__ 150 cm (4'11") (Catastrophe) 151 cm (4'11½") (Vampire Reign) __Affiliation:__ Order of the Imperial Moon, Japanese Imperial Demon Army, [Guren Ichinose](https://anilist.co/character/88993/Ichinose-Guren)'s Aides __Section:__ Moon Demon Company, Guren Squad __Rank:__ Second Lieutenant She is a second lieutenant of the Japanese Imperial Demon Army and a member of Guren's squad in the Moon Demon Company. Like [Sayuri Hanayori](https://anilist.co/character/135249/Hanayori-Sayuri), Shigure is also a servant for the Ichinose Family. ~!Similar to Sayuri, she's very protective of Guren, and does not hesitate to carry out his orders. Like Sayuri, she also has a crush on Guren, but does not show it often.!~

20829.name: Horn  Skuld
20829.desc: Horn Skuld is a vampire noble who serves Thirteenth Progenitor Crowley Eusford. She is fond of both him and her partner, Seventeenth Progenitor Chess Belle, and she can usually be found in their company.

20829.name: Akane  Hyakuya
20829.desc: One of the orphans from Hyakuya Orphanage along with Yuuichirou and Mika. Being the eldest in their group, she did the motherly duties for them, such as preparing food. ~!She had a crush on Mikaela Hyakuya.!~ ~!Ferid Bathory hunts down Mika and Yu. When they agree to surrender, he pulls out Akane's head from the trunk of his fancy western car and tells Yu to say that to her face. Once Yu's demon side takes control, he tosses her head to Yoichi Saotome. After subduing Yu, he tells Mika that he has come to show them how to return Akane to life. He says the name of this experiment is the Seraph of the End.!~

20829.name: Chess  Belle
20829.desc: Race: Human (Formerly), Vampire (Currently)Born: April 1st Height: 151 cm (4'11½") Affiliation: Vampires Section: Ferid Bathory's Faction, Japan Occupation: Crowley Eusford's Aide Rank: 17th Progenitor Status: Alive Chess Belle is a seventeenth progenitor vampire who serves Thirteenth Progenitor Crowley Eusford. Even though she is a noble, her personality is freewheeling gets jealous easily and behavior is very careless. Chess is a very short girl with an hourglass figure and very large breasts. She has chin-length iris-colored hair and bangs that frame her face. Like all vampires, she has red eyes, fangs, and pointed ears. She also has visible lower lashes. She wears a headband that matches Horn's. She also wears a matching black collar and a white cape that reaches past her buttocks. Like Horn, she wears an attire with a low cut that reveals her cleavage. She wears a black and white dress with detached black sleeves. A blue bow decorates the front of her bodice, and the black of the dress emphasizes her breasts and hips as it trails down to the front of her skirts. She has a large bow at her tailbone in the back of her dress. Two white skirts layer over each other and reach down to her knees. She wears black stockings that reach right above her She is immature, careless, playful, and childish, which foils the more serious and mature behavior of her partner, Horn. She is very fond of both Crowley and Horn, and she can usually be found in their company. She gets jealous easil

20829.name: René Simm
20829.desc: René Simm is a vampire who often works with Lacus Welt and Mikaela Hyakuya as a city guard. He is tasked with gathering surviving humans to provide a food source for vampires. Thinking objectively in situations, René keeps a clear head in precarious situations. He does not approve of Mika's behavior in battle and thought he destroyed a Four Horseman of John by himself to gain glory.

20829.name: Lacus Welt
20829.desc: Lacus Welt is a vampire in Japan who often works with René Simm and Mikaela Hyakuya.

99578.name: Hirotaka Nifuji
99578.desc: __Height:__ 184 cm He specializes in video games, but he also reads a lot of manga and watches a lot of anime. (He likes all kinds of games, but he's especially fond of FPS games, fighting games and action games, where it's not necessary to level up.) He goes for one person in video games and finds everything from visuals to status as being important. He prefers e-mail for communication as the tension isn't as high as it is otherwise.

99578.name: Narumi Momose
99578.desc: __Height:__ 154 cm Manga, comics and cosplay are up her alley, and at one time she had a superficial knowledge of the fashion scene. She's a fan of multiple genres, loving many of them at the same time. She's known [Hirotaka](https://anilist.co/character/122189/Nifuji-Hirotaka) since childhood (the one responsible for getting her into the otaku life) and he is the only one who really knows about her being an otaku.

99578.name: Hanako Koyanagi
99578.desc: __Height:__ 167 cm (5'6") She likes things like drama and stage theatre. She also has a soft spot for anime and manga, as well as BL. She admires wifely characters who love someone with all their might. She doesn't have much tolerance for alcohol, so she doesn't bother to drink often, and she smokes very rarely.

99578.name: Tarou Kabakura
99578.desc: __Height:__ 180 cm He's majorly into manga and games, which he has good taste in. He also has good taste in the merchandise he owns. Compared to the typical otaku, however, he falls a little short. Before he gets into new characters, he takes into consideration the guilty feeling he has about crime fiction and married life genres, former wives and current wives meeting genres, and the system type of wife-donos entering temples.

99578.name: Naoya Nifuji
99578.desc: __Height:__ 177 cm Naoya is a university student and the younger brother of [Hirotaka Nifuji](https://anilist.co/character/122189/Hirotaka-Nifuji) who wants the best for Hirotaka and he is genuinely happy when good things happen to him. He works as a barista in a coffee shop that is next to the office building where his brother is working to. Naoya has a cheerful personality who is often portrayed as a cat due to his cat-like smile and he seems to love his work as a barista since having satisfied customers makes him contented.

99578.name: Kou Sakuragi
99578.desc: The way she gets absorbed in games bears an uncanny resemblance to a certain someone. Doesn't use any social media sites or apps. Her messages tend to be very long, as if she carefully collected all her thoughts before writing them down. As a result, it takes her a while to send a response since she ends up revising them over and over. “Sorry” and “apologize” always come up first as suggestions when she starts typing. The anxiety she feels from having to send messages or make phone calls is akin to having a heart attack.

99578.name: Yoshiki Ichijou
99578.desc: __Height:__ 167cm Cheapskate, well-informed, and super perverted. He has been friends with Naoya Nifuji since kindergarten.

99578.name: Chiba
99578.desc: Narumi's co-worker. She is pretty rich.

99578.name: Aiba
99578.desc: Hirotaka's co-worker. He likes women and is a showoff.

99578.name: Baba
99578.desc: Hikotaka's co-worker. He is a morose pervert.

99578.name: Kensuke Mitsui
99578.desc: __Height:__ 172cm One of Naoya's friends. A loud and perverted muscle-head. He has been friends with Naoya Nifuji since kindergarten.

150672.name: Ai Hoshino
150672.desc: __Height__: 151 cm (4'11") She's an idol and lead of B-Komachi, an idol group affiliated with Strawberry Productions. Her life took a turn when through an undetermined amount of time, she became pregnant with twins. Not wanting to squander her reputation, she and her team decide to hide this fact; having to play the role of idol and mother.

150672.name: Ruby Hoshino
150672.desc: __Height:__ 158 cm (5'2") [Ai Hoshino](https://anilist.co/character/172759/Ai-Hoshino)'s daughter, and the younger twin sister of [Aquamarine Hoshino](https://anilist.co/character/183885). ~!She was previously a patient named Sarina under Goro's care. Due to her illness, she was wheelchair-bound. After discovering B-Komachi, she had always aspired to be an idol although her condition kept her from achieving her dream. Since being reincarnated as Ruby, she is now working towards her dream of being an idol like Ai. To do so she's currently working with Strawberry Productions to revive B-Komachi along with Arima Kana and Memcho.!~

150672.name: Aquamarine Hoshino
150672.desc: __Height:__ 172 cm (5'7") [Ai Hoshino](https://anilist.co/character/172759/Ai-Hoshino)'s son. He is the twin big brother of [Ruby Hoshino](https://anilist.co/character/183884/Ruby-Hoshino). ~!He was previously a doctor named Goro, who became a fan of Ai through his patient named Sarina.!~ ~!After reincarnating as Aquamarine and witnessing Ai's murder, he is intent on plotting revenge to the person who schemed Ai's death.!~

150672.name: Kana Arima
150672.desc: __Height:__ 150 cm (4'11") An actress who was called a prodigy child. She has a rather stubborn personality yet an empathic side to her. She easily succumbs to pressure and while she does put up a front to others, she has very self-deprecating thoughts when it comes to her abilities. She's an honest and earnest person, who is very diligent and persistent even in the roughest of times. Also, she tends to place all responsibility on herself when it comes to others as she is the one who has the most experience in the show business world. She also hates bell peppers. ~!After the events of the Sweet Today Drama adaptation, she secretly develops a crush for [Aquamarine](https://anilist.co/character/183885/Hoshino-Aquamarine).!~ ~!She longs for someone to look at her for who she is now and praise her efforts, someone to say that its okay for her to be here. And after the new B-Komachi's first concert, that person becomes Aquamarine after he waves her respected colored glow stick. Only reinforcing Kana's resolve to make Aquamarine fall for her.!~

150672.name: Akane Kurokawa
150672.desc: __Height:__ 163 cm (5'4") Akane Kurokawa is a rising star actress from the Lalalie Theatrical Company. Although a shy and quiet person, she is very serious when it comes to creating a good performance. She does a deep examination of each role she is given, allowing her to perfectly portray the character's personality and motivations. Akane is introduced to [Aqua](https://anilist.co/character/183885) as a fellow cast member on the set of the reality dating show *The Beginning of My Love With An Idol*.

150672.name: MEM-cho
150672.desc: __Height:__ 155 cm (5'1") A girl who strived to become an idol at a young age, but due to her family situation, made sacrifices that ultimately ended with her becoming too old to become one. She is a YouTuber. ~!Mem-cho's real age is 25, and she is later recruited as the third member of the re-formed B-Komachi idol group.!~

150672.name: Miyako Saitou
150672.desc: Miyako is married to [the president](https://anilist.co/character/245521) of Ichigo Productions and is [Ai's](https://anilist.co/character/172759) manager. She is a shallow woman who appears to have only married her husband due to the prospect of working with hot guys. She is also a babysitter to the twins. ~!After Ai's death, she becomes the twin's adoptive parent. As the twins blossom into adolescence, she becomes more mature, both as a caretaker and as a manager. She is also the manager of the new B-Komachi.!~

150672.name: Frill Shiranui
150672.desc: Frill Shiranui is a student in Ruby Hoshino's class. She is a multi-talented performer who can sing, dance, and act. At first, Ruby is in awe of her, yet they eventually become friends. ~!She is the younger sister of [Koromo Shiranui](https://anilist.co/character/212391/Koromo-Shiranui) from [Kaguya-sama wa Kokurasetai: Tensaitachi no Renai Zunousen](https://anilist.co/manga/86635/Kaguyasama-wa-Kokurasetai-Tensaitachi-no-Renai-Zunousen/).!~

150672.name: Pieyon
150672.desc: A famous physical training YouTuber affiliated with Strawberry Productions, where he is the agency's top earner. On request from company president Miyako Saitou, he promotes the new B-Komachi by collaborating with Ruby Hoshino and Kana Arima in a physical training video on his channel.

150672.name: Abiko Samejima
150672.desc: Author of "Tokyo Blade".

150672.name: Yoriko Kichijouji
150672.desc: A mangaka and author of "Today will be sweet" . She used to be [Abiko](https://anilist.co/character/237576/Abiko-Samejima)'s mentor.

150672.name: Taiki Himekawa
150672.desc: Award-winning stage actor affiliated with the Lala Lai Theatrical Company.

150672.name: Nobuyuki Kumano
150672.desc: Nobuyuki Kumano is a dancer in 2nd year of highschool.

150672.name: Sumiaki Raida
150672.desc: Sumiaki Raida works for the company "Magic Flow". He is an executive producer on the 2.5D stage play *Tokyo Blade*.

150672.name: Toshirou Kindaichi
150672.desc: Leader of the Lala Lai Theatrical Company, and one of its founding members. He is the Director of the 2.5D Stage Play *Tokyo Blade*.

150672.name: Melt Narushima
150672.desc: Model and actor affiliated with Sonic Stage Productions. He appeared while still an untrained, yet arrogant, actor on the TV Drama *I'll Go With Sweet Today*. Melt was then cast in the role of Kizami in the 2.5D Stage Play *Tokyo Blade*.

150672.name: GOA
150672.desc: GOA is a popular scriptwriter.

150672.name: Sakuya Kamoshida
150672.desc: Sakuya Kamoshida is an actor specialized in theater adaptations.

150672.name: Masaya Kaburagi
150672.desc: Masaya Kaburagi is a TV and Web-TV producer.

150672.name: Taishi Gotanda
150672.desc: Taishi Gotanda is a movie director, and the "mentor" of [Aquamarine Hoshino](https://anilist.co/character/183885/Aquamarine-Hoshino). He still lives with his [mother](https://anilist.co/character/302910).

150672.name: Ichigo Saitou
150672.desc: Ichigo Saitou is the director of the agency Ichigo Production. He is the one who scouted [Ai](https://anilist.co/character/172759/Ai-Hoshino) and made her a star.

150672.name: Mana Suzushiro
150672.desc: Mana Suzushiro is an underground idol who decided to stop her show business career after seeing the new idol group B-Komachi on stage.

150672.name: Yuki Sumi
150672.desc: Yuki Sumi is a model in 1st year of high school.

150672.name: Minami Kotobuki
150672.desc: She's a classmate and friend of Ruby Hoshino. Minami is a Gravure model who uses a fake accent.

150672.name: Kengo Morimoto
150672.desc: Third-year high schooler and professional musician signed with a record label. He writes all of the music and lyrics for his band and occasionally for others. He was a cast member of the reality dating show "LoveNow."

150672.name: Ryousuke Sugano
150672.desc: A shut-in, Ryosuke is a mentally unstable person who turns towards idols to feel loved in his life. He is an obsessive fan of [Ai Hoshino](https://anilist.co/character/172759). ~!Ryousuke became enraged after learning of Ai's pregnancy and murdered Gorou Amemiya when the doctor interfered in his first attempt to kill Ai. Years later Ryousuke murdered Ai, fatally stabbing her at her home. Shortly afterwards Ryousuke commited suicide.!~

150672.name: Taishi no Haha
150672.desc: Mother of [Taishi Gotanda](https://anilist.co/character/245519).

150672.name: Lala
150672.desc: An idol from a company that wants to scout [Ruby Hoshino](https://anilist.co/character/183884/Ruby-Hoshino) to become its idol.

150672.name: Hikaru Kanzaki
150672.desc: Employee at Ichigo Productions.

150672.name: Drama Kantoku
150672.desc: The director of the drama series I'll Go With Sweet Today.

150672.name: Director
150672.desc: Director of the reality dating show "My Love with a Star Begins Now" (also known as "LoveNow")

150672.name: Akane no Haha
150672.desc: Mother of [Akane Kurokawa](https://anilist.co/character/203384).

150672.name: Manager
150672.desc: The manager of Akane Kurokawa. He tries his best to protect her.

150672.name: Kana no Haha
150672.desc: Mother of Arima Kana.

150672.name: Koyaku Jimusho Manager
150672.original: 子役事務所マネージャー

150672.name: Otaku Fan
150672.desc: A fan of various idol groups, including both the original and current incarnation of B-Komachi.

9756.name: Madoka Kaname
9756.desc: __Height:__ 152 cm (5'0") A 14-year-old girl whose life changes when she encounters the Puella Magi Homura and the familiar Kyuubey, who offers to transform her into a Puella Magi herself. She sees herself as a person without special qualities or talents, and after seeing Mami fighting against witches, wants to be a wonderful and cool Puella Magi like her. She is a rather selfless girl who wishes to be a magical girl simply so that she can help others. She allegedly has a large amount of magical potential within her. Madoka's heavily pink character design evokes a sense of child-like innocence and femininity. Her age and naive attitude is further implied with her pigtail haircut. Her immaturity is exemplified with props several times, such as when she brought an impractical sketchbook to a witch hunt, which is something you'd expect a child to do.

9756.name: Homura Akemi
9756.desc: __Height:__ 155 - 158 cm Homura is a magical girl who first appears in an apocalyptic nightmare of [Madoka](https://anilist.co/character/37832)'s. She transfers into her school the day after the dream. She is a beautiful, mysterious individual that performs exceptionally well in academics and athletics. This makes her instantly popular even though she is cold to others. She seems to know Madoka well and wishes to prevent her from becoming a magical girl. She attacks [Kyuubey](https://anilist.co/character/38566) in the first episode, only to be stopped by [Mami](https://anilist.co/character/38194). ~!Homura's cold personality developed from repeating the same timeline again and again. She was originally a shy, weak transfer student who spent a long time in hospital due to heart disease. She was befriended and eventually saved from a witch by Madoka, who revealed that she was a magical girl. When Madoka was killed in her battle with WalpurgisNacht, Homura contracted with Kyuubey to become a person that could protect her. She became a magical girl with the ability to manipulate time, allowing her to return to her first meeting with Madoka in order to change her fate. She tries, again and again,​ to prevent Madoka from being killed or becoming a magical girl and, inevitably, a witch, but is never able to save her. She always returns to the beginning of the month upon failure. Her magical weapon is a shield filled with sand that allows her to freeze time. However, this power becom

9756.name: Mami Tomoe
9756.desc: __Height:__ 156-159 cm Mami Tomoe is a veteran magical girl and a third-year student at Madoka's school. She lives alone in a penthouse after her parents were killed in a car crash, which Mami survived after contracting with Kyuubey. Mami is particularly focused on saving, guiding, and protecting those around her, which is a traditionally selfless perspective on the role of magical girl. She is much like a maternal figure to Madoka and Sayaka, being the eldest among them. Her name could be considered a play on the word 'mommy', further supported in the third film, where she has a companion named "Bebe". Though Mami's outward disposition is cheery and confident, Mami feels deeply alone as she has no friends to confide in as she fights. ~!Madoka offers to become her partner and save her from her loneliness, but Mami is killed immediately after during battle with a witch; as per Madoka's wish, at the close of the final timeline, this witch never existed, and Mami is therefore seen, alive, with Kyoko and Homura at the end of the series. According to Kyuubey, she never knew the darker truths concerning Soul Gems and origins of witches. In a previous timeline, learning of these truths drove Mami insane and she attempted to murder the remaining magical girls to prevent them from becoming witches, and in the Oriko Magica timeline, she contemplates letting herself be killed and/or committing suicide so she doesn't become a witch herself.!~

9756.name: Sayaka Miki
9756.desc: __Height:__ 158-160 cm __Weapon:__ Cutlass [Madoka](https://anilist.co/character/37832/Kaname-Madoka)'s classmate who, after helping Madoka rescue [Kyuubey](https://anilist.co/character/38566/Kyuubey), ends up getting an offer to become a Puella Magi herself. She cares deeply for her friends, and wants to help an ill boy named [Kyousuke Kamijou](https://anilist.co/character/39835/Kamijou-Kyousuke), whom she has a crush on. Before becoming a Puella Magi, Sayaka wields a baseball bat that [Mami](https://anilist.co/character/38194/Tomoe-Mami) can enhance with magic to defend herself with while on witch hunts. ~!In order to cure Kyosuke's hand, which was damaged in an accident which robbed him of his ability to play the violin, she becomes a Puella Magi. Sayaka's weapon of choice is a sword. She also has regenerative powers stronger than anyone else due to the nature of her wish. Sayaka hates people who think only of themselves whilst hurting others and is easily provoked into a fight. After learning how Puella Magi are created, Sayaka starts to descend into despair, as she believes she's now no better than a zombie and thus cannot openly admit her love for Kyousuke. Her state of mind only worsens as one of her two best friends, Hitomi, confesses that she has feelings for Kyousuke too and makes advances on him. At the same time, she also refuses to purify her Soul Gem with Grief Seeds and neglects it to become tainted. At the end of episode 8, her Soul Gem was finally exhausted,

9756.name: Kyuubey
9756.desc: He is a familiar who can grant any wish to a certain girl, on the condition that she becomes a Puella Magi and fights against witches. ~!When someone makes a contract with him, he extracts their soul and places it inside a Soul Gem, replacing their body with a shell that's more resilient to fighting witches. He has made contracts with Mami, Kyoko, Homura, and Sayaka, and shows particular interest in making Madoka a Puella Magi. It is unknown if there are other familiars besides him. He can only be seen or heard by Puella Magi and those who have potential to become a Puella Magi. He also disposes of used Grief Seeds for the Puella Magi, because, if they are used too extensively, the witch could become reborn from the Grief Seed. He also constantly tries to find chances to persuade girls who have potential to become Puella Magi to form a contract with him, despite the fact that he knows the dangers that Puella Magi face. Much to his dismay, he cannot force a girl to become a Puella Magi. He doesn't fully understand human values and questions any perceived differences between himself and humans. For example, when Madoka claims that he is cruel for forming contracts with girls and turning them into Puella Magi, he compares his actions to the act of humans slaughtering livestock, saying that, unlike humans, who show a lack of interest and sympathy for other creatures' values when it comes to their own survival, he at least recognizes humans as being sentient beings and tries to ne

9756.name: Hitomi Shizuki
9756.desc: Madoka and Sayaka's classmate and friend, who is quite popular with the boys. She attends after-school classes in Piano, Japanese dance and Tea ceremony, feeling obliged to make time for them even when she might reasonably be expected to focus on her studies. ~!She has feelings for Kyousuke, just like Sayaka.!~ (Source: Puella Magi Wikia)

9756.name: Junko Kaname
9756.desc: Junko is Madoka's mother. She's a successful business woman. She often goes out drinking with friends and co-workers, and comes home from a long day of work drunk. She's also friends with Madoka's homeroom teacher. She and Madoka are close, and she cares for her daughter very much, but ultimately lets her go when she tells her there's something she has to do on Walpurgis Nacht.

9756.name: Tomohisa Kaname
9756.desc: Height: 175-180 cm Madoka's father. A stay-at-home dad. He does housekeeping, cooking, laundry and cleaning. (Source: Puella Magi Wikia)

9756.name: Kazuko Saotome
9756.desc: Height: 155-157 cm Kazuko is Madoka's class teacher. Her relationships with guys don't last very long, and so she's extremely frustrated in these regards. Many of her classes involve her complaining about men. She also seems to be a friend of Junko Kaname, Madoka's mother. (Source: Official Production Notes & Puella Magi Wikia)

9756.name: Kyousuke Kamijou
9756.desc: __Height:__ 170-175 cm A terminally ill boy whom Sayaka constantly visits. He used to play violin when he was younger and enjoys listening to classical musical CDs that Sayaka brings him. (Source: Wikipedia)

9756.name: Kyouko Sakura
9756.desc: __Height:__ 156-158 cm __Weapon:__ Spear Kyouko is a veteran magical girl who comes to the city later in the story. Amusingly, she is always seen eating something, even while she is battling. Having grown up in a poor family, she often has to steal food and hates people who waste it, a logic she also applies to Grief Seeds, as she only goes after fully grown witches. Kyouko has been a Puella Magi much longer than the others, and thus is more skillful; she wields a spear which can extend itself, split into multiple sections, and produce a ball at the end of a chain, which can constrict and hit others at the same time. She also has the ability to put up barriers to protect others or keep them from interfering. She initially clashes with Sayaka, but after learning the truth about Soul Gems, she sympathizes with her and tries to help her. ~!She came from a poor church family and used her wish so that people would listen to her father's preaching; when her father learned of this, however, he went mad and killed everyone in his family aside from Kyouko. As such, Kyouko decided only to use her magic for herself from this point on, since using it for others will only cause despair.!~

9756.name: Tatsuya Kaname
9756.desc: Madoka's little brother. He's 3 years old and goes to kindergarten. (Source: Puella Magi Wikia)

9756.name: Walpurgis Night
9756.desc: The witch of stage settings; her nature is helplessness. She symbolizes the fool who continuously spins in circles. The witch's mysteries have been handed down through the course of history; her appellation is "Walpurgis Night." She will continue to rotate aimlessly throughout the world until she completely changes the whole of this age into a drama. When the doll's usual upside-down position reaches the top part of the witch, she completely roils the civilization on the ground in a flash through her gale-like flight. Her true name is unknown. (Source: Puella Magi Wikia)

9756.name: Nakazawa
9756.desc: Nakazawa is rare among Madoka's classmates in that his family name is known. However, his given name is unknown. He answered Ms. Saotome's question about whether he prefers hard-boiled or soft-boiled eggs. Source : Puella-Magi Wiki

137822.name: Yoichi Isagi
137822.desc: __Height:__ 175 cm (5'9") Second-year high school student at Ichinan High School in Saitama. Isagi grew up watching soccer and aspiring to be like [Noel Noa](https://anilist.co/character/268966), a forward for France's National Team. Due to this, he dreams of becoming the best striker in the world. In turn, Isagi played striker for his school soccer team, who was defeated in the Prefectural Finals by Matsukaze Kokou High. After this loss, Isagi is invited to participate in the Blue Lock Project, ranked 299th of 300 strikers, and is assigned to Team Z. Isagi is easygoing and has a generally friendly, cheery personality, but his simple and innocent habits often get on the nerves of the people around him. As time goes on, Isagi develops a more assertive presence on and off the field, becoming the foundation for Team Z and garnering the respect of some of the best players in Blue Lock.

137822.name: Jinpachi Ego
137822.desc: __Height:__ 189 cm (6'2") General Director/Manager of the Blue Lock Project, handpicked to lead the project by [Anri Teieri](https://anilist.co/character/169405). Ego is introduced as a man who radiates ambition and confidence. His egotistical nature is undeniable, especially given his belief that only his methods can lead to Japan's victory in the World Cup. Ego used to play football in his earlier career, with Noel Noa being his rival and former teammate.

137822.name: Ryousuke Kira
137822.desc: Previously a second year football player at Matsukaze Kokuo High and now #289 in Blue Lock. He is a pretty boy with girls swooning over him. He plays as a striker and, like Yoichi, is a team-based player. Ryousuke is skeptical about the whole Blue Lock program and is against the thought of an ego-driven striker. Due to this, he is trying to defeat all 299 other strikers at Blue Lock. ~!He is kicked out of Blue Lock after being defeated by Yoichi and Meguru.!~

137822.name: Meguru Bachira
137822.desc: __Birthplace:__ Chiba __Height:__ 176 cm (5'9") Meguru Bachira is a contender in the Blue Lock Project who currently plays as a center forward for Spain’s FC Barcha during the Neo Egoist League. Bachira is a whimsical forward who plays instinctively.

137822.name: Rensuke Kunigami
137822.desc: __Height:__ 188 cm __Team:__ Team Z Rensuke Kunigami is very serious about his football career and training; he's always the first in the training room in the morning and the last to leave at night. Kunigami tends to get into arguments with Raichi, but is also the one who restrains him the most when he picks a fight with someone. ~! During the second selection Kunigami is eliminated from Blue Lock project, but afterwards gets a second chance through the Wild Card training !~ ~! After Blue Lock vs. Japan U20 match, Kunigami gets back into Blue Lock project. His appearance changed a bit and his attitude too. !~

137822.name: Seishirou Nagi
137822.desc: __Height:__ 190 cm (6'3") Contender for the Blue Lock Project. He attends Hakuho High School alongside [Reo Mikage](https://anilist.co/character/169394/Mikage-Reo). As a striker, Nagi's perfect ball control, flexible movements, and technical ability allow him to breathe life into even the most difficult or hopeless plays. Nagi is a very lazy and unmotivated person with an outstanding aptitude for football. He's unnaturally talented, with amazing reflexes, good speed, and jumping skills. He has no interest in going pro or even playing at all at first. As long as he can get a decent job and keep living a lax life, he is content with doing nothing forever and often appears lethargic in his speech and body language. Introverted to a fault, he lives by himself in an apartment his parents pay for with only a pet cactus for company.

137822.name: Hyouma Chigiri
137822.desc: __Height:__ 177cm (5'10") Hyoma Chigiri is a contender for the Blue Lock Project and member of Team Z. As a young child, he was thought of as a prodigy due to his incredible speed. However, he is now psychologically scarred by a life-changing injury during his first year of high school.

137822.name: Yudai Imamura
137822.desc: __Birthplace:__ Tokushima Prefecture __Height:__ 178 cm (5'10") __Team:__ Team Z Yudai Imamura is a contender in the Blue Lock Project.

137822.name: Reo Mikage
137822.desc: **Height:** 185 cm Reo Mikage is the heir of the Mikage Corporation. Prior to entering Blue Lock, he was a student at an elite high school, the same school as [Seishiro Nagi](https://anilist.co/character/162969/Nagi-Seishirou).

137822.name: Rin Itoshi
137822.desc: __Height:__ 186 cm (6'1") First-year high school student and contender for the Blue Lock Project. He is the younger brother of Sae Itoshi, a prodigy considered one of the best youth soccer players in the world. Rin once had the aspiration of being the greatest in the world alongside his brother, but after a disagreement, he became obsessed with beating his brother in football to demonstrate he can succeed without him. Rin is a player who loves to play perfectly efficient football but isn’t hesitant to be daring and take surprising risks to fully embrace the live-or-die attitude he has grown fond of and appreciates. Whether on offense or defense, Rin's play style consists of him grasping the abilities of both his teammates and his opponents and forcing out their best plays and abilities. He either manipulates them in his efforts to score goals for himself or aims to crush them at their strongest.

137822.name: Sae Itoshi
137822.desc: __Height:__ 180 cm (5'11") Sae Itoshi is regarded as the best player in Japan and is [Rin Itoshi](https://anilist.co/character/169395/Rin-Itoshi)'s older brother. He is a member of Re AL youth team and is regarded as one of the best youth players in the world. ~!He is a member of the New Generation World XI.!~

137822.name: Gurimu Igarashi
137822.desc: __Height:__ 175 cm

137822.name: Shouei Barou
137822.desc: __Height:__ 187 cm

137822.name: Jingo Raichi
137822.desc: __Height:__ 184 cm __Team:__ Team Z Raichi is the most hot-headed of the group and argues with just about everyone on everything, often to the point of needing to be restrained by Kunigami.

137822.name: Gin Gagamaru
137822.desc: __Height:__ 191 cm Gagamaru was a forward who aspired to be the best in the world, along with the others of Blue Lock. When first arriving at Blue Lock, he was a member of Team Z during the First Selection.

137822.name: Anri Teieri
137822.desc: __Height:__ 157cm (5'2") Anri is a new member of the Japan Football Association. Sometime after the defeat of the Japanese National Team in the 2018 World Cup, Anri proposes the Blue Lock plan to the executives of the Japan Football Union to help Japan win the World Cup.

137822.name: Zantetsu Tsurugi
137822.desc: __Birthplace:__ Saitama Prefecture __Height:__ 187 cm (6'2") Zantetsu Tsurugi is a contender in the Blue Lock Project. ~!He was a member of Team V during the First Selection and remained among the selected contenders after the Second Selection. Known for his simplicity and remarkable speed, he played as a right winger for France’s Paris X Gen during the Neo Egoist League. Following the conclusion of the 5th round, he was ranked 19th overall and qualified as one of the 23 players selected for the U-20 World Cup.!~

137822.name: Asahi Naruhaya
137822.desc: __Height:__ 171 cm __Team:__ Team Z Naruhaya is the youngest member of Team Z and is always seen stealing food from Gin. ~!During the Second Selection Naruhaya teams up with Barou, but loses in a 2v2 match against Isagi and Nagi, and is eliminated from Blue Lock!~

137822.name: Ryuusei Shidou
137822.desc: __Birthplace:__ Tokyo __Height:__ 185 cm (6'1") Ryuusei Shidou is a contender in the Blue Lock Project. ~!He was ranked #2 during the Third Selection and was initially chosen as the wildcard for the Blue Lock Eleven in their match against Japan’s U-20 team, but was instead selected by [Itoshi Sae](https://anilist.co/character/169397/Itoshi-Sae) to play for the U-20 side. He later stood out as one of the top players in the project. During the Neo Egoist League, he played as a center forward for France’s Paris X Gen. Following the conclusion of the 5th round, he was ranked 3rd overall and qualified as one of the 23 players for the new Japan U-20 team.!~

137822.name: Eita Otoya
137822.desc: __Birthplace:__ Aichi __Height:__ 177 cm (5'10") Eita Otoya is a contender in the Blue Lock Project. ~!When first introduced, he was ranked #4 during the Third Selection and later played both right wing and right-back for the Blue Lock Eleven in their match against Japan’s U-20 team. He played as a right winger for Spain’s FC Barcha during the Neo Egoist League.!~

137822.name: Tabito Karasu
137822.desc: __Birthplace:__ Osaka __Height:__ 183 cm (6'0") Tabito Karasu is a contender in the Blue Lock Project. ~!He played as a central midfielder for France’s Paris X Gen during the Neo Egoist League. When first introduced, he was ranked #3 during the Third Selection and later played as a defensive midfielder for the Blue Lock Eleven in their match against Japan’s U-20 team.!~

137822.name: You Hiori
137822.desc: __Height:__ 183 cm (6'0") Hiori Yo one of friends that Isagi made before Third Selection begins

137822.name: Nanase  Nijirou
137822.desc: __Height:__ 178 cm (5'10") Nananse Nijirou is one of friends that Isagi made before Third Selection begins

137822.name: Kyouhei Shiguma
137822.desc: One of the players Isagi played aganist in Third Selection.

137822.name: Kenyu Yukimiya
137822.desc: __Team:__ Team C; 3rd Clear Team (formerly); Blue Lock 11 (Left Wing) __Position:__ Forward; Winger He is currently ranked #5 out of the original 300 forwards chosen to be apart of the Blue Lock Project ~!and is currently starting as a winger for the Blue Lock Eleven team against the Japan U-20.!~ Yukimiya is highly confident in his own abilities, declaring himself the strongest player in Japan, when it comes to one-on-one battles. He is also a likable and charismatic personality, appearing to make friends easily, like with Nagi. In addition to this, Yukimiya likes to make banter even with his opponents, indicating a playful element to his personality. Yukimiya claims that he is a pacifist, which forms part of his ego, since he sees the easiest and most peaceful way to score would be to do so himself. He is also inquisitive, often being the first to ask questions of Ego, about his selection criteria.

137822.name: Kairu  Saramadara
137822.desc: One of the players Isagi played aganist in Third Selection.

137822.name: Noel Noa
137822.desc: He is a 31-year old forward from France who plays on France's National Team and on the German club team Bastard München. Noa is known as the best striker in the world and he is Yoichi Isagi's idol. He is initially introduced at the beginning of the series but he officially makes his debut in the Neo Egoist League when he comes to Blue Lock as the master striker/coach of the Germany Stratum.

137822.name: Julian Loki
137822.desc: __Team:__ Paris X Gen, France National Team, Team World Five (Former) __Position:__ Forward Julian Loki is a young French football prodigy renowned for his exceptional speed and skill. He plays as a forward for the French club Paris X Gen (PXG) and is also a member of the France National Team. First introduced during Third Selection, as a member of the Team World 5, he is initially at Blue Lock to analyze and rate the last string of Blue Lock players. He later returns to help train the Blue Lock players and participate in the Neo Egoist League as the master striker and coach of the France Stratum, all in order to train his protégé, [Charles Chevalier](https://anilist.co/character/334890/Charles-Chevalier), into becoming his personal passer so they may become the best in the world together. ~!He is a member of the New Generation World XI.!~

137822.name: Junichi Wanima
137822.desc: __Birthplace:__ Kagoshima Prefecture __Height:__ 182 cm (6'0") Junichi Wanima is a contender in the Blue Lock Project and the older twin brother of [Keisuke Wanima](https://anilist.co/character/284965).

137822.name: Keisuke Wanima
137822.desc: Younger twin brother of [Junichi Wanima](https://anilist.co/character/284964).

137822.name: Hirotoshi Buratsuta
137822.desc: The man who serves as the chairman of the Japan Football Association. He sees soccer as a business and doesn't really think about helping the Japanese national team win The World Cup. He is also skeptical of the "Blue Lock" project.

137822.name: Ranze Kurona
137822.desc: __Height:__ 168 cm (5'6") __Team:__ Bastard München (NEL) __Position:__ Wingback, Forward Ranze Kurona is a participant of the Blue Lock project and plays for Bastard München during the Neo Egoist League. He typically plays as a post-player who can be easily utilized to exchange possession in the instance [Isagi](https://anilist.co/character/140856/Yoichi-Isagi) gets pressured.

137822.name: Shuusaku Nihei
137822.desc: Editor-in-Chief of _SoccerDirect_

137822.name: Girolan Dabadie
137822.original: ジローラン・ダバディ
137822.desc: [Sae Itoshi](https://anilist.co/character/169397/Sae-Itoshi)'s manager

137822.name: Issei Isagi
137822.desc: Father of [Yoichi Isagi](https://anilist.co/character/140856)

137822.name: Iyo Isagi
137822.desc: Mother of [Yoichi Isagi](https://anilist.co/character/140856/)

137822.name: Yuu Bachira
137822.desc: Mother of [Meguru Bachira](https://anilist.co/character/162213). She is a painter.

137822.name: Lionel Messi
137822.desc: Lionel Andrés Messi, also known as Leo Messi, is an Argentine professional footballer.

137822.name: Coach
137822.desc: Middle soccer coach of Meguru Bachira.

137822.name: Dada Silva
137822.desc: __Jersey Number:__ 5 __Position:__ Forward A member of Team World 5. Silva currently plays for Brazi's National Football Team.

137822.name: Leonardo Luna
137822.desc: Professional player from Spain known as 'The Scion of Real Madrid' who plays on Spain's Real Madrid and the Spain National Team. He arrives at Blue Lock as member of the Team World 5 to analyze and rate the last string of Blue Lock players.

137822.name: Pablo Cabassos
137822.desc: Member of the Team World 5. Pablo currently plays for Argentina's National Football Team.

137822.name: Yukio Ishikari
137822.desc: A contender for the Blue Lock Project, known as the tallest high school soccer athlete in Japan.

137822.name: Shingen Tanaka
137822.desc: A contender for the Blue Lock Project. Ranked 5th after the third selection.

137822.name: Shizuka Haiji
137822.desc: A contender for the Blue Lock Project.

137822.name: Taiga Tsunzaki
137822.desc: Contender of the Blue Lock Project.

137822.name: Reiji Hiiragi
137822.desc: Contender for the Blue Lock Project.

137822.name: Tetsu Sokura
137822.desc: Contender for the Blue Lock Project.

137822.name: Jin Kiyora
137822.desc: __Height:__ 165cm Contender for the Blue Lock Project. Plays for Bastard München during the Neo Egoist League

137822.name: Hajime Nishioka
137822.desc: Contender for the Blue Lock Project. He makes it to the third selection, but is mentioned as being treated for an injury sustained during the World's Select Battle and is not introduced with the rest of his team.

108725.name: Norman
108725.desc: __Height:__ 145 cm __Farm Identifier:__ 22194 Norman seems to be logical, well-meaning, and devoted, with a slightly naive side. He can easily plan his actions in advance and he anticipates on other's actions. He is one of the top 3 ranking orphans, along with [Emma](https://anilist.co/character/121725/Emma) and [Ray](https://anilist.co/character/121724/Ray). Norman loves Emma and he is helpful and loyal towards her.

108725.name: Isabella
108725.desc: __Height:__ 170 cm __Farm Identifier:__ 73584 Isabella worked as a Mama at Grace Field House, taking care of the orphans that reside within.

108725.name: Ray
108725.desc: __Height:__ 150 cm __Farm Identifier:__ 81194 As one of the three perfect students at the orphanage, Ray is very logical, smart, cunning, extremely patient and is usually shown to read books by himself. Although he is extremely book smart he says that he never liked to study. According to data obtained by sister [Krone](https://anilist.co/character/121702/Krone), his weakness is that he gives up easily.

108725.name: Emma
108725.desc: __Height:__ 145 cm __Farm Identifier:__ 63194 Emma acts as an older sister to the other children and loves her family very intensely. She is sweet, heroic, caring, and has a big heart. She can also be naive and reckless, and doesn't hesitate to put herself at risk to ensure the safety of the group. The other kids describe her as having monster reflexes and an astounding ability to learn, which enables her to think fast in difficult situations and makes her a very good strategist. She could be considered a beacon of hope for the rest of the children.

108725.name: Don
108725.desc: __Age (2045):__ 10 yo __Farm Identifier:__ 16194 __D.O.B:__ 2035/7/4 __Height (2045-2049):__ 155 - 174 cm Don has dark skin and a tall and slender appearance. He has short, messy black hair with an undercut and brown eyes. He wears the standard white uniform. Like [Emma](https://anilist.co/character/121725/Emma), Don cares deeply about his siblings. Don is portrayed as a cheerful and slightly careless boy, however, he too is fairly intelligent, coming around 5th place in the everyday test, after [Gilda](https://anilist.co/character/126455/Gilda). He also has talents in pick pocketing. His physical ability is also fairly strong.

108725.name: Gilda
108725.desc: __Farm Identifier:__ 65194 __Height (2045-2049):__ 138 - 155 cm Gilda has short olive drab hair kept in a Chinese bob hairstyle and wears circular-lensed glasses. Gilda is an intuitive young girl. She also has a caring personality. She seems to be an introvert, however she also has her moments of bravery. She can also be quite threatening.

108725.name: Phil
108725.desc: __Height:__ 100 cm __Farm Identifier:__ 34394 (Grace Field House) __D.O.B:__ 2041 Phil is very active and can always be seen running around. ~!He is also shown to be very mature and intelligent for his age, even suspecting something was wrong when [Emma](https://anilist.co/character/121725/Emma) and the other older orphans were trying to find out ways to escape.!~

108725.name: James Ratri
108725.original: ジェイムズ・ラートリー
108725.desc: James Latley is the 35th descendant of the Latley Clan who sealed the promise between humans and demons 1000 years ago. After seeing the horrors that humans has been through, he decided to give them a chance to live. He put several codes inside his books so the kids could escape the plantations. ~!The elevator inside Golden Pond is not working anymore, so he said that others can be used, including the one in the Grace Field house. He was betrayed by a person, and so, the Village is not a safe place anymore. The last recording that Emma and Lucas found said that it was the 20th of March, 2031. He is presumed dead.!~

108725.name: Peter Ratri
108725.desc: Peter Ratri is the 36th and current head of the famous Ratri Clan and the younger brother of [James Ratri](https://anilist.co/character/126494/Ratri-James).

108725.name: Sonju
108725.desc: __Age:__ At-Least 1000 __Hair Color:__ Red __Eye Color:__ Black Sonju (or Sung-Joo) is a demon that lives outside Grace Field House. ~!He saved Ray just before he was captured by his demon-hound pursuers. He and Mujika were suspected to be demons by Ray. Sonju believes in the same religion as Mujika, hence is strongly against the practice of eating humans. However, Sonju remained reluctant and was eager to resume his intention of eating humans once their population increased.!~ Sonju retains a stoic and composed personality, as he sometimes refrained himself from interacting with the orphans, and during the times when he does, he was known to intimidate them due to his appearance. Nevertheless, Sonju on a certain degree still care for the orphans' safety and have faith in them being able to break the promise.

108725.name: Mujika
108725.desc: Mujika (or Musica) is a demon descent traveling in the forest outside the Grace Field House.

108725.name: Anna
108725.desc: __Age (2045):__ 9 yo __Farm Identifier:__ 48194 (Grace Field House) __D.O.B:__ 2036/4/25 __Height (2045-2049):__ 135 - 162 cm Just like every other orphans of Grace Field, she wears the standard Grace Field Orphanage uniform. Anna grows to be a surprisingly big boned, tall girl. She has blonde hair tied into twin braids. ~!Later, she cuts her hair in order to help with the escape.!~~!During her time at the B06-32 shelter, she spends a lot of time studying medicine in order to help her family.!~

108725.name: Lannion
108725.desc: __Age (2045):__ 7 yo __Farm Identifier:__ 54294 (Grace Field House) __D.O.B:__ 2038/4/28 __Height (2045-2049):__ 125 - 144 cm Lani is a mischievous and resourceful boy, who enjoys pulling pranks with his best friend, [Thoma](https://anilist.co/character/129784/Thoma). He is a bit cowardly, but also blunt and straightforward.

108725.name: Thoma
108725.desc: __Height:__ 123 cm __Farm Identifier:__ 55294 (Grace Field House) Thoma is a resourceful and mischievous boy, who enjoys pulling pranks alongside his best friend [Lani](https://anilist.co/character/129783). He is blunt, but can also be quite cowardly.

108725.name: Nat
108725.desc: __Age (2045):__ 9 yo __Farm Identifier:__ 48194 (Grace Field House) __D.O.B:__ 2036/12/18 __Height (2045-2049):__ 133 - 156 cm Nat is a rather frail boy, with brown eyes and a tall nose line (which he takes great pride in). He wears the standard orphanage uniform. Even though he can be easily intimidated, he does have his moments of bravery.

108725.name: Sobo
108725.desc: Grandmother is a high-ranking human and once worked as [Isabella's](https://anilist.co/character/121701/Isabella) Mama although she treated her more as a pawn than a human. ~!On January 27, 2046, it was revealed that all of Isabella's mistakes and responsibilities, as in letting the children escape, were placed on Grandma Sarah. Although Isabella wasn't able to manage her products, Sarah wasn't able to manage Isabella. As a result, Sarah was shipped out to be served at the upcoming Tifari in order to make up for the escapees. Isabella took the role of Grandmother after that.!~

108725.name: Zazie
108725.desc: Zazie is a former Λ7214 experiment. He is the strongest among the humans. He gets mad when he doesn't wear the paper bag. He loves his boss, Norman.

108725.name: Cislo
108725.desc: Cislo is a former Lambda 7214 (aka Λ7214) experiment. His hobby is weight training, despite his looks he is easily moved to tears and he loves boss(Norman) . He was shipped to Lambda at age 12/13 from Goodwill Ridge, along with his close friend Barbara. Goodwill is one of the four premium farms.

108725.name: Vincent
108725.desc: Vincent is a previous Lambda 7214 (aka Λ7214) experiment. He was born in Glory bell. He is known to have medical knowledge and is very fashionable. Also he can make snacks , cloths and weapons. He loves boss(aka Norman).

108725.name: Barbara
108725.desc: Barbara is a former Lambda 7214 (aka Λ7214) experiment. She eats a lot, and as a result of the experiments that were done on her she has inherited superhuman strength. At age 12, she was shipped from Goodwill Ridge to Lambda along with her close friend [Cislo](https://anilist.co/character/192864/Cislo). Goodwill is one of the four premium farms. ~!She likes to eat demon meat because she is "pissed off" that humans are the only ones getting eaten. It seems to be safe to do, as she shows no symptoms of it affecting her.!~

108725.name: Yvette
108725.desc: __Farm Identifier:__ 59294 __Height:__ 110 - 133 cm Yvette is a smart and observant girl who is very artistic. She carries a pencil and a block with her. ~!Once they escape, she helps to collect food and draws maps when asked.!~

108725.name: Christie
108725.desc: __Farm Identifier:__ 70394 (Grace Field House) __Height (2045):__ 103 cm Chris is a curious young boy, who is very cheerful and outspoken.

108725.name: Jemima
108725.desc: __Age (2045):__ 5 yo __Farm Identifier:__ 31394 (Grace Field House) __Height (2045-2049):__ 107 - 134 cm Jemima is cheerful and well-behaved. Though, she can display acts of mischievousness. She is seen to have a strong bond with [Alicia](https://anilist.co/character/199115).

108725.name: Alicia
108725.desc: __Height:__ 109cm __Farm Identifier:__ 71394 (Grace Field House) Alicia is a cheerful, extroverted young girl with a tomboyish personality. She can also be sneaky, and knows how to stand up for herself. She is shown to have a strong bond with [Jemima](https://anilist.co/character/199114/Jemima).

108725.name: Rossi
108725.desc: __Age (2045):__ 5 yo __Farm Identifier:__ 50394 (Grace Field House) __D.O.B:__ 2040/4/14 __Height (2045-2049):__ 108 - 130 cm Rossi is a delicate and prudent boy, but he can also be quite mischievous.

108725.name: Dominic
108725.desc: __Farm Identifier:__ 07294 (Grace Field House) __Height (2045-2049):__ 119 - 147 cm Dominic is an energetic and rather muscular young boy. He is very brave as well as caring towards others, and is willing to risk much to make sure everyone is safe.

108725.name: Vylk
108725.desc: A blind demon.

127720.name: Sylphiette
127720.desc: Sylphiette is [Rudeus](https://anilist.co/character/88348/Rudeus-Greyrat)' childhood friend who is part human, elf, and beast race. ~!Following the teleportation incident, during which her hair turned white from mana exhaustion, she became Princess Ariel's personal bodyguard under the alias Fitz.!~ ~!She is Rudeus' first wife and gives birth to their daughter [Lucy](https://anilist.co/character/188846/Greyrat-Lucy) and son [Sieghardt](https://anilist.co/character/273377/Greyrat-Saladin-Sieghardt). She is one of the three goddesses Rudeus worships in his religion. A cloth stained with her virgin blood that serves as a relic for the Goddess of Love is enshrined in the basement.!~

127720.name: Paul Greyrat
127720.original: パウロ・グレイラット
127720.desc: Paul Greyrat is the father of [Rudeus Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/88348/Rudeus-Greyrat), [Norn Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/145458/Greyrat-Norn) and [Aisha Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/145459/Greyrat-Aisha). He is both a talented man that became advanced in all three sword arts at a young age and a lustful man that attracts and sleeps with many women before [Zenith](https://anilist.co/character/179855/Zenith-Greyrat) chained him down.

127720.name: Rudeus Greyrat
127720.original: ルーデウス・グレイラット
127720.desc: __Height:__ 175 cm (5'9") Rudeus is a tall, well-built, and cool-looking man. However, before his reincarnation, he was originally an overweight 34-year-old Japanese NEET who became a recluse following his high-school persecution. Because of his former life, he is careful not to get carried away and become arrogant. As a result, he is extremely self-aware and humble because he does not want to revert to his old self. He is a kind person, helping his friends and protecting his family whenever needed. Due to being capable in many fields, people have high expectations of him. His body possesses a high affinity for magic. Rudeus is very polite to others, often to the point of making them uncomfortable. Rudeus is one of the few people capable of using voiceless magic, and even rarer as someone who can use voiceless incantation with melded magics. He cannot use voiceless incantation for healing magic due to his lack of understanding in regards to how mana is manipulated to heal. A normal Magician takes at least five seconds for a simple spell, while for higher-level spells it's thirty to sixty seconds. Rudeus can do it almost instantly no matter what the difficulty of the spell, with the exception of healing magic.

127720.name: Eris Boreas Greyrat
127720.original: エリス・ボレアス・グレイラット
127720.desc: Eris Boreas Greyrat is a noble girl and distant relative of [Rudeus](https://anilist.co/character/88348/Rudeus-Greyrat). She is a tsundere with a short temper but has potential in the Sword-God style. ~!She is Rudeus' third wife and gives birth to their son [Ars](https://anilist.co/character/273378/Greyrat-Ars) and daughter [Christina](https://anilist.co/character/278862/Greyrat-Christina). She is one of the three goddesses Rudeus worships in his religion. A wooden sword that serves as a relic for the Goddess of War is enshrined in the basement.!~

127720.name: Roxy Migurdia
127720.original: ロキシー・ミグルディア
127720.desc: Roxy Migurdia is a talented mage from the Migurd race, and a former magic tutor. Because she can't use telepathy, she left her village due to feeling isolated from her peers.
