Unable to make a stable living as an adventurer, she became a travelling tutor and eventually becomes [Rudeus'](https://anilist.co/character/88348/Rudeus-Greyrat) teacher. ~!She is Rudeus' second wife and gives birth to their daughter [Lara](https://anilist.co/character/273376/Greyrat-Lara) & [Lily](https://anilist.co/character/321620/Greyrat-Lily). She is one of the three goddesses Rudeus worships in his religion. Her panties that serves as a relic for the Goddess of Wisdom is enshrined in the basement.!~

127720.name: Ruijerd Superdia
127720.original: ルイジェルド・スペルディア
127720.desc: Ruijerd Superdia is the former leader of the Superd's Warrior group whom once served under Laplace with unwavering loyalty. He was accompanying [Rudeus](https://anilist.co/character/88348/Rudeus-Greyrat) and [Eris](https://anilist.co/character/88349/Eris-Boreas-Greyrat). ~!Laplace betrayed his group by giving them each a devil spear which made them ecstatic from killing, even their own family. After giving his son a fatal wound, his son managed to destroy the devil spear and Ruijerd finally wakes up from the brainwash. He considered committing suicide but decided not to and everyone of that warrior group swore revenged on Laplace. He finally got his revenge after several years of hiding. He interfered in the battle between Laplace and the three heroes. But even if Laplace was defeated, there was no way to change the things that had already transpired. After exacting his revenge, he now has a goal of removing the infamy the Superd race has.!~

127720.name: Shizuka Nanahoshi
127720.desc: __Light Novel Volume 9 spoiler__ ~! Nanahoshi Shizuka is a Japanese girl that was saved by [Rudeus](https://anilist.co/character/88348/Rudeus-Greyrat) in his past life, but instead of reincarnating like Rudeus, she was teleported to Asura Kingdom and was saved by [Orsted](https://anilist.co/character/187382/Orsted). !~

127720.name: Norn Greyrat
127720.original: ノルン・グレイラット
127720.desc: Norn Greyrat is the daughter of [Zenith Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/179855/Zenith-Greyrat) and [Paul Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/88347/Paul-Greyrat) and is the younger sister of [Rudeus Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/88348) and older half-sister of [Aisha Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/145459/Aisha-Greyrat).

127720.name: Aisha Greyrat
127720.original: アイシャ・グレイラット
127720.desc: Aisha Greyrat is the daughter of [Lilia](https://anilist.co/character/179854/Lilia) and [Paul Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/88347/Paul-Greyrat) and is the younger half-sister of [Rudeus Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/88348/Rudeus-Greyrat) and [Norn Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/145458/Norn-Greyrat).

127720.name: Lilia
127720.desc: Lilia is a maid of the Greyrat household. She was [Paul](https://anilist.co/character/88347/Paul-Greyrat)'s classmate in a swordsman dojo. A crippling injury forces her to leave her position as a princess guard, and she becomes a maid to Paul and [Zenith](https://anilist.co/character/179855/Zenith-Greyrat). ~!After working through the revelation with the family, she is taken in as Paul's second wife and becomes closer friends with Zenith. Lillia gets pregnant with Paul's daughter and becomes the mother of [Aisha Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/145459/Aisha-Greyrat)!~

127720.name: Zenith Greyrat
127720.original: ゼニス・グレイラット
127720.desc: Zenith Greyrat is the wife of [Paul Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/88347) and the mother of [Rudeus Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/88348) and [Norn Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/145458/Norn-Greyrat). ~!Zenith was born in the Holy Country of Milis, as the second daughter of an earl of Milis. She grew up following the Milis Church religion, never breaking the rules, getting good grade in school, and had nickname Milis young lady standard. But, when Zenith reached the age of 15, she rebelled against her parents and ran away from home. While trying to find a job as a Healer, she was a solo adventurer for a time. However she was frequently conned out of a large amount of money due to the little knowledge she had on how expensive healer's are, but was saved by Paul Greyrat. She then join Paul's party, the Fangs of the Black Wolf, as a healer. She spent a long time in the party as a healer and gradually began to fall in love with Paul and wanted to marry him. However Paul was a womanizer who frequently slept with multiple women and she didn't want to be with someone like that so she told him if he promised to be faithful to her then she would sleep with him, to which he agreed. Shortly after, she became pregnant with Rudeus and as a result both her and Paul retired from adventuring and settled down in the countryside.!~ __Light Novel Volume 13 Spoiler__ ~!After being freed from the Teleport Labyrinth, she does not express emotions actively since she sees the wo

127720.name: Elinalise Dragonroad
127720.original: エリナリーゼ・ドラゴンロード
127720.desc: Elinalise is a former member of Paul's party. She has an erotic nature due to her curse. She is a warrior that is good at managing monster aggro but isn't a great fighter.

127720.name: Kishirika Kishirisu
127720.desc: Kishirika Kishirisu is The Great Empress of the Demon Realm. She is the demon empress known for her demon eyes' powers and the ability to bestow others with demon eyes. She is engaged to [Badigadi](https://anilist.co/character/262620/Badigadi), the demon lord of immortality. __Light Novel Volume 4 Spoiler__ ~!Kishirika Kishirisu is the person that is responsible for giving [Rudeus](https://anilist.co/character/88348/Rudeus-Greyrat) his demon eye, among other favors!~

127720.name: Orsted
127720.desc: Orsted is the current Dragon God, 2nd-ranked of the 7 World Powers, and the sworn enemy of [Hitogami](https://anilist.co/character/211165/Hitogami). Similar to other Dragon Race people such as [Perugius](https://anilist.co/character/209572/Perugius-Dola), he has silver hair and golden sanpaku eyes with an overpowering look. He carries no visible equipment and wears a white coat adorned with fur. Orsted has a curse that makes every living being feel an overwhelming fear just from being within his presence. Strangely enough, this curse does not affect [Rudeus](https://anilist.co/character/88348/Rudeus-Greyrat) or [Nanahoshi](https://anilist.co/character/137816/Nanahoshi-Shizuka).

127720.name: Zanoba  Shirone
127720.desc: Zanoba Shirone is a doll loving prince of Shirone. When he was three years old, he killed his brother, the Fourth prince, as if his brother was a doll. When he was 15 years old, he killed his wife, as if she was a doll.

127720.name: Ariel Asura
127720.original: アリエル・アネモイ・アスラ
127720.desc: Second Princess of the Asura Kingdom. She is hardly ever seen without her two bodyguards, [Luke](https://anilist.co/character/226703) and "[Silent Fitz](https://anilist.co/character/88346)". After surviving many assassination attempts, she and her bodyguards flee to The Magic City of Sharia and enroll at the Ranoa Magic Academy.

127720.name: Ghislaine Dedoldia
127720.original: ギレーヌ・デドルディア
127720.desc: __Ghislaine Dedoldia__ is the daughter of Gustav the former Doldia village chief, and the mentor of [Eris](https://anilist.co/character/88349/Eris-Boreas-Greyrat) and she is also the student of [Rudeus Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/88348/Rudeus-Greyrat) in magic and other subjects. She is one of the few people who have become a Sword King.

127720.name: Pax Shirone
127720.original: パックス・シーローン

127720.name: Sauros Boreas Greyrat
127720.original: サウロス・ボレアス・グレイラット
127720.desc: __Sauros Boreas Greyrat__ was the Landlord of the Fittoa Region, Asura Kingdom and the grandfather of [Eris](https://anilist.co/character/88349/Eris-Boreas-Greyrat). ~!After the Teleport Incident, he was blamed for the loss of the Fittoa Region and was executed.!~ (Source: Mushoku Tensei Wiki)

127720.name: Almanfi
127720.desc: Almanfi is one of eleven servants of Perugius.

127720.name: Perugius Dola
127720.desc: Perugius Dola is one of the heroes who banished Demon God Laplace.

127720.name: Hitogami
127720.desc: Hitogami is the Man God, having the power to see into the future, and the sworn enemy of [Orsted](https://anilist.co/character/187382). He has a blank white face coupled with a grin that eludes memory, which gives off the feeling that his face is covered in a mosaic. He helps [Rudeus](https://anilist.co/character/88348/Rudeus-Greyrat) throughout key points in his journey. ~!Hitogami later becomes the overarching antagonist of the series following the revelation that he actually sought to prevent the birth of Rudeus' children, who are prophesied to kill him one day.!~ ~!Hitogami's exact origins are unknown, however it is known that after the Creator God's death, unbeknownst to anyone, he was born within the Void World. At some point in the distant past, the being who would come to be known as Hitogami killed or otherwise usurped the original Man God and took his form. He then began manipulating the Dragon God and his five Dragon Generals into destroying the other four worlds and then proceeded to help the survivors of those ruined world to flee into the human world.!~

127720.name: Rokari Migurdia
127720.original: ロカリー・ミグルディア
127720.desc: [Roxy](https://anilist.co/character/88350)'s mother and [Rowin](https://anilist.co/character/211181)'s wife.

127720.name: Rowin Migurdia
127720.original: ロイン・ミグルディア
127720.desc: [Roxy](https://anilist.co/character/88350)'s father and [Rokari](https://anilist.co/character/211180)'s husband.

127720.name: Nokopara
127720.desc: A greedy adventurer Rudeus encounters on the Demon Continent. ~!He catches on to Rudeus' plans, which violates guild procedures, and tries to blackmail him out of his money, but upon facing the wrath of Ruijerd, he pitifully begs for his life before falling unconscious.!~

127720.name: Blaze
127720.desc: An arrogant adventurer Rudeus meets on the Demon Continent. ~!He gets killed in action in the middle of a quest.!~

127720.name: Talhand
127720.desc: A dwarf that was member of the Party "Fang of the Black Wolf", with Elinalise and Roxy. He is slow and not agile, so he wears sturdy armor, wields an axe, and uses magic against enemies.

127720.name: Luke Notos Greyrat
127720.original: ルーク・ノトス・グレイラット
127720.desc: Luke Notos Greyrat is the second prince of the Asura kingdom Ariel Anemoi Asura's personal guardian and also holds the status of Knight. He's also the cousin of Rudeus Greyrat, but from another of the four different branch families in the Greyrat genus, namely the Notos family.

127720.name: Geese Nukadia
127720.original: ギース・ヌーカディア
127720.desc: Geese is of the Magic Race, the last surviving tribe member, heritage and is introduced into the series when his and Rudeus's paths collide in a shared jail cell located in the Great Forest. Rudeus address Geese by the nickname of "Newbie" during their time together. He is a Jack of all Trades that can do almost everything, except fighting for the most part. ~!He's a former member of the adventurer party "Fang of the Black Wolf", a party in which Paul and Zenith were former members of. Geese vowed to never teach another woman cooking again after he taught Zenith, which lead to the eventual demise of the party. The connection being that Zenith wanted to impress Paul and after succeeding they left the party which lead to the dissolution.!~

127720.name: Gallus Cleaner
127720.desc: Gallus is a member of a smuggler organization. He is ranked North Saint in the North God Style.

127720.name: Gustav Dedoldia
127720.original: ギュスターヴ・デドルディア
127720.desc: An old warrior and the Chief of the Dedoldia tribe. ~!After he sustains serious injuries in battle, Gyes became the next Chief.!~

127720.name: Gyes Dedoldia
127720.original: ギュエス・デドルディア
127720.desc: Gyes Dedoldia is [Linia](https://anilist.co/character/187380) and [Minitona's](https://anilist.co/character/251609) father and [Ghislaine Dedoldia's](https://anilist.co/character/206392) brother. He is the warrior chief of the Dedoldia tribe.

127720.name: Minitona Dedoldia
127720.original: ミニトーナ・デドルディア
127720.desc: Daughter of the tribe warrior chief [Gyes Dedoldia](https://anilist.co/character/251607).

127720.name: Tersena Adoldia
127720.original: テルセナ・アドルディア
127720.desc: Sister of [Pursena Adoldia](https://anilist.co/character/187381).

127720.name: Vierra
127720.desc: She was caught with her sister, Shierra, in the mana calamity. After being saved by Paul, she helps with finding all the missing people.

127720.name: Shierra
127720.desc: One of the key members of Paul's search party. She was caught with her sister Vierra in the mana calamity, and the two were enslaved by bandits until Paul and his group rescue them.

127720.name: Ginger York
127720.desc: Ginger is a loyal subordinate of Zanoba and a former imperial guard.

127720.name: Somar
127720.desc: One of the kids from Buena Village who bullied [Sylphiette](https://anilist.co/character/88346).

127720.name: Grabell Zafin Asura
127720.original: グラーヴェル・ザフィン・アスラ
127720.desc: First Prince of Asura Kingdom and half-brother of Ariel Anemoi Asura.

127720.name: Darius Silva Ganius
127720.desc: Prime Minister of the Asura Kingdom.

127720.name: Kleene Elrond
127720.original: クリーネ・エルロンド
127720.desc: A noble and one of Ariel's companions who also attends to her daily needs. Like Elmore, she accompanies Ariel to Ranoa Magic Academy and among the survivors of the assassination attempt while travelling to there.

127720.name: Elmore Bluewolf
127720.original: エルモア・ブルーウルフ
127720.desc: Elmore is a noble and Ariel's servant who accompanies her to Ranoa Magic Academy. At the academy, Elmore also gathers information and intelligence for Ariel aside from her servant duties and is a close friend of Sylphiette.

116589.name: Shinei Nouzen
116589.desc: __Height:__ 175 cm Shinei Nouzen is the field commander of Spearhead Squadron. His Personal Name is Undertaker. Having survived five years on the Eastern Front and the Special Reconnaissance Mission, he is considered one of the most elite Processors alive. Among the Eighty-Six, he is known as the Reaper of the Eastern Front. His ability to hear the voices of the Legion allows him to locate the Legion without the use of detection systems like radar. Born on May 19th in Republic Year 351, Shin lived with his family in the First Sector of the Republic before the war with the Giadian Empire began. It is implied he lived a sheltered life, surrounded by "only kindness and affection". He also appeared to have developed his extrasensory ability early on, hearing "voices that spoke without words" from his family. ~!He would often play with the daughter of his father's colleague, [Henrietta von Penrose](https://anilist.co/character/210923/von-Penrose-Henrietta), whom Shin called Rita.!~

116589.name: Vladilena Milizé
116589.original: ヴラディレーナ・ミリーゼ
116589.desc: __Height:__ 160 cm Vladilena Milizé, more commonly known as Lena by her friends and as Handler One to her subordinates, is an elite Republic commissioned officer who rose to the rank of Major at the young age of 16. She is the commander of [Shinei Nouzen](https://anilist.co/character/141060/Nouzen-Shinei) and the Spearhead Squadron, whom she communicates with via the long-distance communication device known as the Para-RAID. ~!After the Spearhead Squadron's departure, she becomes known for demanding orders and highly competent leadership, earning the nickname of Bloody Regina among the Processors.!~

116589.name: Frederica Rosenfort
116589.original: フレデリカ・ローゼンフォルト
116589.desc: __Height:__ 130cm A girl Shin and his team met at Ernst's residence after being provided shelter by the Federacy. She is assigned as the Mascot to the Spearhead Squadron. She has an intelligence and a manner of speech well beyond her young age of ten. ~!She is the last empress of the Federal Empire of Giad, having been secretly rescued by Ernst during the coup against the nobility. Her royal bloodline imparts her the gift of seeing the past and present of people she has known. She was protected by Kiriya Nouzen, a distant relative of Shin from the Nouzen clan and is on the lookout for him after he was assimilated by the Legion as a Black Sheep, having failed to protect his princess. Shin's personality constantly reminds her of Kiri and she treats him as a surrogate big brother.!~

116589.name: Raiden Shuga
116589.desc: __Height:__ 185 cm Raiden Shuga is the vice captain of Spearhead Squadron. As a First Lieutenant, he holds the position of operations commander of the Eighty-Sixth Strike Package and its 1st Armored Division should Shin be deemed unfit to command. His Personal Name is Wehrwolf. Having survived four years on the Eastern Front and the Special Reconnaissance Mission, he is considered one of the most elite Processors alive. As he spent three years with Shin prior to joining Spearhead Squadron, Raiden is the closest person to him in the squadron.

116589.name: Kurena Kukumila
116589.desc: __Height:__ 160 cm Kurena Kukumila is a platoon leader of Eighty-Sixth Strike Package's Spearhead Squadron. She is the squadron's long-range specialist. Her Personal Name is Gunslinger. Having survived four years on the Eastern Front and the Special Reconnaissance Mission, she is considered one of the most elite Processors alive.

116589.name: Theoto Rikka
116589.desc: __Height:__ 165 cm Theoto Rikka is a platoon leader of the Eighty-Sixth Strike Package's Spearhead Squadron and the artist of the squadron member's Personal Marks. His Personal Name is Laughing Fox. Having survived four years on the Eastern Front and the Special Reconnaissance Mission, he is considered one of the most elite Processors alive.

116589.name: Anju Emma
116589.desc: __Height:__ 170 cm Anju Emma is a platoon member and later platoon leader of the Eighty-Sixth Strike Package's Spearhead Squadron. She serves as their support fire and artillery provider. Her Personal Name is Snow Witch. Having survived four years on the Eastern Front and the Special Reconnaissance Mission, she is considered one of the most elite Processors alive.

116589.name: Kaie Taniya
116589.desc: A good-humoured girl with no filter. Part of The Republic of San Magnolia's Spearhead Squadron. ~! Is killed by a Löwe during a sortie. Has her neural network assimilated with a Legion after being taken. !~

116589.name: Daiya Irma
116589.desc: Daiya is the leader of the fifth platoon. As an elite four-year veteran of the Eastern Battlefront, he has earned the personal name Black Dog. He and Anju have been in the same squadron since they were conscripted and are close friends. ~! When his Juggernaut is surrounded by Self-Propelled Mines, moments before they detonate Daiya whispers Anju's name. He is mortally wounded in the explosion and is later euthanised by Shin, so that he won't be assimilated into the Legion. !~

116589.name: Haruto Keats
116589.desc: Haruto is the morale booster of the squadron, often times cheerful and joking.

116589.name: Kujo Niko
116589.desc: A member of the Spearhead Squadron's Fourth Platoon. ~!Fatally wounded against the Legion, he was put to rest by Shin and had his unit's personal mark passed on.!~

116589.name: Jerome Karlsthal
116589.original: ジェローム・カールシュタール
116589.desc: He was Lena's superior in the Republic Armed Forces. Due to his close relationship with Lena's father, she thought of him as her uncle.

116589.name: Lev Aldrecht
116589.desc: The chief mechanic of the Spearhead Squadron. ~!He was an Alba married to a Heliodor wife, whom he had a daughter with. Due to them being taken away to the Eighty-Sixth Sector, he dyed his hair to go after them. By then, it was already too late, both of them had passed. In order to follow his family to the other side, he works as the chief mechanic of the First Ward's First Defensive Squadron of the Eastern Front.!~

116589.name: Henrietta von Penrose
116589.original: アンリエッタ・ペンローズ
116589.desc: A member of the Republic military and later the Eighty-Sixth Strike Package. She serves in the Research Division and specializes on working on the Para-RAID system her father helped develop.

116589.name: Shourei Nouzen
116589.original: ショーレイ・ノウゼン
116589.desc: Shinei's older brother. Rei was a generally friendly and reliable older brother, but he was not without his faults. ~!One night when he was on patrol, he came across a young Vladilena Milizé, who was taken by her father to see the injustices brought upon the Eighty-Six. Their helicopter had been shot by a Stachelschwein and was forced to land, leaving them vulnerable to an attack from a nearby Ameise. He took the only survivor, Lena, to his base and sent her back to inside the Gran Mur.!~

116589.name: Václav Milizé
116589.original: ヴァーツラフ・ミリーゼ
116589.desc: Vaclav Milizé was Vladilena Milizé's father and friend of Jerome Karlsthal. He was a member of the Republic Armed Forces

116589.name: Fido
116589.desc: Fido is an M101 Barrett Scavenger Drone of the Spearhead Squadron. As a Scavenger, Fido provides aid to the squadron by resupplying ammunition and recharging energy packs, as well as finding and extracting materials from abandoned or destroyed units. He has accompanied Shinei Nouzen in his battles across the Eastern Front and beyond, making him Shin's oldest surviving companion.

116589.name: Kiriya Nouzen
116589.desc: He was the personal knight and caretaker of Augusta Frederica Adel-Adler. ~!After the Federacy's forces managed to breach the defensive line at his posting of Rosenfort and the apparent death of his liege, he was assimilated by a Tausendfüßler and became a Legion Shepherd.!~

103572.name: Ichika Nakano
103572.desc: __Height__: 159 cm (5'2") First sister of the Nakano Quintuplets. Despite the negligible age difference among them, she took the role of the eldest sister properly. She is also trusted enough to act as their confidant and leader. Ichika aspires to become an actress. She likes to tease [Fuutarou](https://anilist.co/character/128063).

103572.name: Nino Nakano
103572.desc: **Height:** 159 cm (5'2") Second sister of the Nakano quintuplets. She usually acts as the mother of the family, she cooks for them and takes care of their medical needs. Among the five sisters, she is the one who has the highest hostility towards [Fuutarou](https://anilist.co/character/128063/Uesugi-Fuutarou) and often rebels against him. Nino has a sharp tongue and talks bluntly when confronting the others, even if the other party is her sister. She has an outgoing attitude and is socially aware, resulting in her having many friends. She is a scheming person and doesn't hesitate to use underhanded methods to achieve her goals.

103572.name: Miku Nakano
103572.desc: __Height:__ 159 cm (5'2") Third sister of the Nakano Quintuplets. She is a silent and reserved girl. Miku tends to have a pessimistic attitude and little confidence regarding herself. Due to [Fuutarou](https://anilist.co/character/128063/Uesugi-Fuutarou)'s influence, she's the first among the sisters who open up to him. Miku likes Japanese History (especially Generals from Sengoku Period) and greatly influenced by their philosophies, to the point of affecting her real-life behavior.

103572.name: Yotsuba Nakano
103572.desc: **Height:** 159 cm (5'2") She is the fourth sister of the Nakano Quintuplets, and one of the main characters of the Quintessential Quintuplets series. Having a cheerful and energetic personality, she has a strong tendency of helping people out. Yotsuba is an active and easygoing girl. She is a type of person who can't say no to people who need help. She is also very physically fit, and is capable of tasks that her sisters can not do. She has excellent endurance and is great at sports. She's the only sister with excellent eyesight. She has a good sense of smell and a green thumb. Though she's great at physical activities, she has the lowest score out of all of her sisters. Yotsuba is the only sister who accepts [Fuutarou](https://anilist.co/character/128063) since the beginning and wholeheartedly supports him in everything.

103572.name: Itsuki Nakano
103572.desc: **Height:** 159 cm (5'2") Fifth sister of the Nakano Quintuplets. Itsuki is a serious and earnest girl. Her speech is formal and polite. She is also someone who can't be honest with herself and having difficulty to be more straightforward. Among the sisters, Itsuki is the most familiar with [Uesugi](https://anilist.co/character/128063)'s family members and circumstances. Note: Based on the character file in volume 14, Itsuki’s actual birthday is on May 6th as she was born at midnight. She celebrates her birthday on May 5th and prevents others from looking into it too deeply.

103572.name: Fuutarou Uesugi
103572.desc: __Height:__ 178 cm (5'10'') Fuutarou is the main protagonist of the 5-toubun no Hanayome series. He is a student of the Asahiyama High School. He lives with his father, Isanari Uesugi, and younger sister, Raiha Uesugi, in a small apartment. He is a serious and hardworking high school student and a prodigy at the top of his grade. Because of his family's perpetual poverty, he takes up the offer to tutor the Nakano quintuplets. Fuutarou is noted to have a big ego and high confidence. He is straightforward, tactless, and rude; but is actually capable of holding back his emotions. Despite that, Fuutarou could momentarily lose his composure when agitated and faced with unfavorable circumstances. He also initially did not like getting involved with other people's problems, finding them to be troublesome. Despite his tactlessness and crudeness, he is knowledgeable enough in knowing what to say in specific situations when thrown at him; rarely giving up when trying to achieve a specific objective. Despite his egotistical nature, Fuutarou is very hardworking and has a very high amount of patience; especially when getting the attention of the quintuplets and tutoring them despite various amounts of failures and setbacks. He later on shows a sense of duty strong enough to help the quintuplets in their studies despite them not paying him immediately, even though the money that came with tutoring was the initial reason he accepted the job. He also begins valuing their relationship to the

103572.name: Raiha Uesugi
103572.desc: Fuutarou's cheerful younger sister. Being the only female and the most family-conscious she is effectively the head of the small household. Her cute facial expressions will often sway others' hearts. Appreciating the hard work Fuutarou does for their family, she sometimes delays the supper until his late return home so she can prepare his favourite meal.

103572.name: Maruo Nakano
103572.desc: Stepfather of the Nakano Quintuplets after their mother remarried, several years before the series begins. He runs a large hospital and is also a doctor.

103572.name: Maeda
103572.desc: Student of the Asahiyama High School. Before the school camping trip, Maeda asked Ichika Nakano to see him in a class where he would ask her to dance with him at the bonfire dance. ~!This came out as a failure. Later he went with another girl at the bonfire dance. Five years later, the pair showed up at Fuutarou's wedding, already married and she is pregnant.!~

103572.name: Hongo
103572.desc: She is the captain of the Basketball Club. Yotsuba would constantly assist the the Club, Due to her inability to say no. Hongo would even ask her if she wanted to join the club, to which Yotsuba refuses.

103572.name: Oda
103572.desc: Oda is a film producer of the Oda Talent Productions and Ichika Nakano's manager. He is the single father of Kiku.

103572.name: Matsui
103572.desc: A student at the Asahiyama High School. She danced with [Maeda](https://anilist.co/character/157144/Maeda) at the bonfire during the school field trip.

103572.name: Yamada
103572.desc: She is a student of the Asahiyama High School and friend of [Nino Nakano](https://anilist.co/character/126372/).

103572.name: Yamauchi
103572.desc: He is a male student at the Asahiyama High School and a classmate of [Nino Nakano](https://anilist.co/character/126372/) during her second year.

103572.name: Yotsuba no Tannin
103572.desc: He teaches History. He was also the homeroom teacher of [Yotsuba Nakano](https://anilist.co/character/126374/)'s sophomore class, class 2-2.

103572.name: Tenshu
103572.desc: A shopkeeper from the firework festival.

103572.name: Basket-bu Buchou
103572.desc: Basketball club captain of the basketball club at Asahi High School.

133965.name: Narrator
133965.desc: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

133965.name: Hitohito Tadano
133965.desc: **Height**: 168 cm (170.2 cm later) **Position:** President **Relatives**: [Hitomi Tadano](https://anilist.co/character/130878/Hitomi-Tadano) (younger sister) Hitohito Tadano is a person average in almost every way. His name means, *just some guy*. He is the first to befriend [Shouko Komi](https://anilist.co/character/121956/Shouko-Komi). Tadano is often described as an ordinary student with normal looks and average height and weight. His style of clothing is also considered to be relatively typical. His lone stand-out feature is the white cowlick in his black hair. When he was forced to cross-dress during the Cultural Festival, he was admired implicitly by the boys and Komi. His cross-dressing incorporates a short, red-haired girl's wig with pigtails. Tadano suffered from chuunibyou in his second year of middle school. After confessing to a girl who immediately rejected him, he began to be self-conscious of his identity and drastically altered his style and outlook on life, making himself less noticeable to others. Almost everything about him - height, weight, appearance, academic achievements, athletic abilities, ice skating skills - is perfectly average. Despite his lack of talents, he's been shown to be good at observing and buying gifts for people. On his first day of high school, he met Komi and was seated next to her. He later deduced that she had a communication disorder and became invested in helping her make 100 friends. ~!Tadano can be clueless when it comes to rom

133965.name: Shouko Komi
133965.desc: **Height**: 168 cm (later 169 cm) **Position:** Goddess **Relatives**: [Shousuke Komi](https://anilist.co/character/130870/Shousuke-Komi) (younger brother), [Shuuko Komi](https://anilist.co/character/130867/Shuuko-Komi) (mother), [Masayoshi Komi](https://anilist.co/character/130865/Masayoshi-Komi) (father), [Yuiko Komi](https://anilist.co/character/130875/Yuiko-Komi) (grandmother), [Akira Komi](https://anilist.co/character/130876/Akira-Komi) (cousin), [Sadayoshi Komi](https://anilist.co/character/130873/Sadayoshi-Komi) (uncle) Shouko Komi is the main character of the series. Though she's regarded as the *Madonna* of their school, she's incapable of socializing with others to such a level where it can be called a communication disorder. Shouko is described by her admirers as a girl with glossy dark purple/black hair that flows to her lower back, a slender body, and an incredibly beautiful face. She is usually seen wearing her school uniform. Shouko hardly talks with people. She is unable to utter a word nor sound in her daily life due to her crippling anxiety and fear of rejection by her peers. She often writes whenever she can on her notebook and to the blackboard in class to answer people. She dreams of overcoming her adversity and desires to build friendly relationships with others and make 100 friends. Shouko's first friend was [Hitohito Tadano](https://anilist.co/character/78093/Hitohito-Tadano). He was the first to discover her bad communication. He helps her make friend

133965.name: Najimi Osana
133965.desc: **Position:** Vice President Najimi is a mysterious student whose gender is unknown. They are talented enough at communicating to easily befriend someone within minutes of meeting them. Growing up, Najimi was constantly transferring from one school to another, allowing them to make millions of friends.

133965.name: Omoharu Nakanaka
133965.desc: A student who usually speaks in dubious speech as a result of being a chuunibyou. She states that she was Arsot Les Primavera and that [Shouko Komi](https://anilist.co/character/121956/) is Princess Komilia.

133965.name: Masayoshi Komi
133965.desc: **Relatives**: [Yuiko Komi](https://anilist.co/character/130875) (mother), [Sadayoshi Komi](https://anilist.co/character/130873/Sadayoshi-Komi) (brother), [Shuuko Komi](https://anilist.co/character/130867/Shuuko-Komi) (wife), [Shouko Komi](https://anilist.co/character/121956) (daughter), [Shousuke Komi](https://anilist.co/character/130870/Shousuke-Komi) (son), [Akira Komi](https://anilist.co/character/130876/Akira-Komi) (niece) Masayoshi Komi is Shouko's and Shousuke's father. He is seen as a dandy middle-aged man. Masayoshi rarely speaks and sometimes struggles to express himself verbally and can, at times, be easily flustered. Complementary to his wife's youthful attitude, Masayoshi often appears mature and stoic. While he may come across as stern, he is often shown to be kind, considerate, and supportive. Like his son, Masayoshi tends to make up for his lack of communication with strong actions and is generally talented in a variety of skills, including baking, woodworking, motorcycle riding, and sandcastle construction. Despite his stoic expression, he is adept at non-verbal communication and often holds silent conversations with his children, much to Shuuko's amusement.

133965.name: Shuuko Komi
133965.desc: **Relatives**: [Yuiko Komi](https://anilist.co/character/130875) (mother-in-law), [Masayoshi Komi](https://anilist.co/character/130865) (husband), [Sadayoshi Komi](https://anilist.co/character/130873/Sadayoshi-Komi) (brother-in-law), [Shouko Komi](https://anilist.co/character/121956) (daughter), [Shousuke Komi](https://anilist.co/character/130870/Shousuke-Komi) (son), [Akira Komi](https://anilist.co/character/130876/Akira-Komi) (niece) Shuuko Komi, formerly known as Shuuko Nimi, is Shouko and Shousuke's mother. She looks like her daughter, but her personality is that of a teenager, claiming to be forever 17 years old. When despaired, she ages into *forever 18* Corresponding to her son and daughter, Shuuko is considered beautiful. In contrast, she's very communicative and wonders how her family gets along despite not talking. When young, she was bored of school and did not think much of Masayoshi until seeing him do various things on par with professionals. She slowly fell in love with him, despite his deadpan and silent demeanor. (Source: Komi-san Wiki, edited)

133965.name: Himiko Agari
133965.desc: Himiko Agari is introduced as a shy insecure girl. She also runs a ramen shop review blog and considers herself a "ramen expert."

133965.name: Shousuke Komi
133965.desc: **Relatives**: [Yuiko Komi](https://anilist.co/character/130875) (grandmother), [Masayoshi Komi](https://anilist.co/character/130865) (father), [Shuuko Komi](https://anilist.co/character/130867) (mother), [Sadayoshi Komi](https://anilist.co/character/130873/Sadayoshi-Komi) (uncle), [Ryouko Komi](https://anilist.co/character/130877/Ryouko-Komi) (aunt), [Shouko Komi](https://anilist.co/character/121956) (older sister), [Akira Komi](https://anilist.co/character/130876/Akira-Komi) (cousin) Shousuke Komi is Shouko's younger brother. He's quiet most of the time but can converse well. Shousuke has short trimmed hair and his eyes are usually hidden with his bangs. Still, his very appearance is similar to his mother and sister and can be referred to as a handsome man. Shousuke appears to share many traits with his older sister, often choosing to remain silent and being widely popular among his peers as a result. Unlike Shouko, who stays quiet mainly because of her anxieties and problems communicating, Shousuke doesn't feel bothered talking, perfectly capable of communicating without speaking in the first place. He is very apathetic, often neglecting to do anything he deems annoying or pointless, such as introducing himself to the class, instead opting to remain silent. In contrast to his sister, whose goal is to make friends, Shousuke seems to be perfectly content being by himself as he often flat-out ignores any classmates who invite him to eat lunch with them. (Source: Komi-san Wiki

133965.name: Makeru Yadano
133965.desc: Makeru Yadano is a competitive girl who likes to compete herself to Shouko.

133965.name: Sadayoshi Komi
133965.desc: Sadayoshi Komi is Shouko's uncle and her father's brother. Shouko thinks she gets along well with him because they have similar personality just like her father.

133965.name: Ren Yamai
133965.desc: Ren Yamai is one of Komi Shouko's classmates from Class 1-1.

133965.name: Yuiko Komi
133965.desc: **Relatives**: [Masayoshi Komi](https://anilist.co/character/130865/Masayoshi-Komi) (son), [Sadayoshi Komi](https://anilist.co/character/130873/Sadayoshi-Komi) (son), [Shuuko Komi](https://anilist.co/character/130867/Shuuko-Komi) (daughter-in-law), [Ryouko Komi](https://anilist.co/character/130877/Ryouko-Komi) (daughter-in-law), [Akira Komi](https://anilist.co/character/130876/Akira-Komi) (granddaughter), [Shouko Komi](https://anilist.co/character/121956/Shouko-Komi) (granddaughter), [Shousuke Komi](https://anilist.co/character/130870/Shousuke-Komi) (grandson) Yuiko Komi is Shouko, Akira, and Shousuke's grandmother. She's strict but gentle towards her family. When visiting, she usually challenges them to games.

133965.name: Akira Komi
133965.desc: Akira Komi is Shousuke and Shouko's cousin. She was originally scared of Shouko before because of Shouko's inability to speak and constant staring at Akira silently. The two become close during her Udon festival visit after Shouko tickled her.

133965.name: Ryouko Komi
133965.desc: Ryokuo Komi is Shouko's aunt. She is just as lively as Shouko's mother so she sometimes unknowingly intimidate Shouko.

133965.name: Hitomi Tadano
133965.desc: **Relatives**: [Hitohito Tadano](https://anilist.co/character/78093) (older brother) Hitomi Tadano is the younger sister of Hitohito Tadano. She bears resemblance to her brother in terms of understanding people's minds. She is active, unlike her brother who is timid and more passive in doing things. Hitomi is a short girl that shares the same big beady eyes as her older brother and make similar expressions. She wears her medium length hair in two short twin-tails. In contrast to her older brother, who is usually seen as "normal", Hitomi is an energetic and eccentric girl. Unlike her more self-conscious brother, she's not as concerned with what others think, doing odd things such as introducing herself via rapping and not being embarrassed by it. Because of her cheery nature, she is well-liked among her peers. Hitomi is rather blunt and forthright, openly claiming that she's not very good in either grades or sports during her class introduction. She does not seem to possess the same level of self-awareness as her older brother and tends to jump to conclusions. When [Shousuke Komi](https://anilist.co/character/130870/Shousuke-Komi) wasn't talking to her, Hitomi assumed he had a communication disorder when he was choosing to ignore her. Nonetheless, she does her best to "help" him communicate.

133965.name: Nokoko Inaka
133965.desc: Nokoko Inaka is a with a complex about her coming from the countryside. She later became friends with Shouko.

133965.name: Akako  Onigashima
133965.desc: Onigashima Akako is originally part of Yamai Ren's friend group. Her name translates to Red Girl from Oni Island which is a reference to the tale of Momotarou.

133965.name: Shizuka Odoka
133965.desc: Odoka Shizuka is a second-year at Itan Private High School

133965.name: Chika Netsuno
133965.desc: Chika Netsuno is a student one year above Tadano, Shouko, and Najimi, and serves as Shouko's athletic rival.

133965.name: Gorimi
133965.desc: Gorimi is a student one year above the main characters. She is the Head Librarian, and the disciplinarian of Itan Private High School.

133965.name: Maki Karisu
133965.desc: Karisu Maki is Komi Shouko's hair dresser. Karisu is seen to be very professional with her clients. When Komi comes in to her shop Karisu is able to understand exactly what she wants even without Komi speaking to her.

133965.name: Shigeo Chiarai
133965.desc: Chiarai Shigeo is a student in class 1-1. Chiarai is friends with Sonoda and Shinobino.

133965.name: Mono Shinobino
133965.desc: Shinobino Mono is a student in class 1-1. He is friends with Chiarai and Sonoda. The three are most prominently seen in Volume 6 Chapters 75 and 77 where the three discuss which of the girls in class (+Najimi) would be the best to date.

133965.name: Darou Ramen
133965.desc: Ramen Darou is the chain restaurant that Shouko, Tadano, Najimi, and Agari visit in Chapter 28, due to Shouko's dream being to visit a ramen shop. The Shopkeeper is the cook and owner of Itan's Ramen Darou. He speaks extremely quietly, and is also bad at communicating. Due to also being bad at communicating, he shares an empathy between Shouko and much like her family, can have a conversation without speaking.

133965.name: Taisei Sonoda
133965.desc: Sonoda Taisei is a student in class 1-1. Sonoda is friends with Chiarai and Shinobino. The three are most prominently seen in Volume 6 Chapters 75 and 77 where the three discuss which of the girls in class (+Najimi) would be the best to date.

133965.name: Hoshiko Teshigawara
133965.desc: Hoshiko first appears in pages 8-9 of Chapter 43 "Part Time Job", where Komi is handing out pocket tissues, and Hoshiko really needs some tissues. Hoshiko sees Komi, but going to get a handout herself is awfully desperate. Komi, a good reader of nonverbal cues, recognizes the strong aura of tissue-needing-ness emanating from Hoshiko, and successful hands out her first pack of pocket tissues.

133965.name: Kaede Otori
133965.desc: An airhead who likes to take things slow, to the point where she kept on watching a fireplace recording from Christmas to New Year's Day.

133965.name: Himeko Kishi
133965.desc: Himeko is an enigmatic girl who appears as part of Ren Yamai's troupe of popular girls.

133965.name: Rami Kawai
133965.desc: Kawai is the girl who rejected Tadano in middle school.

108511.name: Rimuru Tempest
108511.desc: __Species:__ Human (past life) → Slime __Kind:__ Reincarnated, Otherworlder Rimuru Tempest, formerly known as Satoru Mikami, is the main protagonist of Tensei Shitara Slime Datta Ken. They are the founder and King of the monster country Tempest, situated in the Great Jura Forest, and the partner and sworn friend of Storm Dragon, [Veldora Tempest](https://anilist.co/character/128034/Veldora-Tempest).

108511.name: Shion
108511.desc: "War Lord" Shion is Rimuru’s first servant to be in charge of his care as his personal secretary. She is also the leader of the Yomigaeri and also one of Rimuru's strongest fighters and is coveted by many of the Demon Lords who have met her.

108511.name: Veldora Tempest
108511.original: ヴェルドラ＝テンペスト
108511.desc: __Height:__ 210 cm (human form), 100 m (dragon form) __Species:__ True Dragon __Blessing / Divine Protection:__ Storm Dragon's Grace, Demon Lord's Ally __Disaster Rank:__ Catastrophe Veldora Tempest is the youngest of the four strongest dragons (True Dragons). He is connected with [Rimuru](https://anilist.co/character/123962) by an agreement and was known to rampage here and there. He was the one to name Rimuru and Rimuru gave him his last name, since they share the same last name, Rimuru could technically be classified as Veldora's adoptive brother.

108511.name: Ranga
108511.desc: "Star Lord" Ranga is a Wind Spirit Wolf and a loyal follower of [Rimuru](https://anilist.co/character/123962/Tempest-Rimuru). The leader of the Star Wolf Clan, and the son of the previous boss of the Direwolves. He is also one of Rimuru's Twelve Patrons who has been given the title of a "Lord".

108511.name: Milim Nava
108511.desc: __Kind:__ Inhabitant "Destroyer" Milim Nava is one of the oldest and strongest Demon Lords. She is a Dragonoid. Her nickname, Destroyer, is not just for show. She is a demon lord one should never fight against.

108511.name: Benimaru
108511.desc: Benimaru is one of the third group of subordinate Monsters to be named by Rimuru Tempest. Originally an Ogre, he was uncertain of his servitude and intended for it to be temporary, but after being named, he evolved into a Kijin, immediately becoming Rimuru's most powerful subordinate for a time, and decided to serve him permanently. He lives in the Capital city of the Jura Tempest Federation: Rimuru City. Soon after, and became Commander-in-Chief, giving him direct command over Tempest's military forces. Upon Rimuru's ascension to a True Demon Lord, Benimaru evolved into a Fair Oni and reached the strength of a Disaster-Class Monster.

108511.name: Souei
108511.desc: __Height__: 180 cm (Kijin), 190 cm (Ogre) Souei is an Ogre that was among the third group of subordinates to be named by Rimuru Tempest. He is Rimuru's faithful shadow and the leader of the Shadow Squad of the Jura Tempest Federation.

108511.name: Shuna
108511.desc: Shuna is one of the third group of subordinate Monsters to be named by [Rimuru](https://anilist.co/character/123962), evolving her from an Ogre to a Kijin. She was originally the princess of the Ogre tribe and even though she had the talent for using Magic, she was a sheltered girl, but quickly got along with the Goblinas Shuna is the daughter of the late ogre chieftain and she is also [Benimaru](https://anilist.co/character/128038)'s younger sister, which is why she's nicknamed "Oni Princess" by Rimuru. Very skilled and knowledgeable in domestic matters, she essentially becomes Rimuru's chief economic advisor together with [Rigurd](https://anilist.co/character/129348).

108511.name: Daikenja
108511.desc: Unique Skill Great Sage is one of the first two Unique Skills (the other being Predator) that [Rimuru Tempest](https://anilist.co/character/123962/Rimuru-Tempest) had upon being born into his new world. It had evolved from Extra Skill Sage during his death, as he thought since he was approaching his forties as a virgin, he must be something much greater than a mere wizard. ~!During Rimuru's evolution into Demon Lord this Unique Skill evolved into the Ultimate Skill: Wisdom King Raphael.!~ ~!Rimuru gave her a name and she evolved into a manas with the name Ciel!~

108511.name: Rigurd
108511.desc: Formerly the chief of the goblin village Rimuru comes across. He's now the acting prime minister of the Jura Tempest Federation. He evolved into a hobgoblin when Rimuru named him.

108511.name: Rigur
108511.desc: Rigur was named after his late elder brother. Rigur, after making Gobuta the garrison squad leader, has been supporting his father Rigurdo.

108511.name: Gobta
108511.desc: Gobta is a hobgoblin and is one of Rimuru Tempest's followers. Though he seems to be air-headed he tends to be a hard-worker and dependable when the time calls for it.

108511.name: Myrd
108511.desc: Myrd is younger brother of Garm and Dord. Though he was a dwarf of few words, he was an expert at what he does. Having knowledge in construction, and well-versed in the arts, he is a one of a kind genius. Myrd was appointed as the captain of the construction team.

108511.name: Kaijin
108511.desc: Kaijin was a blacksmith of the Dwarven Kingdom, and the brother of Kaidou. After he was exiled from his own country, he became Rimuru Tempest's subordinate, and helped build the Monster City "Tempest", he acted as a builder, blacksmith, and craftsmen. He also was the former commander of the Dwargon Engineering Corps.

108511.name: Gido
108511.desc: Gido is a member of Cabal's Party who serves as the 'thief' role. ~!However, he is actually serving as one of the bodyguards of Lady Elyune secretly while under the guise of an adventurer.!~ (Source: Tensei Shitara Slime Datta Ken Wikia)

108511.name: Dord
108511.desc: Dord, the middle brother of Garm and Mild. He is known for his first-­rate craftsmanship. Dord focuses more on dyes and high class attire.

108511.name: Kaval
108511.desc: Kaval is the leader of his adventure's party, where he serves as the 'fighter' role. ~!Alongside Gido, he is also tasked as the secret bodyguard of Lady Elyune under the guise of an adventurer.!~ (Source: Tensei Shitara Slime Datta Ken Wikia)

108511.name: Ellen
108511.desc: Eren is an adventurer and a member of Kaval's Party. ~!She is actually the daughter of the Duke of Sorcerer's Dynasty Sarion Elalude, who ran off to be an adventurer due to her selfishness and free-spirited personality.!~ (Source: Tensei Shitara Slime Datta Ken Wikia)

108511.name: Garm
108511.desc: Garm, the elder brother of Doldo and Mild. He is a skilled blacksmith. Garm is in charge of everyday clothing and underwear. (Source: Tensei Shitara Slime Datta Ken Wikia)

108511.name: Diablo
108511.desc: Diablo is the Black Primordial and a loyal servant of [Rimuru Tempest](https://anilist.co/character/123962/Tempest-Rimuru). Before he met Rimuru, he went by the nicknames Black or Noir, the latter which he received from his fellow Primordial kin. After receiving the name Diablo from Rimuru, he evolved to a Demon Peer.

108511.name: Ramiris
108511.desc: Ramiris is a fairy that resides inside of Tempest's Underground Labyrinth. She is also one of the Eight-Star Demon Lords.

108511.name: Frey
108511.desc: "Sky Queen" Frey is an ex-Demon Lord and currently a subordinate of [Demon Lord Milim Nava](https://anilist.co/character/128036/Nava-Milim). She often scolds Milim for playing around when she is supposed to be working.

108511.name: Gabiru
108511.desc: The captain of the Hiryuu of Tempest, and the former lizardmen raid leader. He suffers from a superiority complex. The root of Gabil's pride and confidence​ is the thought that he is the chosen one.

108511.name: Hinata Sakaguchi
108511.desc: Hinata Sakaguchi is an otherworlder and the leader of the Imperial Guards under the Pope's direct command. Along with Yuuki and Class S, she's a former student of Shizue Izawa. ~!At first she thought monsters should all be exterminated. But after her fight with Rimuru, she was convinced that Rimuru is not evil.!~

108511.name: Hakurou
108511.desc: Hakurou is a Fair Oni and is a loyal follower of Rimuru Tempest. He was one of the survivors of the Orc attack. He was also the teacher of the Dwarven King.

108511.name: Karion
108511.desc: ~!Karion is one of the ten demon lords that existed before Rimuru became a demon lord. During the Walpurgis Banquet where Rimuru killed Clayman. Karion became a subordinate of Milim.!~

108511.name: Kurobee
108511.desc: Kurobee is a Fair Oni and a loyal follower of Rimuru Tempest. Kurobee was originally one of the Oni that survived the Orc attack. He evolved after being named by Rimuru.

108511.name: Clayman
108511.desc: Demon Lord Clayman, is one of the ten demon lords that ~!existed before Rimuru became a demon lord. He turned into Kazaream's underling when Kazaream turned him into a demon lord.!~

108511.name: Vesta
108511.desc: Bester (ベスター Besutā) is a former minister of Dwargon and is currently the lead researcher of Tempest. ~!After joining Tempest he has become more reliable. He got rid of that sharp personality and mellowed out.!~

108511.name: Gazel Dwargo
108511.desc: Species: Dwarf Blessing / Divine Protection: Divine Protector of Ancestor Title: King of Armament Nation Dwargon. The king of Dwargon, Gazel Dwargo, the third generation king of Dwargon, but possesses a similar aura to that of his grandfather in his younger days. He is renowned as a great hero and celebrated as a wise king for his impartial rule.

108511.name: Treyni
108511.desc: Treyni is a dryad that resides in the Jura Forest.

108511.name: Souka
108511.desc: Gabil's younger sister, and the daughter of Abil. After the Orc Lord incident, she swears her allegeiance to Rimuru. She attends to Souei as a spy.

108511.name: Alice Rondo
108511.desc: One of the children who were incompletely summoned. At 9 years old, Alice is the youngest of the group, and she's also a bit of a tomboy.

108511.name: Garde-Myourmiles
108511.original: ガルド・ミョルマイル
108511.desc: An influential merchant from the kingdom of Burumund. Myorumairu is both the chairman of the Burumund shopping district and also a loan shark.

108511.name: Kenya Misaki
108511.desc: A member of a group of children who were incompletely summoned. He is the leader of the pack and has a lively disposition.

108511.name: Ryouta Sekiguchi
108511.desc: One of the children who were incompletely summoned. Ryota has a shy personality, but he generally gets along well with Kenya.

108511.name: Gale Gibson
108511.desc: One of the children who were incompletely summoned. At 11 years old, he is the eldest of the group.

108511.name: Chloe Aubert
108511.desc: One of the children who were incompletely summoned. Chloe is a quiet child who loves books.

108511.name: Geld
108511.desc: He is one of the fourth group of subordinates to be named by Rimuru Tempest. As the right-hand man of the deceased Orc Lord, he was given the same name as him, as a memento and token of appreciation, similar to how Rigur was named after his older brother. As an Orc King, he is the leader of the Yellow Corps, that acts as both the last line of defense for Tempest as well as the main team of the country's Department of Construction and Manufacturing. Later on, he was given the Title of a "Lord" as one of Rimuru's Twelve Patrons.

108511.name: Tear
108511.desc: Member of the Moderate Jesters alongside Laplace and Footman, and as that loyal subordinate of Demon Lord Kazaream.

108511.name: Kaidou
108511.desc: He is the captain of the guards of Dwargon, and Kaijin's younger brother.

108511.name: Youm Farmenas
108511.original: ヨウム・ファルメナス
108511.desc: The Hero-King Farmenas of the Farmenas Kingdom. Formerly the Farmas Kingdom, Count Nidole Maigam’s Territory's, Frontier Garrison Captain Youm.

108511.name: Ifrit
108511.desc: Ifrit is a high-ranking spirit; the ruler of flame which was sealed within Shizue Izawa by Demon Lord Leon Cromwell. He used to live in Dwelling of the Spirit before he was stolen by the "Blonde Demon" Leon Cromwell. After that, he was sealed within Shizue Izawa. As a result of this, it gave Shizue an extended lifespan.

108511.name: Haruna
108511.desc: She is a resident of the goblin village.

108511.name: Laplace
108511.desc: He is the vice-president of the Moderate Jesters and as that a loyal subordinate of Demon Lord Kazaream.

108511.name: Phobio
108511.desc: __Species:__ Leopard Lycanthrope He is one of the "Beastketeers" of the Demon Lord Karion. He is proclaimed to be the strongest warrior of the 3 "Beastketeers".

108511.name: Shougo Taguchi
108511.desc: Shogo Taguchi was one of the Otherworlders summoned to serve Falmuth. A very cocky individual who believed that he was one of the strongest there is and even equal to Hinata Sakaguchi. ~!Overwhelmed and on the verge of losing to Tempest's counterattack, he was saved and managed to escape together with Razen, but was instead killed by his savior as Razen took his body and abilities.!~

108511.name: Kyouya Tachibana
108511.desc: Kyoya Tachibana was one of the Otherworlders summoned to serve Falmuth. A laidback individual, who believed himself of having one of the most powerful skills. ~!He fought against Hakurou the second time, but lost with ease and got decapitated!~

108511.name: Kirara Mizutani
108511.desc: Kirara Mizutani was one of the Otherworlders summoned to serve Falmuth. A self-centered individual who always blames everyone else but herself. ~!She was killed by Shogo in her camp.!~

108511.name: Albis
108511.desc: Albis, known as the Golden Serpent, is one of Carrion's Beastman subordinates. She is the leader of Yuurazania's Three Beastketeers. ~!She becomes one of Benimaru's wives later on along with Momiji!~

108511.name: Grucius
108511.desc: Grucius is a Beastman from the Beast Kingdom Eurazania.

108511.name: Suphia
108511.desc: Suphia, known as the White Tiger Claw, is one of Beast Kingdom Eurazania's Three Beastketeers. She is described as having a ferocious aura that has been likened to a "battle-hardened leader".

108511.name: Mjurran
108511.desc: A travelling wizard who was granted a place in Youm's party as their advisor after defeating the aforementioned in a duel. ~!Of Clayman's "Five Fingers", she was the "Ring Finger", acting as one of his spies until Rimuru severs his control over her heart.!~

108511.name: Tiss
108511.desc: Tiss is a homeroom teacher of the Freedom Academy.

108511.name: Jeff
108511.desc: A teacher at Freedom Academy.

108511.name: Footman
108511.desc: Footman is a Majin who is part of the Moderate Harlequin Alliance

108511.name: Razen
108511.desc: Razen is a brilliant sorcerer who has served many years as a Court Mage in Farmus, part of why he has lived so long is his Possession Spell. He was once a student under the Great Sorcerer Gadra. ~!He's currently possessing Shogo Taguchi's body!~

108511.name: Koby
108511.desc: A Dog Merchant

108511.name: Gobzo
108511.desc: A Goblin in Tempest thats friends with Gobuta

108511.name: Touka
108511.desc: Souka's subordinate. She forms part of the Shadow Squad, where she mostly gathers information. She used to live in the Lizardmen marshes but moved to Tempest by Abiru's order.

108511.name: Hokusou
108511.desc: Souka's subordinate. He forms part of the Shadow Squad, where he mostly gathers information. He used to live in the Lizardmen marshes but moved to Tempest by Abiru's order.

108511.name: Nansou
108511.desc: Souka's subordinate. He forms part of the Shadow Squad, where he mostly gathers information. He used to live in the Lizardmen marshes but moved to Tempest by Abiru's order.

108511.name: Saika
108511.desc: Souka's subordinate. She forms part of the Shadow Squad, where she mostly gathers information. She used to live in the Lizardmen marshes but moved to Tempest by Abiru's order.

108511.name: Folgen
108511.desc: Folgen is the former Knight Leader of the Kingdom of Falmuth.

108511.name: Edmaris Falmuth
108511.original: エドマリス・ファルムス
108511.desc: The former king of the Kingdom of Falmuth.

108511.name: Reyhiem
108511.desc: Reyhiem, an archbishop of the Western Holy Church, was the most powerful religious figure in the Kingdom of Falmuth. He was (on paper, at least) on equal footing with the king himself given Falmuth's adoption of Luminism as its state religion. That was just a formality, however; in reality, Reyhiem was more of a trusted right-hand man, taking his cues from the king.

108511.name: Trya
108511.desc: Trya is a Dryad that resides in the Jura Forest. She is the sister of Treyni.

161645.name: Narrator
161645.desc: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

161645.name: Maomao
161645.desc: Maomao works as an apothecary in the red light district, helping her mentor and father [Luomen](https://anilist.co/character/261968) in caring for its residents, with special attention given to the Verdigris Hall brothel, where she was born and was initially raised. One day, while gathering herbs, she gets kidnapped and sold to be a common servant in the inner court of the imperial palace, where only the Emperor's consorts and their servants reside. Not allowed to leave, her curious personality and skills begin to rope her into mysterious problems that can affect the whole country. ~! It was later revealed that Loumen was actually her adoptive father. Her biological father is [Lakan](https://anilist.co/character/232926), the tactician in the Li military. Loumen is actually Maomao's biological great-uncle. Her biological mother is [Fengxian](https://anilist.co/character/274191), who was a high ranking courtesan at the Verdigris House. !~

161645.name: Jinshi
161645.desc: Jinshi is the eunuch in charge of the affairs of the inner palace. He is described as having a face capable even of outshining the consorts in beauty, amazing women and men alike. He is constantly accompanied by his attendant [Gaoshun](https://anilist.co/character/244317/Gaoshun) and has taken an interest to [Maomao](https://anilist.co/character/126824/Maomao)'s intelligence and active demeanor.

161645.name: Koutei
161645.desc: The current Emperor fulfills the role expected of him. He is hated by his mother, the Empress dowager, for being the product of her rape. His most trustworthy relationship is with his brother, who manages small things behind the scenes for him.

161645.name: Riishu
161645.desc: The Virtuous consort, residing in the Diamond Palace within the inner court. She was sent to be a high consort on the inner court as a young child because her prominent family was aware of the previous Emperor's pedophilic tendencies. When he died, she was allowed to leave as she was never visited by him, but her family arranged for her to return to her high consort position. Due to how young she is, she doesn't get any interest from the current Emperor, commands no respect, nor does she have any influence. She's very naive and gets bullied even by her own attendants.

161645.name: Aaduo
161645.desc: The Pure consort, residing in the Garner Palace within the inner court. She was the current Emperor's milk sibling and childhood crush, being just a year older than him. She became the previous Emperor's consort and gave birth to his child at 18, who was stillborn. The ordeal made her infertile, but circumstances between her and the royal family allowed her to keep her position as a High Consort. She is very spartan on the outside yet has a motherly side to her. ~!She is Jinshi's real mother!~

161645.name: Rifa
161645.desc: The Able consort, residing in the Crystal Palace within the inner court. The second most favoured consort of the Emperor, said to be so in big part due to her voluptuous chest. She gave birth to a boy who succumbed for unknown reasons and she herself is in grave health condition at the start of the story.

161645.name: Gyokuyou
161645.desc: The Noble consort, residing in the Jade Palace within the inner court. Her red hair and green eyes distinguish her from the other consorts, that being part of the reasons she became the Emperor's favoured consort, having already given birth to a girl of his. Despite these circumstances, she is very careful of whom she keeps around so she has the smallest retinue of all the high consorts. ~! Later on, she gives birth to a boy, the new heir to the crown, thus becoming the Empress. !~

161645.name: Lakan
161645.desc: Lakan is a renowned strategist known for his nonchalant disregard of proper manners. His plotting ability causes fear even in the Emperor himself. He sees people's faces as a piece of shogi representing their worth, with a few exceptions like the woman he loved and his daughter. Currently heads the La clan. ~!He is [Maomao](https://anilist.co/character/126824/Maomao)'s biological father and the nephew of [Luomen](https://anilist.co/character/261968/Ruomen)!~

161645.name: Gaoshun
161645.desc: Gaoshun is [Jinshi](https://anilist.co/character/127278/Jinshi)'s attendant. He's shown to be extremely dependable. A stern believer in deference to authority and proper etiquette, his disapproval is often splattered in his transparent facial expressions, even if he says nothing.

161645.name: Hongniang
161645.desc: Lady Gyokuyou's head lady-in-waiting.

161645.name: Meimei
161645.desc: Meimei is one of the Three Princesses of Verdigris Hall. She started as Fenshen's apprentice and, being somewhat cunning herself, inherited Fenshen's taste for strategy board games. She is the most attached to the brothel and the people within.

161645.name: Fuyou
161645.desc: A mid-rank consort, princess of a distant land. She became the Emperor's middle consort against her will.

161645.name: Rouran
161645.desc: The (new) Pure consort, residing in the Garnet Palace within the inner court. She makes a big show of her exorbitant and ever changing clothing, jewellery and make up. Despite that, she doesn't talk any more than she needs to, keeping her distance.

161645.name: Lingli
161645.desc: Lingli is the baby of high consort Gyokuyou. She's the first child of the current Emperor to survive. She's nicknamed Xiaoling by her mother, meaning Little Bell.

161645.name: Ruomen
161645.desc: Ruomen is a physician of the Inner Court, a physician in the red-light district, and Maomao's father.

161645.name: Xiaolan
161645.desc: Xiaolan is a servant in the inner court of the palace. Carefree and easy to please, she looks at her sale to the inner palace as a good thing, since at least she now has proper bedding and meals. She loves gossiping and constantly serves as a source of possibilities for Maomao to brainstorm over.

161645.name: Yarite Baba
161645.desc: Once a high ranking courtesan herself, the Madam is now the runner of the Vergidris Hall.

161645.name: Anshi
161645.desc: Anshi, the Empress Dowager, is the wife of the previous Emperor, mother to the current one. She joined the inner court at 10 years of age as the attendant to a consort and unwillingly got the previous Emperor's attention with her childish innocence. He jumped her and, at 11, she gave birth to the current Emperor. Her relationship with the previous Emperor was cold, for she was disgusted by him while he feared her ever more adult (dominant) presence. Later in life, she found him making advances on underage maid and in a pit of rage, she raped him, resulting in her getting pregnant with the second prince.

161645.name: Pairin
161645.desc: Pairin is the oldest of the Three Princesses of Verdigris Hall. She loves men's bodies and dreams of being taken away by a muscular prince.

161645.name: Fenshen
161645.desc: Fenshen used to be a high ranking courtesan in Verdigris Hall. With a flinty and hard personality, she was unmatched at strategy board games. She fell in love with a man who could challenge her at those, but was later abandoned after bedding him. ~!Her mental condition degraded heavily and she mistreated her baby to the point the other courtesans took Maomao to raise her themselves. Ultimately she contracted syphilis and got bedridden in a backroom of Verdigris.!~

161645.name: Guen
161645.desc: Guen is the current physician of the inner court. The requirement of being castrated to be allowed to work inside the inner court does not attract many physicians to choose from. Guen, not a very good one, accepted such employment terms to prevent his sister being forced to become a court lady.

161645.name: Joka
161645.desc: Joka is the youngest of the Three Princesses of Verdigris Hall and one of Maomao's adopted sisters.

161645.name: Suirei
161645.desc: Suirei is a court lady, doing menial tasks in the outer court.

161645.name: Lihaku
161645.desc: Lihaku is a military officer, residing in the outer court of the palace. He's strong and honest, but not exactly brilliant.

161645.name: Xing
161645.desc: The head lady-in-waiting of the Crystal Pavillion.

161645.name: Rikuson
161645.desc: Subordinate of [Rakan](https://anilist.co/character/232926). A very capable official, he is gentle, diligent, and quick-witted.

114535.name: March
114535.desc: **Relatives:** Unnamed [mother](https://anilist.co/character/202865/March-no-Haha) & [father](https://anilist.co/character/201554/March-no-Chichi), [Risa](https://anilist.co/character/202890/Risa) (baby sibling) March is a young girl from Ninannah. When running away from her village, she stumbles across [Fushi](https://anilist.co/character/136548/Fushi) near a pond. March is very skilled at climbing trees. She's also small enough where she can easily crawl through tight spaces adults can't. March was born in the village of Ninannah. Years later, she is chosen as a sacrifice to the [Spirit Bear](https://anilist.co/character/202861/Oniguma), a god her village worships to bring peace and prosperity, but is rescued by [Parona](https://anilist.co/character/136544/Parona).

114535.name: Parona
114535.desc: **Relatives:** Unnamed mother, father, and [sister](https://anilist.co/character/201557/Paronas-sister). Parona is a girl from Ninannah and a close friend of [March](https://anilist.co/character/136541/March). She looks after March like an older sister.

114535.name: Hayase
114535.desc: __Residence:__ Yanome __Affiliation:__ The Guardian Force (former) __Relatives:__ [Hisame](https://anilist.co/character/136547/Hisame) (Granddaughter), [Oumi](https://anilist.co/character/202881/Oumi) (Great-Granddaughter), [Ushio](https://anilist.co/character/202869/Ushio) (Descendant), [Chisui](https://anilist.co/character/202867/Chisui) (Descendant), [Kahaku](https://anilist.co/character/138875/Kahaku) (Descendent), [Mizuha](https://anilist.co/character/204189/Mizuha) (Descendant (18th)) __Status:__ ~!Deceased, her "Faie" or soul is being passed down her lineage along with a knocker they control.!~ She is a Yanome government official. She was chosen to oversee the Ninannah sacrificial ceremony for the [Spirit Bear](https://anilist.co/character/202861/Oniguma). ~!After Fushi's attack in Yanome, Hayase spends about 5 years searching for him. She eventually meets him again on Jananda. Hayase had developed an obessive love for Fushi ever since they first met. Her love was so strong that she would kill anyone that Fushi was close to in order to have Fushi to herself. Her willpower was so strong that her love for Fushi would be passed down to her descendants, leading to the forming of The Guardian Force.!~

114535.name: Fushi
114535.desc: **Age:** ~!~800 years!~ **Relatives:** [The Beholder](https://anilist.co/character/136553/Kansatsusha) ("father"; creator), [March](https://anilist.co/character/136541/March) (adoptive "mother"), [Gugu](https://anilist.co/character/136554/Gugu) (adoptive brother) Fushi is an immortal being created by The Beholder and placed on Earth to preserve the world. Fushi is an immortal being that can take the form of anything that has given him stimuli. His original form was a featureless white sphere. Without consciousness, he copied the first thing he bumped into, which happened to be a rock. Soon afterward, he became moss and stayed like that for some time. When a wounded wolf wandered close in the middle of winter and died, the immortal copied the wolf. He retains the ability to turn into these things. Later, after the death of the [nameless boy](https://anilist.co/character/201555/Unnamed-Boy), he mimicked the boy's appearance and took the form of a young boy with white hair, a pale complexion, and green eyes. He wears a short, brown fur cloak and a light blue shirt and pants with fur boots. A rope dangled from his hand and neck as the nameless boy died holding [Joaan](https://anilist.co/character/163694/Joaan)'s leash, though the latter soon disappeared. Fushi commented on the form, saying it felt like it belonged to him the most. Other than the nameless boy (whose form he usually defaults to), he can also take the form of many others; most notably: ~!March, a little girl with lo

114535.name: Tonari
114535.desc: __Affiliation:__ Tonari's Group (former) Tonari is a girl that [Fushi](https://anilist.co/character/136548/Fushi) meets on the island of Jananda. She has short brown hair, green eyes, and tan skin. She's seen wearing a blue jacket and shorts, a black and white shirt, and has a pet owl named Ligard. ~!Sometime after Fushi left the island of Jananda, Tonari began ingesting different types of poison to develop strong immunities to them.!~

114535.name: Rean Cropp
114535.desc: Rean is a young girl from Takunaha.

114535.name: Sander
114535.desc: Sander is a young boy from Jananda and a member of [Tonari's](https://anilist.co/character/136550/Tonari) Group.

114535.name: Kansatsu-sha
114535.desc: The mysterious being and observer who cast the orb onto the Earth. His goal is to preserve the world. He sent [Fushi](https://anilist.co/character/136548/Fushi) to acquire various kinds of information from the world and aid his observations.

114535.name: Gugu
114535.desc: Gugu is a young man from Takunaha who originally worked at [Booze Man's](https://anilist.co/character/136555/Sakejii) shop. As [Fushi's](https://anilist.co/character/136548/Fushi) sworn brother, he fought the [Nokkers](https://anilist.co/character/232832/Nokkers) and anti-Fushi faction members on several occasions to create the peaceful world the immortal desires. He wears a mask to hide his face. ~!His head got crushed by a wood log while trying to save [Rean](https://anilist.co/character/136551/Cropp-Rean). He has been wearing a mask to cover it ever since.!~

114535.name: Sakejii
114535.desc: An old man who saved [Gugu](https://anilist.co/character/136554/Gugu)'s life and is also [Pyoran](https://anilist.co/character/136556/Pyoran)'s lover.

114535.name: Pyoran
114535.desc: Pyoran is an old woman from Takunaha. She comes to Ninannah as a shaman.

114535.name: Joaan
114535.desc: Joaan is the [nameless boy](https://anilist.co/character/201555/Shounen)'s pet Reshy wolf. It was also the first animal that [Fushi](https://anilist.co/character/136548/Fushi) obtained.

114535.name: March no Chichi
114535.desc: He is [March’s](https://anilist.co/character/136541/March) father

114535.name: Shounen
114535.desc: It's the first human our main character meets. It is also the first human form our main character can transform into. His version of this boy is called 'Fushi'. The boys own name has never been mentioned.

114535.name: Penna
114535.desc: She's [Parona's](https://anilist.co/character/136544/Parona) sister. One day she went out for food and never came back.

114535.name: Upa
114535.desc: One of the girls that [Fushi](https://anilist.co/character/136548/Fushi) meets on the island of Jananda. ~!After she dies she also becomes a form Fushi can take over!~

114535.name: Mia
114535.desc: One of the girls that [Fushi](https://anilist.co/character/136548/Fushi) meets on the island of Jananda. ~!After she dies she also becomes a form Fushi can take over!~

114535.name: Ligard
114535.desc: [Tonari](https://anilist.co/character/136550/Tonari)'s companion. ~!After [Fushi](https://anilist.co/character/136548/Fushi) leaves the island, Tonari tells Ricard to follow Fushi on his journey. And to one day lead Tonari back to Fushi!~

114535.name: Uroy
114535.desc: One of the guys [Fushi](https://anilist.co/character/136548/Fushi) meets on the island of Jananda.

114535.name: Erran Dalton
114535.original: エラン・ジー・ダルトン
114535.desc: [Tonari's](https://anilist.co/character/136550/Tonari) father. He sent to the island of Jananda because he was suspected of killing his wife

114535.name: Oniguma
114535.desc: He was the Demon Bear dwelling in the forests. [March](https://anilist.co/character/136541/March) was supposed the be the sacrifice to keep the bear away. He has many spikes in his body, which appeared to be spears. After he died, he became one of the forms of our main character.

114535.name: Shin
114535.desc: [Gugu's](https://anilist.co/character/136554/Gugu) "brother". They were both servants that were abandoned. They lived for a long time as siblings.

114535.name: March no Haha
114535.desc: She is [March's](https://anilist.co/character/136541/March) mother

114535.name: Nand
114535.desc: He is one of the Jananda prisoners [Fushi](https://anilist.co/character/136548/Fushi) fought in the arena

114535.name: Meer
114535.desc: [Rean](https://anilist.co/character/136551/)'s friendly dog.

114535.name: Nokkers
114535.desc: Nokkers are unknown creatures that were created to impede [Fushi's](https://anilist.co/character/136548/Fushi) progress in preserving the world. [The Beholder](https://anilist.co/character/136553/Kansatsusha) named them "Nokkers" because they "Knock on the doors of paradise, seeking its destruction." A Nokker's main form resembles long, presumably sharp, vines. However, they adapt to their environment and take on various other forms - forms stolen from Fushi. Each time a Nokker is defeated they are said to come back stronger each time.

114535.name: Igoss Cropp
114535.desc: Igoss Cropp is part of a wealthy family in Takunaha and father of [Rean Cropp](https://anilist.co/character/136551/Cropp-Rean).

21450.name: Joutarou Kuujou
21450.desc: __Height:__ 195 cm (6'5") __Occupation:__ Student, Marine Explorer, Oceanographer __Nationality:__ Japanese Joutarou is Holly Kujo's son and [Joseph Joestar](https://anilist.co/character/6356)'s grandson. In Part 3, he has a recognizable attire of a blue trenchcoat-length school uniform jacket with yellow chains on the collar. He also wears a trademark hat which, while torn in the back, often seems to blend with his hair. When Joutarou first appears, he turned himself in to the police because he believes his Stand is an evil spirit possessing him. After he is released from jail, and learns what his Stand is, Joutarou gets used to Star Platinum -- a fierce, muscular, vaguely Aztec-looking spirit with "the precision of a machine" and the ability to destroy virtually anything with a sledgehammer barrage of fists. He has a very tough exterior, and is even rather rough and delinquent, but he also is very dedicated, intense, and loyal. He is very intelligent, but usually lets his (or Star Platinum's) fists do the talking with the enemy, even though he often has to rely on his wits to deal with stand users' attacks. He is also known for a quick and short temper. His catchphrase is "Yare yare daze." It generally relates of being bored or exasperation. In Part 3, he is the main target of [Dio](https://anilist.co/character/4004), who realizes that Joutarou is his greatest threat. One of the strongest stands in the JoJo universe; Star Platinum possesses super human senses, strength, sta

21450.name: Dio Brando
21450.desc: __Height:__ 195 cm (6'5") __Race:__ Human (formerly), Vampire (onwards) __Nationality:__ British Dio is an immortal vampire and the arch rival of the Joestar clan. __Series 1: Phantom Blood__ ~!Dio is the son of [Dario Brando](https://anilist.co/character/74099/Brando-Dario), an alcoholic and abusive father. Back when Dio was just a boy, he was brought into the household of [George Joestar](https://anilist.co/character/21956/Joestar-I-George) after the mysterious death of his father, so as to repay the debt he owed Dio's father for saving his life. But soon Dio's personality caused trouble for George's young son, [Jonathan Joestar](https://anilist.co/character/8087/Joestar-Jonathan). Even more of a sociopath than his father, Dio was resolute to shatter Jonathan's spirit and take his place as the favored son, even going so far as to arrange for Jonathan's dog [Danny](https://anilist.co/character/222601/Danny) to be burned to death. Initially, Dio is able earn the trust of the patriarch of the Joestar family through deceit (and at Jonathan's expense). However, his plans of taking over the Joestar household were discovered by Jonathan when he discovered that not only had Dio poisoned his biological father to death, he was doing the same to his adoptive father, all to take the Joestar estate for his own. Determined not to be stopped, and understanding the potential to enjoy power over all things instead of just the Joestar estate, Dio wears and activates the Stone Mask, becoming
