When the Prince Yuki Fan Club attempted to weaken Tohru's defenses by finding and using Saki's weakness, Megumi joined his sister in scaring them away. His dark demeanor and his ability to "guess" the girl's names frightened them from the house. The next day, Saki mentioned that the girls would all be cursed in three days' time. While it seems possible for Megumi to do this, since he claimed that all he would need were the girls' names, the manga never shows what happens, so Saki could have been bluffing. Like his sister, he is also highly mature for his age, not only in intelligence and behaviour but as well as in sexual maturity, as Arisa states when he makes a comment how he came to her restaurant only to see her in a miniskirt: "You know, you really don't act like a middle schooler; more like a lecherous old man." (This only happens in the manga.) Megumi, for his part, has been

105334.name: Mayuko Shiraki
105334.desc: Mayuko Shiraki (白木 繭子, Shiraki Mayuko) is Tohru, Kyo, Yuki, Saki, and Arisa's homeroom teacher; what subject she teaches is never given, though in an author's note, Natsuki Takaya said she thinks Shiraki fits the image of a literature teacher. Shiraki is depicted as generally good-humored but sometimes aggressive—when Kyo attempts to leave class on Valentine's Day, she stops him at the door with a folder in his face and threatens to dye his hair black instead of orange, and once breaks up a fight between Hatsuharu and Kyo by dumping a bucket of water over them;she once demanded as a joke that, after some students familiarly addressed her "Mayu-chan-sensei," that they call her "Great Teacher Mayuko." Her parents, who worry about Shiraki being unmarried, run a bookstore where she sometimes helps out. Takaya said in an author's note that Shiraki is "possibly sad" that she is a woman and "secretly insecure of how tall she is," but since Hatori Sohma is tall too, they "might look pretty good together." Shiraki is best friends with Kana, Hatori's former fiancee, and through she met Hatori, Shigure, and Ayame two years before the series begins. While Shiraki was attracted to Hatori, she was glad that Kana and Hatori were happy together. She dated Shigure for a month before breaking up, partly because Shigure was distant and partly because she was only dating him to alleviate her loneliness. She was at a loss when Kana and Hatori broke up, because Hatori had erased Kana's memory of t

105334.name: Kana Souma
105334.desc: She was engaged to Hatori Sohma and was the assistant in his doctor's office. The relationship ended when Hatori asked Akito for permission to marry Kana and in response, Akito attacked Hatori, leaving him almost blind in his left eye; Kana blamed herself for the incident and felt so guilty about it that Hatori was forced to erase her memory of their relationship to ease her suffering.

105334.name: Narrator
105334.desc: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

105334.name: Makoto Takei
105334.desc: He's the student council president of Kaibara Municipal High School at the start of the series.

105334.name: Minami Kinoshita
105334.desc: Minami is a second-year student at Kaibara Municipal High School and an admirer of [Yuki Souma](https://anilist.co/character/208). She is the vice president of the Prince Yuki Fan Club and the next in line to become president, following [Motoko Minagawa](https://anilist.co/character/3874), the current president. She hates [Tohru Honda](https://anilist.co/character/207) and calls her an "evil witch" due to her closeness with Yuki. She and the other girls of the club constantly plot against her, but are constantly thwarted by [Hanajima](https://anilist.co/character/376), who they are terrified of.

105334.name: Hiroshi
105334.desc: Hiroshi is a classmate and goo friend of Kyo Soma.

105334.name: Yuusuke
105334.desc: Yusuke is a classmate and good friend of Kyo Soma.

105334.name: Kazuma no Sofu
105334.desc: __Zodiac Animal:__ Cat (Former) The late grandfather of [Kazuma Souma](https://anilist.co/character/377). He was previously the Cat of the Chinese Zodiac before [Kyou Souma](https://anilist.co/character/209).

130298.name: Cid Kagenou
130298.desc: __Race:__ Human Cid Kagenou, under the moniker of "Shadow," is the founder and leader of the secret organization "Shadow Garden." He founded the organization to help realize his fantasy of becoming an “Eminence in Shadow". However, unbeknownst to him, his fabrications are often revealed to be quite genuine in reality. Cid is the reincarnation of Minoru Kagenou. (Source: The Eminence in Shadow Wiki)

130298.name: Gamma
130298.desc: __Race:__ Elf Gamma is a member of Shadow Garden, being third of the original Seven Shadows as well as the director of the Mitsugoshi Company. Despite her lack of coordination, Gamma's knowledge has allowed her to recreate many of the items described by her master [Shadow](https://anilist.co/character/136837/Cid-Kagenou) to sell as Mitsugoshi's exclusive products. (Source: To Be a Power in the Shadows! Wiki)

130298.name: Alpha
130298.desc: __Race:__ Elf Alpha is the second-in-command of Shadow Garden. After being cured of Demon Possession by [Cid Kagenou](https://anilist.co/character/136837/Cid-Kagenou), she would devote her life to his cause, becoming the first member to be recruited into his organization, Shadow Garden. ~!She is the descendant of the elf [Hero Olivier](https://anilist.co/character/204203/Olivier).!~

130298.name: Beta
130298.desc: __Race:__ Elf Beta is the second member of Shadow Garden, supporting her master [Shadow](https://anilist.co/character/136837/Cid-Kagenou) against the Order of Diabolos. ~!Outside of her Shadow Garden activities, she adopts the identity of Natsume Kafka, an up-and-coming author of numerous original pieces of literature.!~

130298.name: Delta
130298.desc: __Race:__ Beastkin Delta is a member of Shadow Garden, being fourth of the original Shadow Seven to join the organization after her Demonic Possession was healed by her master [Shadow](https://anilist.co/character/136837/Cid-Kagenou). As the most physically gifted of the Seven, Delta is also often the most destructive and brutal of the group due to her lack of sense and self-control. (Source: To Be a Power in the Shadows! Wiki)

130298.name: Epsilon
130298.desc: __Race:__ Elf Epsilon is the fifth member of Shadow Garden. Due to her insecurities with having a flat-chest, she manipulated her slime bodysuit every year to slowly increase the mass on her chest, eventually developing a fake large breast. As a consequence of this, she developed extreme magic control earning her the title, "The Precision."

130298.name: Claire Kagenou
130298.desc: __Race:__ Human Claire is the older sister of [Cid Kagenou](https://anilist.co/character/136837/Cid-Kagenou) and heir to the Kagenou Family. (Source: To Be a Power in the Shadows! Wiki)

130298.name: Alexia Midgar
130298.original: アレクシア・ミドガル
130298.desc: __Race:__ Human Alexia Midgar is the second princess of the Kingdom of Midgar and younger sister of [Iris Midgar](https://anilist.co/character/204204/Iris--Midgar). She is also a student of Midgar Royal Spellsword Academy. (Source: To Be a Power in the Shadows! Wiki)

130298.name: Rose Oriana
130298.desc: __Race:__ Human Rosa Oriana is a noble Princess from the Oriana kingdom. She is known for being a genius in art in her kingdom. However, she came to Midgar Royal Spellsword Academy in order to learn swordsmanship. ~!Later [Alpha](https://anilist.co/character/162246/Alpha) discovered Rose, who became a fugitive for assassinating her father and was then offered membership into Shadow Garden.!~

130298.name: Nu
130298.desc: __Race:__ Human Nu is the thirteenth member of Shadow Garden and an employee of Mitsugoshi Company. (Source: To Be a Power in the Shadows! Wiki)

130298.name: Sherry Barnett
130298.original: シェリー・バーネット
130298.desc: __Race:__ Human Sherry Barnett is a student of Midgar Royal Spellsword Academy. She is also the adopted daughter of [Lutheran Barnett](https://anilist.co/character/291390/Barnett-Lutheran).

130298.name: Annerose Nichtsehen
130298.original: アンネローゼ・フシアナス
130298.desc: __Race:__ Human She is a Dark Knight of the Velgalta Empire. Originally a member of "Velgalta's Seven Blades," she abandoned her position to embark on a journey of self-improvement. While participating in the Bushin Festival to test her strength, she was left impressed by [Mundane Mann](https://anilist.co/character/136837/Kagenou-Cid)'s ability and is now training to reach his level. While she possesses skills and brains, she can sometimes be a little klutzy.

130298.name: Olivier
130298.desc: __Race:__ Elf Olivier is one of the three heroes that managed to defeat the demon Diabolos. As a result, her descendants were cursed by the demon. (Source: To Be a Power in the Shadows! Wiki)

130298.name: Iris  Midgar
130298.desc: __Race:__ Human Iris Midgar is the first princess of the Kingdom of Midgar and older sister of [Alexia Midgar](https://anilist.co/character/168799/Alexia-Midgar). She is also leader of the Crimson Order. (Source: *The Eminence in Shadow* Wiki)

130298.name: Aurora
130298.desc: __Race:__ Human A woman known as the Calamity Witch who once brought chaos and destruction to the world. In the Goddess' Trial in the Sacred Land, she is summoned in reaction to Cid's presence and does battle with him in the form of Shadow. Her body is sealed in the sanctuary, and after helping Cid to escape she disappears together with its destruction. ~!Aurora's true identity is the great demon Diabolos but it is unknown if she founded the Order of Diabolos or cursed the three heroes with possession. !~

130298.name: Akane Nishino
130298.desc: __Race:__ Human Akane Nishino is the daughter of the CEO of Nishino Conglomerate and the former classmate of Minoru Kagenou, Cid's pre-reincarnated self.

130298.name: Beatrix
130298.desc: __Race:__ Elf Beatrix is the champion of the God of War Tournament. ~!She is presumed to be the long lost aunt of [Alpha](https://anilist.co/character/162246/Alpha).!~

130298.name: No.665
130298.desc: __Race:__ Elf 665 is a member of Shadow Garden's Numbers and is in a squad with [664](https://anilist.co/character/229662/No664) and 666. She has a calm personality and is good at providing support.

130298.name: No.664
130298.desc: 664 is a member of Shadow Garden's Numbers and is the squad leader of the squad with [665](https://anilist.co/character/229658/No665) and 666. She has a serious personality, but is kind at heart.

130298.name: Zeta
130298.desc: __Race:__ Beastkin Zeta is the sixth member of Shadow Garden, being one of the original Seven Shadows. She usually travels around the world alone gathering intelligence.

130298.name: Hyoro Gali
130298.desc: One of Cid Kageno's chosen "friends" he is using to blend in as a background character

130298.name: Jaga Imo
130298.desc: One of Cid Kagenou's chosen "friends" to help him blend in as a background character

130298.name: Eta
130298.desc: __Race:__ Elf Eta is the seventh member of Shadow Garden, being one of the original Seven Shadows. She specializes and is in charge of the research faction of Shadow Garden and as a result has her own laboratory. She is known as Eta Lloyd Wright, the genius architect, whose work won unanimous first place in an Architecture of the Year.

130298.name: Glen
130298.desc: Vice-Commander of the Crimson Order

130298.name: Marco Granger
130298.original: マルコ・グレンジャー
130298.desc: Knight of the Crimson Order

130298.name: Lutheran Barnett
130298.original: ルスラン・バーネット
130298.desc: Assistant Principal of Midgar Academy for Dark Knights and adoptive father to [Sherry Barnett](https://anilist.co/character/197922/Sherry-Barnett).

130298.name: Jack Nelson
130298.desc: Acting Archbishop

130298.name: Kai
130298.desc: Member of Shadow Garden, and one of the Numbers (no. 22). She is a subordinate of [Epsilon](https://anilist.co/character/162249). She has a serious and stern demeanor but is surprisingly shy and blushes often.

130298.name: Omega
130298.desc: Member of Shadow Garden, and one of the Numbers (No. 24). She is a subordinate of [Epsilon](https://anilist.co/character/162249). Omega is usually calm and collected but is troubled by her tendency to laugh at silly jokes.

130298.name: Cid no Chichi
130298.desc: Head of the Kagenou family and father to [Cid](https://anilist.co/character/136837) and [Claire](https://anilist.co/character/168798).

130298.name: Cid no Haha
130298.desc: Mother of [Cid](https://anilist.co/character/136837) and [Claire](https://anilist.co/character/168798).

130298.name: Olba
130298.desc: A Viscount who was a member of the Cult of Diabolos. He was the mastermind behind the kidnapping of [Claire Kagenou](https://anilist.co/character/168798). ~!Despite consuming multiple of the strength increasing pills, he was easily overwhelmed by [Shadow](https://anilist.co/character/136837) and was soon slain with a single stroke.!~

130298.name: Tsugiide Makkenjii
130298.original: ツギーデ・マッケンジー

130298.name: Quinton
130298.desc: A ferocious swordsman who has participated in the Bushin Festival many times.

130298.name: Goldou Kinmekki
130298.original: ゴルドー・キンメッキ
130298.desc: A swordsman who participated in the God of War Tournament. ~!While publicly known as the Unbeaten Legend and Victorious Golden Dragon, in reality, he is a coward whose unbeaten streak was the result of him forfeiting matches he was unsure he'd win.!~

130298.name: Raphael Oriana
130298.original: ラファエロ・オリアナ
130298.desc: King of the Oriana Kingdom and [Rose](https://anilist.co/character/168800)'s father.

130298.name: Midgar Kokuou
130298.desc: King of the Midgar Kingdom and father of [Alexia](https://anilist.co/character/168799) and [Iris](https://anilist.co/character/204204).

130298.name: Lambda
130298.desc: Member of Shadow Garden, and one of The Numbers (No. 11). She is in charge of training new recruits.

100388.name: Ash Lynx
100388.desc: __Height:__ 180 cm (5'11") __Nationality:__ American-Irish Ash has the personality, charisma, and skill to gather large groups of individuals together under his influence. Not only is he excellent in combat and an incredible marksman, but he's also highly intelligent with an IQ of 200. His intelligence lends itself well to solving the mystery of 'Banana Fish' and he has also been stated to be quite well-read, knowing his way around the newspaper's daily columns and political novels - unusual for someone who did not finish middle school. Along with his remarkable intelligence, Ash's good looks and charisma allow him to sway the will of people to his benefit in dire situations, and he's well aware of it. Despite the influence he holds over others, however, Ash is mistrustful and holds most people at arms-length except for a few select friends in his inner circle, the most notable being [Eiji Okumura](https://anilist.co/character/21928). He is not afraid of death not because of courage, as he calls himself a coward, but because of his disillusionment with his own life. (Source: Banana Fish Wiki)

100388.name: Eiji Okumura
100388.desc: __Height:__ 172 cm __Nationality:__ Japanese __Languages:__ Japanese, English __Background:__ Eiji was a talented athlete and pole vaulter in Japan, until a injury left him unable to compete. Completely discouraged, faced with losing his sports scholarship, and ridiculed by his former competitors and coaches, Eiji fell into a depressed slump. Then Ibe took him in as his assistant, and the two traveled to New York City, to do a report on youth in street gangs. In New York, Eiji met Ash Lynx. __Best 80's Fashion Statement:__ Hawaiin shirt over a tank top, tied in the front, falling off one shoulder. __Inspiration:__ In an interview, author Akimi Yoshida said that the character design for Eiji was inspired by Japanese actor Nomura Hironobu.

100388.name: Sing Soo-Ling
100388.desc: **Height:** 165 cm, 191 cm (Garden of Light) **Nationality:** Chinese-American Sing Soo-Ling is the current leader of the Chinatown mafia, the younger half-brother of Lao Yen Tai.

100388.name: Max Lobo
100388.desc: __May contain spoilers:__ "Max Lobo" is the pen name of Max Glenreed, a good-natured Vietnam veteran, former cop, journalist, novelist, and jailbird. As a journalist, Max wrote a regular column for the Village Tribune. He also wrote a novel about the Vietnam war called Seven Hundred and Thirty Days in Saigon. When we first meet Max in the manga, he is jailed for punching a cop. However, considering his cozy relationship with Charlie, Antonio, and even the prison guards, there is a strong suggestion that Max is keeping himself in jail as long as he wants. He practically brags that he could get out at any time; however, staying locked up seems to be serving the purpose of good old-fashioned investigative journalism. Ever since the Vietnam war, Max has been hot on the trail of "Banana Fish," and has secretly been collecting notes and research for years. In Vietnam, his close friend Griffin Callenreese took some illicit drugs and went on bad trip, going on a shooting rampage and killing fellow members of his unit; it was Max, ultimately, who shot Griff's legs out from underneath him and stopped the carnage. Max had to abandon Griffin to the "nut house" in Saigon, although after the end of the war, he spent years searching for Griffin's whereabouts. To this day, Max is haunted by the memory of Griffin. Later on in the story, this guilt drives him to protect Ash from danger, despite the antagonistic relationship that Ash initially forces him into. Max provides a lot of comic relief

100388.name: Yue-Lung Lee
100388.desc: __Height__:172 cm He is one of the main antagonists of the series and the youngest son of the Lee family, the largest crime family in China. (Source: BANANA FISH Wiki)

100388.name: Shorter Wong
100388.desc: Shorter is the "boss" of Chinatown, a loyal friend to Ash, and a criminal with a heart of gold. Like Ash, Shorter is an unusual "thug" with a deep sense of honor, and a drive to always do the right thing. He'll go to any lengths to protect his loved ones... even when the interests of those closest to him come into irreconcilable conflict. Shorter is clever, resourceful, and as tough as steel. He's equally skilled at brawling, shooting, and sneaking around like a shadowy thief. Shorter can disguise himself as a completely different person, and fool even Eiji into thinking that he is a dotty old Chinese man. Shorter has an irrepressible sense of humor and can wear a lopsided, devilish grin even during the grimmest of circumstances. Like Ash, he is a charismatic leader who can easily unite the other kids on the street under his rule. At the beginning of the series, Shorter has a mohawk hairdo. But by volume two he has shaved off all of his hair and is completely bald. Shorter's trademark fashion statement is his ever-present sunglasses. He even wears them while sneaking around a cornfield in the middle of the night! In an interview, Akimi Yoshida said that Shorter's character design was inspired by Sanburaza Nakano. (Source: boukenshin.net, HotaruKara)

100388.name: Blanca
100388.desc: __Height:__ 196 cm (6'5") __Hair Color:__ Brown A retired assassin and the man who trained [Ash Lynx](https://anilist.co/character/13580/Ash-Lynx) to become heir to [Dino Golzine](https://anilist.co/character/132705/Dino-Francis-Golzine). Even though he cares for Ash, Blanca is a highly effective killer who dutifully carries out any contract he is hired for, such as when he is hired by [Yut-Lung](https://anilist.co/character/29576/YueLung-Lee) to murder [Eiji Okumura](https://anilist.co/character/21928/Eiji-Okumura). Ultimately declining to, Blanca instead defects to Ash's gang. He is shown to have excellent hand to hand combat skills, and insanely talented at long-range sniping.

100388.name: Shunichi Ibe
100388.desc: A Japanese photojournalist who comes to New York City to do a report on street gangs.

100388.name: Skip
100388.desc: An African-American boy, and member of Ash's gang.

100388.name: Dino Golzine
100388.original: ディノ・フランシス・ゴルツィネ
100388.desc: __Height__: 178 cm A major mafia boss in New York City, and the adoptive guardian of Ash Lynx. He has a taste for young boys.

100388.name: Frederick Arthur
100388.original: フレデリック・オーサー
100388.desc: __Height__: 182 cm A vindictive and cruel ex-member of Ash's street gang, who allies himself with Golzine in order to usurp Ash.

100388.name: Alex
100388.desc: Alex is the second-in-command in Ash's Gang.

100388.name: Jim Callenreese
100388.original: ジム・カーレンリース
100388.desc: Jim Callenreese is Ash and Griffin's dad.

100388.name: Charlie Dickinson
100388.original: チャーリー・ディキンソン
100388.desc: Charlie Dickinson is a homicide detective as well as a friend of Max, when the two later met in a police academy.

100388.name: Willard Evanstine
100388.desc: Evanstine is a member of the New York City police.

100388.name: Thomas Holstock
100388.desc: ~!He was killed by Blanca.!~

100388.name: Michael Glenreed
100388.desc: Michael Glenreed is the son of Max and Jessica.

100388.name: Alexis Dawson
100388.original: アレクシス・ドースン
100388.desc: Alexis Dawson is a pathologist at the University of California.

100388.name: McMurphy
100388.desc: McMurphy is a FBI agent.

100388.name: Dr. Meredith
100388.original: ドクター・メレディス
100388.desc: Dr. Meredith is a back alley doctor. He helps Ash both with looking after Griffin, and finding out what a white powdery substance is that's not heroin.

100388.name: Hua Lung Lee
100388.desc: Lee Hua Lung is one of the Lee brothers.

100388.name: Nadia Wong
100388.desc: Shorter's sister. She works at Chang Dai restaurant in Chinatown.

100388.name: Wang Lung Lee
100388.desc: Lee Wang Lung is the eldest child and heir to the Lee family.

100388.name: Gregory
100388.desc: Gregory is a bodyguard for Dino Golzine.

100388.name: Eduardo L. Fox
100388.original: エドアル ・L・フォックス
100388.desc: **Height:** 190 cm He is the leader of a mercenary group and former regimental leader of the French Foreign Legion.

100388.name: Cain Blood
100388.desc: __Height__: 192 cm The Boss of African-American youth gang Black Sabbath. Referees Ash's fight with Arthur and later supports Ash and his gang in the war against the Corsican mafia.

100388.name: Marvin Crosby
100388.original: マービン・クロスビー
100388.desc: Works for Dino Golzine.

100388.name: Yuen-Tai Lao
100388.desc: Lao Yen Tai is Sing's half-brother. ~!Though Sing forgives Ash Lynx for killing Shorter Wong, after being told about Banana Fish, Lao is not told the truth about Shorter's death and continues to distrust him and resents Sing's deference to Ash in the ongoing gang war.!~

100388.name: Abraham Dawson
100388.original: エイブラハム・ドースン
100388.desc: Abraham Dawson is the younger brother of Alexis, who defied his brother's wishes to destroy Banana Fish, and continues to develop and weaponize the drug for the Corsican mob into his adulthood. As a doctor during the Vietnam War, he tested Banana Fish on unknowing soldiers, including Griffin in Banana Fish. ~!He was later shot by Ash Lynx for experimenting on Shorter Wong.!~

100388.name: Jennifer
100388.desc: Lives with Jim Callenreese. She's the stepmom of Ash and Griffin.

100388.name: Antonio Jenkins
100388.desc: He is a homicide detective.

100388.name: Jessica Randy
100388.desc: She is a journalist, as well as the ex-wife of Max and mother of Michael.

100388.name: George Scott
100388.desc: He acts as Ash Lynx's lawyer to set Ash free from jail through his connection with Max Lobo.

100388.name: Bones
100388.desc: Bones is a lieutenant in Ash's gang.

100388.name: The Fly
100388.desc: He is a supplier of black-market goods.

113813.name: Kazuya Kinoshita
113813.desc: __Height:__ 177 cm (5'10") A struggling university student living in Tokyo. He studies at Nerima University. Kazuya possesses a wishy-washy nature and is susceptible to yielding to his selfish desires. His lies often get him into trouble, because he cannot muster the strength to tell the truth. On the other hand, possessing a straightforward kindness that cares for those around him. He has also developed feelings for [Chizuru](https://anilist.co/character/128106/Ichinose-Chizuru).

113813.name: Chizuru Ichinose
113813.desc: __Height:__ 162 cm (5'4") Chizuru Ichinose, alternatively known as Chizuru Mizuhara in her "rental girlfriend" persona, is a college student at Nerima University who is majoring in Literature and she currently lives in Room 204 of Royal Hills Nerima, just next to [Kazuya Kinoshita](https://anilist.co/character/128105/Kazuya-Kinoshita).

113813.name: Sumi Sakurasawa
113813.desc: **Height:** 156 cm (5'1") Sumi is a college student who works as a rental girlfriend for the Diamond app. She's extremely shy which initially made the job quite difficult for her, but she started to improve after spending time with [Kazuya](https://anilist.co/character/128105/Kinoshita-Kazuya).

113813.name: Ruka Sarashina
113813.desc: __Height:__ 158 cm (5'2") Ruka Sarashina suffers from arrhythmia and seeks a lover that will help her cope with her condition. She's seen as being a very pushy and possessive kind of person. This personality of hers developed after learning of her condition and being alienated from her peers. Because of this, she became very fixated on the idea that getting a boyfriend would help her in having a faster heartbeat. Along with her rather brash personality, she doesn't like giving up easily; often making poor decisions to get what she wants.

113813.name: Mami Nanami
113813.desc: **Height:** 158 cm (5'2") She is a freshman at Nerima University and the ex-girlfriend of [Kazuya Kinoshita](https://anilist.co/character/128105). ~!She dumped him after only one month. Even though she broke up with him, she can not fathom Kazuya moving on and seizes every moment attempting to sabotage his happiness.!~

113813.name: Yoshiaki Kibe
113813.desc: Kazuya's childhood friend from elementary school. He often cares for Kazuya.

100240.name: Ken Kaneki
100240.desc: __Height:__ 169 cm (5'6") Ken Kaneki was originally a human and a normal college student until he encountered a female ghoul named [Rize](https://anilist.co/character/88413/Rize-Kamishiro) who was posing as a human at the time. Rize, using Kaneki's crush on her as leverage, managed to lure him into an alley and tried to eat him but ended up dying when construction beams fell on top of her. Kaneki, already in a half-dead state from Rize's attempts at killing him, ends up in a hospital and has some of Rize's organs transplanted into his body. This results in him absorbing some of Rize's powers and characteristics, such as a ghoul eye, powers of regeneration, and the inability to stomach human food. Terrified and lost, Kaneki's life takes a dramatic turn from then on as he tries to find a place for himself in the world, realizing he now belongs to neither the human nor ghoul world and refusing to eat humans to sustain himself. Meeting some of the ​other ghouls, as well as humans, makes him realize that things aren't just black and white and that there are more to ghouls and humans than originally thought.

100240.name: Touka Kirishima
100240.desc: __Height:__ 156 cm (5'1") Touka is a ghoul successfully posing as a human and working as a waitress at a cafe which serves as a gathering place for other ghouls, as well as a food resource. She saves [Kaneki](https://anilist.co/character/87275/Kaneki-Ken)'s life at one point and acts as a reluctant guide to him and his adaptation to the ghoul society. She doesn't like Kaneki much and has no qualms about expressing her dislike for him. She is very serious, tough and hard-working, trying to keep their district as safe for ghouls and humans as possible. Her powers and strength are also quite great and she makes for a formidable opponent.

100240.name: Hinami Fueguchi
100240.desc: __Height:__ 148 cm - 152 cm (4'10" - 4'11") Hinami is a child ghoul whose parents were killed by ghoul investigators. Before, she and her mother seek help from the owner of the Antique Cafe to acquire food. Hinami is initially quite shy, but when she opens up, she is cheerful and earnest. [Ken](https://anilist.co/character/87275/Kaneki-Ken) helps her learn kanji, as she cannot attend school, and is very eager to learn. Currently, she is living together with [Touka Kirishima](https://anilist.co/character/87277/Kirishima-Touka).

100240.name: Koutarou Amon
100240.desc: __Height:__ 191 cm (6'3") A first class police investigator who investigates Ghouls, also known as a Dove. He comes to the 20th ward with his mentor, [Mado Kureo](https://anilist.co/character/88423), to investigate Ghoul incidents in the area. He has a strong sense of justice, fervently believing it is the right and moral thing to do to exterminate the Ghouls. He hunts the Ghouls in order to prevent more human children from becoming orphaned like himself, and he often works after hours to achieve his goals. He wields a "Quinque" (a weapon made from the "Kagune" of a Ghoul) that has the appearance of a pole-arm with a large cylindrical bludgeon at the end.

100240.name: Nishiki Nishio
100240.desc: __Height:__ 177 cm (5'9") Nishiki Nishio is a ghoul whose original feeding ground was taken from Rize. He is a sophomore in the Pharmaceutical Department of Kamii University and Kimi Nishino's boyfriend.

100240.name: Ayato Kirishima
100240.desc: __Height:__ 159 cm (5'2") Ayato Kirishima is [Touka Kirishima](https://anilist.co/character/87277/Touka-Kirishima)'s younger brother. He grew up with his sister in the 20th ward but at some point of time, he disappeared. Currently, he is an executive of Aogiri Tree. An arrogant youth with a similar harsh attitude that resembles his sister. Other than physical looks, he shares many similarities with Touka such as his cold, hotblooded attitude and a habit for kicking people. However, he's more harsh compared to her and surprisingly nicer than his Aogiri superiors.

100240.name: Juuzou Suzuya
100240.desc: __Height:__ 160 cm (5'3") A Rank 3 Ghoul Investigator. In the past, he went by the name Rei Suzuya. He is the partner of [Yukinori Shinohara](https://anilist.co/character/88408). He is a young man with androgynous appearance. He has many stitches used as both first-aid and fashion. His hair is tied with a stitching string in a roman numeral 13 pattern, with large pupils that leaves an eerie and frightening impression.

100240.name: Uta
100240.desc: __Height:__ 177 cm A ghoul that has his own art studio where he makes masks for other ghouls. He has a lot of piercings and tattoos on his body, making him look pretty intimidating, even as a normal-looking human. He's the one who also made a mask for Kaneki.

100240.name: Tatara
100240.desc: A direct subordinate of the One-Eyed King and one of Aogiri Tree's leaders. He was a former member of the Chinese ghoul organization Chi She Lian. As one of the Aogiri Tree leaders and a trusted subordinate working under the One-Eyed King, Tatara comes off as a rather loyal individual. He is portrayed as composed and stoic mostly. He often monitors the activities of the Aogiri executives, but kills in cold-blood when embarking on a mission. He is also proud of his immense stamina when fighting and the accuracy of his calculations as well. Tatara seems to have a taste for precision; as shown when he turns down Kaneki considering he's an artificial one-eyed ghoul. He appears to hold a grudge against Houji, to the extent that even the Quinque associated with him, is enough to make him enraged and lose his near unflappable composure. As the second-in-command of Aogiri, it can be inferred that he is quite powerful.

100240.name: Nico
100240.desc: __Species:__ Ghoul __Height:__ 175 cm __Affiliations:__ Clown Mask Ghoul Gang A gay ghoul (okama) in love. He was once acting together with Yamori and participating in Aogiri Tree.

100240.name: Shuu Tsukiyama
100240.desc: __Height:__ 180 cm Shuu Tsukiyama was the infamous Gourmet ghoul of the 20th ward. He was a fourth-year student studying Social Welfare at the Department of Human Sciences at Seinan Gakuin University. He comes from the extremely wealthy and influential Tsukiyama family which his father, Mirumo Tsukiyama was the head of. Tsukiyama himself became the head of his family after the Tsukiyama Family Extermination Operation. He was also a member of the Ghoul Restaurant, known as MM until he betrayed them. He joined Kaneki's group with the hidden intention of eating Ken Kaneki, obsessed with his scent and taste but eventually came to genuinely care for Kaneki. Two years later, his severe depression and anorexia after Kaneki's apparent demise left him emaciated and required constant care from his family servants. After finding out Kaneki was alive and meeting him, he recovers, being able to walk and eat on his own as well as take measures to help Kaneki regain his memories.

100240.name: Akira Mado
100240.desc: __Species:__ Human __Height:__ 164 cm __Affiliations:__ CCG __Quinque:__ Amatsu (Koukaku/Bikaku) __Likes:__ making quinques, solving puzzles and cats Akira Mado is a Rank 2 Ghoul Investigator and Kureo's daughter. She is currently partnered with Koutarou Amon. She is an intelligent woman and seems to be always serious about work and her daily routine in general. Like her father, she has deep insight and intuition that helps her in investigation and determining what is going on around her while on the field. She shares her father's "quinque-mania," but it is not as extreme as his was. Akira remains professional in most situations, no matter who she is faced with, and she isn't one to admit her own feelings on a subject unless provoked to a certain degree. Seen through her interactions with others, it is most likely that she would prefer to make a quinque rather than to interact with someone else.

100240.name: Saiko Yonebayashi
100240.desc: **Height:** 143 cm Saiko Yonebayashi is a Rank 3 Ghoul Investigator, a Quinx, and a member of the Quinx Squad. She dislikes having to work, as she prefers having a peaceful, happy-go-lucky and carefree life by playing video games and eating junk food excessively. Saiko often oversleeps, which earns her the absence from most missions. While not trying to reduce it, she is apparently embarrassed about her weight, humorously covering it during her introduction. She is excessively lazy to the point of being a hikikomori, unable to remove herself from her room without the intervention and often force of others, even jeopardizing her occupation. Saiko is also depicted as greedy, and heavily involved in her video games to the point of escapism.

100240.name: Tooru Mutsuki
100240.desc: __Height:__ 165 cm (5'4") Tooru Mutsuki is a Rank 3 Ghoul Investigator, a Quinx and a member of the Quinx Squad. Tooru is kind with a gentle heart and seems to be shy with little self-confidence. Having a constant case of Anemia, ironically, Mutsuki feels repulsive when he comes into contact with blood. Because of this anxiety, he faces discouragement as a ghoul investigator, to the point where he feels as though he isn’t even needed for the job. He expresses frustration with his own weakness, feeling anger at his lack of ability compared to his comrades. When not working, he is shown to enjoy reading books and is the one often left to relate information to Haise Sasaki. As such, he is shown to be a reliable and hard-working individual, following orders in contrast to the more troublesome or lazy members of his team. Though lacking in confidence, he shows a strong desire to help others and does not hesitate to place himself at risk to protect the innocent. ~!A flashback reveals him to have been born female, but unable to reconcile his feelings of discomfort towards his birth sex. As such, he has began living as a man and uses highly-masculine personal pronouns.!~

100240.name: Ginshi Shirazu
100240.desc: __Height:__ 176 cm (5'9") Ginshi Shirazu is a Rank 3 Ghoul Investigator, a Quinx and the Current Squad Leader of the Quinx Squad. Shirazu, like most of his teammates, is shown to have great respect for his mentor, Haise Sasaki. However, this doesn’t stop him from going out of his way to execute missions without Sasaki’s permission, and so he is constantly seen accompanying Kuki Urie, the former squad leader, on dangerous assignments. Although he is a competent fighter with a ruthless nature, Urie describes Shirazu as a simple-minded person. He also seems to be quite exaggerated in his expressions and movements. His primary motive for joining the Quinx Squad is to get fast money for a purpose unknown at this point in time. Shirazu is also a quite carefree individual, and he seems to have an obsession for exterminating ghouls; both of which are traits that submit to the cocky grin he usually displays. He is stated to be poor at tasks that require thought, such as academics or investigation. However, his consideration for others and attention to his surroundings convince Sasaki he has potential as a Squad Leader. In contrast to his loud and violent mannerisms, he is also someone that cares greatly for his team. While prone to bickering with Urie, he shows a gentler side when interacting with Mutsuki or civilians such as Chie

100240.name: Kuki Urie
100240.desc: __Height:__ 173 cm __Species:__ Quinx __Affiliations:__ CCG's Quinx Squad - Former squad leader __RC type:__ Koukaku __Quinque:__ Tsunagi (Bikaku) He is a Rank 2 Ghoul Investigator,a Quinx and the former Squad Leader of the Quinx Squad. Urie often displays himself as a cool-headed individual, holding a monotonous facial expression the majority of the time. As a Ghoul Investigator, he appears to be very dedicated and stern about his work, to the point where it may seem as though he is ruthlessly slaughtering more ghouls than necessary, which is a habit he often gets berated for. Urie also tends to be quite hasty when investigating the slightest details or signs of a suspect. He has a tendency to execute mission objectives independently, without awaiting the arrival of his fellow team mates, or even requesting their help. This is because he is an ambitious person, and does not wish to share credit with others, as he merely wishes to achieve higher ranks as a Ghoul Investigator. To achieve his personal goals, he is willing to go as far as manipulating his comrades or causing discord within the team. But beneath his ambition and cool-headed demeanor is an insatiable jealousy towards his superiors, particularly Sasaki. Urie believes that ghouls, under any circumstance, must cease to exist. He is a person who is always striving for power and as a result, constantly looks for ways to one-up everyone around him which is shown by asking Professor Shiba to help augments his kagune's po

100240.name: Kishou Arima
100240.desc: __Height:__ 180 cm __Quinque:__ IXA (Koukaku), Narukami (Ukaku), Yukimura 1/3 (Koukaku) Kishou Arima is a famed Special Class Ghoul Investigator known as the CCG's Reaper. He is undefeated as a Ghoul Investigator and at some point was formerly partnered with Take Hirako. His investigative skills and prowess in combat has led many investigators such as [Koutarou Amon](https://anilist.co/character/88407/Koutarou-Amon) to admire him. __Tokyo Ghoul:Re__ ~!He later passes down his Yukimura 1/3 (Koukaku) quinque to [Sasaki Haise](https://anilist.co/character/87275/Ken-Kaneki), a rank 1 investigator and mentor of Quinx squad. Along with [Akira Mado](https://anilist.co/character/88838/Akira-Mado), he is the overseer of the Quinx squad and keeps a check on Sasaki Haise along with the Quinx members.!~

100240.name: Eto
100240.desc: __Height:__ 151 cm __RC Type:__ Ukaku __Rating:__ ~!S as Eto SSS as One Eyed Owl!~ Eto is an executive of Aogiri Tree from the 24th ward. Eto is often seen interacting with fellow Aogiri member [Tatara](https://anilist.co/character/88418/Tatara). ~!She is the daughter of [Yoshimura](https://anilist.co/character/136024/Yoshimura), and the half-Ghoul known as the One-Eyed Owl. Her human identity is Sen Takatsuki (高槻 泉), a best-selling horror novelist mentioned throughout the series. Her relation with the One-Eyed King is unclear. However the CCG and [Nico](https://anilist.co/character/88419/Nico) speculate that they are the same person.!~

100240.name: Naki
100240.desc: Naki is a ghoul who was imprisoned in Cochlea until Aogiri Tree's invasion on the prison. He was liberated by Aogiri Tree due to being a direct underling and supposedly the right hand man of Yamori. He was almost always accompanied by the Twins Gagi and Guge. He eventually climbs the ranks within Aogiri, and has become an Executive in his own right. The number of Ghouls following him has grown considerably, forming a gang known as the White Suits for their distinctive dressing style. Naki is left handed.

100240.name: Hairu Ihei
100240.desc: Hairu Ihei is a First Class Ghoul investigator and the partner of Koori Ui. She is the deputy leader of S1 Squad. She is a veteran of the Owl Suppression Operation and serves as a member of Squad 0, commanded by Kishou Arima. ~!She is killed during the Tsukiyama Extermination Operation.!~

100240.name: Chie Hori
100240.desc: Chie is a human photographer and information broker. She is a long-time friend of Shuu Tsukiyama, aware of his secret but uninterested in exposing him as a Ghoul. At his request, she serves as an informant to Kaneki's group. (Source: MAL) She seeks out the members of the Quinx Squad, and offers to sell them information pertaining to Torso. This is because she has an unusual interest in their leader, Sasaki.

100240.name: Kanae von Rosewald
100240.original: カナエ＝フォン・ロゼヴァルト
100240.desc: Kanae von Rosewald is a Ghoul and the last survivor of the Rosewald family. After Matsuri Washuu led an extermination operation to destroy the Rosewalds, Kanae was taken in as an employee of the Tsukiyama family. (Source: Tokyo Ghoul Wikia)

100240.name: Noro
100240.desc: He is one of the direct subordinates of the King of an Eye and one of the leaders of the Aogiri Tree, next to Tatara. In the past he was called Noroi and was responsible for raising Eto, when Kuzen surrendered in District 24. He is a giant who intimidates with an overwhelming silence, seems to communicate only through actions, not words.

100240.name: Seidou Takizawa
100240.desc: __Height:__ 171 cm Takizawa is a Rank 2 Ghoul Investigator. A classmate of [Akira Mado](https://anilist.co/character/88838/Akira-Mado) at the Academy, he is partnered with Kousuke Houji and assigned to the 20th ward to investigate the Gourmet. He greatly respects [Kishou Arima](https://anilist.co/character/88946/Kishou-Arima) and [Koutarou Amon](https://anilist.co/character/88407/Koutarou-Amon) and admires their achievements. ~!Though he was declared among the casualties of the raid in the 20th Ward, it is revealed that he had actually survived as artificial one-eyed ghoul. He is now a member of Aogiri Tree. As an artificial one-eyed ghoul, he is known as Owl. After betraying Aogiri and killing [Tatara](https://anilist.co/character/88418/Tatara), Takizawa reunited with Akira Mado, and became a member of Ken Kaneki's organization, Goat. !~

100240.name: Nimura Furuta
100240.desc: __Height:__ 175 cm ~!__RC Type:__ Rinkaku!~ ~!Kichimura Washuu is the primary antagonist of the Tokyo Ghoul series and the former Bureau Director of the CCG. He is involved in numerous organizations and is responsible for several major events of the series.!~ ~!He was originally the illegitimate son of former CCG Chairman Tsuneyoshi Washuu and an agent of V raised in the Sunlit Garden. To further his own agenda, he has used various identities to infiltrate organizations or build personal alliances. As a member of the Clowns, he was responsible for the Steel Beam Incident. He also joined the Ghoul Restaurant as __PG__, and has been a partner in Akihiro Kanou's ghoulification experiments. Like [Ken Kaneki](https://anilist.co/character/87275/Ken-Kaneki), he is an artificial one-eyed ghoul who possesses [Rize Kamishiro](https://anilist.co/character/88413/Rize-Kamishiro)'s kagune.!~

100240.name: Take Hirako
100240.desc: __Species:__ Human __Height:__ 172 cm __Affiliations:__ CCG __Quinque:__ Nagomi 1/3 (Rinkaku) Take Hirako is a First Class Ghoul Investigator. In the past, he formed a duo with Kishou Arima. Hirako is of average height and his facial features have been described as "plain" or "bland." He usually has a blank expression on his face. Like all members of CCG, he usually wears formal attire. Like his mentor Kishou Arima, Hirako has a very calm personality and has inherited the same cold and calculating approach to fighting ghouls.He is skilled to the point of being able to suppress a S-class Ukaku type ghoul.

100240.name: Taishi Fura
100240.desc: Taishi Fura is a First-Class Ghoul Investigator. He is the protagonist of the side story Tokyo Ghoul: Jack, alongside Kishou Arima.

100240.name: Itsuki Marude
100240.desc: Itsuki is a Special Class Ghoul Investigator. He is the commander of the 11th Ward Special Countermeasures Unit and Chief of Division II.

100240.name: Ui Koori
100240.desc: Koori is a Special Class Investigator and an Investigation Commander in Division I. He is the leader of S1 Squad, and a former protege of Kishou Arima and the partner of Hairu Ihei. He is in charge of the 4th ward.

100240.name: Renji Yomo
100240.desc: __Height:__ 182 cm (5'11") Renji Yomo is a worker at Anteiku and the right hand of [Yoshimura](https://anilist.co/character/136024/Yoshimura). He is an old friend of [Uta](https://anilist.co/character/88414/Uta) and [Itori](https://anilist.co/character/88415/Itori). Because of his scavenging habits and long-beaked, avian mask, he has the nickname of "Raven."

100240.name: Akihiro Kanou
100240.desc: Akihiro Kanou, often referred to as Professor Kanou, is a physician at Kanou General Hospital.

100240.name: Yoriko Kosaka
100240.desc: A university friend of Touka's. In :re she is revealed to be working in a bakery, often frequented by Rank1 Ghoul Inspector Takeomi Kuroiwa, son of the Special Class Ghoul Investigator Iwao Kuroiwa. ~!Takeomi proposes to Yoriko in chapter 104 of :re!~

100240.name: Donato  Porpora
100240.desc: Donato Porpora is a Russian ghoul and a prisoner in the 23rd ward's Ghoul Detention Center. He was once running a Catholic orphanage in Japan. His alias was Priest (神父). He was also Koutarou Amon's foster father. (Source: Tokyo Ghoul Wikia)

100240.name: Kuramoto Itou
100240.desc: __Height:__ 172 cm Kuramoto Itou is a First Class Ghoul Investigator and the deputy squad leader of the Hirako Squad.

100240.name: Mayu
100240.desc: __Height:__ 166 cm __Affiliations:__ Ghoul Restaurant Mayu, also known as Nutcracker, was a ghoul that preyed on men by crushing their testicles before drinking the fluids. She was tasked with capturing humans for an underground "Gourmet" society.

100240.name: Matsumae
100240.desc: Matsumae is a teacher at Seinan Gakuin High School and the homeroom teacher of Shuu Tsukiyama. She is also a Ghoul in the employment of the Tsukiyama family. She's responsible for keeping an eye on Tsukiyama while acting as his teacher. She's shown to keep a cool head, even when surrounded by ghoul investigators, and commanded her group of ghouls in combat. Like her master, Matsumae retains a professional behavior even when under what is normally considered pressuring, such as a CCG extermination. (Source: Tokyo Ghoul Wikia)

100240.name: Kouitsu Chigyou
100240.desc: Kouitsu Chigyou is the head ghoul researcher at CCG Laboratory Division. He used to be a researcher in the GFG in Germany.

100240.name: Maiko Abe
100240.desc: __Height:__ 160 cm Maiko is a member of the Ghoul Restaurant

100240.name: Iwao Kuroiwa
100240.desc: Iwao Kuroiwa is a Special Class Ghoul Investigator. Currently, he serves as the vice commander of the 11th Ward Special Countermeasures Unit. Yukinori Shinohara calls him by the nickname Iwaccho.

100240.name: Roma Hoito
100240.desc: Roma Hoito is a ghoul and used to be a waitress at Anteiku.

100240.name: Nobu Shimoguchi
100240.desc: Nobu was a First Class Ghoul Investigator and led his own Squad. Until recently, he worked on the Torso case, along with the Quinx Squad.

100240.name: Goumasa Tokage
100240.desc: Goumasa Tokage is a combat instructor at the 2nd Academy.

100240.name: Yoshitoki Washuu
100240.desc: Yoshitoki Washuu is the current Bureau Director of CCG's Main Office and Tsuneyoshi Washuu's son.

100240.name: Tsuneyoshi Washuu
100240.desc: Tsuneyoshi Washuu is the current chairman of CCG and Yoshitoki Washuu's father.

100240.name: Miza Kusakari
100240.desc: She's a ghoul and a former executive of Aogiri Tree. She is known by the alias Three Blades (三枚刃, Sanmaiba) in reference to the shape of her kagune. She was the leader of the 18th ward and the Blades gang.

100240.name: Keijin Nakarai
100240.desc: __Height__: 167 cm __Affiliations__: CCG Keijin is a First Class Ghoul Investigator. He is the Vice-Squad Leader of CCG's Suzuya Squad that's assigned to the 13th Ward.

100240.name: Shiki Kijima
100240.desc: Special Class ghoul investigator.

100240.name: Ching-Li Hsiao
100240.desc: Ching-Li Hsiao is a Taiwanese Rank 1 Ghoul Investigator and one of the second batch of recruits to the Quinx Squad.

100240.name: Mirumo Tsukiyama
100240.desc: Mirumo Tsukiyama (月山観母) is an extremely wealthy and eccentric ghoul, well-known within ghoul society for being extravagant. He is the father of Shuu Tsukiyama, and took part in the auction as a major bidder under the alias Croque Monsieur.

119661.name: Emilia
119661.desc: **Height:** 164 cm (5'5") She is a silver-haired half-elf girl who is one of the candidates to become the next ruler in the royal election. [Subaru](https://anilist.co/character/88573/Natsuki-Subaru) first meets her when her insignia is stolen by [Felt](https://anilist.co/character/88574/Felt) as she needs to possess it to be eligible to participate in the election. She introduces herself as Satella when she and Subaru met during the first timeline before introducing herself by her real name when she got her insignia back. Emilia is good natured and likes to take care of others, though she herself refuses to admit it, instead thinking of it as her own selfishness. She is indifferent to her own appearance, leaving [Puck](https://anilist.co/character/90187/Puck) to take care of her clothes and hair. Because her appearance is similar to the [Witch of Envy](https://anilist.co/character/127242/Satella), she has received unfair discrimination from others. She sometimes acts like a child and is unacquainted with the world as she used to live in the woods with other Elves, though despite this she still works hard to become a ruler.

119661.name: Subaru Natsuki
119661.desc: __Height:__ 173 cm (5'8") On the way home from the convenience store, he suddenly finds himself transported into another world. He has the ability that he calls "Return by Death" to go back in time when he dies. Despite being a hikikomori and gamer in his real world, Subaru does a bit of workout and seems to know basic hand-to-hand combat, making him not completely weak. While Subaru tends to not read the situation, he is loyal to those he holds dear, willing to help them, even if that means taking the thorny path. He has his resolve confirmed through the many situations and circumstances he faces in the fantasy world, originally having been one to always take the "easy" route. As a hikikomori, he is hopeful of the possibilities that being sucked into a new realm brings, but later realizes the realities of the predicament he is in. Ultimately, he resolves himself to be faithful and protective of the ones that he cares most about.

119661.name: Rem
119661.desc: __Height:__ 154 cm (5'1") Rem is one of the twin maids working for [Roswaal L Mathers](https://anilist.co/character/90182/Mathers-L-Roswaal). She has medium length sky blue hair that covers her right eye, large light blue eyes, and young features. She also has hair clips towards left side of her hair, flower-shaped ribbon on the same side of her hair, and a maid hairband. She looks nearly identical to her sister [Ram](https://anilist.co/character/88576) apart from her hair, eyes, and ribbon coloring. She usually wears a maid uniform, and since her chest is slightly larger than her sister's, she secretly changes the measurements to hide it. Rem tends to speak in a superficially polite manner and sometimes acts without thinking. She holds both respect to the point of worship and guilt toward her sister for an incident in the past. Because of her respect and guilt toward her sister, she used to think of herself as inferior.

119661.name: Ram
119661.desc: __Height:__ 154 cm (5’1”) Ram is one of the twin maids working for [Roswaal L Mathers](https://anilist.co/character/90182). She has medium length light pink hair that covers her left eye, large darkish pink eyes, and young features. She also has hair clips towards right side of her hair, flower-shaped ribbon on the same side of her hair, and a maid hairband. She looks nearly identical to her sister [Rem](https://anilist.co/character/88575/Rem) apart from her hair, eyes, and ribbon coloring. Ram is seemingly self-centered and does things at her own pace, however in actuality she maintains a distance from people to ascertain them. She believes that Roswaal is the greatest and no one else is as precious except for her sister Rem. She is slightly more outgoing in comparison to the generally taciturn Rem, who generally allows Ram to take the lead in their sisterly bond.

119661.name: Petelgeuse Romanee-Conti
119661.original: ペテルギウス・ロマネコンティ
119661.desc: Sin Archbishop of the Witch Cult, representing sloth. ~!He was later killed by [Natsuki Subaru](https://anilist.co/character/88573/Natsuki-Subaru) with the help of [Julius Juukulius](https://anilist.co/character/90183/Euclius-Julius).!~ ~!A hundred years earlier, Petelgeuse was a moderate, upright and rational man. He was close friends with [Fortuna](https://anilist.co/character/183732/Fortuna) and [Emilia](https://anilist.co/character/88572/Emilia), enough to be described as being like a family. However, when [Regulus](https://anilist.co/character/174098/Corneas-Regulus) and [Pandora](https://anilist.co/character/137522/Pandora) attacked their village, he accidentally killed Fortuna through Pandora's power, causing him to go mad.!~

119661.name: Aldebaran
119661.desc: **Height:** 173 cm (5'8") Aldebaran, commonly known as Al, is [Priscilla Barielle](https://anilist.co/character/90186/Priscilla-Barielle)'s knight, though he claims to just be a subordinate. He has a frivolous personality and acts aloof, but shows insecurity regarding his disfigured face and wears a helmet to conceal it. Due to that, he is a man of both eccentric appearance and behavior. ~!Like Subaru, he is revealed to be from Japan and was summoned roughly 18 years before Subaru. Shortly after he was summoned, he lost his left arm in an unfortunate incident in the Empire of Vollachia. !~

119661.name: Elsa Granhiert
119661.original: エルザ・グランヒルテ
119661.desc: An assassin-for-hire from the Northernmost nation, the Holy Kingdom of Gusteko, known as "The Bowel Hunter". Elsa wishes to make a trade for an insignia, as her client's wishes. ~!Elsa Granhiert was an assassin working together with [Meili](https://anilist.co/character/175577) for an individual they refer to as "Mother" until her death.!~

119661.name: Beatrice
119661.desc: __Height:__ 140 cm (4'7") __Age:__ ~!400+ (Actual)!~ The caretaker of the library in [Roswaal](https://anilist.co/character/90182)'s mansion. She has a distinct way of speaking, adding "I suppose" (かしら, kashira) and "in fact" (のよ, no yo) at the end of some of her sentences. ~!Around 400 years ago, Beatrice was created by [Echidna](https://anilist.co/character/129330). She helped her with her experiments, such as the Sanctuary Barrier, though she wasn't told everything as she didn't know that [Ryuuzu Meyer](https://anilist.co/character/174072) would be sealed in a crystal. Sometime later, Echidna ordered her to stand guard over the library while she waited for "that person," an order which she diligently followed.!~ ~!After numerous and painful attempts to convince her to leave the library [Subaru](https://anilist.co/character/88573) succeeded, and Beatrice became his contract spirit.!~

119661.name: Roswaal Mathers
119661.original: ロズワール・Ｌ・メイザース
119661.desc: ~!__Mental age:__ 400+!~ The lord of the Roswaal Mansion and a descendant of the original Roswaal. He comes across as an eccentric due to his flamboyant appearance and odd speaking style, the latter which he shares with his grandmother. However, he harbors a more calculating and reserved side with a sharp political mind and gaze that reads others quite well. ~!It is later revealed that he is in fact the original Roswaal, Roswaal A. Mathers, who has been possessing his descendants' bodies to meet his teacher Echidna again at any cost, even if that means sacrificing himself or those close to him.!~

119661.name: Puck
119661.desc: __Height:__ 7 cm Puck is an Artificial Spirit that [Emilia](https://anilist.co/character/88572/Emilia) was formerly contracted with. He is the current Great Spirit of Fire. ~!He is currently known as the Beast of The End.!~ ~!Around 400 years ago, Puck was created by Echidna, though he had apparently left her by the time she moved into the Sanctuary. Seven years before the start of the election, Puck unfroze Emilia and began to act as her friend and mentor, and later on started to live at Roswaal's mansion where he was reunited with Beatrice.!~ Puck can be described as cute or adorable, thus his skin being pink around his cheeks. His fur is mostly grey with silver in certain spots (i.e. tip of the tail). His eyebrows are pretty small and rhombus-shaped. He also has a gold earring on his left ear. Sometimes, he carries a purple bag. Puck is generally a nice spirit. He is very happy and stays at Emilia's side to protect her, affectionately calling her "Lia". He occasionally goofs around and gets along especially well with [Beatrice](https://anilist.co/character/90181/Beatrice). ~!However, Puck's demeanor greatly changes in loops where Emilia dies, showing a complete disregard for anyone except her, and was even willing to destroy the world because of the condition in their contract.!~

119661.name: Otto Suwen
119661.original: オットー・スーウェン
119661.desc: Otto Suwen is a merchant appearing in Re:Zero. His remarkable misfortune always takes him to dangerous situations, from which he escapes thanks to his wit. Otto has gray hair that is mentioned to be as long as a gal game protagonist. He is said to be somewhat handsome if he has a serious expression. However, he is usually either retorting, shouting, or panicking, ruining his looks. He has a medium build, but has trained himself since he used to work as a merchant.

119661.name: Satella
119661.desc: Satella is one of the Witches of Sin, being the Witch of Envy. ~! Contrary to popular belief, Satella and the Witch of Envy are separate personalities. Both of them love Subaru, though the Witch of Envy is aggressive about it.!~

119661.name: Echidna
119661.desc: Echidna is one of the Witches of Sin, being the Witch of Greed. She has a strong thirst for knowledge along with a curiosity for the unknown, which defines her behavior. Echidna is described as black hearted, being unable to empathize with others and their feelings due to a lack of understanding. She will do anything to gain knowledge, be it deceit or employed sophistry.

119661.name: Garfiel Tinsel
119661.original: ガーフィール・ティンゼル
119661.desc: Garfiel Tinsel is the former guardian of the Sanctuary and a member of the Emilia Camp. Introduced during Arc 4, he became one of the main supporting characters of the season. He's a half-beast human and [Frederica Baumann's](https://anilist.co/character/143378/Baumann-Frederica) half-brother. He can transform himself in a giant golden tiger that can deal powerful attacks but with a cost of losing his reason, so he uses this ability when he's pushed to the limit. ~!Garfiel and Frederica lived together until she left when he was around 4 years old and he hadn't seen her since until their reunion 10 years later during the Sanctuary incident. After seeing his mother's "death" during the trial at a young age, he began to fear the outside world, causing him to try and protect the Sanctuary.!~

119661.name: Minerva
119661.desc: Minerva is one of the Witches of Sin, being the Witch of Wrath. Minerva dislikes conflict and wishes for all to be well. She also only cares about what's directly in front of her, not worrying about things she cannot see. Minerva has some history with the elves as she cares deeply for Emilia, along with the other elves. ~!Minerva's main ability is "Authority of Wrath". Unlike other authorities this ability is only a support skill. Minerva is able to heal others by attacking any part of their body with her own. The authority also gives her increased speed and strength. The drawback is that every time the authority is used it causes a calamity to happen in another part of the world. The calamity can range from many things such as an earthquake.!~

119661.name: Pandora
119661.desc: Pandora is one of the Witches of Sin, being the Witch of Vanity. She acts dignified and graceful, but is quick to being a maniac when things don't go her way. Pandora also has some ties with the Witch Cult. ~! Pandora's main ability is "Authority of Vainglory". With this authority, Pandora is able to rewrite phenomenon to her liking as much she desires. Examples include being able to negate death, bury people into the ground instantaneously, teleporting individuals and warp and change individuals memories. The only draw back is her authority not being able to function on the demon beasts for full control, but she can still direct them to go to areas of her choosing. !~

119661.name: Hector
119661.desc: Hector is one of the Witches of Sin, being the Warlock of Melancholy. He has a negative personality, usually expressing his negativity in words. Hector has some form of relation with Echidna. He also wears a outfit similar to that of Roswaal's ~! Hector's main ability is "Authority of Melancholy". With this authority, Hector is able to create a force that is able to crush living beings and magic. While on paper this ability seems simple, it was enough to easily overpower the original Roswaal and cause severe injuries to him. Roswaal who is extremely powerful and one of the strongest mages of all time. !~

119661.name: Petra Leyte
119661.desc: Petra is a bright and kind girl from Irlam Village. She likes [Subaru](https://anilist.co/character/88573/Natsuki-Subaru) very much after he saved her from the Wolgarm incident. ~!She became a maid at the Roswaal Mansion after Subaru came back from the witchcult incident. !~

119661.name: Frederica Baumann
119661.original: フレデリカ・バウマン
119661.desc: Frederica Baumann is a maid working for [Roswaal L. Mathers](https://anilist.co/character/90182/Mathers-Roswaal) and a member of the Emilia Camp. She quit her job as a maid a few months before [Subaru's](https://anilist.co/character/88573/Natsuki-Subaru) appearance, but returned after [Ram](https://anilist.co/character/88576/Ram) couldn't manage the mansion ~!after [Rem](https://anilist.co/character/88575/Rem) had her name and memories eaten. !~ ~!She is the half-sister of [Garfiel Tinsel](https://anilist.co/character/133847/Tinsel-Garfiel).!~

119661.name: Ryuuzu Meyer
119661.desc: Ryuuzu was a half-elf who lived in the Sanctuary during the era of the witches, 400 years ago. She was used by [Echidna](https://anilist.co/character/129330/Echidna) in order to activate the Sanctuary's barrier. During Echidna's immortality experiments, she created copies of Ryuzu and tasked them with protecting the Sanctuary.

119661.name: Regulus Corneas
119661.original: レグルス・コルニアス
119661.desc: Regulus is a young man of a medium height. He has gold eyes, white hair and a middle to skinny build. Regulus Is a part of the Sin Archbishops of the Witch Cult and represents greed. Regulus is known for being very talkative and calls himself unselfish, while in fact he is very prideful and likes to act above others and reference himself as above others.

119661.name: Meili Portroute
119661.original: メィリィ・ポートルート
119661.desc: One of the children that lives in the village within [Roswaal](https://anilist.co/character/90182)'s region. She's timid, though is friendly, such as when she introduces a small dog to [Subaru](https://anilist.co/character/88573). ~!Meili Portroute is a Demon Beast User.!~

119661.name: Patrasche
119661.desc: [Subaru](https://anilist.co/character/88573/Natsuki-Subaru)'s Earth Dragon that he officially received from [Crusch Karsten](https://anilist.co/character/90185/Karsten-Crusch) for his efforts in the Hakugei battle. Despite being of a species known for being feisty, Patrasche is extremely loyal to Subaru, as she is willing to put her life on the line for him.

119661.name: Ricardo Welkin
119661.original: リカード・ウェルキン
119661.desc: Ricardo Welkin is one of Anastasia Hoshin's followers and the captain of the mercenary group: Fang of Iron.

119661.name: Naoko Natsuki
119661.desc: [Subaru](https://anilist.co/character/88573/Natsuki-Subaru)'s mother.

119661.name: Fortuna
119661.desc: Fortuna was the guardian of Elior Forest and was Emilia's aunt on her father's side who took care of her instead of her mother. ~!During her time in Eliot Forest, she developed a close bond with Geuse and they both looked after Emilia. After Pandora and Regulus attacked, she fought alongside Geuse to stop them. However, Pandora tricked Geuse into thinking Fortuna was her and Geuse accidentally killed Fortuna, causing him to go insane.!~

119661.name: Archi
119661.desc: Archi was a disciple slated to be the next guardian of Elior Forest and a villager of the Elf Village. He was also family friend to Fortuna and Emilia. ~!After Pandora and Regulus attacked, Arch went to bring Emilia to safety however while doing so he was attacked by the Black Serpent, causing him to sacrifice himself so Emilia could escape!~

119661.name: Reshia Tinzel
119661.original: リーシア・ティンゼル
119661.desc: Mother of [Garfiel](https://anilist.co/character/133847) and [Frederica](https://anilist.co/character/143378).

119661.name: Framir Suewen
119661.original: フラミル・スーウェン
119661.desc: Framir Suewen is the mother of Otto, Oslo and Regin Suewen.

119661.name: Mazeran Suewen
119661.original: マゼラン・スーウェン
119661.desc: Mazeran Suewen is the current head of the Suewen Trading Company based in Picoutatte and is the father of Otto, Oslo and Regin Suewen.

119661.name: Oslo Suewen
119661.original: オスロー・スーウェン
119661.desc: Oslo Suewen is the representative of the Suewen Trading Company and Otto's older brother.

119661.name: Regin Suewen
119661.desc: Regin Suewen is a veterinarian operating at the Suwen Treatment Center in the town of Pappelt.

119661.name: Annerose Miload
119661.original: アンネローゼ・ミロード
119661.desc: Annerose Miload is the heir of the House Miload which is a branch of House Mathers.

119661.name: Clind
119661.desc: Clind is a house steward serving the Miload Family. He is well-mannered, highly considerate of others, is extremely skilled as a servant, and tends to add idioms to the end of his sentences. ~!Being born before the Great Calamity, Clind was acquainted with the Witches and Warlocks of that era. At some point in time, he made a contract with a young Roswaal A Mathers which entailed Clind to protect Roswaal's property by any and all means. According to Roswaal, he had compensated the contract with Clind by forming a united front and defeating Roswaal's yet-unnamed nemesis. Clind has faithfully abided to his contract ever since, due to his ability to perceive souls and sensing Roswaal A Mathers' soul in the bodies of his descendants. At some point in the future, Clind came in contact with an unspecified Witch Factor, which granted him an Authority he possesses to this day. Following the end of the Demi-Human War, Clind accompanied Roswaal J Mathers (Julia Mathers) to a pub where she met with the Sword Demon, Wilhelm van Astrea, where they discussed the threat of Stride Vollachia. During their talk, however, the trio were assaulted by a group of Shinobi, who were swiftly dispatched by Roswaal, Wilhelm, and Clind. Wilhelm noted that Clind's technique was neither sword skill nor magic, but something completely different. Sometime in the following decades, Clind was entrusted with protecting and training Frederica Baumann. During that period, he was also transferred to Miload Manor,

176496.name: Narrator
176496.desc: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

176496.name: Jin-U Seong
176496.desc: __Class:__ Mage __Relatives:__ [Park Kyung-Hye](https://anilist.co/character/209396/KyungHye-Park) (Mother), [Seong Jin-Ah](https://anilist.co/character/138791/JinAh-Sung) (Sister), ~![Seong Il-Hwan](https://anilist.co/character/138790/IlHwan-Sung) (Father), [Cha Hae-In](https://anilist.co/character/138789/HaeIn-Cha) (Wife), [Seong Su-Ho](https://anilist.co/character/306654/Suho-Sung) (Son)!~ ~!__Guild:__ Ahjin Guild (Guild Master) __Affiliation:__ Korean Hunters Association (helper), White Tiger Guild (helper), Hunters Guild (helper), Knights Guild (helper), Ahjin Guild (Guild Master)!~ Seong Jin-U is known as an infamously weak E-Rank Hunter. He is a humble and benevolent individual who cares deeply for his family and has an ardent desire to become stronger. As a result, he shares a close relationship with his sister and his mother, and rarely wastes an opportunity to refine his skills and gain more power. ~!He becomes an S-Rank hunter after being given a chance to become stronger by the System.!~

176496.name: Chi-Yul Song
176496.desc: __Magic Type:__ Fire Korean C-Rank Hunter and kumdo teacher. He is also one of Jinwoo's old friends, having known him since he was a E-Rank Hunter.

176496.name: Ju-Hui Lee
176496.desc: She is a healer with rank B.

176496.name: Dong-Su Hwang
176496.desc: Hwang Dong-su is an​ S-class hunter who works for Scavenger's Guild in America.

176496.name: Jin-Ho Yu
176496.desc: __Class:__ Tanker __Guild:__ ~!Ahjin Guild (Vice-Guild Master)!~ Yoo Jin-Ho is a D rank hunter and is [Jin-U Seong](https://anilist.co/character/129928/JinWoo-Sung)'s faithful assistant and combat partner.

176496.name: Yun-Ho Baek
176496.desc: He is a S rank hunter and master of the White Tiger guild.

176496.name: Jin-Cheol U
176496.desc: An A rank hunter that works for Hunter's association of Korea.

176496.name: Hae-In Cha
176496.desc: __Guild:__ Hunters Guild __Class:__ Sword Fighter __Affiliations:__ Jeju Island Raid Party, [Song Chi-Yul](https://anilist.co/character/136073/ChiYul--Song)’s Dojo (Disciple) Cha Hae-In is the Vice-Guild Master of the Hunters Guild. She is an S rank hunter and the 9th ranked hunter in South Korea. She possesses the unique ability of mana smell and hates the smell of hunters except for [Sung Jin-Woo](https://anilist.co/character/129928/JinWoo-Sung).

176496.name: Il-Hwan Seong
176496.desc: Il-Hwan is a muscular middle-aged man with black eyes, shaggy black hair, and slight facial hair. When using his powers or agitated, his eyes glows bright yellow.

176496.name: Jin-A Seong
176496.desc: [Jin-U](https://anilist.co/character/129928)'s younger sister.

176496.name: Geon-Hui Go
176496.desc: Go Gun-Hee (고건희) is a South Korean S-Rank Hunter and the Chairman of the Korean Hunters Association.

176496.name: Song-I Han
176496.desc: Han Song-I is an E-Rank hunter who quit school after gaining money through the Yoo Jin-Ho and Sung Jin-Woo motley group of party. She is friends with Sung Jin-Ah. She first appeared when Jin-Ah visited Jin-Woo in the hospital but she didn't know him then.

176496.name: Jong-In Choi
176496.desc: Choi Jong-In is one of the 10 S-Rank Hunters of South Korea. He is also the Guild Master of the Hunters Guild.

176496.name: Igris
176496.desc: Igris is one of the first Shadows that [Sung Jin-Woo](https://anilist.co/character/129928/Seong-Jin-U) acquired. He was initially protecting an empty throne in an Instant Dungeon where Jin-Woo was doing his Job Quest in the Job Change Quest Dungeon. After two failed attempts of Shadow Extraction, Sung Jin-Woo convinced him to protect him instead of protecting an Empty throne, obtaining him as a Knight Grade Shadow.

176496.name: Byeong-Gu Min
176496.desc: Min Byung-Gu was a retired hunter and one of the 10 S-Rank and only S-Rank Healer of South Korea. He was a close friend with the White Tiger's Guild Master Baek Yoon-Ho. He took part in the 4th Jeju Island Reclamation Raid and was a member of the Korean Raid Team tasked with killing the boss of the Jeju Island Gate.

176496.name: Beru
176496.desc: Born from the Ant Queen on Jeju Island, The Ant King becomes the main threat during the Fourth Jeju Island Raid. ~!Single-handedly responsible for the deaths of over 8 of the 16 S-Rank Hunters during the raid.!~ ~!After being killed by Sung Jinwoo, the Ant King was revived as one of his shadow soldiers, and was given him the new name of Beru.!~

176496.name: Esil Radiru
176496.desc: Esil Radiru, or Elisa Radiru, is a daughter of the Radiru chief and an Aristocratic Demon found at the S-Rank Demon's Castle Instant Dungeon.

176496.name: Atsushi Kumamoto
176496.desc: Atsushi Kumamoto is one of Japan's strongest S-Rank Hunters. He is a member of Japan's most powerful guild, the Draw Sword Guild led by Goto Ryuji.

176496.name: Goto Ryuji
176496.desc: Goto Ryuji is Japan's strongest S-Ranked Hunter and the Guild Master of Draw Sword Guild, one of the most powerful guilds in Asia.

176496.name: Myung-Han Yu
176496.desc: Yu Myung-Han (유명한) is Jin-Ho's father and the CEO of Yoojin Construction.

176496.name: Min-Sung Lee
176496.desc: Famous Korean actor, known as Asia's biggest movie star. He is also an A-Rank Hunter.

176496.name: Hee-Jin Park
176496.desc: Park Hee-Jin (박희진) is a member of White Tiger Guild that Sung Jin-Woo helped when they got stuck inside the Red Gate.

176496.name: Thomas Andre
176496.desc: Thomas Andre (트마스 아드레) is one of only 5 National Level Hunters that exist and is considered to be the strongest Tank on Earth. He is also the Guild Master of the Scavenger Guild.

176496.name: Ki-Hoon Son
176496.desc: Son Ki-Hoon (손기훈) is the Team Leader of Attack Force B of the Hunters Guild.

176496.name: Minoru Hoshino
176496.desc: Minoru Hoshino (호시노 미노루) is one of Japan's strongest S-Rank Hunters. He is a member of Japan's strongest guild, the Draw Sword Guild led by Goto Ryuji.

176496.name: Tank
176496.desc: Shadow of an ice bear that Jinwoo encountered during the Red Gate Incident.

176496.name: Kaisel
176496.desc: Kaisel is a shadow Sung Jin-Woo obtained in the Demon Castle. Kaisel is the shadow of Kaisellin, a Drake/Wyvern that Demon King Baran used as a mount. Kaisel used to be a mount that the Demon King Baran rode in battle. After Sung Jin-Woo's fight, he looks around and found that Iron already killed Kaisellin, dragging his corpse towards Sung Jin-Woo. After he was extracted, his grade was Knight, which concludes he was at least an A-Rank.

176496.name: Kei
176496.desc: Kei (케이) was one of Japan's strongest S-Rank Hunters who was a member of the Draw Sword Guild, the strongest guild in japan led by Goto Ryuji. He was a powerful mage class hunter specializing in ice magic.

176496.name: Reiji Sugimoto
176496.desc: Reiji Sugimoto is the Vice-Master of Draw Sword Guild, the second most powerful guild in Asia. During the 4th Jeju Island Reclamation Raid, Reiji Sugimoto did not directly participate in the raid like his guild master Goto Ryuji. However, he was onboard the second DDH-184, one of the numerous Japanese boats surrounding the island.

176496.name: Mari Ishida
176496.desc: Mari Ishida was one of Japans strongest S-Rank Hunters. ~!She was effortlessly killed during the 4th Jeju Island Reclamation Raid.!~

176496.name: Ippei Izawa
176496.desc: One of Japan's strongest S-Rank Hunters. He took part in the 4th Jeju Island Reclamation Raid.

176496.name: Zhigang Liu
176496.desc: Zhigang Liu is one of the top five National Level Hunters in the world. Zhigang, who originated from China, was hired by the United States Government to aid with the first S-Rank Gate that appeared in the US.

176496.name: Dong-Wook Ma
176496.desc: Ma Dong-Wook (마동욱) is one of the 10 S-Rank hunters of South Korea and the guild master of Fame Guild.

176496.name: Baruka
176496.desc: S-Rank Ice Elf and the boss of the Red Gate Dungeon.

176496.name: Iron
176496.desc: A shadow Sung Jin-Woo gained after entering the Red Gate. ~!Before being reawakened as a Shadow he was Chul Kim (김철), an A-Rank Hunter of the White Tiger Guild.!~

176496.name: Tusk
176496.desc: A shadow Sung Jin-Woo gained after entering the Hunters Guild Gate. ~!Tusk is a shadow of Kargalgan, originally a High Orc Shaman defeated by Jinwoo Sung during the Hunters Guild Gate Arc. After being resurrected, Tusk becomes one of Jinwoo's most potent magic users, known for his devastating area-of-effect spells and high intelligence. Even as a Shadow, Tusk kept his powerful abilities and spells, making him just as capable and even stronger than when he was alive.!~

176496.name: Kyung-Hye Park
176496.desc: Park Kyung-He is the mother of Jin-U and Jin-Ah. She was in the hospital because of the Eternal Sleep. Her sickness served as the primary motivation for Jin-U becoming a hunter alongside his desire to support his sister with the absence of their father.

176496.name: Hanekawa
176496.desc: Hanekawa is a member and official translator of Japan's most powerful Guild, Draw Sword. Despite serving primarily as a translator of Japan's best hunter, Goto Ryuji, she is also an A-Rank Hunter.

176496.name: Akari Shimizu
176496.desc: Japanese S-Rank healer and a member of the Draw Sword Guild.

176496.name: Gina
176496.desc: Gina is an A-Rank mage and was one of the Raid Members in Son Ki-Hoon's Party in an A-Ranked Gate. She has long blonde hair and deep red eyes. Her height is average and she has a very attractive body. Gina has a serious personality this can be seen when she answers Son Ki-Hoon's question about if she was responsible for killing one of the High Orcs.

176496.name: Michael Connor
176496.desc: Michael Connor is the Deputy Director of the Federal Bureau of Hunters.

176496.name: Kenzo Tanaka
176496.desc: Kenzo Tanaka is a Japanese S-Rank Hunter who specialized in melee combat and a member of the Draw Sword Guild.

176496.name: Tatsumi Fujishima
176496.desc: Tatsumi Fujishima is a Japanese S-Rank Hunter and a member of the Draw Sword Guild.

176496.name: Tae-Gyu Lim
176496.desc: Tae-Gyu Lim is a Korean S-Rank hunter who specializes in archery magic and the Guild Master of the Fiend Guild.

176496.name: Yun-Tae Jeong
176496.desc: Yoontae Jung is a Korean A-Rank Hunter under the Knights Guild.

176496.name: Jong-Su Park
176496.desc: Jongsoo Park is a Korean A-Rank Hunter and the Guild Master of the Knights Guild.

176496.name: Kanae Tawata
176496.desc: Kanae Tawata is a Japanese S-Rank Hunter under the Draw Sword Guild.

176496.name: Baran
