918.desc: __Height:__ 170 cm Twin sister (older) of Mone 百音, ex-priestess is now the colleague and arch-rival of Shimura Tae 志村 妙 at Snack Smile. Has the tendency to act cute in front of customers and uses her temple priestess uniform to that effect. She was called アバズレ abazure aka bitch by her own younger twin sister Mone 百音 and Sakata Gintoki 坂田 銀時. ( Source: Gintama Wikia)

918.name: Kada
918.desc: __Race: Amanto__ __Height:__ 167 cm Peacock Princess Kada was one of the four emperors that ruled the Kabuki District. A skilled professional gambler herself, she operated most of the gambling outfits in Kabuki District. She would later be revealed to be a member of the Harusame Space Pirates, and was imprisoned on one of their ships as penalty for stealing money from them. She was shown to be quite sadistic when she ruthlessly beat Hasegawa after he spoke out of line. After her defeat, she was shown to be in a jail cell maddened and compulsively playing a gambling game in which she would predict her visitor's luck.

918.name: Yocchan
918.desc: Self-proclaimed King of Kabuki District's; is a bully and a Rhinoceros beetle aficionado. His opposite number, Queen of Kabuki District's; is Kagura. (Source: Gintama Wikia)

918.name: Urara
918.desc: Birthday: 4 March Zodiac sign: Pisces Height: 167 cm Weight: 52 kg Outgoing popular younger sister of Kirara きらら, with a previously unknown masochistic streak. (Source: Gintama Wikia)

918.name: Kirara
918.desc: __Height:__ 166 cm Bespectacled, sickly older sister of Urara. Due to her weak constitution which required that she stay indoors most of the time, she doesn't have many friends, unlike her outgoing younger sister.

918.name: Hinowa
918.desc: __Height:__ 164 cm Yoshiwara Paradise's No.1 courtesan. Mother of Seita. Unable to walk, paralyzed by Housen in order to stop her repeated escape attempts.

918.name: Seita
918.desc: __Height:__ 133 cm Seita is the adopted son of Hinowa and the biological son of a courtesan of Yoshiwara, who died after giving birth. As a baby, he was led to the outside world in the care of an old man by Hinowa. As described by Otose, he is clever, honest and learns quickly. He's able to adapt to new situations as evidenced by his ability to make a living through pickpocketing alone but also earn legitly by honest work. He has a kind and strong heart as even after learning Hinowa isn't his biological mother, he stands firm and claims it enough that she risked her own safety to protect him to be considered his mother. He appears during the Yoshiwara is Burning arc (Episodes 139-146) and Red Spider arc (Episodes 177-181).

918.name: Hakkekkyuu Ou
918.desc: The Leukocyte King (白血球王, hakkekkyuu ou) is a part of the antivirus system Tama uses to defend her system. According to Tama, king is based on the strongest person she knows, which is Gintoki. He looks exactly like Gintoki. The only difference between the two is that Leukocyte King wears a costume based on Loto. Although he looks exactly like Gin, his personality is completely different. He is rather noble and more hero-like than Gintoki. However, he exhibits human-like weaknesses as well as he can fall prey to temptations, like succumbing to the lure of treasure chests.

918.name: Tokumori Saigou
918.desc: Father of Saigou Teruhiko 西郷 てる彦 and owner of okama club by the name of 「かまっ娘倶楽部」kamakko club, Saigou Tokumori himself dresses as a woman. A past Joui fighter more senior than Katsura Kotarou's generation, he was well-known at that time as the powerful 白フンの西郷 aka White Loincloth Saigou. Now as one of the 4 Devas of the Kabuki District, he is known as 鬼神マドマーゼル西郷 Fearsome God Mademoiselle Saigou.

918.name: Teruhiko Saigou
918.desc: Son of Saigou Tokumori.

918.name: Azumi Agonoske
918.desc: Transvestite who works in the host club 「かまっ娘倶楽部」kamakko (this club is owned by Tokumori Saigou).

918.name: Wakame
918.desc: A crossdresser hostess

918.name: Tamo
918.desc: Tamo-san is Gintama's version of the real-life Japanese comedian Tamori-san.

918.name: Mamushi
918.desc: Also known as マムシの蛮蔵 mamushi no banzou, aka Banzou the Viper. The originator of the Justaway explosive. He used to work in a government officeverification/corroboration needed but got laid off due to company restructuring, and he became a terrorist in his bitterness. He started a factory, taking in displaced and bitter samurai who also wanted revenge. The factory acts as a front for the manufacture of Justaway, which is actually a bomb. Yamazaki Sagaru was sent here as a spy to uncover more about the mysterious Justaway in Episode 32. It turned out that the factory also manufactured heavy artillery like the Mamushi-Z laser canon.

918.name: Eromes
918.desc: She is an idol. Shinpachi once have fallen in love with her after helping her from the train incident. She invited Shinpachi to her house and seduced him but while shinpachi was taking a bath at her house she stoles his wallet. In the end of the episode it was revealed that she is a theif who steals the wallet of other people. She acts innocent in order to trick people.

918.name: Tomu
918.desc: Charlatan cult leader of the Dream Catcher Cult, of which Hanako was a victim of.

918.name: Kaoru Waki
918.desc: __Height:__ 165 cm Kaoru is a ninja and a member of the Shinobi 5, a mercenary ninja group for hire. She is familiar with Zenzo, and attended his father's funeral. She has been seen working in a flower shop into which Kagura crashed with a ​scooter, damaging a flower-petal birthday present that was planned for Michiko, the wife of Kaoru's manager at another of her part-time jobs, the Kunoichi Café where also Ayame works. Much like Sarutobi Ayame, Kaoru is often childish and playful, eg. when the two of them were supposed to fight during the Ninja Battle in the Elizabeth Rescue episode, but spent a long time just staring and trash talking each other. However, she gets serious when it comes to work.

918.name: Shuwa
918.desc: Member of the シノビ5 Shinobi 5, a mercenary ninja group for hire. He is also known as 毘沙門天の修輪 (bishamonten no shuwa).

918.name: Matsuo
918.desc: Also known as 広目天の松尾 koumokuten no matsuo member of the シノビ5 Shinobi 5, a mercenary ninja group for hire

918.name: Gou
918.desc: Also known as 韋駄天の剛 idaten no gou member of the シノビ5 Shinobi 5, a mercenary ninja group for hire

918.name: Kanbei
918.desc: Kanbei is a gambler who could read luck with his right eye. A legendary charisma gambler, he is also known as つきよみのかんべえ tsukiyomi no kanbee, tsukiyomi meaning luck. He is first encountered by Gintoki and Hasegawa during their losing streak. After discovering that the legendary gambler is cheating, the three are taken prisoner by Kujaku Hime and told to play Mahjong against one of her players. During the match their opponent asks if Kanbei could really read luck to which he recalls the incident in which his eye was damaged. He had to cut his luck-reading right eye deliberately in order to rescue a friend who was held hostage.

918.name: Hachirou
918.desc: Partner of Honjou Kyoushirou. Previously known as Hanako 花子, before cosmetic surgery.

918.name: Katsuo Kurogoma
918.desc: A gang boss who lives his life with one rule. That rule is everything in life has a 7:3 ratio.

918.name: Tetsuya Murata
918.desc: Murata Tetsuya was a swordsmith living in Edo. He was the son of renowned swordsmith Murata Jintetsu, and brother of Murata Tetsuko. He was the creator of the Benizakura bio-mechanical sword, which was based on his father's original Benizakura, as confirmed by Tetsuya's sister in Episode 59. He had severe hearing problems and often spoke like he was shouting. He helped Takasugi Shinsuke by providing him the sword he had made but didn't care for Takasugi's plots or ambition.

918.name: Tsukamu Nishino
918.desc: He likes to eat kid's meals.

918.name: Jirochou Doromizu
918.desc: Big Boss of the Kabuki District yakuza syndicate Dobunezumi Group His henchmen mentioned that Doromizu Jirochou, used to admire Otose, one of the other 4 Devas of Kabuki District. Has facial scars as well as unusually dark skin; called "Ganguro old man" by Gintoki because of this. He was also longtime​ friends with Terada Tatsugorou, deceased husband of Otose. He fought many wars and is a very skilled swordsman. One of many nicknames of him is "All Under Heaven". ~!He was born and raised in Kabuki district. Ever since he was a child, Jirochou would get into fights and start trouble, but Otose would always be there to straighten him out, as they were childhood friends. Even after he got into organized crime, Otose was the only one who stood by him and tried to set him straight. As a result, Jirochou became a vigilante who was popular enough to be considered a leader of the town. They say without Otose, Jirochou wouldn't be the man amongst men. Nobody could defeat him in a fight, except for Terada Tatsugorou. The two of them became friends because they want to protect the Kabuki District, they both loved Otose but Jirochou wanted Otose to be happy and allowed his best friend to marry her. Jirochou would marry later on and have a child named Chin Pirako.!~

918.name: Haji
918.desc: __Height:__ 163 cm Kozenigata's sidekick. In episodes 84-85 it's not stated if Haji is a girl or a boy, despite in his/her picture he/she seems to have a bust.

918.name: Uchino
918.desc: She is in love with Elizabeth.

918.name: Hatsu Hasegawa
918.desc: Daughter of a well-connected Bakufu official's family, Hasegawa Taizou 長谷川 泰三, who was from a poorer samurai needed family, married into her family. Willing to humble herself for her husband's sake, she knelt to beg for forgiveness on her husband's behalf (for dressing inappropriately to work) at his superior's house, even though the superior is of lower social rank than her own family.

918.name: Kurikan
918.desc: Leader of Thief Gang Cat's Punch 盗賊団「キャッツパンチ」

918.name: Shinnoshin Shinohara
918.desc: Kike Yamazaki, Shinohara Shinnoshin is a Shinsengumi Intelligence Agent aka Spy, but he is allied with Itou Kamotarou's camp vs. Yamazaki for Kondou's camp.

918.name: Kaguzou Mashiroi
918.desc: Father of Mashiroi Utsuzou. Leader of Mashiroi Group, a gangster or yakuza organization.

918.name: Utsuzou Mashiroi
918.desc: Son of Mashiroi Kaguzou, who did not want to follow in his father's footsteps of becoming a yakuza.

918.name: Suekichi
918.desc: One of the prisoners. His room was opposite the room in which was signed Katsura. It happened in the 110 episode.

918.name: Juurouta
918.desc: He is a male host at Takamagahara and dates Azumi.

918.name: Seizou Kumanaku
918.desc: Cleanliness freak. Has a mole on the forehead.

918.name: Kamenashi
918.desc: Caught by Kagura making furtive video recordings of women on the beach in Episode ?, Kamenashi tried to bribe his way out of trouble by offering to bring the Yorozuya 万事屋 for a visit to the Dragon Palace. He later gave the reason that he was looking for brave warriors to help him stop Otohime's plan to turn all of Earth's inhabitants into old and ugly people​ and that the trip was only a pretext to bring them over.

918.name: Otohime
918.desc: De-facto ruler of the Dragon Palace City, Otohime fell in love with Earth inhabitant Urashima 浦島 when he rescued one of her minions

918.name: Rei
918.desc: She is a ghost working at the Senbokyo hot spring.

918.name: Tasuke
918.desc: Good-for-nothing Son of Banzou 蛮蔵. Deemed as a boyfriend by Kimiko 公子 though he dumped her during the hostage negotiation in favor of keeping the drugs he stole from the drug peddling syndicate. Was scolded by father Banzou 蛮蔵 in his youth for indulging in video games for 2 years instead of working, but when son saw that father was jobless (due to company restructuring) even though he worked so hard, he became disillusioned and turned to illicit jobs like drug peddling.

918.name: Kimiko
918.desc: She is a daughter of a rich family and she was involved in the shabu shabu incident. In the later episodes it was revealed that she have cleaned her hands from dealing with drugs. She asked the yorozuya to save her boyfriend whom stole a drug from a yakuza.

918.name: Narrator
918.desc: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

918.name: Taki
918.desc: Head of housekeeping, to instruct the female members in the household on their household duties. Has the tendency to ill-treat juniors/newcomers. (Source: Gintama Wikia)

918.name: Iwa Ogami
918.desc: Oiwa is the innkeeper of Senboukyou, a hot springs​ bathhouse where the lingering dead gets help to move on. She runs the inn with a spirit named Rei. She is also a friend of Otose. (Source: Gintama Wikia)

918.name: Zenzou no Chichi
918.desc: Hattori Zenzou's father, who was a highly skilled ninja and member of the Oniwabanshuu. He was said to be one of the most formidable warriors within the Oniwabanshuu, and that as a teacher at Ninja School, he brought up all of the renowned ninjas in Edo of today. He liked to play Kick-The-Can and came back as a ghost to play with the Yorozuya in Episode 48, the same episode in which his funeral was held. (Source: Gintama Wikia)

918.name: Daito
918.desc: Character based on ex-Gintama manga editor Satou Yuu, he was assigned as editor for more than a 1 year.

918.name: Tsuu no Chichioya
918.desc: Father to Terakado Tsuu. Currently serving prison term. Escaped from prison for the sole purpose of watching his daughter's live concert

918.name: Ben
918.desc: He initially works as Santa's assistant.

918.name: Touma Kuraba
918.desc: Mitsuba's fiance.

918.name: Megami
918.desc: Goddess of Victory. She appeared in 89 episode in a dream Okita had.

918.name: Kai
918.desc: She headed the revolt on his planet (not The Earth). It occurs in 96 episode.

918.name: Ivanov
918.desc: He is an assistant Kai in the rebellion.

918.name: Kouhei Konishi
918.desc: He is the editor of JUMP. Gintoki meets him in episode 100. His dream is to work in fashion magazines. His name is a reference to [Kouhei Oonishi](https://anilist.co/staff/168654/), who worked as an editor on Gintama until 2007.

918.name: Sanzou Fudou
918.desc: Sanzo Fudo works as a realtor, considered the "Messiah" of Kabukichou because he would help anyone to get a place to stay no matter who or what their situation was. In episode 136 he helps Madao find an apartment.

918.name: Ojii-san
918.desc: He is the old man who lived in seclusion after his wife died and communicated only with the dog named [Kintaro ](https://anilist.co/character/43219/Kintaro). ~!He dies at the end of episode 130. !~

918.name: Kintarou
918.desc: A dog on his deathbed whose owner, a reclusive old man, is also on his deathbed. ~!In fact, it is an Amanto who captures The Worlds, having filled the inhabitants of these planets.!~ ~!He dies at the end of episode 130.!~

918.name: Hisashi Hongou
918.desc: Hisashi - a boy with poor health. Kagura meets him on the "morning exercises". This occurs in the 189 episode.

918.name: Kirie Muneharu
918.desc: Kirie wants to kill Sogo to avenge her father.

918.name: Kahei Tanaka
918.desc: Dangerous special offender. He was taken for questioning by the Shinsengumi. In 172 ep. ~!In fact Kahei - a good man. His confused with the criminal Tanaka Kouhei.!~

918.name: Shimomoto
918.desc: From episode 1.

918.name: Hideaki Amachi
918.desc: __Height:__ 213 cm Creator/author of Gintaman under Jump Editor Konishi's charge in Gintama world and the second caricature of Gintama's mangaka, Sorachi Hideaki as a gorilla, this time totally naked without T-shirt.

918.name: Kanshichirou Hashida
918.desc: A baby that was left in front of the yorozuya and was mistaken as Gintoki's son since it looks like him. It was revealed that he is the grandson of the leader of a certain organization. He was being taken back to the organization because he will be the successor of the group.

918.name: Fusa
918.desc: She first appears as the woman who leaves a baby at the Yorozuya. ~!It's later revealed that she's the mother of the baby (Kanshichirou) and she was running away from the Hashida who want to take the baby as the heir of the group.!~

918.name: Houichi
918.desc: Houichi is the Kabukichou Boss Cat and rules over the other stray cats. He has a very strict personality and is rough with any newbie. Each new cat must fight him in order for him to see if they are worthy of living in Kabukichou. ~!He used to be a human, but became a cat after the the cat he was taking care of sacrificed itself.!~

918.name: Doman Shirino
918.desc: An Onmyouji and head of the Shirino clan.

918.name: Ochi-san
918.desc: Ochi-san is a down-trodden ex-white-collar worker. He is now the coordinator for the District's Test-Your-Courage Haunted House. (Source: Gintama Wikia)

918.name: Kei
918.desc: Ochi-san's wife.

918.name: Marinosuke
918.desc: A man belonging to a village of hunters, Marinosuke wanted to bring down rogue bear Masamune which had been infected by a strange mushroom virus and had been terrorizing the villages. (Source: Gintama.wikkii)

918.name: Hisho
918.desc: She appears during the first part of the episode 82 as the secretary of the Yamata village's chief. Her name is never revealed and simply called "Secretary". ~!At the end is revealed that she was the one behind the monsters attacks and the herself was "Orochin"!~

918.name: Omohide Sake no Oyaji
918.desc: ~!It's later revealed he's the infamous Chogoro the Foxfire that Kozenigata has been following for 10 years.!~

918.name: Magistrate
918.desc: __Height:__ 167 cm __Weight:__ 57kg The magistrate in charge of the "Oedo Line Kinniku Buster Molestation" case trial.

918.name: Kawasaki
918.desc: Store Manager of the Kunoichi Cafe, suspected of cheating to his wife (Michiko). ~! It's later revealed that the reason he was been suspicious is that he was making a present for her.!~

918.name: Michiko Kawasaki
918.desc: Michiko came to the Odd Jobs with the request job of an investigation of her husband been unfaithful to her.

918.name: Tenchou
918.desc: During the episode 98-99 the Store Manager was the one in charge of the sales promotion of the "Owee".

918.name: Ojii-san
918.desc: During episode 106 when the Odd Jobs is in a need for one last player for a Soccer team, this passing by janitor is chosen as the needed last player.

918.name: Hana
918.desc: ~!During episode 106 while the Odd Jobs think they are helping Daisaku Amarao to make his last goal for his children, it was actually a goal to hit on Hana.!~

918.name: Nakano
918.desc: Nakano was the sports commentator in the last soccer game of Daisaku Amarao.

918.name: Kamemiya
918.desc: Kamemiya is the one who decided to take Otae and Kyubei to the Ryugu (Dragon) Palace. Spoof of actor Umemiya Tatsuo.

918.name: Captain Turtle
918.desc: Captain Turtle is the turtle who decided to take Madao to the Ryugu (Dragon) Palace.

918.name: Cello
918.desc: A parody character based off Cell from the Dragonball Z series.

918.name: Delde
918.desc: A parody of the character Dende in Dragon Ball. He appears in an episode where Hijikata travels across planets to find a cigarette.

918.name: M
918.desc: An online game character who appeared in episodes 121-122. ~!It's revealed he was Hasegawa Taizou in the virtual world.!~

918.name: Ikezawa
918.desc: She was a member of the Old Yorozuya like Kanemaru, Gintoki, and Furuhashi. Before she joined the Old Yorozuya she was a housewife with some serious drinking problems. One day Gintoki walks into her home and asks her if she wants to join the Old Yorozuya, after giving her some alcohol she accepts, but she never did really quit drinking so she always has​ a sake bottle near her.

918.name: Tom
918.desc: Tom is a girl who appears in episode 153/ chapter 227 (manga) during a radio story about her and her first friend Jerry, a dog.

918.name: Debugon
918.desc: He is the Dragon Leader's sidekick who betrayed him and a ​spoof of Hong Kong action-movie actor Samo Hung. (Source: Gintama Wikia)

6746.name: Isaac Dian
6746.original: アイザック・ディアン
6746.desc: Issac Dian forms one half of the bumbling thief couple, who seem to cross into everybody's story in one way or another. He's in love with [Miria](https://anilist.co/character/3796/), and they've robbed everything and anything, from doors to the entire Genoard household. He's completely clueless, super eccentric and happy-go-lucky to the point you can't stop laughing from his bold and sometimes completely weird actions. He has a cameo appearance in Durarara!!

6746.name: Miria Harvent
6746.original: ミリア・ハーヴェント
6746.desc: Another eccentric thief, she is the partner and lover of [Isaac Dian](https://anilist.co/character/3662). Miria wholeheartedly believes and supports everything Isaac says, often even going so far as to mimic his body language. Together they appear extremely stupid, whimsical and oblivious, but they have great affection for the people they meet, whom they always make a big impression on and always believe the best of them. She has a cameo appearance in Durarara!!

6746.name: Mikado Ryugamine
6746.desc: __Height:__ 165 cm (5'5") The primary male protagonist of the series, Mikado Ryugamine is a high school boy who moved to Ikebukuro with the encouragement of his best friend Masaomi in order to search for unusual beings and adventure. Mikado tries hard to change his image but so far he has not had any luck. Mikado has had moments where he speaks his mind, which is a reason why Masaomi admires him.

6746.name: Masaomi Kida
6746.desc: __Height:__ 170 cm (5'7") Kida is [Mikado Ryuugamine](https://anilist.co/character/24592/Ryugamine-Mikado)'s childhood friend and resident of Ikebukuro. Kida is an easy-going guy and appears foolhardy at times. He is 15 years old and is in class 1-B. Mikado says that Kida used to be very energetic in elementary school and describes him as being quite charismatic. Kida seems to know many of the residents of Ikebukuro and he functions as a guide to Mikado. He enjoys flirting with older girls and women although his passes usually aren't taken very well. ~!He was the leader of the gang: Yellow Scarves. During his reign, he is referred as "Shogun" (i.e. "General") although he doesn't seem like to be referred to as that title. He is very strong fighter as demonstrated during the coup of the Yellow Scarves; he took down several opponents with crowbar before collapsing due to a wound on his head. He left Ikebukuro with [Saki](https://anilist.co/character/30337/Mikajima-Saki) at the end of the third novel, but joined the chat-room using alias "Bakyura" to keep in touch with Mikado. He is now working with Saki for [Izaya](https://anilist.co/character/24596/Orihara-Izaya). He returns during the eighth novel and Mikado tells Kida to stay away from him and not to get involved with the current affairs.!~ (Source: Durarara!! DVD)

6746.name: Anri Sonohara
6746.desc: __Height__: 152 cm A bespectacled girl who attends the same school as Mikado and Masaomi. She is rather quiet and timid, but seems very close towards Kida and Mikado. She is very busty and cute, which makes her somehow popular, even though she feels uneasy about it. Mikado seems to have a crush on her. Chat name and origins: ~!Her online chat screenname is "Saika". She is currently in possession of the demon sword Saika, which gives her control over whoever it cuts and people wielding its 'daughter' swords. !~ Her past: ~!When she was younger, her father was extremely abusive towards her. Her mother, who was at the time possessed by Saika, killed him and then herself. !~ (Source: Anri's profile from the 3rd DVD)

6746.name: Shizuo Heiwajima
6746.desc: A man who is always seen to wear sunglasses and a bartender's suit. Although quiet and nondescript while not angered, he has a very short fuse and fights with incredible strength. Despite his simple and unrefined fighting skills, he is often considered the strongest fighter in the series. In the novels his power is described as the naturally unlimited form of human strength and likened to "adrenaline power" that can give people superhuman strength in times of emergency. In addition, Shizuo is capable of often superhuman parkour moves, a skill he obtained naturally from years of hunting down [Izaya Orihara](https://anilist.co/character/24596). Shizuo works as a bodyguard for a debt collector in Ikebukuro and carries intense animosity towards Izaya. He has a younger brother, Kasuka, who is a top idol under the showbiz name of Hanejima Yuuhei. He is also a long-time acquaintance of [Celty](https://anilist.co/character/28331). His first and last name translates literally into "serene man" and "peaceful island" respectively. Shizuo likes receiving gifts from his little brother, [Kasuka Heiwajima](https://anilist.co/character/30441/Kasuka-Heiwajima)

6746.name: Izaya Orihara
6746.desc: __Height:__ 175 cm A young man who sells information for his own enjoyment. He claims to love the entire human race except for [Shizuo Heiwajima](https://anilist.co/character/24595), and exhibits said love by putting humans in often miserable conditions and observing their reactions. He attended Raira Academy with Shizuo, [Shinra](https://anilist.co/character/24597) and [Kadota](https://anilist.co/character/26832/Kadota-Kyohei). According to Shinra, Izaya and Shizuo hated each other with a passion almost from the point they met. In the novels Izaya framed Shizuo for crimes on several occasions. In the anime he puts Shizuo in constant problems, such as gangs attacking him daily up to framing him of crimes. He is a master of parkour, and also quite skilled with his flickblade (the blade he uses must be slightly opened before the mechanics of it springs opens the blade - a switchblade will open on its own after the user presses a switch) as he is implied to be the only one capable of leaving numerous cuts in Shizuo's bartender suit after a fight in the novels. In the anime, he shaves a gang member's head bald without him noticing it. He is also fluent in Russian, which is exhibited in the final episode and episode 13 when he speaks with [Simon](https://anilist.co/character/27889). Izaya has two younger sisters, [Mairu](https://anilist.co/character/30623) and [Kururi](https://anilist.co/character/30624), who are twins and troublemakers. He claims to have grown up in a normal fami

6746.name: Shinra Kishitani
6746.desc: __Height:__ 178 cm A young underground doctor who lives with Celty and is also her lover. He mostly remains indoors and wears his white doctor's coat even when he is not at work. He went to the same primary school as Shizuo and Izaya and finds them interesting, enjoying their fights ... up to a point. His father was also a doctor, and as a child,​ Shinra participated in surgery alongside him, the most notable being an autopsy on Celty when they first met. As a doctor he is rather interested in what he considers to be interesting phenomena, such as the unlimited strength Shizuo shows in times of anger, and Celty's healing, headlessness and bodily functions. Shinra seems to have the "capacity" to tell what Celty is feeling, much to her surprise since she doesn't have a head to show her emotions.

6746.name: Kyohei Kadota
6746.desc: __Height:__ 183 cm Originally part of his own gang, Kyohei is now a member of the gang Dollars. He has a nickname "Dotachin" which is used by several characters in the series (mostly Izaya and Erika). One day he got a message to join the gang Dollars. He first thought is was a joke but on the next day he saw his login name (MONTA) on the list of the members of Dollars. Monta originated from his last name (門田), because 門 is also read as Mon and 田 (Ta) stays the same. He and other members never saw the leader of Dollars, but he has a suggestion who the leader is because there is only one person who could organize such a strange organization. His suspicion is on Izaya Orihara. Izaya was also the person who gave him the nickname "Dotachin". He likes to read, ink and wash paintings, company, hot springs and watch baseball games.

6746.name: Erika Karisawa
6746.desc: __Height:__ 160cm Erika is a very passionate otaku and manga reader. She and Walker are usually together. She is equally enthusiastic about manga or novel-inspired torture. It is noted she is a "fujoshi" or a yaoi fan. Like Izaya, she calls Kadota "Dotachin". ~!She is a member of the anonymous online gang Dollars. She was also a member of Kadota's gang.!~

6746.name: Seiji Yagiri
6746.desc: A classmate of Mikado's. He quits school claiming he has something more important to do with his life. He is very obsessed to his 'true love' who has scar on her head; revealing his psychopathic behaviours. He seems to rely on his sister's money for that. ~!It is revealed that he is in love with Celty's head.!~

6746.name: Namie Yagiri
6746.desc: The Chief of Yagiri Pharmaceuticals and sister of Seiji Yagiri. She harbors feelings for her brother. She is behind the recent human hunting in Ikebukuro which involves kidnapping people whose disappearance would not be noticed for unknown experiments. She seems to rely on Shinra for some tasks, including keeping their secret. She doesn't like the fact that Seiji is in love with Celty's head. She wants to get rid of what she calls "that thing." After Yagiri Pharmaceuticals ends up merging with another company, she makes a deal with Izaya and becomes his secretary.

6746.name: Semyon Brezhnev
6746.original: サーミャ・ブレジネフ
6746.desc: A tall Black Russian who came to the city to help out his Russian friend who runs a sushi shop. His real name is Semyon but everyone just calls him by the name, "Simon". Even though he is a friendly person, it has been shown that he is a force to be reckoned with as he is able to stop a fight with a man his size with just a single arm and also able to fight on par with Shizuo, who is one of the most feared men in Ikebukuro. He is another member of Dollars.

6746.name: Walker Yumasaki
6746.desc: __Height:__ 174cm __Weight:__ 55kg __Birthday:__ Jan. 23rd __Hobbies:__ Everything fictional (including games, movies, etc.), anime songs, ice carving __Things he likes:__ Make-believe, vision, fantasizing, wishful thinking, daydreaming __Things he dislikes:__ Censorship of expression __Foods he likes:__ Manga meat* __Foods he dislikes:__ “I can’t afford to be picky about food if I’m going to end up in the 2D world one day! So I’ll eat anything, even insects!” __Favorite saying:__ “I’m glad you asked! I’ll start from the titles beginning with an ‘A’…(and he went on to cite over 100 sayings from anime and manga as well as those by mangaka and anime producers, which we will omit here.)” Like his female friend and companion, Erika, Walker is a very passionate otaku and manga reader. He and Erika are nearly always together. He also likes to perform torture by letting the victim choose a light novel or manga, and carrying out the contents. He seems to be carefree. He also keeps a wide dumb smile most of the time. But this smile can hide more than people can see at first glance. Like Erika he is a very mysterious person. ~!He is a member of the anonymous online gang Dollars. He was also a member of Kadota's gang and an​ ex-member of the Blue Squares.!~

6746.name: Celty Sturluson
6746.original: セルティ・ストゥルルソン
6746.desc: Celty is a Dullahan from Ireland who came to Japan looking for her stolen head. Her motorcycle is actually a horse in disguise. She has no heart and perceives surroundings via unknown sensors that are not located on the head. The physical strength she possesses is above human, though not quite on par with [Shizuo Heiwajima](https://anilist.co/character/24595). She is also capable of manipulating a shadow-like, durable substance to form objects ranging from gloves to chariots at her will. Celty lives with [Shinra Kishitani](https://anilist.co/character/24597) and works as an underground porter. She wears a helmet when she goes out and communicates via a PDA. She enjoys online chatting, television and DVDs. She is one of the minority who knows the creator of the Dollars. She seems to have feelings for Shinra, but she herself if unsure if it is really love. She tends to get mad when Shinra says she does not need her head. She is afraid of movie scenes such as being chased by extraterrestrials or traffic officers. ~!Her online chat screenname is "Setton".!~

6746.name: Tom Tanaka
6746.desc: Tom Tanaka is an old friend and senpai of Shizuo Heiwajima. He works as a debt collector, and later becomes Shizuo's employer. Tom is usually seen walking around in a suit, but his clothing and his hair don't make him look too formal. This is probably due to his job as a debt collector, which needs him to look sharp and business-like but not too polite and friendly, as he often confronts people. It is likely that he works as an underground debt collector, and not for something like a bank. The light novels state that he works for an online dating website. He generally has a sort of reserved, laid back personality, and as harsh as you might expect an underground debt collector to be. He is usually calm, and is able to calm Shizuo down and make him stop without angering him and incurring his wrath. (Source: Durarara wiki)

6746.name: Kinnosuke Kuzuhara
6746.desc: A motorcycle cop with the police department. In the anime, he is known to chase after criminals viciously and has caused accidents and injuries among bystanders during his chases.

6746.name: Shingen Kishitani
6746.desc: A man with an eccentric personality who is Shinra's father. His behaviour is odd to the point that he wears a Gas Mask, he says: "Tokyo air is very filthy." and that's the reason why he wears it. He has also a habit of spinning a pen in his right hand. While his personality ranges from childish for comic relief up to a somewhat intimidating one(especially around Izaya and Namie), he is the one who offered Celty a home to stay, in exchange for performing surgery on her, to which she agreed. He is in fact the one who made Shinra participate in multiple dissections, which he believes are the reason why Shinra is so twisted now. ~!It is revealed that he is the one who stole Celty's head using the cursed blade Saika to cut the soul that binds together head and body. After that he sold the sword to an acquaintance while handing over Celty's head to Namie's father. !~ He claims his company,Nebula executives are interested in Celty and that is why he returned to Japan from America.

6746.name: Saburou Togusa
6746.desc: __Height:__ 166 cm One of the three Vice Presidents of the Official Fan Club of Hijiribe Ruri. A buddy to Kyohei and knows Kaztano well since he gets his concert tickets from him. He often drives his friends around in his van.

6746.name: Mika Harima
6746.desc: During the Raira Academy entrance exam, Harima Mika sits between Mikado and Seiji and falls in love with Seiji. She immediately begins collecting information about him. Later Seiji saves Mika and Anri from a gang of bullies. Mika then starts to stalk Seiji. ~!The day before school starts Mika breaks into Seiji's apartment and discovers Celty's head. Seiji hits her with a baseball bat (smashes her head against the wall in the anime) and calls his sister Namie, she disposes Mika's body and later on arranges plastic surgery on Mika's face to make her look like Celty's head. In vol.7, she reveals to Namie that she has tapped almost everyone even slightly connected to Seiji, i.e. Mikado, Anri, Masaomi and even Izaya. She now knows miniscule details about the main on-goings in Ikebukuro regarding these people, from basics like Mikado's, Anri's and Masaomi's identities, Izaya's handle name in the chatroom, to more obscure businesses like the incident with Vorona and Slon, and even Mikado joining force with Aoba. According to Mika, this is due to her wish to protect Seiji and get him out of troubles, should he feel obliged to do something for the others out of gratitude for what they have done for him. This makes her the one who knows the most in the story, second to Izaya (or possibly surpassing Izaya). Only Izaya seems to know about this. Mika also has plans to find Celty's head. !~

6746.name: Rio Kamichika
6746.desc: Kamichika Rio is a female classmate of Kida Masaomi. She is one of Orihara Izaya's victims and almost commited suicide. ~!When Mikado faces Namie with a message to all Dollars members Rio is also one of the people who gets the message, meaning: She is also part of the Dollars.!~ ~!After she met Izaya as Miss Magenta and almost committed suicide she got saved by Celty and decides to change her point of view on the world and even forgives her parents - especially her father for cheating on her mother.!~

6746.name: Haruna Niekawa
6746.desc: A former student of Raira Academy, moved to another high school last semester because of the rumor that she and Nasujima are dating. Her father, Niekawa Shuji is a reporter working for a small magazine. ~!Niekawa Haruna, who hosts the daughter blade of Saika, falls in "love" with her teacher Nasujima Takashi. She is caught trying to injure Nasujima with Saika's daughter, and afterwards has to transfer to another high school in West Ikebukuro.!~

6746.name: Takashi Nasujima
6746.desc: A teacher at Raira Academy. Rumors circulate that he and Haruna were dating.

6746.name: Hashim
6746.desc: Is a little kid that hangs around the Dollars gang place. Helps in episode 6 Erika, Kyohei, Togusa and Walker to find Kaztano by identifying the car that took him.

6746.name: Kazutano
6746.desc: Kaztano is person that is important to Togusa as he was the one who got him first place tickets to his favorite Idol Ruri Hijiribe, which were quite hard to obtain. It is believed that Kaztano is an Italian foreigner. While he is an active minor character in the anime, Kaztano does not personally appear in the novels (his name was mentioned though).

6746.name: Saki Mikajima
6746.desc: Acquaintance of Masaomi and Izaya. ~!Saki is a girl who has a godlike idolization of Orihara Izaya. She approaches Masaomi under Izaya's instructions and becomes Masaomi's girlfriend. Later Saki lets herself be abducted and injured by Blue Square under Izaya's instructions. Blue Square members Kadota, Yumasaki and Karisawa betray their gang and save Saki, who is immediately hospitalized. She remains hospitalized more than a year under Izaya's instructions. Then She discovers that her feelings for Kida were true after all.!~

6746.name: Kasuka Heiwajima
6746.desc: __Height:__ 177cm (5'10") Shizuo's younger brother. He is a famous actor of extraordinary skills (praised as "unbelievable" ever since he first started out as an amateur) under the alias Hanejima Yuuhei. However, when away from works, Kasuka is completely devoid of emotion and rarely talks unless necessary - this attitude, according to him, is a direct influence of growing up with Shizuo, who abysmally lacks emotional restraints. Izaya's twin younger sisters, Kururi and Mairu, are his fans.

6746.name: Mairu Orihara
6746.desc: Mairu is one of Izaya's younger sisters. She has a twin named Kururi. Like her brother, she's a troublemaker at school and introduces herself as liking to read encyclopedias, manga, and adult magazines. She also declares that she is bisexual and is looking for girls who are interested. This causes a stir in the class and she is bullied briefly until she responds to one of the bullies by threatening her with thumbtacks as well as taking her to the bathroom and stealing her bra. Later, the sisters are assumed to have framed the bullies for having drugs by sneaking them into their backpacks. She kisses Aoba after Kururi does, claiming she was happy to get an indirect kiss from her sister. Along with her sister, she is known to be a big fan of Shizuo's brother Kasuka, stating that she would even be willing to push Izaya in front of a truck for a chance to meet him.

6746.name: Kururi Orihara
6746.desc: Kururi is one of Izaya's younger sisters. She has a twin sister named Mairu. Unlike her more outgoing sister, Kururi is shy and softspoken. She still stands out at school because she wears a gymnastics outfit as apposed to the usual uniform, and gets bullied due to her sister's reputation. According to Mairu, she was very happy when he said he found her to be cuter than the girl who was bullying her. Like her sister, she is a big fan of Shizuo's brother Kasuka.

6746.name: Shuji Niekawa
6746.desc: A reporter who writes for the Tokyo Incidents. featuring weird events or noteworthy societies in Tokyo. Because of a planned special,​ he comes to Ikebukuro with the intention of doing research on various topics such as who is regarded to be the strongest on the streets. His daughter is Niekawa Haruna.

6746.name: Ruri Hijiribe
6746.desc: __Height:__ 162cm (5'4") A popular idol. Before becoming an idol, she was originally a makeup artist and was in charge of Kasuka's vampire makeup in his debut film Vampire Ninja Carmilla Saizou. ~!Ruri inherited superhuman strength from one of her grandparents, who was (according to Narita's other series Vamp!) a vampire, and is, in fact, the dreaded serial killer Hollywood (the name stems from various monster costumes she wore during each of her kills).!~

6746.name: Hiroshi
6746.desc: Apparently part of the Dollars gang.

6746.name: Kanazawa
6746.desc: One of the trio who goes around kidnapping people for experimentation.

6746.name: Ryo Takiguchi
6746.desc: Goes to school with Kida and Mikado and is a member of the Dollars gang. He is thought to be a bit of a rebel, but actually spends most of his time alone, composing music on his harmonica. ~!He is a victim of violence at the hands of a group of people from the Yellow scarves, headed by Horada. In the scuffle, his arm and Harmonica is broken. He claims to quit Dollars after this incident, but instead stays around and ends up helping Anri escape from Horada later on.!~

6746.name: Haruya Shiki
6746.desc: One of Awakusu-kai's executives and also one of the youngest (about 30). He's unique among the yakuza members featured in this series in that he always uses the honorific speech (except for when he is talking to his subordinates). He is depicted as representative of the "Intelliyakuza", who rely less on violent methods and more on information (intelligence) and financial manipulation for their income. He is a master of aikido and a fan of Hijiribe Ruri (according to Kazamoto). Within Awakusu-kai, he is also seen as the person responsible for dealing with Orihara Izaya, the information broker.

6746.name: Horada
6746.desc: A Yellow Scarves member that picking on Shingen when he just arrives to Ikebukuro. He and his gang was chased away by Celty after he snaps away her PDA.

6746.name: Dennis
6746.desc: Russian Sushi owner. ~! He and Simon used to be in the Soviet special forces and went out of job when the Soviet union collapsed. Afterwards, they worked for Dracon and Lingerin's weapon dealing organization and trained Dracon's daughter, Vorona. Later, the two migrated to Japan and opened the Sushi restaurant. !~

6746.name: Ran Izumii
6746.desc: Older brother of Kuronuma Aoba, does not like his younger brother at all. Aoba had always acted all smart and appeared highly aware of other people's needs, which somehow never failed to stir a weird kind of annoyance in Ran. Ran was Blue Square leader during conflict with Yellow Scarves, that happened one year ago. After that he starts working for Orihara Izaya. ~!Izaya gave him information about Masaomi's girlfriend Saki and later on Blue Square members under Ran's command kidnap her to lure Masaomi out. But Kadota and his gang save Saki thus defecting from Blue Square. Ran and other top members are arrested by police after Saki states about her kidnapping.!~

6746.name: Shiri
6746.desc: Shiri (シュリShuri) is a Russian girl who walks around with a writing pad around her neck. If somebody is looking for something, they write what they're looking for on a page of the writing pad in the hopes that whoever found what they're looking for will read the pad. She also helps Anri escape the Yellow Scarves.

106625.name: Shouyou Hinata
106625.desc: __Teams:__ Yukigaoka Junior High (Former); Karasuno High (Current) __Number:__ 1 (Junior High 3rd Year); 10 (High School 1st year); 5 (High School 3rd year) __Position:__ Captain (Junior High); Outside Hitter (Junior High); Middle Blocker (High School) Hinata has an unusually high ability to jump. Since he was young, Hinata trained his legs to compensate for his lack of height. He joins the Karusuno High School Volleyball team and amazes the team with his natural affinity as a spiker. Although he is a complete beginner and never had any experience playing in a volleyball team, he grows rapidly through each match. ~!After graduating from high school, Hinata traveled to Brazil to gain experience by playing beach volleyball. This is when he got the name, Ninja Shoyo. Upon returning to Japan, he became a member of the MSBY Black Jackals, a Division 1 team in the V-League. He became a member of the Japan Men’s National Volleyball Team during the 2021 Olympics. Currently, that is the year 2022, he is a member of Asas São Paulo, a professional team in the Brazil Super League.!~

106625.name: Tobio Kageyama
106625.desc: __Team:__ Karasuno High, Kitagawa Daiichi Junior High (former) __Height:__ 180.6 cm __Year:__ 1st Year, class 3 __Number:__ 9 __Position:__ Setter A famous setter in his middle school who joins the Karusuno High Volleyball team. He was known as the "King of the Court" in his middle school because of his arrogant demeanor and the way he would order around his teammates. Although he still carries an overbearing attitude, he begins to change when he starts to play with [Hinata Shouyou](https://anilist.co/character/64769) who views him as a rival.

106625.name: Koushi Sugawara
106625.desc: __Height:__ 174 cm Being the vice captain, Sugawara has a soothing personality for his teammates and acts as a pillar of support for them. Even though he isn't Karasuno's official setter anymore, he doesn't dream of giving up on playing in general. As such, he encourages himself and all of his teammates not to give up, no matter how rough the situation might be. Sugawara's dedication to volleyball is clear when he decides to continue club activities even when most third years choose to retire to focus on their futures. In a meeting, his teacher asked Sugawara why he's so determined to continue playing even though he's not a starting member, and Sugawara replied that he doesn't want to have regrets in the future. He is also quite perceptive as he noticed how [Tanaka](https://anilist.co/character/67325/Tanaka-Ryuunosuke) asked for the key to the gym (back during the first years' 3-on-3 match) even though he always comes in late, so Sugawara knew that something was up. He is also intelligent as he can come up with helpful tactics during the game. An example of this is when he came up with the idea of saying "bring it" and "send it to me" for [Kageyama](https://anilist.co/character/64771/Kageyama-Tobio) and [Hinata](https://anilist.co/character/64769/Hinata-Shouyou)'s combo.

106625.name: Daichi Sawamura
106625.desc: __Team:__ Karasuno High __Height:__ 176.8 cm __Year:__ 3rd year, class 4 __Number:__ 1 __Position:__ Wing Spiker The captain of the Karasuno High volleyball club.

106625.name: Ryuunosuke Tanaka
106625.desc: __Height:__ 177.2 cm __Team:__ Karasuno High __Number:__ 5 __Position:__ Wing Spiker

106625.name: Yuu Nishinoya
106625.desc: __Team:__ Karasuno High, Chidoriyama Junior High (former) __Height:__ 159.3 cm (5'2") __Year:__ 2nd year, Class 3 __Number:__ 4 __Position:__ Libero Yuu is a very energetic and temperamental person. His boisterous nature and crazy shenanigans can attract unwanted attention quite easily, which often bodes ill for him. Although he hardly ever worries about the consequences of his actions (and may even revert to violence in order to vent out his anger on certain occasions), he is surprisingly considerate of his friends' feelings and insecurities. Yuu can be extremely impatient, excitable and impulsive. As [Ryuunosuke Tanaka](https://anilist.co/character/67325) puts it, "he simply gets too fired up for his own good." He doesn't bother to filter his words, and is therefore prone to blurting out whatever he's thinking in a loud and tactless manner. In-game, however, his attitude changes drastically: he becomes incredibly focused and serious, remaining calm and doing everything in his power to provide the support his team needs until the very end. For this reason, everyone in the volleyball club respects him greatly.

106625.name: Kei Tsukishima
106625.desc: **Height:** 188 cm **Team:** Karasuno High **Year:** 1st year, class 4 **Number:** 11 **Position:** Middle Blocker A member of the Karasuno High volleyball club. Tsukishima is very blunt and will sometimes rile his teammates up due to his antagonistic nature (most notably being [Hinata](https://anilist.co/character/64769/Hinata-Shouyou), [Kageyama](https://anilist.co/character/64771/Kageyama-Tobio), [Nishinoya](https://anilist.co/character/67327/Nishinoya-Yuu), and [Tanaka](https://anilist.co/character/67325/Tanaka-Ryuunosuke)) and sometimes other teams because of his casual smug attitude, taking pride in and relishing when his opponents see him as a nuisance as seen with [Tendou](https://anilist.co/character/126073/Tendou-Satori) and [Shirabu](https://anilist.co/character/137537/Shirabu-Kenjirou). Tsukishima is standoffish and has an arrogant and condescending personality, but he has low self-esteem and thinks of himself as inferior. Although he is only outwardly close with [Yamaguchi](https://anilist.co/character/71609/Yamaguchi-Tadashi), he can be seen occasionally caring about his other club members.

106625.name: Chikara Ennoshita
106625.desc: __Team:__ Karasuno High __Height:__ 175.4 cm __Year:__ 2nd year, class 4 __Position:__ Wing Spiker Ennoshita seems quiet and reserved but can behave boldly towards the other 2nd years. He's smart and hasn't received a failing mark before. Similarly to Sugawara, he is always smiling. He's supposedly the only one within the 2nd years to be able to control Tanaka and Nishinoya. He's also able to understand different people, as stated a few times by Tanaka and when he knew what to do to give Yamaguchi some courage before his jump float serve.

106625.name: Asahi Azumane
106625.desc: __Team:__ Karasuno High __Height:__ 184.7 cm __Year:__ 3rd year, class 3 __Number:__ 3 __Position:__ Wing Spiker In contrast to his appearance, he is rather quiet and gentle and has his difficulties realizing that he is Karasuno's ace as he initially doesn't feel that way. He shows to be weak-willed at the beginning when he leaves the team before the first years come, feeling that he let down his entire team when they lost against Date Tech High even though they counted on him. After coming back to Karasuno, he realizes that his will to play volleyball is much stronger than he thought and with the help of his teammates, he acknowledges his position as Karasuno's ace (even though he is still mocked sometimes by Daichi for not having any "ace-like presence") and gains self-confidence.

106625.name: Kiyoko Shimizu
106625.desc: __Team:__ Karasuno High __Height:__ 166.2 cm __Year:__ 3rd Year, class 2 The manager of the Karasuno High volleyball club.

106625.name: Keishin Ukai
106625.desc: **Height:** 178.2 cm **Team:** Karasuno High Karasuno High School volleyball club's alumnus, currently coaching volleyball club and helping out his mother at the shop.

106625.name: Kenma Kozume
106625.desc: __Height:__ 169.2 cm The setter of the Nekoma High School volleyball club. Kenma is [Kuroo](https://anilist.co/character/71269)'s childhood friend and keeps playing volleyball because of him. He has a very calm personality and is usually doing things at his own pace. Often seen playing video games and being introverted. Nekoma's backbone, brain and heart.

106625.name: Tetsurou Kuroo
106625.desc: __Team:__ Nekoma High School __Height:__ 187.7 cm __Year:__ 3rd Year, class 5 __Number:__ 1 __Position:__ Middle Blocker The captain of the Nekoma High School volleyball club. Kuroo has a somehow manipulative and cunning personality, but cares about his friends and teammates very deeply. As Nekoma's captain he has a sense of responsibility and confidence. Even though Kuroo's a middle blocker, he often uses offensive plays too.

106625.name: Tadashi Yamaguchi
106625.desc: __Team:__ Karasuno High __Height:__ 179.5cm - 180.0cm __Year:__ 1st year, class 4 __Number:__ 12 __Position:__ Middle Blocker Yamaguchi always hangs out with Tsukishima and is very protective of him. He has trained himself hard to use a jump float serve. He is also a substitute ace server of the Karasuno Volleyball team.

106625.name: Tooru Oikawa
106625.desc: __Height:__ 184 cm The setter and captain of the Aoba Josai High School volleyball club. He was [Kageyama](https://anilist.co/character/64771/Tobio-Kageyama)'s senpai when they were attending Kitagawa Daiichi. According to Kageyama, he is a very talented setter and volleyball player with a ​complex personality. His favourite food is milk bread.

106625.name: Taketora Yamamoto
106625.desc: __Team:__ Nekoma High School __Height:__ 176.7 cm __Year:__ 2nd Year, class 1 __Number:__ 4 __Position:__ Wing Spiker Yamamoto is proud and short tempered wing spiker of the Nekoma High School volleyball club. He usually doesn't think what he says and is somewhat similar to Tanaka.

106625.name: Sou Inuoka
106625.desc: __Team:__ Nekoma High School __Height:__ 185.3 cm __Year:__ 1st Year, class 1 __Number:__ 7 __Position:__ Middle Blocker Middle blocker of the Nekoma High School volleyball club. He has friendly personality and becomes friends with Hinata after their game.

106625.name: Yuuki Shibayama
106625.desc: __Team:__ Nekoma High School __Height:__ 162.5 cm __Weight:__ 53.3 kg __Year:__ 1st Year, class 4 __Number:__ 12 __Position:__ Libero One of the libero of the Nekoma High School volleyball club.

106625.name: Ittetsu Takeda
106625.desc: __Team:__ Karasuno High __Height:__ 166.5 cm Volleyball club faculty advisor of the Karasuno High School. Takeda is inexperienced in volleyball, but still became an advisor for Karasuno. He often doesn't understand rules and that's why he takes notes about every new thing he learns. Takeda has an enthusiastic and brave personality.

106625.name: Yuutarou Kindaichi
106625.desc: __Team:__ Aoba Josai High, Kitagawa Daiichi (former) __Height:__ 189.2 cm __Year:__ 1st year __Position:__ Middle Blocker Middle blocker of the Aoba Josai High School volleyball club. He was Kageyama's teammate back in junior high school. Kindaichi was one of the players who hated Kageyama's selfish plays and refused to understand him.

106625.name: Nobuyuki Kai
106625.desc: __Team__: Nekoma High School __Height__: 176.5 cm __Weight__: 68.9 kg __Year__: 3rd Year, class 4 __Number__: 2 __Position__: Wing Spiker

106625.name: Morisuke Yaku
106625.desc: __Team:__ Nekoma High School __Height:__ 165.2 cm __Year:__ 3rd Year, class 5 __Number:__ 3 __Position:__ Libero Currently playing libero of the Nekoma High School volleyball club.

106625.name: Shouhei Fukunaga
106625.desc: __Team:__ Nekoma High School __Height:__ 178.3 cm __Year:__ 2nd Year, class 2 __Number:__ 6 __Position:__ Wing Spiker

106625.name: Hayato Ikejiri
106625.desc: __Team:__ Tokonami High School __Height:__ 177.2 cm __Year:__ 3rd Year, class 1 __Number:__ 4 __Position:__ Wing Spiker Ikejiri went to the same junior high school as Daichi where they played volleyball together.

106625.name: Wakatoshi Ushijima
106625.desc: __Height:__ 189.5 cm (6' 2.6") __Team:__ Shiratorizawa Academy __Number:__ 1 __Position:__ Wing Spiker Wakatoshi Ushijima is a third year at Shiratorizawa Academy and the captain and ace of the school's boys' volleyball team. Currently, he is the number one ace in Miyagi Prefecture and one of the country's top three aces, along with Sakusa and Kiryu. Left handed. His favourite food is hayashi rice.

106625.name: Kaname Moniwa
106625.desc: **Height:** 176 cm **Team:** Datekougyou High School **Number:** 2 **Position:** Setter The captain of the Datekougyou High School volleyball club.

106625.name: Kenji Futakuchi
106625.desc: __Team:__ Datekougyou High School __Height:__ 184.2 cm According to Moniwa, Futakuchi is a problematic kouhai with a very easy going personality. He's often seen arguing with Kamasaki who is the ​complete opposite of Futakuchi.

106625.name: Takanobu Aone
106625.desc: __Team:__ Datekougyou High School __Height:__ 191.8 cm __Year:__ 2nd Year, class A __Number:__ 7 __Position:__ Middle Blocker Main pillar of Datekou. Even though Aone never smiles and seems serious and scary, he actually has a very kind heart. Futakuchi said that Aone has a habit of "locking on" to you if he knows his opponent is an ace.

106625.name: Yuusuke Takinoue
106625.desc: Height: 185.6 cm Position: Middle Blocker Karasuno High School volleyball club's alumnus. He and Shimada are part of the Karasuno Neighborhood Association team. And they often come to watch current Karasuno's games as well as to root for them. Yuusuke's working at Takinoue Electric Goods.

106625.name: Makoto Shimada
106625.desc: __Height:__ 177.7cm Karasuno High School volleyball club's alumnus. He and Takinoue are part of the Karasuno Neighborhood Association team. And they often come to watch current Karasuno's games as well as to root for them. Makoto's working at Shimada Mart.

106625.name: Hisashi Kinoshita
106625.desc: __Height:__ 174cm Narita, Ennoshita and Kinoshita are 2nd years who couldn't keep up with the training when old Ukai returned and that's why they left volleyball club. However after some time they came back because they realized that they still want to play volleyball, though coach Ukai was no longer there. Ennoshita called them ''disgraceful'' 2nd years.

106625.name: Kazuhito Narita
106625.desc: __Team:__ Karasuno High __Height:__ 180.2 cm __Year:__ 2nd Year, class 4 Narita, Ennoshita and Kinoshita are 2nd years who couldn't keep up with the training when old Ukai returned and that's why they left volleyball club. However after some time they came back because they realized that they still want to play volleyball, though coach Ukai was no longer there. Ennoshita called them ''disgraceful'' 2nd years.

106625.name: Koutarou Bokuto
106625.desc: __Height:__ 185.3 cm Bokuto is a third year student at Fukurodani Academy and is its volleyball team's captain and wing spiker. His spikes pack a powerful punch that others can struggle to receive. Despite this, Bokuto has a tendency to not doing well in the middle of games when getting shut out. Luckily, [Akaashi](https://anilist.co/character/88938) has a whole list of things Bokuto does and tries his best to bring Bokuto back up to his usual self. Besides Akaashi, Bokuto is friends with a few other rival team's players, such as [Kuroo](https://anilist.co/character/71269) and sorta friends with [Tsukishima](https://anilist.co/character/67329).

106625.name: Keiji Akaashi
106625.desc: __Height:__ 182.3 cm A second year at Fukurodani Academy, and its volleyball team's vice-captain and setter. Akaashi is often calm and collected, though he does have times where he begins to get worried about things. More often than not, he has to handle Bokuto and all of his antics during the game. When such happens, Akaashi usually thinks of some way to bring Bokuto into peak condition again, though there are times where he struggles with doing so.

106625.name: Hitoka Yachi
106625.desc: __Team:__ Karasuno High __Position:__ Manager __Occupation:__ High School Student (1st Year, Class 5) A 1st year who was recruited by [Shimizu](https://anilist.co/character/67689/Shimizu-Kiyoko) as a manager trainee. She appears to be very nervous, but easily befriends [Hinata](https://anilist.co/character/64769/Hinata-Shouyou). She's paranoid (which causes her to be intimidated easily), very curious, and is organized with her notes, including the ones that she takes from class; this is largely due to her mother being a graphic designer.

106625.name: Akira Kunimi
106625.desc: __Team:__ Aobajōsai (former Kitagawa Daīchi) (first year at Aoba Johsai) __Height:__ 182.8 cm __Number:__ 13 __Position:__ Wing Spiker He is a quiet and indifferent person, though it's mostly out of laziness. He occasionally skips practice as well and doesn't seem to put his full effort into matches; however, his true strength lies in his late game plays. Kunimi dislikes loud, energetic people and was dismayed when Koganegawa yelled at him to "go all out", which is one of his least liked phrases. He also refers to Hinata, Koganegawa, and Hyakuzawa as the "idiot squad" because of their energy. Kageyama has also mentioned that Kunimi is smart, though it's unknown if that refers to his game sense or general studies.

106625.name: Lev Haiba
106625.desc: __Team:__ Nekoma High School __Height:__ 194 cm __Weight:__ 79,7 kg __Year:__ 1st Year __Position:__ Middle Blocker Lev is a half Russian, half Japanese. However he says he doesn't speak Russian because he was born and raised in Japan. His name in Russian means lion. Lev wasn't around when Karasuno and Nekoma had their first match together. He started playing volleyball in high school, that's why he was still a novice and spent whole time on bench at that time so he didn't come. Lev is blessed with natural physical ability, intuition and height. He declares that he's an ace even though he's a middle blocker. Kenma states that Lev is a good and honest guy. Lev is quite childish and cheerful, shown when he was making fun of Hinata's height. Lev's appearance, as well as his piercing eyes, causes people to believe he is much more intimidating and serious than he actually is. Though he can be blunt, he never seems to mean any harm and adopts a playful attitude towards most things. He is also shown to be enthusiastic about spiking as he gets excited about it very easily, and can be competitive with people he is interested in.

106625.name: Saeko Tanaka
106625.desc: Saeko Tanaka is a former student of Karasuno High and the older sister of Ryuunosuke Tanaka. She was also a classmate of the Small Giant during her high school years. The second years of the volleyball team views her as a cool older sister, especially Nishinoya, but Tanaka thinks of her as a nuisance whenever she bothers his study sessions. Like her brother, she's loud and outspoken. Her driving has been described by her brother as dangerous as he had once stated to Hinata and Kageyama that he can't guarantee their safety in her car.

106625.name: Akiteru Tsukishima
106625.desc: Kei Tsukishima's older brother.

106625.name: Satori Tendou
106625.desc: __Height:__ 187.7 cm (6' 1.9") __Home town:__ Miyagi Prefecture __Home country:__ Japan __Likes:__ Shounen Jump, Chocolate, Ice Cream, Cute Actresses __Jumping Reach:__ 327 cm Satori Tendō is a third year middle blocker in Shiratorizawa Academy. He is often referred to as Guess Monster by other teams. He is cheerful and loud, though a bit sardonic. Tendō enjoys teasing both his teammates and opponents, usually annoying the latter. However, when he gets into the game, he becomes a different, more intimidating person, relishing the look of defeat on people's faces when they are denied. He has a high success rate with this blocking style due to his analytical skills and predictions, thus he is confident in his abilities . He also greatly values the fun aspect of volleyball. ~!As an elementary student, he was called a monster for his looks also probably due to the meaning of his name (Satori refers to a Yokai) and was told he couldn't join the volleyball team by other students because of that. Using his guess block, he was able to block the spike of one of his bullies. This event made him feel happy and he continued to use his unique blocking technique to feel that way again despite much opposition until high school. Since his guess block got a lot of points, the Shiratorizawa coach let him join the team without resistance.!~

106625.name: Kanji  Koganegawa
106625.desc: __Height:__ 191.5 cm __Team:__ Datekougyou High School __Year:__ 1st year __Number:__ 7 __Position:__ Setter Koganegawa is a first year setter at Date Tech High. He is very energetic and enthusiastic but often lacks the ability to think carefully about his actions. Despite being rather simple-minded, he's also shown to be determined to improve his abilities and support his team as their setter and with his height but tends to focus on improving the wrong areas.

106625.name: Takahiro Hanamaki
106625.desc: Takahiro is a 3rd year wing spiker at Aobajohsai High.

106625.desc: Tamahiko is a first year setter and a pinch server at Nekoma High.

106625.desc: Third-year high school student at Fukuroudani Academy. He is the starting libero on the boys' volleyball team.

106625.name: Akinori Konoha
106625.desc: Akinori is a third year wing spiker from Fukuroudani Academy.

106625.name: Takurou Oiwake
106625.desc: Takurou is the coach of Date Tech High's volleyball team.

106625.name: Tarou Onagawa
106625.desc: Tarou is a 2nd year student at Date Tech High. He became one of the team's wing spikers after the 3rd years retired.

106625.name: Tsutomu Goshiki
106625.desc: __Height:__ 181 cm (5'11") __Hometown:__ Miyagi Prefecture Tsutomu Goshiki is a first year wing spiker in Shiratorizawa Academy. Goshiki appears to have been a capable volleyball player even before entering Shiratorizawa Academy. In one of his recollections, he is seen being praised by an elderly lady while showing off a volleyball related trophy. He is also frequently acknowledged for his height and reliability as an ace.

106625.name: Eita Semi
106625.desc: __Height:__ 179.5 cm (5' 10.7") __Hometown:__ Miyagi Prefecture Eita Semi is a third year setter in Shiratorizawa Academy. Like most members of the Shiratorizawa Boys' Volleyball Team, Semi got into the school through a sports scholarship. He was a famous setter during his time at middle school and the main setter for Shiratorizawa before being replaced by Shirabu.

106625.name: Reon Ouhira
106625.desc: __Height:__ 182.7 cm (5' 11.9") __Hometown:__ Miyagi Prefecture __Introduction:__ Reon is a third year wing spiker at Shiratorizawa Academy. It's implied that he was accepted due to a sports scholarship for volleyball. __Personality:__ Ouhira has a soothing personality and tends to be responsible for calming his teammates down when they're hyped up. He doesn't get riled up easily and is similar to Ushijima when it comes to his temperament; along with Ushijima, he wasn't upset about the hundred serves they had to do upon losing. He is confident in his own abilities, going up against three blockers and performing well despite being aware of the audience's disappointment that it wasn't Ushijima attacking. (Source [Haikyuu!! Fandom Wikia](https://haikyuu.fandom.com/wiki/Reon_%C5%8Chira))

106625.name: Kenjirou Shirabu
106625.desc: __Height:__ 174.8 cm (5' 8.8") __Hometown:__ Miyagi Prefecture __Introduction:__ Kenjirou Shirabu is a second year setter at Shiratorizawa Academy. He is the only player on Shiratorizawa's Boys' Volleyball Team who didn't get into the school with a sports scholarship. He took the exam to get into Shiratorizawa in hopes of being able to play with tall and strong players after watching Ushijima play in junior high. __Personality:__ He is respectful towards his upperclassmen but tends to bicker with Goshiki, a first year. Though he appears serious and composed, Shirabu is extremely hot-headed and gets annoyed at nearly every move his opponents pull. However, he is capable of recomposing himself quickly. He is also very studious and hardworking, spending all of his free time studying in order to pass the difficult entrance exam for Shiratorizawa. During junior high, he had good grades.

106625.name: Tanji Washijou
106625.desc: Tanji is the head coach of Shiratorizawa Academy Boys' Volleyball team.

106625.name: Hayato Yamagata
106625.desc: __Date of Birth:__ February 14, 1995 __Height:__ 174.3 cm (5' 8.6") __Weight:__ 66.5 kg (146.6 lbs) __Likes:__ Uni donburi (Sea urchin on rice) __Hometown:__ Miyagi Prefecture __Introduction:__ Hayato Yamagata is a third year libero in Shiratorizawa Academy. __Personality:__ He is serious and focused on the game. When Nishinoya pulled off an incredible move, Yamagata grinned widely. It's been shown he is similar to Nishinoya when it comes to 'getting into' the game, yet he seems more aggressive than most liberos. Yamagata is also seen being very supportive of his kouhai, Goshiki, and was shown telling Ushijima when he was being unintentionally rude towards him. He appears to be very protective of the younger years and often acts as a mentor. (Source [Haikyuu!! Fandom Wikia](https://haikyuu.fandom.com/wiki/Hayato_Yamagata))

106625.name: Ikkei Ukai
106625.desc: Ikkei is the former coach of Karasuno High's Boys' Volleyball Club. He once led the team to nationals and was well-known. After being hospitalized, he resigned from coaching the team.

106625.name: Hiroki Kurokawa
106625.desc: Hiroki was a member of Karasuno High's Boys' Volleyball Club. He played as a wing spiker and was the captain during his third year.

He's also a germaphobe, often wearing a mask when not playing volleyball. ~!He eventually became an outside hitter for the MSBY Black Jackals, a V-League Division 1 team. He became a member of Japan's National team during the 2021 Olympics.!~

106625.name: Motoya Komori
106625.desc: Itachiyama Academy's second year libero that was featured as the #1 high school libero in Volleyball Monthly. He is [Kiyoomi Sakusa’s](https://anilist.co/character/139475/Sakusa-Kiyoomi) cousin.

106625.name: Ren Oomimi
106625.desc: A third year at Inarizaki High and a middle blocker.

106625.name: Hitoshi Ginjima
106625.desc: A second year at Inarizaki High and a wing spiker.

106625.name: Aran Ojiro
106625.desc: __Height:__ 184.7 cm (6' 0.7") __Occupation: __High School Student (3rd Year, Class 5) __Teams:__ Inarizaki High (Former) __Number:__ 4 (High School 3rd Year) __Position:__ Outside Hitter Ace A third year at Inarizaki High and the volleyball club's wing spiker and ace. He is also one of the top aces in Japan. He is best friends with the Miya twins and good friends with Kita Shinsuke, the teams captain.

106625.name: Atsumu Miya
106625.desc: __Height:__ 183 cm __Year:__ Second Year Highschool Student __Number:__ 7 __Position:__ Setter __Team:__ Inarizaki High Atsumu Miya is an second year highschool student who lives in Hyogo Prefecture, Japan. Outwardly, Atsumu appears to be a carefree, confident person who's usually seen with a lazy smile on his face, though he enjoys provoking people and giving offhand compliments. He can be quite condescending, and somewhat selfish at times. His twin brother, [Osamu Miya](https://anilist.co/character/139492/), describes him as someone who doesn't listen to others, doesn't return what he borrows, and lies habitually. He also appears to be a perfectionist who has ridiculously high standards for himself and his spikes. Atsumu is a competitive person who hates losing; sometimes, these traits can veer off in a bad direction. ~!As of 2018, he is a member of MSBY Black Jackals, a professional volleyball team in Division 1 of Japan's V. League. He is also a member of the Japan National Volleyball Team and participated in the 2021 Olympics.!~

106625.name: Norimune Kurosu
106625.desc: The coach of Inarizaki High's Boys' volley club.

106625.name: Heisuke Riseki
106625.desc: A first year at Inarizaki High, along with being a wing spiker and pinch server.

106625.desc: __Height:__ 185.7 cm (6' 1.1") He is the middle blocker of Inarizaki High

106625.desc: A second year at Inarizaki High and a wing spiker.

106625.name: Michinari Akagi
106625.desc: A third year at Inarizaki High and a libero.

106625.name: Osamu Miya
106625.desc: __Height:__183 cm __Number:__11 __Position:__ Opposite Hitter __Team:__ Inarizaki High Osamu is a second-year high school student who lives in Hyogo Prefecture, Japan. Osamu appears to be the calmer of the Miya twins with a laid-back and deadpan personality. Despite his outward demeanor, Osamu is highly competitive and becomes heated even if it isn't obvious on the surface. Osamu is also shown to have a large passion for food. He thinks about it often in the middle of a match and would get distracted by the smell of it. He can't seem to pick a favorite food and wouldn't know what to eat as his last meal. Like his brother, Atsumu Miya, he loses self-control when it comes to eating. He's shown to have a sense of humor, especially regarding Atsumu, whom Osamu teases whenever he messes up.

106625.name: Kourai Hoshiumi
106625.desc: __Height:__ 169.2 cm (5'6.6") __Teams:__ Yurisei Middle School (Former); Kamomedai High __Number:__ 5 __Position:__ Outside Hitter, Ace Hoshiumi Originally planned on playing basketball, but he decided to join the volleyball team in second grade. His reason was listed as wanting to be free from his older brother, Akitomo, who constantly sneered at Hoshiumi over their height difference. Despite his reasoning at first, Hoshiumi soon came to love the sport as he watched official matches on TV.

106625.name: Sachirou Hirugami
106625.desc: __Height:__ 190.4 cm (6' 3") A second year at Kamomedai High and a middle blocker. He likes shumai with extra fillings.

106625.name: Natsu Hinata
106625.desc: Shouyou Hinata's younger sister.

106625.name: Kanoka Amanai
106625.desc: __Height:__ 182.5 cm (5' 11.9") __Uniform Number:__ 6 __Position:__ Wing Spiker (ace) Wing spiker and ace of Niiyama Girls' High SChool Volleyball Team and [Tanaka](https://anilist.co/character/67325/Ryuunosuke-Tanaka)'s childhood friend.

106625.name: Maiko Yonezawa
106625.desc: From Niiyama Girls' High. Friends with Amanai Kanoka.

106625.name: Kai Akakura
106625.desc: __School (Team):__ Shiratorizawa Academy __Grade:__ 1-10 __Position:__ Libero __Height:__ 171.4 cm (5'7'') __Weight:__ 59.5 kg __Kai Akakura__ is a first year libero at Shiratorizawa Academy. He helps out during the first year training camp and befriends Hinata when working together.

His hair is light gray with black tips at the ends. He also has dark eyes and thin eyebrows.

106625.desc: Coach of Inarizaki High's Boys' Volleyball Team

106625.desc: Coach of the All Japan's Boys' Youth Team. He is the main coach at the Intensive Training Camp.

106625.desc: Third-year at Shiratorizawa Academy Junior High and setter on the volleyball team. He attends the Miyagi First Year Training Camp.

106625.name: Yasushi Kamasaki
106625.desc: __Height:__ 186.8cm (6' 1.5") __Uniform Number:__ 1 __Position:__ Middle Blocker __Ability Parameters (out of 5):__ Power = 5; Jump = 2; Stamina = 4; Game Sense 2; Technique = 2; Speed = 4 Third-year student at Datekougyou High School. Prior to retiring, he played on the boys' volleyball team as a middle blocker and the vice-captain. He is loud, strict, and often argues with and threatens his problematic kouhai [Futakuchi](https://anilist.co/character/77415/Kenji-Futakuchi). However, he is incredibly supportive of his team and often attends their official and practices matches with [Moniwa](https://anilist.co/character/77413/Kaname-Moniwa) and [Sasaya](https://anilist.co/character/137486/Takehito-Sasaya) after retiring.

106625.name: Kyoutou
106625.desc: Vice Principal of Karasuno High School. He is balding and attempts to keep his head covered with a toupee. He is said to have a bad relationship with the volleyball club that has gotten worse since Hinata and Kageyama joined the club. However, once the team starts to win again, he begins supporting the club more.

106625.name: Kouji Terada
106625.desc: [Kanoka Amanai](https://anilist.co/character/139520/Kanoka-Amanai)'s cousin

106625.name: Yuushou Sagae
106625.desc: __Height:__ 177.8cm (5'10") First-year at Shiratorizawa Academy and wing spiker on the volleyball team. He is one of the ball boys at the Miyagi First-Year Training Camp.

106625.name: Junji Kuroishi
106625.desc: __Height:__ 173 cm (5’ 8.1”) __Position:__ Libero First-year student at Hakusuikan High School and libero on the volleyball team. He attends the Miyagi FIrst-Year Training Camp at Shiratorizawa Academy. During a practice game against the Shiratorizawa third-years and alumni, he would unintentionally remind [Hinata](https://anilist.co/character/64769/Shouyou-Hinata) of the "split step" technique.

106625.name: Yumeto Nagamatsu
106625.desc: __Height:__ 189 cm (6'2") __Position:__ Middle Blocker Third-year middle school student and volleyball player at Kousen Academy. He attends the Miyagi First-Year Training Camp, where it is revealed that he will be attending Shiratorizawa Academy upon graduating middle school.

125367.name: Narrator
125367.desc: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

125367.name: Kaguya Shinomiya
125367.desc: __Height:__ 158 cm The vice president of the student council of Shuchiin Academy, member of the wealthy Shinomiya family, she is a multi-talented genius who can do anything if she sets her mind to it. Due to the way she was raised, she instinctively looks down on others and thinks of ways to use them for her own benefit. Kaguya rarely interacted with other people before she joined the student council, but that has begun to change. She is an incredibly sheltered girl, resulting in her lacking in several pieces of what might be considered common sense. She still doesn’t understand love very well, and her main objective is to make [Miyuki Shirogane](https://anilist.co/character/121101) fall in love and confess to her. Later in the series: ~!She confesses her love to Miyuki Shirogane and they start dating.!~ ~!In a Oshi no Ko special chapter, it was revealed that she married Miyuki and changed her surname to Kaguya Shirogane!~

125367.name: Miyuki Shirogane
125367.desc: __Height:__ 175 cm He is a second year student at Shuchi'in Academy and the president of the student council. Miyuki is a handsome young man with blond hair and blue eyes. Due to his constant sleep deprivation and nearsightedness, his eyes appear to glare. He usually wears the regular Shuchi'in Academy black male uniform adorned with the Aiguilette, the golden chain-like accessory around his neck. The Aiguilette symbolizes his authority as student council president. Shirogane is a diligent student who, despite his underprivileged background, climbed his way to the top of his class through hard work and determination. Shirogane holds himself in high regard, consistently working to maintain his perfect image. He is textbook workaholic, enjoying his part-time job and often putting his own health at risk for the sake of his work. Due to his poor background, Shirogane values money greatly and goes to great lengths to not be wasteful, and generally dislikes expensive gifts. ~!Miyuki's mother left his family when he was a child. Miyuki's father's factory was shut down and currently has no stable employment. They live in an apartment that costs ￥50,000 (Approx $450) a month.
