Due to this grisly past, he has been led to a lifestyle of part time jobs and hard work. He passed the Level 2 Kanji Kentei exam and has passed Grade Pre 1 on Eiken. He has also got second place on the National mock exam.!~ ~!Miyuki transferred into Shuchi'in Academy during his first year of high school on a scho

125367.name: Yuu Ishigami
125367.desc: The treasurer of the student council of the Shuchiin Academy. He's extremely valued by [Miyuki](https://anilist.co/character/121101), given that he single-handedly manages all the school's funds. He's also terrified of [Kaguya](https://anilist.co/character/120649), though no one else is sure why that is. Yuu keeps to himself and rarely speaks up, often getting into trouble when he does. He has a depressed outlook on life while having an inferiority complex. In contrast to his attitude, he is willing to help those in need and will sacrifice his pride if need be. Unlike his high school self, he had a much different outlook and demeanor during middle school. Later in the series: ~!Ishigami develops a crush on Tsubame that he inadvertently confesses his feelings for her at the school's cultural festival. Ishigami does not realize that his actions were perceived as a confession by the rest of the student body and is therefore oblivious to the implications of having given Tsubame a heart-shaped gift (considered akin to a confession in Shuchiin tradition). After some convincing by Kaguya, Tsubame decides to seriously consider Ishigami's confession, with her original intention being to let him down as gently as possible. It isn't until Ishigami watches Tsubame's performance of the traditional play that gave rise to the aforementioned tradition that he realizes his actions had unintended meaning. Even then, Ishigami's thickheaded nature prevented him from recognizing the full meaning

125367.name: Chika Fujiwara
125367.desc: The secretary of the Shuchiin Academy student council. She could not be predicted, her thoughts could not be read. A natural disaster who unconsciously threw everything into chaos simply by being present, also known as __Subject F__. ~!In chapter 222 of the manga, Chika reveals that she played piano because she wanted to be perfect, and she becomes a prodigy at the piano. The expectations of her family and her fans rose, forcing her to practice more. She quit piano after Kaguya told her to just quit if she didn't like the piano. Soon after Chika challenged Kaguya to a game battle and if she won, she would get to become Kaguya's friend. In the end, she becomes Kaguya's first friend.!~

125367.name: Ai Hayasaka
125367.desc: Ai Hayasaka is a second-year student at Shuchiin Academy and a valet of the Shinomiya family. She is a member of the Hayasaka family, who have served the Shinomiya family for generations, gaining their trust. Having been personally assigned to enter Shuchiin Academy with her, Ai supports [Kaguya Shinomiya](https://anilist.co/character/120649) in her high school life and has been a part of Kaguya's life for ten years. Because of their close relationship, Ai is one of the few people around to which Kaguya's amiability is not an act. Even if she demonstrates maturity as a valet, Ai still has the concerns of a young girl, such as caring to be in fashion and going out with friends, even if she does not have much time for herself due to work. Ai helps Kaguya with the struggles about her feelings for [Shirogane](https://anilist.co/character/121101). ~!She later leaves her job as a maid to Kaguya but still continues her friendship.!~ ~!In the Doujin-ban universe, she starts dating and later gets engaged to Shirogane!~

125367.name: Miko Iino
125367.desc: __Height:__ 147 cm (4'7") She is a freshman at Shuchiin Private Academy and the Auditor of the Student Council. Miko has a strong sense of justice and will correct others on what's right and wrong. Unfortunately, this led to her being bullied, though she still continues to uphold her idea of "right". She idolizes [Chika Fujiwara](https://anilist.co/character/121103), listening to anything she says, even if it's for Chika's enjoyment.

125367.name: Kei Shirogane
125367.desc: Kei Shirogane is [Miyuki Shirogane's](https://anilist.co/character/121101) little sister. She attends Shuchiin middle school and is the treasurer for the middle school student council. She is a hard worker just like her brother and can be very prideful at times. She also inherited his sense of righteousness and hates it when someone doesn't do the right thing in a given situation. Like her brother, she likes helping out those who are in trouble even if it means going out of her way to do it. Since she grew up in a family that places emphasis on saving money, she normally carries coupons and works hard for the things she wants to buy. She developed a prickly attitude towards her brother due to his over protectiveness. She's also entered a rebellious phase and due to her pride and she cannot get herself to have a lighthearted conversation with Miyuki, leading into the similar mind games that Miyuki and [Kaguya](https://anilist.co/character/120649) play against each other, but her objective is to talk to Miyuki without making it look like she has a brother complex. She rarely speaks and most of the time it is only when she exchanges formalities at school or when she hurls abuses at her brother.

125367.name: Erika Kose
125367.desc: She is a member of the mass media club at Shuchi'in Academy.

125367.name: Karen Kino
125367.desc: She is a member of the mass media club at Shuchi'in Academy.

125367.name: Tsubame Koyasu
125367.desc: Tsubame is a third-year student who is vice-captain of the cheer squad and a rhythmic gymnast. She is very popular. She encourages [Yuu](https://anilist.co/character/121102) in the cheering activities.

125367.name: Tsubasa Tanuma
125367.desc: He is a student in Shuchi'in highschool and always asks [Miyuki Shirogane](https://anilist.co/character/121101) for advice about love. [Kashiwagi](https://anilist.co/character/134330)'s boyfriend.

125367.name: Maki Shijo
125367.desc: Maki is a classmate and friend of [Nagisa](https://anilist.co/character/134330). She has short hair styled in short pigtails. She is friends with Nagisa and is secretly jealous of Nagisa's relationship with her boyfriend, as she too liked Kashiwagi's Boyfriend, but could not confess before. As a branch member of the Shinomiya clan, she is [Kaguya](https://anilist.co/character/120649)'s second cousin twice removed so she sometimes refers to Kaguya as "Auntie". [Miyuki](https://anilist.co/character/121101) and [Yuu](https://anilist.co/character/121102/Yuu-Ishigami) observe she acts very tsundere (cold on the outside but wanting to be affectionate), and similar to Kaguya in personality. She declares Yuu and Miyuki as her friends, due to their support in helping her process her failed romance, much to Kaguya's horror

125367.name: Moeha Fujiwara
125367.desc: Moeha is [Chika](https://anilist.co/character/121103)'s little sister who is in junior high. She is the student council vice-president at the junior high. She admires [Miyuki](https://anilist.co/character/121101) as well and hopes to confess someday. She has a habit of voicing dark ideas, which unnerve [Kaguya](https://anilist.co/character/120649) a great deal.

125367.name: Nagisa Kashiwagi
125367.desc: Nagisa is a classmate who occasionally asks [Kaguya](https://anilist.co/character/120649) about what to do in her relationships. [Tsubasa](https://anilist.co/character/134327)'s girlfriend.

125367.name: Kobachi Osaragi
125367.desc: Kobachi is [Miko](https://anilist.co/character/125886)'s classmate with the glasses and a member of the disciplinary committee. She has been looking after Miko for over 10 years. ~!Though she doesn't love him in a romantic way, she has liked Yu Ishigami since middle school. She believes that Tsubame Koyasu is a kind person and is therefore supportive of Ishigami's feelings for Tsubame, despite her friend Miko being in love with Ishigami as well.!~

125367.name: Adolphe Pescarolo
125367.original: アドルフ・ペスカローロ
125367.desc: The Principal of Shuchi'in Academy He's strict regarding school regulations, but knows how to garner the favor of students nonetheless. He helped Yu Ishigami get enrolled to Shuchi'in despite not finishing his task of making an apology letter. Despite being an authority figure within the school, he has shown comical disregard for school rules and discipline when it comes to his own actions, having been openly caught playing Pokemon Go on more than one occasion on school grounds while chastising nearby students for doing the same.

125367.name: Shirogane no Chichi
125367.desc: Father of [Miyuki](https://anilist.co/character/121101) and [Kei Shirogane](https://anilist.co/character/126144). ~!His wife left him and their factory shut down leaving him to not have any stable employment.!~ ~!He later becomes a youtuber.!~

125367.name: Saburo Odajima
125367.desc: One of the Four Ramen Emperors of Tokyo. In the past, Saburo was in a relationship with [The Glutton Girl of Jinbocho](https://anilist.co/character/276380/Jinbouchou-no-Glutton-Girl), but he broke up with her over their polar opposite ramen styles, believing they'll eventually end up at each other's throats.

125367.name: Rei Onodera
125367.desc: She is a supporting character in the series. She was a member of Shuchi'in's Red Cheer Team and is a classmate of Yu Ishigami and Miko Iino. She is a fairly calm girl under normal circumstances and is fairly open-minded, but when involved with the Cheer Team or the culture festival committee, she becomes far more energetic.

125367.name: Kazeno
125367.desc: Kazeno is a third year high school student at Shuchi'in Academy and was the captain of the Cheer Club during the Sports Festival. He is a very energetic and caring person,cheering on his team and giving support to Yu Ishigami.

125367.name: Kozue Makihara
125367.desc: Makkii-senhai is a first-year high school student at Shuchi'in Academy and the president of the Tabletop Gaming Club, As the president of the Tabletop Gaming Club, Kozue loves games. She also has a somewhat sadistic sense of humor, as shown by her cheerfully torturing Miko while gathering audio for their class' event during the culture festival. She is shown to be very intelligent, regularly ranking among the top ten students in the freshman class during the end of semester exams.

125367.name: Terashima
125367.desc: She's a third-year high school student at Shuchi'in Academy and a member of the Tabletop Gaming Club which Chika Fujiwara is also a part of. Terashima, being demoted from Terako to Gigako, is a pun on metric prefixes

125367.name: Daichi Fujiwara
125367.desc: A politician and the father of Toyomi, Chika and Moeha Fujiwara. Daichi is very well mannered and professional. He’s also overly protective of his daughters.

125367.name: Zen Seito Kaichou
125367.desc: The Previous Student Council President (real name unknown) is a supporting character in the series. He is a third-year high school student at Shuchi'in Academy and the president of the 66th Student Council. He is a third year student at Shuchi'in Academy and was the president of the School Council when Miyuki Shirogane was in his first year.

125367.name: Momo Ryuuju
125367.desc: Momo Ryuuju is a supporting character in the series. She is the president of the Astronomy Club and one of The Impossible Girls. As a member of a yakuza family, she places little value on the school rules, as seen by her wearing a hat and playing games on her cellphone while on school grounds. She also has a short temper, and others view her as being threatening.

125367.name: Gou Kazamatsuri
125367.desc: Like Shirogane, he attended an outside middle school before entering Shuchiin. He enrolled in order to look for clues regarding the disappearance of his older brother. He serves as an assistant to the "Investigator of the financial world" Hajime Echizen and, after solving many difficult cases has finally been reunited with his brother.

125367.name: Nao Hayasaka
125367.desc: Nao Hayasaka is Ai's mother. The two of them are shown to have a close relationship, though Ai is often upset by her mother's job keeping them from spending much time together. She also works for the Shinomiya family. Daughter: [__Ai Hayasaka__](https://anilist.co/character/121104/) Spouse: __Masato Hayasaka__

125367.name: J Suzuki
125367.desc: A taxi driver and one of the Four Ramen Emperors of Tokyo.

125367.name: Saburou Toyosaki
125367.desc: In the past, he used underhanded tactics to sabotage [Shirogane](https://anilist.co/character/121101/)'s grades, but he now fights fair and square. He only opens his eyes when he shows his "true power."

125367.name: Fujiwara Sofu
125367.desc: The grandfather of the Fujiwara sisters.

125367.name: Yume Atenbo
125367.desc: President of the Occult Research Club. Her grandfather is a high ranking Shinto priest. She loves to tease couples, so most of her predictions are excuses for sexual harassment.

125367.name: Jinbouchou no Glutton Girl
125367.original: 神保町のグラットンガール
125367.desc: One of the Four Ramen Emperors of Tokyo. She dated [Saburo Odajima](https://anilist.co/character/137169/Saburo-Odajima) in the past, but he broke up with her over their conflicting ramen styles. She felt unable to change her way of life and continued to pursue her style. In the present she had forgotten why she began eating ramen like this, until she happens to see [Chika Fujiwara](https://anilist.co/character/121103/Chika-Fujiwara)'s satisfaction from finishing a bowl of ramen.

125367.name: Takahiko Tanuma
125367.desc: One of the Four Ramen Emperors of Tokyo.

125367.name: Masaru Kobayashi
125367.desc: Treasurer of the culture festival committee. He has a crush on [Tsubame Koyasu](https://anilist.co/character/134326/Tsubame-Koyasu).

125367.name: Teppei Tanaka
125367.desc: A member of Shuchi'in Academy's Public Relations team. He has a crush on [Tsubame Koyasu](https://anilist.co/character/134326/Tsubame-Koyasu).

125367.name: Daiki Satou
125367.desc: Safety Officer of the Shuchi'in Academy culture festival committee. He has a crush on [Tsubame Koyasu](https://anilist.co/character/134326/Tsubame-Koyasu)

20799.name: Joutarou Kuujou
20799.desc: __Height:__ 195 cm (6'5") __Occupation:__ Student, Marine Explorer, Oceanographer __Nationality:__ Japanese Joutarou is Holly Kujo's son and [Joseph Joestar](https://anilist.co/character/6356)'s grandson. In Part 3, he has a recognizable attire of a blue trenchcoat-length school uniform jacket with yellow chains on the collar. He also wears a trademark hat which, while torn in the back, often seems to blend with his hair. When Joutarou first appears, he turned himself in to the police because he believes his Stand is an evil spirit possessing him. After he is released from jail, and learns what his Stand is, Joutarou gets used to Star Platinum -- a fierce, muscular, vaguely Aztec-looking spirit with "the precision of a machine" and the ability to destroy virtually anything with a sledgehammer barrage of fists. He has a very tough exterior, and is even rather rough and delinquent, but he also is very dedicated, intense, and loyal. He is very intelligent, but usually lets his (or Star Platinum's) fists do the talking with the enemy, even though he often has to rely on his wits to deal with stand users' attacks. He is also known for a quick and short temper. His catchphrase is "Yare yare daze." It generally relates of being bored or exasperation. In Part 3, he is the main target of [Dio](https://anilist.co/character/4004), who realizes that Joutarou is his greatest threat. One of the strongest stands in the JoJo universe; Star Platinum possesses super human senses, strength, sta

20799.name: Dio Brando
20799.desc: __Height:__ 195 cm (6'5") __Race:__ Human (formerly), Vampire (onwards) __Nationality:__ British Dio is an immortal vampire and the arch rival of the Joestar clan. __Series 1: Phantom Blood__ ~!Dio is the son of [Dario Brando](https://anilist.co/character/74099/Brando-Dario), an alcoholic and abusive father. Back when Dio was just a boy, he was brought into the household of [George Joestar](https://anilist.co/character/21956/Joestar-I-George) after the mysterious death of his father, so as to repay the debt he owed Dio's father for saving his life. But soon Dio's personality caused trouble for George's young son, [Jonathan Joestar](https://anilist.co/character/8087/Joestar-Jonathan). Even more of a sociopath than his father, Dio was resolute to shatter Jonathan's spirit and take his place as the favored son, even going so far as to arrange for Jonathan's dog [Danny](https://anilist.co/character/222601/Danny) to be burned to death. Initially, Dio is able earn the trust of the patriarch of the Joestar family through deceit (and at Jonathan's expense). However, his plans of taking over the Joestar household were discovered by Jonathan when he discovered that not only had Dio poisoned his biological father to death, he was doing the same to his adoptive father, all to take the Joestar estate for his own. Determined not to be stopped, and understanding the potential to enjoy power over all things instead of just the Joestar estate, Dio wears and activates the Stone Mask, becoming

20799.name: Jean-Pierre Polnareff
20799.original: ジャン＝ピエール・ポルナレフ
20799.desc: __Height:__ 185 cm (6'1") Jean-Pierre Polnareff is a Frenchman who joins the Joestar group on their journey to Egypt after being freed from Dio's control by the group. He aims to avenge the murder of his sister. His brash nature and overconfidence combined with his general tomfoolery is often the source of trouble throughout the journey, and other members of the group often remark on his tendency to endanger himself and others. ~!Polnareff reappears in 2001 (Part 5), now 36 years old and wheelchair-bound, to assist [Giorno](https://anilist.co/character/10529/Giovanna-Giorno) and the rest of Passione in their fight against the boss.!~ He also serves as the inspiration for many characters in other franchises such as [Guile](https://anilist.co/character/9312/Guile) (Street Fighter), [Paul](https://anilist.co/character/285435/Phoenix-Paul) (Tekken), [Benimaru Nikaido](https://anilist.co/character/61203/Nikaido-Benimaru) (King of Fighters).

20799.name: Joseph Joestar
20799.original: ジョセフ・ジョースター
20799.desc: __Height__: 195 cm (6'5") Joseph Joestar begins as a young Englishman in New York, with his grandmother [Erina](https://anilist.co/character/21937). However, an attack by [Straits](https://anilist.co/character/21961) and the disappearance of [Robert Edward O Speedwagon](https://anilist.co/character/21938) soon involve him in the greater chain of events.

20799.name: Jonathan Joestar
20799.original: ジョナサン・ジョースター
20799.desc: __Height:__ 195 cm __Nationality:__ British __Occupation:__ Archaeologist Born the unique son of the wealthy businessman [George Joestar I](https://anilist.co/character/21956), Jonathan is an honest, kind, and positive man whose life is fraught with tragedy after meeting his adopted older brother - and series antagonist - [Dio Brando](https://anilist.co/character/4004). In his battle against Dio, Jonathan becomes a Ripple user under the tutelage of the master [Will Anthonio Zeppeli](https://anilist.co/character/18062). **Part 5:**~!Jonathan is the biological father of [Giorno Giovanna](https://anilist.co/character/10529), the protagonist of Vento Aureo, as well as a handful of other illegitimate offspring.!~

20799.name: Noriaki Kakyouin
20799.desc: __Height:__ 178 cm (5'10") __Stand:__ Hierophant Green Kakyoin is a high school student and user of the stand Hierophant Green. Unlike most stand users, Kakyoin was born with his stand, though it caused him to feel like an outsider for most of his life due to not knowing any other stand users. Until meeting the rest of the main characters, Hierophant was Kakyoin’s only real friend. Hierophant is not physically strong, but is elastic and can able to unravel into tentacles which can capture opponents. It can also enter an enemy’s body to possess them, though Kakyoin rarely uses this ability. Hierophant’s signature power is emerald splash, which hurls emeralds that slice opponents. Kakyoin remains calm and collected even in dangerous situations, and is good at seeing through opponents’ strategies. During a trip to Egypt with his family, he encountered [Dio](https://anilist.co/character/4004/Brando-Dio), who controlled him using a flesh bud. It was later removed by [Jotaro](https://anilist.co/character/4003/Kuujou-Joutarou) and Kakyoin joined the Joestar group.

20799.name: Mohammed Avdol
20799.original: モハメド・アヴドゥル
20799.desc: __Height:__ 188 cm (6'2") __Stand:__ Magician's Red Avdol is a fortune teller and friend of [Joseph Joestar](https://anilist.co/character/6356/Joestar-Joseph). They met three years before the events of the story. He was born with a stand, Magician’s Red, which controls fire. This stand’s abilities include Crossfire Hurricane, which shoots fire in the shape of an Ankh, and Crossfire Hurricane Special, which splits into multiple Ankh-shaped flames. He can also create flame tracker that detects a person’s energy. Avdol presents himself as a serious person but can sometimes let his emotions get the best of him. He often acts as the voice of reason among the Joestar group and exhibits strong loyalty by frequently placing himself in danger to protect his friends. He is knowledgeable about geography and stands, enjoys India’s chaotic atmosphere, and respects [Polnareff](https://anilist.co/character/4368/Polnareff-JeanPierre)'s chivalrous attitude that he displayed when they first met. Avdol gives [Jotaro](https://anilist.co/character/4003/Kuujou-Joutarou)'s stand its name. ~!Avdol encountered [DIO](https://anilist.co/character/4004/Brando-Dio) in Egypt before the main events of the story, but was able to escape unscathed.!~ ~!At one point he is shot by [Hol Horse](https://anilist.co/character/16557/Horse-Hol) and presumed dead, but he was actually in hiding and rejoins the Joestar group later. He is killed protecting Polnareff and [Iggy](https://anilist.co/character/21089/Iggy) from

20799.name: Hol Horse
20799.desc: **Height**: 188cm *(anime)* Hol Horse is a minor antagonist in JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Stardust Crusaders (first seen in Chapter 141 and Episode 10), as well as one of the main characters of Crazy Diamond's Demonic Heartbreak. He is a tall, blonde-haired cowboy-themed mercenary, serving under Dio and his army of other Stand Users. He considers himself "The #2", preferring to work as support with a partner due to his cowardice and caution. He also respects women, no matter how pretty, or how ugly, as seen with his ex, Nena. His Stand is Emperor, named after the Tarot Card of the same name. It manifests itself as a retro-futuristic pistol, which functions as a normal firearm, although the bullets are able to change their trajectory to Hol Horse's command. ~!He is seemingly fatally injured by his own Stand's bullets in Chapter 221 (and episode 37 of the anime), but manages to survive and go into hiding, fearing Dio's punishment for failing his mission of killing the Joestar group.!~

20799.name: Iggy
20799.desc: __Height:__ 33.3 cm __Nationality:__ American Iggy is a boston terrier who wields a stand known as The Fool, which is able to manipulate sand. Since The Fool is made of sand, damaging it will not hurt Iggy. He creates various objects out of sand including the wings of a glider and a statue of DIO. Iggy is depicted as rude and disobedient, as shown by his tendency to chew on people’s hair while farting on them. He loves coffee-flavored gum. Iggy was previously owned by a rich man, but he ran away and became a stray in New York. Avdol caught him and brought him to Egypt to help the Joestar group defeat DIO. He frequently chews Polnareff’s hair and once put chewed gum inside Jotaro’s hat. ~!At first, Iggy seems indifferent towards the Joestar’s quest to defeat DIO. Then he accidentally finds DIO’s mansion and is attacked and injured by Pet Shop, causing his hatred for DIO to grow. He is killed after saving Polnareff from Vanilla Ice.!~ He was initially drawn as realistic dog, but as the story progressed, his face gradually became more similar to a human’s. He is named after Iggy Pop.

20799.name: Suzie Q
20799.desc: __Height:__ 168 cm The female assistant to Lisa Lisa. Suzie Q is a slightly ditzy girl who worries for her friends. Evidently this carefree personality has not diminished even in the events of Stardust Crusaders, when she is shown enthusiastically recording her sightings in Japan on a camcorder when on a trip to see her daughter. ~!She is introduced as the female assistant to Lisa Lisa. When she first appears, she is taken over by the remains of Esidisi and attacks her friends. Thanks to a combination attack by Caesar and Joseph, she is saved with only minor injury. She marries Joseph in 1939.!~

20799.name: Narrator
20799.desc: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

20799.name: Daniel D'Arby
20799.original: ダーニアル・J.・ダービー
20799.desc: __Occupation:__ Gambler __Stand:__ Osiris __Manga Debut:__ Chapter 211 __Anime Debut:__ Episode 34 D'Arby is an expert and inveterate gambler and his Stand, Osiris, can steal souls. He is a member of the Egypt 9 Glory Gods and meets the Joestar Group in Cairo. Here, he tricks them into wagering their souls in various gambles. D'Arby is also Telence T. D'Arby's older brother. Daniel J. D'Arby exhibits an affable but sly, knowing character. D'Arby first and foremost character trait is his love of gambling. He states that he lives for the thrill of gambling (which he recognizes as worthless). This love of gambling is complemented by his enjoyment for cheating, and he proudly admits that cheating is one of his greatest skills shamelessly rigging every game he's seen participating to while justifying himself by claiming that if the cheat isn't exposed, it is "fair" game.

20799.name: Terence D'Arby
20799.original: テレンス・T.・ダービー
20799.desc: __Nationality:__ American __Occupation:__ Butler __Stand:__ Atum D'Arby is one of the Egypt 9 Glory Gods and resides in DIO's mansion in Cairo acting as his butler. He isolates and challenges Jotaro, Joseph and Kakyoin when the Joestar Group enters the mansion and forces them into waging their souls against him in various video game challenges. He is also Daniel J. D'arby's younger brother. As a butler, Terence is a mannerly individual. However, his demeanor is a facade for his twisted and arrogant personality. Due to his occupation, Terence is rather polite and affable, keeping his calm even in the face of provocations and comes to greet and confront the Joestar Group when they enter DIO's Mansion. Terence is a very intelligent man and is especially proficient at video games: He defeated the likes of Tatsuhiko, a child genius with an IQ of 190, albeit without the use of his Stand's ability to read minds.

20799.name: Vanilla Ice
20799.desc: Vanilla Ice is the last Vampire created by DIO and one of the penultimate Stand Users the Joestar Group faces upon infiltrating DIO's Mansion. After the group is split up, he is sent to take out the team consisting of Avdol, Polnareff, and Iggy. Vanilla Ice is a Stand User controlling his void-based Stand ability, Cream, to battle. His name is based off the famous ''rapper'', Vanilla Ice. His stand is named after the band, Cream.

20799.name: Enya Geil
20799.desc: Enya Geil is one of Dio's most loyal supporters, and the one who originally gave him the Stand Arrow, which she obtained from Diavolo. She is the mother of J. Geil. Her stand is Justice, which is able to control people through their wounds, whether alive or dead. For legal reasons, her name is changed in the American version of both the game and the manga, to N-Yah Gail and Enyaba Geil respectively. In the OVA: ~!She is able to change her appearance from that of a young woman to an old lady at will. No explanation as to why is ever given.!~

20799.name: Pet Shop
20799.desc: Pet Shop serves as the guard of Dio Brando's mansion in Egypt. It ruthlessly kills any who may trespass or it deems as suspicious. When it first appeared, Pet Shop decapitates two large dogs with ease and smashes a beggar (employed by Abdul to find Dio's mansion) and his car with his stand. Pet Shop possesses incredible aerial agility and the ability to swim. ~!Ultimately, Pet Shop is defeated by Iggy, but is able to severely injure him by severing his leg in the process.!~ (Source: JJBA wiki)

20799.name: Nukesaku
20799.desc: Nukesaku is a minor antagonist featured in Part III: Stardust Crusaders. He is a henchman of Dio Brando and one of the last vampires in the manga. He apparently suffers abuse from the rest of Dio's allies, being treated as a burden due to his (lack of) power. His stand, The Idiot, is named after an album by Iggy Pop. ~!After his comrades are defeated, Nukesaku attempts to use his ability to defeat Jotaro and company, but is quickly and effortlessly dispatched by them when they discover that his thumbs point in the opposite direction when he is clasping his hands. He is forced to lead the group to Dio and believes that Dio will use this opportunity to defeat the Joestars, but when he removes the lid of his master's coffin, finds himself killed and sectioned to pieces in the coffin instead.!~ (Source: JJBA Wikia)

20799.name: Boingo
20799.desc: Boingo is a young Stand User whose Stand is Tohth. As part of the Egypt 9 Glory Gods, he attempts to assassinate the Joestar Group in Egypt alongside his older brother Oingo and later Hol Horse. Boingo is a young child of ordinary build, but his characteristics include an unusually large mouth and a large afro held together by a topless cap, leaving a few stray hair locks. His attire consists of a bright shirt and trousers over which he wears shorts and a jacket, plus a coat and simple shoes. Tohth is an Artificial Non-Humanoid Stand that takes the form of a manga. The book, titled, Oingo Boingo Brothers Adventure, will show predictions of the future. When an image appears, the prediction(s) then become fate and are destined to come to fruition. However, nobody, not even Boingo, can control the Image projected onto Tohth.

20799.name: Oingo
20799.desc: Oingo is a minor antagonist appearing in Stardust Crusaders. As a part of the Egypt 9 Glory Gods, he attempts to assassinate the Joestar Group alongside his little brother Boingo. His Stand is Khnum, which allows him to disguise himself as anyone.

20799.name: Holly Kuujou
20799.desc: Holly Kuujou née Joestar is the daughter of [Joseph Joestar](https://anilist.co/character/6356/) and mother of [Joutarou Kuujou](https://anilist.co/character/4003/).

20799.name: N'Doul
20799.desc: N'Doul is a man of athletic build and medium height, keeping unkempt dark hair and whose blank eyes are always near shut due to his blindness. He wears a simple T-shirt over which he keeps a stripped overshirt and a drape to protect himself from the sun. N'Doul also wears armbands and simple trousers and shoes. He wears a headband and two earrings which look like bracelets. (Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

20799.name: Roses
20799.desc: Roses is the butler of Joseph Joestar and Suzi Q, also acting as the latter's personal chauffeur and bodyguard.

20799.name: Wilson Phillips
20799.original: ウィルソン・フィリップス
20799.desc: Wilson Phillips is a minor character featured in Stardust Crusaders. Despite being a powerful American Senator, DIO hijacks his car and forces Wilson Phillips to become his chauffeur in order to pursue the Joestar Group in the streets of Cairo.

20799.name: Chaka
20799.desc: Chaka is an Egyptian farmer who found Anubis in a pile of rubble and got possessed, prompting him to go battle Polnareff.

20799.name: Mariah
20799.desc: Mariah is one of the Egypt 9 Glory Gods. She separates the group in Luxor and attempts to take out Joseph and Avdol using her Stand, Bastet, while Alessi confronts the rest of the heroes.

20799.name: Anubis
20799.desc: Anubis is a minor antagonist featured in Stardust Crusaders. It's unique in being a userless Stand who can possess anyone who wields it, and repeatedly tries to kill the Joestar Group's members in Egypt.

20799.name: Alessi
20799.desc: Alessi is one of the Egypt 9 Glory Gods and attempts to assassinate Polnareff in Luxor as Mariah battles Joseph and Avdol. His Stand is Sethan, a rejuvenating shadow.

20799.name: Kenny G.
20799.desc: __Stand:__ Tenore Sax Kenny G. is a minor antagonist featured in Stardust Crusaders. When the Joestar Group enters DIO's Mansion, he casts an illusion on it to make it look like a labyrinth to them but is quickly taken out.

20799.name: Khan
20799.desc: Khan is an ordinary barber and is possessed by Anubis as he gives Polnareff a shave. Consequently, he battles both Polnareff and Jotaro.

20799.name: Malèna
20799.desc: A kind young woman, she nurtures a de-aged Jean Pierre Polnareff after he's injured from his fight against Alessi.

20661.name: Nine
20661.desc: Known as Nine, is one of two members of the Sphinx terrorist group. He grew up in an experimental institution for gifted children with [Twelve](https://anilist.co/character/88096/Twelve), though the both of them managed to escape. Later on, both Nine and Twelve carry out several terroristic acts in Japan. He is reserved, calm and collected, and very, very intelligent. Nine is efficient in many fields, up to exceptional computing and hacking. He's an impeccable strategist, with a knack for chess and classical literature. Good with disguises.

20661.name: Lisa Mishima
20661.desc: Lisa Mishima is a quiet and shy girl who attended the same high school that [Nine](https://anilist.co/character/88094/Nine) and [Twelve](https://anilist.co/character/88096/Twelve) had transferred to. Because of her clumsiness and shyness, she was an easy target for the bullies in her class. As she came to know the two boys, Nine and Twelve, she felt a connection. Like they all had something in common and she had grown attached to them, especially Twelve. Nine didn't see her as very useful when she lived with them. Always in the way and always burning food, you can see why. But Twelve did not feel that way, for he had gotten too involved with her and was very affectionate toward her. Her father and mother are divorced, and her mother is over-protective and appears to be mentally unstable. She holds the fear that Lisa would also one day leave her just like Lisa's father did once.

20661.name: Twelve
20661.desc: Twelve is one of two members of a terrorist group known as Sphinx, working with [Nine](https://anilist.co/character/88094/Nine) as his primary partner. He and Nine grew up together in an institution for children known as the Settlement, and engaged in terrorist activities, with unknown motives. On the outside, he's a typical jokester: light-humored and energetic, enjoying messing around in other people's business. However, he is fully capable and willing to adopt ruthless and violent methods if the situation calls for it. This contradictory set of personality traits are the result of the psychological damage sustained during his stay at the aforementioned children's institution. Nonetheless, he is a loyal and dependable friend, has a genius mind and a keen sense of social justice. He also has a compassionate side, as evidenced by his interactions with [Lisa Mishima](https://anilist.co/character/88095/Mishima-Lisa). ~!Twelve changes dramatically upon interacting with Lisa Mishima. When she runs away, he goes after her against Nine's wishes. He is made by [Five](https://anilist.co/character/88301/Five) to choose between saving Lisa and betraying Nine, and ultimately chooses to save Lisa. However, he later helps Nine out of a sticky situation at great risk to himself. In the final episode, shortly after he, Nine and Lisa are reunited, he is shot and killed by the American government.!~

20661.name: Five
20661.desc: A government operative and a nuclear scientist affiliated with NEST, an organization within the United States FBI. She travels to Japan to assist in investigations regarding the terrorist attack.

20661.name: Kenjirou Shibasaki
20661.desc: A detective in the metropolitan police department. He used to work in the investigations division but now works in the records division. He's a contemporary of the head of the terror incident investigation. He is aloof and lazy, with a reluctance to work, but when push comes to shove and people's lives are in danger he quickly turns into a smart, quick-minded man being able to solve most problems that arise. He is extremely experienced in his field and has a strong sense of justice.

20661.name: Mukasa
20661.desc: Mukasa is Shibazaki's co-worker from the Records Division. He assists Shibazaki in solving the riddles of the Sphinx at the most unlikely of times. He has a carefree personality and is often depicted eating something.

20661.name: Souta Aoki
20661.desc: A former manager within the Ministry of Health and Welfare Guidance Division, he holds information about The Athena Plan.

20661.name: Kurahashi
20661.desc: Works at the police station. He utilizes Shibazaki's detective skills to analyze and resolve the incidents related to Sphinx.

20661.name: Clarence
20661.desc: He's an FBI special agent. He is sent to Japan from the United States government to assist in investigations regarding the Sphinx incidents.

20661.name: Hamada
20661.desc: A bomb specialist working for the Japanese police.

20661.name: Kinoshita
20661.desc: He works at the Technology Crime Division. He belongs to the life safety unit, which performs the crackdown of cyber crime.

20661.name: Hamura
20661.desc: A police officer of the Criminal Division Section 1. He likes solving criminal cases, but he thinks Shibazaki got this job to easily and doesn't get along with him.

20661.name: Okano
20661.desc: A police officer of the Criminal Division Section 1. He is responsible for incidents involving kidnapping or hostages.

100182.name: Kazuto Kirigaya
100182.desc: __Height:__ 172 cm __Weapon(s) of choice:__ Anneal Blade (1st Level), Queen's Knightblade (9th Level), Elucidator (50th level) and Dark Repulser (forged by Lisbeth) Kirito is a "solo" player, a player who hasn't joined a guild and usually works alone. He is also one of the very few people to have had the privilege to play in the beta testing period of Sword Art Online. His game alias, Kirito, is created by taking the syllables of the first and last Kanji of his real last and first names respectively: (Kirigaya Kazuto). In the real world, he lives with his mother and younger sister in a family of 3. When [Kayaba](https://anilist.co/character/36829) announced the start of the death game, he is surprised, but unlike everyone else he quickly gets over it and accepts it to an extent. He invited his friend [Klein](https://anilist.co/character/36830) to go with him but Klein had to find his friends in the game. He was invited to join them but he declined as he couldn't take the pressure of protecting them even with his beta testing knowledge of the game.

100182.name: Asuna Yuuki
100182.desc: __Height:__ 160-168 cm __Weapons of choice:__ Wind Fleuret (1st Floor), Lambent Light (Forged by [Lisbeth](https://anilist.co/character/43906/Shinozaki-Rika)) Asuna is a friend of [Kirito](https://anilist.co/character/36765/Kirigaya-Kazuto) and is a sub-leader of the guild Knights of the Blood (KoB), a medium-sized guild of about thirty players, also called the strongest guild in Aincrad. Being one of the few girls that are in SAO, and even more so that she's extremely pretty, she receives many invitations and proposals. She is a skilled player earning the title "Lightning Flash" for her extraordinary sword skill that is lightning fast. Her game alias is the same as her real world name.

100182.name: Akihiko Kayaba
100182.desc: Director and creator of the Nerve Gear and *Sword Art Online*. He traps all the players within *Sword Art Online* by using the Nerve Gear to cease sending signals to the users' body. Any attempt of removal, loss of power for a certain period, or if the user dies in the game will also kill the user. His motivation is to observe what happens after he traps them. ~!He is in fact Heathcliff in the game *SAO*, who is the leader of the guild Knights of Blood.!~

100182.name: Ryoutarou Tsuboi
100182.desc: A friendly player that meets Kirito at the start of the game and quickly befriends and learns from him. He and Kirito later separate because he has friends who were also new to the game so he couldn't leave them. He survives for the past two years and managed to protect his friends the whole time, something Kirito regretted not doing. He is a katana user and the leader of the small guild Fuurinkazan who participates in the boss battles. As one of the few people close to Kirito, he always keeps him in check and wants Kirito to survive the game. He chose the Salamader race on ALO ~! In the side story Caliber, he fell in love at first sight with the girl on the cage named Freyja and agreed that he will help her find her tribe's treasure which is a hammer, though the decision still remains to be a team's decision. The team said yes on Caliber and it turned out that the girl they saved was Thor. It was revealed that Thor disguised as a beautiful girl to get close to Giant King Þrym and retrieve his hammer. Thor defeated Giant King Þrym and that stopped the medallion from being corrupted and ending the quest. !~

100182.name: Suguha Kirigaya
100182.desc: [Kazuto](https://anilist.co/character/36765)'s sister in the real world. She is 15 years old and in her third year of junior high, as well as a member of the Kendou club. She's a diligent worker and has been practicing Kendou for 8 years. ~!In the VRMMO game *Alfheim Online*, she is known as Leafa, a Sylph fairy. She stumbled onto Kazuto by accident one night and decided to travel with him to the World Tree. She eventually fell in love with him because he showed that he really loves playing VR games as if living in it and is very honest in everything. In the real world she slowly got closer to her brother (actually a cousin) but because they're family and because he already got [Asuna](https://anilist.co/character/36828) as a girlfriend she decided to give up on him and fall in love with Kazuto instead. But soon afterwards she realized that they're the same person. After being convinced by Kazuto to have a fierce duel which ended up in them flying in each others' arms, she decided to help Kazuto in rescuing Asuna.!~

100182.name: Midori Kirigaya
100182.desc: Kirito and Suguha's mother in the real world. After Kazuto got trapped she went to the hospital two months prior to lean by Kazuto's side, eyes brimming with tears and smile bright with gladness that he was still alive.

100182.name: Keiko Ayano
100182.desc: She is a middle level dagger user. She is a very cheerful and sweet girl. She has a very rare familiar, a feathery dragon that she named [Pina](https://anilist.co/character/212810/Pina) after her cat in the real world. She treasured Pina a lot and was the reason she survived in the game. Aside from being a female player, she is also a Beast Tamer and thus perceived as an idol amongst the middle level players. She received endless invitations from parties and guilds who wanted an idol player to join them to get more fame. Because of the attention she got, she became overly proud of herself and left a party one time after a misunderstanding. She got surrounded by monsters and lost Pina in the end. She was then rescued by [Kirito](https://anilist.co/character/36765/Kirigaya-Kazuto) who was passing by and helped her to resurrect the dead familiar.

100182.name: Yui
100182.desc: A young and cheerful girl with long black hair who looks no older than 10 years old. [Kirito](https://anilist.co/character/36765) and [Asuna](https://anilist.co/character/36828) found her in a forest on the 22nd floor of Aincrad. ~!Her true identity is actually a players' self-regulation program for mental maintenance, Mental Health Counseling Program or MHCP. After being forbidden by the game master [Akihiko Kayaba](https://anilist.co/character/36829) to come close to the players at the beginning of the death game, she was flooded with errors and broke down. In the process she became an AI that possesses actual intelligence. When the Cardinal system governing *Sword Art Online* decided to erase her, Kirito turned her into a tear shaped crystal pendant. He actually converted her to a part of environmental data for the client program and was saved to his NerveGear's local memory.!~ ~!In *ALfheim Online*, she was able to return to her normal form because ALO was based on a copy of the SAO server. She supports Kirito there as a Navigation Pixie. Kirito and Asuna still treat her as their daughter.!~

100182.name: Rika Shinozaki
100182.desc: A mace wielder that runs a blacksmith shop in Aincrad on the 48th floor. She made [Asuna](https://anilist.co/character/36828)’s rapier ‘Lament Light’ and one day got a request from [Kirito](https://anilist.co/character/36765) to make him a sword with similar or better quality than his one handed long sword ‘Elucidator’ that he got from a monster drop. She told him that if she had the right materials she could make weapons that would break any sword, so they formed a party and went on a journey to find the material she needed. Because of that journey she came to the conclusion that she felt lonely and yearned for warmth. In ALO she is Leprechaun race blacksmith. ~!She comes to realize that she loves Kirito but after finding out that the one Asuna had feelings for was in fact Kirito she decided to give up on him despite how she feels so Asuna could express her feelings, however during the moments after Kirito's victory and SAO's announcement that the game has been cleared she shouts at the top of her lungs that she loves Kirito and that she will meet him again in the real world, which after the ALO incident she actually does, going to school with him and Asuna.!~

100182.name: Andrew Gilbert Mills
100182.original: アンドリュー・ギルバート・ミルズ
100182.desc: __Height:__ 180cm A merchant stationed at city Algate, located at the 50th floor of Aincrad. His shop motto is "Buy cheap and sell cheap". He is a very strong axe-wielding warrior in the frontlines. Kirito sometimes stays in his shop as sort of a disaster shelter, which he gets annoyed with but later ignores as Asuna also visits, which results in some publicity for his shop. ~!In the real world he is married and owns a Bar called Dicey Cafe!~ ~!In the side story Aria in the Starless Night, he is among the few players who participated in the first floor boss fight and supported Kirito when he knew of the latter's status as a beta tester and later called a Beater. !~ ~!Upon returning to the real world he helps Kirito implement Kayaba's "seed" which allows VR games to be easier accessed throughout the world, also vastly decreasing the large licensing cost that companies would pay in servers.!~

100182.name: Shino Asada
100182.desc: Shino is a skilled VRMMO player. She goes by the name Sinon in *Gun Gale Online* and *Alfheim Online*. She is nicknamed Hecate, after her gun PGM Ultima Ratio Hecate II, a .50 caliber anti-material rare sniper rifle. She is one of the main characters of volumes five and six and first female player that [Kirito](https://anilist.co/character/36765/Kazuto-Kirigaya) meets in *GGO*. She plays *GGO* to overcome her trauma concerning guns. Calm and cool are the two words that best describe Sinon's personality. In battle and most of the time in the game, she keeps a cool head that actually makes other female players admire her. However, Sinon has a violent temper once angered something that is best seen with her interactions with Kirito. It is actually said that Kirito is the first one to make her extremely angry. Despite all this, Sinon, while may be hard to approach, is generally a friendly person and doesn't mind helping others. ~!She becomes a Cait Sith archer in *ALO* where she is capable of hitting targets from 200m away despite her bow being limited to 100m.!~

100182.name: Vassago Casals
100182.desc: Leader and founder of the red guild "Laughing Coffin", known for his large knife and catch phrase "It's show time." His guild was later destroyed by other players in SAO, but his whereabouts are missing. He is presumed to be alive because he wasn't listed as one of the dead players. (Source: SAO Wiki)

100182.name: Atsushi Kanamoto
100182.desc: Johnny Black was a survivor of Sword Art Online, he's a member of the infamous red guild Laughing Coffin and is partnered with Xaxa. He is well known for using poisons and such in battles.

100182.name: Eugeo
100182.desc: Eugeo is the deuteragonist of the first half of the Alicization Arc. Eugeo was a child born in a remote village in the Human Empire of Underworld, where he was assigned the Sacred Task of felling a giant tree with his childhood friend [Kirito](https://anilist.co/character/36765). After a mishap during an adventure to the mountains resulted in his other childhood friend [Alice Zuberg](https://anilist.co/character/75450) being apprehended by an Integrity Knight for breaking the Taboo Index, while his memories of Kirito were sealed by the administrators of the world, Eugeo spent the following six years focusing on his work to avoid thinking about his lost friend, until Kirito's return to Underworld led to Eugeo building the resolve to embark on a journey to become an Integrity Knight himself to rescue Alice, as well as acquiring the skills to wield the Blue Rose Sword he had retrieved from the mountains where Alice had broken the Taboo Index. ~!One year after departing from Rulid Village, Kirito and Eugeo enrolled at the Sword Mastery Academy where Eugeo broke the Taboo Index protecting his valet and her friend from being sexually assaulted by two high-ranked nobles. Kirito and Eugeo were then arrested and brought to prison at the Central Cathedral of the Axiom Church by Integrity Knight Alice Synthesis Thirty, Eugeo's former childhood friend, who no longer had any recollections of her past. After escaping the prison and learning the truth of the world from Cardinal, the duo fou

100182.name: Seijirou Kikuoka
100182.desc: Seijirou Kikuoka is a member of the Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications, Technology, Second Separated Advanced Network Division, or «Virtual Division». He uses the nickname «Chrysheight» in «ALfheim Online»

100182.name: Alice Zuberg
100182.desc: The heroine of Sword Art Online's fourth story arc, Alicization. She is a childhood friend of [Kirito](https://anilist.co/character/36765/Kirigaya-Kazuto) and [Eugeo](https://anilist.co/character/70899/Eugeo). 11 years ago, she broke a taboo in the Taboo Index by entering the Dark Territory by accident, and was later captured by an Integrity Knight of the Axiom Church, the entity that rules the Human World. ~!She later returned as "Alice Synthesis Thirty", devoid of memories before her capture, to arrest Kirito and Eugeo, both who have violated a taboo.!~ ~!She is the very first bottom-up AI developed in the real world, created by RATH, and also the object of interest of the American military.!~

100182.name: Quinella
100182.desc: Quinella was the actual ruler of the Underworld as the highest minister of the Axiom Church.

100182.name: Azurica
100182.desc: Azurica is the dorm supervisor of the novice trainee dorm in the North Centoria's Imperial Sword Mastery Academy in Underworld.

100182.name: Egome Zakkalight
100182.original: イゴーム・ザッカライト
100182.desc: Egome Zakkalight is a competitor in the Zakkaria Sword Arts Tournament. He is of noble blood and a blood relative to the Zakkarian Leader.

100182.name: Cardinal
100182.desc: Cardinal was the embodiment of the Cardinal System in Underworld that had inherited the Cardinal System's sub-process of performing error checks on the main process, which was integrated into Quinella. After her first battle with Quinella, she took refuge in the Great Library Room.

100182.name: Bercouli
100182.desc: __Affiliation:__ Axiom Church __Occupation:__ Swordsman (former), Guardsman (former), Integrity Knight (current) __Weapon:__ Time Piercing Sword __Skills:__ Change time Bercouli, also known as Bercouli Synthesis One, was a supporting character in the Alicization Arc. He is one of the founders of Rulid Village, as well as the leader of the Integrity Knights, and the oldest Integrity Knight in existence. ~!He died from Fatal Bleeding in the aftermath of a battle against Emperor Vecta!~

100182.name: Ronye Arabel
100182.desc: Ronye Arabel is Kirito's valet who learns swordsmanship under him in the Sword Mastery Academy. She is the daughter of a 6th class Noble Family; like Tiese, she entered Sword Mastery Academy trying to raise her family status. She was one of the top 12 of her year, so she became a valet, but what she does not know is that Kirito did not choose her. Instead she was left along with Tiese after all other elite swordsmen selected their valets. The reason for this was that they were from the lowest Noble Class, so none of the noble elite swordsmen wanted to take them as their valets.

100182.name: Selka Zuberg
100182.desc: She is is an apprentice to Sister Azariya and is Alice's sister. She is capable of using Sacred Arts and lives at Rulid's church with the orphans. She dislikes how she is constantly compared to her sister Alice. She takes care of Kirito upon his return to Underworld.

100182.name: Tiese Shtolienen
100182.original: ティーゼ・シュトリーネン
100182.desc: Tiese Shtolienen is Eugeo's former valet who learned swordsmanship under him. She is the eldest daughter of a 6th Class Noble family who entered the Sword Mastery Academy with an intent to rise her family status. She was a valet because she was one of the top 12 of her year, but she stated that it was not because she was a good swordswoman, but instead that it was because the entrance exam was on a Sacred Arts that she was good at. ~!After being saved from two nobles who were trying to rape her by Eugeo and Kirito, she falls in love with Eugeo.!~ (Source: Sword Art Online Wikia)

100182.name: Fanatio
100182.desc: She is the Deputy Knight Leader of the Integrity Knights. Fanatio's weapon of choice is the Heaven Piercing Sword. (Source: Sword Art Online Wiki)

100182.name: Sortiliena Serlut
100182.original: ソルティリーナ・セルルト
100182.desc: Sortiliena Serlut is the mentor of Kirito during his 1st year in the North Centoria Imperial Sword Mastery Academy, and the 2nd-seat elite swordswoman at the Academy where she is known as the "Walking Tactics Manual." She has very long straight hair and can easily be considered beautiful. As an elite-swordswoman, she customized her uniform to a purple one. (Source: Sword Art Online Wiki)

100182.name: Eldrie Woolsburg
100182.original: エルドリエ・ウールスブルーグ

100182.name: Deusolbert
100182.desc: Integrity Knight that arrived to apprehend Alice after she broke the Taboo Index.

100182.name: Fizel
100182.desc: A girl who is an Axiom Church Sister-in-training. Born and raised in Central Cathedral with Linel, they call each other "Nel" and "Zel".

100182.name: Linel
100182.desc: An Axiom Church Sister-in-training, whom Kirito and Eugeo met in Central Cathedral. Often uses honorifics when speaking.

100182.name: Frenica Szeski
100182.desc: is a student at the Sword Mastery Academy in North Centoria in Underworld. She is also the valet of Humbert Zizek.

100182.name: Sister Azalia
100182.desc: She is a teacher at the church in Rulid Village, who taught Sacred Arts to Alice Zuberg and Selka Zuberg. Sister Azariya houses orphans at the church.

100182.name: Gasupht Zuberg
100182.original: ガスフト・ツーベルク
100182.desc: is the Village Chief of Rulid Village. He is the father of Alice and Selka. He presides over a majority of the village ceremonies and rituals.

100182.name: Rinko Koujiro
100182.desc: She is a scientist, as well as the former love interest and co-worker of [Akihiko Kayaba](https://anilist.co/character/36829). She studied at the Toto Institute of Technology in Japan, where she was a part of Shigemura Lab in the institute's Electrical and Electronic Engineering Department.

100182.name: Natsuki Aki
100182.desc: is a nurse who works for the Japan Ground Self-Defense Force (JGSDF) and was assigned by Kikuoka Seijirou to oversee Kirigaya Kazuto's medical condition at «Chiyoda Hospital» when he was hospitalized as well as during his rehabilitation. She is later assigned to watch over Kazuto during the «Death Gun» incident and after Kazuto is injected with succinylcholine.

100182.name: Chudelkin
100182.desc: the Chief Elder of the Axiom Church in Underworld, who worked directly under the highest minister, Quinella.

100182.name: Humbert Zizek
100182.original: ウンベール・ジーゼック
100182.desc: He is a fourth class noble and swordsman-in-training at the North Centoria's Imperial Sword Mastery Academy, as well as Raios Antinous's follower and only friend.

100182.name: Volo  Levantein
100182.original: ウォロ・リーバンテイン
100182.desc: He was the head elite swordsman-in-training at the North Centoria Imperial Master Sword Academy during Eugeo and Kirito's first year at the academy. He graduated as the second-ranked swordsman from the academy after being defeated by Sortiliena Serlut during the graduation tournament and then participated in the Norlangarth North Empire Swordsmanship Tournament, where he was defeated by Eldrie Woolsburg.

100182.name: Takeru Higa
100182.desc: He is the Chief Developer of the «Soul Translator», working under Kikuoka Seijirou in Rath. He helped create «Underworld» as a means to produce «Bottom-Up-Artificial Intelligence» via nurturing a mass number of Artificial Fluctlights, in order to further advance Japan's military force.

100182.name: Raios Antinous
100182.original: ライオス・アンティノス
100182.desc: He was a swordsman-in-training at the Norlangarth Empire's Sword Mastery Academy and was the eldest son of a third class noble family.

100182.name: Gabriel Miller
100182.desc: Chief technology officer of Glowgen Defense Systems and the child of the former president and founder of the company. He was the winner of the 1st and 4th Bullet of Bullets tournament in Gun Gale Online as Subtilizer. ~!Primary antagonist of the War of the Underworld sub-arc of the Alicization Arc. In the Underworld, he is known as Vector, the god of the dark territories. Gabriel plans to steal the Soul Translator technology in order to create his own virtual world where he can analyze souls. In order to achieve that goal, he plans on hunting people with strong souls, especially the Sword Art Online survivors', and steal their Fluctlights.!~

100182.name: Golgorosso Balto
100182.original: ゴルゴロッソ・バルトー
100182.desc: He was Eugeo's mentor during his first year in the North Centoria's Imperial Sword Mastery Academy.

100182.name: Tecchi
100182.desc: He is a close-range, tank-build member of the Sleeping Knights, a guild of terminally ill patients who met in Serene Garden and played various virtual reality games as a form of palliative care. Tecchi had played a variety of virtual reality games, until the guild eventually arrived to ALfheim Online, where Tecchi chose to be a Gnome.

100182.name: Talken
100182.desc: He is a medium-range, damage-dealer member of the Sleeping Knights, a guild of terminally ill patients who met in Serene Garden and played various virtual reality games as a form of palliative care. Talken had played a variety of virtual reality games, until the guild eventually arrived to ALfheim Online, where Talken chose to be a Leprechaun.

100182.name: Pina
100182.desc: is Silica's Feathered Little Dragon and the first known monster to be tamed in Sword Art Online. It understands Silica's commands and will protect her in any way it can, as it is her «Tamed Monster». It is also present in ALfheim Online as her Cait Sith familiar.

100182.name: Takiguri
100182.desc: Eldrie dragon and brother of Amayori.

100182.name: Amayori
100182.desc: Alice's dragon and the brother of Takiguri.

100182.name: Airy
100182.desc: A young-looking girl who was assigned to operate the lifting disc between the 50th and 80th floors of the Underworld Central Cathedral.

100182.name: Sadore
100182.desc: An Underworld resident craftsman who grants Kirito his representative sword in Underworld.

100182.name: Nakanishi
100182.desc: He is a member of the Japanese Self-Defense Forces and an employee of RATH.

100182.name: Alicia Klingerman
100182.original: アリシア・クリンガーマン
100182.desc: She was the childhood friend of Gabriel Miller's, by whom she was murdered during the 2008 Global Financial Crisis.

100182.name: Ugachi
100182.desc: He was the leader of a small scouting party of goblins from the Dark Territory.

100182.name: Zink
100182.desc: An inhabitant of the Rluid town, his task is to monitor who enters the town and verify that they are from there

100182.name: Charlotte
100182.desc: It is a form of artificial intelligence subordinate to Cardinal whose main function has been to observe the young Kirito and Eugeo on their journey to the Central Cathedral in the Underworld.

100182.name: Garitta
100182.desc: Garitta was the sixth generation cutter of the Gigas Cedar in the outskirts of Rulid Village, and the last cutter before Eugeo and Kirito were assigned this Sacred Task.

7054.name: Takumi Usui
7054.desc: __Height:__ 186 cm One of the most popular boys at Seika High, Usui appears to take little interest in anything and prefers to observe things as they unfold, though proves to be extraordinarily talented in numerous areas.

7054.name: Misaki Ayuzawa
7054.desc: __Height:__ 165 cm Misaki is the heroine of Kaichou wa Maid-sama!. She lives alone with her mother and her younger sister [Suzuna](https://anilist.co/character/27982/Ayuzawa-Suzuna), because her father abandoned them, leaving them with a huge debt. ~!She then meets [Usui](https://anilist.co/character/14523/Usui-Takumi), who discovers her working as a maid at the maid café. Misaki thinks Usui will tell the whole school about her working there. Instead, he keeps it a secret under one condition: Misaki has to be his personal maid for the day in order to stay the student council president and keep her part-time job hidden from everyone else.!~ ~!In the manga Usui and Misaki start dating.!~ __Anime only:__ ~!Ayuzawa is confused as to Usui's true feelings the whole series, but in the final episode, they both confess to each other and kiss.!~

7054.name: Aoi Hyoudou
7054.desc: __Height:__ 153 cm Satsuki's nephew, the son of Satsuki's older brother, and a junior high school student who enjoys dressing like a girl. He likes "cute things", and being the center of attention.

7054.name: Shouichirou Yukimura
7054.desc: __Height__: 164 cm The Vice President of the Student Council, Shouichirou Yukimura tries to help Misaki where he can, and enjoys office routine. At first, he, like the rest of the student council, is fearful of Misaki, but he eventually comes to be on fairly close terms with her and Usui. Yukimura is hard-working, earnest, and capable of doing most administrative work, but is not athletic in the least, especially in comparison to Misaki and Usui. His gentle, almost feminine demeanor and slight stature make him appear somewhat weak, a fact he is sensitive about. He's both terrified and awed of Usui, after Usui kisses him as a "reward for his hardwork" (a ruse to restore Misaki's confidence). Yukimura has a seven-year-old sister named Rui.

7054.name: Hinata Shintani
7054.desc: **Height:** 177 cm **Debut:** Chapter 21 He is Misaki-chan's childhood friend. He can eat anything and still be hungry. He works at a gas station. ~!Misaki-chan is Hinata's first love since elementary school, which was when Misaki-chan didn't hate guys. Eventually, after winning the cake eating contest, he finds out that Misaki works in the maid cafe. !~

7054.name: Soutarou Kanou
7054.desc: **Height:** 182 cm A withdrawn male student who is initially against Misaki as the student council President because of her aspirations of increasing the female population of Seika High. ~!In order to sabotage her presidency, Kanou tries to hypnotize Misaki, Usui, and the student council with his pupil-less eyes (one of the very few, random supernatural aspects of the series) into ruining Misaki’s reputation. It is revealed that his gynophobic attitude comes from his mother abandoning his family when he was young and his father warning him to be wary of women, and after failing to hypnotize Misaki, she punishes him by assigning him to work closely with his female classmates during the school's cultural festival, in hopes of forcing him to get over his fear. The punishment is ultimately successful, and he slowly becomes friendlier with Misaki and the rest of his female peers, as well as with Yukimura. Though he runs against Misaki during her re-election as President, he opposes using underhanded means to gain victory, remains on good terms with her, and is genuinely surprised when he realizes his supporters weren't aware of the extent of all that Misaki had accomplished, asking them "didn't you guys already know that the student council president is an incredible person?"!~ (Source: Wikipedia)

7054.name: Tora Igarashi
7054.desc: **Height:** 180 cm The Student Council President at Miyabigaoka High School, he initially appears as a gentleman who marvels at Misaki and the changes she has brought to Seika High, offering her a chance to come to Miyabigaoka with an exceptional loan. ~!He is quickly revealed to be a lecherous young man who has become bored with the women surrounding him, who are easily submissive because of his wealth. He enjoys causing drama around him and he thinks that money can buy anything. Misaki's strong will and outright rejection of his monetary bribe to have her join the Miyabigaoka Student Council captures his interest. It is later revealed that Tora has some ties to or knowledge of Usui's past or background, which he may be exploiting to some as of yet unknown end.!~ (Source: Wikipedia)

7054.name: Kanade Maki
7054.desc: **Height:** 178 cm The Vice President of the Student Council at Miyabigaoka High. ~!He and Igarashi attempt to buy out Café Latte and change it into a butler café. Misaki, Usui, and the Café Latte staff are able to prevent him from realizing his plans through a competition.!~ (Source: Wikipedia)

7054.name: Sakura Hanazono
7054.desc: **Height:** 156 cm A good friend of Misaki's and one of the few female students at Seika High, Sakura is friendly and cheerful and, like the rest of the girls, relies on Misaki for protection from the wild behaviour of the boys. ~!She is quite popular amongst the boys, but frequently rejects their confessions; in particular, she’s rejected ex-rugby captain Masaru Gouda (剛田将, Gōda Masaru) one hundred times. According to Shizuko, Sakura falls in love without carefully considering what the person is really like, as exampled by her persistent feelings for the two-faced, womanising singer Kuuga of a popular band from nearby Yumesaki High.!~ She has high respect for Misaki and despite her constant happy and tolerant attitude, defends Misaki when Kuuga insults her. (Source: Wikipedia)

7054.name: Shizuko Kaga
7054.desc: **Height:** 158 cm One of Misaki and Sakura’s friends, a sensible and intelligent girl who often spends lunchtime with them. Shizuko is a member of the flower arranging club and is good at math, but isn’t very good at physical activities. She has an older brother in university and a younger sister in junior high school; according to Sakura, the three of them look very alike. (Source: Wikipedia)

7054.name: Nagisa Tsuwamono
7054.desc: __Height:__ 162 cm Satsuki’s younger sister and Aoi's aunt, Nagisa is the manager of a beach house known as “Ocean House.” ~!She asks for Satsuki and her employees to come and work at her beach house during the summer since her shop is not as popular as she would like. Nagisa is somewhat tough on Aoi for trying to dress like a girl because her older brother sent Aoi to her beach house to become more masculine. !~ (Source: Wikipedia)

7054.name: Suzuna Ayuzawa
7054.desc: Misaki's younger sister. She is very apathetic and shows little to no emotion. She does not work at any part time jobs and appears to be in middle school. In the anime, she often enters magazine contests and always seems to win food prizes. Her first appearance occurs late in the manga, while she is a frequent recurring character in the anime.

7054.name: Minako Ayuzawa
7054.desc: Misaki's mother. She appears to be somewhat sickly, but does her best to support Misaki and Suzuna by working as a nurse at the hospital. Although she is grateful that Misaki is helping her with their financial problems, she also wants nothing more than for Misaki to have more fun and go out more often as a high school teenager. She becomes acquainted with Usui at the train station in chapter 35 and sees him as a very gentle person and the exact opposite of her husband.

7054.name: Satsuki Hyoudou
7054.desc: **Height:** 158 cm The manager of Café Latte and Misaki’s boss; a 30-year-old woman who has a tendency to voice out her fantasies. She is a cheerful woman who enjoys her job because it allows her to make others happy. She is very understanding of Misaki’s circumstances, knowing that Misaki does not particularly enjoy working at a maid café, and is perceptive of other people’s feelings. Satsuki also ends up hiring Usui as a part-time cook, much to Misaki’s chagrin. (Source: Wikipedia)

7054.name: Honoka
7054.desc: **Height:** 157 cm An employee at Café Latte. She can become somewhat maniacal about getting in character for her job and criticizes Misaki for her initial resistance to acting parts outside of her comfort range, as well as for being ashamed of working at Maid Latte and hiding it from her peers. (Source: Wikipedia)

7054.name: Erika
7054.desc: **Height:** 162 cm A college student working at Café Latte. She notes that Misaki is strong and picks up work quickly, and claims that it doesn't feel like Misaki is younger than her. She has a tendency to eavesdrop and is described as having a “voice fetish.” She is also proud of her bust. (Source: Wikipedia)

7054.name: Subaru
7054.desc: **Height:** 164 cm An employee at Café Latte. Like Honoka, she does not have a full-time job and makes a living from part-time work. She considers Misaki to be hard working. Subaru can be distinguished by her glasses. (Source: Wikipedia)

7054.name: Naoya Shirokawa
7054.desc: __Height:__ 180 cm A male student at Seika High School who initially dislikes Misaki because of her forceful methods of reforming Seika. He and his friends discover that she works at a maid café early on in the story, but after he is defended by Usui, they quickly become her biggest fans, as well as regulars at Cafe Maid Latte, often referred to as the "idiot trio." His nickname is "Shiroyan." He also used to be a delinquent in middle school known as White Demon.

7054.name: Ryuunosuke Kurosaki
7054.desc: __Height:__ 183 cm The third member of the "idiot trio" who frequent Cafe Maid Latte, nicknamed "Kurotatsu". Known for being the perverted one and likes "erotic things". Also used to be a delinquent in middle school with Shiroyan. (Source: Wikipedia)

7054.name: Ikuto Sarashina
7054.desc: __Height:__ 178 cm The second of the "idiot trio", which includes [Shirakawa Naoya](https://anilist.co/character/28197/Naoya-Shirakawa) and [Ryuunosuke Kurosaki](https://anilist.co/character/29387/Ryuunosuke-Kurosaki). A closet otaku, he is actually good at drawing manga illustrations, enjoys writing, and wants to be a mangaka. His friends call him "Ikkun".

7054.name: Takezawa
7054.desc: He attended the same middle school as Misaki.

7054.name: Kenji Sawa
7054.desc: Student Council Accountant.

7054.name: Kiyomasa Katada
7054.desc: Head Disciplinary Officer.

7054.name: Sayu
7054.desc: Employee at Maid Latte.

7054.name: Gon-chan
7054.desc: Employee at Maid Latte.

7054.name: Hirofumi Koganei
7054.desc: The bespectacled Miyabigaoka High School International Chess Club President who looks down upon Seika students. (Source: Wikipedia)

7054.name: Kuuga Sakurai
7054.desc: **Height:** 164 cm Kuuga is the vocalist of band UxMishi (ユメミシ, Yumemishi). While he seems sweet and kind to his fans, in reality he is very arrogant, rude and insensitive to others' feelings. It is due to his attitude that Misaki Ayuzawa dislikes him as he was very insensitive to Sakura Hanazono's feelings while hitting on Misaki herself. ~!Later on, he seems to change, gaining feelings for Sakura since she is the only one who earnestly cares for him. !~ (Source: Kaichou wa Maid-sama! Wikia)

7054.name: Masaru Gouda
7054.desc: **Height:** 181 cm He has been rejected by Sakura one hundred times.

7054.name: Takashi Hagimoto
7054.desc: Commentator of Seika High Sports Festival. Broadcasting Head of the Student Council. One of the committee heads who is given much attention in the show.

7054.name: Hayase Kouta
7054.desc: Head Health Officer

7054.name: Bunta Kosugi
7054.desc: Assistant Clerk. Secretary of the Student Council.

7054.name: Gouki Aratake
7054.desc: He appears in an extra chapter of the manga, in which it's revealed that he was Shirakawa's underclassman and that he looks up to his upperclassman because in the past he was saved by him.

7054.name: Kou
7054.desc: Bassist of UxMishi. Although he is part of the band, Kou is more down to earth and respects his fans. He is seemingly one of the closer people to the band's leader, Kuuga.

7054.name: Shou
7054.desc: Guitarist of UxMishi

7054.name: Yuuji William Adam
7054.desc: Drummer of UxMishi.

7054.name: Yuuta Utsumi
7054.desc: Cleaning Rep who's always afraid of Misaki.

7054.name: Ruri Yukimura
7054.desc: **Debut:** Episode 20 She is Yukimura's younger sister.

7054.name: Chinatsu Aramaki
7054.desc: Sports Executive of the Student Council.

7054.name: Eita Yoshino
7054.desc: Culture Executive of the Student Council.

99539.name: Narrator
99539.desc: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

99539.name: Meliodas
99539.desc: __Race:__ ~!Demon!~ __Height:__ 152cm (5'0") Meliodas the leader of the Seven Deadly Sins and the Sin of Wrath with the symbol of the Dragon. He is the main protagonist of the Nanatsu no Taizai and the owner of the Boar Hat bar.

99539.name: Elizabeth Liones
99539.original: エリザベス・リオネス
99539.desc: Elizabeth Liones is the third adoptive princess of the Kingdom of Liones Originally an alleged survivor of Danafor's destruction, Elizabeth was adopted and raised by the king [Bartra Liones](https://anilist.co/character/131565/Bartra-Liones). After the Holy Knights rebel, she sets on journey to find Seven Deadly Sins, becoming a waitress for [Meliodas](https://anilist.co/character/72921/Meliodas-)' tavern Boar Hat. ~!She is 107th and current incarnation of the Goddess Elizabeth, and the lover of Meliodas, captain of the Seven Deadly Sins. She is the deuteragonist of the series.!~

99539.name: Gilthunder
99539.desc: __Height:__ 185 cm (6'1") One of the holy knights of the Britannia kingdom. He is a Diamond-ranked Holy Knight.

99539.name: Diane
99539.desc: Diane is a member of the Seven Deadly Sins and is The Sin of Envy with the symbol of the Serpent. She is also a member of the Giant's Clan. She is a fair maiden with pink eyes and medium length brown hair which is tied up into Mega Twintails. Despite being a beautiful looking maiden, she is in fact a giant from the giant clan, and is several times larger than ordinary humans. She wears a one piece orange suit, boots that extend almost up to the knees, and a metal armband which is embedded with shiny metal pebbles. Her current outfits and attire is believed to be the most fashionable ones. She wears an orange colored short sleeved bodysuit and boots. As the Serpent's Sin of Envy, her main traits are jealousy and envy. She shows strong affection for Meliodas, so when she met him together with Elizabeth, she grew very jealous and threw him away whilst calling him a cheater. In contrary with Elizabeth who wants to be strong and powerful, she wants to be small.

99539.name: Ban
99539.desc: __Height:__ 210 cm Ban is a member of the Seven Deadly Sins and is The Sin of Greed with the symbol of the Fox. He was imprisoned in the Baste Dungeon.

99539.name: King
99539.desc: __Height:__ 165 cm King is a member of the Seven Deadly Sins and is the Sin of Sloth with the symbol of the Grizzly. He is also Oslo's master. King's real identity is Fairy King Harlequin, the king of the fairy race.

99539.name: Guila
99539.desc: Geera is a Holy Knight who left herself in a near-death state to have access to the Capital of the Dead and kill the Deadly Sins who had gone there. She is a young female with a slim build. She has long black hair and her eyes are depicted as if they are closed.

99539.name: Dreyfus
99539.desc: Dreyfus is one of the current Great Holy Knights, thus also making him one of the two people who have command over the entirety of Britannia after the coup d'état. His attire consists of a standard set of a Holy Knight's armor that has a spike on each shoulder. He has long black hair that reaches up to his shoulder, with a short beard.

99539.name: Hendricksen
99539.desc: Hendricksen is one of the current Great Holy Knights, thus also making him one of the two people who have command over the entirety of Britannia after the coup d'état. He wears a set of and covers it with a robe on top. He has short light-colored hair and also a goatee. Hendricksen is a serious man, who, like Dreyfus, appears to be willing to capture the king and enslave the citizens to prepare for the Holy War. However, he also seems to be plotting something.

99539.name: Elaine
99539.desc: Elaine is King's sister, and the Guardian Saint of the Fountain of Youth. She has long and thin eyelashes, and cut hair that reaches her neck. She wears a single white one-piece dress which is tied together with a butterfly knot at the back. Elaine is shown to be a kind, caring and forgiving girl.

99539.name: Hawk
99539.desc: Hawk is a talking pig and Meliodas's companion. He is introduced as the cleaner of the Boar Hat bar who helps clean the disgusting food scraps. He is a relatively large pink pig who wears an earring with the word star boar on his left ear. His body is well rounded and his legs are fairly short. He has a unique patch of black spots shaped like a four-leafed clover. His body and appearance are fairly similar to a typical Gloucestershire Old Spots Pig.

99539.name: Howzer
99539.desc: Hauser is a Holy Knight, a colleague and partner of Gilthunder, and a subordinate of the Great Holy Knight, Dreyfus. He wears a set of Holy Knight armor and has short light-colored curled up hair. Hauser demonstrates a lot of self confidence and is very optimistic, which is the complete opposite of Gilthunder's personality; he is also shown to be somewhat naive and stupid.

99539.name: Veronica Liones
99539.desc: Veronica is the second princess of Britannia.
