The younger sibling of the first princess, [Margaret](https://anilist.co/character/126382/Liones-Margaret), and elder to her adopted sister; the third princess, [Elizabeth](https://anilist.co/character/72923/Liones-Elizabeth). She has a tomboyish appearance, short light colored hair and a slim build. She wears a stylish fur coat, a knight-styled attire, a belt and a pair of long boots. She is described to be a tomboy, who, as a child, liked to and often used to play with swords with the boys, and would be scolded by her father for doing so. Sharing the Holy Knights' attitude about enslaving the citizens, she also cares about her younger sister, Elizabeth.

99539.name: Jericho
99539.desc: Jericho is an apprentice Holy Knight who served under the Weird Fangs. She was stationed at the Baste Dungeon, where the Deadly Sin, Ban was imprisoned. She is young woman of slim build, with light hair that is swept over the left side of her face and tied into a ponytail at the back. She wears a black coat over her armor, adorned with a cross on the left side and larger cross covering the back. Underneath her armor are similarly fashioned black clothes. Metal gauntlets cover her arms, while metal greaves and sabatons cover her legs and feet. Jericho is a proud and serious individual. She is stern in her command over the guards of Baste Dungeon and overconfident in her abilities, appearing arrogant at times, which led to her humiliation by Ban.

99539.name: Griamor
99539.desc: Griamor is a Holy Knight who comes from a lineage of Holy Knights that have served the kingdom of Lyonesse for many generations. He is Veronica's bodyguard, and shows absolute loyalty towards her. Griamor is a very tall and muscular individual who is at least twice the height of ordinary civilians, and has grey shoulder length hair. His attire consists of a single-spiked helmet, full leg armor and no upper body clothing, except a mysterious metal plate strapped around his chest with two straps. He also wears a glove on one hand and a sleeve-armor on the other arm. He, like many other Holy Knights, is heartless and cruel. Although he is ruthless, he shows absolute loyalty to Veronica and cannot allow himself to displease her, having started to serve her at a quite young age, even role-playing as a horse for her to ride on as a child.

99539.name: Gowther
99539.desc: __Height:__ 175 cm (5'9") (Human size), 23 - 24 cm (0'9") (doll) He is shown to be completely clueless and unaware of others' feelings, not understanding the meaning of friendship. He often states things factually, not understanding how what he says can upset people. He decides to assist [Elizabeth](https://anilist.co/character/72923/Liones-Elizabeth) on her journey, not because of a desire for justice, but because he felt obligated as a member of the Seven Deadly Sins. Since Gowther doesn't understand emotions, he goes to great length to understand them. For example, observing [Meliodas](https://anilist.co/character/72921/Meliodas) and [Ban](https://anilist.co/character/77605/Ban)'s friendship.

99539.name: Merlin
99539.desc: She is a member of the Seven Deadly Sins. She has the mark of the boars sin of gluttony. She was regarded as the greatest mage in Britannia and is the master of [Vivian](https://anilist.co/character/131564) as well as a teacher of [King Arthur of Camelot](https://anilist.co/character/122210). She came to the aid of the sins in their battle against [Hendirkson](https://anilist.co/character/86679) but had to leave to tend to the King. She has not officially rejoined the sins but said she would as soon as she was finished with her other business.

99539.name: Escanor
99539.desc: __Race:__ Human __Height:__ 165-325 cm (5'5"-10'8") A member of the Seven Deadly Sins and is known as Lion's Sin of Pride. He is renowned for gaining immense power during the day, and gradually becoming weaker with the setting of the sun, leaving him frail and submissive at night. His Sacred Treasure is the Divine Axe Rhitta. His inherent power is named Sunshine.

99539.name: Arthur Pendragon
99539.original: アーサー・ペンドラゴン
99539.desc: Named the king of Camelot after pulling a sword from the stone that hundreds of holy knights could not. Arthur is a polite, young man who is still adjusting to his role as king. He takes his responsibilities very seriously, but usually undertakes them with a smile and has a very warm, and happy-go-lucky demeanor. He marched toward the kingdom of Liones with an army of illusions created by Merlin in hopes of meeting with the king; however, he was confronted by Hendricksen who tried to kill him before Meliodas came to his aide. (Source: MyAnimeList)

99539.name: Margaret Liones
99539.original: マーガレット・リオネス
99539.desc: The first princess of the Kingdom of Liones. The elder sibling of the second princess, Veronica and of her adopted sister; the third princess, Elizabeth.

99539.name: Melascula
99539.desc: Melascula is a warrior of the Demon Clan, serving directly under the Demon King as the Faith of the Ten Commandments.

99539.name: Estarossa
99539.desc: Estarossa is a member of the ten commandments, and the second son of the Demon King. ~! It is later revealed that he is Mael, one of the Four Archangels of the Goddess Clan and the initial possessor of the magic ability "Sunshine". !~

99539.name: Gloxinia
99539.desc: Gloxinia is an elite warrior of the Demon Clan, serving directly under the Demon King as the Repose of the Ten Commandments. ~!He is also a former king of the Fairy King's Forest and the first to hold the title, however, he abandoned that position long ago. !~

99539.name: Zeldris
99539.desc: __Height:__ 152 cm (5'0") Zeldris is a demon who is a member of the Ten Commandments, a group of elite warriors of the Demon Clan handpicked by the Demon King himself. He was sealed away along with the rest of the clan in the Coffin of Eternal Darkness until he was set free by Hendrickson.

99539.name: Zaratras
99539.desc: Zaratras was a Great Holy Knight and was once the strongest in the order of Liones' Holy Knights before his death ten years prior to the beginning of series. He is also the father of the Holy Knight, Gilthunder, and was the Seven Deadly Sins' superior.

99539.name: Liz
99539.desc: Liz, or Elizabeth, was a knight from an enemy kingdom of Danafor, which attempted night ambush at Danafor, but got captured and sentenced to death. She was saved by Meliodas, the leader of the Holy Knights of Danafor and ended up living in Danafor and eventually also became Meliodas' lover. She is believed to have been killed during Danafor's complete annihilation.

99539.name: Fraudrin
99539.desc: Fraudrin is a demon who has been using Dreyfus' body as a vessel for the past 10 years. He is a secondary antagonist of the Kingdom Infiltration arc, having conspired to resurrect the Demon Clan with the help of Hendrickson. He is not an official member of the Ten Commandments.

99539.name: Grayroad
99539.desc: Grayroad is a demon who is a member of the Ten Commandments, a group of elite warriors of the Demon Clan handpicked by the Demon King himself.

99539.name: Vivian
99539.desc: Vivian is an enigmatic Holy Knight once directly serving under Great Holy Knight [Hendrickson](https://anilist.co/character/86679/Hendricksen) and used to be an apprentice of [Merlin](https://anilist.co/character/89180/Merlin), the Boar's Sin Gluttony. Vivian is regarded as the kingdom of Liones' greatest mage.

99539.name: Bartra Liones
99539.desc: The eleventh king of Liones and father of Elizabeth. He was held captive after the Seven Deadly Sins were framed for killing the great holy knight Zaratras.

99539.name: Derieri
99539.desc: Derieri is an elite warrior of the Demon Clan, serving directly under the Demon King as the Purity of the Ten Commandments.

99539.name: Gustav
99539.desc: Gustaf is a Ruby ranked Holy Knight and Jericho's older brother.

99539.name: Drole
99539.desc: Drole , is the member of the Ten Commandments and the possessor of the commandment of Patience

99539.name: Matrona
99539.desc: Matrona is a warrior chief of the Giant Clan, as well as the mentor of Diane and Dolores.

99539.name: Denzel Liones
99539.desc: Denzel Liones is the Assistant Great Holy Knight and Captain of the Pleiades of the Azure Sky. He is also the younger brother of King Bartra Liones.

99539.name: Galand
99539.desc: Galand is a demon who is a member of the Ten Commandments, a group of elite warriors of the Demon Clan handpicked by the Demon King himself. He was sealed away along with the rest of the clan in the Coffin of Eternal Darkness until he was set free by [Hendrickson](https://anilist.co/character/86679/Hendricksen).

99539.name: Monspeet
99539.desc: __Height:__ 182 cm (5'11") Monspeet is a demon who is a member of the Ten Commandments, a group of elite warriors of the Demon Clan handpicked by the Demon King himself. He was sealed away along with the rest of the clan in the Coffin of Eternal Darkness until he was set free by [Hendrickson](https://anilist.co/character/86679/Hendricksen).

99539.name: Jenna
99539.desc: Jenna is one of the head of the Druids along with her sister Zaneli in their sacred land Istar.

99539.name: Zeal
99539.desc: Guila's younger brother

99539.name: Zaneri
99539.desc: Zaneri is one of the head of the Druids along with her sister Jenna in their sacred land Istar

99539.name: Dolores
99539.desc: Dolores is a member of the Giant Clan and a friend of Diane.

99539.name: Theo
99539.desc: Theo is a priest in the Druids sacred land Istar, serving as protector of the heads of the Druids.

99539.name: Arbus
99539.desc: Arbus is a priest who joined the Great Fight Festival for unknown purposes.

99539.name: Invisible
99539.desc: Invisible is a fairy who only shows herself to Deathpierce and acts as his informant.

99539.name: Zhivago
99539.desc: ~!is a werefox who was imprisoned at the Aberdeen Prison and who raised Ban in his youth and taught him how to steal.!~

99539.name: Solaseed
99539.desc: Solaseed is a troubadour who joined the Great Fight Festival for an unknown purpose.

99539.name: Puora
99539.desc: Puora is a fairy who lives in the Fairy King's Forest.

99539.name: Selion
99539.desc: ~! is a werefox who was killed by a group of Holy Knights and the biological son of Zhivago.!~

99539.name: Rosa
99539.desc: Rosa is a mysterious woman who helped Escanor escape from his family who were hunting him down for attacking his brother, Daymond.

99539.name: Majin Ou
99539.desc: The Demon King is the ruler of the Demon Clan. He is the one who handpicked the Ten Commandments and granted them their Commandments.He is also the father of Meliodas, Estarossa, and Zeldris, three of the most powerful members of the Demon Clan.

99539.name: Torah
99539.desc: Torah is one of the Assassin Knights of Malachia who joined the Great Fight Festival for an unknown purpose.

99539.name: Slader
99539.desc: Slader was kidnapped and raised as a child by savages who held no regard for his worth as a human. After being freed by the king of Liones he pledged loyalty and resolved to hunt down any who wronged the kingdom. He is a member of Dawn Roar who holds a rivalry against Gowther of the Seven Deadly Sins.

99539.name: Deathpierce
99539.desc: Deathpierce is a Holy Knight and a member of the Pleiades of the Azure Sky, who serve under the assistant to the Great Holy Knight, Denzel.

99539.name: Golgius
99539.desc: A holy knight of the weird fangs. Golgius uses underhanded and deceitful tactics in order to get his way. Contracts a doctor to poison Melodidas while holding his daughter hostage and making off with Elizabeth and his sword, also tries to assassinate Melodidas while holding his hands up in surrender. He has the power of transparency, which he claims to be teleportation

99539.name: Arden
99539.desc: Arden is a Holy Knight of Liones who serves under Denzel as a member of the Pleiades of the Azure Sky.

99539.name: Nerobasta
99539.desc: Nerobasta is a member of the Goddess Clan.

99539.name: Jigumo
99539.desc: Jigumo is one of the Assassin Knights of Malachia who joined the Great Fight Festival for an unknown purpose.

99539.name: Ende
99539.desc: Ende is a fellow Fairy that lived in the Fairy King's Forest. Ende seems to be a gentle, but somewhat emotional fairy. Unlike most fairies she didn't really show actual hatred towards King, and was the only one to talk to him without accusing him of betrayal or even looking at him angrily, though she seems to be at least upset.

99539.name: Estaro
99539.desc: Estaro is one of the Assassin Knights of Malachia who joined the Great Fight Festival for an unknown purpose.

99539.name: Gerheade
99539.desc: Gerheade is the old advisor of the previous Fairy King.

99539.name: Cain Barzard
99539.desc: Cain is a short elderly man with combed hair, and a long mustache and beard. He also wears a clock, and his eyes seem to be always closed. Under his cloak, Cain wears trousers, and a long shirt that bears the crest of Danafor. He seem like a drunk, and strange, weak old man but deep down he might be a powerful fighter and wanted to have revenge on Meliodas for destroying their kingdom long time ago, he seem to be shock when he found out he wasn't Meliodas' son and that he didn't age.

99539.name: Deldry
99539.desc: Deldry is a Holy Knight and a member of the Pleiades of the Azure Sky, who serve under the assistant to the Great Holy Knight, [Denzel](https://anilist.co/character/131570/Liones-Denzel).

99539.name: Waillo
99539.desc: Waillo is a Platinum-ranked Holy Knight and a member of the Pleiades of the Azure Sky, who serve under the assistant to the Great Holy Knight, Denzel.

99539.name: Ganon
99539.desc: Gannon is a corrupt Holy Knight of the Kingdom of Liones responsible for plotting the death of the giantess chieftain, Matrona, sixteen years ago.

99539.name: Daymond
99539.desc: Daymond is Escanor's older brother and prince of their kingdom. Daymond was the reason Escanor was exiled from their kingdom.

99539.name: Nanashi
99539.desc: Nanashi is a foreign swordsman who joined the Great Fight Festival for an unknown purpose.

99539.name: Weinheidt
99539.desc: Weinheidt was a member from the group of Holy Knights, Dawn Roar and was the marksman of the team. Weinheidt was a well-built man with a short beard and mustache and wears a set of medieval archer clothing with a small cloak draped around his shoulders. Like the other Dawn Roar members, Weinheidt was willing to kill anybody for the mission. He was faithful to whatever mission his team is assigned to and doesn't care about the motives behind the mission as long as the job gets done, although he can be curious sometimes. Despite the Holy Knights' coup, Weinheidt retains his loyalty to the king along with his teammates when Baltra ordered Dawn Roar to stop Slader from hurting himself, to which Weinheidt complied.

99539.name: Friesia
99539.desc: Friesia is a Holy Knight with the ability to manipulate insects. Belonging to the infamous Weird Fangs stationed at Baste Dungeon, she aided in the capture of the Deadly Sin, Ban.

99539.name: Taizoo
99539.desc: is a mountain bandit-turned merchant, and a three-time champion of Vaizel's annual fight festival

99539.name: Ruin
99539.desc: A holy knight of the weird fangs whom wishes to bring ruin to the seven deadly sins. Claims his body is his true armor, and more durable than steel. Hypnotizes both Melodidas and Diane into fighting each other with his bell. Easily defeated by Melodidas after Elizabeth tore the hypnotizing bell off his staff.

99539.name: Marmas
99539.desc: Marmas is a Holy Knight. He led Guila and Jericho in the assault on Byzel

99539.name: Simon
99539.desc: is a Holy Knight and a member of Dawn Roar

99539.name: Hawk Mama
99539.desc: She is Hawk's mother and the extremely large, green pig who transports the Boar Hat bar. She is introduced to live underground and transports the bar Boar Hat with her head. So far, her name remains unknown but she has gained many aliases.

99539.name: Dogedo
99539.desc: Platinum Holy Knight in the service of the Liones Kingdom. He is a member of the Pleiades of the Azure Sky, serving under the Assistant Great Holy Knight, Denzel Liones.

99539.name: Helbram
99539.desc: Helbram is a Holy Knight, Geera's master, and the subordinate of the Great Holy Knight, Hendricksen. He wears a set of copper-colored full body armor, adorning it with a purple coat on top. He usually covers his face with a unique helm with a skyblue crest on it. Helbram has a serious personality, but also a playful side, which is seen when he jokes that Meliodas' decoration of Geera's face was not very bad. Helbram was also shown to like doing research, even taking notes during battle. ~!During the fighting festival in the Byzel Arc, he disguised himself as a referee with the alias of Love Helm.!~

8074.name: Saeko Busujima
8074.desc: __Height:__ 172 cm A high school senior and president of the school's kendo club, she is extremely skilled with a bokken and close combat. Calm and collected with a sense of pride in her skills and those that she's with, Saeko is among the most reliable of the group. Everyone can count on her combat skills to pull them through a tough spot if need be. Not much is known about her family except for her father who had traveled abroad on a self-defense conference before the advent of the Outbreak. She has shown fondness towards Takashi and believes in his abilities to get them through the crisis. ~!Four years prior to the start of the story, a man had attempted to assault her. Armed with her bokken, she easily disposed of the would-be assailant, breaking several of his bones before the police came. This experience revealed her sadistic tendencies; she enjoyed holding the power to inflict pain on another human being. In addition to her reliance on killing the undead in order to survive, Saeko continually struggles with this part of her self, which causes momentary weaknesses in her otherwise strong demeanor. After telling Takashi her story and encountering a group of undead afterwards, for a second Saeko considers letting herself get taken away. She is stopped by Takashi who restores her confidence and resolve. After this she accepts herself and promises to continue fighting with Takashi whom she now counts on to be responsible for her actions.!~

8074.name: Rei Miyamoto
8074.desc: __Height:__ 164 cm __Weight:__ 50 kg Classmate and childhood friend of Takashi, they've known each other since kindergarten. When they were little she promised that one day she would marry him. Despite liking Takashi, their relationship was at odds at the beginning of the manga due to his indecisiveness. It was then that she started dating one of his friends, Hisashi, since he wouldn't make a move. As the story progressed they ended up reconciling their relationship. She doesn't find it above herself to reprimand Takashi for acting carelessly. She worries about his well-being yet admits that his selflessness nature is one reason why she fell in love with him. Headstrong and reliable, Rei has proven to be a skilled combatant and strong asset to the group. Initially in the same year as Saeko, Rei was held back despite being an excellent student. Her father- a police detective- had been investigating the corruption behind the father of Shido, one of the teachers at her school. As a result of this he held her back purposefully. Rei bears a lasting grudge against him and feels uneven whenever he's around. After having escaped the high school and resting at the family mansion of Saya, she and the group are in search of their parents. (Source: Wikipedia)

8074.name: Takashi Komuro
8074.desc: A sophomore high school student, Takashi is in the same class as Rei whom he has been friends with since childhood,He's loved her ever since she made a childhood promise to marry him when they were older. However it was his hesitance and ignorance about her feelings that caused tension in their friendship which led to her starting to date his friend Hisashi. He was one of the first people to notice that something was wrong in the school and quickly took action to escape with his friends. His relationship with Rei was shaken further when he was forced to kill her boyfriend after he was bitten and had turned into a zombie. Soon afterwards their relationship was amended. His resolve to protect Rei at all costs and everyone else in the group earned him their respect and admiration as a leader despite his own feelings of inadequacy. He often acts brash and will go out to risk his life to save or protect someone on a whim. Similar to Saeko, Takashi confessed that he's found an exhilaration in killing "them". Though initially depicted as a poor student who often skips class, he's proven to be a very reliable person that all the characters can count on. Saya Takagi has once mentioned that he and Kohta are the most likely to snap if things keep going the way they are. Like the rest of the group, Takashi is determined to find his parents and to make sure that they're safe.

8074.name: Shizuka Marikawa
8074.desc: __Height:__ 174 cm The school nurse at Fujimi High School, she is rather ditsy as compared to the rest of the girls in the group. Her large bust size is often used as a comical element in the story. A 26-year-old bachelorette, she lives with Rika Minami, a sniper of Japan's Special Assault Team. Her home was used as a safe haven for the group once they escaped high school. As a nurse, she is responsible for the health and care of everyone in the group and is efficient at doing so. Despite being the only adult in the group, she is emotionally fragile and doesn't know what will become of her life since the Outbreak started. Like the rest of the main characters, Shizuka worries that she will never see her family or friends again.

8074.name: Kouta Hirano
8074.desc: __Height:__ 158 cm __Weight:__ 88.8 kg A 16-year-old sophomore student who was often bullied in school, Kouta is a gun otaku and knows the ins and outs of the firearms and any military-related equipment that the group may come​ across. At the beginning of the story he helped Saya Takagi escape danger, though only did so by following her orders. His skills as a marksman have proven to be a valuable asset to keeping everyone alive. On a one-month trip to America he was trained by the US military contractor Blackwater USA which furthered his obsession over weapons. His crush on Saya is one-sided as he on occasion tries to ask her out only to be rejected. Before leaving the family mansion of Saya, her father entrusted her safety to him and Takashi. Saya Takagi has once mentioned that he and Takashi are the most likely to snap if things keep going the way they are. He's grown very attached to Alice with whom he is often around playing with. The character Kouta Hirano from the manga series Highschool of the Dead is based on the famous mangaka with the same name that made "Hellsing", Kouta Hirano. (Source: Wikipedia)

8074.name: Saya Takagi
8074.desc: __Height:__ 155 cm __Weight:__ 52 kg First making her escape with fellow classmate Kohta Hirano, she is the daughter of an influential Uyoku dantai politician and her family is deeply involved in Japan's politics. A self-proclaimed genius, Saya's knowledge, and deductive capabilities have allowed the group to escape from harm. She was among the first to conclude that "they" were attracted to only sound. Despite coming from a prestigious family she despises her parents whom she thought had given up on her in this crisis. It was before their escape from the mansion that she managed to make up with her parents. Other than Rei, she is the only one who has a history with Takashi Komuro since they were children and is assumed to having deeper feelings for him. Slightly self-conscious, she detests the fact that people neither address her by her first name nor look her in the eyes while speaking. The only exception to this is Kohta with whom she has a strange friendship. Saya's grown very attached to Alice and acts as a mother figure in this time of crisis. She does her best to keep intact Alice's innocence and will severely scold anyone who would dare tarnish that to any degree. (Source: Wikipedia, HotD wiki)

8074.name: Hisashi Igou
8074.desc: Rei's classmate and boyfriend, he, Takashi, and Rei were among the first to try and escape the rampage at the school. On their way out of class he was bitten by an infected teacher and subsequently turned into one of "them" afterward​. Aware of his fate he instructed Takashi to kill him just as he turned. A brief bitterness between Rei and Takashi occurred as a result of his death.

8074.name: Alice Maresato
8074.desc: Only 7 years old she was saved from being attacked by several undead by Takashi after her father was killed by members of a household who wouldn't allow them safety. Innocent and passive, Alice is the only member of the group that maintains a cheerful attitude despite all their troubles and the loss of her parents. Looking up to everyone in the group as a bigger brother and sister, she is unwilling to leave them even if it's for her own safety. Alice is often seen playing around with a small dog named Zeke whom they had picked up while saving Alice, and Kohta who she has grown fairly attached too. Presiding over her as a mother figure is Saya whom she has also grown attached too. Later in the series, Alice often aids Kouta by handing him magazines for his firearm while the group is under attack. (Source: Wikipedia)

8074.name: Rika Minami
8074.desc: Rika is the chief of first squadron in the prefecture police and an expert sniper in the Special Assault Team sent to clear the nearby airport of any zombie stragglers. She is close friends with Marikawa Shizuka and has the desire to go and save her from the outbreak of zombies. Unknown to her, they had stayed at her residence and have fled in her Humvee. She has been held up in the same airport alongside surviving passengers who were supposed to fly out with surviving Special Assault Team and Special Security Team operatives alongside airport security guards, customs officers and firefighters in clearing the airport of any stragglers by reducing the zombie strength. When her partner/observer helped her use the jet fuel in a tanker to immolate the zombies. She later receive a phone call from Shizuka and they have a very brief conversation before the whole area goes into a massive blackout due to an EMP surge that cuts off all communications and vehicle engines. She has not been seen from since, and it is unknown what happened to her afterwords.

8074.name: Kyouko Hayashi
8074.desc: Appears in episode 1. ~!She is among the first to be seen bitten by "them"!~ In the manga, it is said she was the ping pong club's adviser.

8074.name: Toshimi Niki
8074.desc: Toshimi Niki is a student at Fujimi Academy and the best friend of Mizusu Ichijou ~!Durining the outbreak at school, Toshiki and Mizusu are first seen trying at escape while holding hands as a friendship. As they try to escape, one of them grabs her in near stars pull her behind and got bitten. Toshimi begs Mizusu to save her. But Mizusu refuses and kick her in the process!~

8074.name: Misuzu Ichijou
8074.desc: Misuzu is shortly seen in the first episode running with her friend, Toshimi. ~!Zombies grab Toshimis leg and she screams for help but Misuzu kicks her to the zombies yelling at her to let go. Zombies come up behind Misuzu and it's assumed she get's killed by them.!~

8074.name: Wakisaka
8074.desc: Appears in episode 1 ~!He bites Hisashi!~

8074.name: Okada
8074.desc: Appears in episode 2.

8074.name: Kazu Ishii
8074.desc: Appears in episode 2. ~! He tries to fight off zombies to protect Shizuka, he get's bitten and Saeko kills him by his own choosing.!~

8074.name: Takuzou
8074.desc: A student at Fujimi High School who falls victim to the living dead in "Democracy Under The DEAD".

8074.name: Naomi
8074.desc: A student from Fujimi High School. Possibly be Takuzou's partner after willingly coming back for him even after being bitten by "them".

8074.name: Yuriko Takagi
8074.desc: Souichiro's wife and Saya's mother. Yuriko was once a New York Stock Broker who later married her future husband after she was impressed with his charisma and political skills. Thanks to her business connections, the Takagi family fortune rises significantly. She is very faithful to her husband and loves her daughter very much. She was last seen with her husband and other survivors fighting against the horde that breach their estate.

8074.name: Souichirou Takagi
8074.desc: The father of Saya Takagi, he is also the leader of a extreme nationalist right-wing group.

8074.name: Ichirou Shidou
8074.desc: Shidou Kouichi's father and an influential politician. It was him that made Kouichi hold back Rei for a year to put pressure on her father, a police officer, who was investigating against him.

8074.name: Miku Yuuki
8074.desc: Yuuki is a second-year at Fujimi High School.She is regarded as the sexiest student in their school. She was known to have some "strang talk" surrounding her at school. She escaped with Fujimi Academy's other survivors and stayed with Shidos group, finding pleasure in their debauchery.She has been manipulated like the others that was in Shido's group. She helped Shido enter the Takagi compound by using her sex appeal, but she was forced to leave like everyone else that came with Shido.She has also survived the accident Shido had after the EMP and had subsequently escaped. After that, she is later seen at the school where the evacuation is taking place.

8074.name: Zeke
8074.desc: Zeke is a puppy with white coat and black ear flaps that Komuro's group took in as a member. He also wears a red dog collar with a bone ornament that hangs at its front.

151801.name: Narrator
151801.desc: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

151801.name: Mash Burnedead
151801.original: マッシュ・バーンデッド
151801.desc: __Height:__ 171 cm The main protagonist of the series. Mash is a first-year student at Easton Magic Academy and member of Adler dorm. He has the peculiarity of not possessing any magic but also has inhuman strength which makes him a standout in the academy. Mash is generally quiet and kind. However, if he sees someone hurting his family or friends, he gets incredibly angry. He is also extremely innocent and obedient, making people abuse those qualities, but thanks to his strength he can twist almost every situation. He also loves cream puffs a lot.

151801.name: Lemon  Irvine
151801.desc: __Height:__ 162 cm __Affiliation:__ Easton Magic Academy __Occupation:__ Student Lemon Irvine is a first-year student at Easton Magic Academy. She has short, blonde hair with an orange ribbon. Her mark is under her right eye, straight with a half-moon curve. Usually wears the Easton Magic School uniform. Lemon is a little kooky, but she's honest to goodness person and seems incapable of betraying others. She also gets scared very easily and tends to exaggerate in the conversations she has with other people.

151801.name: Lance Crown
151801.desc: __Height:__ 178 cm __Affiliation:__ Easton Magic Academy __Occupation:__ Student Lance Crown is a student at Easton Magic Academy known for being ranked the first in the entrance exams and having two marks. When Lance was younger he is shown to be a very caring person who was willing to protect people who were being mistreated by other people even if the repercussions are him getting into fights. Lance is very protective of his sister where he vows to become a Divine Visionary so he can save his sister from being taken by the Bureau of Magic. ~! After a fight with Mash, he later approaches Mash and Finn to reconcile. Now he acts as the brains of their group of misfits. !~

151801.name: Finn Ames
151801.desc: __Height:__ 170 cm Finn Ames is a first-year student at Easton Magic Academy and member of Adler dorm. He is the younger brother of [Rayne Ames](https://anilist.co/character/202422). Finn is Mash's roommate and his first and best friend.

151801.name: Dot Barrett
151801.desc: __Affiliation:__ Easton Magic Academy __Occupation:__ Student Dot Barrett is a first-year student at Easton Magic Academy and one of the main characters of the Mashle series. Dot is hot-blooded and obnoxious, however, deep down, he's a nice guy and will apologize if he's wrong about something. He also is shown to fall in love easily.

151801.name: Regro Burnedead
151801.original: レグロ・バーンデッド
151801.desc: He is Mash's father.

151801.name: Rain Ames
151801.desc: Rayne Ames is a second-year student at Easton Magic Academy, the current Sword Cane of the Divine Visionaries, the prefect of the Adler dorm and the older brother of Finn Ames.

151801.name: Wahlberg Baigan
151801.original: ウォールバーグ・バイガン
151801.desc: Wahlberg is the Headmaster of Easton Magic Academy.

151801.name: Abel Walker
151801.desc: __Height:__ 176 cm Abel Walker is a third-year student at Easton Magic Academy. He is the leader of the Magia Lupus and the prefect for Lang dorm.

151801.name: Wirth Mádl
151801.desc: The Third Fang of the Magia Lupus. Younger brother of [Orter Mádl](https://anilist.co/character/264316).

151801.name: Cell War
151801.desc: __Height:__ 171 cm Cell War is a core member of Innocent Zero.

151801.name: Abyss Razor
151801.desc: Second Fang of the Magia Lupus.

151801.name: Anna Crown
151801.desc: Anna Crown is Lance Crown's younger sister.

151801.name: Innocent Zero
151801.desc: Innocent Zero is the alias of the leader of the criminal organization of the same name and the primary antagonist of the series. He was once a pupil of Adam Jobs alongside Wahlberg.

151801.name: Claude Lucci
151801.desc: Claude Lucci is a Professor at Easton Magic Academy, he is tasked with guiding the next generation of mages.

151801.name: Tom Knowles
151801.desc: Tom Knowles is a second-year student at Easton Magic Academy.

151801.name: Love Cute
151801.desc: __Height:__ 160cm Love Cute is a second-year student at Easton Magic Academy. She is the Fifth Fang of the Magia Lupus.

151801.name: Milo Genius
151801.original: マイロ・ジェーニアス

151801.name: Olore Andrew
151801.original: オロル・アンドリュー

151801.name: Brad Coleman
151801.original: ブラッド・コールマン
151801.desc: Magic Police Officer. ~!He gives Mash his fake mark and helps him enroll at Easton Magic Academy.!~

151801.name: Terry
151801.desc: Magic Police Officer.

151801.name: Shuukuriimu-ya no Tenin
151801.original: シュークリーム屋の店員

151801.name: Lloyd Cavill
151801.desc: First-year student at Easton Magic Academy.

151801.name: Farman Cregos
151801.original: ファルマン・グレゴス
151801.desc: Vice Principal of Easton Magic Academy.

151801.name: Silva Iron
151801.desc: Second-year student at Easton Magic Academy, and a member of House Lang. During his first year at Easton he managed to acquire two Gold Coins. However, due to constantly attacking students and teachers, he was held back, much to his shock.

151801.name: Lauren Cabasse
151801.desc: Student at Eason Magic Academy. A manipulative and selfish girl, Lauren has an unnamed magic that causes men to fall for her.

151801.name: Mandragora
151801.desc: A magical type of living plant that is used as a universal ingredient for making potions.

151801.name: Honekakuba
151801.desc: The Unicorn is able to determine students' thoughts and sort them into their House.

151801.name: Rhodes Eamus
151801.desc: Student at Easton Magic Academy. He is a double-liner, and refers to himself as the "Magma Master of Orca Dorm."

151801.name: Jon Pierre
151801.desc: Serial killer, cannibal, and a member of Innocent Zero’s Criminal Canes.

11771.name: Tetsuya Kuroko
11771.desc: __Height:__ 168 cm (5'6") __School:__ Seirin High __Number:__ #11 __Speciality:__ Simple sleight of hand tricks The phantom sixth member of the "Generation of Miracles." He has a very weak presence and often seemingly appears out of nowhere as a result. At the first glance all of his abilities seem to be below average, but despite being bad at dribbling and shooting he can be a dangerous opponent. He specializes in circulating passes without being seen. Because of his largely complementary skill set, Kuroko considers himself a "shadow" whose goal is to help his "light" achieve greatness.

11771.name: Taiga Kagami
11771.desc: __Height:__ 190 cm (6'2'') __School:__ Seirin High __Number:__ #10 __Position:__ Power Forward __Talent:__ Jumping power Kagami was in America until second year of middle school and has recently come back to Japan in his first year of high school. He is determined to surpass "The Generation of Miracles" and become the number one. Along with [Kuroko](https://anilist.co/character/18769/Kuroko-Tetsuya), they're the only two freshmen allowed to play in matches. (Even though it looks like they always disagree over things, he and Kuroko – nicknamed Seirin's Freshmen Duo – are actually on good terms.) At the start of the story, Kagami is shown to have a huge potential – good build, height, skill in basketball – but his strongest weapon is his inhuman jump. With those jumps (that gradually get higher and higher every time), he manages to block his opponent's attacks. He's really bad at studying and always get low grades, even in English. He lives alone, has an enormous appetite and is unexpectedly good at cooking. In the past, he was attacked by a dog, and that made him afraid of dogs.

11771.name: Riko Aida
11771.desc: **Height:** 156 cm (5'1") **School:** Seirin High **Job:** Coach **Talent:** Ability Scan She is the coach of the basketball team. She has the ability to be able to tell the potential of each basketball player just by looking at their bodies. Her ability works best when the players are shirtless. She got this ability by following her father to work. She's so horrible at cooking that her teammates can't endure eating it (moreover, she has the habit of mixing vitamins with her cooking). She's good at studying and is ranked #2 in the whole school. Riko can be really scary when she's mad, and she's often teased as being 'flat-chested' compared to Touou's Momoi.

11771.name: Ryouta Kise
11771.desc: **Height:** 189 cm (6'2") **School:** Teiko, Kaijou High **Number:** #8 (Teiko), #7 (Kaijou) **Position:** Small Forward **Talent:** Copy Now a freshman at Kaijou High, Kise was the rookie of the "Generation of Miracles". Since he only started playing basketball in his second year of middle school, Kise was his team's least experienced member, and notes himself the weakest of the five. Kise's unique skill is his ability to mimic the moves and plays of other players. The only moves he cannot copy are the special skills of truly exceptional players, like the other members of the "Generation of Miracles". Beyond being a strong player in his own right, Kise respects [Kuroko](https://anilist.co/character/18769/Kuroko-Tetsuya)'s abilities and wishes to play with him once again. He seems to have a slight obsession with Kuroko, believing that they were the two who got along most in middle school (though Kuroko said they didn't) and often blurting out random facts about him (mentioning that Kuroko was an Aquarius, even though [Kasamatsu](https://anilist.co/character/42804/Kasamatsu-Yukio) was talking about [Midorima](https://anilist.co/character/22253/Midorima-Shintarou)). Also, he's a model in his free time, so girls are always mobbing him. ~!Later on in the manga series, it's revealed that Kise had developed the strength to mimic the other Generation of Miracles' member's play (shown as Midorima's absolute accuracy, [Aomine](https://anilist.co/character/36820/Aomine-Daiki)'s flexibi

11771.name: Shun Izuki
11771.desc: **Height:** 174 cm (5'8") **School:** Seirin High **Number:** #5 **Position:** Point Guard **Talent:** Eagle's Eye A Seirin sophomore who is known for being calm and composed. He also tends to make lame puns. His special ability is his Eagle Eye, which allows him to 'see' his selected area on the court without actually looking.

11771.name: Rinnosuke Mitobe
11771.desc: A hard working player who has never spoken in front of his team members. For some reason, Koganei can understand what's on his mind and then speaks for him. Mitobe is the eldest son in a really big family, with a lot of brothers and sisters. Mitobe is just as determined to win as the other players at Seirin, but unlike the others, he doesn't show his feelings that often. Most people know him as a quiet, hard worker. According to Riko, no one has ever heard Mitobe talk.

11771.name: Shintarou Midorima
11771.desc: __Height:__ 195 cm (6'5") __School:__ Shuutoku High School __Position:__ Shooting Guard __Special Ability:__ Shooting from anywhere on the court (Far-Distance Shooter) Midorima often acts reserved, mean, and brusque with others, coming off as arrogant—although [Takao](https://anilist.co/character/53563/Takao-Kazunari) claims Midorima is just "tsundere." He has a hard time acting kind to his opponents and generally hates "fooling around" (although Takao often pursues him into it). He can be seen, at all times, with a lucky item due to his strong belief and passion for horoscope. He is left-handed, and always bandages his dominant hand outside of matches (claiming that his hand must be in perfect condition so nothing will influence his shot). Formerly a member of the basketball team of Teikou Middle School, Midorima is a member of the Generation of Miracles (Kiseki no Sedai); during his time with Teikou, his jersey number was seven, switching to six as he joined Shuutoku's. He also served as a vice-captain under [Akashi](https://anilist.co/character/42038/Akashi-Seijuurou). His strength is his absolute accuracy, which is shown in his shots that always go in. He can shoot accurately no matter how far he is from the ring. He likes red bean soup and Oha-Asa

11771.name: Junpei Hyuuga
11771.desc: **Height:** 178 cm (5'10") **School:** Seirin **Number:** #4 **Position:** Shooting Guard **Talent:** Clutch Player, Shooting Sophomore and Seirin basketball club's captain. His specialty is 3 pointers, and can shoot accurately even if under extreme pressure. He's the team's clutch during tough situations. Hyuuga really likes to collect ancient Japanese warrior figurines (ex: Masamune, Yukimura, etc) and treasures them a lot. He got the skill to shoot accurately thanks to his special training, in which when he missed a shot during practice, he had to break one of his figurines. Hyuuga normally has a pleasant personality, but gets arrogant when irritated. ~!When Hyuuga was in middle school, he was also on the basketball team together with Izuki. Unfortunately, the team was very weak. Despite Hyuuga's shooting ability, they never won once. Hyuuga was discouraged and decided to quit basketball when going to high school and also dyed his hair blond. But he was touched by Teppei's seriousness on forming a basketball club, and he finally joins the team. Then due to Teppei's suggestion and everyone's approval, he became the team's captain.!~

11771.name: Shinji Koganei
11771.desc: **Height:** 170 cm (5'7") **Team:** Seirin **Number:** #6 **Position:** Small Forward A Seirin sophomore. Considered a jack of all trades, master of none, Koganei is a fairly skilled all-rounder. This is driven home when his coach denotes his special skill as "being able to shoot from any point on the court, with a so-so accuracy rate"; a decidedly normal ability. He is, however, quite intelligent, ranking in the top 20% of his class, though he does not excel in any particular subject. Mysteriously, he can read Mitobe's mind even though Mitobe never says anything.

11771.name: Narrator
11771.desc: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

11771.name: Daiki Aomine
11771.desc: __Height:__ 192 cm (6'3'') __Number:__ #6 (Teikou), #5 (Touou) __Position:__ Power Forward __Talent:__ Skill and Agility, Unusual Speed, Zone Play Aomine was the ace of Teikou's team, embracing an aggressive and liquid style, made even more powerful by Kuroko's misdirection. In fact, Aomine was once Kuroko's "Light", before Kagami. Incredibly fast and versatile, Aomine's strength lies in his unpredictability, as well as an uncanny ability to shoot from virtually any position. In his second year in middle school, Aomine inspired Kise to play basketball and he became his training partner. Kise was still a complete rookie, apart from his copying ability, and Aomine was obviously stronger than him, but Aomine kept training with Kise, just because he loves basketball. He taught Kise a lot and became his mentor/idol. During that time, Aomine also became the ace of the team. Though he loves basketball, he has grown sardonic and unenthusiastic toward the sport, skipping practice and even arriving late for important matches. This is due to his frustration in not being able to find an opponent capable of matching his skill, and thus making him conclude that the only one that can defeat him is he himself. He and Momoi are childhood friends. Even though he doesn't show it, he's actually really fond of her, and they have a sibling-like relationship.

11771.name: Satsuki Momoi
11771.desc: __Height:__ 161 cm __School:__ Touo Academy __Job:__ Manager __Talent:__ Analyst The ex-manager of the basketball team at Teikou, and now serving as Touou's manager. She's in fact Aomine's childhood friend and enters Touou together with him because she can't leave him alone. She is actually in love with Kuroko and considers herself to be Kuroko's girlfriend. Her reasoning for loving Kuroko is that he once gave her a coupon for an extra ice cream, although he only did this because he was already full. As noted by Riko her data collection abilities are elite and she resembles a spy while observing the game. She doesn't only have the past data, but she can also predict the opponent's growth, and thus making her a great strategist. Apparently she's also bad at cooking. ~!Seen in another Kuroko no Basuke Extra, it turns out that while her relationship with Kuroko is not yet official, they have gone out on a date before.!~

11771.name: Atsushi Murasakibara
11771.desc: __Height:__ 208 cm __School:__ Yousen High __Position:__ Center __Number:__ #9 Formerly playing center for Teikou Middle School's basketball team, he does the same now for Yousen High School. Beyond possessing shoulder-length, purple hair, Murasakibara is immediately recognizable for his great height, at least ten centimeters taller than any other currently revealed member of the Generation of Miracles. Murasakibara likes snacks, a lot. He is sometimes seen carrying tons of snacks wherever he goes. The everyday Murasakibara is childish and often teases people, but once he's on the court, his personality changes. Because of his natural height and great talent, he doesn't care very much for basketball, and he said that he's annoyed seeing average people going so far on playing basketball. He is said to be one of the greatest centers among high school players in Japan. ~!Murasakibara's greatest strength is that he has a monstrous, destructive power that never allows anything get past him. Combined with his other current teammates' strength, they don't allow opponent's team to score even one point. Even though Murasakibara usually plays only in defense, if he gets serious, he also plays in the ​offense, which results in the offensive power getting more extreme.!~

11771.name: Seijuurou Akashi
11771.desc: **Height:** 173 cm **School:** Rakuzan **High Position:** Point Guard The final member of the Generation of Miracles, he stood at their head as captain, leading their team to uncontested victory during the three years he played for Teikou Middle School. He is uninterested in winning, simply because victory in his eyes is an absolute given, requisite to his own life as much as breathing. But he has grown tired of victory in the absence of a chance of defeat; ~!Thus when it became clear that Aomine would not be able to participate in the final rounds of the inter-high school championship, he also withheld himself from playing and demanded Murasakibara do the same, wanting to make the games at least a little interesting. He upholds an extreme 'winner-take-all' philosophy, believing that victors are granted absolution in all things, while losers are denied everything. He claims never to have lost at anything, and as such he believes himself right in all things; he grows violent towards those who thus defy him, attempting to stab Kagami with a pair of scissors when the latter refused to leave even when told to do so. Respected and feared by the Generation of Miracles, they assemble as he demands, and can't help but heed his words.!~

11771.name: Yukio Kasamatsu
11771.desc: **Height:** 178 cm **School:** Kaijou High **Number:** #4 **Position:** Point Guard **Motto:** "Steady progress; rapid advance" The captain of Kaijou's basketball team, Kasamatsu is a nationally credited point guard. Possessed of a short temper and often exceedingly serious demeanor, he can become quickly enraged over the antics of his teammates, Kise in particular, and often vents his feelings with sudden fits of violence. As he takes his responsibility as team captain very seriously, he is extremely devoted to his team and does his best to trust in their abilities and lead them to glory. He likes to play guitar. ~!Though crushed that he was unable to take his teammates to the Inter-High School Championship, he repressed his own furious sorrow in front of them in order to spur them forward to prepare for the Winter Cup, later anguishing alone rather than burden his team.!~

11771.name: Yoshitaka Moriyama
11771.desc: __Height:__ 181 cm __School:__ Kaijou High __Number:__ #5 __Position:__ Shooting Guard __Talent:__ Unorthodox Shooting The flirtatious, third-year Shooting Guard of the Kaijou team, Moriyama is a reliable player with a unique shooting form. He is quick to notice pretty women and often claims to fight for them on the court.

11771.name: Mitsuhiro Hayakawa
11771.desc: A lively and excitable Kaijou High second-year, Hayakawa excels in offensive rebounds and is a ferocious Power Forward. Very energetic and modestly immature, he has a strange tendency in his speech to skip over certain letters, making it difficult even for his teammates to understand him.

11771.name: Kousuke Wakamatsu
11771.desc: __Height:__ 193 cm __School:__ Touo Academy **Number:** #6 __Position:__ Center __Talent:__ Rebounding Second-year regular and center of the Touou team, Wakamatsu is easily agitated and extremely loud. Being a player of notable stature, he performs commendably on the defensive, and scoops up rebounds with relative ease. He despises Aomine and frequently expresses his distaste for the latter's lackluster attitude and special treatment within the team, both out of personal jealousy and concern for their team's longevity.

11771.name: Ryou Sakurai
11771.desc: **Height:** 175 cm **School:** Touo Academy **Number:** #9 **Position:** Shooting Guard **Talent:** Quick Release Shot A first-year regular of the Touou team, Sakurai is the team's Shooting Guard and 'Pre-Emptive Strike Leader'. Able to release the ball very quickly in the midst of a jump shot, opposing players find it almost impossible to effectively time a block to his shots. For this reason he was given his nickname by Imayoshi, as it allows the team to very quickly begin the game with an unexpected and nigh-unblockable three point shot. He possesses a very weak and delicate personality, frequently feeling blame for things that he cannot even control and apologizing for them frequently and comically.

11771.name: Shouichi Imayoshi
11771.desc: __Height:__ 180 cm __School:__ Touo Academy __Number:__ #4 __Position:__ Point Guard __Talent:__ Intelligence, Mind Games Touou High's captain and Point Guard, he is a well-spoken and superficially kind on first glance, but hides a somewhat darker personality that more subtly reveals itself in conversation. Speaking in the typically polite Kansai dialect, Imayoshi laces what would be pleasant conversation with slight jabs at other's weaknesses and understated but absolute expressions of his own confidence. While he displays no unique skills, he is a highly effective captain, culling the collective efforts of the Touou team (widely known for being composed of individuals with very specialized styles and poor compatibility with other teammates).

11771.name: Teppei Kiyoshi
11771.desc: __Height:__ 193 cm (6'3") __School:__ Seirin High __Position:__ Center __Number:__ #7 __Favorite Phrase:__ Let's have fun~ The progenitor of Seirin's basketball team and its ace, Kiyoshi is the last of the original Seirin team members to be introduced, due to a hospitalization for a knee injury he got during a game. Rumored to be very capable, his preferred position is that of the point guard, but since their team lacked any other player with the body size to play center, he offered to fill that hole. On [Koganei](https://anilist.co/character/22255/Koganei-Shinji)'s suggestion, he apparently tries to play both, despite the inherent impossibility. While goofy nearly to the point of stupidity, he is very shrewd and is almost always plotting something, though it is rarely what others would inherently conclude. With a pair of big hands that allow him to grasp the ball in play single-handedly, Kiyoshi possesses immense ball-handling skills, and an uncanny sense of timing that allows him to make decisions on-court after his opponents have already reacted. He is renowned and even revered by many players in the realm of high-school basketball, and is one of the few players to have held his own against the Generation of Miracles during their peak. While he is currently able to play, the knee injury he sustained during his freshman year was quite severe: formally speaking it required surgery, but the process would make him unable to play basketball for the rest of his high school caree

11771.name: Taisuke Ootsubo
11771.desc: **Height:** 198 cm **School:** Shuutoku High **Number:** #4 **Position:** Center **Talent:** Basket-Control Taisuke Ootsubo is Shūtoku High's center and captain. Ootsubo is very large and muscular, so his position as a center under the goal is very secure. Usually, he takes rebounds and scores with dunks. He is able to take rebounds even when there are multiple opponents under the basket. He just pushes them away with his huge body. His rebound is even that strong that he can compete against Teppei Kiyoshi. He is seen to apply to the team coach's premise of letting Midorima get away with three selfish acts a day, but unlike their coach he seems to intimidate Midorima into not failing otherwise he insures there will be grave consequences awaiting him.

11771.name: Tomoki Tsugawa
11771.desc: **Height:** 180 cm **School:** Seihou High **Number:** #10 **Position:** Forward **Talent:** Pressure defense Tomoki Tsugawa is a player of Seihou High. He is infamous for his pressure defense. Tsugawa has a shaven head, which has given him a lot of remarks. He has heavy eyebrows and is often seen with a smile on his face. He wears the Seihou uniform with the number 10. He's very straightforward and never hesitates to speak his mind, which results in others being annoyed.

11771.name: Tsutomu Iwamura
11771.desc: **Height:** 187 cm **Team:** Seihou **Position:** Center **Talent:** Power **Number:** #4 Tsutomu Iwamura is Seihou's center. After the Interhigh preliminaries, he and Kasuga quit the Seihou basketball team. Iwamura is one of the widest and biggest (not necessarily tallest) players seen in the series. He has short, spikey black hair. He has a rather big nose and sports a small goatee. Iwamura is one of the best and strongest centers of Japanese high school basketball. With his wide posture, he dominates under the basket. He has no problem overpowering his opponents when dunking, blocking a shot or taking a rebound.

11771.name: Genta Takeuchi
11771.desc: Genta Takeuchi is the coach of Kaijou High.

11771.name: Kazunari Takao
11771.desc: **Height:** 176 cm **School:** Shuutoku High **Position:** Point Guard **Talent:** Hawk's Eye A freshman at Shuutoku High, Takao is much like Kuroko in that he is a passing expert. However, unlike Kuroko, Takao has none of Kuroko's invisibility. Instead, Takao is an almost perfect match for Kuroko because he has the "Hawk's Eye," a mental skill superior even to Seirin's Izuki's "Eagle's Eye." The main difference between the "Hawk's Eye" and the "Eagle's Eye" is scope; the "Hawk's Eye" has an even wider range of vision, allowing the player to see everything without focusing on anything. Because of this, Takao is not fooled by Kuroko's misdirection, which utilizes both Kuroko's naturally invisible nature and techniques to divert the attention of those trying to focus on him in particular. Takao's "Hawk's Eye's" only weakness results from when Kuroko purposely draws attention to himself, which forces Takao to unconsciously focus on him. This allows Kuroko to use misdirection successfully and disappear from Takao's view. In his free time, Takao likes to hang out with Midorima, as he is constantly seen driving Midorima around in a trailer for his bicycle. Although they always flip a coin to determine who will drive the other, Midorima wins every time.

11771.name: Kiyoshi Miyaji
11771.desc: A Shuutoku regular. He dislikes Midorima's attitude and special status greatly; whenever Midorima makes an outlandish demand he frequently responds with a violent threat spoken with a rather eerie smile.

11771.name: Shinsuke Kimura
11771.desc: A Shuutoku regular. He shares Miyaji's distaste for Midorima, and frequently offers support of the latter's violent proposals in an all-too serious manner, even providing realistic means for them to be accomplished.

11771.name: Katsunori Harasawa
11771.desc: Katsunori Harasawa is the coach of Touou High.

11771.name: Masaaki Nakatani
11771.desc: Masaaki Nakatani is the coach of Shūtoku High School. When Masaaki and Kagetora met at the Winter Cup, it is revealed that the two know each other. They share some mutual past, as they called each other Tora and Ma-Boy.

11771.name: Satoshi Tsuchida
11771.desc: __Height:__ 176 cm __School:__ Seirin High __Number:__ #9 **Position:** Power Forward __Talent:__ Rebounding

11771.name: Kouki Furihata
11771.desc: **Height:** 170 cm **School:** Seirin High **Number:** #12 **Position:** Point Guard

11771.name: Kouichi Kawahara
11771.desc: __Height:__ 175 cm __School:__ Seirin High __Number:__ #15 __Position:__ Center He is a first year small forward at Seirin High. Kawahara is just as determined to win as the other players at Seirin. Even if he's just sitting on the bench he still cheers for the team.

11771.name: Kagetora Aida
11771.desc: Riko's father. He is a sports trainer and a former Japanese national basketball team member, thus making him an expert when it comes to basketball. He's really fond of his daughter Riko, and declares that he will 'kill' anyone who dares to mess with her.

11771.name: Hiroshi Kobori
11771.desc: **Height:** 192 cm **School:** Kaijou High **Number:** #8 **Position:** Center **Talent:** Defense **Motto:** "Perseverance Prevails." Kouji Kobori is center and vice-captain of Kaijou High. Kobori is rather calm and prefers to stay out of the spotlight and trouble. He is focused and passionate. He can hold his own defensively against most centers and can score in the low post. He likes astronomical observation

11771.name: Papa Mbai Siki
11771.desc: **School:** Shinkyo High He is an exchange-student from Senegal and is over two meters long, towering over his teammates and opponents. Due to his extremely long build, he can block his opponents with no trouble. Due to him being an exchange student, he does not speak fluent Japanese.

11771.name: Yuusuke Tanimura
11771.desc: __School:__ Shinkyo High __Number:__ #4 __Position:__ Point Guard Yuusuke Tanimura is Shinkyo Academy's captain. When he heard about Seirin's win against Kaijo High from Hyuuga, he figured that the Generation of Miracles aren't such a big deal as he thought. He underestimates Seirin and therefore also the Generation of Miracles. He believes that there is nothing wrong with inviting a strong player and winning a match easily.

11771.name: Ryuuhei Kasuga
11771.desc: **Height:** 179 cm **Team:** Seiho **Position:** Point Guard **Talent:** Scoop Shot **Number:** #5 Ryuuhei Kasuga is Seiho's guard. After the Interhigh preliminaries, he and Iwamura retired from the Seiho basketball team. Kasuga is a kind and controlled person, who keeps his head cool at all times. He is respectful towards his teammates and towards his opponents. He is sportsmanlike and even acknowledged Seirin's strength after they won over Seiho, even when Seiho won last year. Skill: Kasuga has regular ball-handling skills, fitting to his position as point guard. In his play with Tsutomu Iwamura, a hard type player, he is a soft player.

11771.name: Yukinori Matsumoto
11771.desc: Yukinori Matsumoto is Seihou High School's coach.

11771.name: Yoshinori Susa
11771.desc: **Height:** 190 cm **School:** Touo Academy **Number:** #7 **Position:** Small Forward Yoshinori Susa is a third year and the small forward of the Touo team. Susa's abilities have not been fully shown yet, but being a regular starter at Touo Academy, he is an elite player. In Touo's match against Seirin, he was seen guarding Kagami, proving at least that he is capable of taking care of him for a half of the match.

11771.name: Tetsuya #2
11771.desc: Tetsuya #2 is Tetsuya Kuroko's pet dog. He is taken care of by Kuroko and the Seirin team, and has become somewhat of the club's mascot. Kuroko also calls him #2. (source: kurokonobasuke.fandom.com)

11771.name: Kenji Takeda
11771.desc: He is the adviser of Seirin High's Basketball Club

124845.name: Rika Kawai
124845.desc: A girl who doesn't hesitate to say what's on her mind, even for people she has just met.

124845.name: Momoe Sawaki
124845.desc: A girl who has a very distinct beauty mark and slim figure. She is often mistaken for a man, and is popular among girls.

124845.name: Ai Ooto
124845.desc: A girl who has very distinct heterochromia and for that she's bullied at school. Due to a certain event, she is temporarily not attending school. She's a very introverted girl who spends a lot of time alone, she's very protective when it comes to people that she cares about. She has no special power or abilities but wields a multi-colored pen which can transform into a weapon.

124845.name: Neiru Aonuma
124845.desc: A girl who has very distinct green eyes and pigtails. She is very quiet and still at most times, loves herself and makes no initiative to get to know people. On the contrary, she avoids contact with people. She confesses to [Ai](https://anilist.co/character/199892/Ai-Ohto) her goal, to save [her sister](https://anilist.co/character/260352), for whose death she feels responsible.

124845.name: Koito Nagase
124845.desc: Koito is [Ai Ohto](https://anilist.co/character/199892/Ai-Ohto)‘s first friend. Because of her friendship with Ai, she was bullied at school. She is very calm by nature and is able to find good sides in all situations, as shown in her reaction to being bullied at school. She is also kind and gentle, especially towards people she cares about. ~!Koito's eventual suicide is what leads Ai to become a shut-in, avoiding school and refusing to speak to the [teacher](https://anilist.co/character/204921/Shuichiro-Sawaki) when he visits her home. It is for Koito's sake that Ai begins using the Wonder Eggs.!~

124845.name: Tae Ooto
124845.desc: [Ai Ooto](https://anilist.co/character/199892/Ai-Ohto)’s mother. She is a very soft spoken woman and cares deeply about Ai. She is always calm, polite and very kind with anyone she talks with. ~!She has divorced Ai's father and takes care of her alone, both of them living together. She is worried about her daughter and tries to support her in her own way, though Ai rarely leaves her own room. Tae is then relieved to see that she made some friends. She is currently dating [Shuichiro Sawaki](https://anilist.co/character/204921/Shuichiro-Sawaki), who visits the Ohto household quite often.!~ (Source: Wonder Egg Priority Fandom Wiki)

124845.name: Ura-Acca
124845.desc: Ura-Acca, together with Acca, is responsible for leading Ai and the others to the Egg World. In contrast to Acca, Ura-Acca's speech and appearance are more laidback and informal. Sometimes, he states very pointed opinions. He is also quite honest and prefers telling the truth rather than hiding It or avoiding the subject, as Acca would. ~!Ura-Acca, along with Acca, is one of the founders of Japan Plati. Originally regular humans, both of them abandoned their bodies and uploaded their brains into the bodies of mannequins that only exist in the Egg World.!~ Abilities : ~!He shows the same abilities as Acca to communicate with the protagonists from anywhere or anything, in both reality and Egg World. He can even make electronic objects work remotely such as an arcade when the girls requested it.!~

124845.name: Acca
124845.desc: Acca is a mannequin with black glasses and a very slight smile. His build appears to be that of an average male, although it can be hard to tell since he is covered foot to neck. Although his true motives are quite unclear for now, his purpose is to guide the four main protagonists to battle in the Egg World as Ura-Acca does. ~!Acca, along with Ura Acca, is one of the founders of Japan Plati. Originally regular humans, both of them abandoned their bodies and uploaded their brains into the bodies of mannequins that only exist in the Egg World.!~ Abilities : ~!He is capable of making his voice heard by the protagonists from anywhere or anything, or interact with non living objects, in the Egg World and in the reality. For example, in episode 5 and episode 6, he uses speakers or bins. Ura-Acca possesses the same ability. They can also communicate through the pomanders. Both Acca and Ura-Acca can observe what the protagonists are doing, even in their dreams, through a big screen which shows directly what's happening. They almost always have an eye on them.!~

124845.name: Kurumi Saijou
124845.desc: ~!Kurumi Saijo emerges from Ai's first Wonder Egg.!~ Kurumi is an empathetic girl. She sometimes speaks to others in an authoritative manner, but is a helpful person. She is very sarcastic in serious situations. ~!Kurumi was a student who had no real friends, only the superficial kind with whom you exchange empty phrases. Her Wonder Killer was an unknown schoolgirl with axes who endlessly laughed at her.!~ (Source: Wonder Egg Priority Fandom Wiki)

124845.name: Minami Suzuhara
124845.desc: ~!Minami Suzuhara is the second person to hatch from a Wonder Egg bought by Ai.!~ Minami is very shy and timid. She has no confidence in herself nor her abilities at all, often describing herself as weak and lacking spirit. She is also very submissive due to her abuse at the hands of her gymnastics coach, obeying her without any questions and accepting the abuse without complaint. ~!Minami was in her school's gymnastics club, the coach of which physically and emotionally abused her. Minami's Wonder Killer takes the coach's form, as her abuse was ultimately the cause of Minami's presumed suicide.!~ (Source: Wonder Egg Priority Fandom Wiki)

124845.name: Shuichiro Sawaki
124845.desc: Shuichiro Sawaki is [Ai](https://anilist.co/character/199892/Ai-Ohto) and [Koito](https://anilist.co/character/204115/Koito-Nagase)'s homeroom teacher. He is the art club's advisor and often visits Ai's home and says he doesn't mind because her home is on the way to his house.

124845.name: Mako
124845.desc: ~!Mako and her best friend Miko are hatched from eggs bought by Ai and Rika.!~ Along with her best friend Miko, Mako was a fanatical fan of an idol named Yu-Yu. She and Miko attended concerts and meet-ups together in life. She is very cheerful and enthusiastic when talking about Yu-Yu, and very happy to see her best friend in the dream world. In life, Mako often attended concerts and meet-ups for her favourite idol, Yu-Yu, along with Miko. They both admit to having aquired 'sugar daddies' in order to be able to afford attending Yu-Yu’s events. ~!When Yu-Yu committed suicide, both Miko and Mako were quick to follow in his death as soon as possible, though they don't seem particularly remorseful about it.!~

124845.name: Miko
124845.desc: ~!Miko and her best friend Mako are hatched from eggs bought by Ai and Rika.!~ Along with her best friend Mako, Miko was a fanatical fan of an idol named Yu-Yu. She and Mako attended concerts and meet-ups together in life. She is very cheerful and enthusiastic when talking about Yu-Yu, and very happy to see her best friend in the dream world. In life, Miko often attended concerts and meet-ups for her favourite idol, Yu-Yu, along with Mako. They both admit to having acquired 'sugar daddies' in order to be able to afford attending Yu-Yu’s events. ~!When Yu-Yu committed suicide, both Miko and Mako were quick to follow in his death as soon as possible, though they don't seem particularly remorseful about it.!~

124845.name: Chiemi
124845.desc: Chiemi was Rika's #1 fan when she was a junior idol and the reason why Rika uses the Wonder Eggs. She would frequently attend Rika's handshake events. ~!Although Chiemi seems very "happy go lucky" at Rika's handshake events, it is later revealed that she possibly starved herself after taking Rika's harsh words to heart.!~

124845.name: Komon Kyoushi
124845.desc: ~!Komon Kyoushi, addressed as Coach, is Minami Suzuhara's Wonder Killer!~ (Source: Wonder Egg Priority Fandom Wiki)

124845.name: Miwa
124845.desc: ~!Miwa is a girl hatched from Momoe’s egg.!~ __Background :__ ~!Miwa was a girl who was molested on the train by the same person every day. One day, she gathered up her courage and called the man out for it, shouting for help to the other passengers on the train. Everyone pinned the molester down, helping Miwa. However, the man was actually an executive at her dad’s company. Her dad was fired from the company and her mother asked why she just could not just put up with it. Her mother had said that being groped shows how cute Miwa was, that the molester had picked her because she was cute. She was blamed by her mother for her father’s forced resignation, and expresses emotional distress when recalling this event to Momoe.!~

124845.name: Aoi
124845.desc: ~!Aoi (葵, Aoi) is a girl hatched from Neiru’s egg.!~ ~!It assumed by her tangent of her mother's attempts to look young again that Aoi killed herself to preserve her beauty. She even goes as far as to suggesting that Neiru should take her life, due to the fact that she is still young and beautiful.!~ ~!She is the only Wonder Egg Maiden introduced that is actually a Wonder Killer.!~

124845.name: Ayaka
124845.desc: ~!Ayaka (綾香, Ayaka) is a girl hatched from Neiru’s egg. Unlike many of the other Wonder Egg girls, Ayaka seems quite headstrong and attempts to attack her Wonder Killer without help or direction.!~ ~!Although not much is known about Ayaka, from the taunts her Wonder Killer made, it can be assumed that she ran away from home and had attempted to run away multiple times. It can also be assumed that she has a strained relationship with her parents. Based of what her Wonder Killer says, we can speculate her reasons for suicide. Because her Wonder Killer, Yodare, refers to itself as "God" and says things like "Love is me" we can assume that Ayaka has a resentment for religion or has atheist beliefs.!~

124845.name: Yae Yoshida
124845.desc: ~!She is a girl hatched from Ai’s egg.!~~!Little is known about Yae’s background, but she had the ability which allowed her to see entities that resembled spirits and ghosts. She was seen as insane and stupid by her parents and teachers, leading her to be sent a psychiatric hospital. Yae was the only one to have that power, feeling afraid of what she saw and being lonely, unable to confide her sufferance to anyone as nobody would trust her. Due to the stress she experienced, she decided to commit suicide as a way to free herself from the shackles that have weighed her down for too long.!~

124845.name: Chiaki Kawai
124845.desc: Rika’s mother.

124845.name: Miteminufuri
124845.desc: Seeno Evils (or Miteminufuri) are creatures that appear within the dream world of Wonder Egg Priority. They appear as small child-sized beings in black suits. All of them wear identical red masks, carry kitchen knives, and giggle incessently. They relentlessly chase the people that hatch out of Wonder Eggs in order to harm them. The Seeno Evils are seemingly able to track the Wonder Egg people, regardless of walls or distance. They leave paint-like splotches on every surface they pass by, and a creaking door sound is heard each time they appear. They move by bouncing in large groups, and are able to do so at considerable speed in order to chase their prey. They appear to obey Wonder Killers. ~!Despite their unnerving appearance, they can be destroyed quite easily, with a single hit from a magical weapon (such as the pen Ai wields).!~Seeno Evils are able to transform into a "Hater". (Source: Wonder Egg Priority Fandom Wiki)

124845.name: Kotobuki Awano
124845.desc: She was born into a corporation called Japan Plati as Neiru. Her genetic makeup is identified as extremely rare, presenting the characteristics of heterochromia, albinism and high intelligence at the same time. Kotobuki Awano became both a scientist and a doctor and took the post attributed to Doctor Seki unintentionally. Neiru it's her only friend in the entire corporation.

124845.name: Kaoru Kurita
124845.desc: He is a boy hatched from Momoe’s egg. ~!Having been assigned female at birth and struggling with his gender identity, Kaoru went to his kendo club advisor for advice. However, the teacher forced him down, beat him, and raped him, resulting in him becoming pregnant. This is presumably the reason that Kaoru committed suicide. Momoe fights to protect Kaoru after he emerges from one of her Wonder Eggs!~ (Source: Wonder Egg Priority Wiki)

124845.name: Leon
124845.desc: Ai’s pomander pet provided by the Acca and Ura-Acca to be used as a power up in the egg worlds. However in the real world it’s a small and gentle animal.

124845.name: Panic
124845.desc: Momoe’s pomander pet provided by Acca and Ura-Acca to be used as a power up in the egg worlds. However in the real world it’s a small and gentle animal.

124845.name: Mannen
124845.desc: Rika’s pomander pet provided by Acca and Ura-Acca to be used as a power up in the egg worlds. However in the real world it’s a small and gentle animal.

124845.name: Pinky
124845.desc: Neiru’s pomander pet provided by Acca and Ura-Acca to be used as a power up in the egg worlds. However in the real world it’s a small and gentle animal

124845.name: Frill
124845.desc: Frill is an artificial human created by Acca and Ura-Acca. Frill is cheerful and clever by design, showing intelligence significantly higher than that of the average fourteen year old. She also has a sense of humour, and is often seen laughing as a result of practical jokes or general silliness. ~!Frill's true nature however, proves to be far more sinister. She is shown to become easily jealous when anyone threatens to take attention away from her, or be superior to her in any way, growing to even despise these people. She seems to care little about people who are not her two creators. Frill seems to lack the ability to properly develop empathy. Her obsessive and envious nature culminates when Acca and Ura-Acca both begin to turn their attention away from her, causing her to resort to murder. Following this, Frill's lack of empathy is fully displayed, showing very little, if any, remorse for her actions. After this, her creators call her a monster, and stop treating as if she were a human. This seems to confuse Frill, as she still seeks affection from her creators despite their disdain towards her.!~

124845.name: Kirara
124845.original: キララロドリゲスマチュード18世宵の明星SSプラン

18153.name: Mirai Kuriyama
18153.desc: __Height:__ 152 cm Mirai Kuriyama is the deuteragonist of the Kyoukai no Kanata series. She is a first-year student and a member of the school's Literary Club. She comes from a bloodline of Spirit World Warriors who possess blood-manipulation abilities. However, because these abilities are considered heretical among the Spirit World Warrior clans, she is shunned. After meeting [Kanbara Akihito](https://anilist.co/character/81757) she started opening up to people and relating to them again.

18153.name: Mitsuki Nase
18153.desc: __Height:__ 165 cm (5'5") Nase Mitsuki is the sadistic second daughter of the famous underworlder Nase household. She is with [Akihito](https://anilist.co/character/81757/Kanbara-Akihito) in order to observe him, but she is in fact very worried about him. She is good enough friends with Akihito to be able to speak frankly with him, and is the president of the school's literature club as a second-year student. (Source: Anime News Network)

18153.name: Akihito Kanbara
18153.desc: __Race:__ Half-Youmu __Height:__ 171 cm (5'7'') Akihito is one of the main characters of the Kyoukai no Kanata series. He is an alone living second year student and a member of his school's Literary Club. He is a half-youmu and has the ability to instantly heal from his wounds. He is mostly unfamiliar with spirit world warriors and Youmu, something rare for someone like him.

18153.name: Hiroomi Nase
18153.desc: **Race:** Spirit World Warrior __Height:__ 178 cm (5'10") Nase Hiroomi is the eldest son of the famous underworlder Nase family and [Mitsuki's](https://anilist.co/character/81753/Nase-Mitsuki) elder brother. It appears that Hirooumi and [Akihito](https://anilist.co/character/81757/Kanbara-Akihito) had something happen between them in the past, but now they are on such good terms that they can joke around with each other. He has a little sister complex. Due to his barrier powers as an underworlder, he is extremely sensitive to cold, and is almost always seen wearing a muffler or scarf. Hiroomi is a third-year student in high school.

18153.name: Miroku Fujima
18153.desc: **Race:** Spirit World Warrior __Height:__ 180 cm (5'11") He is an antagonist and secondary character in the Kyoukai no Kanata series. He is an Interrogation Officer in the Spirit World Warriors Society.

18153.name: Sakura Inami
18153.desc: __Height:__ 159 cm (5'3") She is the second daughter of a family to whom [Mirai](https://anilist.co/character/81751) is indebted. She came to Nagatsuki City in pursuit of Mirai, who killed her older sister, [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/87630). (Source: Kyoukai no Kanata Wiki)

18153.name: Izumi Nase
18153.desc: __Height:__ 170 cm The eldest daughter of the Nase clan. She usually has a calm demeanor despite having a malicious undertone. She has the viewpoint that youmu are no different from crops or farm animals and exist solely to provide her clan with a livelihood. (Source: Wikipedia)

18153.name: Ai Shindou
