Yumiko's personality is pompous. Due to her popularity, she is held in highest hierarchy. Hence, she has no trouble making friends and also has little to no understanding towards people who have social troubles. Yumiko doesn't show interest, or mind anyone other than higher hierarchy of the class, which is noted by Hachiman Hikigaya by her attitude towards him. She holds herself in a very high esteem, and is not afraid to use her authority. Yumiko has be shown to be very good at tennis as it was stated that she won the Junior High Championship. She also demonstrated her skills in the tennis match showdown and she also participated in the athletic festival sports event of cavalry battle for the white team.

20698.name: Hina Ebina
20698.desc: Hina is a classmate of [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/67069) and [Hachiman](https://anilist.co/character/67065), who is a quiet girl and hangs around [Yumiko](https://anilist.co/character/79593/). She is a fujoshi, which is why other boys from her class are always avoiding her.

20698.name: Kakeru Tobe
20698.desc: Kakeru is one of [Hayato](https://anilist.co/character/79591)'s friends. He is in the football club. He has feelings for [Hina](https://anilist.co/character/79595) and is the only guy in class who often supports Hina's scripts.

20698.name: Yamato
20698.desc: Yamato is one of Hayato's friends. He is in the rugby club.

20698.name: Oooka
20698.desc: Oooka is one of Hayato's friends. He is in the baseball club.

20698.name: Rumi Tsurumi
20698.desc: Rumi is a lonely primary school student who is openly despised by her peers. Hayato at first tried to resolve the situation through talking to her in front of her classmates, which instead attracted more hateful attention to her. After much discussion, Hachiman and company decided that the only way out is to destroy the trust between her peers, through having Hayato and Kakeru acting as bullies threatening Rumi's group-mates during treasure hunt and exposing their selfish nature to each other, thus preventing further organized acts of teasing on Rumi. However, in exchange, she would hardly have any friends after this. (Source:Wikipedia)

20698.name: Meguri Shiromeguri
20698.desc: Meguri is a third year student and the president of Sobu High School's student council. Although she is not a reliable leader herself, her personality has brought her immense support from the councilors and thus she is able to unite the student council. (Source: Wikipedia)

20698.name: Iroha Isshiki
20698.desc: Iroha is a 1st-year student of class 1-C in Sobu High school, introduced in Volume 7.5. Hachiman sees her as a “not cute [Komachi](https://anilist.co/character/67075/Komachi-Hikigaya)” or a “better version of [Sagami](https://anilist.co/character/85283/Minami-Sagami).” She acts in front of anyone to maintain her “cute appearance” with the image of an innocent girl in order to keep her image well with others, but she is a sly and crafty girl underneath. She shows her true color to [Hachiman](https://anilist.co/character/67065/Hachiman-Hikigaya) and [Tobe](https://anilist.co/character/82543/Kakeru-Tobe), which irritates the former while the latter is unaware of it.

20698.name: Tamanawa
20698.desc: Tamanawa is the head of the planning committee for the Christmas festival. He really likes synergy and has shown a talent in freestyle rap.

20698.name: Kaori Orimoto
20698.desc: [Hachiman](https://anilist.co/character/67065) and Kaori both went to the same junior school. Hachiman also used to like her and asked her out before.

20698.name: Keika Kawasaki
20698.desc: The younger sister of Saki Kawasaki.

20698.name: Fujin Yuigahama
20698.desc: [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/67069)'s mother. She seems to be lenient, kind, friendly person being mostly like Yui herself.

21613.name: Tanya Degurechaff
21613.original: ターニャ・デグレチャフ
21613.desc: While Tanya Degurechaff may look like a cute, adorable and innocent little girl, but deep inside, she is a cold-hearted and ruthless contractualist. This side of her is especially evident when she is in battle against her enemies; she shows no remorse as she weaves through a chaotic battleground inflicting maximum damage through whatever means necessary to accomplish her missions. Tanya strongly disapproves of failure and disobedience from her subordinates. She is loyal to her own job and always wants to finish it as soon as possible. Tanya will never let anyone discriminate against her appearance because of how fast she goes through the ranks in the military. ~!Tanya was originally a male salaryman who was murdered by a coworker after he fired them. Tanya was reborn as a young girl living in an alternate universe version of Europe during World War I. At just nine years of age, to avoid conscription into less work, Tanya volunteers for the Empire's Mages Division and is promoted to Second Lieutenant shortly after.!~

21613.name: Hans von Zettour
21613.original: ハンス・フォン・ゼートゥーア
21613.desc: Imperial Army General, Chief of Staff. A rationalist boasting enormous knowledge. Cooperates with [Rudersdorf](https://anilist.co/character/121059), Chief of Operations, to plan and implement strategies.

21613.name: Viktoriya Serebryakov
21613.original: ヴィクトーリヤ・イヴァーノヴナ・セレブリャコーフ
21613.desc: Viktoriya Ivanovna Serebryakov is a mage and a conscript in the Empire's army, and in the past were a member of Platoon 3 under [Tanya](https://anilist.co/character/121052)'s leadership. After that, she joined the new Wing Battalion named "V601" to serve as Tanya's adjutant.

21613.name: Erich von Lergen
21613.original: エーリッヒ・フォン・レルゲン
21613.desc: A high-ranking officer in the Empire's Military Command, belonging to Strategic Headquarter. He is part of the General Staff's strategic advisory member that deals with the Empire's war tactics. A thoughtful and keen man, he quickly deduces the true nature of [Tanya Degurechaff](https://anilist.co/character/121052/Degurechaff-Tanya), calling her a demon. Even so, he trusts her ruthless efficiency to carry out tasks perfectly.

21613.name: Kurt von Rudersdorf
21613.original: クルト・フォン・ルーデルドルフ
21613.desc: Imperial Army General, Chief of Operations. A wonderful and involved soldier, able to plan out large scale strategies as well as finely tune precise operations towards success. Friend of [Zettour](https://anilist.co/character/121056), Chief of Staff.

21613.name: Séverin  Bientôt
21613.original: セヴラン・ビアント
21613.desc: Séverin Bientôt is Captain of the 2nd Mage Squadron of the Francois Republic. His Mage Squadron is famous as the elite Special Forces.

21613.name: Augustin  Hosman
21613.original: オーギュスタン・ホスマン

21613.name: Isaac Dustin Drake
21613.original: サー・アイザック・ダスティン・ドレイク
21613.desc: Sir Isaac Dustin Drake is a Captain of a Marine Mage Wing

21613.name: Warren Grantz
21613.original: ヴォーレン・グランツ

21613.name: Pierre-Michel  De Lugo
21613.original: ピエール・ミシェル＝ド・ルーゴ
21613.desc: Pierre-Michel de Lugo is the Vice Minister of Defense and Armies of the Francois Republic.

21613.name: Olvajoule  Kazole
21613.original: オルバジュール . カゾール

21613.name: Sonzai X
21613.original: 存在 X
21613.desc: Being X is the main antagonist of the Youjo Senki series. It is, in its own words, "God", but [Tanya](https://anilist.co/character/121052) in her first meeting with it labeled it as the devil. Being X is a mysterious being. It claims to be a God, the God of the Bible, the one that gave the 10 commandments to Moses. However, there are a number of Gods and Archangels overseeing the world(s), which goes against what is postulated in the First Commandment. Its goal appears to be the increase of the number of faithful people in the world.

21613.name: Cunningham
21613.original: カニンガム

21613.name: Wilibald Koenig
21613.original: ヴィリバルト・ケーニッヒ
21613.desc: Wilibald Koenig is the 3rd Company commander of V601 under the command of [Tanya Degurechaff](https://anilist.co/character/121052).

21613.name: Adelheid Von Schugel
21613.original: アーデルハイト・フォン・シューゲル
21613.desc: He is a talented mad engineer, inventing many useful weapons during the war.

21613.name: Anson Sioux
21613.original: アンソン・スー
21613.desc: He is the commanding officer of the Legadonia Entente Alliance's 5th Air Mage Battalion.

21613.name: Harald Von Vist
21613.original: ハラルド・フォン・ヴィスト
21613.desc: Imperial Mage hailing from the volunteer wing who graduated from the same year as Visha and Kurst. He was a member of the third platoon in the 205th Mage Company under [Tanya Degurechaff](https://anilist.co/character/121052).

21613.name: Mortiz-Paul  Von Hans
21613.original: モーリッツ＝ポール・フォン・ハンス
21613.desc: He is the Commander of the Western Theater

21613.name: Heinrich  Schreise
21613.original: ハンリヒ・ツー・シュライゼ
21613.desc: He is the Strategic Commander of the Northern Theater.

21613.name: Mary Sioux
21613.original: メアリー・スー
21613.desc: She is the sole daughter of [Anson Sioux](https://anilist.co/character/135048). ~!Mary Sioux is one of the main antagonists of the series, the ultimate rival and the tool used by [Being X](https://anilist.co/character/135044) in order to stabilize a neutral war against [Tanya Degurechaff](https://anilist.co/character/121052). After her father's death, she became rather more vengeful and serious. Her hatred grows when she hears the name "Devil of the Rhine," she will begin to rage but resulting exposing herself in a controlless side. She is the only person who can match Tanya von Degurechaff in many battles. !~

21613.name: Ihlen  Schwarzkopf
21613.original: イーレン・シュワルコフ

21613.name: Kurst Von Walhorf
21613.original: クルスト・フォン・ヴァルホルフ
21613.desc: Kurst von Walhorf is a volunteer mage who just graduated from Cadet Corps and was sent to the Rhine as part of the reinforcements from Central.

21613.name: Aisha  Schubert
21613.original: アイシャ . シューベルト

21613.name: Sean
21613.original: ショーン

21613.name: Rhiner Neumann
21613.original: ライナー・ノイマン
21613.desc: Rhiner Neumann is serving as the 4th Company Commander of V601 under the command of [Tanya Degurechaff](https://anilist.co/character/121052).

21613.name: Matheus Johann Weiss
21613.original: マテウス・ヨハン・ヴァイス
21613.desc: He is the vice captain of the 203rd Aerial Mage Wing, and the captain of the 2nd Aerial Mage Squadron belongs to it.

21613.name: Maximilian Johann Von Ugar
21613.original: マクシミリアン・ヨハン・フォン・ウーガ
21613.desc: Maximilian Johann von Ugar is a classmate and rival of [Tanya Degurechaff](https://anilist.co/character/121052) in their class during War College Arc. He hails from a plain family, and had a newborn daughter in 1924. After graduating from War College, their friendship goes on, and Tanya gains personal connections with him, which helps her many times afterwards.

21613.name: Klein Balheim
21613.original: クライン . バルハイム

21613.name: Ragald
21613.original: ラガルド

226.name: Kouta
226.desc: Kouta is one of the main characters of the series and is first introduced in Volume 1 when he arrives in Kanagawa Prefecture to attend college, having previously arranged to stay with his cousin Yuka while at school.

226.name: Lucy
226.desc: Lucy is a Diclonius girl around eighteen years old. She has developed strong emotions of hatred and vengeance towards regular humans mainly because of how she was treated by the majority of them as a child, making fun of her horns and giving her insulting nicknames such as freak.

226.name: Nana
226.desc: Also known as Number 7, she is a young Silpelit girl who has the physical appearance of being 12-14 years old (though because Silpelits age rapidly, she is actually only about 6 years old). Her name, 'Nana', is Japanese for the number seven, the number by which she was called at the research facility ("Nana" is also a fairly common female name in Japan). Most diclonius babies are euthanized at birth in sweeps of hospital maternity wards, but Nana was one of a handful kept alive for use as a test subjects; as a result she has spent her entire life in the diclonius research facility. Kurama sees her as his daughter and cares very much for her. In an attempt to recapture Lucy, Kurama sent out Nana to find her (diclonii can telepathically sense each other), then retreat until Kurama could arrive with soldiers, but Nana wanted to impress Kurama so she tried to capture Lucy herself. Lucy and Nana engaged in a brutal telekinetic battle that ended with Lucy tearing all of Nana's limbs off. Kurama personally came to stop Lucy and save Nana, then also disregarded Director General Kakuzawa's order to kill her by giving her new prosthetic limbs and setting her free with a lot of money. Unlike many other Diclonius, because Kurama treated her with kindness, she is not homicidal or sadistic. She has the ability to temporarily disable other Diclonius' vectors by having her vectors go through their pineal gland. Although her vector power is slightly superior to Lucy's in terms of range (3 met

226.name: Yuka
226.desc: Yuka is Kouta's cousin. She is planning to attend the same university as Kouta. She moves in with him at the inn after having not seen him in many years. Having had a crush on Kouta since childhood, she is in love with him, and is therefore jealous of Kouta's attention to Nyū, to the point of being very irrational. (Source: Wikipedia)

226.name: Mariko Kurama
226.desc: Also known as Number 35, she is a young girl described as the only surviving "third generation" Silpelit (a Silpelit born from one infected by another Silpelit, as opposed to one born from one infected by a Diclonius), and the daughter of Kurama at five years old. During an escape attempt by Number Three (who was actually Nana's sister), Kurama was infected by her vectors and thus turned into a carrier of the diclonius virus, and his daughter was born a silpelit. In the anime she possesses 33 vectors , each with an approximate range of 11 meters (the number and range is much higher in the manga). Mariko was imprisoned as an infant and raised inside a steel container with human contact consisting of nothing more than a scientist acting as a sort of foster mother through speakers and monitors. Her physical impairment is seen in her atrophied limbs as she moves around in a wheelchair. Despite the environment she was raised in, she is relatively well developed psychologically. She is extremely homicidal and sadistic, and enjoys torturing and dismembering her victims. However, her personality is not blatantly evil. She is only having fun, and the pleasure she gets from it is equivalent to a child playing with toys. ~!In order to keep Mariko under control, the research institute implanted at least two bombs (probably more) in her body during infancy; one is used to remove her right arm after she attacks scientists at the institute. Kurama later orders the other bomb(s) to be detona

226.name: Mayu
226.desc: She is a young girl, abandoned by her mother and a victim of sexual abuse by her stepfather. She has run away from home and is homeless at the start of the series, subsisting on bread crusts she is given at a local bakery under the pretence that they are for the small puppy that accompanies her. She found and named the puppy "Wanta." She ends up living with Kohta and Yuka as her legal guardians. Mayu befriends Nana and tries to take her under her wing. (Source: Wikipedia)

226.name: Kurama
226.desc: He is the chief of research, aged in his mid-30's, of the diclonius children in the research containment facility. He is also the surrogate father of Nana and biological father of Mariko. ~!His wife, Hiromi Kurama, died from Caesarean section complications shortly after she gave birth to Mariko. Although he had previously been tasked with killing all diclonius births, he falters when he must kill his own daughter. Lucy carries a deep hatred toward Kurama, stemming from his failure to save Aikon Takada (seen in the Elfen Lied OVA); however, she states that she will not kill him but will kill everything that loves him. It is revealed late in the series that the General Director of the diclonius research program kept his daughter alive, increasing Kurama's perceived debt to him. Kurama dies at the end of the anime after the explosives inside Mariko (whom he is cradling in his arms while walking away) are detonated at his command. It should be noted that right before the explosion, Kurama has a series of images flash in his mind. In them, his wife is still alive and Mariko is a normal baby, and together the images make up Kurama's idea of how life presumably would have played out if Mariko had been born normal (Mariko as a toddler, Mariko on her first day of school, etc.). Kurama does not die in the manga; Mariko (worried about the safety of her father) confronts Lucy and clings to her as the bomb inside her detonates; this results in Lucy's horns being destroyed and turning back

226.name: Bando
226.desc: He is an operative in his mid-30's for the National Police Agency's Special Assault Team (SAT). Though he is fully human, he is as homicidal and apathetic to other people as the worst diclonius are. He is a hardy and effective soldier. After being maimed by Lucy and repaired with bionic, cybernetic and prosthetic implants, he escapes on a quest for revenge against her. He gets two or more Desert Eagle hand guns. In the manga he gets other weapons such as a RPG. The guns fire .50 caliber rounds which are so powerful the rounds can not be blocked with vectors. But the bullets can be pushed off course at long range though; however at close range not even Lucy can stop them. ~!He gets sidetracked several times in this quest, and ultimately receives aid from Kurama to "kill a diclonius that was coming." Bando is driven by the will to fight and to prove his superior ability in combat. At the end of the anime he is crippled again by Lucy while in the manga he is ripped in half, saving Mayu's life when Lucy tries to kill her. He is shown to have survived at the end, reuniting with Mayu.!~ (Source: Wikipedia)

226.name: Kanae
226.desc: She was [Kouta](https://anilist.co/character/737)'s younger sister and was about 7-9 years old. She was protective of her brother and was jealous of other girls' attentions to him. ~! Kouta repressed much of his memory of her after Lucy murdered her on a train along with Kouta's father. Kouta's repression of the events leads him to believe she died of a sickness of some kind !~

226.name: Arakawa
226.desc: She is a young researcher in her mid-20's who is also Professor Kakuzawa's partner who works alongside him to create a vaccine in order to counter the threat of the Diclonius virus. She along with Kohta inadvertently discovered Professor Kakuzawa's severed head and warned the boy not to disclose anything of what he saw or heard with anybody else. Afterwards, she reported her finding to Director Kakuzawa at his compound facility, but he wouldn't let her go scot-free after seeing his son's horns. She was threatened by Chief Kakuzawa to take charge of his deceased son's research or else be killed.

226.name: 3-Ban
226.desc: She was a Silpelit child of around 3-4 years old whose name is her designation number given by the human scientists at the research facility, as she does not possess a personal name of her own. She appears only in episode 10 of the anime when Kurama experiences a series of flashbacks back when he became director at Chief Kakuzawa's island facility. Kurama's flashbacks give insight on the activities the scientists were performing on Diclonius to measure the range and power of their vectors. Everyday, Number 03 was chained up on a wall, and on a far end a machine shot small iron balls at her from different angles. The purpose of that test was to evaluate the maximum range at which each Diclonius's vectors could reach and deflect the balls. When the experience became too traumatic for Number 03, Kurama voiced out his protest for witnessing such inhuman activities. Afterwards, the locks on Number 03's bounds were mysteriously opened up, and she went on a killing spree until she found Kurama. Number 03 had concealed the true length of her growing vectors from the research team, aiding in her escape. She immediately placed her vector on his head and thanked him in a haunting manner, before being shot dead at the head by Professor Kakuzawa with an armor piercing bullet. Several months later, Kurama's wife gave birth to a Diclonius baby (Mariko) much to Kurama's fear and astonishment. But, it made Kurama to quickly recall his near-death experience with Number 03 and finally realized

226.name: Kakuzawa Choukan
226.desc: He is the head of the research center at 70+ years old performing experiments on diclonius. He is from a long line of diclonius ancestry that has been watered down by inter-breeding with humans (much of this is, however, only revealed in the manga). As a result of this he has no vectors and much smaller horns on his head. The aim of him and his son is, in part, to replenish their bloodline with the diclonius they are experimenting on (of which Lucy is the first to be able to reproduce) and thus gain power as "kings" of the new race.

226.name: Kakuzawa Kyouju
226.desc: He is the son of Chief Kakuzawa and also a watered-down diclonius with smaller horns and no vectors in his mid-30's. When he and Kurama were younger, they both went to university together and it was Kakuzawa that originally got Kurama involved in the research on Diclonius. He ends up, coincidentally, being the lecturer for a course at the university in which Kouta and Yuka are enrolled. (Source: Wikipedia)

226.name: Tomoo
226.desc: Tomoo was a young boy about 10–11 years of age and the ringleader of the group of bullies in the orphanage, which was also home to Kaede. He is a key figure in her descent into madness, murder, and misanthropy. Due to the bullying he and his group inflicted upon her, Kaede developed a deep hatred of the human race.

226.name: Kisaragi
226.desc: Kurama's personal secretary who seems to space out at work often and is often quite clumsy. She is killed by Lucy at the start of the story when she, completely oblivious of what is going on, trips in front of the rampaging Lucy, who tears off her head and uses the body to shield herself from the security team's gunfire. In the manga, Kisaragi came across Lucy while walking down the hall. Noticing that she was covered in blood, Kisaragi approached her. Lucy used this opportunity to take her hostage. Since Kurama's men were unable to get a clear shot of Lucy, Kurama told Kisaragi they had to sacrifice her. Kisaragi did not seem upset after hearing this, instead saying she was happy to give her life if it meant she was helping. Kurama assured her that her death would not be meaningless, but before Kurama could tell his men to shoot, Lucy tore off Kisaragi's head. After using Kisaragi's decapitated body as a shield and killing the men, Lucy told Kurama that Kisaragi's death was meaningless, and left laughing. (Source: Wikipedia)

226.name: Shirakawa
226.desc: Is a scientist that works very closely with Kurama. Though her personality on the surface reflects a business-like demeanor, she holds a secret affection and genuine concern for Kurama.

226.name: Saitou
226.desc: Saito was a scientist in her late twenties working at Chief Kakuzawa's island facility She was in charge of research involving Mariko and talked with her through the use of loudspeakers. Mariko always referred to Saito as Mommy during these interactions. She also took secret steps to undo any parental feelings Mariko may have retained towards her birth parents Kurama and Hiromi.

226.name: Hiromi Kurama
226.desc: Hiromi was the wife of Director Kurama, the mother of Mariko.

166240.name: Tanjirou Kamado
166240.desc: __Height:__ 165 cm (5'5") __Combat Style:__ Water Breathing & ~!Sun Breathing!~ Tanjirou is kind by nature and has been described by others as having very gentle eyes. He has a great deal of determination and will not give up once he has a goal to achieve, an example being finding a cure for [Nezuko](https://anilist.co/character/127518). Even though he is relatively strong on his own, he isn't opposed to asking others for help when he needs it. He is very protective of his friends and even more so of his younger sister. His biggest attribute is his ability to empathize with anyone, even demons. ~!Eventually, he discovers that he is a legendary Sun Breathing user.!~

166240.name: Nezuko Kamado
166240.desc: __Height:__ 153 cm (5'0") Transformed into a demon and left mute, Nezuko travels with her older brother [Tanjirou](https://anilist.co/character/126071/Kamado-Tanjirou) in a box on his back. She can change her size at will, and is a capable fighter when she needs to be, but has never killed or eaten any humans. Instead of gaining nourishment from humans, it seems that she recovers her energy by sleeping for long periods of time.

166240.name: Inosuke Hashibira
166240.desc: **Height:** 164 cm (5'4") __Combat Style:__ Beast Breathing Inosuke is usually seen wearing a grey boar mask, with a shirtless version of the Demon hunter uniform. Without the mask he has messy shoulder length black hair and large green eyes with long eyelashes. He is described as having a girly looking face which greatly contrasts with his muscular body. Inosuke is extremely short-tempered and proud, and makes a big deal out of fighting opponents stronger than him claiming that's his only hobby. He is a sore loser and is always trying to compete with Tanjiro and provoke him into fighting him, and usually failing. Due to growing up in the mountains by himself Inosuke has trouble interacting with others and only cares about himself most of the time. Though he's often seen with 2 swords in hand, Inosuke is left-handed.

166240.name: Zenitsu Agatsuma
166240.desc: __Height:__ 164 cm (5'4") __Combat Style:__ Thunder Breathing __Affiliation:__ Demon Slayer Corps __Occupation:__ Demon Slayer Zenitsu Agatsuma is one of the main protagonists of Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba and along with [Inosuke Hashibira](https://anilist.co/character/129130/Inosuke-Hashibira), a traveling companion of [Tanjiro Kamado](https://anilist.co/character/126071/Tanjirou-Kamado) and [Nezuko Kamado](https://anilist.co/character/127518/Nezuko-Kamado).

166240.name: Muzan Kibutsuji
166240.desc: __Height:__ 179 cm (5'10") He is the Demon King, the first of his kind, and the progenitor of all other demons in existence. Muzan is also the leader of the Twelve Kizuki, an organization of the twelve strongest demons in existence that serve directly under him. ~!A millennium ago, during the Heian Era, Muzan was turned into a demon during an experimental treatment trying to cure his terminal illness, and his goal since then was to live without the fear of death and become truly eternal. He believes that Sun Breathing users are his only threat. He has a grand total of seven hearts and five brains.!~

166240.name: Giyuu Tomioka
166240.desc: __Height:__ 176 cm (5'9½") __Combat Style:__ Water Breathing Water pillar in the Demon Killing Corps. Giyuu is reserved and displays little emotion, instead giving off a calm feeling most of the time. As a water breath user, Giyuu has created his own style. The eleventh style, Lull, gives him the ability to nullify any oncoming attacks, though rapid attacks can pierce through it. Though Giyuu is reserved, he does have a few friends, such as Tanjirou and, in the past, [Sabito](https://anilist.co/character/137809/Sabito). Shinobu often pokes fun at Giyuu and is merciless when doing so, such as saying he has no friends and that others don't like him. ~!He is one of the only Pillar, aside from [Sanemi](https://anilist.co/character/137774/Sanemi-Shinazugawa), who survived during the final fight against [Muzan](https://anilist.co/character/129132/Muzan-Kibutsuji).!~

166240.name: Muichirou Tokitou
166240.desc: __Height:__ 160 cm (5'3") __Combat Style:__ Mist Breathing Muichiro is an air-headed individual who seems to constantly wander off in thought and never focus on one thing. Impassive and, at times, obtuse, he tends to think only for himself and operates on logic alone, never letting emotion guide him. Despite this, he has been shown to get serious when it is required and is devoted to his position as the Demon Slayer Corps' Mist Hashira. Alternatively, he seems to display a cold and arrogant side as well. ~!He later died at Kokushibo's hand.!~

166240.name: Shinobu Kochou
166240.desc: __Height:__ 151 cm (4'11") __Combat Style:__ Insect Breathing Shinobu is a demon slayer and the Insect Pillar of the Demon Killing Corps. She is 18 years old and one of two female pillars. Shinobu appears rather laid back, and always has a smile on her face regardless of the situation. Despite her relaxed exterior and her initial claim of wanting to get along with demons, she can be rather cruel and harbors a great deal of anger towards them. She is generally kind to other humans, but is rather sadistic in her treatment of demons. As a pillar, she is a top-class fighter despite her small stature. She is also well-versed in medical knowledge, and can concoct poisons and medicines alike. ~!During the Infinity Castle Arc, she encounters the Upper 2 demon [Douma](https://anilist.co/character/144591) and is slain by him in a fight. However, since she poisoned herself before the fight, Douma is severely incapacitated after eating her.!~

166240.name: Tengen Uzui
166240.desc: __Height:__ 198 cm (6'6") __Combat Style:__ Sound Breathing A Demon Slayer, and the Sound Pillar of the Demon Slayer Corps. Tengen is a very eccentric person, always wanting to complete actions as flashy as possible. Although he has displayed an uncaring and forceful attitude towards some people, he also has a caring side that is mainly only shown towards his most treasured ones, most notably his three wives, [Makio](https://anilist.co/character/250554), [Suma](https://anilist.co/character/250555), and [Hinatsuru](https://anilist.co/character/250556). He also shows a somewhat nicer side towards [Tanjiro](https://anilist.co/character/126071) after their mission and starts to accept him more as the series goes on.

166240.name: Mitsuri Kanroji
166240.desc: __Height:__ 167 cm (5'5") __Combat Style:__ Love Breathing Demon Hunter and the Love Pillar of the Demon Killing Corps. Mitsuri is a soft and kind person. She is very emotional and passionate, constantly complimenting people in her head, which probably contributes to her nickname of "the Hashira of Love". Although she is rather shy and is easily flustered, she is always kind to others, most notably towards [Obanai](https://anilist.co/character/137777), whom she appears to share a strong bond with. Besides her rather emotional personality, she can also come off as somewhat childish at times. ~!She was taught by Rengoku to use the flame breathing. However, although Mitsuri has learnt it, she was not as skillful with it and cannot fight to her fullest using it, leading her to solely develop the Love Breathing.!~

166240.name: Sakonji Urokodaki
166240.desc: Retired member of the Demon Slayer Corps, previously holding the title of Water Hashira. He is the main cultivator of the Water Breathing style, having trained Makomo, Sabito, Giyu Tomioka, and Tanjiro Kamado.

166240.name: Sanemi Shinazugawa
166240.desc: __Height:__ 179cm (5'10½") Demon Hunter and the Wind Pillar of the Demon Killing Corps. He is the older brother of [Genya Shinazugawa](https://anilist.co/character/137776). Sanemi specializes in Wind Breathing, which has 9 forms. The technique consists of drawing the air from around the user to create whirlwind attacks that follow the user's movements. Form names include Dust Whirlwind Cutter, Claws-Purifying Wind, Clean Storm Wind Tree, Rising Dust Storm, Cold Mountain Wind, Black Wind Mountain Mist, Gale - Sudden Gusts, Primary Gale Slash, and Idaten Typhoon.

166240.name: Genya Shinazugawa
166240.desc: __Height:__ 180 cm (5'11") Genya Is a Demon Hunter of the Demon Killing Corps. He is also the younger brother of the Wind Pillar [Sanemi Shinazugawa](https://anilist.co/character/137774). ~! Due to his lack of breath forms he is dependent on using his shotgun and demon form. His shotgun pelts are made from sun steel to be effective against demons. His demon form is active when he digests anything from a demon to gain demon like strength and abilities. He is the only demon hunter to have this ability given that it is drastically rare !~

166240.name: Obanai Iguro
166240.desc: __Height:__ 162 cm (5'3") Obanai is a Demon Slayer and the Snake Pillar of the Demon Slayer Corps. A young man of short stature and a pale complexion. He has straight-edged black hair of varying lengths, the longest reaching down to his shoulders and the shortest stopping at his cheekbones, which he wears down with two shorter strands hanging between his eyes. He wears a navy blue version of the standard Demon Slayer uniform, along with a black and white pinstriped haori, the hem and cuffs of which are striped lengthways rather than vertically, which covers his hands. Obanai also sports bandages in place of the leg-wraps around his calves, as well as another set of bandages that cover his mouth, and blue-strapped zori on his feet. He is also always seen with his white snake, Kaburamaru, wrapped around his shoulders.

166240.name: Gyoumei Himejima
166240.desc: __Height:__ 220cm (7'2½") He is a Demon Slayer and the Stone Hashira of the Demon Slayer Corps. Gyomei also serves as the mentor of Genya Shinazugawa.

166240.name: Kagaya Ubuyashiki
166240.desc: He is the head of the Ubuyashiki Family and 97th leader of the Demon Slayer Corps known mainly as "Oyakata-sama" ("Master") by his subordinates and peers.

166240.name: Sabito
166240.desc: He is a former apprentice of [Urokodaki Sakonji](https://anilist.co/character/137773/Urokodaki-Sakonji). ~!He dies saving the participators in the final selection, including [Giyuu](https://anilist.co/character/130050/Tomioka-Giyuu).!~

166240.name: Matsuemon Tennouji
166240.desc: Kasugai Crow assigned to Tanjirou Kamado. Very intelligent and seems to have a large ego.

166240.name: Yushirou
166240.desc: __Height:__ 157 cm (5'2") Yushiro is a traveling companion of Tamayo and close ally of Kamado Tanjirou. He was turned into a Demon by Tamayo. Yushiro was a human who was under the care of Tamayo as she was practicing as a medical practitioner. He was in the frail state fighting disease when Tamayo gave him the choice of succumbing to his illness or to live longer as a Demon. He agreed to become a Demon and has since stayed by Tamayo's side serving as an assistant as well as her guard. ~!Yushiro would become the last known survivor of the Demon race. In time he would dedicate himself to a life of art and become a world famous painter in the present day under the name of Yushiro Yamamoto, known for his paintings of Tamayo to wide critical acclaim!~

166240.name: Tamayo
166240.desc: __Height:__ 150 cm (4'11") Tamayo is a doctor and close ally of [Kamado Tanjirou](https://anilist.co/character/126071/Kamado-Tanjirou). She was turned into a Demon by [Kibutsuji Muzan](https://anilist.co/character/129132/Kibutsuji-Muzan).

166240.name: Hotaru Haganezuka
166240.desc: Hotaru Haganezuka is a swordsmith affiliated with the Demon Killing Corps.

166240.name: Kanao Tsuyuri
166240.desc: __Height:__ 156 cm (5'1½") Kanao Tsuyuri is a Demon Hunter and the Tsuguko, who is personally looked after by the Demon Killing Corps' Pillars. She uses Flower Breathing. ~!When Kanao is first introduced, she is an indecisive and quiet girl due to the abuse she endured in her past before meeting the Kocho sisters. She became unable to make decisions by herself and repressed her emotions as a defense mechanism. In order to help rectify this, Kanae gave her a coin to flip to decide which path to follow when she didn't know what to do. Later on, Tanjiro helps Kanao overcome her indecisiveness and Kanao soon becomes more confident in making decisions with or without her coin. Kanao and Tanjiro would eventually marry and start a family, having two great-great-grandchildren by the names of [Kanata Kamado](https://anilist.co/character/171144/Kanata-Kamado) and [Sumihiko Kamado](https://anilist.co/character/171145/Sumihiko-Kamado) between them.!~

166240.name: Kiriya Ubuyashiki
166240.desc: ~!Kiriya Ubuyashiki is the son and middle child of Kagaya Ubuyashiki. He is the current head of the Ubuyashiki Household and leader of the Demon Slaying Corps!~

166240.name: Nakime
166240.desc: Nakime is a mysterious Biwa Demon that dwells in the Dimensional Infinity Fortress. ~!Actually she is a member of the Twelve Demon Moons, replacing Hantengu and holding the position of Upper Moon Four.!~ (Source: Fandom)

166240.name: Ukogi
166240.desc: Ukogi is Zenitsu's Kasugai Crow. He is the only sparrow to appear in the series and pass the Kasugai Crow Test and also the only Kasugai Crow without the ability to talk. His family was killed by Demons.

166240.name: Naho Takada
166240.desc: She is a servant of the Butterfly Estate.

166240.name: Kiyo Terauchi
166240.desc: She is a servant of the Butterfly Estate.

166240.name: Aoi Kanzaki
166240.desc: She is a Demon Slayer, though she works as a servant in the Butterfly Estate rather than taking to the front lines.

166240.name: Sumi Nakahara
166240.desc: She is a servant of the Butterfly Estate.

166240.name: Kaigaku
166240.desc: __Height:__ 167 cm (5'6") A member of the Demon Slaying Corps, who was taught the Breath of Thunder by former Thunder Pillar, Jigoro, with fellow disciple Zenitsu.

166240.name: Murata
166240.desc: Murata is a member of the Demon Slayer Corps.

166240.name: Kozo Kanamori
166240.desc: Kozo Kanamori is a swordsmith affiliated with the Demon Slayer Corps.

166240.name: Gotou
166240.desc: Goto is a member of the Kakushi, the clean-up brigade of the Demon Slayers. He is the one who found a near-dead Tanjiro, Inosuke, and Zenitsu in the aftermath of the Entertainment District Arc. He possesses deep respect for the three because of their capability and bravery. At one point in his life, he was found worthy of being a Demon Slayer, but for unknown reasons, he decided to become one of the Kakushi.

166240.name: Amane Ubuyashiki
166240.desc: __Height:__ 167cm (5'6") She is the wife and caretaker of [Kagaya Ubuyashiki](https://anilist.co/character/137808/Kagaya-Ubuyashiki) and the mother of Hinaki Ubuyashiki, Nichika Ubuyashiki, Kiriya Ubuyashiki, Kanata Ubuyashiki and Kuina Ubuyashiki. Her maiden name is Amane Himorogi.

166240.name: Makio
166240.desc: Makio is a kunoichi and one of Tengen Uzui's wives. ~! According to the second official fanbook, Makio is actually a distant cousin of Tengen's.!~

166240.name: Suma
166240.desc: Suma is a kunoichi and one of Tengen Uzui's wives.

166240.name: Hinatsuru
166240.desc: Hinatsuru is a kunoichi and one of Tengen Uzui's wives.

166240.name: Ginko
166240.desc: Kasugai Crow assigned to [Muichirou Tokitou](https://anilist.co/character/136069). Does not get along well with [Tanjirou](https://anilist.co/character/126071) and his crow or the other crows in general. She is very proud of Muichirou.

166240.name: Urara
166240.desc: Kasugai Crow assigned to [Mitsuri Kanroji](https://anilist.co/character/136072). Wears a clover-shaped crown similar to Mitsuri's Nichirin Sword tsuba. Often appears to be nervous and fidgety, and is rumored to have a sweet tooth as a result of how often she has tea time with Mitsuri.

166240.name: Kagaya no Kasugai Garasu
166240.desc: [Kagaya Ubayashiki](https://anilist.co/character/137808)'s kasugai crow.

166240.name: Takeuchi
166240.desc: Member of the Demon Slayer Corps. He is close friends with Murata.

136430.name: Thorfinn Karlsefni
136430.original: トルフィン・カルルセヴニ
136430.desc: __Birthyear:__ 996 __Height:__ 100 cm (6-7 years old), 153 cm (16-18 years old), 155 cm (19 years old) Thorfinn is a courageous young man armed with two twin blades he inherited from his deceased [father](https://anilist.co/character/13021). He's traveling with [Askeladd](https://anilist.co/character/13020), who is the leader of a ruthless group of mercenaries who take jobs from whoever they think can offer them a reasonable reward. Besides, Askeladd is the man who killed Thorfinn's father, Thors, and the only reason Thorfinn is traveling with Askeladd is so he can defeat him in a duel and win back his father's pride. Thorfinn only wants to win his father's pride with a fair duel. Askeladd only agrees to these duels when Thorfinn completes a certain task (like bringing him the head of the opposing armies general on the battlefield). He does not fight for the love of battle, but is still prone to losing his composure when in combat. This hotheadedness often costs him battles against more experienced opponents.

136430.name: Askeladd
136430.desc: Askeladd is the commander of a small but powerful Viking band, which owed its success to Askeladd's exceptional intelligence. Ten years before the main Vinland Saga storyline, Askeladd accepted a contract to assassinate [Thors](https://anilist.co/character/13021), father of [Thorfinn](https://anilist.co/character/10138). During the Viking invasion and war in England, he manipulated Thorfinn's desire for revenge against him as a way of keeping the gifted young fighter in his service. Askeladd is one of the most skilled fighters in the series, and is particularly adept at predicting his opponents' moves in combat. Askeladd shares the name of Askeladden, a Norwegian folk character known for his cleverness. ~!He is half-Danish and half-Welsh, being the son of a Welsh princess captured by a Viking raider. He believes in the legend of Avalon, which inspired him to support Prince [Canute](https://anilist.co/character/17438)'s bid for kingship of the Danes and ultimately sacrifices himself assassinating King [Sweyn](https://anilist.co/character/27957) in order to install Canute as the Danish King and to ensure the safety of Wales from Denmark.!~

136430.name: Thors Snorresson
136430.original: トールズ・スノーレソン
136430.desc: __Height:__ 180 cm (5'11") Thors is the father of [Thorfinn](https://anilist.co/character/10138), a Jomsviking general whose phenomenal combat prowess earns him the epithet "The Troll of Jom". Thors grows weary of battle after the birth of his children, fakes his own death, and retires to become a pacifist farmer. Thors is largely considered the greatest fighter to appear in the series, having defeated the likes of Askeladd and [Thorkell](https://anilist.co/character/17440) in single combat. Such was his strength that Floki was unwilling to engage him directly, even with an entire squadron of Jomsviking warriors. Unlike his son, Thors has no explicit or implied historical basis.

136430.name: Canute Svenson
136430.desc: __Birthyear:__ 996 __Height:__ 170 cm Canute is the prince of the Danes. He is initially portrayed as timid and womanly, with a bishounen appearance and inability to function without his retainer [Ragnar](https://anilist.co/character/82533). These traits, along with his strong Christianity, earn him the mockery of the Vikings with whom he works. ~!After Ragnar's death, however, he has a sharp reversal of personality, becomes strong and kingly, and develops an ambition to create utopia on earth before God's return. Towards this end, he plots to overthrow his father [Sweyn Forkbeard](https://anilist.co/character/27957) and take the crown of the Danes. Canute is based on the historical King Canute the Great, the most prominent Danish ruler of England.!~

136430.name: Thorkell
136430.desc: __Height:__ 230 cm (7'7") Thorkell is a Jomsviking general and brother of the Jomsviking Chief. A giant man who loves combat, Thorkell defected from the Danish army to become a mercenary for the English, believing that fighting his fellow Vikings will give him a better challenge. This same love of war leads him to support Prince [Canute](https://anilist.co/character/17438)'s bid for kingship of the Danes. Before [Thors](https://anilist.co/character/13021)' defection he works with and highly respects the man, and bears a fondness for his son [Thorfinn](https://anilist.co/character/10138) in the main plot. He duels twice with Thorfinn and dominates each time, though he loses two fingers in the first duel and an eye in the second. In battle, Thorkell typically wields a pair of axes as his primary weapons, but his greatest asset is probably his vast physical strength. During a skirmish with [Askeladd](https://anilist.co/character/13020)'s band, he hurled a spear with such force that it skewered three men at once, despite having been thrown from several hundred feet away. Thorkell's character is based on Thorkell the Tall, a historical Jomsviking lord who is a mentor to Canute in the Flateyjarbók. ~!Joined Canute as his servant after seeing him change in front of Askeladd and Thorfinn.!~

136430.name: Bjorn
136430.desc: Bjorn is [Askeladd](https://anilist.co/character/13020)'s second in command, a burly man who fights for the love of combat. He is a berserker, able to enter powerful rages through the consumption of certain mushrooms.

136430.name: Leif Erikson
136430.desc: __Birthyear:__ 965 __Height:__ 152 cm (4'11") ~!An explorer who joins [Thorfinn](https://anilist.co/character/10138) in his quest to find paradise.!~

136430.name: Ylva
136430.desc: She is [Thorfinn](https://anilist.co/character/10138)'s older sister. After Thorfinn has set on a journey to avenge his father, [Thors](https://anilist.co/character/13021), she takes care of household and [her mother](https://anilist.co/character/141589).

136430.name: Sweyn
136430.desc: Danish king who managed to conquer almost the entirety of England and Wales, all the while keeping control of his more northern kingdoms. Father of [Canute](https://anilist.co/character/17438). ~!After being provoked by Sweyn, [Askeladd](https://anilist.co/character/13020) executes the king by cutting off his head with a sword.!~

136430.name: Einar
136430.desc: __Height:__ 184 cm Einar is a man from Northern England that was sold into slavery. He ends up in Denmark, where he meets [Thorfinn](https://anilist.co/character/10138). Together with him, Einar is working his way out of slavery by harvesting the land his master has lent to him and Thorfinn. ~!After [Arnheid's](https://anilist.co/character/75590) death, he and Thorfinn agree to create a country of peace in Vinland!~

136430.name: Narrator
136430.desc: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

136430.name: Arnheid
136430.desc: __Height:__ 155cm One of Ketil's slaves, serving as his personal maid and concubine. Arnheid is kind, hard-working, honest, and tries her best to get through her slave life without trouble.

136430.name: Hebi
136430.desc: __Height:__ 172 cm __Occupation:__ Leader of the Guests A warrior employed by Ketil as head of his farm's guards. He is an extremely formidable warrior, with Thorfinn attesting that Snake is faster than anyone he has ever fought. ~!Snake was formerly a warrior of Miklagard (the Old Norse name of Constantinople).!~

136430.name: Ragnar
136430.desc: He is the main adviser for Prince [Canute](https://anilist.co/character/17438). Ragnar is bald apart from very long, black, curly hair on the sides of his head. He has very thick black eyebrows that lie close to his deepset eyes. His wrinkles are also very deep, especially in his cheeks, just above his thick beard. (Source: Vinland Saga Wiki)

136430.name: Thorgil
136430.desc: __Height:__ 176 cm Eldest son of [Ketil](https://anilist.co/character/223346) and brother of [Olmar](https://anilist.co/character/224512). Much like [Thorkell](https://anilist.co/character/17440) he loves a good fight and has no qualms killing anybody who gets in his way. Served as a Thegn under Canute.

136430.name: Floki
136430.desc: A Jomsviking commander whom contracted [Askeladd](https://anilist.co/character/13020) to assassinate [Thors](https://anilist.co/character/13021), Floki's former comrade.

136430.name: Ari
136430.desc: __Height:__ 170 cm Ari is from [Thorfinn](https://anilist.co/character/10138/Thorfinn-Karlsefni)’s village in Iceland.~!He is the husband of [Ylva](https://anilist.co/character/27876) and the father of their four children.!~

136430.name: Helga
136430.desc: She is the mother of [Thorfinn](https://anilist.co/character/10138) and [Ylva](https://anilist.co/character/27876), and the wife of [Thors](https://anilist.co/character/13021). ~!She's the daughter of the Jomsviking Chief.!~

136430.name: Asgeir
136430.desc: __Height:__ 170cm [Thorkell](https://anilist.co/character/17440)'s first mate. Asgeir is one of the few characters Thorkell outwardly respects, meeting him at eye-level in conversation, listening to his advice, and putting him in charge of strategies and planning. Asgeir is often shown yelling at Thorkell and becoming easily worried and even panicked when Thorkell is in danger.

136430.name: Mols
136430.desc: [Leif](https://anilist.co/character/19486)'s traveling partner.

136430.name: Gunnar
136430.desc: He is Ragnar's Brother. ~!now he is a politician who currently serves as an adviser to King Canute.!~

136430.name: Bug-Eyes
136430.desc: __Height:__ 175cm Thorfinn, better known by his nickname Bug-Eyes, is a trader working with [Leif Erikson](https://anilist.co/character/19486/). A former slave, Bug-Eyes was bought by Leif under the false assumption that he was [Thorfinn](https://anilist.co/character/10138/), son of Thors.

136430.name: Ketil
136430.desc: __Height:__ 175cm Owner of a farm in Southern Denmark, and father of Thorgil and Olmar. ~!Thorfinn, Einar and Arnheid work his farm as slaves!~

136430.name: Olmar
136430.desc: __Height:__ 170 cm (initial) Youngest son of [Ketil](https://anilist.co/character/223346).

136430.name: Sverkell
136430.desc: Sverkel is the elderly father of Ketil, living on the ground of his son's farm in Jutland, Denmark. ~!At first glance he seems to be quite a grumpy person, but he appears to actually be soft at heart. This is suggested by the fact that he helps out Thorfinn and Einar by lending them his farming utensils in exchange for their helping hands on his fields. This is further implied by his deep bond with Snake, even though they are depicted fighting a lot. On top of that, Sverkel is strong-willed, hardworking and stubborn.!~

136430.name: Lotta
136430.desc: [Einar](https://anilist.co/character/28030)'s sister.

136430.name: Emma
136430.desc: [Einar](https://anilist.co/character/28030) and [Lotta](https://anilist.co/character/296218)'s mother

136430.name: Kitsune
136430.desc: Member of [Snake](https://anilist.co/character/79913/)'s mercenaries employed as guards of [Ketil](https://anilist.co/character/223346)'s farm.

136430.name: Anaguma
136430.desc: Member of [Snake](https://anilist.co/character/79913/)'s mercenaries employed as guards of [Ketil](https://anilist.co/character/223346)'s farm.

136430.name: Pater
136430.desc: __Height:__ 165 cm A former slave working for [Ketil](https://anilist.co/character/223346) as a farm hand.

136430.name: Ethelred II
136430.desc: English king deposed from his throne by [Sweyn](https://anilist.co/character/27957).

136430.name: Eadric
136430.desc: An earl loyal to [Ethelred II](https://anilist.co/character/2981050) who was pressured into serving [Canute](https://anilist.co/character/17438) for his family's safety.

136430.name: Okusama
136430.desc: [Ketil](https://anilist.co/character/223346)'s wife.

136430.name: Wulf
136430.desc: __Height:__ 175cm Canute's head thegn and his battle instructor.

136430.name: Estrid
136430.desc: Daughter of King Sweyn and sister to Harald and Canute.

136430.name: Harald
136430.desc: Eldest son of King Sweyn and brother to Canute and Estrid.

136430.name: Brodd
136430.desc: A messenger for King Canute.

136430.name: Gardar
136430.desc: __Height:__ 180 cm A former Viking warrior turned slave. ~!Before being a slave, he had a happy life with his wife [Arnheid](https://anilist.co/character/75590) and son [Hjatli](https://anilist.co/character/302134).!~

136430.name: Tokage
136430.desc: A member of Snake's band of mercenaries employed by Ketil.

136430.name: Hjalti
136430.desc: Son of Arnheid and Gardar.

136430.name: Suzume
136430.desc: Member of Snake's band of Guests.

136430.name: Drott
136430.desc: Soldier serving as personal guard of Canute.

136430.name: Ylva no Kodomo
136430.desc: Eldest son of Ari and Ylva.

116742.name: Rimuru Tempest
116742.desc: __Species:__ Human (past life) → Slime __Kind:__ Reincarnated, Otherworlder Rimuru Tempest, formerly known as Satoru Mikami, is the main protagonist of Tensei Shitara Slime Datta Ken. They are the founder and King of the monster country Tempest, situated in the Great Jura Forest, and the partner and sworn friend of Storm Dragon, [Veldora Tempest](https://anilist.co/character/128034/Veldora-Tempest).

116742.name: Shion
116742.desc: "War Lord" Shion is Rimuru’s first servant to be in charge of his care as his personal secretary. She is also the leader of the Yomigaeri and also one of Rimuru's strongest fighters and is coveted by many of the Demon Lords who have met her.

116742.name: Veldora Tempest
116742.original: ヴェルドラ＝テンペスト
116742.desc: __Height:__ 210 cm (human form), 100 m (dragon form) __Species:__ True Dragon __Blessing / Divine Protection:__ Storm Dragon's Grace, Demon Lord's Ally __Disaster Rank:__ Catastrophe Veldora Tempest is the youngest of the four strongest dragons (True Dragons). He is connected with [Rimuru](https://anilist.co/character/123962) by an agreement and was known to rampage here and there. He was the one to name Rimuru and Rimuru gave him his last name, since they share the same last name, Rimuru could technically be classified as Veldora's adoptive brother.

116742.name: Ranga
116742.desc: "Star Lord" Ranga is a Wind Spirit Wolf and a loyal follower of [Rimuru](https://anilist.co/character/123962/Tempest-Rimuru). The leader of the Star Wolf Clan, and the son of the previous boss of the Direwolves. He is also one of Rimuru's Twelve Patrons who has been given the title of a "Lord".

116742.name: Milim Nava
116742.desc: __Kind:__ Inhabitant "Destroyer" Milim Nava is one of the oldest and strongest Demon Lords. She is a Dragonoid. Her nickname, Destroyer, is not just for show. She is a demon lord one should never fight against.

116742.name: Benimaru
116742.desc: Benimaru is one of the third group of subordinate Monsters to be named by Rimuru Tempest. Originally an Ogre, he was uncertain of his servitude and intended for it to be temporary, but after being named, he evolved into a Kijin, immediately becoming Rimuru's most powerful subordinate for a time, and decided to serve him permanently. He lives in the Capital city of the Jura Tempest Federation: Rimuru City. Soon after, and became Commander-in-Chief, giving him direct command over Tempest's military forces. Upon Rimuru's ascension to a True Demon Lord, Benimaru evolved into a Fair Oni and reached the strength of a Disaster-Class Monster.

116742.name: Souei
116742.desc: __Height__: 180 cm (Kijin), 190 cm (Ogre) Souei is an Ogre that was among the third group of subordinates to be named by Rimuru Tempest. He is Rimuru's faithful shadow and the leader of the Shadow Squad of the Jura Tempest Federation.

116742.name: Shuna
116742.desc: Shuna is one of the third group of subordinate Monsters to be named by [Rimuru](https://anilist.co/character/123962), evolving her from an Ogre to a Kijin. She was originally the princess of the Ogre tribe and even though she had the talent for using Magic, she was a sheltered girl, but quickly got along with the Goblinas Shuna is the daughter of the late ogre chieftain and she is also [Benimaru](https://anilist.co/character/128038)'s younger sister, which is why she's nicknamed "Oni Princess" by Rimuru. Very skilled and knowledgeable in domestic matters, she essentially becomes Rimuru's chief economic advisor together with [Rigurd](https://anilist.co/character/129348).

116742.name: Daikenja
116742.desc: Unique Skill Great Sage is one of the first two Unique Skills (the other being Predator) that [Rimuru Tempest](https://anilist.co/character/123962/Rimuru-Tempest) had upon being born into his new world. It had evolved from Extra Skill Sage during his death, as he thought since he was approaching his forties as a virgin, he must be something much greater than a mere wizard. ~!During Rimuru's evolution into Demon Lord this Unique Skill evolved into the Ultimate Skill: Wisdom King Raphael.!~ ~!Rimuru gave her a name and she evolved into a manas with the name Ciel!~

116742.name: Rigurd
116742.desc: Formerly the chief of the goblin village Rimuru comes across. He's now the acting prime minister of the Jura Tempest Federation. He evolved into a hobgoblin when Rimuru named him.

116742.name: Gobta
116742.desc: Gobta is a hobgoblin and is one of Rimuru Tempest's followers. Though he seems to be air-headed he tends to be a hard-worker and dependable when the time calls for it.

116742.name: Gido
116742.desc: Gido is a member of Cabal's Party who serves as the 'thief' role. ~!However, he is actually serving as one of the bodyguards of Lady Elyune secretly while under the guise of an adventurer.!~ (Source: Tensei Shitara Slime Datta Ken Wikia)

116742.name: Kaval
116742.desc: Kaval is the leader of his adventure's party, where he serves as the 'fighter' role. ~!Alongside Gido, he is also tasked as the secret bodyguard of Lady Elyune under the guise of an adventurer.!~ (Source: Tensei Shitara Slime Datta Ken Wikia)

116742.name: Ellen
116742.desc: Eren is an adventurer and a member of Kaval's Party. ~!She is actually the daughter of the Duke of Sorcerer's Dynasty Sarion Elalude, who ran off to be an adventurer due to her selfishness and free-spirited personality.!~ (Source: Tensei Shitara Slime Datta Ken Wikia)

116742.name: Diablo
116742.desc: Diablo is the Black Primordial and a loyal servant of [Rimuru Tempest](https://anilist.co/character/123962/Tempest-Rimuru). Before he met Rimuru, he went by the nicknames Black or Noir, the latter which he received from his fellow Primordial kin. After receiving the name Diablo from Rimuru, he evolved to a Demon Peer.

116742.name: Ramiris
116742.desc: Ramiris is a fairy that resides inside of Tempest's Underground Labyrinth. She is also one of the Eight-Star Demon Lords.

116742.name: Daggrull
116742.desc: "Earthquake" Daggrull is a giant that is close friends with Deeno. He is the fourth seat of the Octagram (Eight-Star Demon Lords).

116742.name: Luminous Valentine
116742.original: ルミナス・バレンタイン
116742.desc: "Queen of Nightmares" Luminous Valentine is an elite vampire and one of the Eight-Star Demon Lords. She is also the true ruler of the Holy Kingdom Ruberion.

116742.name: Frey
116742.desc: "Sky Queen" Frey is an ex-Demon Lord and currently a subordinate of [Demon Lord Milim Nava](https://anilist.co/character/128036/Nava-Milim). She often scolds Milim for playing around when she is supposed to be working.

116742.name: Gabiru
116742.desc: The captain of the Hiryuu of Tempest, and the former lizardmen raid leader. He suffers from a superiority complex. The root of Gabil's pride and confidence​ is the thought that he is the chosen one.

116742.name: Hinata Sakaguchi
116742.desc: Hinata Sakaguchi is an otherworlder and the leader of the Imperial Guards under the Pope's direct command. Along with Yuuki and Class S, she's a former student of Shizue Izawa. ~!At first she thought monsters should all be exterminated. But after her fight with Rimuru, she was convinced that Rimuru is not evil.!~

116742.name: Hakurou
116742.desc: Hakurou is a Fair Oni and is a loyal follower of Rimuru Tempest. He was one of the survivors of the Orc attack. He was also the teacher of the Dwarven King.

116742.name: Karion
116742.desc: ~!Karion is one of the ten demon lords that existed before Rimuru became a demon lord. During the Walpurgis Banquet where Rimuru killed Clayman. Karion became a subordinate of Milim.!~

116742.name: Kagali
116742.desc: Kagali is an elf that serves as secretary to Yuuki Kagurazaka. ~!Her true identity is that of a former Demon Lord, and president of the Moderate Harlequin Alliance, who had once been known as Curse Lord Kazaream. Seemingly killed by Leon Cromwell 200 years ago, Kazaream managed to survive by escaping with just his Astral Body and now occupies a Homunculus body in the shape of a female elf.!~

116742.name: Leon Cromwell
116742.original: レオン・クロムウェル
116742.desc: Leon Cromwell is a former hero and a current Demon Lord of the Eight-pointed Star Octagram. He is the ruler of El Dorado, an island nation located south-west of the world.

116742.name: Guy Crimson
116742.desc: Guy Crimson is the oldest of the Demon Lords. He has forever ruled over the frozen continent. Being androgynous, he can become a man or woman at will.

116742.name: Deeno
116742.desc: Demon Lord Deeno, known as the Sleeping Ruler, is one of the Eight-Star Demon Lords.

116742.name: Kurobee
116742.desc: Kurobee is a Fair Oni and a loyal follower of Rimuru Tempest. Kurobee was originally one of the Oni that survived the Orc attack. He evolved after being named by Rimuru.

116742.name: Clayman
116742.desc: Demon Lord Clayman, is one of the ten demon lords that ~!existed before Rimuru became a demon lord. He turned into Kazaream's underling when Kazaream turned him into a demon lord.!~

116742.name: Beretta
116742.desc: Beretta is a Greater Demon that was summoned by Rimuru to protect Ramiris to make up for destroying her previous golem. They incarnated in a golem made out of pure magisteel and have served her since.

116742.name: Gazel Dwargo
116742.desc: Species: Dwarf Blessing / Divine Protection: Divine Protector of Ancestor Title: King of Armament Nation Dwargon. The king of Dwargon, Gazel Dwargo, the third generation king of Dwargon, but possesses a similar aura to that of his grandfather in his younger days. He is renowned as a great hero and celebrated as a wise king for his impartial rule.

116742.name: Treyni
116742.desc: Treyni is a dryad that resides in the Jura Forest.

116742.name: Souka
116742.desc: Gabil's younger sister, and the daughter of Abil. After the Orc Lord incident, she swears her allegeiance to Rimuru. She attends to Souei as a spy.

116742.name: Yuuki Kagurazaka
116742.desc: A former student of Shizu who originally came from Japan and ~!one of the main antagonists of the series. !~ Yuuki serves as the Guild Master of the Adventurers' Guild in the kingdom of Ingracia, and he loves manga. ~!Although Yuuki first comes as a friendly person he is actually a master in manipulating others without hesitation to achieve his goal of a just world that treats everyone fairly. Even though Rimuru and Yuuki get along at first he later addresses Rimuru as a very serious threat to his plans. !~

116742.name: Geld
116742.desc: He is one of the fourth group of subordinates to be named by Rimuru Tempest. As the right-hand man of the deceased Orc Lord, he was given the same name as him, as a memento and token of appreciation, similar to how Rigur was named after his older brother. As an Orc King, he is the leader of the Yellow Corps, that acts as both the last line of defense for Tempest as well as the main team of the country's Department of Construction and Manufacturing. Later on, he was given the Title of a "Lord" as one of Rimuru's Twelve Patrons.

116742.name: Tear
116742.desc: Member of the Moderate Jesters alongside Laplace and Footman, and as that loyal subordinate of Demon Lord Kazaream.

116742.name: Fuze
116742.desc: He is the Brumund Kingdom's Freedom Association, Guild Master.

116742.name: Youm Farmenas
116742.original: ヨウム・ファルメナス
116742.desc: The Hero-King Farmenas of the Farmenas Kingdom. Formerly the Farmas Kingdom, Count Nidole Maigam’s Territory's, Frontier Garrison Captain Youm.

116742.name: Ifrit
116742.desc: Ifrit is a high-ranking spirit; the ruler of flame which was sealed within Shizue Izawa by Demon Lord Leon Cromwell. He used to live in Dwelling of the Spirit before he was stolen by the "Blonde Demon" Leon Cromwell. After that, he was sealed within Shizue Izawa. As a result of this, it gave Shizue an extended lifespan.

116742.name: Laplace
116742.desc: He is the vice-president of the Moderate Jesters and as that a loyal subordinate of Demon Lord Kazaream.

116742.name: Phobio
116742.desc: __Species:__ Leopard Lycanthrope He is one of the "Beastketeers" of the Demon Lord Karion. He is proclaimed to be the strongest warrior of the 3 "Beastketeers".

116742.name: Kumara
116742.desc: One of the ninth group of subordinates to be named by Rimuru Tempest. She was originally a small fox spirit enslaved by Clayman and was freed from his curse by Rimuru. (Source: The Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime wiki)

116742.name: Albis
116742.desc: Albis, known as the Golden Serpent, is one of Carrion's Beastman subordinates. She is the leader of Yuurazania's Three Beastketeers. ~!She becomes one of Benimaru's wives later on along with Momiji!~

116742.name: Grucius
116742.desc: Grucius is a Beastman from the Beast Kingdom Eurazania.

116742.name: Suphia
116742.desc: Suphia, known as the White Tiger Claw, is one of Beast Kingdom Eurazania's Three Beastketeers. She is described as having a ferocious aura that has been likened to a "battle-hardened leader".

116742.name: Mjurran
116742.desc: A travelling wizard who was granted a place in Youm's party as their advisor after defeating the aforementioned in a duel. ~!Of Clayman's "Five Fingers", she was the "Ring Finger", acting as one of his spies until Rimuru severs his control over her heart.!~

116742.name: Tiss
116742.desc: Tiss is a homeroom teacher of the Freedom Academy.

116742.name: Footman
116742.desc: Footman is a Majin who is part of the Moderate Harlequin Alliance

116742.name: Mizeri
116742.desc: The green Demon Primordial and a subordinate of fellow Primordial [Guy Crimson](https://anilist.co/character/131048/Guy-Crimson). Guy is the one who gave Mizeri her name. Mizeri's partner is the Blue Primordial [Raine](https://anilist.co/character/198042/Raine).

116742.name: Raine
116742.desc: The Blue Primordial and subordinate of fellow Primordial Guy Crimson. Guy was the one who gave Raine her name.

116742.name: Razen
116742.desc: Razen is a brilliant sorcerer who has served many years as a Court Mage in Farmus, part of why he has lived so long is his Possession Spell. He was once a student under the Great Sorcerer Gadra. ~!He's currently possessing Shogo Taguchi's body!~

116742.name: Gobzo
116742.desc: A Goblin in Tempest thats friends with Gobuta

116742.name: Velzard
116742.desc: Velzard, also known as White Ice Dragon, is the second-oldest of the four True Dragons and the partner of Guy Crimson. Uninterested in most worldly matters, Velzard usually spends her time in the Palace of White Ice, releasing her aura that keeps the Ice Continent frozen.

116742.name: Erald Grimwald
116742.original: エラルド・グリムワルト
116742.desc: An Archduke of Sorcerer's Dynasty Sarion. He is the empress' uncle and Ellen's father. He's an envoy representing the empress.

116742.name: Yamza
116742.desc: Yamza was the Clayman Army Commander-In-Chief and the Middle-finger of Clayman's Five Fingers. (Source: That Time I got Reincarnated as a Slime fandom)

116742.name: Middray
116742.desc: A Dragonewt and the Head Priest of the Dragon Faithful that worships Milim Nava.

116742.name: Hermes
116742.desc: A priest of the Dragon Faithful that worships Milim Nava. He is Middray's assistant.

116742.name: Roy Valentin
116742.original: ロイ・ヴァレンタイン
116742.desc: A member of the Ten Great Demon Lords. In Kagali's prime, his strength was comparable to hers. ~!It is revealed he was just a stand-in and proxy demon lord for Luminous Valentine, the true ruler of Ruberios, and the god of Luminism.!~

116742.name: Adalman
116742.desc: Adalman, formerly the Index Finger of Clayman's Five Fingers, is an Undead and the guardian of the 70th floor of Ramiris' Labyrinth.

116742.name: Yashichi
116742.desc: __Race:__ Dragonewt One of [Gabiru](https://anilist.co/character/131041)'s subordinates and friends. Yashichi fervently supports Gabiru through victory and defeat.

116742.name: Trya
116742.desc: Trya is a Dryad that resides in the Jura Forest. She is the sister of Treyni.

139630.name: Katsuki Bakugou
139630.desc: __Height:__ 172 cm (5'7") __Quirk:__ Explosion Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Katsuki is a crude, arrogant, short-tempered, and aggressive person, especially at the beginning of the series. Due to the constant praise of his abilities and powerful Quirk, Katsuki has developed a superiority complex, and because of that, he desires to be the first and best at everything. He loves to win above all else and cannot stand it when he doesn't, leading him to lose his already short temper if he achieves anything but a complete victory. Katsuki is not only very athletic and talented at fighting, but also very intelligent and extremely perceptive, capable of strategic planning and improvisation. Additionally, his grades are among the highest of his class. Katsuki also possesses surprising talent in other areas, such as cooking and music, even though he doesn't show a particular interest in them. Overall, Katsuki is considered a natural-born genius with the potential to be one of the best Pro Heroes. Katsuki's Quirk "Explosion" allows him to secrete nitroglycerin-like sweat from the palms of his hands and ignite it on command, allowing him to create strong explosions. The more Katsuki sweats, the stronger his explosions become. Not only can Katsuki use the explosions for attacking, he can also use them to propel himself and navigate through the air at high speeds, allowing him to fly at his opponents without giving them time to react, as well as evade incoming attacks, even whi

139630.name: Izuku Midoriya
139630.desc: __Height:__ 166 cm (5'5¼") __Quirk:__ One For All Student in Class 1-A at U.A High School. Although he was born without a Quirk, Izuku's innate heroism and strong sense of justice manages to catch the attention of the legendary hero [All Might](https://anilist.co/character/89224). Izuku has since become All Might's closest pupil. Izuku is a very timid, reserved, and polite boy. Although initially portrayed as insecure, tearful, and vulnerable, Izuku gradually matures into a more confident and braver person. His infectious leadership skills, combined with his passion and strategic abilities, have turned Izuku into a central figure of Class 1-A. He is caring and emotional, never hesitating to help or rescue someone in danger, even if he knows that he might not be strong or otherwise qualified enough to do it. Izuku is extremely (and sometimes scarily) enthusiastic about topics related to heroes. His dream drives him to write down notes about everything he learns about heroes' Quirks and fighting capabilities. Thanks to this practice, Izuku has developed a great analytical mind and can form complex battle plans in a few seconds, factoring in the best ways he can utilize the Quirks of allies and enemies alike for his own advantage. Izuku's Quirk "One For All" was transferred to him from All Might. His Quirk allows him to stockpile an enormous amount of raw power, allowing him to significantly enhance all of his physical abilities to various boundless levels. This results in unbel

139630.name: Shouto Todoroki
139630.desc: __Height:__ 176 cm (5'9") __Affiliation:__ U.A. High School __Quirk:__ Half-Cold Half-Hot Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School, where he got in through official recommendations. He is the youngest son of the top hero [Endeavor](https://anilist.co/character/126158). Shouto initially has a cold, aloof personality, which stemmed from his complicated family life. Focused and unemotional, Shouto preferred to keep things to himself instead of hanging out with others. After the events of the U.A. Sports Festival, however, he notably became more sociable and kinder than ever before. He even gained a sense of humor and would occasionally smile, although still retaining some fragments of his previous distant attitude and nonchalant demeanor. While usually quiet and reserved, Shouto initially possessed a moderate level of arrogance, which, combined with his solitary tendencies, sometimes made him take the initiative without considering the opinions of others. Shouto's Quirk Half-Cold Half-Hot gives him the ability to generate ice from the right side of his body, and flames from his left side. Due to years of rejecting his father, Shouto has developed a habit of favoring ice, even when fire would be a better option. This grudge also caused him to have difficulty controlling his flames. If he overuses one element without utilizing the other, then his own body temperature will suffer.

139630.name: Ochako Uraraka
139630.desc: __Height:__ 156 cm (5'1") __Quirk:__ Zero Gravity Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School Ochako is an outgoing, lively person who thinks about everything positively, though she is objective enough to see flaws and virtues. She gets excited over little things very easily. Ochaco has been described by other students as "the most laidback girl" among her class, being very bubbly and kind of an airhead at times. She is often incredibly blunt without being aware of it. She is on good terms with everyone and is particularly close friends with several class members, including [Izuku](https://anilist.co/character/89028/Midoriya-Izuku), [Tenya Ida](https://anilist.co/character/89222/Iida-Tenya), and [Tsuyu](https://anilist.co/character/89223/Asui-Tsuyu). Ochaco's Quirk gives her the power to manipulate gravity upon touching solid things with the pads on her fingertips. The targets lose their gravitational pull, effectively making them weightless. She is able to activate or cancel her Quirk's effects by closing her fingers together, and is shown to be careful with her hands in order to avoid accidental quirk activation.

139630.name: Tenya Iida
139630.desc: __Height:__ 179 cm (5'10") __Quirk:__ Engine Class representative of Class 1-A at U.A. High School Tenya may look severe, but he's actually just a very serious person, who takes everything, even the most insignificant thing, seriously. A testament to his generally hyperactive and intense behavior, Tenya often exhibits plenty of peculiar tics, such as moving his arms around in strange chopping patterns or sometimes twitching his body uncontrollably. Tenya is very humble, willing to admit to his mistakes, apologize for rude behavior, and improve in areas he lacks. Being part of the highly-esteemed Ida Family of Heroes, Tenya is proud of his lineage and works hard to meet his expectations. He greatly admires his older brother, Tensei (also known as the Turbo Hero: Ingenium), and aspires to become a similar hero. Tenya's Quirk Engine gives him car-like engines in each of his calves, giving him incredible running speed and extreme kicking power. Tenya needs to fuel his engines by drinking orange juice. Tenya's engines have multiple gears; it is currently unknown how many, but it has been implied that there are more than three.

139630.name: Tsuyu Asui
139630.desc: __Affiliation:__ U.A. High School __Quirk:__ Frog Tsuyu is a very straight-forward girl that always says what's on her mind and what she thinks about others. She prefers to be called by her first name.

139630.name: Toshinori Yagi
139630.desc: __Height:__ 220 cm (7'2") __Quirk:__ One for All All Might is the No. 1 Hero and the "Symbol of Peace." In his hero form, All Might is a very tall and over-muscular man whose design resembles the american hero comics. His hair spikes on top of his head and his whole body has more shadows than a normal human being. However, in his true form, he is an overly-skinny man who spits a lot of blood out of his mouth and his clothes appear loose.

139630.name: Shouta Aizawa
139630.desc: __Height: __183 cm (6') __Occupation:__ Pro Hero, Teacher __Affiliation:__ U.A. High School __Quirk:__ Erasure Aizawa's hero name, Eraserhead, was coined by [Present Mic](https://anilist.co/character/127425) when they were younger. Using the binding cloth, Aizawa has a unique fighting style that allows him to immobilize his enemies. He is known to expel students that don't meet his standards, however it should be noted that he did not expel anyone from Class 1-A. Aizawa is extremely vocal, able to voice his opinions very easily. Although seeming emotionless and reserved, he has a soft spot for his students and genuinely cares for them.

139630.name: Tomura Shigaraki
139630.desc: __Height:__ 175 cm (5'9) __Quirk:__ Decay Leader of the League of Villains and protégé of [All For One](https://anilist.co/character/125956/All-For-One). He was raised by his master, All For One, with the goal of killing [All Might](https://anilist.co/character/89224/Yagi-Toshinori), and ultimately destroying the society he represents. Tomura is a very twisted, malevolent, and maliciously warped young man, who is considered to be the polar opposite of [Izuku Midoriya](https://anilist.co/character/89028/Midoriya-Izuku). He doesn't care for his or almost anyone else's life, having no qualms about performing evil deeds like murdering innocent people. Tomura was initially perceived to be a "man-child": arrogant, selfish, dependent, and demanding, becoming angry if things didn't go his way and likening reality to some sort of video game. Unlike his mentor, Tomura lacked subtlety, preferring to eliminate problems through force. Much like a child, Tomura seemed unable to cope with his own feelings, instead lashing out and abusing both others or himself, tearing at his own neck when he becomes frustrated. Initially, Tomura seemingly caused destruction just for the sake of it and felt directionless about the League's path forward after [Stain](https://anilist.co/character/126067/Akaguro-Chizome)'s arrest. It would take a fateful meeting with Izuku in a mall for him to develop an epiphany and become aware of his true convictions: to crumble hero society through All Might's death. Tomur

139630.name: Momo Yaoyorozu
139630.desc: __Height:__ 173 cm (5'8") __Quirk:__ Creation Vice class representative of Class 1-A at U.A. High School. She was admitted to the school through official recommendations. Momo is a very prudent, dedicated person who acts as a natural leader. She is generally level-headed and calm in dangerous situations, but she isn't above falling into a panic. Momo can be blunt with her comments about people's mistakes and miscalculations, tending to be very direct and wishing to help her peers improve enough to become great heroes. Momo's Quirk gives her the ability to create any non-living material/object from her exposed skin by transforming the molecular structure of her fat cells. In order to create something, she needs to understand the molecular structure of which the material/object is made.

139630.name: Eijirou Kirishima
139630.desc: __Height:__ 170 cm (5'7") __Quirk:__ Hardening Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Eijiro is a boisterous and outgoing guy with a fondness for manliness, often using the terms "manly" and "unmanly" to describe things and people he does or doesn't like, respectively. Eijiro is very honest and kind-hearted, having a straightforward way of thinking and following a specific code of chivalry that motivates him to live without regret. He is determined and selfless, bravely putting the safety of others before himself.
