He is also a big fan of Crimson Riot, a retro hero from whom he takes inspiration, including personal values and his hero name. Although Eijiro may not be as hot-blooded and competitive as [Katsuki Bakugou](https://anilist.co/character/88892), he does not shy away from comparing himself to him, with [Izuku](https://anilist.co/character/89028) stating that the two have managed to develop a relationship between equals. As a result, Eijiro is notably one of the few people that Katsuki holds in higher esteem. Eijiro's Quirk gives him the power to harden and sharpen any or all parts of his body, causing his flesh to become jagged and rock-like. There is a limit to how much damage his hardened body can withstand, which causes the Hardening itself to slowly dissipate, and Eijiro to lose stamina from struggling to keep his Quirk active.

139630.name: Minoru Mineta
139630.desc: __Height:__ 108 cm (3' 6½") __Quirk:__ Pop Off __Affiliation:__ U.A. High School __Fighting Style:__ Medium Ranged Support Minoru Mineta, also known as the Fresh-Picked Hero: Grape Juice, is a student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School, training to become a Pro Hero.

139630.name: Mina Ashido
139630.desc: __Height:__ 159 cm (5'3") __Quirk:__ Acid Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Mina is a cheerful and easygoing girl who usually displays a smile. Highly social and excitable, she loves to hang out with her friends and is shown to become very upset when denied an opportunity to be at a gathering. She possesses a strong fashion sense and likes to go shopping. Due to her athleticism and energy, Mina enjoys and is very skilled at dancing. Mina is extremely courageous and is viewed as an ideal personality for hero work. Mina's Quirk Acid allows her to produce a corrosive liquid from her body. She can control the solubility and viscosity of this corrosive liquid. There is a limit to how long she can produce the corrosive liquid until her skin gradually loses its natural resistance to it. Overusing her Quirk or pushing it too far can also be fatal, as it dehydrates her body very fast. Mina can use her acid offensively, but has shown utility with it as well, such as melting handholds for herself to climb with. She is also known to secrete a non-corrosive version of the acid from her feet in order to slide around.

139630.name: Denki Kaminari
139630.desc: __Height:__ 168 cm (5'6") __Quirk:__ Electrification Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Denki is a friendly, social, and energetic boy who enjoys hanging out with others. He is rather casual when interacting with other people, including the generally unfriendly [Katsuki Bakugou](https://anilist.co/character/88892/Bakugou-Katsuki). Denki's Quirk Electrification allows him to store and discharge electricity. While he can also discharge this energy over a distance, Denki has little to no control over it, meaning it will go everywhere indiscriminately. Denki is also able to absorb and neutralize electricity and other lightning-based Quirks. Whenever Denki exceeds his wattage limit, he loses his ability to discharge energy, with his entire personality changing into that of a giggling idiot for a certain period until he reverts to normal. In this state, he is always giving thumbs-ups as a way to let others know that he is okay.

139630.name: Jin Bubaigawara
139630.desc: __Height:__ 178 cm (5'10") __Quirk:__ Double Villain affiliated with the League of Villains, and part of its Vanguard Action Squad. Jin has an incredibly unique personality: explosive, and lively with a very comedic demeanor. He enjoys assuming dramatic poses and eccentric facial expressions. Jin constantly contradicts himself, making a statement in one voice and immediately saying the opposite in another. This juxtaposition iss part of a mental instability that Jin embraces as a villain. He believes understanding your own identity is the most essential aspect in life, an understanding he lost during the 9-day conflict with his own clones that left him unsure whether he was the original or not. Now, if his mask is removed, he panics and threatens to "split" until he put his mask back on to become "whole". Jin's Quirk allows him to create an exact duplicate of anything, living or not. To duplicate something, he needs to know its precise measurements and characteristics. The clones he makes do not disappear; instead, they disintegrate into a mud-like substance after taking a certain amount of damage. The duplicates are less durable than the original, and the second duplicate is even less durable than the first. When Jin creates duplicates of a person, he has no control over the clones because they have their own autonomy, personalities, and abilities that are utterly identical to the original.

139630.name: Hanta Sero
139630.desc: __Height:__ 177 cm (5' 9¾") __Quirk:__ Tape Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Hanta is amicable and has proven to be one of the more sociable members of Class 1-A. He can sometimes be loud and showy, often trying to impress his peers with his Quirk. He is often the only person to call his classmates out when they act crazy. He is pretty humorous and usually makes jokes with his classmates. However, when push comes to shove, Hanta is a brave hero-in-training who wishes to prosper on his own while helping others do the same. Hanta's Quirk is that he has tape dispenser-like organs in his elbows, from which he can shoot long cellophane tape-like strips; he can also retract them. They appear to be somewhat sturdier than regular tape. Overuse of his Quirk will cause his skin to dry out. He can use his tape to wrap people, swing long distances, and create traps, among other applications.

139630.name: Kyouka Jirou
139630.desc: __Height:__ 154 cm (5'1") __Quirk:__ Earphone Jack __Affiliation:__ U.A. High School __Fighting Style:__ Medium Ranged + Support Combat Kyoka is a petite, fair-skinned girl with a slender build. She has triangular, lazy-looking onyx eyes with notably long lower eyelashes, and rather small eyebrows. Kyoka has a pragmatic, unenthusiastic and teasing personality that is mostly shown to those she finds irritating. Kyoka is not always like this though, as she does enjoy socializing with others, in which case she is usually nice and friendly. Kyoka's Quirk (Earphone Jack) allows her to plug the jacks that hang from her earlobes into all sorts of things and channel the sound of her heartbeat into them; causing havoc inside the plugged objects. It's also used to catch sounds and vibrations from her surroundings.

139630.name: Fumikage Tokoyami
139630.desc: __Height:__ 158 cm __Quirk:__ Dark Shadow Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Fumikage is reserved, serious, and focused, albeit noble and valiant. Though not talkative, Fumikage will directly ignore questions or requests that seem in some way pointless. During combat, Fumikage is known to be fierce and dependable, with his strength and capabilities rarely being questioned. Fumikage is fond of darkness and other related concepts, considering himself a "creature of the dark" and employing archaic-sounding speeches that paint him slightly creepy or dramatic. Fumikage's Quirk "Dark Shadow" allows him to manifest a sentient shadow monster from his body that he can materialize and contract freely. Dark Shadow's energy is limited and can be drained by bright light. Dark Shadow retracts into Fumikage's body when it runs out of energy. The shadow entity's personality, strength, defense, and control depend on the lack of light. In bright light, Dark Shadow is weaker and smaller but still has considerable strength and defense and is easier to control, but in total darkness, Dark Shadow's size and parameters are drastically enhanced. It is powerful enough to rip out and cut down multiple full-grown trees easily. However, Dark Shadow is more difficult to control in the dark, causing it to rampage based on its own free will.

139630.name: Mezou Shouji
139630.desc: __Height:__ 187 cm (6'2") __Quirk:__ Dupli-Arms Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Shouji is friendly and gentle, and he will work nicely with anyone. He is not the type to hold grudges, showing no ill will towards those that harm him unwillingly. Shouji is entirely selfless and willing to risk his life for anyone. He can be empathetic and understanding, but still shows a sense of maturity and responsibility that prevents him from acting under emotional impulses. He is very protective of his classmates, especially if they are hurt or injured. He is also quite thick-skinned, as he said he is used to being feared due to his appearance. Shouji's Quirk grants him a set of tentacles alongside his arms. He can transform the tips of these tentacles to replicate other parts of his body (ex: mouth, ears, eyes). The duplicated body parts are more efficient than the originals; as a result, Mezo is able to hear better, see-through more angles at a time, and they grant him much higher degrees of strength. He uses these arms to talk most of the time through duplicate mouths, rather than his actual mouth.

139630.name: Tooru Hagakure
139630.desc: __Height:__ 152 cm (5'0") __Quirk:__ Invisibility Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Tooru is a bubbly, cheery, and easygoing girl who does most things with an upbeat attitude. She is very socially eager and likes shopping, and her room suggests that she likes plushies and other cute things. Tooru's Quirk is that her body is completely invisible. In addition to the stealth capabilities granted to her by her invisible body, Tooru can refract light that passes through her, allowing her to intensify the light into a blinding flash. She has further refined this application of her Quirk, achieving the ability to manipulate and redirect light-based attacks, such as [Yuuga Aoyama](https://anilist.co/character/127042/Aoyama-Yuuga)'s Navel Laser.

139630.name: Kouji Kouda
139630.desc: __Height:__ 186 cm (6'1") __Quirk:__ Anivoice Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Contrary to his strong and powerful appearance, Kouji is very timid and quiet. He rarely speaks and prefers using sign language to communicate with his classmates. He hates violence due to his kind-hearted nature. Kouji appears to greatly enjoy the company of animals, as his Quirk allows him to interact with animals in ways others cannot. He owns a small rabbit as a pet. Kouji's Quirk "Anivoice (生き物ボイス, Ikimono Voice)" gives him the ability to command any creature in the animal kingdom by speaking to them. Whatever command he gives, the animal will carry it out. However, he cannot exert control if they cannot hear his command. The target must also be a real animal and not merely animal-like. Kouji can also exchange information with the animals to find the locations of various people and potential enemies faster. Kouji has been shown to use the Quirk effectively with flocks of birds to create a smokescreen of animals and to attack an opponent, along with his use of insects to distract and attack his opponents. He has now also overcome his fear of bugs, so he often uses bugs to swarm opponents with numbers.

139630.name: Rikidou Satou
139630.desc: __Height:__ 185 cm (6'1") __Quirk:__ Sugar Rush Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Rikidou is interested in sweets and baking, a valuable skill due to his Quirk. He is surprisingly talented at making sweets. Rikidou's Quirk Sugar Rush allows him to increase his strength five-fold for three minutes. To activate his Quirk, he needs to consume 10 grams of sugar. When converting sugar into strength, his cognitive functions gradually drop, making him sleepy afterward. For every additional 10 grams of sugar he ingests, he extends the time of increased strength by another three minutes.

139630.name: Yuu Takeyama
139630.desc: __Height:__ 162 cm (5'4") (Normal form); 2062cm (67'8") (Transformed) __Quirk:__ Gigantification __Occupation:__ Pro Hero Pro Hero. Her Quirk allows her to grow to a gigantic size. She cannot variate between her base-height and the gigantified height achieved via her Quirk, making her only able to be either her normal height of 162cm (5 feet 4 inches) or her enlarged height of 2,062cm (67 feet 8 inches) tall.

139630.name: Mirio Togata
139630.desc: __Height:__ 181 cm (5'11") __Occupation:__ Student __Affiliation:__ U.A. High School __Quirk:__ Permeation He is third-year student at U.A. High School and is part of The Big 3 _(the strongest three hero students in all of Japan)_. Before [Izuku Midoriya](https://anilist.co/character/89028/Midoriya-Izuku), Mirio was the top candidate for [All Might](https://anilist.co/character/89224/Yagi-Toshinori)'s successor and inheritor of One For All. His Quirk, Permeation, gives him the ability to become intangible, letting him pass through any tangible matter; he can phase through walls and/or the ground, as well as let enemy attacks pass through him harmlessly.

139630.name: Himiko Toga
139630.desc: __Height:__ 157 cm __Quirk:__ Transform Himiko Toga is a villain affiliated with the League of Villains and part of its Vanguard Action Squad. She originally joined the group as a means to get closer to [Stain](https://anilist.co/character/126067). Himiko is a very cheerful girl, to the point of smiling even after having presumably killed someone, displaying apparent sadistic tendencies. She has a very twisted perception of love and friendship Himiko's Quirk Transform grants her the ability to transform into a physical lookalike of another individual, as well as copy their voice. She can only transform into people whose blood she has ingested. The more blood she drinks, the longer she has access to that person's form. For example, 1 cup of blood allows her to transform for a total of 18 hours. She can even switch between the appearances of multiple people if she drinks the blood of more than one person.

139630.name: Tamaki Amajiki
139630.desc: __Height:__ 177 cm (5'10") __Quirk:__ Manifest Third-year student in Class 3-A at U.A. High School and part of The Big 3 (the strongest three hero students in all of Japan). Tamaki is extremely shy, aloof, depressed, "intimidating", and introverted, especially around big audiences. He gets nervous very easily when talking to other people. If his anxiety gets the best of him, Tamaki will often face away and lean into a wall to hide his face from others. While his physical abilities and Quirk are outstanding, Tamaki is socially awkward and lacks confidence in his powers. Despite his timid heart, Tamaki can show flashes of bravery. Even though he's always been a shy and reserved boy, Tamaki was able to hone his skills and climb the ranks into one of U.A.'s Big 3. [Mirio Togata](https://anilist.co/character/123527/Togata-Mirio) is a big inspiration for Tamaki. Tamaki's Quirk Manifest grants him the ability to manifest the physical characteristics of anything he's eaten; for example, if he eats takoyaki, he can transform his fingers into octopus tentacles. Additionally, anything Tamaki manifests is significantly stronger than normal. The more of a substance Tamaki eats, the stronger his manifestation will be. He can only manifest the traits of substances still in his system and loses access to those traits once the substance is fully digested. He must resupply his Quirk daily and decide what foods to eat beforehand.

139630.name: All For One
139630.original: オール・フォー・ワン
139630.desc: __Quirk:__ All For One __Occupation:__ Villain __Fighting Style:__ Close Range and Long Range All For One is the true leader and benefactor of the League of Villains. Once Japan's most powerful villain and All Might's arch-nemesis, his true motives are unclear and his true identity unknown. His current goal is to raise Shigaraki to become his eventual successor.

139630.name: Shuuichi Iguchi
139630.desc: __Height:__ 174 cm __Occupation:__ Villain __Affiliation:__ League of Villains (formerly), Paranormal Liberation Front (Lieutenant of Brown Regiment) __Quirk:__ Gecko Shuuichi is a villain affiliated with the League of Villains and part of its Vanguard Action Squad. He is completely obsessed with the ways of [Stain](https://anilist.co/character/126067) to the point where he copies his clothing and weaponry style, aiming to follow the same ideals as him and make his dreams come true.

139630.name: Itsuka Kendou
139630.desc: __Height:__ 166 cm (5'5") __Quirk:__ Big Fist Class representative of Class 1-B at U.A. High School, Itsuka is a spirited girl who is thoughtful of others. She does not hesitate to criticize even her classmates if she feels what they are doing is not correct. Due to Itsuka's cheerful personality, she can bring all of Class 1-B together, thus making her the "big sister" of Class 1-B. Itsuka's Quirk Big Fist grants her the ability to enlarge both of her hands to a gigantic size. With the increased size comes enhanced striking power and gripping capabilities.

139630.name: Chizome Akaguro
139630.desc: __Height:__ 182 cm (6'0) __Quirk:__ Bloodcurdle Villain and former vigilante that was notorious for having killed many Pro Heroes. He attacks and kills heroes who he believes do not fit his definition of a "true hero." Chizome is a cruel, unforgiving, and merciless man with a sense of duty to cleanse society of false heroes. He believes that those who become Heroes for fame or money are unworthy of being called the name and only [All Might](https://anilist.co/character/89224/Yagi-Toshinori) is a true hero. Due to his strong ideology, he took it upon himself to become the Hero Killer: Stain to stain his own hands with blood to purge fake heroes and change the current society. Despite his extremist views and beliefs, Stain did have genuine ideals about heroism, which he stood by firmly. He did not hesitate to save people he deemed worthy of being called Heroes, did not like killing without reason, and would even give advice to his enemies. Stain acknowledged that what he did was morally wrong but believed that for society to be put on the right path, someone must be what he was, suggesting that he saw himself as a martyr. Stain's Quirk "Bloodcurdle" allows him to paralyze his target upon tasting a sample of their blood. The amount of time a victim remains paralyzed depends on their blood type; in ascending order from shortest to longest duration, they are: O, A, AB, and B. The maximum amount of time that anyone can be paralyzed is eight minutes. _In My Hero Academia: Vigilantes

139630.name: Eri
139630.desc: __Height:__ 110 cm __Quirk:__ Rewind Eri is a child with bandages all over her body. She wears a white short sleeve dress and has a small horn on the right side of her forehead and has white, long, choppy, unkempt hair. She also has red eyes. Under her bandages, her arms are shown to have numerous scars. ~!Eri is the key source to [Kai Chisaki's](https://anilist.co/character/126357/Kai-Chisaki) operation to manufacture a Quirk-Destroying Drug. She is the granddaughter of the Eight Precepts of Death's boss!~

139630.name: Enji Todoroki
139630.desc: __Height:__ 195 cm (6' 4¾") __Occupation:__ Pro Hero __Quirk:__ Hellflame Endeavor is a tall man with a muscular physique. He has short and spiky, red hair with bright blue eyes. His beard and mustache appear to be made of fire, but when he turns off his flames on his face voluntarily, his stubble shows. ~!His desire to surpass the number one hero has driven him in family matters. Enji put [Shouto](https://anilist.co/character/89220/Todoroki-Shouto) through ruthless "training" which caused Shouto a severe degree of physical and emotional pain. Shouto, harboring a bitter hatred towards his father on account of this, refuses to use his fire powers in battles until [Izuku Midoriya](https://anilist.co/character/89028/Midoriya-Izuku) reminded him of his mother's encouragement. Later, Enji understood his mistakes and told his son he would try to be a better hero and father. He hopes for Shouto and the rest his family to forgive him in the future.!~ ~!He's the former No.2 Hero, but later becomes the new No.1 Hero after [All Might](https://anilist.co/character/89224/Yagi-Toshinori) loses his Quirk!~

139630.name: Nana Shimura
139630.desc: Shimura Nana was the seventh user of the One For All Quirk, [All Might](https://anilist.co/character/89224)'s mentor, and a close friend of [Gran Torino](https://anilist.co/character/127428). ~!It was revealed that she is the grandmother of [Shigaraki](https://anilist.co/character/89226)!~

139630.name: Kai Chisaki
139630.desc: __Height:__ 179 cm (5'10") __Quirk:__ Overhaul Kai Chisaki, also known by the villain name Overhaul, is the Yakuza Captain of the Shie Hassaikai. Overhaul is a mysophobic, antisocial sociopath obsessed with returning the world to the way it was before the Quirk phenomenon. Due to a combination of an old theory claiming Quirks derived from rats and his own mysophobia, Overhaul believes that Quirks are actually a plague on humanity, having infected people with "syndromes" of heroism and villainy. He looks down upon those that use their abilities for either purpose, referring to acts of heroic sacrifice or petty crime as "sicknesses". Overhaul is extremely determined to his ambition of eradicating Quirks, not only due to his own personal phobias, but also because such a thing would allow the yakuza to reclaim the power they once held over society. Kai's Quirk "Overhaul" grants him the ability to disassemble anything he touches, as well as reassemble it in any configuration he desires, effectively giving him full control over matter. Kai can disassemble people to kill them or reassemble them to heal their wounds. He can also do this to himself and even merge his body with others, even allowing him to use their Quirks

139630.name: Dabi
139630.desc: __Height:__ 176 cm (5'9¼") __Quirk:__ Blueflame Dabi is a villain affiliated with the League of Villains and a member of the organization's Vanguard Action Squad. Dabi is a stoic, aloof, confident, and focused individual who rarely shows emotion. While rather crude and violent, he's also shown to be quite cautious. Overall, Dabi is a highly enigmatic individual who trusts no one, preferring to do things alone and in his way. He also gives off the impression of knowing more about certain people than he lets on. Dabi's Quirk grants him the ability to generate and control highly destructive blue flames from his body. He has very well-developed control of his flames and can project them far from himself and in large amounts. However, Dabi's body has a low tolerance for his flame, and he will get burned if he uses them for prolonged periods. ~!It is later revealed that Dabi is Touya Todoroki (轟燈矢), the eldest son of the Pro Hero [Endeavor](https://anilist.co/character/126158/Todoroki-Enji) and his wife [Rei](https://anilist.co/character/150628/Todoroki-Rei), and the older brother to [Shouto Todoroki](https://anilist.co/character/89220/Todoroki-Shouto). For a significant period of time, his whereabouts were unknown.!~

139630.name: Nejire Hadou
139630.desc: __Height:__ 164 cm (5'4") __Occupation:__ Student __Quirk:__ Wave Motion (ability to convert body's vitality into energy that can discharge as blast waves) She is third-year student at U.A. High School and is part of The Big 3 _(the strongest three hero students in all of Japan)_. Nejire is very enthusiastic, affable and cheery, and is always seen moving. She shows great interest in people's unique physical features and is easily distracted by them. She seems to like knowing more than others, but not in a proud way, as she just enjoys explaining things to people and sharing her knowledge. Despite her happy-go-lucky personality, Nejire is fierce in battle. When the situation calls for it, Nejire can be very calm and focused. Her curiosity never seems to extend to the enemy and she always maintains her focus on taking them down.

139630.name: Yuuga Aoyama
139630.desc: **Height:** 168 cm (5'6") **Quirk:** Navel Lazer Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Yuuga appears to be vain and prideful, thinking of himself as superior to the rest of his classmates, especially regarding his Quirk. He exhibits flamboyant mannerisms, is fond of posing, and likes to grab the attention of those around him despite frequently getting ignored by his peers. He also plays up his French heritage, occasionally implementing French words into his sentences. Yuuga's Quirk allows him to shoot a powerful sparkling laser cannon from his navel. It is so powerful, it can blast through two meters of solid concrete. If he fires the laser for more than 1 second at a time, he will suffer intestinal distress.

139630.name: Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu
139630.desc: __Height:__ 174cm (5'9") __Quirk:__ Steel Student in Class 1-B at U.A. High School. Tetsutetsu is defined by his very hotheaded and outspoken personality. He is confident, stubborn, and straightforward in his motivations and actions. He tends to be very vocal about his intentions and has a one-track mind, often looking for the simplest solution to problems to solve them most directly. Tetsutetsu's direct personality shows through his tenacious and upfront fighting style during battles. Tetsutetsu's Quirk allows him to turn his body into steel. This power grants Tetsutetsu both augmented defensive abilities to withstand attacks and the increased strength of his unarmed physical attacks.

139630.name: Hizashi Yamada
139630.desc: __Height:__ 185cm (6'1") __Quirk:__ Voice Pro Hero. He also works as an English teacher at U.A. High School and as a radio talk show host. Yamada maintains the eccentric persona of a radio host. He often poses when he talks and maintains a certain level of excitement or volume, regardless of the situation. Though he tends to be a jovial individual, Hizashi is capable of great rage when it comes to his friends and colleagues. Yamada's Quirk "Voice" allows him to increase the volume of his voice, giving him an ability that is similar to a sonic scream. The sound from his Quirk is strong enough to cause people's ears to bleed from far away. The only known weakness of this Quirk is that the loud sounds do not travel well underground, making this Quirk ineffective against anything that is underground or separated from him by layers of earth.

139630.name: Ibara Shiozaki
139630.desc: __Height:__ 167cm (5'6") __Quirk:__ Vine Student in Class 1-B at U.A. High School. Ibara is a very modest and courteous person. Although graceful and soft-spoken, she is not afraid to make her pure intentions known. She seems highly religious due to her talking about heaven and divine beings in passing on multiple occasions, and her ultimate moves having somewhat religious names such as "Faith's Shield" and "Crucifixion". Ibara's Quirk "Vine (ツル, Tsuru) gives her hair-like vines that grow on her head. She can lengthen and manipulate the vines, allowing her to attack, defend and grapple. She also can detach them at will. The vines will grow back, provided her head receives proper sunlight and water. (Source: MyHero Academia Wiki)

139630.name: Nemuri Kayama
139630.desc: __Height:__ 175 cm (5'9") __Quirk:__ Somnambulist Pro Hero. She also works as a Modern Hero Art History teacher at U.A. High School. Nemuri is a very playful and flirtatious person with an unpredictably serious and temperamental side to her. She gets angry whenever someone interrupts her or insults her. She is especially sensitive about her age. Despite her flirtatious personality, Nemuri was intelligent, perceptive, and articulate. While she comes off as a hero who enjoys her fame derived from her beauty and sex appeal, Nemuri has demonstrated true heroism and bravery, willing to fight on the front lines and put her life at risk for others. Nemuri's Quirk "Somnambulist" allows her to put nearby people to sleep by exuding a sleep-inducing aroma from her body. Her Quirk works better on males than females.

139630.name: Sorahiko Torino
139630.desc: __Height:__ 128 cm (4'2") __Affiliation:__ Yuuei (Retired) __Quirk:__ Jet A retired hero who is one of All Might's colleagues and his former homeroom teacher. He was the one who taught All Might to control One For All during the his early days, and his training was so intense that All Might fears him to the point he subconsciously tried to forget about him until Grantorino sent his recommendation for Izuku to help him improve One For All, becoming his work place mentor. His Quirk is "Jet," allowing him to take in air through the sole of his foot to allow him to jump higher. (Source: Wikipedia)

139630.name: Keigo Takami
139630.desc: __Height:__ 172 cm (5' 7¾") __Occupation:__ Pro Hero (No.3 - former, No.2 - current) __Quirk:__ Fierce Wings __Affiliation:__ Hero Public Safety Commission, ~!Paranormal Liberation Front (as a spy)!~ Hawks is carefree, jovial, and dislikes formalities, often acting in a spontaneous and unpredictable way while being cocky and taunting. He believes that popular approval is the most important metric a Pro Hero should be judged for, and does not appear to take the official rankings seriously, showing a preference for the lower ranks as it would allow him to act more freely and avoid the burdens of being a top hero. He states his wish to patrol in a leisurely fashion and "take it easy". It is hinted that Hawks was a fan of [Endeavor](https://anilist.co/character/126158/Todoroki-Enji) from an early age, as depicted by the drawing of him as a child holding an Endeavor figurine.

139630.name: Taishirou Toyomitsu
139630.desc: __Height:__ 250 cm (8'2") (Fat form) __Quirk:__ Fat Absorption In his fat form, Taishiro is a big round man, easily towering over other adults. In this form, his mouth is big, and his nose is smaller, which alongside his odd body proportions, give him an odd look. After burning through his fat, however, it is revealed that he is quite muscular, and his body adapts conventional proportions. His hero costume consists of black pants and an orange zippered hood, which has the initials of his alias on the front of Fat Gum. Alongside them, he also wears gloves, metallic boots, and a mask that covers his eyes and his forehead.

139630.name: Shinji Nishiya
139630.desc: __Height:__ 168 cm (5'6") __Quirk:__ Arbor Pro Hero. Underneath his helmet, he has puffy red leaf-like hair, though his face has remained unseen since he has only been shown while wearing his mask. Shinji is a very serious and focused person when it comes to being a hero in his hero duties; however, he easily feels down when someone takes his glory or credit. Shinji's Quirk "Arbor" (樹木, Jumoku) allows him to enlarge and control his wooden body parts into strong tree branches. These branches are excellent for binding.

139630.name: Natsuo Todoroki
139630.desc: __Height:__ 181 cm Natsuo Todoroki is a college student. He is the son of [Enji](https://anilist.co/character/126158/Todoroki-Enji) and [Rei Todoroki](https://anilist.co/character/150628/Todoroki-Rei), the younger brother of Toya and [Fuyumi](https://anilist.co/character/150627/Todoroki-Fuyumi), and the older brother of [Shoto](https://anilist.co/character/89220/Todoroki-Shouto). Natsuo is a young man of average height, sporting white spiky hair with two small pieces of hair hanging down by his forehead. He greatly resembles his father at his age. Natsuo seems to be a care-free individual, as seen in his interactions with him and his family. However, he can be serious, and cares deeply for his family, except his father who he resents for his abusive treatment to his family. He does not feel forgiving to his father, blaming him for his mother Rei's hospitalization and Shoto's suffering.

139630.name: Mirai Sasaki
139630.desc: __Height:__ 200 cm (6'6¾") __Birthplace:__ Tokyo, Japan __Quirk:__ Foresight A Pro Hero and [Mirio Togata](https://anilist.co/character/123527)'s mentor. He was formerly [All Might](https://anilist.co/character/89224)'s sidekick and was considered to be the brains behind All Might's hero operation before opening his own hero agency. Sir Nighteye is a lean but muscular man with a clean, well-kept appearance. Unlike most Pro Heroes, he seems to prefer plain office clothes (a plain white suit with gold buttons, a white dress shirt, and a red tie with white dots) instead of an elaborate hero costume. Sir Nighteye maintains a stoic and intimidating presence, with a cold and sharp glare, but that is only the side of his personality that he shows in public. He greatly values humor and actually requires people to make him laugh before he acknowledes them. Nighteye believes that humor and energy are vital elements for the future of society and punishes subordinates that fail to display those qualities.

139630.name: Naomasa Tsukauchi
139630.desc: Naomasa Tsukauchi is a police detective in the Police Force. Naomasa is a tall man with short black hair and black eyes. As a member of the police force, he is normally seen in his uniform. He wears a signature tan overcoat and a matching hat. He also sports a black suit underneath with matching slacks and dress shoes. Detective Tsukauchi is an earnest, hardworking individual who has earned the right to be a close friend of All Might. Enough so, that he was even entrusted with the truth about One For All and the latter's true form. He appears to have a close relationship with All Might, as he even leaked sensitive information to the hero just because he felt it was the right thing to do.

139630.name: Shikkui Makabe
139630.desc: __Height:__ 180cm __Quirk:__ Stiffening Second year student at Ketsubutsu Academy, his quirk, 'stiffening', allows him to harden objects with his hands by rubbing or kneading them

139630.name: Itejirou Touteki
139630.desc: __Height:__ 171cm __Affiliation:__ Ketsubutsu Academy __Quirk:__ Boomerang A second year student at Ketsubutsu Academy. His Quirk, "Boomerang," allows him to plan the trajectory of any given object he can throw, including underground.

139630.name: Tatami Nakagame
139630.desc: __Height:__ 155cm __Occupation:__ Student __Affiliation:__ Ketsubutsu Academy __Quirk:__ Telescopic A second year student as Ketsubutsu Academy. Her Quirk, "Telescopic," allows her to fold her limbs into her body, similar to a turtle.

139630.name: You Shindou
139630.desc: __Height:__ 176 cm (5'9") __Affiliation:__ Ketsubutsu Academy High School __Quirk:__ Vibrate A second year at Ketsubutsu Academy. His quirk, "Vibrate," allows him to create large tremors similar to earthquakes, but firing off strong attacks leaves him immobile.

139630.name: Kouta Izumi
139630.desc: __Height:__ 107cm (3'5") Kota Izumi is the nephew of Shino Sosaki and the son of the hero team Water Hose.

139630.name: Inko Midoriya
139630.desc: __Height:__ 160 cm (5'3'') Izuku Midoriya's mother. Her quirk allows her to pull small objects towards her.

139630.name: Atsuhiro  Sako
139630.desc: Mr. Compress's Quirk allows him to "compress" anything in a spherical area into a small marble without actually damaging it. The weight of the target is reduced alongside them, making them very easy to carry. If used on a person, it effectively entraps them, terminating the fight instantly and allowing Mr. Compress to abduct them without difficulty. The Quirk can also be used on select body parts, maiming the target.

139630.name: Giran
139630.desc: Giran is a B-rank villain and broker in affiliation with the League of Villains, working to scout new recruits for their organization

139630.name: Muscular
139630.desc: Befitting his appearance, Muscular has a very sadistic and bloodthirsty personality. He openly admits that he wants to use his Quirk freely to kill. Muscular enjoys killing and tormenting those he fights, often saying "show me your blood!". Unlike most of the other members of the Vanguard Action Squad, he joined the League of Villains just to let loose his brutal tendencies, rather than following Stain's ideology

139630.name: Moonfish
139630.desc: Blade-Tooth (歯刃 Shijin?): Moonfish's quirk gives him the ability to enlarge and manipulate his teeth into powerful blade. Being one of the most powerful people in the Vanguard action squad being able to take on numerous powerful heros at once

139630.name: Emi Fukukado
139630.desc: __Height:__ 5'5 __Quirk:__ Outburst Pro Hero and a teacher of 2nd year, Class 2 at Ketsubutsu Academy High School.

139630.name: Shinya Kamihara
139630.desc: __Height:__ 170 cm (5'7") __Quirk:__ Foldabody: Shinya's Quirk allows him to make his body and limbs extremely thin and long, effectively allowing him to transform himself into a razor sharp string. He is able to transform faster than the speed of sound. Shinya is a calm and focused individual, who is able to maintain a level head even when in a crisis situation, and encourages his teammates when they begin to panic. He is proven to be quite intelligent and is good at analyzing situations and strategy. He is the former Number 5 Pro-Hero, and is currently Number 4.

139630.name: Tomoko Shiretoko
139630.desc: Her Quirk allowed her to observe and monitor up to 100 people at a time, including their location and weak points.

139630.name: Tsunagu Hakamada
139630.desc: __Height:__ 190cm (6'3") __Quirk:__ Fiber Master Pro Hero, ranked in the top 4. He is the recipient of the "Best Jeanist" award for eight consecutive years. Tsunagu is an elegant man with flamboyant tendencies. He believes very strongly that people with influence must maintain a positive appearance both physically and socially. Tsunagu often uses metaphors referencing jeans, denim, and various other sewing and fabric-based phrases, often inspiring his recruits with speeches, telling them to keep their life straight like their jeans. Tsunagu takes the role of being a hero very seriously. He is selfless, brave, and charismatic, and he aims to spread a sense of a peace to all people, no matter how dire the situation. Tsunagu's Quirk "Fiber Master (ファイバーマスター)" allows him to freely manipulate the threads in any nearby piece of fabric. He has power over all types of cloth, but his Quirk works best with denim and is less effective on sweats. Fiber Master also works on other types of fiber not related to fabric, such as carbon fibers. He primarily uses this power to restrain his targets, either by using their own clothing against them, or simply unravels portions of his own clothing into strings.

139630.name: Shino Sousaki
139630.desc: Telepath: This Quirk allows Shino to utilize a mental transmission and send telepathic messages directly into people's minds. Shino, has displayed the ability to send a message to tens of people at a time. She can send messages, but she can't receive them

139630.name: Yawara Chatora
139630.desc: Pliabody: Yawara's Quirk allows him to stretch, flatten, and bend his body in ways that would normally be impossible

139630.name: Nezu
139630.desc: __Height:__ 85 cm __Quirk:__ High Spec Nezu, also known as Mr. Principal is a Pro Hero and the principal of U.A. High School. He is an extremely rare case of an animal who manifested a Quirk. He can be very long-winded at times when explaining or educating.

139630.name: Gigantomachia
139630.desc: Gigantomachia is a villain associated with the League of Villains.[1] He is one of All For One's faithful servants and his former bodyguard, cultivated to be of use to Tomura Shigaraki if anything were to happen to him.

139630.name: Ryuuko Tsuchikawa
139630.desc: __Height:__ 167cm (5'6") __Quirk:__ Earth Flow Ryuko Tsuchikawa also known as Pixie-Bob, is a Pro Hero and a member of the Wild, Wild Pussycats. She is a very hyperactive and loud person with little regard for how she may come off to other people and also is very self-conscious about her age. Ryuko's Quirk allows her to freely manipulate the earth for a variety of effects.

139630.name: Thirteen
139630.desc: Thirteen is a wise, well-mannered person. As a rescue hero, Thirteen has displayed how passionate they are about saving people through their teachings. They even developed their own training facility - the Unforeseen Simulation Joint - to train future heroes in search and rescue tactics. They are very passionate about Quirks, specifically on the topic of using Quirks for creation and assistance rather than for destruction and battle. Thirteen has also been shown to be very brave. Despite not being a combat type, they do not hesitate to use their Quirk to fight against villains in the name of protecting others

139630.name: Ryuuko Tatsuma
139630.desc: When she activates her Quirk, her body transforms into that of a large, winged dragon with pale gray scales, although she still has the same skin tone, hair and eyes, and her hero costume remains visible bar her boots.

139630.name: Ken Takagi
139630.desc: Quirk: Lock Down:/Ken can immobilize anything not living, locking it into a particular place. However, it can be overwhelmed by force and cannot apply to large areas. Ken is a man of average height, with a darker complexion and dark, curly hair. He has pierced ears with padlocks in them. Notably, his fingertips have protrusions that resemble key teeth. Part of his hero costume is a small white mask that covers his eyes. He wears a necklace around his neck with five keys dangling from it. Rock Lock wears a two-colored, short-sleeved shirt with a black section and a white print on it, resembling a keyhole. He wears two light-colored shoulder pads with a dark keyhole shape on both of them.

139630.name: Daruma Ujiko
139630.desc: Daruma Ujiko is the pseudonym of a villain affiliated with the League of Villains, later the Paranormal Liberation Front. He is a faithful servant of All For One and later Tomura Shigaraki as well.

139630.name: Oboro Shirakumo
139630.desc: Oboro was a man of average stature with light, wavy hair that was swept back to flow upwards above his head, two shorter, ear-length tufts left hanging downwards to frame his face. He usually wore an expression of excitement, possessing a large, teeth-bearing grin and semicircular, inward-tilting eyes that were often squeezed shut. Quirk: **Cloud** (he is capable of moving through the air by creating clouds and riding on them.)

139630.name: Rumi Usagiyama
139630.desc: Rumi is the No. 5 Pro Hero. She has an athletic build with muscular arms and legs. She has dark skin, red eyes which are tilted slightly inwards, and straight white hair reaching down past her waist. On her head, she has a pair of long white rabbit ears pointing upwards with a slight crook. Along with these, she also has a round white tail, which gives her overall design a definite resemblance to an albino rabbit. Her hero costume consists of a sleeveless white leotard with dark purple trim around her shoulders and waist, a wide, yellow crescent moon design over her chest, and two thick metal plates on her midriff. She wears purple thigh-high boots to compliment her leotard, with more plating around the heel and toe areas, making her feet look like those of a rabbit. She also has white gloves on her hands, with long cuffs, sporting small triangular protrusions around the edges.

139630.name: Setsuna Tokage
139630.desc: Setsuna Tokage is a student in Class 1-B at U.A. High School, and is one of four students admitted through recommendations; one being her fellow 1-B classmate Juzo Honenuki, as well as rival Class 1-A students Shoto Todoroki and Momo Yaoyorozu.

139630.name: Kinoko  Komori
139630.desc: Kinoko Komori is a student in Class 1-B, and is training to be a Pro Hero. Her quirk, Mushroom, allows her to spread spores that sprout mushrooms wherever they land, including inside of people's bodies.

139630.name: Juzo Honenuki
139630.desc: __Height:__ 174 cm (5'8½") __Affiliation:__ U.A High __Quirk:__ Softening Juzo Honenuki is a student in Class 1-B at U.A. High School, and is one of four students admitted through recommendations; one being his fellow 1-B classmate [Setsuna Tokage](https://anilist.co/character/149179/Tokage-Setsuna), the others being rival 1-A students [Shoto Todoroki](https://anilist.co/character/89220/Todoroki-Shouto) and [Momo Yaoyorozu](https://anilist.co/character/89241/Yaoyorozu-Momo). Juzo's Quirk allows him to soften any non-living thing he touches. For example, he can soften the ground to make it similar to quicksand, hindering movements and mobility. If Juzo makes contact again, he can undo the effect. He is also capable of swimming through softened material.

139630.name: Rikiya Yotsubashi
139630.desc: Rikiya, better known by his code name Re-Destro, is the president and CEO of the Detnerat Company, the son of the infamous villain Destro (for which he named his own code name after), as well as the secret leader of the villainous Meta Liberation Army, an organization that follows the philosophy that the usage of Quirks is a basic human right, and seeks to liberate society and allow for the free use of Quirks.

139630.name: Tatsuyuki Tokoname
139630.desc: A Pro Hero. ~!He is also secretly a member of the villainous Meta Liberation Army.!~

139630.name: Kuugo Sakamata
139630.desc: Gang Orca is the current No. 11 Pro Hero, dropping from his previous No. 10 place. He took part in the assault on All For One and the League of Villains at Kamino Ward, and later served as a makeshift villain during the Provisional Hero License Exam.

139630.name: Desutegoro
139630.desc: Death Arms is a Pro Hero. He took part in the fight against the Sludge Villain, and later witnessed the U.A. Sports Festival from outside the arena, along with Mt. Lady and Kamui Woods.

139630.name: Ken Ishiyama
139630.desc: Cementoss is a Pro Hero as well as a teacher at U.A. High School. During the U.A. Sports Festival, he acted as the proctor for the 1-on-1 fights in case things got out of hand. He also faced off against Eijiro Kirishima and Rikido Sato in their Final Exam.

139630.name: Fuyumi Todoroki
139630.desc: The only daughter of Eiji and Rei. Fuyumi is the younger sister of Touya and the older sister of Natsuo and Shouto. Fuyumi is a hard working girl, often making meals for the family and works as a teacher at an unnamed school. Unlike her family members, she doesn't resent her father and just wishes they could all be a happy family, though she realizes such a thing is unlikely. Upon hearing Shouto gains friends, however, Fuyumi gets quite excited over it and is happy for him. In the past, Fuyumi took care of Shouto after their mother went to a hospital and never came back. To this day, her wish that she could have done something for Shouto still lingers within her.

139630.name: Rei Todoroki
139630.desc: The damaged mother of the Todoroki family. Rei has an ice related quirk, which is believed to be powerful, as Eiji would not have had kids with her otherwise. In the past, Rei was very supportive towards Shouto and his dreams to become like All Might. She used to always say that his blood does not define him for him and for herself. Rei, who was once a kind and caring woman, is now in a mental ward. After all the abuse she faced from Eiji, she began to become mentally unstable. Over time, she had slowly began to snap, until she finally poured boiling water onto Shouto's left side after seeing it. Immediately after burning Shouto, Rei began to apologize and attempt to comfort him when she realized what she had done. Due to her snapping, she was placed into a mental ward for her own safety. Even though Rei is in a mental ward, she has since returned to her former self. When Shouto visited, she was immensely happy and apologized for what she had done to him. Fuyumi and Natsuo also visit her as well, though she has yet to meet Eiji face to face again out of fear.

139630.name: Ectoplasm
139630.desc: __Height:__ 180 cm (5' 11") __Affiliation:__ Yuuei __Quirk:__ Clones Ectoplasm has the ability to produce ectoplasm from his mouth and transform it into clones of himself. He can create up to thirty clones at once, and push his limit to thirty-six if he's feeling good. He can also produce a giant clone of himself, although this sacrifices his ability to produce normal-sized ones for the time being. His clones can be defeated with a strong blow, but otherwise, only Ectoplasm can dispel them.

139630.name: Geten
139630.desc: Geten is a loyal warrior of the Liberation Army and a devout believer in its principles. He feels greatly indebted and thankful to Re-Destro for granting him more power and desires to create a world where the strongest superpowers stand at the top of the hierarchy.

139630.name: Moe Kamiji
139630.desc: Moe Kamiji, also known as her hero name Burnin, is a pro hero and one of over 30 sidekicks working at the Endeavor Hero Agency.

139630.name: Koku Hanabata
139630.desc: Koku Hanabata, also know as Trumpet, is a member of the Meta Liberation Army, a Paranormal Liberation Front lieutenant, and also the leader of the Hearts and Mind party.

139630.name: Tomoyasu Chikazoku
139630.desc: Tomoyasu Chikazoku, also known as Skeptic, is a member of the Meta Liberation Army.

139630.name: Snipe
139630.desc: __Quirk:__ Homing Snipe is a Pro Hero and a member of the teaching staff at U.A. High School. Snipe has the appearance of a stereotypical western cowboy Snipe's Quirk allows him to lock on to any target he can see within six hundred meters and make any projectile he releases chase after said target

139630.name: Shihai Kuroiro
139630.desc: Shihai is a sly, deceitful schemer, who prefers to catch people off guard. He appears to enjoy dark concepts and has a penchant for dramatic speech

139630.name: Juurouta Shishida
139630.desc: Juurouta seems to be an intellectual as he uses a fairly verbose way of speaking and often addresses others by respectful titles such as 'sir' and 'miss'. This is because he was brought up in a very well mannered and doting family. While transformed, however Juurouta is rather boisterous and energetic, which is likely a side effect of his Quirk.

139630.name: Nirengeki Shoda
139630.desc: Nirengeki has a very humble attitude, as he will not take credit for something he does not feel he earned by his own strength.

139630.name: Reiko Yanagi
139630.desc: Reiko is a quiet and emotionless teenager who often shows an odd body posture.

139630.name: Selkie
139630.desc: Can do pretty much everything a spotted seal can do. He can even make sonar-like sound and use the echo to determine his opponent's position. He is also very strong even if he believes that he can make a very cute seal face (which most people think is not).

139630.name: Masaki Mizushima
139630.desc: __Height:__ 176 cm __Occupation:__ Pro Hero Masaki Mizushima, also known as Normal Hero: Manuais, is the current No. 222 Pro Hero. He is based out of Hosu City.

139630.name: Yoichi Shigaraki
139630.desc: All For One's younger brother.

139630.name: Kaina Tsutsumi
139630.desc: __Quirk:__ Rifle A villain who used to be a Pro Hero. Kaina Tsutsumi can protrude and retract a rifle from her right elbow, which she can fire bullets out of with a range of 3 kilometers. She can create and use different types of bullets by mixing and molding her hair, such as hollow-point bullets and curving bullets.

139630.name: Daigorou Banjou
139630.desc: __Occupation:__ Pro Hero __Quirk:__ Blackwhip; One For All (formerly) The 5th user of One For All whose natural Quirk was Blackwhip. His Quirk allowed him to create tendrils of black energy from his arms, excellent for grappling and increasing his mobility.

139630.name: Mitsuki Bakugou
139630.desc: Mitsuki Bakugou is Katsuki Bakugou's mother and the wife of Masaru Bakugou.

139630.name: Sansa Tamakawa
139630.desc: Sansa is a member in the Police Force.

139630.name: Cider House Leader
139630.original: サイダーハウスリーダー
139630.desc: The leader of a gang of pickpockets who operated mainly during the holiday season, having studied the patterns and routes of hero and civilian activity in a specific street for a whole month, with the intent of maximizing profits from their looted items while facing minimal resistance. He possesses a Quirk that allows him to control carbonated water. He also has connections with the black market, having acquired a pair of gauntlets provided by Detnerat that could convert his water blasts into gatling shots.

139630.name: Hiroshi Tameda
139630.desc: __Height:__ 170cm Hiroshi Tameda also known as "Can't You See?" kid, is a loyal fan of Endeavor.

139630.name: Kotarou Shimura
139630.desc: Kotarou Shimura was the father of [Tenko](https://anilist.co/character/89226/Tomura-Shigaraki) and [Hana Shimura](https://anilist.co/character/290001/Shimura-Hana) and the son of [Nana Shimura](https://anilist.co/character/126319/Nana-Shimura).

139630.name: Cathleen Bate
139630.original: キャスリーン・ベイト
139630.desc: __Height:__ 193 cm __Quirk:__ New Order The current No. 1 Pro Hero of the United States of America. She is stated to be the strongest woman in the whole world. Cathleen's Quirk allows her to set a rule onto her surroundings, allowing her to manipulate and bestow new properties onto herself and the world around her. In order to activate her Quirk, she has to first make physical contact with the target and speak its name, then explains the rule she wishes to impose. She could only impose two rules at any given time.

139630.name: Kidou
139630.desc: __Occupation:__ Pro Hero (Sidekick) __Affiliation:__ Endeavor Agency (Team Flaming Sidekickers) __Quirk:__ Traject One of many sidekicks who works at Endeavor's Agency. His Quirk allows him to manipulate the trajectory of anything that passes through his bandages.

139630.name: Backdraft
139630.desc: Backdraft is a pro hero. His quirk, Hydrokinesis, allows him to create and manipulate water through spigots that he has in place of hands. He is affiliated with Musutafu Fire Department

139630.name: Crust
139630.desc: __Quirk:__ Shield __Occupation:__ Pro Hero (No.6) __Fighting Style:__ Close-ranged combat

139630.name: X-Less
139630.desc: __Occupation:__ Pro Hero __Quirk:__ Laser One of the heroes who raided Jaku General Hospital, coming into conflict with several High-End Nomu. ~!During the raid, X-Less destroys a strange looking machine which is later revealed to produce Quirk-Destroying Drugs!~ ~!When Shigaraki awakens from his near-death state, he kills X-Less and takes the deceased hero's cape for himself.!~

139630.name: Hana Shimura
139630.desc: Hana was the older sister of [Tenko Shimura](https://anilist.co/character/89226/Tomura-Shigaraki) and granddaughter of [Nana Shimura](https://anilist.co/character/126319/Nana-Shimura). ~!She was killed by her brother when his Quirk went out of control!~

139630.name: Nao Shimura
139630.desc: Nao was the wife of [Kotarou Shimura](https://anilist.co/character/251812/Kotarou-Shimura) and the mother of their two children, [Tenko](https://anilist.co/character/89226/Tomura-Shigaraki) and [Hana](https://anilist.co/character/290001/Hana-Shimura). ~!She died when her son's Quirk went out of control.!~

139630.name: Eel Boy
139630.desc: __Occupation:__ Pro Hero __Quirk:__ Unnamed Eel Quirk Takes part in the raid on Gunga Mountain Villa led by [Edgeshot](https://anilist.co/character/143275/Shinya-Kamihara). ~!After using his Quirk to capture Mr. Compress and Himiko Toga, Eel Boy is stabbed and killed by a Double of [Twice](https://anilist.co/character/89589/Jin-Bubaigawara). Himiko would later take on Eel Boy's appearance using her Transform Quirk, slicing through many heroes while impersonating him in a blind rampage.!~

139630.name: Salaam
139630.desc: __Height:__ 190 cm __Occupation:__ Pro Hero (Egypt No. 1) __Quirk:__ Papyrus The No. 1 Pro Hero in Egypt. He has a strange aura that makes the Egyptian citizens feel at ease when they see him fight, but to this day no one has ever seen his back. Salaam's Quirk Papyrus allows the user to flatten their body like papyrus. He can slip through narrow spaces and ride the wind to move at incredible speed. His weakness is mold in places with high humidity.

139630.name: Enma Kannagi
139630.desc: __Height:__ 183 cm __Occupation:__ Pro Hero __Fighting Style:__ Long Range Support __Quirk:__ Magic Pro Hero. During U.A. High School's Work Studies II, he takes in [Creati](https://anilist.co/character/89241) and [Lizardy](https://anilist.co/character/149179). He is one of the heroes assigned to the Villa Raid Team led by Edgeshot.

139630.name: Daikaku Miyagi
139630.desc: __Occupation:__ Newscaster __Quirk:__ Big Horn A newscaster who occasionally reports daily news of recent events occurring throughout the series. His most prominent features are the two horns protruding from each side of his forehead, which is a result of his Quirk. Daikaku cut off one of his horns in order to relay the news with more ease, a decision considered controversial by his viewers.

139630.name: Hero Kouan Iinkai Kaichou
139630.original: ヒーロー公安委員会会長
139630.desc: Head of the Hero Public Safety Commission which is in charge of the Hero Association in Japan. She tasked [Hawks](https://anilist.co/character/128299) to infiltrate the League of Villains in order to gather intel on the group and learn more on their current agenda.

139630.name: Gyges
139630.desc: One of the guards at the main entrance of Tartarus

139630.name: Briareos
139630.desc: One of the guards of the main entrance of Tartarus.

139630.name: Tomie Takami
139630.desc: Mother of [Keigo Takami](https://anilist.co/character/128299).

139630.name: Hawks no Smartphone Onsei
139630.original: ホークスのスマートフォン音声

139630.name: Yoroi Musha
139630.desc: __Quirk:__ Unknown __Occupation:__ Pro Hero ~!(Retired)!~ No. 9 Pro Hero. ~!He retired due to the high backlash against Heroes following the Paranormal Liberation War.!~

139630.name: Rei no Chichi
139630.desc: Father of [Rei Todoroki](https://anilist.co/character/150628).

139630.name: Hikage Shinomori
139630.desc: __Quirk:__ Danger Sense; ~!One For All (formerly)!~ Hikage Shinomori was a valiant and noble man who was determined to defeat [All For One](https://anilist.co/character/125956). His Quirk, Danger Sense, allowed him to sense incoming threats in the surrounding area, giving him ample opportunity to react. ~!He was the fourth user of the One For All Quirk.!~

139630.name: En Tayutai
139630.desc: __Quirk:__ Smokescreen; ~!One For All (formerly)!~ En is a former Pro Hero. His Quirk, Smokescreen, allowed him to generate clouds of smoke which could obscure vision. ~!He was the sixth user of the One For All Quirk.!~

139630.name: Bruce Lee
139630.desc: __Quirk:__ ~!Fa Jin; One For All (formerly)!~ The Third user of the One For All Quirk. He was part of the resistance fighting against All For One, alongside the second user. ~!Fa Jin, the Quirk he was born with, allows the user to build up kinetic energy by repeating regular motions and store it for later use. When the user chooses to release the energy, they gain an explosive burst of speed and power.!~

139630.name: Toshigtsugu Kudou
139630.desc: __Quirk:__ ~!Gearshift; One For All (formerly)!~ The Second user of the One For All Quirk. He was the leader of a resistance movement who fought against All For One during the peak of his power. ~!Gearshift, the Quirk he was born with, allows the user to change the speed at which things accelerate through space. It is even capable of changing speeds while ignoring the laws of inertia.!~

139630.name: Big Red Dot
139630.original: ビッグ・レッド・ドット
139630.desc: __Height:__ 215cm (7'0¾") __Birthplace:__ Singapore __Occupation:__ Pro Hero (No. 1 in Singapore) __Quirk:__ Tidal Bore The Number 1 Hero in Singapore. He helped to fight Humarise in his home country. He was one of the foreign heroes contacted by the Hero Public Safety Commission to fight All For One, and is frustrated at all the red tape involved in aiding his friend All Might.

139630.name: Wedge
139630.desc: One of the fighter jet pilots loyal to [Star and Stripe](https://anilist.co/character/254809), accompanying her on her flight to Japan. **His name is a reference to the Star Wars character Wedge Antilles, a renowned starfighter pilot.*

139630.name: Ouji Harima
139630.desc: A former infamous villain and the great-great-grandfather of [Atsuhiro Sako](https://anilist.co/character/141748) (Mr. Compress). He was a Robin Hood-like figure, stealing from wealthy heroes and giving back to the civilians. Harima is considered one of the great villains of the past.

18897.name: Chitoge Kirisaki
18897.desc: __Height:__ 160 cm The main female protagonist of the series. She is the daughter of [Adelt Wogner Kirisaki](https://anilist.co/character/82935) and [Hana Kirisaki](https://anilist.co/character/84919) who served as the fake girlfriend of [Raku Ichijou](https://anilist.co/character/48393) for the next three years of her school life to prevent a war from starting between their families. Chitoge is somewhat a forgetful, stern and bold girl. However, once someone gets to know her better, she becomes very talkative and nice. Similar to Raku, Chitoge is the type to go out of her way to help someone. For example, when Raku lost his pendant once again from the chain being broken, Chitoge had secretly gotten the Beehive gang to help fix it for him and gave it back later that night. Chitoge is somewhat oblivious when it comes to love and others' love interests, for example, how she didn't know what [Seishirou Tsugumi](https://anilist.co/character/58885)’s "symptoms" were, which were actually love. She is also very athletic as she can easily jump over the school's walls and swim the length of the school pool in a couple of seconds. Ever since she was a child she had a hard time making friends as they disliked her. As a result, she had a cold demeanor toward people at the start of the series due to her relationship with her family. This led her to create notebooks filled with information on classmates in an attempt to make friends. When Chitoge had lost her ribbon, she becomes very emoti

18897.name: Raku Ichijou
18897.desc: **Height:** 168 cm Son of a Yakuza family. He's intelligent but not an adept fighter. He likes sweet things, wants to marry a Yamato Nadeshiko and says he's the kind of person who has to do it absolutely correctly when he puts his mind into something otherwise he can't be satisfied.

18897.name: Kosaki Onodera
18897.desc: **Height:** 157 cm She is one of the main characters in the manga series Nisekoi. She is shown to have a crush on [Raku Ichijou](https://anilist.co/character/48393/Raku-Ichijou), the male protagonist of Nisekoi, and is also the only girl that Raku openly has feelings for. Kosaki is discreet, innocent, and slightly timid. She is very kind, she takes care of Raku when he is wounded or ill. Generally, she opts to think carefully before acting, as seen when she stalls her confession to Raku in consideration that he may have feelings for [Chitoge](https://anilist.co/character/48391/Chitoge-Kirisaki). In confrontation with Raku, Kosaki displays inconfidence, initially needing encouragement from [Ruri](https://anilist.co/character/58281/Ruri-Miyamoto) attempt confessing her love. Kosaki works well with her classmates, possessing close friends and being the most popular girl for the boys before Chitoge transferred and after Kosaki and Raku allegedly began dating. Both Kosaki and Raku are completely unaware that the feelings they hold for each other are mutual. Like in many average fictional love stories, these two try not to show their feelings to each other. She loves Raku because he is kind and caring. Just like the other girls who like him, she can be jealous as well but not to the point of having bloodlust. She often worries/wonders whether Raku and Chitoge's "fake relationship" is actually developing into something more than just that. Chitoge and Kosaki have a really trusting r

18897.name: Ruri Miyamoto
18897.desc: __Height:__ 145 cm She is [Kosaki](https://anilist.co/character/52723/Kosaki-Onodera)'s friend. She supports Kosaki's love for [Raku](https://anilist.co/character/48393/Raku-Ichijou), often giving her a push from behind to take the next step forward. Also beats up Shu for his perverted comments. ~!She fell in love with Shu later on in the series and eventually confessed to him. She also said that she will wait for Shu to get over his feelings for Kyoko. In the final chapter it is shown that she is now working as a translator and living with Shu.!~

18897.name: Seishirou Tsugumi
18897.desc: **Height:** 165 cm Tsugumi is a hitwoman who was raised and trained by [Claude](https://anilist.co/character/82933/Claude-Ringheart) of the Beehive Gangsters. Tsugumi is originally introduced as a guy who transfers to [Chitoge](https://anilist.co/character/48391/Chitoge-Kirisaki)'s class, and has orders to protect her from [Raku](https://anilist.co/character/48393/Raku-Ichijou), whom she thinks forced Chitoge into the relationship. She and Chitoge are childhood friends; she tries to keep a ten year old promise of becoming strong to protect Chitoge. However, after Raku treats her nicely, she begins to develop some feelings for him, even though she is too stubborn and embarrassed to admit it. In America, her assassin code name is "Black Tiger", who had a rivalry with "[White Fang](https://anilist.co/character/84917/McCoy-Paula)". She does well academically, having ranked next to Chitoge on a yearly exam.

18897.name: Shuu Maiko
18897.desc: **Height:** 174 cm Although Shuu appears to be playful, he is actually very sensitive. He was the first one who realized that [Chitoge](https://anilist.co/character/48391/Chitoge-Kirisaki) and [Raku](https://anilist.co/character/48393/Raku-Ichijou) were not actually dating. Also, he was the only one who seemed to realize that [Tsugumi](https://anilist.co/character/58885/Seishirou-Tsugumi) was a girl, though he hid the thought and decided to play along just for his own amusement. Also, it should be noted that Shuu is the kind of person that would do almost anything for a laugh. Best friend of Raku Ichijou.

18897.name: Marika Tachibana
18897.desc: **Height:** 152 cm Marika transfers to [Raku](https://anilist.co/character/48393/Raku-Ichijou)'s class and is introduced as his fiancée; she bears a key that she thinks will unlock Raku's pendant, and is the most vocal about expressing her love to Raku. She is the daughter of the police chief, and has been in love with Raku for the past ten years. She does not get along with [Chitoge](https://anilist.co/character/48391/Chitoge-Kirisaki); she states she hates girls with long hair despite the fact that she also has long hair. She has a frail constitution; ten years prior, she was frequently visited by a young Raku, who brought her gifts and sparked a friendship with her. She used to speak in a rather vulgar manner but has attempted to correct her language after Raku had told her that he likes a girly girl with long hair. However, when flustered, she reverts to her old speaking habits.

18897.name: Claude Ringheart
18897.desc: **Height:** 190 cm Claude is one of the leaders of the Bee Hive Gangsters, and one of the few characters who suspects the relationship between [Raku](https://anilist.co/character/48393/Raku-Ichijou) and [Chitoge](https://anilist.co/character/48391/Chitoge-Kirisaki) is fake. He stalks Chitoge regularly to make sure Raku does not take advantage of her. Chitoge stated that when she was young, she was unable to make friends because of Claude's over-protectiveness and background checks. He raises [Tsugumi](https://anilist.co/character/58885/Seishirou-Tsugumi) as a hitman, and appears to be clueless as to her gender, having given her a boy's name, Seshirou.

18897.name: Adelt Wogner Kirisaki
18897.original: アーデルト 桐崎 ウォグナー
18897.desc: **Height:** 192 cm [Chitoge](https://anilist.co/character/48391/Chitoge-Kirisaki)'s father and husband of [Hana](https://anilist.co/character/84919/Hana-Kirisaki). Adel is an old friend of the father of [Raku](https://anilist.co/character/48393/Raku-Ichijou) despite disagreements between of the Yakuza and Mafia.

18897.name: Ryuunosuke Sasaki
18897.desc: **Height:** 188 cm He is the head member of the Shuei-Gumi Clan much like Claude is of the Bee Hive Gang.

18897.name: Kyouko Nichihara
18897.desc: **Height:** 169 cm English teacher of first year, class C. She has appeared since the first story. A rough character.

18897.name: Gen Tachibana
18897.desc: **Height:** 195 cm He is the father of [Marika Tachibana](https://anilist.co/character/66597/Marika-Tachibana) and holds the highest rank in the Police Department.

18897.name: Nanako Onodera
18897.desc: **Height:** 173 cm Mother of [Haru](https://anilist.co/character/84911/Haru-Onodera) and [Kosaki](https://anilist.co/character/52723/Kosaki-Onodera). She is also the owner of the Onodera Sweets Shop.

18897.name: Shinobu Honda
18897.desc: Honda is Marika's personal attendant and police escort. She monitors Marika and at times advises her to not overexert herself due to her frail condition. ~!In chapter 195, it is revealed that her name before gaining her title as a shinobu is Youko.!~

18897.name: Issei Ichijou
18897.desc: __Height__: 163 cm He is the former boss of the Shuei-Gumi Clan, and the father of [Raku](https://anilist.co/character/48393/Raku-Ichijou).

18897.name: Yoshino
18897.desc: One of the frequent costumers of Onodera's Sweet Shop.

120697.name: Hayase Nagatoro
120697.desc: **Height:** 150 cm (4'11") A high school student that can suddenly pop-up anywhere and anytime. She is always crazy about her [Senpai](https://anilist.co/character/124697). She seems to be a member of the Swimming Club. Nagatoro is an energetic, athletic, popular and rather sadistic - but deep down very sweet - girl, often referred to as a "sadodere". She is part of a 'cool kids' clique together with her friends [Gamo-chan](https://anilist.co/character/145715/Maki-Gamo), [Yoshi](https://anilist.co/character/145718/Yoshi) and [Sakura](https://anilist.co/character/145716/Sakura), and is a member of the swimming club, despite also having a liking for martial arts such as muay thai, boxing, capoeira and especially judo. ~!Chapter 81 — there's major development between Nagatoro & [Naoto](https://anilist.co/character/124697/Naoto-Hachiouji) which reveals that Nagatoro is supposedly interested romantically in him and sets out a dare to get a kiss from him as a reward for beating her judo rival [Orihara](https://anilist.co/character/220340/Orihara)!~

120697.name: Naoto Hachiouji
120697.desc: __Height:__ 176 cm (5'9") As a high schooler and a member of the art club, he enjoys illustrating his own mangas and drawing still images of even his kouhai, [Nagatoro](https://anilist.co/character/124696), after meeting her. Naoto spends his time after school in the art club with Nagatoro on most days where the crazy antics ensue. He is an introvert, twitchy, loner, nerdy and shy aspiring artist, who tries to avoid social interaction with other people and doesn't seem to have any friends. He is also referred as closet-perv by Nagatoro. ~!Naoto eventually notices his romantic feelings for [Nagatoro](https://anilist.co/character/124696/Hayase-Nagatoro) and sets out different scenarios to get closer with her and date her in the future.!~

120697.name: Gamou
120697.desc: **Height:** 168 cm (5'6") A character with semi-long hair. She likes to make fun of people.

120697.name: Sakura
120697.desc: **Height:** 157 cm (5'2") A girl with a tan and soft wavy hair. She actually has a "haraguro" personality. (Haraguro: a character that is kind or friendly on the outside but uses those traits as a means to manipulate others.)

120697.name: Sana Sunomiya
120697.desc: **Height:** 171 cm (5'7") The art club president. She has long hair that frames her face with dark-brown eyes. Her personality is stern and serious based on her interactions with [Senpai](https://anilist.co/character/124697), but she treats him with respect unlike [Nagatoro](https://anilist.co/character/124696). She also bears a resemblance to a female character in one of the manga Senpai wrote. [Sunomiya](https://anilist.co/character/226964/Sunomiya) is her younger cousin.

120697.name: Yoshi
120697.desc: **Height:** 160 cm (5'2") A natural airheaded twintail girl. She is a moron who likes [Gamo-chan](https://anilist.co/character/145715) as she usually repeats or follows her up with something she has just said. Yoshi also seems to like animals as she’s been seen with a gorilla shirt and she has a pet dog. She also seems to be into cute things as she once accepted a “Squiddy” plush from [Nagatoro](https://anilist.co/character/124696) in return for [Senpai](https://anilist.co/character/124697) in a contest.

120697.name: Fuuki Iinchou
120697.desc: She is a high school student who serves as Kazehaya High School's "Public Morals Committee Chief" until she - presumably - graduates.

112301.name: Narrator
112301.desc: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

112301.name: Anos Voldigoad
112301.original: アノス・ヴォルディゴード
112301.desc: __Species:__ Mixed Blood (currently), Demon (formerly) Anos is the reincarnation of the man who was feared as the Demon King of Tyranny 2,000 years ago. He is resolute, stalwart, and invincible. His absolute power instils a veritable self-confidence that is only surpassed by his ego. Because of his overwhelming prowess, Anos possesses an easy going attitude and an unrivalled sense of perseverance when facing any challenge that may come his way. Despite his title as the Demon King, Anos has a definitive moral compass and generally has a kind and caring outlook. He takes a great interest in the well-being of not only his family, but also his subordinates and followers, and is quick to reward them for their loyalty. He is willing to go through great lengths to assist in their development, in order for them to reach their full potential. Other people may see him as cruel, but his personal creed is not to kill people needlessly. Even if he would never admit it, Anos is very protective of his fellow subordinates and followers. While Anos is not inherently evil, his chaotic and sometimes ruthless methods when dealing with his enemies, earned him his title. While he originally never proclaimed himself as the Demon King, he has openly embraced it as the rest of the world views him as such. Those who oppose him, fear his power, and are threatened by the mere fact that a single man possesses such power. (Source: Maou Gakuin wiki)

112301.name: Misha Necron
112301.desc: Misha is a student at Delzogade, the Demon King Academy. She quickly becomes friends with [Anos](https://anilist.co/character/138595/Voldigoad-Anos) after they meet. Her magic power is quite high among most students at Delzogade.

112301.name: Kanon
112301.desc: Kanon is a hero that battles against Anos. He seems to have a mutual respect with Anos, with both of them understanding each other. Before Anos was slain by Kanon, Anos wished they could be friends in 2000 years, should they ever meet.

112301.name: Izabella
112301.desc: The mother of reincarnated Anos. She cares for [Anos](https://anilist.co/character/138595/Voldigoad-Anos), loving him constantly. She is married to [Gusta](https://anilist.co/character/139560/Raizeo-Gusta). When Anos brings home [Misha](https://anilist.co/character/138596/Necron-Misha), Izabella is quick to jump the gun and assumes that Anos is together with Misha. She decides that is the case and supports it through and through.

112301.name: Emilia Ludowell
112301.original: エミリア・ルードウェル
112301.desc: The homeroom teacher of the class [Anos](https://anilist.co/character/138595/Voldigoad-Anos) is in. Initially, Emilia holds no respect towards Anos; however, that changes after he proves himself to her.

112301.name: Zepes Indu
112301.desc: Considered a demon duke by some, Zepes is an arrogant student at Delzogade. He is the younger brother of Leorig Indu.

112301.name: Gusta Raizeo
112301.desc: The father of reincarnated Anos. As a father, he cares for Anos and is accepting of his abilities. He is also married to Izabella. When Anos brought Misha to his place, Gusta figured Anos hooked up with Misha, accepting it right away; even willing to distract Issabelle so they can do the deed, to Anos' dismay.

112301.name: Leorig Indu
112301.desc: A pure-blood descendant of the Demon Lord. Leorig dislikes disgraceful people that tarnish the pure-blood descendants of the Demon Lord. He is also the older brother of Zepis Indu. Like his brother, he is arrogant, but not to the same extent.

112301.name: Sasha Necron
112301.desc: A member of the House of Necron and direct descendant of [Ivis Necron](https://anilist.co/character/186471/Necron-Ivis). Sasha Necron is called the, "Witch of Destruction," by others. She has the Demon Eyes of Destruction, which allow her to destroy anything she chooses within her field of view. Sasha is the older sister of [Misha Necron](https://anilist.co/character/138596/Necron-Misha). Sasha has a cold personality towards her sister, calling her a, "defective doll." Towards others, she acts superior and above them, due to her status. Though she does act as such, she is able to respect others and be friendly towards them.

112301.name: Ivis Necron
112301.original: アイヴィス・ネクロン
112301.desc: One of the Seven Elder Demon Emperors created by Anos, as well as the head of the Necron family.

112301.name: Shin Reglia
112301.desc: Right hand of Demon King [Anos Voldigoad](https://anilist.co/character/138595) and the most powerful swordsman among the demons.

112301.name: Eugo La Raviaz
112301.original: エウゴ・ラ・ラヴィアズ
112301.desc: **Eugo La Raviaz** is the Guardian God of Time, and has the appearance of the traditional Grim Reaper, wearing a long black cloak while wielding a scythe.

112301.name: Lay Glanzudlii
112301.original: レイ・グランズドリィ
112301.desc: Lay Glanzudlii is a member of the Generation of Chaos, commonly known as "The Demon Sword Saint" and a transfer student at Demon King Academy. ~!He is the reincarnation of the Hero Kanon.!~

112301.name: Sheila Glanzudlii
112301.original: シーラ・グランズドリィ
112301.desc: [Lay Glanzudlii](https://anilist.co/character/186477/Lay-Glanzudlii) adoptive mother.

112301.name: Misa Ilioroagu
112301.desc: **Misa Ilioroagu** is Anos' classmate, and shows herself as skeptical about the current society in which pure-blooded demons are favored. ~!She is the spirit that was formed from the rumors and traditions of the fictional Demon King Avos Dilhevia!~ ~!She is the daughter of Great Spirit Reno and Spirit King Shin Regalia.!~

112301.name: Eleonore Bianca
112301.original: エレオノール・ビアンカ
112301.desc: Eleonore is a humanoid magic. She specializes in root magic and is able to create root clones (Zeshia & Diego). She harbours no ill feelings towards the demons and is considered a failure due to her lack of hatred towards the demons. ~!She later becomes Anos' magic.!~

112301.name: Melheis Boran
112301.desc: Melheis Boran is one of the Seven Elder Demon Emperors created by Anos Voldigoad.

112301.name: Gaios Anzem
112301.desc: Gaios Anzem is one of the Seven Elder Demon Emperors created by Anos Voldigoad.

112301.name: Ydol Anzeo
112301.desc: Ydol Anzeo is one of the Seven Elder Demon Emperors created by Anos Voldigoad.

112301.name: Maia Zemut
112301.desc: Maia Zemut is a student of the Demon King Academy and a member of the Anos Fan Union.

112301.name: Jessica Arnet
112301.original: ジェシカ・アーネート

112301.name: Laos Kanon Jilfor
112301.original: ラオス・カノン・ジルフォー
112301.desc: Rank 4 of the Hero Academy and member of the Jerga Kanon class.

112301.name: Krut Ludowell
112301.original: クルト・ルードウェル
112301.desc: Emilia's older brother and the previous champion of the Magic Sword Tournament.

112301.name: Menou Historia
