It soon was revealed this Karin was Majhal's lost lover and he tried to resurrect her using girls of the village, alchemically transferring their souls into mannequin versions of Karin so she could be reborn. Unfortunately, none worked out and some even wandered freely until Majhal destroyed them afterwards. Majhal tried his scheme one more time, trying to force Ed and Al to help. However, he was told by Ed that an elderly woman who helped him in his plots was actually Karin, aged. It is later revealed that Karin had not died, but lost her memory after hitting her head when her wagon crashed. Majhal couldn't see his lover in the woman's face and attempted to kill Ed, Al and Karin using a transmuted sword. However, Ed transformed a rose into a whip and sent Majhal's sword flying into the air. Majhal could only watch helplessly as the sword flew down and stabbed him through the stomach,

121.name: Lujon
121.desc: A character appearing only in the 35th episode of the anime. An alchemist Lust encountered years ago, Envy saw potential in him to advance their plans to make a Philosopher's Stone. After the Homunculi deliberately spread the Fossil Disease in his village, Lust gave him a Red Stone ring to use against the Fossil Disease. However, Lujon fell in love with Lust, and Lust began to feel the first stirrings of her humanity, as Lujon reminded her of her creator, Scar's brother. When they met again, Lust killed him to "fix" the mistake of getting him involved in the Homunculi's plans. Upon his death, everyone in the village fell to the disease and none were left alive. Despite Gluttony's pleading her, Lust did not allow Gluttony to eat Lujon's body after his death. In the English Dub he also mentions the Ishballan God, Ishballa, and when using Alchemy frequently prays to him. He resembles Scar's brother from the manga.

121.name: The Exile
121.desc: A key character in the anime, the Exile was the one who originally instructed Scar’s brother in the ways of the Grand Arcanum, the Ishbalan version of alchemy. At the time of his introduction in the anime the Exile was living alone in the southern refugee camp after he had been banished from Ishbal by the Ishbalans for using alchemy. When Scar accidentally wandered into his hut he learned of his brother's training under the Exile, and sought to learn how to complete the Philosopher’s Stone from him. After Mustang and his men arrived looking for Scar, the Ishbalan refugees were rounded up with the intention of being transferred to state-run camps set up to house Ishbalan refugees; however, the military had to separate the Exile from his own people after they attacked him. As a result, he was set to be moved independently from the main group for his protection. When Ed and Al arrived in the camp and spoke with him he revealed that the Ishbalan people were once alchemists, practicing the Grand Arcanum to reshape the things that Ishbala had given them. It is implied that this was once a highly respected position in Ishbalan society; however, times changed and the practice of the Grand Arcanum gradually became a taboo, as it was felt to go against the teachings of Ishbala by reshaping the things that Ishabala had given the Ishbalans. During this conversation the Exile revealed that the only difference between the regular method of producing the Philosopher’s Stone and the Ishbalan

121.name: Leo
121.desc: A young Ishbalan who looks after his younger brother Rick. For a time he held a deep resentment against his mother for abandoning them during a military raid, but changed his opinion after learning that his mother suffered from an illness leading to blindness. After Scar decided to fulfill his brother's goal and create the Philosopher's Stone, Leo hated Scar for becoming an 'exile'; however, Edward's word convinced him not to judge people for their choices. Toward the end of the anime series Edward receives permission from the military to have Leo and his brother Rick released and transferred to Resembool; however both Rick and Leo turn down the offer. Leo doesn't appear in the manga.

121.name: Kurara
121.desc: Psiren, whose real name is Clara, is a cat burglar who publicizes her crimes so that her sinking city Aquroya (pronounced "Ah-croy-ya"), an analogue of Venice, will be full of life before it eventually disappears beneath a lake. Her alchemy utilizes cards and water and her transmutation circle is on her chest. She uses this to her advantage when battling men by slowly unzipping her shirt and then using alchemy against them. Known as a great beauty, she was Ed's first female opponent, which is pretty obvious when he tackled her on a roof as he accidentally grabbed her left breast with his automail hand. Psiren/Clara also took advantage of Al's gullibility by claiming she was stealing to save a hospital, a convent, and a school all while disguised as a nurse, nun, and schoolteacher respectively. She shows an affinity towards Edward, possibly romantic, even as he finally captures her, going so far as to offer to steal anything he wanted. When they part ways, she tells him to go to Xenotime for more information on the Philosopher's Stone. After she is arrested, she easily escapes an hour later. Neither Psiren nor Clara make an appearance in the manga.

121.name: Fletcher Tringham
121.desc: Russell's younger brother. He was uncomfortable with fraudulently posing as the Elric Brothers, and was disturbed by the side effects of the Red Water. While the other brothers Russell and Edward fought, Fletcher and Al became friendly, and Fletcher eventually helps convince Russell to not fight the Elric Brothers. The Tringum Brothers specialized in alchemy dealing with plant life. Sony's Aniplex anime DVDs spell his family name as Tringum, although Sony's Aniplex website spells his name as Tlingum. FUNimation's anime DVDs spell his family name as Tringham. Fletcher and his brother had a small, albeit crucial role in "Goodbye" and "The Other Side Of the Gate," where they were almost executed for being the Elrics, before informing Ed of the existence of the Underground City.

121.name: Mugear
121.desc: He was the richest man in the city of Xenotime, owning most of the land. When Xenotime's gold supply diminished, Mugwar had Nash Tringum crystallize red water to make imitation Philosopher's Stones, called Red Stones. He used the crystals to transmute rock into gold so that people would come to the city and he would gain money. He murdered Nash when he refused to help at the cost of the deaths caused by the red water. He took advantage of the Tringum brothers by pretending to fall for their deception and had them continue their father's work. He was one of the men Lust took advantage of for her own ambitions. He was killed, crushed by a cave-in caused by the pressure from the red water. Sony's Aniplex anime DVDs spell his name as Mugwar, although Sony's Aniplex website and the first novel, The Land of Sand spell his name as Mugear. A common unofficial translation has his name as Magwar. The Japanese pronunciation is "Maguwaaru," while FUNimation's English-dubbed pronouncation is "Mu-gee-ahr".

121.name: Wilson
121.desc: Only appearing in one episode (though he made a brief appearance during Edward's State Alchemy Exam), Wilson and his group of mercenaries were hired by Sloth to attack the Ishbalans under the guise of State Military soldiers. He is an alchemist, and carries no gun. He wears a machine on his back that launches small dagger-like objects that charge with electricity. A transmutation circle then appears, along with a huge sphere of electricity, and the attack is launched at the opponent. This is similar to Xingese alchemy, since even the daggers look similar. He kidnapped Rick to try to get Scar and the other Ishbalans to come out of hiding so he could kill them as ordered. He is defeated by Scar, and learns that Ed is a State Alchemist. He was under the impression that he was working for the military, and went to ask Sloth why other military personnel were working against him. He was killed by Sloth after threatening to tell King Bradley.

121.name: Frank Archer
121.original: フランク・アーチャー
121.desc: Frank Archer is a character exclusive to the first anime. He is cool, calm, and collected, with a love for violence and war. He dreams of becoming a hero on the battlefield, viewing it as a way to rise up the ranks of the military. To this end, he does whatever is necessary to please his superiors, and always ensures that his actions earn him some publicity. As the series progresses, Archer develops an interest in the military's various projects, such as the homunculi, chimeras, and the Philosopher's Stone. ~!Archer lost the left half of his body when the Philosopher's Stone was created in Liore, and received automail modification in order to regain his mobility. After the operations left him mentally unstable, Archer raged through Central, carrying out King Bradley's ordered executions. Riza Hawkeye shoots Archer down while he tries to kill Roy Mustang.!~ (Source: Wikipedia)

121.name: Grumman
121.desc: The commander of the eastern headquarters and grandfather of Riza Hawkeye. As he is not under the constant surveillance of the Humonculi, he aids Mustang in trying to topple the Humonculi controlled government, but seems to do so strictly out of personal ambition.

121.name: Heymans Breda
121.desc: Heymans Breda is one of Roy Mustang's most trusted subordinates. He was recruited by Mustang for his high level of intelligence, indicated by his talent with chess and other strategy games. Despite his intelligence, he still has an irrational fear of dogs. Breda is usually tasked by Mustang with jobs that require he travel abroad. In the course of doing so he uses up all of his days off, showing his dedication to Mustang. He is transferred to Western Headquarters when Mustang's group is broken up by the homunculi. In the manga, he eventually defects from the military so that he can help Mustang overthrow King Bradley.

121.name: Clause
121.desc: A girl who lives in the same village as Majhal and dresses like a boy. She believes sister died because of Karin. ~!After Ed and Alphonse left and had solved the whole mystery around Karin, she started dressing like a girl again.!~

121.name: Dante
121.desc: Dante is the main antagonist of the first anime adaptation. She is the former lover of Hohenheim, and has used Philosopher's Stones to transfer her soul to new bodies for around four hundred years. She leads the homunculi, either creating them herself, or finding them after they are created, and uses them to create conflicts in the hope of having a desperate alchemist create a new stone for her. She first appears as an elderly woman, who is the former alchemy teacher of Izumi Curtis. ~!She fakes her death at the hands of Greed, and later reveals herself to have transferred her soul to the body of her student Lyra , a young girl who had wished to become a State Alchemist. She is eventually killed by Gluttony, whom she reduced to a feral state to further her own purposes.!~

121.name: Kathleen Elle Armstrong
121.original: キャスリン·エル·アームストロング
121.desc: Major Armstrong's sister. She likes to lift pianos and dreams of having a boyfriend who's as strong as her brother. Her appearance is different from the rest of her family since she looks rather cute.

121.name: Yoki
121.desc: Yoki is, when first introduced, a corrupt member of the military who imposes heavy taxes on the town of Youswell, bankrupting its citizens. When the Elric brothers arrive in town, they trick Yoki into giving up ownership of the town and promptly report his actions to the military He is stripped of his rank and lives as a homeless person on the outskirts of Central, where he meets the fugitive Scar. In the anime, Yoki alerts the military to Scar's location, and in the subsequent raid to apprehend Scar he is killed by Lust. In the manga, Yoki is forced to work for Scar under the threat of death. Though he tries to convince those they encounter that Scar is his servant, Yoki does as Scar commands and calls him "master". Since he has started following Scar around the country, Yoki has assumed a role as comic relief, often having pain inflicted upon him when he tries to seem superior to others. -Wikipedia

121.name: Elicia Hughes
121.desc: Daughter of Maes and Gracia Hughes. She is an innocent, 3 year old girl. Her Dad loves her and he says every time how cute and talented she is.

121.name: Denny Brosh
121.desc: Denny Brosh is the partner of Maria Ross. He is rather nosy and lazy, and has an enormous infatuation with his partner. He is very sensitive to criticism, and will fall into despair at the slightest insult. Both he and Ross are introduced when they are assigned to protect Edward Elric.[77] In the anime, Brosh later appears in the rebellion against King Bradley, saving various characters from execution. In the manga, he appears again after Ross's apparent death. Though he is deeply saddened by the news, Ross feels it is for the best that he not know she is alive, as he has difficulty hiding his emotions. When Roy Mustang begins waging an assault on Central, Brosh rushes into the city to provide assistance. (Wiki)

121.name: Den
121.desc: [Winry Rockbell](https://anilist.co/character/63/)'s dog that has an auto-mail left leg.

121.name: Scar Ani
121.desc: Scar's Brother giving up his life and arm to save Scar's after he had been gravely wounded. Just like Scar his real name has never been revealed. In the 2003 anime, he created Lust during a failed human transmutation, while attempting to bring back his lover.

121.name: Bradley-fujin
121.desc: Mrs. Bradley is the wife of the Fuhrer, King Bradley. A kind and trusting wife. Though she rarely appears in either series, usually accompanying Selim, Mrs. Bradley's appearances usually fall under the category of comic relief as she speaks jovially of her familial life and romantic past with the Fuhrer.

121.name: Philip Gargantos Armstrong
121.original: フィリップ・ガルガントス・アームストロング
121.desc: Former General Philip Gargantos Armstrong is is the current head of the illustrious Armstrong family, father to Major Alex Louis Armstrong, Major General Olivier Mira Armstrong, and their younger sisters Amue, Strongine, and Kathleen Elle. His wife's name is not known. A bit of a windbag, Philip enjoys relating stories of his family's grandeur and his own eventful military career to anyone unfortunate enough to become his captive audience, and seems to have passed on this family pride to Alex. Being a former General, it would seem that Philip is a rather insightful man, quickly understanding from Oliver's demands for the Armstrong estate that Amestris was no longer safe, and taking his wife and daughter Kathleen off to Xing on an "extended vacation". (Source: The Fullmetal Alchemist Wikia)

121.name: Karl Haushofer
121.original: カール・ハウスホーファー
121.desc: A German general, geographer, and geopolitician. Through his student Rudolf Hess, Haushofer's ideas may have influenced the development of Adolf Hitler's expansionist strategies.

121.name: Alexander
121.desc: Alexander is the family pet of the Tucker Family and [Nina's](https://anilist.co/character/4159/) inseparable best friend.

19603.name: Shirou Emiya
19603.desc: __Height:__ 167 cm Shirou is the main character of Fate/stay night. He is a serious yet helpful, hardworking, and honest teenager. His hobbies include fixing a variety of broken things, from VCRs to stoves, as well as cooking and cleaning. He is initially confused about the Holy Grail War and attempts to irrationally shield others from danger, including his own Servant, [Saber](https://anilist.co/character/497)

19603.name: Artoria Pendragon
19603.original: アルトリア・ペンドラゴン
19603.desc: __Height:__ 154 cm (5'1) Artoria Pendragon, better known as Arthur Pendragon and King Arthur, is regarded as a male in history but is actually female. She is the "Once and Future King" and a legendary hero of Britain known as the King of Knights. She used to wield the sword from the stone, Caliburn, but it was eventually destroyed and the Lady of the Lake gifted her with Excalibur and Avalon. __In Fate/Prototype:__ ~!He is presented as male instead, conserving his original name of Arthur Pendragon. Also called Prototype Saber, he is the Saber-class Servant under the control of [Ayaka Sajyou](https://anilist.co/character/54223).!~ __In Fate/stay night:__ ~!Saber is summoned in the Fifth Holy Grail War as the Servant of [Shirou Emiya](https://anilist.co/character/496). Shirou had been having dreams of Excalibur in the days leading up to the start of the Holy Grail War after receiving his Command Spells and, while stumbling in his shed during his escape from [Lancer](https://anilist.co/character/499), Avalon, hidden inside him, reacts to the traces of a magic circle and summons Artoria as his Servant.!~ __In Fate/stay night: Heaven's Feel:__ ~! Corrupted by [Angra Mainyu](https://anilist.co/character/120855), Artoria is vastly different from her normal self. She is also called Saber Alter/Black Saber. The results of her alteration is not only within Artoria's interior but also extends to her outward appearance. The color of her skin becomes pale, and the pupil of her eyes that w

19603.name: Rin Tohsaka
19603.desc: __Height:__ 124 cm (Fate/Zero), 159 cm (Fate/stay night) Rin is a model student and idol of [Shirou](https://anilist.co/character/496)'s school. She barely talks to other students in her school and exhibits a desire to be left alone, as exemplified by her tendency to stay on the school's rooftop, away from the rest of the students. She is also secretly a Magus and a Master in the Fifth Holy Grail War. In the beginning of the anime, she summons [Archer](https://anilist.co/character/2087) for her Servant, although she originally wanted to summon Saber. Rin is reared as the successor to her family's magecraft, instructed by her father, [Tokiomi Tohsaka](https://anilist.co/character/16017), to prioritize sorcery over her own interests. After her father is killed, Rin continues to perfect her sorcery, with some guidance from her guardian, [Kirei Kotomine](https://anilist.co/character/506). She strives to earn the admiration of her peers to avoid drawing attention to her private life, even though she is secretly stingy, tomboyish, and a perfectionist. She is perceptive, resourceful and avidly competitive. ~!Rin is [Sakura](https://anilist.co/character/500/Matou-Sakura)'s older sister, but the two were forced to live apart by their father, Tokiomi. Rin once had a good relationship with Sakura before their separation, evident by a ribbon Sakura always kept. Rin later convinced herself that Sakura was living a happier life with the Matou family than she was living as the Tohsaka famil

19603.name: Cú  Chulainn
19603.desc: Born as Sètanta from a mortal woman, Deichtine, and the Sun God Lugh he's a Hero from the Ulster Cycle of Irish Mythology. He took the name Cú Chulainn after he killed the guard dog of the blacksmith Culann, said to be stronger than 10 men, when he was only a child. To make up to the old blacksmith he offered himself as a guard dog and since then was called Cú Chulainn, "Culann's savage dog". Trained in the Arts of the Spear and magic Runes by Scáthach, he wields the cursed Gàe Bolg, the spear that inflicts wounds that never heal. __In Fate/Stay Night:__ ~! Originally the servant of [Bazett Fraga McRemitz](https://anilist.co/character/24332/Fraga-McRemitz-Bazett), he becomes the Servant of [Kirei Kotomine](https://anilist.co/character/506/Kotomine-Kirei) after Kirei fatally wounds Bazett and remains under his command for the duration of the War. !~ __In Fate/Grand Order -First Order:__ ~! He is a Caster-class servant. Unlike the other Servants, he's not blackened and aids [Mash](https://anilist.co/character/120735/Kyrielight-Mash) and [Ritsuka](https://anilist.co/character/120734/Fujimaru-Ritsuka) in their task !~ __In Fate/hollow Ataraxia:__ ~! [Caren Hortensia](https://anilist.co/character/46957/Hortensia-Caren) acts as his Master.!~

19603.name: Sakura Matou
19603.desc: __Height:__ 120 cm (Fate/Zero), 156 cm (Fate/stay night) A student in her first year of high school, Sakura is the sister of [Shinji Mato](https://anilist.co/character/501). After [Shirou](https://anilist.co/character/496)'s father [Kiritsugu](https://anilist.co/character/10010) died, Sakura often visited Shirou's home to help him with his daily chores. She is outwardly shy and timid, but possesses great inner strength. Sakura has a long standing and obvious crush on Shirou Emiya.

19603.name: Shinji Matou
19603.desc: [Sakura Matou](https://anilist.co/character/500/Matou-Sakura)'s older brother, and a long-time friend of [Shirou](https://anilist.co/character/496/Emiya-Shirou). Shinji is very popular as vice-captain of the archery dojo despite being chauvinistic and a narcissist. Like [Rin Tohsaka](https://anilist.co/character/498/Tohsaka-Rin), he is of a distinguished lineage of sorcerers, though the Matou blood has thinned and no longer produces heirs naturally capable of sorcery. Shinji feels uncomfortable with his sister's daily visits to Shirou's home. He has an open crush on Rin, but she does not return his favors.

19603.name: Medusa
19603.desc: ~!Medusa is a Greek mythological figure described as a winged human female with living venomous snakes in place of hair. Those who gazed upon her face would turn to stone. With her older sisters [Stheno](https://anilist.co/character/191058/Stheno) and [Euryale](https://anilist.co/character/191065/Euryale), they made up the three Gorgon Sisters who inhabited the Shapeless Isle. She came into existence thanks to the thoughts and prayers of humans, who desired a perfect goddess, but she was cursed for her beauty and turned into a monster hated by all. She is thus not a Heroic Spirit but a monster closer to a Divine Spirit. Due to her nature, she can manifest through different aspects depending on which disposition is predominant (more or less monstrous)!~ __In Fate/stay night:__ ~!She is the Rider-class Servant of [Shinji Matou](https://anilist.co/character/501/Matou-Shinji) in the Fifth Holy Grail War of Fate/stay night.!~ __In Fate/stay night: Heaven's Feel:__ ~!She only truly acts as [Sakura](https://anilist.co/character/500/Matou-Sakura)'s Servant when their connection is revealed in Heaven's Feel.!~ __In Fate/Grand Order - First Order:__ ~!She is a Lancer-class Servant. Medusa is Blackened, a process by which a being is tainted by an outside force, causing their personality to be reversed toward the orientation of evil.!~ __In Fate/Grand Order: Absolute Demonic Front Babylonia:__ ~!In this singularity Medusa manifests as two separate beings: One is Ana, a Lancer-class Serva

19603.name: Illyasviel von Einzbern
19603.original: イリヤスフィール・フォン・アインツベルン
19603.desc: **Height:** 133 cm **Birthday in [Fate/kaleid](https://anilist.co/manga/33526/): **Jul 20 A young Teutonic aristocrat, she traveled to Japan to participate in the Holy Grail War as a Master. Illyasviel has an angelic appearance and an unsurpassed degree of magical power. She lives in a castle on the outskirts of Fuyuki City, accompanied only by her Servant and two maids. Illyasviel asks those she feels comfortable around to simply call her "Illya".

19603.name: Heracles
19603.desc: __In Fate/Stay Night:__ ~!The Servant of [Illya](https://anilist.co/character/503/von-Einzbern-Illyasviel), he is a swarthy giant with adamantine skin and gross brawn. He wields a colossal stone Axe-Sword, and is capable of causing massive destruction with the mere backlash of his swings. As a Berserker, he was stripped of his sanity and reason, acting feral and animalistic in combat. Berserkers are praised as members of the "Strongest" class, though they are difficult to control. Illya, however, appears to have little trouble managing Berserker.!~

19603.name: Taiga Fujimura
19603.desc: __Height:__ 165 cm She is an English teacher at [Shirou's](https://anilist.co/character/496/Emiya-Shirou) school, homeroom instructor of Shirou's class and the supervising teacher for the archery dojo. After [Kiritsugu](https://anilist.co/character/10010/Emiya-Kiritsugu) died, Taiga became Shirou's guardian and has been living with him for several years. Taiga and Shirou are very close, and she regards him as a younger brother. She's initially distrustful of [Saber](https://anilist.co/character/497/Pendragon-Artoria), believing that "some strange woman was trying to take Shirou from her" as she put it. She becomes exasperated whenever a new girl appears at Shirou's house, thinking he stashes girls at his house. Taiga always shows up for breakfast and dinner at Shirou's house to have some of [Sakura's](https://anilist.co/character/500/Matou-Sakura) cooking, and always saves some scraps from breakfast for her lunch. ~!During Rider's Blood Fort attack on Shirou's school, Taiga was the only person who could still move around somewhat. Begging [Shinji Matou](https://anilist.co/character/501/Matou-Shinji) for help, he quickly kicks her in the head, knocking her unconscious. She recovers quickly though, even pigging-out on hospital food while recovering.!~

19603.name: Kirei Kotomine
19603.desc: __Height:__ 185 cm (Fate/Zero), 193 cm (Fate/stay night) ~!Through an agreement between the Mages' Association and the Church, the Holy Grail Wars are moderated by a priest. Kirei's father was the mediator for the 4th Holy Grail War, and when he died, Kirei felt obligated to replace him. His selection as mediator is unusual, for Kirei is a member of both the Church and Mages' Association, organizations on hostile terms with one another. Since the death of [Rin](https://anilist.co/character/498/Tohsaka-Rin)'s father, he has also acted as an indirect caretaker for Rin.!~

19603.name: Archer
19603.desc: __Height:__ 187 cm (6'1) __In Fate/stay night UBW:__ ~!He is the Servant of one of the series' main heroines, [Rin Tousaka](https://anilist.co/character/498/Tohsaka-Rin). Due to an incomplete summon, he apparently has no memory of his previous life or identity. Archer is sarcastic and cynical but under his hardened exterior lies a complex and dark personality that unfolds throughout the story. Though skilled with ranged weapons, he can hold his own in melee combat. Archer considers [Shirou Emiya](https://anilist.co/character/496/Emiya-Shirou)'s idealism to be weak and delusional, recognizing the mentality of "wanting to save everyone" as naive and impossible. Archer is actually a future version of Emiya Shirou, who became a hero through Emiya's wish to save innocent lives. After his death he became a Counter Guardian, a Spirit deployed to maintain balance and prevent humanity's extinction, but without the ability to act on his own he was forced to kill and face the fact that his ideals were not realizable time and time again. To escape this cycle the only hope for EMIYA was to be summoned as a Heroic Spirit and kill his past self before he became a Counter Guardian, which would cause a time paradox and release him from the cycle.!~ __In Fate/Grand Order - First Order:__ ~!EMIYA was Blackened, a process by which a being is tainted by an outside force, causing their personality to be reversed toward the orientation of evil!~

19603.name: Gilgamesh
19603.desc: __Height:__ 182 cm Gilgamesh is the King of Uruk, said to have reigned during the Sumer Dynasty in Mesopotamia 5000 years ago. He's the namesake Hero described in the Epic of Gilgamesh, making him the most ancient Hero on which all the others legends were modeled. This grants him the title of King of Heroes and, within his Gates of Babylon, the prototypes of all the Noble Phantasms of the Heroes yet to come. Born from the human Lugalbanda, the King of Uruk, and the goddess Rimat-Ninsun, he was a being so perfect and transcendent to the point that he was two-thirds deity and one-third human. He was the chosen one that would guide humanity on the earth that was slowly abandoning the Age of Gods, but instead he grew up to be a selfish and arrogant despot. His only friend and being he considered his equal was [Enkidu](https://anilist.co/character/60059). __In Fate/Zero:__ ~! Initially summoned as the Archer-class Servant of [Tokiomi Toosaka](https://anilist.co/character/16017/Tokiomi-Toosaka) in the 4th Holy Grail War, using the fossil of the first skin ever shed by a snake as a catalyst, he soon becomes bored with his Master and takes interest in Kirei Kotomine. Together they plot to kill Tokiomi and forge a new pact, with Gilgamesh pushing Kotomine to accept his true desires. He also takes interest in Iskandar as a worthy opponent to kill, and in Artoria, a tragic figure to take as his bride. In the end, invested by the pollution of the Holy Grail, he is gifted a mortal body an

19603.name: Kojirou Sasaki
19603.desc: He was summoned by [Caster](https://anilist.co/character/3440/Medea) as a guardian and watchmen for the front gate of the Ryudo Temple. As an improper servant, Assassin is entirely dependent on Caster for mana and cannot move freely beyond the grounds of Ryudoji. Furthermore, he lacks most of the usual parameters and abilities granted to his class. Because of his limited status, Assassin cares little for the Holy Grail, and outside of his duties to Caster, he only seeks to enjoy a decent sword fight.

19603.name: Soichirou Kuzuki
19603.desc: A well-built man with angular glasses, Kuzuki is the strict homeroom instructor of [Rin's](https://anilist.co/character/498/Tohsaka-Rin) class. He primarily lectures on World History, though he also holds classes in Ethics. Kuzuki is well respected among staff and students, but he is widely regarded as austere and impersonal. ~!A serial killer, he is [Caster's](https://anilist.co/character/3440/Medea) ally but acts more as her servant. He is in love with Caster although he hides it completely. He hid the fact that they had been defeated by the protagonists from Caster when she lay dying to spare her feelings; saying that victory was theirs he held her until she died, and perished himself immediately afterward.!~

19603.name: Medea
19603.desc: __Height:__ 163 cm __Servant type:__ Caster ~!An honored guest of the Ryudou family​ permitted to live at their temple until the preparations for her marriage have been finalized. A gorgeous and talented yet mysterious woman of high stature, her presence has attracted the attention of many trainee monks.!~

19603.name: Kiritsugu Emiya
19603.desc: __Height:__ 175 cm __Sidearm:__ Thompson contender in conjunction with his Mystic Code Origin Bullets [Shirou](https://anilist.co/character/496)'s foster father and his savior from the aftermath of the massive Fuyuki fire. During his lifetime, Kiritsugu was disillusioned with becoming a Hero of Justice, a defender of humanity who could save everyone. Although he feels he failed to do so, his efforts were a source of inspiration for Shirou. Prior to his fateful meeting with Shirou, Kiritsugu was notorious as the "Magus Killer," a freelancer who would hunt down heretical magi. Although he was a magus with Magic Circuits and abilities he was considered unorthodox in that he would utilize modern technology and weaponry along with his magecraft to track down and kill magi. Although mentioned and seen in flashbacks in Fate/stay night, Kiritsugu is one of the main protagonists in its prequel Fate/Zero. ~!It is hinted at in certain parts of Fate/stay night and confirmed in its prequel Fate/Zero that Kiritsugu is in fact [Illyasviel von Einzbern](https://anilist.co/character/503/von-Einzbern-Illyasviel)'s biological father, making Shirou and her step-siblings.!~

19603.name: Issei Ryuudou
19603.desc: Issei is the Student Body President of Shirō's school, and another close friend of [Shirō](https://anilist.co/character/496/Emiya-Shirou). Issei often asks Shirō to fix broken equipment for the Student Body to try and reduce save money on the school's bill. Issei and Shirō often have lunch together in the Student Body's office where they talk about what ever comes to mind. His father is the head priest of Ryūdōji Temple, and his brother was a classmate of [Taiga](https://anilist.co/character/505/Fujimura-Taiga) and [Neko-san](https://anilist.co/character/187774/Hotaruzuka-Otoko). He dislikes [Rin](https://anilist.co/character/498/Tohsaka-Rin) and seems to have some sort of fear of females, although he seems to be unusually at ease around [Saber](https://anilist.co/character/497/Pendragon-Artoria). ~!Issei unknowingly tells Shirō that [Caster](https://anilist.co/character/3440/Medea) is at the Temple.!~

19603.name: Ayako Mitsuzuri
19603.desc: __Height:__ 162 cm A stellar athlete, and captain of the archery dojo. Ayako and [Rin](https://anilist.co/character/498/Tohsaka-Rin) are actively competing to see who will be the first to snag a boyfriend. Ayako often asks [Shirou](https://anilist.co/character/496/Emiya-Shirou) to come to the archery dojo and watch them practice. ~!She is victimized by [Rider](https://anilist.co/character/502/Medusa) or [Caster](https://anilist.co/character/3440/Medea) early in the story and is later found unconscious in an alleyway. After she is attacked, Ayako is not seen again.!~ In the anime, ~!Ayako is seen with [Shinji](https://anilist.co/character/501/Matou-Shinji) after her disappearance, although Shinji denies it when asked by Shirou.!~

19603.name: Leysritt
19603.desc: Leysritt is a homunculus created by the Einzbern family to serve as a maid much like Sella. Despite her appearance, she is only about two years old. Regardless of her thin ego, she developed a sense of reason due to her alignment with Illya. As a result, Leysritt often says what she thinks without any consideration and this gets her often into a verbal conflict with Sella. She and Illya are actually very close friends and should Illya die, Leysritt would die as well. In contrast to Sella, she possesses a casual personality but has difficulty expressing her emotions and comes across as robotic at times. However, she appears to enjoy teasing Sella and also takes a liking to Shirou because his presence makes Illya happy.

19603.name: Sella
19603.desc: Sella is a homunculus created by the Einzbern family to serve as a maid and to teach Illya sorcery. Despite her appearance, she is only about two years old. Sella is highly protective of Illya, whom she loves and cares for deeply, and thus is very suspicious of Shirou Emiya. Despite her apparent coldness to everyone but Illya, Sella is actually rather fickle and insecure, particularly about her body, and Leysritt and Illya often tease Sella for her harsh personality.

19603.name: Kaede Makidera
19603.desc: Classification: Human Height: 163 cm Weight: 49 kg BWH: 72-56-78 Likes: wind chimes, competition Dislikes: Failure Affiliation: Homurahara Academy, Year 2 class A, track team Kaede is a friend of Rin Toosaka and known at Homura academy as the leader of track team. Even though she wishes to be called "Black Panther of Homura", her real nickname is simply "Maki." (Source: Type-Moon Wikia)

19603.name: Yukika Saegusa
19603.desc: Classification: Human Weight: 39 kg Height: 155 cm BWH: 75-57-78 Likes: cooking, taking care of her brothers Dislikes: sports Affiliation: Homurahara Academy, Year 2 class A, track team Yukika is a gentle, cheerful girl and the mascot of the famous Homura Academy track girl trio, along with Kaede and Kane. She also is one of the few non-magi who can see Assassin sitting in front of Ryuudou Temple. (Source: Type-Moon Wikia)

19603.name: Kane  Himuro
19603.desc: She is a student at Homurahara School. She is a friend of Yukika Saegusa and Kaede Makidera, they are known as Class 2-A's famed track girl trio and she generally plays the straight man of the group. She is the track team's high-jumping ace. She is considerate and intelligent. She is the brains of the trio. She is quiet, reserved, and doesn't speak that much as well. She is Minori's best friend and has a passion for gossip, especially if it involves those around her. (Source: Type-Moon Wikia)

19603.name: Otoko Hotaruzuka
19603.desc: Otoko Hotaruzuka is the daughter of the owner of Copenhagen in Fuyuki. Otoko went to highschool with [Taiga Fujimura](https://anilist.co/character/505/Fujimura-Taiga), keeping a close friendship since then. During the Fourth Holy Grail War, [Rider](https://anilist.co/character/16021/Iskandar) stole a barrel of wine from their bar meant for the Fujimura family, prompting Taiga to track down the culprit out of friendship. Five years before the Fifth Holy Grail War, [Shirou Emiya](https://anilist.co/character/496/Emiya-Shirou) came to start working for them. He took any job given to him, even including working while both she and her father were out sick.

17895.name: Kouko Kaga
17895.desc: She had a perfect future planned with [Mitsuo Yanagisawa](https://anilist.co/character/43671/Yanagisawa-Mitsuo) as her husband, and nothing will get in her way! She has a side of her that is not violent as Mitsuo has described.

17895.name: Banri Tada
17895.desc: Having had an nearly fatal accident shortly after high school graduation, he has lost all memories from before then. He spent a year recovering, and has now entered Law School.

17895.name: Mitsuo Yanagisawa
17895.desc: __Height:__ 177 cm (5'10") He tried to escape from Kouko by secretly taking the entrance exams for a private law school in Tokyo. Just when he thought he was free of her at long last, she appeared out of nowhere, having found him out and secretly followed him to the same school.

17895.name: Nana Hayashida
17895.desc: A second year student and Banri and Kouko's senior in the Festival Research Society. Her nickname Linda (りんだ) is an alternate reading of the kanji for Hayashida (林田). ~!Banri's love interest and best-friend during High School, she now follows him and keeps an eye out for him, though he cannot remember her at all. For reasons unknown as yet, she has not told him about their shared past.!~

17895.name: Chinami Oka
17895.desc: A rather petite girl specializing in film studies, she plays the role of young girls as a voice actor.

17895.name: Takaya Satou
17895.desc: __Height:__ 162cm (5'3") First year law student. Totally fascinated by two-dimensional girls, he is awkward around three-dimensional (aka real) girls. He has gone so far as to invent his own ideal girl, a two-dimensional creation of his imagination known to him as VJ (Brigitte Jeomillia).

17895.name: Nana
17895.desc: Nana is a third-year female student. She dresses and acts similarly to the character of the same name in the manga "Nana".

17895.name: Shii
17895.desc: A member of the Tea Club.

130003.name: Hitori Gotou
130003.desc: Gotou Hitori is a shy, gloomy high-schooler who started learning guitar after seeing rock bands on TV, in the hope that she too could become as popular as them. However, after 2 years she has yet to make a single friend or join a band. She instead sits in her closet at home, recording guitar covers and posting them to her YouTube channel, "guitarhero", on which she has amassed a reasonable following.

130003.name: Nijika Ijichi
130003.desc: An energetic and cheerful second-year high school student. She is the drummer of Kessoku Band and the organizer who takes care of [Hitori](https://anilist.co/character/257562). She has an older sister, [Seika](https://anilist.co/character/289054), who is the manager of the live house "STARRY" and has a special feeling for the live house.

130003.name: Ryou Yamada
130003.desc: A cool and solitary second year of high school. She is in charge of the bass of Kessoku Band. She's the best friend of [Nijika](https://anilist.co/character/261674). Her hobbies are out of the ordinary, and she rejoices when called a weirdo. She lives with a wealthy family, but she spends much of her money on instruments and always runs out of money. She occasionally eats weeds to get rid of her hunger.

130003.name: Ikuyo Kita
130003.desc: A bright and popular first year of high school. She is in charge of the guitar and vocals of Kessoku Band. She is a cheerful character who likes to interact with people and can talk to her with a smile without hesitation, even when she meets her for the first time. She longs for [Ryo](https://anilist.co/character/264529), and her feelings can go too far. She often takes photos and uploads to Isosta.

130003.name: Seika Ijichi
130003.desc: Nijika's older sister and manager of the live house "STARRY".

130003.name: PA-san
130003.desc: __Height:__ 162cm Mysterious looking female PA engineer with a mouth piercing. In her private life, she is active as a virtual Youtuber under the name "Otogi Alto" producing gameplay videos.

130003.name: Kikuri Hiroi
130003.desc: Bassist and vocalist of the band "SICK HACK". Always drunk to forget about life's downsides.

130003.name: Ryou no Classmate
130003.original: リョウのクラスメイト

130003.name: Ryou no Classmate
130003.original: リョウのクラスメイト

130003.name: Eliza Shimizu
130003.desc: Guitarist of the band "SICK HACK". She originally came from England, and moved to Japan 3 years ago so she could attend Comiket ("Comima" in the Japanese release of the manga) and be in an anison cover band. On top of her band activities, she also makes doujinshi.

130003.name: Ginjirou Yoshida
130003.desc: The manager of the live house "FOLT".

130003.name: Yoyoko Ootsuki
130003.desc: Guitarist and vocalist of the band "SIDEROS".

140439.name: Narrator
140439.desc: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

140439.name: Arataka Reigen
140439.desc: __Height:__ 179 cm (5'10.5") [Mob's](https://anilist.co/character/89616) mentor and boss in the Mob Psycho 100 series. He owns a business exorcising ghosts and is a self-proclaimed psychic. He is Mob's moral compass. He was the first person to ever consider Mob as normal and his teachings have never failed Mob.

140439.name: Shigeo Kageyama
140439.desc: **Height:** 157 cm He is the assistant and disciple of [Arataka Reigen](https://anilist.co/character/89334/Reigen-Arataka). He is also the newest member of the Body Improvement Club. Shigeo is a quiet and polite individual who tries to live a normal life despite having strong telepathic power, he wants to be seen as a good human among the people in his social life. This often makes him naive and gullible when those with malicious intent want to use him for a laugh or to cause trouble but Shigeo has very strong beliefs to never use his powers to hurt another person because of an altercation he faced once as a child.

140439.name: Ekubo
140439.desc: Ekubo is a self-proclaimed upper-class evil spirit who has aligned himself with [Mob](https://anilist.co/character/89616) after being defeated by him. Ekubo wants to be a god. Specifically, he wants to be worshipped by all humanity. ~!Despite having that kind of ego, he didn't hesitate to put himself at Mob's mercy in the hopes of using the boy to his advantage. At first, he wanted to steal Mob's body and use it to become a god, but he eventually decided to try to make Mob a god instead.!~

140439.name: Ritsu Kageyama
140439.desc: __Height:__ 159.4 cm Ritsu is very clever and apparently serious, he also serves on the student council and excels in academics and everything else he tries. None of that matters to him as much as psychic power, however, his brother is more important to him than anyone or anything else. ~!Before he awoke his own psychic powers, he longed for the esper abilities his brother has always had and was frustrated by his own inability to do things like bend spoons. He may have a habit of carrying spoons around with him, for bending purposes. He is a perfectionist with a not-so-hidden dark side. Unlike [Mob](https://anilist.co/character/89616/Kageyama-Shigeo), he finds it okay to use psychic violence against people when necessary.!~

140439.name: Tenga Onigawara
140439.desc: Tenga Onigawara is the leader of Salt Middle School and an unofficial member of the Body Improvement Club.

140439.name: Tome Kurata
140439.desc: __School:__ Salt Middle School __School club:__ Telepathy Club (President) Tome seems to be a slacker but is passionate about the possibility of using telepathy to contact extraterrestrials. However, when the Telepathy Club's research into the matter bears no results, she quickly gives up. When she learns that [Mob](https://anilist.co/character/89616/Kageyama-Shigeo) is an Esper, her passion is revitalized.

140439.name: Teruki Hanazawa
140439.desc: __Height:__ 161.4 cm Hanazawa Teruki is an esper who was first introduced as an antagonist, but later became [Mob](https://anilist.co/character/89616/Kageyama-Shigeo)'s friend after being defeated by him. He was the shadow leader (urabanchou) of Black Vinegar Middle School, using his psychic powers to rule over the delinquents at his own school, as well as to defeat those from other schools. Teruki is a talented, quick-thinking, and hardworking esper. In terms of raw power, he is nowhere near Mob's level, but he compensates for this by putting in effort and training diligently. He is able to analyze other espers' techniques and their weaknesses in a short amount of time, and often incorporates said techniques in his own fights. He is constantly training to improve himself, and is remarked by various espers as possessing a keen and powerful set of skills.

140439.name: Ichi Mezato
140439.desc: Ichi Mezato is a school girl who goes to Salt Middle School and is part of the News Club. She is in class 2-1.

140439.name: Tsubomi Takane
140439.desc: She is a middle schooler at Salt Middle School. Mob harbors a large crush on her. ~!Most of what we know about Tsubomi's personality in the manga is from what Mob and other characters say about her. However, in the anime adaptation, there are extra scenes of Tsubomi that add to her character and personality and make her a more compassionate individual.!~

140439.name: Shou Suzuki
140439.desc: ~!Sho Suzuki is the son of the leader of Claw. He led a direct resistance against his father's world domination plan.!~

140439.name: Musashi Gouda
140439.desc: Musashi Goda is a student of Salt Middle School and the Body Improvement Club's President. Musashi has a strong sense of justice but strongly disagrees with senseless violence

140439.name: Gou Asahi
140439.desc: Gou is an esper and one of the children who was invited to the Awakening Lab.

140439.name: Rei Kurosaki
140439.desc: Rei is an esper and one of the children who was invited to the Awakening Lab

140439.name: Takeshi Hoshino
140439.desc: Takeshi is an esper and one of the children who was invited to the Awakening Lab

140439.name: Yusuke  Sakurai
140439.desc: The partner of Koyama who is also one of the executives of the Tsume group.

140439.name: Megumu Koyama
140439.desc: Megumu is an esper and a former member of Claw. He was part of the upper echelon called "Scar".

140439.name: Toichirou Suzuki
140439.desc: Toichiro is an extremely powerful esper and the founder and leader of Claw.

140439.name: Kaito Shiratori
140439.desc: Kaito is an esper, the twin brother of [Daichi Shiratori](https://anilist.co/character/133206/Shiratori-Daichi), and one of the children who was invited to the Awakening Lab.

140439.name: Daichi Shiratori
140439.desc: Daichi is an esper, the twin brother of [Kaito Shiratori](https://anilist.co/character/133205/Shiratori-Kaito), and one of the children who was invited to the Awakening Lab.

140439.name: Mob no Chichi
140439.desc: Mob's Father.

140439.name: Kenji  Mitsuura
140439.desc: He is the founder of the Awakening Lab.

140439.name: Shinji Kamuro
140439.desc: He is the president of the student council at Salt Middle School.

140439.name: Hikaru Tokugawa
140439.desc: He is the vice-president of the school council of Salt Mid.

140439.name: Hiroshi Kumagawa
140439.desc: He is part of the Body Improvement Club and a student of Salt Middle School.

140439.name: Hideki  Yamamura
140439.desc: He is a student of Salt Middle School and a member of the Body Improvement Club.

140439.name: Banshoumaru Shinra
140439.desc: He is the self-proclaimed "greatest psychic of the century" and a member of the Sun Psychic Union led by Kirin Shoudou.

140439.name: Minori Asagiri
140439.desc: Minori Asagiri is a middle-school girl and the daughter of a wealthy businessman. Asagiri is very spoiled and very cruel. The first we see of her, she throws a tantrum due to dissatisfaction over lavish birthday presents. This is her true personality, according to her father, that existed before she was possessed by Mogami. Within the world Mogami created and trapped Mob in, she acts very similarly. She bullies, isolates and abuses Mob. Apparently, she does this because she wants to prove herself superior, and by preying on those who are weaker and can't stand up for themselves, she establishes her position. However, after being saved by Mob, she is brought to tears and resolves to become a better person because of him.

140439.name: Momozou  Takenaka
140439.desc: Takenaka is originally introduced as an image-conscientious character pushed into the Telepathy Club similarly to Mob. However, once it is revealed that he is a Telepath, he is shown to be standoffish despite his humor and tendency to tease others. He feels lonely given his telepathy and is overwhelmed by the consciousness of society. ~!Takenaka had previously filled a gap in the Telepathy Club to maintain the minimum number of members needed for the club. He had no interest in the club or in telepathy. He worried about how people looked at him because of his club membership, so he decided to leave the club. As a result of him leaving the club, Tome Kurata had to find a new member to keep the club open. He is later revealed to have joined the tennis club. In chapter 98 he is revealed to be a telepath. He returned to their former club room investigate the telepathic ringing generated by Mob and Shiratori brothers. He is subsequently recruited to help contact extraterrestrial life, although he only joins out of obligation. Later, he is revealed to have actually memorized the summoning formation and incantation despite knowing it to be a hoax, as he didn't want to ruin their memory. He proceeds to spend his New Years' with the others after successfully coming into contact with alien lifeforms.!~

140439.name: Jun Sagawa
140439.desc: He is a student of Salt Middle School and the president of the Body Improvement Club.

140439.name: Kirin Shodou
140439.desc: He is a haughty psychic and the President of the Sun Psychic Union. ~!Like many other self-proclaimed psychics, Shodo possesses no special abilities. However, he was able to produce a noticeable aura in his ultimately fruitless attempt to exorcize​ Keiji Mogami from Minori Asagiri's body.!~

140439.name: Emi
140439.desc: She is a student at Salt Middle School. Emi first appears as a questionably nice girl who shows an interest in Mob. She has an interest in books and writing novels. ​However, she seems to be easily influenced by her friends and quickly interprets things others say about her negatively, even if they weren't meant that way. She was grateful to Mob for retrieving and restoring her writings after they were torn up.

140439.name: Haruto  Kijibayashi
140439.desc: He is a third-year middle school student and a member of the Telepathy Club.

140439.name: Shirihiko Saruta
140439.desc: He is a first-year middle school student and a member of the Telepathy Club.

140439.name: Katsuya Serizawa
140439.desc: He is an extremely powerful Esper who was formerly a part of the Super 5 of Claw. He now works at the agency alongside Reigen and Mob.

140439.name: Mameta  Inukawa
140439.desc: He is a second-year middle school student and a member of the Telepathy Club.

140439.name: Ryohei Shimura
140439.desc: He is a student of Salt Middle School and a member of the Body Improvement Club.

140439.name: Nozomu Hatori
140439.desc: He is a powerful Esper and a former member of the terrorist organization​ Claw as part of the Ultimate 5.

140439.name: Toshiki Minegishi
140439.desc: He is a powerful esper, a former member of the terrorist organization​ Claw and once part of the Ultimate 5.

140439.name: Haruaki  Amakusa
140439.desc: He is a self-proclaimed youkai hunter.

140439.name: Joseph
140439.desc: He is an esper mercenary and assassin hired by the government.

14227.name: Shizuku Mizutani
14227.desc: __Height:__ 158 cm (5'2") A high school student who is only interested about studying and getting the top grades in the class. She appears indifferent towards everything outside of studying.

14227.name: Haru Yoshida
14227.desc: __Height:__ 178 cm (5'10") Haru is the male protagonist of the story. He is a high school student who sits next to Shizuku in class. He is a delinquent boy who is absent for a long time after getting in a fight early in the story. Despite being a trouble maker, he is a passionate boy who helps others and can achieve high grades with little effort. He does not like going to school because most people see him as a threat and are afraid of him, saddening him as he is unable to make real friends. After meeting Shizuku, he takes her as his first real friend and starts to attend school, falling in love with her in the process. He also keeps a rooster and brings it to school everyday, despite his teacher's disapproval. He has somewhat of a perverted mind, openly saying to Shizuku that he would "do" her and has "dirty thoughts" about her. It is unclear whether or not he actually thinks before he speaks. ~!At first, Haru was shown to be a delinquent, but as the story unfolds, it was revealed that he was rather a shy and innocent boy. However, he has bipolar tendencies, most likely the result of not interacting with many people in the past.!~

14227.name: Asako Natsume
14227.desc: __Height:__ 157 cm She was a classmate of [Shizuku](https://anilist.co/character/37685/Mizutani-Shizuku) who one day asks for help in a re-test that she must not fail. She's revealed to be active on the web, where she has a blog, on which she even posted to need two strands of Mitti's hair to complete a ritual that'd assure them to become best friends. She's good at sports. She has poor grades, and does not have any friends outside of the internet. She was bullied and ostracized by her friends and classmates in the past, due to her popularity with the boys. She falls in love with [Mitsuyoshi Misawa](https://anilist.co/character/64079/Misawa-Mitsuyoshi) and is often comforted by [Souhei Sasahara](https://anilist.co/character/52617/Sasahara-Souhei) when her love attempts fail. She is voiced by Yuiko Tatsumi in drama CD.

14227.name: Souhei Sasahara
14227.desc: **Height:** 164 cm (5'5) He is a cheerful, friendly, straightforward guy who says what's on his mind without hesitation. He has knows Haru since middle school and he gets along with everyone. Due to his kindness, he is seen by his friends as a popular boy who is always surrounded by people. ~!In the manga, it is confirmed that he likes Natsume.!~

14227.name: Yuuzan Yoshida
14227.desc: __Height:__ 176 cm Haru's older brother. He loves sweet things and is often seen eating them. He especially loves donuts. He and his brother don't really get along with each other. Although Yuuzan tries to get closer to his younger brother and understand him, Haru doesn't accept him. However Yuuzan claims Haru has a brother complex, though this is denied by Haru himself. He came to take Haru back home upon their father's request for Haru to attend a nearer school, where he has more leverage, although Yuuzan does want Haru to continue going to school with Shizuku.

14227.name: Kenji Yamaguchi
14227.desc: __Height:__ 177 cm (5'10) He "takes" money from Haru, even though he is rich. He always is with 3 more guys and he knows Haru since he was a child. He is often lost and is very wary of Yuuzan. ~!Later, he starts to like Shizuku, confessing to her.!~

14227.name: Chizuru Ooshima
14227.desc: __Height:__ 165 cm (5'5) She is a member of the committee class, chosen because she wears glasses. She was helped by Yoshida Haru, and after been cheered her up by Haru, she fell in love with him. She is very shy, a little pessimistic, and anxious, and even though she likes Haru, she always gives him advice when he can't understand Shizuku.

14227.name: Yuu Miyama
14227.desc: __Height:__ 146 cm (4'9) A close friend of Oshima since middle school. She is currently in a long distance relationship with a prior classmate of hers from middle school.

14227.name: Mitsuyoshi Misawa
14227.desc: __Height:__ 185 cm (6') Mitsuyoshi is a tall, tan skinned young man with dark brown combed back hair. His attire often consists of casual clothes, his ever-present sunglasses, piercings, a silver necklace, two rings on each hand, a cigarette, and the occasional wrist band. Also, according to the manga, Mitsuyoshi's eyes strongly resemble [Haru](https://anilist.co/character/37687/Yoshida-Haru) and [Yuuzan](https://anilist.co/character/53087/Yoshida-Yuuzan)'s father's eyes, which is why he wears sunglasses constantly; so the two siblings do not hate him.

14227.name: Nagoya
14227.desc: Nagoya is a stray rooster that Haru named.

21518.name: Souma Yukihira
21518.desc: __Height:__ 171 cm He is the son of [Jouichirou Yukihira](https://anilist.co/character/77495) and, until it closed, worked at his father's restaurant, Restaurant Yukihira. Souma fight his odds in the elite school to becoming the best chef in the world even with strong background discrimination of his academy. He is currently a student at Tootsuki Culinary Academy and a resident of Polar Star Dormitory. Souma is a rather energetic child who has the constant drive to move forward with his cooking, mostly due to his rivalry with his father. Due to his drive to move forward Souma is willing to try odd things with food including "Grilled Squid Tentacles Dressed in Peanut Butter," though these dishes usually don't go over too well. It is because the will of Soma to try to move forward, his dish often considered as creative and innovative by some peers and lecturers; lead his rivalry with all the students in the Tootsuki Culinary Academy even rough. Through all this Souma maintains a laid back attitude towards just about everything but cooking. Souma can cook many different foods in many different styles, though he prefers what he calls "Yukihira Style," which is the cooking style which he learned from his father. Souma shows an immense capability for cooking and a special adaption with learning from his mistakes and improvising through learning from said mistakes. It is due to his creativity and also resourcefulness, Souma is able to create the same dish with different ways of cook

21518.name: Erina Nakiri
21518.desc: __Height:__ 162 cm One of the two main heroines in the manga, Erina is initially the primary antagonist of [Souma Yukihira](https://anilist.co/character/75216), until this develops into more of a friendship. Erina is the only daughter of [Azami Nakiri](https://anilist.co/character/156421) and an unnamed mother who is [Senzaemon](https://anilist.co/character/76028)'s biological daughter. Erina often detests whoever is considered "common" due to her regal pedigree and status within the Toutsuki organization. Her "God Tongue" can accurately describe the taste and composition of any food, and she gives harsh critiques to chefs and students alike. However, there have been rare occasions where she gives credit to chefs with skill. She had been promoted as the Elite Ten's 10th seat as a middle-schooler.

21518.name: Megumi Tadokoro
21518.desc: __Height:__ 154 cm __Cuisine Style:__ Hospitality Megumi is from a cold harbor town in the Tōhoku region and enrolled into Tōtosuki's junior high program hoping to be able to help her family's bed-and-breakfast the Shokei'en Inn. Because of her stage fright and shyness she performs poorly and causes her to rank at the bottom of her class. Megumi is clumsy and timid, thoughtful, kind and honest girl with polite manners. She is always looking out for others and is willing to assist them in any way she can. According to Gin Dōjima, Megumi's greatest gift is her warm hospitality as she cooks. She highly idolizes her mother. Although Megumi is a capable chef, she does not fare well under pressure because she has stage fright. Because she is intimidated very easily, she makes simple mistakes when she cooks, causing many of her classmates to see her as a weak student. She is quick to panic when something goes awry and tends to over think situations when under pressure or stress, such as repeatedly packing and unpacking a suitcase to make sure she packed something, even though she did not need to pack a suitcase in the first place. ~!Megumi eventually even becomes the 10th seat of the Elite Ten Council of the Tōtsuki Culinary Academy after the Promotion Exams Arc.!~

21518.name: Senzaemon Nakiri
21518.desc: Senzaemon is headmaster of Tōtsuki Academy and [Erina](https://anilist.co/character/75284)'s grandfather. Known as the "Gastric Godfather", he has the tendency of stripping his upper body when he eats a good dish. Despite his appearance and reputation, he is reasonable and gives accurate commentary and assessment for the food he tastes without being overly critical to the losers. ~!Many years previously, Senzaemon and Gin noticed Jōichirō Saiba's critical condition at the start of a tournament, and took upon themselves some of the blame for pressuring Jōichirō into becoming mentally trapped in the creation of his dishes. Feeling Jōichirō's talent was beyond the tasks of the academy, Senzaemon freed his former student to travel abroad and learn independently, a proposal Jōichirō happily accepted, as well as Gin whom Senzaemon offered him as the head of resort planner as a mean to atone their sins to ensure no one will share a similar fate as what happened to Joichiro before. For a period thereafter, Senzaemon hired Jōichirō as his private chef.!~ ~!Six years ago, Senzaemon exiled his son-in-law, Azami, for abusing Erina with brainwashing, and turns out even worst and dangerous to rule the academy than Joichiro's previous ill-fate. Senzaemon became Erina's legal guardian and had Azami's name struck from the Tōtsuki records. However, in the year Erina enrolls in the academy, Azami returns and a majority of the Elite Ten vote to support Azami as headmaster, replacing Senzaemon. I

21518.name: Fumio Daimidou
21518.desc: She is the warden and guardian of Polar Star Dormitory.

21518.name: Roland Chapelle
21518.original: ローランド・シャペル
21518.desc: Roland Chapelle (Rōran Shaperu) is one of the stern lecturer in the Totsuki Culinary Academy, who was infamous for his extreme discipline. Earned the nickname as the Chef Who Never Smiles, Chapelle takes student's performance and presentation in a serious matter which every presentations counts as if it is their conduct in their future careers, not just in French cuisine but also others involves cookery. Whoever failed to reach his eligible standard shall faced his worst judgment upon them, making this veteran lecturer a judge, jury and even executioner in this prestige academy. He always has been this strict until Yukihira Soma, the Yukihira transfer student's resourceful and innovative cooking that made him smile for the first time with the impression Soma's version of Boeuf Bourguignon; making Soma is the first (and the only) rookie chef intrigued by this iron heart veteran. As the professional lecturer with French Cuisine is part of his forte and pride, Chapelle is very serious upon his native dish and he is not tolerate any fools (student or anyone alike) making fun of it. It is also believed that rigid discipline meant 100% success, Chapelle has a concept that any student whom didn't pass with the flying colors are considered people who failed to prove their worth. With his grumpy and no-nonsense attitude combined, Chapelle's strict discipline is so extreme that every students feared him as his judgement meant absolute end should the requirement didn't meet his expectat

21518.name: Jouichirou Yukihira
21518.desc: The father of Sōma Yukihira, and owner of the diner Yukihira in the Sumire Shopping District. His passion for cooking knows no bounds and his skill is world-class. As the sole parental-figure and family member in Sōma's life, he is a mentor, teacher, and rival to his son. Like Sōma, Jōichirō is laid-back but professional and has a serious side that emerges when he is cooking. The two share the same habit of creating horrible experimental dishes. Jōichirō is supportive of his son but does occasionally like to see Sōma stressed and frustrated by challenging him to many cook-offs – always ending in Jōichirō's victory – to show him how much he has to grow. He left home to work abroad and sent his son to Tōtsuki Academy, telling Sōma that he needs to succeed in Tōtsuki if he ever wants to surpass him.

21518.name: Satoshi Isshiki
21518.desc: He is a student at Totsuki Culinary Academy, a resident of Polar Star Dormitory and the current 7th seat of the Elite Ten Council. Aside from that, Satoshi's position as one of the Elite 10 also promote a strong determination for his kouhai(junior),Yukihira Soma to drive his dream to become one of the 10 seat and could be a potential challenge for Soma due to his natural cooking abilities.

21518.name: Ikumi Mito
21518.desc: She is one of the student of Tootsuki Culinary Academy whom is also a former rival to Yukihira Soma. As the sole successor of the meat culinary expert of the Mito family for abundance knowledge about the meat culinary (especially beef and donburi), Ikumi is responsible to hold the pride of her family's name and like any other students in Tootsuki Culinary Academy, Ikumi is extremely prejudice upon the society classes and use high class ingredient to make a high standard dish. It is said that Ikumi's rigid family rules and regulations had made her cooking skill more elegant and grace like playing piano. Using all graces of cooking by using the high grade materials as well as expensive, Ikumi can almost made the dish as elegant as it look to impressed her clients.

21518.name: Ryouko Sakaki
21518.desc: Ryouko is gentle and kind, responding to the eccentrics of the other Polar Star residents in a level-headed manner and comforting the other students when they are troubled. Ryōko's specialty is fermented foods due to her parents owning a well-known fermented-goods shop, and she maintains a workshop near the dorms to produce her own ingredients. She also keeps a bottle of "fermented rice drink" that she would sometimes bring out during parties and celebrations, which [Souma](https://anilist.co/character/75216/Yukihira-Souma) suspects is illegally brewed sake. ~!During the Autumn Elections, she presented a "curry soy-natto rice" using charcoal-fermented natto and homemade rice-sauce fermented with koji. The dish garnered praise from the judges, who suddenly felt as if they were in a festival due to the quintessentially Japanese and festive taste of the dish. She ultimately took 7th place in her block.!~

21518.name: Yuuki Yoshino
21518.desc: She is a student at Tōtsuki Culinary Academy and a resident of Polar Star Dormitory. She and the other resident students from his hostel befriended with their fellow roommate Yukihira Soma and also aware to Soma's talent as one of the finest and unique of all. She is also a roommate and friend to her fellow student, Tadokoro Megumi and Sakaki Ryoko. Yuki is more focus on animal meat as her main cuisine. Unlike Ikumi, the meat master in any meat culinary, Yuki often used the animal hunted game from domestic poultry to any other animals (like rabbits and deer) as her main theme. Yuki's cutting skill could be yet

21518.name: Shun Ibusaki
21518.desc: Shun is presumably known his senior, Isshiki Satoshi better than anyone else as he was stayed much longer than the rest of the Polar Star Gang. Unlike his passionate room mates, Shun is very realistic on the terms and very serious upon making his style in perfection. Shun is also a quiet student who prefer speak only whenever is considered as crucial by many. It is also once claimed that he is a calculative chef whose choose to act wisely over hesitation.

21518.name: Takumi Aldini
21518.original: タクミ・アルディーニ
21518.desc: __Height:__ 168 cm Takumi is the oldest nephew of the owner of the Trattoria Aldini, a trattoria (family-style restaurant) located in Florence, Italy. He is half-Japanese but, unlike his brother [Isami](https://anilist.co/character/85785/Aldini-Isami), appears more European – with blond hair and blue eyes – and is noted as being extremely handsome, having fan clubs in Toutsuki Academy and his hometown. He enrolled in Tōtsuki at the behest of his uncle, taking with him his mezzaluna (two-handed knife) and a bottle of homemade olive oil as a good luck charm. His specialty is Italian cuisine, although many professional chefs noted that he has a broad vision; like [Souma](https://anilist.co/character/75216/Yukihira-Souma), he will incorporate ingredients and methods from other culinary styles to create inventive dishes, and can modify his recipes while cooking. He is very kind and supportive of his less-skilled brother, to the point of risking his pride to defend Isami's honor. Takumi has a fierce (and somewhat one-sided) rivalry with Sōma. Takumi sees Sōma as someone similar to himself – both having grown-up working at small family restaurants – and a worthy rival, and jumps at any chance to compete with him. He frequently tries to challenge Sōma to informal cooking challenges (usually leading to an embarrassing situation for himself), hoping to one day defeat Sōma in a formal Shokugeki. Despite their rivalry, both he and Sōma greatly respect each other, and likely view each oth

21518.name: Hinako Inui
21518.desc: One of the graduated students from Tootsuki Culinary Academy who turned professional, she is one of the respected legends of both her former school and alumni, among the few students who successfully graduated academy. Like most of the 10 alumni, Inui took the quality of the food very serious for it's freshness as well as. Fame for her nickname as the Mist Queen during her admission in the academy, Inui is able to know the quality of the food just by her nibble before she could bite into her mouth. With this, she can easily tell of the food is good or bad by just putting the food on her lips before finally eating them. Behind her mature, stern and professional personality however, Inui may be childish and rather whenever she confused of either decision which she could made. Considered as a joke member of all alumni, Inui actually make several jokes to cheer her peers. Inui's cooking style would preferred to the Japanese traditional style/ known as Washi. (Source: Shokugeki no Souma Wiki)

21518.name: Koujirou Shinomiya
21518.desc: Owner of a French cuisine restaurant called Shino's, Kojirou was a student of the 79th generation and held the first seat of the Elite Ten. He is commonly seen sporting glasses and red hair. Known as the "Legumes Magician", Kojirou was convinced he was going to be successful in France with his French–Japanese fusion restaurant, Shino's. However, his French staff refused to follow his recipes, even sabotaging his dishes. Facing financial ruin, he hardened himself emotionally and fired anyone who questioned his skills in the kitchen. Although this allowed him to reach the top, his proud and stubborn refusal to make exceptions resulted in his skills stagnating over the years. ~!Kojirou returns to Toutsuki as a guest teacher, and "fires" Megumi for altering his recipe despite there being an insufficient quantity of suitable ingredients. He threatens to do the same to Souma for coming to her defense, leading Souma to challenge him to an unofficial Shokugeki. During this match, Shinomiya makes a technically perfect dish that is the unanimous winner. However, Gin gives a bonus vote for Megumi's dish, prompting Shinomiya to try it and admit that her flexible cooking style suits the tastes of the customer. Shinomiya is reminded of his mother's kindness, and taking this to heart lets Megumi pass.!~ ~!Kojirou reappears in the story when Souma is assigned as a stagiaire (intern) at his new restaurant, Shino's Tokyo. His personality has noticeably softened since their last encounter, and

21518.name: Gin Doujima
21518.desc: Graduated from Tootsuki Culinary Academy, he is one of the respected legends of both his former school and Tootsuki Academy Alumni that is among the few who successfully graduated his academy with flying colors, thus became one of the proficient members of Tootsuki Resort as his graduation. As a living legend, Doujima is skillful in both culinary and board administration due to his talents in both culinary and managements that he handle the kitchen solo without the assistance of any chef around him. It is due to his professional discipline and tenacity, he is both respected and feared by many students and lecturers alike in his former academy. As the legend by the students of the Tootsuki Culinary Academy, Doujima is believed to possesses all styles of cooking to create much unique cuisine in different way. Usually handle the kitchen solo, Doujima has no problem to make 100 different meals thanks to his vast knowledge of ingredients as well of the varieties of cuisine. (Source: Shokugeki no Souma Wikia)

21518.name: Isami Aldini
21518.original: イサミ・アルディーニ
21518.desc: Isami is Takumi's brother, and the younger nephew of the owner of Trattoria Aldini. Unlike his brother, he has more of a Japanese appearance, with black hair and sharp eyes. Isami is originally shown to be overweight, with his eyes and mouth drawn in a simple fashion, although he briefly became much thinner during the Autumn Election preliminaries. Like Isami, he enrolled in Tōtsuki to hone his skills at the behest of their uncle. Although an equally talented chef, Isami is shown to be less sophisticated than his brother. He was scolded for trying to (and failing to) revise a dish that Takumi had made during their time in the trattoria, and constantly sought to be praised for his cooking like Takumi. Though Isami is supportive of his brother, he does aim to eventually surpass him as a cook. Nonetheless, the brothers are very close. ~!At the Autumn Election, he presented a tomato-curry calzone that was praised by the judges. He aimed to surpass his brother's score with the dish, but ultimately finished 5th in his block. He tried to support Takumi in his quarter-finals match against Subaru Mimasaka, and was devastated when Takumi lost to his own dish. He and Takumi opened a booth during the Moon Banquet Festival, naming it a branch of Trattoria Aldini, and gained first place in sales in their area. He is targeted as a rebel by the Azami Administration's Promotional Exams, defeated by Eishi on the third exam and expelled.!~ Isami and Takumi are featured in the Shokugeki no Soma

21518.name: Fuyumi Mizuhara
21518.desc: Italian restaurant "Ristorante F" chef. Withdrawn basically cynical personality.

21518.name: Hitoshi Seikimori
21518.desc: Hitoshi Sekimori is a 78th Generation Tōtsuki Academy Alumnus. He is the owner and head chef of the sushi restaurant, Ginza Hinowa.

21518.name: Goutoda Donato
21518.desc: Donato Gotōda is an 80th Generation Tōtsuki Academy Alumnus. He is the owner and head chef of the Auberge, Tesoro.

21518.name: Zenji Marui
21518.desc: He is a student at Totsuki Culinary Academyand a resident of Polar Star Dormitory. he and the other resident students from this hostel befriended with their fellow roommate/kouhai, Yukihira Soma whom also seen the amazing skill of the freshman. It is due to he rarely cooks, Zenji is considered as the weakest chef among the Polar Star Gang despite his brains has seemly possessed with infinite knowledge about cooking and black-&-white documents.

21518.name: Alice Nakiri
21518.desc: Alice Nakiri is a 92nd Tōtsuki Generation student and [Erina Nakiri](https://anilist.co/character/75284/Nakiri-Erina)'s cousin, whose cooking style is specialized in Molecular Gastronomy. Unlike her cousin though, Alice is much more friendly and cheery. She even will talk to her rivals casually, sometimes merely to poke fun at them, something she inherited from her mother. She is also a modern girl, eager to talk about love and gossip, even with the incredibly socially dense Erina. She is also very cunning, able to manipulate Erina using reverse psychology to keep her at a local public pool despite the latter's initial disgust at the location. She is quite bossy with [Ryō](https://anilist.co/character/88972/Kurokiba-Ryou), usually ordering him to do nearly everything for her. She tends to overreact when she is unhappy, throwing fits or snapping back at people. However, most of these are temporary and she will quickly return to normal in a few minutes.

21518.name: Ryou Kurokiba
21518.desc: Ryou Kurokiba is a 92nd Toutsuki Generation Student and Alice Nakiri's aide. Generally lazy and gloomy, Ryou's personality drastically shifts once he puts on his bandana, becoming aggressive, short-tempered, and brash. He grew up in a port town in Denmark, where he became the head chef of a pub due to his commanding personality and great skill. Due to his heritage, he is an expert in seafood and he can judge the quality of any and all seafood with only a glance. Mainly seen to be beside Alice Nakiri and has known her since childhood.

21518.name: Eizan Etsuya
21518.desc: He is a 91st Toutsuki Generation student of Toutsuki Culinary Academy and the current 9th Seat of the Elite Ten Council. He is known as the Alquimista aka "The Alchemist".

21518.name: Akira Hayama
21518.desc: An assistant of Professor [Jun Shiomi](https://anilist.co/character/144632/Shiomi-Jun), Akira comes from overseas; they met when he was an orphaned child and warned her about adultered spices in a market (presumably in India). Jun recognized the dormant talent in him and brought him back to Japan, where he was adopted by her teacher, Hayama. Akira quickly learned Japanese and studied spices and aroma under Shiomi. Jun became a mother figure for him, and his motivation to succeed at cooking stems from wanting to give something back to Jun. Akira specializes in curry dishes, with a wide knowledge of spices and aroma. He is a tall and handsome man with tanned skin and silver hair. Like [Sōma](https://anilist.co/character/75216/Yukihira-Souma), he aims to be at the top of the Elite Ten. His nose is very sharp when it comes to spices, capable of identifying ingredients and grade of cooking by the first smell, considered a worthy match of Erina's God's Tongue and being identified as an "Aroma Master". Although Jun and Akira are both experts in spices, she uses theoretical knowledge while he depends on his sense of smell. In contrast to Jun's naive, ditzy, easily angered and dependent persona, Akira is mature, reliable, street smart, cool and down-to-earth.

21518.name: Subaru Mimasaka
21518.desc: A heavily built student who is introduced during the Autumn Election. Despite his look, he's smarter than he appears and has a strong sense for details. He has no specialty, but painstakingly researches and copies the chefs he faces, predicting the exact dish they will make and marginally improving upon it.
