He loves intense cooking-duels and totally defeating his opponent, so he always bets his opponent's precious tool at Shokugekis. He is a gracious host and not averse to having a casual chat with future opponents. However, before and during a match he will mock, belittle and set out to destroy his opponent. ~!Subaru first appears during the Autumn Election preliminaries, taking the fourth spot from Zenji Marui and Shun Ibusaki. He insults Takumi and his brother, provoking Takumi to bet his mezzaluna, and having previously stalked Takumi and investigated his preparations, Subaru copies Takumi's dish with a slight improvement. Although the judges dislike his actions and methods, Subaru's dish is judged superior. This leads Sōma to challenge Subaru to give back all 100 cooking tools he'd won, against the total defeat of Sōma quitting being a cook. Sōma circumvents Subaru's research method by waiting until the competition starts before thinking of ways to improve his dish, something Subaru didn't believe was possible. After his defeat, Subaru tries to leave Tōtsuki and quit as a cook but Sōma convinces him to continue his studies. Subaru later appears when Sōma asks for assista

21518.name: Hisako Arato
21518.desc: Erina's secretary and close friend, Hisako specializes in medicinal-based dishes. She thinks of Erina as the best, that only she could be Erina's number two and nobody could ever get past her to Erina's level.

21518.name: Nao Sadatsuka
21518.desc: Nao Sadatsuka is a 92nd Tootsuki Generation student of Tootsuki Culinary Academy. Nao holds a deep harboring affection towards Erina Nakiri. Nao would do anything to get close to Erina including sending her 30 letters daily or watching her from afar using binoculars.

21518.name: Jun Shiomi
21518.desc: Shiomi is a 74th Generation Toutsuki Academy Alumnus and a former resident of the Polar Star Dormitory. She is one of the lecturers in Tootsuki Culinary Academy as well as the professor of the Shiomi Seminar. Shiomi Jun is leagal guardian of Hayama Akira. Jun is the youngest lecturer in the academy, but is actually older than she physically appears. Despite the fact that she in her 30s, she is shorter than both Souma and Megumi and has a noticeably youthful face, causing both Souma and Megumi to mistake her as a middle school student of the academy.

21518.name: Miyoko Houjou
21518.desc: A 92nd Totsuki Generation student. She is also the heiress to her family restaurant.

21518.name: Mitsuru Soutsuda
21518.desc: Mitsuru Soutsuda is a 93rd Generation Totsuki Academy student at Totsuki Culinary Academy and a member of the Newspaper Club, also known as Totsuki Sports.

21518.name: Shouji  Satou
21518.desc: Shōji Satō is a 92nd Tōtsuki Generation student and a resident of Polar Star Dormitory.

21518.name: Daigo  Aoki
21518.desc: Daigo Aoki is a 92nd Tōtsuki Generation student and a resident of Polar Star Dormitory.

21518.name: Taki Tsunozaki
21518.desc: Taki Tsunozaki is an 88th Generation Tōtsuki Academy Alumnus and a previous 2nd seat of the Elite Ten Council who is the owner and head chef of the Spanish restaurant called Taki Amarillo.

21518.name: Sonoka  Kikuchi
21518.desc: Sonoka Kikuchi is an 89th Generation Tōtsuki Academy Alumnus and a previous 2nd seat of the Elite Ten Council. She is the owner and head chef of the Western-style restaurant, Shunkatei.

21518.name: Leonora Nakiri
21518.desc: The mother of Nakiri Alice and one of the three judges that participates in the finals of the Fall selection tournament.

21518.name: Urara Kawashima
21518.desc: Urara is a 92nd Toutsuki Generation student and a popular idol at Toutsuki Culinary Academy. She is often an emcee for many of the academy's grand events.

21518.name: Yua Sasaki
21518.desc: A 92nd Tōtsuki Generation student. Like her fellow schoolmate, Urara Kawashima, she is also an MC for hosting important events occurring around and within Tōtsuki Culinary Academy.

21518.name: Kakinoshin Oizumi
21518.desc: Kakinoshin Ōizumi is the President of the Japanese Food Industry Council and a frequent culinary judge for Tōtsuki Culinary Academy.

21518.name: Yuuya Tomita
21518.desc: Yūya Tomita is the chairman of the Sumiredōri Shopping District and the 2nd generation owner of Tomitaya.

21518.name: Lucie Hugo
21518.desc: Lucie Hugo is the Chief Boucher of Shino's and temporarily holds the same position at Shino's Tokyo.

21518.name: Kazune Nishizono
21518.desc: Kazune Nishizono is an employee of Totsuki Culinary Academy Affairs Division and an observer for the students participating in the Stagiaire event.

21518.name: Kiyo
21518.desc: Kiyo is a resident in the Sumiredori Shopping District and also one of Restaurant Yukihira's regulars.

21518.name: Shimizu
21518.desc: Shimizu is a regular patron of Western Cuisine Mitamura.

21518.name: Tetsuji Kabutoyama
21518.desc: Tetsuji Kabutoyama is a 91st Generation student of Totsuki Culinary Academy and the president of the Skewer RS.

21518.name: Abel Blondin
21518.desc: Abel Blondin is the Head Chef of the French restaurant, Shino's Tokyo. He also served as Sous Chef to Kojirou Shinomiya in his main restaurant, Shino's, back in Paris, France.

21518.name: Gao Wei
21518.desc: Gao Wei is the Service Manager of Shino's and temporarily holds the same position at Shino's Tokyo.

21518.name: Seishuu Saotome
21518.desc: Seishuu Saotome is the Director of Japan Gourmet Society and a frequent culinary judge for Totsuki Culinary Academy.

21518.name: Hisanao Kageura
21518.desc: Hisanao Kageura is the president of the Shokugeki Administration Bureau.

4898.name: Sebastian Michaelis
4898.original: セバスチャン・ミカエリス
4898.desc: __Height:__ 185 cm (6'1") __Race:__ Demon Sebastian Michaelis is the series' antihero. He is the butler of the Phantomhive household and acts as [Ciel](https://anilist.co/character/12531/Phantomhive-Ciel)'s bodyguard, two jobs he is completely devoted to. He is highly skilled in any area and handles every task, no matter how impossible it is as well as any problem that arises from the errors of the other staff with ease, stating it is only natural as the butler to the Phantomhive family. This is due to the fact he is a demon bound by a Faustian contract to abide by Ciel's will.

4898.name: Ciel Phantomhive
4898.original: シエル・ファントムハイヴ
4898.desc: __Race__: Human __Height__: 152 cm (5") ~ 158 cm (5'2") __Afiliation__: Phantomhive Family, Faustian Contract, Funtom Company __Occupation__: Earl of Phantomhive, Watchdog of the Queen __Know Relatives__: ~!Vincent Phantomhive (father, deceased), Rachel Phantomhive (mother, deceased), "Ciel Phantomhive" (twin brother), Angelina Durless (aunt, deceased), Frances Midford (aunt), Edward Midford (cousin), Elizabeth Midford (cousin, fiancée), Clause (uncle)!~ The Phantomhive family has, for years, been well known for making toys and sweets for small children. However, they are also the Queen's watchdogs; the Phantomhive family keeps an eye on black market dealings in ways that Scotland Yard isn't able to. Ciel Phantomhive is the heir to this legacy. Earl Ciel Phantomhive is the business-savvy, twelve-year-old (later thirteen-year-old) head of the English Phantomhive noble family, taking over after the deaths of his parents, Lord Vincent and Lady Rachel Phantomhive. He also runs Funtom Company, which manufactures toys and sweets, and later adds a food branch after winning a Royal Warrant. His right eye, which is usually covered with a black eyepatch, bears a pentacle sign of the Faustian contract which binds the demon Sebastian Michaelis to his will. He also has a brand burnt into his back from when he was sold as a slave after his house was burnt down. Ciel is engaged to his cousin, Elizabeth Middleford. He sees her as an important friend and someone he needs to protect. His paren

4898.name: Grell Sutcliff
4898.desc: __Height:__ 175 cm (5'9") Grell is Madam Red's somewhat ineffectual butler. Mostly, she tends to hang around the edges of the scene, fretting over the socially unacceptable things that her mistress continually gets up to. When something is not up to Madam Red's exacting standards, she takes it out on Grell whether or not it's actually her fault. Her tea is said to be far inferior to Sebastian's. Meek, easily scandalized, and highly nervous, Grell's personality is entirely at odds with her mistress's. As a result, the other characters tend to either ignore or walk all over her. ~!This mild personality is entirely a facade. Grell's true identity is that of a death god; one with a true personality just as flamboyant as Madam Red's, perhaps even more so. The real Grell is a cheerful sadist who enjoys flirting and bloody murder, sometimes at the same time. She meets Madam Red during a night where she murders one of her patients and is attracted to her--both because her favorite color is red and because of her issues regarding childbirth. (Grell confesses to her that she, too, wishes that she could bear a child. But is unable to, being biologically male.) Grell refers to herself with feminine pronouns and has more than a passing interest in Sebastian; at one point she compares the two of them to Romeo and Juliet during their battle (leaving Sebastian horrified). Though having an interest in Sebastian, it was stated that Grell's 'true love' is William. Overall, she appears to have a

4898.name: Mey-Rin
4898.desc: __Height__: 165 cm (5'5") The glasses-wearing maid of the Phantomhive household. Mey-Rin is enthusiastic about her job but extremely bad at it (her main fault being clumsy.) She adds too much soap while washing clothes, trips and shatters the good china, and is generally a gigantic klutz. When asked to do an important task, she stutters and panics, which only adds to her natural clumsiness. She owns a pair of glasses that do nothing to improve her clumsiness. However, she refuses to purchase a new pair as they are the first thing [Ciel](https://anilist.co/character/12531/Phantomhive-Ciel) bought for her. It's implied that she has a crush on [Sebastian](https://anilist.co/character/10863/Michaelis-Sebastian) as she is even clumsier when Sebastian is watching.

4898.name: Finnian
4898.desc: __Height__: 163 cm (5'4") Finnian often called Finny, is Phantomhive household gardener. However, it seems every time he tends to the garden it is killed through an accident caused by his clumsiness and overenthusiastic pruning or not noticing that the pesticide container is leaking. In fact, if left to his own devices, he's stated that he'd like to make the garden into the shape of a giant robot. He is portrayed as an innocent, child-like character, but is dubbed an idiot by Sebastian. But his combination of tears, innocent looks, and willful ignorance of anything that doesn't fall into his cheerful worldview makes Finny probably the most successful of the servants at wheedling favors and money out of Sebastian. He is very carefree and is almost always seen with a happy smile on his face. ~!Finnian displays feats of superhuman strength, which he tries to suppress from fear of hurting others and risk of sabotaging his work. The sequence S-012 are tattooed to the back of his neck and are covered by his straw hat. He works as a gardener to spend as much time as possible outside because he was not able to do so before, and explains that he loves working for Ciel because he does not give him injections, kill his friends or lock him in a cage. He was experimented on as a scientific/medical test subject to increase physical strength before the events of the story until he was rescued by Ciel.!~ ~!He seems to have feelings for Angela because her kindness and beauty until he saw her

4898.name: Bardroy
4898.desc: Bardroy, usually referred to as Bard, is the household cook of American descent. Bard gruffly treats everything as though it's a military exercise, often referring to troops, enemies, and weaponry when he goes off into one of his many long-winded speeches about what it truly means to appreciate the culinary arts. He rarely produces anything edible as he uses weaponry such as a series of flamethrowers, each more extravagant than the last to cook and believes cooking is an art requiring explosions. Sebastian believes anything he creates is made up of charcoal and carcinogens. It's unknown if the food he produces is actually edible. ~!Bardroy Was a Former Soldier who was left at the Battlefield and is Hired By Sebastian. !~ (Source: Wikipedia)

4898.name: Tanaka
4898.desc: The steward of the Phantomhive household. No one actually knows what Tanaka does around the house, save for sit around and drink tea. His reaction to any situation, no matter how strange, is to merely smile, take a sip of his tea, and chuckle. In other words, he's a bit of an enigma. Most of the time he is in what is known as a chibi form. It is said he can only revert back to Normal Tanaka for a few minutes before reverting back to his small form. ~! It seems Tanaka served Ciel's parents as well. When Lord and Lady Phantomhive were murdered, the young Ciel ran to Tanaka, who warned him away. Tanaka was then stabbed by an unseen assailant...!~

4898.name: Angelina Durless
4898.original: アンジェリーナ･ダレス
4898.desc: __Height__: 168 cm (5'7") Angelina is the widow of the late Baron Barnett, the queen of high society (which has nicknamed her "Madam Red" due to the color of her hair and clothes), and Ciel's aunt. When she's not invading Ciel's home in London unannounced or flirting with her many admirers, she actually makes a living as a rare, female doctor. She appears to serve mostly female and child patients. Though childless herself, she's told Ciel in the past that she considers him her own son, and appears to have been keeping watch over him since he reappeared after the fire. She has her own butler, Grell, and is constantly reprimanding him to be more like Sebastian.

4898.name: Undertaker
4898.desc: Known only by his profession, the Undertaker is a mysterious man whose scarred face is never fully visible beneath his long hair and crooked top hat. He occasionally provides information to Ciel. While he finds Ciel amusing and enjoys helping him out, he has nothing but disdain for the Queen. He tends to punctuate his words with sweeping gestures and creepy giggles and seems to spend a good deal of time inside of coffins. He also likes to hear jokes and ask people to tell him for exchanging information. __In the anime:__ ~!He is revealed to be a Shinigami, one that William respects highly and is ranked in Management Level. Though he is legendary and retired, he still can access the Shinigami Library and alter the books.!~ __In the Manga:__ ~! In chapter 35, a manga panel showed that he is somehow linked to a person with a name, Claudia P. His scythe is akin to that of the stereotypical Grim Reaper scythe. In chapter 59 of manga, during the Ship arc, he is shown to use Japanese Grave markers (Sotoba) as weapons. In chapter 60 of the manga it has been confirmed by Grell that he was a Shinigami. He is now retired and bored, so he creates zombies out of curiosity. Also, this is the first time you can see his eyes. In chapter 82 of manga, it is revealed that he was, in fact, the principal.!~ (Source: Devil's Food Cake Site and Wikipedia.)

4898.name: Lau
4898.desc: Lau is originally introduced as the branch manager of a profitable Chinese trading company's English operations, and an acquaintance of both Ciel and Madam Red. But despite his odd friendship with Ciel, it seems that Lau is in a dubiously legal business himself: his real business is opium, and he runs an opium den that appears to be very well-off. Though he's aware that Ciel technically has some measure of power over such illegal businesses, his response to Ciel's threat to shut him down is merely to cheerfully comment that if that happens, he'll find another way to make a profit. Most of Lau's personal history remains unknown at this point, but he's very familiar with Ciel and far more powerful than he pretends: before anyone else notices, he somehow incapacitates the guards to a mansion that Ciel and the others are sneaking into. Lau is a cheerful enigma. It's a rare occurrence indeed that he wears an expression other than a highly amused smile, even when engaging in dangerous investigations. He enjoys making Ciel's life interesting-- though not, perhaps, in the way that Ciel would like-- by dropping in at odd hours for a cup of tea or to watch Ciel track down a murderer. He has a tendency to refer to people by their titles (Earl for Ciel and Butler for Sebastian). Nothing seems to phase him. He's also quite good at acting like he knows more than he does, and uses this to his own benefit in various situations.

4898.name: Elizabeth Midford
4898.original: エリザベス・ミッドフォード
4898.desc: __Height__: 157 cm (5'2") - 162 cm (5'3") (Season 2) Elizabeth (who demands to be called by the more affectionate "Lizzie") is Ciel's cousin and fiancée. She is the daughter of Ciel's aunt, Frances, and her husband, Marquis Midford. Lizzie is strong-willed and cheerful, with a fondness for cute things. She has known Ciel since childhood, and the two appear to have been very close. Despite this childhood connection, though, Ciel has not told her the circumstances of his parents' deaths and his own disappearance. Lizzie takes this in stride, not pestering him for information and continues to attempt to restore the close friendship. She ran away from home to see Ciel at least once, in spite of her mother's fearsome personality— she may just be the only person in the series not at all terrified of the Marchioness. Her hobby, much to Ciel's chagrin, is to make everything and everybody "cute"; this involves everything from decorating the mansion with hearts and sparkly bunnies to putting old men in dresses ("just like Marie Antoinette!"). ~!In the manga, Lizzie is shown to be an excellent swordswoman. Ciel was unaware of Lizzie's skills because she hid her talent out of fear it would make her seem less "cute". The reason she knows how to fight is because her father, Marquis Alexis Midford, is the head of the British knights. Her father, mother and brother also all know how to wield a sword, and she carries on the family tradition.!~

4898.name: Soma Asman Kadar
4898.original: ソーマ・アスマン・カダール
4898.desc: The 26th child of the King of Bengal, Soma came to England with his butler, Agni, in search of a missing servant from his household. When he was young, he received a palace, complete with attendants, from his parents. Among those servants was a woman named Meena, a cook, who he came to see as an older sister. However, one day, Meena disappeared from the palace, leaving Soma devastated. ~!After the disaster in London, both he and Agni are seen in London, passing out the curry bread Sebastian taught them to make to hungry survivors.!~ Circumstances surrounding Meena's disappearance causes Soma to take his search for her to England, where he accidentally runs into Ciel and Sebastian in the East End. Though originally he orders Agni to fight on the side of the Indian thugs (calling them his "brethren") against Sebastian, when he hears that Ciel did nothing to provoke the thugs, he switches sides for the sake of honor. After the fight, he follows Ciel back to the Phantomhive manor and proceeds to make himself at home. He claims that as an acquaintance of his, under the customs of his home country, Ciel is now required to entertain Soma as a guest.

4898.name: Agni
4898.desc: Soma's highly-dedicated butler, Agni comes with his master to England in search of Meena. Agni is a master at Indian cooking, and has even shown some skill in landscaping (turning the bushes in the Phantomhive Manor's garden into topiary elephants, for instance). But even more impressive than his cooking skills is his martial arts ability. When he and Soma meet Ciel and Sebastian, Soma orders the butlers to fight. In a move that surprises even Sebastian, Agni proceeds to give the demon a run for his money. In battle, he attacks his enemy's marmam, or pressure points, which can result in paralysis or death. In addition, his right hand has been blessed by the goddess Kali, giving him enhanced strength.

4898.name: Vincent Phantomhive
4898.original: ヴィンセント・ファントムハイヴ
4898.desc: He was the head of the Phantomhive family and handsome enough to attract the attention of both [Rachel](https://anilist.co/character/16737/Phantomhive-Rachel) and her sister [Angelina](https://anilist.co/character/14956/Durless-Angelina), though he favored the older, more refined sister. It's because of his compliments on her red hair that Angelina originally began wearing red. Though he appears in several flashbacks, his face is never shown. He and Rachel were killed on [Ciel](https://anilist.co/character/12531/Phantomhive-Ciel)'s tenth birthday. ~!Vincent was a handsome, well-dressed man with short, dark hair, a mole under his left eye and a kind smile. He bares a vague resemblance to Sebastian Michaelis. When alive, he was shown to be exceptionally kind and welcoming. This was demonstrated when he noticed that Angelina is self-conscious of her red hair and he made a point to compliment it. He also welcomed Baron Kelvin in to his home, and always took a minute to spare a greeting and a kind word, while others of his social status looked on with disdain. People were shown to have been easily drawn to him, as Angelina fell in love with him easily, and as a child, Ciel accompanied Vincent whenever he could, even when still recovering from being ill. He was a loving father and his family was always very important to him. However, he was just as capable as Ciel at manipulating individuals, and Baron Kelvin took note of him and his acquaintances as being "evil noblemen." It is sh

4898.name: Rachel Phantomhive
4898.original: レイチェル・ファントムハイヴ
4898.desc: Ciel's mother was patient and kind, with an elegant kind of poise occasionally shattered by her propensity to tease her younger sister into being more self-confident. She cared deeply for Angelina and took care of her after her accident. Everything points to her having been a good wife and loving mother, though as with her husband, not much is known about her, though her face is visible in flashbacks.

4898.name: William T. Spears
4898.original: ウィリアム・T・スピアーズ
4898.desc: William is a supervisor in the Dispatch Managment Division of the Death Gods. He appears in the 12th chapter of manga (or in the 6th episode of anime) to pick up Grell Sutcliff. William is emotionless and generally calm. In regards to his job, he is strict, follows the rules precisely, and seems extremely devoted. He does not take kindly to individuals who cause problems or create more work for him, particularly if it forces him to apologize for their actions. Nonetheless, he seems to share Ronald's distaste for overtime work. He has no qualms with inflicting minor injury on others, as shown when he jumps off a roof to land on Grell Sutcliff's head and when he uses his death scythe to attack Sebastian on a few occasions. He finds demons to be disgusting creatures, and is seen calling Sebastian Michaelis a variety of names, including "devilish fiend," "leech," and "hound." However, it is implied that he finds other demons to be even more abhorrent than Sebastian. In the anime, though, he is much more willing to work with Sebastian, as he aids him on a number of occasions. However, he does not seem to like anyone very much, as Ronald comments that William is disappointed to see him, and he insults a variety of individuals, including Grell, Sebastian, and Ciel Phantomhive.

4898.name: Ran Mao
4898.desc: __Height__: 168 cm One of Lau's girls from his opium den. He introduces her to Ciel and company as "his little sister, though not by blood." Ranmao almost never speaks and seems entirely unflappable. But she's not as harmless as she looks... ~! Ran Mao fights Sebastian who comments that "She has destructive power despite her tiny body". !~

4898.name: Angela Blanc
4898.desc: Angela is a maid to the Lord Henry Barymore of Houndsworth, though he treats her poorly in public. Finnian initially becomes infatuated with her beauty and seeming gentle kindness... ~!...until he learns of her true dominatrix personality. She has ties with the organization that killed Ciel's parents, even suggesting it might have been her who killed them, and later she is shown to be an angel. Like other members of the organization, she has an obsession of purifying souls filthy with negative emotions, referring to them as Unclean.!~ She appears only in the anime adaption.

4898.name: Aleister Chamber
4898.original: アレイスト・チェンバー
4898.desc: Viscount Druitt is a Noble that was one of the main suspects for the Jack the Ripper murders. He graduated from Medical School but does not practice medicine. He is later revealed to be kidnapping women and using their body parts for the Black Market and was arrested by Scotland Yard. He returns as a curry judge and a ice sculpture judge, with Ciel believing that he must have bribed his way out of jail. He has a habit of relating anything he sees as beautiful to that of women. Comically Ciel keeps getting creeped out when he refers to when he had to dress up as a girl for a disguise. (Source: Wikipedia)

4898.name: Drocell Cainz
4898.desc: Drocell is a puppetmaster who aids his boss in the kidnappings of young girls. He uses string as a weapon to strangle his targets. He even appears to be a puppet himself, as some of his reflexes are that of a doll's.

4898.name: Paula
4898.desc: __Height__: 165 cm (5'5") Paula is Lady Elizabeth's maid who accompanies her where ever she goes. It is shown within the anime that Elizabeth and Paula have a close relationship, as Paula gives her advice and cares for her. After the market on ice (Ep 10) in the anime, Paula became obsessed with jingling bells, that she does throughout the rest of the series. [Wikipedia]

4898.name: Edward V Plantagenet
4898.desc: Ghost of Edward V, one of the princes murdered in the Tower of London. (Ep 16)

4898.name: Ash Landers
4898.original: アッシュ・ランダーズ
4898.desc: Ash is the Queen's butler who delivers all of the Queen's request to the Phantomhive Head. His appearance is the exact opposite of Sebastian's, where Sebastian has a black suit and hair color, Ash has a white suit and hair color. It is hinted that he might be connected to the organization that killed Ciel's parents as in the new opening he is seen walking away from the burning mansion. He also has the same facial features as Angela. In the manga, he wears large goggles and is known as John. He plays a shorter, more comical role mostly spent trying to keep up with Queen Victoria and calming her hysterical fits of tears. (Source: Wikipedia)

4898.name: Richard
4898.desc: Ghost of Richard, Duke of York, the youngest of the two princes murdered in the Tower of London. (Ep. 16)

4898.name: Meena
4898.desc: Meena was a servant in Prince Soma's household that he looked up to, who was always there for him when his parents couldn't be. An Englishman (revealed to be Lord West) wanted her for his wife, and she left India with him.

4898.name: Victoria Joou
4898.desc: She is the queen of the England. Her voice first appeared in episode 22. She usually covers her face with a black sheet and is accompanied by Ashe (in anime).

4898.name: Pluto
4898.desc: Pluto, also known as the Demon Dog, is a large dog that terrorizes the town of Houndsworth until Sebastian tames him. Afterward, he lives at the Phantomhive Estate. He can breathe fire, walk through barriers and shape-shift into a human. As a human, he retains dog-like qualities. Although Sebastian hates dogs, Pluto has taken a liking to him and gets jealous when he receives less attention than a cat. He only listens to Sebastian's orders. Finnian is in charge of walking him, as he is the only one strong enough to do so. ~!It is hinted that he might have ties to the organization that killed Ciel's parents, as he rested by the feet of one of the members and licked his hand, along with being with Angela prior to living at the Phatomhive Estate, later proven true when Ash uses him to set fire to the mansion and burn London.!~ ~!Ciel then orders his staff to kill Pluto to stop his rampage, stating that Pluto is no longer the Pluto they once knew. In the last episode Sebastian reveals that they did indeed kill Pluto, and offers to collect the bones for Ciel. !~ Pluto appears only in the anime adaptation (Source: Wikipedia)

4898.name: Fred Aberline
4898.original: フレッド・アバーライン
4898.desc: A Scotland Yard Inspector. In the anime adaption, he is portrayed as one who truly believes in the justice system. He wishes to make London a place where it is safe to have a family and plans to propose to his pregnant girlfriend. Like Ciel, he had to go through hard times to reach his current situation. Despite this, Ciel describes him as someone who walks in the light, whereas Ciel walks in the darkness. ~!He is killed by Lau in an effort to protect Ciel.!~ (Source: Wikipedia)

4898.name: Damian
4898.desc: Damian was an owner of the Poseiden Company's Indian factory that makes and supplies stuffed animals for Ciel Phantomhive's Funtom Company. He is a scam artist and is a main antagonist during the kidnapping storyline in the anime.

4898.name: Azzurro Vanel
4898.desc: Azzurro Vanel belongs to the Ferro family, which operates under the trading organization called Ferro Company

4898.name: Arthur Randall
4898.original: アーサー・ランドール

4898.name: Maria
4898.desc: Maria is the fiancee of Inspector Fred Aberline. She first appears in episode 22.

145545.name: Kiyotaka Ayanokouji
145545.desc: __Height:__ 176 cm (5'9") Ayanokouji is an inconspicuous and unobtrusive student. He is shown to be extremely intelligent and possesses a profound insight to study the emotions of people around him. Almost everything about his life prior to the entrance exams is unknown. He is shown to be extremely calculating and possessing superhuman intellect, perception, and strength. He's skilled at fighting and is able to easily manipulate the people around him. He is quite fond of his friends and protects those that he can without standing out. He has little regard for others' feelings and will coldly let them suffer to succeed, occasionally even his friends.

145545.name: Suzune Horikita
145545.desc: __Height:__ 156 cm (5'1") A beautiful girl who sits next to [Ayanokouji](https://anilist.co/character/123212/Ayanokouji-Kiyotaka). She is the opposite of Ayanokouji when it comes to friendship; she disregards it and thinks of making friends unnecessary, thus she does not communicate much with her classmates. She is not convinced that she was placed in the D class, therefore she aims to get promoted to the A class.

145545.name: Kikyou Kushida
145545.desc: __Height:__ 155 cm She boasts tremendous popularity among men and women as the D class' idol. She aims to be friends with everyone not just in D class. She wants to get along well with her classmate, [Horikita](https://anilist.co/character/123213/Horikita-Suzune).

145545.name: Airi Sakura
145545.desc: __Height:__ 153 cm (5'0") A girl who is into photography. She hates standing out and likes to take modeling pictures.

145545.name: Honami Ichinose
145545.desc: __Height:__ 159 cm (5'2") If there was one sentence to describe Honami, it would be that she is genuinely kind-hearted, benevolent, and a pacifist to the core who is against using underhanded means and violence. One of her main traits is her unselfish and supportive personality, combined with her excellent social skills and her being naturally people-oriented. Honami is also a charismatic and energetic person, and extends her sweet and benign character even to those of the lower classes, unlike many other upper-class students.

145545.name: Sae Chabashira
145545.desc: __Height:__ 160 cm The homeroom teacher of the protagonist's class (D). She is originally indifferent to her class, doing almost nothing to help them in the battle between classes, and remains unmotivated for the most part.

145545.name: Yousuke Hirata
145545.desc: __Height:__ 174 cm (5'8") The social leader of the D class. He has excellent academic and athletic ability, and is considered extremely handsome by his classmates, he is shown to be extremely compassionate and puts others before himself, considering everybody equal. He is considered a perfect male student and his placement in the D-class is originally considered a mystery.

145545.name: Manabu Horikita
145545.desc: __Height:__ 178 cm (5'10") He is the leader of the school council and is [Horikita Suzune](https://anilist.co/character/123213/Horikita-Suzune)'s elder brother.

145545.name: Arisu Sakayanagi
145545.desc: __Height:__ 150 cm (4'11") Arisu Sakayanagi is one of the class representatives of class 1-A along with [Kohei Katsuragi](https://anilist.co/character/207026). She suffers from congenital heart disease which limits her physical ability. She appears to possess a "go with the flow" attitude as she accepts most situations with no protest though she voices her dislike of boring situations after Katsuragi noted of the class scores. Unlike Kohei Katsuragi, who has a conservative stance, Arisu possesses an innovative attitude. Together, the pair effectively lead class A through the school years. She enjoys situations she finds interesting as shown when she smiled at [Kakeru Ryuen](https://anilist.co/character/159627)'s declaration to rule the school or when she listened to the speech of [Suzune Horikita](https://anilist.co/character/123213) and found it amusing. In the light novels, Arisu enjoys toying with people as seen when she cryptically hinted to [Kiyotaka Ayanokoji](https://anilist.co/character/123212) of knowing him while he had voiced he never saw her before. Later on, while being together with [Honami Ichinose](https://anilist.co/character/123216), she also had the chance to show her confidence and complacency after [Teruhiko Yukimura](https://anilist.co/character/173450) of Ayanokoji Group boldly claimed that D-Class has the plan to overtake A-Class soon. Additionally, although she has an easygoing personality, it was shown in the later part of the series that she's easil

145545.name: Mei-Yu Wang
145545.desc: Mei-Yu is of Chinese descent and is shown to be one of the academically gifted students. She has a visible crush on Hirata Yosuke.

145545.name: Kei Karuizawa
145545.desc: __Height:__ 154 cm (5'0") She is a girl with a bad attitude who is located at the top of the D class hierarchy. She fights with [Kushida](https://anilist.co/character/123214/Kushida-Kikyou) for their class' top 2 places. Even though she gives off the impression of someone who is careless, arrogant, and messy, Kei's true self is very logical and astute with a sharp mind. She has remarkable ability to read the environment and the people around her, and makes the correct decision often.

145545.name: Rokusuke Kouenji
145545.desc: Rokusuke Kouenji is one of the students of class 1-D. He came from a well-known family of scholars. However, he ended up in D-Class for his egotistical behavior. ~!In Year 1, Volume 11, he watches a scuffle between [Hirata](https://anilist.co/character/123218/Hirata-Yousuke) and [Mii-Chan](https://anilist.co/character/136233/Wang-MeiYu), which ended with Hirata pushing a desperate Mii-Chan, who was trying to help him, on the ground. Kouenji then intervenes and states his annoyance at Hirata "for treating a girl wrong" referring him as "like a fly, very irritating". His friendship with Mii-Chan is then showed to progress in Year 2, Volume 5, when they are seen walking together often, and Mii-chan referring to him as "someone easy to talk to" when asked about their relationship by [Satou](https://anilist.co/character/163519/Satou-Maya) and [Matsushita](https://anilist.co/character/191401/Matsushita-Chiaki).!~ ~!During the Second Year Uninhabited Island Special Exam, he strikes an agreement with [Suzune Horikita](https://anilist.co/character/123213/Horikita-Suzune), in which he would try for a first-place finish and Suzune would reward him with complete protection from class vote expulsion until graduation and exempt him from being forced to co-operate with the rest of the class, which he wins.!~

145545.name: Kakeru Ryuuen
145545.desc: __Height:__ 173 cm (5'8") Kakeru Ryuuen is the class representative of class 1-C and is known for being an infamous delinquent. He does not lead his class by trust, but rather by fear. He has a group of henchmen who do his dirty work, which contributes to his fearsome reputation.

145545.name: Haruka Hasebe
145545.desc: Haruka is a pretty normal person, but she is not very open to other people as shown when she didn't participate in the class's swimming session where she tends to prefer keeping to herself and not bothering people, simply to avoid trouble. She is considered to have good looks and is often viewed lustfully by boys, thus wanting to seclude herself. She is mostly seen wearing the school's uniform, with the difference that she has the upper button of her shirt undone and her tie relatively loosened. She prefers giving people nicknames the moment she meets them, which is said by Kushida to be a method for her "to appear closer to the people she isn't close to". ~! In Year 2, Volume 5, Haruka is told off by Kushida when she tries to help the latter. She is then seen aggressively opposing the motion by Ayanokoji to expel Airi Sakura, being her closest friend, to no avail. She is one of the 4 remaining members and the sole remaining girl of the Ayanokoji Group.!~

145545.name: Hiyori Shiina
145545.desc: Hiyori Shiina is one of the students of Class 1-C who is a loner. She's a quiet girl, though sometimes she is seen occasionally smiling. She always carries books with her in her bag in case she meets someone who shares the same interest in literature as her. Since nobody in class 1-C is into literature, she doesn't have anyone to talk to. She always speaks politely. She dislikes how the classes are competing with each other, wanting everyone to be friends. ~! She encounters Kiyotaka in the library, and they find themselves having the same taste in books. As she always wanted a friend who has similar interests as her, their friendship gradually blossoms and she refers to him as her "reading buddy". She slowly starts developing romantic feelings for Kiyotaka.!~

145545.name: Maya Satou
145545.desc: She is a student of class 1-D. ~!In Volume 7.5, Maya asks for [Kei Karuizawa](https://anilist.co/character/141122/Karuizawa-Kei)'s help to plan her "date" with [Kiyotaka Ayanokouji](https://anilist.co/character/123212/Ayanokouji-Kiyotaka). Kei was surprised and suggested other boys to her, but she refused, and said that she only liked Kiyotaka. She told her plan to Kei and made some changes according to her suggestions. She then later asked Kei if they could make it a "double-date", by including her and [Yousuke Hirata](https://anilist.co/character/123218/Hirata-Yousuke) in the plan. Eventually, Kei agreed and decided to schedule the double date on December 25. She confessed to Kiyotaka after the double date during Christmas, but was rejected and ran away crying. They promised each other that they will hang out again in the future and wants to see each other again but Maya couldn’t hold her feelings and excused herself first as she didn’t want him to see her in a pathetic state. She was hinted to have cried an innumerable amount of times behind closed doors after being rejected as the next time we saw her, she was able to frankly tell her friends she was rejected without being choked up. Her friends summarised that this could only had happened if she had come to terms with the rejection showing an immense amount of willpower to move on. That said, she still harbours feelings for Kiyotaka and has admitted that she finds him way cooler and hotter than Hirata not holding against

145545.name: Teruhiko Yukimura
145545.desc: Teruhiko Yukimura is a student of class 1-D. Despite his excellent academic ability, he was placed there due to his poor athletic ability and lack of social skills. During the formation of the Ayanokoji Group, it is revealed that he does not like his first name Teruhiko, given to him by his mother who left their family. He prefers the name his father gave him: Keisei

145545.name: Mio Ibuki
145545.desc: Mio Ibuki is a student of class 1-C. Not only does she possess excellent academic qualities, but her physical ability is also not to be underestimated. She is skilled in combat, having the knowledge of several martial skills that can rival those of many martial artists.

145545.name: Chiaki Matsushita
145545.desc: Matsushita is one of the students of class 2-D. She has a quiet older sister type of personality. She is generally kind to all the boys and girls alike, but she does not actively go out to make friends. ~!Chiaki had believed from early on in the first year that Class D had no hopes of ever reaching Class A and thus resigned herself to a carefree school life, never putting in any real effort into her academics. She considers herself to be a major underachiever, believing that she could easily score in the top 10% of her class if she truly tried to, but believed it to be pointless as long as she was in Class D. Later on in the light novels, she starts seeing improvements in the class and becomes willing to start contributing to the class. She is also known to be skilled at mental arithmetic and can calculate quickly. She even held her own against Kouhei Katsuragi from Class A in the Mental Arithmetic event in the Event Selection Exam.!~ ~!Later, in her monologue, she states that she had started to pay close attention to Kiyotaka after the end of year special exam, but she was not romantically interested in him. According to her, she was probably among the top 10% of students in their year, but had not revealed her abilities since she did not want people to be jealous of her. She had thought that even if she tried her best, the chance of Class-D being able to rank up the classes was minimal. However, after closely observing Kiyotaka, she had arrived at the conclusion that Class-

145545.name: Akane Tachibana
145545.desc: Akane Tachibana is a former student of Advanced Nurturing High School who has graduated from Class 3-A and the former secretary of the Student Council.

145545.name: Satsuki Shinohara
145545.desc: Satsuki Shinohara is one of the students of class 2-D. She is considered to have below-average looks. She has an outspoken personality and can often be seen arguing with Ike.

145545.name: Masumi Kamuro
145545.desc: Masumi Kamuro is a student of Class 2-A and a member of the Art Club. She is one of the members of the inner circle of Sakayanagi faction but is shown to be only interested in doing so as Sakayanagi has some information about her criminal history.

145545.name: Chie Hoshinomiya
145545.desc: Chie Hoshinomiya is the homeroom teacher of class 1-B. She has a cheerful, flirty personality and is referred to as "never having grown from her high school days" by Ayanokoji. She shows glimpses of a more serious side of hers upon matters relating to reaching Class-A. She was a classmate of her colleague Sae Chabashira during their time in the Advanced Nurturing High School.

145545.name: Miyabi Nagumo
145545.desc: __Height:__ 178 cm (5'10") Miyabi Nagumo is a student of Class 3-A at Advanced Nurturing High School ~!Succeeds Manabu Horikita as the Student Council President.!~

145545.name: Ryuuji Kanzaki
145545.desc: __Height:__ 174 cm (5'8½") Apart of Class 1-B and Honami Ichinose's right hand man. Not much is known about Ryūji, but he appears to be a diligent student who behaves seriously and he is a very helpful person as shown when he aided Honami Ichinose in the case of Ken Sudō. He is a friendly person as he does not look down on D-Class and gets along with them.

145545.name: Haruki Yamauchi
145545.desc: Haruki is apart of Class 1-D. He is apart of the three idiots of Class D along with Ike and Sudou. He has a tendency to lie and his grades are the lowest in the class. Similar to his friends, Haruki has a perverted side who is attracted to Kikyō Kushida as he was willing to peep on the girls. He is also very attracted to Airi Sakura and Haruka Hasebe, mainly for their well-endowed bodies and quiet nature. ~!Haruki got expelled during the Class Vote Exam.!~

145545.name: Akito Miyake
145545.desc: In middle school, Akito became fond of archery and joined the club there and even participated in country-level competitions. However, he began to neglect other activities or duties, such as studies, in the process. At that time he started to create some ruckus by causing quarrels with other people. That, and the fact that he neglected his studies lead to his evaluation as a D-Class student. In high school, he once again became a member of the Archery Club. He is a good friend of Kiyotaka and is apart of the Ayanokouji friend group.

145545.name: Ken Sudou
145545.desc: __Height:__ 183 cm (6'0") Ken is apart of Class 1-D and is apart of the Basketball Club. Due to his poor academic ability, he is referred to as one of the 3 Idiots of D-Class. Regardless of this, his athletic ability is without a doubt one of the best among the school. He has a crush on Suzune after receiving help from her. Under the constant supervision of Suzune, he gradually matures and begins to improve academically rising out of the bottom ladder of class and earning her trust.

145545.name: Kouhei Katsuragi
145545.desc: **Height:** 180 cm (5'11") Kōhei is an intelligent student who worked very hard to reach Class 1-A that he became one of its representatives alongside Arisu Sakayanagi. He is a serious man who adheres to the rules of manners and good conduct. He has a feud with Sakayanagi for control of the class, leading him to oppose her with his faction. He is bald due to an illness. He has a twin sister and they were originally orphans. Volume 2 Year 2 ~!He's transferred to Ryuuen's Class !~

145545.name: Masayoshi Hashimoto
145545.desc: Masayoshi is a very self-serving individual with no real loyalty to anyone other than himself. He always sides with and places his bets on the winning team, in order to always stay on top. When the Class-A leadership conflict breaks out at the beginning of the first year, Masayoshi determines that Arisu Sakayanagi is the better candidate for the position of leader and quickly joins her faction and becomes part of her inner circle.

145545.name: Tomonari Mashima
145545.desc: Mashima is an English teacher and the homeroom teacher of class 1-A. Mashima is a man who takes his job seriously and puts his students first.

145545.name: Kanji Ike
145545.desc: Kanji Ike is one of the students of Class 1-D who is known as one of the 3 Idiots of D-Class. While his intelligence is poor, his communication skills are excellent.

145545.name: Albert Yamada
145545.desc: Albert Yamada is one of the students of Class 1-C.

145545.name: Yahiko Totsuka
145545.desc: Yahiko Totsuka is a student of Class 1-A and belongs to Katsuragi Faction.

145545.name: Kayano Onodera
145545.desc: Kayano Onodera is one of the students of Horikita’s class. She is a member of the Swimming Club and she is the best swimmer out of the girls in her class.

145545.name: Kokoro Inogashira
145545.desc: Kokoro Inogashira is one of the students of Horikita’s class.

145545.name: Hideo Sotomura
145545.desc: Hideo Sotomura is one of the students of Horikita’s class.

145545.name: Nene Mori
145545.desc: Nene Mori is one of the students of Horikita’s class.

145545.name: Minori Kinoshita
145545.desc: Minori Kinoshita is one of the students of Ryuuen’s class.

145545.name: Narumori Sakayanagi
145545.desc: Naruomi Sakayanagi took over the position of Chairman seven to eight years prior to the current story, succeeding his father. He seems to know Sensei Ayanokouji since before becoming the Chairman, and holds great respect towards him. He has also visited White Room together with his daughter, [Arisu Sakayanagi](https://anilist.co/character/124691/Arisu-Sakayanagi).

104157.name: Sakuta Azusagawa
104157.desc: __Height:__ 172 cm (5'7") A strange 2nd year student in high school, who doesn't have a cellphone in this day and age. He is currently an outcast at school due to rumors of a violent past... but doesn't seem to care. ~!Sakuta eventually starts dating [Mai Sakurajima](https://anilist.co/character/127222)!~ (Source: Aniplex USA)

104157.name: Mai Sakurajima
104157.desc: __Height:__ 162 cm (5'4") A 3rd-year student at Minegahara High School. She is serious and polite, but has a strong will. Well known, famous actress, who is currently on hiatus. Because her life had always revolved around her work in entertainment, she remains isolated at school. (Source: Aniplex USA)

104157.name: Kaede Azusagawa
104157.desc: __Height:__ 5'4" (162 cm) She is the younger sister of Sakuta Azusagawa. ~!Suffered amnesia and gained a different personality after her ordeal with Adolescence Syndrome stemming from online bullying. Since then, she has lived with Sakuta and has not attended school.!~

104157.name: Rio Futaba
104157.desc: __Height:__ 155 cm (5'1") __Talent:__ Explaining any strange phenomenon with science She is [Sakuta](https://anilist.co/character/127221/Azusagawa-Sakuta)'s classmate, who is always cool and calm, always willing to give various advice on puberty syndrome. She is also the sole member of the Science Club, and known as an eccentric person at the school. (Source: Aniplex USA)

104157.name: Tomoe Koga
104157.desc: __Height:__ 150 cm (4'11") A typical 1st year high-school student at Minegahara High School who can take hints, but is slightly scatterbrained. Being overly concerned about how people look at her, she hides her Hakata accent, which comes out when she panics or is relaxed. (Source: Aniplex USA, edited)

104157.name: Nodoka Toyohama
104157.desc: __Height:__ 158cm (5'2") __Talent:__ Changing clothes quickly Mai's half-sister, related through her father. A member of the idol group "Sweet Bullet" and designated as the most fashionable within the group. Despite her flashy looks, she attends an elite all girls' high school. She is confident and can be competitive. (Source: Aniplex USA)

104157.name: Shouko Makinohara
104157.desc: __Height:__ 150 cm (4'11") __Talent:__ Early to bed, early to rise A girl who has the same first and last name as [Sakuta](https://anilist.co/character/127221/Azusagawa-Sakuta)'s first crush. She is a shy middle school girl, but reliable and kind. She bumps into Sakuta, while holding an umbrella over an abandoned cat in the rain. ~!It is later revealed that the older Shouko that Sakuta encounters is from the future, and is able to return to the past due to her puberty syndrome.!~

104157.name: Saki Kamisato
104157.desc: [Yuuma](https://anilist.co/character/130307/Yuuma-Kunimi)'s girlfriend. Popular within the school and can be a standoffish person, but she shows great affection towards Yuuma. She is quite protective of him and often clashes with [Sakuta](https://anilist.co/character/127221/Sakuta-Azusagawa) as a result. ~!It is revealed that Saki has an older sister whom her parents often compare her to, causing her to develop low self-esteem. Sakuta believes this to be the reason why she is so protective of Yuuma's image and her own, as in her eyes she already has a fragile self-image.!~ ~!After graduating she attends the same college as Sakuta and goes into health studies, in the hopes of becoming a nurse in order to help Yuuma whenever she can due to his decision to partake in firefighter training.!~

104157.name: Yousuke Maesawa
104157.desc: A member of the school basketball team. He has an attractive and charming demeanor, but he is ultimately not above slandering other students. Maezawa has bad-mouthed all of his past girlfriends.

104157.name: Mai no Haha
104157.desc: She is the mother of Mai Sakurajima.

104157.name: Yuuma Kunimi
104157.desc: A good friend of [Sakuta Azusagawa](https://anilist.co/character/127221/Sakuta-Azusagawa) and [Rio Futaba](https://anilist.co/character/127633/Rio-Futaba), as well as the boyfriend of [Saki Kamisato](https://anilist.co/character/130304). He is a member of Minegahara High's basketball team, being quite athletic and popular within the school.

20458.name: Miyuki Shiba
20458.desc: __Height:__ 160 cm __Classification:__ A-rank Magician Miyuki is a first year student in Course 1 of First High School. She is the younger sister of [Tatsuya Shiba](https://anilist.co/character/55743/Shiba-Tatsuya). She is a bloom, which is considered the upper class. She was appointed as the freshmen representative, and is well known throughout the school. Described as very beautiful, she draws attention everywhere she goes. Yet, she is still modest and kind. She has a warm and loving nature, and defends her brother readily. She feels bad about being labelled as a "genius"; she feels that her brother is the real genius. Miyuki feels sad that their father only cares about her, and ignores Tatsuya completely.

20458.name: Tatsuya Shiba
20458.desc: __Height:__ 182 cm Shiba Tatsuya is a First Year Student in Course 2 of the First High School. He is the eldest son of Four Leaves Technology (FLT) company's president. His only sibling is [Shiba Miyuki](https://anilist.co/character/55741/Shiba-Miyuki). Since he was born in April and Miyuki born in March, they are studying in the same year according to Japanese school system. He is known as a Weed, which is the considered the lower class. He has a rather cold personality and he doesn't show his feelings, but he seems to love his sister and cares for her. He calms her down, when she's about to lose control over her magic and doesn't seem to mind that she is one of the most talented students at the school, while he's only a reserve. He is not easily intimidated by his opponents.

20458.name: Erika Chiba
20458.desc: A First year 2nd course student in E class with Tatsuya, Mikihiko, Leo and Mizuki A beauty in her own right she is someone who garners attention from those around her. She has an outgoing personality that allows her to befriend people easily but is someone who is not easily committed and goes off on a whim, (She doesnt get along with Leo though). A member of one of the 'Hundreds Families' the Chiba family, a family famous for training people in swordsmanship. She herself is proficient in the sword, enough for her to be recognised and allowed to carry the Chiba family name.

20458.name: Azusa Nakajou
20458.desc: A Second Year Student. The student council secretary of the First High School.

20458.name: Haruka Ono
20458.desc: Haruka is the general counselor at First High for 1st year A and E classes.

20458.name: Katsuto Juumonji
20458.desc: Katsuto is the Club Activities Group Leader of the First High School. He is the eldest child and heir of the Juumonji family, one of the 'Ten Number Clans'.

20458.name: Yakumo Kokonoe
20458.desc: Yakumo is an ancient magic "Ninjutsu" user. He is Tatsuya's martial arts master.

20458.name: Kanon Chiyoda
20458.desc: Kanon is a 2nd year course 1 student at First High.

20458.name: Sayuri Shiba
20458.desc: Sayuri is the stepmother of [Tatsuya](https://anilist.co/character/55743/Tatsuya-Shiba) and [Miyuki](https://anilist.co/character/55741/Miyuki-Shiba).

20458.name: Hanzou Hattori
20458.desc: Hanzou is a Second Year Student. The student council vice president of the First High School.

20458.name: Suzune Ichihara
20458.desc: Suzune is a third year student. She is the student council accountant of the First High School.

20458.name: Masaki Ichijou
20458.desc: Masaki is a first year attending Third High.

20458.name: Shinkurou Kichijouji
20458.desc: Shinkurou is a first year attending Third High.

20458.name: Takeaki Kirihara
20458.desc: Takeaki is a second year student in course 1 of the First High School. He is in the Kenjustu Club.

20458.name: Shizuku Kitayama
20458.desc: A first year 1st course student in A class with [Miyuki](https://anilist.co/character/55741/Shiba-Miyuki), Jun and [Honoka](https://anilist.co/character/88191/Mitsui-Honoka).

20458.name: Sayaka Mibu
20458.desc: Sayaka is a second year student in course 2 of the First High School. She is in the Kendo Club.

20458.name: Honoka Mitsui
20458.desc: A first year 1st course student in A class with [Miyuki](https://anilist.co/character/55741/Shiba-Miyuki), Jun, and [Shizuku](https://anilist.co/character/88188/Kitayama-Shizuku). Becomes the next student council secretary after [Azusa](https://anilist.co/character/72563/Nakajou-Azusa).

20458.name: Shun Morisaki
20458.desc: Morisaki Shun is a Course 1 student in First High School who exhibited elitism and used derogatory words against Tatsuya and the other Course 2 students on the first day of school.

20458.name: Mayumi Saegusa
20458.desc: __Height__: 155 cm Mayumi is the Student Council President of First High School. She is a member of the Saegusa family, one of the 'Ten Master Clans'. She is the very first person from First High School to converse with Shiba Tatsuya on his enrollment day.

20458.name: Leonhart Saijou
20458.desc: A First year 2nd course student in E class with [Tatsuya](https://anilist.co/character/55743/Shiba-Tatsuya), Mizuki and [Erika](https://anilist.co/character/72311/Chiba-Erika).

20458.name: Midori Sawaki
20458.desc: Midori is a member of the Moral Committee

20458.name: Mizuki Shibata
20458.desc: A first year 2nd course student in E class with Tatsuya, Leo and Erika.

20458.name: Kinoe Tsukasa
20458.desc: Kinoe is a third year student in course 2 of the First High School. He is the ace of the kendo club.

20458.name: Mari Watanabe
20458.desc: Mari is the Moral Committee Chairman of the First High School.

20458.name: Mikihiko Yoshida
20458.desc: A first year 2nd course student in E class with Tatsuya, Mizuki and Erika. He is childhood friends with Erika.

20458.name: Eimi Akechi
20458.desc: Freshman in First High School, in the same year as the Shiba siblings. She is one of the representatives of their school for the Newcomers' Division of the Nine Schools Competition in the events Ice Pillar Break and Speed Shooting. Her full name is Amelia Eimi Akechi Goldie and often referred to as Eimi. (Source: Mahouka Koukou no Rettousei Wiki)

20458.name: Tatsurou Shiba
20458.desc: Shiba Tatsurou is the father of [Miyuki](https://anilist.co/character/55741/Miyuki-Shiba) and [Tatsuya](https://anilist.co/character/55743/Tatsuya-Shiba). He is the Vice President of Four Leaves Technology, the largest shareholder of the company, and is also in charge of all FLT Research & Development divisions. Tatsurou is extremely cold and uncaring towards his son, Tatsuya.

20458.name: Kei Isori
20458.desc: Kei is a year 2 student of First High School during the main characters' freshman year. He was also one of the 8 engineers selected to be part of the technical support team, also known as the auxiliary team or technician team, for the Nine Schools Competition.

20458.name: Hagane Tomitsuka
20458.desc: Hagane is a student of First High School, a Year 2 Course 1 student who is in the Magic Engineering Course, and was one of the lead representatives among of his cohorts during the Nine Schools Competition. He is a member of the Tomitsuka Family, which is one of the Hundred Families

20458.name: Kyouko Fujibayashi
20458.desc: Fujibayashi Kyouko is a First Lieutenant from the 101 Independent Magic-Equipped Battalion, the daughter of the Fujibayashi Family, and the granddaughter of Kudou Retsu. She is known throughout the world of combat Magicians as the "Electron Sorceress."

20458.name: Maya Yotsuba
20458.desc: Yotsuba Maya is the twin-sister of Shiba Miya, and the aunt of Shiba Tatsuya and Shiba Miyuki. She is the current Head of the Yotsuba Family. She is one of the strongest Magicians of the modern era in the world, known as the "Queen of Night" and "Demon King of the Far East".

20458.name: Gongjin Zhou
20458.desc: Ancient magic user from the Great Asian Union. Looks very young despite being much older in reality. ~!He has no loyalty to the Great Asian Union and is actively sabotaging them for his own needs. His true loyalty lies with Gu Jie.!~

146065.name: Sylphiette
146065.desc: Sylphiette is [Rudeus](https://anilist.co/character/88348/Rudeus-Greyrat)' childhood friend who is part human, elf, and beast race. ~!Following the teleportation incident, during which her hair turned white from mana exhaustion, she became Princess Ariel's personal bodyguard under the alias Fitz.!~ ~!She is Rudeus' first wife and gives birth to their daughter [Lucy](https://anilist.co/character/188846/Greyrat-Lucy) and son [Sieghardt](https://anilist.co/character/273377/Greyrat-Saladin-Sieghardt). She is one of the three goddesses Rudeus worships in his religion. A cloth stained with her virgin blood that serves as a relic for the Goddess of Love is enshrined in the basement.!~

146065.name: Rudeus Greyrat
146065.original: ルーデウス・グレイラット
146065.desc: __Height:__ 175 cm (5'9") Rudeus is a tall, well-built, and cool-looking man. However, before his reincarnation, he was originally an overweight 34-year-old Japanese NEET who became a recluse following his high-school persecution. Because of his former life, he is careful not to get carried away and become arrogant. As a result, he is extremely self-aware and humble because he does not want to revert to his old self. He is a kind person, helping his friends and protecting his family whenever needed. Due to being capable in many fields, people have high expectations of him. His body possesses a high affinity for magic. Rudeus is very polite to others, often to the point of making them uncomfortable. Rudeus is one of the few people capable of using voiceless magic, and even rarer as someone who can use voiceless incantation with melded magics. He cannot use voiceless incantation for healing magic due to his lack of understanding in regards to how mana is manipulated to heal. A normal Magician takes at least five seconds for a simple spell, while for higher-level spells it's thirty to sixty seconds. Rudeus can do it almost instantly no matter what the difficulty of the spell, with the exception of healing magic.

146065.name: Eris Boreas Greyrat
146065.original: エリス・ボレアス・グレイラット
146065.desc: Eris Boreas Greyrat is a noble girl and distant relative of [Rudeus](https://anilist.co/character/88348/Rudeus-Greyrat). She is a tsundere with a short temper but has potential in the Sword-God style. ~!She is Rudeus' third wife and gives birth to their son [Ars](https://anilist.co/character/273378/Greyrat-Ars) and daughter [Christina](https://anilist.co/character/278862/Greyrat-Christina). She is one of the three goddesses Rudeus worships in his religion. A wooden sword that serves as a relic for the Goddess of War is enshrined in the basement.!~

146065.name: Shizuka Nanahoshi
146065.desc: __Light Novel Volume 9 spoiler__ ~! Nanahoshi Shizuka is a Japanese girl that was saved by [Rudeus](https://anilist.co/character/88348/Rudeus-Greyrat) in his past life, but instead of reincarnating like Rudeus, she was teleported to Asura Kingdom and was saved by [Orsted](https://anilist.co/character/187382/Orsted). !~

146065.name: Elinalise Dragonroad
146065.original: エリナリーゼ・ドラゴンロード
146065.desc: Elinalise is a former member of Paul's party. She has an erotic nature due to her curse. She is a warrior that is good at managing monster aggro but isn't a great fighter.

146065.name: Kishirika Kishirisu
146065.desc: Kishirika Kishirisu is The Great Empress of the Demon Realm. She is the demon empress known for her demon eyes' powers and the ability to bestow others with demon eyes. She is engaged to [Badigadi](https://anilist.co/character/262620/Badigadi), the demon lord of immortality. __Light Novel Volume 4 Spoiler__ ~!Kishirika Kishirisu is the person that is responsible for giving [Rudeus](https://anilist.co/character/88348/Rudeus-Greyrat) his demon eye, among other favors!~

146065.name: Linia Dedoldia
146065.original: リニア・デドルディア
146065.desc: Linia Dedoldia is the granddaughter of the Village Chief, Gustav, of the Doldia Tribe. ~!She later becomes the slave of Rudeus Greyrat for buying/saving her from the slave trader.!~

146065.name: Pursena Adoldia
146065.original: プルセナ・アドルディア
146065.desc: Together with Linia Dedoldia they are the two troublemakers in Ranoa Magic Academy, but when it comes to fulfilling her dreams of becoming the Village Chief she will do her best. She likes eating meat.

146065.name: Orsted
146065.desc: Orsted is the current Dragon God, 2nd-ranked of the 7 World Powers, and the sworn enemy of [Hitogami](https://anilist.co/character/211165/Hitogami). Similar to other Dragon Race people such as [Perugius](https://anilist.co/character/209572/Perugius-Dola), he has silver hair and golden sanpaku eyes with an overpowering look. He carries no visible equipment and wears a white coat adorned with fur. Orsted has a curse that makes every living being feel an overwhelming fear just from being within his presence. Strangely enough, this curse does not affect [Rudeus](https://anilist.co/character/88348/Rudeus-Greyrat) or [Nanahoshi](https://anilist.co/character/137816/Nanahoshi-Shizuka).

146065.name: Zanoba  Shirone
146065.desc: Zanoba Shirone is a doll loving prince of Shirone. When he was three years old, he killed his brother, the Fourth prince, as if his brother was a doll. When he was 15 years old, he killed his wife, as if she was a doll.

146065.name: Ariel Asura
146065.original: アリエル・アネモイ・アスラ
146065.desc: Second Princess of the Asura Kingdom. She is hardly ever seen without her two bodyguards, [Luke](https://anilist.co/character/226703) and "[Silent Fitz](https://anilist.co/character/88346)". After surviving many assassination attempts, she and her bodyguards flee to The Magic City of Sharia and enroll at the Ranoa Magic Academy.

146065.name: Ghislaine Dedoldia
146065.original: ギレーヌ・デドルディア
146065.desc: __Ghislaine Dedoldia__ is the daughter of Gustav the former Doldia village chief, and the mentor of [Eris](https://anilist.co/character/88349/Eris-Boreas-Greyrat) and she is also the student of [Rudeus Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/88348/Rudeus-Greyrat) in magic and other subjects. She is one of the few people who have become a Sword King.

146065.name: Sara
146065.desc: Sara was born in Asura in the Milbotts Region ruled by the Notos Greyrat Family. Her father was a hunter from whom she learned how to use the bow. Now a prodigy for her talent with the bow, she is an A-ranked adventurer and member of the party Counter Arrow. ~!When a horde of monsters attacked her hometown, the Notos family refused to send their soldier, because of that she lost her father, which lead to her hatred of the nobility in general. Suzanne who was helping in the subjugation of the monsters, picked up Sara. After some years, she became a official member of the party Counter Arrow.!~

146065.name: Hitogami
146065.desc: Hitogami is the Man God, having the power to see into the future, and the sworn enemy of [Orsted](https://anilist.co/character/187382). He has a blank white face coupled with a grin that eludes memory, which gives off the feeling that his face is covered in a mosaic. He helps [Rudeus](https://anilist.co/character/88348/Rudeus-Greyrat) throughout key points in his journey. ~!Hitogami later becomes the overarching antagonist of the series following the revelation that he actually sought to prevent the birth of Rudeus' children, who are prophesied to kill him one day.!~ ~!Hitogami's exact origins are unknown, however it is known that after the Creator God's death, unbeknownst to anyone, he was born within the Void World. At some point in the distant past, the being who would come to be known as Hitogami killed or otherwise usurped the original Man God and took his form. He then began manipulating the Dragon God and his five Dragon Generals into destroying the other four worlds and then proceeded to help the survivors of those ruined world to flee into the human world.!~

146065.name: Luke Notos Greyrat
146065.original: ルーク・ノトス・グレイラット
146065.desc: Luke Notos Greyrat is the second prince of the Asura kingdom Ariel Anemoi Asura's personal guardian and also holds the status of Knight. He's also the cousin of Rudeus Greyrat, but from another of the four different branch families in the Greyrat genus, namely the Notos family.

146065.name: Juliette
146065.desc: Juliette is an orphaned Dwarf and slave purchased by Rudeus and Zanoba with the purpose of helping them in the making of dolls. She was acquired because she fit the criteria of being a child, a Dwarf and by being a Dwarf having dexterous hands, which is preferable in doll-making. She's wary of Rudeus to an extent because of him befitting the behaviour of a folklore individual characterised by typical traits parents tell their children to deter them.

146065.name: Soldat Heckler
146065.original: ゾルダート・ヘッケラー
146065.desc: Soldat Heckler is an S-ranked adventurer and the leader of the S-ranked party Stepped Leader. He is a skilled swordsman with advanced-ranked Sword God Style and intermediate-ranked Water God Style.

146065.name: Cliff Grimoire
146065.desc: Cliff Grimoire is the Grandson of the Pope, and a friend of Rudeus. Cliff has a very high amount of pride, so much so that he will proudly tell people when they ask him for help. Though this trait may irk many people it cannot be said that he is arrogant since he is shown to be constantly studying to improve himself showing that he is very diligent as well. He is also very loyal to his friends, since it is shown that if he is asked for help, then that becomes his main priority

146065.name: Suzanne
146065.desc: Suzanne is the vice leader of the party Counter Arrow.

146065.name: Timothy
146065.desc: Timothy is the leader of the adventurer party Counter Arrow.

146065.name: Mimir
146065.desc: Mimir is a member of the party Counter Arrow.

146065.name: Patrice
146065.desc: Patrice is a member of the party Counter Arrow.

146065.name: Badigadi
146065.desc: Engaged to the Great Demon Emperor Kishirika Kishirisu, it is said that he is the demon lord who grants wisdom to those who deserve it. He is the current Fighting God and has been alive even before the war with Laplace. He has an immortal body, being able to regenerate injuries and body parts instantly. ~!He disappears later in the series with his whereabouts unknown, to reappear once again as Hitogami's apostle.!~

146065.name: Nina Farion
146065.desc: The eldest daughter of the current Sword God Gal Farion.

146065.name: Grabell Zafin Asura
146065.original: グラーヴェル・ザフィン・アスラ
146065.desc: First Prince of Asura Kingdom and half-brother of Ariel Anemoi Asura.

146065.name: Darius Silva Ganius
146065.desc: Prime Minister of the Asura Kingdom.

146065.name: Derek Redbat
146065.original: デリック・レッドバット
146065.desc: An advanced ranked magician and the previous guardian knight of Ariel before Fitz.

146065.name: Pilemon Notos Greyrat
146065.original: ピレモン・ノトス・グレイラット
146065.desc: Head of the Notos family. Brother of Paul Greyrat and father of Luke.

146065.name: Konrad
146065.desc: Member of the S-ranked adventurer party Stepped Leader.

146065.name: Stepped Leader Kenshi B
146065.original: ステップトリーダー剣士B

146065.name: Stepped Leader Kenshi A
146065.original: ステップトリーダー剣士A

146065.name: Jenius Halfas
146065.original: ジーナス・ハルファス
146065.desc: Vice Principal of the Ranoa Magic Academy, also known as the Ranoa University of Magic. He was formerly a teacher at the University, and taught Roxy during her time as a student. After hearing of Rudeus's achievements as an adventurer, Jenius sends him a letter inviting him to study as a special student in Ranoa.

21049.name: Arata Kaizaki
21049.desc: A 27-year old man who seems to fail at every job interview he partakes in. He accepts an offer to be part of the ReLIFE experiment in order to receive a recommendation to a company. ~!In Chapter 221, he learns that [Chizuru](https://anilist.co/character/89426/Hishiro-Chizuru) was a subject of ReLIFE and was shocked to discover she is older than him. After she briefly becomes sad at his possible disappointment, he assures her that he is happy with the revelation and hugs her which surprises but delights her. He then confesses his feelings for her that he is truly in love with her and wishes to be with her forever, and asks her to go out on a date with him. She is very touched by this declaration and states if he is okay with her she'll go out with him on a date, as they smile at each other and share their first kiss.!~

21049.name: Chizuru Hishiro
21049.desc: A prodigy who has the best grades among the girls in her class. She's extremely bad at communication. She has a habit of immediately looking up anything she doesn't understand on the internet. ~!Hishiro was in fact Test Subject No. 001 of the Kantou Branch of ReLIFE Laboratory. Her inter-personal issues had made her not able to keep any job for long, and the list of short-term employments on her resume eventually made her unemployable. Her first year of ReLIFE experiment was a failure, but she was given a second chance, and she made the effort to make friends the second year. With the help of [Kaizaki](https://anilist.co/character/89425/Kaizaki-Arata) and her friends, she was able to overcome her past issues and restore her feelings that were damaged in the past. After her ReLIFE experiment ended, she joined the ReLIFE Laboratory in the Research and Development Division.!~

21049.name: Ryou Yoake
21049.desc: A member of the ReLife research team, and the person in charge of Arata's experiment. He's always cheerful, but has a cunning personality. He takes the form of a high schooler and supports Arata as a classmate.

21049.name: An Onoya
21049.desc: __Height:__ 153 cm (5'0") A third year in [Arata Kaizaki](https://anilist.co/character/89425/Kaizaki-Arata)'s class. She may be positive about everything she thinks about, but then she may not be thinking about anything. ~!However, she is in fact an employee of the ReLIFE Support Division and [Ryo Yoake](https://anilist.co/character/89427/Yoake-Ryou)'s junior supervisor in the ReLIFE experiment. She was actually going to be the support of Kaizaki, though this was changed. Her real age is 26-27!~

21049.name: Rena Kariu
21049.desc: A stoic tsundere who has good grades, sports prowess, and a competitive personality. However, she's never satisfied and is always aiming higher.

21049.name: Kazuomi Ooga
21049.desc: __Height:__ 171 cm (5'7") Kazuomi Ooga looks like a flashy student, but he has the best grades among the boys in his class. He has a pure side and is not interested in romance. He is not athletic. ~!Kazuomi greatly respects his older brother, who had previously shouldered the responsibilities of providing for the family. Even after Takaomi became a NEET, Kazuomi simply felt it is now his old turn to be responsible and let his brother time to rest. The piercing Kazuomi got from his brother was one of his greatest treasures, as a remembrance for when Takaomi was cheerfully working hard.!~

21049.name: Honoka Tamarai
21049.desc: Honoka Tamarai is the captain of the volleyball team. She has a spacey personality and is easy-going, but is extremely skilled at sports and has monster strength. She's the childhood friend of [Inukai](https://anilist.co/character/89839/Inukai-Akira) and [Asaji](https://anilist.co/character/89840/Asaji-Nobunaga), and they call her "Tama (-chan)."

21049.name: Akira Inukai
21049.desc: A young man with an unfriendly, blunt, but also honest personality. He's the kind of person to act before speaking. [Tamarai](https://anilist.co/character/89838/Tamarai-Honoka) and [Asaji](https://anilist.co/character/89840/Asaji-Nobunaga) call him "Aki (-chan)."

21049.name: Nobunaga Asaji
21049.desc: A kind and friendly young man. He is very skilled in athletics. [Tamarai](https://anilist.co/character/89838) and [Inukai](https://anilist.co/character/89839) call him "Nobu (-chan)."

21049.name: Kokoro Amatsu
21049.desc: The teacher of Year 3 Class 3. She specializes in physical education. She is also in charge of the girls' volleyball club.

21049.name: Rumi Naomi
21049.desc: An employee who joined Arata's company after he was fired.

21049.name: Kento Amagase
21049.desc: An employee of the ReLIFE institute in the field of research, within the laboratory of the company. He takes care of providing the pills to transform subjects from adults to adolescents and vice versa.

21049.name: Zen Kamioka
21049.desc: A new employee of the former company of Arata Kaizaki. ~!After meeting Arata at the cemetery, he tells him that his actions inspired some people at the company.!~

21049.name: Saiki Michiru
21049.desc: Michiru was Arata Kaizaki's superior from his former company. ~!She commits suicide after getting severely rebuked by her coworkers.!~

21049.name: Koushi Usa
21049.desc: He is a teacher at Aoba High School. He's in charge of 3rd year, class 4. He's also the supervisor of the boys volleyball club.

107660.name: Legoshi
107660.desc: __Height:__ 185 cm (debut), 187 cm (currently) Our main character is the quiet and sensitive gray wolf Legoshi. Because of his fearsome appearance and odd habits he is widely mistaken to be a scary, bloodthirsty carnivore. Legoshi is wholly aware of this and does everything in his power to minimize himself and downplay his intimidating aspects. The series is largely about him coming to terms with his place in the world as a wolf. Legoshi develops some complicated feelings for the rabbit [Haru](https://anilist.co/character/125169). ~!He is a 1/4 komodo dragon, because of his grandfather [Gosha](https://anilist.co/character/132981).!~

107660.name: Haru
107660.desc: __Species:__ Netherland dwarf rabbit Haru is the lone member of Cherryton School's gardening club. She is earnest and forthright which, in addition to her sexual promiscuity, has earned her a sleazy reputation. Haru is broadly confident, but a defeatist side sometimes peeks through her facade. In spite of her caring nature she tends to keep people at an emotional distance.

107660.name: Louis
107660.desc: __Species:__ Red deer The proud face of Cherryton's drama club. He has an enormous ego, but with acting skills like his this isn't surprising. He carries a number of personality complexes owing to his status as a deer, a species traditionally seen as carnivore fodder. While he has shown moments of genuine kindness he is also very emotionally manipulative. Louis' greatest ambition is to achieve the rank of Beastar. (Source: TV Tropes)

107660.name: Bill
107660.desc: Bengal Tiger who is a student and member of the Drama Club at Cherryton Academy.

107660.name: Juno
107660.desc: __Species:__ Gray wolf Juno is one of the five main characters of Beastars and is a member of the drama club on the actor team. A feminine, affable wolf, she wishes to become the next Beastar, competing against Louis.

107660.name: Gouhin
107660.desc: A back alley psychiatrist who tries to rehabilitate carnivorous animals that crave meat. The wounds on his face were made by violent patients. Despite his gruff appearance and rough character, he's gentle and caring.

107660.name: Jack
107660.desc: __Species:__ Labrador Retriever Both one of [Legoshi](https://anilist.co/character/125168/Legoshi)'s roommates and his best friend for many years, Jack is a rather average guy. He is often weirded out by Legoshi's behavior, especially involving [Haru](https://anilist.co/character/125169/Haru), but he is always there for his best friend.

107660.name: Riz
